(He said to her from beneath her, before he had grown: Shake the trunk toward you, it will yield you the ripe fruit.)
and he ought to have said: yajniki. And one of them recited to me with the wāw:
هجوتَ زَبّان ثم جئت معتذِرا * من سبّ زَبَّان لم تهجو ولم تدع
(You lampooned Zabbān, then came apologizing for insulting Zabbān — you did not [truly] lampoon, nor did you leave off.)
The third way is that the yāʾ is an extension (ṣila) of the fatḥa of the shīn, as Imruʾ al-Qays said:
* ألا أيُّها الليلُ الطويل ألا انجلى *
(O long night, will you not clear away?)
This yāʾ is not the final radical of the verb; it is an extension of the kasra of the lām, just as rhymes are extended by the vowel of their rhyme-letter, like the saying of al-Aʿshā:
* بانت سُعَادُ وأمسى حبلُها انقطاعا *
(Suʿād has gone away, and her bond has come to be severed.)
and the other's saying:
* أمِن أُمِّ أوفى دِمْنةٌ لم تكلمى *
(Is it of Umm Awfā — a campsite trace that does not speak?)
The second [verb] may be jussive, when it has (lā), on the intention of a prohibition while carrying some meaning of the condition, just as in His saying ﴿وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَايَاكُمْ﴾ there is a trace of the condition while it is a command. Of that is the saying of Allah, Blessed and Exalted: ﴿يأيُّها النَّمل ادْخُلُوا مَساكِنَكُم لا يَحْطِمَنَّكُم سُلَيْمانُ وجُنُوده﴾ — the meaning, and Allah knows best: if you do not enter, you will be crushed [Translator's note: the source reads «إن؟ تدخلن حُطّمتُنَّ» with a question mark; «إن لم تدخلن» seems intended];  and it is a pure prohibition, because had it been an apodosis neither the heavy nor the light nūn would enter it; do you not see that you do not say: "If you hit me I will surely hit you (aḍribannaka)," except in poetic necessity, as in his saying:
فمهما تشأ منه فَزَارةُ تُعْطِكُم * ومهما تَشَأ منه فَزَارةُ تمنعَا
(Whatever of it Fazāra wishes, it will give you; and whatever of it Fazāra wishes, it will surely withhold.)
His saying: ﴿وَمَا لَنَآ أَلاَّ نُقَاتِلَ﴾ — (أَن) came in one place and was dropped in another. He said in another place: ﴿وَمَا لَكُمْ لا تُؤْمِنونَ بالله والرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكم﴾, and He said in another place: ﴿وما لنا ألاَّ نتوكّل على الله﴾. Whoever drops (an), the word is in the manner of Arabic in which there is no problem, and the verb is in the position of the accusative [Translator's note: as a ḥāl], like the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿فما لِلَّذينَ كفروا قِبَلَكَ مُهْطعين﴾ and like His saying: ﴿فما لَكُمْ فى المنافِقِين فِئَتَيْنِ﴾. This is the proper way of speech in your saying: mā laka? mā bāluka? and mā shaʾnuka?: that you put what follows it in the accusative when it is a noun, and in the nominative when it is a verb beginning with yāʾ, tāʾ, nūn or alif, like the poet's saying:
* مالك تَرْغِين ولا تَرْغُو الخَلِفْ *
(What is wrong with you that you groan, while the pregnant she-camel does not groan?)
Al-khalifa: the one with her young in her belly.
As for when He said (أن), it is of what goes toward the meaning that admits the entry of (an); do you not see that your saying to a man: "What is wrong with you that you do not pray in congregation?" means "What prevents you from praying?" So (an) was put into (mā laka) since its meaning agreed with the meaning of preventing. The proof of that is the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿مَا مَنَعَكَ أن لا تسجد إذ أمرتك﴾ and in another place: ﴿مالك ألاّ تكون مع الساجدين﴾; the story of Iblīs is one, and He said it in two wordings whose meaning is one even though they differ.
Similar to it — what is carried on a meaning different from its counterpart in wording — is the poet's saying:
يقول إذا اقْلَوْلى عليها وأقْرَدَتْ * ألا هل أخو عيشٍ لذيذ بدائم
(He says, when he mounts high upon her and she grows still: Is the man of a pleasant life ever lasting?)
He put the bāʾ in (hal), which is interrogative, whereas the bāʾ enters only the mā of negation, as when you say: "You are not one to say (mā anta bi-qāʾil)." Since the intention in (hal) was negation, the bāʾ was put in for it. Similar to it is His saying in the reading of ʿAbd Allāh: "كَيْفَ يكونُ لِلمشْرِكين عَهْدٌ": [meaning] the idolaters have no [covenant]. Likewise the poet's saying:
فاذهب فأىُّ فتىً فى الناس أحرزه * من يومه ظُلَمٌ دُعْج ولا جَبَل
(Go, then: what young man among people have pitch-dark shadows protected from his fated day — nor a mountain?)
(he answered it with lā) as though the meaning of "what young man among people have they protected" is: pitch-dark shadows do not protect the young man from his fated day, nor does a mountain. Al-Kisāʾī said: I heard the Arabs say: "Where were you to escape me (ayna kunta li-tanjuwa minnī)!" because the meaning is: you were not going to escape me; so he put the lām in (ayna) because its meaning is negation: you were not going to escape me. And the poet said:
فهذى سيوف يا صُدَىُّ بن مالك * كثير ولكن أين بالسيف ضارب
(Here are swords, O Ṣudayy ibn Mālik, many — but where is one who strikes with the sword?)
He meant: there is no one striking with the sword; had he not meant (laysa), the expression would not be permissible, because the bāʾ belongs to the ṣila of (ḍārib), and the complement of a noun is not put before it; do you not see that you do not say: "I struck with the slave girl a guarantor," until you say: "I struck a guarantor with the slave girl"? [Translator's note: the example is as written; the point is the word order of the prepositional complement.] And it is permissible to say: "There is no guarantor for the slave girl (laysa bi-l-jāriya kafīl)," because (laysa) is the counterpart of (mā), since it is not proper for it to put the noun in the nominative just as (mā) does not put it in the nominative.
Al-Kisāʾī said of their putting (an) in (mā laka): it is like His saying: "What is wrong with you in not fighting (mā lakum fī allā tuqātilū)." Had it been as he said, it would be permissible in speech to say: "What is wrong with you that you stood (an qumta)," and "What is wrong with you that you are standing (annaka qāʾim)," because you say "in your standing" both past and future; that is not permissible, because preventing comes only with the future: you say: "I prevented you from standing (an taqūma)," and you do not say: "I prevented you that you stood (an qumta)."
Therefore it comes in (mā laka) with the future and does not come with the continuous or the past. That is a witness to the agreement of the meaning of mā laka and mā manaʿaka. Some grammarians have said: it is among the cases where the wāw is implied, deleted from what is like your saying in speech: "What have you to do with going to so-and-so (mā laka wa-li-an tadhhaba)?" — so the wāw was dropped from it because (an) is a word not firmly established among nouns.
It was said [to him]: "Do you permit me to say: mā laka an taqūma, and not permit: mā laka al-qiyāma?" [He said]: "Because al-qiyām is a sound noun and (an) is a noun that is not sound." He argued from the saying of the Arabs: "Beware of speaking (iyyāka an tatakallama)," and claimed that the meaning is: iyyāka wa-an tatakallama. This was refuted against him by the fact that the Arabs say: "Beware of uttering falsehood (iyyāka bi-l-bāṭili an tanṭiqa)"; had the wāw been implied with (an), the verbs after the wāw could not act on what precedes it; do you not see that it is not permissible to say: "I hit you with the slave girl, and you are a guarantor," meaning: and you are a guarantor for the slave girl? And you say: "I saw you, and it is us you want (wa-iyyānā turīdu)," and it is not permissible: "I saw you us, and you want." The poet said:
فبُحْ بالسرائر فى أهلها * وإيّاك فى غيرهم أن تبوحا
(Disclose secrets among those fit for them, and beware of disclosing them among others.)
So the verb after (an) was allowed to act on his saying (فى غيرهم), and that shows that implying the wāw with (an) is not permissible.
As for the poet's saying:
* فإياك المَحَايِن أن تحينا *
(Beware of the places of perdition, lest you perish.)
he warned him, saying "iyyāka," then intended a pause, then began (al-maḥāyin) with another command, as if he said: beware of the places of perdition. Had he meant something like "iyyāka wa-l-bāṭila," dropping the wāw would not be permissible, because it is a noun made to follow a noun in its accusative, so it would be like his saying outside [the case of] the command: "You and your opinion," and "every garment and its price"; just as "You your opinion" or "every garment its price" is not permissible, so "iyyāka al-bāṭila" is not permissible when you mean: iyyāka wa-l-bāṭila.

Then He said ﴿وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ آمَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلآخِرِ﴾,
making the wording singular, then He said ﴿وَمَا هُم بِمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾, making the wording plural. That is because ﴿مَنْ﴾ is singular in wording, yet it can be plural in meaning, and it can be dual. If you express its verb according to its meaning, that is correct; and if you make its verb singular according to its wording, that is correct. [And] among what has come of that is His words ﴿بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُ للَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَلَهُ أَجْرُهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ وَلاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ﴾; and He said ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَّن يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ﴾, and He said ﴿وَمِنهُمْ مَّن يَنظُرُ إِلَيْكَ﴾, and He said ﴿وَمَن يَقْنُتْ مِنكُنَّ للَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتَعْمَلْ صَالِحاً نُؤْتِهَـآ أَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ﴾: He said ﴿يَقْنُتْ﴾ according to the wording, because the wording of ﴿مَن﴾ is masculine, and made ﴿تَعْمَلْ﴾ and ﴿نُؤْتِهَآ﴾ according to the meaning. Some read ﴿ويَعْمَلْ﴾, according to the wording, because the wording of ﴿مَنْ﴾ is masculine. And some read ﴿وَمَنْ تَقْنُتْ﴾, according to the meaning, because it refers to a woman. This is a proof against whoever said: "The wording with مَن is not made according to the meaning unless ﴿مَنْ﴾ has the sense of ﴿الذي﴾ (who, relative); as for [in] conditional sentences and questions, the wording with ﴿مَنْ﴾ is not according to the meaning."
Their saying* this is an error, because this place in which ﴿وَمَنْ تَقْنُتْ﴾ occurs is conditional. [Translator's note: the asterisk appears thus in the source.] The Arabs have said "ما جاءَتْ حاجَتُكَ" (what has your need become?), making "جاءتْ" feminine because it belongs to "ما"; they made it feminine only because the meaning of "ما" is the need. And the Arabs, or some of them, said "من كانت أمّكَ" (who was your mother?), with the accusative. The poet said [in the ṭawīl metre; this is the nineteenth evidentiary verse]:
تَعَشّ فإِنْ عاهدَتنِي لا تخونُني * نَكُنْ مثلَ مَنْ يا ذئبُ يَصطَحِبانِ
(Have your supper; if you pledge to me not to betray me, we shall be, O wolf, like two who keep company together.)
It is also related as ﴿تَعالَ فإن﴾ (come, and if…). [Translator's note: here the dual verb is used with مَن.] And ﴿مَنْ﴾ has been treated like "رجل" (a man, indefinite). The poet said [in the ramal metre; this is the twentieth evidentiary verse]:
رُبَّ مَنْ انضجتُ غيظاً صَدْرَهُ * قد تَمَنَّى لِيَ شَرّاً لم يُطَعْ
(Many a one whose breast I made boil with rage has wished me harm, but was not obeyed.)
Were it not indefinite, like "رجل", "ربّ" would not fall on it.
Likewise (ما) is indefinite, except that it is like "شيء" (a thing). It is said that His words ﴿هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ﴾ are of this kind: He made (ما) like "شيء" and did not make it like "الذي", so He said [in effect]: "ذا شَيْءٌ لَدَيَّ عَتيد" (this is a thing with me, ready). The poet said [in the khafīf metre; this is the twenty-first evidentiary verse]:
رُبَّ ما تَكْرَهُ النفوسُ من الأمْرِ * له فَرْجَةٌ كَحَل العِقالِ
(Many a thing in affairs that souls dislike has a release like the untying of a hobble.)
Were it not indefinite, like "مَنْ", "رُبَّ" would not fall on it. ﴿هذا مالَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ﴾ may also be on another view: He gave a single predicate about both, as you say "هذا أحمرُ أخضرُ" (this is red-green). That is because some Arabs say "هذا عبدُ اللَّهِ مقبلٌ" (this is ʿAbd Allāh, coming). In the reading of Ibn Masʿūd: ﴿وهذا بَعلي شَيْخٌ﴾, as though he gave a single predicate about both; or it may be as though he made it nominative as an explanation: as though, when He said ﴿هذا ما لَدَيَّ﴾, it was said "What is it?", or He knew that this was wanted from Him, so He said ﴿عَتِيد﴾, i.e. what I have is ready. Likewise ﴿وهذا بَعْلِي شيخٌ﴾*. [Translator's note: the asterisk appears thus in the source.] The rajaz poet said [this is the twenty-second evidentiary verse]:
مَنْ يَكُ ذابَتٍّ فهذا بَتّى * مُقَيِّظٌ مُصَيِّف مُشَتِّى
(Whoever has a cloak — this is my cloak: for high summer, for summer, for winter.)
And He said ﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ نِعِمَّا يَعِظُكُمْ بِهِ﴾: "ما" here is a noun that has no ṣila (relative clause), because if you made ﴿يَعِظُكُمْ بِهِ﴾ a ṣila of (ما), it would become like your saying "إنّ اللهَ نِعْمَ الشيء" (Allah, excellent is the thing) or "نعم شيئا" (excellent as a thing), and this is not [proper] speech. Rather you make (ما) a noun on its own, as you say "غَسَلتُه غَسْلاً نِعِمّا" (I washed it with an excellent washing), meaning by it "نِعْمَ غَسْلاً" (excellent as a washing). If it is said: "How can (ما) be a noun on its own when it is not spoken on its own?", I say: it is like "يا أيُّها الرجل" (O man), because "أي" here is a noun, and it is not spoken on its own until it is qualified; so (ما) has become like the qualified [noun] here. For when you say "غَسَلتُه غَسْلاً نِعِمّا", you only mean intensity and excellence, so this sufficed, so that it was spoken on its own. Similarly "ما أَحْسَنَ زيدا" (how handsome Zayd is!): (ما) here on its own is a noun. And his saying "اني مما ان اصنع كذا وكذا" (it is of my way to do such-and-such): (ما) here on its own is a noun, as though he said "إنّي مِن الأمر" or "منْ أَمْري صنيعي كذا وكذا" (it is of my affair that I do such-and-such). Among what has come according to the meaning is His words {كَمَثلِ الذي استوقدَ ناراً أَضاءَتْ ما حولَهُ ذهبَ الله بنورِهِم}, because "الذي" may be for the plural, as He said ﴿وَٱلَّذِي جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ أُوْلَـٰئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ﴾. [Translator's note: the verse is quoted in the source with "فلما" omitted between "ناراً" and "أضاءت".]

Allah Teâlâ ﴿ٱدْخُلُواْ فِي ٱلسِّلْمِ كَآفَّةً﴾ buyurdu. "السِّلْمُ": İslâm'dır. ﴿وَتَدْعُوۤاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّلْمِ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلأَعْلَوْنَ﴾ sözündeki ise barıştır (الصُلْح). Bazıları "barış" için de "السِّلم" demiştir. Allah Teâlâ ﴿وَيُلْقُوۤاْ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلسَّلَمَ﴾ buyurdu; bu, teslimiyettir (الاستسلام). Allah Teâlâ ﴿وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الجَاهِلُونَ قَالُواْ سَلاَماً﴾ buyurdu; yani "بَراءَةً مِنْكُم" (sizden uzağız) dediler; çünkü "السَّلام" bazı sözlerde berâettir (uzak durmaktır). "إنّما فلانٌ سَلامٌ بِسلام" dersin; yani "kimseyle karışmaz." Şair şöyle demiştir: [Vâfir bahrinden; yüz kırk birinci şâhid]:
سَلامَكَ رَبَّنا في كلِّ فَجْرٍ * بَريئا ما تَغَنَّثُكَ* الذُّمومُ
(Rabbimiz, her şafakta seni tenzih ederiz; kınanacak şeyler sana ilişmekten uzak olarak.)
«تَأَوَّبَكَ» (sana dönüp gelmek) demek istiyor; "Senin berâetini (tenzihini)" demektir.

Allah Teâlâ ﴿إِذْ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلاَماً قَالَ سَلاَمٌ﴾ buyurdu. Müfessirlerin iddiasına göre bu: "Hayır söylediler" demektir. Sanki —Allah daha iyi bilir— onlardan tevhidi işitti; böylece hayır söylemiş oldular. Onların muvahhid olduklarını anlayınca "سلامٌ عَلَيْكُم" dedi ve onlara selam verdi. Bu vecihte (سَلاَمٌ) mübtedâ olarak merfûdur. Bazıları şöyle demiştir: "Selam hususunda meleklerin sözünden olan mansûb, insanın sözünden olan merfûdur." Bu zayıftır, delil değildir. Allah Teâlâ ﴿فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلاَمٌ﴾ buyurdu. Bu, selam vermede "سلامٌ عَلَيْكُم" anlamında caizdir; yahut berâet anlamında olur; ancak onu (mahzûf) mübtedânın haberi kılmıştır; sanki "أمِري سَلامٌ" (benim işim selamdır), yani "benim işim sizden uzak durmaktır" demiştir. Haberin gizlendiği gibi isim (mübtedâ) de gizlenmiştir. Şair şöyle demiştir: [Tavîl bahrinden; on dördüncü şâhid]:
فَيا ظَبْيَةَ الوَعْساءِ بَيْنَ جَلاجِلٍ * وَبَينَ النَّقا آأَنْتِ أَمْ أُمُ سالِمِ
(Ey Celâcil ile Nekâ arasındaki kumluğun ceylanı! Sen misin, yoksa Ümmü Sâlim mi?)
"أَ أَنْتِ هِي أَمْ أم سالِمِ" (o sen misin, yoksa Ümmü Sâlim mi?) takdiri üzeredir; yani "Ümmü Sâlim'in sana benzemesiyle bana karıştın." Bunların hepsinde haber gizlenmiştir. Bunun gibisi: ﴿لاَ يَسْتَوِي مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَاتَلَ أُوْلَـٰئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُواْ مِن بَعْدُ وَقَاتَلُواْ﴾. ﴿أُوْلَـٰئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُواْ مِن بَعْدُ وَقَاتَلُواْ﴾ deyince, bunda ﴿لاَ يَسْتَوِي مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ﴾ "ومن أنفق من بعد الفتح" (ve fetihten sonra infak eden) anlamına bir delil* vardır; yani: "Bunlarla şunlar eşit değildir."

Allah Teâlâ ﴿وَلاَ تَتَّبِعُواْ خُطُوَاتِ ٱلشَّيْطَانِ﴾ buyurdu. (Burada ikinci harf dammelidir;) çünkü "فُعْلَة" vezninde hafif olan her isim cemilendiğinde ikinci harfi damme ile harekelenir; "ظُلُمات" ve "غُرُفات" gibi. Çünkü iki harfin mahreci tek bir telaffuzla olduğunda, birini diğerine yaklaştırmak [onlara] daha kolay [gelir]. Bazıları onu fethalı okuyup "الرُكَبات", "الغُرفاَت" ve "الظُلُمات" demiştir [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «الظُلُمات» burada da dammeli harekelenmiştir; fetha ile «الظُلَمات» kastedilmiş olabilir.]. Bazıları da vavlı olanı, yâlı olanı sakin kıldıkları gibi sakin kılmıştır; "كُلْيات" gibi: Yâ vava dönüşmesin diye lâmı sakin kılmıştır; aynı şekilde "خُطْوات"ta da sakin kılmıştır; çünkü vav yânın kardeşidir.

"سَلْوَة" ve "شَهْوَة" gibi "فَعْلة" vezninde olanların ikinci harfi cemide fetha ile harekelenir; "سَلَوات" ve "شَهَوات" gibi. İlk harfi kesralı olduğunda ikincisi de kesralı olur; "كِسْرة" ve "كِسِرات", "سِدْرة" ve "سِدِرات" gibi. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta "كِسْره" şeklinde yazılmıştır.] Bazıları, dammeli olanın ikincisini fethalı okudukları gibi bunun ikincisini de fethalı okumuş, iki damme ve iki kesrayı ağır bulmuşlardır. Bunun gibi olup da ikinci harfi vav veya yâ olan ya da içinde aynı cinsten iki harf bir araya gelen kelimeler harekelenmez; "دُوْمَة" ve "دُومات", "عُوذَة" ve "عوذات" —bu, muskadır (المعاذة)—, "بَيْضَة" ve "بَيْضات", "مَيْتة" ve "مَيْتات" gibi. Çünkü bu harekelenseydi değişip elife dönüşürdü ve ismin binasını bozardı; bunu ağır buldular. "عِضَةٌ" ve "عِضات" dediler ve (ikinci harfi) harekelemediler; çünkü burası fiilin lâmının harekelendiği bir yerdir; dolayısıyla zayıf olmaz; harekelenmeseydi zayıf olurdu. "الظُلُمات", "الكِسِرات" ve bunlara benzeyenlerde [çoğunlukla] olan, ikinci harfin birinciye uyularak harekelenmesidir. Bu (uyum), onları "أُذْكُر" demeye bile sevk etmiştir: Arada bir harf bulunduğu hâlde kâfın dammesi sebebiyle elifi dammeli okudular; şu (bitişik olan) hâl buna daha lâyıktır. Bazıları "أَنَا أُنْبُوك" ve "أَنا أُجُوك" demiş; hemzenin dammesi sebebiyle bâ ve cîmi dammeli okumuş, onları tek bir telaffuz üzere kılmak istemiştir; bu, ötekinden daha ileridir. "هذا هُو مُنْحَدُرٌ من الجَبَل" (bu, dağdan iniş yeridir) demiş, "مُنْحَدَرٌ"ı kastetmiş; "أُنْبُوكَ" ve "أُجُوكَ"deki bâ ve cîmi dammeli okuduğu gibi râ'nın dammesi sebebiyle dâli dammeli okumuştur.

His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَإذْ قالَ مُوسى لِقَوْمِهِ يا قَوْمِ إنَّكم ظَلَمْتُمْ أنْفُسَكم بِاتِّخاذِكُمُ العِجْلَ﴾. The reading is ”يا قَوْمِ“ with kasra on the mīm; it is an annexed (muḍāf) vocative, and the preferred form in it is dropping the yāʾ, because the yāʾ is a single letter, the vocative is a domain of omission, and it is at the end of the noun just as the tanwīn is at its end; so the yāʾ was dropped and the kasra remained to indicate it.
Four ways are permissible in ordinary speech; but in the Qurʾān [only] the kasra with dropping of the yāʾ, because it is the best of the ways and it is the consensus of the Readers. What is permissible in speech is that you say ”يا قَوْمِ إنَّكم“, as it is read in the Qurʾān; ”يا قَوْمِي“, with the yāʾ kept and quiescent; and ”يا قَوْمِيَ“, with the yāʾ vowelled. These are three ways with annexation. And ”يا قَوْمُ“, with ḍamma on the mīm, is permissible, in the sense of ”يا أيُّها القَوْمُ“ ("O people").
The meaning of His saying ”ظَلَمْتُمْ أنْفُسَكم بِاتِّخاذِكُمُ العِجْلَ“: of everyone who does a deed that returns upon him with harm it is said: ”إنَّما أسَأْتَ إلى نَفْسِكَ“ ("you have only harmed yourself") and ”ظَلَمْتَ نَفْسَكَ“ ("you have wronged yourself"). The root meaning of ”اَلظُّلْمُ“ in the language is putting a thing in other than its place. The Arabs say: ”وَمَن أشْبَهَ أباهُ فَما ظَلَمَ“ ("whoever resembles his father has done no ẓulm"), meaning: the resemblance did not fall for him in other than its place. One says ”ظُلِمَ الرَّجُلُ سِقاءَهُ مِنَ اللَّبَنِ“ when [the milk in his skin] is drunk and served before it has properly set; and ”أرْضٌ مَظْلُومَةٌ“ ("wronged ground") when it is dug where it had not been dug before, or when the rain came near it and passed it by. Al-Nābigha said:
؎إلّا الأوارِيَّ لَأْيًا ما أُبَيِّنُها ∗∗∗ والنُّؤْيَ كالحَوْضِ بِالمَظْلُومَةِ الجَلَدِ
(Except the tethering-posts, which I can make out only with difficulty, and the trench, like a cistern, in the hard, "wronged" ground.)
The meaning of His saying ”بِاتِّخاذِكُمُ العِجْلَ“ is: you took it as a god.
The meaning of His saying ﴿فَتُوبُوا إلى بارِئِكُمْ﴾ is: to your Creator. One says ”بَرَأ اللَّهُ الخَلْقَ“ ("Allah created the creatures"); so ”اَلْبارِئُ“ is the Creator, and ”اَلْبَرِيَّةُ“ and ”اَلْخَلْقُ“ are the created beings, except that ”اَلْبَرِيَّةُ“ occurs in most of their speech without hamza; its origin «[Translator's note: the text says "wa-aṣluhā" and then cites the verse directly; something may be missing between the two]»: ﴿أُولَئِكَ هم خَيْرُ البَرِيَّةِ﴾ [al-Bayyina: 7]. Most of the Readers and of speech have ”اَلْبَرِيَّةُ“ without hamza, though some people read ”اَلْبَرِيئَةِ“ with hamza; the preferred form is that of the majority.
It is related from Abū ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAlāʾ that he read ”إلى بارِئْكم“ with the hamza made quiescent, while Sībawayh transmitted this with the kasra pronounced fleetingly (ikhtilās). I reckon that the correct transmission is what Sībawayh transmitted, for he is more exact concerning what is transmitted from Abū ʿAmr, and [this] iʿrāb is more in keeping with the transmission from Abū ʿAmr, because dropping the kasra in the like of this, and dropping the ḍamma, occur only under the constraint of poetry. Sībawayh recited – and he claimed that it is among what is permissible in poetry specifically:
؎إذا اعْوَجَجْنَ قُلْتُ صاحِبْ قَوِّمِ
(When they [the camels] veer off course, I say: "Companion, straighten [them]!")
with the bāʾ quiescent; and he also recited:
؎فاليَوْمَ أشْرَبْ غَيْرَ مُسْتَحْقِبٍ ∗∗∗ إثْمًا مِنَ اللَّهِ ولا واغِلِ
(So today I drink, not bearing a sin before Allah, nor as an uninvited intruder.)
Correct speech is to say ”يا صاحِبُ أقْبِلْ“ or ”يا صاحِبِ أقْبِلْ“ ("O companion, come forward"); there is no justification for the quiescence. Likewise ”فاليَوْمَ أشْرَبُ يا هَذا“. Others than Sībawayh transmitted these verses in the regular form, as it ought to be in speech and poetry; they transmitted this verse in two ways: they transmitted ”فاليَوْمَ فاشْرَبْ غَيْرَ مُسْتَحْقِبٍ“, and they also transmitted ”فاليَوْمَ أُسْقى غَيْرَ مُسْتَحْقِبٍ“; and they also transmitted ”إذا اعْوَجَجْنَ قُلْتُ صاحِ قَوِّمِ“. Sībawayh – Allah willing – would only transmit what he had heard; but what these others heard is what is established in the language, and Sībawayh himself mentioned that analogy is other than what he transmitted. So it ought to be read only as ”إلى بارِئِكم“ with kasra, and likewise ”عِنْدَ بارِئِكم“.
The meaning of ”فاقْتُلُوا أنْفُسَكم“: Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, tested them by making their repentance consist in their killing one another. It is said that they were lined up in two rows, killing one another: whoever was killed was a martyr, and whoever was not killed was a penitent whose past sins were forgiven. It is also said that the seventy whom Moses ﷺ chose were not among those who worshipped the calf, and that they were the ones who did the killing. The first is more in keeping with the verse, because His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿فاقْتُلُوا أنْفُسَكُمْ﴾ indicates that it was the repentance of the calf-worshippers. Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, tested them with this great trial only because of their disbelief after the proofs and the great signs.

Allah Teâlâ'nın ﴿قُلْ مَن كانَ عَدُوًّا لِجِبْرِيلَ﴾ kavli: «جِبْرِيلُ»in isminde birkaç lügat vardır; bir kısmıyla okunmuştur, bir kısmıyla okunmamıştır. Lügatlerin en iyisi cîmin fethası ve hemze ile «جَبْرَئِيلُ»dir; çünkü Sûr'un sahibi hakkında Hz. Peygamber'den (s.a.v.) rivayet edilen şudur: «Cebrâil (جَبْرَئِيلُ) onun sağında, Mîkâil (مِيكائِيلُ) solundadır». Hadis ehlinin zabtettiği budur. Cîmin fethası ve kesresiyle «جِبْرِيلُ» de denir. Yânın hazfi, hemzenin isbâtı ve lâmın şeddesiyle «جِبْرَألُّ» de denir. Nûn ile «جِبْرِينُ» de denir; bu, yani nûnun isbâtı, Kur'an'da caiz değildir; çünkü Mushaf'a muhaliftir. Şair şöyle demiştir:
؎شَهِدْنا فَما تَلْقى لَنا مِن كَتِيبَةٍ ∗∗∗ يَدَ الدَّهْرِ إلّا جَبْرَئِيلُ أمامَها
([Savaşlara] katıldık; zaman boyunca bizim hiçbir bölüğümüzle karşılaşmazsın ki Cebrâil onun önünde olmasın.)
Bu beyit hadisteki lafız ve kurrâdan birçoğunun üzerinde olduğu lafız üzeredir. Şiirde «جِبْرِيلُ» de gelmiştir; şair şöyle demiştir:
؎وَجِبْرِيلٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فِينا ∗∗∗ ورُوحُ القُدْسِ لَيْسَ لَهُ كِفاءُ
(Allah'ın elçisi Cebrâil aramızdadır; Rûhu'l-Kudüs'ün bir dengi yoktur.)
Bunun zikri, yahudilerin Hz. Peygamber'e (s.a.v.) «Cebrâil bizim düşmanımızdır; sana Mîkâil gelseydi senden kabul ederdik» demeleri sebebiyle geçmiştir. Bunun üzerine Allah Teâlâ şöyle buyurdu: ﴿قُلْ مَن كانَ عَدُوًّا لِجِبْرِيلَ فَإنَّهُ نَـزَّلَهُ عَلى قَلْبِكَ بِإذْنِ اللَّهِ مُصَدِّقًا لِما بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ﴾; bununla önceki kitapları kastetmektedir; ﴿وَهُدًى وبُشْرى لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾. «مُصَدِّقًا» hâl üzere mansûb olmuştur.

O'nun ﴿وَوَصّى بِها إبْراهِيمُ بَنِيهِ ويَعْقُوبُ﴾ sözü: O'nun «بِها» sözündeki bu hâ zamiri millete döner; çünkü onun İslâm'ı, kendi yolunu ve sünnetini açığa vurmasıdır. O'nun ﴿إنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفى لَكُمُ الدِّينَ﴾ sözü, O'nun ﴿وَمَن يَرْغَبُ عَنْ مِلَّةِ إبْراهِيمَ﴾ [Bakara: 130] sözüne delâlet eder. Bu sözde «إنَّ» kesreli olmuştur; çünkü «وَصّى» ve «أوْصى»nın mânâsı söylemektir (kavl). Mânâ: Onlara "Allah sizin için dini seçti" dedi. «وَصّى», «أوْصى»dan daha beliğdir; çünkü «أوْصى»da onlara bir kere söylemiş olması câizdir; «وَصّى» ise ancak birçok defa için olur.
Allah Teâlâ'nın ﴿فَلا تَمُوتُنَّ إلا وأنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾ sözü: Biri "Onlar ancak ölüme uğratıldıkları hâlde, onları ölmekten nasıl nehyeder?" derse (cevap şudur): Bu, sözdeki genişlik ve Arapların çokça kullandığı üslup üzere vâki olmuştur; onların «لا أرَيَنَّكَ هَهُنا» ("Seni burada görmeyeyim") sözleri gibi. Nehyin lafzı konuşan içindir; hakikatte ise muhatap içindir. Mânâ: "Burada olma; çünkü burada olanı görürüm." Âyetteki mânâ şudur: "İslâm'a sımsıkı sarılın; böylece ölüm size eriştiğinde sizi Müslüman olarak bulsun."

His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿أمْ كُنْتُمْ شُهَداءَ إذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوبَ المَوْتُ﴾. The meaning is: rather, were you witnesses when death came to Jacob, when he said to his sons...? The position of the second "إذْ" is accusative, like the position of the first; this is an emphasising badal (substitute).

His saying: ﴿قالُوا نَعْبُدُ إلَهَكَ وإلَهَ آبائِكَ﴾. The reading is with the plural. Some read "وَإلَهَ أبِيكَ", as if disliking to make the paternal uncle his father, and made "إبْراهِيمَ" a badal from "أبِيكَ", explaining it. With "إسْماعِيلَ" and "إسْحاقَ" in the genitive, the meaning would be: "your God, and the God of your father, and the God of Ishmael", as you say "رَأيْتُ غُلامَ زَيْدٍ وعَمْرٍو" (I saw the servant of Zayd and ʿAmr), i.e. the servant of both. Whoever says "وَإلَهَ آبائِكَ" in the plural — which is the agreed reading — makes "إبْراهِيمَ وإسْماعِيلَ وإسْحاقَ" a badal, and their position is genitive as an explanatory badal from "آبائِكَ".

His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿إلَهًا واحِدًا﴾ is accusative in two ways. If you wish, as ḥāl (circumstantial), as if they said: "we worship your God in the state of His being one"; and if you wish, as badal, the benefit of this badal being the mention of the divine oneness (tawḥīd), so that the meaning is: "we worship one God".

His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿قُلْ أتُحاجُّونَنا في اللَّهِ﴾. In "أتُحاجُّونَنا في اللَّهِ" there are several forms. The best of them is "أتُحاجُّونَنا" with two nūns. If you wish, with one nūn: "أتُحاجُّونّا", by assimilating (idghām) the first into the second; this is a good way. Some of them, when assimilating, hint at the fatḥa, as they read: ﴿ما لَكَ لا تَأْمَنّا عَلى يُوسُفَ﴾ [Yūsuf: 11] with assimilation and a hint at the ḍamma. If you wish you may delete one of the two nūns and say "أتُحاجُّونا", deleting because two nūns come together. The poet said:

؎تَراهُ كالثِّغامِ يُعَلُّ مِسْكًا ∗∗∗ يَسُوءُ الغانِياتِ إذا فَلْيَنِي
(You see it [my hair], like the white thaghām plant, drenched again and again with musk; it grieves the fair women when they search my head [for lice].)

He means "فَلَيْنَنِي". I have seen that the position of al-Māzinī and others is to reject this reading, and likewise they rejected ﴿فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ﴾ [al-Ḥijr: 54]. Abū Isḥāq [al-Zajjāj] said: Venturing to reject this reading is an error, because Nāfiʿ, may Allah have mercy on him, read it. Ismāʿīl ibn Isḥāq informed me that Nāfiʿ, may Allah have mercy on him, did not read any letter unless at least two of the readers of Medina had read it; and it has a basis in Arabic, so it should not be rejected. But the fatḥa in His saying "فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ" is stronger in Arabic.

The meaning of His saying "﴿قُلْ أتُحاجُّونَنا في اللَّهِ﴾" is that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, commanded the Muslims to speak to the Jews who had supported those who do not affirm the oneness of Allah, Mighty and Majestic — the Christians and idol-worshippers. Allah commanded that the argument against them be: "You claim that you affirm the oneness [of Allah], and we affirm His oneness; so why have you supported those who do not affirm the oneness of Allah, Majestic and Mighty, while He is our Lord and your Lord, and to us belong our deeds and to you your deeds?" Then they informed them that they are sincere (mukhliṣūn), and their sincerity is their faith that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is One, and their assent to all His messengers. So they made known that they are sincere, unlike those who opposed them.

{وإذ قال ربك} kavli: «إذ», mahzûf bir fiil takdiriyle nasb mahallindedir; takdiri: «Ey Muhammed, Rabbinin şöyle dediği zamanı an.» Onda «قال» amel etmez; çünkü «إذ» kendinden sonraki cümleye muzâftır; muzâfun ileyh de muzâfta amel etmez.

{أتجعل فيها} kavli: Elif, istirşâd (yol gösterilmesini isteme) elifidir; bir faydayı sormaktır, inkâr değildir. Lafzı istifhâm lafzıdır. Bunun bir taaccüp olduğu, meleklerin Allah'ın kudretine hayret ettikleri de söylenmiştir.

{إني أعلم} kavli: «أعلم»in, nefsinden haber veren için bir fiil olması güzeldir; çünkü öncesinde nefisten haber verme vardır, o da «إني»dir. «فاعل» anlamında bir isim olması da caizdir; bu durumda onda tenvin takdir edilir; fakat tasarruf etmez (gayr-i munsariftir); böylece «ما»yı onunla nasb edersin. [Mütercim notu: Metin «ولكن لا يتصرف فتنصب ما به» şeklindedir; ifade kapalıdır, anlamı bağlama göre verilmiştir.]

{للملائكة} kavli: «ملك»in cemiidir. «ملك»in aslı «مألك»tir; sonra hemze kalb edilip lâmın yerine getirilmiş ve «ملأك» olmuştur. Aslî vezni «مفعل» olup «معفل»e kalb edilmiştir. Sonra hemzenin harekesi lâma nakledilmiş ve «ملك» olmuştur. Cemi yapılınca kalbden sonraki aslına döndürülmüştür; bu yüzden «ملائكة»de hemze lâmdan sonra gelmiştir. Kalbden önceki aslına göre cemi yapılsaydı «مفاعلة» vezninde «مآلكة» derdin. Dolayısıyla «ملائكة»nin vezni «معافلة»dir, aslı «مفاعلة»dir. Hemze aslında fiilin fâ'sı, lâm fiilin ayn'ı, kâf da fiilin lâm'ıdır; çünkü risâlet (elçilik) anlamındaki «الألوكة»dan türemiştir.

İbn Keysân: «O, «ملكت»ten türemiştir» demiştir; ona göre hemze, «شمأل»deki ziyadesi gibi zâiddir. Bu durumda «ملك»in vezni «فعل», «ملائكة»nin vezni de «فعائلة» olur; çünkü mîm aslî, hemze zâiddir. Ebû Ubeyd: «O, «لأك»ten türemiştir; (bu) gönderdiği zaman (denir)» demiştir. Ebû Ubeyd'in görüşüne göre hemze (fiilin) ayn'ıdır ve onda kalb yoktur.

Buna göre «ملائكة» lafzının vezni, cumhurun görüşüne göre «معافلة»dir, çünkü maklûbdur ve hemze fiilin fâ'sıdır. İbn Keysân'ın görüşüne göre «فعائلة»dir, çünkü mîm aslîdir ve hemze ona göre zâiddir. Ebû Ubeyd'in görüşüne göre ise «مفاعلة»dir, çünkü hemze ona göre fiilin ayn'ıdır.

His words {كَمَا كتب على الَّذين}: the kāf is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), its implied form being "كتبا كَمَا كتب" (a prescribing as it was prescribed) or "صوما كَمَا كتب" (a fasting as it was prescribed). It may be in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الصّيام, its implied form being "كتب عَلَيْكُم الصّيام مشبها لما كتب على الَّذين من قبلكُمْ" (fasting has been prescribed for you resembling what was prescribed for those before you). It may also be in the position of the nominative as a naʿt of الصيام, since it is general in wording and its explanation comes only in what follows it. If you make the kāf a naʿt of الصوم, you make أَيَّامًا معدودات accusative by الصّيام, because it is all included in its ṣila (complement). It is not permitted to make أَيَّامًا معدودات accusative by الصّيام on the other analyses of the kāf, because you would be separating the ṣila from the relative, since the kāf and what follows it would not be included in the ṣila of الصّيام; and if you make أيّاما accusative by الصّيام while it is included in the ṣila of الصّيام, you have separated the ṣila from the relative. And so that you make أَيَّامًا accusative by كتب, you make it an object by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa) [Translator's note: the edition reads «ولكي تنصب»; «ولك أن تنصب» (you may make … accusative) is probably intended]. If you make الْأَيَّام accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), the operator on it being الصّيام, all that was disallowed when you made الْأَيَّام a direct object becomes permitted, because there is latitude with adverbs, and abstract meanings may govern them, and objects are not like that. There is disagreement over permitting that with adverbs.

The hāʾ in His words {فَمن بدله} and the three hāʾs after it refer to الإيصاء (the making of a bequest), since الْوَصِيَّة indicates الإيصاء. It is also said that they rather refer to the prescribing (al-katb), because كتب indicates الكتب.
{أجيب دعوة} kavli: «لآن» için ikinci haberdir; «قريب» birinci haberdir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «لآن» yazılıdır; {فإني قريب} kavlindeki «إنّ» kastedilmektedir.]

Allah the Exalted says: (إِنْ تُبْدُوا الصَّدَقَاتِ فَنِعِمَّا هِيَ وَإِنْ تُخْفُوهَا وَتُؤْتُوهَا الْفُقَرَاءَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْكُمْ مِنْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ (٢٧١)).
His saying, Exalted is He: (فَنِعِمَّا): niʿma is an inflexible (jāmid) verb that has no imperfect. Its original is naʿima, like ʿalima, and it has occurred in that form in poetry; but they gave the ʿayn sukūn and transferred its vowel to the nūn, to be an indication of the original. Some leave the nūn with fatḥa according to the original (naʿma).
And some give kasra to both the nūn and the ʿayn for vowel harmony (niʿima); it has been read with each.
There is another reading here: sukūn on the ʿayn and the mīm, with assimilation (niʿmmā); this is far-fetched because it combines two quiescent letters. It has been said: the transmitter did not record the reading accurately, because the reciter slurred (ikhtalasa) the kasra of the ʿayn and he took it for sukūn. The fāʿil (agent) of niʿma is latent, and مَا is in the sense of "a thing"; it is the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ), i.e. "excellent is the thing, as a thing". «[Translator's note: as printed; on the usual analysis مَا is the tamyīz (specification) and هِيَ is the one specified for praise, as the next sentence goes on to say.]» (هِيَ): the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), as though someone said, "What is the thing praised?" and it is said, "It", i.e. the one praised is the charity. There is another view on it: that هِيَ is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and niʿma with its fāʿil is the khabar, i.e. "charity — excellent is the thing"; a pronoun referring back to the mubtadaʾ is dispensed with because the genus includes the mubtadaʾ.
(فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ): the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and its position is jussive. هُوَ is the pronoun of a maṣdar (verbal noun) that has not been mentioned, though its verb has been mentioned; the implied form is "then the concealing is better for you", or "then giving it to the poor in secret is better". (وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْكُمْ): it is read with nūn, attributing the act to Allah, Mighty and Majestic.
It is also read with yāʾ on this same construal, and also on another construal, namely that the fāʿil is the pronoun of the concealing.
It is also read wa-tukaffar, with tāʾ, on the basis that the verb is attributed to the pronoun of the charity.
It is read with the rāʾ in the jussive, conjoined to the position of فَهُوَ, and in the nominative by implying a mubtadaʾ, i.e. "and We…" or "and it…". And (مِنْ) here is redundant (zāʾida) according to al-Akhfash, so سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ would be the object; according to Sībawayh the object is omitted, i.e. "something of your misdeeds". Al-sayyiʾa is فِعْلِيَّة [Translator's note: so printed; the known pattern is فَيْعِلَة (fayʿila)], and its middle radical is wāw, because it is from sāʾa yasūʾu; its original is saywiʾa, then what we mentioned regarding صَيِّب was done to it.

﴿وَكَذَلِكَ﴾ sizi ona hidayet ettiğimiz gibi ﴿جَعَلْنَاكُمْ﴾ ey Muhammed ümmeti ﴿أُمَّةً وَسَطًا﴾ seçkin ve âdil ﴿لِتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾ kıyamet günü, peygamberlerinin onlara tebliğ ettiğine ﴿وَيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا﴾ size tebliğ ettiğine ﴿وَمَا جَعَلْنَا﴾ kılmadık ﴿الْقِبْلَةَ﴾ şimdi senin için, yönü ﴿الَّتِي كُنْتَ عَلَيْهَا﴾ başta; o da Kâbe'dir. (Hz. Peygamber) (s.a.v.) ona doğru namaz kılardı; hicret edince Yahudilerin gönlünü kazanmak için Beytülmakdis'e yönelmekle emrolundu; ona doğru on altı veya on yedi ay namaz kıldı, sonra (kıble) değiştirildi. ﴿إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ﴾ zuhur bilgisiyle ﴿مَنْ يَتَّبِعُ الرَّسُولَ﴾ ve onu tasdik edeni ﴿مِمَّنْ يَنْقَلِبُ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ﴾ yani dinde şüpheye düşerek ve Peygamber'in (s.a.v.) işinde şaşkınlık içinde olduğunu zannederek küfre döneni; nitekim bu yüzden bir topluluk irtidat etti ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ sakîleden muhaffeftir; ismi mahzûftur, yani وَإِنَّهَا ﴿كَانَتْ﴾ yani ona yönelme ﴿لَكَبِيرَةً﴾ insanlara ağır ﴿إِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِينَ هَدَى اللَّهُ﴾ onlardan ﴿وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَانَكُمْ﴾ yani Beytülmakdis'e doğru kıldığınız namazınızı; bilakis size onun sevabını verir; çünkü onun (ayetin) nüzul sebebi, kıblenin değiştirilmesinden önce ölenler hakkındaki sorudur ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِالنَّاسِ﴾ mü'minlere ﴿لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ amellerini zayi etmemekte. Re'fet, rahmetin şiddetlisidir; fâsıla için daha beliğ olanı öne alındı.

﴿وَكَذَلِكَ﴾ just as We guided you to it, ﴿جَعَلْنَاكُمْ﴾ O community of Muhammad, ﴿أُمَّةً وَسَطًا﴾ choice and upright (ʿudūl), ﴿لِتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾ on the Day of Resurrection, that their messengers conveyed [the message] to them, ﴿وَيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا﴾ that he conveyed it to you. ﴿وَمَا جَعَلْنَا﴾ We did not make (ṣayyarnā) ﴿الْقِبْلَةَ﴾ for you now the direction ﴿الَّتِي كُنْتَ عَلَيْهَا﴾ at first, namely the Kaaba. He ﷺ used to pray towards it; then when he emigrated he was commanded to face Bayt al-Maqdis (Jerusalem) to win over the Jews, so he prayed towards it for sixteen or seventeen months, then he was turned [back] ﴿إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ﴾ with a knowledge of manifestation (ʿilm ẓuhūr) ﴿مَنْ يَتَّبِعُ الرَّسُولَ﴾ and believes him ﴿مِمَّنْ يَنْقَلِبُ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ﴾ i.e. returns to disbelief, doubting the religion and supposing that the Prophet ﷺ was perplexed about his affair; and a group did apostatize because of that. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ lightened from the heavy [form, inna], and its noun (ism) is omitted, i.e. "and indeed it" (wa-innahā) ﴿كَانَتْ﴾ i.e. the turning towards it ﴿لَكَبِيرَةً﴾ hard upon people ﴿إِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِينَ هَدَى اللَّهُ﴾ among them. ﴿وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَانَكُمْ﴾ i.e. your prayer towards Bayt al-Maqdis; rather He will reward you for it, since the occasion of its revelation was the question about those who died before the change [of qibla]. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِالنَّاسِ﴾ the believers ﴿لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ in not letting their deeds go to waste. Raʾfa is intense mercy, and the more emphatic [word] was put first for the sake of the verse-ending (fāṣila).
[Translator's note: al-Jalalayn identifies the earlier qibla «الَّتِي كُنْتَ عَلَيْهَا» as the Kaaba, translated as written.]

Allah Teâlâ'nın {خَتَمَ الله على قُلُوبِهمْ} . . âyeti: {على قُلُوبِهمْ}, «خَتَم»e mütealliktir. «على سمعهم»in «قلوبهم» üzerine atfedilmesi ihtimali vardır; zâhir olan da budur; çünkü bu, yani mührün kulağa (işitmeye) nispet edilmesi, Allah Teâlâ'nın {وَخَتَمَ على سَمْعِهِ} [Câsiye: 23] sözünde açıkça belirtilmiştir. Öne alınmış haber olması, sonrasının da ona atfedilmesi ihtimali de vardır. «غِشَاوة» mübtedâdır. Onunla ibtidâ (cümleye başlamak) caiz olmuştur; çünkü nekirenin haberi bir zarf veya tam bir câr-mecrûr olup ona takdim edildiğinde, onunla ibtidâ caiz olur. Bu durumda haberin öne alınması, nekire ile ibtidâyı sahih kıldığı için vacip olur; âyet bu kabildendir. Bu, Allah Teâlâ'nın {وَأَجَلٌ مُّسمًّى عِندَهُ} [En'âm: 2] sözünden farklıdır; çünkü o âyette başka bir mübah kılıcı (müsevviğ) vardır; o da sıfattır. Birinci ihtimale göre «سمعهم» üzerinde vakıf yapılır ve sonrasıyla, yani «وعلى أبصارهم غشاوةٌ» ile başlanır; «على أبصارهم» öne alınmış haber, «غشاوة» sonraya bırakılmış mübtedâdır. İkinci ihtimale göre ise «قلوبهم» üzerinde vakıf yapılır. Cer harfi olan «على»nın tekrarlanması, te'kîd ifade etmesi içindir; yahut bunun, iki mühürlemenin birbirinden farklı olduğunu, yani kalplerin mühürlenmesinin kulakların mühürlenmesinden başka olduğunu hissettirmesi içindir. Nahivciler «مررت بزيد وعمرو» ile «مررت بزيد وبعمرو» arasını ayırmışlar ve birincisinde tek bir uğrama, ikincisinde iki uğrama olduğunu söylemişlerdir; bu da benim söylediğimi destekler. Ancak te'kîd ile gerekçelendirme iki i'rabı da kapsar; yani «وعلى سَمْعِهم»in «على قلوبهم» sözüne ma'tûf kılınmasını da, öne alınmış haber kılınmasını da. İki mühürlemenin farklılığı ile gerekçelendirme ise ancak birinci ihtimale göre gelir. İkinci ihtimale göre de şöyle denebilir: Harfin tekrarı iki perdenin farklılığını hissettirir; yani -iki mühürlemede geçtiği gibi- kulak üzerindeki perde, göz üzerindeki perdeden başkadır.

«غِشاوةً» nasb ile de okunmuştur. Bunda üç vecih vardır. Birincisi: Uygun bir fiilin gizlenmesi (takdiri) iledir; yani: «وجَعَلَ على أبصارهم غشاوةً». Bu âmil, Allah Teâlâ'nın {وَجَعَلَ على بَصَرِهِ غِشَاوَةً} [Câsiye: 23] sözünde açıkça zikredilmiştir. İkincisi: Cer harfinin düşürülmesiyle (nez'u'l-hâfıd ile) mansûb olmasıdır; «وعلى أبصارهم» kendinden öncekine ma'tûf olur; takdiri: «ختم الله على قلوبهم وعلى سَمْعهم وعلى أبصارهم بغشاوة»; sonra cer harfi hazfedilmiş ve sonrası mansûb olmuştur; şu sözde olduğu gibi:
148 - تَمُرُّون الدِّيارَ ولم تَعُوجوا ... كلامُكُمُ عليَّ إذاً حَرامُ
(Yurtlara uğrayıp geçiyorsunuz da (yanıma) dönüp uğramıyorsunuz; öyleyse sizinle konuşmak bana haramdır.)
Yani «تمرون بالديارِ»; ancak bu kıyasî değildir. Üçüncüsü: «غِشاوةً»nin, mana bakımından «خَتَم» ile buluşan masdarın yerine konmuş bir isim olmasıdır; çünkü mühürleme ve örtme, örtme manasında ortaktır. Sanki te'kîd yoluyla «وخَتَم تغشيةً» (örterek mühürledi) denmiştir. Bu, «قَعَدْتُ جلوساً» bâbındandır; onların kalpleri, kulakları ve gözleri mühürlenmiş ve örtülmüş olur.

Fârisî şöyle dedi: «Ref' kıraati daha evlâdır. Çünkü nasbı ya zâhir olan «خَتَم»e hamledersin; bu durumda atıf harfi ile kendisiyle atfedilen arasına (başka bir şeyle) girmiş olursun; bu da bize göre ancak şiirde caizdir. Ya da onu «خَتَم»in delâlet ettiği bir fiile hamledersin; takdiri: «وجَعَلَ على أبصارهم غشاوةً» olur; bu durumda söz şu bâbdan olur:
149 - يا ليتَ زَوجَكَ قد غَدَا ... متقلِّداً سيفاً ورُمْحا
(Keşke kocan kılıç kuşanmış ve mızrak [taşımış] olarak sabahleyin yola çıksaydı.)
Ve şu sözden:
150 - عَلَفْتُها تِبْناً وماءً بارداً ... حتى شَتَتْ هَمَّالةً عَيْناها
(Ona saman yedirdim ve soğuk su [içirdim]; ta ki gözleri yaş döken hâlde kışı geçirdi.)
Bu kullanımı genişlik (serbestlik) ve tercih hâlinde neredeyse bulamazsın.» Bazıları bu ifadeyi müşkil bulmuş ve şöyle demiştir: «Onun "Çünkü nasbı ya zâhir olan «خَتَم»e hamledersin" sözünün ne manaya geldiğini bilmiyorum. Mansûb olan «غشاوةً»yi bir fiil olan «ختم»e nasıl hamledebilirsin? Bu, hamlin söz konusu olmadığı bir şeydir.» Sonra şöyle dedi: «Ancak şunu kastetmiş olabilir: Allah Teâlâ'nın {خَتَمَ الله على قُلُوبِهمْ} sözü haber değil, onlar aleyhine bir bedduadır; «غشاوة» da onların aleyhine dua edilen ve fiilin yerine geçen masdar manasındadır; sanki "Allah gözlerini örtsün" denmiştir. Bu durumda o, duada fiilinin yerine geçen masdarın atfı gibi «خَتَم» üzerine ma'tûf olur; «رَحِمَ الله زيداً وسقياً له» (Allah Zeyd'e rahmet etsin ve onu sulasın) gibi. O zaman ma'tûf olan «غشاوة» ile ma'tûfun aleyh olan «ختم» arasına câr ve mecrûr ile girmiş olursun.» Bitti. Bu güzel bir tevildir; ancak onda lafzî bir itiraz vardır: Fârisî ma'tûf ile ma'tûfun aleyh arasında fasıla iddia etmemiştir; ancak atıf harfi ile onunla, yani harfle atfedilen arasında fasıla iddia etmiştir. Dolayısıyla tevilin doğru ifadesi şöyle denmesidir: "Böylece «غشاوة» ile atıf harfi arasına câr ve mecrûr ile girmiş olursun."

«غشاوة» [Mütercim notu: metinde «العين» (ayn) yazılıdır; kastedilen ilk harf, yani ğayn olmalıdır] fethası ve dammesiyle, ayrıca noktasız (ayn ile) «عشاوة» olarak da okunmuştur. Kıraatlerin en doğrusu meşhur olandır; çünkü kuşatma (iştimâl) bildiren şeyler hep bu vezinde gelir; «العِمامة» (sarık), «الضِمامة» (deste) ve «العِصابة» (sargı) gibi.

«الخَتْم» sözlükte bir mühür (tâbi') veya başka bir şeyle damgalamaktır. «القلب»in aslı masdardır; bu organa onunla ad verilmiştir; o, çam kozalağı biçimindeki et parçasıdır. (Bu adı) düşüncelerin ona hızla gelmesi ve üzerinde gidip gelmesi sebebiyledir. Bu yüzden şair şöyle dedi:
151 - ما سُمِّي القلبُ إلاَّ مِنْ تقلُّبِه ... فاحذَرْ على القَلْبِ من قَلْبٍ وتَحْويلِ
(Kalbe ancak dönüp durmasından dolayı "kalb" adı verilmiştir; kalp için dönmekten ve değişmekten sakın.)
Bu organa onunla ad verilince, onunla aslı arasını ayırmak için onu tefhîm etmeyi (kalın okumayı) gerekli saymışlardır. Çoğu zaman onunla akıl kastedilir. Her şeyin özüne ve halis kısmına da denir.

«السَّمع» ve «السَّماع», «سَمِع»in iki masdarıdır. Bazen «الاستماع» (dinleme) manasında kullanılır; şair şöyle dedi:
152 - وقد تَوَجَّس رِكْزاً مُقْفِرٌ نَدُسٌ ... بِنَبْأةِ الصوتِ ما في سَمْعِهِ كَذِبُ
(Issız yerlerde dolaşan, sesin en hafifini sezen zeki (avcı) gizli bir ses sezdi; onun işitmesinde yanılma yoktur.)
Yani «في استماعه». «السِّمْع» -kesra ile- güzel anılmadır; ayrıca kurdun sırtlandan olan yavrusudur. Ondan önceki ve sonrakiler gibi bununla da cemi kastedilmiş olsa da tekil getirilmiştir; çünkü o hakikatte masdardır; ayrıca bir muzâfın hazfı üzeredir, yani «مواضعِ سَمْعِهم» (işitme yerleri); yahut onunla kulak kinâye edilmiştir ve mana anlaşıldığı için tekil getirilmiştir; şu sözde olduğu gibi:
153 - كُلُوا في بعض بَطْنِكُم تَعِفُّوا ... فإنَّ زمانَكمْ زَمَنٌ خَمِيصُ
(Karnınızın bir kısmıyla yiyin ki iffetli olasınız; zira zamanınız aç bir zamandır.)
Yani «بطونكم». Bunun benzeri:
154 - لها جِيَفُ الحَسْرى فأمَّا عِظامُها ... فبِيضٌ وأمَّا جِلْدُها فصليبُ
(Yorgunluktan ölen develerin leşleri onlarındır [kuşların]; kemiklerine gelince bembeyazdır, derisine gelince sertleşmiştir.)
Yani «جلودها». Bunun benzeri:
155 - لا تُنْكِروا القَتْلَ وقد سُبينا ... في حَلْقِكم عَظْمٌ وقد شُجِينا
(Esir edildiğimiz hâlde öldürmeyi yadırgamayın; boğazlarınızda bir kemik var, biz de (kemik) boğazımıza takıldı.)
Şâz olarak «على أسماعِهم» da okunmuştur; bu, bunu destekler.

«الأَبْصار»: «بَصَر»ın cemidir; o, görülen şeylerin kendisiyle idrak edildiği göz nurudur. Cemi yapıldığı için masdar değildir dediler. Biri şöyle diyebilir: Cemi yapılması aslında masdar olmasına engel değildir; onun cemiini kolaylaştıran, göz nuruna onunla ad verilmiş olması ve böylece onda masdarlık manasının terk edilmesidir; tıpkı «قَلْب»ın cemii olan «قلوب»da geçtiği gibi; siz de onun aslında masdar olduğunu, sonra onunla ad verildiğini söylediniz. «السمع»in aslında -geçtiği üzere- masdar olmasına rağmen onunla kulak kinâye edildiği gibi, onunla da göz kinâye edilebilir.

«الغِشاوة» [Mütercim notu: metinde «الغِشاوى» yazılı] örtüdür. Şair şöyle dedi:
156 - تَبِعْتُك إذ عَيْني عليها غِشاوةٌ ... فلمَّا انْجَلَتْ قَطَّعْتُ نفسي أَلومُها
(Gözümün üzerinde bir perde varken sana uydum; perde kalkınca kendimi kınamaktan helak ettim.)
Bir başkası şöyle dedi:
157 - هَلاَّ سألْتِ بني ذُبْيان ما حَسْبي ... إذا الدُّخانُ تَغَشَّى الأشْمَطَ البَرِمَا
(Duman [kıtlık zamanında yakılan ateşin dumanı], (kumara katılmayan) cimri ak saçlı ihtiyarı örttüğünde, benim soyumun ne olduğunu Zübyânoğulları'na sormaz mısın?)
Cemii «غِشَاء»dır; hâ hazfedilince vâv hemzeye kalbedilmiştir. «أداوى» gibi «غشاوى» olduğu da söylenmiştir. Fârisî şöyle dedi: «"الغِشاوة"dan vâv ile tasrif edilmiş (çekimli) bir şey işitmedim. Bu bulunmayınca ve manası, lâm harfi yâ olan «غَشِي يغشى»nin manası olunca -«الغِشْيان» demelerinin delâletiyle-, «الغِشاوة», «غَشِيَ»den olup, «جَبَيْت»ten «الجِباوَة» gibi olur; şu bakımdan ki vâv sanki yânın bedelidir; zira «الجباوة»dan bir fiil tasrif edilmediği gibi bundan da (vâvlı) fiil tasrif edilmemiştir.» Bitti. İfadesinin zâhiri, vâvın yâdan bedel olduğu; yâ'nın asıl olduğudur; delili de fiilin vâv maddesinden değil yâdan tasrif edilmesidir. Zâhir olan şudur: Bu mananın iki maddesi vardır: غ ش و ve غ ش ي; sonra iki maddeden birinde tasarruf etmişler ve bununla diğer maddede tasarruf etmekten müstağni kalmışlardır. Bu, sebepsiz yere vâvın yâya kalbedildiğini iddia etmekten daha yakındır. Ayrıca yâ vâvdan daha hafiftir; daha hafif olanı nasıl daha ağır olana kalbederler? [Mütercim notu: Metinde "vâvın yâya kalbi" denmektedir; tartışmanın gidişatına göre kastedilen, (asıl) yânın vâva kalbi olmalıdır; son cümle de buna işaret eder.]

{وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عظِيمٌ}: «لهم» öne alınmış haberdir; dolayısıyla mahzûf bir şeye mütealliktir. «عذابٌ» sonraya bırakılmış mübtedâ, «عظيمٌ» onun sıfatıdır. Burada haberin öne alınması caizdir (vacip değildir); çünkü mübtedânın bir müsevviği vardır, o da sıfatlanmasıdır. Dolayısıyla caiz olma bakımından {وَأَجَلٌ مُّسمًّى عِندَهُ} [En'âm: 2]'nin benzeridir.

«العَذاب» aslında devam etmektir; sonra her acının devamına bu ad verilmiştir. Aslının men etmek olduğu da söylenmiştir; zâhir olan budur. Suya «عَذْب» (tatlı) denmesi buradandır; çünkü susuzluğu men eder; azap da suçtan men eder. «عظيمٌ», «عَظُم»den ism-i fâildir; «كَرُم»den «كَريم» gibi; zaman manasına gidilmeyerek. Aslı onunla cisimlerin vasıflandırılmasıdır; sonra bazen onunla manalar da vasıflandırılır. Acaba o ve «الكبير» aynı manada mıdır, yoksa o «الكبير»den üstün müdür? Çünkü «العظيم» hakirin, «الكبير» küçüğün karşılığıdır; hakir de küçükten aşağıdır. İki görüş vardır.

«فعيل»in birçok manası vardır: İsim ve sıfat olur. İsim tekil ve cemi olur; tekil de mana ismi ve ayn (somut varlık) ismi olur; örneğin: «قميص», «ظريف», «صهيل» ve «كَلْب»in cemii «كلِيب». Sıfat ise «فُعَلَة»nın tekili olur: «عُرَاة» diye cemi yapılan «عَرِيّ» gibi; «فَعَلة»nın tekili olur: «سَراة» diye cemi yapılan «سَرِيّ» gibi. «فَعُل»den ism-i fâil olur: geçtiği gibi «عظمُ»den «عظيم». «فاعِل»de mübalağa olur: «عالم»den «عليم» gibi. «أَفْعل» manasında olur: «أَشْمط» manasında «شَمِيط» gibi; «مفعول» manasında: «مَجْروح» manasında «جِريح» [Mütercim notu: metinde böyle; bilinen şekli «جَريح»] gibi; «مُفْعِل» manasında: «مُسْمِع» manasında «سميع» gibi; «مُفْعَل» manasında: «مُولَد» manasında «وليد» gibi; «مُفاعِل» manasında: «مُجالِس» manasında «جليس» gibi; «مُفْتَعِل» manasında: «مُبْتدِع» manasında «بديع» gibi; «مُتَفَعِّل» manasında: «مُتَسَعِّر» manasında «سَعِير» gibi; «مُسْتَفْعِل» manasında: «مُسْتَمْكِن» manasında «مكين» gibi; «فَعْل» manasında: «رَطِب» manasında «رطيب» gibi; «فَعَل» manasında: «عَجَب» manasında «عَجِيب» gibi; «فِعال» manasında: «صِحاح» manasında «صحيح» gibi; fâil ve mef'ûl manasında: «صارخ» veya «مصروخ» manasında «صريخ» gibi; tekil ve cemi manasında: «خليط» gibi; ve «فاعِل»in cemii olarak: «غارِب»in cemii «غريب» gibi.

The saying of the Exalted: {يُخَادِعُونَ الله}: this verbal clause may be resumptive (mustaʾnafa), as an answer to an implied question, namely: "What is the matter with them that they said 'We believe' while they are not believers?" So it was said: "They try to deceive Allah." It may also be a badal (substitute) for the clause that serves as the ṣila (relative clause) of «مَنْ», namely «يقولُ», and this would be a substitute of inclusion (badal al-ishtimāl), because their saying such-and-such includes deception. It is thus analogous to the poet's saying:
172 - إنَّ عليَّ اللهَ أن تُبايعا ... تُؤْخَذَ كَرْهاً أو تَجِيءَ طائِعا
(I owe it to Allah that you shall pledge allegiance — be taken by force or come willingly.)
And another's saying:
173 - متى تَأْتِنا تُلْمِمْ بنا في ديارنا ... تَجِدْ حَطَباً جَزْلاً وناراً تَأجَّجَا
(Whenever you come to us — call on us in our dwellings — you will find thick firewood and a blazing fire.)
So «تُؤْخَذَ» is a badal of inclusion from «تُبايع», and likewise «تُلْمم» is a badal from «تأتِنا». On these two views this clause has no grammatical position. The clauses that have no grammatical position are four, not more than that — even if some have imagined otherwise — namely: the mubtadaʾ [Translator's note: the source reads «المبتدأ»; «المبتدأة», the initial (resumptive) clause, is evidently meant], the ṣila, the parenthetical (al-muʿtariḍa) and the explicative (al-mufassira); their details will come in their places. This clause may also be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun latent (mustatir) in «يقول», its implied form being: "And among people is he who says, while they are deceiving." Abū al-Baqāʾ permitted it to be a ḥāl from the pronoun latent in «بمؤمنين», with the active participle governing it. Some refuted him with something whose meaning is that this noble verse is analogous to «ما زيدٌ أقبل ضاحكاً» ("Zayd did not come forward laughing"). He said: "The Arabs have two ways in a construction like this. One of them: negating the qualifier alone and affirming the root of the action; this is the more common, and the meaning is that the coming forward is affirmed and the laughing is negated. This meaning cannot conceivably be intended in the verse, I mean negating the deception and affirming faith. The second way: the qualifier is negated, so what governs it is negated too; it is as though it were said in the previous example: 'He did not come forward and did not laugh.' This meaning too is decisively not intended by the noble verse, I mean negating faith and deception together; rather, the meaning is upon negating faith and affirming deception. So making it a ḥāl from the pronoun in «بمؤمنين» is invalid." What is astonishing about Abū al-Baqāʾ is how he sensed this difficulty and so prohibited making this clause in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of «مؤمنين» — he said: "because that would entail negating their deception, whereas the meaning is upon affirming the deception" — and then made it a ḥāl from the pronoun of «مؤمنين», when there is no difference between the ḥāl and the adjective in this respect.
Al-khidāʿ (deception) is originally concealment; from it come al-akhdaʿān, two veins hidden in the neck, and from it mikhdaʿ al-bayt (the inner chamber of the house). So the meaning of «خادع» is: making one's companion imagine something other than the harm one intends for him. It was also said: it is corruption; the poet said:
174 - أبيضُ اللونِ لذيذٌ طَعْمُهُ ... طَيِّبُ الرِّيقِ إذا الريقُ خَدَعْ
(White of colour, delicious of taste, sweet of saliva when saliva has gone bad.)
i.e. "has gone bad". The maṣdar (verbal noun) is al-khidʿ, with kasra on the khāʾ, and similar to it is al-khadīʿa. The meaning of «يخادعون الله» is: in terms of outward form, not in terms of reality. It was also said: because of their lack of knowledge of Allah the Exalted and His attributes, they supposed Him to be one who can be deceived. Abū al-Qāsim al-Zamakhsharī said: "The name of Allah the Exalted is inserted (muqḥam), and the meaning is: they try to deceive those who believe; it is of the type «أعجبني زيدٌ وكرمُه» ('Zayd and his generosity pleased me'), the meaning being: Zayd's generosity pleased me, and «زيدٌ» was mentioned only as a lead-in to mentioning his generosity." He made that analogous to the saying of the Exalted: {والله وَرَسُولُهُ أَحَقُّ أَن يُرْضُوهُ} [al-Tawba: 62], {إِنَّ الذين يُؤْذُونَ الله وَرَسُولَهُ} [al-Aḥzāb: 57]. This of his is not satisfactory, because if attributing their deception to Allah the Exalted is valid on the aforementioned grounds, there is no necessity calling for claiming that the name of Allah the Exalted is redundant. As for «أعجبني زيدٌ وكرمُه», the pleasing is attributed to Zayd as a whole, then one of his attributes is conjoined to him, singling out this attribute from among all the attributes for its nobility; so in meaning it became analogous to the saying of the Exalted: {وملائكته وَرُسُلِهِ وَجِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَالَ} [al-Baqara: 98].
The pattern «فاعَلَ» has five meanings: participation in meaning, as in «ضاربَ زيدٌ عمراً» ("Zayd and ʿAmr struck one another"); agreement with the bare form, as in «جاوَزْتُ زيداً», i.e. «جُزْتُه» ("I passed Zayd"); agreement with transitive «أَفْعَل», as in «باعَدْتُ زيداً» and «أَبْعدته» ("I distanced Zayd"); substituting for «أَفْعل», as in «وارَيْتُ الشيءَ» ("I concealed the thing"); and for the bare form, as in «سافَرْت» ("I travelled"), «قاسَيْت» ("I endured") and «عاقَبْت» ("I punished"). In the verse, «فاعَلَ» may bear the first two meanings. As for participation: their deceiving Allah the Exalted — its meaning has preceded; Allah's deceiving them is in that He applied to them the rulings of the Muslims in this world; and the believers' deceiving them is their carrying out the command of Allah the Exalted concerning them. As for its being in the sense of the bare form, the reading of Ibn Masʿūd and Abū Ḥaywa, «يَخْدَعون», makes it clear.
Abū ʿAmr and the two Ḥaramīs [Nāfiʿ and Ibn Kathīr] read «وما يُخَادِعون» like the first, and the rest «وما يَخْدعون». The two readings may have a single meaning, i.e. «فاعَلَ» being in the sense of «فَعَل»; or the mufāʿala may be in its proper sense, I mean issuing from two parties: they deceive their souls, in that they make them wish for falsehoods, and their souls deceive them, in that they too make them wish for that; so it is as though it were a dialogue between two. This would be close to the saying of another:
175 - لم تَدْرِ ما لا ولستَ قائلَها ... عُمْرَكَ ما عِشْت آخرَ الأبدِ
ولم تُؤامِرْ نَفْسَيْكَ مُمْتَرِياً ... فيها وفي أختِها لم تَكَدِ
(You did not know what "no" is, and you will not say it as long as you live, to the end of time; nor did you consult your two souls, doubting about it and its sister — you did not even come close.)
And another said:
176 - يؤامِرُ نَفْسَيْهِ وفي العيشِ فُسْحَةٌ ... أَيَسْتَوْقِعُ الذُّوبانَ أَمْ لا يَطورُها
(He consults his two souls, while there is room in life: should he await the wolves, or not approach them?)
His saying «إلا أنفسَهم»: «إلا» is originally a particle of exception, and «أنفسَهم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). This exception is an emptied exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh), which is an expression [Translator's note: the source has the typo «عبادرة» for «عبارة»] for that in which what precedes «إلا» needs what follows it. Do you not see that «يُخادعون» needs an object? Similar to it is «ما قام إلا زيدٌ» ("none stood except Zayd"), for «قام» needs a fāʿil (agent). The complete (tāmm) exception is the opposite, i.e. that in which what precedes «إلاَّ» does not need what follows it, as in «قام القومُ إلا زيداً» ("the people stood except Zayd") and «ضربتُ القوم إلا بكراً» ("I struck the people except Bakr"): «قام» has taken its fāʿil and «ضربتُ» has taken its object. The condition of the emptied exception is that it come after a negation or what resembles it, such as interrogation and negation. [Translator's note: "and negation" (والنفي) here is probably a corruption of "and prohibition" (والنهي).] As for their saying «قرأتُ إلا يومَ كذا» ("I read except on such-and-such a day"), the meaning is upon an interpreted negation, its implied form being: "I did not leave off reading except on such-and-such a day." Similar to it are: {ويأبى الله إِلاَّ أَن يُتِمَّ نُورَهُ} [al-Tawba: 32] and {وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلاَّ عَلَى الخاشعين} [al-Baqara: 45]. Exception has many rulings which will come in detail in the course of the book, if Allah the Exalted wills.
It was also read «وما يُخْدَعون», passive, and it is explained on the basis that the original was «وما يُخْدَعون إلا عن أنفسِهم»; when the preposition was omitted it became accusative, in the manner of:
177 - تَمُرُّون الديار ولم تَعُوجوا ... . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
(You pass the dwellings and do not turn aside …)
And «يُخَدِّعون», from «خَدَّعَ» with doubling; and «يَخَدِّعون», with fatḥa on the yāʾ and doubling, the original being «يَخْتَدِعون», then it was assimilated.
{وَمَا يَشْعرونَ}: this verbal clause may have no grammatical position, because it is resumptive; or it may have a position, namely the accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «يَخْدعون», the meaning being: the evil consequence of their deception returns only upon themselves, while they are not aware of that. The object of «يَشْعُرون» is omitted because it is known, its implied form being: "and they are not aware that the evil consequence of their deception returns upon themselves", or "[they are not aware of] Allah's knowledge of them". It is better not to imply an object for it, because the purpose is to negate awareness of them altogether without regard to what it relates to. The first is called ellipsis for brevity (ḥadhf al-ikhtiṣār), meaning omitting something because of an indication; the second is called ellipsis of restriction (ḥadhf al-iqtiṣār), which is omitting something without an indication.
Al-shuʿūr (awareness) is perceiving a thing in a way that is subtle and hidden; it is derived from al-shaʿr (hair) because of its fineness. It was also said: it is perception by the senses, derived from al-shiʿār, which is the garment next to the body; and from it come mashāʿir al-insān, i.e. his five senses by which he perceives.

The saying of the Exalted: {وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لاَ تُفْسِدُواْ فِي الأرض}: the verse. «إذا» is an adverb of future time, and it usually carries the meaning of a condition. It is used only for something certain or whose occurrence is preponderant; for that reason it does not put [the verb] in the jussive except in poetry, since it differs from the conditional particles, which are for something merely possible. Among instances of the jussive is the poet's saying:
182 - تَرفعُ لي خِنْدِفٌ واللهُ يَرْفَعُ لي ... ناراً إذا خَمَدَتْ نيرانُهم تَقِدِ
(Khindif raises for me — and Allah raises for me — a fire which, when their fires die down, blazes.)
Another said:
183 - واستَغْنِ ما أغناك ربُّك بالغِنى ... تُصِبْكَ خَصَاصةٌ فَتَجَمَّلِ
(Be content with wealth as long as your Lord enriches you; [and when] want befalls you, bear it with dignity.)
[Translator's note: the verse as quoted here lacks «وإذا» before «تُصِبْكَ», which is the word that makes it an example of jussive after «إذا».]
And another's saying:
184 - إذا قَصُرَتْ أسيافُنا كان وصلُها ... خُطانا إلى أعدائِنا فَنُضَارِبِ
(When our swords fall short, their extension is our steps towards our enemies, and so we fight.)
His saying «فَنُضَارِبِ» is jussive because it is conjoined to the position of his saying «كان وصلُها». Al-Farazdaq said:
185 - فقام أبو ليلى إليه ابنُ ظَالمٍ ... وكان إذا ما يَسْلُلِ السيفَ يَضْرِبِ
(So Abū Laylā, Ibn Ẓālim, rose up to him; and whenever he drew the sword, he would strike.)
It may be for past time, like «إذ», just as «إذ» may be for the future, like «إذا». It is also used for surprise (al-mufājaʾa); in that case, does it remain a time adverb, or does it become an adverb of place, or a particle? There are three views, the soundest being the first, by presumption of continuity (istiṣḥāb al-ḥāl). Is it declinable in function (mutaṣarrifa) or not? The apparent view is that it is not. The one who claimed that it is adduced as evidence the saying of the Exalted, in the reading of whoever read: {إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الواقعة لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ خَافِضَةً رَّافِعَةً إِذَا رُجَّتِ الأرض رَجّاً} [al-Wāqiʿa: 1-4], with {خَافِضَةً رَّافِعَةً} in the accusative: he made the first «إذا» a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the second its khabar (predicate), the implied sense being: "the time of the occurrence of the Event is the time of the shaking of the earth." [He also adduced] His saying: {حتى إِذَا جَآءُوهَا} [al-Zumar: 71] and {حتى إِذَا كُنتُمْ} [Yūnus: 22], making «حتى» a preposition and «إذا» genitive by it. The verification of that will come in its places. It is put in construct only with verbal clauses, contrary to al-Akhfash.
The saying of the Exalted: «قيل» is a past verb, passive. Its original form is «قُوِلَ», like «ضُرِبَ» [Translator's note: the source prints «قُولَ»]; the kasra was found heavy on the wāw, so it was transferred to the qāf after its own vowel was removed; then the wāw became unvowelled after a kasra, so it was changed to yāʾ. This is the most eloquent of the dialectal forms. There is a second form in it, namely ishmām, and ishmām is an expression for making the vowel between ḍamma and kasra; and a third form, namely pure ḍamma, as in «قُوْلَ» and «بُوعَ»; the poet said:
186 - ليت وهل يَنْفَع شيئاً ليتُ ... ليت شباباً بُوْعَ فاشتريْتُ
(Would that — and does "would that" avail anything? — would that youth were sold [būʿa], so that I could buy it.)
Another said:
187 - حُوكَتْ على نِيْرَيْنِ إذ تُحاكُ ... تَخْتَبِطَ الشَّوْكَ ولا تُشَاكُ
(It was woven [ḥūkat] on two warp-threads when it was woven; it beats through thorns and is not pricked.)
Al-Akhfash said: "And «قُيْل» is permitted, with ḍamma on the qāf and the yāʾ", meaning with the yāʾ, not that the yāʾ also takes ḍamma. These three forms occur in «اختار», «انقاد», «رَدَّ», «حَبَّ» and the like; so you say «اختير» with kasra and with ishmām, and «اختُور»; likewise «انقيد» and «انقُود», and «رُدَّ» and «رِدَّ»; and they recited:
188 - وما حِلَّ مِنْ جَهْلٍ حُبا حُلَمائِنا ... ولا قائِلُ المعروفِ فينا يُعنَّفُ
(The sitting-cloths of our forbearing men are never loosed [ḥilla] out of folly, nor is one among us who speaks what is right rebuked.)
— with kasra on the ḥāʾ of «حِلَّ». And «ولو رِدُّوا» was read with kasra on the rāʾ. The rule for the verb whose agent is not named is that the first letter of the verb takes ḍamma absolutely; then, if it is past, the letter before the last takes kasra, either overtly, as in «ضُرِب», or by implication (taqdīran), as in «قِيلَ» and «اخْتِير»; and if it is imperfect, it takes fatḥa, overtly, as in «يُضْرَبُ», or by implication, as in «يُقال» and «يُختار». The second letter of the past may also take ḍamma if it begins with the tāʾ of reflexivity (muṭāwaʿa), as in «تُدُحْرج الحجرُ» ("the stone was rolled"), and the third if it begins with a connective hamza (hamzat waṣl), as in «انطُلِق بزيدٍ» ("Zayd was taken off").
Know that the condition for permitting the three forms in «قيل», «غيض» and the like is that it not cause ambiguity; if it causes ambiguity, one acts according to what avoids ambiguity. Thus some said, although Sībawayh permitted that without restriction. Al-Kisāʾī read with ishmām: {قيل} [al-Baqara: 11], {وغيض} [Hūd: 44], {وجيء} [al-Zumar: 69], {وحيل بينهم} [Sabaʾ: 54], {وسيق الذين} [al-Zumar: 71], {وسيىء بهم} [Hūd: 77] and {وسيئت وجوهُ} [al-Mulk: 27]. Hishām agreed with him in all of them, Ibn Dhakwān in «حيل» and what follows it, and Nāfiʿ in «سيئ» and «سيئَتْ»; the rest read with pure kasra in all of them. Ishmām has four meanings in the terminology of the Qur'an readers; that will come in [Sūrat] Yūsuf, if Allah the Exalted wills, at {مَا لَكَ لاَ تَأْمَنَّا} [Yūsuf: 11], for it is more fitting there.
«لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to «قيل»; the lām is for conveying (al-tablīgh). «لا» is a particle of prohibition that puts one verb in the jussive; «تُفْسِدوا» is jussive (majzūm) by it, the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn, because it is one of the five verb forms (al-amthila al-khamsa); and «في الأرضِ» is attached to it. What stands in place of the fāʿil (agent) [i.e. the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent)] is the clause «لا تُفْسِدوا», because it is what is said in meaning; Abū al-Qāsim al-Zamakhsharī chose this. The implied sense is: "and when this speech, or this utterance, is said to them"; so it is of the type of verbal predication (al-isnād al-lafẓī). It was also said: what stands in place of the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being: "and when it [a saying] is said to them"; and this latent pronoun is explained by the context of the speech, just as it explained it in His saying: {حتى تَوَارَتْ بالحجاب} [Ṣād: 32]. The meaning is: "and when a sound saying is said to them"; this qualified saying was made latent, and the clause after it came explicative, so it has no grammatical position. He said: "When semantic predication (al-isnād al-maʿnawī) is possible, one does not turn to verbal predication, and that is possible by what has preceded." Abū al-Baqāʾ preceded him in this view, for he said: "The object standing in place of the agent is a maṣdar (verbal noun), namely 'the saying', and it was made latent because the clause after it explains it; and it is not permitted for «لا تُفْسِدوا» to stand in place of the agent, because a clause cannot be an agent, so it cannot stand in place of an agent" — end of quote. The answer to that has preceded, namely that the meaning is: "and when this utterance is said to them". It is not permitted for «لهم» to stand in place of the agent except in the opinion of the Kufans and al-Akhfash, since according to them it is permitted to make something other than the direct object stand [in place of the agent] while a direct object is present. It is summed up from this that the clause «لا تُفْسدوا» is in the position of the nominative according to al-Zamakhsharī's view, and has no position according to the view of Abū al-Baqāʾ and those who followed him. The clause «قيل» and what falls within its scope is in the position of the genitive by the adverb's being put in construct with it. What governs «إذا», according to the majority, is its apodosis (jawāb), namely «قالوا»; the implied sense being: "they said, 'We are only reformers,' at the time of the one saying to them, 'Do not cause corruption.'" [Translator's note: «وقتَ القائل لهم» presumably stands for «وقتَ قولِ القائل لهم», "at the time of the saying of the one who says to them".] Some said: "What we choose is that the clause that comes after it and follows it puts it in the accusative, and that what follows it is not in the position of the genitive by construct, because it is a conditional particle; so its ruling is the ruling of the adverbs used for conditional requital. Just as when you say «متى تقمْ أقمْ» ("whenever you stand, I stand"), «متى» is accusative by the verb of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), so likewise «إذا»."
This speaker said: "What invalidates the doctrine of the majority is the permissibility of your saying «إذا قمت فعمورٌ قائمٌ» ("when you stand, then ʿAmr is standing") [Translator's note: «فعمورٌ» is a typo for «فعمرٌو»], and the occurrence of the «إذا» of surprise as its apodosis; for what follows the fāʾ and the «إذا» of surprise does not govern what precedes them." This is a clear objection.
His saying: {إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُونَ}: «إنَّ» is a particle restrained (makfūf) from governing by the redundant «ما»; for that reason a clause of any kind may follow it. It conveys restriction (al-ḥaṣr) according to some. Far off the mark is whoever claimed that «إنما» is compounded from the «إنَّ» of affirmation and the «ما» of negation, and that through the compounding a meaning arose that conveys restriction. Know that when the redundant «ما» follows «إنَّ» and its sisters, their governing is cancelled and their being specific to nouns goes away, as has passed — except «ليت», in which both treatments are permitted on the basis of what is heard. They recited the saying of al-Nābigha:
189 - قالتْ ألا ليتما هذا الحمامَُ لنا ... إلى حمامتِنا ونصفَُهُ فَقَدِ
(She said: "Would that these doves were ours, added to our dove, together with half of them — and that is enough.")
— with «الحمام» in the nominative and the accusative. Its governing is because its specificity [to nouns] remains, and its non-governing is by analogy with its sisters. Moreover, it has been related from Sībawayh concerning the verse that it is governing on the nominative reading as well, by making «ما» a relative meaning «الذي», like that in the saying of the Exalted: {إِنَّمَا صَنَعُواْ كَيْدُ سَاحِرٍ} [Ṭāhā: 69], with «هذا» the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ which is the referent, «الحَمام» a naʿt (adjective) of «هذا», and «لنا» the khabar of «ليت»; the referent is omitted even though the ṣila (relative clause) is not long. The implied sense is: "Would that that which is these doves were ours." This is better than claiming that it is not governing, because what requires governing — namely specificity — remains. Some claimed that when the redundant «ما» is attached to «إنَّ» and its sisters, governing is permitted in all of them.
«نحن» is a mubtadaʾ; it is a detached nominative pronoun for the speaker and those with him, or for one who magnifies himself. «مصلحون» is its khabar, and the clause is in the position of the accusative because it is quoted by «قالوا». The conditional clause, namely His saying «وإذا قيلَ لهم», is conjoined to the ṣila of «مَنْ», which is «يقولُ», i.e. "and among people is he who says, and among people is he who, when it is said to them, 'Do not cause corruption in the land,' they say …". It was also said: it may be resumptive. On these two views it has no grammatical position, for the reason given earlier; but it is part of a sentence on the first view and an independent sentence on the second. Al-Zamakhsharī and Abū al-Baqāʾ permitted it to be conjoined to «يَكْذِبُون», which is the khabar of «كانوا», so that its position is the accusative. Some refuted them on the grounds that what they permitted, on one of the two possibilities of «ما» in His saying {بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْذِبُونَ} — namely its being a relative meaning «الذي» — is a mistake, since there is no referent in it returning to the relative «ما»; and likewise if it is made maṣdariyya, for it needs a referent according to al-Akhfash and Ibn al-Sarrāj. The answer to this is that they permit that only while believing that «ما» is a particle relative (mawṣūla ḥarfiyya) [i.e. maṣdariyya]; as for the doctrine of al-Akhfash and Ibn al-Sarrāj, they are not bound to hold it. But it poses a difficulty for Abū al-Baqāʾ alone, for he considers «ما» being maṣdariyya weak, as has preceded.

Allah Teâlâ'nın {مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ الذي استوقد نَاراً} kavli: «مثلُهم» mübtedâdır; «كمثل» câr ve mecrûr olup onun haberidir; dolayısıyla babın kaidesi üzere mahzûf bir şeye müteallik olur. Teşbih kâfının hiçbir şeye müteallik olmadığını söyleyenlerin muhalefetine aldırış edilmez. Takdir: «مَثَلُهم مستقر كمثل» (Onların meseli … meseli gibi sabittir). Ebü'l-Bekā ve İbn Atıyye, kâfın haber olan bir isim olmasını caiz görmüşlerdir. Bunu şairin şu sözüne benzetmiştir:
207 - أَتَنْتَهُون ولن ينهى ذوي شَطَط ... كالطَّعْن يَذْهَبُ فيه الزيتُ والفُتُل
(Vazgeçecek misiniz? Haddi aşanları, içinde yağın ve fitillerin kaybolduğu (derin) bir mızrak darbesi gibisi vazgeçiremez.)
Bu, Ahfeş'in mezhebidir: Kâfın mutlak olarak isim olmasını caiz görür. Sîbeveyh'in mezhebi ise bunu ancak şiirde caiz görür. (Âyeti) beyitle benzetmesine gelince, durum onun dediği gibi değildir; çünkü beyitte, fâil olduğu için onu isim yapmak zorunda kalırız; âyet ise böyle değildir. Söylenmesi gereken şudur: Teşbih kâfının üç hâli vardır: Birincisi, isim olmasının taayyün ettiği (kesinleştiği) hâldir; bu, fâil olduğu veya bir harf ya da izafe ile mecrûr olduğu durumdur. Fâil örneği: «أتنتهون ولن يَنْهى…» beyti. Harf ile mecrûr olmasının örneği İmruülkays'ın şu sözüdür:
208 - وَرُحْنا بكابْنِ الماء يُجْنَبُ وَسْطَنا ... تَصَوَّبُ فيه العينُ طوراً وتَرْتقي
(Ortamızda yedekte çekilen, su kuşu gibi (hafif) bir atla akşamladık; göz ona bazen aşağı iner, bazen yukarı çıkar.)
Ve şu sözü:
209 - وَزَعْتُ بكالهَراوةِ أَعْوَجِيٍّ ... إذا جَرَت الرياحُ لها وِثابا
(Rüzgârlar estiğinde onlara sıçrayan, sopa gibi (ince ve sağlam) bir A'vecî atıyla (düşmanı) geri püskürttüm.)
İzafe ile mecrûr olmasının örneği şu sözdür:
210 - فَصُيِّروا مثلَ كعَصْفٍ مأكولْ ... . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
(Yenmiş ekin yaprağı gibisine döndürüldüler.)
İkincisi, harf olmasının taayyün ettiği hâldir; bu da «جاء الذي كزيدٍ» örneğinde olduğu gibi sıla olarak gelmesidir; çünkü onu isim yapmak, sıla uzun olmadığı hâlde mübtedâ olan âidin hazfını gerektirir; bu ise Basralılara göre imkânsızdır. Üçüncüsü, iki şeyin de caiz olduğu hâldir; bu da «زيد كعمرو» gibi bunların dışındaki durumlardır. Âyet-i kerîmede onun zâide olduğunu, yani (manasının) «مَثَلُهم مثلُ الذي» olduğunu iddia eden ve bunu «فَصُيِّروا مثل كعصف» sözüne benzeten kimse isabetten uzaklaşmıştır. Sanki o, «المِثْل» ile «المَثَل»i aynı manada kabul etmiştir. Doğru olan vecih, «المَثَل»in burada kıssa manasında olmasıdır; takdir: Onların vasfı ve kıssası, ateş yakmak isteyenin kıssası gibidir. Bu te'vile göre (kâf) zâide değildir. Ancak fethalı «المَثَل» aslında «شِبْه», «شَبَه» ve «شَبيه» gibi «مِثْل» ve «مثيل» manasındadır. Denildi ki: Bilakis aslında sıfat (vasıf) manasındadır. «ضَرَب مَثَلاً» sözündeki «المَثَل» ise, bazı yönlerden gariplik taşıyan, dilden dile dolaşan sözdür. Bu yüzden lafzı korunmuş ve değiştirilmemiştir; telafisi zor bir işte kusur eden herkese, muhatap ister tekil, ister ikil, ister çoğul, ister müzekker, ister müennes olsun, «الصيفَ ضَيّعْتِ اللبنَ» (Sütü yazın zayi ettin) denir; böylece (sözün asıl) kasdına delâlet etsin diye.
«الذي» izafe ile hafd mahallindedir. O, tekil müzekker için mevsûldür; ancak burada onunla çoğul kastedilmiştir. Bu yüzden {ذَهَبَ الله بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ} kavlinde manası gözetilmiş ve zamir ona çoğul olarak döndürülmüştür. Daha evlâ olanı şöyle denmesidir: «الذي», çoğul manası veren bir şeyin sıfatı olarak gelmiş, sonra o mevsûf, ona delâlet olduğu için hazfedilmiştir. Takdir: «مَثَلهم كَمَثَل الفريق الذي استوقد» (ateş yakmak isteyen topluluğun meseli gibi) veya «الجمعِ الذي استوقَدَ». Böylece bir defa sıfat gözetilmiş ve «استوقد» ile «حَوْلَه» sözlerinde zamir ona tekil olarak dönmüş; bir defa da mevsûf gözetilmiş ve «بنورِهم» ile «وتركَهم» sözlerinde zamir ona çoğul olarak dönmüştür.
Ebü'l-Bekā yanılarak bu âyeti, nûnun hafifletme için hazfedildiği şeyler babından saymış; aslının «الذين» olduğunu, sonra hazf ile hafifletildiğini söylemiştir. Sanki onu, Allah Teâlâ'nın diğer âyetteki {وَخُضْتُمْ كالذي خاضوا} [Tevbe: 69] kavli ve şairin şu sözü gibi kabul etmiştir:
