«السجود» sözlükte: zillete bürünmek ve boyun eğmektir; en son noktası alnı yere koymaktır. İbnü's-Sikkît: «O, meyletmektir» demiştir. Zeydü'l-Hayl şöyle demiştir:
356 - بجَمْعٍ تَضِلُّ البُلْقُ في حَجَراته ... ترى الأُكْمَ فيها سُجَّداً للحَوافِرِ
(Öyle bir orduyla ki alaca atlar onun kenarlarında kaybolur; orada tepeleri, toynaklara secde eder hâlde görürsün.)
[Toynakların yere bastığını ve tepelerin toynaklardan etkilenmesini secde kıldığını kastediyor.] Bir başkası da şöyle demiştir:
357 -. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ... سُجودَ النصارى لأَِحْبارِها
(… Hristiyanların din adamlarına secdesi gibi.)
Bazıları «سَجَد» ile «أَسْجد» arasını ayırmıştır: «سجد», alnını [yere] koydu; «أَسْجَدَ» ise başını eğip indirdi demektir. Şair şöyle demiştir:
358 - فُضُولَ أَزِمَّتِها أَسْجَدَتْ ... سُجودَ النَّصارى لأرْبابها
(Yularlarının artan kısımlarına, Hristiyanların rablerine secdesi gibi başlarını eğdiler.)
Bir başkası da şöyle demiştir:
359 - وقُلْنَ له أسْجِدْ لِلَيْلَى فَأَسْجدا ... . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
(Ona: «Leylâ için başını eğ» dediler, o da başını eğdi …)
Yani deve onun için başını eğdi. «دراهم الأسجاد», üzerinde kendilerine secde ettikleri suretler bulunan dirhemlerdir. Şair şöyle demiştir:
360 -. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . وافى بها كدَراهمِ الأَسْجادِ
(… onu [şarabı] secde suretli dirhemler gibi [parlak] olarak getirdi.)
«إبليس» hakkında ihtilaf edilmiştir. Bir görüşe göre alemiyet ve ucmet sebebiyle gayr-i munsarif olan yabancı bir isimdir; sahih olan budur. Bir görüşe göre de Allah Teâlâ'nın rahmetinden ümit kesmek ve ondan uzak olmak anlamındaki «الإبلاس»tan türemiştir. [Şair] şöyle demiştir:
361 - وفي الوُجوهِ صُفْرَةٌ وإبْلاسْ ... . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
(Yüzlerde sarılık ve ümitsizlik var …)
Bir başkası da şöyle demiştir:
362 - يا صاحِ هل تَعْرِفُ رَسْماً مُكْرَسَا ... قال نَعَمْ أَعْرِفُه وأَبْلَسَا
(Ey arkadaş, gübre izleri birikmiş bir yurt kalıntısı tanıyor musun? «Evet, tanıyorum» dedi — ve [o yurt] ıssız kalmıştı.)
Yani imardan ve onunla ünsiyetten uzaklaştı. Bunlara göre vezni «إِفْعِيل»dir. Onlara, munsarif olması gerektiği yönünde itiraz edilmiştir. Onlar, Arapça isimlerde benzeri bulunmadığı için yabancı isimlere benzediği şeklinde cevap vermişlerdir. Buna da, Arapçada benzerlerinin çok olduğu ileri sürülerek reddedilmiştir; «إزْميل», «إكليل», «إغْريض», «إخْريط» ve «إحْليل» gibi. Bir görüşe göre de Araplardan hiç kimse bu adı almadığı için dillerinde sanki yabancı bir kelime (dahîl) gibi olmuş ve yabancı isimlere benzemiştir. Bunda uzaklık vardır.
{أبى واستكبر} kavli: Zâhir olan, bu iki cümlenin «Peki ne yaptı?» diyene cevap olarak isti'nâfiyye olmasıdır; {إِلاَّ إِبْلِيسَ} kavli üzerinde vakf tamdır. Ebü'l-Bekâ şöyle demiştir: «[Bu cümleler] İblis'ten hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir; takdiri: 'Secdeyi istemeyerek ve ondan büyüklenerek terk etti'dir.» Dolayısıyla ona göre vakf «واستكبر» üzerinedir. O, Allah Teâlâ'nın {وَكَانَ مِنَ الكافرين} kavlinin de isti'nâfiyye olmasını ve hâl olmasını caiz görmüştür.
«الإباء»: kaçınmaktır (imtinâ'). Şair şöyle demiştir:
363 - وإما أَنْ يقولوا قَدْ أَبَيْنا ... وشَرُّ مواطِنِ الحَسَبِ الإِباءُ
(Ya da «Kabul etmedik» derler; şerefin [gösterileceği] en kötü yer, kaçınmaktır.)
O, nefy ifade eden fiillerdendir; bu yüzden ondan sonra müferrağ istisnâ gelmiştir. Allah Teâlâ şöyle buyurmuştur: {ويأبى الله إِلاَّ أَن يُتِمَّ نُورَهُ} [Tevbe: 32]. Meşhur olan, her ikisinde de fethayla «أبى يأبى»dır. Kıyas, muzâride aynü'l-fiilin kesralı olmasıydı; bu yüzden bazıları bunu dikkate alarak muzâraat harfini kesralı okumuş ve «تِئْبى», «نِئْبى» demiştir. Bir görüşe göre de elif boğaz harflerine benzediği için onun sebebiyle muzârinin aynü'l-fiili fethalı kılınmıştır. Bir görüşe göre her ikisinde de fethayla «أَبى يأبى»dır; kıyas, muzâride aynü'l-fiilin kesralı olmasıydı; bu yüzden bazıları bunu dikkate alarak muzâraat harfini kesralı okumuş ve «تئبى», «نئبى» demiştir. Bir görüşe göre de elif boğaz harflerine benzediği için onun sebebiyle muzârinin aynü'l-fiili fethalı kılınmıştır. [Mütercim notu: Bu iki cümle kaynakta aynen tekrarlanmıştır; tekrar olduğu gibi çevrilmiştir.] Bir görüşe göre de mâzîde kesra, muzâride fetha ile «أَبِيَ يأبى»dır; bu kıyasa uygundur. Buna göre, her ikisinde fethayla «أبى يأبى» diyenin, kesrayla «أبِيَ» diyenin muzârisiyle yetinmiş olması ve bunun «ركَن يركَنُ» ve onun babı gibi tedâhül (lehçelerin iç içe geçmesi) kabilinden olması muhtemeldir.
«استكبر», «تكبَّر» (büyüklendi) anlamındadır. Sıralamada ondan sonra olduğu hâlde kaçınmayı (الإباء) ona takdim etmesi, onun açık (zâhirî) fiillerden olmasından dolayıdır; büyüklenme ise böyle değildir, o kalp fiillerindendir. «وكان» kavli: Bir görüşe göre «صار» (oldu) anlamındadır; şairin şu sözünde olduğu gibi:
364 - بتَيْهاءَ قَفْرٍ والمَطِيُّ كأنَّها ... قطا الحَزْن قد كانَتْ فراخاً بيوضُها
(Issız, yolu kaybettiren bir çölde; binitler sanki sert arazinin bıldırcınları gibi; yumurtaları yavru olmuş [bıldırcınlar].)
Yani «قد صارَتْ» (olmuştu). İbn Fûrek bunu reddetmiş ve «Usul onu reddeder» demiştir. Daha açık olan, onun kendi asıl anlamı üzere olmasıdır. Anlam şudur: Rivayet edildiğine göre Âdem'in yaratılışından önce yeryüzünde bulunan kâfir kavimdendi; ya da: Allah'ın ilminde [kâfirlerden] idi.

Allah Teâlâ'nın {وَقُلْنَا يَاآدَمُ اسكن أَنْتَ وَزَوْجُكَ الجنة} sözü: Bu cümle «إذْ قلنا» cümlesine ma'tûftur; ikisinin zamanları farklı olduğu için yalnız «قُلْنا»ya ma'tûf değildir. «أنت», kendisine atfın sahih olması için «اسكُن» içindeki müstetir zamirin te'kîdidir; «زوجُك» de ona ma'tûftur. Bu, Basralıların mezhebidir; yani ma'tûfun aleyh bitişik merfû bir zamir olduğunda atfedilen iki öğe arasında bir ayırıcının (fasl) bulunmasını şart koşmalarıdır. Ayırıcının te'kîd olması şart değildir; [aksine] hangi ayırıcı olursa olsun yeter. Şu örnekte olduğu gibi: {مَآ أَشْرَكْنَا وَلاَ آبَاؤُنَا} [En'âm: 148]. Kûfeliler ise bunu ayırıcı olmaksızın caiz görürler ve şu beyti delil getirmişlerdir:
365 - قُلْتُ إذا أقبلَتْ وزهرٌ تَهادى ... كنعاجِ الفَلا تَعَسَّفْنَ رَمْلا
(Kadın ve Zühr [kadınları] çöl ceylanları gibi kumda yolsuz yürüyerek salınıp geldiklerinde dedim ki…)
Bu, Basralılara göre bir şiir zarureti olup üzerine kıyas yapılmaz. Bazıları «زوجُك»in «اسكُنْ» içindeki müstetir zamire ma'tûf olmasını kabul etmemiş, onu cümlelerin birbirine atfından saymıştır; yani «زوجُك» mahzûf bir fiille merfûdur, takdiri: «وَلْتَسْكُنْ زوجك» (zevcen de otursun); «اسكنْ» ona delâlet ettiği için hazfedilmiştir. Bunu Allah Teâlâ'nın {لاَّ نُخْلِفُهُ نَحْنُ وَلاَ أَنتَ} [Tâhâ: 58] sözüne benzetmiş ve bunun Sîbeveyh'in mezhebi olduğunu ileri sürmüştür. Bu konudaki şüphesi galiba şudur: Ma'tûfun hakkı, ma'tûfun aleyhin yerine geçebilmesidir; burada ise «زوجُك»in zamirin yerine geçmesi sahih değildir. Çünkü tekil müzekker emir fiilinin fâili, meselâ قُمْ ve اسكُنْ'de, ancak müstetir zamir olur; نفعلُ'ün fâili de böyledir. O hâlde zâhir ismin, ondan önceki zamirin yerine geçmesi nasıl sahih olur? Onun bu iddiası bir şey ifade etmez; çünkü Sîbeveyh'in açık sözü (nassı) buna muhaliftir. Ayrıca «تقوم هندٌ وزيدٌ» (Hind ve Zeyd kalkıyor) sözünün sıhhatinde ihtilaf yoktur; hâlbuki «تقوم» fiili müennes olduğundan Zeyd'in doğrudan «تقوم»un fâili olması sahih değildir.
السكون ve السُّكْنى: karar kılmak (istikrar) demektir. المِسْكينُ (miskin) kelimesi de buradandır; çünkü onun istikrarı, hareketi ve tasarrufu yoktur. السِّكِّينُ (bıçak) da böyledir; çünkü kesilen hayvanın hareketini keser. السَّكِينة de böyledir; çünkü onunla kaygı (kalak) gider.
«الجَنَّةَ»: mef'ûlün bihtir, zarf değildir; «سَكَنْتُ الدارَ» (eve yerleştim) gibi. Genişletme (ittisâ') yoluyla zarftır da denmiştir; aslında ona «في» ile geçişli olması gerekirdi, çünkü o muhtass (belirli) bir mekân zarfıdır. Kavilden (sözden) sonrakiler kavil ile mansûbdur.
{وَكُلاَ مِنْهَا رَغَداً} sözü: Bu cümle «اسكُنْ»a ma'tûftur; dolayısıyla kavil ile nasb mahallindedir. كُلْ'ün aslı iki hemzeyle أُأْكُلْ'dir: Birincisi vasl hemzesi, ikincisi kelimenin fâ'sıdır. Bu kelime bu asıl üzere gelseydi, ikinci hemze kendinden önceki harekeye uygun bir harfe çevrilerek اُوكُلْ denirdi. Ancak Araplar emir kipinde hafiflik için onun fâ'sını hazfetmişler, bu durumda vasl hemzesine ihtiyaç kalmamıştır; vezni عُلْ'dür. خُذْ ve مُرْ da bunun gibidir. Diğer fiiller bu fiillere kıyas edilmez; meselâ أَجَر'den جُرْ denmez. Araplar atıf hâlinde bu fâ'yı geri getirmezler; aksine قم وخذ وكُلْ derler. Yalnız «مُرْ» müstesnadır; onda vav ve fâ'dan sonra fâ'nın geri getirilmesi çoğunluktadır. Allah Teâlâ şöyle buyurmuştur: {وَأْمُرْ قَوْمَكَ} [A'râf: 145] ve {وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ} [Tâhâ: 132]; geri getirilmemesi azdır. Sîbeveyh, asıl üzere «اؤْكُلْ» şeklini de nakletmiştir; bu şâzdır.
İbn Atıyye şöyle demiştir: «"كُلا"dan nun [emir sebebiyle] hazfedilmiştir.» Bu ifade Kûfelilerin mezhebini çağrıştırmaktadır; daha önce geçtiği üzere onlara göre emir, kademeli olarak (tedrîcen) mu'reb'dir. Basralılara göre ise emir, meczûma hamledilir: Meczûm sâkin kılınırsa ondan yapılan emir de sâkin kılınır; meczûmdan bir harf hazfedilirse emirden de hazfedilir.
«منها»: ona (كُلا'ya) mütealliktir. «مِنْ» teb'îz içindir; mutlaka bir muzâfın hazfı gerekir, yani: «مِنْ ثمارِها» (onun meyvelerinden). «مِنْ»in ibtidâü'l-gâye (başlangıç) için olması da caizdir ve bu daha güzeldir. «رَغَداً»: mahzûf bir masdarın sıfatıdır. Daha önce geçtiği üzere Sîbeveyh'in bu ve benzerlerindeki mezhebi, hâl olarak mansûb olmasıdır. Hâl yerinde bir masdardır da denmiştir; yani: «Hoş ve afiyetle yiyenler olarak yiyin» (كُلا طيِّبَيْنِ مُهَنَّأَيْنِ).
Gayn'ın sükûnuyla «رَغْداً» şeklinde de okunmuştur; bu Temîm lehçesidir. Bazıları şöyle demiştir: Ayn'ül-fiili boğaz harfi (halkî) olup lâm'ı sahih olan her فعْل kalıbında ayn'ın fethası da sükûnu da caizdir; نهر ve بحر gibi. Bu görüşte nazar vardır (tartışmalıdır). Aksine nakledilen şudur: Basralılara göre ayn'ı sâkin olan فعْل kalıbında, ayn'ı halkî olduğunda, fethası caiz değildir; ancak semâ' yoluyla işitilirse onunla yetinilir ve bu iki lehçe olur; çünkü biri diğerinden alınmıştır. Kûfelilere gelince, onlara göre bunun bir kısmı iki lehçelidir, bir kısmının aslı sükûndur ve kıyasen fethası caizdir. Ayn'ı fethalı ve halkî olan فعَل kalıbında ise teskîn caiz olup السَّحَر'de السَّحْر denebileceğine gelince, bunu hiç kimse caiz görmez. الرغَدُ: geniş ve hoş (bol ve afiyetli) olandır. İmruülkays şöyle demiştir:
366 - بينما المرءُ تراهُ ناعماً ... يَأْمَنُ الأحداثَ في عيشٍ رَغَدْ
(Kişiyi bir bakarsın nimet içinde, bol ve rahat bir hayatta, musibetlerden emin…)
رَغُِدَ عيشُهم (geçimleri bollaştı) denir; gayn'ın dammesi ve kesresiyle. أَرْغَدَ القومُ: kavim bolluk içine girdi demektir.
{حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا} sözü: حيث mekân zarfıdır. Meşhur olan, bir cümleye muhtaç olmada harfe benzediği için damme üzere mebnî olmasıdır; harekesinin damme olması da «قبل» ve «بعد»e benzetildiği içindir. Kisâî, Fak'as (kabilesin)den onun mu'reb olduğunu nakletmiştir. Onda birçok lehçe vardır: Sâ'nın üç harekesiyle حيث, yine sâ'nın üç harekesiyle حَوْث; elifle حاث da nakledilmiştir. O, [zarflığı lâzımdır, tasarruf etmez (başka i'rab mevkilerinde kullanılmaz); bazen مِنْ ile mecrûr olur, Allah Teâlâ'nın şu sözlerinde olduğu gibi: {مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ} [Bakara: 222], {مِّنْ حَيْثُ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ} [A'râf: 182]. O] mutlak olarak bir cümleye izafeti lâzım olan bir kelimedir; müfrede ancak nadiren izafe edilir. Şair şöyle demiştir:
367 - أَمَا تَرى حيثُ سهيلٍ طالِعا ... . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
(Süheyl yıldızının doğduğu yeri görmez misin…)
Bir başkası şöyle demiştir:
368 - وَنَطْعَنُهم تحت الحُبَى بعد ضَرْبهم ... ببيضِ المواضي حيثُ لَيِّ العَمائم
(Keskin parlak kılıçlarla sarıkların dolandığı yerden vurduktan sonra onları ihtibâ yerlerinin altından mızraklarız.)
Bazen ona «ما» eklenir ve إنْ gibi şart ve cevap olarak iki fiili cezmeder; bir grubun aksine, «ما» olmadan onunla cezm yapılmaz. Bazen ta'lîl (sebep bildirme) manasını da yüklenir. Ahfeş onun zaman zarfı da olabileceğini ileri sürmüş ve şu beyti okumuştur:
369 - للفتى عَقْلٌ يَعيشُ به ... حيث تَهْدي ساقَهُ قَدَمُهْ
(Gencin, ayağının baldırını yönlendirdiği yerde/sürece kendisiyle yaşadığı bir aklı vardır.)
Bunda delil yoktur; çünkü o, kendi babı (asıl anlamı) üzeredir.
Burada ondaki âmil «كُلا»dır; yani onlara genişlik tanınarak: «Dilediğiniz her yerde yiyin.» Ebü'l-Bekā onun «الجنَّة»den bedel olmasını caiz görmüş ve «Çünkü الجنة mef'ûlün bihtir; dolayısıyla "حيث" de mef'ûlün bih olur.» demiştir. Bunda nazar vardır; çünkü daha önce geçtiği üzere o, «مِنْ» ile cer dışında tasarruf etmez.
«شِئْتُمَا» sözü: Cümle, zarfın ona izafesiyle cer mahallindedir. Şîn üzerindeki kesre, جِئْتُما ve خِفْتُما'daki gibi asıl mıdır, yoksa بِعْتما'da olduğu gibi yâlı fiillere delâlet etmek için fethadan mı çevrilmiştir? Bu konuda iki görüş vardır ve bunlar شَاءَ'nın vezninin ne olduğu meselesine dayanır: Müberred'in mezhebi onun ayn'ın fethasıyla فَعَل, Sîbeveyh'in mezhebi ise ayn'ın kesresiyle فَعِل olduğudur. İkisinin tasrifi gizli değildir.
{وَلاَ تَقْرَبَا هذه الشجرة} sözü: لا nehy (yasak) edatıdır; «تَقْرَبا» onunla meczûmdur, nunu hazfedilmiştir. Muzâri harfinin kesresiyle «تِقْرَبا» şeklinde de okunmuştur. Elif fâildir. «هذه»: mef'ûlün bihtir; müennes için ism-i işarettir. Onda birçok lehçe vardır: هذي, هذهِ, [هذهِ] — hâ'nın kesresiyle, işbâ'lı ve işbâ'sız —, hâ'nın sükûnuyla هذهْ ve yalnızca zâl'in kesresiyle ذِهْ. Hâ, gizlilikte (hafâ) yâ'ya yakın olduğu için yâ'dan bedeldir. İbn Atıyye — Nehhâs'tan da nakledildiğine göre — şöyle demiştir: «Kelâmda "هذه" dışında, öncesi meksur olan bir te'nîs hâ'sı yoktur.» Bunda nazar vardır; çünkü te'nîse delâlet eden o hâ, bu hâ değildir. Zira o hâ, vakıf hâlinde te'nîs tâ'sından bedeldir. Bu hâ'nın ise te'nîse hiçbir delâleti yoktur; aksine ona delâlet eden kelimenin bütünüdür. Nitekim «هذي»deki yâ için de "te'nîs içindir" dersin. Yakınlık, uzaklık, orta mesafe ile tenbîh hâ'sının ve hitap kâfının girmesi hususunda hükmü «ذا»nın hükmü gibidir; bu daha önce geçmiştir. Ona ayrıca تَيْك, تَيْلَكَ, تِلْكَ ve تالِك de denir. Şair şöyle demiştir:
370 - تعلَّمْ أنَّ بعدَ الغَيِّ رُشْدا ... وأنَّ لتالِكَ الغُمَرِ انْحِسَاراً
(Bil ki sapkınlığın ardından doğruluk gelir ve o sıkıntıların (kin ve dertlerin) de bir gün açılması vardır.)
Hişâm şöyle demiştir: «"تافَعَلَتْ" de denir.» Şu beyti okumuşlardır:
371 - خَليليَّ لولا ساكنُ الدارِ لم أُقِمْ ... بتا الدارِ إلاَّ عابرَ ابنِ سبيلٍ
(İki dostum! O evin sakini olmasaydı, bu evde ancak yoldan geçen bir yolcu gibi kalırdım.)
«الشجرةِ»: «هذه»den bedeldir. Müştak (türemiş isim) ile te'vil edildiği için onun sıfatıdır da denmiştir; yani: «Ağaçtan şu hazır olanı.» Meşhur olan şudur: İsm-i işaretten sonra müştak bir isim gelirse onun sıfatı olur; câmid bir isim gelirse ondan bedel olur. الشجَرةُ, ism-i cins olan الشَّجَر'in tekilidir; o, gövde üzerinde duran bitkidir, النجم (gövdesiz bitki) bunun aksidir. İkisinin tahkiki inşallah «Rahmân» sûresinde gelecektir. «الشجرة», şîn ve cîmin kesresiyle, cîmin sükûnuyla ve — mahreçte yakın olduğu için — cîmin yâ'ya çevrilmesiyle, şînin fethası ve kesresiyle de okunmuştur. Nitekim şu beyitte cîm, yâ'dan bedel kılınmıştır:
372 - يا رَبِّ إنْ كنْتَ قَبِلْتَ حَجَّتِجْ ... فلا يَزالُ شاحِجٌ يأتيكَ بِجْ
(Ya Rabbi! Eğer haccımı kabul ettiysen, anırarak yük taşıyan [bir hayvan] beni sana getirmeye devam etsin.)
Bununla حَجَّتي ve بي'yi kastetmektedir. Bir başkası şöyle demiştir:
373 - إذا لم يكُنْ فِيكُنَّ ظِلٌّ وَلاَ جَنًى ... فَأَبْعَدَكُنَّ اللهُ من شِيَرَاتِ
(Sizde ne gölge ne de devşirilecek meyve yoksa, Allah sizi uzak eylesin ey ağaçlar!)
Ebû Amr şöyle demiştir: «Bunu (şiyera kıraatini) ancak Mekke'nin Berberîleri ve siyahîleri okur.» الشجر ayrıca شَجْراء şeklinde de cemlenmiştir. Bu vezinde ancak şu cemiler gelmiştir: قَصَبَة / قَصْباء, طَرَفَة / طَرْفاء ve حَلَفة / حَلْفاء. Esmaî «lâm'ın kesresiyle حَلِفة» derdi. Sîbeveyh'e göre bu lafızlar hem tekil hem cemidir.
قَرِبْتُ الأمرَ أقرَبه dersin; mâzîde ayn'ın kesresi, muzâride fethasıyla; yani: «O işe bulaştım.» Cevherî şöyle demiştir: «قَرُب, dammeyle, يقرُبُ قُرْباً: yaklaştı demektir. قَرِبْتُهُ, kesreyle, قُرْبَاناً: [ona] yaklaştım demektir. قَرَبْتُ أقرُبُ قِرابَةً, كَتَبْتُ أكتُبُ كِتابة gibi: Seninle su arasında bir gecelik mesafe varken suya doğru yol aldığında söylenir.
Şöyle de denmiştir: Râ'nın fethasıyla لا تَقْرَبْ denirse manası "o fiile bulaşma"dır; dammeyle لاَ تَقْرُب denirse manası "ona yaklaşma"dır.»
{فَتَكُونَا مِنَ الظالمين} sözü: Bunda iki vecih vardır: Birincisi: «تَقْرَبَا»ya atfen meczûm olmasıdır; şu beyitte olduğu gibi:
374 - فقلت له: صَوِّبْ ولا تَجْهَدَنَّهُ ... فَيُذْرِكَ من أُخرى القَطَاةِ فَتَزْلَقِ
(Ona dedim ki: Aşağı yönelt (dizgini gevşet), atı fazla zorlama; yoksa seni sağrısının arkasından atar da kayıp düşersin.)
İkincisi: Nehyin cevabı olarak mansûb olmasıdır; Allah Teâlâ'nın {لاَ تَطْغَوْاْ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ} [Tâhâ: 81] sözünde olduğu gibi. Nasb, Basralılara göre «أَنْ»in gizlenmesiyle, Cermî'ye göre bizzat fâ ile, Kûfelilere göre ise "hilâf" (muhalefet) ile olur. Bunun gibi gelen her yerde durum böyledir.
{مِنَ الظالمين}: كان'ın haberidir. الظُلْمُ: bir şeyi yerinin dışında bir yere koymaktır. Kazılmayı hak etmediği hâlde kazılan toprağa «مظلومة» denmesi de buradandır. Nâbiğa ez-Zübyânî şöyle demiştir:
375 - إِلاَّ أَوارِيَّ لأَيَاً ما أُبَيِّنُهَا ... والنُّؤْيُ كالحوضِ بالمظلومةِ الجَلَدِ
(Güçlükle seçebildiğim ahır kazıkları ve sert, haksız yere kazılmış toprakta havuz gibi duran çadır hendeği müstesna.)
Yağmur ona gelmediği için «مظلومة» diye adlandırıldığı da söylenmiştir. Amr b. Kamîe şöyle demiştir:
376 - ظَلَمَ البطاحَ له انهِلاَلُ حَرِيصةٍ ... فصفَا النِّطافُ له بُعَيْدَ المُقْلَعِ
(Şiddetli bir sağanağın boşanması, yeri olmayan vadilere zulmetti (oraları sel bastı); dinince su birikintileri onun için duruldu.)
«مَنْ أشبه أباهَ فما ظَلَمْ» (Babasına benzeyen zulmetmemiştir, yani yersiz iş yapmamıştır) demişlerdir. Şair şöyle demiştir:
377 - بأبِهِ اقتدى عَدِيٌّ في الكَرَمْ ... ومَنْ يشابِهْ أَبَه فما ظَلَمْ
(Adî cömertlikte babasına uydu; babasına benzeyen zulmetmemiştir.)

His saying, Exalted is He: {وَقُلْنَا يَاآدَمُ اسكن أَنْتَ وَزَوْجُكَ الجنة}: this clause is conjoined to the clause «إذْ قلنا», not to «قُلْنا» alone, because their times differ. «أنت» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «اسكُن», so that conjoining to it becomes sound, and «زوجُك» is conjoined to it. This is the doctrine of the Basrans, I mean: the requirement of a separation between the two conjoined items when the one conjoined to is an attached nominative pronoun; and it is not required that the separator be a tawkīd — rather any separation whatsoever, as in: {مَآ أَشْرَكْنَا وَلاَ آبَاؤُنَا} [al-Anʿām: 148]. As for the Kufans, they permit that without a separator, and they cited:
365 - قُلْتُ إذا أقبلَتْ وزهرٌ تَهادى ... كنعاجِ الفَلا تَعَسَّفْنَ رَمْلا
(I said, when she approached, and Zahr [with her] swaying along like the wild cows of the desert treading across sand…)
To the Basrans this is poetic licence (ḍarūra), on which no analogy is built. Some have forbidden «زوجُك» from being conjoined to the latent pronoun in «اسكُنْ», and made it a conjoining of clauses, in the sense that «زوجُك» is nominative by an omitted verb, i.e. "and let your wife dwell" (وَلْتَسْكُنْ زوجك), omitted because «اسكنْ» indicates it; and he compared it with His saying, Exalted is He: {لاَّ نُخْلِفُهُ نَحْنُ وَلاَ أَنتَ} [Ṭā Hā: 58], and claimed that this is the doctrine of Sībawayh. It seems his doubt in that is that the conjoined item ought properly to be able to occupy the place of the item conjoined to, and here «زوجُك» cannot occupy the place of the pronoun, because the agent of a singular masculine imperative verb, such as قُمْ and اسكُنْ, can only be a latent pronoun, and likewise the agent of نفعلُ; so how could an overt noun stand in the place of the pronoun before it? What he claimed amounts to nothing, because Sībawayh's doctrine, by his explicit text, contradicts it, and because there is no disagreement over the soundness of «تقوم هندٌ وزيدٌ» (Hind and Zayd stand), although Zayd cannot directly follow «تقوم» because of its feminine form.
Sukūn and suknā mean: settling (istiqrār). From it comes al-miskīn (the destitute), because of his lack of settledness, movement and freedom of action; al-sikkīn (the knife), because it cuts off the movement of the slaughtered animal; and al-sakīna (tranquillity), because through it anxiety departs.
«الجَنَّةَ» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), not an adverb (ẓarf), as in: سَكَنْتُ الدارَ (I inhabited the house). It has also been said: it is an adverb by extension (ʿalā al-ittisāʿ), the original being that the verb is made transitive to it by «في», since it is a specific adverb of place. What comes after the verb "to say" is in the accusative by it.
His saying: {وَكُلاَ مِنْهَا رَغَداً}: this clause is conjoined to «اسكُنْ», so it is in the position of the accusative by the verb "to say". The origin of كُلْ is أُأْكُلْ with two hamzas: the first is the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl), and the second is the first radical (fāʾ) of the word. Had this word come according to this origin, one would say اُوكُلْ, changing the second into a letter consonant with the vowel before it; however, the Arabs dropped its first radical in the imperative for lightness, and thereupon dispensed with the connecting hamza, so its pattern is عُلْ. Like it are خُذْ and مُرْ, and no other verbs are measured by analogy on these verbs: you do not say جُرْ from أَجَر. The Arabs do not restore this first radical after a conjunction; rather they say: قم وخذ وكُلْ — except «مُرْ», for most commonly its first radical is restored after wāw and fāʾ. Allah the Exalted said: {وَأْمُرْ قَوْمَكَ} [al-Aʿrāf: 145] and {وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ} [Ṭā Hā: 132]; not restoring it is rare. Sībawayh reported «اؤْكُلْ» according to the origin, and it is anomalous (shādhdh).
Ibn ʿAṭiyya said: "The nūn has been dropped from «كُلا» [for the imperative]". This expression gives the false impression of the doctrine of the Kufans, that the imperative is, in their view, declinable (muʿrab) by gradual derivation, as has preceded; whereas to the Basrans it is treated like the jussive: if the jussive is made quiescent, the imperative from it is made quiescent, and if a letter is dropped from it, it is dropped from the imperative.
«منها» is attached to it, and «مِنْ» is partitive, and an omitted muḍāf must be supposed, i.e. "of its fruits". «مِنْ» may also be for the beginning of the extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya), and that is better. «رَغَداً» is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun). It has preceded that Sībawayh's doctrine in this and the like is that it is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). It has also been said: it is a maṣdar in the position of a ḥāl, i.e. "eat, the two of you, in goodness and ease".
It has been read «رَغْداً» with a quiescent ghayn, and this is the dialect of Tamīm. Some said: every word of the pattern with a guttural middle radical and a sound final radical may have its middle radical vowelled with fatḥa or made quiescent, as in nahr and baḥr. This is questionable; rather, what is transmitted is that faʿl with a quiescent middle radical, when its middle radical is guttural, may not be given fatḥa according to the Basrans unless it is heard, in which case one restricts oneself to it, and that is then on the basis of two dialects, because one of them is taken from the other. As for the Kufans, some of this is in their view a word with two dialectal forms, and some of it originally has sukūn and may be given fatḥa by analogy. As for the claim that faʿal, with an open, guttural middle radical, may be made quiescent, so that al-saḥr is permitted for al-saḥar — this no one permits. Al-raghad: ample and pleasant. Imruʾ al-Qays said:
366 - بينما المرءُ تراهُ ناعماً ... يَأْمَنُ الأحداثَ في عيشٍ رَغَدْ
(While you see a man living in comfort, feeling safe from misfortunes in an ample life…)
One says: رَغُِدَ عيشُهم (their life became ample) with ḍamma and kasra on the ghayn, and أَرْغَدَ القومُ: the people came into ampleness.
His saying: {حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا}: حيث is an adverb of place. The well-known view is that it is indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, because it resembles a particle in needing a clause; and its vowel is ḍamma by assimilation to «قبل» and «بعد». Al-Kisāʾī transmitted its declension from the tribe of Faqʿas. It has dialectal forms: حيث with all three vowels on the thāʾ, and حَوْث likewise with all three; حاث with alif has also been transmitted. It is restricted [to adverbial use and is not freely inflected, though it may be put in the genitive by مِنْ, as in His saying, Exalted is He: {مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ} [al-Baqara: 222], {مِّنْ حَيْثُ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ} [al-Aʿrāf: 182]; and it is restricted] to annexation to a clause absolutely, and is not annexed to a single word except rarely. He said:
367 - أَمَا تَرى حيثُ سهيلٍ طالِعا ... . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
(Do you not see where Canopus is, rising…)
And another said:
368 - وَنَطْعَنُهم تحت الحُبَى بعد ضَرْبهم ... ببيضِ المواضي حيثُ لَيِّ العَمائم
(We pierce them beneath the waist-wraps after striking them with gleaming, sharp blades where the turbans are wound.)
«ما» may be added to it, and it then puts two verbs in the jussive, as protasis and apodosis, like إنْ; it does not put them in the jussive without «ما», contrary to some people. It may also be imbued with the sense of causation. Al-Akhfash claimed that it can be an adverb of time and cited:
369 - للفتى عَقْلٌ يَعيشُ به ... حيث تَهْدي ساقَهُ قَدَمُهْ
(The young man has a mind by which he lives, wherever his foot guides his leg.)
There is no proof in it, because it is in its normal sense there.
What governs it here is «كُلا», i.e. "eat, the two of you, in whatever place you wish", as a granting of latitude to them. Abū al-Baqāʾ permitted it to be a badal (substitute) of «الجنَّة»; he said: "because al-janna is a direct object, so «حيث» would be a direct object". This is questionable, because it is not freely inflected, as has preceded, except for being put in the genitive by «مِنْ».
His saying: «شِئْتُمَا»: the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation of the adverb to it. Is the kasra on the shīn original, as in your saying جِئْتُما and خِفْتُما, or transformed from a fatḥa to indicate that the root has yāʾ, as in بِعْتما? Two views, built on what the pattern of شَاءَ is: al-Mubarrad's doctrine is that it is faʿala with a fatḥa on the middle radical, and Sībawayh's doctrine is that it is faʿila with a kasra on it; the morphology of both is evident.
His saying: {وَلاَ تَقْرَبَا هذه الشجرة}: lā is prohibitive, and «تَقْرَبا» is jussive by it, its nūn having been dropped. It has been read «تِقْرَبا» with a kasra on the imperfect prefix. The alif is the fāʿil (agent), and «هذه» is a mafʿūl bihi, the demonstrative for the feminine. It has dialectal forms: هذي, هذهِ [and هذهِ] with a kasra on the hāʾ, with lengthening and without it, هذهْ with the hāʾ quiescent, and ذِهْ with a kasra on the dhāl alone. The hāʾ is a substitute for the yāʾ, because of its closeness to it in faintness. Ibn ʿAṭiyya said — and it has also been transmitted from al-Naḥḥās —: "There is in the language no feminine hāʾ preceded by a kasra other than «هذه»." This is questionable, because that hāʾ which indicates the feminine is not this one, since that one is a substitute for the feminine tāʾ in pause; whereas this hāʾ has no indication of the feminine; rather what indicates it is the word as a whole, just as you say: the yāʾ in «هذي» is for the feminine. Its rule as regards nearness, distance and the intermediate, and the entry of the hāʾ of alerting and the kāf of address, is the rule of «ذا», which has preceded. One also says for it: تَيْك, تَيْلَكَ, تِلْكَ and تالِك. The poet said:
370 - تعلَّمْ أنَّ بعدَ الغَيِّ رُشْدا ... وأنَّ لتالِكَ الغُمَرِ انْحِسَاراً
(Know that after error comes right guidance, and that those floods of trouble have a receding.)
Hishām said: "One also says: تافَعَلَتْ", and they cited:
371 - خَليليَّ لولا ساكنُ الدارِ لم أُقِمْ ... بتا الدارِ إلاَّ عابرَ ابنِ سبيلٍ
(My two friends, were it not for the one who dwells in the house, I would not have stayed at this house except as a passing wayfarer.)
«الشجرةِ» is a badal of «هذه»; it has also been said: a naʿt of it, being interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "this one present among the trees". The well-known view is that when a derived word comes after a demonstrative, it is its naʿt, and if it is a non-derived (jāmid) noun, it is a badal of it. Al-shajara is the singular of al-shajar, a generic noun, and it is what stands on a trunk, unlike al-najm (stemless plants); their precise treatment will come in Sūrat al-Raḥmān, if Allah the Exalted wills. It has been read «الشجرة» with kasra on the shīn and the jīm, and with the jīm quiescent, and with the jīm replaced by yāʾ, with fatḥa or kasra on the shīn, because of its closeness to it in point of articulation, just as jīm was substituted for yāʾ in his saying:
372 - يا رَبِّ إنْ كنْتَ قَبِلْتَ حَجَّتِجْ ... فلا يَزالُ شاحِجٌ يأتيكَ بِجْ
(O Lord, if You have accepted my pilgrimage, then may a braying [mount] keep coming to You with me.)
By that he means حَجَّتي and بي. Another said:
373 - إذا لم يكُنْ فِيكُنَّ ظِلٌّ وَلاَ جَنًى ... فَأَبْعَدَكُنَّ اللهُ من شِيَرَاتِ
(If there is in you neither shade nor fruit, then may Allah banish you, O trees.)
Abū ʿAmr said: "Only the Berbers of Mecca and its Blacks read it so." Al-shajar has also been pluralized as shajrāʾ, and no plural has come on this pattern except qaṣaba / qaṣbāʾ, ṭarafa / ṭarfāʾ and ḥalafa / ḥalfāʾ; al-Aṣmaʿī used to say: "ḥalifa, with a kasra on the lām". According to Sībawayh these words are both singular and plural.
You say: قَرِبْتُ الأمرَ أقرَبه, with a kasra on the middle radical in the past and a fatḥa in the imperfect, i.e. "I became involved in it". Al-Jawharī said: "قَرُب with ḍamma, يقرُبُ, قُرْباً, i.e. he drew near; and قَرِبْتُهُ with kasra, قُرْبَاناً: I drew near [to it]; and قَرَبْتُ أقرُبُ قِرابَةً, like كَتَبْتُ أكتُبُ كِتابة, when you journey towards water and there is one night between you and it.
It has been said: when one says لا تَقْرَبْ with a fatḥa on the rāʾ, its meaning is 'do not become involved in the act', and when one says لا تَقْرُب with ḍamma, its meaning is 'do not draw near to it'."
His saying: {فَتَكُونَا مِنَ الظالمين}: there are two aspects in it. The first: that it is jussive, conjoined to «تَقْرَبَا», as in his saying:
374 - فقلت له: صَوِّبْ ولا تَجْهَدَنَّهُ ... فَيُذْرِكَ من أُخرى القَطَاةِ فَتَزْلَقِ
(So I said to him: "Keep low, and do not overtax it, lest it toss you from the back of its rump and you slip off.")
The second: that it is accusative as the answer to the prohibition, like His saying, Exalted is He: {لاَ تَطْغَوْاْ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ} [Ṭā Hā: 81]. The accusative is by an implied «أَنْ» according to the Basrans, by the fāʾ itself according to al-Jarmī, and by divergence (al-khilāf) according to the Kufans; and so it is with everything that comes like this.
{مِنَ الظالمين} is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. Al-ẓulm: putting a thing in other than its place; hence land that did not deserve digging and was dug is called maẓlūma ("wronged"). Al-Nābigha al-Dhubyānī said:
375 - إِلاَّ أَوارِيَّ لأَيَاً ما أُبَيِّنُهَا ... والنُّؤْيُ كالحوضِ بالمظلومةِ الجَلَدِ
(Except tethering-posts, which I can make out only with difficulty, and the trench [around the tent] like a trough in the "wronged", hard ground.)
It has also been said: it was called maẓlūma because rain does not come to it. ʿAmr ibn Qamīʾa said:
376 - ظَلَمَ البطاحَ له انهِلاَلُ حَرِيصةٍ ... فصفَا النِّطافُ له بُعَيْدَ المُقْلَعِ
(The pouring of a scouring rain "wronged" the valley-beds for it, so the pools cleared for it shortly after it ceased.)
And they said: "Whoever resembles his father has not done wrong." He said:
377 - بأبِهِ اقتدى عَدِيٌّ في الكَرَمْ ... ومَنْ يشابِهْ أَبَه فما ظَلَمْ
(ʿAdī followed his father's example in generosity, and whoever resembles his father has done no wrong.)

His saying: {قُلْنَا اهبطوا}: He repeated His saying «قُلْنا» only because the two descents differ with respect to what each is connected with: with the first descent [He connected the enmity, and with the second He connected the coming of guidance. It has also been said: "because the first descent] is from the Garden to heaven, and the second from heaven to the earth." Some considered this far-fetched because of His saying: {وَلَكُمْ فِي الأرض مُسْتَقَرٌّ}. [Translator's note: the printed text has «واستَعْبَدَه», evidently a misprint for «واستبعده» (considered it far-fetched); rendered by sense.] Ibn ʿAṭiyya said: "Al-Naqqāsh related that the second descent is only from the Garden to heaven, and the first in the order of the verse is only to the earth, and it is the last in occurrence." End of quotation. It has also been said: it was repeated by way of emphasis, as in your saying: قُمْ قُمْ (stand, stand). The pronoun in «منها» refers to the Garden or to heaven.
His saying: «جميعاً» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of «اهبِطوا», i.e. "together": either at one time or at separate times, because what is meant is sharing in the basic act. This [is] the difference between جاؤوا جميعاً (they all came) and جاؤوا معاً (they came together): your saying «معاً» entails their coming all at one time, because of the accompaniment which «مع» indicates, unlike «جميعاً», which conveys only that none of them stayed behind from coming, without touching on the unity of time. This question arose between Thaʿlab and someone else; that man did not know it, and Thaʿlab informed him of it.
«جميع» is originally one of the words of tawkīd (emphasis), like «كُل», and some counted it with them. Ibn ʿAṭiyya said: "جميعاً is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «اهبِطوا»; it is neither a maṣdar (verbal noun) nor an active participle, but it is a substitute for them, indicating them, as though He had said: 'a descending all together' or 'descenders all together'." It seems he means that the ḥāl in reality is omitted and that «جميعاً» is a tawkīd of it; however, supposing it as a maṣdar negates making it a ḥāl, except by an interpretation that is not needed. Some said: the implied form is: "We said: descend, together; so they descended all together" — the ḥāl was omitted from the first because the second indicates it, and the governor was omitted from the second because the first indicates it. This is a strained construction to which no necessity calls.
His saying: {فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدًى فَمَن تَبِع} … the verse. The fāʾ is ordering and sequential. «إمَّا» is originally the conditional إن with «ما» added to it for emphasis. «يأتينَّكم» is in the position of the jussive by the condition, because it has been made indeclinable (mabnī) owing to its being attached to the nūn of emphasis. It has also been said: rather it is declinable absolutely; and it has been said: indeclinable absolutely. The correct view is the detailed one: if the nūn is directly attached to it, as in this verse, it is indeclinable; otherwise it is declinable, as in: هل يقومانِّ؟ It was made indeclinable on fatḥa seeking lightness; it has also been said: rather it was made indeclinable on sukūn and vowelled with fatḥa because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. Al-Zajjāj and al-Mubarrad held that a verb occurring after the conditional إن reinforced by «ما» must be emphasized with the nūn; they said: for that reason the Revelation has come only with it. Sībawayh held that it is permissible, not obligatory, because of how often it has come in poetry without emphasis; its frequent occurrence without emphasis indicates that it is not obligatory. Of that is his saying:
387 - فإمَّا تَرَيْني كابنةِ الرَّمْلِ ضاحياً ... على رِقَّةٍ أَحْفَى ولا أَتَنَعَّلُ
(If you see me like the daughter of the sand [the snake?], exposed to the sun, going barefoot on thin soles and wearing no sandals…)
And another's saying:
388 - يا صاحِ إمَّا تَجِدْني غيرَ ذي جِدَةٍ ... فما التَخلِّي عن الخُلاَّنِ من شِيَمي
(O friend, if you find me without wealth, yet abandoning friends is not among my traits.)
And another's saying:
389 - زَعَمَتْ تُماضِرُ أنَّني إمَّا أَمُتْ ... يَسْدُدْ أُبَيْنُوها الأَصاغِرُ خُلَّتي
(Tumāḍir claimed that if I die, her little sons will fill the gap I leave.)
[Translator's note: the verse numbers here are printed in the source as «38 - 9-», «39 - 0-», «39 - 1-», i.e. 389, 390, 391.]
And another's saying:
390 - فإمَّا تَرَيْني ولِي لِمَّةٌ ... فإنَّ الحوادثَ أودى بِها
(If you see me, and I have my locks, [know that] misfortunes have done away with them.)
And another's saying:
391 - فإمَّا تَرَيْني لا أُغَمِّضُ ساعةً ... مِن الدهرِ إلا أَنْ أَكِبَّ فَأَنْعَسَا
(If you see me not closing my eyes for an hour of time unless I bend over and doze…)
And another's saying:
392 - إمَّا تَرَيِْني اليومَ أمَّ حَمْزِ ... قارَبْتُ بينَ عَنَقي وجَمْزِي
(If you see me today, O Umm Ḥamz, having shortened the distance between my brisk pace and my leaping…)
Al-Mahdawī said: "«إما» is the conditional إنْ, with «ما» added to it so that the nūn of emphasis may properly enter the verb; had «ما» been dropped, the nūn would not enter. So «ما» reinforces the beginning of the utterance and the nūn reinforces its end." Ibn ʿAṭiyya followed him. Someone said: "This which the two of them held — that the nūn is necessary for the verb of the protasis when إنْ is joined with «ما» — is the doctrine of al-Mubarrad and al-Zajjāj." End of quotation. But there is nothing in their words indicating that the nūn is necessary, as you see; the most it contains is that they made the addition of «ما» to «إنْ» a condition for the soundness of emphasizing it with the nūn; as for whether the emphasis is necessary or not, they did not touch on it. Emphasis of the protasis has come without «إنْ», as in his saying:
393 - مَنْ نَثْقَفَنْ منهم فليس بآئِبِ ... أبداً وقتلُ بني قُتَيْبَةَ شافي
(Whoever of them we catch will never return, and the killing of Banū Qutayba is a cure.)
«مني» is attached to «يَأْتِيَنَّ», and it is for the beginning of the extent, figuratively. It may also be in the position of a ḥāl from «هُدَىً», because it is originally the adjective of an indefinite noun put before it; it parallels what preceded in His saying, Exalted is He: {مِن رَّبِّهِ كَلِمَاتٍ} [al-Baqara: 37]. «هُدى» is the fāʿil (agent). The fāʾ together with what comes after it, in His saying {فَمَن تَبِعَ}, is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the first condition, and the fāʾ in His saying, Exalted is He, {فَلاَ خَوْفٌ} is the apodosis of the second; the [second] condition [and its apodosis have occurred as the apodosis of the first. It has been transmitted from al-Kisāʾī that His saying {فَلاَ خَوْفٌ} is the apodosis of both conditions] together. Ibn ʿAṭiyya said, after transmitting it from al-Kisāʾī: "So it has been related, and it is questionable; there is no reason to differ from Sībawayh here. The disagreement is only in the likes of His saying: {فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ المقربين فَرَوْحٌ} [al-Wāqiʿa: 88-89], where Sībawayh says: the apodosis of one of the two conditions is omitted because His saying «فَرَوْحٌ» indicates it, while the Kufans say «فَرَوْح» is the apodosis of both conditions. As for this verse, the meaning prevents «فلا خوف» from being the apodosis of both conditions." It has also been said: the apodosis of the first condition is omitted, its implied form being: "If guidance comes to you from Me, then follow it", and His saying {فَمَنْ تَبِع} is an independent clause. This too is far-fetched.
«مَنْ» may be conditional, which is the apparent view; it may also be a relative, the fāʾ entering its khabar (predicate) by assimilating it to the condition; but there is no need for this.
If it is conditional, «تبع» is in the position of the jussive, and likewise «فلا خَوْفٌ», since they are protasis and apodosis; if it is a relative, «تَبِع» has no position. When it is said to be conditional, it is also a mubtadaʾ (subject), but there is a well-known disagreement over its khabar. The more correct view is that it is the verb of the protasis, as proven by the fact that a pronoun must refer from the protasis verb to the conditional noun, while that is not necessary in the apodosis. You say: مَنْ يَقُمْ أُكْرِمْ زيداً (whoever stands, I shall honour Zayd), [and there is no pronoun in «أُكرم زيداً» referring to «مَنْ»; had it been the khabar, a pronoun would have been necessary in it]; and if you said «مَنْ يَقُمْ زيداً أُكْرِمْه», referring the hāʾ to «مَنْ», it would not be permissible, because the protasis verb lacks the pronoun. It has also been said: the khabar is the apodosis; those holding this must bring in it a pronoun referring to the conditional noun, so that «مَنْ يَقُمْ أُكْرِمْ زيداً» is not permissible in their view — yet it is permissible. This is what Abū al-Baqāʾ adduced. The precise treatment of the necessity of a pronoun referring from the apodosis to the conditional noun will come at His saying, Exalted is He: {مَن كَانَ عَدُوّاً لِّجِبْرِيلَ} [al-Baqara: 97]. It has also been said: the protasis and apodosis together are the khabar, because the useful information is obtained only from both. And it has been said: whichever contains a pronoun referring to the mubtadaʾ is the khabar.
The well-known reading is «هُدَايَ»; it has also been read هُدَيَّ, changing the alif into yāʾ and assimilating it into the yāʾ of the first person. This is the dialect of Hudhayl; they say for عَصاي: عَصَيَّ. Their poet said, lamenting his sons:
394 - سَبَقوا هَوَيَّ وأَعْنَقُوا لِهَوَاهُمُ ... فَتُخُرِّمُوا ولكلِّ جَنْبٍ مَصْرَعُ
(They outran my wish and hastened to their own desire, and so were cut off — and every side has its place of falling.)
It is as though, since they could not give what the first-person yāʾ requires — a kasra on what precedes it — because it is an alif, they brought what is akin to the kasra and changed the alif into yāʾ. This is a regular usage in their dialect, unless the alif is that of the dual, for they keep it, as in: جاء مسلمايَ وغلامايَ.
His saying: {فَلاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ}: it has preceded that it may be the apodosis of the condition, and so in the position of the jussive; and that it may be the khabar of «مَنْ» if it is said to be a relative — which is preferable because it is matched by the relative in His saying {والذين كَفَرواْ} — and so in the position of the nominative. «لا» may govern like laysa, so that «خوفٌ» is its noun and «عليهم» is in the position of the accusative as its khabar; and it may be non-governing, so that «خوفٌ» is a mubtadaʾ and «عليهم» is in the position of the nominative as its khabar. This is preferable to the former for two reasons. The first: its governing like laysa is rare, and it is established only by something open to interpretation, namely his saying:
395 - تَعَزَّ فلا شيءٌ على الأرضِ باقياً ... ولا وَزرٌ ممَّا قضى اللهُ واقِيَا
(Be consoled, for nothing on earth is lasting, and there is no refuge that shields from what Allah has decreed.)
The second: the clause after it, {وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ}, determines that «لا» in it is non-governing, because it does not govern definite nouns; so making it non-governing here matches what comes after it. Someone erred and made it govern a definite noun, adducing his saying:
396 - وحَلَّتْ سوادَ القلبِ لا أنا باغياً ... سِواها في حُبِّها مُتَراخِيا
(She settled in the core of the heart; I am not seeking another besides her, nor slackening in my love for her.)
so that «أنا» is its noun and «باغياً» its khabar. It was said: there is no proof in it, because «باغياً» is a ḥāl whose governor is omitted, and that is in reality the khabar, its implied form being: "nor am I seen seeking"; or the implied form is: "nor am I seen (لا أُرَى) seeking", and when the verb was omitted, the pronoun became detached.
It has been read «فلا خَوْفُ» in the nominative without tanwīn. The best view of it is that an annexation is implied, i.e. "fear of anything"; it has also been said: because it is in the intention of the article al-; and it has been said: the tanwīn was dropped for lightness. It has also been read «فلا خوفَ», indeclinable on fatḥa, because it is the lā of exculpation (lā al-tabriʾa, i.e. generic negation), which is more emphatic in negation. But people preferred the nominative reading. Abū al-Baqāʾ said: "For two reasons. The first: that something has been conjoined to it in which only the nominative is possible, namely His saying «ولا هم», because it is definite and «لا» does not govern definite nouns; so it is preferable that what it is conjoined to be likewise, so that the two clauses match." Then he compared it with their saying «قام زيد وعمراً كلَّمْتُه» (Zayd stood, and ʿAmr I spoke to him), meaning in the preference for the accusative in the clause of preoccupation (ishtighāl) for the sake of matching. Then he said: "The second reason is from the side of meaning, namely that the indeclinable form indicates negation of fear from them altogether, and that is not what is meant; rather what is meant is negating it from them in the Hereafter. If it is said: why should not the reason for the nominative be that this speech is mentioned as the reward of those who follow the guidance, and it does not befit that slight fear be negated from them while the presence of great fear is imagined? It is answered: with the nominative the negation of great fear may be implied, its implied form being: 'no great fear is upon them', so that the presence of slight fear is imagined — the reverse of what was supposed in the question. So it is clear that the reason for the nominative is what we mentioned." End of quotation.
His saying, Exalted is He: {وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ}: it has preceded that it is a negated clause and that the correct view is that «لا» is non-governing; «يَحْزنون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and on that weak view it would be in the position of the accusative.
Al-khawf: alarm and fright. One says: خافَ يخاف, so he is خائِف (afraid). The origin is خَوِف on the pattern of عَلِمَ [Translator's note: the printed text has «بزون», a misprint for «بوزن» (on the pattern of)]. It is made transitive by the hamza and by doubling; the Exalted said: {وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ} [al-Isrāʾ: 60]. It is only about a future matter. Al-ḥuzn is the opposite of joy, taken from al-ḥazn, which is rugged ground, as though it were rugged anxiety; it is only about a past matter. One says: حَزِن يَحْزَن حُزْناً وحَزَناً. It is made transitive by the hamza, as in أَحْزَنْتُه, and حَزَّنْتُه with the same meaning, so faʿʿala and afʿala are of one meaning. It has also been said: أَحْزَنَه means he caused him grief. It has also been said: the fatḥa makes the verb transitive, as in شَتِرَتْ عينُه (his eyelid was split) and شَتَرها الله (Allah split it); this is on the view of those who hold that a vowel makes the verb transitive. It has been read in both dialectal forms, «حَزَنَه» and «أَحْزَنه», and their precise treatment will come.

{والذين كَفَرواْ … خَالِدُونَ} sözü: «الذين» mübtedâdır; sonrası sıla ve âiddir (dönen zamirdir). «بآياتنا»: كذَّبوا'ya mütealliktir. Ayetin i'mâl (tenâzu') babından olması da caizdir; çünkü «كفروا» da onu talep eder; birinciden hazf yapıldığı için ikincinin amel ettirilmesi kabilinden olur. Takdiri: «كفروا بنا وكَذَّبوا بآياتِنا» (Bizi inkâr ettiler ve ayetlerimizi yalanladılar). «أولئك» ikinci mübtedâ, «أصحابُ» onun haberidir; cümle birincinin haberidir. «أولئك»in mevsûlden bedel veya ona atf-ı beyân olması, «أصحابُ»ün de mevsûl olan mübtedânın haberi olması da caizdir. {هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ} sözü: Hâl olarak nasb mahallinde bir isim cümlesidir; çünkü bu, birçok yerde açıkça zikredilmiştir. Allah Teâlâ {أَصْحَابُ النار خَالِدِينَ} [Teğâbün: 10] buyurmuştur. Ebü'l-Bekā onun «النار»dan hâl olmasını caiz görmüş ve şöyle demiştir: «Çünkü onda ona dönen bir zamir vardır; ondaki âmil de izafet manası veya takdir edilen lâm olur.» (Alıntı bitti.) Bundaki husus bilinmektedir.
«أولئك»in haberi olarak ref' mahallinde olması da caizdir; bu durumda da ondan iki haberle haber verilmiş olur: Biri müfreddir, o da «أصحابُ»dür; [diğeri] cümledir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «أحدُهما مفردٌ وهو «أصحابُ» . جملةٌ» şeklinde ifade eksik görünmektedir; «والآخر» gibi bir kelime düşmüş olabilir.] Bundaki ihtilaf da bilinmektedir.
«فيها»: «خالدون»a mütealliktir. Şöyle demişlerdir: Birinci sözden ikincide ispat edilen, ikinciden de birincide ispat edilen hazfedilmiştir. Takdiri şöyledir: «Kim hidayetime uyarsa ona ne korku ne de hüzün ulaşır ve o cennet ehlidir; kim de inkâr edip yalanlarsa ona hüzün ve korku ulaşır ve o ateş ehlidir.» Çünkü taksim bunu gerektirir. Bunu şairin şu sözüne benzetmişlerdir:
397 - وإني لَتَعْروني لِذِكْراكِ فَتْرَةٌ ... كما انتفَضَ العصفورُ بلَّلَه القَطْرُ
(Seni andıkça beni bir titreme kaplar; tıpkı yağmur damlasının ıslattığı serçenin silkinmesi gibi.)
الآية [sözlükte] alâmettir. Nâbiğa ez-Zübyânî şöyle demiştir:
398 - تَوَهَمْتُ آياتٍ لها فَعَرَفْتُها ... لستةِ أعوامٍ وذا العامُ سابِعُ
(Ona ait izleri dikkatle süzdüm ve altı yıl sonra onları tanıdım; bu yıl da yedincisidir.)
Kur'an ayetine, kendinden öncesinin sonrasından ayrılmasına alâmet olduğu için [ayet] denmiştir. Kur'an'dan harfleri bir araya topladığı için bu adı aldığı da söylenmiştir; bu durumda «خرج بنو فلان بآيتِهم» (Falanoğulları topluluklarıyla çıktılar) sözlerinden olur. Şair şöyle demiştir:
399 - خَرَجْنا مِن النَّقْبَيْنِ لا حَيَّ مِثْلُنا ... بآياتِنا نُزْجي اللِّقاحَ المَطافِلاَ
(İki dağ geçidinden, bizim gibisi olmayan bir kabile olarak, topluluğumuzla, yavrulu sağmal develeri sürerek çıktık.)
Nahivciler onun vezninde ihtilaf etmişlerdir: Sîbeveyh ve Halîl'in mezhebi, onun فَعَلَة olduğudur; aslı ayn'ın fethasıyla أَيَية'dir; yâ harekeli olup öncesi meftûh olunca elife çevrilmiştir. Bu şâzdır; çünkü iki illet harfi bir araya gelince sonuncusu i'lâl edilir; çünkü değişikliğin yeri odur; هوى ve حوى gibi. Şâzlıkta onun benzerleri غاية, طاية ve راية'dir.
Kisâî'nin mezhebi, onun vezninin فاعِلة vezninde آيِيَة olduğudur. Kıyasa göre idğam edilip دابَّة gibi آيَّة denmesi gerekirdi; ancak hafiflik için bu terk edilmiş ve ayn'ı hazfedilmiştir; tıpkı كَيْنونة'yi hafifletmeleri gibi; onun aslı yâ'nın şeddesiyle كيَّنونة'dir. Bu görüş şöyle zayıf görülmüştür: كيَّنونة binası daha ağır olduğundan hafifletme ona uygun düşmüştür; bu ise öyle değildir.
Ferrâ'nın mezhebi, onun ayn'ın sükûnuyla فَعْلة olduğudur. Ebü'l-Bekā bunu tercih etmiş ve şöyle demiştir: «Çünkü o, "kavim toplandı" manasındaki تَأَيَّا القوم'dandır. Cemide آياء demişlerdir; [birinci] yâ ortaya çıkmıştır, sondaki hemze yâ'dan bedeldir; vezni أَفْعال'dir; ikinci elif, kelimenin fâ'sı olan bir hemzeden bedeldir. Ayn'ı vav olsaydı cemide آواء derlerdi. Sonra sâkin yâ'yı kıyas dışı olarak elife çevirmişlerdir.» (Alıntı bitti.) Yani illet harfi, harekeli olup öncesi meftûh olmadıkça çevrilmez.
Bazı Kûfeliler, onun vezninin نَبِقَة gibi ayn'ın kesresiyle أَيِيَة olduğu, sonra i'lâl edildiği görüşüne gitmiştir; bu da şâzlıkta Sîbeveyh ve Halîl'in mezhebi gibidir. Vezninin ayn'ın dammesiyle فَعُلَة olduğu da söylenmiştir. Aslının ikincisi i'lâl edilerek أياة olduğu, sonra lâm öne alınıp ayn sona alınarak kalb (yer değiştirme) yapıldığı da söylenmiştir; bu zayıftır. İşte bunlar altı mezheptir; hiçbiri şâzlıktan kurtulamaz.

The saying of the Exalted: {استسقى موسى لِقَوْمِهِ}: the sīn is for requesting, by way of supplication, i.e. he asked for water (al-suqyā) for them. The alif of استسقى is changed from a yāʾ, because it is from al-saqy. The meaning of istafʿala has preceded in full at the beginning of the sūra. One says سَقَيْتُه and أَسْقَيْتُه with the same meaning, and [this] was recited:
491 - سَقَى قومي بني بكر وأَسْقَى ... نُمَيْراً والقبائلَ من هِلالِ
(May He give drink to my people, Banū Bakr, and give drink to Numayr and the tribes of Hilāl.)
It has been said: سَقَيْتُه means "I gave him what he drinks", and أَسْقَيْته "I made that available to him to take as he pleases"; on this [view] isqāʾ is more intensive than saqy. It has also been said: أَسْقَيْته means "I guided him to water". This will come, if Allah the Exalted wills, at His saying: {نُّسْقِيكُمْ مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهِ} [al-Naḥl: 66].
«لقومِه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the lām is for cause, i.e. "for the sake of"; or it is for clarification, since what is meant by it is supplication, like the one in their saying «سُقْياً لك» ("may you be watered"), so it is attached to something omitted, like its counterpart.
His saying: {اضرب بِّعَصَاكَ}: the assimilation [here] is obligatory, because whenever two identical [letters] come together in two words or one word, the first of them being quiescent, assimilation is obligatory, as in اضربْ بكرا ("strike Bakr"). The alif of «عصاك» is changed from a wāw, because of their saying in the relative adjective ʿaṣawī, and in the dual ʿaṣawān. [The poet] said:
492 - . . . . . . . . . . . ... على عَصَوَيْها سابِرِيٌّ مُشَبْرَقُ
(…on its two sticks a torn fine Sābirī garment.)
The plural is ʿiṣiyy and ʿuṣiyy, with ḍamma and with kasra on the ʿayn by assimilation [of vowels], and aʿṣin, like zaman and azmun; the original is ʿuṣuww and aʿṣuw, and it underwent weak-letter change. One says عَصَوْتُه بالعَصا ("I struck him with the stick") and عَصَيْتُه بالسيفِ ("I struck him with the sword"). «ألقى عصاه» ("he threw down his stick") expresses reaching one's abode. [The poet] said:
493 - فَأَلْقَتْ عَصاها واستقرَّ بها النَّوى ... كما قرَّ عَيْناً بالإِيابِ المسافِرُ
(So she threw down her stick, and her destination settled her, as the traveller is gladdened by his return.)
And انشقَّت العصا بين القومِ ("the stick split among the people"), i.e. disagreement arose. The poet said:
494 - إذا كانتِ الهيجاءُ وانشَقَّتِ العَصا ... فَحَسْبُك والضحاكُ سيفٌ مُهَنَّدُ
(When battle comes and the stick splits, then sufficient for you and al-Ḍaḥḥāk is an Indian sword.)
Al-Farrāʾ said: "The first solecism heard in Iraq was 'هذه عصاتي' ('this is my stick')", meaning with the tāʾ. «الحَجَرَ» is an object, and the al in it is for the known [referent] (ʿahd); it has also been said: for the genus.
His saying: {فانفجرت}: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining [it] to something omitted that must be supposed, its implied form being: "so he struck, and it gushed forth". Ibn ʿUṣfūr said: "This fāʾ that is present is the one that enters upon that omitted verb, and the fāʾ entering upon «انفجَرتْ» is omitted." It is as though he says: the first verb was omitted because the second indicates it, and the second fāʾ was omitted because the first indicates it. There is no need for that; rather it is said: a fāʾ and what it conjoins before it were omitted. Al-Zamakhsharī made it the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. He said: "Or: so if you strike, it has gushed forth." He said: "On this [view] it is a fāʾ faṣīḥa (an eloquent fāʾ), which occurs only in eloquent speech." It seems that he intends an explanation of the meaning, not of the i'rab.
Al-infijār is splitting and opening; from it is al-fajr ("dawn"), because it splits with light. In al-Aʿrāf it is {فانبجست} [verse: 160]. It has been said: they have one meaning; it has also been said: al-inbijās is narrower, because it comes first and al-infijār second.
His saying: {اثنتا عَشْرَةَ عَيْناً} is the fāʿil (agent) of «انفجرت». The alif is the sign of the nominative, because it is treated like the dual, though it is not truly a dual since it has no singular from its own wording; likewise its masculine «اثنان». It is not annexed to a tamyīz (specification), since mentioning the counted thing in the dual makes it unnecessary: you say رجلان ("two men") and امرأتان ("two women"), and you do not say اثنا رجلٍ or اثنتا امرأةٍ, except for what has come rarely, on which no analogy is built. [The poet] said:
495 - كأنَّ خِصْيَيْهِ مِنَ التَّدَلْدُلِ ... ظَرْفُ عجوزٍ فيه ثِنْتا حَنْظَل
(As though his testicles, from their dangling, were an old woman's bag holding two colocynths.)
Thintān is like ithnatān. The rule for ithnān and ithnatān in compound numbers is that they are declined, unlike all their sisters. They said: this is because there has been omitted with them what is omitted in a declinable noun upon annexation, namely the nūn, so they resembled the declinable [noun] and were declined like the dual: with alif in the nominative and with yāʾ in the accusative and genitive. As for «عَشْرة», it is indeclinable (mabnī) because it is treated like the feminine tāʾ; it has many rules. «عَيْناً» is a tamyīz.
It has been read «عَشِرة» with a kasra on the shīn, and that is the dialect of Tamīm. Al-Naḥḥās said: "This is strange, for the dialect of Tamīm is ʿashira with kasra, though their way is lightening, and the dialect of the Ḥijāz is ʿashra with sukūn, though their way is making heavy." Al-Aʿmash read ʿasharah with a fatḥa. Al-ʿayn is a homonym shared by the human eye, the spring of water, the cloud, gold [coin], and the [tongue of the] balance; al-ʿayn is also rain lasting six or five [days]; al-ʿayn is the hole in a water-skin; and "a land with little ʿayn" means one with few people.
[His saying: {كُلُّ أُنَاسٍ}. The discussion that it is the origin of al-nās has preceded. Al-Zamakhsharī said in Sūrat al-Aʿrāf: it is a collective noun (ism jamʿ), not a broken plural. Then he said: "It is possible that the original was with kasra, and [it is] a broken plural, the ḍamma being a substitute for the kasra, as it was substituted for the fatḥa in sukārā." The precise investigation with him will come, if Allah the Exalted wills, in the sūra mentioned.]
His saying: {مَّشْرَبَهُمْ} is the object of «عَلِمَ» in the sense of "knew (recognized)". Al-mashrab here is the place of drinking, because it is narrated that each tribe had a spring out of the twelve springs which no other [tribe] shared with it. It has also been said: it is the drink itself, so it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) standing in the place of the direct object.
His saying: {كُلُواْ واشربوا}: these two clauses are in the position of the accusative governed by an implied "saying", its implied form being: "and We said to them: eat and drink". The morphology of «كل» and what has been omitted from it has preceded.
His saying: {مِن رِّزْقِ الله}: this is of the category of iʿmāl (rival governors), because each of the two verbs can properly govern it; it is a case of the second being made to govern, with omission from the first, the implied form being: "and eat of it". «مِنْ» may be for the beginning of the extent or partitive. The object of eating may also be omitted, and likewise the object of drinking, because they are indicated, the implied form being: "eat the manna and the quails" — since they were mentioned before in His saying {وَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ المن والسلوى} [al-Baqara: 57] — "and drink the water of the springs that gushed forth". On this [view] the preposition and its genitive noun may be attached to the verb before it, or may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from that [omitted] object, and so attached to something omitted. It has also been said: what is meant by the provision is the water alone, and eating is ascribed to it because it is a cause of the growth and life of what is eaten, so it is a provision from which one eats and drinks. What is meant by al-rizq is what is provided (al-marzūq); it may be of the category of dhibḥ and riʿy [i.e. a fiʿl pattern with passive meaning], or of the category of «درهمٌ ضَرْبُ الأميرِ» ("a dirham, the striking of the emir", i.e. struck by him); the explanation of that has preceded.
His saying: {وَلاَ تَعْثَوْاْ فِي الأرض مُفْسِدِينَ}: the original of «تَعْثَوا» is taʿthayuwā. The ḍamma was found heavy on the yāʾ and was deleted; two quiescent letters then met, and the first of them, the yāʾ, was deleted. Or: since the yāʾ was vowelled and the letter before it had a fatḥa, it was changed into an alif; two quiescent letters met, the alif was deleted, and the fatḥa remained to indicate it. This is preferable. So its pattern is tafʿūn. [Translator's note: the source reads «تَفْعُون»; since the lām is dropped, the expected pattern would be «تَفْعَوْن».]
Al-ʿithiyy and al-ʿayth are the most severe corruption, and they are close [in meaning]. Some said: "Except that al-ʿayth is mostly said of what is perceived by the senses, and al-ʿithiyy of what is perceived by judgment." One says عَثَى يَعْثَى عِثِيَّاً, which is the usage of the Quran; and عثا يَعْثُو عُثُوّاً; and عاثَ يعيثُ عِثِيّاً. عاثَ is not a metathesis of عثى, like جَبَذَ and جَذَبَ, because their meanings differ, as preceded; though that is possible, each then being specialized for one kind. One also says عَثِيَ يعثى عِثِيّاً ومَعَاثاً. The original of عَثِي is not عَثِوَ with the wāw changed into yāʾ because of the kasra before it, like رَضِيَ from al-riḍwān, because al-ʿithiyy is established [as a form], even if some imagined that. And عَثَا is as preceded. One also says عَثَّ يَعُثُّ, doubled, i.e. "it decayed"; from it is al-ʿuththa, a moth that ruins wool. As for «عَتَا» with the dotted tāʾ, it is close to it in meaning, and its discussion will come.
«مُفْسدين» is a ḥāl from the agent of «تَعْثَوْا». It is an emphatic ḥāl (ḥāl muʾakkida), because its meaning is understood from its governing word; what made that good is the difference of the two words. Like it is {ثُمَّ وَلَّيْتُم مُّدْبِرِينَ} [al-Tawba: 25]. So they said. It may also be an explanatory ḥāl (ḥāl mubayyina), because corruption is more general and al-ʿithiyy more specific, as preceded. For this reason al-Zamakhsharī said: "So it was said to them: do not persist in corruption while you are corrupt, because they were persisting in it." So he distinguished between them, as you see.
{فِي الأرض} may be attached to «تَعْثَوْا», which is the apparent [view], or to «مفسدين».

The saying of the Exalted: {مَنْ آمَنَ بالله}. Two options are possible for «مَنْ». The first: that it is conditional, in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), «آمَن» being jussive (majzūm) by it in implied form and being the khabar (predicate) according to the correct view, in accordance with the disagreement mentioned before about it. His saying «فلهم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and this conditional clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of «إنَّ» in His saying «إنَّ الذين آمنُوا»; the returning pronoun is omitted, its implied form being "whoever of them believes", as is stated explicitly in another place. The second: that it is a relative in the sense of «الذي», its position then being the accusative as a badal (substitute) from the noun of «إنَّ», namely «الذين» — a substitute of part for whole; the returning pronoun is also omitted, as preceded, and «آمن» is its ṣila (relative clause), so it then has no grammatical position.
His saying: {فَلَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ} is the khabar of «إنَّ الذين»; the fāʾ entered because the relative resembles the condition. This is according to those other than al-Akhfash; as for al-Akhfash, it is transmitted from him that when the mubtadaʾ is abrogated by «إنَّ», that is not allowed in it. So the position of His saying {فَلَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ} is the nominative on this view, and the jussive on the first view. «لهمْ» is a fronted khabar attached to something omitted, and «أجرُهُمْ» is the mubtadaʾ. According to al-Akhfash it may be a fāʿil (agent) of the preposition [phrase] before it, even though it is not supported [by a preceding element]; the disagreement about that has been mentioned before.
His saying: {عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ}: «عند» is an adverb of place that is necessarily annexed, in wording and in meaning. What governs it is the [notion of] being settled (al-istiqrār) contained in «لهم». It may also be in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أجرُهم», and so be attached to something omitted, its implied form being: "then they have their reward, established with their Lord". The "with-ness" (ʿindiyya) is figurative, because He is exalted above direction. It may pass into [being] an adverb of time when what it contains is an abstract notion; from it is his saying, peace be upon him: «إنما الصبرُ عند الصَّدمةِ الأولى» ("patience is only at the first blow"). The well-known [vocalization] is a kasra on its ʿayn; it may also take a fatḥa and a ḍamma.
«والذين هادُوا» are the Jews. There are two views about the alif of «هادُوا». The first is that it is from a wāw, the original being هاد يهودُ, i.e. "he repented". The poet said:
512 - إنِّي امرؤٌ من حُبِّه هائِدُ
(I am a man repentant of [excessive] love for him.)
i.e. repentant. From it the Jews were named, because they repented of worshipping the calf. And the Exalted said: {إِنَّا هُدْنَآ إِلَيْكَ} [al-Aʿrāf: 156], i.e. we have repented. It has also been said: it is from al-tahwīd, which is speaking with calm and gravity, and they recited:
513 - وخُودٌ من اللائي تَسَمَّعْنَ بالضُّحى ... قَريضَ الرُّدافَى بالغِناءِ المُهَوَّد
(And a soft young woman, of those who in the forenoon listen to the poetry of the riders behind, sung in gentle song.)
It has also been said: it is from al-hawāda, which is submission. The second: that it is from a yāʾ, the original being هاد يَهِيد, i.e. "to move"; from it the Jews were named, because of their moving [their bodies] in their study. It has also been said: they were named Yahūd by attribution to Yahūdhā, with the dotted dhāl, who was the son of Jacob, peace be upon him; the Arabs changed it from the dotted dhāl to the undotted [dāl], following their custom of playing with foreign names.
Al-naṣārā ("Christians") is a plural; its singular is naṣrān and naṣrāna, like nadmān, nadmāna and nadāmā. Sībawayh said this, and recited:
514 - فَكِلْتاهما خَرَّتْ وأَسْجَدَ رأسُها ... كما أَسْجَدَتْ نَصْرانَةٌ لم تَحَنَّفِ
(Both of them fell down and bowed their heads, as a Christian woman bows who has not become a ḥanīf.)
Al-Ṭabarī recited for naṣrān his saying:
515 - يَظَلُّ إذا دارَ العِشَا مُتَحَنِّفاً ... ويُضْحي لَدَيْه وهو نَصرْانُ شامِسُ
(When evening comes round he becomes a ḥanīf, and by forenoon he is with him a Christian worshipping the sun.)
Sībawayh said: "Except that it is not used in speech except with the yāʾ of relation." Al-Khalīl said: "The singular of al-naṣārā is naṣriyy, like mahriyy and mahārā." Al-Zamakhsharī said: "The yāʾ in naṣrāniyy is for intensiveness, like the one in aḥmariyy." Naṣārā is indefinite, and for that reason al is added to it and it is qualified by an indefinite [adjective] in the poet's saying:
516 - صَدَّتْ كما صَدَّ عما لا يَحِلُّ له ... ساقي نصارى قُبَيْل الفِصْحِ صُوَّامِ
(She turned away, as the cupbearer of fasting Christians turns away, shortly before Easter, from what is not lawful for him.)
They were named thus by attribution to a village called Nāṣira (Nazareth), where Jesus, peace be upon him, used to stay; or because they used to help one another (yatanāṣarūn). The poet said:
517 - لَمَّا رأيتُ نَبَطاً أَنْصارا ... شَمَّرْتُ عن رُكْبَتيَ الإِزارا
كُنْتُ لهم من النَّصارى جَارا
(When I saw Nabataeans as helpers, I tucked my waist-wrapper up from my knees; I was to them a protector among the helpers.)
Al-ṣābiʾūn are a people who worshipped the angels; it has also been said: the stars. The majority pronounce it with hamza, and Nāfiʿ read it without hamza. Those who pronounce the hamza make it from صَبَأَ نابُ البعير, i.e. the camel's tooth came out, and صَبَأَتِ النجومُ, "the stars rose". Abū ʿAlī said: "صَبَأْتُ على القومِ means 'I came upon the people unexpectedly'; so the ṣābiʾ is the one who leaves his religion, like the ṣābiʾ who comes upon a people unexpectedly, for he has left his land and moved from it." Those who do not pronounce the hamza: two possibilities exist. The first: that it is taken from the hamzated [form], the hamza being replaced by a weak letter, either yāʾ or wāw, so it became of the category of the defective noun (manqūṣ) like qāḍin or ghāzin, the original being ṣābin; then it was pluralized as al-qāḍī or al-ghāzī is pluralized — except that Sībawayh does not consider changing this hamza [permissible] except in poetry, while al-Akhfash and Abū Zayd consider it [permissible] without restriction. The second: that it is from صَبَا يَصْبو, when one inclines; so al-ṣābī is like al-ghāzī, its original being ṣābiwun, and it underwent weak-letter change like ghāzin. Abū ʿUbayd related with a chain to Ibn ʿAbbās: "What is al-ṣābūn? It is only al-ṣābiʾūn. What is al-khāṭūn? It is only al-khāṭiʾūn." So the reading of Nāfiʿ combines pronouncing the hamza in al-nabiyyīn and omitting the hamza in al-ṣābiʾīn, and you have learned that the reverse is more eloquent in both.
He construed the pronoun in His saying {مَنْ آمَنَ وَعَمِلَ} according to the wording of «مَنْ», so He made it singular; and according to the meaning in His saying {فَلَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ}, so He made it plural, as in his saying:
518 - أَلِمَّا بسَلْمى عنكما إنْ عَرَضْتُما ... وقولا لها عُوجِي على مَنْ تَخَلَّفوا
(Visit Salmā briefly on my behalf if you pass by, and say to her: turn aside toward those who have stayed behind.)
So he observed the meaning. The verification of that has preceded at His saying: {وَمِنَ الناس مَن يَقُولُ آمَنَّا} [al-Baqara: 8].
Al-ajr is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun): one says أَجَرَهُ الله يأجِرُهُ أَجْراً. It may express the very thing with which one is recompensed, and the noble verse admits both meanings.
Abū al-Sammāl read {والذين هَادَوْا} with a fatḥa on the dāl, as though in his view it were from the mufāʿala [form], the original being «هادَيُوا», and it underwent weak-letter change like its counterparts.

Allah Teâlâ'nın {مَا لَوْنُهَا} sözü: «هي» sözü gibidir. Ebu'l-Bekâ şöyle demiştir: «Eğer "لونَها" nasb ile okunsaydı bunun da bir vechi olurdu; o da "ما"nın {أَيَّمَا الأجلين قَضَيْتُ} [Kasas: 28] sözündeki gibi zâide olmasıdır; takdir de "يبين لنا لونَها" (bize onun rengini açıklasın) olurdu. "ما هي" ise yalnızca mübtedâ ve haberdir, başka bir şey değildir; zira "ما"yı zâide kılmak mümkün değildir, çünkü "هي"nin "يبيِّن"in mef'ûlü olması sahih değildir.» Yani o ref' sîgasındadır. Bu (ayet), «ما»nın zâide olduğu yerlerden değildir; dolayısıyla buna ihtiyaç yoktur.
«اللون» (renk): kırmızılık, siyahlık ve benzerlerinden ibarettir. «اللون» aynı zamanda tür demektir; o da «الدَّقَل»dir, «النحل»den bir türdür. [Mütercim notu: Metinde «النحل» (arılar) yazılıdır; bağlam «النخل» (hurma ağaçları) olmasını gerektirir; «الدَّقَل» düşük kaliteli bir hurma türüdür.] Ahfeş şöyle demiştir: «O bir topluluk (çoğul) ismidir, tekili "لِينة"dir.» Bu ileride gelecektir. «فلان يَتَلَوَّن» (falan renkten renge giriyor), yani bir hal üzere sabit durmuyor demektir. Şair şöyle demiştir:
540 - كلَّ يومٍ تتلوَّنْ ... غيرُ هذا بك أَجْمَلْ
(Her gün renkten renge giriyorsun; bundan başkası sana daha yakışır.)
{صَفْرَآءُ فَاقِعٌ لَّوْنُهَا} sözü: «فاقعٌ»ün sıfat, «لونُها»nın da onun fâili olması caizdir [Mütercim notu: Metinde «بجوز» yazılıdır; «يجوز» olarak okunmuştur.]; ayrıca «فاقعٌ»ün mukaddem haber, «لونُها»nın muahhar mübtedâ olması ve cümlenin sıfat olması da caizdir. Bunları Ebu'l-Bekâ zikretmiştir. Birinci vecihte ise tereddüt (nazar) vardır. Şöyle ki: bazıları, renklere tâbi olan bu kelimelerin fiillerin amelini yapmadığını nakletmiştir. Eğer: «Amel "فاقع"e değil "صفراء"ya ait olur; tıpkı "مررتُ برجلٍ أبيضَ ناصعٍ لونُه" (rengi bembeyaz bir adama uğradım) demen gibi; burada "لونُه", "ناصع" ile değil "أبيض" ile merfûdur» denirse, cevap şudur: Bu, burada başka bir yönden engellidir; o da «صفراء»nın lafız bakımından müennes olmasıdır. Eğer «لونُها»yı ref' eden o olsaydı «أصفرُ لونُها» denirdi; tıpkı «مررت بامرأةٍ أصفرَ لونُها» (rengi sarı bir kadına uğradım) demen gibi. «صفراءَ لونُها» demek ise caiz değildir; çünkü sıfat fiil gibidir. Ancak şöyle denebilir: «لون» müennese izafe edilince ondan müenneslik kazanmış ve ona göre muamele görmüştür; bunun zikri ileride gelecektir.
«لونُها»nın mübtedâ, «تَسُرُّ»nun da onun haberi olması caizdir. Fiil, izafe yoluyla müenneslik anlamı kazandığı için müennes getirilmiştir; şairin şu sözünde olduğu gibi:
541 - مَشَيْنَ كما اهتَزَّتْ رماحٌ تَسَفَّهَتْ ... أعاليهَا مَرُّ الرياحِ النَّواسِمِ
(O kadınlar, uçlarını hafif esen rüzgârların geçişinin salladığı mızrakların sallanışı gibi yürüdüler.)
Ve bir başkasının sözü:
542 - وتَشْرَقُ بالقولِ الذي قد أَذَعْتَه ... كما شَرِقَتْ صدرُ القناةِ من الدمِ
(Yaydığın sözle boğazın tıkanır; mızrağın ön kısmının kanla dolup tıkandığı gibi.)
Şair, «المَرّ» ve «الصدر» müennese izafe edilince onların fiilini müennes getirmiştir. {تَلْتَقِطْهُ بَعْضُ السيارة} [Yûsuf: 10] şeklinde de okunmuştur. Denildi ki: Çünkü burada «اللون» ile kastedilen sarılıktır (الصفرة); o da müenneştir, bu hususta anlama hamledilmiştir.
«أصفرُ فاقعٌ» (sapsarı) ve «أبيضُ ناصعٌ», «يَقِقٌ», «لَهِقٌ», «لِهاقٌ» (bembeyaz), «أخضرُ ناصعٌ» (yemyeşil), «أحمرُ قانئٌ» (kıpkırmızı), «أسودُ حالِكٌ», «حائِك», «حَلَكُوك», «حُلْكُوك», «دَجُوجيّ», «غِرْبيب» ve «بهيم» (simsiyah) denir. Denildi ki: «"البهيم", her renkten (karışmamış) halis olandır.» Bununla «صفراء»nın, bazılarının dediği gibi «siyah» değil, bilinen renk anlamında kendi asıl manasında olduğu ortaya çıkar. Çünkü «فاقع» (parlaklık) özellikle sarının sıfatıdır. Ayrıca bu (sarıyı siyah anlamında almak) uzak bir mecazdır ve ancak develer hakkında, siyahlıklarının sarılığa yakın olması sebebiyle kullanılır; Allah Teâlâ'nın {كَأَنَّهُ جِمَالَةٌ صُفْرٌ} [Mürselât: 33] sözündeki gibi. Şair de şöyle demiştir:
543 - تلك خَيْلِيْ منه وتلكَ رِكابي ... هُنَّ صُفْرٌ أولادُها كالزَّبيبِ
(İşte onun verdiği atlarım, işte binek develerim; onlar sarıdır [kara-sarıdır], yavruları kuru üzüm gibidir.)
{تَسُرُّ الناظرين} sözü: Bu cümle de «بقرة»nin sıfatı olarak ref' mahallindedir. Daha önce, zikredilen iki te'vil ile «لونها»nın haberi olmasının da caiz olduğu geçmişti. «السرور»: bir faydanın elde edilmesi veya beklenmesi anında kalpte duyulan lezzettir. Nimet sahiplerine ait olduğunda üzerine oturulan «السرير» (taht/sedir) da buradandır. Ölünün «سرير»ine (teneşir/tabut) de şekil bakımından buna benzetilerek ve hayra yorularak bu ad verilmiştir.

The words of Allah the Exalted: {أَوْ أَشَدُّ قَسْوَةً}: this «أو» is like the «أو» in His words {أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ} [al-Baqara: 19], so everything said about it there may be said here. When Abū al-Aswad said:

551 - أُحِبُّ محمداً حُبَّاً شديداً ... وعَبَّاساً وحمزةَ أو عَلِيَّا
(I love Muḥammad with an intense love, and ʿAbbās, and Ḥamza, or ʿAlī.)

they objected to his use of «أو», which implies doubt, and said to him: "Are you in doubt?" He said: "Not at all", and cited as evidence the words of Allah the Exalted {وَإِنَّآ أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لعلى هُدًى أَوْ فِي ضَلاَلٍ} [Sabaʾ: 24], and said: "Was the One who informed of this in doubt?" He, may Allah have mercy on him, only intended to leave the matter vague for the addressee.

«أشدُّ» is nominative because it is conjoined to the position of «كالحجارة», i.e. "so they are like stones or harder". The kāf may be a particle, and so be attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted element, or a noun, and so not be attached to anything. It may also be the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "or they are harder". «قسوة» is accusative as a tamyīz (specification), because the vagueness arose in the attribution of the preference to it [i.e. to the hearts]. The thing over which preference is given is omitted because it is indicated, i.e. "harder than stones".

It has been read «أشدَّ» with fatḥa; the way to account for it is that it is conjoined to «الحجارة», i.e. "so they are like stones or like what is harder than them". Al-Zamakhsharī said, accounting for the nominative: "أشدُّ is conjoined to the kāf, either on the meaning 'or like what is harder', the muḍāf being omitted and the muḍāf ilayhi put in its place; and this is supported by the reading of al-Aʿmash with the dāl in the accusative, conjoined to الحجارة." On what he said, it is also possible that it is genitive by the omitted muḍāf, left in its state, like the reading {والله يُرِيدُ الآخرة} [al-Anfāl: 67] with الآخرة in the genitive, i.e. "the reward of the Hereafter". The outcome of this is that the fatḥa of the dāl may be either accusative or genitive.

Al-Zamakhsharī also said: "If you say: why was it said «أشدُّ قسوةً», when the verb of hardness is one from which the elative of preference and the verb of wonder can be formed?" — meaning that it fulfils the conditions: being triliteral, complete, not of colour or defect, inflected, and not bound to negation. Then he said: "I say: because it is clearer and more indicative of the excess of hardness. And there is another aspect: He does not intend the meaning of 'harder' (الأقسى); rather He intended to describe the hardness as intense, as though it were said: 'the hardness of stones has become intense, and their hearts are more intense in hardness'." This is a very fine statement, except that [the claim] that the verb of wonder may be formed from القسوة is questionable, since it is among innate qualities or among defects, and both of these bar the formation of the two patterns. It has also been read: قَساوة.

His words: {لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنْهُ}: the lām is the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ) entering the noun of «إنَّ», because the khabar, {مِنَ الحجارة}, comes first. ما is in the sense of الذي and in the position of the accusative. Had the khabar not come first, the lām could not enter the noun, lest two particles of emphasis follow one another, even though the original would require it. The pronoun in «منه» refers back to «ما», construed according to the form. Abū al-Baqāʾ said: "Were it outside the Qurʾān, «منها» according to the meaning would be permissible." I say: this is what Ubayy ibn Kaʿb and al-Ḍaḥḥāk read.

Mālik ibn Dīnār read «يَنْفَجِرُ», from الانفجار. Qatāda read {وَإِنْ مِنَ الحجارة} with إنْ lightened from the heavy form, bringing the lām to distinguish it from negative «إنْ»; and likewise {وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَهْبِطُ}. In this reading «ما» may be in the position of the nominative, which is the well-known [view], or in the position of the accusative, because with lightened «إنْ» both governing and non-governing are heard. Allah the Exalted said {وَإِنَّ كُلاًّ لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ} [Hūd: 111] in the reading of those who read it so, and in another place {وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ} [Yā Sīn: 32]; but the well-known [usage] is non-governing.

{يَشَّقَّقُ}: its origin is يَتَشَقَّقُ, then assimilated; al-Aʿmash read with the original. Ṭalḥa ibn Muṣarrif read «لَمَّا» with doubled mīm in both places; Ibn ʿAṭiyya said: "It is a reading without a sound justification." He also read «يَنْشَقُّ» with nūn; its fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun of «ما». Abū al-Baqāʾ said: "Its agent may be the pronoun of the water, because «يَشَّقَّقُ» may be assigned to the water according to the meaning; so you have two verbs, the second of which governs الماء, and the agent of the first is latent/ on condition of later explanation; according to the Kufans the first governs, so in the second there is a pronoun" — meaning that it belongs to the chapter of tanāzuʿ (two governors competing for one word). A resumptive pronoun must be omitted from «يَشَّقَّق» referring to relative «ما», indicated by His words «منه», the implied sense being: "and among the stones there is that from which the water cleaves, so the water comes out of it." He also said: "Had «تتفجَّر» been read with tāʾ, it would be permissible." I say: Abū Ḥātim said «لما تتفجَّر» with tāʾ is permissible because he made it feminine by the femininity of الأنهار, but this cannot be in تشَّقَّق — meaning the feminine.
