The Encyclopaedia of Islam, in its article on the Qur'an, says what amounts to this: the scholars have laboured much to understand the intent of these letters. These letters occur in twenty-nine sūras, all of them Meccan except the openings of Sūrat al-Baqara and Sūrat Āl ʿImrān, which belong to the Medinan period, and the total number of different letters repeated in these openings is fourteen.
We admired a study written by Dr. Zakī Mubārak in his book "al-Nathr al-Fannī" and wished to quote from it what is pleasing. The author of al-Nathr al-Fannī said, in summary: I was talking about the openings of the sūras with Monsieur Blā Nashū (المسيو بلا نشو), and he presented to me a new interpretation worthy of consideration, worthy of study and verification, the gist of which is:
that the letters الم, الر, حم, طسم are the letters: [Translator's note: the source text here is garbled and incomplete («الحروف:.. التي توجد في بعض المواطن من:-»); it is translated as far as it is intelligible] which are found in some places of: they are nothing but signs and musical indications, whose melodies are indicated by one, two or three letters, so they are vocal symbols. It is not unlikely, then, that the openings of the sūras are vocal signs to guide the recitation. Perhaps what Dr. Zakī Mubārak adduced is connected, closely or remotely, with what we have given of the meaning of challenge and of rapping the staff at the obstinate, who probed the depths of the Qur'an and perceived by their rhetorical instinct the eloquence by which it is distinguished. Al-Suyūṭī, in his delightful book al-Itqān, has an opinion supporting what we have held, for he said: the intention was to take the Arabs, who are the people of eloquence and rhetoric, by surprise with symbols and signs with which they had no familiarity, so that their attention would increase and their minds and souls be alerted.
(رَيْبَ): rayb is doubt and the disquiet and agitation of the soul. In the ḥadīth: «دع ما يريبك إلى ما لا يريبك» ("Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt"). Now rayb has three meanings in the language: the first is doubt, and this is what is meant here; the second is suspicion; Jamīl said:
بثينة قالت: يا جميل اربتني ... فقلت: كلانا يا بثين ريب
(Buthayna said: "O Jamīl, you have made me suspicious." I said: "We are both, O Buthayna, objects of suspicion.")
and the third is need. He said:
قضينا من تهامة كل ريب ... وخيبر ثم أجمعنا السيوفا
(We fulfilled every need in Tihāma and Khaybar, then we gathered up the swords.)
(يُنْفِقُونَ): nafaqa al-shayʾ and naqada [Translator's note: so in the source («ونقد»); nafada is evidently intended] mean the same. Everything that comes with nūn as first radical and fāʾ as second indicates the sense of exhaustion, going out and departing. One says nafatha al-shayʾa min fīhi: he threw it out of his mouth; and nafatha fī al-ʿuqad (he blew on the knots). Among their sayings are «لا بد للمصدور أن ينفث» ("the one with a chest ailment must expectorate") and «هذه نفثة مصدور» ("this is the expectoration of a chest-sufferer"). Nafaqa al-ḥimār: the donkey died. A full account of this chapter is more than the scope of this book can hold, and it is one of the marvels by which our noble language is distinguished; you will meet many like it in this wonderful book. (الْمُفْلِحُونَ): those who attain their desire, before whom the faces of victory have opened. Everything that comes with fāʾ as first radical and lām as second indicates the sense of opening and splitting, such as falaqa and falaḥa.

* I'rab:
(الم): a word whose wording is intended and not its meaning, in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, that is, "this is Alif Lām Mīm". (ذلِكَ): a demonstrative in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. (الْكِتابُ): the khabar of «ذلك». This is preferable to making it a substitute for the demonstrative, because what is intended is to inform that it is the holy Book, deserving this name, to reinforce the challenge. The clause is inceptive and has no grammatical position; though it is permissible to make it a substitute for the demonstrative, in which case the clause «لا ريب فيه» is a khabar for the demonstrative. (لا رَيْبَ فِيهِ): lā is the lā of generic negation, and «ريب» is its noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the noun of lā; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted element which is its khabar. The clause is a khabar for «ذلك», or a ḥāl from «الكتاب». (هُدىً): a third khabar of «ذلك». (لِلْمُتَّقِينَ): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «هدى», because it is a maṣdar; and you may make it an adjective of «هدى». (الَّذِينَ): a relative noun in the position of genitive, an adjective of «المتقين». (يُؤْمِنُونَ): a nominative imperfect verb, the sign of its nominative case being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs; and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative, an agent. The verbal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative. (بِالْغَيْبِ): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «يؤمنون». (وَيُقِيمُونَ): the clause is conjoined to the clause «يؤمنون», entering within the scope of the ṣila. (الصَّلاةَ): direct object. (وَمِمَّا): the wāw is a conjunction, and «مما» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «ينفقون». (رَزَقْناهُمْ): a past verb, an agent and a direct object; the clause «رزقناهم» has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of «ما», and the returning pronoun is omitted, that is, "We provided them with it". (يُنْفِقُونَ): a nominative imperfect verb conjoined to «يقيمون», entering within the scope of the ṣila as well. (وَالَّذِينَ): the wāw is a conjunction, and the relative noun is conjoined to the first relative, included with it in the string of the God-fearing. (يُؤْمِنُونَ): a nominative imperfect verb, the wāw an agent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative. (بِما): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يؤمنون». (أُنْزِلَ): a passive past verb, its deputy agent a latent pronoun implied in it, its implied form being "he", referring to «ما», that is, the Qur'an; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative. (إِلَيْكَ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أنزل». (وَما): the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is conjoined to «بما أنزل إليك», and the clause (أُنْزِلَ) has no position because it is the ṣila of the relative. (مِنْ قَبْلِكَ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl; this is preferable to attaching them to «أنزل». (وَبِالْآخِرَةِ): the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يوقنون». (هُمْ): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ. (يُوقِنُونَ): a nominative imperfect verb, the wāw its agent; the nominal clause is conjoined to the verbal clause, namely «ومما رزقناهم ينفقون», and the secret of the difference between the two clauses will come in the section on rhetoric. (أُولئِكَ): a demonstrative indeclinable on kasra, in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ; the kāf is for address. (عَلى هُدىً): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of «أولئك». (مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element, an adjective of «هدى»; and the clause is resumptive and has no position. (وَأُولئِكَ هُمُ): «أولئك» is mubtadaʾ, and «هم» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) or support (ʿimād), with no position. (الْمُفْلِحُونَ): the khabar of «أولئك»; and you may parse «هم» as mubtadaʾ and «المفلحون» as its khabar, the nominal clause being the khabar of «أولئك».

* Rhetoric:
In these verses are several arts, which we set out below:
1- Definiteness: in making «الكتاب» definite by the alif and lām, to magnify its matter; and it is originally a maṣdar. The Exalted said: «كتاب الله عليكم».
2- Fronting: «الريب» was put before the preposition and its genitive noun because it is more apt to be mentioned, in readiness for its picture, so that it becomes embodied before the hearer.
3- Putting the maṣdar «هدى» in place of the derived adjective hādin, which goes further in expressing its permanence and continuity.
4- Free trope (majāz mursal): in the saying «هدى للمتقين», its relation being consideration of what it will become, that is, those who will come to piety (taqwā).
5- Concision: in mentioning «المتقين», because wiqāya (guarding) is a comprehensive name for everything against which one must guard.
6- Explicit metaphor of the subordinate kind (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya tabaʿiyya) in the saying «على هدى»: the condition of the God-fearing is likened to the condition of one who has mounted the back of his horse; the thing likened was dropped and the word «على», indicating being above, was borrowed to show that something rises above and tops what follows it, either in reality, as in "Zayd is on the roof", or in judgement, as in «عليه دين» ("he has a debt"): the debt, because of its binding nature and his bearing it, is as if he were riding on it and carrying it. The subtlety in it is that the metaphor is by means of a particle, and in carrying it out it is said: a mere connection between guidance and the guided is likened to a mere connection between one who is above and that which is above him, on the ground of firm position in each; so the likening passed from universals to particulars; then «على», which is one of the particulars of the thing likened to, was borrowed for a particular of the particulars of the thing likened, by way of the explicit subordinate metaphor. Like the noble verse is the saying:
لسنا وإن أحسابنا كرمت ... يوما على الآباء نتكل
(Even though our lineages are noble, we do not, one day, rely on our fathers.)
So consider this discussion, for it is of such subtlety and beauty; and examples of it will occur in the Noble Qur'an, like lawful magic.
7- Repetition: in the saying «يؤمنون بالغيب» and «يؤمنون بما انزل إليك», and in the repetition of the relative noun even though the one described is one; the one described may also be different, so it is repetition of the wording without the meaning. Its benefit is fixing it in the mind and affecting the emotions, and it is frequent in poetry.
8- Omission: in the saying «الم», meaning "this is Alif Lām Mīm", and «هدى», meaning "it is guidance", the mubtadaʾ being omitted; and in the saying «ينفقون», meaning "wealth", the direct object being omitted. Spending in the way of praiseworthy deeds and noble acts has enthralled the souls of the Arab poets; how beautiful is the saying of Diʿbil:
قالت سلامة: اين المال؟ قلت لها: ... المال ويحك لاقى الحمد فاصطحبا
(Salāma said: "Where is the wealth?" I said to her: "The wealth, woe to you, met praise and they went off together.")
9- Fine division (ḥusn al-taqsīm), an art of rhetoric whose gist is that the speaker comprehends all the divisions of the meaning he is engaged in, leaving nothing of it behind. These verses comprehended all the praiseworthy attributes and the acts of worship to which the believers devote themselves, because acts of worship are all confined to two types: bodily and financial, and both must be fulfilled for all acts of worship to be accepted. How beautiful is the noble ḥadīth saying: «يقول العبد مالي مالي وإنما له من ماله ثلاث: ما أكل فأفنى، أو لبس فأبلى أو أعطى فاقتنى، وما سوى ذلك فهو ذاهب وتاركه للناس» ("The servant says: 'My wealth, my wealth,' but he has of his wealth only three: what he ate and consumed, or wore and wore out, or gave and thereby acquired; and whatever is besides that is going away and he leaves it to the people"). His saying «مالي مالي» is a direct object of an omitted verb, that is, "I love my wealth", and the second is emphasis of the first.

* Lügat:
(سَواءٌ): «Eşit olma» (الاستواء) manasında bir isimdir; masdarlar gibi kullanılmıştır, bu yüzden tesniye ve cemi yapılmaz. «هما وهم سواء» (Onlar ikisi / onlar eşittir) derler. Tesniye lafzını kastettiklerinde «سيّان» derler; dilersen «سواءان» da diyebilirsin. Cemide «هم أسواء» denir; ayrıca kıyasa aykırı olarak «هم سواس» ve «سواسية» de denir; yani "eşit olan ikisi" ve "eşit olanlar". السّواء: iki uç arasındaki orta, adil olan yerdir. «ضرب سواءه» denir, yani onun ortasına vurdu; «جئته في سواء النهار» denir, yani günün ortasında ona geldim. سواء, teswiye hemzesinden sonra gelirse —iki kelime ister isim ister fiil olsun— mutlaka أم gelir. Ondan sonra teswiye hemzesi olmaksızın iki fiil gelirse, ikincisi أو ile atfedilir; «سواء عليّ قمت أو قعدت» (Kalksan da otursan da benim için birdir) gibi. Ondan sonra iki masdar gelirse, ikincisi vâv veya أو ile atfedilir; «سواء عليّ قيامك وقعودك» ve «قيامك أو قعودك» gibi.
(غِشاوَةٌ): غشاه veya غشيه'den, «onu örttü» manasında, فعالة vezninde bir kelimedir. Bu bina (vezin), bir şeyi kuşatan şeyler için kullanılır; العصابة (sargı) ve العسامة gibi. [Mütercim notu: «العسامة» kaynakta böyle yazılıdır; muhtemelen «العمامة» (sarık) olmalıdır.] Gayn harfinde kesra, damme ve fetha caizdir.

* İ'rab:
(إِنَّ الَّذِينَ): إنّ ve onun ismidir. Fiil ve fâilden oluşan (كَفَرُوا) cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü ism-i mevsûlün sılasıdır.
(سَواءٌ): Mukaddem haberdir veya inne'nin haberidir.
(عَلَيْهِمْ): Câr ve mecrûrdur; سواء'ya mütealliktir.
(أَأَنْذَرْتَهُمْ): Teswiye manasında istifhâm hemzesidir. Bu hemze ve ondan sonraki fiil, müevvel masdar olarak muahhar mübtedâdır, ya da masdarlar gibi kullanılan سواء'nın fâilidir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «نسواء» yazılıdır; «لسواء» olması gerektiği açıktır.] Cümle inne'nin haberidir.
(أَمْ): Muttasıl atıf harfidir; hükmü Fevâid bölümünde gelecektir.
(لَمْ تُنْذِرْهُمْ): لم: nefy, kalb (zamanı çevirme) ve cezm harfidir. تنذرهم: لم ile meczûm muzâri fiildir; fâil, içinde vücûben müstetir olan ve takdiri «أنت» olan zamirdir. Hâ bitişik zamirdir, mef'ûlün bih olarak nasb mahallindedir. Cümle أأنذرتهم cümlesine ma'tûftur.
(لا): Nefy harfidir.
(يُؤْمِنُونَ): Merfû muzâri fiildir; ref' alâmeti nûnun sabit olmasıdır; vâv fâildir. لا يؤمنون cümlesi haberden sonra haberdir (ikinci haber). Dilersen onu i'rabdan mahalli olmayan tefsîriyye cümle de yapabilirsin.
(خَتَمَ): Mâzî fiildir.
(اللَّهُ): Fâildir.
(عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ): Câr ve mecrûr ختم'e mütealliktir.
(وَعَلى سَمْعِهِمْ): على قلوبهم sözüne ma'tûftur.
(وَعَلى أَبْصارِهِمْ): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir mukaddem habere mütealliktir.
(غِشاوَةٌ): Muahhar mübtedâdır.
(وَلَهُمْ): Vâv atıf harfidir; câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir şeye (habere) mütealliktir.
(عَذابٌ): Muahhar mübtedâdır.
(عَظِيمٌ): عذاب'ın sıfatıdır (na't). Cümle önceki cümleye ma'tûftur.

* Belâgat:
1- Mührün (الختم) kalplere isnad edilmesinde istiâre-i temsîliyye vardır: Onların kalpleri, haktan uzak durmaları ve ona kulak vermemeleri bakımından, Allah'ın üzerine mühür vurduğu kalplerin hâline, yani hayvanların kalplerine benzetilmiştir. Bu, akılla kavranan bir şeyin duyuyla algılanan bir şeye benzetilmesidir. Ya da bu, mecâz-ı aklîdir; bu, Araplarda geniş bir bâbdır. Helâk olduklarında «سال بهم الوادي» (Vadi onları alıp akıp gitti) derler; birinin gaybubeti uzadığında «طارت بفلان العنقاء» (Ankâ kuşu falanı alıp uçtu) derler.
2- Kulak (السمع), işitilen şeyin tek olması sebebiyle tekil getirilmiştir; kalpler ve gözler ise idrak edilenlerin ve görülenlerin çeşitliliği sebebiyle tekil getirilmemiştir.
3- Burada العذاب kelimesinin nekre getirilmesinde, onun miktarı ve keyfiyeti bilinmeyen bir azap türü olduğuna işaret vardır. Onun عظيم ile nitelenmesi, azlığı ve nadirliği vehmini gidermek ve büyüklük derecesine ulaştığını te'kîd etmek içindir.

* Fevâid:
1- Teswiye hemzesi: سواء'dan sonra [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «بين سواء» (سواء'nın arasında) yazılıdır; «بعد» (sonra) kastedilmiş olmalıdır], ما أبالي (aldırmam), ما أدري (bilmiyorum) ve ليت شعري (keşke bilseydim) ifadelerinden sonra gelen hemzedir. Ölçüsü şudur: Bu, —daha önce geçtiği gibi— yerine masdarın gelmesi sahih olan bir cümlenin başına giren hemzedir.
2- أم'in iki hâli vardır:
a- Muttasıl: Bu iki türle sınırlıdır; çünkü ondan önce ya ayetteki gibi teswiye hemzesi, ya da tayin istenen bir hemze gelir; «أزيد في الدّار أم عمرو؟» (Evde Zeyd mi var, yoksa Amr mı?) gibi. Muttasıl diye adlandırılmıştır, çünkü ondan öncekiyle sonrakinden biri diğerinden müstağni olamaz. Birinci türde hemzeye denk olduğu için «muâdile» (denk) diye de adlandırılır; zira ikisi de teswiye ifade eder.
b- Munkatı': Saf haber cümlesinin önünde bulunduğu أم'dir; Allah Teâlâ'nın «تنزيل الكتاب لا ريب فيه من رب العالمين أم يقولون افتراه» (Kitabın indirilmesi, şüphe yok ki âlemlerin Rabbindendir. Yoksa "Onu uydurdu" mu diyorlar?) kavlinde olduğu gibi. Munkatı' diye adlandırılmıştır, çünkü ondan sonraki öncekinden kopuktur; her biri diğeriyle bağı olmayan bağımsız bir sözdür.

* Vocabulary:
(سَواءٌ): a noun meaning equality (istiwāʾ), treated like the maṣdars, and for this reason it is neither dualised nor pluralised. They said "humā wa-hum sawāʾ" ("the two of them and they are alike"). When they want the dual wording they say sayyān, and if you wish you may say sawāʾān; and in the plural, hum aswāʾ, and also, contrary to analogy, hum sawās and sawāsiya, meaning "two who are equal" and "persons who are equal". And sawāʾ is the just middle between two limits. One says "ḍaraba sawāʾahu", meaning "he struck its middle", and "ji'tuhu fī sawāʾ al-nahār", meaning "in the middle of the day". When sawāʾ is followed by the hamza of equalisation (hamzat al-taswiya), there must be an «أم» whether the two items are two nouns or two verbs; and if it is followed by two verbs without the hamza of equalisation, the second is conjoined with «أو», as in "sawāʾun ʿalayya qumta aw qaʿadta"; and if it is followed by two maṣdars, the second is conjoined with wāw or with «أو», as in "sawāʾun ʿalayya qiyāmuka wa-quʿūduka" and "qiyāmuka aw quʿūduka". (غِشاوَةٌ): the pattern fiʿāla from ghashāhu or ghashiyahu, when he covered it. This pattern is for what envelops a thing, like the headband (ʿiṣāba) and the turban (ʿasāma) [Translator's note: so in the source; ʿasāma is presumably a slip for ʿimāma]. In the ghayn, kasra, ḍamma and fatḥa are all permitted.

* I'rab:
(إِنَّ الَّذِينَ): inna and its noun; and the clause (كَفَرُوا), consisting of verb and agent, has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative. (سَواءٌ): a fronted khabar, or the khabar of inna. (عَلَيْهِمْ): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «سواء». (أَأَنْذَرْتَهُمْ): the interrogative hamza has the meaning of equalisation; it and the verb after it are, in interpretation, a maṣdar, a postponed mubtadaʾ, or the agent of sawāʾ, which is treated like the maṣdars [Translator's note: the source reads «فاعل نسواء», evidently a misprint for «لسواء»]; and the clause is the khabar of inna. (أَمْ): a connective (ʿāṭifa muttaṣila); its ruling will come in the section of benefits. (لَمْ تُنْذِرْهُمْ): lam is a particle of negation, conversion and jussive; «تنذرهم» is an imperfect verb jussive through lam, its agent a latent pronoun obligatorily implied, its implied form being "you"; and the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative, a direct object; and the clause is conjoined to the clause «أأنذرتهم». (لا): negative. (يُؤْمِنُونَ): a nominative imperfect verb, the sign of its nominative case being the retention of the nūn, the wāw an agent; the clause «لا يؤمنون» is a khabar after a khabar, and you may make it explicative, with no grammatical position. (خَتَمَ): past verb. (اللَّهُ): agent. (عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «ختم». (وَعَلى سَمْعِهِمْ): conjoined to the saying «على قلوبهم». (وَعَلى أَبْصارِهِمْ): the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (غِشاوَةٌ): postponed mubtadaʾ. (وَلَهُمْ): the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted element. (عَذابٌ): postponed mubtadaʾ. (عَظِيمٌ): naʿt of «عذاب»; and the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause.

* Rhetoric:
1- In the ascription of sealing to the hearts there is a representational metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya): their hearts, in their recoiling from the truth and not listening to it, are likened to hearts upon which Allah has set a seal, namely the hearts of beasts; it is a likening of an intelligible to a sensible. Or it is a rational trope (majāz ʿaqlī), which is a wide chapter among the Arabs: they say "the valley flowed with them" when they perished, and "the ʿanqāʾ flew away with so-and-so" when his absence was long.
2- The hearing is given in the singular because the thing heard is one, unlike the hearts and the eyes, because of the diversity of what is perceived and what is seen.
3- The indefiniteness of «العذاب» here points to its being a kind of it whose quantity and quality are unknown, and its description as «عظيم» is to remove the suggestion of its being little or rare, and to emphasise that it reaches the extreme of greatness.

* Benefits:
1- The hamza of equalisation is the one that falls after sawāʾ [Translator's note: the source reads «بين سواء» ("between sawāʾ"); «بعد» ("after") is evidently intended] and after mā ubālī, mā adrī and laytā shiʿrī; and its rule is: it is the hamza that enters a clause in whose place a maṣdar can be put, as previously stated.
2- «أم» has two states:
(a) Connected (muttaṣila), confined to two kinds, because it is preceded either by the hamza of equalisation, as in the verse, or by a hamza with which specification is sought, as in:
أزيد في الدّار أم عمرو؟
("Is Zayd in the house, or ʿAmr?")
It is called muttaṣila because what comes before it and after it cannot dispense with each other; it is also called muʿādila (equating), because it equates the hamza in the first kind, since both indicate equalisation.
(b) Disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), which is preceded by a pure statement, as in the saying of the Exalted: «تنزيل الكتاب لا ريب فيه من رب العالمين أم يقولون افتراه». It is called munqaṭiʿa because what is after it is cut off from what is before it, each being an independent speech with no connection to the other.

* Lügat:
(النَّاسِ): Kendi lafzından tekili olmayan bir ism-i cemdir. Sîbeveyh ve Ferrâ'ya göre kökü hemze, nûn ve sîndir; hemzesi şâz olarak hazfedilmiştir. Aslı «أناس»tır; Kur'an bu aslı da kullanmıştır. Allah Teâlâ şöyle buyurur: «يوم ندعو كلّ أناس بإمامهم» (O gün her insan topluluğunu önderleriyle çağıracağız). Kisâî ise kökünün nûn, vâv ve sîn olduğu görüşüne gitmiştir; «hareket» manasındaki النّوس'tan türemiştir. «ناس ينوس نوسا» denir; النّوس, bir şeyin havada sallanmasıdır. Kulaktaki küpenin sallanması (نوس القرط) da bundandır. Ebû Nüvâs bu adla anılmıştır, çünkü iki perçemi kulaklarının yanında sallanırdı; gerçek adı el-Hasen b. Hânî'dir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «كاتنا» yazılıdır; «كانتا» olmalıdır.] Bu bahsi uzattık, çünkü bazı modern sözlükler onun aslını karıştırmış; bazısı onu أنس maddesinde, bazısı نوس maddesinde zikretmiş ve böylece öğrenciyi ve başvuranı çıkışı olmayan labirentlerde kaybetmişlerdir.
(يُخادِعُونَ): الخداع aslında gizlemektir. الأخدعان de bundandır; bunlar boynun içinde gizli olan iki damardır. المخدع de bundandır; o, evin iç kısmıdır. Sonra (bu kelime) nefiste olanın dışında bir şeyi açığa vurmak için kullanılmıştır.
(يَشْعُرُونَ): الشعور: bir şeyi ince ve gizli bir yönden idrak etmektir. İnceliğinden dolayı الشعر (kıl)'dan türemiştir. Bunun duyu organıyla idrak olduğu da söylenmiştir; buna göre bedene bitişik elbise olan الشعار'dan türemiştir. İnsanın meşâiri onun duyularıdır. شعر بالأمر —نصر ve كرم bâblarından— işi bildi ve ona uyandı demektir. Şâir de zekâsı ve bilgisinin inceliği sebebiyle bu adla anılmıştır. Tahkike göre şuur, duyusal ve aklî olanlardan ince olanı idrak etmektir.
(مَرَضٌ): المرض: مرض fiilinin masdarıdır; lügatte zaaf ve gevşeklik (fütûr) için kullanılır. Şöyle demişlerdir: Kalpteki maraz haktan gevşemektir; bedende uzuvların gevşekliğidir; gözde ise bakışın baygınlığıdır ki bu güzel bir şeydir ve şairler onu terennüm eder. Şair şöyle der:
مرضي من مريضة الأجفان ... علّلاني بذكرها علّلاني
(Hastalığım, göz kapakları baygın bir güzeldendir; onu anarak beni oyalayın, beni oyalayın.)
Maraz kelimesi kullanılıp karanlık da kastedilir; şair şöyle der:
في ليلة مرضت من كلّ ناحية ... فما يحس بها نجم ولا قمر
(Her yanından kararmış bir gecede ki onda ne yıldız hissedilir ne ay.)

* İ'rab:
(وَمِنَ النَّاسِ): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir. Söz, dilleriyle iman edip kalpleriyle küfreden münafıkları zikretmek için sevk edilmiş müste'nef bir sözdür. Allah Sübhânehû önce müttakîleri zikrederek başlamış, ikinci olarak zâhiren ve bâtınen kâfir olanları, üçüncü olarak münafıkları zikretmiştir. Câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir mukaddem habere mütealliktir.
(مَنْ): İsm-i mevsûldür; muahhar mübtedâ olarak ref' mahallindedir. من'in mevsûf bir nekre olması da caizdir; bu durumda yine muahhar mübtedâ olarak ref' mahallindedir; sanki «ومن الناس ناس» (İnsanlardan bir kısım insanlar vardır) denmiş gibidir. Bunun bahsi gelecektir.
(يَقُولُ): Merfû muzâri fiildir; fâili, içinde müstetir olan ve takdiri «هو» olan zamirdir. Fiil cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; من mevsûl ise onun sılasıdır, mevsûf nekre ise onun sıfatıdır.
(آمَنَّا): Fiil ve fâildir; fiil cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir.
(بِاللَّهِ): Câr ve mecrûr آمنا'ya mütealliktir.
(وَبِالْيَوْمِ): بالله'ya ma'tûftur.
(الْآخِرِ): اليوم'ün sıfatıdır (na't).
(وَما): Vâv hâliyyedir; ما, ليس'in amelini yapan Hicâziyye nefy ما'sıdır.
(هُمْ): Ayrı zamirdir; ما'nın ismi olarak ref' mahallindedir.
(بِمُؤْمِنِينَ): Bâ, te'kîd için zâide cer harfidir —çünkü Kur'an'da zâid cer harfi yoktur, ancak nahiv ıstılahı böyle cari olmuştur; belâgatçılara göre bu, kendisinden müstağni olunamayan bir harftir—. İsim cümlesi hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir.
(يُخادِعُونَ): Muzâri fiildir; ref' alâmeti nûnun sabit olmasıdır, çünkü ef'âl-i hamsedendir; vâv fâildir. Fiil cümlesi müste'neftir; sanki "Niçin iman ediyormuş gibi görünüyorlar?" denmiş, "Aldatıyorlar" denilmiştir. يقول'deki gizli zamirden hâl olması da muhtemeldir; yani Allah'ı ve iman edenleri aldatanlar olarak.
(اللَّهَ): يخادعون'un mef'ûlün bihidir.
(وَالَّذِينَ): الله'ya ma'tûftur.
(آمَنُوا): Fiil cümlesinin mahalli yoktur, çünkü ism-i mevsûlün sılasıdır.
(وَما): Vâv hâliyyedir; ما nefy harfidir.
(يَخْدَعُونَ): Merfû muzâri fiildir; ref' alâmeti nûnun sabit olmasıdır; vâv fâildir.
(إِلَّا): Hasr edatıdır.
(أَنْفُسَهُمْ): Mef'ûlün bihtir; hâ bitişik zamir olup izafetle cer mahallindedir.
(وَما): Vâv atıf veya isti'nâf harfidir; ما nefy harfidir.
(يَشْعُرُونَ): Merfû muzâri fiildir; cümle وما يخدعون cümlesine ma'tûftur veya müste'neftir.
(فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ): Câr ve mecrûr mukaddem haberdir.
(مَرَضٌ): Muahhar mübtedâdır.
(فَزادَهُمُ): Fâ atıf harfidir; زاد mâzî fiil, hâ mef'ûlün bihtir. Cümle, haberin müteallik olduğu şeye ma'tûftur. Fâ'nın isti'nâfiyye olması ve زادهم الله cümlesinin mahalli olmayan bir dua cümlesi (duâiyye) olması da muhtemeldir.
(اللَّهُ): زادهم'in fâilidir.
(مَرَضاً): İkinci mef'ûlün bihtir. زاد hem lâzım hem de ikincisi birincisinden başka olan iki mef'ûle müteaddî olarak kullanılır.
(وَلَهُمْ): Vâv atıf veya isti'nâf harfidir; câr ve mecrûr mukaddem haberdir.
(عَذابٌ): Muahhar mübtedâdır.
(أَلِيمٌ): عذاب'ın sıfatıdır.
(بِما): Bâ sebebiyet için cer harfidir; ما ism-i mevsûl olup bâ ile cer mahallindedir.
(كانُوا): كان ve ismidir.
(يَكْذِبُونَ): Muzâri fiil ve fâildir; cümle كانوا'nın haberidir. كان, ismi ve haberinden oluşan cümlenin mahalli yoktur, çünkü ism-i mevsûlün sılasıdır. (ما'nın) masdariyye olması da caizdir. Birinci görüşe göre mana "yalanladıkları şey sebebiyle", ikincisine göre "yalan söylüyor olmaları sebebiyle"dir. Câr ve mecrûr عذاب'ın ikinci sıfatıdır veya masdardır, yani "yalan söylüyor olmaları sebebiyle". [Mütercim notu: «أو مصدر» ifadesi kaynakta bu şekildedir; kastedilen, ما'nın masdariyye olması takdirindeki müevvel masdardır.]

* Belâgat:
1- Müşâkele: «يخادعون الله» sözündedir; çünkü mufâale (karşılıklılık) bâbı manada ortaklığı gerektirir. Bu, münafıkların aldatmasına karşılık olarak Allah Teâlâ hakkında da kullanılmıştır; tıpkı mekrin onların mekrine karşılık kullanılması gibi. Şiirde bu sanatın örneklerinden biri birinin şu sözüdür:
قالوا: التمس شيئا فجد لك طبخه ... قلت: اطبخوا لي جبة وقميصا
(Dediler ki: "Bir şey iste de sana onu güzelce pişirelim." Dedim ki: "Bana bir cübbe ve bir gömlek pişirin.")
2- Mecâz: Ona [Allah'a] nispet edilen aldatmada vardır; çünkü onlar, bunu yapabileceklerini zannederek aldatıcının fiillerini işliyorlardı; bunun nefyi doğrudur. Bu yüzden «وما يخدعون إلا أنفسهم» (Onlar ancak kendilerini aldatıyorlar) buyurmuştur.
3- İstiâre-i tasrîhiyye: «في قلوبهم مرض» sözündedir; zira maraz, onların kalplerini kaplayan cehalet, bozuk inanç ve helâke götüren benzeri cehalet türleri için istiâre edilmiştir.

* Fevâid:
1- من, nekreye mahsus bir yerde mevsûf nekre olarak gelir; Süveyd b. Ebî Kâhil'in şu sözündeki gibi:
ربّ من أنضجت غيظا قلبه ... لو تمنّى لي موتا لم يطع
(Nice kimseler vardır ki kalbini öfkeyle pişirdim; benim ölümümü temenni etse de [temennisine] itaat edilmez.)
2- Hicâziyye ما, ليس'in amelini yapan ما'dır. Hicâziyye diye adlandırılmıştır, çünkü Kur'an Hicazlıların lügatiyle gelmiştir. Hükümleri nahiv kitaplarında genişçe anlatılmıştır.

* Lügat:
(الفساد): Bir şeyin dürüst (istikametli) hâlinden çıkmasıdır; zıddı salâhtır. Yeryüzünde fesat: savaşları kızıştırmak, fitneleri körüklemek ve insanların geçim yollarını bozmaktır.
(السُّفَهاءُ): سفيه'in cemidir; sefehe (beyinsizliğe) nispet edilen kimsedir. السّفه: aklın noksanlığının gerektirdiği görüş hafifliği ve akılsızlıktır; karşılığı hilimdir. «سفه» fâ'nın kesrası ve dammesiyle söylenir.

* İ'rab:
(وَإِذا): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; ondan sonraki cümle müste'neftir, mahalli yoktur. Vâv'ın atıf harfi olması ve ondan sonraki cümlenin يكذبون cümlesine ma'tûf olması da caizdir; bu durumda كان'in haberine atıf olarak nasb mahallinde olur —habere ma'tûf olan da haberdir—; böylece bu cümle, onların elem verici azaba müstahak oldukları sebebin bir parçası olur. إذا, gelecek zaman için zarftır; şartına (izafetle) cer verir, cevabı ile mansûbdur.
(قِيلَ): Meçhul mâzî fiildir; nâib-i fâil, içinde müstetir olan ve takdiri Allah Teâlâ'ya dönen zamirdir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynak bu şekildedir; ifade eksik görünmektedir («تقديره» sonrası takdir lafzı yoktur). Ayrıca aşağıdaki «Fevâid» bölümünde nâib-i fâilin masdar zamiri olduğu söylenmektedir.] Bu ifade tarzında önemli bir bahis vardır, Fevâid bölümünde gelecektir. قيل cümlesi, zarfın ona izafe edilmesiyle cer mahallindedir.
(لَهُمْ): Câr ve mecrûr قيل'e mütealliktir.
(لا): Cezmeden nehiy lâsıdır.
(تُفْسِدُوا): لا ile meczûm muzâri fiildir; cezm alâmeti nûnun hazfidir, çünkü ef'âl-i hamsedendir; vâv fâildir.
(فِي الْأَرْضِ): Câr ve mecrûr تفسدوا'ya mütealliktir.
(قالُوا): Fiil ve fâildir; fiil cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır.
(إِنَّما): Kâffe ve mekfûfedir.
(نَحْنُ): Mübtedâdır.
(مُصْلِحُونَ): نحن'in haberidir, merfûdur; ref' alâmeti vâvdır, çünkü cem-i müzekker-i sâlimdir. Cümle mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir.
(أَلا): Kendisiyle söze başlanan tenbih harfidir.
(إِنَّهُمْ): إنّ fiile benzeyen harftir (harf-i müşebbehe bi'l-fiil); hâ onun ismidir.
(هُمُ): Fasıl veya imâd zamiridir, i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. Dilersen هم'yi mübtedâ olarak i'rab edebilirsin.
(الْمُفْسِدُونَ): Onun haberidir; isim cümlesi inne'nin haberi olarak ref' mahallindedir.
(وَلكِنْ): Vâv atıf harfidir; لكن, sakîlden (لكنّ'den) muhaffef olup yalnızca istidrak içindir.
(لا): Nefy harfidir.
(يَشْعُرُونَ): Merfû muzâri fiildir; vâv fâildir. Cümle öncekine ma'tûftur.
(وَإِذا قِيلَ): Vâv isti'nâfiyye veya atıf harfidir; bundan önce bahsi geçti. قيل fiil cümlesi, zarfın ona izafe edilmesiyle cer mahallindedir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «فيل» yazılıdır; «قيل» olmalıdır.]
(لَهُمْ): Câr ve mecrûr قيل'e mütealliktir; قيل cümlesi zarfın ona izafe edilmesiyle cer mahallindedir.
(آمِنُوا): Nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir; vâv (fâildir). Cümlenin mahalli yoktur, çünkü müfessiredir (tefsîriyye). Nâib-i fâil masdardır, yani «القول»dür; gizli tutulmuştur, çünkü ondan sonraki cümle onu tefsir etmektedir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «تفسرة» yazılıdır; «تفسّره» olmalıdır.] Takdir: «وإذا قيل لهم قول هو آمنوا» (Onlara "İman edin" şeklinde bir söz söylendiğinde); çünkü emir ve nehiy birer sözdür. Nahivciler cümlenin fâilin yerine geçmesini kabul etmemişlerdir; çünkü cümle fâil olamaz, dolayısıyla onun yerine de geçemez.
(كَما): Câr ve mecrûr, mahzûf bir masdarın sıfatıdır (na't); takdir: «آمنوا إيمانا كإيمان الناس» (İnsanların imanı gibi bir imanla iman edin). Sîbeveyh ise —kâf ister harf olsun ister «مثل» manasında isim olsun— onun hâl olarak nasb mahallinde olmasını tercih etmiştir; zü'l-hâl, önceki fiilden anlaşılan masdardır. ما masdariyyedir.
(آمَنَ النَّاسُ): Fiil ve fâilidir.
(قالُوا): Fiil ve fâildir; إذا, قالوا'ya mütealliktir. Cümlenin mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır.
(أَنُؤْمِنُ): Hemze inkârî istifhâm içindir; نؤمن muzâri fiildir, fâili içinde vücûben müstetir olan ve takdiri «نحن» olan zamirdir.
(كَما): İ'rabı az önce geçti.
(آمَنَ السُّفَهاءُ): Fiil ve fâildir.
(أَلا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ السُّفَهاءُ وَلكِنْ لا يَعْلَمُونَ): Bu cümlenin bir benzerinin i'rabı az önce geçti.

* Belâgat:
1- Ayette istifhâm, asıl manası olan bilgi talebinden, sözün muhtevasından anlaşılan başka amaçlara çıkmıştır. Bunun tafsilatı Meânî ilmindedir; bunun dönüp dayandığı yer selim zevktir. Voltaire «Zevkin senin hocandır» derken doğru söylemiştir.
2- Teğâyür (farklılık): Bu, neredeyse «من المرقص» olacak bir sanattır [Mütercim notu: Kaynaktaki «يكاد يكون من المرقص» ifadesi belirsizdir; olduğu gibi bırakılmıştır]. Birinci fâsılada «لا يشعرون», ikinci fâsılada «لا يعلمون» gelmiştir; bunda ancak ilham sahiplerinin kavrayabileceği şaşırtıcı bir sır vardır. Bunun tafsilatı şudur: Din meselesi ve müminlerin hak üzere, münafıkların ise bâtıl üzere olduğunu kavramak, bakan kişinin ilim ve marifet kazanması için uzak görüşe ve istidlâle ihtiyaç duyan bir iştir. Nifak ise ve onda bulunan, fitnenin kızışmasına ve yeryüzünde fesadın yayılıp derinleşmesine götüren azgınlık, âdetlere dayanan dünyevî bir iştir ve insanlarca bilinir; hatta onlara göre duyuyla algılanan bir şey gibidir. Bu yüzden onun hakkında «لا يشعرون» (farkında değiller) buyurmuştur. Ayrıca ikinci ayette —tam bir cehalet olan— sefeh zikredilince, ilmin zikredilmesi daha uygun düşmüş ve «لا يعلمون» (bilmiyorlar) buyurmuştur. Bu, ince noktalardandır; buna dikkat et.

* Fevâid:
1- قيل'in nâib-i fâili: Nahivciler onu masdarının zamiri olarak takdir ederler; nehiy cümlesi o zarfı tefsir eden (müfessire) cümledir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «لذلك الظرف» (o zarfı) yazılıdır; bağlama göre «o masdarı / zamiri» kastedilmiş olabilir.] Zarfın nâib-i fâil olduğu da söylenmiştir; bu durumda cümle nasb mahallindedir. Cümlenin fâil veya nâib-i fâil olarak gelmesi hususunda ihtilaf etmişlerdir. Doğru görüş şudur: Lafzı kastedilen cümleye müfredlerin hükmü verilir. Bu yüzden mübtedâ olarak da gelir; «لا حول ولا قوة كنز من كنوز الجنة» ("Lâ havle ve lâ kuvvete" sözü cennet hazinelerinden bir hazinedir) örneğinde olduğu gibi. Atasözünde de «زعموا مطيّة الكذب» ("İddia ettiler ki" sözü yalanın bineğidir) denir. Bu yüzden haber bir râbıtaya ihtiyaç duymamıştır.
2- (أَلا): Bunun, söze kendisiyle başlanan ve kendisinden sonrakinin mutlaka gerçekleşmiş olduğuna dikkat çeken basit bir harf olduğu söylenmiştir. Bunun, istifhâm hemzesi ile nefy harfinden mürekkep bir harf olduğu da söylenmiştir; istifhâm nefyin üzerine girdiğinde tahkik ifade eder. Kardeşi, yeminin öncülerinden olan (أما)'dır; şairin şu sözünde olduğu gibi:
أما والذي بكى وأضحك والذي ... أمات وأحيا والذي أمره الأمر
(Dikkat edin! Ağlatan ve güldüren, öldüren ve dirilten, emri asıl emir olan [Allah]'a yemin olsun ki...) [Mütercim notu: Beyitte kaynakta «بكى» yazılıdır; beytin bilinen rivayeti «أبكى»dir ve anlam buna göre verilmiştir.]

* Vocabulary:
(الفساد): corruption (fasād) is a thing's going out of its state of uprightness; its opposite is ṣalāḥ (soundness). Corruption in the earth is stirring up wars, provoking sedition (fitan), and disrupting people's livelihoods.
(السُّفَهاءُ): plural of safīh, meaning one ascribed to safah; and safah is lightness of judgement and flimsiness required by deficiency of intellect, and its opposite is forbearance (ḥilm). One says safiha, with kasra on the fāʾ, and safuha, with ḍamma on it.

* I'rab:
(وَإِذا): the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is a new start with no position; it is also possible that the wāw is a conjunction and the clause after it conjoined to the clause «يكذبون», so that it is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the khabar of kāna, and what is conjoined to a khabar is a khabar. In this case it is part of the cause for which they deserved the painful punishment. And «إذا» is an adverb of future time, governing its protasis in the genitive and being put in the accusative by its apodosis. (قِيلَ): a passive past verb, its deputy agent a latent pronoun implied in it, its implied form being [Translator's note: the source gives no pronoun here; apparently "he"] referring to Allah the Exalted; there is an important discussion of this expression that will come in the section of benefits. The clause «قيل» is in the position of genitive, the adverb being annexed to it. (لَهُمْ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «قيل». (لا): lā of prohibition, which jusses. (تُفْسِدُوا): an imperfect verb jussive through lā, the sign of its jussive case being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, the wāw an agent. (فِي الْأَرْضِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تفسدوا». (قالُوا): verb and agent; the verbal clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. (إِنَّما): inna with the preventing mā (kāffa and makfūfa). (نَحْنُ): mubtadaʾ. (مُصْلِحُونَ): the khabar of «نحن», nominative, the sign of its nominative case being the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; and the clause is in the position of accusative, the thing said. (أَلا): a particle of alerting, with which speech is opened. (إِنَّهُمْ): inna is a particle resembling the verb and the hāʾ is its noun. (هُمُ): a separating pronoun or support, with no grammatical position; you may also parse «هم» as mubtadaʾ. (الْمُفْسِدُونَ): its khabar, and the nominal clause is in the position of nominative, the khabar of inna. (وَلكِنْ): the wāw is a conjunction, and lākin is the lightened form of the heavy one, for mere rectification (istidrāk). (لا): negative. (يَشْعُرُونَ): a nominative imperfect verb, the wāw an agent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. (وَإِذا قِيلَ): the wāw is resumptive or a conjunction, and discussion of it has preceded; and the verbal clause «قيل» is in the position of genitive, the adverb being annexed to it. (لَهُمْ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «قيل», and the clause «قيل» is in the position of genitive, the adverb being annexed to it. (آمِنُوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on dropping of the nūn, and the wāw; the clause has no position because it is explicative. The deputy agent is a maṣdar, namely «القول», and it was implied because the clause after it explains it; the implied form: "and when a saying was said to them, which is 'believe'", because command and prohibition are speech. The grammarians have forbidden that a clause stand in the place of the agent, because a clause is not an agent and so does not stand in its place. (كَما): the preposition and its genitive noun are an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being "believe with a belief like the belief of the people"; Sībawayh preferred that it be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, whether the kāf is a particle or a noun meaning "like", and the owner of the ḥāl is the maṣdar understood from the preceding verb; and «ما» is maṣdar-forming. (آمَنَ النَّاسُ): verb and agent. (قالُوا): verb and agent, and «إذا» is attached to «قالوا», and the clause has no position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. (أَنُؤْمِنُ): the hamza is of denying interrogation, and «نؤمن» is an imperfect verb, its agent a latent pronoun obligatorily implied, its implied form being "we". (كَما): its parsing has just preceded. (آمَنَ السُّفَهاءُ): verb and agent. (أَلا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ السُّفَهاءُ وَلكِنْ لا يَعْلَمُونَ): the parsing of the like of this clause has just preceded.

* Rhetoric:
1- In the verse the interrogative departs from its original meaning, which is the seeking of knowledge, to other purposes understood from the content of the speech; the details are in the science of maʿānī, and the matter returns to sound taste. Voltaire spoke truly when he said: «ذوقك أستاذك» ("Your taste is your teacher").
2- Variation (taghāyur): an art that is almost [Translator's note: the source reads «يكاد يكون من المرقص», which is unclear; translated as it stands]. In the first closing phrase there occurred «لا يشعرون», and in the second closing phrase there occurred «لا يعلمون», for a wonderful secret that only the inspired grasp. The detail of it: the matter of religion, and the standing upon the fact that the believers are on the truth while the hypocrites are on falsehood, is a matter that needs far-sightedness and inference, so that the observer acquires knowledge and cognition; whereas hypocrisy and the wrongdoing in it that leads to the clashing of sedition and the vastness of corruption in the earth is a worldly matter based on customs, known to people, indeed like something perceived by the senses among them; therefore He said of it: «لا يشعرون». Also, since He mentioned foolishness (safah) in the second verse, which is total ignorance, the mention of knowledge was more fitting, so He said: «لا يعلمون». This is among the subtleties, so be alert to it.

* Benefits:
1- The deputy agent of «قيل»: the grammarians take it to be a pronoun for its maṣdar, and the clause of prohibition explains that adverb [Translator's note: so in the source]. It was also said that the adverb is the deputy agent, and so the clause is in the position of accusative. They disagreed about a clause's occurring as agent or deputy agent; the sound view is that a clause whose wording itself is meant is given the ruling of single words, which is why it can occur as mubtadaʾ, as in «لا حول ولا قوة كنز من كنوز الجنة» ("lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata is a treasure from the treasures of Paradise") and in the proverb «زعموا مطيّة الكذب» ("They claimed is the mount of falsehood"); and for this reason the khabar needs no link.
2- (أَلا): it was said that it is a simple particle with which speech is opened, alerting that what follows is certainly realised; and it was said that it is a particle compounded of the interrogative hamza and the negative particle, and an interrogative that enters a negative gives confirmation. Its sister is «أما», which is among the preliminaries of an oath, as in the saying:
أما والذي بكى وأضحك والذي ... أمات وأحيا والذي أمره الأمر
[Translator's note: the source reads «بكى» (wept); «أبكى» (made weep) is the known reading and is rendered here.] (By Him who made weep and made laugh, and who gave death and gave life, and whose command is the Command.)

* Lügat:
(الطّغيان): طغى fiilinin masdarıdır; tâ'nın dammesi ve kesrasıyla «طغيانا» denir. طغى'nın lâm'ının (lâme'l-fiilinin) yâ olduğu da, vâv olduğu da söylenmiştir. Manası haddi aşmaktır.
(يَعْمَهُونَ): العمه: tereddüt ve şaşkınlıktır. العمى (körlük)'ya yakındır; ancak ikisi arasında umum-husus vardır; çünkü العمى hem gözün nurunun gitmesi hem de görüşte (fikirde) hata için kullanılır; العمه ise yalnızca görüşte hata için kullanılır.

* İ'rab:
(وَإِذا): Öncekine ma'tûftur. إذا'nın i'rabı tekrar tekrar geçti; geçene kıyas edilir.
(لَقُوا): Aslı «لقيوا»dur. Cemaat vâvına bitiştiği için damme üzere mebnî mâzî fiildir. Damme yâ üzerinde ağır görülmüş, hazfedilmiş ve harekesi kâfa nakledilmiştir. Vâv fâildir. Cümle, zarfın ona izafe edilmesiyle cer mahallindedir.
(الَّذِينَ): İsm-i mevsûldür, mef'ûlün bihtir.
(آمَنُوا): Fiil ve fâildir; cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü ism-i mevsûlün sılasıdır.
(قالُوا): Fiil ve fâildir; fiil cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır.
(آمَنَّا): Fiil ve fâildir; fiil cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavldir.
(وَإِذا): Önceki وإذا'ya ma'tûftur.
(خَلَوْا): İki sâkinin birleşmesi sebebiyle hazfedilen elif üzerinde takdîrî damme üzere mebnî mâzî fiildir; vâv fâildir. Cümle, zarfın ona izafe edilmesiyle cer mahallindedir.
(إِلى شَياطِينِهِمْ): Câr ve mecrûr خلوا'ya mütealliktir. إلى'nın manası gayenin sonudur (intihâü'l-ğâye); bahsi Fevâid bölümünde gelecektir.
(قالُوا): Mâzî fiildir; cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
(إِنَّا): إنّ fiile benzeyen harftir; نا bitişik zamir olup onun ismi olarak nasb mahallindedir.
(مَعَكُمْ): مع mekân zarfıdır, inne'nin mahzûf haberine mütealliktir; kâf muzâfun ileyhtir. إنا معكم isim cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir.
(إِنَّما): Kâffe ve mekfûfedir.
(نَحْنُ): Ayrı zamirdir, mübtedâ olarak ref' mahallindedir.
(مُسْتَهْزِؤُنَ): نحن'in haberidir, merfûdur; ref' alâmeti vâvdır, çünkü cem-i müzekker-i sâlimdir. İsim cümlesi, إنا معكم cümlesinin te'kîdidir; dolayısıyla mekûlü'l-kavl kapsamına dahildir. Dilersen onu, beraberlik iddiasından doğan bir soruya dayanan, mahalli olmayan müste'nef bir cümle de yapabilirsin; sanki onlar «إنا معكم» dediklerinde kendilerine "Öyleyse ne oluyor da iman kelimesiyle müminlere uyuyorsunuz?" denmiş, onlar da «إنما نحن مستهزئون» (Biz sadece alay ediyoruz) demişlerdir. Ya da bu cümle beraberliği ta'lîl eden (ta'lîliyye) bir cümledir.
(اللَّهُ): Mübtedâdır.
(يَسْتَهْزِئُ): Muzâri fiildir; fâili, içinde cevâzen müstetir olan ve الله'ya dönen zamirdir. Fiil cümlesi haberdir.
(بِهِمْ): Câr ve mecrûr يستهزئ'e mütealliktir.
(وَيَمُدُّهُمْ): Vâv atıf harfidir; يمدهم, يستهزئ'e atfen merfû muzâri fiildir; fâil müstetir olup takdiri «هو»dur; hâ bitişik zamir olup mef'ûlün bih olarak nasb mahallindedir.
(فِي طُغْيانِهِمْ): Câr ve mecrûr يمدهم'e mütealliktir.
(يَعْمَهُونَ): Merfû muzâri fiildir; vâv fâildir. Fiil cümlesi, يمدهم'deki zamirden hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir.

* Belâgat:
Bu iki ayet birçok belâgat sanatını içine almıştır; bunları aşağıda özetliyoruz:
1- Cümleler arasındaki farklılık (mufâraka): Müminlere fiil cümlesiyle, yani آمنا cümlesiyle hitap etmişler; şeytanlarına ise isim cümlesiyle, yani إنا معكم cümlesiyle hitap etmişlerdir. Bunun sebebi, isim cümlesinin fiil cümlesinden daha sabit olmasıdır. Onların imanı kısa sürelidir; dili kımıldatmayı ya da müminlerle karşılaştıkları süreyi aşmaz. Şeytanlarına meyletmeleri ise sürekli devam eden ve yenilenen bir şeydir; nefislerine daha bağlı ve onlarda kökleşmiş olana daha sıkı bağlıdır.
2- مستهزئون cümlesi ile يستهزئ cümlesi arasındaki farklılık: Çünkü Allah'ın onlarla alay etmesi vakitten vakte, hâlden hâle yenilenmektedir; onları cezalandırmayı artırmak için şaşkınlık ve karışıklık labirentlerine düşürür.
3- Müşâkele: Sabittir ki istihzâ (alay) bir tür abesle iştigal ve oyundur; bu ikisi Allah Teâlâ'ya yakışmaz ve O bunlardan münezzehtir. Fakat O, istihzânın cezasını istihzâ diye adlandırmıştır; bu, ne eksik ne fazla lafzî bir müşâkeledir.
4- «الله يستهزئ بهم» sözündeki vâcib fasıl: Çünkü bu cümlenin önceki cümlelerden birine atfedilmesinde güçlü bir engel vardır; zira o takdirde münafıkların sözü (mekûlü'l-kavl) kapsamına girerdi. Hâlbuki Allah'ın onlarla alay etmesi ve onları yardımsız bırakması, ister şeytanlarıyla baş başa kalsınlar ister kalmasınlar, sabit ve süreklidir. Dolayısıyla cümle her hâlükârda müste'neftir; çünkü ortaya çıkan bir soruya yer açar: "Onların işinin varacağı yer nedir? Hâllerinin akıbeti nedir?" denir; bu soruya cevap olarak isti'nâf yapılır (yeni söze başlanır).

* Fevâid:
Nahivciler cer harfi إلى için birtakım manalar zikretmişlerdir. Birincisi intihâ (son)dır; bu onda asıldır. İkincisi beraberliktir; Allah Teâlâ'nın «مَنْ أَنْصارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ» kavlinde olduğu gibi, yani «مع الله» (Allah ile beraber). Üçüncüsü tebyîndir: Sevgi veya buğz ifade eden bir taaccüp fiilinden ya da ism-i tafdîlden sonra, mecrûrunun fâil olduğunu açıklayan إلى'dır; «رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ» (Rabbim! Zindan bana daha sevimlidir) gibi. Dördüncüsü lâm ile eş anlamlı olmasıdır; «وَالْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ» (Emir sana aittir) gibi. Beşincisi (في) manasına uygun olmasıdır; Nâbiğa ez-Zübyânî'nin şu sözünde olduğu gibi:
فلا تتركني بالوعيد كأنني ... إلى الناس مطليّ به القار أجرب
(Beni tehditlerle, insanlar arasında katran sürülmüş uyuz biri gibi bırakma.)
Altıncısı (عند) manasına uygun olmasıdır; Ebû Kebîr el-Hüzelî'nin şu sözünde olduğu gibi:
أم لا سبيل إلى الشباب وذكره ... أشهى إليّ من الرحيق السّلسل
(Yoksa gençliğe dönmenin bir yolu yok mu? Onu anmak bana göre berrak, saf şaraptan daha hoştur.)
Yedincisi te'kîddir; bazılarının «أفئدة من الناس تهوى إليهم» kavlini تهوى'deki vâvın fethasıyla (تَهْوَى) okuması gibi; تهوى'ya «meyleder» (تميل) manası tazmin edilerek.

* Vocabulary:
(الطّغيان): the maṣdar of ṭaghā ṭughyānan, with ḍamma or kasra on the ṭāʾ; the lām of ṭaghā, it was said, is yāʾ, and it was said wāw; its meaning is transgressing the limit.
(يَعْمَهُونَ): ʿamah is wavering and bewilderment. It is close to blindness (ʿamā), but between them there is a general-and-specific relation, because ʿamā is applied to the departure of the light of the eye and to error in judgement, whereas ʿamah is applied only to error in judgement.

* I'rab:
(وَإِذا): conjoined to what precedes, and the parsing of «إذا» has been repeated, so it is inferred from what precedes. (لَقُوا): its original is laqiyū; it is a past verb indeclinable on ḍamma because it is attached to the wāw of the group; the ḍamma was felt heavy on the yāʾ so it was dropped and its vowel moved to the qāf; the wāw is an agent, and the clause is in the position of genitive, the adverb being annexed to it. (الَّذِينَ): a relative noun, direct object. (آمَنُوا): verb and agent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative. (قالُوا): verb and agent; the verbal clause has no position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. (آمَنَّا): verb and agent; the verbal clause is the thing said. (وَإِذا): conjoined to the preceding «وإذا». (خَلَوْا): a past verb, indeclinable on an implied ḍamma on the omitted alif, dropped because of the meeting of two sākins, the wāw an agent; the clause is in the position of genitive, the adverb being annexed to it. (إِلى شَياطِينِهِمْ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خلوا», and the meaning of «إلى» is the end of the limit; its discussion will come in the section of benefits. (قالُوا): a past verb; the clause has no position. (إِنَّا): inna is a particle resembling the verb, and nā an attached pronoun in the position of accusative, its noun. (مَعَكُمْ): maʿa is an adverb of place attached to an omitted element which is the khabar of inna, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «إنا معكم» is nominal, in the position of accusative, the thing said. (إِنَّما): kāffa and makfūfa. (نَحْنُ): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ. (مُسْتَهْزِؤُنَ): the khabar of «نحن», nominative, the sign of its nominative case being the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the nominal clause is an emphasis of the clause «إنا معكم», so it is within the scope of the thing said; you may also make it resumptive, with no position, based on a question arising from the claim of being "with" them, as though it were said to them when they said «إنا معكم»: "Then why do you follow the believers in the word of belief?", and they said: «إنما نحن مستهزئون»; or it is a justification of the "withness". (اللَّهُ): mubtadaʾ. (يَسْتَهْزِئُ): an imperfect verb, its agent a latent pronoun optionally implied, referring to Allah; the verbal clause is the khabar. (بِهِمْ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يستهزئ». (وَيَمُدُّهُمْ): the wāw is a conjunction, and «يمدهم» is a nominative imperfect verb conjoined to «يستهزئ»; the agent is latent, its implied form being "he", and the hāʾ [Translator's note: in the source; the pronoun is «هم»] is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative, a direct object. (فِي طُغْيانِهِمْ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يمدهم». (يَعْمَهُونَ): a nominative imperfect verb, the wāw an agent; the verbal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun in «يمدهم».

* Rhetoric:
These two verses contain several arts of rhetoric, which we summarise below:
1- Contrast between the clauses: they addressed the believers with a verbal clause, namely «آمنا», and addressed their devils with a nominal clause, namely «إنا معكم», because the nominal clause is more firmly established than the verbal clause. Their belief is of short range, going no further than the movement of the tongue, or the duration of their meeting with the believers, whereas their relying on their devils is permanently continuous and renewed, more attached to their souls and more connected to what has taken root in them.
2- The difference between the clause «مستهزئون» and the clause «يستهزئ»: because Allah's mocking of them is renewed time after time and state after state, casting them into the mazes of bewilderment and confusion, to increase the exemplary punishment of them.
3- Isomorphism (mushākala): it is established that mockery is a kind of frivolity and play, which do not befit Allah the Exalted, and He is exalted above them; but He called the requital of mockery "mockery"; so it is a verbal isomorphism, no less and no more.
4- Obligatory separation (faṣl) in the saying «الله يستهزىء بهم»: because in conjoining it to any of the preceding clauses there is a strong obstacle, as it would then enter within the scope of what the hypocrites said, whereas Allah's mocking of them and His forsaking them are established and continuous, whether they are alone with their devils or not. So the clause is resumptive in every case, because it is a place where a question arises, "What is the outcome of their affair? What is the end of their state?", so it is begun anew as an answer to this question.

* Benefits:
The grammarians mentioned meanings for the prepositional «إلى». The first is termination, which is its original; the second is accompaniment, as in the saying of the Exalted: «مَنْ أَنْصارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ», that is, "with Allah"; the third is clarification, being the one that clarifies the agency of its genitive noun after what indicates love or hate, from a verb of wonder or a noun of preference, as in «رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ»; the fourth is synonymy with lām, as in «وَالْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ»; the fifth is agreement with «في», as in the saying of al-Nābigha al-Dhubyānī:
فلا تتركني بالوعيد كأنني ... إلى الناس مطليّ به القار أجرب
(Do not leave me with your threats, as though I were, among the people, a scabby one smeared with tar.)
the sixth is agreement with «عند», as in the saying of Abū Kabīr al-Hudhalī:
أم لا سبيل إلى الشباب وذكره ... أشهى إليّ من الرحيق السّلسل
(Or is there no way back to youth, and the mention of it is more desirable to me than smooth pure wine?)
and the seventh is emphasis, as in the reading of some: «أفئدة من الناس تهوى إليهم» with fatḥa on the wāw of «تهوى», on the basis that «تهوى» is made to contain the meaning "inclines".

* I'rab:
(أُولئِكَ) a demonstrative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (الَّذِينَ) khabar (predicate) of أولئك. (اشْتَرَوُا) a past verb, indeclinable on an implied ḍamma on the omitted alif, omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الضَّلالَةَ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بِالْهُدى) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اشتروا; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. (فَما) the fāʾ is a conjunction expressing immediate sequence, and ما is negative. (رَبِحَتْ) a past verb, and the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine. (تِجارَتُهُمْ) the fāʿil of ربحت. (وَما) the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negative. (كانُوا) كان is a defective past verb and the wāw is its ism (subject). (مُهْتَدِينَ) its khabar, and the sign of its accusative case is the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. (مَثَلُهُمْ) mubtadaʾ. (كَمَثَلِ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted word that is the khabar of مثلهم; or else the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), serving as khabar, and مثل is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive complement). (الَّذِي) a relative noun in the position of genitive as the second term of the genitive construct. (اسْتَوْقَدَ) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, meaning أوقد ("he kindled"); it is the form istafʿala used in the sense of afʿala, like أجاب and استجاب, and أخلف and استخلف. The fāʿil is a latent pronoun (permissibly latent), its implied form being "he". The clause استوقد has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun. The singular الذي is used in the place of the plural الذين, which is why He said afterwards: «بنورهم». (ناراً)
mafʿūl bihi. The clause مثلهم is resumptive, put forward to coin a parable for the state of the hypocrites who bought error with guidance, to bring the picture vividly to mind and to lift the veils from the realities. (فَلَمَّا) the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لما is an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna) that contains the sense of a condition; it is also said to be a particle of "occurrence due to occurrence" (ḥarf wujūb li-wujūb), and Ibn Hishām called it a "linking" particle (rābiṭa). (أَضاءَتْ) a past verb, the tāʾ being the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun (permissibly latent), its implied form being "it" (feminine). (ما) a relative noun meaning "the place", mafʿūl bihi. (حَوْلَهُ) an adverb of place attached to an omitted word that is the ṣila of ما. Some lexicographers claimed that أضاء is an intransitive verb, in which case ما must be redundant (zāʾida), that is, "it shone around him". (ذَهَبَ اللَّهُ) verb and agent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of a non-jussive condition. (بِنُورِهِمْ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ذهب. (وَتَرَكَهُمْ) a past verb, with a latent agent (permissibly latent) and a first direct object. (فِي ظُلُماتٍ) the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of the second object of تركهم. (لا) negative. (يُبْصِرُونَ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as an emphatic ḥāl (circumstantial), because whoever is in darkness does not see.

* Rhetoric:
These two verses contain rhetorical devices that the pages can hardly hold; we shall try to summarize these devices.
1- The explicit metaphor with embellishment (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya tarshīḥiyya). The meaning is "they chose" and "they exchanged", and the clue to the metaphor is الضلالة. Then this metaphor is embellished by His words: فما ربحت تجارتهم, in which profit is attributed to trade. So the source of the metaphor, which is buying, is embellished with the words "profit" and "trade" because of the congruity between buying and profit. Embellishment (tarshīḥ) is to present the figurative expression in the form of the literal, and then to judge it with some of the attributes of the literal, so that one figure is added to another. An example is the line of Ḥumayda bint al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr: ؟؟ بكى الخزّ من روح وأنكر جلده ... وعجّت عجيجا من جذام المطارف (The silk wept over Rawḥ and disowned his skin, and the silk mantles cried out loudly over Judhām.) [Translator's note: the source text shows two question marks (؟؟) here, an apparent scanning/printing defect; they are reproduced as they stand.] ؟؟ She made the silk stand in for a person when it came into contact with Rawḥ, weeping for the lack of fit, by her words: وأنكر جلده. Then she added further embellishment of the figure by her words:
وعجّت, that is, the silk mantles shouted on account of the tribe of Rawḥ, which is the tribe of Judhām. The meaning of the verse is that Rawḥ and his tribe Judhām are not fit to wear silk and its mantles, because they have no habit of it, so she alluded to them in the manner she did in the verse.
2- The difference between اشتروا and استبدلوا in two respects:
a- Exchange (istibdāl) is not a purchase unless it contains a benefit sought by the one making the exchange, whether real or imagined.
b- Purchase takes place between two parties to a sale, unlike exchange: if you take one of your garments in place of another, it is said that you "exchanged a garment for a garment". So the meaning that the verse conveys is that those people chose error over guidance for a benefit they believed they would obtain from people in return for it; thus it is a transaction between two parties aiming at profit, and this is the meaning of ishtirāʾ (buying), as with "selling" (bayʿ) and "trading" (ibtiyāʿ), whereas mere exchange does not convey it. Once you know this, you will grasp the secret of choosing اشتروا over استبدلوا, and you will see that the Qur'an, which is the highest degree of eloquence, does not choose one word over another that could stand in its place except for a wisdom in that and a particularity not found in the other.
3- Completion (tatmīm) in His words: «وما كانوا مهتدين». Its definition is that a word or a statement comes in the speech which, if removed, would make the meaning deficient in itself or in its attributes, or it comes for a fine addition. So His words «وما كانوا مهتدين» complete what precedes, indicating that they are misguided in all the actions they undertake.
4- The representational simile (tashbīh tamthīlī) in His words: «مثلهم كمثل الذي استوقد نارا فلما أضاءت ما حوله ذهب الله بنورهم». The reality of the representational simile is that the point of likeness is a picture drawn from several elements: that is, the state of the hypocrites in their hypocrisy, showing the opposite of the disbelief they conceal, is like the state of one who kindled a fire to gain light by it, then it went out and he could no longer see anything. Thus it appears to you that the representational simile works like magic in joining disparate things; it shows you for meanings represented only by fancies a likeness in figures standing before you; it makes the mute speak for you, gives you eloquence from the inarticulate, shows you life in inanimate things, and makes the near thing far. An example of it in poetry is the saying of Bashshār:
كأن مثار النقع فوق رؤوسنا ... وأسيافنا ليل تهاوى كواكبه
(As though the raised dust above our heads, with our swords, were a night whose stars come tumbling down.) For he likened the dust stirred up and massed above the heads, with the swords clashing within it during the battle, to the pitch-black night in which the stars tumble and the meteors fall. And the saying of Abū Tammām describing spring:
يا صاحبيّ تقصّيا نظريكما ... تريا وجوه الأرض كيف تصوّر
تريا نهارا مشمسا قد شابه ... زهر الربا فكأنما هو مقمر
(O my two companions, strain your sight to the farthest, and you will see the face of the earth, how it is being shaped. You will see a sunlit day mixed with the blossoms of the hills, so that it seems moonlit.) He likened the sunny day in the splendid garden crowned with flowers to the calm, moonlit night.
5- The variation between the two pronouns. The pronoun is singular in استوقد and حوله, looking to the side of the wording, because the hypocrites all share one saying and one deed. As for regard for the side of meaning in (بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ), it is because the context is one of denouncing their states and declaring their selves («ذاتهم») [Translator's note: so in the source; «ذواتهم» or «ذمّهم» may be intended] and misguidance, so the judgement is established for every one of them.
6- Muraʿāt al-naẓīr (observing the counterpart), a device known among the scholars of rhetoric as "congruity" and "harmony" (tanāsub, i'tilāf). Its definition is that the speaker joins a thing with what suits it while leaving out mention of its opposite, so as to exclude antithesis (muṭābaqa). Here it lies in the mention of "illumination" (ḍawʾ) and "light" (nūr). The secret of mentioning "light" although the context would require saying بضوئهم to match أضاءت, is that ḍawʾ carries an indication of increase, so had He said بضوئهم it would have suggested the taking away of the surplus while what is called nūr remained, whereas the aim is the removal of the light from them entirely and its complete obliteration. This meaning is confirmed by His saying ذهب بنورهم and not أذهب نورهم. The difference between the two is that أذهبه means "he removed it and made it go", whereas ذهب به means "he took it along and went off with it". The aim is to convey that no hope is left of that light ever returning to them at all; for had it been said أذهب الله نورهم, it might have been imagined that He only took the light away from them while it remained with Him, and that He might perhaps compensate them for what they lost. When He said ذهب الله بنورهم, that cut off and severed the root of any hope of their obtaining any good for themselves or from Him. This is among the loftiest that eloquence reaches. Ibn al-Rūmī clung to the fringes of this eloquence when he said, describing the Rāziqī grape:
لم يبق منه وهج الحرور ... إلّا ضياء في ظروف نور
(The blaze of the scorching heat left nothing of it but a radiance within vessels of light.) He made the grape's juice a radiance because it is more intensely blazing and gleams more, while its skin is like a light that protects and preserves that radiance. How skilled Ibn al-Rūmī was in borrowing it!

* Benefits:
1- The kāf of likeness has three states:
a- It must be a noun, which is when it is a khabar, a fāʿil, a mafʿūl, or governed by a preposition or by annexation, as in the verse above and as in the saying of Abū al-Ṭayyib:
وما قتل الأحرار كالعفو عنهم ... ومن لك بالحر الذي يحفظ اليدا
(Nothing kills free men like pardoning them; and who will provide you a free man who remembers a favour?)
b- It must be a particle, which is when it occurs as the ṣila of a relative noun.
c- Both are permissible in what remains besides these, and further discussion of the kāf will come in this book.
2- ترك: originally means "he cast away and left", so it takes one object; sometimes it contains the sense of "making into", so it takes two.

* Vocabulary:
(صُمٌّ) plural of أصمّ, the one who does not hear. One says صمّ يصمّ (with fatḥa on the ṣād in both), meaning his hearing became heavy; it is also said that the root meaning is "blocking", and one says «صست القارورة», meaning "I blocked the bottle" [Translator's note: so in the source; «صممت» (ṣamamtu) is presumably intended].
(بُكْمٌ) plural of أبكم, the one who does not speak, that is, the mute.
(عُمْيٌ) plural of أعمى. ʿAmā (blindness) is a darkness in the eye that prevents the perception of visible things. Its verb is of the pattern عمي, fa-ʿila with kasra on the ʿayn, and its active participle is of the pattern أعمى, which is the regular analogy for ailments and defects.
(صيّب) it is the rain that pours down (yaṣūbu), that is, descends; its origin is ṣayyūb: the yāʾ and the wāw came together with the first of them quiescent, so the wāw was changed to yāʾ and the yāʾ was merged into the yāʾ.
(السّماء) everything that is above you and shades you is a "sky" (samāʾ). The word samāʾ is feminine, and sometimes made masculine. He said:
فلو رفع السماء إليه قوما ... لحقنا بالسماء مع السحاب
(Had the sky raised a people up to it, we would have reached the sky with the clouds.)

* I'rab:
(صُمٌّ) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, that is, "they are deaf"; the clause is resumptive. (بُكْمٌ) a second khabar. (عُمْيٌ) a third khabar. Although these predicates differ in wording, they are united in what they denote and mean, because they all come down to non-acceptance of the truth. (فَهُمْ) the fāʾ is a conjunction and هم is mubtadaʾ. (لا يَرْجِعُونَ) لا is negative and يرجعون is an imperfect verb, nominative, with the wāw as fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of هم, and the clause is conjoined to "they are deaf", that is, "they do not return to guidance". The meaning is that their faculties of perception have had their structures, built for sensation and comprehension, demolished. (أَوْ) a conjunction of distribution (lil-tafṣīl), that is, among those who look at their state, some liken them to the state of the one who kindled a fire and some liken them to the owners of a downpour. (كَصَيِّبٍ) the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to كمثل, and a muḍāf must be implied, that is, "like the owners of a downpour", by the evidence of يجعلون أصابعهم في آذانهم. (مِنَ السَّماءِ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of صيب. (فِيهِ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (ظُلُماتٌ) a postponed mubtadaʾ. (وَرَعْدٌ وَبَرْقٌ) conjoined to ظلمات. (يَجْعَلُونَ) an imperfect verb, nominative, with the wāw as fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, brought to answer an implied question, as if it had been asked, "And what is their state with that thunder?", and it was said, "They put...". (أَصابِعَهُمْ) mafʿūl bihi. (فِي آذانِهِمْ) the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of the second object of يجعلون. (مِنَ الصَّواعِقِ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يجعلون, and min is causal; see the Benefits. (حَذَرَ الْمَوْتِ) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). (وَاللَّهُ) the wāw is parenthetical and الله is mubtadaʾ. (مُحِيطٌ) khabar. (بِالْكافِرِينَ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to محيط; the clause has no grammatical position because it is parenthetical between two clauses of a single story, namely «يجعلون أصابعهم» and «يكاد البرق». (يَكادُ) an imperfect verb, nominative, one of the verbs of approximation that work like كان; it has two dialects, faʿila and faʿula [Translator's note: the source writes both patterns unvowelled; these are evidently meant], which is why one says kidtu (with kasra on the kāf) and kudtu (with ḍamma). (الْبَرْقُ) the nominative ism of يكاد. (يَخْطَفُ) an imperfect verb, nominative, with a latent agent (permissibly latent), its implied form being "it", referring to البرق; the clause يخطف is the khabar of يكاد, and the khabar of these verbs can only be an imperfect verb. The clause يكاد is resumptive, as if it were the answer of someone who says, "And what is their state with that lightning?", and it was said: «يكاد». (أَبْصارَهُمْ) mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as the second term of the genitive construct. (كُلَّما) كل is accusative as an adverb of time; the adverbial sense has passed to كل from its annexation to the temporal maṣdar-forming ما, and ما with what follows it, (أَضاءَ), is in the interpretation of a maṣdar in the position of genitive as the second term of the construct. It is also said that ما is an indefinite noun that is qualified, meaning "time", the returning pronoun being omitted, the implied form being "every time it shone for them in it". So the clause أضاء in the first view has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-like relative, and in the second its position is genitive as an adjective. Kullamā by itself contains the sense of a condition, and the operator in it is its apodosis. (لَهُمْ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أضاء. (مَشَوْا) a past verb, indeclinable on an implied ḍamma on the omitted alif, omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause مشوا فيه has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. (فِيهِ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مشوا. (وَإِذا) the wāw is a conjunction and إذا is an adverb for the future time, governing its condition in the genitive, accusative by its apodosis. (أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa; the fāʿil is latent (permissibly latent), its implied form being "it", referring to البرق; the clause is in the position of genitive through the annexation of the adverb to it, and عليهم is attached to أظلم. (قامُوا) verb and agent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. (وَلَوْ) the wāw is resumptive and لو is conditional. Sībawayh's phrase is that it is "a particle for what would have occurred because of the occurrence of something else", which is better than the grammarians' saying that it is a "particle of prevention due to prevention"; interesting discussions of it will come in this book. (شاءَ اللَّهُ) verb and agent; the object of willing is omitted. This omission is permissible in the speech of the Arabs, who hardly ever mention the object of شاء except for a remarkable matter, as in the saying of al-Khuraymī:
فلو شئت أن أبكي دما لبكيته ... عليه ولكن ساحة الصبر أوسع
(Had I wished to weep blood I would have wept it over him, but the expanse of patience is wider.) Here أن and what follows it is in the interpretation of a maṣdar, the object of شئت, because it is a remarkable thing, so mentioning it is good. أراد ("he wanted") is like شاء in this ruling. (لَذَهَبَ) the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو, and ذهب is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, whose fāʿil is latent (permissibly latent), its implied form being "he". (بِسَمْعِهِمْ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ذهب. (وَأَبْصارِهِمْ) conjoined to يسمعهم. [Translator's note: the source says "conjoined to يسمعهم", which does not match the verse; the intended word is evidently بسمعهم, "their hearing".] (إِنَّ) a particle resembling a verb. (اللَّهُ) its accusative ism. (عَلى كُلِّ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قدير. (شَيْءٍ) muḍāf ilayhi. (قَدِيرٌ) khabar of inna. The clause لذهب has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, and the clause إن الله is explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

* Rhetoric:
1- The explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya). He likened them to the deaf, the mute and the blind and omitted mention of the thing likened, which some rhetoricians count as though mentioned, so that for them it is an eloquent simile (tashbīh balīgh), which occurs often in their speech. Their poet said:
صم إذا سمعوا خيرا ذكرت به ... وإن ذكرت بسوء عندهم دفنوا
(Deaf when they hear a good thing mentioned of you; and if you are mentioned with evil in their presence, they bury [the thing].)
But the eloquent, rigorous masters forget the thing likened and turn away from imagining it entirely. Abū Tammām said, praising Khālid ibn Yazīd al-Shaybānī:
ويصعد حتى يظنّ الجهول ... بأنّ له حاجة في السماء
(He climbs until the ignorant man thinks he has some need in the sky.) He borrowed "ascending" from physical height for moral height, by way of the explicit metaphor, then built upon it what is built upon height in place, as embellishment and completion for the sake of exaggeration, and did not mention the thing likened.
2- The repeated representational simile. The Exalted likened the hypocrites, with their showing faith and concealing disbelief, to one who kindled a fire which then went out, and that in three respects:
a- The one who kindles a fire gains light by its illumination and the desolation of darkness leaves him; when it goes out, the illumination goes, and benefit and guidance are lost.
b- If the kindler of the fire does not feed it with fuel, its light goes; likewise the hypocrite, if he does not sustain faith, his faith goes.
c- The one who kindles a fire and gains light from it is in a dusky darkness of his own self; when the fire goes, he remains in two darknesses: the darkness of the night and the darkness of his own self. Then He likened the religion to the downpour (ṣayyib), because hearts come alive by it as the earth comes alive by rain; and what is connected to that: the likening of the disbelievers to the darknesses, and what is in it of promise and threat in the lightning and thunder, and of the trials and afflictions that strike the disbelievers in the thunderbolts.
3- He used the singular for thunder and lightning, although the apparent sense and context require their plural, as ظلمات was made plural, and although the plural is more eloquent than the singular, according to the saying of al-Buḥturī:
يا عارضا متلفّعا ببروده ... يختال بين بروقه ورعوده
(O cloud wrapped in its mantles, strutting between its lightnings and its thunders.) We say that the Qur'an inclined to the singular for an important point, which is that lightning and thunder were originally two maṣdars, and maṣdars are not pluralized (one says "the sky thundered, thundering" and "it flashed, flashing"), so the ruling of the origin was observed by leaving them unpluralized even though the sense of plurality is intended. This point escaped al-Buḥturī. It is not hidden that among words there are some whose singular is sweet and whose plural is ugly, and vice versa; all of that will come in its place in this wonderful book.
4- The free metaphor (majāz mursal) in His saying «يجعلون أصابعهم في آذانهم», because it is not the whole finger that is put in the ear; He mentioned the fingers and meant the fingertips, and the relation is that of wholeness (kulliyya). The figurative expression here is more eloquent than the literal, which is why He turned from it to it. He used the plural "fingers" because He did not mean a specific finger, since the state is one of bewilderment and perplexity: whichever finger happens to come to them they block their ears with, without dwelling on a customary order or a presumed specification.

* Benefits:
The chief judge Tāj al-Dīn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAqīl, the commentator on Ibn Mālik's Alfiyya in grammar, claimed that من الصواعق is attached to حذر الموت, which involves fronting what depends on a maṣdar. Ibn ʿAqīl said: What led him to this is that if he attached it to يجعلون, it would be in the position of mafʿūl li-ajlihi, and this would require multiple objects of purpose without conjunction, which the grammarians forbid. He answered this objection by saying that the first object of purpose gives the reason for the "putting" in general, and the second gives its reason as restricted by the first; the general and the restricted are different, so the thing explained is multiple in meaning even if single in wording. Ibn Hishām took issue with Ibn ʿAqīl in Mughnī al-Labīb; refer to it if you wish, for there is pleasure and benefit in it.

* Vocabulary:
أندادا is the plural of nidd (with kasra on the nūn), which is the equal; it is said only of an equal that is opposed and contrary. Jarīr said: أتيما تجعلون إليّ ندّا ... وما تيم لذي حسب نديد (Do you make Taym an equal to me? And Taym is no peer of a man of lineage.)

* I'rab:
(يا أَيُّهَا) يا is a particle of vocative for the middle-distance one addressed; no other vocative particle occurs in the Qur'an. أي is the one addressed, an indefinite specified noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative. (النَّاسُ) a badal (substitute) of أي on the wording. (اعْبُدُوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn because its imperfect is one of the "five verbs"; the wāw is fāʿil. (رَبَّكُمُ) mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as the second term of the construct. (الَّذِي) a relative noun, naʿt (adjective) of ربكم. (خَلَقَكُمْ) a past verb, the kāf its object, and the agent is latent, its implied form being "He".
