(وَالَّذِينَ) the wāw is a conjunction and الذين is a relative noun conjoined to the kāf, that is, "and He created those who...". (مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted word that has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun. (لَعَلَّكُمْ) لعل is a particle of hope that governs the accusative, and the kāf is its ism. (تَتَّقُونَ) an imperfect verb, nominative, with the wāw as fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of لعل. The clause لعلكم تتقون has no position because its relation to what precedes is that of the result to the condition; it may also be parsed as a ḥāl, that is, "while you hope for piety and aspire to it". (الَّذِي) a relative noun in the position of accusative as a second adjective of ربكم. (جَعَلَ) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "He"; the verbal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun. (لَكُمُ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective of فراشا and then was fronted. (الْأَرْضَ) the first object of جعل if it is from jaʿl in the sense of "making into" (taṣyīr) [Translator's note: the source reads «التعبير»; «التصيير» is evidently intended]. (فِراشاً) the second direct object; but if it is from jaʿl in the sense of "creating", then فراشا is an interpreted ḥāl. (وَالسَّماءَ) conjoined to His words الأرض. (بِناءً) conjoined to فراشا. (وَأَنْزَلَ) the wāw is a conjunction, and أنزل is conjoined to His words جعل. (مِنَ السَّماءِ) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل. (ماءً) the object of أنزل. (فَأَخْرَجَ) conjoined to أنزل. (بِهِ) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخرج. (مِنَ الثَّمَراتِ) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective and was fronted. (رِزْقاً) mafʿūl bihi. (لَكُمُ) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second adjective of رزقا. (فَلا) the fāʾ is explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya) and لا is
prohibitive. (تَجْعَلُوا) an imperfect verb, jussive by لا, its sign of jussive being the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is explanatory of cause, with no position, serving like a resumptive clause, and the meaning is that this prohibition is caused by the bringing into being of these dazzling signs. (لِلَّهِ) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted word in the position of the second object of تجعلوا. (أَنْداداً) the first object of تجعلوا. (وَأَنْتُمْ) the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and أنتم is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (تَعْلَمُونَ) an imperfect verb, its sign of nominative being the persistence of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the verbal clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنتم, and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

* Benefits:
1- The grammarians' discussion was unsettled over the parsing of a noun made definite by al- after يا أيها. Most of them said that it is an adjective; their argument is that each of the vocative particle and al- is a particle of definiteness, and they dislike two particles for a single function, so أي was inserted to be the apparent one addressed, and the noun with al- is an adjective of it. This is objected to on the ground that it is a non-derived noun, as in يا أيها الرجل; the reply is that although it is non-derived it has the ruling of a derived noun, that is, "the one characterized by manhood". What we see is that one says [Translator's note: the source reads «يقال في أن أي», which appears garbled; rendered by sense]: أي or أية is the one addressed, ها is a particle of alerting, and the word with al- is a badal of the one addressed if it is non-derived, otherwise it is parsed as a naʿt.
2- The earth (arḍ) was only called arḍ because it "earths" (tata'arraḍu) what is in its belly, meaning it eats what is in it.
3- When "hope" (tarajjī) occurs in the speech of Allah the Exalted, there are three interpretations:
a- لعل keeps its proper sense of hope and aspiration, but relative to the addressees. Sībawayh stated this interpretation in his book and al-Zamakhsharī in his Kashshāf.
b- لعل is for giving a reason, that is, "worship your Lord so that you may be pious"; Quṭrub stated it and al-Ṭabarī chose it in his great Tafsīr.
c- It is for exposing oneself to a thing, as if it were said: "Do that, exposing yourselves to the chance of becoming pious"; Abū al-Baqāʾ stated it and al-Mahdawī chose it in his Tafsīr al-Mumtiʿ.
4- When the adjective precedes the thing it describes, it is parsed as a ḥāl, and it is therefore permissible for the owner of the ḥāl to be indefinite, though it is ruled that it should be definite, because judging about something unknown generally yields no benefit. On this is the poet's line:
لميّة موحشا طلل ... يلوح كأنه خلل
(Mayya has a deserted ruin, which gleams as if it were the lining of a sword-sheath.)

* Vocabulary:
(يَسْتَحْيِي) Ḥayāʾ (shyness, modesty) is a change and shrinking that comes over a person from fear of what he may be blamed and censured for. Among the sayings of the Arabs: "So-and-so is shyer than a girl kept in her chamber." And Laylā said:
وأحيا حياء من فتاة حييّة ... وأشجع من ليث بخفّان حادر
(Shyer in modesty than a bashful girl, and braver than a thick-necked lion of Khaffān.)
(البعوض) the well-known biting insect; its derivation is from baʿḍ, which is cutting, and from it comes baʿḍ al-shayʾ ("part of a thing"), because it is a piece of it.
(النقض) annulment and undoing of arrangement.

* I'rab:
(إِنَّ) a particle resembling a verb. (اللَّهَ) its accusative ism. (لا) negative. (يَسْتَحْيِي) an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent (permissibly latent), its implied form being "He", referring to Allah; the verbal clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن. (أَنْ يَضْرِبَ) أن is a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative, and يضرب is an imperfect verb accusative by an implied (permissibly implied) أن; أن with what follows it is in the interpretation of a maṣdar in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, if يستحيي is transitive by itself, or in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition; its discussion has come a little earlier. (مَثَلًا) mafʿūl bihi of يضرب. (ما) there are many views on it; the most preferable, in our view, is that it is the ibhāmiyya (indefinite-making) ما, which, when it accompanies an indefinite noun, adds to it spread, generality and vagueness. You say, "Give me a book, ما you want", that is, any book you wish. It is parsed as an adjective of the noun before it. (بَعُوضَةً) badal of مثلا. (فَما) the fāʾ is a conjunction and ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative, conjoined to بعوضة. (فَوْقَها) an adverb of place attached to an omitted word that has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun. What is meant:
"what exceeds it" in the meaning for which the parable was coined, namely smallness and insignificance, or "what exceeds it in size", as though He intended thereby to answer their disdain at coining a parable with the fly and the spider, since both are bigger than the gnat. You say: "So-and-so does not mind being stingy with half a dirham or what is above it," meaning a dirham or two. Beautiful is the hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in what Muslim relates from Ibrāhīm from al-Aswad, who said: Some young men of Quraysh entered upon ʿĀʾisha, may Allah be pleased with her, while she was at Minā, and they were laughing. She said, "What makes you laugh?" They said, "A man fell upon the rope of a tent, and his neck or his eye nearly went." She said, "Do not laugh, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'There is no Muslim who is pricked by a thorn, or by what is above it, except that a degree is written for him by it and a sin is erased from him.'" It may mean what is beyond the thorn and exceeds it in smallness, and it may mean what is more severe and painful than the thorn. (فَأَمَّا) the fāʾ is resumptive and أما is a particle of condition and distribution. (الَّذِينَ) a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (آمَنُوا) verb and agent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of الذين. (فَيَعْلَمُونَ) the fāʾ links the apodosis, and يعلمون is an imperfect verb, nominative, its sign of nominative being the persistence of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause يعلمون is in the position of nominative as the khabar of الذين. (أَنَّهُ) أنّ is a particle resembling a verb, and the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as its ism. (الْحَقُّ) its khabar; أن and what is within its scope take the place of the two objects of يعلمون. (مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl. (وَأَمَّا) the wāw is a conjunction and أما is a particle of condition and distribution. (الَّذِينَ) a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (كَفَرُوا) verb and agent; the clause has no position, being the ṣila of the relative noun. (فَيَقُولُونَ) the fāʾ links the apodosis, and يقولون is an imperfect verb, nominative, its sign of nominative being the persistence of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the relative noun. (ماذا) an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a fronted object of أراد; or ما is an interrogative noun and ذا a relative noun (in this case specifically) in the position of nominative as khabar of ما, and the clause is in the position of accusative as the content of the saying; on the first view the clause أراد is parsed as the content of the saying. (أَرادَ) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa. (اللَّهَ) fāʿil of أراد. (بِهذا) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أراد. (مَثَلًا) an emphatic tamyīz, or a ḥāl of the demonstrative, that is, "as an illustration by it", or of the fāʿil, that is, "illustrating". (يُضِلُّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent (permissibly latent), its implied form being "He"; the verbal clause is resumptive, running in the course of explanation and clarification of the two clauses introduced by أما. It is also said that it is in the position of accusative as an adjective of مثلا, the meaning being "a parable by which people are divided into the misguided and the guided". (بِهِ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يضل. (كَثِيراً) mafʿūl bihi. (وَيَهْدِي) conjoined to يضل. (بِهِ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يهدي. (كَثِيراً) mafʿūl bihi. (وَما يُضِلُّ) the wāw is circumstantial or resumptive, and ما is negative. (بِهِ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يضل. (إِلَّا) a particle of restriction. (الْفاسِقِينَ) mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, or is circumstantial. (الَّذِينَ) a relative noun in the position of genitive because it is an adjective of الفاسقين. (يَنْقُضُونَ) an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause has no position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun. (عَهْدَ اللَّهِ) mafʿūl bihi and muḍāf ilayhi. (مِنْ بَعْدِ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ينقضون. (مِيثاقِهِ) muḍāf ilayhi; the pronoun returns to the name Allah or to al-ʿahd, and an interesting explanation of mīthāq will come in the Benefits section. (وَيَقْطَعُونَ) conjoined to His words ينقضون. (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (أَمَرَ) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa. (اللَّهِ) fāʿil of أمر. [Translator's note: the source shows الله with the genitive ending here, although it is the fāʿil.] (بِهِ) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أمر. (أَنْ يُوصَلَ) أن is a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative, and يوصل is a passive imperfect verb whose nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "it"; أن and what is within its scope are in the interpretation of a maṣdar, a badal of the pronoun in به, the meaning being "and they sever what Allah ordered to be joined"; or it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, the implied form being "from dislike that it be joined" or "lest it be joined". (وَيُفْسِدُونَ) conjoined to يقطعون. (فِي الْأَرْضِ) the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يفسدون. (أُولئِكَ) a demonstrative noun, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (هُمُ) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) or ʿimād, with no position. (الْخاسِرُونَ) khabar of أولئك; and you may parse هم as mubtadaʾ and الخاسرون as its khabar, the nominal clause being in the position of nominative as khabar of أولئك.

* Rhetoric:
1- Parable-coining (tamthīl): the Arabs took great care over tamthīl, and the scholars of rhetoric mention two manifestations of it:
a- One is that the meaning appears from the outset in the form of a parable.
b- The other is what follows meanings to clarify them and establish them in the souls. In both cases it clothes meanings with splendour and beauty, raises their worth, stirs movement and life in them, and embodies them for the reader until he can almost feel them by touch. People have never ceased to coin parables with beasts, birds and insects. Among the finest that the Arabs composed in this is the book Kalīla wa-Dimna, which is said to have been translated from Persian by ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Muqaffaʿ; and in French there are the fables of La Fontaine.
It is related from al-Ḥasan and Qatāda: when Allah mentioned the fly and the spider in His Book and coined a parable of them for the polytheists, the Jews laughed and said, "This does not resemble the speech of Allah", so Allah, glory be to Him, sent down the verse. What supports the view that it was sent down about them is that it includes the breaking of covenants, which is among their most prominent traits. Our Arabic literature is full of parables drawn from various vermin and all insects. Their poet said:
وإنّي لألقى من ذوي الضغن منهم ... وما أصبحت تشكو من الوجد ساهره
كما لقيت ذات الصفا من خليلها ... وما انفكت الأمثال في الناس سائره
(I meet from those of them who bear rancour, and the sleepless one does not complain of passion, what Dhāt al-Ṣafā met from her friend; and proverbs have never ceased to travel among people.) Dhāt al-Ṣafā is a snake [Translator's note: the source runs the words together as «الصفاحية»; read as «الصفا حية», "Dhāt al-Ṣafā, a snake"]. The Arab legend says she had killed a relative of her ally, so they pledged by Allah that she would pay the blood-money for that slain man... to the end of that delightful legend.
2- The implicit metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya) in His words: «ينقضون عهد الله». He likened the covenant to a twisted rope, then omitted the thing likened to and hinted at it by something of its characteristics or necessary attributes, namely unravelling, because it is one of the two states of a rope, which are unravelling and twisting.
3- Antithetical balance (muqābala), which is a multiplicity of antitheses (ṭibāq) in speech. He made antitheses between يضل and يهدي and between يقطعون and يوصل.

* Benefits:
1- (أمّا) is a particle of condition and distribution. Its first mīm may be replaced by yāʾ out of dislike for doubling, as in the saying of ʿAmr ibn Abī Rabīʿa:
رأت رجلا أيما إذا الشمس عارضت ... فيضحي وأيما بالعشيّ فيخصر
(She saw a man who, when the sun faces him, goes out into the open [lit. "as for when..."], and in the evening feels the chill.) One of six things separates أما from the answering fāʾ:
a- The mubtadaʾ: as in the verse mentioned above.
b- The khabar: such as "As for in the house, ʿAlī [is there]."
c- The condition clause, as in His words: «فأمّا إن كان من المقربين فروح وريحان».
d- A noun governed by an omitted verb, as in His words: «وأما ثمود فهديناهم».
e- A noun accusative in wording or in position by the answer, as in His words: «فأما اليتيم فلا تقهر».
And an adverb governed by أما because of the sense of the verb for which it stands, such as "As for today, I am going."
Also, أما can be for emphasis and condition, standing in for مهما, as in "Ammā baʿd, jihād is a door among the doors of Paradise", the implied form being "whatever there be of anything". The wāw sometimes stands in for أما, so one says wa-baʿd; this usage is common in sermons and letters, and to it the poet alluded in his words:
لقد علمت قيس بن عيلان أنني ... إذا قلت: أما بعد أني خطيبها
(Qays ibn ʿAylān knows that I, when I say "Ammā baʿd", am their orator.)
2- ماذا: it has two aspects:
a- ذا is compounded with ما, both losing their individual character, as a single interrogative noun, parsed according to its position.
b- ذا is a relative noun meaning "that which", so it is the khabar of the interrogative ما, and the effect of this appears in the answer to it. For this reason we gave both aspects in the i'rab. The words of the Exalted «يسألونك ماذا ينفقون؟ قل العفو» have been read with العفو accusative and nominative, on the two interpretations. And Labīd said:
ألا تسألان المرء ماذا يحاول ... أنحب فيقضى أم ضلال وباطل
(Will you two not ask the man what he is trying to do: a vow to be fulfilled, or error and falsehood?) It was reported that أنحب is nominative as a badal of ذا on the second view; and had he said أنحبا, as a badal of the whole of ماذا, accusative as the object of يحاول, it would have been permissible.

* I'rab:
(وَإِذْ) The wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إذ is an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, in the accusative position as a direct object (mafʿūl bihi) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). This i'rab is the prevalent one for the إذ mentioned at the opening of the stories in the Qur'an, and it was chosen by al-Zamakhsharī, Ibn ʿAṭiyya and other i'rab scholars. Abū Ḥayyān and al-Karkhī rejected it, and it may be of interest to cite a curious passage of Abū Ḥayyān on this point. He said: «It is nothing, because it takes إذ out of its proper use, which is that it is not used in any way other than as an adverb, or with an adverb of time being annexed to it.» Ibn Hishām replied to him, as you will see in detail in the section on Benefits. Abū Ḥayyān went on: «What Arabic requires is to make it accusative by the words: قالوا أتجعل, that is, at the time of Allah's saying to the angels: إني جاعل في الأرض خليفة they said: أتجعل — just as you say in speech: إذ جئتني أكرمتك (when you came to me I honoured you), meaning at the time of your coming I honoured you, and إذ قلت لي كذا قلت لك كذا (when you said such-and-such to me I said such-and-such to you). Look at this easy, clear way — how most people were not guided to it, and instead plunged into a calamity and blundered like a night-blind camel.»
(قالَ) a past verb; the verbal clause is in the genitive position by the annexation of the adverb to it. (رَبُّكَ) fāʿil (agent). (لِلْمَلائِكَةِ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قال. (إِنِّي) inna is a particle resembling the verb, and the yāʾ is its ism (noun). (جاعِلٌ) its khabar (predicate). (فِي الْأَرْضِ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاعل if it means "creator", and in the accusative position as a second direct object if it is an active participle from الجعل in the sense of "making into"; the clause إني جاعل is in the accusative position as the reported speech (maqūl al-qawl). (خَلِيفَةً) direct object of جاعل, because it is an active participle.
(قالُوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because of its attachment to the wāw of the group; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive. (أَتَجْعَلُ) The hamza is for a pure interrogative of astonishment, as though they were seeking to fathom a wisdom that was hidden from them, a dazzling one; تجعل is an imperfect nominative verb, its fāʿil an obligatorily latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (فِيها) a preposition and its genitive noun; you may attach them to جعل if it means "creating", or make them the second object, put forward, if it means "making into". (يُفْسِدُ) an imperfect verb, its fāʿil a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; the clause has no grammatical position because it is a ṣila (relative clause). (فِيها) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يفسد. (وَيَسْفِكُ) an imperfect verb conjoined to يفسد, within the scope of the ṣila. (الدِّماءَ) direct object. (وَنَحْنُ) The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and نحن is a detached pronoun in the nominative position as mubtadaʾ. (نُسَبِّحُ) an imperfect verb, its fāʿil a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن"; the verbal clause is in the nominative position as the khabar of نحن. (بِحَمْدِكَ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "accompanied by Your praise". (وَنُقَدِّسُ) an imperfect verb conjoined to نسبح. (لَكَ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نقدس; some made the lām redundant (zāʾida) with the kāf as the object of نقدس.
(قالَ) a past verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "هو"; the clause is resumptive. (إِنِّي) inna and its ism. (أَعْلَمُ) an imperfect nominative verb, its fāʿil a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا"; the clause is the khabar of inna. (ما) a relative noun in the accusative position as direct object. (لا) negative. (تَعْلَمُونَ) an imperfect verb, nominative by the presence of the nūn; the clause has no grammatical position because it is a ṣila; and the nominal clause إني أعلم is in the accusative position as the reported speech.

* Rhetoric:
In the interrogative found in His saying أتجعل, the question departs from its original meaning, being for astonishment, as we chose in the i'rab. It was also said that it is for seeking guidance (istirshād), that is: "Will You place in it one who will cause corruption, like those who were in it before?" It was also said that they were asking about their own state, i.e.: "Will You place in it a corrupter while we remain in obedience to You, never slackening from it for the blink of an eye?" Others said it is for affirmation (ījāb). In truth, every interrogative expression occurring in the Book of Allah the Exalted falls under one of the following six aspects:
1- Rebuke (tawbīkh), 2- astonishment (taʿajjub), 3- equivalence (taswiya), 4- affirmation (ījāb), 5- command (amr), 6- confirmation (taqrīr). As for a genuine question, it does not occur from Allah the Exalted in the Qur'an, because the questioner learns what he does not have, whereas Allah knows things before they come to be. Rebuke is, for example: «أذهبتم طيباتكم»; confirmation: «أأنت قلت للناس»؟; equivalence, for example: «سواء عليهم أأنذرتهم»; affirmation, for example: «أتجعل فيها من يفسد فيها»; and command, for example: «أأسلمتم». By this, what occurs in the Book of Allah is recognised; so learn its places and ponder.

* Benefits:
1- إذ is an adverb of past time, and only a sentence follows it. The sentence may be omitted and replaced by tanwīn, called tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ (compensatory tanwīn), for example: «ويومئذ يفرح المؤمنون». The original is "يوم إذ غلبت الروم يفرح المؤمنون"; the clause غلبت الروم was omitted and tanwīn brought as a replacement for it, so two sukūn letters met, the dhāl and the tanwīn, and the dhāl was given a kasra following the basic rule for the meeting of two sukūns. Its i'rab is summarised in five aspects:
a- That it be an adverb, for example: «فقد نصره الله إذ أخرجه الذين كفروا».
b- That it be a direct object (mafʿūl bihi): this is the prevalent case of the إذ mentioned at the opening of the Revelation.
c- That it be a substitute (badal) for the object, for example: «واذكر في الكتاب مريم إذ انتبذت»; إذ is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from مريم.
d- That a noun of time which can be dispensed with be annexed to it, for example: «يومئذ تحدث أخبارها».
e- And إذ comes for suddenness (mufājaʾa) and occurs after بينا and بينما. The poet said:
استقدر الله خيرا وارضينّ به ... فبينما العسر إذ دارت مياسير
(Ask Allah to ordain good and be content with it; for while there is hardship, behold, ease comes round.)
And when إذ is for suddenness, what is its i'rab? Then the more likely view is to regard it as a particle of suddenness.
2- Opinions have differed greatly about how the angels knew that the offspring of Adam would cause corruption on earth. The closest to logic that we have seen is that they knew it from the word "khalīfa" (vicegerent). They said: the khalīfa is the one who judges between disputants, and a disputant is either a wrongdoer or one wronged; and whenever mutual wrongdoing occurs among them, corruption occurs on earth and spreads.

* Lügat:
(إِسْرائِيلَ): Bunda ihtilaf etmişlerdir. En sahih olanı, onun yabancı (a'cemî) bir alem olduğudur; bu yüzden gayr-i munsarif kılınmıştır. İzafet terkibiyle mürekkeptir: «إسرا» İbrânîcede «kul», «إيل» de «Allah» demektir. Araplar onda çeşitli lügatlerle tasarrufta bulunmuşlardır; bunların en sahihi Kur'an'ın lügatidir. O, Ya'kûb'un lakabıdır. Ebû Ca'fer ve A'meş «إسرائيل» kelimesini elifden sonra hemzesiz bir yâ ile («إسراييل») okumuşlardır. Verş'ten, elifden sonra yâ olmaksızın hemze ile «اسرائل» ve râ ile lâm arasında halis bir elif ile «اسرال» rivayet edilmiştir. Nâfi'den de «اسرائين» şeklinde bir kıraat rivayet edilir; «أصيلان» (أصيلال) kelimesinde olduğu gibi lâmdan nûn ibdâl etmişlerdir. Bununla birlikte, lâm ile nûn işitilmiş (semâî) bazı kelimelerde birbirinin yerine geçer; bunlardan bazıları: «عنوان الكتاب» ve «علوانه» (kitabın başlığı), «أبّنته» ve «أبّلته» (birini ölümünden sonra övdüğünde) ve diğerleri.

* İ'rab:
(وَالَّذِينَ): Vâv atıf harfidir; «الذين» mübtedâdır. Cümle, önceki ayetteki «فمن تبع هداي» kavline ma'tûftur, çünkü onun karşı kısmıdır (kasîm). Taksîmin gereği «ومن لم يتبع هداي» (hidayetime uymayan kimse) demesiydi; fakat bundan, karşı kısmı üzerine küfrü tescil ederek öne çıkarmak için vazgeçmiştir. (كَفَرُوا): fiil cümlesi sıla olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. (وَكَذَّبُوا): «كفروا»ya ma'tûftur, sılanın kapsamına dahildir. (بِآياتِنا): câr ve mecrûr; «كذبوا»ya müteallik. (أُولئِكَ): ism-i işaret, ikinci mübtedâ. (أَصْحابُ النَّارِ): «أولئك»in haberi; isim cümlesi «الذين»in haberidir. (هُمْ): ref' mahallinde mübtedâ olan ayrı zamir. (فِيها): câr ve mecrûr; «خالدون»a müteallik. (خالِدُونَ): «هم»in haberi; isim cümlesi, «أولئك» olan mübtedânın ikinci haberi olarak ref' mahallindedir. Hâl olarak nasb mahallinde olması da muhtemeldir. Bazıları onu «أولئك أصحاب النار» kavlini açıklayan (müfessire), i'rabdan mahalli olmayan bir cümle olarak i'rab etmiştir; onların ateşle beraberliğinin sadece yakınlıktan ibaret olmayıp devamlılık ve ebedîlik için olduğunu beyan etmek için. Bu, makbul ve güzel bir i'rabdır. (يا بَنِي): «يا» nidâ harfidir; «بني» muzâf münâdâdır, nasb alâmeti fethaya niyabeten yâdır, çünkü cem-i müzekker sâlime mülhaktır; müfredinin binası değişmiştir. «ابن»in aslı vâvîdir; «البنوّة» (oğulluk) buna delildir. Aslının yâî olduğu da söylenmiştir, çünkü «البناء»dan müştaktır; o da bir şeyi bir şeyin üzerine koymaktır; oğul babanın fer'idir, dolayısıyla onun üzerine konulmuştur. Cem-i teksîr olarak toplanıp «أبناء», cem-i sâlim olarak toplanıp «بنون» denmiştir. (إِسْرائِيلَ): mecrûr muzâfun ileyh; cer alâmeti kesreye niyabeten fethadır, çünkü alemiyet ve ucmet sebebiyle gayr-i munsariftir. (اذْكُرُوا): cemaat vâvına bitiştiği için nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiil; vâv fâildir. (نِعْمَتِيَ): mansûb mef'ûlün bih; nasb alâmeti mütekellim yâsından önceki harf üzerinde takdîrî fethadır; yâ muzâfun ileyhtir. (الَّتِي): ism-i mevsûl; «نعمتي»nin sıfatı (na't) olarak nasb mahallinde. (أَنْعَمْتُ): fiil ve fâil. (عَلَيْكُمْ): câr ve mecrûr; «أنعمت»e müteallik. «أنعمت» cümlesi sıla olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. (وَأَوْفُوا): «اذكروا»ya atıf. (بِعَهْدِي): câr ve mecrûr; «أوفوا»ya müteallik. (أُوفِ): talebin cevabı olduğu için meczûm muzâri fiil. (بِعَهْدِكُمْ): câr ve mecrûr; «أوف»e müteallik. (وَإِيَّايَ): Vâv atıftır; «إياي» ayrı zamir olup takdir edilmiş bir «ارهبوا» fiilinin mukaddem mef'ûlün bihi olarak nasb mahallindedir; (takdir edilir,) çünkü «فارهبون» kendi mef'ûlünü almıştır; o da takdir edilen yâdır; aslı «فارهبوني»dir. (فَارْهَبُونِ): Kur'an'da çokça tekrarlanan bu terkipteki fâ hakkında iki görüş vardır: Birincisi, onun takdir edilmiş bir (fiilin) cevabı olduğudur; takdiri «تنبّهوا» (dikkat edin) veya benzeridir; «الكتاب فخذ» sözün gibi, yani «dikkat et de kitabı al»; sonra fâ sözün başına düşmesin diye lafzı düzeltmek amacıyla mef'ûl öne alınmıştır. İkincisi, onun zâide olduğudur. (وَآمِنُوا): öncekine atıf. (بِما): câr ve mecrûr; «آمنوا»ya müteallik. (أَنْزَلْتُ): fiil ve fâil; cümle sıla olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. (مُصَدِّقاً): ism-i mevsûlden hâl. (لِما): Lâm, ta'diyeyi kuvvetlendiren cer harfidir; «ما» sükûn üzere mebnî, lâm ile cer mahallinde ism-i mevsûldür; câr ve mecrûr «مصدقا»ya müteallik. (مَعَكُمْ): mekân zarfı; sıla olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli olmayan mahzûf (bir fiile) müteallik. (وَلا): Vâv atıf harfidir; «لا» nâhiyedir. (تَكُونُوا): «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiil; cezm alâmeti nûnun hazfidir; vâv ismidir. (أَوَّلَ): «تكونوا»nın haberi. (كافِرٍ): muzâfun ileyh. (بِهِ): «كافر»e müteallik. (وَلا تَشْتَرُوا): «ولا تكونوا»ya atıf. (بِآياتِي): câr ve mecrûr; «تشتروا»ya müteallik. (ثَمَناً): «تشتروا»nın mef'ûlün bihi. (قَلِيلًا): sıfat. (وَإِيَّايَ فَاتَّقُونِ): Bu terkibin i'rabı geçmiştir.

* Belâgat:
Allah Teâlâ'nın «أوف بعهدكم» kavlinde «teattuf» (التعطف) denilen bir sanat vardır. Muhtevası, aynı lafzın sözün içindeki cümlede aynen tekrar edilmesidir. Bazıları buna «müşâreket sanatı» (فن المشاركة) adını verir. Ahdin umumuna, Allah'ın onlardan ve bütün insanlardan aldığı ahit de girer: O da tedebbür (derin düşünme) ve hayatlarında karşılarına çıkan her şeyi —şaşmaz bir terazi olan— akıl ve nazar terazisiyle tartmaktır; şaşkın bir terazi olan heva ve gurur terazisiyle değil.

* Fevâid:
Bu geçen ayetler pek çok faydayı içine almıştır; bunları aşağıda sıralıyoruz:
1- Kıyasın gereği, «تكونوا»daki vâva uyması için «أول كافرين به» demesiydi; fakat bundan şu sebeplerle vazgeçmiştir:
a- Mevsûfun hazfi üzeredir; takdiri «أول فريق كافر به» (ona ilk inkâr eden topluluk)tur.
b- İsm-i tafdîlin muzâf olduğu nekrenin müfred yapılması vâciptir; örneğin: «أنت أفضل رجل»، «أنتما أفضل رجل»، «أنتم أفضل رجل».
2- «واياي فارهبون» kavli ve benzerleri iştiğâl babındandır. Oradaki «إيا», zikredilen (fiilin) tefsir ettiği mahzûf bir fiille mansûbtur. Zamirin, kendisini takip eden fiilin mukaddem mef'ûlü olması sahih değildir; çünkü fiil, vikâye nûnundan sonra gelen ve tahfif için hazfedilmiş olan zamiri nasbetmiştir.

* Vocabulary:
(وَلا تَلْبِسُوا): it is said لبست الشيء بالشيء: I mixed it with it; and the maṣdar is اللّبس, with the fatḥa on the doubled (mushaddad) lām.

* I'rab:
(وَلا تَلْبِسُوا) The wāw is a conjunction, لا is prohibitive, and تلبسوا is an imperfect verb jussive by لا, its sign of jussion being the omission of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الْحَقَّ) direct object. (بِالْباطِلِ) the preposition and its genitive noun attached to تلبسوا; the bāʾ is for association (mulābasa) or for instrumentality. (وَتَكْتُمُوا): the wāw is a conjunction, and تكتموا is an imperfect verb jussive, conjoined to تلبسوا and coming under the ruling of the prohibition; you may also make the wāw one of accompaniment (maʿiyya), in which case تكتموا is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن after it, preceded as it is by a prohibition. (الْحَقَّ) direct object. (وَأَنْتُمْ) The wāw is circumstantial, and أنتم is a detached pronoun in the nominative position as mubtadaʾ. (تَعْلَمُونَ) an imperfect verb, nominative by the presence of the nūn, the wāw being the fāʿil; the verbal clause تعلمون is the khabar of أنتم, and the nominal clause وأنتم تعلمون is circumstantial. (وَأَقِيمُوا) The wāw is a conjunction, and أقيموا is an imperative verb, indeclinable with the omission of the nūn, the wāw being the fāʿil. (الصَّلاةَ) direct object. (وَآتُوا الزَّكاةَ) conjoined to أقيموا الصلاة. (وَارْكَعُوا) likewise a conjunction. (مَعَ) an adverb of place attached to اركعوا. (الرَّاكِعِينَ) muḍāf ilayhi.

* Vocabulary:
(واعَدْنا) and وعدنا are of one meaning; it is not of the chapter of mufāʿala that requires participation, like your saying عافاه الله ("may Allah grant him well-being") and عاقبت اللص ("I punished the thief").
(مُوسى): a foreign proper name, not fully declined. It is originally a compound; the original is موشى with the dotted shīn, because water in Hebrew is called مو and tree is called شا; the Arabs Arabised it and said موسى. As for the well-known موسى, the razor, it is derived from ماس يميس when one struts in his walk, and the yāʾ was changed to wāw because it came after a ḍamma, as in موقن, because the razor moves in shaving with it; it was also said it is derived from أوسيت رأسه when you shaved it. The razor is both masculine and feminine, and is pluralised as مواسي and موسيات.

* I'rab:
(وَإِذْ) its i'rab has been given often. (فَرَقْنا) verb and fāʿil; the clause is in the genitive position by the annexation of the adverb to it. (بِكُمُ) the preposition and its genitive noun attached to فرقنا, or to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "we split it in association with you"; the meaning is that the splitting of the sea took place by your entering it. (الْبَحْرَ) direct object. (فَأَنْجَيْناكُمْ وَأَغْرَقْنا) likewise conjunctions. (آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ) direct object, and فرعون is muḍāf ilayhi. (وَأَنْتُمْ) a detached pronoun in the nominative position as mubtadaʾ. (تَنْظُرُونَ) the verbal clause is in the nominative position as the khabar of أنتم, and the nominal clause is in the accusative position as ḥāl from the kāf in أنجيناكم.
(وَإِذْ) conjoined to the first إذ. (واعَدْنا) the clause is in the genitive position by the annexation of the adverb to it. (مُوسى) first direct object. (أَرْبَعِينَ) second direct object; it is not permissible to make it accusative as an adverb because the meaning would be spoiled, since the promise was not made within forty nights; its sign of accusative is the yāʾ because it is joined to the sound masculine plural. (لَيْلَةً) an overt specification (tamyīz), and the governor in this kind is the numeral noun before it. (ثُمَّ) a conjunction of order with delay. (اتَّخَذْتُمُ) conjoined to واعدنا. (الْعِجْلَ) first direct object, and the second object is omitted because it is understood from the context, i.e. "to it" [Translator's note: the source reads «إليها»; the sense appears to require «إلها» ("as a god")]. (مِنْ بَعْدِهِ) the preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. (وَأَنْتُمْ) The wāw is circumstantial, and أنتم is a mubtadaʾ. (ظالِمُونَ) its khabar; the nominal clause is in the accusative position as ḥāl. (ثُمَّ عَفَوْنا) conjoined to what preceded. (عَنْكُمْ) the preposition and its genitive noun attached to عفونا. (مِنْ بَعْدِ ذلِكَ) the preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; the demonstrative points to the maṣdar understood from اتخذ, i.e. "after that taking". (لَعَلَّكُمْ) laʿalla with its ism. (تَشْكُرُونَ) the verbal clause is in the nominative position as the khabar of لعل, and the clause of hope is circumstantial.

* Vocabulary:
(لِقَوْمِهِ): al-qawm is a collective noun with no singular from its own wording; its singular is rather "imruʾ" (man), and by analogy it should not be pluralised, but its pluralisation is irregular: they said aqwām, and a plural of its plural, they said aqāwīm. It was said to be specific to men. Allah the Exalted said: «لا يسخر قوم من قوم ... ولا نساء من نساء», and Zuhayr said:
وما أدري وسوف إخال أدري ... أقوم آل حصن أم نساء
(I do not know — and I shall think I know — whether the family of Ḥiṣn are men or women.)
And it was said that it is not specific to men but applies to men and women. Allah the Exalted said: «إنا أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه». The first view is more correct, and the inclusion of women in "qawm" here is by extension, giving precedence to men over women. They were called qawm because they "stand up" (yaqūmūna) for affairs.
(بارِئِكُمْ): al-bāriʾ is the Creator; it is said برأ الله الخلق, i.e. He created them. The origin of the root برأ indicates the separation of a thing and its distinction from something; it is said برأ المريض من مرضه when the illness leaves him and separates from him; and برىء المدين من دينه when the debt leaves him and falls from him. From it comes al-Bāriʾ among the attributes of Allah the Exalted, because He is the One who brought creation out of non-existence and separated them from it into existence.

* I'rab:
(وَإِذْ) discussed before. (آتَيْنا) verb and fāʿil; the clause is in the genitive position by the annexation of the adverb to it. (مُوسَى) first direct object. (الْكِتابَ) second direct object. (وَالْفُرْقانَ) The wāw is a conjunction, and الفرقان is conjoined to الكتاب; what is meant by "the Book" is the Torah, and by "the Criterion" what distinguishes between truth and falsehood, and guidance from error, conjoined to it although the meaning is one. (لَعَلَّكُمْ) laʿalla with its ism. (تَهْتَدُونَ) the verbal clause is the khabar of لعل, and the clause of hope is circumstantial. (وَإِذْ قالَ مُوسى) conjoined to what preceded. (لِقَوْمِهِ) the preposition and its genitive noun attached to قال. (يا قَوْمِ) yā is a vocative particle, and قوم is a vocative annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person. (إِنَّكُمْ) inna and its ism. (ظَلَمْتُمْ) the verbal clause is the khabar of inna. (أَنْفُسَكُمْ) direct object. (بِاتِّخاذِكُمُ) the preposition and its genitive noun attached to ظلمتم; the bāʾ is causal, i.e. "because of your taking". (الْعِجْلَ) direct object of the maṣdar اتخاذ. (فَتُوبُوا) The fāʾ is explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya), because wrongdoing is the cause of repentance, and توبوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable with the omission of the nūn. (إِلى بارِئِكُمْ) the preposition and its genitive noun attached to توبوا. (فَاقْتُلُوا) The fāʾ is a conjunction of immediate succession. (أَنْفُسَكُمْ) direct object; the meaning of the killing will come in the chapter on Rhetoric. (ذلِكُمْ) a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. (خَيْرٌ) khabar. (لَكُمْ) the preposition and its genitive noun attached to خير, because it is a superlative (ism tafḍīl) contrary to analogy, the analogy being "akhyar"; likewise شر, whose analogy is "ashar". (عِنْدَ) an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl. (بارِئِكُمْ) muḍāf ilayhi. (فَتابَ) The fāʾ is a conjunction upon an omitted clause, the implied form being "so you did what He commanded you, and He relented". (عَلَيْكُمْ) the preposition and its genitive noun attached to تاب. (إِنَّهُ) inna and its ism. (هُوَ) a separating pronoun or support, with no position. (التَّوَّابُ) the first khabar of inna. (الرَّحِيمُ) the second khabar of inna; or هو is a mubtadaʾ with التواب الرحيم as its two khabars, and the nominal clause as the khabar of inna.

* Rhetoric:
1- In His saying: «فاقتلوا أنفسكم» there is a majāz mursal (unrestricted figurative usage) whose relation is regard for what a thing leads to, i.e. "give yourselves up to be killed as a purification for them", that is, so that this judgment issued may be carried out; and this is one of the views about the killing. It was also said that what is meant by killing the selves is humbling them and curbing their wildness, for "killing" comes in the sense of humbling; from it is the saying of Ḥassān ibn Thābit in describing wine:
إن التي ناولتني فرددتها ... قتلت، قتلت، فهاتها لم تقتل
(The one you handed me and I sent back — it has been "killed", "killed"; so bring it to me unkilled.)
He meant mixing it with water so that its sharpness goes away.
2- Iltifāt (shift of person) in His saying: «فتاب عليكم»; the iltifāt here is from the first person that the course of the speech requires, since the requirement of the context was for Him to say: "so I enabled you and relented toward you".

* Vocabulary:
(الْقَرْيَةَ): derived from قريت, i.e. I gathered, because it gathers its people; you say قريت الماء في الحوض, i.e. I gathered it. There is disagreement about the town: it was said to be Bayt al-Maqdis (Jerusalem), and it was said to be Jericho, a town in the Jordan valley.
(حِطَّةٌ): a fiʿla form (with kasra on the ḥāʾ) from al-ḥaṭṭ (lowering, putting down).

* I'rab:
(وَإِذْ) discussed before. (قُلْنَا) verb and fāʿil; the clause is in the genitive position by the annexation of the adverb to it. (ادْخُلُوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable with the omission of the nūn, the wāw being the fāʿil; the clause is in the accusative position as reported speech. (هذِهِ) the hāʾ is a particle of alerting, and ذه is a demonstrative in the accusative position as an object by extension. (الْقَرْيَةَ) badal from the demonstrative. (فَكُلُوا) The fāʾ is a conjunction, and كلوا is conjoined to ادخلوا. (مِنْها) the preposition and its genitive noun attached to كلوا. (حَيْثُ) an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "moving about". (شِئْتُمْ) verb and fāʿil; the clause is in the genitive position by the annexation of the adverb to it. (رَغَداً) absolute object or ḥāl. (وَادْخُلُوا) conjoined to ادخلوا. (الْبابَ) direct object, by extension. (سُجَّداً) ḥāl, i.e. humble and lowly, in the manner of one prostrating. (وَقُولُوا) conjoined to وادخلوا. (حِطَّةٌ) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "our request is ḥiṭṭa" or "our affair is خطة" [Translator's note: the source reads «خطة»; «حطة» is meant]; the nominal clause is reported speech. The original in it is the accusative, because its meaning is "lower from us our sins", but it was turned to the nominative to indicate the permanence of the lowering and steadfastness in it. (نَغْفِرْ) an imperfect verb jussive because it is the response to a request. (لَكُمْ) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نغفر. (خَطاياكُمْ) direct object. (وَسَنَزِيدُ) The wāw is resumptive, and نزيد is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن". (الْمُحْسِنِينَ) direct object.

* Benefits:
Every adverb of place that is bounded and non-derived cannot be made accusative as an adverb, but must be governed in the genitive by في, as in جلست في الدار (I sat in the house), أقمت في البلد (I stayed in the town) and صليت في المسجد (I prayed in the mosque); except when it occurs after دخل, نزل and سكن, in which case it may be made accusative as an adverb or by removal of the preposition (nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); the sound view is that it is accusative as an object by extension.

* Vocabulary:
(الْأَسْباطِ): plural of «سبط», with kasra on the sīn, which is the daughter's child, as opposed to «الحفيد», which is the son's child.

* I'rab:
(قُولُوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn because its imperfect is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (آمَنَّا): a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). (بِاللَّهِ): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آمنا». (وَما أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْنا): conjoined to «الله», and the clause «أنزل إلينا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative «ما». (وَما أُنْزِلَ إِلى إِبْراهِيمَ وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَإِسْحاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَالْأَسْباطِ): also conjoined. (وَما): also conjoined. (أُوتِيَ): the clause is the ṣila of «ما». (مُوسى): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (وَعِيسى): conjoined to «موسى». (وَما أُوتِيَ النَّبِيُّونَ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ): also conjoined. (لا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ): the verbal clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «منهم» is an adjective of «أحد». (وَنَحْنُ): the wāw is circumstantial, and «نحن» is a mubtadaʾ (subject). (لَهُ): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «مسلمون». (مُسْلِمُونَ): khabar (predicate) of «نحن», and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

* Rhetoric:
An indefinite noun occurring in the context of negation conveys generality in its wording, so that its singular is treated as a plural in covering the individuals; that is why «بين» could properly be used with it, though «بين» is only used between two things.

* Vocabulary:
(الْفُلْكِ): ships. It can be singular, as in His saying, Exalted be He: «في الفلك المشحون», and it is then masculine. It can be plural, as in this verse, as shown by His saying:
«التي تجري في البحر»; and all of that is in a single form. The author of al-Munjid blundered remarkably over it, making it both masculine and feminine. His wording is: «الفلك: the ship; it is feminine and masculine.» The origin of the blunder is that he did not reflect — while copying the wording of al-Qāmūs haphazardly — that the masculine belongs specifically to the singular, while the feminine comes upon it through its being made a broken plural. The text of al-Qāmūs is: «الفلك, with ḍamma, is the ship; it is treated as masculine, and it is for the singular and the plural; or the فلك that is a broken plural of the فلك that is singular, and it is not like جنب, which is singular and plural, and its like, because فُعْل and فَعَل share in one thing, like العُرْب and العَرَب.» [Translator's note: the vowelling of the patterns in the quotation is not marked in the source.] If it is said that a broken plural must involve some change, the answer is that its change is implied: the ḍamma when it is plural is like the ḍamma in حُمْر and بُدْن, and when it is singular like the ḍamma in قُفْل. Moreover, Ibn Barrī added a correction, saying: «If you make الفلك singular, it is masculine only, and if you make it plural, it is feminine only.» So reflect on this paragraph, for it excels all paragraphs.
(الرِّياحِ): plural of ريح. The yāʾ of الريح and الرياح is from a wāw; the original forms are روح and رواح, and it was converted into yāʾ only because it is vowelless and preceded by a kasra. This is a regular substitution, and therefore, when the cause of its conversion disappeared, it returned to its origin, and one says: أرواح.
Maysūn bint Baḥdal said:
لبيت تخفق الأرواح فيه ... أحبّ إليّ من قصر منيف
(A tent in which the winds flutter is dearer to me than a lofty palace.)
In the plural it is mostly used for good, and in the singular for evil.
ʿUmāra ibn ʿAqīl ibn Bilāl ibn Jarīr committed a solecism with this word, using الأرياح in his poetry. Abū Ḥātim said to him: الأرياح is not permissible. ʿUmāra said: do you not hear them say رياح? Abū Ḥātim said to him: that is different from this. He said to him: you are right, and retracted. We say: but the plural أرياح does occur in al-Qāmūs of al-Fīrūzābādī; the text of his wording is: «الريح is feminine, and its plural is أرياح, أرواح, رياح and رِيَح like عنب, and the plural of the plural is أرواح and أراييح.» The author of al-Munjid copied his wording almost verbatim.

* I'rab:
(إِنَّ): a particle resembling the verb. (فِي خَلْقِ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of إن. (وَاخْتِلافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهارِ): conjoined to خلق السموات. (وَالْفُلْكِ): also conjoined. (الَّتِي): naʿt (adjective) of الفلك. (تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ): the verbal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause). (بِما): the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). You may also make ما maṣdariyya, so that it, with the interpreted maṣdar it governs in the genitive, is attached to تجري, [in the sense of] "by means of what benefits people". (يَنْفَعُ النَّاسَ): the verbal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of ما in either case. (وَما): conjoined to the first ما. (أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ): the clause is the ṣila of ما. (مِنَ السَّماءِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أنزل. (مِنْ ماءٍ): the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal (substitute) from His saying من السماء, a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl). The objection of attaching two identical particles to a single governing word does not apply, for what is forbidden is that they be identical together without conjunction or substitution. (فَأَحْيا): conjoined to فأنزل. (بِهِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أحيا. (الْأَرْضِ): mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بَعْدَ مَوْتِها): the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl. (وَبَثَّ): conjoined to أنزل or أحيا. (فِيها): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl. (مِنْ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to بث. (وَتَصْرِيفِ الرِّياحِ): conjoined to «خلق». (وَالسَّحابِ): also conjoined. (الْمُسَخَّرِ): naʿt of السحاب. (بَيْنَ السَّماءِ وَالْأَرْضِ): the adverb is attached to مسخر, because it is a passive participle. (لَآياتٍ): the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آيات is the postponed noun of إن. (لِقَوْمٍ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of آيات. (يَعْقِلُونَ): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is a naʿt of قوم. This verse is an explicit exhortation to the obligation of reflection and contemplation; it is reported from the Prophet ﷺ: «Woe to whoever recites this verse and spits it out», i.e. does not take a lesson from it.
So the verse is a resumptive clause, brought to urge reflection and taking lessons from dazzling wisdom.

* Lügat:
(تُدْلُوا بِها): onu (mallarınızı) atmanız. «أدلى الدلو»: kovayı kuyuya sarkıttı. «سقى أرضه بالدّالية وبالدوالي»: arazisini dolaplarla suladı; bunlar su dolaplarıdır (النواعير). «دلّى شيئا في مهواة»: bir şeyi bir boşluğa sarkıttı; «تدلّى هو بنفسه»: kendisi sarktı; «دلّى برجليه من السرير»: ayaklarını sedirden sarkıttı; «دلّاه بحبل من سطح أو جبل»: onu bir damdan veya dağdan iple sarkıttı. el-Ferazdak şöyle demiştir:
هما دلّتاني من ثمانين قامة ... كما انقضّ باز أقتم الرّيش كاسره
(O iki kadın beni seksen kulaç yükseklikten sarkıttılar; tıpkı tüyleri koyu renkli, kanatlarını kırıp süzülen bir doğanın inişi gibi.)
الدوالي: tam kapkara olmayan siyah üzümdür. el-Müncid sahibinin onun muvelled (sonradan türemiş) olduğu iddiasında neye dayandığını bilmiyorum. Bununla birlikte, fâ harfi dâl, ayn harfi lâm olan her kelimeyi araştırdım; bir de baktım ki sarkma ve kayıp gitme (الانملاس) anlamı ifade ediyor. الدلج de bu kabildendir; o gece yürüyüşüdür; bundaki kayıp gitme anlamı gizli değildir. «دلف الشيخ»: yaşlı adam emeklemekten biraz hızlı yürüdü; sanki yüksek bir yerden sarkıyor gibidir. Bu, son derece şaşılacak bir şeydir.

* İ'rab:
(وَلا تَأْكُلُوا): الواو isti'nâfiyye; cümle isti'nâfiyyedir; mallar ve onları kazanma yollarıyla ilgili başka bir hükmü takrir etmek için getirilmiştir. لا nehiy lâsı; تأكلوا, لا ile meczûm muzâri fiil; الواو fâildir. (أَمْوالَكُمْ): mef'ûlün bih. (بَيْنَكُمْ): zarf, أموالكم'den mahzûf bir hâle müteallik; yani «onları aranızda bulunur olduğu hâlde yemeyin». (بِالْباطِلِ): câr ve mecrûr, تأكلوا'ya müteallik; yani onları bâtıl bir sebeple almayın. (وَتُدْلُوا): الواو atıf harfi; تدلوا, تأكلوا'ya ma'tûf muzâri fiildir ve nehyin etki alanına dâhildir. Onu (vâvı) maiyyet için [Mütercim notu: metinde «للمغية» yazılıdır; «للمعية» olmalıdır.] kılman da caizdir; bu durumda تدلوا, ondan sonra gizli (muzmer) أن ile mansûb olur. (بِها): câr ve mecrûr, تدلوا'ya müteallik. (إِلَى الْحُكَّامِ): câr ve mecrûr, mahzûf bir hâle müteallik; yani sığınarak, muhakemeye başvurarak. (لِتَأْكُلُوا): اللام ta'lîl içindir; تأكلوا, ta'lîl lâmından sonra gizli (muzmer) أن ile mansûb muzâri fiildir; الواو fâildir; câr ve mecrûr mef'ûlün lieclih olarak nasb mahallindedir. (فَرِيقاً): mef'ûlün bih. (مِنْ أَمْوالِ النَّاسِ): câr ve mecrûr, mahzûf bir sıfata müteallik. (بِالْإِثْمِ): câr ve mecrûr, mahzûf bir hâle müteallik; yani yalancı şahitlik ve yalan yemin gibi günahı gerektiren şeylere tutunarak. (وَأَنْتُمْ): الواو hâliyye; أنتم ayrı zamir olup mübtedâdır. (تَعْلَمُونَ): merfû muzâri fiil ve fâil; cümle haberdir; hâl vâvından sonraki cümle hâliyyedir.

* Vocabulary:
(تُدْلُوا بِها): "you cast them". Adlā l-dalwa means he lowered the bucket into the well; and he watered his land with the dāliya and the dawālī, which are water-wheels. He lowered (dallā) something into a pit, and he himself dangled (tadallā); he dangled his legs from the bed, and lowered him by a rope from a roof or a mountain. Al-Farazdaq said:
هما دلّتاني من ثمانين قامة ... كما انقضّ باز أقتم الرّيش كاسره
(The two of them lowered me from eighty fathoms, as a dusky-feathered hawk swoops down, breaking its wings.)
Al-dawālī are black grapes that are not jet black. I do not know on what the author of al-Munjid based his claim that it is a post-classical coinage (muwallada). I have examined everything whose first radical is dāl and second lām, and it all conveys the meaning of hanging down and slipping away. From it comes al-dalaj, which is night travel, and the slipping away in it is not hidden; and dalafa al-shaykh means the old man walked faster than a creep, as if he were hanging down from a high place. This is a wonder in its own right.

* I'rab:
(وَلا تَأْكُلُوا): the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, brought to establish another ruling that concerns property and the ways of acquiring it. لا is prohibitive, and تَأْكُلُوا is an imperfect verb jussive by لا, the wāw being the agent. (أَمْوالَكُمْ): a direct object. (بَيْنَكُمْ): an adverbial attached to an omitted ḥāl from أَمْوالَكُمْ, i.e. "do not eat them while they are among you". (بِالْباطِلِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تَأْكُلُوا, i.e. do not take them by means of falsehood. (وَتُدْلُوا): the wāw is a conjunction, and تُدْلُوا is an imperfect verb conjoined to تَأْكُلُوا, falling within the scope of the prohibition; you may also make it a wāw of accompaniment [Translator's note: the source has «للمغية», evidently for «للمعية» ("of accompaniment")], in which case تُدْلُوا is in the accusative by an implied أَنْ after it. (بِها): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تُدْلُوا. (إِلَى الْحُكَّامِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "resorting, seeking judgement". (لِتَأْكُلُوا): the lām is for justification, and تَأْكُلُوا is an imperfect verb put in the accusative by an implied أَنْ after the lām of justification, the wāw being the agent; the preposition and its genitive noun are in the accusative position as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). (فَرِيقاً): a direct object. (مِنْ أَمْوالِ النَّاسِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective. (بِالْإِثْمِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "clinging to what makes one liable to sin, such as false testimony and the false oath". (وَأَنْتُمْ): the wāw is a ḥāl, and أَنْتُمْ is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ. (تَعْلَمُونَ): an imperfect verb in the nominative, with an agent, and the clause is the khabar; and the clause after the wāw of ḥāl is a ḥāl.

* Vocabulary:
(مَواقِيتُ): the plural of mīqāt, whose origin is mawqāt; the wāw was changed to yāʾ because of the kasra before it. They are landmarks by which people time the affairs of their livelihood.

* I'rab:
(يَسْئَلُونَكَ): an imperfect verb in the nominative, with an agent and an object, and the clause is resumptive, brought to explain the wisdom in the variation of the new moons, after they had pressed their question about it. It is reported that Muʿādh ibn Jabal and Thaʿlaba ibn Ghanm al-Anṣārī said: "O Messenger of Allah, what is the matter with the crescent that appears thin, then grows until it is full and complete, then keeps waning until it returns as it began, never being in one state?" So the verse came with the comprehensive, decisive ruling. The wisdom sought [Translator's note: the source has «المنوخاة», evidently for «المتوخاة» ("sought")] from the changing of the crescent is the timing of livelihoods and their regularity on a single, wondrous pattern. Al-hilāl is singular, and it is plural according to the difference of its time; and it is pluralised by analogy as ahilla, which is the analogy for the doubled fiʿāl form, such as ʿinān and aʿinna, zimām and azimma, sinān and asinna. (عَنِ الْأَهِلَّةِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يَسْئَلُونَكَ. (قُلْ): an imperative verb whose agent is latent, the implied form being "you", and the clause is resumptive. (هِيَ مَواقِيتُ): a nominal clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar, in the accusative position as the quoted speech. (لِلنَّاسِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of مَواقِيتُ. (وَالْحَجِّ): conjoined to النَّاسِ. (وَلَيْسَ): the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, brought for the sake of a digression (istiṭrād), the mention of which will come; or it is as if it were a reversal of their question, and that their likeness in it is as the likeness of one who leaves the door of the house and enters it from its back. لَيْسَ is a defective past verb. (الْبِرُّ): the noun of لَيْسَ. (بِأَنْ تَأْتُوا الْبُيُوتَ): the bāʾ is a redundant preposition in the khabar of لَيْسَ; أَنْ with what follows it is in the interpretation of a maṣdar, the khabar of لَيْسَ; and الْبُيُوتَ is a direct object. (مِنْ ظُهُورِها): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تَأْتُوا. (وَلكِنَّ): the wāw is a conjunction, and لكِنَّ is a particle of rectification resembling the verb. (الْبِرُّ): its noun, in the accusative; and an omitted element must be implied for the speech to be coherent, as if it were said: "What you do by way of probing in the question is not righteousness, but righteousness". (مَنْ): a relative noun, the khabar of لكِنَّ; and it cannot be without [Translator's note: the source has «ولا من», evidently for «ولا بد من» ("it cannot be without")] an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "the righteousness of him who". (اتَّقى): the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no position. (وَأْتُوا): the wāw is a conjunction; and conjoining an imperative sentence to a declarative one is permissible, for two declarative clauses have preceded, namely "righteousness is not" and "but righteousness is the one who fears Allah", and two imperative clauses are conjoined to them, namely "and come to the houses" and "and fear Allah". (الْبُيُوتَ): a direct object. (مِنْ أَبْوابِها): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أْتُوا. (وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ): the clause is conjoined to the imperative clause. (لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ): laʿalla and its noun, and the clause تُفْلِحُونَ is its khabar, and the clause of hope is a ḥāl.

* Rhetoric:
"Digression" (al-istiṭrād): a subtle, branching art to which the speaker inclines in one of the purposes of speech, making you imagine that he continues in it; then he leaves it for another because of a connection between them, then returns to the first. Here He mentioned the new moons and their variation, that they are timings for the pilgrimage, and that their likeness in asking is as the likeness of one who leaves the door of the house and enters from its back. For some of the Anṣār, when they entered the state of iḥrām, none of them would enter an orchard (ḥāʾiṭ, that is, a garden), a house or a tent by its door; if he was of the people of the clay-built (madar), he would cut a hole in the back of his house through which he entered and left, or would make a ladder by which to climb; and if he was of the people of hair-tents (wabar), he would go out from behind the tent. So that was said to them. Among the fine examples of this art is the saying of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib:
لنا نفوس لنيل المجد عاشقة ... فان تسلّت أسلناها على الأسل
لا ينزل المجد إلا في منازلنا ... كالنوم ليس له مأوى سوى المقل
(We have souls that are lovers of the attainment of glory; if they find consolation, we make them flow on the spear-points. Glory descends only in our dwellings, like sleep, which has no shelter but the eyes.)

* Benefits:
The scholars of rhetoric differed about the question: is it a question about the cause or about the wisdom? Al-Zamakhsharī, al-Rāghib and al-Qāḍī al-Bayḍāwī chose that it is a question about the wisdom, as the answer indicates, bringing the speech out according to the apparent requirement, because it is the original. Al-Sakkākī chose that it is a question about the cause, because the wisdom is obvious and does not deserve to be asked about, and the answer is of the "wise style" (al-uslūb al-ḥakīm).
Each party went on at length in arguing for what it claims, and the matter ended with them pelting one another with stinging words, which this place has no room for. How excellent are the men of our heritage; how thorough their investigation and how abundant their digging!

* Vocabulary:
«ثقفتموهم»: "you found them". Thaqifa l-shayʾ: he took it, or won it, or reached it. Thaqiftu the knowledge and the craft in the shortest time, if I was quick to take it. A thaqif laqif boy: one quick to learn; he has attained thaqāfa, with fatḥa on the thāʾ. The thāʾ and the qāf, when they come together at the beginning of a word, indicate the meaning of taking by overpowering: al-thiql (weight) is well known, the bearer staggers under it because it overpowers him; and illness weighed him down (athqalahu) when it overpowered him. Al-thaqāl, with fatḥa on the thāʾ, is the woman of large buttocks, heavy in movement.
Al-Rāʿī said:
ثقال إذا راد النساء فريدة ... صناع فقد صادت لدى الغوانيا
(Heavy when women roam, a unique one, deft; she has hunted among the beauties.) [Translator's note: the source verse seems corrupt in places; reproduced as printed.]
Thaqaba l-shayʾ bi-l-mithqab: he pierced the thing with the awl; the pearl-piercer pierced the pearl; and the women pierced their veils for their eyes.
Al-Muthaqqib al-ʿAbdī said:
أرين محاسنا وكننّ أخرى ... وثقّبن الوصاوص للعيون
(They showed some charms and hid others, and pierced the face-veils for the eyes.)

* I'rab:
(وَقاتِلُوا): the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, brought to explain the rulings of fighting; it is the first verse revealed about fighting in Medina to exalt the word of Allah. قاتِلُوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent. (فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قاتِلُوا. (الَّذِينَ يُقاتِلُونَكُمْ): the relative noun is a direct object, and the clause يُقاتِلُونَكُمْ is the ṣila. (وَلا تَعْتَدُوا): the wāw is a conjunction, لا is prohibitive, and تَعْتَدُوا is an imperfect verb jussive by لا, the wāw being the agent. (إِنَّ اللَّهَ): inna and its noun. (لا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ): لا is a negative, and يُحِبُّ is an imperfect verb in the nominative whose agent is latent, referring to Allah, and الْمُعْتَدِينَ is a direct object; and the clause لا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ is the khabar of inna, and the clause of inna and what follows it is justificatory. (وَاقْتُلُوهُمْ): also a conjunction, and the command to kill them is repeated for emphasis. (حَيْثُ): an adverb of place, indeclinable on ḍamma, attached to اقْتُلُوهُمْ. (ثَقِفْتُمُوهُمْ): verb, agent and object; the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural and has been lengthened by a redundant wāw; and the verbal clause is in the genitive position through annexation. (وَأَخْرِجُوهُمْ): conjoined to اقْتُلُوهُمْ. (مِنْ حَيْثُ): the preposition is brought onto حَيْثُ, which is governed in the genitive only by it and by the bāʾ; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أَخْرِجُوهُمْ. (أَخْرَجُوكُمْ): verb, agent and object, and the clause is in the genitive position through annexation. (وَالْفِتْنَةُ): the wāw is parenthetical, and الْفِتْنَةُ is a mubtadaʾ. (أَشَدُّ): the khabar. (مِنَ الْقَتْلِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أَشَدُّ; and the clause is parenthetical, with no position, running the course of a proverb, as will come. (فَإِنْ): the fāʾ is resumptive, and إِنْ is conditional. (قاتَلُوكُمْ): a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, the wāw is the agent and the kāf is the object; and the verb is in the position of a jussive as the protasis. (فَاقْتُلُوهُمْ): the fāʾ links to the apodosis, and اقْتُلُوهُمْ is an imperative verb with agent and object, and the clause فَاقْتُلُوهُمْ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis. (كَذلِكَ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar placed first. (جَزاءُ الْكافِرِينَ): a delayed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive. (فَإِنِ): the fāʾ is resumptive, and إِنْ is conditional. (انْتَهَوْا): a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis. (فَإِنِ): the fāʾ links to the apodosis, and إِنَّ is a particle resembling the verb. (اللَّهَ): the noun of inna. (غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ): two khabars of inna.

* Rhetoric:
In His saying «والفتنة أشد من القتل» there is the art of proverb-sending (irsāl al-mathal): it is a clause brought on the pattern of a proverb, because expulsion from the homeland is the trial after which there is no trial. It was said to someone: "What is harsher than death?" He said: "That with which one wishes for death." Expulsion from the homeland is like the drawing out of the soul from the body. Ibn al-Rūmī said:
فقد ألفته النفس حتى كأنه ... لها جسد إن بان غودر هالكا
(The soul has grown so used to it that it is as if it were its body; if it parted, she would be left perishing.)
Perhaps the prince of the creative poets in this is Abū l-Ṭayyib al-Mutanabbī. If we wished to cite him, the space would be too narrow for us; it is enough for you to go back to his dīwān and find what captivates you.

* İ'rab:
(وَقاتِلُوهُمْ): Vâv atıf harfidir; «قاتلوهم» emir fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir. Allah Teâlâ onlara, fitnenin —ki o, vatandan çıkarılmaktır— baş göstermesinin önüne geçmek için savaşmayı emretmiştir. (حَتَّى): gâye ve cer harfidir; burada bununla kastedilen ta'lîldir (sebep bildirmedir). (لا): nefy harfidir. (تَكُونَ): «حتى»dan sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir; burada tâmmedir (haber almaz). Câr ve mecrûr «قاتلوهم»a mütealliktir. (فِتْنَةٌ): «تكون»un fâilidir. (وَيَكُونَ): «تكون»a ma'tûftur; burada nâkısadır. (الدِّينُ): onun ismidir. (لِلَّهِ): câr ve mecrûr, onun mahzûf haberine mütealliktir. Bunun da tâmme olması uzak değildir; o takdirde «الدين» fâil olur, câr ve mecrûr da mahzûf bir hâle müteallik olur, yani «yalnızca Allah'a hâlis olarak». (فَإِنِ): Fâ isti'nâfiyyedir, «إن» şartiyyedir. (انْتَهَوْا): fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallinde mâzî fiildir. (فَلا): Fâ cevâbü'ş-şartı bağlayan (râbıta) fâdır, «لا» cinsini nefyeden lâdır. (عُدْوانَ): onun fetha üzere mebnî ismidir. (إِلَّا): hasr edatıdır. (عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ): câr ve mecrûr, «لا»nın mahzûf haberine mütealliktir; cümle cevâbü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir. (الشَّهْرُ الْحَرامُ): «الشهر» mübtedâ, «الحرام» sıfattır. (بِالشَّهْرِ): câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir habere mütealliktir. Burada bir muzâfın hazfi zorunludur; yani «Haram ayın hürmetini çiğnemek» — bu, hicretin yedinci yılındaki Zilkade'dir — haram ayın hürmetini çiğnemeye karşılık (وبهتك حرمة الشهر الحرام) — bu da altıncı yıldaki Zilkade'dir; zira Hudeybiye yılında sizinle savaşmışlardı. Yedinci yılın Zilkade ayında Umretü'l-kazâ için çıktıklarında ve o ayda savaşmaktan hoşlanmadıklarında onlara şöyle denildi: Bu ay şu aya karşılıktır, bunun hürmetinin çiğnenmesi onunkinin çiğnenmesine karşılıktır; her kötülüğün cezası da onun misli bir kötülüktür. [Mütercim notu: kaynaktaki bu bölümün sırası biraz bozuktur; haram ayın hürmetinin çiğnenmesi ibaresi tekrarlanmıştır; olduğu gibi aktarılmıştır.] (الْحَرامُ): sıfattır; cümle isti'nâfiyyedir. (وَالْحُرُماتُ قِصاصٌ): Vâv atıf harfidir; «الحرمات» mübtedâ, «قصاص» haberdir. (فَمَنِ): Fâ, fasîha fâsıdır; «من» şartiyye olup mübtedâdır. (اعْتَدى): fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallinde mâzî fiildir. (عَلَيْكُمْ): câr ve mecrûr «اعتدى»ya mütealliktir. (فَاعْتَدُوا): Fâ cevâbü'ş-şartı bağlayan fâdır; «اعتدوا» nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir, vâv fâildir; cümle cevâbü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir. Fasîha fâsından sonra gelen cümle ise i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen bir şartın cevabıdır. (عَلَيْهِ): câr ve mecrûr, «فاعتدوا» sözüne mütealliktir. (بِمِثْلِ): câr ve mecrûr «اعتدوا»ya veya mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir. (مَا): masdariyyedir. (اعْتَدى): mâzî fiildir; «ما» ile «اعتدى»dan oluşan müevvel masdar muzâfun ileyhtir, yani «بمثل اعتدائه» (onun saldırısının misliyle). (عَلَيْكُمْ): câr ve mecrûr «اعتدى»ya mütealliktir. (وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; cümle isti'nâfiyye olup intikamda aşırı gitmekten sakındırmak için getirilmiştir, çünkü nefis intikamda aşırı gitmeyi sevmek üzere yaratılmıştır. «اتقوا» nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir, vâv fâildir; lafza-i celâl mef'ûlün bihtir. (وَاعْلَمُوا): «اتقوا»ya ma'tûftur. (أَنَّ اللَّهَ): «أنّ» ve ismidir. (مَعَ الْمُتَّقِينَ): «مع» mahzûf habere müteallik mekân zarfıdır, «المتقين» muzâfun ileyhtir. «أنّ» ve mâ ba'dı, «اعلموا»nın iki mef'ûlünün yerini tutmuştur.

* Lügat:
(التهلكة): nadir masdarlardandır ve kıyasa uygun olanlardan değildir. el-Kâmûs'ta lâmının üç harekeyle (müselles) okunduğu belirtilir.
Cevherî es-Sıhâh'ında ve Râzî Muhtâr'ında yalnızca «مهلك» kelimesinin lâmının üç harekeyle okunduğunu zikretmekle yetinmişlerdir; «التهلكة»ye gelince, o lâmın dammesiyledir.

* İ'rab:
(وَأَنْفِقُوا): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; cümle isti'nâfiyye olup can ile cihad emrinden sonra mal ile cihadı emretmek için getirilmiştir. «أنفقوا» nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir, vâv fâildir. (فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ): câr ve mecrûr «أنفقوا»ya mütealliktir. (وَلا تُلْقُوا): Vâv atıf harfidir, «لا» nehiy edatıdır, «تلقوا» «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiildir, vâv fâildir. (بِأَيْدِيكُمْ): Bâ zâidedir; boyun eğen kimse için söylenen «أعطى بيده» (elini verdi) sözündeki bâ gibidir; çünkü «ألقى» kendi kendine (harf-i cersiz) müteaddî olan bir fiildir. Bir görüşe göre «تلقوا» fiiline bâ ile müteaddî olan bir fiilin anlamı tazmin edilmiştir, yani «لا تفضوا بأيديكم» (ellerinizle ulaşmayın/varmayın). Bir başka görüşe göre ikinci mef'ûl mahzûf olup takdiri «ولا تلقوا أنفسكم بأيديكم» (kendinizi kendi ellerinizle atmayın)dır. (إِلَى التَّهْلُكَةِ): câr ve mecrûr «تلقوا»ya mütealliktir. (وَأَحْسِنُوا): Vâv atıf harfidir; «أحسنوا» emir fiil ve fâildir. (إِنَّ اللَّهَ): «إنّ» ve ismidir. (يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ): muzâri fiil, müstetir fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir; «يحب المحسنين» cümlesi «إنّ»nin haberidir. «إنّ» ve mâ ba'dından oluşan cümle ta'lîliyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.

* Belâgat:
«الأيدي» (eller) kelimesinde mecâz-ı mürsel vardır; bununla kastedilen nefislerdir (canlardır), çünkü yakalama ve hareket onlarla olur. Bu, alâkası cüz'iyyet olan bir mecâz-ı mürseldir: cüz söylenip kül kastedilmiştir. Yahut alâkası sebebiyyettir, çünkü daha önce geçtiği gibi el hareketin sebebidir.

Tarihî bir bakış:
Müfessirler ellerle tehlikeye atılmanın anlamında ihtilaf etmişlerdir. Bu konuda söylenebilecek en yakın söz şudur: Muhacirlerden bir adam düşman safına hücum etti; insanlar ona: "Kendini eliyle tehlikeye attı!" diye bağırdılar. Bunun üzerine Ebû Eyyûb el-Ensârî şöyle dedi: "Biz bu ayeti daha iyi biliriz; o ancak bizim hakkımızda indi. Resûlullah (s.a.v.) ile beraber olduk, ona yardım ettik, onunla birlikte savaşlarda bulunduk, onu ailelerimize, mallarımıza ve çocuklarımıza tercih ettik. Savaş ağırlıklarını bırakınca (sona erince) ailelerimize, çocuklarımıza ve mallarımıza dönüp onları düzeltmek ve aralarında kalmak istedik. İşte tehlike (التهلكة), aile ve mal arasında kalıp cihadı terk etmekti." Başkaları da bu ayetin tefsirinde şöyle demiştir: «ولا تلقوا بأيديكم إلى التهلكة», yani israf ederek ve geçim yolunu zayi ederek; yahut gazâdan ve onun için infak etmekten geri durarak (kendinizi tehlikeye atmayın); çünkü bu, düşmanı güçlendiren ve onu size musallat eden şeylerdendir. Eslem Ebû İmrân'dan rivayet edildi; dedi ki: "Şehre —Kostantiniyye'yi kastediyor— gazâya gittik. Mısır halkının başında Ukbe b. Âmir, topluluğun başında da Abdurrahman b. Hâlid b. Velîd vardı. İki saf hâlinde dizildik; ondan daha geniş ve daha uzun iki saf hiç görmemiştim. Rumlar ise sırtlarını şehrin duvarına dayamışlardı. Bizden bir adam düşmana hücum etti. İnsanlar: 'Dur! Lâ ilâhe illallah, kendini eliyle tehlikeye atıyor!' dediler. Ebû Eyyûb el-Ensârî şöyle dedi: 'Siz bu ayeti, bir adam şehadet arayarak savaşmak için hücum ederse diye böyle yorumluyorsunuz. Hâlbuki bu ayet biz Ensar topluluğu hakkında indi. Allah peygamberine yardım edip İslam'ı galip kılınca aramızda şöyle dedik:
Biz ailelerimizi ve mallarımızı terk ettik; onların arasında kalmak ve onları düzeltmek [Mütercim notu: kaynaktaki ifade «أن نقيم فيها ونصلحها» şeklindedir; cümle bu hâliyle eksik/kapalıdır, olduğu gibi aktarılmıştır]. Bunun üzerine Allah gökten haberi indirdi.'" Ebû İmrân dedi ki: "Ebû Eyyûb, şehid edilip Kostantiniyye'de defnedilinceye kadar Allah yolunda cihad etmeye devam etti." Ben derim ki: Bu gazve, Ebû Eyyûb'un vefat ettiği meşhur gazveden başkadır. Ondan sonra Yezîd b. Muâviye, hicretin kırk dokuzuncu yılında, yanında sahabenin ileri gelenlerinden bir topluluk olduğu hâlde oraya sefer düzenledi.
Sonra Yezîd elli iki yılında tekrar oraya sefer düzenledi; Ebû Eyyûb'un vefat ettiği gazve budur. Kabri bugün hâlâ oradadır ve üzerine meşhur bir cami inşa edilmiştir. Bu konuda sözü uzatmamızın sebebi, onun içinde bulunduğumuz hâle ve cihaddan geri kalan, imkânlarını seferber etmeyi ve güçlerini toplamayı ihmal eden her ümmetin hâline uygun düşmesidir.

* Lügat:
(الْعُمْرَةَ): hacda (bilinen ibadet olarak) malumdur; «اعتمر» (umre yaptı) denir. Aslı ziyaret anlamındandır.
Zeccâc dedi ki: Umrenin amel bakımından anlamı yalnızca Beyt'i tavaf etmek ve Safâ ile Merve arasında sa'y etmektir. Hac ile umre arasındaki fark şudur: Umre insan için yılın tamamında yapılabilir, hac ise yılda tek bir vakittedir. Hükümleri fıkıh ilmindedir. Çoğulu «عمر» ve «عمرات»tır.
(أُحْصِرْتُمْ): engellendiniz. Korku, hastalık veya acizlik gibi bir durum birini engellediğinde «أحصر فلان» denir. İbn Meyyâde dedi ki:
وما هجر ليلى أن تكون تباعدت ... عليك ولا أن أحصرتك شغول
(Leylâ'yı terk edişin, onun senden uzaklaşmış olmasından da değildi, seni birtakım meşguliyetlerin alıkoymuş olmasından da.)
(اسْتَيْسَرَ): kolaylaştı, kolay geldi. «يسر الأمر» ve «استيسر» denir.
(الْهَدْيِ): hacı veya umrecinin Harem halkına hediye olarak sevk ettiği hayvana denir. el-Muhtâr'da şöyle geçer: «حتى يبلغ الهدي محلّه» hafif ve şeddeli [Mütercim notu: kaynak hangi harfin kastedildiğini belirtmez] olarak okunmuştur. Tekili «هدية» ve «هديّة»dir. «ما أحسن هديته» (onun gidişatı ne güzel), yani hâli/yolu denir. (Araplar) yeminlerinde onlarla (hedy hayvanları ile) yemin ederlerdi. Alâ b. Huzeyfe el-Ganevî dedi ki:
يقولون من هذا الغريب بأرضنا ... أما والهدايا إنني لغريب
(Diyorlar ki: "Topraklarımızdaki bu yabancı kim?" Evet, hedy kurbanlarına yemin olsun ki ben bir yabancıyım.)
(مَحِلَّهُ): «حل يحل» fiilinden ism-i mekândır, yani kesilmesinin helal olduğu yer.
Hâ harfi kesreli olmuştur, çünkü muzârisinin ayn'ül-fiili kesrelidir.

* İ'rab:
(وَأَتِمُّوا): Vâv atıf harfidir; «أتموا» nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir, vâv fâildir. (الْحَجَّ): mef'ûlün bihtir. (وَالْعُمْرَةَ): «الحج»e ma'tûftur. (لِلَّهِ): câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir, yani «O'nun rızası için hâlis olarak». İstersen onları «أتموا»ya müteallik kılabilirsin; o takdirde lâm, mef'ûlün lieclih lâmı olur. Şairler bu güzel ifadeyi iktibas edip gazel (aşk şiiri) yönlerine çevirmişlerdir. Zü'r-Rumme şöyle demiş ve harika söylemiştir:
تمام الحجّ أن تقف المطايا ... على خرقاء واضعة اللثام
(Haccın tamamı, binitlerin peçesini indirmiş Harkâ'nın yanında durmasıdır.)
O, Âmiroğulları'ndan sevgilisi olan Harkâ'nın yanında durmayı, tamamlanmasından kaçınılmaz olan hac menâsikinden biri gibi kılmıştır. (فَإِنْ): Fâ, fasîha fâsıdır; «إن» şartiyyedir. (أُحْصِرْتُمْ): fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallinde meçhul mâzî fiildir. (فَمَا): Fâ râbıtadır; «ما» ref' mahallinde mübtedâ olan ism-i mevsûldür, haberi mahzûftur, yani «فعليكم ما استيسر» (size düşen, kolay geleni …dır); cümle cevâbü'ş-şart olarak cezm (mahallin)dedir. (اسْتَيْسَرَ): mâzî fiildir, fâili müstetirdir; cümle i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü «ما»nın sılasıdır. (مِنَ الْهَدْيِ): câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir, yani «hedyden olarak». (وَلا): Vâv atıf harfidir, «لا» nehiy edatıdır. (تَحْلِقُوا): «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiildir, vâv fâildir. (رُؤُسَكُمْ): mef'ûlün bihtir. (حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ): «حتى» gâye ve cer harfidir, câr ve mecrûr «تحلقوا»ya mütealliktir; «يبلغ» gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir. (الْهَدْيِ): fâildir. (مَحِلَّهُ): mef'ûlün bihtir. (فَمَنْ): Fâ isti'nâfiyyedir; «من» ref' mahallinde mübtedâ olan, cezmeden şart ismidir. (كانَ): fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallinde nâkıs mâzî fiildir; ismi «من»e dönen müstetir zamirdir. (مِنْكُمْ): câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir. (مَرِيضاً): «كان»ın haberidir. (أَوْ): atıf harfidir. (بِهِ): câr ve mecrûr, öne alınmış (mukaddem) mahzûf habere mütealliktir. (أَذىً): sonraya bırakılmış (muahhar) mübtedâdır; ref' alâmeti, iki sâkinin birleşmesi sebebiyle hazfedilen elif üzerindeki takdîrî dammedir. (مِنْ رَأْسِهِ): câr ve mecrûr, «أذى»nın mahzûf sıfatına mütealliktir. (فَفِدْيَةٌ): Fâ cevâbü'ş-şartı bağlayan fâdır; «فدية» haberi mahzûf mübtedâdır, yani «فعليه فدية» (ona fidye gerekir); cümle cevâbü'ş-şarttır. (مِنْ صِيامٍ): câr ve mecrûr, «فدية»nin mahzûf sıfatına mütealliktir. (أَوْ): atıf harfidir. (صَدَقَةٍ): «صيام»a ma'tûftur. (أَوْ): atıf harfidir. (نُسُكٍ): «صيام»a ma'tûftur. Fiilü'ş-şart ve cevabı «من»in haberidir. (فَإِذا): Fâ isti'nâfiyyedir; «إذا» gelecek zaman için zarftır. (أَمِنْتُمْ): fiil cümlesi izafet ile cer mahallindedir. (فَمَنْ تَمَتَّعَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ): Fâ «إذا»nın cevabıdır; «من» mübtedâ olan, cezmeden şart ismidir; «تمتع» fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallinde mâzî fiildir; «بالعمرة» «تمتع»e mütealliktir; «الى الحج» mahzûf bir şeye mütealliktir, yani «temettüu ve (ihramda) yasak olan şeylerden faydalanması hacca kadar devam etti». (فَمَا): Fâ cevâbü'ş-şartı bağlayan fâdır; «ما» haberi mahzûf mübtedâ olan ism-i mevsûldür, yani «فعليه ما» (ona … olan gerekir). (اسْتَيْسَرَ): cevâbü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallinde fiildir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta böyledir; yukarıdaki benzer ifadede «استيسر» «ما»nın sılası sayılmış, cevâbü'ş-şart ise «ما» ile başlayan cümle olarak gösterilmişti.] (مِنَ الْهَدْيِ): câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir. (فَمَنْ): Fâ isti'nâfiyyedir; «من» şartiyye olup mübtedâdır. (لَمْ يَجِدْ): «لم» nefy, kalb (anlamı geçmişe çevirme) ve cezm harfidir; «يجد» «لم» ile meczûm muzâri fiildir. Meczûm fiil fiilü'ş-şarttır; fâili «من»e dönen müstetir zamirdir; mef'ûlü, anlamın açıklığı sebebiyle hazfedilmiştir; takdiri «فمن لم يجد ما استيسر من الهدي» (kim kolayına gelen hedyi bulamazsa)dır. (فَصِيامُ): Fâ cevâbü'ş-şartı bağlayan fâdır; «صيام» haberi mahzûf mübtedâdır, yani «فعليه فصيام» [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta takdir bu şekilde, fâ ile yazılmıştır; kastedilen «فعليه صيام»dır.]; cümle cevâbü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir. (ثَلاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ): muzâfun ileyhtir. (فِي الْحَجِّ): câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir. (وَسَبْعَةٍ): «ثلاثة»ya ma'tûftur. (إِذا رَجَعْتُمْ): «إذا» gelecek zaman için zarftır; «رجعتم» cümlesi izafet ile cer mahallindedir. (تِلْكَ): ism-i işaret olup mübtedâdır. (عَشَرَةٌ): haberdir. (كامِلَةٌ): sıfattır. (ذلِكَ): ism-i işaret olup mübtedâdır. (لِمَنْ): Lâm cer harfidir; «من» lâm ile cer mahallinde ism-i mevsûldür; câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir habere mütealliktir. (لَمْ يَكُنْ): «لم» nefy, kalb ve cezm harfidir; «يكن» «لم» ile meczûm nâkıs muzâri fiildir. (أَهْلُهُ): onun ismidir. «لم يكن» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü ism-i mevsûlün sılasıdır. (حاضِرِي): «يكن»in haberidir. (الْمَسْجِدِ): muzâfun ileyhtir. (الْحَرامِ): sıfattır. (وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; «اتقوا» nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir, vâv fâildir; lafza-i celâl mef'ûlün bihtir. (وَاعْلَمُوا): «اتقوا»ya ma'tûftur. (أَنَّ اللَّهَ): «أنّ» ve ismidir. (شَدِيدُ الْعِقابِ): «أنّ»nin haberidir. «أنّ» ve mâ ba'dı «اعلموا»nın iki mef'ûlünün yerini tutmuştur.

* Belâgat:
