Bu ayette, inceliği derin, yüksek bir beyân sanatı vardır; belâgat âlimleri buna tekrîr (tekrar) derler. Tarifi, lafzın anlama tekrarlanarak delâlet etmesidir. Ayette bu, Allah Teâlâ'nın «üç» ve «yedi»den sonra gelen «تلك عشرة كاملة» (İşte tam on gün) sözündedir; bu söz «üç ve yedi» sözünün iki kez söylenmesi yerine geçer. Sonra «كاملة» (tam) demiştir; bu da üçüncü bir te'kîddir. Emir, emredenden emredilene tekrar lafzıyla sâdır olur ve belirli bir vakitle sınırlandırılmamış olursa, bunda emre uymaya koşmaya ve hükme hiç beklemeden, gecikmeden derhal boyun eğmeye bir çağrı vardır. Bu sebeple yedi günün orucu dönüşte derhal vâcib olmuştur. Buna dikkat et, çünkü bu, sırlardandır. Kur'an-ı Kerim'de tekrîrin, onu tam olarak açıklayan örnekleri gelecektir. Şairler de Kur'an'ın semasına göz dikmişlerdir. Ebû Temmâm övgü olarak şöyle demiştir:
نهوض بثقل العبء مضطلع به ... وإن عظمت فيه الخطوب وجلّت
(Yükün ağırlığını kaldırmaya koşan, onu omuzlayan biridir; bu yolda musibetler büyüse ve ağırlaşsa da.)
«الثقل» (ağırlık) «العبء»dur (yüktür); onu mübalağa için tekrarlamıştır. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «كره» yazılıdır; bağlama göre doğrusu «كرّره» (tekrarladı) olmalıdır.] Buhtürî de gazel olarak şöyle demiştir:
ويوم تثنّت للوداع وسلّمت ... بعينين موصول بلحظهما السحر
توهمتها ألوى بأجفانها الكرى ... كرى النوم أو مالت بأعطافها الخمر
(Vedâ için kırılarak salındığı ve bakışlarına büyü bitişik iki gözle selam verdiği gün, onu sandım ki uyku uyuşukluğu göz kapaklarını bükmüş, yahut şarap onun bellerini eğmiş.)
O, bakışını gevşekliği sebebiyle uyuyana benzetmek istemiş, bunda anlamı muzâf ve muzâfun ileyh yoluyla tekrarlamıştır; bu da «كرى النوم» (uykunun uyuşukluğu) sözüdür; bunu, onu te'kîd etmek ve açıklamasını artırmak için yahut dinleyiciyi saracak her vehmi gidermek için yapmıştır.
Müberred şöyle demiş ve güzel söylemiştir: «Bunu (on sayısını), sayının bittiğine delâlet etsin diye zikretmiştir; tâ ki birisi, yediyi zikrettikten sonra geriye başka bir şey kaldığını vehmetmesin.»

* Vocabulary:
(الْعُمْرَةَ) in the context of the Hajj is well known; one says اعتمر (he performed ʿumra). Its root meaning is "visiting".
Al-Zajjāj said: The meaning of the ʿumra in practice is only the circumambulation of the House and the running between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwa. The difference between the Hajj and the ʿumra is that the ʿumra may be performed by a person throughout the whole year, whereas the Hajj has a single time in the year. Their rulings belong to the science of jurisprudence. The plural is ʿumar and ʿumarāt.
(أُحْصِرْتُمْ) means "you were prevented". One says أحصر فلان when something prevents him, whether fear, illness or incapacity. Ibn Mayyāda said:
وما هجر ليلى أن تكون تباعدت ... عليك ولا أن أحصرتك شغول
(Leila's abandonment of you is not because she has grown distant from you, nor because preoccupations have kept you back.)
(اسْتَيْسَرَ) means "became easy" (تيسّر). One says يسر الأمر and استيسر.
(الْهَدْيِ) is applied to the animal which the pilgrim or the performer of ʿumra drives as an offering for the people of the Sanctuary. In al-Mukhtār: «حتى يبلغ الهدي محلّه» was read lightened and doubled (shaddada) [Translator's note: the source does not say which letter is meant]. The singular is «هدية» and «هديّة». One says ما أحسن هديته, meaning "how fine is his conduct", and they used to swear by it in their oaths. Al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Ḥudhayfa al-Ghanawī said: يقولون من هذا الغريب بأرضنا ... أما والهدايا إنني لغريب (They say, "Who is this stranger in our land?" By the sacrificial offerings, I am indeed a stranger!)
(مَحِلَّهُ) is a noun of place from حل يحل, that is, the place where its slaughter becomes lawful (ḥalāl). The ḥāʾ is vowelled with kasra because the middle radical of its imperfect is vowelled with kasra.

* I'rab:
(وَأَتِمُّوا) The wāw is a conjunction; أتموا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) by the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الْحَجَّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (وَالْعُمْرَةَ) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الحج. (لِلَّهِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "purely for His sake"; or you may attach them to أتموا, in which case the lām is the lām of the mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The poets borrowed this beautiful expression and turned it to the purposes of love poetry. Dhū l-Rumma said, and excelled:
تمام الحجّ أن تقف المطايا ... على خرقاء واضعة اللثام
(The completion of the Hajj is that the riding beasts halt at Kharqāʾ, who has put down her veil.)
He made halting at Kharqāʾ, his beloved from Banū ʿĀmir, like one of the rites of the Hajj which one has no way to avoid completing. (فَإِنْ) The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (eloquent fāʾ), and إن is conditional. (أُحْصِرْتُمْ) a past passive verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm), being the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (فَمَا) The fāʾ is the connecting fāʾ, and ما is a relative noun in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "so upon you is what is easy", and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (اسْتَيْسَرَ) a past verb whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. (مِنَ الْهَدْيِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "being of the offering". (وَلا) The wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive. (تَحْلِقُوا) an imperfect verb jussive by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (رُؤُسَكُمْ) mafʿūl bihi. (حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ) حتى is a particle of limit and of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تحلقوا; يبلغ is an imperfect verb accusative by an implied أن. (الْهَدْيِ) fāʿil. (مَحِلَّهُ) mafʿūl bihi. (فَمَنْ) The fāʾ is resumptive, and من is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (كانَ) a defective past verb in the position of a jussive, being the protasis; its subject (ism) is a latent pronoun referring to من. (مِنْكُمْ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl. (مَرِيضاً) khabar of كان. (أَوْ) a conjunction. (بِهِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (أَذىً) a postponed mubtadaʾ, its nominative sign being an implied ḍamma on the omitted alif because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. (مِنْ رَأْسِهِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of أذى. (فَفِدْيَةٌ) The fāʾ is the connecting fāʾ of the apodosis, and فدية is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "so upon him is a ransom", and the clause is the apodosis. (مِنْ صِيامٍ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣifa of فدية. (أَوْ) a conjunction. (صَدَقَةٍ) conjoined to صيام. (أَوْ) a conjunction. (نُسُكٍ) conjoined to صيام. The protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of من. (فَإِذا) The fāʾ is resumptive and إذا is an adverb for what is to come of time. (أَمِنْتُمْ) The verbal clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. (فَمَنْ تَمَتَّعَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ) The fāʾ is the apodosis of إذا; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ; تمتع is a past verb in the position of a jussive, the protasis; بالعمرة is attached to تمتع; and إلى الحج is attached to an omitted element, i.e. "and his enjoyment and benefit from what is forbidden continued up to the Hajj". (فَمَا) The fāʾ is the connecting fāʾ of the apodosis, and ما is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "so upon him is what" (اسْتَيْسَرَ) a verb in the position of a jussive, the apodosis. [Translator's note: so in the source; in the similar passage above, استيسر was treated as the ṣila of ما and the apodosis was given as the clause beginning with ما.] (مِنَ الْهَدْيِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl. (فَمَنْ) The fāʾ is resumptive and من is conditional, a mubtadaʾ. (لَمْ يَجِدْ) لم is a particle of negation, reversal and jussive, and يجد is an imperfect verb jussive by لم; the jussive verb is the protasis; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun referring to من; its object is omitted because the meaning is evident, the implied form being "whoever does not find what is easy of the offering". (فَصِيامُ) The fāʾ is the connecting fāʾ of the apodosis, and صيام is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "so upon him is fasting" (فعليه فصيام) [Translator's note: the source writes the implied form with a fāʾ, «فعليه فصيام»; the intended form is «فعليه صيام»], and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis. (ثَلاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ) muḍāf ilayhi. (فِي الْحَجِّ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl. (وَسَبْعَةٍ) conjoined to ثلاثة. (إِذا رَجَعْتُمْ) إذا is an adverb for what is to come of time, and the clause رجعتم is in the position of genitive by annexation. (تِلْكَ) a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. (عَشَرَةٌ) khabar. (كامِلَةٌ) ṣifa. (ذلِكَ) a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. (لِمَنْ) The lām is a preposition, and من is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar. (لَمْ يَكُنْ) لم is a particle of negation, reversal and jussive, and يكن is a defective imperfect verb jussive by لم. (أَهْلُهُ) its ism; the clause لم يكن has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun. (حاضِرِي) khabar of يكن. (الْمَسْجِدِ) muḍāf ilayhi. (الْحَرامِ) ṣifa. (وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ) The wāw is resumptive; اتقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi. (وَاعْلَمُوا) conjoined to اتقوا. (أَنَّ اللَّهَ) أنّ and its ism. (شَدِيدُ الْعِقابِ) khabar of أنّ; أنّ and what is within its scope stand in the place of the two objects of اعلموا.

* Rhetoric:
In this verse there is a lofty figure of speech, subtle in its derivation, which the scholars of rhetoric call "repetition" (takrīr); its definition is that the expression indicates the meaning by repeating it. In the verse it is in the saying of the Exalted: «تلك عشرة كاملة» after "three" and "seven": it stands in place of saying "three and seven" twice, and then He said كاملة (complete), which is a third emphasis. When a command issues from the commander to the one commanded in repeated wording and is not restricted to a specific time, this is a summons to hasten to obey the command and comply with the ruling at once, without delay or tardiness. Hence the fasting of the seven days is obligatory immediately upon return. So take note of it, for it is among the secrets. Examples of repetition in the Noble Qur'an will come which will clarify it completely. The poets glanced at the sky of the Qur'an, and Abū Tammām said in praise:
نهوض بثقل العبء مضطلع به ... وإن عظمت فيه الخطوب وجلّت
(One who rises under the weight of the burden and is equal to it, even if the calamities in it are great and grave.)
الثقل is the same as العبء; it was repeated only for emphasis. [Translator's note: the source has «كره», evidently for «كرّره» ("he repeated it").] And al-Buḥturī said in love poetry:
ويوم تثنّت للوداع وسلّمت ... بعينين موصول بلحظهما السحر
توهمتها ألوى بأجفانها الكرى ... كرى النوم أو مالت بأعطافها الخمر
(On the day she swayed at the farewell and greeted me, with two eyes whose glance is joined to sorcery; I imagined her eyelids overcome by drowsiness, the drowsiness of sleep, or her body swaying with wine.)
He meant to liken her glance, in its languor, to that of a sleeper, so he repeated the meaning by way of muḍāf and muḍāf ilayhi, in his saying «كرى النوم», to emphasise it and increase its clarity, or to remove any misgiving that might trouble the listener.
Al-Mubarrad said, and said well: "He mentioned that to indicate the completion of the number, lest someone imagine that after mentioning the seven something else remained."

* Vocabulary:
(الفسوق): One says فسق عن أمر الله, that is, he departed from it; and فسقت الرطبة عن قشرها (the fresh date burst out of its skin) and "the mouse from its hole". Among the rare features of the letters fāʾ and sīn is that their coming together as the first and second radicals of a word indicates something repugnant in the meaning of the word, and this is a wonderful matter by which our language is distinguished from all other languages. For example: فسأ الثوب, i.e. he tore it, and you dislike that anyone should tear your garment; فسىء (with kasra on the sīn), when the chest sticks out and the back goes in, which is an ugly, repellent form; فسخ العقد means he annulled the contract, and I do not suppose anyone is pleased to have a contract annulled for him; and الفسل is the base, the unwholesome. Al-Farazdaq said:
فلا تقبلوا منهم أباعر تشترى ... بوكس ولا سودا تصحّ فسولها
(Do not accept from them camels bought at a loss, nor black ones whose baseness is sound.)

* I'rab:
(الْحَجُّ أَشْهُرٌ مَعْلُوماتٌ) mubtadaʾ and khabar; معلومات is a ṣifa of أشهر. The known months are: Shawwāl, Dhū l-Qiʿda and ten days of Dhū l-Ḥijja according to Abū Ḥanīfa; according to al-Shāfiʿī, nine days of Dhū l-Ḥijja and the night of the Day of Sacrifice; and according to Mālik, the whole of Dhū l-Ḥijja in one of his opinions. Part of the month is given the standing of the whole month; you say, "I saw you in such-and-such a year", when the seeing took place only in an hour of the year, not all of it. The clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. (فَمَنْ) The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it comes as a detailed answer to one who asks for clarification of what was summarised, and من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ. (فَرَضَ) the protasis, and its fāʿil is هو (latent). (فِيهِنَّ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to فرض. (الْحَجَّ) mafʿūl bihi, i.e. upon himself. (فَلا رَفَثَ) The fāʾ is the connecting fāʾ of the apodosis, لا is the lā of generic negation, and رفث is its ism; the meaning of رفث has already been given. (وَلا فُسُوقَ) conjoined to His saying فلا رفث. (وَلا جِدالَ فِي الْحَجِّ) also conjoined, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of لا; the nominal clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of من. (وَما) The wāw is resumptive, and ما is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of تفعلوا. (تَفْعَلُوا) the jussive protasis, its jussive sign being the omission of the nūn. (مِنْ خَيْرٍ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl. (يَعْلَمْهُ اللَّهُ) the apodosis; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and الله is fāʿil. (وَتَزَوَّدُوا) The wāw is resumptive; تزودوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (فَإِنَّ) The fāʾ is causal, and إنّ is a particle resembling the verb. (خَيْرَ الزَّادِ) ism of إنّ and its muḍāf ilayhi. (التَّقْوى) its khabar; the clause has no grammatical position. (وَاتَّقُونِ) The wāw is a conjunction; اتقون is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the first-person yāʾ, which is omitted and indicated by the kasra, is mafʿūl bihi. (يا أُولِي الْأَلْبابِ) يا is a vocative particle; أولي الألباب is the one addressed, a muḍāf, its accusative sign being the yāʾ because it is annexed to the sound masculine plural; and الألباب is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause is conjoined to the clause تزودوا.

* Rhetoric:
1- In this verse there is a wonderful kind of prohibition: the measure of the thing prohibited depends on where it occurs, so that it would be considered not deserving of prohibition if it occurred in any other place. The specification of the Hajj with the prohibition of lewdness, wickedness and disputation within it conveys that these acts outside the Hajj, although they are prohibited and ugly, have an ugliness that is as nothing compared with their occurrence in the Hajj; so avoiding them is imperative in every case, but avoiding them in the Hajj is something above ordinary avoidance. Prohibition in our Arabic language has branches and paths whose depths can scarcely be sounded. Among them is that you prohibit something which is in reality praiseworthy and commendable, but which destroys its owner if it reaches him. The immortal poet al-Mutanabbī noticed these secrets when he forbade his two companions to convey to Sayf al-Dawla his praise of him, lest he be driven further and cast himself into destructive dangers. He said, having soared as he pleased:
فلا تبلغاه ما أقول فإنّه ... شجاع متى بذكر له الطعن يشتق
(Do not convey to him what I say, for he is a brave man who, whenever the thrust is mentioned to him, longs for it.)
He did not mean, in asking his two companions to conceal from Sayf al-Dawla what they had heard of the qualities of his deeds and of the lance-thrusts of his horsemen, to be gentle with him and to fear that longing would drive him to throw himself into perils. Somewhat similar is the saying of Kuthayyir, the companion of ʿAzza:
فلا تذكراه الحاجبيّة إنّه ... متى تذكراه الحاجبيّة يحزن
(Do not mention to him the Ḥājibiyya, for whenever you mention the Ḥājibiyya to him he grieves.)
2- The eloquent simile (tashbīh baligh): piety (taqwā) is likened to provision (zād) on the ground of the common element of strengthening, tightening of the grip and restraint.
3- Elaboration (iṭnāb) in His saying: «يا أولي الألباب». The command to piety is not specific to people of understanding alone, and the address is not directed to them rather than others in urging it, since every human being is commanded to be pious. This is called mentioning the specific after the general, to draw attention to the superiority and greater weight of the specific over the general. People differ in rank only by their minds (albāb), which are the intellects. Al-Mutanabbī glanced at the sky of this meaning and said:
لولا العقول لكان أدنى ضيغم ... أدنى إلى شرف من الإنسان
(Were it not for intellects, the lowest lion would be nearer to nobility than man.)
4- The Qur'an used «الألباب» in the plural and did not bring it in the singular, because it is among the words whose singular is unpleasant and whose plural is sweet; and this is an inherent property of our language.

* Lügat:
(أَفَضْتُمْ): kendinizi sevk ettiniz ve oradan çıkmak için yürüdünüz. «الإفاضة» bol miktarda akıtmak/sevk etmektir; suyu bolca döktüğünde söylenen «أفضت الماء» sözündendir. el-Misbâh'ta şöyle geçer: «'أفاض الناس من عرفات', insanlar oradan akın etti demektir; her bir akın bir ifâzadır. 'أفاضوا من منى إلى مكة' kurban günü Minâ'dan Mekke'ye döndüler demektir. Tavâfü'l-ifâza da buradan gelir, yani Minâ'dan Mekke'ye dönüş tavafı.»
(عَرَفاتٍ): vakfe yerinin özel ismidir (alem). Sîbeveyh onun alem oluşuna şu sözle delil getirmiştir:
«هذه عرفات مباركا فيها», «مباركا» hâl olarak mansûbtur; nekre olsaydı (bu kelime) ona sıfat olarak (tâbi olup) gelirdi. Ayrıca nekre olsaydı ona elif-lâm girerdi; hâlbuki girmez. İ'rabının hükmü Fevâid'de gelecektir.
(الْمَشْعَرِ): Müzdelife'nin sonunda Kuzah denilen bir dağdır. «Meş'ar» diye adlandırılmıştır, çünkü işaret anlamındaki «الشعار»dan gelir.

* İ'rab:
(لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُناحٌ): «ليس» nâkıs mâzî fiildir; «عليكم» câr ve mecrûr olup öne alınmış mahzûf haberine mütealliktir; «جناح» «ليس»in sonraya bırakılmış ismidir. (أَنْ): masdar ve nasb harfidir. (تَبْتَغُوا): «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir; nasb alâmeti nûnun hazfidir; vâv fâildir. «أن» ve mâ ba'dı, nez'u'l-hâfıd ile mansûb bir masdar te'vilindedir, yani «في أن تبتغوا» (aramanızda); câr ve mecrûr «جناح»ın sıfatıdır. (فَضْلًا): mef'ûlün bihtir. (مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ): câr ve mecrûr «تبتغوا»ya veya «فضلا»nın mahzûf sıfatına mütealliktir. (فَإِذا): Fâ isti'nâfiyyedir; «إذا» gelecek zaman için zarf olup cevaba mütealliktir. (أَفَضْتُمْ): fiil ve fâildir; cümle izafet ile cer mahallindedir. (مِنْ عَرَفاتٍ): câr ve mecrûr «أفضتم»a mütealliktir. (فَاذْكُرُوا): Fâ cevâbü'ş-şartı bağlayan fâdır; «اذكروا» emir fiil ve fâildir; cümle i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır. (اللَّهَ): mef'ûlün bihtir. (عِنْدَ الْمَشْعَرِ): zarf «اذكروا»ya mütealliktir. (الْحَرامِ): «المشعر»in sıfatıdır. İstersen zarfı mahzûf bir hâle müteallik kılabilirsin, yani «Meş'ar-i Haram'ın yanında bulunanlar olarak». (وَاذْكُرُوهُ): Vâv atıf harfidir; onu te'kîd için tekrarlamıştır. «اذكروه» nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir, vâv fâildir, hâ mef'ûlün bihtir. (كَما هَداكُمْ): Kâf cer harfidir, «ما» masdariyyedir; (kâf) mecrûruyla birlikte mef'ûl-i mutlak veya hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir, yani «O'nu güzel bir zikirle zikredin» ya da «O'nu, sizi hidayete erdirmesinin misli (bir zikir)le zikredin». «هداكم» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü harfî bir mevsûlden sonra gelmiştir. (وَإِنْ): Vâv hâliyyedir; «إن» ağırdan (إنّ'den) hafifletilmiştir; hafifletildiğinde hükmü daha önce geçti ve çoğunlukla ihmal edilir (amel ettirilmez). (كُنْتُمْ): nâkıs «كان» ve ismidir. (مِنْ قَبْلِهِ): câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir. (لَمِنَ الضَّالِّينَ): Lâm, fârika (ayırıcı) lâmdır; «من الضالين» câr ve mecrûr olup «كنتم»ün mahzûf haberine mütealliktir. (ثُمَّ): tertip ve terâhî (ara ile) için atıf harfidir. (أَفِيضُوا): nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir, vâv fâildir. (مِنْ حَيْثُ): câr ve mecrûr «أفيضوا»ya mütealliktir; «حيث» hakkındaki söz daha önce geçti. (أَفاضَ النَّاسُ): fiil ve fâildir; cümle izafet ile cer mahallindedir. (وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّهَ): Vâv atıf harfidir; «استغفروا الله» fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir. (إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ): «إنّ», ismi ve iki haberidir; cümle ta'lîliyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.

* Fevâid:
«عرفات», cem-i müennes-i sâlimin i'rabıyla i'rab olunur. «أذرعات» gibi bu (çoğul) ile isimlendirilen her şey de böyledir; bu konuda fasîh olan budur. Bazıları onun gayr-i munsarifin i'rabıyla i'rab olunmasını caiz görmüştür. Bir görüşe göre de cem-i müennes-i sâlimin i'rabıyla i'rab olunur, ancak tenvin almaz. İmruülkays'in şu sözü üç vecihle de rivayet edilmiştir:
تنورتها من أذرعات وأهلها ... بيثرب أدنى دارها نظر عال
(Onun ateşini Ezriât'tan gördüm; hâlbuki ailesi Yesrib'deydi; yurdunun en yakını bile yüksek bir bakış(la görülecek uzaklık)tadır.)

* Vocabulary:
(أَفَضْتُمْ) means: you pushed yourselves forth and set out to leave it. Ifāḍa is pushing forth in abundance, from أفضت الماء when I poured the water abundantly. In al-Miṣbāḥ: أفاض الناس من عرفات means they pushed forth from it, and every push is an ifāḍa. "أفاضوا من منى إلى مكة" on the Day of Sacrifice means they returned to it; from this comes ṭawāf al-ifāḍa, i.e. the circumambulation of return from Minā to Mecca.
(عَرَفاتٍ) is a proper name for the place of standing. Sībawayh argued that it is a proper name from his saying: هذه عرفات مباركا فيها, with «مباركا» in the accusative as a ḥāl; had it been indefinite it would have been followed by an adjective; and had it been indefinite the alif and lām would have entered it, yet they do not enter it. The ruling on its i'rab will come under the Benefits.
(الْمَشْعَرِ) is a mountain at the end of al-Muzdalifa called Quzaḥ; it is called مشعر from شعار, which is a sign.

* I'rab:
(لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُناحٌ) ليس is a defective past verb; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar of it; جناح is the postponed ism of ليس. (أَنْ) a particle of masdar and of accusative. (تَبْتَغُوا) an imperfect verb accusative by أن, its accusative sign being the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; أن and what is within its scope are in the interpretation of a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in that you seek", and the preposition and its genitive noun are a ṣifa of جناح. (فَضْلًا) mafʿūl bihi. (مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تبتغوا or to an omitted ṣifa of فضلا. (فَإِذا) The fāʾ is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb for what is to come of time, attached to the apodosis. (أَفَضْتُمْ) verb and fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. (مِنْ عَرَفاتٍ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أفضتم. (فَاذْكُرُوا) The fāʾ is the connecting fāʾ of the apodosis; اذكروا is an imperative verb with its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional. (اللَّهَ) mafʿūl bihi. (عِنْدَ الْمَشْعَرِ) The adverb is attached to اذكروا. (الْحَرامِ) ṣifa of المشعر; you may also attach the adverb to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "being at the Sacred Landmark". (وَاذْكُرُوهُ) The wāw is a conjunction, and He repeated it for emphasis. اذكروه is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. (كَما هَداكُمْ) The kāf is a preposition and ما is maṣdar; together with its genitive it is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq or a ḥāl, i.e. "remember Him with a fine remembrance", or "remember Him as He guided you"; the clause هداكم has no grammatical position because it follows a particle-type relative (mawṣūl ḥarfī). (وَإِنْ) The wāw is circumstantial, and إن is the lightened form of the heavy إنّ (the rule for it when lightened has been given earlier; it is mostly left without effect). (كُنْتُمْ) كان the defective with its ism. (مِنْ قَبْلِهِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl. (لَمِنَ الضَّالِّينَ) The lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), and من الضالين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of كنتم. (ثُمَّ) a conjunction of sequence with delay. (أَفِيضُوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (مِنْ حَيْثُ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أفيضوا; what has been said about حيث has already preceded. (أَفاضَ النَّاسُ) verb and fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. (وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّهَ) The wāw is a conjunction; استغفروا الله is verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi. (إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ) إنّ with its ism and its two khabars; the clause is causal and has no grammatical position.

* Benefits:
عرفات is declined as the sound feminine plural, and likewise everything named by such a form, such as أذرعات; this is the eloquent usage for it. Some permitted that it be declined as a diptote; and it is said that it is declined as the sound feminine plural except that it takes no tanwīn. The verse of Imruʾ al-Qays has been transmitted in the three ways:
تنورتها من أذرعات وأهلها ... بيثرب أدنى دارها نظر عال
(I looked at her fire from Adhriʿāt, while her people are in Yathrib; the nearest of her abodes is a lofty sight away.)

* Lügat:
(المناسك): «منسك»in çoğuludur; sîn fethalı ve kesreli olarak (okunur). Mîmî masdar veya ism-i mekândır; birincisi daha tercihe şayandır; yani haccınızın ibadetleri.

* İ'rab:
(فَإِذا): Fâ isti'nâfiyyedir; «إذا» gelecek zaman için zarftır; şartını (izafetle) cerreder, cevabıyla mansûbdur. (قَضَيْتُمْ): fiil ve fâildir; cümle izafet ile cer mahallindedir. (مَناسِكَكُمْ): mef'ûlün bihtir; kâf izafet ile cer mahallinde bitişik zamirdir. (فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ): Fâ cevâbü'ş-şartı bağlayan fâdır; «اذكروا الله»:
emir fiil, fâil ve mef'ûldür; cümle i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır. (كَذِكْرِكُمْ): kâf mecrûruyla birlikte mef'ûl-i mutlak olarak nasb mahallindedir, yani «Allah'ı, babalarınızı anmanıza benzer bir anışla anın»; yahut hâldir. (آباءَكُمْ): fâiline izafe edilmiş masdarın mef'ûlün bihidir. (أَوْ أَشَدَّ ذِكْراً): Bu atıf, i'rab yapan kimse için müşkil olan şeylerdendir; bu konuda talebenin içinde kaybolacağı labirentler gibi görüşler vardır. Nahivcilerin ve müfessirlerin serdettiği görüşler tercih bakımından eşit olduğu için, onları sade ve anlaşılır bir şekilde özetlemeyi uygun gördük: 1- «أشدّ» kâfa ma'tûftur, yani «كذكركم أو ذكر قوم أشد منهم ذكرا» (sizin anmanız gibi veya onlardan daha şiddetli anan bir kavmin anması gibi).
2- «أشدّ» «آبائكم»e ma'tûftur; dolayısıyla mansûbdur ve anlamı «أو أشد من ذكر آبائكم» (veya babalarınızı anmaktan daha şiddetli)dir.
3- «أشدّ» bizzat «الذكر»e ma'tûftur; bu durumda sözü, «شعر شاعر» (şiir şairlik etti) ve «جن جنونه» (deliliği delirdi) ve benzeri sözler kabilinden mecâz-ı aklîye hamletmek zorunludur. Bu vecihlerde daha müşkil bir husus kalır: İsm-i tafdîl, kendinden sonraki şey kendinden önceki şeyin cinsinden olursa ona izafe edilir; şu sözün gibi:
«ذكرك أشدّ ذكر» (senin anman anmaların en şiddetlisidir) ve «وجهك أحسن وجه» (yüzün yüzlerin en güzelidir). Kendisinden sonraki temyîz olarak mansûb olursa, sonraki şey öncekinden başka olur; «عليّ أجمل وجها» (Ali yüzce daha güzeldir) sözün gibi; burada güzellik Ali'ye değil yüze aittir. «زيد أكرم أبا» deseydin, Zeyd oğullardan olurdu (babası daha cömert olan biri); şayet
«زيد أكرم أب» deseydin, Zeyd babalardan olurdu (en cömert baba).
4- Son olarak, Ebü'l-Bekâ el-Ukberî'nin çareler kendisini âciz bıraktıktan sonra başvurduğu bir vecih: "Bana göre söz anlama hamledilmiştir; takdiri «أو كونوا أشد ذكرا لله منكم لآبائكم» (veya Allah'ı, babalarınızı anmanızdan daha çok anan kimseler olun) şeklindedir. Bu anlama Allah Teâlâ'nın
«فاذكروا الله» sözü delâlet etmektedir, yani 'O'nu ananlar olun.'"
Ebû Hayyân bu vecihleri serdettikten sonra hepsini zayıf olarak nitelemiş ve şöyle demiştir: «Ayeti, onlara Allah'ı babalarını anmalarına benzer veya ondan daha şiddetli bir anışla anmalarının emredildiği anlamına hamletmemiz bize mümkün olmuştur. Bu da onların gözden kaçırdığı açık bir izahla olur: «أشدّ» hâl olarak mansûbdur; o, sonra gelseydi «ذكرا» sözünün sıfatı olurdu; öne geçince hâl olarak mansûb olmuştur. Tıpkı şu sözleri gibi: لمية موحشا طلل ... يلوح كأنه خلل
(Meyye'nin ıssız bir harabesi vardır; sanki bir kın kaplaması gibi parıldar.)
Sonra gelseydi «لميّة طلل موحش» olurdu. Aynı şekilde bu da sonra gelseydi «أو ذكرا أشد» olurdu, yani babalarınızı anmanızdan (daha şiddetli). Bu durumda «أو ذكرا أشد», «كذكركم»deki kâfın mahalline ma'tûf olur.»
Deriz ki: Belki de bu, mantığa en yakın ve anlaşılmaya en elverişli olanıdır. Bazı müteahhir müfessirler uzun hâşiyelerinde bununla yetinmişlerdir. (فَمِنَ النَّاسِ): Fâ isti'nâfiyyedir; câr ve mecrûr öne alınmış mahzûf habere mütealliktir. (مَنْ): sonraya bırakılmış mübtedâ olan ism-i mevsûldür. (يَقُولُ): muzâri fiildir; fâili takdiri «هو» olan, «من»e dönen müstetir zamirdir. Burada «من»in lafzı gözetilmiştir ki o tekildir; anlamı gözetilseydi «يقولون» derdi. (Bu) isti'nâfiyye cümle i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; kâfirlerin hâlini, mü'minlerin hâlini ve iki istek arasındaki farkı açıklamak için getirilmiştir. «يقول» cümlesi «من»in sılasıdır. (رَبَّنا): mansûb muzâf münâdâdır; nidâ harfi hazfedilmiştir. (آتِنا): illet harfinin hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir; fâil takdiri «أنت» olan müstetir zamirdir; mütekellim-i maa'l-gayr zamiri «آت»in birinci mef'ûlüdür; ikinci mef'ûl mahzûftur, yani «نصيبنا» (payımızı). (فِي الدُّنْيا): câr ve mecrûr «آتنا»ya mütealliktir. (وَما): Vâv hâliyyedir, «ما» nefy harfidir. (لَهُ): câr ve mecrûr öne alınmış mahzûf habere mütealliktir. (فِي الْآخِرَةِ): câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir. (مِنْ خَلاقٍ): «من» zâide cer harfidir; «خلاق» lafzen mecrûr, mahallen merfûdur, çünkü sonraya bırakılmış mübtedâdır. (وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ رَبَّنا آتِنا فِي الدُّنْيا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً): önceki cümleye ma'tûftur; i'rabı daha önce geçti. Burada ikinci mef'ûl teşvik ve öğretim için açıkça zikredilmiştir. (وَقِنا): Vâv atıf harfidir; «ق» illet harfinin hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir; fâili takdiri «أنت» olan müstetir zamirdir; çoğul zamiri «ق»nin birinci mef'ûlüdür. (عَذابَ النَّارِ): «ق»nin ikinci mef'ûlüdür. (أُولئِكَ): ism-i işaret olup mübtedâdır. (لَهُمْ): câr ve mecrûr öne alınmış mahzûf habere mütealliktir. (نَصِيبٌ): sonraya bırakılmış mübtedâdır; cümle ism-i işaretin haberidir. Cümle, ikinci grubun hâlini açıklamak için isti'nâfiyyedir; çünkü birinci grubun hâli «وما له في الآخرة من خلاق» sözüyle daha önce zikredilmişti. (مِمَّا): câr ve mecrûr «نصيب»in mahzûf sıfatına mütealliktir. (كَسَبُوا): mâzî fiil ve fâildir; cümle «ما» mevsûlünün sılasıdır. (وَاللَّهُ): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; «الله» mübtedâdır. (سَرِيعُ الْحِسابِ): onun haberidir. Bu isti'nâfiyye cümle, Allah Teâlâ'nın bütün mahlukatı göz açıp kapayıncaya kadar geçen süreden daha kısa bir sürede hesaba çekmeye kadir olduğunu açıklamak için getirilmiştir.

* Belâgat:
«أشد ذكرا» sözünün i'rab vecihlerinden birinde mecâz-ı aklîye işaret geçti; bu daha önce incelenmişti. Bu mecazı daha da açarak deriz ki: Zikri zikre isnat etmek imkânsızdır; fakat ona sıkı sıkıya bitişik oluşu sebebiyle sanki onu yerine getiren, ondan ayrı akıllı bir şahıs hâline gelmiştir. Ebû Temmâm'ın şu sözü ne güzeldir:
تكاد عطاياه يجنّ جنونها ... إذا لم يعوّذها بنغمة طالب
(Onun bağışları, bir isteyenin sesiyle muska edilmezse neredeyse deliliği delirecektir.)
Burada deliliği kendi masdarına isnat etmiştir. Bunun sırrı, açıkladığımız şiddetli bitişikliktir; bu bitişiklik, akılsız olanı, ondan şiddetle vuku bulması sebebiyle akıllı kılar. Talebeler, bunda kasıtlı bir benzerlik olmadığı hâlde, bununla istiâre-i mekniyye arasındaki farkı neredeyse karıştırırlar. Ebû Firâs dedi ki: سيذكرني قومي إذا جدّ جدهم ... وفي الليلة الظّلماء يفتقد البدر
(Kavmim, ciddiyetleri ciddileştiğinde beni anacaktır; karanlık gecede dolunayın yokluğu hissedilir.)
Ebü't-Tayyib'in (Mütenebbî'nin) mecâz-ı aklî tarzında gelmiş bir kıt'ası vardır; bu, güzel şiirdendir:
صحب الناس قبلنا ذا الزمانا ... وعناهم من أمره ما عنانا
وتولوا بغصّة كلّهم منه وإن سرّ بعضهم أحيانا ربما تحسن الصّنيع لياليه ولكن تكدّر الإحسانا
كلما أنبت الزمان قناة ... ركب المرء في القناة سنانا
(Bizden önce de insanlar bu zamana arkadaş oldular; onun işinden bizi meşgul eden şey onları da meşgul etti. Bazen bazılarını sevindirmiş olsa da hepsi ondan boğazlarında bir düğümle ayrıldılar. Belki geceleri iyilik yapar, fakat yapılan iyiliği bulandırır. Zaman ne zaman bir mızrak sapı bitirse, insan o sapa bir mızrak ucu takar.)

* Fevâid:
Cer harfi «من», fâilde, mef'ûlün bihte ve mübtedâda zâide olarak gelir; şu şartla ki ondan önce nefy, nehiy veya istifhâm bulunsun ve mecrûru nekre olsun. Bu durumda zâide oluşu kıyâsîdir. Bunun daha fazla örneği gelecektir.

* Vocabulary:
(المناسك): plural of منسك, with fatḥa or kasra on the sīn; it is a maṣdar mīmī (noun of action with initial mīm) or a noun of place, the former being preferable, i.e. the acts of worship of your Hajj.

* I'rab:
(فَإِذا) The fāʾ is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb for what is to come of time, governing its protasis in the genitive and being put in the accusative by its apodosis. (قَضَيْتُمْ) verb and fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. (مَناسِكَكُمْ) mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ) The fāʾ is the connecting fāʾ of the apodosis; اذكروا الله: imperative verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional. (كَذِكْرِكُمْ) The kāf with its genitive noun is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "remember Allah with a remembrance like your remembrance of your fathers", or a ḥāl. (آباءَكُمْ) mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar which is annexed to its fāʿil. (أَوْ أَشَدَّ ذِكْراً) This conjunction is among the things that trouble the one who parses, and there are opinions about it in whose mazes the student is lost. Since the opinions which the grammarians and exegetes have adduced are equal in weight, we saw fit to summarise them in a simple, accessible form: 1- أشدّ is conjoined to the kāf, i.e. "like your remembrance or the remembrance of a people stronger than them in remembrance".
2- أشدّ is conjoined to آبائكم, so it is accusative, meaning "or stronger than the remembrance of your fathers".
3- أشدّ is conjoined to the remembrance (dhikr) itself, and the words must then be taken as a rational trope (majāz ʿaqlī), like their sayings شعر شاعر (a poet's poem) and جن جنونه (his madness went mad), and the like. There remains in these views a more troublesome matter: the elative is annexed to what follows it when that is of the same kind as what precedes it, as when you say ذكرك أشدّ ذكر (your remembrance is the strongest remembrance) and وجهك أحسن وجه (your face is the finest face); and when what follows it is put in the accusative as a tamyīz, what follows is other than what precedes, as when you say عليّ أجمل وجها: the beauty belongs to the face, not to ʿAlī. And if you said زيد أكرم أبا, Zayd would be among the sons; and if you said زيد أكرم أب, Zayd would be among the fathers.
4- Finally, a view to which Abū l-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī resorted after devices had failed him; he said: "In my opinion the sentence is carried according to the meaning, and the implied form is: 'or be stronger in remembering Allah than you are in remembering your fathers'. This meaning is indicated by the saying of the Exalted «فاذكروا الله», i.e. be those who remember Him."
After citing these views, Abū Ḥayyān described them all as weak and said: "It is possible for us to carry the verse to the meaning that they were commanded to remember Allah with a remembrance equal to the remembrance of their fathers or stronger, by a clear elucidation which they overlooked, namely that «أشدّ» is accusative as a ḥāl, being an adjective (naʿt) of His word «ذكرا» had it come later; when it was fronted it became accusative as a ḥāl, like their saying:
لمية موحشا طلل ... يلوح كأنه خلل
(Of Mayya there is a desolate ruin, gleaming as though it were a sword-sheath lining.)
Had it come later it would have been «لميّة طلل موحش». Likewise, had this come later it would be «أو ذكرا أشد», meaning than your remembrance of your fathers, and «أو ذكرا أشد» would then be conjoined to the position of the kāf in «كذكركم»."
We say: perhaps this is closer to logic and nearer to understanding, and some later exegetes have been content with it in their lengthy marginal notes. (فَمِنَ النَّاسِ) The fāʾ is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (مَنْ) a relative noun, postponed mubtadaʾ. (يَقُولُ) an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun, the implied form being هو, referring to من; the wording of من, which is singular, has been observed; had its meaning been observed He would have said يقولون. The resumptive clause has no grammatical position, and it is brought to explain the state of the disbelievers and the state of the believers and the difference between the two requests. The clause «يقول» is the ṣila of من. (رَبَّنا) the one addressed, a muḍāf in the accusative, the vocative particle having been omitted. (آتِنا) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the weak letter, the fāʿil being latent, the implied form being أنت, and the first-person plural pronoun is the first object of آت; the second object is omitted, i.e. "our share"; and (فِي الدُّنْيا) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آتنا. (وَما) The wāw is circumstantial and ما is negative. (لَهُ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (فِي الْآخِرَةِ) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. (مِنْ خَلاقٍ) من is a redundant preposition, and خلاق is genitive in form and nominative in position because it is a postponed mubtadaʾ. (وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ رَبَّنا آتِنا فِي الدُّنْيا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً) conjoined to the preceding clause, whose i'rab has been given; here the second object is stated explicitly, as encouragement and instruction. (وَقِنا) The wāw is a conjunction, and ق is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the weak letter, its fāʿil being a latent pronoun, the implied form being أنت, and the plural pronoun is the first object of ق. (عَذابَ النَّارِ) second object of ق. (أُولئِكَ) a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. (لَهُمْ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (نَصِيبٌ) a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the khabar of the demonstrative; the clause is resumptive, to explain the state of the second group, since the state of the first group was mentioned earlier in His saying «وما له في الآخرة من خلاق». (مِمَّا) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣifa of نصيب. (كَسَبُوا) a past verb with its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative ما. (وَاللَّهُ) The wāw is resumptive and الله is a mubtadaʾ. (سَرِيعُ الْحِسابِ) its khabar. The resumptive clause is brought to explain His, the Exalted's, power to reckon with all creatures in less than the twinkling of an eye.

* Rhetoric:
In one of the ways of parsing His saying «أشد ذكرا» there is an allusion to the rational trope, whose discussion has already preceded; we add to this trope some elaboration and say: Attributing the remembrance to the remembrance is impossible, but it is closely associated with it, so that it becomes as if it were a rational person, separate from it, performing it. Fine is the saying of Abū Tammām:
تكاد عطاياه يجنّ جنونها ... إذا لم يعوّذها بنغمة طالب
(His gifts almost go mad with madness, if he does not shield them with the plea of a petitioner.)
He attributed madness to its own verbal noun, and the secret in it is the intense association which we explained, which makes the non-rational rational because of its intense occurrence from it. Students are almost confused about the difference between it and the implicit metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya), though there is in it no intended resemblance. Abū Firās said:
سيذكرني قومي إذا جدّ جدهم ... وفي الليلة الظّلماء يفتقد البدر
(My people will remember me when their earnestness is earnest, and in the dark night the full moon is missed.)
Abū l-Ṭayyib has a short poem which came in the pattern of the rational trope, and it is among the fine poetry:
صحب الناس قبلنا ذا الزمانا ... وعناهم من أمره ما عنانا
وتولوا بغصّة كلّهم منه وإن سرّ بعضهم أحيانا ربما تحسن الصّنيع لياليه ولكن تكدّر الإحسانا
كلما أنبت الزمان قناة ... ركب المرء في القناة سنانا
(People kept company with this age before us, and what concerned us of its affairs concerned them. All of them departed from it with a lump in the throat, though it pleased some of them at times. Perhaps its nights do good, but they sully the good done. Whenever time grows a spear-shaft, a man fixes a spearhead on that shaft.)
[Translator's note: the second couplet is printed in the source as one run of text, without the usual division into hemistichs; it is rendered here as printed.]

* Benefits:
The prepositional من is added with the fāʿil, the mafʿūl bihi and the mubtadaʾ, on condition that it is preceded by a negation, prohibition or interrogative, and that the noun it governs is indefinite; in that case the addition is regular. More examples of it will come.

* Vocabulary:
(تُحْشَرُونَ): you are gathered. When the letters ḥāʾ and shīn occur as the first and second radicals of a word they indicate the meaning of gathering, filling and mustering; this is what we have investigated, and for it we mustered everything our hands could reach of the sources and lengthy reference works of the language. From it come الحشاش, i.e. the gatherer of grass or the buyer of hashish, which is a plant from which an intoxicating substance is extracted; and الحشمة, which is modesty, and it indicates that a person collects himself lest some slip escape him. From it also come الحشم, i.e. the servants gathered together.

* I'rab:
(وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ) The wāw is a conjunction; اذكروا is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and الله is mafʿūl bihi. (فِي أَيَّامٍ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اذكروا. (مَعْدُوداتٍ) ṣifa of أيام; these are the three days of al-tashrīq, which are three days after the Day of Sacrifice, which is the view of al-Shāfiʿī, or the Day of Sacrifice and two days after it, which is the view of Abū Ḥanīfa. (فَمَنْ) The fāʾ is resumptive and من is conditional, a mubtadaʾ. (تَعَجَّلَ) a past verb in the position of a jussive, the protasis. (فِي يَوْمَيْنِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تعجل. (فَلا إِثْمَ) The fāʾ is the connecting fāʾ; لا is the lā of generic negation, and إثم is its ism, indeclinable on fatḥa. (عَلَيْهِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of لا; the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of من. (وَمَنْ تَأَخَّرَ فَلا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ) its i'rab has preceded, and the clause is conjoined. (لِمَنِ اتَّقى) The lām is a preposition, من is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "that option"; the negation of sin for the one who hastens and the one who delays is for the one who has been pious. (وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ) The wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi. (وَاعْلَمُوا) conjoined to اتقوا. (أَنَّكُمْ) أنّ and its ism. (إِلَيْهِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تحشرون. (تُحْشَرُونَ) an imperfect verb with its fāʿil (deputy agent); the verbal clause is the khabar of أنّ; أنّ and what follows it are in the interpretation of a maṣdar standing in the place of the two objects of اعلموا.
[Translator's note: the source says "fāʿil" for the wāw of the passive verb «تُحْشَرُونَ»; it is rendered as written, with "(deputy agent)" added for clarity.]

* Lügat:
(أَلَدُّ الْخِصامِ): «الألدّ» sıfat-ı müşebbehedir. «اللدد» tartışmada şiddettir. «تركت فلانا يتلدّد» (falancayı etrafına bakınırken bıraktım), yani şaşkınlığından sağa sola dönüp bakıyor, hiçbir hâl üzere karar kılamıyor (demektir). Bu, birleşik bir tabloyu canlandıran hareketli bir kelimedir. «الخصام»:
«خاصم» fiilinin masdarıdır; bunu Halîl söylemiştir. Zeccâc ise «الخصام», «خصم»in çoğuludur demiştir; «صعب» ile «صعاب» ve «ضخم» ile «ضخام» gibi.

* İ'rab:
(وَمِنَ النَّاسِ): Vâv atıf harfidir; câr ve mecrûr öne alınmış mahzûf habere mütealliktir; cümle «فمن الناس…» cümlesine ma'tûftur. (مِنَ) [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta böyle harekelenmiştir; ayetteki kelime «مَنْ»dir.]: sonraya bırakılmış mübtedâ olan ism-i mevsûldür. (يُعْجِبُكَ قَوْلُهُ): muzâri fiil, öne alınmış mef'ûlün bih ve sonraya bırakılmış fâildir; cümle i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü mevsûlün sılasıdır. (فِي الْحَياةِ): câr ve mecrûr «قوله»ye veya «يعجبك»e mütealliktir. Birinciye göre söz dünya hayatında sâdır olmuş olur; ikinciye göre beğenme orada sâdır olmuş olur. (الدُّنْيا): «الحياة»nın sıfatıdır. (وَيُشْهِدُ): Vâv isti'nâfiyye veya atıf harfidir; «يشهد» muzâri fiildir, fâili takdiri «هو» olan müstetir zamirdir. (اللَّهَ): lafza-i celâl mef'ûlün bihtir. (عَلى ما): câr ve mecrûr «يشهد»e mütealliktir. (فِي قَلْبِهِ): câr ve mecrûr, mevsûlün sılası olan mahzûf bir şeye mütealliktir; yani sözün delâlet ettiği şeyden (kalbinde olan). (وَهُوَ): Vâv hâliyyedir; «هو» mübtedâdır. (أَلَدُّ الْخِصامِ): haberdir. (وَإِذا): Vâv atıf harfidir; «إذا» gelecek zaman için zarf olup cevaba mütealliktir. (تَوَلَّى): mâzî fiildir, fâili takdiri «هو» olan müstetir zamirdir; cümle izafet ile cer mahallindedir. (سَعى): mâzî fiildir, fâili takdiri «هو» olan müstetir zamirdir; cümle i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır. (فِي الْأَرْضِ): câr ve mecrûr «سعى»ya mütealliktir. (لِيُفْسِدَ فِيها): Lâm ta'lîl içindir; «يفسد» ta'lîl lâmından sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir; câr ve mecrûr «يفسد»e mütealliktir. (وَيُهْلِكَ الْحَرْثَ وَالنَّسْلَ): «ليفسد»e ma'tûftur. (وَاللَّهُ): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; «الله» mübtedâdır. (لا): nefy harfidir. (يُحِبُّ الْفَسادَ): muzâri fiildir; fâili takdiri «هو», yani Allah Teâlâ olan müstetir zamirdir; «الفساد» mef'ûlün bihtir. Fiil cümlesi «الله»nin haberi olarak ref' mahallindedir. (وَإِذا قِيلَ): Vâv, «يعجبك» sözüne atfeden atıf harfidir; istersen onu isti'nâfiyye de yapabilirsin. «إذا» gelecek zaman için zarftır; «قيل» cümlesi izafet ile cer mahallindedir. (لَهُ): câr ve mecrûr «قيل»e mütealliktir. (اتَّقِ اللَّهَ): «اتق» illet harfinin hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir, fâili takdiri «أنت» olan müstetir zamirdir; lafza-i celâl mef'ûlün bihtir; cümle mekûlü'l-kavldir. (أَخَذَتْهُ الْعِزَّةُ): mâzî fiil ve sâkin te'nîs tâsıdır; hâ mef'ûlün bih, «العزة» onun fâilidir; cümle i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır. (بِالْإِثْمِ): câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir, yani «(günahla) bitişik olarak»; bâ musâhabe (beraberlik) içindir.
Bunların «أخذته»ye müteallik olması da caizdir; bu durumda bâ sadece ta'diye (fiili geçişli kılma) için olur. (فَحَسْبُهُ جَهَنَّمُ): Fâ, fasîha fâsıdır; sanki onun akıbeti (sorusu)na cevap vermiştir. «حسبه» öne alınmış haber, «جهنم» sonraya bırakılmış mübtedâdır. (وَلَبِئْسَ الْمِهادُ): Vâv kasem vâvıdır, lâm kasemin cevabında gelen lâmdır, yani «والله» (Allah'a yemin olsun ki). «بئس» zem inşâsı için olan câmid mâzî fiildir; «المهاد» onun fâilidir; zemme mahsus olan (mahsûs bi'z-zem) mahzûftur, yani «هي» (o). Cümle kasemin cevabı olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.

* Vocabulary:
(أَلَدُّ الْخِصامِ): ألد is an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha), and اللدد is intensity of disputation. One says "I left so-and-so يتلدد", i.e. looking about to the right and left in his bewilderment, unable to settle in any state; it is thus a word in motion that depicts a composite image. الخصام is the maṣdar of خاصم, as al-Khalīl said; and al-Zajjāj said: الخصام is the plural of خصم, like صعب وصعاب and ضخم وضخام.

* I'rab:
(وَمِنَ النَّاسِ) The wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar; the clause is linked to the clause «فمن الناس» etc. (مِنَ) a relative noun, postponed mubtadaʾ. [Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; the word in the verse is «مَنْ».] (يُعْجِبُكَ قَوْلُهُ) an imperfect verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi and a postponed fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative. (فِي الْحَياةِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «قوله» or to «يعجبك»; on the first, the speech issues in this life; on the second, the admiration arises in it. (الدُّنْيا) ṣifa of الحياة. (وَيُشْهِدُ) The wāw is resumptive or a conjunction; يشهد is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, the implied form being هو. (اللَّهَ) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. (عَلى ما) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يشهد. (فِي قَلْبِهِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative, i.e. of what the speech signifies. (وَهُوَ) The wāw is circumstantial and هو is a mubtadaʾ. (أَلَدُّ الْخِصامِ) khabar. (وَإِذا) The wāw is a conjunction and إذا is an adverb for what is to come of time, attached to the apodosis. (تَوَلَّى) a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, the implied form being هو; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. (سَعى) a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, the implied form being هو; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional. (فِي الْأَرْضِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to سعى. (لِيُفْسِدَ فِيها) The lām is causal and يفسد is an imperfect verb accusative by an implied أن after the causal lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يفسد. (وَيُهْلِكَ الْحَرْثَ وَالنَّسْلَ) conjoined to «ليفسد». (وَاللَّهُ) The wāw is resumptive and الله is a mubtadaʾ. (لا) negative. (يُحِبُّ الْفَسادَ) an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, the implied form being هو, i.e. Allah the Exalted, and الفساد is mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of الله. (وَإِذا قِيلَ) The wāw is a conjunction to His saying «يعجبك», and you may make it resumptive; إذا is an adverb for what is to come of time, and the clause قيل is in the position of genitive by annexation. (لَهُ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قيل. (اتَّقِ اللَّهَ) اتق is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the weak letter, its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, the implied form being أنت, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). (أَخَذَتْهُ الْعِزَّةُ) a past verb with the quiescent feminine tāʾ, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and العزة is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional. (بِالْإِثْمِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "accompanied", the bāʾ being that of accompaniment.
It is also permissible that they be attached to «أخذته», in which case the bāʾ is merely for transitivity. (فَحَسْبُهُ جَهَنَّمُ) The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, as if he answered about his destiny; حسبه is a fronted khabar and جهنم a postponed mubtadaʾ. (وَلَبِئْسَ الْمِهادُ) The wāw is the wāw of oath, and the lām falls in the answer to the oath, i.e. "by Allah"; بئس is a past, non-conjugating verb to express blame, المهاد is its fāʿil, and the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e. "it"; the clause is the answer to an oath and has no grammatical position.

* Lügat:
(يَشْرِي): satar.
(السلم): teslim olmak (الاستسلام); sîn harfi kesre ve fetha ile okunur.
(كَافَّةً): الكفّ (alıkoyma) kökündendir; sanki onlardan birinin ayrı düşmesinden alıkonmuşlardır.

* İ'rab:
(وَمِنَ النَّاسِ): Vâv atıf harfidir; câr ve mecrûr öne alınmış mahzûf habere mütealliktir. (مِنَ) [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta böyle harekelenmiştir; ayetteki kelime «مَنْ»dir.]: sonraya bırakılmış mübtedâdır; cümle, kısımlarını tamamlamak için «فمن الناس» sözüne ma'tûftur. (يَشْرِي نَفْسَهُ): muzâri fiil, müstetir fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir; cümle mevsûlün sılasıdır. (ابْتِغاءَ مَرْضاتِ اللَّهِ): mef'ûlün lieclihtir; sonrası muzâfun ileyhtir. (وَاللَّهُ): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; «الله» mübtedâdır. (رَؤُفٌ): haberdir. (بِالْعِبادِ): câr ve mecrûr «رءوف»a mütealliktir. (يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا): benzerlerinin i'rabı geçti. (ادْخُلُوا): nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir; vâv fâildir. (فِي السِّلْمِ): câr ve mecrûr «ادخلوا»ya mütealliktir; cümle isti'nâfiyyedir. (كَافَّةً): «ادخلوا»daki vâvdan ve «السلم»den hâldir; çünkü o hem müzekker hem müennes olarak kullanılır. (وَلا): Vâv atıf harfidir; «لا» nehiy edatıdır. (تَتَّبِعُوا): «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiildir; cezm alâmeti nûnun hazfidir; vâv fâildir. (خُطُواتِ الشَّيْطانِ): mef'ûlün bih ve muzâfun ileyhtir. (إِنَّهُ): «إنّ» ve ismidir. (لَكُمْ): câr ve mecrûr «عدو»ya mütealliktir. (عَدُوٌّ): haberdir. (مُبِينٌ): sıfattır; cümle ta'lîliyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. (فَإِنْ زَلَلْتُمْ): Fâ isti'nâfiyyedir, «إن» şartiyyedir; «زللتم» mâzî fiil ve fâilidir ve fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir. (مِنْ بَعْدِ ما جاءَتْكُمُ الْبَيِّناتُ): câr ve mecrûr «زللتم»a mütealliktir; «ما» masdariyyedir, kendisinden sonraki fiille birlikte izafet ile cer mahallinde bir masdar olarak te'vil edilir; «جاءتكم البينات» fiil, mef'ûlün bih ve fâildir. (فَاعْلَمُوا): Fâ cevâbü'ş-şartı bağlayan fâdır; «اعلموا» nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir, vâv fâildir; cümle cevâbü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir. (أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ): «أنّ», ismi ve iki haberi, «اعلموا»nın iki mef'ûlünün yerini tutmuştur.

* Vocabulary:
(يَشْرِي): sells.
(السلم): submission (istislām); it is read with kasra or fatḥa on the sīn.
(كَافَّةً): from كفّ (restraining), as if they were restrained from any one of them straying.

* I'rab:
(وَمِنَ النَّاسِ) The wāw is a conjunction and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (مِنَ) [Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; the word in the verse is «مَنْ».] a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to His saying «فمن الناس» to complete their categories. (يَشْرِي نَفْسَهُ) an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila of the relative. (ابْتِغاءَ مَرْضاتِ اللَّهِ) mafʿūl li-ajlihi, and what follows it is muḍāf ilayhi. (وَاللَّهُ) The wāw is resumptive and الله is a mubtadaʾ. (رَؤُفٌ) khabar. (بِالْعِبادِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «رءوف». (يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا) the i'rab of its like has preceded. (ادْخُلُوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (فِي السِّلْمِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «ادخلوا»; the clause is resumptive. (كَافَّةً) a ḥāl from the wāw in «ادخلوا» and from «السلم», because it is used as masculine and feminine. (وَلا) The wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. (تَتَّبِعُوا) an imperfect verb jussive by لا, its jussive sign being the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (خُطُواتِ الشَّيْطانِ) mafʿūl bihi and muḍāf ilayhi. (إِنَّهُ) إنّ and its ism. (لَكُمْ) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «عدو». (عَدُوٌّ) khabar. (مُبِينٌ) ṣifa; the clause is causal and has no grammatical position. (فَإِنْ زَلَلْتُمْ) The fāʾ is resumptive, إن is conditional, and زللتم is a past verb with its fāʿil, in the position of a jussive as the protasis. (مِنْ بَعْدِ ما جاءَتْكُمُ الْبَيِّناتُ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «زللتم»; ما is maṣdar, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by annexation; جاءتكم البينات is verb, mafʿūl bihi and fāʿil. (فَاعْلَمُوا) The fāʾ is the connecting fāʾ of the apodosis; اعلموا is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis. (أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ) أنّ with its ism and its two khabars, standing in the place of the two objects of «اعلموا».

* Lügat:
(الظّلل): zâ'nın dammesiyle «ظلّة»nin çoğuludur; seni gölgeleyen her şeydir; «ظلّ»in çoğulu olan «ظلال» gibi.
(الْغَمامِ): ince, beyaz buluttur; rahmetin umulduğu yerdir; göğü örter ve rengini değiştirir. Gayn ve mîm'in şaşırtıcı özelliklerinden biri şudur: Kelimenin fâ'ül-fiili ve ayn'ül-fiili olarak geldiklerinde örtme, bir şeyi perdeleme ve gizleme anlamına delâlet ederler. «غمد السيف», yani kılıcı gizleyen kını bu kökendendir. «تغمّد الله فلانا برحمته», Allah falancayı rahmetiyle örttü demektir. «غمره الماء», su onu örttü demektir. «أرض غمقة», çiylerin kapladığı (nemli) toprak demektir. Ömer b. el-Hattâb'dan: «Ürdün nemli (غمقة) bir topraktır, Câbiye ise temiz havalı bir topraktır.» «غم الهلال» hilal gizlendi demektir. Bu da şaşırtıcı şeylerdendir.

* İ'rab:
(هَلْ): anlamı inkâr ve azarlama olan istifhâm harfidir. (يَنْظُرُونَ): merfû muzâri fiildir, vâv fâildir; anlamı «bekliyorlar»dır; ya da bakmak anlamındaki «النظر»den «ينظرون»dur. (إِلَّا): hasr edatıdır. (أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ): «أن» masdar ve nasb harfidir; o ve mâ ba'dı «ينظرون»un mef'ûlü olan bir masdar te'vilindedir. Cümle isti'nâfiyyedir; İslam'a girmekten geri duranları veya kayıp hata edenleri azarlamak için getirilmiştir. (اللَّهُ): «يأتيهم»in fâilidir. (فِي ظُلَلٍ): câr ve mecrûr «يأتيهم»e mütealliktir. (مِنَ الْغَمامِ): câr ve mecrûr «ظلل»in mahzûf sıfatına mütealliktir. (وَالْمَلائِكَةُ): Vâv atıf harfidir; «الملائكة» «الله»ye ma'tûftur. (وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ): «يأتيهم»e ma'tûftur ve beklemenin kapsamına dâhildir; istersen bunu isti'nâfiyye cümle de yapabilirsin. (وَإِلَى اللَّهِ): Vâv atıf harfidir; câr ve mecrûr «ترجع»e mütealliktir. (تُرْجَعُ): meçhul muzâri fiildir. (الْأُمُورُ): nâib-i fâildir. (سَلْ بَنِي إِسْرائِيلَ): «سل» sükûn üzere mebnî emir fiildir; fâili takdiri «أنت» olan müstetir zamirdir. «بني» mansûb mef'ûlün bihtir; nasb alâmeti yâdır, çünkü cem-i müzekker-i sâlime mülhaktır. «إسرائيل» muzâfun ileyhtir; cer alâmeti, gayr-i munsarif olduğu için kesreye niyâbeten fethadır. Cümle isti'nâfiyyedir. (كَمْ آتَيْناهُمْ): «كم», «آتيناهم»in ikinci mef'ûlün bihi olarak nasb mahallinde istifhâm ismidir. «آتيناهم» fiil, fâil ve birinci mef'ûlün bihtir. «آتيناهم» cümlesi «سل»in ikinci mef'ûlü yerindedir; çünkü (fiil) lafzen amelden alıkonmuş (mu'allak) olup anlamda amel etmektedir. «سل» kalp fiillerinden olmadığı hâlde ta'lîk edilmiştir (amelden alıkonmuştur), çünkü sormak bilginin sebebidir; bu hususta sebep, müsebbebin yerine konmuştur. Bazıları «كم»in haberiyye olmasını caiz görmüştür; bunda, içinde bulunduğu cümlenin (öncekinden) koparılması söz konusudur. (مِنْ آيَةٍ): istifhâmiyye «كم»in temyîzidir. Onunla temyîzi arasına (bir şey) girerse, «من»in getirilmesi daha güzeldir. «من» hakkında ihtilaf edilmiştir: Zâide olduğu söylenmiştir; el-Muğnî hâşiyelerinde ise beyâniyye olması ve temyîzin mahzûf olması tercih edilmiştir. «من آية» (bu durumda) fiile mütealliktir. Bu incelemenin devamı Fevâid bölümünde gelecektir. (بَيِّنَةٍ): sıfattır. «سل بني إسرائيل» cümlesi, Allah'ın nimetine nankörlük edip onu değiştiren İsrâiloğulları'nı kınamak için isti'nâfiyyedir. (وَمَنْ): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; cümle isti'nâfiyye olup azarlamayı artırmak ve onlara karşı hücceti ikame etmek için getirilmiştir. «من» ref' mahallinde mübtedâ olan şartiyyedir. (يُبَدِّلْ): fiilü'ş-şarttır. (نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ): mef'ûlün bihtir. (مِنْ بَعْدِ ما جاءَتْهُ): câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir. «ما» masdariyyedir; sonrasıyla birlikte izafet ile cer mahallinde bir masdar olarak te'vil edilir. «جاءته» mâzî fiil ve mef'ûlün bihtir; fâili takdiri «هي» olan müstetir zamirdir. (فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ): Fâ cevâbü'ş-şartı bağlayan fâdır; «إنّ» ve ismidir. (شَدِيدُ الْعِقابِ): onun haberidir. «إنّ» ve mâ ba'dından oluşan cümle, cezmeden şartın cevabı olarak cezm mahallindedir.

* Belâgat:
Allah Teâlâ'nın «في ظلل من الغمام» sözünde alâkası sebebiyyet olan mecâz-ı mürsel vardır; çünkü bulut, rahmetin veya azabın umulduğu yer ve ikisinin sebebidir. Yağmurlar ondan yağar; bazen (onunla) telef edici, süpürüp götürücü seller oluşur ve helâk edici yıldırımlar iner.

* Fevâid:
İbn Hişâm bu ayetin i'rabında bir bölüm serdetmiştir; önemi sebebiyle onu aşağıda özetliyoruz [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «فلخصه فيهما يلي» yazılıdır; «فنلخصه فيما يلي» olarak anlaşılmıştır.]:
«Allah Teâlâ'nın «سل بني إسرائيل كم آتيناهم من آية» sözü: «من»i zâide takdir edersen «كم» mübtedâ olur veya kendisinden sonra takdir edilen bir «آتينا»nın mef'ûlü olur. Eğer onu, «ما ننسخ من آية»deki «ما»nın beyânı olduğu gibi «كم»in beyânı olarak takdir edersen, bu iki vecihten hiçbiri caiz olmaz; çünkü bu durumda «كم»e dönen bir zamir yoktur. (O hâlde) o, ancak öne alınmış ikinci mef'ûldür; «أعشرين درهما أعطيتك» (Sana yirmi dirhem mi verdim?) gibi.» Zemahşerî «كم»in haberiyye olmasını caiz görmüştür; yani daha önce geçenlerin hepsi «كم»in istifhâm ismi olması esasına dayanır, bu ise onun karşılığıdır. Sonra (İbn Hişâm) şöyle demiştir: «Nahivciler haberiyye «كم»in âmili amelden alıkoyduğunu (ta'lîk ettiğini) zikretmemişlerdir. Bazıları «من»in zâide olmasını caiz görmüştür; hâlbuki o ancak istifhâmdan sonra, özellikle «هل» ile (olan istifhâmdan sonra) zâide olur. Onun bunu caiz görmesi, sözün olumsuz (gayr-i mûcib) olmasını mutlak olarak şart koşmayanların görüşüne, yahut bunu temyîz babı dışında şart koşan ve «رطل من زيت» (bir ratl zeytinyağı) ve «خاتم من حديد» (demirden bir yüzük) sözlerinde («من»in) zâide olduğunu, müsbet (isbât edici) olmadığını kabul edenlerin görüşüne dayanıyor olabilir.» [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «مثبتة» yazılıdır; muhtemelen «مبيّنة» (beyân edici) kastedilmiştir.] Son.
Bu arada «كم» iki kısım üzere gelir: istifhâmiyye ve haberiyye. Bunların incelemelerinden birçoğu bu kitapta gelecektir.

* Vocabulary:
(الظّلل): plural of ظلّة (with ḍamma on the ẓāʾ), which is anything that shades you, like ظلال, plural of ظلّ.
(الْغَمامِ): the white, thin cloud, which is a place where mercy is expected; it covers the sky and changes its colour. Among the wonders of the letters ghayn and mīm is that when they occur as the first and second radicals of a word they indicate the meaning of covering, veiling a thing and hiding it. From it come غمد السيف, the scabbard of the sword which hides it; تغمّد الله فلانا برحمته, i.e. He covered him; غمره الماء, i.e. the water covered him; أرض غمقة, land which the dews flood; and on the authority of ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb: "The Jordan is a غمقة land and al-Jābiya is a pleasant land"; and غم الهلال, the crescent was hidden. This is among the wonders.

* I'rab:
(هَلْ) an interrogative particle whose meaning is denial and rebuke. (يَنْظُرُونَ) an imperfect verb in the nominative and the wāw is the fāʿil; its meaning is "they wait", or "they look", from النظر. (إِلَّا) a particle of restriction. (أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ) أن is a particle of maṣdar and of accusative; it and what is within its scope are in the interpretation of a maṣdar, the object of «ينظرون»; the clause is resumptive, brought to rebuke those who hold back from Islam, or those who slip and err. (اللَّهُ) fāʿil of «يأتيهم». (فِي ظُلَلٍ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يأتيهم». (مِنَ الْغَمامِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣifa of «ظلل». (وَالْمَلائِكَةُ) The wāw is a conjunction and الملائكة is conjoined to الله. (وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ) conjoined to «يأتيهم», entering within the scope of the waiting; you may also make it a resumptive clause. (وَإِلَى اللَّهِ) The wāw is a conjunction and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «ترجع». (تُرْجَعُ) an imperfect passive verb. (الْأُمُورُ) nāʾib fāʿil. (سَلْ بَنِي إِسْرائِيلَ) سل is an imperative verb, indeclinable on sukūn, its fāʿil a latent pronoun, the implied form being أنت; بني is mafʿūl bihi in the accusative, its accusative sign being the yāʾ because it is annexed to the sound masculine plural, and إسرائيل is muḍāf ilayhi, its genitive sign being the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote; the clause is resumptive. (كَمْ آتَيْناهُمْ) كم is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of «آتيناهم»; آتيناهم is verb, fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi; the clause «آتيناهم» stands in the place of the second object of «سل», because it is suspended from operating (muʿallaqa) while operating in meaning. «سل» was suspended although it is not among the verbs of the heart because asking is the cause of knowing, so the cause was treated like the effect in that. Some permitted that كم be declarative (khabariyya), which would cut off the clause in which it occurs. (مِنْ آيَةٍ) the tamyīz of the interrogative كم; when the two are separated, it is better to bring من. There is disagreement about من: it is said to be redundant, and in the marginal notes to al-Mughnī they preferred it to be explicative (bayāniyya) with the tamyīz omitted. «من آية»: both attached to the verb. More of this discussion will come in the Benefits. (بَيِّنَةٍ) ṣifa; the clause «سل بني إسرائيل» is resumptive, to denounce the Children of Israel who disbelieve in the favour of Allah and change it. (وَمَنْ) The wāw is resumptive; the clause is resumptive, brought to add reproach and establish the argument against them; من is conditional, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (يُبَدِّلْ) the protasis. (نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ) mafʿūl bihi. (مِنْ بَعْدِ ما جاءَتْهُ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl; ما is maṣdar, interpreted with what follows as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by annexation; جاءته is a past verb with a mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, the implied form being هي. (فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ) The fāʾ is the connecting fāʾ of the apodosis, and إنّ with its ism. (شَدِيدُ الْعِقابِ) its khabar; the clause of إنّ and what follows is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of the jussive conditional.

* Rhetoric:
In the saying of the Exalted «في ظلل من الغمام» there is a mujāz mursal (non-metaphorical trope) whose relation is causality, because the cloud is a place where mercy or punishment is expected and their cause: from it the rains pour down, and from it may arise destructive, sweeping torrents, and destroying thunderbolts descend.

* Benefits:
Ibn Hishām gave a section on the parsing of this verse, which we summarise as follows because of its importance:
"His saying, the Exalted: «سل بني إسرائيل كم آتيناهم من آية»: If you take «من» as redundant, then «كم» is a mubtadaʾ, or the object of an implied «آتينا» after it. If you take it as explicative of «كم», as it is explicative of «ما» in «ما ننسخ من آية», neither of the two views is permissible, because there would then be no referent returning to «كم»; rather it is a fronted second object, like «أعشرين درهما أعطيتك». Al-Zamakhsharī permitted that «كم» be declarative (khabariyya). [Translator's note: the source text, which appears garbled here, reads: "i.e. that all that preceded was based on «كم» being an interrogative noun; and this is its opposite".] Then he said: "The grammarians did not mention that declarative «كم» suspends the operator from operating. Some permitted «من» to be redundant, but it is only added after interrogation with «هل» specifically; perhaps his permitting that is according to the view of one who does not require the sentence to be non-affirmative in every case, or according to one who requires that outside the chapter of tamyīz, and holds that in «رطل من زيت» and «خاتم من حديد» it is redundant and not affirmative." [Translator's note: the source has «مثبتة» ("affirmative"), probably for «مبيّنة» ("explicative").] End."
Now, كم comes in two kinds: interrogative and declarative, and much of the discussion of them will come in this book.

* I'rab:
(زُيِّنَ) a past passive verb. (لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «زين», and the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila of the relative and has no grammatical position. (الْحَياةُ) nāʾib fāʿil. (الدُّنْيا) ṣifa of الحياة; the clause is resumptive, brought to denounce those who made this world and its enchanting pleasures their goal in it. (وَيَسْخَرُونَ) conjoined to the clause «زين»; it is also possible that it is a khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "and they mock", in which case it would be the conjoining of a nominal clause to a verbal one, to indicate that He brought the first as a verbal clause to indicate renewal and occurrence. (مِنَ الَّذِينَ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يسخرون». (آمَنُوا) verb and fāʿil; the verbal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of «الذين». (وَالَّذِينَ) The wāw is a conjunction and «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ. (اتَّقَوْا) the clause is the ṣila of the relative. (فَوْقَهُمْ) an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar of «الذين». (يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ) attached to what the adverb is attached to. (وَاللَّهُ) The wāw is resumptive and الله is a mubtadaʾ. (يَرْزُقُ) an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, referring to Allah, the Name of Majesty; the clause is the khabar of the Name of Majesty الله. (مِنَ) [Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; the word in the verse is «مَنْ».] a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. (يَشاءُ) an imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila of من. (بِغَيْرِ حِسابٍ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يرزق».

* Rhetoric:
In this verse there is a contrast between the clauses: the adornment of the life of this world in the eyes of those who disbelieved, and their mockery of the believers, are expressed with verbal clauses, to indicate occurrence, and that it is a passing matter that does not remain long before it disappears through numerous diverting causes.
As for the superiority of those who were pious over them, it is a matter of lasting permanence upon which no change comes.

* I'rab:
(كانَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً) كان with its ism and khabar. (واحِدَةً) ṣifa. (فَبَعَثَ) The fāʾ is a conjunction to an implied clause, omitted for brevity and concision, i.e. "the people were agreed upon the truth, then they differed, so He sent". The speech is resumptive, brought to indicate how the prevailing disagreement among people arose, and the deviation that led to their division, as indicated by what follows. بعث is a past verb. (اللَّهُ) fāʿil. (النَّبِيِّينَ) mafʿūl bihi. (مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ) two ḥāls, the second conjoined to the first. (وَأَنْزَلَ) conjoined to «فبعث». (مَعَهُمُ) an adverb of time attached to an omitted ḥāl from «الكتاب», i.e. "and He sent down the Book accompanying them at the time of sending down". (الْكِتابَ) mafʿūl bihi. (بِالْحَقِّ) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «أنزل», the bāʾ being that of association, i.e. He sent it down a sending down accompanied by the truth. (لِيَحْكُمَ) The lām is causal and يحكم is an imperfect verb accusative by an implied أن after the causal lām; the causal lām and its interpreted genitive noun are also attached to «أنزل». (بَيْنَ النَّاسِ) the adverb of place is attached to «يحكم», and الناس is muḍāf ilayhi. (فِيمَا) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يحكم». (اخْتَلَفُوا) verb and fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative «ما». (فِيهِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اختلفوا». (وَمَا) The wāw is a conjunction and ما is negative. (اخْتَلَفَ) a past verb. (فِيهِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اختلف». (إِلَّا) a particle of restriction. (الَّذِينَ) fāʿil of «اختلف». (أُوتُوهُ) a past passive verb; the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil, which is the first object, and the hāʾ is the second mafʿūl bihi. (مِنْ بَعْدِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اختلف». (مَا) maṣdar, interpreted with what follows as a maṣdar, muḍāf ilayhi, i.e. after the coming of the clear proofs. (جاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّناتُ) verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and البينات a postponed fāʿil. (بَغْياً) mafʿūl li-ajlihi, i.e. out of envy on their part; it is also said to be an interpreted ḥāl, which is not far-fetched. (بَيْنَهُمْ) the adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣifa of «بغيا». (فَهَدَى اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا) The fāʾ is a conjunction; هدى is a past verb, الله is fāʿil, and الذين with its ṣila is mafʿūl bihi. (لِمَا) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «هدى», and ما is relative. (اخْتَلَفُوا) verb and fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما. (فِيهِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اختلفوا». (مِنَ الْحَقِّ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl from «ما». (بِإِذْنِهِ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl from «الذين آمنوا», i.e. "permitted to them", so it is a ḥāl from the mafʿūl bihi. (وَاللَّهُ) The wāw is resumptive and الله is a mubtadaʾ. (يَهْدِي) an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, the implied form being هو, referring to Allah the Exalted; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of الله. (مِنْ) [Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; the word in the verse is «مَنْ».] a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. (يَشاءُ) the clause is the ṣila of the relative and has no grammatical position. (إِلى صِراطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يهدي», and «مستقيم» is a ṣifa.

* Rhetoric:
In this noble verse there is the figure of inversion (qalb), which is common in their speech. Al-Sakkākī, al-Zamakhsharī and al-Jawharī gave as an example the saying of the Exalted: «ويوم يعرض الذين كفروا على النار», whose original is: "and on the day the Fire is presented to those who disbelieved". They also exemplified it in poetry with the saying of ʿUrwa ibn al-Ward:
فديت بنفسه نفسي وما لي ... وما آلوك إلا ما أطيق
(I ransomed his soul with my soul and my wealth, and I spare you nothing but what I am unable to do.)
The original is "I ransomed his soul with my soul": the one ransomed is the soul of the beloved and the one ransomed with is the poet's own soul, not the reverse as the apparent sense of the verse suggests. And with the saying of al-Mutanabbī:
وعذلت أهل العشق حتى ذقته ... فعجبت كيف يموت من لا يعشق
(I used to blame the people of love until I tasted it, and I wondered how one who does not love can die.)
for its original is "how does one who loves not die", and the correct view is the opposite: that what is meant is that he came to see that there is no cause of death other than love. On the verse which we have in hand Abū Jaʿfar al-Ṭabarī said: "The meaning of that is only: Allah guided those who believed to the truth in that of the Book of Allah about which those who were given it differed, and Allah, blessed and exalted, addressed them only in the idiom of the Arabs." And Abū Jaʿfar exemplified it with the saying of al-Nābigha al-Jaʿdī:
كانت فريضة ما تقول كما ... كان الزّناء فريضة الرجم
(What you say was an obligation, as adultery was the obligation of stoning.)
whereas in fact stoning is the obligation of adultery.

* Lügat:
(زُلْزِلُوا): Başlarına gelen dehşet ve korku sebebiyle, depreme benzer şiddetli bir sarsıntıyla sarsıldılar. Zâ ve lâmın tekrarı, sarsıntının defalarca tekrarlandığını sezdirir. İbn Cinnî el-Hasâis kitabında bu babı ima etmiş ve ona «anlamın kuvveti için lafzın kuvveti» adını vermiştir; İbnü'l-Esîr de el-Meselü's-sâir kitabında bunu zikretmiştir.
İkisinin tespit ettiklerinin özeti şudur: Lafız bir vezin üzere iken ondan daha fazla (harfli) başka bir vezne nakledilirse, mutlaka önceki taşıdığından daha fazla anlam taşır. Nitekim «اخشوشن», sertlikte «خشن»den daha fazla artışa delâlet eder; «اعذوذب الماء» (su iyice tatlılaştı) da tatlılıkta «عذب»den daha fazla artışa delâlet eder. Bu kitapta bunun birçok örneği gelecektir.
(حَسِبْتُمْ): «حسبت زيدا قائما أحسبه», «تعب» babındandır; yani bütün Arapların lehçesinde mâzîde sîn'in kesresi, muzâride fethası iledir; yalnız Kinâneoğulları müstesnadır; onlar mâzînin sîn'i kesreli iken kıyasa aykırı olarak muzârinin sîn'ini de kesreli okurlar. (Masdarı) kesre ile «حسبانا»dır; anlamı «onu zannettim»dir. «حسبت المال حسبا» ise «قتل» babındandır, yani mâzîde sîn'in fethası, muzâride dammesiyledir; anlamı «onu sayarak tespit ettim»dir; masdarda da öyledir ve damme ile «حسبانا» da vardır.

* İ'rab:
(أَمْ): «بل» ile takdir edilen munkatıa atıf harfidir; istifhâm hemzesi mahzûftur. Anlam: «بل أحسبتم» (Yoksa … mı sandınız?). İstifhâm azarlama ve inkâr içindir. (حَسِبْتُمْ): fiil ve fâildir. (أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا): «أن» masdar ve nasb harfidir; «تدخلوا» «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir; nasb alâmeti nûnun hazfidir; vâv fâildir. (الْجَنَّةَ): tevessü' yoluyla mef'ûlün bihtir. «أن» ve mâ ba'dı, «حسبتم»ün iki mef'ûlünün yerini tutan bir masdar te'vilindedir. (وَلَمَّا): Vâv hâliyyedir; «لما» cezmeden nefy harfidir. (يَأْتِكُمْ): «لما» ile meczûm muzâri fiildir; cezm alâmeti illet harfinin hazfidir; kâf «يأتكم»in mef'ûlüdür. (مَثَلُ): «يأتكم»in fâilidir. (الَّذِينَ): muzâfun ileyhtir. (خَلَوْا): fiil ve fâildir; cümle i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü «الذين»in sılasıdır. (مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ): câr ve mecrûr «خلوا»ya mütealliktir. (مَسَّتْهُمُ): «مسّ» mâzî fiildir; tâ, sâkin te'nîs tâsıdır; hâ mef'ûlün bihtir. (الْبَأْساءُ): fâildir. (وَالضَّرَّاءُ): «البأساء»ya ma'tûftur. Cümle isti'nâfiyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; sanki biri «O misal nasıldı, mahiyeti nedir?» demiş de «مستهم البأساء» (onlara darlık dokundu) denmiştir. İstersen onu tefsîriyye de yapabilirsin; her hâlükârda i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. (وَزُلْزِلُوا): Vâv atıf harfidir; «زلزلوا» meçhul mâzî fiildir, vâv nâib-i fâildir; cümle «مستهم»e ma'tûftur. (حَتَّى يَقُولَ الرَّسُولُ): «حتى» gâye ve cer harfidir; «يقول» «حتى»dan sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir; «الرسول» fâildir. (وَالَّذِينَ): «الرسول»e ma'tûftur. (آمَنُوا): cümle i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü «الذين»in sılasıdır. (مَعَهُ): mekân zarfı «آمنوا»ya mütealliktir. (مَتى نَصْرُ اللَّهِ): «متى», zaman zarfı olarak nasb mahallinde istifhâm ismidir; zarf, öne alınmış mahzûf habere mütealliktir; «نصر الله» sonraya bırakılmış mübtedâdır; cümle mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir. (أَلا): istiftâh ve tenbîh edatıdır. (إِنَّ نَصْرَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ): «إنّ», ismi ve haberidir; cümle isti'nâfiyyedir.

* Vocabulary:
(زُلْزِلُوا): they were shaken violently, in a manner resembling an earthquake (zalzala), by the terror and fright that befell them.
