The repetition of the zāy and the lām gives the sense of repeated shaking, time after time. Ibn Jinnī alluded to this chapter in the book al-Khaṣāʾiṣ and called it "the strength of the word for the strength of the meaning", as Ibn al-Athīr mentioned in the book al-Mathal al-Sāʾir. The sum of what the two established is that when a word is on a pattern and is then moved to another, longer pattern, it must contain more meaning than it did before: اخشوشن indicates more roughness than خشن, and اعذوذب الماء indicates more sweetness than عذب. Many examples will come in this book.
(حَسِبْتُمْ): حسبت زيدا قائما أحسبه is of the pattern تعب, that is, with kasra on the sīn in the past and fatḥa in the imperfect, in the language of all the Arabs except Banū Kināna, who put kasra on the sīn of the imperfect also, together with kasra on the sīn of the past, contrary to analogy; حِسْبانا with kasra, meaning "I thought him". And حسبت المال حسبا is of the pattern قتل, that is, with fatḥa on the sīn in the past and ḍamma in the imperfect: I counted it up; likewise in the maṣdar, and حُسْبانا with ḍamma.

* I'rab:
(أَمْ) a disconnected conjunction (munqaṭiʿa) taken as بل, with the interrogative hamza omitted; the meaning is "rather, did you think", and the interrogation is for rebuke and denial. (حَسِبْتُمْ) verb and fāʿil. (أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا) أن is a particle of maṣdar and accusative, and تدخلوا is an imperfect verb accusative by أن, its accusative sign being the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الْجَنَّةَ) mafʿūl bihi by extension; أن and what follows are in the interpretation of a maṣdar standing in the place of the two objects of «حسبتم». (وَلَمَّا) The wāw is circumstantial and لما is a particle of negation and jussive. (يَأْتِكُمْ) an imperfect verb jussive by لما, its jussive sign being the omission of the weak letter, and the kāf is the mafʿūl of «يأتكم». (مَثَلُ) fāʿil of «يأتكم». (الَّذِينَ) muḍāf ilayhi. (خَلَوْا) verb and fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of «الذين». (مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خلوا». (مَسَّتْهُمُ) مسّ is a past verb, the tāʾ is the quiescent feminine tāʾ, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. (الْبَأْساءُ) fāʿil. (وَالضَّرَّاءُ) conjoined to «البأساء»; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position, as if someone had said: "How was that example, and what is its nature?" and it was said: "Adversity and hardship touched them"; you may also make it explicative; in any case it has no grammatical position. (وَزُلْزِلُوا) The wāw is a conjunction and زلزلوا is a past passive verb, the wāw being nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to «مستهم». (حَتَّى يَقُولَ الرَّسُولُ) حتى is a particle of limit and genitive, يقول is an imperfect verb accusative by an implied أن after حتى, and الرسول is fāʿil. (وَالَّذِينَ) conjoined to الرسول. (آمَنُوا) the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of «الذين». (مَعَهُ) the adverb of place attached to «آمنوا». (مَتى نَصْرُ اللَّهِ) متى is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of time, the adverb attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and نصر الله is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of accusative as the content of the saying. (أَلا) a particle of opening and alerting. (إِنَّ نَصْرَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ) إنّ with its ism and khabar; the clause is resumptive.

* I'rab:
(يَسْئَلُونَكَ) an imperfect verb in the nominative, its nominative sign being the retention of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. (ماذا) What has been said about «ماذا» has preceded, so we may parse it as an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of «ينفقون»; and it is permissible to parse ما as an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ and ذا as a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar, the clause being in the position of accusative as a fronted object of «ينفقون». The clause «يسألونك» is resumptive, brought to ask about the money spent and where it is to be spent.
They said: The questioner was ʿAmr ibn al-Jamūḥ, an old man possessed of wealth, who asked the Prophet ﷺ: What should he spend, and on whom should he spend? All this concerns voluntary charity. (يُنْفِقُونَ) an imperfect verb in the nominative, its nominative sign being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the second object of «يسألونك». (قُلْ) an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, brought to give the answer to the question. (ما أَنْفَقْتُمْ) ما is conditional, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of «أنفقتم», and «أنفقتم» is a verb in the position of a jussive, the protasis, with its fāʿil; the clause is the content of the saying. (مِنْ خَيْرٍ) the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. (فَلِلْوالِدَيْنِ) The fāʾ is the connecting fāʾ of the apodosis, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "so it is for the parents"; the nominal clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis. (وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ وَالْيَتامى وَالْمَساكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ) all conjoined to الوالدين. (وَما تَفْعَلُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِهِ عَلِيمٌ) its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse.

* Benefits:
A general rule for parsing the conditional particles من، ما، مهما: if the protasis verb requires a direct object, they are accusative in position as mafʿūl bihi; if it is intransitive, or transitive and has already received its object, they are nominative in position as mubtadaʾ.
حيثما is in the position of accusative as an adverb of place. [Translator's note: the source text here reads حيثما ... ظرف زمان (adverb of time); it is rendered as written, though حيثما is ordinarily an adverb of place.]
متى، أيان، أين، أنى are in the position of accusative as adverbs of time. [Translator's note: as printed; أين and أنى are ordinarily adverbs of place.]
كيفما is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of the protasis.
أي depends on what it is annexed to.

* İ'rab:
(كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتالُ): «كتب» meçhul fiildir; «عليكم» «كتب»e mütealliktir; «القتال» nâib-i fâildir. Cümle isti'nâfiyye olup savaşın meşruiyetini açıklamak için getirilmiştir. «كتب»in anlamı «farz kılındı»dır. Bu farz, düşman ülkeye girdiğinde farz-ı ayndır; düşman kendi beldelerinde ise farz-ı kifâyedir. (وَهُوَ): Vâv hâliyyedir; «هو» mübtedâdır. (كُرْهٌ): haberdir. (لَكُمْ): câr ve mecrûr «كره»e mütealliktir. Hâl vâvından sonra gelen isim cümlesi hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir. (وَعَسى): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; «عسى» ümit (tereccî) inşâsı için câmid mâzî fiildir; burada tâmmedir. Bu, «عسى», «اخلولق» ve «أوشك» fiillerinden sonra «أن» geldiğinde kıyâsîdir. (أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا): «أن» ve mâ ba'dı «عسى»nın fâili olan bir masdar te'vilindedir. (شَيْئاً): mef'ûlün bihtir. (وَهُوَ): Vâv hâliyyedir; «هو» mübtedâdır. (خَيْرٌ): haberdir. (لَكُمْ): câr ve mecrûr «خير»e mütealliktir. Vâvdan sonraki isim cümlesi hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir. Burada bir müşkil var ki onu Fevâid bölümünde ele alacağız. (وَعَسى أَنْ تُحِبُّوا شَيْئاً وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَكُمْ): i'rabı geçti. (وَاللَّهُ): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; «الله» mübtedâdır. (يَعْلَمُ): muzâri fiil ve müstetir fâildir; cümle mübtedânın haberidir. (وَأَنْتُمْ): Vâv atıf harfidir; «أنتم» mübtedâdır. (لا تَعْلَمُونَ): «لا» nefy harfidir; «تعلمون» muzâri fiildir, vâv fâildir; cümle «أنتم»ün haberidir.

* Belâgat:
Ayette sevgi ile nefret arasında ve «كره» ile «شرّ» arasında tıbâk vardır [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta böyledir; kastedilen muhtemelen «خير» ile «شرّ»dir.]; bu durumda buna mukâbele denir; incelemesi daha önce geçti.

* Fevâid:
Ayette, nekreden hâlin, bilinen şartlarından hiçbiri bulunmaksızın gelmesi müşkil görülür. Bu yüzden bazı i'rabcılar, «وهو خير لكم» cümlesini «شيئا»nın sıfatı olarak i'rab etmeye meyletmişlerdir. Sıfat olan cümleye vâvın girmesi, onun şeklinin hâl şeklinde olmasındandır; vâv ona hâl olduğunda nasıl giriyorsa, sıfat olduğunda da girer. Zemahşerî bunu Allah Teâlâ'nın «وما أهلكنا من قرية إلا ولها كتاب معلوم» sözünde caiz görmüştür; yerinde gelecektir.

* I'rab:
(كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتالُ) كتب is a passive verb, عليكم is attached to «كتب», and القتال is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, brought to explain the legitimacy of fighting. The meaning of «كتب» is "was made obligatory", and the obligation is either individual (ʿayn) when the enemy enters the land, or collective (kifāya) when the enemy is in his own land. (وَهُوَ) The wāw is circumstantial and هو is a mubtadaʾ. (كُرْهٌ) khabar. (لَكُمْ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «كره»; the nominal clause after the circumstantial wāw is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. (وَعَسى) The wāw is resumptive and عسى is a past, non-conjugating verb to express hope; here it is complete (tāmma), and that is regular with عسى, اخلولق and أوشك when أن follows them. (أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا) أن and what is within its scope are in the interpretation of a maṣdar, the fāʿil of «عسى». (شَيْئاً) mafʿūl bihi. (وَهُوَ) The wāw is circumstantial and هو is a mubtadaʾ. (خَيْرٌ) khabar. (لَكُمْ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خير»; the nominal clause after the wāw is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. Here there is a difficulty, which we take up in the chapter of Benefits. (وَعَسى أَنْ تُحِبُّوا شَيْئاً وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَكُمْ) its i'rab has preceded. (وَاللَّهُ) The wāw is resumptive and الله is a mubtadaʾ. (يَعْلَمُ) an imperfect verb with a latent fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. (وَأَنْتُمْ) The wāw is a conjunction and أنتم is a mubtadaʾ. (لا تَعْلَمُونَ) لا is negative and «تعلمون» is an imperfect verb, the wāw being the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «أنتم».

* Rhetoric:
In the verse there is antithesis (ṭibāq) between loving and disliking, and between «كره» and «شرّ» [Translator's note: so in the source; probably «خير» and «شرّ» is meant], which is then called contrast (muqābala); its discussion has preceded.

* Benefits:
In the verse the coming of a ḥāl from an indefinite noun, without any of its well-known conditions, is troublesome. For this reason some who parse leaned towards parsing the clause «وهو خير لكم» as a ṣifa of «شيئا». The wāw entered the clause which falls as a ṣifa only because its form is the form of a ḥāl; so, as the wāw enters it as a circumstantial, it enters it as an adjective. That is what al-Zamakhsharī permitted in the saying of the Exalted: «وما أهلكنا من قرية إلا ولها كتاب معلوم», and it will come in its place.

* Vocabulary:
(حَاجَّ): he overcame his opponent by means of the argument. Among their expressions: "There was between them muḥājja and mulājja" (disputation and wrangling).
(خاوِيَةٌ): fallen, or empty of its people.
(يَتَسَنَّهْ): the hāʾ is either part of the root or a hāʾ of pause (hāʾ al-sakt). That is, the year did not pass over it, whereas a thing ordinarily changes with the passing of time. So the lām of "sana" (year) is either a wāw or a hāʾ. It was also said: its origin is "yatasannan", from "al-ḥamaʾ al-masnūn" (aged black mud). A full discussion of this word will come in the I'rab.
(نُنْشِزُها): we move them and raise some of them onto others for assembly.

* I'rab:
(أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِي حَاجَّ إِبْراهِيمَ فِي رَبِّهِ): a resumptive clause, brought to express wonder at the story of one of the tyrants; the address is to the Prophet ﷺ, but the intended meaning is general. The hamza is for the interrogative of wonder; «لم» is a particle of negation, reversal (of tense) and jussive; «تر» is an imperfect verb, jussive through «لم», its sign of jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and its agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you". «إلى الذي» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «تر»; a muḍāf must necessarily be omitted, i.e. "to the story of the one who disputed". «حاجّ» is a past verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; «إبراهيم» is its direct object; «في ربّه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «حاجّ».
(أَنْ آتاهُ اللَّهُ الْمُلْكَ): «أن» is a particle of maṣdar and accusative; «آتاه» is a past verb in the position of the accusative through «أن», and the hāʾ is the direct object. The maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb after it is in the accusative position as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), with an implied lām, because one of the conditions of the mafʿūl li-ajlihi is missing, namely sameness of agent; and dropping the lām before «أن» and «أنّ» is regular. The meaning is: he went forward to dispute with Abraham and to quarrel with him out of arrogance and insolence, whereas it would have been more fitting for him to give thanks for the blessing and to be humble when raised up. This is preferable to making it an adverbial of time meaning "the time of the giving of the blessing". [Translator's note: the source reads «من جملة ظرفا»; «من جعله ظرفا» (than making it an adverbial) is meant.] Maṣdars may indeed occur as adverbials, as in "khufūq al-najm" (the setting of the star) and "miqdam al-ḥājj" (the arrival of the pilgrim).
(إِذْ قالَ إِبْراهِيمُ): «إذ» is an adverbial for past time, attached to «حاجّ». Al-Zamakhsharī and al-Jalāl allowed it to be a badal (substitute) for «أن آتاه» if the latter is taken to mean "time"; but the grammarians have stated explicitly that nothing takes the place of an adverbial of time except a maṣdar expressed in its own wording, so it is not permissible to say "ajīʾu an yaṣīḥa al-dīk" (I will come when the rooster crows) nor "jiʾtu an ṣāḥa al-dīk" (I came when the rooster crowed). «قال إبراهيم» is a verb and agent, and the clause is in the genitive position by annexation.
(رَبِّيَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ): «ربي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «الذي» is its khabar (predicate); the clause «يحيي» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no position; «يميت» is conjoined to «يحيي»; the clause «ربي…» etc. is the content of the saying.
(قالَ أَنَا أُحْيِي وَأُمِيتُ): the clause is resumptive. «قال» is a past verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; «أنا» is a mubtadaʾ; «أحيي» is an imperfect verb whose agent is latent, its implied form being "I", and the clause is the khabar of «أنا»; the clause «أنا أحيي» is a nominal clause in the accusative position as the content of the saying; «أميت» is conjoined to «أحيي».
(قالَ إِبْراهِيمُ): a verb and agent, and the clause is resumptive, brought to move from one argument to a clearer one.
(فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْتِي بِالشَّمْسِ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ): the fāʾ is the "eloquent" fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), which occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are able, as you falsely and presumptuously claim, then Allah brings the sun from the east…". «إن» and its noun; the clause «يأتي» is its khabar; the clause after the fāʾ has no position because it is the apodosis of an implied non-jussive condition. The preposition and genitive noun «بالشمس» are attached to «يأتي», and «من المشرق» is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to «يأتي».
(فَأْتِ بِها مِنَ الْمَغْرِبِ): the eloquent fāʾ is repeated for emphasis and as a prelude to the argument. «أت» is an imperative verb, indeclinable through the dropping of the weak letter, and the agent is "you"; «بها» is attached to «أت»; «من المغرب» is attached to it as well.
(فَبُهِتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ): the fāʾ is a conjunction. «بهت» is among the verbs that have come only in the passive; «الذي» is the nāʾib fāʾil (deputy agent) in terms of wording, and it may be an agent in terms of meaning, which is perhaps preferable. «كفر» is a past verb with a latent agent, and the clause is the ṣila of «الذي».
(وَاللَّهُ لا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ): the wāw is resumptive; «الله» is a mubtadaʾ and the clause «لا يهدي» is its khabar; «القوم» is a direct object; «الظالمين» is an adjective.
(أَوْ كَالَّذِي مَرَّ عَلى قَرْيَةٍ): the sense of the speech is: "or have you seen the like of the one who…". So «أو» is a conjunction and the kāf is a noun meaning "like"; the verb was omitted because «ألم تر» indicates it. In such constructions the verb of seeing is often omitted, the purpose being wonder; one says "Have you not seen the one who did such-and-such" meaning "look at him" . In any case the nominal kāf is conjoined to «الذي حاج ابراهيم», and «الذي» is a muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «مر على قرية» is the ṣila of the relative noun. As for the village, it was said that he meant Jerusalem when Nebuchadnezzar destroyed it.
(وَهِيَ خاوِيَةٌ عَلى عُرُوشِها): the wāw is for ḥāl (circumstantial); «هي» is a mubtadaʾ and «خاوية» a khabar; «على عروشها» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «خاوية». The meaning is that the roofs fell first and the buildings followed them.
This depiction is a poetic embodiment of the perishing of created things: the perishing begins with the living beings and worlds, and the inanimate things follow them. Abū al-Ṭayyib al-Mutanabbī had caught sight, as if by a sidelong glance, of the sky of this wondrous meaning, and he transferred it precisely, faster than phantoms move across eyelids, saying in an elegy:
أين الذي الهرمان من بنيانه؟ ... ما قومه؟ ما يومه؟ ما المصرع؟
(Where is he whose building the two pyramids are? What was his people? What was his day? What was his place of fall?)
تتخلف الآثار عن أصحابها ... حينا ويدركها الفناء فتتبع
(The monuments outlast their owners for a time, then perishing overtakes them and they follow.)
The second verse is the intended one. Its meaning is that the monuments, that is, the buildings, remain after their masters to point to their power and strength, then there befalls them after the masters what befell the masters of perishing; ruin will overtake them and they will collapse in disrepair, then the roofs and lofty ceilings will fall on top of them, and the monuments will vanish. The exegetes have taken curious paths concerning the story of this passer-by, which it is pleasant to consult in the longer works. Did he say what he said by way of denying the resurrection? Was he an unbeliever? All of these are conjectures out of which a winged tale is composed; who will give us the gifted writer?
(قالَ: أَنَّى يُحْيِي هذِهِ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِها): «قال» is a verb whose agent is "he". «أنى» has two possible analyses: one, that it means "when" (matā), so that it is an adverbial attached to «يحيي»; the other, that it means "how" (kayfa), so that it is a ḥāl from «هذه», the operator in it being «يحيي». The clause «يحيي» is in the genitive position by annexation if «أنى» is an adverbial, or is the content of the saying if it means "how". «يحيي» is an imperfect verb; «هذه» is a preposed direct object; «الله» is a postposed agent; «بعد موتها» is an adverbial of time also attached to «يحيي». The clause «قال» is resumptive, brought to express longing for it and yearning for its rebuilding while sensing despair of it.
(فَأَماتَهُ اللَّهُ مِائَةَ عامٍ): the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أماته الله» is a verb, direct object and agent; «مائة» is an adverbial of time attached to «أماته», and «عام» is a muḍāf ilayhi.
(ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُ): conjoined to «أماته»; it is conjoined with «ثم» to indicate delay and the length of the period.
(قالَ: كَمْ لَبِثْتَ): the clause is resumptive, brought as a reply to a question that may stir in the mind, as if it were said: "What did Allah the Exalted say to him when He raised him after death?" «كم» is an interrogative noun in the accusative position as an adverbial of time attached to «لبثت», and its specified noun is omitted, as if it were said: "How much time did you remain?" «لبثت» is a verb and agent, and the clause is in the accusative position as the content of the saying.
(قالَ: لَبِثْتُ يَوْماً أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ): the clause of saying is resumptive, to serve as the reply to the question; the clause «لبثت» is in the accusative position as the content of the saying; «يوما» is an adverbial of time attached to «لبثت»; «أو» is a conjunction; «بعض يوم» is conjoined to «يوما», strung on the same thread of the temporal adverbial.
(قالَ: بَلْ لَبِثْتَ مِائَةَ عامٍ): the clause «قال» is resumptive; «بل» is a conjunction joining an omitted clause which must be supplied, the implied form being: "You did not stay a day or part of a day; rather you stayed a hundred years." «مائة عام» is an adverbial; and the clause is the content of the saying.
(فَانْظُرْ إِلى طَعامِكَ وَشَرابِكَ لَمْ يَتَسَنَّهْ): the fāʾ is the eloquent fāʾ, here the apodosis of an implied condition, its implied form being: "if doubt and lack of reassurance arise in you concerning the matter of the resurrection, then look." «انظر» is an imperative verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you"; «إلى طعامك» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «انظر»; «شرابك» is conjoined to «طعامك»; «لم» is a particle of negation, reversal and jussive; «يتسنه» is an imperfect verb jussive through «لم», its sign of jussive being the sukūn if the hāʾ is part of the root; if the hāʾ is a hāʾ of pause, the verb is jussive by the dropping of the weak letter, and then the hāʾ of pause is retained in pausal form and not in connected speech, and its ruling will come. If the verb is from "tasannun", which means alteration, it is jussive by an implied sukūn on the dropped weak letter for which the second nūn was substituted. The clause «لم يتسنه» is a ḥāl.
(وَانْظُرْ إِلى حِمارِكَ): conjoined to what precedes. He singled it out for mention only because the passer-by used to ride it, and because the lesson drawn from living creatures has a stronger effect. The i'rab of its like has already been given.
(وَلِنَجْعَلَكَ آيَةً لِلنَّاسِ): the wāw is a conjunction and the lām is for cause; «نجعلك» is an imperfect verb in the accusative through an implied «أن» after the lām of cause; the lām and the maṣdar governed by it are attached to an omitted verb, i.e. "We did all that in order to make you a sign"; the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "We"; the kāf is the first direct object and «آية» the second direct object; «للناس» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of «آية».
(وَانْظُرْ إِلَى الْعِظامِ كَيْفَ نُنْشِزُها): the wāw is a conjunction; «انظر» is an imperative verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you"; «إلى العظام» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «انظر»; «كيف» is an interrogative noun in the accusative position as a ḥāl, and the owner of the ḥāl is the accusative pronoun in «ننشزها»; the clause is a badal (substitute) from «العظام» and is in the genitive or accusative position, because the verb «نظر» of eyesight is transitive with «إلى», but it is suspended from operating because of the interrogative, so it is in the accusative position, i.e. "to the state of the bones". «ننشزها» is an imperfect verb in the nominative; the hāʾ is the direct object and the agent is latent, its implied form being "We".
(ثُمَّ نَكْسُوها لَحْماً): «ثم» is a conjunction of order with delay; «نكسوها» is an imperfect verb taking two objects, the first being the hāʾ, and «لحما» is the second object.
(فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ): the fāʾ is a conjunction joining something implied that the context requires, as if He said: "So Allah raised them up and clothed them with flesh, and he looked at them, and it became clear to him how the giving of life and the resurrection are completed." «لما» is a temporal, non-jussive particle attached to the apodosis; «تبين» is a past verb indeclinable on an overt fatḥa; the agent of «تبين» is a concealed pronoun referring to the manner of giving life; al-Zamakhsharī implied it in a curious way, saying: "when what had been obscure to him became clear to him", while al-Jalāl implied: "when that became clear to him by direct witnessing". The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تبين», and the clause «تبين» is in the genitive position by annexation.
(قالَ: أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ): «قال» is a verb whose agent is latent; the clause «أعلم» is the content of the saying, and the clause of saying has no position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; «أن» with its noun and khabar takes the place of the two objects of «أعلم».

* Benefits:
1- The maṣdar substitutes for the adverbial when it is a muḍāf ilayhi and specifies a time or a quantity, e.g. "jiʾtuka ṣalāt al-ʿaṣr" (I came to you at the time of the afternoon prayer) and "miqdam al-ḥājj" (the arrival of the pilgrim).
2- The hāʾ of pause (hāʾ al-sakt): it is so called because one pauses on it without pausing on the end of the word. It has three places:
(a) The defective verb with its end dropped because of the jussive or the sukūn, such as: «لم يتسنه», "lam yaghzuh", "lam yakhshah", "lam yarmih", and "ighzuh", "ikhshah", "irmih"; and of it is His saying the Exalted: «فبهداهم اقتده». In all of this it is permissible, not obligatory, except in one case, namely where the verb has been subjected to dropping and remains on a single letter, like the imperative of "waʿā yaʿī", for you say "ʿih", dropping its first and last letters.
(b) The interrogative «ما» governed by a preposition: its alif must be dropped when it is governed by a preposition, as in "ʿamma", "mimma", "bima" and "fīma". When you pause on them you attach the hāʾ to preserve the fatḥa that indicates the alif.
(c) Every indeclinable word built on a vowel that does not resemble the declinable, such as the yāʾ of the first person, and "huwa" and "hiya": you pause on them with the hāʾ of pause to preserve the fatḥa. In the Qur'an: «ماهيه», «ماليه» and «سلطانيه». Ḥassān said:
إذا ما ترعرع منا الغلام ... فما إن يقال له: ما هوه؟
(When our boy grows up, it is not said of him: "Who is he?")
The proper state of the hāʾ of pause is to be vowelless, and vowelling it is a solecism according to the Basrans. Abū al-Ṭayyib al-Mutanabbī used to defy the grammarians, saying: وأحرّ قلباه ممن قلبه شبم ... ومن بجسمي وحالي عنده سقم
(Oh, how my heart burns for one whose heart is cold, and for one in whose view my body and condition are sick.)
He was, as you know, a Kufan, and the Kufans allow that. In fact the grammarians were greatly perplexed over this question, and were left bewildered [Translator's note: the source writes «ووفقوا»; «ووقفوا» is meant] before the saying of ʿUrwa about his beloved ʿAfrāʾ:
يا مرحباه بحمار عفرا ... ويا مرحباه بحمار ناجيه
(O welcome to the donkey of ʿAfrāʾ, and O welcome to the donkey of Nājiya.)
Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī defended Abū al-Ṭayyib al-Mutanabbī in his commentary on his Dīwān in an engaging discussion; it would be good if you consulted it.
3- The interrogative in this verse departs from its original meaning. The first, «ألم تر», means wonder, i.e. "Marvel, Muhammad, at this story"; and the second interrogative is for deeming something momentous, namely «أنى يحيي هذه الله بعد موتها».

A necessary historical glimpse:
ʿUzayr ibn Sharkhiyā [Translator's note: the source writes «عزيز بن شرخيا» here and «عزير» afterwards; the correct name is «عزير»] was among the inhabitants of Jerusalem and was among those whom Nebuchadnezzar took captive. When he was freed from captivity and came and saw it in that state, riding on a donkey, he entered it and went about in it, and saw no one there.
Most of its trees were bearing fruit, so he ate of the fruit and pressed some grapes, then tied his donkey with a rope, put the rest of the fruit in a basket and the rest of the juice in a skin or small waterskin. Then Allah cast sleep upon him and he slept, and when he slept Allah took his soul from him and caused his donkey to die, while his juice and figs remained with him. When seventy years had passed since his death, Allah gave power to one of the kings of Persia, who marched with his troops until he reached Jerusalem and rebuilt it, and it became better than it had been, and its people returned to it, and Allah blinded the eyes to ʿUzayr throughout this period. When the hundred years had passed, Allah revived him, and he began to look at his donkey as the spirit moved in it and its limbs came together, and so on to the end of that story, which we wish a skilled storywriter would take up and make into an artistic tale. It condemns the saying of the Jews about ʿUzayr, that he is the son of Allah, exalted is Allah above that.

Important remarks:
1- We spoke about His saying the Exalted «ألم تر» in the section on I'rab, and we came across an important statement of al-Taftāzānī, the gist of which is: both the expression «ألم تر» and «أرأيت» are used with the intention of wonder, except that the first relates to the thing wondered at, so one says "Have you not seen the one who did such-and-such" meaning "look at him and marvel at his state", whereas the second relates to the like of the thing wondered at, so one says "Have you seen the like of the one who did such-and-such?" meaning that he is so strange that his like is not seen. It is not correct to say "alam tara ilā mithlihi" (have you not seen his like), since the implication would be "look at the like and marvel at the one who did such-and-such". Hence the conjoining of «كالذي مرّ» to «الذي حاج» was not straightforward, and interpretation was needed either in the conjoined, by making it attached to an omitted "have you seen…", or in the one conjoined to, considering it to be in the meaning of "have you seen like the one who disputed", so that conjoining to it becomes valid.
I say: this is a limitless subtlety of observation and depth, and an unrivalled scholarly thoroughness; we have not corrected our i'rab as he saw it, and have contented ourselves with recording this remark.
2- Abū al-Suʿūd al-ʿImādī [Translator's note: the source writes «العماري»; the known nisba is al-ʿImādī], muftī of the Ottoman court, who held the Islamic fatwa office for thirty years, author of the commentary called "Irshād al-ʿAql al-Salīm ilā Mazāyā al-Kitāb al-Karīm" [Translator's note: the source writes «إرشاد السليم»; the actual title is «إرشاد العقل السليم»] and who died in 1574 CE, said in his discussion of the kāf in His saying «أو كالذي»:
"The kāf is either a noun, as a group chose, brought to alert to the multiplicity of the evidences and that they are not restricted to what has been mentioned, as in your saying: 'The past verb is like naṣara'; or redundant (zāʾida), as others have preferred, the meaning being: 'Have you not seen the one who passed by a village, how Allah guided him and brought him out of the darkness of doubt into the light of sight and witnessing?' that is, you have seen that and witnessed it."
3- Ibn Hishām said in al-Mughnī: "Among the misconceptions in this chapter is the statement of some regarding His saying «وانظر إلى العظام كيف ننشزها» that the interrogative clause is a ḥāl. The correct view is that «كيف» alone is a ḥāl from the object of «ننشزها», and that the clause is a badal from «العظام»."
Al-Dasūqī cited in his gloss on Ibn Hishām that this clause cannot take the place of the thing substituted for, which is a condition for the validity of the badal. But al-Dasūqī overlooked that the attention is to the meaning, that is, to the bones and the manner of their raising, apart from the fact that this rule holds in the majority of cases.

* Vocabulary:
(فَصُرْهُنَّ): with ḍamma on the ṣād, and a kasra is also possible; an imperative verb from "ṣāra yaṣūru" or from "ṣāra yaṣīru", meaning to gather or to incline. He said:
وفرع يصير الجيد وحف كأنه ... على الليت قنوان الكروم الدّوالح
(And hair that bends the neck, thick and black, as though upon the nape were clusters of laden vines.)
He describes the hair of his beloved as bending her neck because of its heaviness upon it, and likens it to clusters of vines weighed down with fruit. [Translator's note: the source reads «لنقله»; «لثقله» (because of its heaviness) is meant.] In Mukhtār al-Ṣiḥāḥ he says: "ṣārahu: he inclined it, of the pattern qāla and bāʿa; and it was read «فصرهن إليك» with ḍamma and kasra on the ṣād. Also ṣāra al-shayʾ, of both patterns: he cut it and separated it. Whoever explains it thus makes the verse have a preposing and postposing, i.e. 'take to yourself four of the birds, and cut them up'."

* I'rab:
(وَإِذْ قالَ إِبْراهِيمُ): the wāw is resumptive and the speech is resumptive, brought to adduce another proof of Allah's care for the believers; it also calls attention to the fact that sight and direct witnessing are indispensable for strengthening and rooting conviction, since Abraham was not in doubt about Allah's giving life to the dead. «إذ» is an adverbial attached to an implied "mention" [Translator's note: the source reads «بما ذكر مقدرا»; presumably «باذكر مقدرا» (to an implied «اذكر») is meant]; «قال إبراهيم» is a verb and agent, and the clause is in the genitive position by annexation.
(رَبِّ أَرِنِي كَيْفَ تُحْيِ الْمَوْتى): «رب» is the one addressed, a muḍāf to the omitted yāʾ of the first person, and the clause is in the accusative position as the content of the saying. «أرني» is an imperative verb from the visual "irāʾa", which takes one object, and with the entry of the hamza it became transitive to two. The origin of «أرني» is "ariʾīnī"; the first yāʾ was dropped giving "ariʾnī", then the vowel of the hamza was moved to the rāʾ and the hamza dropped. «أرني» is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the dropping of the weak letter; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ of the first person is the first direct object. «كيف» is an interrogative ḥāl; «تحيي» is an imperfect verb whose agent is latent; «الموتى» is a direct object; the clause «كيف تحيي الموتى» is in the accusative position as the second object of «أرني».
(قالَ أَوَلَمْ تُؤْمِنْ): «قال» is a past verb and the agent is "he"; the clause is resumptive, serving to affirm what has occurred, i.e. "Do you ask while you do not believe?"; the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (taqrīrī), because the question concerns a matter whose existence is established for the asker and the one asked alike. The wāw is a conjunction; «لم» is a particle of negation, reversal and jussive; «تؤمن» is an imperfect verb jussive through «لم»; the interrogative clause is in the accusative position as the content of the saying.
(قالَ بَلى): a resumptive clause, brought to affirm belief. He used «بلى», which is a particle of response, to establish the negated belief; had the answer been «نعم», it would have been unbelief.
(وَلكِنْ لِيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِي): the wāw is a conjunction joining an omitted clause whose implied form is "I asked You"; «لكن» is a disregarded particle of rectification (istidrāk); the lām of «ليطمئن» is for cause, and «يطمئن» is an imperfect verb in the accusative through an implied «أن». An omitted element must be supplied for the lām to be attached validly, i.e. "but I asked You the manner of giving life so that my heart may be at ease". «قلبي» is an agent, nominative by an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi.
(قالَ فَخُذْ أَرْبَعَةً مِنَ الطَّيْرِ): a resumptive clause, brought to demonstrate Allah the Exalted's guardianship of the believers and His leading them along the stretches of the straight path. [Translator's note: the source reads «مسوفة»; «مسوقة» is meant.] The fāʾ is the eloquent fāʾ, i.e. "if you wish to know that by sight, then take". «خذ» is an imperative verb and the agent is "you"; «أربعة» is a direct object; «من الطير» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of «أربعة».
(فَصُرْهُنَّ إِلَيْكَ): the fāʾ is a conjunction; «صرهن» is an imperative verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you"; the hāʾ is the direct object and the nūn is the sign of the feminine plural, with no position; «إليك» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "gathered to you".
(ثُمَّ اجْعَلْ عَلى كُلِّ جَبَلٍ مِنْهُنَّ جُزْءاً): «ثم» is a conjunction of order and delay; «اجعل» is an imperative verb and the agent is "you"; «على كل» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «اجعل» as its second object; «جبل» is a muḍāf ilayhi; «منهن» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective of «جزءا» and when it was put before the described it was parsed as a ḥāl; «جزءا» is the first object.
(ثُمَّ ادْعُهُنَّ يَأْتِينَكَ سَعْياً): also a conjunction. «ادعهن» is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the dropping of the weak letter, the agent is "you", the hāʾ is the direct object and the nūn is the sign of the feminine with no position; «يأتينك» is an imperfect verb indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of the jussive as the answer to the request, the nūn is the agent and the kāf the direct object, and the clause is the answer to the request with no position; «سعيا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. swift walking. You may also parse it as a ḥāl, i.e. "hastening".
(وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ): the wāw is a conjunction; «اعلم» is an imperative verb and the agent is "you"; «أن» with its noun and its two khabars takes the place of the two objects of «اعلم».

* Rhetoric:
In this verse there is concision by omission (ījāz bi-l-ḥadhf): the remainder of the story is omitted, since He, glory be to Him, related His commands without mentioning Abraham's, peace be upon him, carrying them out, because that is understood at once.

* Vocabulary:
(السنبلة) is well known; its pattern is fanʿala, so the nūn is redundant (zāʾida). One says: أسبل الزرع — the crop sent out what is in it. Some lexicographers report سنبل الزرع, in which case the nūn is radical and the pattern is faʿlal. Al-Asās and al-Lisān report:
«أسبل الزرع وسنبل: its ears (سبله and سنبله) came out».
(المن): to count one's kindness against the one to whom one has been kind.

* I'rab:
(مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ) is a resumptive statement brought to strike a parable for spending wealth in the way of Allah. A muḍāf must be taken as omitted, i.e. "the likeness of their spending". (مثل) is the mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذين) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause (ينفقون) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (أموالهم) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (في سبيل الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ينفقون). (كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنْبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنابِلَ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); here too a muḍāf must be taken as omitted, i.e. "like the likeness of the sower of a grain". (أنبتت) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) is "it" (هي); (سبع) is the direct object; (سنابل) is muḍāf ilayhi, its sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote, being on the pattern of the ultimate plural (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ); and the clause (أنبتت) is an adjective of (حبة). (فِي كُلِّ سُنْبُلَةٍ مِائَةُ حَبَّةٍ): (في كل) — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (سنبلة) is muḍāf ilayhi; (مائة حبة) is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and the nominal clause is an adjective of (سنابل), so it is in the position of the genitive, or an adjective of (سبع), so it is in the position of the accusative. (وَاللَّهُ يُضاعِفُ لِمَنْ يَشاءُ): the wāw is resumptive; (الله) is the mubtadaʾ; (يضاعف) is an imperfect verb whose agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he", referring to Allah the Exalted; the clause (يضاعف) is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ «الله»; (لمن) — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (يضاعف); and the clause (يشاء) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of (من). (وَاللَّهُ واسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ): the wāw is a conjunction; (الله) is the mubtadaʾ; (واسع) is the first khabar and (عليم) the second khabar. (الَّذِينَ يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ): you may make it follow the preceding clauses as a badal (substitute) from them, or you may make it resumptive, brought to mention spending that is not tainted by reproach. (الذين) is a mubtadaʾ, or a badal from the first (الذين); the clause (ينفقون أموالهم) has no grammatical position because it is a ṣila; and (في سبيل الله) is attached to (ينفقون). (ثُمَّ لا يُتْبِعُونَ ما أَنْفَقُوا مَنًّا وَلا أَذىً): (ثم) is a conjunction expressing sequence and delay, in time and in rank; (لا) is negating; (يتبعون) is an imperfect verb conjoined to (ينفقون); (ما) is a relative noun, the first direct object; the clause (أنفقوا) is the ṣila of (ما); (منا) is the second direct object; and (ولا أذى) is conjoined to «منا». (لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ): the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar; (أجرهم) is the postponed mubtadaʾ; the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (ربهم) is muḍāf ilayhi; and the nominal clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar of (الذين) if it is taken as a mubtadaʾ; but if it is a badal, the clause is resumptive. (وَلا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ): the i'rab of this verse, letter for letter, has preceded.

* Rhetoric:
1- Representational simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): the spending of those who spend in the way of Allah is likened to a grain in the multiplication of the reward; when the planter plants it, it puts forth a stalk from which seven branches spread, each with an ear. It contains a splendid embodiment by setting up a correspondence between the thing likened and the thing it is likened to. The purpose of the simile here is, first, to clarify the meaning and bring it near to minds; second, to support it with tangible proof that no obstinate person can dispute and no stubborn person can quibble with; and third, to adorn and beautify the thing likened and to kindle desire for it, so that no one hesitates to spend after having seen with his own eyes, in advance, the reward prepared for it.
2- «ثم» in its original coinage indicates that there is a delay (tarākhī) between what is conjoined by it and what it is conjoined to. People have differed over this delay; some say:
It is a delay in time and the distance between the two. Al-Zamakhsharī, may Allah have mercy on him, takes it as a disparity in rank. So to which of the two is it to be referred in this verse?
The scholars of rhetoric have spoken at length on this matter. Some said: what is meant is delay in time, given what is usual, namely that reproach and injury necessarily occur after the spending [Translator's note: the source reads «يعد الإنفاق»; «بعد الإنفاق» is meant]; indeed they follow from it and cannot be conceived of before it occurs. This is good and fine. Al-Zamakhsharī held that the delay here is to be understood as a disparity in ranks and the distance between them, since it cannot be taken as temporal because of a context in the verse that refuses that. The upshot is that it has been borrowed from distance between times for distance in rank. This is among the most wonderful things that sound thought and deep intelligence can reach, for drawing out this metaphor in this form is not grasped by the short-sighted and the beginners. On this basis it is said: its original meaning is the delay of the time of the act's occurrence and coming about, and the meaning to which it is borrowed is the continuance of the act's existence and the prolongation of the time of its remaining.

* Vocabulary:
(نَخِيلٍ) النخيل: it is said that it is a collective-plural noun (ism jamʿ) whose singular is نخلة. It is also said:
it is the plural of نخل, and نخل is a generic noun (ism jins).
(الأعناب): the plural of عنب, or it is a generic noun whose singular is عنبة. (إِعْصارٌ): a violent wind that rises high; it is also said to be the scorching wind (al-samūm).
It was so named because it twists as a wrung-out (maʿṣūr) garment twists; it is also said, because it wrings (taʿṣir) the clouds. إعصار is pluralised as أعاصير.

* I'rab:
(أَيَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمْ) is a resumptive clause brought to strike another parable for the spending of those who show off and those who reproach. The hamza is interrogative; (يود) is an imperfect verb; (أحدكم) is its fāʿil (agent); and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (أَنْ تَكُونَ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ): (أن) and what follows it are a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the accusative as the object of (يود); (له) — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); and (جنة) is its postponed noun (ism). (مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَأَعْنابٍ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (جنة); and (أعناب) is conjoined to (نخيل). (تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ): (تجري) is an imperfect verb; (من تحتها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (تجري); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; (الأنهار) is the agent; and the clause is a second adjective of (جنة). (لَهُ فِيها مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَراتِ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (من كل الثمرات) — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of the postponed, omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "he has provision consisting of all the fruits, while it is in it"; and the clause is a third adjective of (جنة). (وَأَصابَهُ الْكِبَرُ): the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause (أصابه الكبر) is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl; «قد» must be implied. (وَلَهُ ذُرِّيَّةٌ ضُعَفاءُ): the wāw is circumstantial; (له) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (ذرية) is the postponed mubtadaʾ; (ضعفاء) is an adjective of (ذرية); and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the hāʾ in «أصابه». (فَأَصابَها إِعْصارٌ): the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أصاب) is a past verb; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إعصار) is the agent; and the clause is conjoined to the adjective of the garden. (فِيهِ نارٌ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (نار) is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and the nominal clause is an adjective of (إعصار). (فَاحْتَرَقَتْ) is conjoined to (أصابها). (كَذلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الْآياتِ): the preposition and its genitive noun «كذلك» are attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or are in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl; (يبين) is an imperfect verb in the nominative; (الله) is the agent of (يبين); (لكم) is attached to (يبين); (الآيات) is the direct object, accusative with the kasra; and the clause (يبين) is resumptive. (لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَفَكَّرُونَ): (لعل) and its noun, and the clause (تتفكرون) is its khabar; and the clause of hope is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

* Rhetoric:
In this verse Qur'anic eloquence soars to the highest summit the human mind can conceive, though all the verses of the Qur'an are of lofty, sublime eloquence. But this verse [Translator's note: the source repeats the word «هذه» twice] — and many verses that have come and will come in their places — have attained the utmost from the rhetorical side and gone beyond the limit. It serves as the parable of the spending of the show-off who spends to boast and to proclaim his self-love, and to make people imagine that he has reached the furthest goals, while his deeds go to waste. We shall discuss it at a length matching its far-reaching aims; what follows is what we have grasped of it:
1- The interrogative in His words «أيود؟» is for disapproval and negation. As for where the negation falls, it is on His words «فأصابها إعصار», because that is its point of attachment and its resting place. Beautiful is the saying of Ibn ʿAbbās about it: «It is a parable of a man who did acts of obedience, then Satan made things fair-seeming to him, so he did acts of disobedience until he burned up his deeds and they were lost».
2- This verse also contains the device of completion (al-tatmīm), which has been referred to before.
We shall expand on it further here, and say: it is that the poet or writer brings into his speech words which, if they were dropped, would diminish its meaning or its images, though the speech would remain sound.
Here are the images it comprises:
a- When He, Glorified is He, mentioned the garden (الجنة), He was not content to mention it free of any qualification, because in the language الجنة is a word applying to any dense, intertwined trees that cover whoever takes shelter in their spreading shade. Among such trees are some of limited benefit, like the tamarisk (الأثل) and the arak (الخمط) and other trees fit only for firewood; and among them are some whose benefit is multiplied: their fruit is eaten, other useful materials are extracted from them, and then their wood is fit for fuel. So He completed that deficiency by saying «من نخيل وأعناب», and it was understood self-evidently that this garden was distinguished by its trees being of the second kind, of multiplied benefit. That is, the burning of that garden — even if it contained tamarisk, arak and the like, of limited benefit — would grieve its owner; so how much more if it was of date-palms and grapevines? Would not the sorrow over it be more intense?
And the grief at its burning greater?
b- Then He completed that by mentioning the flowing rivers, to indicate the permanence of fertility. For what use is it if the waters in it dry up? Would its end not be dryness and withering?
c- And to remove the false impression that might occur to the listeners that this garden might be restricted to these two kinds of fruit, namely date-palms and grapes, He completed it by saying «له فيها من كل الثمرات», i.e. that it gathers every variety of fruit; so the regret at its burning is then more intense, and the sorrow over its perishing more comprehensive.
d- When He had finished describing the garden, He began describing the destructive event that led to the garden's perishing, by saying: «فأصابها إعصار», which sweeps away the green and the dry and destroys tillage and offspring.
e- However, a whirlwind, however great its effect, might be of delayed destruction; so He removed this false impression by saying «فيه نار», so it burned it after having destroyed its trees. And He was not content with mentioning the fire, because it may consume part of what it burns while something else of it remains afterwards; so He removed this false impression once more by mentioning the burning (فاحترقت).
Al-Buḥturī and completion:
An example of completion in poetry is the saying of al-Buḥturī describing camels worn thin by travel by day and by night:
كالقسيّ المعطّفات بل الأسهم مبريّة بل الأوتار
(Like bent bows — nay, like arrows pared thin — nay, like bowstrings.) He likened the camels to bent bows, a beautiful simile because of its allusion to leanness and to the humped, curved build of camels. Then he made them pared (like arrows) by way of a correction (iḍrāb) that hints at a mistake, and then rose further and made them like bowstrings. All of this is among al-Buḥturī's rare gems, which the ancient critics called «chains of gold». However, I afterwards came across a hadith of the Arab Messenger Muhammad ﷺ, and learned that al-Buḥturī did not originate these deep meanings cast in the most beautiful expression, but that he gazed at the sky of the Prophetic hadith and took from it in a way that outran his pared arrows. It is his saying ﷺ: «If you prayed to Allah until you became like bows, and fasted until you became like bowstrings». This is among what was taken in its very wording and substance.
3- This verse also contains the device of «obedience and disobedience» (al-ṭāʿa wa-l-ʿiṣyān). This name was coined by the poet of the philosophers and philosopher of the poets, Abū al-ʿAlāʾ al-Maʿarrī, when he examined the poetry of Abū al-Ṭayyib al-Mutanabbī and discussed it in his book «Muʿjiz Aḥmad», meaning Aḥmad al-Mutanabbī. He came to his saying:
يردّ يدا عن ثوبها وهو قادر ... ويعصي الهوى في طيفها وهو راقد
(He holds back a hand from her garment though he is able, and disobeys desire in her phantom though he is asleep.)
He said: «Al-Mutanabbī wanted antithesis (al-ṭibāq), but it disobeyed him, and paronomasia (al-jinās) obeyed him. For he wanted to say: "He holds back a hand from her garment while awake (مستيقظ)", but that disobeyed him because it could not enter the metre; so he said "though he is able" (قادر), because one who is able is awake and more, so that there would be a correspondence between it and the rhyme. Thus the reversed paronomasia between قادر and راقد obeyed him, and the antithesis between راقد and مستيقظ disobeyed him».
I say: this is what Abū al-ʿAlāʾ al-Maʿarrī mentioned, but there is nothing of that in al-Mutanabbī's verse. Had he wanted to say «يردّ يدا عن ثوبها وهو ساهر» or «متنبها», dropping the word «وهو», he would have achieved his aim of antithesis and the metre would not have disobeyed him. Rather, his intent is to show the chastity of one who is able, not of anyone else, i.e. that despite his power over her he does not permit himself to stretch his hand to her wrap, just as, when he sees her image in sleep, he refrains from it as he refrains from it when awake. He is describing himself as having a lofty aspiration far from flirting with women. So the device of obedience and disobedience, which al-Maʿarrī invented but was not successful in illustrating, was affirmed by the scholars of rhetoric, who illustrated it with the saying of Ibn al-Nabīh:
بيضاء حجّبها الواشون حين سرت ... عني فلو لمحت صبغ الدجى لمحت
(A fair one whom the slanderers veiled when she travelled by night away from me; had she glanced at the dye of the darkness, she would have been seen.)
He wanted to say: "had she glanced at the blackness (سواد) of the darkness", to bring in the colour-device (al-tadbīj) through "white" (بيضاء) and "blackness" (سواد); but the metre disobeyed him, so he said «صبغ الدجى», which is equivalent to blackness. So it holds true of him that the tadbīj disobeyed him and the device of indirect expression (al-irdāf) obeyed him.
Like it is the saying of al-Arrajānī:
كم رعت هذا الحي إما زائرا ... فردا وإما سائرا في جحفل
(How often I have alarmed this tribe, either visiting alone or marching in a great army.)
He wanted to say "or warring" (محاربا), so that the contrast would be between visitor and warrior — and no doubt the visitor is peaceable — [as there is] between his saying «فردا» and his saying «في جحفل» [Translator's note: the source reads «ولا شك أن الزائر يكون مسالما بين قوله فردا وقوله في جحفل», which appears to have lost part of its text; translated as written]; but the metre disobeyed him and gave him [Translator's note: the source reads «وأعطاه لجناس», presumably «وأطاعه الجناس», "and paronomasia obeyed him"] the consecutive paronomasia (al-jinās al-lāḥiq) between زائر and سائر. As for the noble verse we are dealing with, completion occurs in it, and we have spoken of it a little earlier. Since the speaker originally aims at equivalence (al-musāwāh) in all he says, if equivalence disobeys him for the purposes mentioned above, completion obeys him. So take note of this, for it is among the subtleties of the devices.

* Lügat:
(تَدايَنْتُمْ): Birbirinize borç verdiniz (borçlandınız). «داينت الرجل» denir; yani onunla (borçlu) muamele ettim. Ru'be şöyle demiştir:
داينت أروى والدّيون تقضى ... فمطلت بعضا وأدّت بعضا
(Ervâ ile borçlu muamele ettim —borçlar ödenir— kimini sürüncemede bıraktı, kimini ödedi.)
«Borçla mı sattın, ayn ile mi?» derler; ayn peşin paradır. «دنت», «أدّنت», «تديّنت» ve «استدنت»: yani borç aldım. Kesîr şöyle demiştir:
قضى كلّ ذي دين فوفّى غزيمه ... وعزّة ممطول معنّى غريمها
(Her borçlu borcunu ödedi ve alacaklısına hakkını tam verdi; Azze'nin alacaklısı ise sürüncemede bırakılmış, eziyet çekmektedir.) [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta ilk mısrada «غزيمه» yazılıdır; «غريمه» olmalıdır.]
(وَلْيُمْلِلِ) «الإملال» ve «الإملاء»dan olup ikisi aynı anlamdadır. Bununla birlikte, yâ, sayıca epeyce harften şâz yoldan ibdâl edilmiştir ve buna kıyas yapılmaz. Bundan biri de «أمليت الكتاب» (kitabı yazdırdım) sözleridir; Allah Teâlâ şöyle buyurmuştur: «فهي تملى عليه بكرة وأصيلا». Asıl «أمللت»tir; Allah Teâlâ şöyle buyurmuştur: «وليملل الذي عليه الحقّ». Doğru görüş bunların iki lügat (iki ayrı kullanım) olduğudur; çünkü ikisinin tasrifi birdir: «أملى الكتاب يمليه إملاء» ve «أملّه يملّه إملالا» dersin. Dolayısıyla birini asıl, diğerini fer' saymak, bunun tersinden daha evlâ değildir. «قصّيت أظفاري» (tırnaklarımı kestim) demişlerdir; İbnü's-Sikkît bunu «قصّصت» hakkında nakletmiştir; teşdîdin ağırlığı sebebiyle üçüncü sâd yerine yâ getirmişlerdir. «تقصّيت أظفاري», yani tırnaklarımın en uç noktalarına vardım anlamının kastedilmiş olması da caizdir; çünkü alınan, onların uçlarıdır; her şeyin ucu da en uzak noktasıdır. Bu, sözün uzadığı bir bahistir; geçenle yetiniyoruz. Bu kitapta başka uygun örneklere de rastlayacaksın.
(فَرِهانٌ) râ'nın kesresiyle: masdar veya «رهن»in çoğuludur. Rehin, borca teminat olarak konulan şey, bir şeyi mutlak olarak alıkoymak ve rehin verilen şeydir. İki damme ile «فرهن» şeklinde de okunmuştur; bu da «رهن»in çoğuludur.

* İ'rab:
(يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا) i'rabı geçti. Nidâ cümlesi ve sonrası isti'nâfiyyedir; borç hükümlerini ve insanlarla genel toplumsal maslahatı güvence altına alacak şekilde muameleyi açıklamaya başlamak için sevk edilmiştir. (إِذا تَدايَنْتُمْ بِدَيْنٍ إِلى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَاكْتُبُوهُ) «إذا» gelecek zaman için zarf olup şart anlamını içerir ve cevaba müteallik; «تداينتم» cümlesi muzâfun ileyh olarak cer mahallindedir. «بدين»: «تداينتم»a müteallik; «إلى أجل»: «دين»in mahzûf sıfatına müteallik; «مسمى» «أجل»in sıfatıdır. Fâ «إذا»nın cevabını bağlayıcıdır; «اكتبوه» emir fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir. Fâ ile birleşen cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır. (وَلْيَكْتُبْ بَيْنَكُمْ كاتِبٌ بِالْعَدْلِ) Vav atıf harfi; lâm emir lâmı; «يكتب» lâm ile meczûm muzâri fiil; «بينكم» mekân zarfı olup «يكتب»e müteallik; «كاتب» fâil; «بالعدل»: «كاتب»e onun sıfatı makamında müteallik; yani yazdığı şeyde eşitlik ve ihtiyatla güvenilir bir kâtip; yazılması gerekenden fazla yazmaz, eksik de yazmaz. İbn Atiyye'nin, bâ'nın Allah Teâlâ'nın «وليكتب» sözüne müteallik olduğu, «كاتب»e müteallik olmadığı yönündeki sözüne gerek yoktur. [Gerekçesi şudur:] Çünkü o (bu takdirde) belgeyi ancak kendisi âdil olan kimsenin yazmasını gerekli kılmış olurdu; hâlbuki onu çocuk ve ihtiyatlı köle de, onun fıkhını (hukukî gereklerini) yerine getirdiklerinde yazabilir. (وَلا يَأْبَ كاتِبٌ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ كَما عَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ) Vav atıf harfi, «لا» nehiy edatı; «يأب» meczûm muzâri fiil olup cezm alâmeti illet harfinin hazfidir; «كاتب» fâil. «أن» ve etki alanındaki kısım nez'u'l-hâfıd ile nasb mahallinde müevvel masdardır, çünkü «أبى» «imtina etti (kaçındı)» anlamındadır. «كما علمه الله»: câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir mef'ûl-i mutlaka müteallik veya hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir; «علمه» cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü harfî mevsûlün sılasıdır. (فَلْيَكْتُبْ) Fâ fasîha fâsıdır; yani bu hükmü bildiğinize göre, yazsın. Lâm emir lâmı; «يكتب» lâm ile meczûm muzâri fiil; fâil «هو»dur. (وَلْيُمْلِلِ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ الْحَقُّ) Vav atıf harfi; «الذي» «يكتب»in fâili [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta böyle yazılıdır; «الذي» burada «يملل»in fâilidir.]; «عليه» önce gelmiş mahzûf habere müteallik; «الحق» sonraya kalmış mübtedâ; isim cümlesi mevsûlün sılasıdır. (وَلْيَتَّقِ اللَّهَ رَبَّهُ) Vav atıf harfi; lâm emir lâmı; «يتق» lâm ile meczûm muzâri fiil olup cezm alâmeti illet harfinin hazfidir; fâil takdiri «هو» olan müstetir zamir; lafza-i celâl mef'ûlün bih; «ربه» bedeldir. (وَلا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْئاً) Vav atıf harfi, «لا» nehiy edatı; «يبخس» «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiil; fâil «هو». «منه»: câr ve mecrûr «يبخس»e veya mahzûf bir hâle müteallik; çünkü o «شيئا» sözünün sıfatı idi ve ona takdim edilmiştir. «شيئا» mef'ûl-i mutlak veya mef'ûlün bihtir; yani ondan hiçbir şey eksiltmesin. (فَإِنْ كانَ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ الْحَقُّ سَفِيهاً أَوْ ضَعِيفاً) Fâ isti'nâfiyye; «إن» şartiyye; «كان» nâkıs mâzî fiil olup fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir; «الذي» «كان»ın ismi; «عليه»: câr ve mecrûr önce gelmiş mahzûf habere müteallik; «الحق» sonraya kalmış mübtedâ; isim cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü sıladır. «سفيها» «كان»ın haberi; «أو» atıf harfi; «ضعيفا» «سفيها» üzerine atıftır. (أَوْ لا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يُمِلَّ هُوَ) «أو» atıf harfi; «لا» nefy harfi; «يستطيع» muzâri fiil; «أن» ve etki alanındaki kısım masdar te'vilinde olup «يستطيع»in mef'ûlü olarak nasb mahallindedir. «هو» fâildir veya müstetir fâilin te'kîdidir. (فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُ بِالْعَدْلِ) Fâ cevâbü'ş-şartı bağlayıcıdır; lâm emir lâmı; «يملل» lâm ile meczûm muzâri fiil; «وليه» fâil; «بالعدل»: mahzûf bir hâle müteallik, yani âdil olarak; istersen bunları «فليملل» sözüne de müteallik kılabilirsin. Cümle cevâbü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir. (وَاسْتَشْهِدُوا شَهِيدَيْنِ مِنْ رِجالِكُمْ) Vav atıf harfi; «استشهدوا» nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiil; vav fâil; «شهيدين» mef'ûlün bih; «من رجالكم»: mahzûf bir sıfata veya «واستشهدوا» sözüne müteallik. (فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُونا رَجُلَيْنِ) Fâ isti'nâfiyye; «إن» şartiyye; «لم» nefy, kalb ve cezm harfi; «يكونا» «لم» ile meczûm muzâri fiil olup fiilü'ş-şarttır; elif ismi, «رجلين» haberidir. (فَرَجُلٌ وَامْرَأَتانِ) Fâ cevâbü'ş-şartı bağlayıcıdır; «رجل» mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberidir veya mübtedâ olup haberi mahzûftur; «امرأتان» «رجل» üzerine atıftır. Takdir: «فالشهود رجل وامرأتان» (şahitler bir erkek ve iki kadındır) veya «فرجل وامرأتان يشهدون» (bir erkek ve iki kadın şahitlik ederler). Cümle cevâbü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir. (مِمَّنْ تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ الشُّهَداءِ) Câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir sıfata müteallik; «ترضون» cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü sıladır; «من الشهداء»: câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir hâle müteallik. (أَنْ تَضِلَّ إِحْداهُما) «أن» ve etki alanındaki kısım masdar te'vilinde olup mef'ûlün lieclih olarak mansûbdur; çünkü unutmak (dalâl) hatırlatmanın sebebidir; sanki «birinin diğerine hatırlatmasını istemek için» denmiştir. Bu i'rab hakkında daha fazlası Fevâid bölümünde gelecektir. «إحداهما» «تضل»in fâilidir. (فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْداهُمَا الْأُخْرى) Fâ atıf harfi; «تذكر» «أن تضلّ» üzerine atıftır; «إحداهما» fâil, «الأخرى» mef'ûlün bihtir. (وَلا يَأْبَ الشُّهَداءُ إِذا ما دُعُوا) Vav atıf harfi, «لا» nehiy edatı; «يأب» «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiil olup cezm alâmeti illet harfinin hazfidir; «الشهداء» fâil. «إذا» şart anlamını içeren gelecek zaman zarfı olup cevaba müteallik; «ما» zâide; «دعوا» meçhul muzâri fiil [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «فعل مضارع» yazılıdır; «دُعُوا» meçhul mâzî fiildir.], vav nâib-i fâil; cümle muzâfun ileyh olarak cer mahallindedir. (وَلا تَسْئَمُوا أَنْ تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيراً أَوْ كَبِيراً إِلى أَجَلِهِ) Vav atıf harfi, «لا» nehiy edatı; «تسأموا» «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiil, vav fâil; «أن» ve etki alanındaki kısım «تسأموا»nın mef'ûlün bihidir. «صغيرا» hâl; vav atıf harfi [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta böyledir; ayette atıf harfi «أو»dır.]; «كبيرا» «صغيرا» üzerine atıf; «إلى أجله»: mahzûf bir hâle müteallik, yani vadesi gelinceye kadar zimmette sabit olarak. Bunu «تكتبوه»ya müteallik kılmak caiz değildir, çünkü yazma işi vadesine kadar devam etmez. (ذلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهادَةِ) Cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü tefsîriyyedir. «ذلكم» mübtedâ, «أقسط» haberidir. Dikkat edilirse ism-i tafdîl rubâîden gelmiştir; kıyas ise sülâsîden gelmesidir; çünkü fiil «أقسط»tır, yani adalet etti; sülâsî «قسط» ise «zulmetti» anlamındadır. Allah Teâlâ şöyle buyurmuştur: «وأما القاسطون فكانوا لجهنم حطبا». «عند» mekân zarfı olup «أقسط»a müteallik; lafza-i celâl muzâfun ileyh; «أقوم» «أقسط» üzerine atıf; «للشهادة» «أقوم»a müteallik. Anlam: daha sahih ve daha sağlam. (وَأَدْنى أَلَّا تَرْتابُوا) Vav atıf harfi; «أدنى» «أقوم» üzerine atıf; «أن» ve etki alanındaki kısım masdar te'vilinde olup nez'u'l-hâfıd ile mansûbdur, yani şüphenin ortadan kalkmasına daha yakın; câr ve mecrûr «أدنى»ya müteallik. (إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ تِجارَةً حاضِرَةً) «إلا» istisnâ edatı; «أن» ve etki alanındaki kısım munkatı' istisnâ üzere mansûb masdardır; çünkü bu, şahit tutmaya veya yazmaya ihtiyaç duymayan peşin (hazır) bir ticarettir. Bununla birlikte onu muttasıl istisnâ saymak da sahihtir; sanki ticaretten bir istisnâdır: yazma emri yürürlüktedir ve peşin ticaretle yazma istisnâ edilmiştir. «تكون» muzâri fiil; ismi takdiri «هي» olan müstetir zamirdir, yani ticaret; «تجارة» haberdir. «تكون»u tam sayıp «تجارة»yı fâil kabul etmek de sahihtir; her ikisiyle de okunmuştur. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «بما جميعا» yazılıdır; «بهما جميعا» olmalıdır. Kastedilen, «تجارةً» (nasb) ve «تجارةٌ» (ref') kıraatleridir.] «حاضرة» «تجارة»nın sıfatıdır (na't). (تُدِيرُونَها بَيْنَكُمْ) Cümle «تجارة»nın ikinci sıfatıdır; «بينكم» mekân zarfı olup «تديرونها»ya müteallik. (فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُناحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوها) Fâ atıf harfidir; bu cümleyi «إلا أن تكون تجارة» cümlesine atfetmiştir; yani bundan, yazmamakta günahın kalkması sonucu doğmuştur. «ليس» nâkıs mâzî fiil; «عليكم» önce gelmiş mahzûf habere müteallik; «جناح» sonraya kalmış ismi; «أن» ve etki alanındaki kısım nez'u'l-hâfıd ile mansûb müevvel masdardır, yani «في أن لا تكتبوها» (onu yazmamanızda); câr ve mecrûr «جناح»ın mahzûf sıfatına müteallik. (وَأَشْهِدُوا إِذا تَبايَعْتُمْ) Vav atıf harfi; «أشهدوا» emir fiil, vav fâil; «إذا» şart anlamını içeren gelecek zaman zarfı olup cevaba müteallik; «تبايعتم» cümlesi muzâfun ileyh olarak cer mahallindedir; cevap mahzûftur, takdiri «فأشهدوا»dır. İstersen «إذا»yı şartiyyelikten soyup sadece zaman zarfı kılabilirsin; yani alışveriş vaktinde şahit tutun. (وَلا يُضَارَّ) Vav atıf harfi, «لا» nehiy edatı; «يضار» muzâri fiildir; mâlûm olması muhtemeldir, bu durumda aslı birinci râ'nın kesresiyle «يضارِر»dir; meçhul olması da muhtemeldir, bu durumda aslı onun fethasıyla «يضارَر»dir. Her hâlükârda meczûmdur; muzâaf olduğu için hafifliğinden dolayı fetha ile harekelenmiştir. (كاتِبٌ وَلا شَهِيدٌ) «كاتب» fâil veya nâib-i fâil; vav atıf harfi; «لا» nefy harfi; «شهيد» «كاتب» üzerine atıftır. (وَإِنْ تَفْعَلُوا فَإِنَّهُ فُسُوقٌ بِكُمْ) Vav atıf harfi; «إن» şartiyye; «تفعلوا» fiilü'ş-şart olan meczûm muzâri fiil olup cezm alâmeti nûnun hazfidir. Fâ cevâbü'ş-şartı bağlayıcıdır; «إن» ve ismi; «فسوق» haberi; «بكم» «فسوق»un mahzûf sıfatına müteallik, yani «(size) bitişen». Fâ ile birleşen cümle cevâbü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir. (وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ) Vav atıf harfi; «اتقوا» emir fiil, vav fâil, lafza-i celâl mef'ûlün bih. (وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ اللَّهُ) Vav isti'nâfiyyedir. Celâl'in tespit ettiği ve müfessir ve i'rabcılardan birçoğunun ona uyduğu gibi onu hâliyye kılmaya imkân yoktur; çünkü müsbet muzâriye hâl vavı doğrudan girmez. Bazıları cümle isim cümlesi olsun diye mahzûf bir mübtedâ takdir etmeye çalışmışsa da —yani «وهو يعلمكم»— bunda zorlama vardır. Onu atıf vavı kılmak ise evlâ olanın hilafınadır, çünkü bunda haberin inşâ üzerine atfı işlenmiş olur; bu da bu kitapta yeri geldiğinde gelecek olan ihtilaflı bir konudur. Lafza-i celâl «يعلمكم»un fâili, kâf «يعلمكم»un mef'ûlüdür. (وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ) Vav isti'nâfiyye; «الله» mübtedâ; «بكل شيء» «عليم»e müteallik; «عليم» lafza-i celâlin haberidir.

* Belâgat:
Bu ayet, belki de kulların işlerinin kendisiyle düzene girdiği ve ona uyana güzel bir âkıbet sağlayan geçim işlerini zikretme bakımından en dolu ayetlerdendir. Allah Sübhânehû bu ayette, dinin özü ve direği olan güzel muamele üzerinde ısrarla durmuş, helâl malı korumayı ve onu helâk olmaktan koruyacak şeylerle kuşatmayı tavsiye etmekte son derece ileri gitmiştir. Bu yüzden ayet, aşağıda özetlediğimiz çeşitli te'kidleri ihtiva eder; okuyucunun bilinen kaynaklara başvurmasını kendisine bırakıyoruz.
1- Hataya veya unutkanlığa maruz kalmaktan sakınmak için «فاكتبوه» sözüyle yazmayı emretti.
2- «تداينتم» sözünden anlaşıldığı hâlde te'kid için ve zamir «فليكتبوه» sözüyle ona dönsün diye «بدين»i zikretti [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «فليكتبوه» yazılıdır; ayetteki lafız «فاكتبوه»dur.]; çünkü zikredilmeseydi «فاكتبوا الدين» denmesi gerekirdi ki bunda nazmın güzelliğine halel vardır. Bir de umuma delâlet etsin diye; yani az olsun çok olsun her türlü borç.
3- «إلى أجل مسمى»yı te'kid yoluyla ve vadenin yıl, ay ve günlerle tayin edilerek bilinmesinin vadenin hakkı olduğu bilinsin diye zikretti. Mesela «hasada kadar» deseydi, tayin olmadığı için caiz olmazdı.
4- Yazmayı, adaletle vasıflanmış adil bir kâtibe bağladı.
5- Kendisinden yazması istenen kimsenin, yüklendiği şeyden kaçınmasını yasakladı.
6- Yazma konusunda sıkı davranmak için yazma emrini başka bir sîgayla tekrarladı ve «فليكتب» dedi.
7- Borçlu olana, elinde bir bahane kalmasın diye, kâtibe adaletle yazdırmasını emretti.
8- «وليتق الله ربه» sözüyle ona Allah'tan korkmasını emrederek işi ihtiyat altına aldı.
9- Takvâyı, onun gerektirdiği eksiltmeme («البخس») ile takip etti ve aslî lügat anlamında kör göz için kullanılan bu lafzı kullandı; «بخست عينه» denir, yani gözü kör oldu. Bunda bulunan somutlaştırıcı, canlı tasvir gizli değildir.
10- İnsanlara ârız olabilen usanç ve bıkkınlığa ve bunların doğurduğu ihmale karşı ihtiyat aldı; çünkü o takdirde —şahit oldukları şeyi, büyük olsun küçük olsun, tam yazmadıkları için— kargaşa yaygınlaşır ve bozukluk baş gösterir.
11- Tavsiye ettiklerini tavsiye ettikten sonra bunun en doğru yol ve en âdil tarik olduğuna dikkat çekti ve bilinen akıbeti açıklamak, ihmal edenin ihmalinden ve hakka tecavüz edenin tecavüzünden sakındırmak için «عند الله» diyerek ismini açıkça zikretti.
12- Kalplere korku salmak, nefislerde heybet uyandırmak, hükmü zihinlerde yerleştirmek ve Allah Teâlâ'nın gizliliklere muttali olduğunu, kalplerin fısıltılarının ve vicdanların kıpırtılarının O'ndan gizli kalmadığını hissettirmek için ayeti Allah'ın adını art arda üç kez zikrederek bitirdi.

* Fevâid:
Zemahşerî, Allah Teâlâ'nın «أن تضل إحداهما فتذكر إحداهما الأخرى» sözünü, «أعددت الخشبة أن يميل الحائط فأدعمه» (Duvar eğilirse onu desteklemek için kütüğü hazırladım) ve «أعددت السلاح أن يجيء عدو فأدفعه» (Düşman gelirse onu püskürtmek için silahı hazırladım) sözleriyle misallendirmiştir. Sanki «birinin diğerine hatırlatmasını istemek için» denmiştir. Teftâzânî Keşşâf üzerine haşiyelerinde şöyle sormuştur: «Ele alınması gereken şeylerden biri de 'إحداهما'nın tekrarının sebebidir. Bunun zamir yerine zâhir isim koyma (vaz'u'z-zâhir mevzia'l-mudmer) türünden olmadığında gizlilik yoktur; çünkü (ikinci kez) zikredilen, (önceki ile) uyuşan değildir. Ancak ikinci 'إحداهما' mef'ûl konumunda kılınırsa olur; iltibas olan yerde ise mef'ûlün fâile takdimi caiz değildir. Evet, 'فتذكر الأخرى' demek sahihtir; o hâlde (bundan) vazgeçmenin bir nüktesi olmalıdır.» Teftâzânî nükteye değinmemiş ve okuyucusunu şaşkınlık içinde bırakmıştır. Bununla birlikte Demâmînî Muğnî şerhinde şunu zikretmiştir: Maksat, hatırlatmanın —nasıl takdir edilirse edilsin— birinden diğerine olmasıdır ve bu ancak böyle doğru olur. Görmez misin, «أن تضلّ إحداهما فتذكرها الأخرى» denseydi mef'ûl zamirinin unutana dönmesi gerekirdi; böylece (hatırlatılma) ona taayyün ederdi. Bu ise kastedilen anlamı bozar; çünkü şimdi şahitlikte unutan, başka bir zamanda onu hatırlayan olabilir; o zaman hatırlatan (kişi), (şimdiki) unutan olur. «فتذكرها الأخرى» dendiğinde, zamirin unutana dönmesi taayyün ettiği için bu (anlam) ifade edilmez. «فتذكر إحداهما الأخرى» dendiğinde ise ikisinden her biri için mübhem olur. Biri unutsa da diğeri ona hatırlatsa ve hatırlasa (bu ifadeye) dahil olur; sonra iş tersine dönse —şahitlik aynı olup başka bir vakitte— bu da onun altına girer, çünkü «فتذكر إحداهما الأخرى» sözü belirsiz (gayr-i muayyen) olarak gelmiştir. Böylece «فتذكرها»dan «فتذكر إحداهما الأخرى»ya dönülmesinin sebebi ortaya çıkmış olur.
Bu izahta, bu kitabın kaldıramayacağı bir şey (bir çekince) içimde vardır.

* Lügat:
(الوسع): İnsana yeten ve onu darlığa düşürmeyen şeydir.
(الطاقة): Güç ve kudret. Zâid harfleri hazfedilerek gelmiş bir masdardır; aslı «الإطاقة»dır.
(الإصر): ağır yük. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «العب» yazılıdır; «العبء» olmalıdır.] «أصره» onu alıkoydu demektir; bâbı «ضرب»dir. Bununla kastedilen, bedenin altında ezildiği ve nefsin aciz kaldığı meşakkatli teklifler (yükümlülükler)dir.

* İ'rab:
(لِلَّهِ ما فِي السَّماواتِ وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ) İ'rabdan mahalli olmayan isti'nâfiyye bir sözdür; «والله بما تعلمون عليم» sözüne delil getirmek için sevk edilmiştir [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «تعلمون» yazılıdır; önceki ayetin sonu «بما تعملون عليم»dir.]. «ما» kullanılarak akılsızlar akıllılara tağlîb edilmiştir (galip tutulmuştur), çünkü onlar daha çoktur. Câr ve mecrûr önce gelmiş mahzûf habere müteallik; «ما» ism-i mevsûl olup sonraya kalmış mübtedâ; «في السموات»: câr ve mecrûr, i'rabdan mahalli olmayan mahzûf bir şeye müteallik, çünkü o mevsûlün sılasıdır. «وما في الأرض» «ما في السموات» üzerine atıftır. (وَإِنْ تُبْدُوا ما فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ) Vav isti'nâfiyye; söz isti'nâfiyye olup teklifi açıklamak için sevk edilmiştir. Muâheze, kişinin kaçamayacağı hâtıralarla (خواطر) olur. [Mütercim notu: Metin böyledir; bağlamdan ve aşağıdaki beyitten anlaşıldığı üzere kastedilen, kişinin kaçamayacağı hâtıralarla muâheze olup olmadığı meselesidir; yazar ileride muâhezenin bunlara olmadığını açıkça söyler.] Bazıları kastın mertebelerini şöyle nazmetmiştir:
مراتب القصد خمس: هاجس ذكروا ... وخاطر فحديث النفس فاستمعا
يليه همّ فعزم كلها رفعت ... سوى الأخير ففيه الأخذ قد وقعا
(Kastın mertebeleri beştir: hâcis —böyle zikrettiler—, sonra hâtır, sonra hadîs-i nefs; dinle! Onu hemm, sonra azm takip eder. Sonuncusu hariç hepsi (hesaptan) kaldırılmıştır; muâheze ancak sonuncusunda vâki olmuştur.)
Bunun ayrıntısı geniş eserlerde uzunca anlatılmıştır; dileyen onlara başvursun.
«إن» şartiyye; «تبدوا» fiilü'ş-şart olup cezm alâmeti nûnun hazfidir; vav fâil; cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. «ما» ism-i mevsûl olup mef'ûlün bihtir; «في أنفسكم»: câr ve mecrûr i'rabdan mahalli olmayan mahzûf bir şeye müteallik, çünkü o mevsûlün sılasıdır. (أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ) «تبدوا» üzerine atıf; hâ mef'ûlün bih. (يُحاسِبْكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ) Meczûm cevâbü'ş-şart; kâf bitişik zamir olup mef'ûlün bih olarak nasb mahallindedir; câr ve mecrûr «يحاسبكم»e müteallik; «الله» fâil; cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. (فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشاءُ) Fâ isti'nâfiyye; «يغفر» merfû muzâri fiil, yani «فهو يغفر». Fânın atıf harfi olması ve «يغفر»in «يغفر» üzerine atıf yoluyla meczûm muzâri fiil olması da caizdir [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «بالعطف على يغفر» yazılıdır; kastedilen «يحاسبكم» üzerine atıftır.]. Her iki kıraat de yedi kıraattendir. Ayrıca «أن» gizlenerek nasb ile de okunmuştur; bu durumda bundan, tevehhüm edilen bir şey üzerine ma'tûf merfû bir masdar çıkar; yani «تكن محاسبة فغفران» (bir hesaba çekme, sonra bir bağışlama olur). Nâbiğa ez-Zübyânî'nin şu beyti de buna göre tahrîc edilir:
فإن يهلك أبو قابوس يهلك ... ربيع الناس والشهر الحرام
ونأخذ بعده بذناب عيش ... أجب الظهر ليس له سنام
(Ebû Kâbûs helâk olursa insanların baharı ve haram ay helâk olur; ondan sonra da sırtı kesik, hörgücü olmayan bir hayatın kuyruğuna tutunuruz.)
«نأخذ» cezm, ref' ve nasb ile rivayet edilir. Bununla birlikte Sîbeveyh nasbı zayıf görmüştür; çünkü okuyucu Za'ferânî yedi kurrâdan değildir ve çünkü (söz) mûcebdir (olumlu). [Mütercim notu: Sîbeveyh'in gerekçesinin kıraatin kurrâ-i seb'adan olmamasıyla açıklanması kaynaktaki ifadedir; Sîbeveyh'in değerlendirmesi beyit hakkındadır.] Sîbeveyh'in ibaresinin metni şudur: «وقد يجوز النصب في الواجب في ضرورة الشعر وهو ضعيف في الكلام» (Vâcib [olumlu sözde] nasb, şiir zaruretinde caiz olabilir; ancak nesirde zayıftır). «لمن»: câr ve mecrûr «يغفر»e müteallik; «يشاء» cümlesi sıladır. (وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشاءُ) öncekine atıftır. (وَاللَّهُ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ) Vav isti'nâfiyye; «الله» mübtedâ; «على كل شيء» «قدير»e müteallik; «قدير» lafza-i celâlin haberidir. (آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِما أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ) İsti'nâfiyye bir cümledir; Resûl'ün (s.a.v.), Allah'ın kullara farz kıldığı namaz, zekât, oruç, hac, talâk, îlâ, hayız ve cihad gibi her şeye ve surede zikri geçen peygamber kıssalarına iman ettiğini haber vermek için sevk edilmiştir. «آمن الرسول» fiil ve fâildir; «بما»: câr ve mecrûr «آمن»e müteallik; «أنزل» cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü sıladır; nâib-i fâil takdiri «هو» olan müstetir zamirdir. «إليه»: câr ve mecrûr «أنزل»e müteallik; «من ربه»: câr ve mecrûr yine «أنزل»e müteallik. İstersen bunları mahzûf bir hâle de müteallik kılabilirsin; yani Rabbinden inmiş olarak; çünkü o, insan toplumunun saadetini güvence altına alır. (وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ) Vavın atıf harfi olması ve «المؤمنون»un «الرسول» üzerine atıf olması caizdir; bu durumda vakıf burada olur. Ali b. Ebî Tâlib'in «وآمن المؤمنون» şeklindeki kıraati bu i'rabı destekler; o, fiili açıkça zikretmiştir. Vavın isti'nâfiyye olması ve «المؤمنون»un birinci mübtedâ olması da caizdir. (كُلٌّ آمَنَ) «كل» ikinci mübtedâ; «آمن» cümlesi onun haberidir; isim cümlesi birinci mübtedâ olan «المؤمنون»un haberidir; ikinci vecihte râbıt mahzûftur. Birinci vecihte ise «كل آمن» cümlesi isti'nâfiyye olur. Nekre olduğu hâlde «كل» ile ibtidâ caiz olmuştur, çünkü izâfet niyetindedir; yani «كل واحد منهم» (onlardan her biri); tenvin, hazfedilen kelimeye ivazdır. (بِاللَّهِ وَمَلائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ) Câr ve mecrûr «آمن»e müteallik; sonrası ona atıftır. (لا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ) Bu cümle mahzûf bir kavlin mekûlüdür; kavl cümlesi hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir, yani «لا نفرق» diyerek. «لا» nefy harfi; «نفرق» merfû muzâri fiil; «بين» mekân zarfı olup «نفرق»a müteallik; «أحد» muzâfun ileyh; «من رسله»: câr ve mecrûr «أحد»ın mahzûf sıfatına müteallik. «بين آحاد» denmemiştir, çünkü «أحد» teki ve çoğulu kapsar; Allah Teâlâ'nın «فما منكم من أحد عنه حاجزين» sözünde olduğu gibi; onu çoğul anlamında olduğu için çoğulla vasıflandırmıştır. Bu yüzden «بين» ona girmiştir. Bu kitapta «أحد» hakkında zevkli bir ayrıntı gelecektir. (وَقالُوا سَمِعْنا وَأَطَعْنا) Vav isti'nâfiyye; «قالوا» mâzî fiil, vav fâil; «سمعنا» ve «أطعنا» cümleleri mekûlü'l-kavldir. (غُفْرانَكَ رَبَّنا) Âmili gizlenmiş mef'ûl-i mutlaktır. «غفرانك لا كفرانك» sözleri de bundandır; yani «نستغفرك ولا نكفرك» (Senden bağışlanma dileriz, Sana nankörlük etmeyiz). «ربنا» nidâ harfi hazfedilmiş muzâf münâdâdır. (وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ) Vav atıf harfidir; ma'tûfun aleyh mahzûf olup kavlin kapsamına dahildir; yani «قائلين منك المبدأ وإليك المصير» (Başlangıç Sendendir, dönüş de Sanadır diyerek). «إليك»: câr ve mecrûr önce gelmiş mahzûf habere müteallik; «المصير» sonraya kalmış mübtedâ. (لا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلَّا وُسْعَها) İsti'nâfiyye bir cümledir; nefislerden sıkıntıyı kaldırmak ve muâhezenin güç ve takat dahilindekiyle sınırlı olduğunu açıklamak için sevk edilmiştir; bunun dışındaki nefsin hâtıraları ve hâcisleri için hesaba çekme yoktur. Bununla, bazı müfessirleri meşgul eden müşkil ortadan kalkar; onlar şöyle demişlerdir: Hata ve unutma bağışlanmıştır, onlarla muâheze edilmez; öyleyse bununla dua etmenin anlamı nedir? Bu, neredeyse tahsîl-i hâsıl (var olanı yeniden elde etmek) olur. «لا» nefy harfi; «يكلف» merfû muzâri fiil; «الله» fâili; «نفسا» birinci mef'ûlün bih; «إلا» hasr edatı; «وسعها» ikinci mef'ûlün bihtir. (لَها ما كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْها مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ) Cümle, «وسعها» sözünde mücmel bıraktığını tefsir edicidir; bunun açıklaması Belâgat bölümünde gelecektir. «لها»: câr ve mecrûr önce gelmiş mahzûf habere müteallik; «ما» ism-i mevsûl olup sonraya kalmış mübtedâ; «كسبت» cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü sıladır. «وعليها ما اكتسبت» öncekine atıftır; i'rabı zikredildi. (رَبَّنا لا تُؤاخِذْنا) «ربنا» muzâf münâdâ; «لا» nehiy edatı olup burada dua anlamındadır; «تؤاخذنا» «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiil; «نا» mef'ûlün bih; fâil «أنت». Cümle önceki kavlin kapsamına dahildir; nidâ cümlesi isti'nâfiyyedir.
