The researcher is perplexed and astonished at the case of this noble language: how did it develop? What interactions of time contributed to this development? One who follows its linguistic material marvels at how this dynamic development was prepared for it, one which needs an incalculable span of time. The letters ح and ر originally indicate heat and burning, and if we followed all the other roots we would see that every word beginning with them indicates a meaning almost extracted from this meaning or branching from it.
Let us now survey the root ح-ر-ب: it is burning in every blazing sense; and الحرب with two fatḥas is destruction, which follows from burning and is entailed by it. Abū Tammām said:
لما رأى الحرب رأي العين توفلس ... والحرب مشتقة المعنى من الحرب
(When Tawfalis saw the war with his own eyes... and war is derived in meaning from burning.) [Translator's note: the second hemistich is reproduced as printed in the source, with the two words الحرب (war) and الحرب (spoliation/burning) shown identically.]
And حرث الأرض ("ploughing the land") is splitting it with the ploughshare, and this is related to the original meaning by the closest of connections; الحرج is narrowness; and حرد الرجل, with kasra on the راء, means "the man became angry", so he is حارد and حردان, a colloquial word that is eloquent. And so on to the end of the root, where it ends in this wonderful conclusion.

* I'rab:
(فَتَقَبَّلَها رَبُّها بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ) The فاء is a conjunction; تقبل is a past verb and the هاء a direct object; ربها is the agent; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تقبلها; and حسن is an adjective. (وَأَنْبَتَها نَباتاً حَسَناً) The واو is a conjunction; أنبتها is a verb, a latent agent and a direct object; نباتا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) and حسنا an adjective. (وَكَفَّلَها زَكَرِيَّا) The واو is a conjunction; كفل is a past verb, the هاء is the first direct object and زكريا the second direct object, i.e. "He made Zakariyyā her guardian and guarantor of her welfare"; and in the reading with a light فاء, Zakariyyā is the agent. Legends have been woven around this guardianship; refer to the longer works for them. (كُلَّما دَخَلَ عَلَيْها زَكَرِيَّا الْمِحْرابَ) كلما is an adverbial of time whose i'rab was given many times, attached to وجد because it is the apodosis. The clause دخل عليها is in the position of genitive by the annexation of the adverbial to it, and المحراب is a direct object by way of extension (ʿalā l-ittisāʿ), or accusative by removal of the preposition. (وَجَدَ عِنْدَها رِزْقاً) The clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional; عندها is an adverbial attached to وجد; رزقا is a direct object; and the conditional clause is resumptive. (قالَ يا مَرْيَمُ أَنَّى لَكِ هذا) The clause is resumptive, and this is the soundest of what has been said about it, despite the severe disagreement which is fruitless. قال is a past verb and the agent is "he"; يا is a vocative particle; مريم is a vocative, a single proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma; أنى is an interrogative noun in the sense of كيف, as though a question about manner, i.e. "how was the arrival of this provision to you made possible?" Al-Kumayt said:
أنى ومن أين آبك الطرب ... من حيث لا صبوة ولا طرب
(How, and from where did delight come back to you, from a place where there is neither youthful passion nor delight?)
It is also said that its meaning here is "from where" (من أين). In both cases it is accusative as an adverbial, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; لك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; and هذا is a postponed mubtadaʾ. (قالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ) The clause is resumptive; هو is the mubtadaʾ and من عند الله is attached to an omitted khabar. (إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسابٍ) إن and its noun; the clause يرزق is the khabar; من is a relative noun, a direct object; the clause يشاء has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative; بغير حساب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرزق; and the clause إن الله is also part of the content of what is said, if it is her speech, or else is resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
In this verse are arts to which we point as follows:
1- Jinās mughāyir (paronomasia of differing forms) in His saying «فتقبلها ربها بقبول حسن», in His saying «فأنبتها نباتا حسنا», and in His saying «رزقا» and «يرزق».
2- Ishāra (allusion), which is expressing by an overt word the hidden meaning, in «هو من عند الله», i.e. it is a provision that none but Allah brings at that time.
3- Indefiniteness (tankīr) in His saying «رزقا» to convey commonness and abundance, and that it was not of a single kind but of many kinds.

* Vocabulary:
(أَقْلامَهُمْ) الأقلام is the plural of قلم, which is of the pattern فعل in the sense of مفعول, i.e. "cut" (مقلوم). القلم is cutting; likewise القبض and النقض in the sense of "what is seized" and "what is undone".
(الْمَسِيحُ): a title among the noble titles that suggest eminence, like الصديق and الفاروق. In Hebrew it is المشيح, meaning "the blessed". It is said he was called المسيح because of his much travelling; it is also said because his feet were smooth (masīḥ al-qadamayn) with no arch; and it is also said because whenever he stroked someone afflicted with an infirmity, he was healed.
(عِيسَى): an Arabicised form of Īshūʿ; and it is said to be derived from العيس, which is whiteness with a flush of red above it.

* I'rab:
(ذلِكَ مِنْ أَنْباءِ الْغَيْبِ) ذلك is a demonstrative, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and من أنباء الغيب is its khabar (predicate); the sentence is resumptive, put forward to report that all of that, from the tidings of Zakariyyā, Yaḥyā, Maryam and ʿĪsā, peace be upon them, is of the news of the unseen. (نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ) An imperfect verb whose agent is "We", with the هاء a direct object, and the preposition and its genitive noun attached to نوحيه; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or likewise resumptive. (وَما كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ) The واو is a ḥāl-waw or resumptive; ما is a negative particle; كان and its noun; and لديهم is an adverbial of place attached to an omitted khabar of كنت, i.e.:
"present with them". (إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلامَهُمْ) إذ is an adverbial of past time, and its entering upon the imperfect is to relate a past situation; it is attached to whatever «لديهم» is attached to, namely the omitted "being established". Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī said: the operator in «إذ» is «كنت». That has been objected to on the basis of what he himself established when he said: the defective «كان» is stripped of the indication of the event and left bare for time, so neither the adverbial nor the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to it. The clause يلقون is in the position of genitive by annexation, and أقلامهم is a direct object. (أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ) The clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, by supposing a verb, i.e. "they asked one another"; it is unlikely to make it the agent of an omitted verb because of the artificiality in that, as al-Jalāl did. أي is a mubtadaʾ, the هاء is a muḍāf ilayhi, and the ميم is the sign of the masculine plural; the clause يكفل مريم is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. (وَما كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ) The واو is a conjunction; ما is a negative particle; كان and its noun; لديهم is an adverbial of place attached to an omitted khabar of كنت; إذ is an adverbial of past time attached to the omitted "being established"; and the clause يختصمون is in the position of genitive by annexation. (إِذْ قالَتِ الْمَلائِكَةُ) The adverbial is attached to an omitted element, i.e. "remember"; قالت الملائكة is a verb and an agent, and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation; and the clause of the adverbial and what it is attached to is resumptive, put forward to begin the story of ʿĪsā, peace be upon him. (يا مَرْيَمُ) يا is a vocative particle and مريم a vocative, a single proper noun. (إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ) The clause is the content of what is said; إن and its noun, and the clause يبشرك is its khabar. (بِكَلِمَةٍ) attached to يبشرك. (مِنْهُ) an adjective of كلمة. (اسْمُهُ الْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ) اسمه is a mubtadaʾ and المسيح a khabar, and the clause is a second adjective of كلمة; عيسى is a badal (substitute) for المسيح, and ابن مريم is a badal or an adjective. Maryam is mentioned although she is the one being addressed, to signal that ʿĪsā, peace be upon him, is distinguished by being born without a father, as the custom goes. (وَجِيهاً فِي الدُّنْيا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ) وجيها is a ḥāl from كلمة, even though it is indefinite, because it is qualified; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to وجيها, so they are in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. (وَيُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِي الْمَهْدِ) The واو is a conjunction; يكلم is an imperfect verb and the agent is "he"; the clause is conjoined to «وجيها», so it is also a ḥāl; it turned to the verbal form for renewal; الناس is a direct object; and في المهد is attached to an omitted ḥāl from the agent of «يكلم». (وَكَهْلًا وَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ) Conjoined to His saying «في المهد», i.e. "as a child and as a middle-aged man"; and من الصالحين is conjoined to وجيها, thus completing the four attributes of «كلمة».

* Rhetoric:
Kināya (metonymy) in His saying: «يلقون أقلامهم» for casting lots.

* Benefits:
(إِذْ) occurs in three ways:
2- It is for causation, and this is a particle in the position of the لام of causation, as in the saying of al-Farazdaq:
... after it an imperfect verb, so it is for relating a past situation.
[Translator's note: the source prints the numbering as "2-", then a fragment, then "2-" again; the first item (apparently إذ as an adverbial of time) is missing from the printed text, and only the fragment "after it an imperfect verb, so it relates the past situation" survives. The text is rendered in the order printed.]
2- It is for causation, and this is a particle in the position of the لام of causation, as in the saying of al-Farazdaq:
فأصبحوا قد أعاد الله نعمتهم ... إذ هم قريش وإذ ما مثلهم بشر
(They found that Allah had restored their favour, since they are Quraysh, and since there is no man like them.)
Adverbial sense is here stripped away and is in no way sound, because the meaning would be spoiled, i.e. "Allah restored their favour at the time of their being Quraysh", which would mean that their being of Quraysh is something that befell them incidentally.
3- It is for surprise (mufājaʾa), and this is the one occurring after «بينا» and «بينما», as in his saying:
استقدر الله خيرا وارضين به ... فبينما العسر إذ دارت مياسير
(Ask Allah to decree good, and be content with it; for while hardship was there, behold, ease came round.)
And then it is preferable that it be a particle.
(أي) occurs in five ways:
1- A jussive-governing conditional noun, parsed according to its position.
2- A relative noun, parsed according to its position, except when it is annexed and the beginning of its ṣila is omitted, in which case it is indeclinable on the ḍamma: «ثم لننزعن من كل شيعة أيهم أشد على الرحمن عتيا».
3- An interrogative noun, as in the preceding verse, and its ruling is that of the relative.
4- It occurs as an adjective of an indefinite noun or as a ḥāl after a definite noun, to indicate the meaning of completeness and perfection, as in the saying of Abū l-ʿAtāhiya:
إن الشباب والفراغ والجده ... مفسدة للمرء أيّ مفسدة
(Youth, leisure and wealth are a corruption to a man, and what a corruption!)
5- It serves as a means to the vocative of what has «ال»: يا أيها الناس.
(العلم) The proper name (ʿalam) is divided into ism (given name), kunya and laqab (title). When the ism and the laqab are combined, the laqab is put after the ism, and perhaps it is put before it, as in the verse. This is regular when the laqab is better known than the ism; there is no ordering in the kunya. The second is parsed as a badal of the first, and it is permissible to annex the laqab to the ism if they are both single words, like هرون الرشيد and محمد المهديّ.

* Lügat:
(الأكمه): Kör doğan kimse. «كمه كمها», «تعب» bâbından denir; o «أكمه», kadın ise «كمهاء»dır; «أحمر» ve «حمراء» gibi. Bu, insanın üzerinde doğduğu körlüktür; bazen sonradan arız olan (körlük) da olabilir.
(الأبرص): İki fetha ile «البرص» hastalığına tutulmuş kimse. Bu, insana arız olan bilinen bir hastalıktır. Araplar hiçbir şeyden ondan nefret ettikleri kadar nefret etmezlerdi. Bu yüzden büyük bir kişi buna yakalanınca onu «الوضّاح» (parlak, ak) diye vasfederlerdi; «جذيمة الوضاح» demişlerdir; o meşhur Arap krallarındandır. Ay'a, beyazlığının şiddetinden dolayı «أبرص» denir; keler (alacakertenkele) için de beyazlığından dolayı «سام أبرص» denir.

* İ'rab:
(قالَتْ: رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٌ) İ'rabı az önce harfi harfine geçti; onu yeniden hatırla.
(وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ) Vâv hâl içindir; «لم» nefy, kalb ve cezm harfidir; «يمسسني» «لم» ile meczûm muzâri fiildir; nûn vikâye için, yâ mef'ûlün bihtir; «بشر» fâildir. Cümle hâliyyedir.
(قالَ كَذلِكِ اللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ ما يَشاءُ) Cümle isti'nâfiyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. Câr ve mecrûr, mahzûf bir fiilin mef'ûl-i mutlakı olan mahzûf bir şeye mütealliktir veya hâldir. Bazıları onları mahzûf bir mübtedânın mahzûf haberine müteallik kılmıştır. «الله» mübtedâdır; «يخلق» cümlesi haberdir; «ما» mef'ûlün bih olan ism-i mevsûldür; «يشاء» cümlesi mevsûlün sılası olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. «الله يخلق» cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavldir.
(إِذا قَضى أَمْراً) «إذا» istikbâl zarfıdır; «قضى» cümlesi izafetle cer mahallindedir; «أمرا» mef'ûlün bihtir.
(فَإِنَّما يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ) Fâ «إذا»nın cevabı için râbıtadır. «إنما يقول» cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır. «له» «يقول»e mütealliktir. «كن» tam emir fiildir; cümle mekûlü'l-kavldir. Fâ isti'nâfiyyedir; «يكون» damme ile merfû tam muzâri fiildir, fâil «هو»dur. Cümle mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberidir; yani «فهو يكون»; cümle isti'nâfiyyedir. Bu, Sîbeveyh'in görüşüdür ve sahih olan budur. İbn Âmir «فيكون»u fâ'nın sebebiyye olması üzere nasb ile okumuştur. Bu kıraate göre müşkil olan şudur: Bu durumda istikbâl [manası] bununla ondan soyulmuş olur.
(وَيُعَلِّمُهُ الْكِتابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالتَّوْراةَ وَالْإِنْجِيلَ) Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; onu «وجيها»ya atfedebilirsin; sanki «وجيها ومعلما» (itibarlı ve öğretici) demiş gibidir. «ونعلمه» şeklinde de okunmuştur; bu durumda cümle mahzûf bir kavlin mekûlü olur; çünkü Allah'ın sözünden olur. «يعلمه» muzâri fiil, müstetir fâil ve birinci mef'ûlün bihtir; «الكتاب» ikinci mef'ûlün bihtir; sonrakiler ona ma'tûftur (nesak yoluyla).
(وَرَسُولًا إِلى بَنِي إِسْرائِيلَ) Vâv atıf harfidir; «رسولا» mahzûf bir fiilin mef'ûlün bihidir; yani «ويجعله رسولا» (onu bir resul kılar); yani gaybî şeyleri haber verme babındandır. Zemahşerî ve başkaları «رسولا»nın hâl olarak i'rab edilmesini caiz görmüşlerdir; sanki onu mana bakımından «يعلمه»e atfetmiştir. «إلى بني إسرائيل» «رسولا» için mahzûf bir sıfata mütealliktir.
(أَنِّي قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِآيَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ) «أن» ve etki alanındaki şey, nez'u'l-hâfıd ile mansûb bir müevvel masdardır; yani «بأني قد جئتكم». Bunun «أنّ» ve «أن»den önce muttarid (yaygın, kıyasî) olduğu daha önce söylenmişti. Câr ve mecrûr «رسولا»ya mütealliktir; çünkü o, konuşma manasını tazammun etmiştir; yani «ve: Size gerçekten geldim, diye konuşan bir resul olarak». Bu ifadelerde tevil çoğalmıştır; bu yüzden Zemahşerî bunu i'câz gösteren dar geçitlerden (müşkil yerlerden) saymıştır. Bâ'nın mülâbese için olduğu ve girdiği kelimeyle birlikte hâl olarak nasb mahallinde bulunduğu da söylenmiştir; mana: «Ben, ayetleri getirmemle mülâbis (birlikte) olduğum hâlde size Allah'ın resulüyüm». «قد جئتكم» cümlesi «أن»nin haberidir; «بآية» «جئتكم»e mütealliktir; «من ربكم» «آية» için mahzûf bir sıfata mütealliktir.
(أَنِّي أَخْلُقُ لَكُمْ مِنَ الطِّينِ كَهَيْئَةِ الطَّيْرِ) «أن» ve etki alanındaki şey, «آية»den bedel olan müevvel masdardır; çünkü onun yaptığı şey, onun göz kamaştırıcı ayetlerinin delillerinden olmaktan öte değildir. Onu takdiri «هي» olan mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberi de yapabilirsin; mana aynıdır. Bir kıraatte «إن»nin hemzesi kesreli okunmuştur; bu durumda «إن» ve sonrası isti'nâfiyye olur. «أخلق» cümlesi inne'nin haberidir. «لكم», ta'lîl manası üzere, yani «sizin hidayetiniz için», veya hâl manası üzere, yani «size hidayet edici olarak», nasb mahallinde mahzûf bir şeye mütealliktir. «من الطين» «أخلق»a mütealliktir. «كهيئة»: Kâf «مثل» manasında isimdir; bu durumda mef'ûlün bih olarak nasb mahallindedir. Ya da harftir; bu durumda o ve sonrası mahzûf bir mef'ûlün bihin sıfatı olarak nasb mahallindedir; yani «kuşun şekli gibi bir şey». [Kâf] isim ise «هيئة» muzâfun ileyhtir. «الطير» de «هيئة»ye muzâfun ileyhtir. [Mütercim notu: Metinde «والطير مضاف مضاف إلى هيئة» yazılıdır; kastın «مضاف إليه» olduğu anlaşılmaktadır.]
(فَأَنْفُخُ فِيهِ) Fâ atıf harfidir; «أنفخ» «أخلق»a ma'tûftur; câr ve mecrûr «أنفخ»a mütealliktir.
(فَيَكُونُ طَيْراً بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ) Fâ atıf harfidir; «يكون» «أخلق»a ma'tûf nâkıs muzâri fiildir; «طيرا» «يكون»un haberidir, ismi müstetirdir. «بإذن الله», câr ve mecrûrun ve zarfın nâkıs fiillere müteallik olmasını caiz görenlerin görüşüne göre «يكون»a mütealliktir; veya mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir. Birincisi manaya daha yakındır.
(وَأُبْرِئُ الْأَكْمَهَ وَالْأَبْرَصَ) «أخلق»a atıftır; «الأكمه» mef'ûlün bihtir.
(وَأُحْيِ الْمَوْتى بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ) Bu da öncekine atıftır; «بإذن الله» «أحيي»ye mütealliktir.
(وَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِما تَأْكُلُونَ) Bu da atıftır; câr ve mecrûr «أنبئكم»e mütealliktir ve iki mef'ûlün yerini tutmuştur. «تأكلون» cümlesi mevsûlün sılası olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
(وَما تَدَّخِرُونَ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ) Vâv atıf harfidir; «ما», önceki «ما»ya atıftır; «تدخرون» cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; «في بيوتكم» câr ve mecrûr olup «تدخرون»a mütealliktir.
(إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآيَةً لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ) «إن» fiile benzeyen harftir; «في ذلك» câr ve mecrûr olup «إن»nin mahzûf mukaddem haberine mütealliktir. Lâm müzahlaka lâmıdır; «آية» onun muahhar ismidir; «لكم» câr ve mecrûr olup «آية» için mahzûf bir sıfata mütealliktir. «إن» ve etki alanındaki cümle, ya Îsâ'nın (a.s.) sözündendir, bu durumda kavlin etki alanına dâhildir; ya da Allah Teâlâ'nın sözünden olma ihtimali vardır, bu durumda isti'nâfiyyedir. «إن» şartiyyedir; «كنتم» fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir; «كان» nâkıs mâzî fiildir, tâ ismi, «مؤمنين» haberidir. Cevâbü'ş-şart mahzûftur; takdiri: «Eğer mü'min iseniz bu ayetten faydalanırsınız.» Şart cümlesi isti'nâfiyyedir.
(وَمُصَدِّقاً لِما بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْراةِ) Vâv atıf harfidir; «مصدقا» mahzûf bir fiilden hâldir; yani «وجئتكم مصدقا» (ve size tasdik edici olarak geldim). Ya da onu «بآية»nın mahalline atfedersin. «لما»: lâm cer harfidir; «ما» lâm ile mecrûr ism-i mevsûldür; câr ve mecrûr «مصدقا»ya mütealliktir. «بين», «ما»nın sılası olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli olmayan mahzûf bir şeye müteallik zarftır. «يديّ» muzâfun ileyhtir, cer alâmeti yâdır, çünkü tesniyedir; yâ [-i mütekellim] muzâfun ileyhtir. «من التوراة» câr ve mecrûr olup mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir.
(وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِي حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ) Vâv atıf harfidir; lâm ta'lîl içindir; «أحلّ», ta'lîl lâmından sonra caiz olarak gizlenmiş «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir. Lâm ve girdiği kelime takdir edilen «جئتكم»e mütealliktir. Onu «مصدقا»ya atfetmek caiz değildir; çünkü o hâldir, «لأحل» ise ta'lîldir. «لكم» câr ve mecrûr olup «أحل»e mütealliktir; «بعض» mef'ûlün bihtir; «الذي» muzâfun ileyh olan ism-i mevsûldür; «حرم عليكم» cümlesi mevsûlün sılası olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
(وَجِئْتُكُمْ بِآيَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ) Vâv atıf harfidir; «جئتكم» cümlesi önceki «جئتكم»e atıftır ve te'kîd için tekrarlanmıştır. «بآية» câr ve mecrûr olup mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir; bâ mülâbese içindir; mana: «Ben, gelişimle mülâbis olduğum hâlde size resulüm». Onu «جئتكم»e de müteallik kılabilirsin. «من ربكم» câr ve mecrûr olup «آية» için mahzûf bir sıfata mütealliktir.
(فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ) Fâ fasîhadır; yani «Size lütfettiğim bu göz kamaştırıcı nimetlerden sonra Allah'a itaatte gevşekliğe kapılmanızın size yakışmayacağını bildiğinize göre Allah'tan korkun». «اتقوا» nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir; vâv fâildir. «أطيعون» «اتقوا»ya atıftır; mütekellim yâsı fâsılalara riayet için hazfedilmiştir.

* Vocabulary:
(وَجْهَ النَّهارِ): its beginning. The face (al-wajh) is called wajh because it is the first thing of a person that appears to whoever sees him. The poet said:
من كان مسرورا بمقتل مالك ... فليأت نسوتنا بوجه نهار
(Whoever is glad at the killing of Mālik, let him come to our women at the face [i.e. the beginning] of the day.)
And he said:
وتضيء في وجه الظلام منيرة ... كجمانة البحري سلّ نظامها
(She shines in the face of the darkness, radiant, like the pearl of the diver whose string has been drawn out.)

* I'rab:
(وَقالَتْ طائِفَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتابِ): the wāw is resumptive and the clause is resumptive, brought to speak about another kind of the Jews' deceptions. Twelve rabbis of the Jews of Khaybar conspired, and some of them said to others: "Enter the religion of Muḥammad at the beginning of the day with the tongue, without belief in the heart, then disbelieve at the end of the day, to bring doubt into the breasts of Muḥammad's Companions; perhaps that will lead to their turning back from their religion." قالت is a past verb, طائفة is the fāʿil (agent), and من أهل الكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of طائفة. (آمِنُوا بِالَّذِي أُنْزِلَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا): the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). آمنوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; بالذي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آمنوا; the clause أنزل is the ṣila (relative clause); أنزل is a past verb in the passive, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "it" (هو); على الذين آمنوا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل, and the clause آمنوا is a ṣila. (وَجْهَ النَّهارِ): an adverb of time attached to آمنوا. (وَاكْفُرُوا آخِرَهُ): the wāw is a conjunction; اكفروا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, conjoined to آمنوا; آخره is an adverb of time attached to اكفروا. (لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ): the clause of hope is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "hoping for their turning back from their religion". لعلّ and its noun, and the clause يرجعون is its khabar (predicate). Then He followed it with the rest of their saying, so it falls within its scope. (وَلا تُؤْمِنُوا إِلَّا لِمَنْ تَبِعَ دِينَكُمْ): the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive; تؤمنوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil; إلا is a particle of exception. لمن: the lām is a preposition and من is a relative noun in the position of a genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of an accusative by exception from something omitted, implied as: "Do not believe — i.e. acknowledge and make known — that anyone is given the like of what you were given, to anyone of the people, except to your partisans, not others." تبع is a past verb and its fāʿil is "he"; the verbal clause is the ṣila, and دينكم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (قُلْ: إِنَّ الْهُدى هُدَى اللَّهِ): the clause made up of قل and what is said — namely إنّ with its noun and its khabar — has no grammatical position because it is parenthetical. (أَنْ يُؤْتى أَحَدٌ مِثْلَ ما أُوتِيتُمْ): أن and what is within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تؤمنوا. أحد is the nāʾib fāʿil of يؤتى and مثل is the second object; ما is a relative noun in the position of a genitive by annexation, and the clause أوتيتم is the ṣila. (أَوْ يُحاجُّوكُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ): أو is a conjunction; يحاجوكم is an imperfect verb conjoined to يؤتى, and the sign of its accusative is the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi; عند is an adverb of place attached to an omitted ḥāl, and ربكم is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (قُلْ إِنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ): قل is an imperative verb and its fāʿil is "you"; إنّ and its noun, and بيد الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; إنّ and what is within its scope form a nominal clause in the position of an accusative as the maqūl al-qawl. (يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشاءُ): the clause يؤتيه is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl. يؤتي is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil is "he"; the hāʾ is the first object of يؤتي; من is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as the second object of يؤتي, and the clause يشاء is the ṣila. (وَاللَّهُ واسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ): the wāw is resumptive; الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject), واسع a first khabar and عليم a second khabar. (يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِ مَنْ يَشاءُ): the clause is a third khabar. يختص is an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil is "he", i.e. Allah the Exalted; برحمته is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يختص; من is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause يشاء has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative. (وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ): the wāw is a conjunction; الله is a mubtadaʾ and ذو الفضل is the khabar, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw in place of the ḍamma because it is one of the five nouns; الفضل is a muḍāf ilayhi and العظيم is a naʿt of الفضل.

* Benefits:
There has been much discussion of this verse and disagreement over its i'rab and its explanation; some parsers brought the possible analyses in it to nine, without arriving at a decisive one free of objections.

What al-Wāḥidī says:
Al-Wāḥidī, one of the great scholars occupied with questions of i'rab, said: «This verse is among the difficult passages of the Qur'an, and the hardest of it in i'rab and interpretation. I have reflected on the statements of the people of tafsīr and of [the books of] maʿānī on this verse, and I did not find a view that runs consistently through the verse from its beginning to its end while explaining the meaning and keeping the construction sound.»

What al-Shihāb al-Ḥalabī says:
Al-Shihāb al-Ḥalabī, known as al-Samīn, said: «Know that people, the exegetes and the parsers have differed on this verse in several ways.» Al-Samīn mentioned the nine analyses. Since our book aims at what is easiest, closest to reason and furthest from artificiality, we have confined ourselves in the I'rab section to what we presented there, and we considered it closest to what we aimed at; al-Zamakhsharī chose it in his Kashshāf. But we consider it useful to record what Abū Ḥayyān said, and then follow it with what Ibn Hishām said.

What Abū Ḥayyān says:
Abū Ḥayyān al-Andalusī said in his tafsīr al-Baḥr al-Muḥīṭ, after a long discussion:
«The statement admits several readings:
1- That the meaning is: Do not give true credence and belief except to one who comes with the like of your religion, for fear that anyone be given of prophethood and honour the like of what you were given, and for fear that they argue against you, by your having believed them, before their Lord [Translator's note: so in the source, «ربهم»] if they did not persist in it. This statement, on this meaning, is the fruit of envy and disbelief despite knowing the truth of the prophethood of Muḥammad ﷺ.
2- That the implied form is أن لا يؤتى, with لا omitted because the speech indicates it; and that this [negated content] falls within the scope of إلا, not being implied as entering before it. The meaning is: Do not believe anyone in anything except one who follows your religion, by virtue of the negation of anyone's being given the like of what you were given, and the negation of their arguing against you before your Lord — i.e. except with the negation of such-and-such.
3- That the implied form is بأن يؤتى, attached to تؤمنوا, and not falling within the scope of إلا. The meaning is: Do not believe that anyone is given the like of what you were given, except one who follows your religion, comes with its like and supports it, for that is not given to anyone other than you. And the meaning of أو يحاجوكم عند ربكم is "unless they argue against you", as you say: "I will not leave you or [i.e. unless] you pay me my due." This statement, on this meaning, is the fruit of their denying Muḥammad ﷺ, out of their belief that prophethood is only among the Children of Israel.
4- That the meaning is: Do not believe in Muḥammad and acknowledge his prophethood — since you have known its truth — except to the Jews who are of you; and أن يؤتى أحد مثلما أوتيتم is a description of the state of Muḥammad ﷺ. So the meaning is: conceal your acknowledgement that someone has been given the like of what you were given; or [else], for they — meaning the Arabs — will argue against you with the acknowledgement before your Lord.»
By my life, Abū Ḥayyān did excellently, but he confined himself to giving the meaning stripped of the i'rab.

What Ibn Hishām says:
Ibn Hishām said, in the course of his discussion of clauses: «The parenthetical clause is often confused with the circumstantial clause, and several things distinguish it from it. One of them is that it is non-declarative, like the imperative clause in «ولا تؤمنوا إلا لمن تبع دينكم قل: إن الهدى هدى الله أن يؤتى أحد مثلما أوتيتم». So Ibn Mālik and others gave it as an example, on the basis that «أن يؤتى أحد» is attached to تؤمنوا, and that the meaning is: Do not make known your belief that anyone is given of the books of Allah the like of what you were given, and that that "anyone" will argue against you before Allah the Exalted on the Day of Resurrection with the truth and overcome you — except to the people of your religion, because that does not change their belief, unlike the Muslims, for that would increase them in steadfastness, and unlike the polytheists, for that would call them to Islam. The meaning of the parenthesis, then, is that guidance is in the hand of Allah, so if He decrees it for someone, their scheming will not harm him. The verse also admits another reading, namely that the speech is complete at the exception, and what is meant is: Do not make known the false faith [Translator's note: the source reads «لا تظهروا والإيمان», apparently with an extra wāw] which you profess at the beginning of the day and break at its end except to those who were of you, like ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām, and then became Muslim; that is because their Islam was more vexing to them, and their return [Translator's note: the source has «رجوهم», apparently for رجوعهم] to disbelief was nearer in their view. On this reading «أن يؤتى» is from the speech of Allah the Exalted, and it is attached to something omitted and postponed, i.e.: out of dislike that anyone be given [the like], you contrived this plot.
This reading is preferable for two reasons. First, it agrees with the reading of Ibn Kathīr: أأن يؤتى with two hamzas, i.e.: "out of dislike that anyone be given, you said that". Second, in the first reading what precedes إلا governs what follows it, although it is not one of the three cases mentioned just before. The second of the things that distinguish it is [that the parenthetical clause may be] a supplication, as in the saying of ʿAwf ibn Muḥallim:
إن الثمانين، وبلغتها ... قد أحوجت سمعي إلى ترجمان
(Eighty years — and may you reach them — have made my hearing need an interpreter.)
or a declaration of transcendence, as in His saying, Exalted is He: «ويجعلون لله البنات، سبحانه، ولهم ما يشتهون», or an interrogative, as in His saying, Exalted is He: «فاستغفروا لذنوبهم، ومن يغفر الذنوب إلا الله ولم يصروا»» — to the end of this «البحث الممتنع» (the refractory discussion) which the dry style has muddied. [Translator's note: so in the source, «الممتنع»; the context may suggest «الممتع» ("delightful").]

What al-Zamakhsharī says:
We cannot avoid mentioning the words of al-Zamakhsharī, which came in support of what we adopted in the i'rab. He said: «ولا تؤمنوا is connected to His saying أن يؤتى أحد, and what is between them is a parenthesis; i.e. do not make known your belief that anyone is given the like of what you were given except to the people of your religion, not others. They meant: keep secret your belief that the Muslims have been given the like of what you were given, and do not divulge it except to your partisans alone, not to the Muslims, lest it increase them in steadfastness, and not to the polytheists, lest it call them to Islam. أو يحاجوكم به عند ربكم is conjoined to أن يؤتى, and the pronoun in يحاجوكم is for أحد, because it has a plural meaning; [i.e.] and do not believe, [confiding it] to anyone but your followers, that the Muslims will argue against you on the Day of Resurrection with the truth and overcome you before Allah with the proof.»
We have almost gone beyond the condition of the book in summarising the views, so what we have presented is enough for us. Perhaps one of the scholars was right when he determined that this verse is the most difficult of the verses of these sūras, and the speech of Allah is greater, and the depth of our Arabic language is farther and deeper than can be fathomed.

* Vocabulary:
(دينار): the dīnār is a kind of ancient gold coin; the plural is danānīr. Its origin is dinnār, with two nūns; the succession of two like letters was felt heavy, so they replaced the first of them with a weak letter for lightness, because of its frequent circulation in use. What shows this is its return to the two nūns when it is given a broken plural or a diminutive, so they said: danānīr and dunaynīr.
(الْأُمِّيِّينَ): plural of ummī; what is meant here is one who is not of the People of the Book. It is well known that the Jews held the blood, property and honour of the Arabs to be lawful.

* I'rab:
(وَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتابِ): a resumptive clause, brought to begin explaining their treachery in property after explaining their treachery in religion. The wāw is resumptive, and من أهل الكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (مَنْ إِنْ تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنْطارٍ يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ): من is a relative noun, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); you may also parse it as an indefinite qualified noun, i.e. "people", and it is a postponed mubtadaʾ. إن is conditional; تأمنه is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "you"; بقنطار is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تأمنه. يؤده is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤده. The conditional clause and its apodosis are either the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, if من is a relative, or its naʿt (adjective), in the position of a nominative, if من is an indefinite qualified noun. (وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ إِنْ تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينارٍ لا يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ): conjoined to the previous clause; its i'rab preceded word for word. (إِلَّا ما دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قائِماً): إلا is a particle of restriction; ما دمت is an incomplete past verb, the tāʾ is its noun and قائما its khabar; عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «قائما». The exception is "emptied" (mufarragh) from the general adverb, so it is an adverb. (ذلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قالُوا): a resumptive clause, brought to explain their treating the property of the Arabs as lawful. The demonstrative is in the position of a nominative as a mubtadaʾ; the bāʾ is a preposition; أنّ and what follows it are in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar; the clause قالوا is the khabar of إنّ [Translator's note: so in the source; أنّ is meant]. (لَيْسَ عَلَيْنا فِي الْأُمِّيِّينَ سَبِيلٌ): the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl). ليس is an incomplete past verb; علينا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to something omitted, in the position of an accusative as the fronted khabar of ليس; في الأميين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); سبيل is the postponed noun of ليس. (وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ): the wāw is resumptive; يقولون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يقولون; الكذب is a mafʿūl bihi by way of taḍmīn (implied meaning), so that the meaning of يقولون is "they fabricate". It is better to parse it as a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), that maṣdar being a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "the lying saying". (وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ): the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as a mubtadaʾ, and the clause يعلمون is the khabar.

* Benefits:
(ما دام) is one of the sisters of kāna, and the condition for it to operate is that it be preceded by the adverbial, maṣdar-forming «ما». So if you say: لا أكلمك ما دام زيد قاعدا ("I will not speak to you as long as Zayd is sitting"), what is meant is the time of the continuance of his sitting. The «ما» in your saying ما دام is necessary and cannot be dispensed with, and the verb with it can only be past. ما زال is not like that: another negative particle may take the place of «ما», and the verb with the negative may be past or imperfect, as in ما زال, لم يزل and لا يزال. The root meaning of «دام» is stillness and fixity; one says: دام الماء, i.e. the water became still, and دوّمت الشمس when the sun stands still in the middle of the sky.

* Lügat:
(العض): Dişlerin birbirine bastırılmasıdır. «عضه بأسنانه» dişleriyle onu tuttu demektir. Dâd kesreli olarak «عضضت أعض عضا وعضيضا» denir. «العض» kelimesi her yerde dâd iledir; ancak zaman ve benzeri ile kullanıldığında müstesnadır: «عظ الزمان» yani zaman şiddetlendi, «عظت الحرب» yani savaş şiddetlendi derler; bu ikisinde (dâd ile zâ) birbirinin yerine kullanılır. Ayn ve dâd, kelimenin fâ ve ayn harfi olduklarında garip bir özelliğe sahiptir: Bu ikisi şiddet, eziyet ve bunların anlamına giren şeyleri ifade eder. Ahtal şöyle demiştir:
ضجوا من الحرب إذ عضت غواربهم ... وقيس عيلان من أخلاقها الضجر
(Savaş omuzlarını ısırınca ondan bıkıp feryat ettiler; bıkkınlık zaten Kays Aylân'ın huylarındandır.)
«العضب» sövmek ve kesmektir; bu ikisinde şiddet ve eziyet olduğu açıktır. «سيف عضب» keskin kılıç; «شاة عضباء» boynuzu kırık koyun demektir. «عضده» ona arka çıktı ve yardım etti demektir; mü'min Allah'ın tevfîkiyle desteklenmiştir (معضود). Allah Teâlâ şöyle buyurmuştur: «سنشد عضدك بأخيك». «داء معضل» çözülmez zor hastalıktır; «به مرض عضال» onda doktorları aciz bırakıp çaresiz koyan (أعضلهم) müzmin bir hastalık var demektir; «أعضل الأمر» iş çetinleşti demektir. Zü'l-İsba' evlenmiş, kabilesine gelip onun mehrini istemiş, onlar da vermemişler; bunun üzerine şöyle demiştir:
واحدة أعضلكم أمرها ... فكيف لو درت على أربع
(Bir tanesinin işi sizi aciz bıraktı; ya (o iş) dört kadına dönseydi, nasıl olurdu?)
«فلان عضلة من العضل» falan, belalardan bir beladır demektir. Bu, bu şerefli dil hakkında işitilen en şaşırtıcı şeylerdendir.
(الْأَنامِلَ): «أنملة»nin çoğuludur; parmağın ucudur.

* İ'rab:
(ها أَنْتُمْ أُولاءِ تُحِبُّونَهُمْ وَلا يُحِبُّونَكُمْ): Mü'minleri yahudileri dost edinmekteki hatalarına dikkat çekmek için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye bir cümledir. «ها» tenbîh ve uyarı (kur'u'l-asâ) içindir; «أنتم» mübtedâ, «أولاء» haberidir. Daha önce geçtiği üzere, tenbîh için olan «ها» bulunduğundan ism-i işaretin zikredilmesi gerekir. «تحبونهم» cümlesi hâliyyedir veya isti'nâfiyyedir; sanki onların hatalarını ve samimi dost seçimlerindeki kötülüğü açıklama mesabesindedir. «ولا يحبونكم» cümlesi «تحبونهم» cümlesine ma'tûftur. Celâl (Celâleyn) ve başkaları «أولاء»yı münâdâ olarak i'rab etmişlerdir, yani «يا هؤلاء»; bu durumda «تحبونهم» cümlesi haber olur.
(وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْكِتابِ كُلِّهِ): Vavın atıf harfi olması sahihtir; bu durumda cümle «تحبونهم» cümlesine ma'tûf olur. Vavın hâliyye olması da sahihtir; bu durumda cümle hâl olarak nasb mahallinde olur. «بالكتاب» câr ve mecrûr olup «تؤمنون»a müteallik olur; «كله» «الكتاب»ın te'kîdidir. Bunda onları kınamanın son haddi vardır; zira seni sevmeyen kimseyle samimi olmak kınamayı ve azarı gerektiren bir iştir. Ebû Hayyân vavın hâliyye olmasını kabul etmemiştir; çünkü müsbet muzâri hâl olarak geldiğinde ona hâl vavı girmez; «جاء زيد يضحك» dersin, «ويضحك» demek caiz değildir. Sonunda şu söze varmıştır: «Fakat evlâ olan, bizim zikrettiğimiz gibi atıf için olmasıdır.»
(وَإِذا لَقُوكُمْ قالُوا آمَنَّا): Vav isti'nâfiyyedir; «إذا» şart anlamını tazammun eden, gelecek zaman için bir zarftır; «لقوكم» cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir; «قالوا» cümlesi cezmetmeyen şartın cevabı olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; «آمنا» cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir.
(وَإِذا خَلَوْا عَضُّوا عَلَيْكُمُ الْأَنامِلَ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ): Vav atıf harfidir; «إذا» gelecek zaman için bir zarftır; «خلوا» cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir. «خلا», iki sakinin bir araya gelmesi sebebiyle hazfedilen elif üzerinde takdîrî fetha üzere mebnî mâzî fiildir; vav bitişik zamir olup fâil olarak ref' mahallindedir. «عضوا» cümlesi cezmetmeyen şartın cevabı olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. «عليكم» câr ve mecrûr olup «عضوا»ya müteallik olur; «الأنامل» mef'ûlün bihtir; «من الغيظ» câr ve mecrûr olup temyîz olarak nasb mahallindedir, yani «غيظا». (Buradaki «من»in) lâm anlamında olup illet ifade etmesi de caizdir; bu durumda câr ve mecrûr mef'ûlün lieclih olarak nasb mahallinde olur, yani «öfke sebebiyle».
(قُلْ مُوتُوا بِغَيْظِكُمْ): Cümle isti'nâfiyyedir; «موتوا» cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir; «بغيظكم» câr ve mecrûr olup hâl olarak mansûb mahzûf bir kelimeye müteallik olur, yani «öfkenize bürünmüş olarak». [Mütercim notu: Metinde takdir «متلبسين يغيظكم» şeklinde yazılmıştır; doğrusu «متلبسين بغيظكم» olmalıdır.]
(إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ بِذاتِ الصُّدُورِ): Ölüm emrinin ta'lîlini ifade eden isti'nâfiyye bir cümledir. Daha kolay olanı, söylenen sözün (mekûl) bir parçası olmasıdır; bu durumda «قول» ile nasb mahallinde olur. «إن», ismi ve haberi; «بذات الصدور» câr ve mecrûr olup «عليم»e müteallik olur. «ذات الصدور»un anlamı, gizlenen şeyler ve nefislerin iç kıpırtılarıdır. «ذات», «ذي»nin müennesidir; «göğüslerin sahibi» anlamındadır; göğüslerden ayrılmadıkları için onlara «göğüslerin sahibi» denmiştir.

* Belâgat:
1- Bu âyette kinâye sanatı vardır; parmak uçlarını ısırmak sıfattan kinâyedir. Araplar, yaptığına pişman olan öfkeli kişiyi parmak uçlarını ve parmaklarını ısırmakla ifade etmeyi âdet edinmişlerdir; şiirleri bu ifadeyle doludur. Ebû Tâlib şöyle demiştir:
وقد صالحوا قوما علينا أشحة ... يعضون عضا خلفنا بالأباهم
(Bize karşı kıskanç olan bir kavimle barıştılar; arkamızdan başparmaklarını ısırıp duruyorlar.)
2- Âyette emir, hakiki anlamından çıkıp öfkelerinin daim olması için onlara beddua anlamına gelmiştir.

* Fevâid:
Kûfeliler, ism-i işaretlerle takrîb (yakınlık bildirme) kastedildiğinde bunların, merfû bir isme ve mansûb bir habere ihtiyaç duymaları bakımından kâne'nin kardeşlerinden olduğu görüşüne gitmişlerdir. Şu örneklerde olduğu gibi: «كيف أخاف الظلم وهذا الخليفة قادما؟» (Halife gelmekteyken nasıl zulümden korkarım?), «وكيف أخاف البرد وهذه الشمس طالعة» (Güneş doğmuşken nasıl soğuktan korkarım?). Aynı şekilde, ism-i işaretten sonra gelen ismin varlıkta ikincisi bulunmadığı her durum da böyledir; «هذا ابن صياد أسقى الناس» örneğinde olduğu gibi. Buna göre takrîb için olan «هذا»yı nâkıs bir isim olarak, merfû olanı takrîbin ismi, mansûb olanı da takrîbin haberi olarak i'rab ederler. Bu mantıklı bir sözdür; bu yüzden bilgi edinilsin diye onu zikrettik.

* Vocabulary:
(العض): the pressing of the teeth against one another; and عضه بأسنانه: he seized it with his teeth. One says عضضت, with kasra on the ḍād, أعض, عضا and عضيضا. Al-ʿaḍḍ is always with ḍād, except with "time" or the like, in their saying عظ الزمان, i.e. it became severe, and عظت الحرب, i.e. the war became severe, for in these the two letters interchange. The ʿayn and the ḍād, when they are the first and second radicals of a word, have a strange particular property: they convey the meaning of severity and harm and what falls within their meaning. Al-Akhṭal said:
ضجوا من الحرب إذ عضت غواربهم ... وقيس عيلان من أخلاقها الضجر
(They cried out against war when it bit their withers; and Qays ʿAylān — complaint is among its traits.)
Al-ʿaḍb is reviling and cutting, and the severity and harm in both are not hidden; سيف عضب is a cutting sword; شاة عضباء is a ewe with a broken horn; عضده: he strengthened his back and helped him, and the believer is معضود (supported) by Allah's granting of success — Allah the Exalted said: «سنشد عضدك بأخيك»; داء معضل is a difficult illness that cannot be resolved, and he has a مرض عضال (an incurable disease) which has defeated the physicians and baffled them (أعضلهم); and أعضل الأمر (the matter became intractable). Dhū al-Iṣbaʿ married, then came to his clan asking them for her dowry, and they refused him, so he said:
واحدة أعضلكم أمرها ... فكيف لو درت على أربع
(One woman's affair has baffled you — so how would it be had it gone round to four?)
And so-and-so is a ʿuḍla of the ʿuḍal, i.e. a calamity among calamities. This is among the most wondrous things one hears about this noble language.
(الْأَنامِلَ): plural of أنملة, which is the tip of the finger.

* I'rab:
(ها أَنْتُمْ أُولاءِ تُحِبُّونَهُمْ وَلا يُحِبُّونَكُمْ): a resumptive clause, brought to alert the believers to their error in befriending the Jews. (ها) is for alerting and rebuke; (أنتم) is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and (أولاء) is its khabar (predicate). It has preceded that the demonstrative must be mentioned because of the presence of «ها», which is for alerting. The clause (تحبونهم) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, or resumptive, as though serving as an explanation of their error and their poor choice of intimates; and the clause (ولا يحبونكم) is conjoined to the clause (تحبونهم). Al-Jalāl and others parsed (أولاء) as one addressed in the vocative, i.e. "O these", so that the clause (تحبونهم) is the khabar. (وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْكِتابِ كُلِّهِ): it is sound for the wāw to be a conjunction, so that the clause is conjoined to the clause (تحبونهم), and it is sound for the wāw to be circumstantial, so that the clause is accusative as a ḥāl. (بالكتاب) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to (تؤمنون), and (كله) is tawkīd (emphasis) of (الكتاب). In this is the utmost censure of them, because showing pure friendship to one who does not love you is a matter that calls for blame and censure. Abū Ḥayyān, however, rejected the wāw being circumstantial, because when an affirmative imperfect occurs as a ḥāl, the circumstantial wāw does not enter upon it: you say "جاء زيد يضحك" ("Zayd came laughing"), and "ويضحك" is not permissible. He concluded by saying: but the preferable is what we mentioned, that it is for conjunction. (وَإِذا لَقُوكُمْ قالُوا آمَنَّا): the wāw is resumptive; (إذا) is an adverb for the future time including the meaning of condition; the clause (لقوكم) is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (genitive construct); the clause (قالوا) has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and the clause (آمنا) is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). (وَإِذا خَلَوْا عَضُّوا عَلَيْكُمُ الْأَنامِلَ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ): the wāw is a conjunction; (إذا) is an adverb for the future time; the clause (خلوا) is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa; (خلا) is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif which was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil (agent); the clause (عضوا) has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; (عليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (عضوا); (الأنامل) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (من الغيظ) is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the accusative as a tamyīz (specification), i.e. "in rage". It may also have the meaning of the lām, conveying the reason, so that the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "because of rage". (قُلْ مُوتُوا بِغَيْظِكُمْ): the clause is resumptive; the clause (موتوا) is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying; and (بغيظكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "bound up with your rage" [Translator's note: the source reads «يغيظكم», a misprint for «بغيظكم».]. (إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ بِذاتِ الصُّدُورِ): the clause is resumptive, conveying the reason for the command to die; the easier view is that it is part of what is said, so that it is in the position of the accusative by the verb of saying. (إن) with its noun and its khabar; (بذات الصدور) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (عليم). The meaning of (ذات الصدور) is the things concealed and the stirrings of souls; (ذات) is the feminine of (ذي), meaning "the possessor of the breasts", and they were made "possessor of the breasts" because they never part from them.

* Rhetoric:
1- In this verse is the device of metonymy (al-kināya), and biting the fingertips is a metonymy for an attribute. It was the custom of the Arabs to express one who is enraged and regretful over what he has done by biting the fingertips and fingers, and their poems overflow with this expression. Abū Ṭālib said:
وقد صالحوا قوما علينا أشحة ... يعضون عضا خلفنا بالأباهم
(They have made peace with a people grudging towards us, who bite hard behind our backs upon their thumbs.)
2- And in the verse the imperative departs from its literal meaning to the meaning of an imprecation against them, that their rage may be perpetual.

* Benefits:
The Kufans held that demonstratives, when "approximation" (taqrīb) is intended by them, are among the sisters of kāna in needing a nominative noun and an accusative khabar, as in: "How should I fear injustice when this caliph is arriving (قادما)?" and "How should I fear the cold when this sun is rising (طالعة)?"; and likewise everything in which the noun occurring after the demonstrative has no second in existence, as in: "This is Ibn Ṣayyād, the most generous of people in giving drink" (أسقى الناس). So they parse "هذا" of approximation as a defective noun, the nominative as the noun of approximation and the accusative as the khabar of approximation. It is a logical view, and therefore we have presented it for information.

* Lügat:
(طَرَفاً): Bununla onlardan bir kesimi veya bir grubu kastetmiştir.
(يَكْبِتَهُمْ): Onları rezil eder ve öfkelendirir; hoşa gitmeyen bir şeyle musibete uğratmak demek olan «الكبت»ten gelir. Bunun yüzüstü ve elleri üzerine yere yıkmak olduğu da söylenmiştir. Bu iki anlama göre tâ asli harftir, herhangi bir şeyin bedeli değildir; aksine başlı başına müstakil bir köktür. Tânın dâlden bedel olduğu da söylenmiştir; aslı, ciğerinde (كبد) acı iz bırakan bir musibetle onu vurduğunda söylenen «كبده»dir; başına vurduğunda «رأسته» demen gibi. Bazılarının «أو يكبدهم» şeklinde dâl ile okuması da buna delâlet eder. Araplar bazen dâlin yerine tâ getirirler. Ebü't-Tayyib el-Mütenebbî'nin bu ibdâle göz ucuyla bakarak iki lafız arasında şu sözünde garip bir uyum kurmuş olması muhtemeldir:
لأكبت حاسدا وأري عدوا ... كأنهما وداعك والرحيل
(Bir hasedi kahredeyim ve bir düşmanın ciğerini yakayım diye; sanki ikisi senin vedan ve göç idi.)
Ebü't-Tayyib dâlden tâ ibdâlini göz önünde bulundurmuş ve onu «لأكبد» olarak tevehhüm etmiş; buna uygun olarak da akciğere isabet etmek demek olan «الوري»den «أري»yi getirmiştir. «وراه الحب ريا وتورية» denir; bu, hüzünden veya aşk ateşinden için bozulmasıdır. Benî Hashâs'ın kölesi şöyle demiştir:
وراهن ربي مثلما قد ورنيني ... وأحمي على أكبادهن المكاويا
(Onlar beni nasıl hasta ettilerse Rabbim de onların içini öyle yaksın; ciğerleri üzerine dağlama demirleri kızdırayım.) [Mütercim notu: Metinde «ورنيني» şeklinde yazılmıştır; beyit genellikle «ورينني» şeklinde rivayet edilir.]
Hadîs-i şerif de bu köktendir: «لأن يمتلىء جوف أحدكم قيحا حتى يريه» (Birinizin içinin, onu bozacak kadar irinle dolması…). Bu, Ebü't-Tayyib'in yetişilemeyen nadide buluşlarındandır.

* İ'rab:
(وَما جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرى لَكُمْ): Zaferin keyfiyetini açıklamak için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye bir sözdür. Vav isti'nâfiyyedir; «ما» nefy harfidir; «جعله الله» mâzî fiil, mukaddem mef'ûlün bih ve muahhar fâildir; «إلا» hasr edatıdır; «بشرى», buradaki «جعل» «تصيير» (kılmak) anlamında olursa ikinci mef'ûlün bihtir. Buradaki «جعل»i yaratmak anlamında kabul edebilirsin; bu durumda tek mef'ûle geçişli olur ve «بشرى» illetlerin en genelinden istisnâ olarak mansûb olur; böylece mef'ûlün lieclih olur ve nasb şartlarını tamamlamıştır. «لكم» câr ve mecrûr olup «بشرى»nın sıfatı olan mahzûf bir kelimeye müteallik olur.
(وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُكُمْ بِهِ): Vav atıf harfidir; lâm ta'lîl içindir; «تطمئن», ta'lîl lâmından sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir. Câr ve mecrûr «بشرى»ya atıf olarak nasb mahallindedir; nasb şartlarından birinin, yani fâilin bir olması şartının bulunmaması sebebiyle lâm ile mecrûr olmuştur; zira «جعل»in fâili Allah Teâlâ, mutmain olmanın fâili ise kalplerdir. Câr ve mecrûru, takdiri «فعل هذا لتطمئن قلوبكم» (kalpleriniz mutmain olsun diye bunu yaptı) olan mahzûf bir fiile müteallik kılman da mümkündür. «قلوبكم» «تطمئن»in fâilidir; «به» câr ve mecrûr olup «تطمئن»e müteallik olur.
(وَمَا النَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ): Vav isti'nâfiyyedir; «ما» nefy harfidir; «النصر» mübtedâdır; «إلا» hasr edatıdır; «من عند الله» câr ve mecrûr olup mahzûf habere müteallik olur; «العزيز» ve «الحكيم» Allah Teâlâ'nın iki sıfatıdır.
(لِيَقْطَعَ طَرَفاً مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا): Lâm ta'lîl içindir; «يقطع», lâmdan sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir. Câr ve mecrûr, «ولقد نصركم الله ببدر» sözündeki «نصركم»e müteallik olur. Takdiri «أمدكم ونصركم» olan mahzûf bir fiile (müteallik olduğu) da söylenmiştir. Ebû Hayyân ise bunların zikredilenlerin en yakınına, yani «من عند الله» sözündeki âmile müteallik olmalarını tercih etmiştir; takdir sanki şöyledir: «Zafer ancak Allah katındandır, başkasının katından değildir; iki şeyden biri için: ya kâfirlerden bir kesimi öldürme ve esir alma ile kesip koparmak, ya da rezil etmek ve hüsranla geri döndürmek.» «طرفا» mef'ûlün bihtir; «من الذين» câr ve mecrûr olup mahzûf bir sıfata müteallik olur; «كفروا» cümlesi sıla olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
(أَوْ يَكْبِتَهُمْ فَيَنْقَلِبُوا خائِبِينَ): «أو» atıf harfidir; «يكبتهم» «يقطع»e ma'tûf muzâri fiildir; hâ bitişik zamir olup mef'ûlün bih olarak nasb mahallindedir; fâ atıf harfidir; «ينقلبوا» «يكبتهم»e ma'tûftur [Mütercim notu: Metinde «وبنقلبوا» yazılıdır; doğrusu «وينقلبوا»dır.]; «خائبين» hâldir, nasb alâmeti yâdır, çünkü cem-i müzekker-i sâlimdir.

* Belâgat:
«ليقطع طرفا» sözünde istiâre-i tasrîhiyye-i tebeiyye vardır: Onlardan öldürülen ve dağılanlar, kesilip parçaları dağılmış ve düzeni bozulmuş bir şeye benzetilmiştir.

* İ'rab:
(لَقَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ): Lâm mahzûf bir kasemin cevabıdır; «قد» tahkîk harfidir; «منّ الله» fiil ve fâildir; «على المؤمنين» câr ve mecrûr olup «منّ»e müteallik olur. Söz, Hz. Peygamber'in (s.a.v.) temizliğini te'kîd etmek ve ona hıyanet isnat edenlerin hatasını açıklamak için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye bir sözdür.
(إِذْ بَعَثَ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ): «إذ» geçmiş zaman için bir zarf olup «منّ»e müteallik olur; «بعث» cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir; «فيهم» câr ve mecrûr olup «بعث»e müteallik olur; «رسولا» mef'ûlün bihtir; «من أنفسهم» câr ve mecrûr olup «رسولا»nın sıfatı olan mahzûf bir kelimeye müteallik olur.
(يَتْلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ آياتِهِ): Cümle «رسولا»nın ikinci sıfatıdır; «عليهم» câr ve mecrûr olup «يتلو»ya müteallik olur.
(وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ): İki cümle «يتلو»ya ma'tûftur; «الكتاب» «يعلمهم»ün ikinci mef'ûlün bihidir; «الحكمة» «الكتاب»a ma'tûftur.
(وَإِنْ كانُوا مِنْ قَبْلُ لَفِي ضَلالٍ مُبِينٍ): Vav hâliyyedir; «إن» ağır (şeddeli) olandan hafifletilmiş olup mühmeldir, ameli yoktur. «كان» ve ismi; «من قبل» câr ve mecrûr olup mahzûf bir hâle müteallik olur; «قبل» damme üzere mebnî bir zarf olup «من» ile cer mahallindedir. «لفي»: lâm fârika lâmıdır; «في ضلال» câr ve mecrûr olup «كانوا»nın haberi olan mahzûf bir kelimeye müteallik olur; «مبين» sıfattır (na't).

* Belâgat:
Âyette tecrîd sanatı diye bilinen, belâgat sanatlarından yüksek bir sanat vardır. O, konuşanın, bir sıfata sahip olan bir şeyden, o sıfatta onun benzeri olan başka bir şeyi, o sıfatın onda kemâlini mübalağa ile ifade etmek için çekip çıkarmasıdır; sanki bu, o sıfatla nitelenmekten daha beliğdir. [Mütercim notu: Metinde «لكسالها» yazılıdır; doğrusu «لكمالها»dır.] Bunun birçok kısmı vardır; belâgat kitaplarına başvurulabilir [Mütercim notu: Metinde «يسكن الرجوع» yazılıdır; doğrusu «يمكن الرجوع»dur.]; fakat biz en önemlilerine işaret ediyoruz:
1- Cer harfi «من» ile olur. Nesirdeki nadide örneklerinden biri, Ebû Tâlib'in Hz. Hatice'nin Peygamber (s.a.v.) ile evlendirilmesi sırasındaki hutbesidir; şu sözler ondandır: «الحمد لله الذي جعلنا من ذرية إبراهيم وزرع إسماعيل وضئضي معد» (Bizi İbrâhîm'in zürriyetinden, İsmâil'in neslinden ve Mead'in kökünden kılan Allah'a hamdolsun.)
2- Tecrîd bildiren cer harfi bâ ile olur; Ebû Temmâm'ın şu sözü gibi:
هتك الظلام أبو الوليد بعزة ... فتحت لنا باب الرجاء المقفل
بأتمّ من قمر السماء إذا بدا ... بدرا وأحسن في العيون وأجمل
بأجلّ من قيس إذا استنطقته ... رأيا وألطف في الأمور وأجزل
(Ebü'l-Velîd, bize kapalı ümit kapısını açan bir izzetle karanlığı yırttı; dolunay olarak doğduğunda gökteki aydan daha mükemmel, gözlere daha güzel ve daha hoş biriyle; konuşturduğunda görüşte Kays'tan daha yüce, işlerde daha ince ve daha cömert biriyle.)
3- Tecrîd bildiren cer harfi «في» ile olur [Mütercim notu: Metinde «يفي» yazılıdır; doğrusu «بفي»dir.]; Allah Teâlâ şöyle buyurmuştur: «لهم فيها دار الخلد», yani cehennemde; ondan mübalağa için başka bir yurt çekip çıkarmıştır. Ebü't-Tayyib buna göz dikerek şöyle demiştir:
تمضي المواكب والأبصار شاخصة ... منها إلى الملك الميمون طائره
قد حرن في بشر في تاجه قمر ... في درعه أسد تدمى أظافره
(Alaylar geçip gider, gözler onlardan uğuru kutlu hükümdara dikilmiştir; tacında bir ay, zırhında tırnakları kanlı bir arslan bulunan bir insan karşısında şaşırıp kalmışlardır.)
Arslan, övülen kimsenin ta kendisidir; fakat onun işini korkunç göstermek ve cesaret ve atılganlıkla nitelenmesinde mübalağa etmek için ondan başka bir arslan çekip çıkarmıştır.
4- Tecrîdin kısımlarından biri de insanın kendinden, sözün sevk edildiği sıfatta kendisi gibi olan başka bir şahıs çekip çıkarması, sonra ona hitap etmesidir; Mütenebbî'nin şu sözü gibi:
لا خيل عندك تهديها ولا مال ... فليسعد النطق إن لم تسعد الحال
وأجز الأمير الذي نعماه فاجئة ... بغير قول ونعمى القوم أقوال
(Yanında hediye edecek ne at var ne mal; hal yardım etmiyorsa söz yardım etsin. Nimetleri sözsüz ansızın gelen emîre karşılık ver; başkalarının nimetleri ise sözlerden ibarettir.)
Ebû Nüvâs'ın şu sözü de güzeldir:
يا كثير النّوح في الدمن ... لا عليها بل على السكن
سنة العشاق واحدة ... فإذا أحببت فاستنن
(Ey harabe yurt izleri başında çok ağlayan —onlara değil, orada oturan sevgiliye—! Âşıkların yolu birdir; sevdiğinde sen de o yola uy.)
Muradı kendi kendine hitaptır; bu yüzden bu ikisinden sonra şöyle demiştir:
ظنّ بي من قد كلفت به ... فهو يجفوني على الظّنن
بات لا يعنيه ما لقيت ... عين ممنوع من الوسن
رشأ لولا ملاحته ... خلت الدنيا من الفتن
(Tutulduğum kimse benim hakkımda kuşkulandı; o kuşkular üzerine bana cefa ediyor. Uykudan alıkonmuş bir gözün çektikleri onu hiç ilgilendirmeden geceledi. O bir ceylan yavrusu ki onun güzelliği olmasaydı dünya fitnelerden boş kalırdı.)
Modern çağda Şevkî de şöyle demiştir:
قم ناج جلّق وانشد رسم من بانوا ... مشت على الرسم أحداث وأزمان
(Kalk, Cillık'a [Şam'a] fısılda ve gidenlerin yurt izini ara; o izin üzerinden nice olaylar ve zamanlar geçti.)
Kendinden, şairlikte ve sömürgeciliğe karşı daima direnmiş ebedî Dımaşk'a seslenme kudretinde kendini temsil eden başka bir şahıs çekip çıkarmıştır. Bu kısım kasidelerin girişlerinde çok olur; fakat yolu zordur ve tehlikelerle çevrilidir; çünkü (şair) övdüğü kişiye, sevgilisine veya hitap ettiği her kim olursa ona, hoşlanmadığı ve uğursuz saydığı bir şeyle hitap edebilir [Mütercim notu: Metinde «مسدوحه» yazılıdır; doğrusu «ممدوحه»dur.]; Cerîr'in, Abdülmelik b. Mervân'ı övdüğü bir kasideye şöyle başladığında yaptığı gibi:
أتصحو أم فؤادك غير صاح ... عشيّة هم صحبك بالرّواح
(Ayılıyor musun, yoksa arkadaşların akşamleyin yola koyulmaya niyetlendiğinde gönlün hâlâ ayık değil mi?)
Abdülmelik ona: «Yazıklar olsun sana! Bu soruyla senin ne işin var, ey fâhişenin oğlu!» demiştir. Ebü't-Tayyib el-Mütenebbî'nin Kâfûr'u överken bile bile kendini düşürdüğü şu durum da böyledir:
كفى بك داء أن ترى الموت شافيا ... وحسب المنايا أن يكنّ أمانيا
(Ölümü şifa görmen sana dert olarak yeter; ölümlere de emeller olmaları yeter.)
Tecrîdin beyitlerine sindiği bedî' kasidelerden biri de Sımme b. Abdullah'ın sevgilisi Reyyâ hakkındaki kasidesidir. Onu tam olarak zikrediyoruz; zira onda edebiyat âşıkları için teselli ve avuntu vardır:
[Mütercim notu: Kaynakta bu kasidenin beyitleri satır sonlarında bozuk bölünmüş, bazı kelimeler iki satır arasında kesilmiştir («ت / دمعا», «ن / زّعا», «أسبلتا / معا», «وأ / خدعا»). Aşağıda beyitler, kaynaktaki kelimeler değiştirilmeden yalnızca satır düzeni toparlanarak verilmiştir. Kaynaktaki «فقا» kelimesi, şiirin bilinen rivayetinde «قفا»dır.]
حننت إلى ريا ونفسك باعدت ... مزارك من ريا وشعباكما معا
فما حسن أن تأتي الأمر طائعا ... وتجزع أن داعي الصبابة أسمعا
فقا ودعا نجدا ومن حلّ بالحمى ... وقل لنجد عندنا أن يودّعا
بنفسي تلك الأرض ما أطيب الربا ... وما أحسن المصطاف والمتربّعا
وليست عشيّات الحمى برواجع ... إليك ولكن خلّ عينيك تدمعا
ولما رأيت البشر أعرض دوننا ... وحالت بنات الشوق يحننّ نزّعا
بكت عيني اليسرى فلما زجرتها ... عن الجهل بعد الحلم أسبلتا معا
تلفّت نحو الحي حتى حسبتني ... وجعت من الإصغاء ليتا وأخدعا
وأذكر أيام الحمى ثم أنثني ... على كبدي من خشية أن تصدّعا
(Reyyâ'ya özlem duydun; oysa Reyyâ'ya ziyaretini kendin uzaklaştırdın, ikinizin yolu bir aradayken. Bir işe kendi isteğinle girip, sonra aşkın davetçisi sana sesini duyurunca feryat etmen güzel değildir. Durun da Necd'e ve Hımâ'da konanlara veda edin; Necd'e de söyleyin: bizim yanımızda ona veda edilsin. Canım feda o topraklara; tepeleri ne hoş, yazlık ve baharlık konak yerleri ne güzeldir! Hımâ'nın akşamları sana geri dönecek değil; fakat bırak gözlerin yaşarsın. Bişr dağının önümüze set çektiğini ve özlem kızlarının sılaya hasretle çırpındığını görünce sol gözüm ağladı; ağırbaşlılıktan sonra cehaletten ötürü onu azarlayınca ikisi birden yaş döktü. Obaya doğru öyle döndüm ki dinlemekten boynumun yanları ve damarlarım ağrıdı sandım. Hımâ günlerini anar, sonra parçalanmasından korkarak ciğerimin üzerine kapanırım.)

* Fevâid:
Fiile benzeyen, hemzesi kesreli «إنّ» hafifletilir ve (isme) ihtisası ortadan kalktığı için mühmel olur; habere de fârika lâmı denen bir lâm girer; «إن خالد لمسافر» gibi; bu, onunla nefiy «إن»i arasını ayırmak içindir. Ondan sonra bir fiil gelirse kesinlikle mühmel olur; bu fiil de nevâsıhtan, yani «كان», «ظن» ve kardeşlerinden olur; bu lâmın bu fiillere girmesi gerekir. Bazı Araplar birinci kısımda onu azınlıkla amel ettirmişler ve «إن خالدا لمسافر» dememizin caiz olduğunu söylemişlerdir. Bu yüzden Zemahşerî, Allah Teâlâ'nın «وإن كانوا من قبل لفي ضلال مبين» sözünde [Mütercim notu: Metinde «قولها تعالى» yazılıdır; doğrusu «قوله تعالى»dır.] onu amel ettirdiğinde, yani isminin zâhir bir isim olduğunu takdir edip «إن الشأن والحديث» dediğinde hata etmiş ve kendi el-Mufassal kitabına muhalefet etmiştir. [Mütercim notu: Metin takdir edilen ismi «zâhir isim» olarak nitelemektedir; Zemahşerî'nin takdiri şe'n zamiri (ضمير الشأن) şeklindedir; metin olduğu gibi çevrilmiştir.] Celâl (Celâleyn) ve Ebü's-Suûd da hatada Zemahşerî'ye uymuşlardır. Yanılmaktan münezzeh olan yalnız Allah'tır.

* I'rab:
(لَقَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ) The lām is the answer to an omitted oath; «قد» is a particle of confirmation; «من الله» is a verb and an agent; «على المؤمنين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «من». The discourse is resumptive, introduced to confirm the purity of the Prophet ﷺ and to show the error of those who attributed ghulūl to him. (إِذْ بَعَثَ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ) «إذ» is an adverb for past time attached to «من»; the clause «بعث» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; «فيهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «بعث»; «رسولا» is a direct object; «من أنفسهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element, an adjective of «رسولا». (يَتْلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ آياتِهِ) The clause is a second adjective of «رسولا»; «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «يتلو». (وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ) The two clauses are conjoined to «يتلو»; «الكتاب» is the second direct object of «يعلمهم», and «الحكمة» is conjoined to «الكتاب». (وَإِنْ كانُوا مِنْ قَبْلُ لَفِي ضَلالٍ مُبِينٍ) The wāw is circumstantial; «إن» is the lightened form of the heavy «إنّ», rendered inoperative (muhmala), with no effect; «كان» and its noun; «من قبل» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl; «قبل» is an adverb indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of a genitive by «من»; «لفي»: the lām is the distinguishing lām (lām fāriqa); «في ضلال» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element, the khabar of «كانوا»; and «مبين» is an adjective.

* Rhetoric:
In the verse there is a lofty art of rhetoric known as the art of tajrīd (abstraction): the speaker draws out of a thing that has an attribute another thing like it in that attribute, to emphasise its perfection in it, as if that were more eloquent than being described by the attribute. It has many divisions, which can be consulted in the books of rhetoric, but we point to the most important of them.
1- That it be with the preposition «من». Among its rare instances in prose is the sermon of Abū Ṭālib at the marriage of Khadīja to the Prophet ﷺ, which includes: «الحمد لله الذي جعلنا من ذرية إبراهيم وزرع إسماعيل وضئضي معد» ("Praise be to Allah who made us of the descendants of Ibrāhīm, the seed of Ismāʿīl and the stock of Maʿadd").
2- That it be with the abstracting bāʾ, as in the words of Abū Tammām:
هتك الظلام أبو الوليد بعزة ... فتحت لنا باب الرجاء المقفل
بأتمّ من قمر السماء إذا بدا ... بدرا وأحسن في العيون وأجمل
بأجلّ من قيس إذا استنطقته ... رأيا وألطف في الأمور وأجزل
(Abū al-Walīd tore through the darkness with a might that opened for us the locked door of hope; with one more perfect than the moon of the sky when it appears as a full moon, and fairer and more beautiful in the eyes; with one nobler than Qays when you make him speak in opinion, and subtler and more generous in affairs.)
3- That it be with the abstracting «في». The Exalted said: «لهم فيها دار الخلد» ("For them therein is the abode of eternity"), that is, in Hell, so He drew out of it another abode for emphasis. Abū al-Ṭayyib aspired to it and said:
تمضي المواكب والأبصار شاخصة ... منها إلى الملك الميمون طائره
قد حرن في بشر في تاجه قمر ... في درعه أسد تدمى أظافره
(The processions pass, the eyes fixed on them toward the king whose omen is blessed; they have stalled in a handsome man, in whose crown is a moon, in whose coat of mail is a lion whose claws drip blood.)
For the lion is the one praised himself, but he drew out of him another lion to make his matter dreadful and to stress his being described with courage and boldness.
4- Among the divisions of tajrīd is that a person draws out of himself another person like him in the attribute for which the speech is made, and then addresses him, as in al-Mutanabbī's words:
لا خيل عندك تهديها ولا مال ... فليسعد النطق إن لم تسعد الحال
وأجز الأمير الذي نعماه فاجئة ... بغير قول ونعمى القوم أقوال
(You have no horses to give as gifts and no wealth; so let speech help if circumstance does not. And reward the emir whose favours come suddenly without a word, while the favours of others are words.)
And the beautiful words of Abū Nuwās:
يا كثير النّوح في الدمن ... لا عليها بل على السكن
سنة العشاق واحدة ... فإذا أحببت فاستنن
(O you who wail much over the ruins, not over them but over their inhabitants! The way of lovers is one; so if you love, follow the way.)
His intention is addressing himself, and so he said after them:
ظنّ بي من قد كلفت به ... فهو يجفوني على الظّنن
بات لا يعنيه ما لقيت ... عين ممنوع من الوسن
رشأ لولا ملاحته ... خلت الدنيا من الفتن
(The one I am devoted to thought ill of me, and he shuns me on the strength of suspicions; he spent the night unconcerned by what I met, the eye of one barred from sleep. A fawn: were it not for his beauty, the world would be free of trials.)
And Shawqī said in the modern age:
قم ناج جلّق وانشد رسم من بانوا ... مشت على الرسم أحداث وأزمان
(Arise, commune with Jillaq (Damascus) and seek the traces of those who departed; events and ages have passed over the traces.)
He drew out of himself another person who represents him in poetic gift and the ability to commune with immortal Damascus, which has always stood firm against colonialism. This division is frequent at the openings of poems, but its path is hard and fraught with danger, because the poet may address his patron or his beloved or any addressee with something he dislikes or finds ill-omened, as Jarīr did when he opened a poem in praise of ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Marwān:
أتصحو أم فؤادك غير صاح ... عشيّة هم صحبك بالرّواح
(Do you awaken, or is your heart not awake, in the evening when your companions were about to depart?)
ʿAbd al-Malik said to him: "Woe to you! What have you to do with this question, son of the loose woman!" Just as Abū al-Ṭayyib al-Mutanabbī got himself deliberately into trouble in his praise of Kāfūr:
كفى بك داء أن ترى الموت شافيا ... وحسب المنايا أن يكنّ أمانيا
(It is enough of an illness that you see death as a cure; and it suffices for deaths that they be wishes.)
Among the wonderful poems into whose verses tajrīd has penetrated is the poem of al-Ṣimma ibn ʿAbd Allāh about his beloved Rayyā, which we cite in full, for in it lovers of literature find solace and consolation:
حننت إلى ريا ونفسك باعدت ... مزارك من ريا وشعباكما معا
فما حسن أن تأتي الأمر طائعا ... وتجزع أن داعي الصبابة أسمعا
فقا ودعا نجدا ومن حلّ بالحمى ... وقل لنجد عندنا أن يودّعا
بنفسي تلك الأرض ما أطيب الربا ... وما أحسن المصطاف والمتربّعا
وليست عشيّات الحمى برواجع ... إليك ولكن خلّ عينيك تدمعا
ولما رأيت البشر أعرض دوننا ... وحالت بنات الشوق يحننّ نزّعا
بكت عيني اليسرى فلما زجرتها ... عن الجهل بعد الحلم أسبلتا معا
تلفّت نحو الحي حتى حسبتني ... وجعت من الإصغاء ليتا وأخدعا
وأذكر أيام الحمى ثم أنثني ... على كبدي من خشية أن تصدّعا
(You yearned for Rayyā, though your own self made your visiting place far from Rayyā, with your two mountain paths together. How is it fine to approach the matter willingly and then despair that the caller of passion has made himself heard? Stop, both of you, and bid farewell to Najd and whoever dwells in the protected land, and say to Najd that it be bidden farewell with us. By my life, that land! How sweet its hills, how fair the summer camp and the spring camp! The evenings of the protected land will not return to you, but let your eyes weep. When I saw al-Bishr [Translator's note: a mountain of Najd; the source gives no gloss] turn away from us, and the daughters of longing came yearning and drawing away, my left eye wept; and when I rebuked it for ignorance after forbearance, both streamed together. I turned toward the tribe until I thought I had hurt my neck from listening; and I remember the days of the protected land, then I bend over my liver for fear that it may split.)
(Translator's note: the verses are given in the source with line breaks that fall mid-verse; the glosses above follow the evident sense.)

* Benefits:
The «إنّ» with kasra on the hamza, which resembles a verb, is lightened and rendered inoperative because its specificity ceases; and a lām called the distinguishing lām enters upon the khabar, as in «إن خالد لمسافر», to distinguish it from the negative «إن». If a verb follows it, it is necessarily inoperative, and this verb must be one of the nawāsikh, that is, kāna and ẓanna and their sisters, and this lām must enter upon these verbs. Some Arabs made it operative in the first case, though rarely, so they said it is permissible to say «إن خالدا لمسافر». For this reason al-Zamakhsharī erred and went against his own book al-Mufaṣṣal when he made it operative in the words of the Exalted «وإن كانوا من قبل لفي ضلال مبين», when he implied its noun as an overt noun, that is, «الشأن» or «الحديث» ("the matter" or "the account"). Al-Jalāl and Abū al-Suʿūd followed al-Zamakhsharī in the error; and glory to Him who does not forget.

* I'rab:
(أَوَلَمَّا أَصابَتْكُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ) The hamza is interrogative of denial and rebuke; the wāw is a conjunction on what preceded of the story of Uḥud. The meaning is: it is not fitting for you to be astonished at your failure, for you know the cause, and when the cause is known, astonishment is void. «لما» is a temporal adverb meaning "when", attached to «قلتم», or it is a linking particle (ḥarf); its rule will come under Benefits. «أصابتكم» is a past verb and a direct object, and «مصيبة» is the agent. (قَدْ أَصَبْتُمْ مِثْلَيْها) The clause is an adjective of «مصيبة»; «قد» is a particle of confirmation; «أصبتم» is a verb and an agent; «مثليها» is a direct object. (قُلْتُمْ أَنَّى هذا) The clause «قلتم» has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional; «أنى» is an interrogative noun, a fronted khabar, and «هذا» is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative as the content of what is said. The meaning: "From where has this defeat and killing come upon us, while we fight in the way of Allah, the Messenger of Allah is with us, and Allah has promised us victory over them?" (قُلْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ أَنْفُسِكُمْ) The clause «قل» is the content of the saying; «هو» is a mubtadaʾ and «من عند أنفسكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element, the khabar. (إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ) «إن» with its noun and khabar; «على كل شيء» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «قدير»; and the clause is causal and has no grammatical position.

* Benefits:
1- Ibn Hishām cited this verse in the Mughnī as evidence that the hamza enters upon negation as it enters upon affirmation. This is a slip on his part that we did not expect from so intelligent a man, because «لما» here is temporal ("when"), not negative, so it is not suitable as an example of the hamza's entering upon negation. Nor can it be said that the hamza is for denial, which is like negation, so the speech it enters upon is also negated and the example is sound; for we say: the denial here is one of rebuke, so what it governs is established, as you say to one who strikes his father: "Do you strike him when he is your father?" It is better to acknowledge that the word «لما» was confused for Ibn Hishām; perhaps he meant the negative «لما». Al-Suyūṭī noticed this error and said: "It is better to give as the example the poet's words: «فقلت: الما أصح والشيب وازع»" ("I said: Have I not yet awakened, while grey hair restrains?"). This is one of Ibn Hishām's minor slips that we have recorded against him; and glory to Him who does not err. Al-Damāmīnī said in his commentary on the Mughnī: "It is better to take what the hamza governs as omitted, being what is conjoined to, that is: 'Did you not lament, or did you say, when a calamity struck you...', and the author would be exemplifying the negation mentioned and the omitted element." He said: "If you say, the author does not hold this, as will come, but holds that the hamza that enters upon what the wāw governs was fronted to signal its original claim to the beginning of the sentence, as will come, how then can his words be taken as you mention? I say: the author did not mention this regarding the hamza of denial, as in «أفأمن أهل القرى» and «أفلم يسيروا», or he exemplified according to the view of al-Zamakhsharī and those who followed him."
2- «لَمَّا» has three uses:
a- It is specific to the imperfect, which it jussivises and turns to the past like «لم», but its negation continues up to the present, unlike «لم».
b- It is specific to the past. The grammarians disagreed about it: one group said it is an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna); another group said it is a particle for linking two clauses, both of which are needed, as in «لما جاءني أكرمته» ("When he came to me I honoured him").
c- It is a particle of exception, entering upon the nominal clause, as in «إن كل نفس لما عليها حافظ» ("There is no soul but has over it a guardian"); the discussion of it will come in its place.
3- «قد» is a particle of expectation, because it is joined to verbs that are expected and asked about. Therefore it is said: when it enters upon the past it is a particle of confirmation, and when it enters upon the imperfect it is a particle of reduction (taqlīl); the meaning of its reduction is bringing it close to the present. From this is the Exalted's saying: «قد يعلم الله المعوقين منكم» ("Allah already knows those among you who hinder others"). It may also depart from its place and come as a noun meaning "enough" (ḥasb); you say «قدك», that is, «حسبك» ("enough for you"). Abū Tammām said:
قدك اتّئب أربيت في الغلواء ... كم تعذلون وأنتم سجرائي
(Enough, be gentle; you have exceeded in excess; how long will you blame me, while you are my companions?)

* I'rab:
(يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ) The verb is repeated for emphasis, and the clause is resumptive, introduced for emphasis; you may also make it an emphasis (tawkīd) of the preceding one or a badal of it. «بنعمة» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «يستبشرون»; «من الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element, an adjective of «نعمة»; and «فضل» is conjoined to «نعمة». (وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ) The wāw is a conjunction; «أن» and its noun; and the clause «لا يضيع» is its khabar. (الَّذِينَ اسْتَجابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ) The relative noun is a mubtadaʾ; you may also make it accusative by an omitted verb for praise, or genitive as an adjective of «المؤمنين». The clause «استجابوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun; «لله» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «استجابوا»; and «الرسول» is conjoined to «الله». (مِنْ بَعْدِ ما أَصابَهُمُ الْقَرْحُ) «من بعد» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl; «ما» is maṣdariyya; «أصابهم القرح» is a verb, a direct object and an agent; and the maṣdariyya «ما» and what is within its scope are in the interpretation of a maṣdar annexed to «بعد». (لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا مِنْهُمْ وَاتَّقَوْا أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ) «للذين» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element, a fronted khabar; the clause «أحسنوا» is the ṣila; «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl; «اتقوا» is conjoined to «أحسنوا»; «أجر» is a postponed mubtadaʾ and «عظيم» an adjective; and the clause «للذين...» is the khabar of «الذين» in His words «الذين استجابوا», if you parse «الذين» as a mubtadaʾ, or it is circumstantial.

The expedition of Ḥamrāʾ al-Asad:
