(وَبَثَّ مِنْهُما رِجالًا كَثِيراً وَنِساءً): Vav atıf harfi; «بث» mâzî fiil; «منهما» câr ve mecrûr olup «بث»e müteallik; «رجالا» mef'ûlün bih; «كثيرا» sıfat; «نساء», «رجالا»ya atıf.
(وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسائَلُونَ بِهِ وَالْأَرْحامَ): Vav atıf harfi; «اتقوا الله» emir fiil (fâil ve mef'ûl); «الذي» sıfat; «تساءلون» cümlesi sıla; «به» câr ve mecrûr olup «تساءلون»a müteallik; «الأرحام», «الله»ye atıftır. Bu atıfta akrabalığın değerini, ona iyilik etmenin ve onu gözetmenin vacip olduğunu yüceltme vardır.
(إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيباً): Cümle ta'lîliyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. «إنّ» ve ismi; «كان» ve kapsamındakilerden oluşan cümle «إنّ»nin haberi. «كان» nâkıs mâzî fiil; «عليكم» câr ve mecrûr olup «رقيبا»ya müteallik; «كان»ın ismi müstetir; «رقيبا» haberi.

* Belâgat:
Yukarıdaki ayette berâat-i istihlâl sanatı vardır: Sûreye yaratılışın ve oluşumun başlangıcına işaretle başlamış, kadının önemli rolüne işaret etmiş ve sıla-i rahmi tavsiye etmiştir. Arap şiiri, sıla-i rahmin ve onun Allah katındaki değerinin zikriyle doludur. Ma'n b. Evs'in şu beyitle başlayan kasidesine işaret etmemiz yeterlidir:
وذي رحم قلمت أظفار ضغنه ... بحلمي وهو ليس له حلم
(Nice akraba vardır ki, kendisinde hilm yokken, onun kininin tırnaklarını hilmimle kestim.)
Bu, neredeyse hiçbir edebiyat kitabının kendisinden hâli olmadığı harika bir kasidedir; dileyen ona müracaat etsin.

* Vocabulary:
(الْيَتامى): those whose fathers have died, so they are left alone without them; اليتم is being alone. From it come الرملة اليتيمة (the solitary sand-dune) and الدرة اليتيمة (the unique pearl). It has been said: the orphan among humans is from the side of the fathers, and among animals from the side of the mothers. اليتامى is a plural of a plural: اليتيم was pluralised as يتمى, like أسرى, then يتمى was pluralised as يتامى, like أسرى into أسارى. It may also be pluralised on the pattern فعائل because اليتيم is treated like nouns such as صاحب and فارس, so one says يتائم and then يتامى by metathesis.
(الحوب), with ḍamma or fatḥa on the ḥāʾ: the great sin; it is the maṣdar (verbal noun) of حاب حوبا وحابا.

* I'rab:
(وَآتُوا الْيَتامى أَمْوالَهُمْ): the واو may properly be resumptive, so the clause is resumptive, introduced to begin [explaining] the manner and ways of fearing [Allah]; اليتامى is put first because of complete concern for their affair. It may also properly be conjunctive, joined to what preceded, so that the narrative is continuous. آتوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the واو is the fāʿil (agent); اليتامى is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and أموالهم the second mafʿūl bihi. (وَلا تَتَبَدَّلُوا الْخَبِيثَ بِالطَّيِّبِ): conjoined to what preceded; لا is prohibitive; تتبدلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the واو is the fāʿil; الخبيث is a mafʿūl bihi; the باء is a preposition and الطيب — which is what is given up — is genitive by it, and the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تتبدلوا. (وَلا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوالَهُمْ إِلى أَمْوالِكُمْ): the واو is conjunctive; لا is prohibitive; نأكلوا [Translator's note: so in the source, for تأكلوا] is an imperfect verb, jussive by لا; أموالهم is a mafʿūl bihi; إلى أموالكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "joined to your wealth". (إِنَّهُ كانَ حُوباً كَبِيراً): إن and its noun; the clause of كان with its noun and khabar (predicate) is the khabar of إن; the clause of إن and what falls within its scope is causal, with no grammatical position, and for this reason the hamza of إن is given kasra.

* Rhetoric:
In this verse there are instances of eloquence reaching the level of inimitability, which we summarise as follows:
1- Majāz mursal (metonymic trope) in the words of the Exalted: «وآتوا اليتامى أموالهم», because Allah, Glory be to Him, does not command that young orphans be given their wealth — that would be unreasonable; rather, the fact is that Allah commands that wealth be given to those who have reached the age of maturity after having been orphans. So the word اليتامى here is a majāz mursal, because it is used of those who are mature, and the relation is consideration of what they formerly were.
2- Istiʿāra makniyya (implicit metaphor) in the eating of the orphans' wealth: He likened their wealth to food that is eaten, then lent to it the most prominent property of food, which is eating. In this metaphor there are two of the subtlest secrets:
a- The way of eloquence is to forbid the lesser in order to draw attention to the greater, when what is forbidden has degrees. The requirement of this rule would have been to forbid the eating of the orphan's wealth by one who is poor (فقبر) [Translator's note: the source has «فقبر»; «فقير» is meant] and in need of it, so that the prohibition of the rich would follow a fortiori. So there must be a secret explaining the benefit of singling out the greater for prohibition in this verse, and that is what is understood from the words «إلى أموالكم». The secret in that is that eating the orphan's wealth while having no need of it is the ugliest form of eating, so it was singled out for prohibition to brand whoever falls into it as shameful.
b- The second secret is in singling out eating, because the Arabs held excessive eating to be blameworthy and counted it as gluttony equal to bestiality. So it is as though the one who eats the orphan's wealth — when he has no need of it and has much wealth (لدية) [Translator's note: the source has «لدية»; «لديه» is meant] — is worse than one who eats it while destitute and in severe need of it, even though both share in eating what is forbidden and are strung together on one rope. It is known that the more deeply what is forbidden is steeped in ugliness and the more extreme in hideousness, the more the soul naturally recoils from it.
3- Ṭibāq (antithesis) between الخبيث, which is unlawful wealth, and الطيب, which is lawful and agreeable wealth.

* Lügat:
(السُّفَهاءَ): Mallarını harcanmaması gereken yerlere veya kendisinde bir fayda bulunmayan şeylere harcayan müsrifler.
(قِياماً): «قام» fiilinin masdarıdır; yani onunla ayakta durur ve canlanırsınız. Eğer onu zayi etseydiniz siz de zayi olurdunuz; sanki o sizin ayakta duruşunuz ve canlanışınızdır.
(آنَسْتُمْ): Gördünüz ve açıkça anladınız.

* İ'rab:
(وَلا تُؤْتُوا السُّفَهاءَ أَمْوالَكُمُ الَّتِي جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ قِياماً): İsti'nâfiyye bir sözdür; yetimlerin mallarıyla ilgili hükümlerin geri kalanını açıklamak için sevk edilmiştir. «لا» nâhiye; «تؤتوا» «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiil, vav fâil; «السفهاء» mef'ûlün bih; «أموالكم» ikinci mef'ûlün bih; «التي» «أموالكم»in sıfatı olarak nasb mahallinde ism-i mevsûl; «جعل الله لكم» cümlesi mevsûlün sılası. «قياما», «صيّر» (kıldı) anlamındaki «جعل»in ikinci mef'ûlün bihidir; birinci mef'ûl mahzûftur; takdir «التي صيّرها لكم قياما» şeklindedir. «لكم» câr ve mecrûr olup «قياما»ya mütealliktir. Eğer «جعل» «خلق» (yarattı) anlamında ise «قياما» mahzûf âid (zamir)den hâldir; yani: «Onu, ayakta tutucu olduğu hâlde kıldı.»
(وَارْزُقُوهُمْ فِيها وَاكْسُوهُمْ وَقُولُوا لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفاً): «وارزقوهم»: Vav atıf harfi; «ارزقوهم» emir fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bih; «فيها» câr ve mecrûr olup «ارزقوهم»e müteallik; «اكسوهم», «ارزقوهم»e atıf; «قولوا» da «وارزقوهم»e atıftır; «لهم» câr ve mecrûr olup «قولوا»ya müteallik; «قولا» mef'ûl-i mutlak; «معروفا» sıfat.
(وَابْتَلُوا الْيَتامى حَتَّى إِذا بَلَغُوا النِّكاحَ): Vav atıf harfi; söz ma'tûftur; onda yetimlerin mallarının kendilerine teslim edilme vaktinin belirlenmesi vardır. «اليتامى», «ابتلوا» fiilinin mef'ûlün bihi. «حتى» gâye ve cer harfidir; bulûğa ermeyi ve rüşdün görülmesini (malların) verilmesinin gâyesi kılmıştır. Denmiştir ki:
«حتى» ibtidâiyyedir, fakat gâye ifade eder; bu, kendisinden sonra cümlelerin geldiği «حتى»dır; (şairin) şu sözündeki gibi:
فما زالت القتلى تمجّ دماءها ... بدجلة حتى ماء دجلة أشكل
(Öldürülenler Dicle'de kanlarını akıtmaya devam etti; öyle ki Dicle'nin suyu kızıla çalan bir renk aldı.)
«إذا», şart anlamını tazammun eden istikbal zarfıdır; «بلغوا النكاح» cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir.
(فَإِنْ آنَسْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ رُشْداً): Fâ şartın cevabı için râbıta; «إن» şart edatı; «آنستم» fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallinde mâzî fiil. «فإن آنستم» cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır. «منهم» câr ve mecrûr olup «آنستم»e müteallik; «رشدا» mef'ûlün bih.
(فَادْفَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوالَهُمْ): Fâ râbıta; «ادفعوا» emir fiil, vav fâil; «إليهم» câr ve mecrûr olup «ادفعوا»ya müteallik; «أموالهم» mef'ûlün bih. Cümle şartın cevabı olarak cezm mahallindedir.
(وَلا تَأْكُلُوها إِسْرافاً وَبِداراً أَنْ يَكْبَرُوا): Vav isti'nâfiyye; «لا» nâhiye; «تأكلوها» «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiil, vav fâil, hâ mef'ûl. «إسرافا» ve «بدارا» hâl mevziinde iki masdardır, yani «israf ederek ve acele ederek»; ya da ikisi mef'ûlün lieclih mevziindedir, yani «israfınız ve onların büyümesinden önce davranmanız sebebiyle». «أن يكبروا» masdarın mef'ûlün bihi olan müevvel masdardır; ya da mef'ûlün lieclihtir ve (masdarın) mef'ûlün bihi mahzûftur; bu durumda bir muzâf takdir etmek zorunludur, yani «مخافة أن يكبروا» (büyüyecekleri korkusuyla). Cümle isti'nâfiyyedir. Sözün zâhiri vavın âtıfe olduğunu çağrıştırdığı hâlde onu isti'nâfiyye saymamızın sebebi şudur: (Atıf olsaydı) anlam «Onlara verin ve onu yemeyin» olurdu; bu ise fâsittir; çünkü şart ve cevabı bulûğa ermeye terettüp etmektedir; dolayısıyla bundan, (yememenin de) ona terettüp eden şeye terettüp etmesi lâzım gelir; bu ise imkânsızdır.
(وَمَنْ كانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ): Vav isti'nâfiyye; «من» mübtedâ olan cezmeden şart ismi; «كان» nâkıs mâzî fiil; ismi takdiri «هو» olan müstetir zamir; «غنيا» haberi. Fiilü'ş-şart ve cevabından oluşan cümle mübtedâ olan «من»in haberidir. «فليستعفف»: Fâ şartın cevabı için râbıta; lâm emir lâmı; «يستعفف» onunla meczûm.
(وَمَنْ كانَ فَقِيراً فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ): Öncekine atıftır; i'rabı geçmiştir. «بالمعروف» câr ve mecrûr olup «يأكل»e müteallik. Ayet vasînin durumunu zengin olması ile fakir olması arasında taksim etmektedir: Zengin, Allah'ın kendisine lütfettiğiyle yetinir; fakir ise yetimin malını gözeterek gücü yettiğince ihtiyatlı davranıp örfe uygun şekilde yer. «فليأكل» cümlesi şartın cevabı olarak cezm mahallindedir; fiilü'ş-şart ve cevabı «من»in haberi olarak ref' mahallindedir.
(فَإِذا دَفَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوالَهُمْ فَأَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِمْ): Fâ isti'nâfiyye; «إذا» gelecek zaman için zarf; «دفعتم إليهم أموالهم» cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallinde. Fâ şartın cevabı için râbıta; «أشهدوا» emir fiil ve fâil; cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır. «عليهم» câr ve mecrûr olup «أشهدوا»ya müteallik.
(وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ حَسِيباً): Vav isti'nâfiyye; «كفى» mâzî fiil; «بالله»: Bâ zâid cer harfi; «الله», «كفى»nın fâili olup lafzen bâ ile mecrûrdur; «حسيبا» temyîz.

* Belâgat:
Bu ayette beyânın ilginç türlerinden biri vardır; buna «manânın kuvveti için lafzın kuvveti» adı verilir. Bu, «فليستعفف» sözündedir: «استعفّ», «عفّ»tan daha beliğdir; sanki kişi nefsini kırmak ve onu, toplumun fertlerine öncülük etmesi gereken temizliğe sevk etmek için nefsinden iffetin artmasını talep etmektedir. Bilinmektedir ki bir lafız vezinlerden birinde iken ondan daha fazla (harfli) başka bir vezne nakledilirse, ilk başta içerdiğinden daha fazla mana içermesi kaçınılmazdır; çünkü lafızlar manalara delâlet eder; lafızlarda artırma yapılınca bu artış manalarda da artışı gerektirir. Bu tür ancak mübalağada kullanılır. Bunlardan biri onların şu sözüdür:
«أعشب المكان» (yer otlandı); otun çokluğunu gördüklerinde «اعشوشب» derler. Bundan biri de:
«قدر» ve «اقتدر»dır; «اقتدر»ın anlamı «قدر»ın anlamından daha kuvvetlidir; bu yüzden Allah Teâlâ:
«فأخذناهم أخذ عزيز مقتدر» buyurmuştur. Ebû Nüvâs bu nükteye göz dikmiş ve şöyle demiştir:
فعفوت عني عفو مقتدر ... حلت له نقم فألغاها
(Beni, intikamları kendisine helal olduğu hâlde onları iptal eden kudretli birinin affıyla affettin.)
Yani: «Beni, hiçbir şeyin kudretini yürütmekten kendisini alıkoyamadığı, kudrete tam sahip birinin affıyla affettin.»

* Fevâid:
(كَفى): En sahih görüşe göre mâzî fiildir; bu ayette olduğu gibi fâiline bâ ziyade edilir. Mef'ûlün bihine de ziyade edilebilir; Ebu't-Tayyib el-Mütenebbî'nin şu sözündeki gibi:
كفى بجسمي نحولا أنني رجل ... لولا مخاطبتي إياك لم ترني
(Zayıflık olarak bedenime şu yeter: Ben öyle bir adamım ki seninle konuşmasaydım beni göremezdin.)
«كفى»nın fâilinin bâdan soyulmuş olarak gelmesi azdır; Suhaym'ın şu sözündeki gibi:
عميرة ودّع ان تجهّزت غاديا ... كفى الشيب والإسلام للمرء ناهيا
(Sabah yola çıkmak için hazırlandıysan Umeyre'ye veda et; ağarmış saç ve İslam kişiye nehyedici olarak yeter.)
«كفى», «أجزأ» veya «أغنى» (yetti, müstağni kıldı) anlamında olduğunda fâiline veya mef'ûlüne bâ ziyade edilmez; (şairin) şu sözündeki gibi:
قليل منك يكفيني ولكن ... قليلك لا يقال له قليل
(Senden azı bana yeter; fakat senin azına az denmez.)
Korumak (وقاية) kökünden «وقى» anlamındaki «كفى»da da (ziyade edilmez); Allah Teâlâ'nın «وكفى الله المؤمنين القتال» sözündeki gibi. Bununla birlikte Ebu't-Tayyib'i, «أجزأ» veya «أغنى» anlamındaki «كفى»nın fâiline onu ziyade ettiği için eleştirmişlerdir; o şöyle demiştir:
كفى ثعلا فخرا بأنك منهم ... ودهر لأن أمسيت من أهله أهل
(Senin onlardan olman Ta'l (ثعل) kabilesine övünç olarak yeter; senin ehlinden olduğun bir zaman da (övülmeye) layıktır.)
Tenkitçiler bu beytin şerhinde uzun uzun konuşmuşlardır; onun Divan'ında ona müracaat et.

Yetim Hakkındaki Sıkılık:
İslam şeriatı, yetimin işi ve ona örfe uygun şekilde muamele edilmesi hususunda sıkı davranmıştır; bununla birlikte onun mallarını idare etmesi sebebiyle vasîye bir hak tanımıştır. Hz. Peygamber (s.a.v.)'den rivayet edildiğine göre bir adam ona: «Benim himayemde bir yetim var, onun malından yiyebilir miyim?» demiş; o da: «Örfe uygun olarak; (kendine) mal biriktirmeksizin ve kendi malını onun malıyla korumaksızın» buyurmuştur. Adam:
«Onu dövebilir miyim?» demiş; o da: «Kendi çocuğunu dövdüğün sebeplerden dolayı» buyurmuştur.

* Vocabulary:
(كَلالَةً): maṣdar (verbal noun) of كلّ فلان, when he is neither a child nor a parent [of the deceased], i.e. he fell short (كلّ) of attaining the immediate kinship. Al-Ṭirimmāḥ said, describing the bull:
يهزّ سلاحا لم يرثه كلالة ... يشكّ به منها غموض المغابن
(He brandishes a weapon he did not inherit through distant kin, with which he pierces the hidden folds of their armpits.)
The scholars of jurisprudence and exegesis have spoken much about al-kalāla, and more will be said about this word in this sura.

* I'rab:
(وَلَكُمْ نِصْفُ ما تَرَكَ أَزْواجُكُمْ): the واو is a conjunction; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); نصف is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ما is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ترك is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; أزواجكم is the fāʿil (agent). (إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُنَّ وَلَدٌ): إن is conditional; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يكن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and it is also the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); لهن is the fronted khabar of يكن and ولد its postponed noun; the conditional clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. (فَإِنْ كانَ لَهُنَّ وَلَدٌ): the فاء is conjunctive; إن is conditional; كان with its fronted khabar and postponed noun; the clause is conjoined. (فَلَكُمُ الرُّبُعُ مِمَّا تَرَكْنَ): the فاء is linking; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; الربع is the postponed mubtadaʾ; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause تركن is the ṣila; the clause joined with the فاء is the apodosis. (مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ يُوصِينَ بِها أَوْ دَيْنٍ): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl; وصية is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause يوصين is a naʿt (adjective) of وصية; بها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يوصين; أو is a conjunction and دين is conjoined to وصية. (وَلَهُنَّ الرُّبُعُ مِمَّا تَرَكْتُمْ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكُمْ وَلَدٌ فَإِنْ كانَ لَكُمْ وَلَدٌ فَلَهُنَّ الثُّمُنُ مِمَّا تَرَكْتُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ تُوصُونَ بِها أَوْ دَيْنٍ): the i'rab of all of this has been given before, so turn back to it. (وَإِنْ كانَ رَجُلٌ يُورَثُ كَلالَةً): the واو is conjunctive; إن is conditional; كان may be either defective (nāqiṣa) or complete (tāmma). If it is defective, رجل is its noun, the clause يورث, in the passive, is its khabar, and كلالة is a ḥāl. If it is complete, رجل is the fāʿil, the clause يورث is an adjective, and كلالة is a ḥāl. كلالة may also be parsed as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), its meaning then being kinship; or as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar if its meaning is the heirs, i.e. he is inherited from with an inheritance of kalāla. Some permitted it to be a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), but I do not find that acceptable. (أَوِ امْرَأَةٌ وَلَهُ أَخٌ أَوْ أُخْتٌ): أو is a conjunction and امرأة is conjoined to رجل; وله: the واو is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; أخ is the postponed mubtadaʾ; أو is a conjunction and أخت is conjoined to أخ. (فَلِكُلِّ واحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا السُّدُسُ): the فاء is linking; لكل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; واحد is muḍāf ilayhi; منهما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of واحد; السدس is the postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause joined with the فاء is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. (فَإِنْ كانُوا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذلِكَ فَهُمْ شُرَكاءُ فِي الثُّلُثِ): the فاء is resumptive; إن is conditional; كانوا is a defective past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis; the واو is the noun of كان and أكثر its khabar; من ذلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أكثر; the فاء is linking; هم is a mubtadaʾ and شركاء a khabar; في الثلث is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شركاء. (مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ يُوصى بِها أَوْ دَيْنٍ): its i'rab has been given before, so renew your acquaintance with it. (غَيْرَ مُضَارٍّ وَصِيَّةً مِنَ اللَّهِ): غير مضار is a ḥāl from the pronoun of يوصى; وصية is an emphatic mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of يوصيكم; من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of وصية. (وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ): the واو is resumptive; الله is a mubtadaʾ, and عليم and حليم are its two khabars.

* Benefits:
1- A curious discussion:
Al-Shalawbīn said: it was related to me that a grammarian was asked about the i'rab of «كلالة» in the words of the Exalted: (وَإِنْ كانَ رَجُلٌ يُورَثُ كَلالَةً). He said: "Tell me: what is al-kalāla?" They told him: "The heirs when there is among them no father or higher, and no son or lower." He said: "Then it is a tamyīz (specification)." The explanation of his view is that the original form would be: «وإن كان رجل يرثه كلالة»; then the agent was omitted and the verb made passive, so the pronoun became nominative and latent; then كلالة was brought as a tamyīz.
Ibn Hishām's rejoinder:
Ibn Hishām replied to this grammarian, saying: «This grammarian was right in his question and wrong in his answer, for specifying by the agent after omitting it undoes the purpose for which it was omitted, and goes back on what the clause was built upon, namely folding away mention of the agent in it. For this reason there is nothing in their speech like: ضرب أخوك رجلا.» Ibn Hishām digressed, as is his habit, until he said: «The correct view in the verse is that «كلالة» is with an implied annexed noun, i.e. ذا كلالة (one of kalāla), and it is either a ḥāl from the pronoun of يورث — so «كان» is defective and يورث is the khabar, or complete and يورث is an adjective — or it is a khabar, and يورث is an adjective. Whoever explained «كلالة» as the deceased who left neither child nor parent, it is likewise a ḥāl or a khabar, but it does not need an implied omitted annexed noun. And whoever explained it as kinship, it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi.»
2- It is the custom of the Arabs, when they alternate between two nouns with أو, to refer the pronoun back to both of them together — you say: «من كان له أخ أو أخت فليصلهما» (whoever has a brother or a sister, let him keep ties with them both) — or to one of them, whichever you wish: you say «من كان له أخ أو أخت فليصله», and if you wish, «فليصلها».

* Vocabulary:
(الرئاء) and al-riyāʾ: spending for the sake of boasting and vying.

* I'rab:
(وَالَّذِينَ يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوالَهُمْ رِئاءَ النَّاسِ) The wāw is a conjunction; الذين is conjoined to the preceding الذين; the clause ينفقون is the ṣila; أموالهم is a direct object; and رئاء الناس is an interpreted ḥāl, i.e. "showing off"; it may also be parsed as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, i.e. "so that it may be said: how generous they are!", and this is more apparent than the ḥāl, for the conditions for the accusative are fulfilled in it. (وَلا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَلا بِالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ) Conjoined to what precedes; the secret of the repetition of لا will come in the section on Rhetoric. (وَمَنْ يَكُنِ الشَّيْطانُ لَهُ قَرِيناً) The wāw is resumptive; من is conditional, a mubtadaʾ; يكن is the protasis; له is attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective of «قرينا»; and قرينا is the khabar of يكن. (فَساءَ قَرِيناً) The fāʾ links the apodosis, because ساء here is a non-conjugating (jāmid) past verb used to express censure; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «هو»; قرينا is a tamyīz explaining the fāʿil; and the one specified for censure is omitted, its implied form being «هو», referring back to «الشيطان».
The clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of «من».

* Rhetoric:
In the repetition of the negative «لا» there is the art of repetition, and likewise of the bāʾ, to signal that each of the two is negated separately. If you say: لا أكرم زيدا وعمرا, the speech admits that generosity is negated of the pair together without it following that generosity is negated of each one of them, and it also admits that it is negated of both. But if you say: «ولا عمرا», the negation of generosity of both together is determined.

* Vocabulary:
(المثقال): what something is weighed against, whether heavy or much. The mithqāl of a thing is its weight or its balance; the plural is mathāqīl. By custom the mithqāl equals a dirham and a half, and it may sometimes exceed or fall short of that somewhat.

* I'rab:
(وَماذا عَلَيْهِمْ لَوْ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ) The wāw is resumptive; as for ماذا, it was said earlier that we have two ways of parsing it. One is that you make «ما» interrogative, in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ, and «ذا» a relative here specifically, the khabar of «ما»; then «عليهم» is attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative. The other
is that you make the whole of ماذا an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ, and عليهم attached to an omitted khabar. What is meant by the question here is rebuke, censure and denunciation. لو is conditional; آمنوا is the protasis, and the apodosis is omitted, the implication being "what harm would that do them?"
It is a common construction: you say to the avenger, "What would it harm you if you forgave?", and to the disobedient child, "What would it cost you if you were dutiful to your parents?", although it is known that there is neither harm nor loss in forgiveness and dutifulness; it is purely for rebuke and censure. It is also possible that «لو» is a maṣdar particle, and the interpreted maṣdar from «لو» and the verb is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "what is upon them in their believing". بالله is attached to آمنوا; اليوم is conjoined to the word of majesty; and الآخر is an adjective. (وَأَنْفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَهُمُ اللَّهُ) Conjoined to آمنوا; مما is attached to أنفقوا; and the clause رزقهم الله is the ṣila of the relative. (وَكانَ اللَّهُ بِهِمْ عَلِيماً) The wāw is resumptive; كان and its ism; بهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عليما; and عليما is the khabar of كان. (إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَظْلِمُ مِثْقالَ ذَرَّةٍ) A resumptive clause, introduced as a preface to mentioning the recompense for good deeds and bad deeds. إن and its ism; the clause لا يظلم is its khabar; and مثقال ذرة is an adjective of an omitted verbal noun, i.e. "a wrong the weight of an atom".
It was also said that «يظلم» is made to include the meaning of a verb that takes two objects, so «مثقال» is accusative as a second direct object, and the second is omitted [Translator's note: so in the source; from the context the first is probably meant], the implication being: "He does not diminish or defraud anyone of the weight of an atom". The first is easier and involves less strain. (وَإِنْ تَكُ حَسَنَةً يُضاعِفْها) The wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; تك is the protasis, its jussive sign being the sukūn implied on the nūn, which is omitted from the jussive imperfect of كان for lightness, a discussion of which has preceded. The ism of تك refers back to المثقال, and he made it feminine because it is annexed to ذرة, as has also been discussed. حسنة is the khabar of «تك»; يضاعفها is the apodosis and the hāʾ is a direct object. (وَيُؤْتِ مِنْ لَدُنْهُ أَجْراً عَظِيماً) يؤت is conjoined to يضاعفها; من لدنه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤت, or to an omitted ḥāl because it precedes the thing qualified; أجرا is a direct object and عظيما an adjective.

* I'rab:
(فَكَيْفَ إِذا جِئْنا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ): The فاء is resumptive, and كيف is an interrogative noun. In a construction like this it admits of two analyses and no third: first, that it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "how is their state?"; second, that it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of an omitted element, i.e. "how will they act?". إذا is an adverb of time attached to this omitted element, and the clause جئنا is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of a genitive construct). من كل is attached to an omitted element functioning as ḥāl, because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of شهيد that was then placed before it; بشهيد is attached to جئنا. There is also a third analysis, which Ibn ʿAṭiyya reported from Makkī, namely that «كيف» is governed by جئنا. (وَجِئْنا بِكَ عَلى هؤُلاءِ شَهِيداً): The واو is a conjunction; جئنا is a verb and agent, and the two are conjoined to the first جئنا; بك [Translator's note: the source reads «ولك»] is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جئنا; على هؤلاء is attached to «شهيدا»; and شهيدا is a ḥāl. (يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا): The adverb is attached to يودّ. إذ is an adverb annexed to the adverb, and the adverb and the tanwīn are a compensation for a clause. [Translator's note: the source reads "annexed to the adverb"; the sense is that it is annexed to the omitted clause, for which the tanwīn compensates.] The implied sense is: "on the day when We bring a witness from every nation and bring you as a witness against these, those who disbelieved will wish". The clause يود is resumptive, and the clause كفروا is a ṣila (relative clause). (وَعَصَوُا الرَّسُولَ لَوْ تُسَوَّى بِهِمُ الْأَرْضُ): The واو is a conjunction; عصوا الرسول is conjoined to كفروا. لو is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) after a verb of wishing, and together with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar functioning as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يود, i.e. "they wish that the earth be levelled over them so that they are buried in it"; and الأرض is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of تسوّى. (وَلا يَكْتُمُونَ اللَّهَ حَدِيثاً): It is conjoined to «يود», and it may also be resumptive. يكتمون is an imperfect verb, nominative, its nominative marking being the retention of the nūn; and الله is accusative by removal of the preposition, and حديثا is a mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "they do not conceal from Allah any statement". Some scholars permitted that the name of Majesty (الله) be a mafʿūl bihi of يكتمون, because in their view it takes two objects.

* Benefits:
The tanwīn attached to annexed adverbs such as يومئذ, حينئذ and عندئذ is called the nūn of compensation (nūn al-taʿwīḍ), because it is a compensation for a clause, as you saw in the section on i'rab. Then two quiescent letters meet, the dhāl of «إذ» and the tanwīn, so the dhāl is given a kasra according to the basic rule for the meeting of two quiescent letters. This kasra is not a kasra of i'rab, because «إذ» is permanently indeclinable. Nor is the annexation in «يومئذ» and the like an annexation of one synonym to another; rather it is the annexation of the more general to the more specific, as in "shajar arāk" (the tree of arāk).

* Lügat:
(جُنُباً): Bilinen bir kelimedir. Müzekker ve müennes, tekil, tesniye ve çoğul bunda eşittir; çünkü o, «الإجناب» masdarı yerine geçmiş bir isimdir. Dilde meşhur ve fasih olan budur; Kur'an da bununla gelmiştir. Onu ref' hâlinde vâv ve nûn, nasb ve cer hâlinde yâ ve nûn ile cem-i sâlim yaparak «قوم جنبون» demişler; cem-i teksîr yaparak da «قوم أجناب» demişlerdir. Tesniyesinde ise «جنبان» demişlerdir.
(الْغائِطِ): Aslında yeryüzünün geniş ve çukur kısmıdır. Adam ihtiyacını gidermek istediğinde yeryüzünün bir çukuruna giderdi; bu yüzden abdest bozan herkes için, hadesi açıkça anmaktan utanılarak «تغوّط» denmiştir.
(الصعيد): Topraktır. «التيمم بالصعيد» ifadesinde teyemmümün aslı kastetmektir; «تيمّمتك», «تأمّمتك» ve «أممتك» (seni kastettim) denir. Sonra bu kelimeyi çok kullanmışlar, nihayet teyemmüm, yüzü ve elleri toprakla meshetmek olmuştur. Bütün bunlarda asıl, bitkiden, ağaçlardan ve binadan boş, düz yeryüzüdür. Zü'r-Rumme'nin şu sözü de bundandır:
كأنه بالضحى ترمي الصعيد به ... دبابة في عظام الرأس خرطوم
(Kuşluk vakti onu yeryüzüne çarpması, sanki kafa kemiklerinde dolaşan sert bir şarabın etkisiyledir.)
Yani onu yeryüzüne atar.

* İ'rab:
(يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا): Benzerlerinin i'rabı geçti.
(لا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَنْتُمْ سُكارى): Sarhoşluk hâlinde namazı yasaklamak için getirilmiş müste'nef bir sözdür. (لا) nehiy harfidir. (تقربوا) «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiildir; (الواو) fâildir. (الصلاة) mef'ûlün bihtir. (وأنتم): (الواو) hâl içindir; (أنتم) mübtedâ, (سكارى) haberidir.
(حَتَّى تَعْلَمُوا ما تَقُولُونَ): (حتى) gâye ve cer harfidir. (تعلموا) «حتى»den sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir. (ما) ism-i mevsûl olup mef'ûlün bihtir; «ما»nın masdariyye olması ve müevvel masdarın mef'ûlün bih olması da caizdir. «أن» ve sonrası «حتى» ile mecrûr bir masdar te'vilindedir; câr ve mecrûr (تقربوا)ya mütealliktir.
(وَلا جُنُباً إِلَّا عابِرِي سَبِيلٍ حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلُوا): «وأنتم سكارى» sözüne ma'tûftur; çünkü o, «تقربوا»nın fâilinden hâl olarak nasb mahallinde olan bir cümledir; sanki şöyle denmiştir: «Namaza sarhoş olarak ve cünüp olarak yaklaşmayın.» (إلا) hasr edatıdır. (عابري سبيل), muhatapların genel hâllerinden istisnâdır; bu sebeple hâl olarak mansûbtur. İki hâl bir araya getirilmiştir ki iki hâlin bulunduğuna delâlet etsin; sanki şöyle denmiştir: «Cünüplük hâlinde namaza yaklaşmayın; ancak sizinle birlikte, içinde mazur sayılacağınız başka bir hâl, yani yolculuk bulunursa başka.» Yoldan geçmek (عبور السبيل) yolculuktan ibarettir. «حتى تغتسلوا» da «حتى تعلموا» gibidir; nehiy fiiline mütealliktir.
(وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضى أَوْ عَلى سَفَرٍ): (الواو) atıf harfidir. (إن) şart edatıdır. (كنتم): «كان» nâkıs mâzî fiil olup fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir; (التاء) ismi, (مرضى) haberidir. (أو) atıf harfidir. (على سفر): câr ve mecrûr «مرضى»ya atfen nasb mahallindedir.
(أَوْ جاءَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ مِنَ الْغائِطِ): (أو) atıf harfidir. (جاء) öncekine ma'tûftur. (أحد) fâildir. (منكم) câr ve mecrûr olup «أحد»in mahzûf sıfatına mütealliktir. (من الغائط) (جاء)ya mütealliktir.
(أَوْ لامَسْتُمُ النِّساءَ): Bu da ma'tûftur. Buna göre şartın hükmüne girenler dörttür —bu hükümler hakkında daha fazla açıklama Mâide sûresinde gelecektir—: hastalar, yolcular, abdestsizler ve cünüpler.
(فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا ماءً): (الفاء) atıf harfidir; cümle (كنتم)e ma'tûftur.
(فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيداً طَيِّباً): (الفاء) şartın cevabını bağlar. (تيمموا) emir fiildir; (الواو) fâildir. (صعيدا) mef'ûlün bih, (طيبا) sıfattır. (فتيمموا) cümlesi şartın cevabı olarak cezm mahallindedir.
(فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ): (الفاء) atıf harfidir. (امسحوا), (تيمموا)ya ma'tûftur. (بوجوهكم) (امسحوا)ya mütealliktir. Sîbeveyh «مسحت رأسه» ve «مسحت برأسه» (başını meshettim) kullanımlarını nakletmiştir. (أيديكم), (وجوهكم)e ma'tûftur. Bazı nahivciler bânın teb'îz (bir kısmını ifade) için olduğunu söylemiş ve Allah Teâlâ'nın «عينا يشرب بها عباد الله» sözünü ve Ömer b. Ebî Rebîa'nın şu sözünü bundan saymışlardır:
فلثمت فاها آخذا بقرونها ... شرب النزيف ببرد ماء الحشرج
(Saç örgülerinden tutarak ağzını öptüm; sersemlemiş (en-nezîf) kimsenin Haşrec suyunun serinliğinden içmesi gibi.)
Başkaları ise onun isti'ânet (vasıta) için olduğunu söylemiştir. Bunların hepsi câizdir.
(إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ عَفُوًّا غَفُوراً): (إن) ve ismi; «كان», ismi ve iki haberi «إن»nin haberidir.

* Belâgat:
1- «من الغائط» sözünde kinâye vardır; zikri çirkin görülen şeyden kinâye yapmıştır. İki görüşten birine göre «الملامسة» ile de cimâdan kinâye yapmıştır. Bu, Mâide sûresinde ayrıntılı olarak gelecektir.
2- «أو جاء أحد» sözünde iltifat vardır: Hitaptan gâib sîgasına iltifat etmiştir; çünkü bu, anılmasından utanılan bir şeyden kinâyedir; bu yüzden onlara bununla doğrudan hitap etmemiştir. Bu, sözün güzelliklerindendir.

* Vocabulary:
(جُنُباً): well known. The masculine and feminine, the singular, dual and plural are alike in it, because it is a noun that has taken on the role of the verbal noun, which is al-ijnāb. This is the well-known and eloquent usage in the language, and the Qur'an came with it. They have also formed a sound plural of it with wāw and nūn in the nominative and yāʾ and nūn in the accusative and genitive, saying "qawm junubūn"; and a broken plural, saying "qawm ajnāb"; and as for the dual, they said "junubān".
(الْغائِطِ): originally the wide, low-lying hollow of land. When a man wished to relieve himself, he would go to a hollow (ghāʾiṭ) of the ground, so everyone who had an occurrence of ritual impurity came to be described as "taghawwaṭa", out of modesty about mentioning the impurity.
(الصعيد): earth. Tayammum with ṣaʿīd is originally "deliberate intent"; one says "tayammamtuka", "taʾammamtuka" and "amamtuka". Then they used this word so often that tayammum came to mean wiping the face and hands with earth. The basis of all this is the surface of the ground, free of plants, trees and buildings, and level. From it comes the saying of Dhū l-Rumma:
كأنه بالضحى ترمي الصعيد به ... دبابة في عظام الرأس خرطوم
(As if, in the forenoon, a creeping draught of strong wine (khurṭūm) in the bones of the head were casting him onto the ground.) He means: casting it onto the surface of the earth.

* I'rab:
(يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا): the i'rab of its like has already been given. (لا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَنْتُمْ سُكارى): A resumptive statement, introduced to forbid prayer in a state of drunkenness. لا is prohibitive; تقربوا is an imperfect verb jussive by لا, and the واو is the agent; الصلاة is a mafʿūl bihi; the واو in وأنتم is the wāw of ḥāl; أنتم is a mubtadaʾ and سكارى is its khabar. (حَتَّى تَعْلَمُوا ما تَقُولُونَ): حتى is a particle of limit and of genitive; تعلموا is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن after حتى; ما is a relative noun and mafʿūl bihi, though ما may also be maṣdar-forming, in which case the interpreted maṣdar is the mafʿūl bihi. أن and what follows it are in the interpretation of a maṣdar governed in the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تقربوا. (وَلا جُنُباً إِلَّا عابِرِي سَبِيلٍ حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلُوا): It is conjoined to His words وأنتم سكارى, for that is a clause whose position is accusative as ḥāl from the agent of تقربوا, as if it had been said: "do not approach the prayer drunk, nor in a state of major impurity". إلا is a particle of restriction; عابري سبيل is an exception from all the states of those addressed, so it is accusative as ḥāl. The two ḥāls are combined to show that there are two states, as if it had been said: "do not approach the prayer in a state of major impurity unless there is with you another state in which you are excused, namely travel"; and "crossing a way" is an expression for travelling. «حتى تغتسلوا» is like «حتى تعلموا», and it is attached to the verb of prohibition. (وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضى أَوْ عَلى سَفَرٍ): The واو is a conjunction, and إن is conditional; كنتم: كان is a defective past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the تاء is its ism; مرضى is its khabar; أو is a conjunction; and the preposition and its genitive noun على سفر are in the position of accusative, conjoined to مرضى. (أَوْ جاءَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ مِنَ الْغائِطِ): أو is a conjunction; جاء is conjoined to what preceded; أحد is the agent; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element functioning as naʿt of أحد; and من الغائط is attached to جاء. (أَوْ لامَسْتُمُ النِّساءَ): Conjoined as well. So those who fall under the ruling of the condition are four, and more explanation of these rulings will come in Sūrat al-Māʾida; they are the sick, travellers, those who have had a minor impurity, and those in a state of major impurity. (فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا ماءً): The فاء is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to كنتم. (فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيداً طَيِّباً): The فاء links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); تيمموا is an imperative verb and the واو is the agent; صعيدا is a mafʿūl bihi and طيبا a naʿt; and the clause فتيمموا is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. (فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ): The فاء is a conjunction; امسحوا is conjoined to تيمموا; بوجوهكم is attached to امسحوا. Sībawayh reported: "masaḥtu raʾsahu" and "masaḥtu biraʾsihi". And أيديكم is conjoined to وجوهكم. Some grammarians said the باء denotes partitiveness (tabʿīḍ), and counted among such cases His words «عينا يشرب بها عباد الله», and the saying of ʿUmar ibn Abī Rabīʿa:
فلثمت فاها آخذا بقرونها ... شرب النزيف ببرد ماء الحشرج
(I kissed her mouth, taking hold of her locks, drinking like one dazed from the coolness of the water of al-Ḥashraj.)
Others said it denotes instrumentality (istiʿāna). All of that is acceptable. (إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ عَفُوًّا غَفُوراً): إن and its ism; and كان with its ism and khabar are the khabar of إنّ.

* Rhetoric:
1- Euphemism (kināya) in His words: من الغائط, for He used a euphemism for what is distasteful to mention; and "touching" (mulāmasa) for sexual intercourse, according to one of the two views. This will come in detail in al-Māʾida.
2- Iltifāt (shift of person) in His words: «أو جاء أحد», for He shifted from the second person to the third, because it is a euphemism for what one is ashamed to mention, so He did not address them with it. This is among the finer points of speech.

* Vocabulary:
(الجبت): the idol, and everything worshipped besides Allah.
(الطاغوت): the sorcerer. Many legends have been woven around the two, which you will find in the longer works.

* I'rab:
(أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا نَصِيباً مِنَ الْكِتابِ): A resumptive statement, introduced to speak of Kaʿb ibn al-Ashraf and others of the Jews when they came to Makka, saw the slain of Badr, and incited the polytheists to take revenge for them and to fight the Prophet ﷺ. The i'rab of its like was given just before. نصيبا is the second object of أوتوا, and من الكتاب is attached to an omitted element functioning as naʿt of نصيبا. (يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوتِ): The clause يؤمنون is a ḥāl from «الذين» or from the واو in أوتوا; and if the seeing is of the heart, its position is accusative as second mafʿūl bihi of the «تر» of knowing. (وَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا): The واو is a conjunction and يقولون is conjoined to يؤمنون; وللذين is attached to يقولون; and the clause كفروا is a ṣila of the relative. (هؤُلاءِ أَهْدى مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا سَبِيلًا): The clause is in the position of accusative as the quoted speech of their saying; هؤلاء is a demonstrative and mubtadaʾ; أهدى is its khabar; من الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أهدى; the clause آمنوا is a ṣila of the relative; and سبيلا is a tamyīz. (أُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ): A resumptive clause to show their state and the reality of their affair. أولئك is a mubtadaʾ; الذين is the khabar of the demonstrative; and the clause لعنهم is a ṣila of the relative. (وَمَنْ يَلْعَنِ اللَّهُ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُ نَصِيراً): The واو is resumptive; من is conditional and a fronted mafʿūl bihi of يلعن; يلعن is the protasis, jussive, and given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. Al-Jalāl (may Allah have mercy on him) erred, for he implied an accusative pronoun, and it escaped him that the wording of the Qur'an may not be tampered with. الله is the agent; the فاء links the apodosis; لن is a particle of negation, putting the verb in the accusative (naṣb), and futurity; تجد is an imperfect verb made accusative by لن; the clause joined with the فاء is in the position of jussive as apodosis; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نصيرا; and نصيرا is the mafʿūl bihi of تجد. The protasis and apodosis are the khabar of «من».
(أَمْ لَهُمْ نَصِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُلْكِ): أم is a disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) conjunction meaning بل; it is a conjunction of rejection and transition from censuring them for declaring themselves pure and the like, to censuring them for something else, namely their claim that they have a share of sovereignty. لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element functioning as fronted khabar; نصيب is a delayed mubtadaʾ; and من الملك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element functioning as naʿt of نصيب. (فَإِذاً لا يُؤْتُونَ النَّاسَ نَقِيراً): The فاء is the "eloquent" (faṣīḥa) فاء, because it discloses an implied condition, i.e. "if they were given a share of sovereignty, then…". إذن is a particle of response and consequence, and it has been made inoperative because it occurs after a conjunction, which is the more eloquent usage, as will come in the section on benefits. لا is negative; يؤتون is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the واو is the agent; الناس is the first mafʿūl bihi and نقيرا the second. (أَمْ يَحْسُدُونَ النَّاسَ عَلى ما آتاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ): أم is a particle of conjunction and rejection meaning بل, and it is for beginning the second of their ugly traits; يحسدون is an imperfect verb, nominative; الناس is a mafʿūl bihi; على ما آتاهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يحسدون; the clause آتاهم is a ṣila; الله is the agent; and من فضله is attached to آتاهم. (فَقَدْ آتَيْنا آلَ إِبْراهِيمَ الْكِتابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ): The فاء is causal, as if giving the reason for the denial and the condemnation; قد is a particle of emphasis; آتينا is a verb and agent; آل ابراهيم is the first mafʿūl bihi; الكتاب the second; and الحكمة is conjoined to الكتاب. (وَآتَيْناهُمْ مُلْكاً عَظِيماً): conjoined to what preceded.

* Benefits:
(إذا) [Translator's note: the source prints إذا, but إذن is clearly meant throughout the discussion that follows.] is one of the particles that make the imperfect verb accusative by themselves, whereas the others do so through an implied أن accompanying them; they are: أن, لن, إذن, كي. As for إذن, it is a particle that governs the accusative because of its specificity and because it turns the verb to the future, and it is a particle of response and consequence. It has three cases:
1- That it enters the verb at the beginning of the response; here it must be operative, as in your saying "idhan akrimuka" ("then I will honour you"), in response to "I will visit you".
2- That what precedes it is a wāw or a fāʾ; here it is permissible to make it operative or inoperative, on two different considerations, as in your saying "Zayd yaqūmu wa-idhan yadhhabu" ("Zayd stands and then he goes"). Here both nominative and accusative are permissible on two different considerations. That is, if you conjoin «wa-idhan yadhhabu» to «yaqūmu», which is the khabar, you make «idhan» inoperative and it becomes like the khabar, because what is conjoined to something takes its place, as if you had said "Zayd idhan yadhhabu", and so what follows it depends on what precedes it, because it is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. If you conjoin it to the first clause, the wāw is like a resumptive, and it is at the beginning of a speech, so for that reason it is made operative and the verb is accusative through it.
3- As for the third case, it is that it occurs in the middle, with what follows it depending on what precedes it, or the verb is a verb of present time, not future, in response to one who said: "I will visit you", "I, then, will honour you". Here the verb is nominative, because the verb after it depends on the mubtadaʾ, which is "anā". Likewise if you said: "In tukrimnī idhan akrimuka" ("If you honour me, then I will honour you"), the verb is jussive, because the verb after «idhan» depends on the particle of condition.
There are further details to which one returns in the books of grammar.

* I'rab:
(أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا بِما أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ): A resumptive statement, introduced to show the occasion for wonder at the state of those who claimed for themselves that they had combined belief in what was sent down to the Messenger of Allah, namely the Qur'an, and in what was sent down to the prophets before him, and then came with what contradicts this claim and topples it from its foundation, namely their desire to seek judgment from the ṭāghūt; thus they combined the two contradictories and joined the two opposites. The hamza is for interrogation of wonder. لم is a particle of negation, reversal and jussive; تر is an imperfect verb jussive by لم, its jussive marking being the dropping of the weak letter, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta", the one addressed being the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; إلى الذين is attached to تر; and the verb of seeing is suspended (ʿulliqa) if it is of the heart. [Translator's note: the source has the misspelling «فععل» for «فعل».] The clause يزعمون is a ṣila of the relative; وأنهم: أن and its ism, and the clause آمنوا is its khabar; أن with its ism has taken the place of the two objects of يزعمون; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آمنوا; أنزل is a passive past verb and the clause is a ṣila; and إليك is attached to أنزل. (وَما أُنْزِلَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ): The واو is a conjunction, and ما is conjoined to the first ما; the clause أنزل is a ṣila; and من قبلك is attached to أنزل or to an omitted element functioning as ḥāl. (يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَتَحاكَمُوا إِلَى الطَّاغُوتِ): The clause يريدون is a ḥāl clause; أن and what is within its scope are an interpreted maṣdar functioning as mafʿūl bihi of يريدون; and إلى الطاغوت is attached to يتحاكموا. (وَقَدْ أُمِرُوا أَنْ يَكْفُرُوا بِهِ): The واو is a wāw of ḥāl; قد is a particle of emphasis; أمروا is a passive past verb and the واو is the nāʾib fāʿil; أن يكفروا is an interpreted maṣdar accusative by removal of the preposition; and به is attached to يكفروا. (وَيُرِيدُ الشَّيْطانُ أَنْ يُضِلَّهُمْ ضَلالًا بَعِيداً): The واو is a conjunction; يريد الشيطان is conjoined to يريدون; أن يضلهم is an interpreted maṣdar, the object of يريد; ضلالا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq; and بعيدا is a naʿt.

* İ'rab:
(وَإِذا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعالَوْا إِلى ما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ وَإِلَى الرَّسُولِ): Onların hâlinden duyulan hayretin malzemesini tamamlamak için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye bir sözdür. Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; (إذا) şart anlamını içeren istikbal zarfıdır, cevaba —ki o «رأيت»tir— müteallik. (قيل) cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir; (لهم): «قيل»e müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur; (تعالوا) cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavldir; (إلى ما أنزل الله): «تعالوا»ya müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur; (أنزل الله) cümlesi sıladır; (إلى الرسول) «إلى ما أنزل الله» kavline ma'tûftur. (رَأَيْتَ الْمُنافِقِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنْكَ صُدُوداً): (رأيت) fiil ve fâildir; cümlenin, cezmetmeyen şartın cevabı olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. (المنافقين) mef'ûlün bihtir; (يصدون) cümlesi, görme gözle ise hâliyyedir; görme kalbî ise ikinci mef'ûlün bihtir. (عنك): «يصدون»a müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur; (صدودا) mef'ûl-i mutlaktır. (فَكَيْفَ إِذا أَصابَتْهُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ بِما قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ): fâ isti'nâfiyyedir; (كيف) fetha üzere mebnî istifhâm ismi olup hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir; yani: «Ne yaparlar?» veya «Onları nasıl görürsün?». Mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberi olması da caizdir; yani: «Yaptıkları ya da hâlleri nasıl olur?». (إذا) şart anlamını içeren istikbal zarfıdır, mahzûf cevaba müteallik; (أصابتهم) cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir; (مصيبة) fâildir; (بما): «أصابتهم»e müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur; «ما»nın masdariyye veya mevsûle olması caizdir. (قدمت أيديهم) cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; (أيديهم) fâildir. (ثُمَّ جاؤُكَ يَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَدْنا إِلَّا إِحْساناً وَتَوْفِيقاً): (ثم جاءوك) «أصابتهم»e ma'tûftur. Beyzâvî'nin gördüğü gibi bazılarının onu «يصدون» cümlesine atfetme işlemine ben bir cevaz görmüyorum. (يحلفون بالله) cümlesi hâliyyedir; (إن) nâfiyedir; (أردنا) fiil ve fâildir; (إلا) hasr edatıdır; (إحسانا) mef'ûlün bihtir; (توفيقا) «إحسانا»ya ma'tûftur. (أُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ ما فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ): cümle, onların münafıklığına dikkati artırmak için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyyedir. (أولئك) mübtedâ, (الذين) ism-i işaretin haberidir; (يعلم الله) cümlesi sıladır; (ما) ism-i mevsûl olup mef'ûlün bihtir; (في قلوبهم) mahzûf bir sılaya müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. (فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَعِظْهُمْ وَقُلْ لَهُمْ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ قَوْلًا بَلِيغاً): fâ fasîhadır; o, takdir edilen bir şartı açığa vuran fâdır; yani:
«Onların hâli böyle olunca, onlardan yüz çevir ve hiçbir özürlerini kabul etme.» (أعرض) emir fiildir, fâili «أنت»tir; (عنهم): «أعرض»e müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. Cümlenin, cezmetmeyen mahzûf bir şartın cevabı olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. (عظهم) «أعرض»e ma'tûftur; (قل لهم) «أعرض»e ma'tûftur; (لهم): «قل»e müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. (في أنفسهم): Bu câr ve mecrûrun neye müteallik olduğu hakkında sıhhat ve güzellikte eşit üç vecih vardır:
1- «بليغا»ya müteallik olması; çünkü onları tehdit etme emri kalplerinin derinliğine ulaşmıştır. «فكيف إذا أصابتهم مصيبة بما قدمت أيديهم», «ثم جاءوك» kavlindeki tehdit siyakı buna şahitlik eder.
2- «قل»e müteallik olması; anlamı: «Onlara, kötü nefisleri ve şerri gizleyen kalpleri hakkında beliğ bir söz söyle.» Siyaktan buna uyan, «أولئك الذين يعلم الله ما في قلوبهم» kavlidir; yani azgınlığın iç saikleri ve sapıklığın meyilleri (anlamında).
3- Mahzûf bir hâle müteallik olması; yani söylenen sözün, onların nefislerini aşmayan ve onların ötesine geçmeyen gizli bir söz olması hâlinde. Hz. Peygamber'in (s.a.v.) siyreti buna şahitlik eder; bu, doğruya dönüp isabete yönelmeleri ümidiyle Hz. Peygamber'in örtme ve yumuşaklığa olan düşkünlüğü ile de uyuşur. (قولا) mef'ûl-i mutlak, (بليغا) sıfattır; ya da onlarla baş başa olarak hâl (حال كونا خاليا بهم). [Mütercim notu: Bu son ibare kaynakta bu şekilde yer almaktadır; anlamı, üçüncü vecihte «في أنفسهم»in, Hz. Peygamber'in onlarla baş başa iken söylemesi hâlini ifade ettiği yönündedir.] Gizlice yapılan nasihat, açıkta yapılandan daha faydalıdır.

* I'rab:
(وَإِذا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعالَوْا إِلى ما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ وَإِلَى الرَّسُولِ): A resumptive statement, introduced to complete the material of wonder at their state. The واو is resumptive; إذا is an adverb of the future containing the meaning of condition, attached to the apodosis, which is رأيت; the clause قيل is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; لهم is attached to قيل; the clause تعالوا is the quoted speech; وإلى ما أنزل الله is attached to تعالوا; the clause أنزل الله is a ṣila of the relative; and وإلى الرسول is conjoined to His words: إلى ما أنزل الله. (رَأَيْتَ الْمُنافِقِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنْكَ صُدُوداً): رأيت is a verb and agent, and the clause has no position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; المنافقين is a mafʿūl bihi; the clause يصدون is a ḥāl if the seeing is of the eye, or a second mafʿūl bihi if the seeing is of the heart; عنك is attached to يصدون; and صدودا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq. (فَكَيْفَ إِذا أَصابَتْهُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ بِما قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ): The فاء is resumptive; كيف is an interrogative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as ḥāl, i.e. "how will they act?" or "how will you see them?"; it may also be a khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "how is their doing, or their state?". إذا is an adverb of the future containing the meaning of condition, attached to the omitted apodosis; the clause أصابتهم is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; مصيبة is the agent; بما is attached to أصابتهم; ما may be maṣdar-forming or a relative; the clause قدمت أيديهم has no position; and أيديهم is the agent. (ثُمَّ جاؤُكَ يَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَدْنا إِلَّا إِحْساناً وَتَوْفِيقاً): ثم جاءوك is conjoined to أصابتهم, and I see no justification for what some have done in conjoining it to the clause يصدون, as al-Bayḍāwī holds. The clause يحلفون بالله is a ḥāl clause; إن is negative; أردنا is a verb and agent; إلا is a particle of restriction; إحسانا is a mafʿūl bihi; and توفيقا is conjoined to إحسانا. (أُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ ما فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ): The clause is resumptive, introduced to add warning about their hypocrisy. أولئك is a mubtadaʾ and الذين is the khabar of the demonstrative; the clause يعلم الله is a ṣila of the relative; ما is a relative noun and mafʿūl bihi; and في قلوبهم is attached to an omitted element functioning as ṣila of the relative. (فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَعِظْهُمْ وَقُلْ لَهُمْ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ قَوْلًا بَلِيغاً): The فاء is the "eloquent" فاء, which discloses an implied condition, i.e. "if their state is thus, then turn away from them and accept no excuse from them". أعرض is an imperative verb whose agent is "anta"; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعرض; and the clause has no position, because it is the apodosis of an omitted non-jussive condition. وعظهم is conjoined to أعرض; وقل لهم is conjoined to أعرض; لهم is attached to قل; and as for في أنفسهم, concerning what this preposition and its genitive noun are attached to there are three analyses, equal in soundness and quality:
1- That they are attached to بليغا, because his command to threaten them reaches the core of their hearts. The context of the threat in His words: «فكيف إذا أصابتهم مصيبة بما قدمت أيديهم، ثم جاءوك» bears witness to it.
2- That they are attached to قل, and its meaning: "say to them, concerning their own vile selves and their hearts folded upon evil, a penetrating word". The context suits it, in His words: «أولئك الذين يعلم الله ما في قلوبهم», of the inner recesses of error and impulses of misguidance.
3- That they are attached to an omitted element functioning as ḥāl, i.e. the thing said being a secret that does not go beyond their selves and does not pass them. The conduct of the Prophet ﷺ bears witness to it, and it accords with the Prophet's eagerness for concealment and gentleness, in the hope that they would return to right guidance and settle on the right. قولا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq and بليغا a naʿt, or a ḥāl: «حال كونا خاليا بهم» [Translator's note: so in the source; the sense is: while he is alone with them]. And advice in private is more beneficial than in public.

* Vocabulary:
(شَجَرَ): it was mixed, varied, interwoven and entangled; from it the tree (shajar) is named because of the interweaving and entanglement of its branches. Ṭarafa ibn al-ʿAbd said:
وهم الحكّام أرباب الهدى ... وسعاة الناس في الأمر الشّجر
(They are the judges, the lords of guidance, and the pursuers of the people's interests in the entangled affair.)
meaning the varied and entangled. From it comes "tashājur al-rimāḥ", that is, the lances' crossing one another.

* I'rab:
(فَلا وَرَبِّكَ لا يُؤْمِنُونَ): The فاء is resumptive; لا is added to emphasise the oath; the واو is a particle of oath and genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "uqsimu"; and «لا يؤمنون»: لا is negative and يؤمنون is an imperfect verb, nominative, with the واو as agent; and the clause لا يؤمنون has no position, because it is the answer to the oath. (حَتَّى يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيما شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ): حتى is a particle of limit and genitive; يحكموك is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن after حتى, the واو is the agent and the كاف the mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يؤمنون; فيما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يحكّموك; the clause شجر is a ṣila of the relative; and بينهم is an adverb of place attached to شجر. (ثُمَّ لا يَجِدُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ حَرَجاً مِمَّا قَضَيْتَ): ثم is a particle of conjunction denoting delay; لا is negative; يجدوا is conjoined to يحكموك; في أنفسهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يجدوا, serving as the second object; حرجا is the first mafʿūl bihi of يجدوا; مما is attached to an omitted element functioning as naʿt of حرجا; and the clause قضيت is a ṣila of the relative. (وَيُسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيماً): conjoined to يجدوا, and تسليما is a mafʿūl muṭlaq.

* Rhetoric:
In this verse there are numerous intensifications that reach the highest ranks of eloquence. The aim of them is to increase the warning and the threat, at which the muscles shudder and the hearts tremble. We shall point to them in detail:
1- First, He, glorified be He, swore by Himself, reinforcing this oath with the particle of negation, that they do not believe. Faith is the capital of the righteous among Allah's servants, until there comes to them one of the noblest of goals, namely recourse to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and making him the judge in what has broken out between them of dispute.
2- Then He, glorified be He, was not content with that, but said: «ثم لا يجدوا في أنفسهم حرجا مما قضيت», adding to the seeking of judgment another matter, namely finding no constraint at all in their breasts; so mere seeking of judgment and submission is not sufficient, but it must spring from their breasts, issuing from contentment, reassurance and goodness of soul. This is the finest depiction of the relationship that must be rooted between the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the believers, and between a leader and those he leads, and the trust that takes root in the hearts of the people towards their leader and the one in authority over them, so long as he is well guided and walks in the way of sound uprightness.
3- Then He, glorified be He, was not content with all of this, but added to it His words: ويسلموا, that is, submit with complete submission and yield outwardly and inwardly, not a blind yielding, but the yielding of one who is confident and reassured of the soundness of the position of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
4- And to «يسلموا» He added the confirming maṣdar, saying «تسليما». Thus faith is not established for a servant until this seeking of judgment takes place from him, and he finds no constraint in his breast at what has been decreed against him, and submits to the ruling of Allah and His law with a submission mixed with no rejection and tainted by no blemish. Glorified be the One who said these words! And listen to the rest of this section in the following verse.

* Benefits:
What we mentioned in parsing His words, the Exalted: «فلا وربك» is the preferred view in our opinion, and we think it fitting, to complete the benefit, to cite [Translator's note: the source reads «تميما»; «تتميما» is probably meant] some of what has been said about it. Know that the redundant «لا» with an oath is frequent in the Noble Qur'an where the oath is by a verb, such as: «فلا أقسم بمواقع النجوم», «لا أقسم بهذا البلد», «لا أقسم بيوم القيامة» and others. The benefit of it is to confirm the magnification of what is sworn by, and it is known that one swears by a thing only to magnify it; so it is as if He were saying: "My magnification of these things by oath is as no magnification", meaning that they are of such greatness and grandeur that they deserve more than that and require what is above it. An example in poetry is his saying:
فلا وأبيك ابنة العامر ... يّ لا يدعي القوم أني أفرّ
(No, by your father, O daughter of al-ʿĀmirī, let the people not claim that I flee.)
More of its discussion will come in its coming places in this wonderful book. There are sayings of the scholars on this construction which we record because they are not without merit, among them:
1- That «لا» is a rejection of a statement whose implied form is "they will not do so", or "the matter is not as they claim, that they have believed in what was sent down to you"; then the oath is begun anew with His words: وربك لا يؤمنون. On this view the pause at «لا» is complete, and al-Ṭabarī approved it, and that suffices.
2- The second is that the first «لا» was put before the oath out of concern for the negation, then repeated for emphasis.
3- The third is that the second «لا» is redundant and the oath is parenthetical between the particle of negation and the negated verb, the implied form being "so, by your Lord, they will not believe"; thus the analyses of it are four.

* I'rab:
(وَلَوْ أَنَّا كَتَبْنا عَلَيْهِمْ أَنِ اقْتُلُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ): A resumptive statement, introduced to rebuke those who hang back from responding to the Messenger and obeying him. The واو is resumptive; لو is conditional; أن and what is within its scope are the agent of an omitted verb, i.e. "had Our prescribing been established" (its like has already been given); أن with its ism, and the clause كتبنا is its khabar; عليهم is attached to كتبنا; أن is maṣdar-forming; اقتلوا is an imperative verb and the واو is the agent; the interpreted maṣdar is the object of كتبنا. It was also said that أن is explicative (mufassira), because كتبنا contains the meaning of saying without its letters. أنفسكم is a mafʿūl bihi. (أَوِ اخْرُجُوا مِنْ دِيارِكُمْ): conjoined to اقتلوا أنفسكم, and من دياركم is attached to اخرجوا. (ما فَعَلُوهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ مِنْهُمْ): The clause has no position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. The pronoun in «فعلوه» refers to one of the two matters, or to what was prescribed for them. إلا is a particle of restriction; قليل is a badal from the واو in «فعلوه», because it is an exception from a complete, non-affirmative statement; and منهم is attached to an omitted element functioning as naʿt of قليل. It has also been read in the accusative, as an exception from them. (وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ فَعَلُوا ما يُوعَظُونَ بِهِ): Conjoined to what preceded; the i'rab of this construction was given a little earlier. ما is a relative noun and mafʿūl bihi, and the clause يوعظون به is a ṣila of the relative. (لَكانَ خَيْراً لَهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ تَثْبِيتاً): The لام occurs in the apodosis of لو; كان and its latent ism; خيرا is its khabar; أشد is conjoined to «خيرا»; and تثبيتا is a tamyīz. (وَإِذاً لَآتَيْناهُمْ مِنْ لَدُنَّا أَجْراً عَظِيماً): The واو is a conjunction; إذن is a particle of response and consequence made inoperative because it occurs after one of the two conjunctions, namely the wāw and the fāʾ; and it is the answer to an implied question, as if it had been said: "And what would be theirs after being firmly established?" So it was said: "And then, had they been firmly established…, We would have given them". The لام is the apodosis of the implied لو; آتيناهم is a verb, agent and first mafʿūl bihi; من لدنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آتيناهم; أجرا is a mafʿūl bihi; and عظيما a naʿt. (وَلَهَدَيْناهُمْ صِراطاً مُسْتَقِيماً): Conjoined as well; صراطا is a second mafʿūl bihi or accusative by removal of the preposition, to which reference was made in al-Fātiḥa; and مستقيما is a naʿt.

* Benefits:
A picture of the marvels of Arab-Islamic heroism:
History relates that al-Zubayr ibn al-ʿAwwām and Ḥāṭib ibn Abī Baltaʿa brought a dispute before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ over shirāj (water channels) by which they used to water their palm trees, which is a watercourse. He said: "Water, O Zubayr, then send the water to your neighbour." Ḥāṭib became angry and said: "Because he is your cousin?" The face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ changed, and then he said: "Water, O Zubayr, then hold back the water until it returns to the base of the trees, and take your full due, then send it to your neighbour." He had advised al-Zubayr with an opinion that gave leeway to him and to his opponent, but when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was angered he gave al-Zubayr his full right in an explicit ruling.
Then the two went out and passed by al-Miqdād, who said to him: "For whom was the judgment?" The Anṣārī said: "He judged for his cousin," and twisted his mouth. A Jew exploited the situation and said: "They testify that he is the Messenger of Allah, then accuse him in a judgment he passes between them! By Allah, we once committed a sin in the lifetime of Moses, and he called us to repent of it and said: 'Kill yourselves,' and we did so, and our slain reached seventy thousand until He was pleased with us." Thābit, Ibn Masʿūd and ʿAmmār ibn Yāsir said: "If Muḥammad had commanded us to kill ourselves, we would have killed ourselves." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "By the One in whose hand is my soul, among my community are those whose faith is more firmly fixed in their souls than the towering mountains."

* İ'rab:
(ما أَصابَكَ مِنْ حَسَنَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ): Onların sözüne cevabı ve onlara reddiyeyi beyan için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye bir sözdür. Kötülüğün kula izâfe edilmesi ile her şeyin Allah'a izâfe edilmesi arasını cem etmenin anlamı, Belâgat bahsinde susuzluğu giderecek biçimde gelecektir. (ما) cezmeden şart ismi olup mübtedâdır; (أصابك) fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallinde mâzî fiildir; (من حسنة) mahzûf bir hâle müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. Fâ cevâbü'ş-şarta bağlayıcıdır; (من الله) câr ve mecrûr, mahzûf bir mübtedânın mahzûf haberine müteallik; yani «فهي من الله» (o Allah'tandır). Fiilü'ş-şart ve cevabından oluşan cümle «من»in haberidir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «من» yazılmıştır; âyetteki şart ismi «ما»dır.] (وَما أَصابَكَ مِنْ سَيِّئَةٍ فَمِنْ نَفْسِكَ): öncekine atıftır. (وَأَرْسَلْناكَ لِلنَّاسِ رَسُولًا): vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; cümle, Resûl'ün mertebesini beyan ve onun büyük ve yüce himmetini yüceltmek için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyyedir. (أرسلناك) mâzî fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir; (للناس) «أرسلناك»e müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur; ya da mahzûf bir hâle müteallik; çünkü aslında (رسولا'nın) sıfatı idi, önce gelmiştir. (رسولا) hâldir. (وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيداً): vâv âtıfe veya isti'nâfiyyedir; bâ zâide cer harfidir; (الله) mahallen «كفى»nin fâilidir, lafzen bâ ile mecrûrdur; (شهيدا) temyîz veya hâldir; bunun i'rabı daha önce geçti.

* Belâgat:
Kötülüğün kula izâfe edilmesinde mecâz-ı mürsel vardır; alâka sebebiyettir. Çünkü sahibini helâke sürükleyen ve onu günah işlemeye bulaştıran nefistir. Nefsin yaratılmış olması ile (sahibini) bulaştırıcı olması arasında bir çelişki yoktur; bütün bunlar «قل كل من عند الله» kavlinde bir düzene girer. Mu'tezile'nin bu konuda uzun sözleri vardır; Ehl-i Sünnet ile Mu'tezile arasındaki ihtilafın kızıştığı uzun eserlere başvurulur.

* Vocabulary:
(بيّت): بيّت الأمر means: he fabricated it, arranged it and decided it by night. التبييت is either from البيتوتة (spending the night), because it is deciding a matter and planning it at night — one says: هذا أمر بيّت بليل ("this is a matter plotted by night") — or from أبيات الشعر (verses of poetry), because the poet plans them and arranges them. The meaning in the verse is that they said and devised something other than the obedience they gave you; and every deed done at night has been "plotted"; from that comes بيّت للعدو, which is falling upon them by night. And from it is the saying of ʿUbayda ibn Hammām:
أتوني فلم أرض ما بيّتوا ... وكانوا أتوني بشيء نكر
لأنكح أيّمهم منذرا ... وهل ينكح العبد حرّ لحر
(They came to me, and I was not pleased with what they plotted, for they had come to me with something monstrous: that I should marry their widow to Mundhir. Does a free man, himself born of the free, give in marriage to a slave?) He means by his saying "فلم أرض ما بيتوا" the night: that is, what they settled upon by night.
The meaning of his saying حر لحر is: a free man whom noble people bore, as you say: he is noble from noble people, and free from free people; the lām in it is of lineage, and "free" is traced to fathers and free people. This you will not find in a book, so memorise it.

* I'rab:
(مَنْ يُطِعِ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدْ أَطاعَ اللَّهَ) A resumptive speech, meant to explain that obedience to the Messenger is part of obedience to Allah and to explain the rulings of his message. من is a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ; يطع الرسول is the protasis; the fāʾ is connecting; قد is a particle of certainty; the clause فقد أطاع الله is in the position of the jussive, the apodosis; and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of من. (وَمَنْ تَوَلَّى فَما أَرْسَلْناكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظاً) The wāw is a conjunction; من is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; تولى is a past verb in the position of the jussive, the protasis; the fāʾ is connecting for the answer; ما is negative; أرسلناك is a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «حفيظا»; حفيظا is a ḥāl; and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: "so pay no heed to him"; the protasis and its omitted apodosis are in the position of the nominative, the khabar of «من»; and the clause ما أرسلناك is explanatory of the reason, with no position. (وَيَقُولُونَ طاعَةٌ) The wāw is resumptive; يقولون is an imperfect verb and fāʿil; طاعة is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "our command and our affair" [is obedience]; the clause is the quoted speech; and the clause يقولون is resumptive, meant to show their treatment of the Messenger after having shown the obligation of obeying him. (فَإِذا بَرَزُوا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ) The fāʾ is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb of the future containing the sense of a condition; the clause برزوا is in the position of the genitive by annexation; and من عندك is attached to برزوا, i.e. "they went out from you". (بَيَّتَ طائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ غَيْرَ الَّذِي تَقُولُ) The clause بيت طائفة has no position because it is the answer to a non-jussive condition; منهم is attached to an omitted adjective of طائفة; غير is the mafʿūl bihi; الذي is the muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause تقول has no position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun. (وَاللَّهُ يَكْتُبُ ما يُبَيِّتُونَ) The wāw is resumptive or circumstantial; الله is a mubtadaʾ and the clause يكتب its khabar; ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; and the clause يبيتون has no position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun. (فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ) The fāʾ is the eloquent fāʾ; أعرض is an imperative; عنهم is attached to أعرض; توكل is conjoined to أعرض; and على الله is attached to توكل. (وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا) The i'rab of its like has already been given.

* Benefits:
The verb is masculine in «بيت طائفة» because the feminine of الطائفة is not a real feminine, since it is in the sense of الفريق and الفوج (a company, a band), so it is a collective noun (ism jamʿ) or a generic noun (ism jins).
The rulings on making the verb masculine or feminine with the fāʿil are set out at length in the books of grammar, so go back to them, and Allah is the Granter of success.

* Vocabulary:
(يَتَدَبَّرُونَ): they ponder. تدبر الشيء means to ponder it and to look into its consequences and what results from it and where it ends up.
(أَذاعُوا): It has the sense of the base verb «ذاع». One says ذاع الشيء يذيع, and one also says أذاع الشيء, and it takes an object the same way. It may be a case of taḍmīn (embedding a meaning), أذاع having been made to include the meaning of "he spoke of", so that it is transitive by itself and with the bāʾ. This word is, as it were, a correct expression for the broadcasting which broadcasts news at set times. الإذاعة is spreading abroad (الإشاعة). He said:
أذاع به في الناس حتى كأنه ... بعلياء نار أوقدت بثقوب
(He spread it abroad among the people until it was like a fire kindled on a height with a kindling stick.)
al-Zamakhsharī preferred that the meaning be "they performed the act of broadcasting with it", which is more eloquent than أذاعوه, so that the discipline is more forceful and the prohibition more comprehensive. In that is teaching and a warning of the obligation to keep secret the news of armies and their movements; and how great is the harm in people's chattering about every report and rumour that strikes their ears, particularly in our time, after the abandoned enemy invaded the Arab lands — may Allah purify them of his filth and protect them from his abomination.
(يَسْتَنْبِطُونَهُ): they draw out its management by their sagacity and their complete knowledge of the affairs and stratagems of war. In origin it means drawing out water when the earth is first dug, and it was borrowed for what a man draws out of meanings by the excellence of his mind. In the coming together of the nūn and the bāʾ as the first and second radicals of the word there is a wondrous secret, for they indicate appearing and becoming clear: النبأ is the report that appears to people so that they pass it on and exchange it among themselves. سبيل نأبيء means a road that is evident and sudden. نبّ التيس نبيبا means the billy-goat bleated in rut, and in his bleating is an appearing of himself. ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, may Allah be pleased with him, said to the delegation of the people of Kufa when they complained of Saʿd: "Some of you speak to me, but do not bleat before me the bleating of billy-goats."
From this word is derived الانبوب (tube), plural أنابيب. He said:
أو من مشعشعة ورهاء نشوتها ... أو من أنابيب تفاح ورمان
(Or from a diluted wine, a foolish one in its intoxication; or from the tubes of apple and pomegranate.)
And نبت: it appeared; one says: ظهر النبات والنبت في الأرض (the plant and the sprout appeared in the earth).
And نبس: he spoke; you say: كلمته فعبس وما نبس ("I spoke to him and he frowned and did not utter a word").
And نبش الأرض عما تحتها نبشا (he dug up the earth for what is under it). He said:
مهلا بني عمنا مهلا موالينا ... لا تنبشوا بيننا ما كان مدفونا
(Gently, sons of our uncle, gently, our allies; do not dig up between us what was buried.)
The discussion of النبط has preceded, and from it they derived الأنباط. Khālid ibn al-Walīd said to ʿAbd al-Masīḥ ibn Buqayla: "Are you Arabs or Nabateans?" He said: "Arabs who became Nabateanised (استنبطنا), and Nabateans who became Arabised (استعربنا)." And Abū al-ʿAlāʾ al-Maʿarrī said:
أين امرؤ القيس والعذارى ... إذ مال من تحته الغبيط
استنبط العرب في الموامي ... بعدك واستعرب النبيط
(Where is Imruʾ al-Qays and the maidens, when the camel-saddle tilted beneath him? The Arabs drew water in the deserts after you, and the Nabateans became Arabised.)
This is among the strange things of this noble language.

* I'rab:
(أَفَلا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ) The hamza is for a disapproving question and the fāʾ is a conjunction on an implied clause, i.e.: "Do they turn away from the Qur'an, so that they do not ponder it?" لا is negative; يتدبرون is an imperfect verb and fāʿil; and القرآن is its mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: the source prints «مفعونه», evidently a misprint for «مفعوله»]. (وَلَوْ كانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ غَيْرِ اللَّهِ لَوَجَدُوا فِيهِ اخْتِلافاً كَثِيراً) The wāw is circumstantial and لو is conditional; كان is the defective verb with a latent noun, i.e. the Qur'an; من عند غير الله is attached to an omitted khabar; the lām occurs in the answer to لو; وجدوا is a verb and fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to a non-jussive condition; فيه is attached to وجدوا; اختلافا is the mafʿūl bihi; and كثيرا is an adjective. (وَإِذا جاءَهُمْ أَمْرٌ مِنَ الْأَمْنِ أَوِ الْخَوْفِ أَذاعُوا بِهِ) A resumptive speech, meant to describe the hypocrites who broadcast rumours to discourage the people and to spread fear in their souls. إذا is an adverb of the future containing the sense of a condition; the clause جاءهم أمر is in the position of the genitive by annexation; من الأمن is attached to an omitted adjective of أمر; الخوف is conjoined to الأمن; and the clause أذاعوا به has no position because it is the answer to a non-jussive condition. (وَلَوْ رَدُّوهُ إِلَى الرَّسُولِ وَإِلى أُولِي الْأَمْرِ مِنْهُمْ) The wāw is circumstantial and لو conditional; ردّوه is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; إلى الرسول is attached to ردّوه; إلى أولي الأمر is conjoined to «إلى الرسول»; and منهم is attached to an omitted ḥāl. (لَعَلِمَهُ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَنْبِطُونَهُ مِنْهُمْ) The lām occurs in the answer to لو; علمه الذين: verb, mafʿūl bihi and fāʿil; the clause يستنبطونه has no position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; the clause لعلمه الذين has no position because it is the answer to a non-jussive condition; and منهم is attached to an omitted ḥāl. (وَلَوْلا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ لَاتَّبَعْتُمُ الشَّيْطانَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا) The wāw is resumptive and لولا is a particle of prevention due to existence, containing the sense of a condition; فضل الله is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted; عليكم is attached to فضل; رحمته is conjoined to فضل; the lām occurs in the answer to لولا; the clause اتبعتم has no position because it is the answer to a non-jussive condition; الشيطان is the mafʿūl bihi; إلا is a particle of exception; and قليلا is the excepted from the fāʿil of اتبعتم, i.e.: "except a few of you"; or from the fāʿil of أذاعوا به, i.e.: "they made that matter known, except a few of them." More of its meaning and i'rab will come in the section on Benefits.

* Benefits:
The exegetes and i'rab-writers expanded at length on this exception. Were we to seek exhaustiveness, the space would be too narrow for us, and the danger of expanding is increased by the bitter dispute between Ahl al-Sunna and Ahl al-Iʿtizāl (the Muʿtazila); and we do not like to pass over that without pointing to it. The gist of what they set out is that in His saying «إلا قليلا» there are several views; we have chosen what seemed to us closest to the meaning and nearest to logic, and there is no harm in citing some of what they said:
1- That it is excepted from the fāʿil of «اتبعتم», i.e.: a small group among you did not follow Satan; and by "bounty" would be meant the sending of Muḥammad ﷺ, like Quss ibn Sāʿida al-Iyādī, ʿAmr ibn Nufayl, Waraqa ibn Nawfal and others who believed before the sending of the Prophet ﷺ.
2- That what is meant is whoever the obligation had not reached, so the exception on this view is discontinuous (munqaṭiʿ).
3- That it is excepted from the fāʿil of أذاعوا, i.e.: they made that matter known, except a few of them.
4- That it is excepted from the fāʿil of «لعلمه الذين يستنبطونه».
5- That it is excepted from the fāʿil of «لوجدوا».
6- That it is excepted from the general, and by "the few" is meant the community of Muḥammad.

What Abū Jaʿfar al-Ṭabarī says:
Abū Jaʿfar al-Ṭabarī said: «The most correct of these views, in my opinion, is the view of whoever said: "What is meant is the exception of the few from the broadcasting."» And he said after a long discussion: «We said that this is more correct only because the matter cannot fall outside one of the views we have mentioned, and it is impermissible that it be from His saying "لاتبعتم الشيطان", because it is impermissible that someone upon whom Allah has bestowed His bounty and mercy be of the followers of Satan.
