So then the second exception is a substitute (badal) for the first, i.e. 'No leaf falls except it is in a Book, and «وما يعلمها»' [Translator's note: the final words are given as printed in the source, which appears defective.]" End of quotation. The answer to it is what preceded, of making the exception an emphasis. This will be established, if Allah wills, in Sūrat Yūnus, since it has its own discussion.

«Translator's note: the source also reads «قُرْقُرر» (usually «قُرْقُور») in the first poem section and «الدارهيم» in the verse (usually «الدراهيم»); the source prints «ماجاءني» (without space) and «أمرأةٍ» (for «امرأة»), and «الاستثاءُ» for «الاستثناءُ»; translated as intended.»

Allah Teâlâ'nın {وَيُرْسِلُ} kavli: Bunda beş vecih vardır. Birincisi: el-'in (أل) sılası olarak vâki olan ism-i fâile ma'tûf olmasıdır; çünkü o يفعل manasındadır. Takdiri: «O, kullarını kahreden ve gönderendir.» Fiil, ismin te'vilinde olduğu için isme atfedilmiştir. Bazılarına göre bunun benzeri {إِنَّ المصدقين والمصدقات وَأَقْرَضُواْ} [Hadîd: 18] kavlidir. Dediler ki: «أقرضوا», el-'in sılası olarak vâki olan «مصدقين»e ma'tûftur; çünkü o «إنَّ الذين صدَّقوا وأقرضوا» manasındadır. Bu bir şey değildir; çünkü bundan sılanın parçaları arasına yabancı bir şeyle fasıla verilmesi lâzım gelir. Şöyle ki: «وأقرضوا», «المصِّدِّقين»deki el-'in sılasının tamamlayıcısıdır; mevsûle ise yabancı olan «المصدقات» kavli atfedilmiştir. Mevsûle ancak sılası tamamlandıktan sonra tâbi getirilebileceği birçok kez takrir edilmişti. Allah Teâlâ'nın {فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ} [Mülk: 19] kavline gelince, «يقبضن» isim te'vilindedir; yani «وقابضات». İsmin te'vilinde olduğu için ismin fiile atfedilmesine örnek, Allah Teâlâ'nın {يُخْرِجُ الحي مِنَ الميت وَمُخْرِجُ الميت} [En'âm: 95] kavli ve şâirin şu sözüdür:
194 - 0- فأَلْفَيْتُه يوماً يُبيرُ عدوَّهُ ... ومُجْرٍ عطاءً يستخفُّ المعابرا
(Onu bir gün düşmanını helak ederken ve bağış akıtırken buldum; «المعابرا»yı hafife alıyordu.)
İkincisi: {وَهُوَ القاهر} kavlinden ibaret isim cümlesine atfedilmiş bir fiil cümlesi olmasıdır. Üçüncüsü: sılaya ve ona atfedilen şeye, yani «يتوفَّاكم» ve «يعلم» kavli ve sonrasına ma'tûf olmasıdır; yani: «O, sizi vefat ettiren ve gönderendir.» Dördüncüsü: mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberi olması ve cümlenin hâl olarak nasb mahallinde olmasıdır. Hâl sahibinde iki vecih vardır. Daha zâhir olanı: «القاهر»deki müstetir zamir olmasıdır. İkincisi: zarfta müstetir olan zamirden hâl olmasıdır; Ebü'l-Bekâ böyle demiştir; Şeyh de bunu (ondan) nakletmiş ve «Bu vecih i'rab vecihlerinin en zayıfıdır» demiştir. İkisinin «zarftaki zamir» sözüne gelince: burada bu hâlin, içindeki bir zamirden olduğu vehmedilebilecek bir zarf yoktur, «فوق عباده» kavli müstesna. Fakat bu zarf hangi yolla bir zamiri taşır?
[Mütercim notu: Metinde «ونقله عن الشيخ» yazılıdır; bağlamdan «ونقله عنه الشيخ» (Şeyh bunu ondan nakletti) kastedildiği anlaşılmaktadır.]
Cevap şudur: Buna benzeyen ayette, «فوق عباده»de beş vecih bulunduğu daha önce geçmişti; bunlardan üçünde bir zamir taşır: ikinci haber olması, haberden bedel olması veya hâl olması. «يُرْسِلُ»den önce bir mübtedâ takdir etmek zorunda kalmamız, müsbet muzâri hâl olarak vâki olduğunda vâv ile birlikte gelmemesindendir; bunun açıklaması birçok kez geçmişti. Beşincisi: bunu haber vermek için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye cümle olmasıdır; bu vecih mana bakımından ikincisi gibidir.
{عَلَيْكُم} kavli: Üç vecih muhtemeldir. En zâhiri: «يرسل»e müteallik olmasıdır; {يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا} [Rahmân: 35], {فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ} [A'râf: 133], {وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْراً} [Fîl: 3] ve diğerleri de bu kabildendir. İkincisi: «حَفَظَة»ye müteallik olmasıdır. «حَفِظْتُ عليه عمله» (onun amelini aleyhine kaydettim) denir; takdiri: «Üzerinize koruyucular gönderir.» Şeyh şöyle demiştir: «Yani sizin aleyhinize onların amellerini korurlar (kaydederler); Allah Teâlâ'nın {وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَافِظِينَ} [İnfitâr: 10] buyurduğu gibi; "حَفِظْتُ عليك ما تعمل" (Yaptığını aleyhine kaydettim) demen gibi.» Onun «Allah'ın "إن عليكم لحافظين" buyurduğu gibi» sözü mana bakımından bir benzetmedir; «عليكم»in «حافظين»e müteallik olduğu değil; çünkü (orada) «عليكم», «إن»nin haberidir ve mahzûf bir şeye mütealliktir.
[Mütercim notu: Şeyh'in ibaresinde «أعمالهم» geçmektedir; bağlama uygun olan «أعمالكم»dir; metin yazıldığı gibi çevrilmiştir.]
Üçüncüsü: «حفظة»den hâl olmak üzere mahzûf bir şeye müteallik olmasıdır; zira sonra gelseydi onun sıfatı olması caiz olurdu.
Ebü'l-Bekâ şöyle demiştir: «"عليكم"de iki vecih vardır. Birincisi: يرسل'e mütealliktir. İkincisi: te'hîr niyetinde olmasıdır; bunda da iki vecih vardır. Birincisi: bizzat "حَفَظة"ye müteallik olması ve mef'ûlün mahzûf olmasıdır; yani: "Üzerinize amellerinizi koruyacak kimseler gönderir." İkincisi: "حَفَظة"nin sıfatı olup öne alınması ve böylece hâl olmasıdır.» Sözü bitti. Onun «mef'ûl mahzûftur» sözüyle «حفظة»nin mef'ûlünü kastediyor. Ancak bu, mef'ûlün takdirinin onun zikrettiği vecihle sınırlı olduğu vehmini verir; durum böyle değildir; bilakis her vecihte onun takdiri zorunludur. «حَفَظَة» o takdir edilen mef'ûlde, mahzûf bir şeyin sıfatı olduğu için amel etmiştir; takdiri: «Üzerinize koruyucu melekler gönderir.» Çünkü o ancak birtakım şartlarla amel eder ve bu da onlardandır; yani bir mevsûfa dayanması.
«حَفَظَة», حافظ'ın çoğuludur. Bu, lâm harfi sahih olan, akıllı ve müzekker için fâil veznindeki her sıfatta kıyasîdir: «بارّ» - «بَرَة», «فاجِر» - «فَجَرة», «كامل» - «كَمَلة» gibi. Akıllı olmayanda azdır; «غراب ناعق» (öten karga) ve «غربان نَعَقَه» demeleri gibi. «حتى إذا جاء» kavlinin benzeri de daha önce geçmişti.
{تَوَفَّتْهُ} kavli: Cumhur {توفَّتْه} kelimesini, çoğulun müennesliğinden dolayı teenîs tâsıyla mâzî olarak okumuştur. Hamza ise teenîs tâsı olmaksızın {توفَّاه} okumuştur. Bu iki vecih muhtemeldir. Daha zâhir olanı: mâzî olmasıdır; teenîs tâsını iki sebepten dolayı hazfetmiştir: Birincisi, müennesliğin mecazî olması; ikincisi, fiil ile fâili arasına mef'ûlün fasıla olması. İkincisi: muzâri olmasıdır; aslı iki tâ ile تتوفاه'dir; hangisinin hazfedildiği hususunda ihtilaf bulunmakla birlikte biri hazfedilmiştir; «تَنَزَّلُ» ve benzerleri gibi. Hamza bu tür eliflerin imâlesinde kendi usulü üzeredir. A'meş ise müennesliğin mecazî olması veya fasıla itibarıyla gâib yâsıyla muzâri olarak {يتوفَّاه} okumuştur. Bu, fiilin müzekker getirilmesi bakımından Hamza'nın kıraatinin birinci vechi gibi, muzâri olarak getirilmesi bakımından da onun kıraatinin ikinci vechi gibidir. Ebü'l-Bekâ şöyle demiştir: «Şâz olarak istikbal üzere {تتوفَّاه} de okunmuştur.» Yâ veya tâ ile olduğunu zikretmemiştir.
{وَهُمْ لاَ يُفَرِّطُونَ} kavli: Bu cümle iki vecih muhtemeldir. Daha zâhir olanı: «رسلنا»dan hâl olmasıdır. İkincisi: onları bu sıfatla haber vermek için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye cümle olmasıdır. Cumhur «يُفْرِّطون» kelimesini şeddeli okumuştur; manası «kusur etmezler»dir. Amr b. Ubeyd ve A'rec ise أفرط'tan şeddesiz «يُفْرِطون» okumuşlardır. Bunda iki te'vil vardır. Birincisi: «Emrolundukları şeyde haddi aşmazlar» manasında olmasıdır. Zemahşerî şöyle demiştir: «التفريط, gevşeklik ve hadden geri kalmaktır; الإِفراط ise haddi aşmaktır; yani emrolundukları şeyden ne eksiltirler ne de artırırlar.» İkincisi: manasının «Allah'ın emrinin önüne geçmezler» olmasıdır. Bu, أفرط'ın فَرَط, yani «öne geçti» manasında olduğunun nakledilmesine muhtaçtır. Câhız da buna yakın bir şey söyleyerek şöyle demiştir: «لا يُفْرِطون'un manası: kimsenin onlardan فرط etmesine, yani onları geçip elden kaçmasına izin vermezler.» Ebü'l-Bekâ da şöyle demiştir: «Şeddesiz de okunur; yani emrolundukları şeyin üzerine ziyade etmezler.» Bu, önce geçene yakındır.
[Mütercim notu: Metinde «أنَّ أفرط بمعنى فَرَّط» yazılıdır; açıklamadaki «تَقَدَّم» manası «فَرَط» (şeddesiz) fiiline aittir.]

His saying, the Exalted: {وَيُرْسِلُ}: There are five aspects in it. The first: it is conjoined to the active participle that occurs as the ṣila (relative clause) of the definite article «أل», because it has the meaning of a verb, the implied meaning being: "and He is the One who subdues His servants and sends." So the verb is conjoined to the noun because it is in its interpretation. Similar to it, according to some, is {إِنَّ المصدقين والمصدقات وَأَقْرَضُواْ} [الحديد: 18]; they said: «وأقرضوا» is conjoined to «مصدقين» which occurs as the ṣila of «أل», because it means "those who gave charity and lent". This is nothing, because it necessitates separation between the parts of the ṣila by a foreigner: «وأقرضوا» is a completion of the ṣila of «أل» in «المصِّدِّقين», and His saying «المصدقات», which is a foreigner, has been conjoined to the relative. It has been established more than once that nothing is attached to the relative except after the completion of its ṣila. As for His saying, the Exalted: {فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ} [الملك: 19], «يقبضن» is in the interpretation of a noun, i.e. "and folding (their wings)". And among the conjoining of a noun to a verb because it is in the interpretation of a noun is His saying, the Exalted: {يُخْرِجُ الحي مِنَ الميت وَمُخْرِجُ الميت} [الأنعام: 95] and the saying:

194 - 0- فأَلْفَيْتُه يوماً يُبيرُ عدوَّهُ ... ومُجْرٍ عطاءً يستخفُّ المعابرا
(I found him one day destroying his enemy, and one who makes bestowals flow, making light of «المعابرا».)

The second: it is a verbal clause conjoined to a nominal clause, namely His saying {وَهُوَ القاهر}. The third: it is conjoined to the ṣila and what was conjoined to it, namely "He takes you" and "He knows" and what follows, i.e. "and He is the One who takes you and sends." The fourth: it is the predicate of an omitted subject, and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). As to its owner there are two aspects, the more apparent being that it is the latent pronoun in «القاهر». The second: that it is a ḥāl from the latent pronoun in the adverbial phrase; so said Abū al-Baqāʾ, who reported it from the Shaykh and said: "This aspect is the weakest of the i'rabs." As to their saying "the pronoun in the adverbial phrase", there is no adverbial phrase here from which this ḥāl might be imagined to be from a pronoun in it except His saying «فوق عباده»; but by what means does this adverbial phrase carry a pronoun? The answer is that it was mentioned in the verse similar to this that «فوق عباده» has five aspects, three of which carry a pronoun, namely its being a second predicate, or a substitute for the predicate, or a ḥāl. We were compelled to imply a subject before «يُرْسِلُ» only because an affirmative imperfect, when it occurs as a ḥāl, is not accompanied by the wāw; its explanation has gone before more than once. The fifth: it is resumptive, brought to report that, and this aspect is in meaning like the second.

His saying: {عَلَيْكُم} admits three aspects, the most apparent being that it is attached to «يرسل», and from it are {يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا} [الرحمن: 35], {فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ} [الأعراف: 133] and {وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْراً} [الفيل: 3], and so on. The second: it is attached to «حَفَظَة». One says «حَفِظْتُ عليه عمله», so the implied meaning: "He sends guardians over you." The Shaykh said: "i.e. they preserve for you their deeds, as He said: {وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَافِظِينَ} [الانفطار: 10], as you say «حَفِظْتُ عليك ما تعمل»." His saying "as He said: 'Indeed over you are guardians'" is a comparison in meaning, not that «عليكم» is attached to «حافظين»; for «عليكم» is the predicate of «إن» and so is attached to an omitted word.

The third: it is attached to an omitted word as a ḥāl from «حفظة», since if it were postponed it could be an adjective of it. Abū al-Baqāʾ said: «عليكم» has two aspects: one, that it is attached to «يرسل»; the second, that it is in the intention of postponement, and in it are two aspects: one, that it is attached to «حفظة» itself and the object is omitted, i.e. "He sends over you those who preserve your deeds"; the second, that it is an adjective of «حفظة» that was fronted and so became a ḥāl. End of quotation. His saying "the object is omitted" means the object of «حفظة», but it gives the impression that the implying of the object is specific to the aspect he mentioned, and it is not so; rather it must be implied in every aspect, and «حَفَظَة» works on that implied object only because it is an adjective of an omitted noun, the implied meaning: "He sends over you angels, guardians", because it does not work except under conditions of which this is one, I mean its relying on a described noun.

«حَفَظَة» is the plural of «حافظ», and it is regular for every adjective on the pattern fāʿil with sound lām, for a rational masculine, like «بارّ» and «بَرَة», «فاجِر» and «فَجَرة», «كامل» and «كَمَلة», and it is rare for non-rational beings, as in their saying «غراب ناعق» and «غربان نَعَقَه». The like of His saying «حتى إذا جاء» has been mentioned earlier.

His saying: {تَوَفَّتْهُ}: The majority read {توفَّتْه} as a past verb with the feminine tāʾ because of the feminine plural. Ḥamza read {توفَّاه} without the feminine tāʾ, which admits two aspects, the more apparent being that it is a past verb and the feminine tāʾ was omitted for two reasons: one, that the feminine is figurative; the second, the separation between the verb and its agent by the object. The second: that it is an imperfect, its original being «تتوفاه» with two tāʾs, one of which was dropped, with disagreement as to which, like «تَنَزَّلُ» and its type. Ḥamza follows his rule in the imāla of an alif like this. Al-Aʿmash read {يتوفَّاه} as an imperfect with the yāʾ of the third person, taking into account that the feminine is figurative or for the separation; so it is like Ḥamza's reading in the first aspect in that the verb is masculine, and like his reading in the second aspect in that he brought it as an imperfect. Abū al-Baqāʾ said: "{تتوفَّاه} was read irregularly, in the future," and did not mention it with yāʾ or tāʾ.

His saying: {وَهُمْ لاَ يُفَرِّطُونَ}: This clause admits two aspects, the more apparent being that it is a ḥāl from «رسلنا». The second: that it is resumptive, brought to report about them with this attribute. The majority read «يُفَرِّطون» with doubling, and its meaning is "they do not fall short". ʿAmr ibn ʿUbayd and al-Aʿraj read «يُفْرِطون» light, from «أفرط», and there are two interpretations of it. One: that it means they do not exceed the limit in what they have been commanded. Al-Zamakhsharī said: "Tafrīṭ is slackness and delay beyond the limit, and ifrāṭ is exceeding the limit, i.e. they do not diminish what they have been commanded, nor do they add." The second: that its meaning is they do not go ahead of the command of Allah; this requires a report that «أفرط» has the meaning of «فَرَّط», i.e. went ahead. Al-Jāḥiẓ said something close to this, for he said: "The meaning of «لا يُفْرِطون» is: they do not leave anyone to slip away from them, i.e. get ahead of them and escape them." Abū al-Baqāʾ said: "It is also read light, i.e. they do not add to what they have been commanded," which is close to what has preceded.

«Translator's note: the source reads «الاية» (for «الآية») in the passage on «فوق عباده», «ونقله عن الشيخ» (apparently «ونقله عنه الشيخ»; translated as written), «أعمالهم» in the Shaykh's quotation (apparently «أعمالكم»; translated as written), and «ايتهما» (for «أيتهما»); translated as intended. The word «المعابرا» in the verse is left in Arabic because its sense here could not be verified.»

His saying, the Exalted: {قُلْ مَن يُنَجِّيكُمْ}: The Seven read this one with doubling; {قل الله ينجيكم}: the Kufans and Hishām ibn ʿAmmār from Ibn ʿĀmir read it with doubling like the first; and Ḥumayd ibn Qays, Yaʿqūb and ʿAlī ibn Naṣr from Abū ʿAmr read both with the light form, from «أنجى». The result is that the Kufans and Hishām double in both places, that Ḥumayd and those with him lighten in both, and that Nāfiʿ, Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr and Ibn Dhakwān from Ibn ʿĀmir double the first and lighten the second. The readings are clear, as they derive from «نجَّى» and «أنجى», and the doubling and the hamza both serve to make the verb transitive; the Kufans and Hishām kept to transitivity by doubling, Ḥumayd and his group kept to it by the hamza, and the others combined both forms of transitivity, combining the two dialects, as in His saying, the Exalted: {فَمَهِّلِ الكافرين أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْداً} [الطارق: 17]. The interrogative is for affirmation and reproach. There is an omitted muḍāf in the discourse, i.e. "from the perils of the darknesses" or "from their terrors"; the darknesses are a figure for hardships.

His saying: {تَدْعُونَهُ}: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), either from the object of «ينجيكم», which is the apparent, i.e. "He saves you while you call upon Him", or from its agent, i.e. "while called upon by you."

«Translator's note: the source reads «مَدْعُوَّاً مِنْ جتهكم» (apparently «من جهتكم»), «يُثْقِّون» (apparently «يُثقِّلون», "double") and «ويكونه ذلك القول» (apparently «ويكون ذلك القول»); translated as intended.»

His saying: {تَضَرُّعاً وَخُفْيَةً}: Two aspects are permissible for them. One: that they are two maṣdars in the position of ḥāl, i.e. "you call upon Him humbly and secretly." The second: that they are two maṣdars from the meaning of the governor, not from its wording, like "I sat sitting". The majority read {خُفْية} with ḍamma on the khāʾ. Abū Bakr read it with kasra, and they are two dialects, like «العُدوة» and «العِدوة», «الأُسوة» and «الإِسوة». Al-Aʿmash read {وخيفة} like the one in al-Aʿrāf, which is from «الخوف», the wāw being turned into yāʾ because the preceding letter has kasra and it is quiescent. On this reading it would appear to be an object of purpose (mafʿūl min ajlihi), were it not for what «تضرُّعاً» refuses of the meaning.

His saying: {لَّئِنْ أَنجَانَا}: Apparently this oath clause is an explanation of the supplication before it, and it may also be accusative in position by an implied "saying", and that saying would be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the agent of «تَدْعُونه», i.e. "you call upon Him saying that." You already know from what has gone before, more than once, how the condition and the oath combine. The Kufans read «أَنْجانا» in the third person, in keeping with {تَدْعُونَهُ}, and the rest «أَنْجَيْتنا» in the second person, relating their address in the state of supplication. Each read according to what is written in his codex, for in the codices of Kufa it is «أنجانا» and in the others «أَنْجَيْتنا».

His saying: {مِنْ هذه}: attached to the verb before it; «مِنْ» is for the beginning of the range, and «هذه» refers to the darknesses, since they run in the manner of a single feminine; likewise «منها» returns to the darknesses for the reason given.

His saying: {وَكَذَّبَ بِهِ}: The hāʾ in «به» refers back to the punishment mentioned before in His saying {عَذَاباً مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ}; so said al-Zamakhsharī. It was also said: it refers to the Qurʾān. It was said: it refers to the warning included in these preceding verses. It was said: to the Prophet ﷺ, and this is remote because the address with the kāf follows immediately, so had it been so, He would have said «وكذَّب به قومك»; and the claim of an iltifāt (shift of person) in it is more remote. It was also said: an adjective must be omitted here, i.e. "and your people, the obstinate, or the disbelievers, denied it", because not all his people denied him, like His saying: {إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ} [هود: 46], i.e. of those saved. The omission of the adjective with the described noun remaining is very rare, unlike the opposite. Ibn Abī ʿAbla read {وكَذَّبَتْ} with the feminine tāʾ, like His saying, the Exalted: {كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ} [الشعراء: 105] and {كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ} [القمر: 33], taking the group into account.

His saying: {وَهُوَ الحق}: There are two aspects in this clause, the apparent being that it is resumptive. The second: that it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «به», i.e. "they denied it while it is the truth", which is more serious in ugliness.

His saying: {عَلَيْكُمْ}: attached to what follows it, and it is an emphasis, fronted for the sake of the verse-endings. It may also be a ḥāl from His saying «بوكيل», because if it were postponed it could be an adjective of it; this is according to those who allow the ḥāl to precede its owner when the latter is governed by a preposition, which is the choice of a group, and they recited as evidence the verse:

194 - 4- غافلاً تُعْرَضُ المَنِيَّةُ للمَرْ ... ءِ فيُدْعَى ولات حين إباءُ
(Death is presented to a man while he is heedless, and he is called, when there is no time for refusal.)

So he fronted «غافلاً» before its owner, which is «المرء», and before its governor, which is «تُعرض»; this is therefore more fitting. And from it:

194 - 5- لَئِنْ كان بَرْدُ الماءِ هَيْمانَ صادياً ... إليَّ حبيباً إنها لحبيبُ
(If the coolness of water is dear to me, thirsty and parched, then she is dear indeed.)

i.e. "dear to me, thirsty and parched"; and similarly:

194 - 6- فإن يك أذوادٌ أُصِبْنَ ونسوةٌ ... فَلَنْ يذهبوا فَرْغاً بقتل حبالِ
(If camels and women were taken, they will not go in vain for the killing of Ḥibāl.)

«فرغاً» is a ḥāl from «بقتل», and «حبال» with undotted ḥāʾ is the name of a man; and the preposition here is redundant, so its permissibility is more fitting than what we mentioned.

«Translator's note: the source text has «وكذِّبَتْ» with kasra on the dhāl in the printed vocalization; the phrase is translated as the reading with feminine tāʾ. The source also has «الجماعمة» for «الجماعة» and «أعزم» (apparently «أعظم», rendered "more serious"); and in the discussion of the Prophet ﷺ the source reads «وكذَّب به قومك» (apparently «وكذَّب بك قومك»), translated as written.»

His saying, the Exalted: {وَمَا عَلَى الذين}: It is permissible to take «ما» as the Ḥijāzī one, so that «من شيء» is its subject (ism), with «من» added in it to confirm inclusiveness, and {عَلَى الذين يَتَّقُونَ} is its predicate according to those who allow it to work with the predicate fronted absolutely, or who see that in the adverbial phrase and its equivalent. {مِنْ حِسَابِهِم} is a ḥāl from «شيء», because if it were postponed, it would be an adjective of it. It may also be non-working, either on the dialect of Tamīm or on the dialect of the Ḥijāz, owing to the loss of a condition, namely the fronting of its predicate, even if it is an adverbial; the verification of that is in what preceded in His saying: {مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ} [الأنعام: 52].

His saying: {ولكن ذكرى}: four aspects. The first: it is accusative as a maṣdar by an implied verb; some implied it as a command, i.e. "but remind them with a reminder", and some implied it as a report, i.e. "but they remind them with a reminder". The second: it is a subject whose predicate is omitted, i.e. "but upon them is a reminder", or "upon you is a reminder", i.e. reminding them. The third: it is the predicate of an omitted subject, i.e. "it is a reminder", i.e. the prohibition of sitting with them and abstaining from it is a reminder. The fourth: it is conjoined to the position of «شيء» which is genitive by «مِنْ», i.e. "nothing of their account is upon the God-fearing, but upon them is a reminder", so it is a conjoining of single terms; whereas according to the previous aspects it is a conjoining of clauses. Al-Zamakhsharī rejected this fourth aspect, and the Shaykh rejected him in turn, so their two statements must be cited. Abū al-Qāsim said: "It is not permissible that it be conjoined to the position of «من شيء», like your saying «ما في الدار من أحد ولكن زيد», because His saying «من حسابهم» refuses that."

The Shaykh said: "It is as if he imagined that in the conjunction the restriction in the conjoined-to term is necessarily carried over, namely «من حسابهم», which is a restriction in «شيء»; so according to him it is not permissible that it be a conjoining of single terms conjoined to «من شيء» by position, because the implied meaning for him would become: 'but a reminder of their account', and the meaning is not so. What he imagined is nothing; what he mentioned is not necessary in conjunction with «ولكن». You say: «ما عندنا رجل سوء ولكن رجلُ صدق», and «ما عندنا رجل من تميم ولكن رجل من قريش», and «ما قام من رجل عالم ولكن رجل جاهل». So on what we have established, it may be a conjoining of clauses as mentioned earlier, or a conjoining of single terms, the conjunction being by the wāw, and «لكن» being brought for the correction (istidrāk)."

I say: his saying "You say: «ما عندنا رجل سوء ولكن رجل صدق»", and so on to the end of the examples he mentioned, does not refute al-Zamakhsharī, because al-Zamakhsharī and others among the people of the language and the legal theorists say: conjunction is apparently for sharing; so if there is a restriction in the conjoined-to term, the apparent is that the conjoined term is bound by that restriction, unless a diverting indication comes, to which the matter is then referred.

So if you say: «ضربت زيداً يوم الجمعة وعمراً», the apparent is that ʿAmr shares with Zayd in the beating restricted to Friday; if you say «وعمراً يوم السبت», he does not share his restriction. The noble verse is of the first kind, i.e. no indication is brought with the conjoined term to take it out; so the apparent is that it shares with the first in its restriction, and if it shared with it in its restriction, what al-Zamakhsharī mentioned would follow. As for the examples he brought, the conjoined term is restricted by a restriction other than that by which the first was restricted. He should have brought examples like these, saying: «ما عندنا رجل سوء ولكن امرأة», and «ما عندنا رجل من تميم ولكن صبي»; the apparent from this is that the meaning is: "but an evil woman" and "but a boy of Quraysh". And al-Zamakhsharī's saying "conjoined to the position of «من شيء»", rather than saying "conjoined to its form", has a fine benefit that is hard to recognize: it is that «لكن» is a particle of affirmation, so if what follows it were conjoined to the genitive noun of «مِنْ» by form, «من» would necessarily be redundant in an affirmative context, and most of the Basrans hold that it is not redundant in that. What indicates that affirmation is considered in «لكن» is that when they conjoin after the predicate of the Ḥijāzī «ما», they invalidate the accusative, because it does not work when the negation is broken by an exception; and «بل» is like «لكن» in what I have told you.

«Translator's note: the source prints «اي» for «أي», «ماعندما» for «ما عندنا», and, in the explanation of the second example, «ولكن صبي من قريش» where «ولكن صبي من تميم» would be expected from the example; translated as written/intended.»

His saying, the Exalted: {اتخذوا دِينَهُمْ لَعِباً وَلَهْواً}: «اتخذوا» admits two aspects. One: that it is transitive to one object, with the meaning "they acquired and made", and «لهواً ولعباً» on this is an object of purpose (mafʿūl min ajlihi), i.e. "they acquired it for the sake of amusement and play." The second: that it is the one transitive to two objects, the first being «دينهم» and the second «لعباً ولهواً». The Shaykh said: "It appears from some of al-Zamakhsharī's statement and from Ibn ʿAṭiyya's that «لعباً ولهواً» is the first object and «دينهم» the second object. Al-Zamakhsharī said: 'i.e. their religion, which they ought to have taken up, as play and amusement; that is, their worship and what they were upon, of slitting the ears of the baḥīra camels and setting free the sāʾiba camels, belongs to amusement and play and following the desire of the self and to what is of the kind of jesting, not seriousness; or they took what is play and amusement, from the worship of idols, as a religion for themselves; or they took their religion that they were charged with, which is the religion of Islam, as play and amusement, in that they mocked it.' He said: so the apparent form of his second implied reading indicates what we mentioned."

Ibn ʿAṭiyya said: "He annexed the religion to them in the sense that they made play and amusement a religion; and it may be that the meaning is: they took their religion, which they ought to have had, as play and amusement; his first explanation is what we mentioned from him." End of quotation. I say: what the two mentioned they only mentioned as an explanation of meaning, not of i'rab. How could they make the indefinite the first object and the definite the second object without any reason, though they are among the greatest authorities in this field? And look how they made what they called the first object appear as definite and what they called the second as indefinite in the structure of their statement, in order to conform to (apparently «ليحذوا»; see note) the speech of the Arabs; so how can it be supposed of them that they make the indefinite the subject-of-report and the definite the report, in the speech of Allah the Exalted?

«Translator's note: the source reads «ليَخِدوا على كلام العرب» (apparently a misprint for «ليحذوا» or «ليجروا»; rendered as "to conform to"), «تبحير البحائر», «وأو اتخذوا», «معفولاً», «النكر» (for «النكرة»), «نقله ابن عطية بشيء» (incomplete in the source; translated as written), «والقوافي مجورة» (for «مجرورة»), «المعدول به» (for «المفديّ به»), «خيراً للمبتدأ» (for «خبراً») and «ذلك» for «أولئك» in the last paragraph; translated as intended. «بفتح العين» in the explanation of «الغَرّ» is as printed in the source.»

His saying: {وَذَكِّرْ بِهِ}: i.e. by the Qurʾān, which is indicated by His saying: {فَذَكِّرْ بالقرآن مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ} [ق: 45]. It was said: it refers to their account. It was said: to «الذين». It was also said: this is a pronoun explained by what follows it, and its clarification will come.

His saying: {وَغَرَّتْهُمُ الحياوة} admits two aspects. One: that it is resumptive. The second: that it is conjoined to the ṣila of «الذين», i.e. "who took ... and who were deceived by ...". The meaning of «الغرور» has been given at the end of Āl ʿImrān. It was also said here: «غَرَّتهم» is from «الغَرّ» with fatḥa on the ʿayn [as printed], i.e. it filled their mouths and satiated them, and on this is the poet's saying:

195 - 0- ولمَّا التَقَيْنا بالحُلَيْبَةِ غَرَّني ... بمعروفِهِ حتى خرجْتُ أفوقُ
(When we met at al-Ḥulayba, he stuffed me with his generosity until I left gasping.)

His saying: {أَن تُبْسَلَ}: There are two aspects regarding this. The well-known one, indeed the consensus, is that it is an object of purpose (mafʿūl min ajlihi), the implied meaning being "for fear that it be given up to destruction", or "in dislike that it be given up", or "that it not be given up". The second: the Shaykh said, after reporting the agreement on the object of purpose: "In my view it may be in the position of genitive as a substitute (badal) for the pronoun, the pronoun being explained by the substitute, and the giving-up (ibsāl) being implied for the magnification inherent in implying, as they implied the pronoun of the matter and the case, the implied meaning being: 'and remind by the pledging of souls and their confinement for what they earned', as they said: «اللهم صلِّ عليه الرؤوفِ الرحيمِ» ('O Allah, bless him, the Compassionate, the Merciful')." Sībawayh allowed that, saying: "If you say «ضربت وضربوني قومك», you put it in the accusative, except in the speech of one who says «أكلوني البراغيث», or you take it as a substitute for the pronoun."

He also said: "If you say «ضربني وضربتُهم قومُك», you put it in the nominative on the basis of fronting and postponing, unless you take the substitute here as you took it in the nominative." End of quotation. The saying has been transmitted:

195 - 1-. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ... . . . . . . فاستاكَتْ به عُودِ إسْحِلِ

with genitive «عُود» as a substitute for the pronoun. I say: as for explaining a non-nominative pronoun by a substitute, it is the statement of al-Akhfash, who recited this second half-verse as evidence, whose first half is:

إذا هي لم تَسْتَكْ بعودِ أراكةٍ ... تُنُخَّلَ فاستاكَتْ به عودِ إسحلِ
(When she did not use a stick of arāk to clean her teeth, one was selected for her, and she cleaned them with it, a stick of isḥil.)

The verse is by Ṭufayl al-Ghanawī. It is transmitted with nominative «عود», which is the well-known form among the grammarians, its nominative being by giving effect to the first verb, which is «تُنُخِّل», and ignoring the second, which is «فاستاكَتْ», to which he gave its pronoun; had he given effect to it, he would have said «فاستاكَتْ بعود إسحل», which is not possible because it would break the meter. The other transmission, which he used as evidence, is very weak and unknown to most of the i'rab scholars. Had he cited as evidence what is not disputed, like the saying:

195 - 2- على حالةٍ لو أن في القوم حاتِماً ... على جوده لضَنَّ بالماءِ حاتمِ
(In a state in which, had Ḥātim been among the people, despite his generosity, Ḥātim would have been stingy with water.)

with genitive «حاتم» as a substitute for the hāʾ in «بجوده», and the rhyme-letters being in the genitive, it would have been better. «الإِبسال» is pledging, and one says «أَبْسَلْتُ ولدي وأهلي», i.e. I pledged them. He said:

195 - 3- وإبسالي بَنِيَّ بغير جُرْمٍ بَعَوْناه ولا بدمٍ مُراق
(And my pledging of my sons without a crime we committed, nor for blood shed.)

«بَعَوْنا» means "we committed", and «البَعْو» is the crime. It was also said: «الإِبسال» is a man's giving himself up to destruction.

Al-Rāghib said: "«البَسْلُ» is gathering a thing and withholding it. Because of its including the sense of gathering, it was borrowed for the frowning of the face, so it is said «باسل» and «مُتْبَسِلُ الوجه»; and because of its including the sense of withholding, the forbidden and the pledged are called «بَسْلٌ»." Then he said: "The difference between the forbidden (ḥarām) and the basl is that the ḥarām is general for what is withheld by compulsion and by ruling, while the basl is what is withheld by compulsion. Courage is called «بسالة» either because of the frowning of the face with which the brave man is described, or because he is forbidden to his peers, or because he withholds what is in his possession and under his hand from his enemies. «البُسْلَةُ» is the wage of the one who recites a charm, taken from the reciter's saying «أَبْسَلْتُ زيداً», i.e. I made him forbidden to Satan or I made him brave and strong in defending himself; and «بَسَل» has the meaning of «أَجَلْ» and «بَسْ»," i.e. it is a particle of response like «أجل», and a verbal noun meaning "enough" like «بس».

His saying {بِمَا}: attached to «تُبْسَل», i.e. "by reason of"; «ما» is a maṣdar or has the meaning of the relative, or is indefinite, and its matter is clear.

His saying: {لَيْسَ لَهَا}: This clause has three aspects. One, the apparent: it is resumptive, brought to report that. The second: it is in the position of nominative as an adjective of «نفس». The third: it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun in «كسبت».

His saying: {مِن دُونِ}: There are two aspects regarding «مِنْ», the more apparent being that it is for the beginning of the range; the second: that it is redundant, which Ibn ʿAṭiyya reported with something. If it is for the beginning of the range, there are two aspects as to what it is attached to. One: that it is a ḥāl from «وليّ», because if it were postponed it would be an adjective of it, so it is attached to an omitted word which is the ḥāl. The second: that it is the predicate of «ليس», so it is attached to an omitted word that is the predicate of «ليس»; and on this «لها» is attached to an omitted word by way of explanation (bayān). Parallels have gone before. In {مِن دُونِ الله} there is an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "other than His punishment and recompense".

His saying: {كُلَّ عَدْلٍ}: accusative as a maṣdar because «كل» takes its sense from what it is annexed to; this is the well-known view. It may also be accusative as a direct object, i.e. "even if she ransoms with all that one ransoms with, it will not be accepted". The pronoun in «لا يُؤْخَذُ» on the first view, the Shaykh said, "returns to that which is given in exchange, understood from the course of the discourse, and does not return to the maṣdar, because taking is not ascribed to it; as for {وَلاَ يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌ} [البقرة: 48], its meaning is the thing ransomed with, so it is sound." End of quotation. That is, he ascribed taking explicitly to «عدل» in al-Baqara only because what is meant is not the maṣdar but the thing ransomed with; and on the second view it returns to «كل عدل», because it is not a maṣdar, so it is like the verse of al-Baqara.

His saying: {أولئك الذين أُبْسِلُواْ}: It is permissible that «الذين» be the predicate and «لهم شراب» a second predicate, and that «لهم شراب» be a ḥāl: either from the pronoun in «أُبْسِلوا» or from the relative itself, with «شرابٌ» an agent because the preposition and its genitive noun before it relies on the owner of the ḥāl. «لهم شراب» may also be resumptive; so these are three aspects for «لهم شراب». It is also permissible that «الذين» be a substitute for «أولئك» or an adjective of them, in which case it is necessary that the clause «لهم شرابٌ» be a predicate of the subject. So three aspects are obtained for the relative as well: its being a predicate, a substitute or an adjective; so, with what precedes, six aspects in this verse.

«شراب» may be nominative in two ways: as a subject, and as an agent according to al-Akhfash, and also according to Sībawayh, on the basis that «لهم» is the predicate of the subject, or a ḥāl where we made it a ḥāl, with «شراب» nominative by it because it relies on what precedes. «من حميمٍ» is an adjective of «شراب», so it is in the position of nominative and attached to an omitted word.

«شراب» is on the pattern faʿāl with the meaning of mafʿūl, and faʿāl with the meaning of mafʿūl, like «طعام» meaning "food eaten" and «شراب» meaning "drink drunk", is not regular; one does not say «أَكال» meaning «مأكول», nor «ضَراب» meaning «مضروب». The reference by «ذلك» in the statement of al-Zamakhsharī and al-Ḥawfī is to those who took (their religion as play), so he brought the plural form; and in the statement of Ibn ʿAṭiyya and Abū al-Baqāʾ it is to the confinement understood from His saying «أن تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌ», since what is meant by it is souls in general, so it is referred to in the plural.

His saying, the Exalted: {أَنَدْعُواْ}: an interrogative of reproach and denial. The clause is in the position of accusative as the content of the saying. «ما» is the object of «ندعو», and it is a relative or an indefinite noun with a description. «مِنْ دون الله» is attached to «ندعو». Abū al-Baqāʾ said: "It cannot be a ḥāl from the pronoun in «يَنْفَعنا», nor governed by «ينفعنا», because it precedes «ما», and the ṣila and the description do not work on what precedes the relative and the described noun." His saying "from the pronoun in «ينفعنا»" means the nominative one returning to «ما», and his saying "do not work on what precedes the relative and the described noun" means that «ما» does not depart from these two categories. But it is permissible that «من دون» be a ḥāl from «ما» itself, according to his own statement, since he did not make the preventing factor, in making it a ḥāl from its pronoun in «ينفعنا», other than a technical one, not a semantic one; and there is no difference between the overt noun and its pronoun, in the sense that if it may be a ḥāl from an overt noun, it may be a ḥāl from its pronoun, unless a preventer prevents.

His saying: {وَنُرَدُّ}: There are two aspects in it, the more apparent being that it is conjoined to «ندعو», so it falls within the scope of the interrogative over which the saying has authority. The second: that it is a ḥāl, with an implied subject, i.e. "and we are being returned". The Shaykh said, after reporting from Abū al-Baqāʾ: "It is weak, because of the implying of the subject, and because it would be a confirmatory ḥāl." There is something to examine in its being confirmatory, because the confirmatory is that whose meaning is understood from the first, and it is as if he says that turning back on the heels is inherent in calling on something "other than Allah".

His saying: {على أَعْقَابِنَا}: two aspects. One: it is attached to «نُرَدُّ». The second: it is attached to an omitted word as a ḥāl from the nominative pronoun of «نُرَدُّ», i.e. "we are returned going back on our heels", or "turning back", or "lagging behind"; so he implied it, and this is an explanation of meaning, since what is implied in the like of it is a general "being"; and it can be said of this that it is a confirmatory ḥāl. «بعد إذ» is attached to «نُرَدُّ».

His saying: {كالذي استهوته}: There are two aspects in this kāf. One: that it is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "we are returned a return like the return of the one who ...". The second: that it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the nominative pronoun of «نرد», i.e. "we are returned resembling the one whom the devils lured". So whoever permits multiple ḥāls makes it a second ḥāl if he makes «على أعقابنا» a ḥāl; and whoever does not permit that makes this ḥāl a substitute for the first ḥāl, or he does not make «على أعقابنا» a ḥāl but attaches it to «نُرَدُّ».

«Translator's note: the source reads «ألم يجعل» here (apparently «أو لم يجعل»); translated as "or he does not make".»

The majority read «اسْتَهْوَتْهُ» with the feminine tāʾ, and Ḥamza «استهواه», following his rule of imāla; the two aspects are known from what preceded in {تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا} [الأنعام: 61]. Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān and al-Aʿmash read «استهوَتْه الشيطان», with the verb feminine and «الشيطان» singular. Al-Kisāʾī said: "And it is so in the codex of Ibn Masʿūd." The justification of this reading is that it interprets the masculine as a feminine, as in their saying «أتته كتابي فاحترقها», i.e. my sheet; and parallels have preceded. Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī read «الشياطون», and they made it a solecism, but it does not reach solecism; it is a poor minor dialect. It has been heard: "around the garden of so-and-so are «بساتون»", and "he has «سلاطون»". It is related that when the reading of al-Ḥasan was reported, some called it a solecism, and al-Farrāʾ said: "Yes, by Allah, they call the Shaykh a solecist, and they cite as evidence the saying of Ruʾba." By my life, al-Farrāʾ spoke truly in denying that. «الذي» is meant as a genus, and it may be meant as the single individual.

His saying: {فِي الأرض}: four aspects. One: it is attached to His saying {استهوته}. The second: it is a ḥāl from the object of «استهوته». The third: it is a ḥāl from «حَيْران». The fourth: it is a ḥāl from the latent pronoun in «حيران». «حَيْران» is a ḥāl: either from the hāʾ of «اسْتَهْوَتْه», on the basis that it is a substitute for the first, or according to the one who permits multiple ḥāls; or from «الذي», or from the latent pronoun in the adverbial phrase. «حيران» has the feminine «حَيْرى», and for that reason it is a diptote. The verb is «حار يحار حَيْرةً وحَيَراناً وحَيْرورة».

His saying: {لَهُ أَصْحَابٌ}: a clause in the position of accusative as an adjective of «حيران»; it may also be a ḥāl from the pronoun in «حيران», and it may be resumptive. «إلى الهدى» is attached to «يَدْعُونه». In the codex of Ibn Masʿūd and in his reading it is «أتينا» in the past form, and «إلى الهدى» on this reading is attached to it; on the reading of the majority, the imperative clause is in the position of accusative by an implied saying, i.e. "they say: Come to us", and the implied saying is in the position of an adjective of «أصحاب», and likewise «يدعونه».

«Translator's note: the source prints «محصل نصب» for «محل نصب» here; translated as "position of accusative".»

His saying: {لِنُسْلِمَ}: There are several statements regarding this lām. The first, which is the position of Sībawayh: that this lām after volition, command and the like is attached to an omitted word as the predicate of a subject, and that subject is the maṣdar of that preceding verb; so if you say «أردْتَ لتقوم» or «أمرت زيداً ليذهب», the implied meaning is "the volition is for standing" and "the command is for going". So the Shaykh reported that from Sībawayh and his companions, and there is weakness in it which I presented in Sūrat al-Nisāʾ at His saying: {يُرِيدُ الله لِيُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ} [الآية: 26]. The second: that the object of the command and volition is omitted, and its implied form is: "and we were commanded to sincerity so that we submit". The third: al-Zamakhsharī said: "It gives a reason for the command, meaning: 'We were commanded, and it was said to us: submit, in order that we submit.'" The fourth: that the lām is redundant, i.e. "we were commanded to submit". The fifth: that it has the meaning of the bāʾ, i.e. "with the submitting". The sixth: that the lām and what follows is the object of the command, occurring in the place of «أن», i.e. the two alternate, so you say «أمرتُك لتقومَ» and «أن تقوم»; this is the position of the Kufans. Ibn ʿAṭiyya said: "The position of Sībawayh is that «لنُسْلِمَ» is in the position of the object, and that your saying «أُمِرْت لأقومَ» and «وأَنْ أقومَ» run the same; and the poet said:

195 - 4- أُريد لأَنْسى حبَّها فكأنَّما ... تَمثَّلُ لي ليلى بكل طريقِ
(I want to forget her love, but it is as if Laylā appears to me in every path.)

This is not the position of Sībawayh; his position is what preceded, and the verification of this question has gone before in the sūra indicated earlier.

Allah Teâlâ'nın {أتحاجواني} kavli: Nâfi', İbn Zekvân ve —kendisinden ihtilaflı olarak— Hişâm hafif (tek) nûn ile, diğerleri ise ağır (şeddeli) nûn ile okumuştur. Teşdîd asıldır; çünkü birinci nûn «el-emsiletü'l-hamse»deki (beş örnek fiillerdeki) ref' nûnu, ikincisi ise vikâye nûnudur; ikisinin bir araya gelmesi ağır görülmüştür. Bunda üç lehçe vardır: Fekk (ikisini ayrı ayrı olduğu gibi bırakmak), idğam ve hazf. Allah Teâlâ'nın {أَفَغَيْرَ الله تأمروني أَعْبُدُ} [Zümer: 64] kavlinde bu lehçelerin hepsiyle okunmuştur. Burada ise yalnızca hazf veya idğam ile okunmuştur. Hicr sûresindeki {فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ} [Hicr: 54] de böyledir: İbn Kesîr'in kıraati idğam iledir, Nâfi'inki hazf iledir; diğerleri ise nûnu fetha ile okurlar; çünkü onlara göre o ref' nûnudur. Nahl sûresindeki {تُشَاقُّونَ فِيهِمْ} [Nahl: 27] ise cumhura göre nûnun fethasıyla okunur; çünkü o ref' nûnudur; Nâfi' ise onu hazf üzere kesreli hafif nûn ile okur. Böylece Nâfi', sana zikrettiğim bu yerlerin hepsinde iki nûndan birini hazfetmiştir; zira Zümer'de de ikisinden birinin hazfiyle okur. Allah Teâlâ'nın {أتعدانني} [Ahkâf: 17] kavlini ise Hişâm idğam ile, diğerleri hazf olmaksızın izhâr ile okumuştur.

Nahivciler, ikisinden hangisinin hazfedildiği hususunda ihtilaf etmişlerdir: Sîbeveyh ve ona uyanların mezhebi, hazfedilenin birincisi olduğudur; Ahfeş ve ona uyanların mezhebi ise hazfedilenin ikincisi olduğudur.

Sîbeveyh buna şununla istidlal etmiştir: Ref' nûnunun, kendi misliyle karşılaşmadan da ref' hâlinde hazfedildiği bilinmektedir. Şu beyit okunmuştur:

1968 - فإنْ يكُ قومٌ سَرَّهمْ ما صنعتُمُ ... سَتَحْتَلبوها لاقِحاً غير باهِلِ
(Eğer yaptığınız şey bir topluluğu sevindirdiyse, onu [bu işi] gebe, sütü bol bir deve olarak sağacaksınız [yani acı sonucunu tadacaksınız].)

Yani «فستحتلبونها». Nûnun şartın cevabında cezm sebebiyle hazfedildiği söylenemez; çünkü burada cezâ cümlesi şart olmaya elverişli olmadığından fânın girmesi vâciptir. Fânın vücûbu sabit olup sadece zaruret sebebiyle hazfedildiği belli olunca, ref' nûnunun aslında sabit kalması gerektiği, ancak zaruret sebebiyle hazfedildiği sabit olur. Şairin şu sözünü de okumuşlardır:

1969 - أبيتُ أَسْرِي وتَبِيتي تَدْلُكي ... وجهكِ بالعنبرِ والمِسْك الذكي
(Ben geceleri yol yürüyerek geçiriyorum; sen ise geceyi yüzünü amber ve güzel kokulu miskle ovarak geçiriyorsun.)

Yani «تبيتين» ve «تَدْلُكين». Hadiste de şöyle geçer: «Nefsim elinde olana yemin olsun ki, iman etmedikçe cennete giremezsiniz; birbirinizi sevmedikçe de iman etmiş olmazsınız.» «تدخلوا» ve «تؤمنوا»ya giren «لا», nefy içindir, nehy için değildir; çünkü o takdirde mana bozulur. Ref' nûnunun «misil» ile karşılaşmadan ref' hâlinde hazfedildiği sabit olunca, ağırlık sebebiyle «misil» ile karşılaştığında hazfedilmesi evleviyetle ve daha layık olarak sabit olur.

Ayrıca nûn dammenin nâibidir; dammenin ise fasih sözde hazfedildiği bilinmektedir; Ebû Amr'ın {يَنصُرْكُمُ} [Âl-i İmrân: 160], {يُشْعِرُكُمْ} [En'âm: 109], {يَأْمُرُكُمْ} [Bakara: 67] ve benzerlerini fiilin sonunu sâkin okuması gibi. Şairin şu sözü de böyledir:

1970 - فاليومَ أشربْ غيرَ مُسْتَحقِبٍ ... إثماً من اللهِ ولا واغِلِ
(Bugün içerim; ne Allah'tan bir günah yüklenmiş olarak ne de davetsiz bir sofra misafiri olarak.)

Aslın hazfi sabit olunca, fer'in aslından üstün tutulması gerekmesin diye fer'in hazfi de sabit olmalıdır.

Ayrıca ref' nûnunun hazfedildiğini iddia etmek başka bir hazfe ihtiyaç doğurmaz; vikâye nûnunun hazfi ise buna ihtiyaç doğurabilir. Bunun açıklaması şudur: Bu örnek fiillerden birine bir câzim veya nâsıb girdiğinde, eğer hazfedilen vikâye nûnu olsaydı, bu (kalan) nûnun hazfedilmesi gerekirdi; çünkü o ref' nûnudur ve nâsıb ile câzim sebebiyle düşer. Ref' nûnunun hazfini iddia etmek ise buna ihtiyaç doğurmaz; çünkü [câzim ve nâsıbın] vikâye nûnunda bir amelî yoktur.

Bir kimse şöyle diyebilir: Aslın hazfinin câiz olmasından fer'in hazfi gerekmez; çünkü aslda hazfinin câiz olmasını gerektiren bir kuvvet vardır, fer'de ise yoktur. Diğerine karşı da şöyle diyebilir: Bu, âmilin ilgası ile çelişir (muâraza edilir); şöyle ki: Eğer vikâye nûnu sebebiyle hazfedilen ref' nûnu olsaydı ve câzim ile nâsıb girseydi, hazfedecek bir şey bulamazdı; çünkü nûn başka bir ârızî sebeple hazfedilmiştir.

Sîbeveyh lehine şununla da istidlal etmişlerdir: Vikâye nûnu kesrelidir; onun hâli üzere kalmasından bir değişiklik gerekmez. Onun hazfini iddia etseydik, ref' nûnunu fethadan kesreye değiştirmemiz gerekirdi; amelî (işlemi) azaltmak ise daha evlâdır.

Şununla da istidlal etmişlerdir: Ref' nûnu, vikâye nûnu olmasa bile misliyle birlikte hazfedilmiştir; şairin şu sözünde olduğu gibi:

1971 - كل له نِيَّةٌ في بُغْضِ صاحبِهِ ... بنعمةِ الله نَقْلِيْكُمْ وتَقْلُونا
(Her birimizin arkadaşına buğz etmede bir niyeti var; Allah'ın nimetiyle biz size buğzediyoruz, siz de bize buğzediyorsunuz.)

Yani «وتَقْلُوننا». Hazfedilen ref' nûnudur, «ن» nûnu değildir [Mütercim notu: Metinde «ن» yazılıdır; «نا» olduğu anlaşılmaktadır.]; çünkü o zamirin bir parçasıdır. Buna, ref' nûnunun da i'raba delâlet ettiği için bir kuvveti olduğu, dolayısıyla onun hazfinin de câiz olmadığı şeklinde muâraza edilmiştir.

Sîbeveyh, şairin şu sözünde hazfedilenin vikâye nûnu değil, fâil nûnu olduğunu kabul etmiştir:

1972 - تراه كالثَّغامِ يُعَلُّ مِسْكاً ... يَسُوءُ الفالِياتِ إذا فَلَيْني
(Onu [saçımı] misk ile tekrar tekrar kokulandırılmış beyaz sagam bitkisi gibi görürsün; beni bitlerimden temizleyen kadınları, beni ayıkladıklarında üzer.)

Ahfeş ise şununla istidlal etmiştir: Ağırlık ancak ikincisiyle hâsıl olmuştur. Ayrıca ondan müstağni kalınmıştır; zira o, fiili kesreden korumak için getirilmiştir; kesre ref' nûnu üzerine düştüğü için bundan emin olunmuştur. Ayrıca vikâye nûnu bir manaya delâlet etmez; ref' nûnu ise öyle değildir. Bir de o, «ليتني» gibi yerlerde hazfedilir ve «ليتي» denir; şairin şu sözünde olduğu gibi:

1973 - كمُنْيَةِ جابر إذ قال ليتي ... أُصادِفُه وأُتْلِفُ بعضَ مالي
(Câbir'in temennisi gibi; o "Keşke ona rastlasam da malımın bir kısmını telef etsem" demişti.)

Bil ki bu gibi yerlerde nûnun hazfi câiz ve fasihtir. Bunu ancak zaruret hâlinde veya az bir sözde câiz görüp başka durumda yasaklayanların sözüne iltifat edilmez. Bu yüzden Mekkî b. Ebû Tâlib şu sözü sebebiyle ayıplanmıştır: «Hazf, Arapçada uzak, çirkin ve mekruhtur; ancak şiirde vezin için câizdir. Kur'an'da ise buna ihtimal verilmez; zira buna davet eden bir zaruret yoktur.» Bazıları ise cüret ederek şöyle demiştir: «Bu kıraat, yani nûnun tahfîfi, lahindir (hatadır).» Bu iki söz, bunun tevâtürü sebebiyle sahiplerine reddedilmiştir. Ben de onun dil bakımından sıhhatine dair delili daha önce takdim ettim. Ayrıca sika (güvenilir) kimseler bunun Araplar için sabit bir lehçe olduğunu nakletmişlerdir; bunlar Ğatafânlılardır; dolayısıyla onu inkâr etmenin bir anlamı yoktur.

«في الله», «حاجَّه»ye değil, «أتحاجُّوني»ye müteallikır. Mesele tenâzu' babındandır; ikincisi amel ettirilmiştir; çünkü birincisinde zamir takdir edildiğinde hazfedilmiştir; eğer birincisi amel ettirilseydi, ikincisinde hazf olmaksızın zamir getirilirdi. Bunun benzeri {يَسْتَفْتُونَكَ قُلِ الله يُفْتِيكُمْ فِي الكلالة} [Nisâ: 176] kavlidir. Şeyh böyle söylemiştir. Bunda nazar vardır; çünkü mana, «وَحَاجَّهُ»nin «في الله» kavline tesir etmesi üzere değildir; zira zâhir olan, kavl cümlesinin kendisinden öncekinden kopuk olmasıdır. «في الله» kavli, yani O'nun şanı ve birliği hakkında demektir.

«وَقَدْ هَدَاني» kavli: Hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir. Sâhibü'l-hâl hakkında iki vecih vardır: En zâhiri: «أتحاجونني»deki tâ'dır [Mütercim notu: Burada «التاء» yazılıdır; muhtemelen «الياء» (mütekellim yâsı) kastedilmektedir; nitekim aşağıda «iki hâl de "أتحاجونِّي"deki yâdan olur» denmektedir.]; yani: «Ben O'nun katından hidayete erdirilmiş olduğum hâlde, O'nun hakkında benimle mi tartışıyorsunuz?» İkincisi: «الله»tan hâldir; yani: «O bana hidayet eden olduğu hâlde, O'nun hakkında benimle mi çekişiyorsunuz?» Dolayısıyla sizin delilinizin hiçbir faydası yoktur; çünkü o geçersizdir.

{وَلاَ أَخَافُ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِ} kavli: Bu cümlenin isti'nâfiyye olması câizdir; Hz. İbrâhim (a.s.), Rabbine güvendiği için O'na ortak koştuğunuz şeylerden korkmadığını haber vermiştir. Onlar, ilahlarına sövmesi sebebiyle kendisine bir zarar ulaşacağı korkusunu ona vermişlerdi. İki itibarla hâl olarak nasb mahallinde olması da muhtemeldir: Birincisi: Birinciye atfedilmiş ikinci bir hâl olur; bu durumda iki hâl de «أتحاجونِّي»deki yâdan olur. İkincisi: «هداني»deki yâdan hâldir; bu durumda bir hâl cümlesinin bir kısmından gelen hâl cümlesi olur; bu da mütedâhil hâle yakındır. Ancak bu vecihte muzâri fiilden önce bir mübtedânın gizlenmesi zorunludur; çünkü daha önce geçtiği üzere «لا» ile gelen muzâri fiilin hükmü, vâvın ona doğrudan bitişmemesi bakımından müsbet muzârinin hükmü gibidir.

«ما»da üç vecih câizdir: Masdariyye olması: Buna göre cumhura göre «به»deki hâ «ما»ya değil, Allah Teâlâ'ya döner; takdir: «Sizin Allah'a şirk koşmanızdan korkmam»; mef'ûl hazfedilmiştir; yani «Allah'tan başkasını O'na ortak koşmanızdan». «الذي» manasında olması ve nekre-i mevsûfe olması: Bu iki vecihte «به»deki hâ «ما»ya döner; mana: «Allah'ı kendisine ortak koştuğunuz şeyden korkmam»; birinci vecihte hazfedildiği gibi burada da mef'ûl hazfedilmiştir. Ebü'l-Bekâ zamirden önce bir muzâf takdir ederek şöyle demiştir: «Hânın "ما"ya dönmesi de câizdir; yani: "Sebebiyle şirk koştuğunuz şeyden korkmam".» Buna ihtiyaç yoktur.

«إلا أَنْ يشاء» kavli: Bu istisnâ hakkında iki görüş vardır: En zâhiri: Muttasıldır. İkincisi: Munkatıdır. Muttasıl olduğunu söyleyenler müstesnâ minh (kendisinden istisnâ yapılan) hakkında ihtilaf etmişlerdir: Zemahşerî onu zaman olarak kabul edip şöyle demiştir: «Ancak Rabbimin korkulacak bir şey dilediği vakit müstesnâ; "vakit" hazfedilmiştir; yani: Sizin mabutlarınızdan hiçbir vakitte korkmam; çünkü onlar ne bir fayda ne de bir zarar vermeye güç yetiremezler; ancak Rabbim dilerse müstesnâ.» Ebü'l-Bekâ ise onu hâl kabul ederek şöyle demiştir: «Takdiri: Ancak Rabbimin dilemesi hâlinde müstesnâ; yani her hâlde onlardan korkmam, ancak bu hâlde müstesnâ.» Munkatı olduğu görüşüne gidenler arasında İbn Atıyye, Havfî ve iki vecihten birinde Ebü'l-Bekâ vardır. Havfî şöyle demiştir: «Takdiri: Fakat Allah'ın bana bir zarar dilemesinden korkarım.» İbn Atıyye de şöyle demiştir: «Birinciden (cinsinden) olmayan bir istisnâdır. Sözün gücü onun bir zarardan korkmadığı yönünde olunca, Rabbinin kendisine bir zarar dilemesini istisnâ etmiştir.»

«شيئاً» kavli: Bunda iki vecih câizdir: En zâhiri: Masdar (mef'ûl-i mutlak) olarak mansûbtur; takdiri: «Ancak Rabbim bir dileme (meşîet) dilerse». İkincisi: «يشاء»nın mef'ûlün bihidir. Birincisinin daha zâhir olması iki sebepledir: Birincisi: Te'kîdli söz, te'kîdsiz sözden daha güçlü ve nefiste daha sabittir. İkincisi: Daha önce geçtiği üzere meşîet ve irâde fiillerinin mef'ûlü ancak onlarda bir gariplik bulunduğunda zikredilir; şairin şu sözünde olduğu gibi:

1974 - ولو شِئْتُ أَنْ أبكي دماً لبَكَيْتُه ... . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
(Kan ağlamayı dileseydim, onu ağlardım…)

«عِلْماً» kavli: Bunda iki vecih vardır: En zâhiri: Temyîz olarak mansûbtur; fâilden dönüştürülmüştür; takdiri: «Rabbimin ilmi her şeyi kuşattı»; {واشتعل الرأس شَيْباً} [Meryem: 4] kavli gibi. İkincisi: Mef'ûl-i mutlak olarak mansûbtur; çünkü «وَسِعَ»nin manası «عَلِم»dir. Ebü'l-Bekâ şöyle demiştir: «Çünkü bir şeyi kuşatan şey onu ihata etmiştir; bir şeyi bilen de ilmiyle onu ihata eder.» Onun iddia ettiği bu mecaz uzaktır. «كل شيء», her iki takdire göre de «وسع»in mef'ûlüdür. «أفلا تتذكرون» takrir ve azarlama cümlesidir; isti'nâfiyye olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.

The words of Allah the Exalted: {أتحاجواني}: Nāfiʿ, Ibn Dhakwān and Hishām (with a disagreement from him) read it with a single light nūn, and the rest with a doubled (heavy) nūn. The doubling is the original, because the first nūn is the nūn of the nominative in the "five verb forms" (al-amthila al-khamsa) and the second is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and their coming together was felt to be heavy. There are three usages in it: separating them and leaving both as they are, assimilation (idghām), and omission. All these usages have been read in the words of Allah the Exalted {أَفَغَيْرَ الله تأمروني أَعْبُدُ} [al-Zumar: 64]; here it was read only with omission or assimilation. Likewise in Sūrat al-Ḥijr {فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ} [al-Ḥijr: 54]: Ibn Kathīr's reading is with assimilation and Nāfiʿ's with omission, and the rest give the nūn fatḥa, because for them it is the nūn of the nominative. In Sūrat al-Naḥl, {تُشَاقُّونَ فِيهِمْ} [al-Naḥl: 27] is read by the majority with fatḥa on the nūn, because it is the nūn of the nominative, and Nāfiʿ reads it with a light nūn with kasra, by omission. So Nāfiʿ omitted one of the two nūns in all these places I have mentioned to you, for he also reads [the verse] in al-Zumar with one of them omitted. As for the words of Allah the Exalted {أتعدانني} [al-Aḥqāf: 17], Hishām read it with assimilation and the rest with the two pronounced separately, without omission.
The grammarians differed as to which of the two is omitted. The doctrine of Sībawayh and those who follow him is that the omitted one is the first; the doctrine of al-Akhfash and those who follow him is that the omitted one is the second. Sībawayh argued for that from the fact that omission of the nūn of the nominative is attested without meeting an identical letter, in the nominative; and there was recited:
1968 - فإنْ يكُ قومٌ سَرَّهمْ ما صنعتُمُ ... سَتَحْتَلبوها لاقِحاً غير باهِلِ
(If there are people whom what you did has pleased, you will milk it [i.e. the war] pregnant, not one left unmilked [i.e. you will reap its bitter yield].)
i.e. «فستحتلبونها». It cannot be said that the nūn was omitted for the jussive in the apodosis of the condition, because the fāʾ here must enter, since the apodosis clause is not fit to be a protasis. Once it is established that the fāʾ is required, and that it was omitted only by poetic necessity, it is established that the nūn of the nominative ought to have been retained, but it was omitted by necessity. They also recited his saying:
1969 - أبيتُ أَسْرِي وتَبِيتي تَدْلُكي ... وجهكِ بالعنبرِ والمِسْك الذكي
(I pass the night travelling, while you pass the night rubbing your face with ambergris and fragrant musk.)
i.e. «تبيتين» and «تَدْلُكين». And in the hadith: "By the One in whose hand is my soul, you will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another"; the «لا» on «تدخلوا» and «تؤمنوا» is negative, not prohibitive, since the meaning would be spoilt by that. Once its omission is established without meeting an identical letter, in the nominative, then its omission when meeting an identical letter, because of heaviness, is all the more fitting. Also, the nūn stands in for the ḍamma, and omission of the ḍamma is attested in eloquent speech, as in Abū ʿAmr's reading {يَنصُرْكُمُ} [Āl ʿImrān: 160], {يُشْعِرُكُمْ} [al-Anʿām: 109] and {يَأْمُرُكُمْ} [al-Baqara: 67] and its class with the end of the verb unvowelled, and his saying:
1970 - فاليومَ أشربْ غيرَ مُسْتَحقِبٍ ... إثماً من اللهِ ولا واغِلِ
(So today I drink, not burdening myself with a sin before Allah, nor intruding [on others' drinking].)
And if omission of the original is established, then let omission of the derivative be established too, lest it follow that a derivative is preferred over its original. Also, claiming omission of the nūn of the nominative does not necessitate another omission, while omission of the nūn of protection may necessitate that. The explanation is that when a jussive or subjunctive particle enters one of these forms, if the omitted [nūn] were the nūn of protection, this [remaining] nūn ought to be dropped, since it is the nūn of the nominative, and that drops for the subjunctive and jussive particle; unlike claiming omission of the nūn of the nominative, which does not necessitate that, since [the particle] has no effect on the one for protection.
Someone may say: the permissibility of omitting the original does not entail omitting the derivative, because in the original there is a strength that permits its omission, unlike the derivative. And on the other point he may say: this is countered by the nullification of the governing word; for if the omitted [nūn] were the nūn of the nominative because of the nūn of protection, and the jussive or subjunctive particle entered, it would find nothing to omit, because the nūn had been omitted for another incidental reason. They also argued for Sībawayh that the nūn of protection has kasra, so keeping it as it is entails no change, unlike if we claimed its omission, for then we would have to change the nūn of the nominative from fatḥa to kasra, and minimising operations is preferable. They also argued that it has been omitted together with its like even where it was not a nūn of protection, as in his saying:
1971 - كل له نِيَّةٌ في بُغْضِ صاحبِهِ ... بنعمةِ الله نَقْلِيْكُمْ وتَقْلُونا
(Each has an intent of hating his fellow; by Allah's grace we loathe you and you loathe us.)
i.e. «وتَقْلُوننا»; the omitted one is the nūn of the nominative, not the nūn of «ن» [Translator's note: the text reads «ن»; evidently «نا» is meant], because it is part of a pronoun. This was countered by [saying] that the nūn of the nominative also has strength because it indicates the case inflection, so omitting it is also not permissible. Sībawayh made the omitted one in the poet's saying:
1972 - تراه كالثَّغامِ يُعَلُّ مِسْكاً ... يَسُوءُ الفالِياتِ إذا فَلَيْني
(You see it [his hair] like white thaghām, drenched again and again with musk; it grieves the women delousing [it] when they delouse me.)
the nūn of the agent, not the nūn of protection. Al-Akhfash argued that the heaviness arose only through the second; and because it is dispensable, since it was only brought to protect the verb from kasra, and that is secured because the kasra falls on the nūn of the nominative; and because it indicates no meaning, unlike the nūn of the nominative. Also, it is omitted in e.g. «ليتني», so one says «ليتي», as in his saying:
1973 - كمُنْيَةِ جابر إذ قال ليتي ... أُصادِفُه وأُتْلِفُ بعضَ مالي
(Like the wish of Jābir when he said: would that I met him, even if I lost some of my wealth.)
Know that omitting the nūn in this kind of case is permissible and eloquent, and no attention is paid to the view of those who forbade it except in poetic necessity or in a little of speech. For this reason Makkī ibn Abī Ṭālib was faulted when he said: "The omission is far-fetched in Arabic, ugly and disliked; it is permissible only in poetry for the metre, and the Quran does not admit it, since no necessity calls for it." Some of them even dared to say: "This reading—I mean lightening the nūn—is a solecism (laḥn)." Both of these views are rejected, because [this reading] is mass-transmitted (mutawātir); I have already given the proof of its correctness linguistically. Also, trustworthy authorities transmitted that it is an established usage of the Arabs, namely of Ghaṭafān, so there is no sense in denying it.
«في الله» is attached to «أتحاجُّوني», not to «حاجَّه». The question belongs to the topic of tanāzuʿ (two governing words competing for one governed word); he gave government to the second, because, when [the object] is pronominalised in the first, it is omitted; had he given government to the first, it would have been pronominalised in the second without omission. Like it is {يَسْتَفْتُونَكَ قُلِ الله يُفْتِيكُمْ فِي الكلالة} [al-Nisāʾ: 176]. So said the Shaykh; but this is open to consideration, since the meaning is not that «وَحَاجَّهُ» governs His words «في الله», as what is apparent is that the clause of the saying is cut off from what precedes it. His words «في الله» mean: concerning His affair and His oneness.
His words: «وَقَدْ هَدَاني»: in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). Concerning the one it describes (ṣāḥib al-ḥāl) there are two aspects. The more apparent: it is the [first-person] tāʾ [Translator's note: so in the text; the pronoun meant is the yāʾ] in «أتحاجونني», i.e. "Do you dispute with me concerning Him while I am guided by Him?"
The second: it is a ḥāl from «الله», i.e. "Do you contend with me concerning Him while He is my guide? Your argument is of no avail, since it is refuted."
His words: {وَلاَ أَخَافُ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِ}: this clause may be resumptive: he (upon him be peace) states that he does not fear what you associate with his Lord, trusting in Him; they had frightened him with harm that would befall him because of reviling their gods. It may also be in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl, in two respects. One: that it be a second [ḥāl] conjoined to the first, so that the two ḥāls are from the yāʾ in «أتحاجونِّي». The second: it is a ḥāl from the yāʾ in «هداني», so it is a ḥāl clause from part of a ḥāl clause, close to the "overlapping ḥāl" (mutadākhila). But on this aspect a mubtadaʾ must be implied before the imperfect verb, because, as stated before, the imperfect verb with «لا» has the rule of the affirmative in that the wāw does not directly precede it.
In «ما» the three aspects are possible. That it be maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya): on this view the hāʾ in «به» does not refer back to «ما», according to the majority, but to Allah the Exalted, the implied form being: "And I do not fear your associating with Allah," with the object omitted, i.e. what you associate—others than Allah—with Him. That it be in the sense of «الذي». And that it be a qualified indefinite. On these two aspects the hāʾ in «به» refers to «ما», and the meaning is: "And I do not fear that with which you associate Allah"; so the object is omitted here too, as in the first aspect. Abū al-Baqāʾ implied a muḍāf before the pronoun, saying: "The hāʾ may refer to «ما», i.e. and I do not fear that because of which you associate"; there is no need for that.
His words: «إلا أَنْ يشاء»: there are two views concerning this exception. The more apparent: it is connected (muttaṣil). The second: it is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ). Those who hold it connected differed about the thing excepted from. Al-Zamakhsharī made it a time, saying: "Except at the time of my Lord's willing something to be feared; so the [word for] time was omitted. That is: I do not fear your objects of worship at any time at all, because they have no power of benefit or harm, unless my Lord wills." Abū al-Baqāʾ made it a state, saying: its implied form is "except in the state of my Lord's willing," i.e. I do not fear them in any state except in this state. Among those who held it disconnected are Ibn ʿAṭiyya, al-Ḥawfī, and Abū al-Baqāʾ in one of his two aspects. Al-Ḥawfī said: "Its implied form is: but Allah's willing me harm, I fear." Ibn ʿAṭiyya said: "An exception not from the first [category]; since the thrust of the speech is that he does not fear harm, he excepted his Lord's will in wanting harm for him."
His words: «شيئاً»: two aspects are possible in it. The more apparent: it is in the accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), its implied form being: "unless my Lord wills something of willing." The second: it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يشاء». The first was more apparent for two reasons. One: emphasised speech is stronger and more firmly fixed in the mind than unemphasised.
The second: it has been stated before that the object of «المشيئة» and «الإرادة» is not mentioned unless there is something unusual about it, as in his saying:
1974 - ولو شِئْتُ أَنْ أبكي دماً لبَكَيْتُه ... . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
(And had I wished to weep blood, I would have wept it…)
His words: «عِلْماً»: there are two aspects. The more apparent: it is in the accusative as a tamyīz (specification), converted from the fāʿil (agent), its implied form being: "My Lord's knowledge encompasses everything," like His words {واشتعل الرأس شَيْباً} [Maryam: 4]. The second: it is in the accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because the meaning of «وَسِعَ» is «عَلِم». Abū al-Baqāʾ said: "Because what encompasses a thing has comprehended it, and the knower of a thing comprehends it in his knowledge." This figurative usage he claims is far-fetched. «كل شيء» is the object of «وسع» on both assumptions. «أفلا تتذكرون» is a clause of affirmation and rebuke, and it has no grammatical position because it is resumptive.

The words of Allah the Exalted: {ذلك هُدَى الله}: what is pointed to is the maṣdar (verbal noun) understood from the verb before it: either the choosing (ijtibāʾ) or the guiding (hidāya), i.e. "that choosing is a guidance," or "that guidance to the straight path is the guidance of Allah." It is also possible that «هدى الله» be the khabar (predicate), and also that it be a badal (substitute) from «ذلك», with the khabar being «يهدي به». On the first view «يهدي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), the governing word in it being the demonstrative; and it may also be a second khabar. «مِنْ عبادِه» is either an explanation (tabyīn) or a ḥāl: either from «مَنْ» or from its omitted referent pronoun.

The words of the Exalted: {جَعَلَ لَكُمُ النجوم}: The apparent sense is that «جعل» means "created", so it is transitive to one object, and «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جَعَلَ», and likewise «لتهتدوا». If it is said: how can two prepositions identical in wording and meaning be attached [to one verb]? The answer is that the second is a badal (substitute) of the first, a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) with repetition of the governing word, for «ليهتدوا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, since the lām is the lām of kay (purpose), and the verb after it is accusative by an implied «أن» according to the Basrans — its establishment has already preceded. The implied form is: He made the stars for you for your being guided. Its parallel in the Qur'an is {لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بالرحمن لِبُيُوتِهِمْ} [al-Zukhruf: 33], for «لبيوتهم» is a badal of «لمن يكفر» with repetition of the governing word. Ibn ʿAṭiyya said: "It may possibly be in the sense of «صيَّر» (made into), and the second object is supplied from «لتَهْتدوا», i.e. He made the stars for you a guidance."
The Shaykh [Abū Ḥayyān] said: "It is weak because omission of one of the two objects of ẓanna and its sisters is rare." I say: Ibn ʿAṭiyya did not claim omission of the second object such that he [Abū Ḥayyān] could declare it weak; he only said that it is from «لتهتدوا», i.e. the attachment of the preposition-phrase that occurs as the second object is implied, as it is implied in its parallels, the implied form being: He made the stars for you settled, or existing, for your being guided. As for his words "i.e. He made the stars for you a guidance", that is to clarify and explain the meaning.
The stars are well known; they are the plural of najm. Al-najm is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun); one says: najama al-kawkab yanjumu najman wa-nujūman, so it is nājim; then it was applied to the star (al-kawkab) figuratively. So al-najm is used at times as a noun for the star and at times as a maṣdar, and al-nujūm is used at times for the stars and at times as a maṣdar; from it: najama al-nabt, i.e. the plant came up, and najama the horn of the sheep and others. And al-najm among plants is that which has no stem, and al-shajar is that which has a stem. And al-tanjīm: dispersing; from it nujūm al-kināna, by comparison with the dispersion of the stars.

Allah Teâlâ'nın {أَنْعَامٌ} kavli: Cumhur bunu böyle, çoğul kalıbında okumuştur. Ebân b. Osmân ise tekil olarak «نَعَمٌ» okumuştur; bu da yakındır, çünkü cins ismi çoğulun yerini tutar. Cumhur «حِجْر» kelimesini noktasız hânın kesresi ve cîmin sükûnuyla okumuştur. Hasan, Katâde ve A'rec hânın dammesi ve cîmin sükûnuyla okumuşlardır. Hasan ve Katâde'den ayrıca hânın fethası ve cîmin sükûnu da nakledilmiştir. Ebân b. Osmân'dan da hâ ile cîmin birlikte dammeli okunuşu nakledilmiştir. Hârûn şöyle demiştir: «Hasan, Kur'an'da geçtiği her yerde حجر kelimesinin hâsını dammeli okurdu; yalnız bir yer hariç [o da]: {وَحِجْراً مَّحْجُوراً} [Furkân: 53].» [Mütercim notu: Bu ifade Furkân sûresinde 22 ve 53. ayetlerde geçer; kaynakta 53 yazılıdır.] Hâsılı bu kök men' (engelleme) ve hasr (kısıtlama) anlamına delâlet eder. «فلانٌ في حِجْر القاضي» (falan kimse kadı'nın hacri altındadır), yani onun men'i altındadır, sözü ve «حِجْري», yani elbisenin, içinden bir şeyin kaçmasını engelleyen kısmı da bundandır. Bunun tahkiki Nisâ sûresinde geçmişti. Buna göre Allah Teâlâ'nın {وَحَرْثٌ حِجْرٌ} kavli «memnû' (yasaklanmış)» demektir; dolayısıyla «فِعْل» kalıbı, tıpkı «مذبوح» ve «منطوح» anlamındaki «الذِّبْح» ve «النِّطْح» gibi, ism-i mef'ûl anlamındadır. Eğer: «Önce iki şey geçti, o da أنعام ve حرث'tir; sıfat ise tekil getirildi» denirse, cevap şudur: O aslında masdardır; masdar ise mutlak olarak müzekker ve tekil kullanılır. Zemahşerî şöyle demiştir: «Onunla vasıflandırmada müzekker ile müennes, tekil ile çoğul eşittir; çünkü onun hükmü, sıfat olmayan isimlerin hükmüdür.» Derim ki: «Hükmü isimlerin hükmüdür» sözüyle onun aslında sıfat değil masdar olduğunu kastediyor; burada «isim»den maksat masdardır ve o, sıfatın mukabilidir.
Diğer kıraatlere gelince, Ebü'l-Bekâ: «Bunlar kelimedeki lugatlerdir» demiş [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «تفي الكلمة» yazılıdır; «في الكلمة» olması muhtemeldir.] ve anlamını «yasaklanmış» diye tefsir etmiştir. Derim ki: Hâ ve cîmi dammeli olanın masdar olması da caizdir; sülâsî masdarlar arasında fâ ve aynın dammesiyle فُعُل vezninde olanlar gelmiştir, حُلُم gibi. Hâsı fethalı ve cîmi sâkin «حَجْر»ın çoğulu olması da caizdir; فُعُل, az da olsa فَعْل'in çoğulu olarak gelmiştir: سَقْف ile سُقُف ve رَهْن ile رُهُن gibi. Fâsı kesreli فِعْل'in çoğulu olması da caizdir; فُعُل, fâsı kesreli ve aynı sâkin فِعْل'in çoğulu olarak da gelmiştir: حِدْج ile حُدُج gibi. Hâsı dammeli ve cîmi sâkin حُجْر ise, (hâ ve cîmi) dammeli olandan tahfîf edilmiştir; dolayısıyla masdar olması da, حَجْر veya حِجْر'in çoğulu olması da caizdir. Übeyy b. Ka'b, Abdullah b. Abbâs, Abdullah b. Mes'ûd, Abdullah b. Zübeyr, İkrime, Amr b. Dînâr ve A'meş ise hânın kesresi ve cîmden önce gelen sâkin bir râ ile «حِرْج» okumuşlardır. Bunda iki te'vil vardır. Birincisi: Bu, daraltma anlamındaki الحَرَج kökündendir. Ebü'l-Bekâ şöyle demiştir: «Bunun aslı hânın fethası ve rânın kesresiyle حَرِج'dir; fakat فخِذ'deki فَخْذ gibi tahfîf edilmiş ve (hareke) nakledilmiştir.» Derim ki: Bunu iddia etmeye gerek yoktur; bilakis bu, asıl yoluyla فِعْل vezninde gelmiştir. İkincisi: Bu, حجر'den maklûbdur (harf yeri değiştirilmiştir); kelimenin lâmı aynından önce getirilmiştir ve vezni فِلْع'dir; tıpkı نأى yerine ناء ve عميق yerine معيق demeleri gibi. Kalb (harf yer değiştirmesi) onların dilinde azdır.
Bundan Mâide sûresinde Allah Teâlâ'nın «أشياء» kavli üzerinde (durulurken) yeterli bir kısmını önceden zikretmiştim.
{لاَّ يَطْعَمُهَآ إِلاَّ مَن نَّشَآءُ} kavli: Bu cümle أنعام'ın sıfatı (na't) olarak ref' mahallindedir. Onu iki vasıfla vasıflandırdılar: Birincisi onun «hicr» (yasak) olması, ikincisi onu kendi diledikleri kimselerden başkasının yememesi; bunlar da kadınlar değil erkekler, ya da putların hizmetkârlarıdır. «من يشاء» [Mütercim notu: Ayette «من نشاء» olarak geçer; kaynakta böyle yazılıdır.] «يَطْعَمُها»nın fâilidir; bu, müferrağ istisnâdır. «بزعمهم» da, benzerinde geçtiği gibi, hâldir.
«افتراءً» kavli: Bunda dört vecih vardır. Birincisi, ki Sîbeveyh'in mezhebidir: Mef'ûlün lieclihtir; yani geçen sözü Bârî Teâlâ'ya iftira etmek için söylediler. İkincisi: Fiilinin masdarından olmayan bir masdardır; çünkü onlardan hikâye edilen sözleri bir iftiradır; bu da «قعد القرفصاء» (ellerini dizlerine dolayarak oturdu) benzeridir. Bu, Zeccâc'ın sözüdür. Üçüncüsü: Âmili kendi lafzından olan takdîrî bir fiil olan masdardır; yani «افْتَرَوا ذلك افتراءً» (bunu iftira olarak uydurdular). Dördüncüsü: Hâl yerinde bir masdardır; yani bunu iftira ederlerken söylediler. Bu, müekkide hâle benzer; çünkü bu özel sözü söyleyen ancak müfterî olabilir. «على الله» kavlinin birinci ve dördüncü görüşe göre «افتراء»ya müteallik olması caizdir; ikinci ve üçüncüye göre ise «افتراء»ya değil «قالوا»ya müteallik olur; çünkü te'kîd için gelen masdar amel etmez. Mahzûf bir şeye müteallik olarak «افتراء»nın sıfatı olması da caizdir; bu, önceki görüşlerin her birine göre caizdir. «بما كانوا» kavlinde bâ sebebiyye içindir; «ما» ise masdariyye, ya da mevsûfe (nekra), ya da «الذي» anlamındadır.

Allah Teâlâ'nın {ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ} kavli: Bunun nasbında altı vecih vardır. En güzeli: Zeccâc'ın naklettiği, daha önce geçen icmâ olmasaydı, «حَمولة وفرشاً»dan bedel olmasıdır; fakat o (icmâ)da bunun develere münhasır olduğu (bilgisi) yoktur. Bedel görüşü Zeccâc ve Ferrâ'nın görüşüdür. İkincisi: Kendisinden önceki «كلوا» ile mansûbdur, yani «كلوا ثمانيةَ أزواج» (sekiz çiftten yiyin); bu durumda «ولا تَتَّبِعُوا» kavlinden sonuna kadarki kısım fiil ile mansûbu arasında i'tirâziyye gibi olur. Bu, Ali b. Süleymân'ın görüşüdür ve o bunu «كُلوا لحمَ ثمانية» (sekizin etinden yiyin) diye takdir etmiştir. Ebü'l-Bekâ şöyle demiştir: «O, "كلوا" ile mansûbdur; takdiri "كُلوا مما رزقكم الله ثمانية أزواج"dır; "ولا تُسْرفوا" ikisi arasında i'tirâziyyedir.» Derim ki: Doğrusu onun «ولا تسرفوا» yerine «ولا تتَّبعوا» demesidir; çünkü kendisini «ولا تسرفوا»nın takip ettiği «كُلوا» buna yönelmiş değildir, zira ondan uzaktır ve ondan sonra amel etmeye ondan daha lâyık olan bir şey vardır. Müstensihin onun adına hata yapmış ve onun aslında «ولا تَتَّبعوا» demiş olması da muhtemeldir. Buna delâlet eden şudur: O, «Takdiri "كلوا ممَّا رزقكم الله"dır» demiştir; birinci كلوا'dan sonra «مما رزقكم» yoktur, o ancak ikincisinden sonradır. Üçüncüsü: «جنات»a ma'tûftur, yani «أنشأ جنات وأنشأ ثمانية أزواج» (bahçeler yarattı ve sekiz çift yarattı); sonra fiil ve atıf harfi hazfedilmiştir. Bu, Kisâî'nin mezhebidir. Ebü'l-Bekâ: «Bu zayıftır» demiştir. Derim ki: Durum öyledir; bununla birlikte bu, onların kelâmında nesir ve nazımda işitilmiştir. Nesirde «أكلت لحماً سمكاً تمراً» (et, balık, hurma yedim) sözleri; nazımlarında ise şâirin şu sözü:
2102 - ... كيف أصبحتَ كيف أَمْسَيْتَ مِمَّا
يزرَعُ الودَّ في فؤاد الكريمِ
(«Nasıl sabahladın, nasıl akşamladın» demek, cömert kimsenin gönlüne sevgi eken şeylerdendir.)
Yani «أكلت لحماً وسمكاً وتمراً» ve «كيف أصبحت وكيف أمسيت». Bu, bu husustaki iki görüşten birine göredir. İkinci görüş ise bunun bedel-i bedâ (fikir değiştirme bedeli) olduğudur.
