Şöyle der: «Allah Teâlâ'nın «قل تعالوا أتل ما حرم ربكم عليكم أن لا تشركوا به شيئا» kavlinde, «لا»nın nâfiye olduğu söylenmiş, nehiy harfi olduğu söylenmiş, zâide olduğu söylenmiştir; hepsi muhtemeldir. Ayet hakkındaki sözün özeti şudur: «ما», «الذي» mânâsında haberiyyedir ve «أتل» ile mansûbdur; «حرم ربكم» sıladır; «عليكم» de «حرم»e mütealliktir. Zâhir olan budur. Zeccâc, «ما»nın «حرم» ile mansûb istifhâmiyye olmasını ve cümlenin «أتل» ile hikâye edilmesini câiz görmüştür; çünkü «أتل», «أقول» mânâsındadır. «عليكم»in «أتل»e müteallik kılınması da câizdir; tenâzu' eden iki âmilden birincisinin amel ettirilmesini tercih edenler —ki bunlar Kûfelilerdir— bunu «حرم»e müteallik olmasına tercih etmişlerdir. «أن» ve sonrası hakkında birkaç vecih vardır: (Birincisi) ikisinin «ما»dan bedel olarak nasb mahallinde olması; bu, «ما»nın istifhâmiyye değil mevsûle olmasına göredir; çünkü bedel istifhâm hemzesiyle birlikte gelmemiştir. İkincisi, ikisinin mahzûf bir «هو»nun haberi olarak ref' mahallinde olması. Bu ikisini bazı i'rabcılar câiz görmüştür. Bu ikisine göre «لا» zâidedir. İbnü'ş-Şecerî şöyle demiştir: Doğrusu, birinciye göre nâfiye, ikinciye göre zâide olmasıdır.
Üçüncüsü, aslın «بيّن لكم ذلك لئلا تشركوا» (Şirk koşmayasınız diye bunu size açıkladı) olmasıdır. Çünkü onların reisleri, Allah Sübhânehû ve Teâlâ'nın helâl kıldığı şeyi onlara haram kıldığında, onlar da reislerine itaat ettiklerinde şirk koşmuş olurlar; çünkü Allah'tan başkasını O'nun yerine koymuşlardır. Dördüncüsü, aslın «أوصيكم بأن لا تشركوا» (Size şirk koşmamanızı tavsiye ederim) olmasıdır. Delili, «وبالوالدين إحسانا»nın mânâsının «وأوصيكم بالوالدين» olması ve ayetin sonunda «ذلكم وصّاكم به» ifadesinin bulunmasıdır. Bu iki vecihe göre cümle ve cer harfi hazfedilmiştir. Beşincisi, takdirin, öncekinin delâletiyle «أتل عليكم أن لا تشركوا» olmasıdır. Bu üç vechi Zeccâc câiz görmüştür. Altıncısı, sözün «حرم ربكم»de tamamlanması, sonra «عليكم أن لا تشركوا وأن تحسنوا بالوالدين إحسانا وأن لا تقتلوا ولا تقربوا» ile başlanmasıdır; buna göre «عليكم», «الزموا» (sarılın) mânâsında bir ism-i fiildir. Altı vecihte de «أن» masdariyyedir; son dört vecihte «لا» nâfiyedir. Yedincisi, «أن»nin «أي» mânâsında müfessire, «لا»nın nehiy harfi olması ve fiilin mansûb değil meczûm olmasıdır; sanki şöyle denilmiştir: "Size diyorum ki: O'na hiçbir şeyi ortak koşmayın ve anne babaya iyilik edin." Bu iki vechi İbnü'ş-Şecerî câiz görmüştür.» İbn Hişâm el-Muğnî'nin başka bir yerinde şöyle demiştir:
«Bazılarının «قل تعالوا أتل ما حرم عليكم ربكم أن لا تشركوا به شيئا» hakkında, vakfın «عليكم»den önce olduğu ve «عليكم»in iğrâ (teşvik) olduğu yönündeki sözü ise güzeldir; ayette te'vile muhtaç kılan zâhir bir problemden de kurtarır.» [Mütercim notu: Bu alıntıda ayet kaynakta «ما حرم عليكم ربكم» sırasıyla yazılmıştır; mushaftaki sıra «ما حرم ربكم عليكم»dir.]
Nakli uzun tuttuk; çünkü bu ayet hakkında çok tartışılmıştır. İyice düşün; Allah seni korusun.

* Vocabulary:
(تعال): one of the specific usages that became general; originally it was said by one who was in a high place to one below him, then it became frequent and widened until it became general. It is an imperative verb that always has a fatḥa at its end, and for this reason they accused Abū Firās al-Ḥamdānī of a grammatical error in his saying:
أيا جارتا ما أنصف الدهر بيننا ... تعالي أقاسمك الهموم تعالي
(O my neighbour, Time has not been fair between us; come, let me share my sorrows with you, come.)

* I'rab:
(قُلْ: تَعالَوْا أَتْلُ ما حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ): a new sentence, uttered to command him ﷺ to recite to them what their Lord has forbidden them, as a reality and not a conjecture, as certainty and not guesswork. The clause تعالوا is in the position of the accusative as the content of the saying; it is an imperative verb indeclinable through the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; أتل is an imperfect verb in the jussive because it is the answer to a request, though Ibn Hishām prefers to say that it is the answer of an implied condition; ما is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a direct object; the clause حرم عليكم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e.
"that which He has forbidden". It is also permissible that "ما" be a maṣdar particle, i.e. "recite the forbidding of your Lord"; but a prohibition is not recited; rather it is a maṣdar standing in the place of the direct object.
ربكم is the agent of حرم; and عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حرم or to أتل, on the basis that the matter belongs to the chapter of conflict (tanāzuʿ). (أَلَّا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئاً وَبِالْوالِدَيْنِ إِحْساناً): there are many views on "أن", of which two are preferred. The first is that it is explicative, because what has the meaning of saying, without its letters, precedes it; لا is prohibitive; تشركوا is an imperfect verb jussive by it, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is explicative. The second view is that it is a maṣdar particle, and it and what is within its scope are a badal of «ما حرم»; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تشركوا; شيئا is a direct object, or in the sense of a maṣdar, in which case it is an absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq); and a like of it has been indicated before. بالوالدين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "show kindness to the parents"; and إحسانا is an absolute object of the omitted verb. An important discussion by Ibn Hishām on the i'rab of this verse will come in the section on Benefits. (وَلا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلادَكُمْ مِنْ إِمْلاقٍ نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكُمْ وَإِيَّاهُمْ): the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تقتلوا is an imperfect verb jussive by لا; أولادكم is a direct object; من إملاق is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تقتلوا, i.e. "for the sake of poverty", so من is causal (sababiyya); the object of purpose was not put in the accusative because its condition fails, since الإملاق is a maṣdar that is not of the heart; further discussion of it will come in the section on Rhetoric. نحن is a mubtadaʾ and the clause نرزقكم is the khabar; the clause نحن نرزقكم is resumptive, giving the reason for the prohibition before it; إياهم is conjoined to the pronoun in نرزقكم; and He put those addressed before the pronoun of the children, the reverse of the verse in al-Isrāʾ, for a rhetorical secret that will come in the section on Rhetoric. (وَلا تَقْرَبُوا الْفَواحِشَ ما ظَهَرَ مِنْها وَما بَطَنَ): the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تقربوا is an imperfect verb jussive by لا, and the wāw is the agent; الفواحش is a direct object; ما is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a badal of الفواحش, a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl); the clause ظهر has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; منها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ظهر; and ما بطن is conjoined to ما ظهر. (وَلا تَقْتُلُوا النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ): conjoined to what precedes and included within its scope, to complete the list of prohibitions, which are ten things.
لا is prohibitive; تقتلوا is an imperfect verb jussive by لا; النفس is a direct object; التي is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective; the clause حرم الله has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; إلا is a particle of restriction; and the exception is an emptied one from the most general of circumstances, i.e. "do not kill it in any circumstance except the circumstance of your being linked with the truth", so the باء is the باء of accompaniment, and it with its genitive noun is attached to an omitted ḥāl from the wāw in «تقتلوا». It is also permissible that the emptied exception be from the verb itself, in which case the preposition and its genitive noun are an absolute object, i.e. "except the killing that is linked with the truth", such as retaliation (qawad), the ḥadd for apostasy, and the stoning of a muḥṣan. (ذلِكُمْ وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ): the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive, uttered to point to what precedes; the clause وصاكم is the khabar of ذلكم; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to وصاكم; and لعلكم تعقلون is لعل with its noun and khabar; the clause of hope is a ḥāl clause, i.e. "that you may use your intellects, which restrain your selves and hold them back from committing these prohibited things".

* Rhetoric:
This verse contains marvellous varieties of rhetoric that require length, but it is a length that does not weary, for talk of beauty is long, and the longer it is, the more it improves, like beauty itself: the more you look closely at it, the more the marks of its loveliness increase:
يزيدك وجهه حسنا ... إذا ما زدته نظرا
(His face increases you in beauty whenever you increase your gazing.)

1- Tawhīm (creating a false impression):
The first art in this verse is the art of tawhīm, which was indicated in Sūrat Āl ʿImrān, and we renew our acquaintance with it here and say: it is that the speaker brings a word such that what follows it of speech gives the impression that the speaker intended a corruption of it (taṣḥīf), whereas he intends something else; and that is in His saying: «أن لا تشركوا به شيئا».
For the apparent speech indicates the prohibition of the negation of polytheism, and its entailment is the permitting of polytheism, which is impossible and contrary to the intended meaning. The interpretation that resolves the difficulty is that, among the commands mentioned in the context of the verse and what follows, there are things forbidden to them and things they are commanded to do. Polytheism towards Allah, the killing of the inviolable soul, and the consuming of the orphan's property are among what is forbidden outwardly and inwardly, while giving full measure and weight with equity, justice in speech let alone in deed, fulfilling the covenant, and following the straight path are among the deeds commanded with an obligatory command. Were the speech to come without «لا», it would be cut off, disordered and corrupted in meaning, for the meaning would become: "He has forbidden you polytheism and kindness to parents", which is the opposite of the intended meaning. For this reason the addition came, whose outward appearance gave the impression of corruption of meaning, so that one would resort to the interpretation by which the conjoining of the remaining commands to what precedes is made sound.

2- Taghāyur (variation):
The second art in it is taghāyur, and that is in His saying: «ولا تقتلوا أولادكم من إملاق». Its definition is the variation of two approaches, whether in a single meaning, such that a person praises a thing or blames it, or blames what another has praised, and the reverse, and prefers one thing over another, then returns and makes the less-preferred one the preferred. Among the forms of taghāyur is the variation of meaning through the variation of wording, as in His saying: «ولا تقتلوا أولادكم من إملاق نحن نرزقكم وإياهم», which differs from His saying on this very same subject in (Sūrat) Banī Isrāʾīl: «ولا تقتلوا أولادكم خشية إملاق نحن نرزقهم وإياكم». In the verse of al-Anʿām it was put first for the poor, as His saying «من إملاق» shows; so rhetoric required that the promise to them, I mean the impoverished fathers, of provision that would enrich them come first, and rhetoric required completing the meaning with a promise for the sons after the promise for the fathers, so that the souls might be completely at rest. In Banī Isrāʾīl the address is to the rich, as His saying «خشية إملاق» shows, for none fears poverty but the rich, while the poor man's poverty is already present. So rhetoric required putting first the promise of provision to the sons, so that this precedence might point to the fact that He, glory be to Him, is the One who provides for the sons, in order to remove what the rich imagined, that by spending on the sons they would come to poverty after wealth; then this reassurance was completed by their promise of provision after the promise for their sons. Glory be to the One who spoke this speech!

Taghāyur in Arabic poetry:
The poets have excelled in this meaning, played with it and taken every path with it, and we shall present to you below a selection of what has been completed by taghāyur, where poets praised what is commonly blamed and blamed what deserves praise. The first to allude to this was ʿAntara ibn Shaddād, the ʿAbsī poet and the famous horseman, when he desired to kiss swords because they gleamed like the flash of the mouth of the one who loves them, and he said his two famous verses:
ولقد ذكرتك والرماح نواهل ... منّي وبيض الهند تقطر من دمي
(I remembered you while the spears were drinking from me and the white swords of India were dripping with my blood,)
فوددت تقبيل السيوف لأنها ... لمعت كبارق ثغرك المتبسّم
(and I longed to kiss the swords because they gleamed like the flash of your smiling mouth.)
How lovely is the saying of Abū Firās al-Ḥamdānī, who took another path and said:
مسيء محسن طورا وطورا ... فما أدري عدّوي أم حبيبي
(At one time wrongdoer and at another benefactor; I do not know whether he is my enemy or my beloved.)
يقلّب مقلة ويدير طرفا ... به عرف البريء من المريب
(He turns an eye and rolls a glance by which the innocent is known from the suspect.)
وبعض الظالمين وإن تناهى ... شهيّ الظلم مغتفر الذنوب
(And some wrongdoers, even if they go to extremes, are pleasing in their wrong and their sins are forgiven.)
Al-Buḥturī was fond of this art, and said:
عيّرتني بالشيب من بدآته ... في عذاري بالهجر والاجتناب
(She reproached me for grey hair, from its beginnings at my cheek, with shunning and avoidance.)
لا تريه عارا فما هو بالشيب ولكنه جلاء الشباب
(Do not see it as a disgrace; it is not grey hair, but rather the brightening of youth.) [Translator's note: the source prints this verse as a single run without the hemistich separator]
وبياض البازيّ أصدق حسنا ... إن تأمّلت من سواد الغراب
(And the whiteness of the falcon is truer in beauty, if you ponder, than the blackness of the raven.)
And he said on the same meaning, and did well:
عذلتنا في عشقها أمّ عمرو ... هل سمعتم بالعاذل المعشوق؟
(Umm ʿAmr blamed us for loving her; have you ever heard of a blamer who is beloved?)
ورأت لمّة ألمّ بها الشّيب فريعت من ظلمة في شروق
(She saw a lock of hair that grey had touched, and was alarmed at a darkness amid a dawn.)
ولعمري لولا الأقاحي لأبصر ... ت أنيق الرياض غير أنيق
(By my life, were it not for the white camomile flowers, you would see the lovely meadows as not lovely.)
ومزاج الصهباء بالماء أولى ... بصبوح مستحسن وغبوق
(And mixing the red wine with water is better suited to a morning or evening draught that is deemed good.)
وسواد العيون لو لم يكمّل ... ببياض ما كان بالموموق
(And the blackness of the eyes, were it not completed by whiteness, would not be admired.)
أيّ ليل يبهى بغير نجوم؟ ... وسماء تندى بغير بروق؟
(What night is splendid without stars? And what sky is moist without lightning?)
Al-Buḥturī described the day of parting as short, though people have agreed on its length, where he said:
ولقد تأمّلت الفراق فلم أجد ... يوم الفراق على امرئ بطويل
(I have pondered parting and found the day of parting not long for anyone.)
قصرت مسافته على متزوّر ... منه لدهر هن صبابة وغليل
(Its span is short for one who visits from it, for a time of longing and thirst.) [Translator's note: the second verse is textually obscure in the source]
As for Ibn al-Rūmī, he rose above the earlier and later poets in blaming what people have agreed to praise, and said, satirising the full moon:
لو أراد الأديب أن يهجو البد ... ر رماه بالخطة الشنعاء
(If the man of letters wished to satirise the full moon, he would pelt it with the ugly charge.)
قال: يا بدر أنت تغدر بالسا ... ري وتغري بزائر الحسناء
(He would say: O full moon, you betray the night traveller and expose the visitor of the beauty.)
يعتريك المحاق في كل شهر ... فترى كالقلامة الحجناء
(The waning befalls you every month, and you appear like a curved nail-paring.)
نمش في بياض وجهك يحكي ... كلفا فوق وجنة برصاء
(Freckles in the whiteness of your face resemble blotches on the cheek of a leper.)
لا لأجل المديح بل خيفة الهجر أخذنا جوائز الخلفاء
(Not for the sake of praise but for fear of abandonment have we taken the caliphs' rewards.) [Translator's note: this line, appended in the source without a hemistich separator, appears to be a separate fragment]
And al-Sharīf al-Raḍī satirised the sun, saying:
في خلقة الشمس وأخلاقها ... شتى عيوب ستة تذكر
(In the sun's creation and character are various faults, six of which may be mentioned.)
رمداء عمشاء إذا أصبحت ... عمياء عند الليل لا تبصر
(She is bleary and dim-eyed by morning, and blind at night, unable to see.)
ويغتدي البدر لها كاسفا ... وجرمه من جرمها أصغر
(The full moon goes forth at dawn as an eclipser against her, though its body is smaller than hers.)
حرورها في القيظ لا يتّقى ... ودفؤها في القر مستحقر
(Her scorching heat in summer cannot be warded off, and her warmth in the cold is despised.)
وخلقها خلق الملول الذي ... ينكث للعهد ولا يبصر
(Her nature is the nature of the weary one who breaks the covenant and does not see.)
ليست بحسناء وما حسن من ... يحسر منه الطرف إذ ينظر
(She is not beautiful, and what beauty is it from which the eye recoils when it looks?)
Were we to expand, we would fill the whole book with this delightful, unique poetry, but it suffices us of the necklace to take what encircles the neck.

3- Al-majāz al-mursal (the unrestricted figurative use):
In His saying, the Exalted: «من إملاق», which runs the course of a metonymy (kināya), because when his wealth leaves his hand poverty rides him, so the word of the cause is used in the place of the effect. It is said in Asās al-Balāgha: "Among the figurative usages: أملق الدهر ماله, 'Time took his wealth away and removed it from his hand'; and أملق الرجل means 'the man spent his wealth until he became poor', and he is a مملق. A Bedouin said: 'May Allah fight women, how they draw out excuses, as if they came out from beneath their feet', i.e. they extract them."

* Benefits:
Ibn Hishām has a lengthy discussion of this verse. He said: "As for His saying, the Exalted:
«قل تعالوا أتل ما حرم ربكم عليكم أن لا تشركوا به شيئا», it was said that لا is negative, it was said prohibitive, and it was said redundant, and all are possible. The sum of the matter in the verse is that «ما» is declarative, in the sense of "that which", in the accusative by «أتل», and «حرم ربكم» is the ṣila, and «عليكم» is attached to حرم. This is the apparent view. Al-Zajjāj allowed «ما» to be interrogative, in the accusative by حرم, with the clause quoted by «أتل», because it has the sense of "I say"; and it is permissible that «عليكم» be attached to «أتل», and whoever prefers giving effect to the first of the two conflicting words, namely the Kufans, prefers it over its being attached to حرّم. Concerning «أن» and what follows it there are several views: first, that the two are in the position of the accusative as a badal of «ما», on the basis that it is relative and not interrogative, since the badal is not accompanied by the interrogative hamza. Second, that the two are in the position of the nominative as the khabar of an omitted «هو»; some of the grammarians allowed these two. On these two, «لا» is redundant; Ibn al-Shajarī said: the correct view is that it is negative on the first and redundant on the second.
Third, that the original is: 'He made that clear to you so that you not associate partners (with Him)'; this is because when their leaders forbid them what Allah, glory be to Him, the Exalted, has made lawful, and they obey them, they commit polytheism, because they have set up other than Allah in His position. Fourth, that the original is: 'I enjoin you not to associate partners', by the proof that «وبالوالدين إحسانا» means 'and I enjoin you regarding the parents', and that at the end of the verse is «ذلكم وصّاكم به'; on these two views the clause and the preposition are omitted. Fifth, that the implied form is: «أتل عليكم أن لا تشركوا», indicated by what precedes. Al-Zajjāj allowed these three views. Sixth, that the speech is complete at «حرم ربكم», then begins «عليكم أن لا تشركوا وأن تحسنوا بالوالدين إحسانا وأن لا تقتلوا ولا تقربوا»; in that case «عليكم» is a verbal noun (ism fiʿl) meaning 'hold fast to'. «أن» in the six views is a maṣdar particle, and «لا» in the last four views is negative. Seventh, that «أن» is explicative, with the meaning of 'أي', and «لا» is prohibitive, and the verb is jussive, not accusative, as if it had been said: 'I say to you: do not associate anything with Him, and show kindness to the parents.' These two views were allowed by Ibn al-Shajarī." Ibn Hishām also said in another place in al-Mughnī:
"As for the saying of some of them regarding «قل تعالوا أتل ما حرم عليكم ربكم أن لا تشركوا به شيئا» that the pause is before «عليكم», and that «عليكم» is an incitement (ighrāʾ), it is good, and it escapes an apparent difficulty in the verse that requires interpretation."
We have lengthened the quotation only because much has been said about the verse. So reflect, and Allah protect you.

* Lügat:
(الأشد): «بلغ فلان أشدّه» denir, yani: kuvvetine (erdi); idrak ve bulûğ mânâsındadır. Bu, ömrün on sekiz ile otuz yaş arasıdır. Tekili olmayan bir çoğuldur; ya da çoğul kalıbında gelmiş bir tekildir. el-Kâmûs'tan özetlenen budur.
Başkası şöyle demiştir: «"الأشدّ" hakkında, lafız ve mânâ bakımından müfred bir isim olduğu söylenmiştir. İsm-i cem' olduğu da söylenmiştir; buna göre tekili «نعمة» gibi «شدّة», ya da «كلب» gibi «شَدّ», ya da «ضُرّ» gibi «شُدّ»dur; tekili hakkında üç görüş vardır.» Onun hakkında şöyle de denebilir: O, gençlik ve yaş kuvvetinin sağlamlaşması, öyle ki gençlikte erkeklik sınırına kadar varmasıdır.
(الْكَيْلَ): Kendisiyle ölçülen alettir; aslı alete ad olarak verilmiş bir masdardır.
(الْمِيزانَ): Aslı «الوزن»den «مفعال» veznindedir. İ'lâli Bakara sûresinde «ميقات» kelimesinde geçmiştir [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta burada tekrar «من الوزن» ibaresi yer almaktadır; «ميقات» «الوقت» kökündendir.]; aslı alete nakledilmiş bir masdardır. Kendisiyle aydınlanılan ve ölçülen şey için «المصباح» ve «المقياس» de böyledir.

* İ'rab:
(وَلا تَقْرَبُوا مالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُ): Vâv atıf harfidir. (لا): nehiy harfi. (تقربوا): «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiil; vâv fâil. (مال اليتيم): onun mef'ûlü. (إلا): hasr edatı. (بالتي): ism-i mevsûl mahzûf bir masdarın sıfatıdır; câr ve mecrûr «تقربوا»ya müteallik; yani: «إلا بالخصلة التي هي أحسن» (ancak en güzel olan hasletle). (هي): mübtedâ; (أحسن): haberi; isim cümlesi sıla olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. Bu hususta son derece dikkatli olunması ve en güzelinin yapılması gerektiğine dikkat çekmek için ism-i tafdîl kalıbını getirmiştir. (حتى): gâye ve cer harfi. (يبلغ): «حتى»dan sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiil; câr ve mecrûr «تقربوا»ya müteallik. (أشده): mef'ûlün bih.
(وَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزانَ بِالْقِسْطِ): Cümle ma'tûftur. (أوفوا الكيل): fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bih. (الميزان): «الكيل»e ma'tûf mef'ûlün bih. Câr ve mecrûr (بالقسط), «أوفوا»nun fâilinden mahzûf bir hâle müteallik, yani: adaletli ve hakkaniyetli olarak. Mef'ûlün bihten hâl olması da câizdir, yani: tam olarak.
(لا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْساً إِلَّا وُسْعَها): Cümle, birbirine atfedilen iki şey arasında i'tirâziyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; ölçek ve tartı işinin ve bunlarda adalete riayetin incelik ve hevâya karşı mücadele gerektirdiğine dikkat çekmek içindir. (لا): nâfiye. (نكلف): merfû muzâri fiil. (نفسا): mef'ûlün bih. (إلا): hasr edatı. (وسعها): ikinci mef'ûlün bih. Sanki: "Gücünüzün ve takatinizin yettiği her şeyi yapın" denilmiştir.
(وَإِذا قُلْتُمْ فَاعْدِلُوا وَلَوْ كانَ ذا قُرْبى وَبِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ أَوْفُوا): Vâv atıf harfidir. (إذا): şart bildiren zarf. «قلتم» cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir. Fâ râbıtadır. (اعدلوا): nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiil. Vâv hâliyyedir. (لو): cezmetmeyen şart. (كان): nâkıs mâzî fiil; ismi müstetir zamir; (ذا قربى) haberi. (بعهد الله): câr ve mecrûr; «أوفوا»ya müteallik. (أوفوا): nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiil.
(ذلِكُمْ وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ): Benzerinin i'rabı geçmiştir.
(وَأَنَّ هذا صِراطِي مُسْتَقِيماً فَاتَّبِعُوهُ): Öncekine ma'tûftur. «أن» ve ismi; (صراطي) haberi. (مستقيما): «صراطي»den te'kîd eden hâl; hâlde âmil işaret mânâsıdır. Fâ, fasîha fâsıdır. (اتبعوه): emir fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlü; cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. Mânâ şudur: Eğer kurtuluşu ve bid'atlerin uçurumlarından, sapıklıkların düşüş yerlerinden selâmeti istiyorsanız. (اتبعوه): emir fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bih; cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. [Mütercim notu: Bu son cümle kaynakta tekrar edilmiştir.]
(وَلا تَتَّبِعُوا السُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ): Vâv atıf harfidir. (لا): nehiy harfi. (تتبعوا): «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiil; vâv fâil. (السبل): mef'ûlün bih. (فتفرّق): fâ sebebiyye fâsıdır; (تفرق), aslı «تتفرق» olan, nehyin cevabında fâdan sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir. (بكم): câr ve mecrûr; «تفرق»a müteallik. (عن سبيله): câr ve mecrûr; mahzûf bir hâle müteallik, yani: O'nun yolundan uzaklaşmış olarak.
(ذلِكُمْ وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ): İ'rabı geçmiştir.

* Vocabulary:
(الأشد): one says «بلغ فلان أشدّه», i.e. he reached his full strength, in the sense of maturity and puberty. It is the age between eighteen and thirty. It is a plural with no singular, or a singular that came on the pattern of a plural. This is the gist of what is in al-Qāmūs.
Someone else said: «It is said that الأشدّ is a noun singular in form and meaning. It is also said that it is a collective noun (ism jamʿ); on this view its singular is شدّة, like نعمة, or شدّ like كلب, or شدّ like ضرّ — three opinions about its singular.» It may also be said of it: it is the firm establishment of the strength of youth and age until one reaches, at the end of youth, the stage of grown men.
(الْكَيْلَ)
It is the instrument with which one measures; originally it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) applied to the instrument.
(الْمِيزانَ)
Originally on the pattern مفعال, from الوزن; its phonological change (iʿlāl) was discussed under ميقات in al-Baqara. From الوزن, so it is originally a maṣdar transferred to the instrument. Similar are المصباح and المقياس, for that by which one obtains light and that by which one measures.

* I'rab:
(وَلا تَقْرَبُوا مالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُ)
The و is a conjunction, لا is prohibitive, and تقربوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; the و is the fāʿil (agent), and مال اليتيم is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and بالتي: the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to تقربوا, i.e. "except with the manner that is best". هي is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and أحسن its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The form of the elative (ism al-tafḍīl) is used to draw attention to the fact that one should take the utmost care in this and do what is best. حتى is a particle of limit and of the genitive, and يبلغ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تقربوا, and أشده is a direct object. (وَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزانَ بِالْقِسْطِ)
The clause is conjoined. أوفوا الكيل is a verb, agent and direct object; الميزان is a direct object conjoined to الكيل; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of أوفوا, i.e. "being equitable and just"; it may also be a ḥāl of the direct object, i.e. "complete". (لا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْساً إِلَّا وُسْعَها)
The clause is parenthetical between the two conjoined clauses and has no grammatical position; it serves to draw attention to the fact that the matter of measure and weight and observing justice in them requires precision and struggle against desire. لا is negating, نكلف is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), نفسا is a direct object, إلا is a particle of restriction, and وسعها is a second direct object; as if it were said: "Do all that is within your capacity and power." (وَإِذا قُلْتُمْ فَاعْدِلُوا وَلَوْ كانَ ذا قُرْبى وَبِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ أَوْفُوا)
The و is a conjunction, إذا is conditional and adverbial, and the clause قلتم is in the position of the genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi (by annexation). The ف is connective (rābiṭa), and اعدلوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the ن. The و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), لو is a non-jussive conditional particle, كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, and ذا قربى is its khabar. بعهد الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوفوا, and أوفوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the ن. (ذلِكُمْ وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ)
The i'rab of its parallel has already been given. (وَأَنَّ هذا صِراطِي مُسْتَقِيماً فَاتَّبِعُوهُ) It is conjoined to what preceded. أنّ and its noun; صراطي is its khabar, and مستقيما is an emphatic ḥāl of صراطي, the governing agent in it being the sense of the demonstrative. The ف is the faṣīḥa ف, and اتبعوه is an imperative verb, its agent and its object; the clause has no grammatical position. The meaning is: if you want success and salvation from the pits of innovations and the falls of error. اتبعوه is an imperative verb, agent and direct object, and the clause has no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source repeats this last sentence.] (وَلا تَتَّبِعُوا السُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ) The و is a conjunction, لا is prohibitive, and تتبعوا is an imperfect verb, jussive by لا; the و is the agent and السبل is a direct object. فتفرّق: the ف is causative (al-sababiyya), and تفرق — originally تتفرق — is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the ف in answer to the prohibition. بكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تفرق, and عن سبيله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "far removed from His path". (ذلِكُمْ وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ) Its i'rab has already been given.

* Lügat:
(دِراسَتِهِمْ): «درس العلم» (ilmi okudu) fiilinin masdarıdır; «قتل» bâbındandır; «درسا» da denir. Burada kastedilen mânâ budur. Bu maddenin şaşırtıcı mânâları vardır: «درس الحنطة دراسا»: Buğdayı harmanda dövdü. «درس الناقة»: Dişi deveyi alıştırdı ve uysallaştırdı. «رجل مدرّس». «درس الكتاب»: Ezberlemek için kitabın okunuşunu tekrarladı; masdarı «درسا» ve «دراسة». «درس المرأة»: Kadınla cinsî münasebette bulundu. «درست المرأة»: Kadın hayız gördü. «درس الثوب»: Elbise eskidi; o hâlde «درس» ve «دريس»tir. «بسط دريسا», yani eskimiş bir elbise ve yaygı serdi. Nu'mân b. el-Münzir'in meclisinde bir adam bir adamı öldürdü; Nu'mân onun öldürülmesini emretti. Adam: "Hükümdar komşusunu öldürür ve himayesindekini zayi eder mi?" dedi. Nu'mân: "Evet, eğer o, meclis arkadaşını öldürür ve onun 'derîs'ini (yaygısını) boyarsa" dedi; yani yaygısını. «طريق مدروس»: İnsanların üzerinde çokça yürüdüğü, onu düzleştirdikleri yol. «ربع دارس ومدروس»: İzleri silinmiş yurt. Görüyorsun ki bu madde, bütün mânâlarıyla alıştırma, uysallaştırma ve düzleştirme mânâsına işaret etmektedir; bu, son derece ince bir husustur.
(صَدَفَ): Yüz çevirdi. Çoğunlukla lâzım olarak kullanılır; burada da lâzım olarak kullanılmıştır. el-Kâmûs'ta şöyle der: «صدف عنه»: Ondan yüz çevirdi; bâbı «ضرب» veya «جلس»tir. «صدف فلانا»: Onu çevirdi; «أصدفه» gibi. Buradan, «صدفة» kelimesini «المصادفة» (tesadüf) mânâsında kullanmanın hata olduğu ortaya çıkar.

* İ'rab:
(ثُمَّ آتَيْنا مُوسَى الْكِتابَ تَماماً عَلَى الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ وَتَفْصِيلًا لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ): «ثم»de asıl olan, zamanda mühlet ve gecikme ile birlikte tertip için olmasıdır. Bu sebeple müfessirler ve nahivciler burada onunla yapılan atfın hakikati hususunda duraksamışlardır. Ben onların söylediklerinde ikna edici bir şey bulamadım. Önce onların söylediklerini nakledeceğim, sonra daha tercihe şayan olana işaret edeceğim. Bazıları şöyle demiştir: «ثمّ» haber vermede tertip için gelir; sanki bu sözü söyleyen, Mûsâ'nın (a.s.) zamanca önce olması hususundan kaçınmak istemiştir. Ahfeş, «ثم»nin bazen gecikme (terâhî) mânâsından ayrılabileceğini ileri sürmüştür; delili şu sözündür: «أعجبني ما صنعت اليوم ثم ما صنعت أمس أعجب» (Bugün yaptığın hoşuma gitti; dün yaptığın ise daha da hoş). Çünkü burada «ثم» haber vermenin tertibi içindir; iki haber verme arasında gecikme yoktur. İbn Mâlik de Allah Teâlâ'nın «ثم آتينا موسى الكتاب» kavlini bundan saymıştır. el-Muğnî'de şöyle der: «Zâhir olan, «ثمّ»nin fânın yerinde vâki olmasıdır.» Nahivciler, «ثم»nin fânın yerine konduğunu açıkça belirtmişlerdir; Ebû Duâd Câriye b. el-Haccâc'ın şu sözü gibi:
كهزّ الرّدينيّ تحت العجاج ... جرى في الأنابيب ثم اضطرب
(Toz bulutu altında Rudeynî mızrağının sallanması gibi; titreme boğumlarında aktı, sonra çalkalandı.)
Zeccâc şöyle demiştir: Bu, «أتل»e ma'tûftur; takdiri: «أتل ما حرّم ثم أتل ما آتينا» (Haram kılınanı okuyayım, sonra verdiğimizi okuyayım).
Zemahşerî şöyle demiştir: «Eğer: "«ثم آتينا موسى الكتاب» sözü neye atfedilmiştir?" dersen, derim ki: «وصّاكم به»e. Eğer: "Verme (kitabın verilmesi), tavsiyeden uzun bir zaman önce olduğu hâlde, onun «ثم» ile ona atfı nasıl sahih olur?" dersen, derim ki: Bu tavsiye eskidir; her ümmet onu peygamberlerinin diliyle tavsiye olunagelmiştir. Sanki şöyle denilmiştir: Ey Âdemoğulları! Size eskiden de şimdi de bunu tavsiye ettik; sonra bundan daha büyüğü, Mûsâ'ya Kitabı vermemizdir.» Belki bu, bu hususta söylenebileceklerin en yakın olanıdır. [Mütercim notu: Zemahşerî alıntısının kapanış tırnağı kaynakta bulunmamaktadır; son cümlenin Derviş'e mi Zemahşerî'ye mi ait olduğu belirsizdir.]
(آتينا موسى الكتاب): fiil, fâil ve iki mef'ûlü. (تماما): mef'ûlün lieclih, yani: nimetin ve ikramın tamamlanması için. Mef'ûl-i mutlak olarak mansûb bir masdar olması da câizdir; çünkü «آتيناه إيتاء تمام لا نقصان» (Ona eksik değil tam bir veriş verdik) mânâsındadır. Ya da «آتينا»nın fâilinden hâl olarak mansûb bir masdardır, yani: tamamlayıcılar olarak; ya da «الكتاب»tan, yani: tam olduğu hâlde. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «ماما» şeklinde yazım hatası vardır; «تاما» kastedilmiştir.] (على الذي): câr ve mecrûr; «تماما»ya müteallik, yani: Onu en güzel şekilde yerine getiren kimse üzerine. «أحسن» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli olmayan sıladır. (تفصيلا): «تماما»ya ma'tûf. (لكل شيء): câr ve mecrûr; «تفصيلا»ya müteallik.
(وَهُدىً وَرَحْمَةً لَعَلَّهُمْ بِلِقاءِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ): (هدى ورحمة): «تماما» ve «تفصيلا»ya ma'tûf. «لعل» ve ismi; ümit cümlesi hâliyyedir. (بلقاء ربهم): câr ve mecrûr; «يؤمنون»a müteallik. «يؤمنون» cümlesi «لعل»in haberidir.
(وَهذا كِتابٌ أَنْزَلْناهُ مُبارَكٌ فَاتَّبِعُوهُ وَاتَّقُوا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; cümle, Kur'an'ın şanını yüceltmek için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye cümledir. (هذا): mübtedâ; (كتاب): haberi. «أنزلناه» cümlesi birinci sıfat; (مبارك) ikinci sıfat. (فاتبعوه): fâ, fasîha fâsıdır; yani: Onun bereketinden faydalanmak istiyorsanız; dolayısıyla kendisinden sonrakini öncekine tertip etmek içindir. (اتبعوه): fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bih. Cümle, cezmetmeyen şartın cevabı olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. (اتقوا): «فاتبعوه»ya ma'tûf. Ümit cümlesi hâliyyedir.
(أَنْ تَقُولُوا إِنَّما أُنْزِلَ الْكِتابُ عَلى طائِفَتَيْنِ مِنْ قَبْلِنا): «أن» ve alanındakiler, bir muzâfın hazfi üzere mef'ûlün lieclih olan masdar te'vilindedir, yani: «كراهية أن تقولوا» (demenizi hoş görmediği için). (إنما): kâffe ve mekfûfe. (أنزل): meçhul binâ edilmiş mâzî fiil. (الكتاب): nâib-i fâil. (على طائفتين): câr ve mecrûr; «أنزل»e müteallik; bu ikisinden maksat Yahudiler ve Hıristiyanlardır. Cümle mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir. (من قبلنا): câr ve mecrûr; «طائفتين»in mahzûf sıfatına müteallik.
(وَإِنْ كُنَّا عَنْ دِراسَتِهِمْ لَغافِلِينَ): Vâv hâliyyedir. (إن): ağır olandan hafifletilmiş ve amelden düşmüş (mühmel) «إن»dir; incelemesi daha önce geçmiştir. «كان» ve ismi; (عن دراستهم) câr ve mecrûr, «غافلين»e müteallik. Lâm, muhaffefe «إن» ile nâfiye «إن»yi birbirinden ayıran (fârika) lâmdır. (غافلين): «كنا»nın haberi.
(أَوْ تَقُولُوا لَوْ أَنَّا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْكِتابُ لَكُنَّا أَهْدى مِنْهُمْ): «أن تقولوا»ya ma'tûftur. (لو): şartiyye. «أن» ve ismi; «أنزل علينا الكتاب» cümlesi onun haberi. (الكتاب): nâib-i fâil. (علينا): câr ve mecrûr; «أنزل»e müteallik. Lâm, «لو»nun cevabında gelen lâmdır. «كان» ve ismi; (أهدى) haberi. (منهم): câr ve mecrûr; «أهدى»ya müteallik.
(فَقَدْ جاءَكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَهُدىً وَرَحْمَةٌ): Fâ, fasîha fâsıdır; çünkü kendisiyle ta'lîl edilen mahzûf bir şeyin cevabıdır; yani: Özür beyan etmeyin; çünkü özür sebepleri sizin için ortadan kalkmıştır. (فقد جاءكم): (قد) tahkîk harfi; (جاءكم) fiil ve mukaddem mef'ûlün bih; (بينة) fâil. Mahzûfun bir şart olması da câizdir; yani: Kendinizi oyaladığınız sahte vaadler ve uçarı hayaller hususunda doğru söylüyorsanız. (من ربكم): câr ve mecrûr; «بينة»nin mahzûf sıfatına veya «جاءكم»e müteallik. (هدى ورحمة): «بينة»ye ma'tûf. Her iki vecih de güzel ve uygundur.
(فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَّبَ بِآياتِ اللَّهِ وَصَدَفَ عَنْها): Fâ, kendisinden sonrakini öncekine tertip etmek için atıf harfidir; çünkü Kur'an'ın, hidayet ve rahmetin bütün etkenlerini kapsayarak inmesi, onu yalanlayan ve ondan yüz çevirenin insanların en zalimi olmasını gerektirir. (من): nefiy mânâsını içeren istifhâmiyye, yani: hiç kimse; mübtedâ olarak ref' mahallinde. (أظلم): haber. (ممن): câr ve mecrûr; «أظلم»e müteallik. «كذب» cümlesi sıla. (بآيات الله): câr ve mecrûr; «كذّب»e müteallik. (صدف عنها): «كذب»e ma'tûf.
(سَنَجْزِي الَّذِينَ يَصْدِفُونَ عَنْ آياتِنا سُوءَ الْعَذابِ): Cümle, bu inatçı tutuma terettüp eden cezayı takrir için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye cümledir. (نجزي): muzâri fiil; fâili müstetir. (الذين): mef'ûlü. «يصدفون» cümlesi sıla. (سوء العذاب): «نجزي»nin ikinci mef'ûlün bihi olarak ya da nez'u'l-hâfıd ile mansûbdur. «السوء»un «العذاب»a izâfesi, sıfatın mevsûfuna izâfesi kabîlindendir, yani: «العذاب السيّء» (kötü azap).
(بِما كانُوا يَصْدِفُونَ): Bâ cer harfi; (ما) masdariyye olup kendisinden sonrasıyla birlikte bâ ile mecrûr bir masdar te'vilindedir; câr ve mecrûr «نجزي»ye müteallik. «كان» ve ismi; «يصدفون» cümlesi onun haberidir; yani: yüz çevirmeleri ve sırt dönmeleri sebebiyle.

* Vocabulary:
(دِراسَتِهِمْ): the maṣdar (verbal noun) of «درس العلم» (he studied knowledge), of the pattern قتل, also درسا; this is the meaning intended here. This root has remarkable meanings. One says «درس الحنطة دراسا»: he threshed the wheat. «درس الناقة»: he broke in the she-camel and tamed her. «رجل مدرّس», and «درس الكتاب» for memorisation: he repeated its reading, درسا and دراسة. «درس المرأة»: he had intercourse with the woman. «درست المرأة»: the woman menstruated. «درس الثوب»: the garment wore out, so it is درس and دريس. «بسط دريسا», i.e. he spread a worn-out garment or carpet. A man killed another man in the assembly of al-Nuʿmān ibn al-Mundhir, and he ordered him to be killed. The man said: «أيقتل الملك جاره؟ ويضيع ذماره؟» (Will the king kill his protégé and neglect what he is bound to protect?) He said: «نعم إذا قتل جليسه، وخضب دريسه» (Yes, if he killed his companion and stained his carpet with blood),
i.e. his carpet. «طريق مدروس»: a road on which people have walked much until they have made it smooth.
And «ربع دارس ومدروس» (an effaced encampment). So you see that it points to the meaning of training, subduing and smoothing in all its senses, and this is of great subtlety.
(صَدَفَ): he turned away. It is mostly used intransitively, and here it is used intransitively. In al-Qāmūs: «صدف عنه»: he turned away from him, of the pattern ضرب or جلس; and «صدف فلانا»: he turned him away, like أصدفه. From this the error of using صدفة in the sense of المصادفة (chance encounter) becomes clear.

* I'rab:
(ثُمَّ آتَيْنا مُوسَى الْكِتابَ تَماماً عَلَى الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ وَتَفْصِيلًا لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ) The basic function of ثم is sequence with delay and an interval of time; hence the exegetes and grammarians hesitated over the real nature of the conjunction by it here, and I have not found in what they said anything convincing. I will first relate what they said, then indicate what is more deserving of preference. Some said that «ثمّ» comes for sequence in the reporting, as if this speaker wanted to avoid Moses, peace be upon him, being earlier in time. Al-Akhfash claimed that «ثم» may lack the sense of interval, as evidenced by your saying: «أعجبني ما صنعت اليوم ثم ما صنعت أمس أعجب» (What you did today pleased me; then what you did yesterday is more pleasing), because «ثم» in that is for the sequence of the reporting and there is no interval between the two reports. Ibn Mālik counted among this His saying the Exalted: «ثم آتينا موسى الكتاب». In al-Mughnī he said: «The apparent view is that «ثمّ» occurs in place of the ف». The grammarians have stated explicitly that «ثم» is put in place of the ف, as in the saying of Abū Duwād Jāriya ibn al-Ḥajjāj:
كهزّ الرّدينيّ تحت العجاج ... جرى في الأنابيب ثم اضطرب
(Like the shaking of a Rudaynī lance beneath the dust: it ran through the joints, then quivered.)
Al-Zajjāj said: it is conjoined to «أتل», the implied form being: «Recite what He has forbidden, then recite what We gave.»
Al-Zamakhsharī said: «If you say: to what is His saying «ثم آتينا موسى الكتاب» conjoined? I say: to «وصّاكم به». If you say: how is it valid to conjoin it to it with «ثم» when the giving was a long time before the enjoining? I say: this enjoining is ancient; every nation has continued to be enjoined with it on the tongue of its prophet. So it is as if it were said: That is what We enjoined upon you, O children of Adam, of old and recently; then, greater than that, We gave Moses the Book.» Perhaps this is the closest thing that can be said about it. [Translator's note: the source does not close the quotation mark of al-Zamakhsharī's passage; it is unclear whether the preceding sentence belongs to him or to the author.] آتينا موسى الكتاب is a verb, agent and its two objects. تماما is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. for the sake of completing the favour and honour; it may also be a maṣdar in the accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it means "We gave it to him with a complete giving, without deficiency"; or a maṣdar in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of آتينا, i.e. "completing", or of الكتاب, i.e. "while it is complete" [Translator's note: the source has «ماما», evidently a misprint for «تماما»]. على الذي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «تماما», i.e. upon whoever carried it out well; the clause أحسن is a ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. تفصيلا is conjoined to «تماما», and لكل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «تفصيلا». (وَهُدىً وَرَحْمَةً لَعَلَّهُمْ بِلِقاءِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ) هدى and رحمة are conjoined to تماما and تفصيلا. لعل and its noun; the clause of hope is circumstantial; بلقاء ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤمنون, and the clause يؤمنون is the khabar (predicate) of لعل. (وَهذا كِتابٌ أَنْزَلْناهُ مُبارَكٌ فَاتَّبِعُوهُ وَاتَّقُوا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ) The و is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, set forth to magnify the status of the Qur'an. هذا is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and كتاب its khabar; the clause أنزلناه is a first adjective (ṣifa) and مبارك a second adjective. فاتبعوه: the ف is the faṣīḥa ف, i.e. "if you want to benefit from its blessing"; it serves to make what follows it consequent upon what precedes it. اتبعوه is a verb, agent and direct object, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. اتقوا is conjoined to فاتبعوه, and the clause of hope is circumstantial. (أَنْ تَقُولُوا إِنَّما أُنْزِلَ الْكِتابُ عَلى طائِفَتَيْنِ مِنْ قَبْلِنا) أن and what falls in its scope are to be interpreted as a maṣdar that is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "out of dislike that you should say". إنما is a restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); أنزل is a passive past verb, الكتاب is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and على طائفتين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل — the Jews and the Christians are meant by them. The clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). من قبلنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of طائفتين. (وَإِنْ كُنَّا عَنْ دِراسَتِهِمْ لَغافِلِينَ) The و is circumstantial, and إن is lightened from the heavy (inna), and it is inoperative (muhmala); its discussion has already been given. كان and its noun; عن دراستهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to غافلين; the لام is the distinguishing lām between the lightened إن and the negating إن, and غافلين is the khabar of كنا. (أَوْ تَقُولُوا لَوْ أَنَّا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْكِتابُ لَكُنَّا أَهْدى مِنْهُمْ) Conjoined to أن تقولوا. لو is conditional, أنّ and its noun; the clause أنزل علينا الكتاب is its khabar; الكتاب is the deputy agent, and علينا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل. The لام occurs in the apodosis of لو; كان and its noun, أهدى is its khabar, and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أهدى. (فَقَدْ جاءَكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَهُدىً وَرَحْمَةٌ) The ف is the faṣīḥa ف, because it is the answer to an omitted [statement] that it gives the reason for, i.e. "Do not make excuses, for the grounds for excuse have escaped you." فقد جاءكم: قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq), and جاءكم is a verb and a direct object placed before [the agent], and بينة is the agent. The omitted element may also be a condition, i.e. "if you are truthful in the false promises and wild dreams with which you beguile yourselves". من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of بينة, or to جاءكم; هدى and رحمة are conjoined to بينة. Both views are fine and acceptable. (فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَّبَ بِآياتِ اللَّهِ وَصَدَفَ عَنْها) The ف is a conjunction making what follows it consequent upon what precedes it, for the revelation of the Qur'an — containing all the factors of guidance and mercy — requires that whoever denies it and turns his face away from it be the most unjust of people. من is interrogative, containing the sense of negation, i.e. "no one"; it is in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ, and أظلم is the khabar. ممن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أظلم; the clause كذب is the ṣila of the relative noun; بآيات الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كذّب; and صدف عنها is conjoined to كذب. (سَنَجْزِي الَّذِينَ يَصْدِفُونَ عَنْ آياتِنا سُوءَ الْعَذابِ) The clause is resumptive, set forth to establish the recompense resulting from this obstinate stance. نجزي is an imperfect verb, its agent latent (mustatir), and الذين is its object; the clause يصدفون is the ṣila of the relative noun. سوء العذاب is accusative as a second direct object of نجزي, or accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). The annexation of السوء to العذاب is an annexation of the adjective to the qualified noun, i.e. "the evil punishment". (بِما كانُوا يَصْدِفُونَ) The ب is a preposition, and ما is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows as a maṣdar in the genitive by the ب; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نجزي. كان and its noun, and the clause يصدفون is its khabar, i.e. "because of their turning away and aversion".

* İ'rab:
(هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْمَلائِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِيَ رَبُّكَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَ بَعْضُ آياتِ رَبِّكَ): Cümle, onlardan imanın gelmesinin uzak görüldüğünü ifade etmek için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye cümledir. (هل): nefiy mânâsını içeren istifhâm harfi; çünkü onlar bunu bekleyenler konumundaydılar. (ينظرون): merfû muzâri fiil; vâv fâil. (إلا): hasr edatı. (أن تأتيهم الملائكة): müevvel masdar, müferrağ müstesnâdır; dolayısıyla mef'ûlün bih olarak nasb mahallindedir. (أو): atıf harfi. (يأتي ربك): «تأتيهم الملائكة»ya ma'tûf. (أو يأتي بعض آيات ربك): bu da ma'tûftur. Mânâ şudur: Onlar, kendilerine kıyameti haber vermek üzere Rabbinin bütün ayetlerinin veya bir kısmının gelmesini beklemektedirler.
(يَوْمَ يَأْتِي بَعْضُ آياتِ رَبِّكَ لا يَنْفَعُ نَفْساً إِيمانُها لَمْ تَكُنْ آمَنَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ أَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِي إِيمانِها خَيْراً): Zarf, «لا ينفع» sözüne mütealliktir. «يأتي بعض آيات ربك» cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir. (لا): nâfiye. (ينفع نفسا إيمانها): fiil, mef'ûlün bih ve fâil. «لم تكن آمنت» cümlesi «نفسا»nın sıfatıdır; mevsûf ile sıfatı arasında fasıla câiz olmuştur; çünkü fâil yabancı değildir. Cümlenin isti'nâfiyye veya hâliyye olması da câizdir. (من قبل): câr ve mecrûr; mahzûf bir hâle müteallik. «آمنت» cümlesi «تكن»in haberidir. (أو): atıf harfi. (كسبت): «آمنت»e ma'tûf. (خيرا): mef'ûlün bih.
(قُلِ انْتَظِرُوا إِنَّا مُنْتَظِرُونَ): Cümle, onları tehdit için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye cümledir. «انتظروا» cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir. Buradaki emir tehdit içindir. Beklenen mef'ûlün bih, korkutmayı ve dehşeti artırmak için hazfedilmiştir; sanki o, tahmin ve kestirme sınırlarına girmekten daha büyüktür; nefis de bilinmeyenden daha çok korkar. (إنا منتظرون): «إن», ismi ve haberi. Bu cümle de isti'nâfiyyedir; onların beklemesini benzeriyle karşılamak için sevk edilmiştir.

* Belâgat:
Ayette leff vardır; leff ve neşrden daha önce söz edilmiştir. Sözün aslı şudur: Rabbinin ayetlerinden bazısının geldiği gün, daha önce mü'min olmayan bir nefse sonraki imanı fayda vermez; imanında hayır kazanmamış bir nefse de sonra kazanacağı hayır fayda vermez. Ancak belâgati ve i'cazı tercih ederek iki sözü birbirine sarmış (leff) ve onları tek bir söz yapmıştır. Arkasından neşr getirmemiştir; çünkü sonuç birdir ve her ikisi için de bilinmektedir.

* Lügat:
(النسك): «ن» harfi üç harekeyle (fetha, damme, kesre) ve «س» sükûnla; ayrıca «ن» ve «س» dammeli olarak (نُسُك) okunur. Bunun gibi النّسوك, النّسكة ve المنسكة da aynı anlamdadır: zühd, ibadet ve dünya nimetlerinden el çekmek. الناسك: zâhid âbid; çoğulu نسّاك gelir. Ebü'l-Alâ şöyle demiştir:
صم ثمّ صلّ وطف بمكّة زائرا ... سبعين لا سبعا فلست بناسك
جهل الديانة من إذا عرضت له ... أطماعه لم يلف بالمتماسك
(Oruç tut, sonra namaz kıl, Mekke'yi ziyaret edip yedi değil yetmiş kez tavaf et; yine de nâsik [gerçek âbid] değilsin. Hırsları karşısına çıktığında kendini tutamayan kimse dindarlığı bilmemiştir.)
(خَلائِفَ الْأَرْضِ): İzâfet «في» manasınadır. الخلائف, خليفة'nin çoğuludur; صحيفة – صحائف gibi. Bu, şu sözün kapsamına girer:
والمدّ زيد ثالثا في الواحد ... همزا يرى في مثل كالقلائذ
(Tekilde üçüncü harf olarak ziyade edilen med harfi, [çoğulda] «القلائد» örneğinde olduğu gibi hemze olarak görülür.) [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «كالقلائذ» diye yazılmıştır; doğrusu «كالقلائد» olmalıdır.]
Halîfe'nin zikri daha önce Bakara sûresinde geçmişti.

* İ'rab:
(قُلْ: إِنَّ صَلاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيايَ وَمَماتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ): İsti'nâfiyye bir cümledir; asıl (usûl) ve fer'î şer'î hükümleri yerine getirmeyi te'kîd etmek için getirilmiştir. «إن» ve sonrasından oluşan cümle mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir. «إن» ve ismi; «نسكي», «محياي» ve «مماتي» ma'tûftur. Mütekellim yâsına muzâf olan [ismin] hükmü Fevâid bölümünde gelecektir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «المنادى المضاف» (mütekellim yâsına muzâf münâdâ) yazılmıştır; Fevâid bölümünde ele alınan konu ise genel olarak mütekellim yâsına muzâf isimdir.] «لله»: câr ve mecrûr; mahzûf habere müteallik. «رب»: sıfat. «العالمين»: muzâfun ileyh; cemi müzekker sâlime mülhak olduğu için. Bu, Fâtiha'da geçmişti.
(لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ): «لا»: cinsini nefyeden lâ. «شريك»: onun ismi. «له»: câr ve mecrûr; onun mahzûf haberine müteallik. Cümle «رب العالمين»den hâldir veya onun sıfatıdır. Vâv atıf harfi; «بذلك»: câr ve mecrûr; «أمرت»e müteallik. «وأنا»: vâv yine atıf harfi; «أنا» mübtedâ, «أول المسلمين» onun haberi.
(قُلْ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْغِي رَبًّا): Cümle isti'nâfiyyedir; bu kâfirler ona "Dinimize ve ilahlarımıza ibadete dön" dediklerinde onların davetine bir reddiye olmak üzere getirilmiştir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «لتكون بدا» yazılmıştır; bağlama göre «لتكون ردا» (reddiye olsun diye) kastedildiği anlaşılıyor.] Hemze, nefy manasını içeren istifhâm içindir; yani: "Ondan başka bir Rab aramam." «غير الله»: mukaddem mef'ûlün bih. «ربا»: temyîz; hâl olarak i'rab edilmesi de caizdir.
(وَهُوَ رَبُّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ): Vâv hâliyyedir. «هو» mübtedâ, «رب كل شيء» onun haberi. Cümle hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir.
(وَلا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ إِلَّا عَلَيْها): Vâv atıf harfi; «لا» nefy harfi; «تكسب كل نفس»: fiil, fâil ve muzâfun ileyh. «إلا»: hasr edatı. «عليها»: câr ve mecrûr; mahzûf hâle müteallik; yani: "Ancak günahı, ona zarar verip fayda vermeyecek şekilde üzerine binmiş olduğu hâlde."
(وَلا تَزِرُ وازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرى): Vâv yine atıf harfi; «لا» yine nefy harfi. «تزر وازرة»: muzâri fiil ve fâil. «وزر»: mef'ûlün bih. «أخرى»: muzâfun ileyh.
(ثُمَّ إِلى رَبِّكُمْ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِما كُنْتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ): «ثم» atıf harfi. «إلى ربكم»: câr ve mecrûr; mahzûf mukaddem habere müteallik. «مرجعكم»: muahhar mübtedâ. Fâ atıf harfi. «ينبئكم»: muzâri fiil, müstetir fâil ve mef'ûlün bih. Bâ, sebebiyet için cer harfi; «ما» bâ ile cer mahallinde ism-i mevsûl; câr ve mecrûr ikinci mef'ûl yerindedir. «كنتم» cümlesi sıladır; kâne ve ismi. «فيه»: câr ve mecrûr; «تختلفون»a müteallik. «تختلفون» cümlesi «كنتم»in haberidir.
(وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلائِفَ الْأَرْضِ): Vâv atıf harfi; «هو» mübtedâ, «الذي» onun haberi. «جعلكم» cümlesi sıladır. «خلائف الأرض»: «جعلكم»in ikinci mef'ûlün bihi.
(وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَكُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجاتٍ): Vâv atıf harfi; «رفع» mâzî fiil; «بعضكم» mef'ûlün bih; «فوق بعض» mekân zarfı, «رفع»e müteallik; «درجات» zarftır. Bunun i'rabı ve hakkındaki görüşler daha önce geçmişti.
(لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِي ما آتاكُمْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ سَرِيعُ الْعِقابِ وَإِنَّهُ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ): Lâm ta'lîl içindir. «يبلوكم»: lâmdan sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiil. Câr ve mecrûr «رفع»e müteallik. «فيما»: câr ve mecrûr; «يبلوكم»a müteallik. «آتاكم» cümlesi sıla olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. «إن» ve ismi; «سريع العقاب» onun haberi; cümle ta'lîl için isti'nâfiyyedir. «وإنه لغفور رحيم» öncekine ma'tûftur. Bunun i'rabı defalarca geçmişti.

* Belâgat:
«ورفع بعضكم فوق بعض درجات» sözünde şeref ve fazilet hakkında kinâye vardır. Bu farklılık, aralarında eşitlik sağlamaktan acizlikten doğmuş değildir; bilakis imtihan ve deneme içindir.

* Fevâid:
Mütekellim yâsına muzâf isim:
Mütekellim yâsına muzâf olan ismin sonunu, yâya uygunluk için kesreli yapmak vaciptir; yâyı fethalı ve sükûnlu okumak caizdir. Bundan maksûr, menkûs, tesniye ve cemi müzekker sâlim istisna edilir; bu dördünün sonu sükûnlu olmak zorundadır ve bunlarla birlikte yâ fethalı olmak zorundadır. el-Hulâsa'da (Elfiyye) şöyle der:
آخر ما يضاف للياء اكسر إذا ... لم يك معتلا كرام وقذى
أو يك كابنين وزيدين ففي ... جميعها اليا بعد فتحها احتذي
(Yâya muzâf olanın sonunu kesreli yap; eğer «رام» ve «قذى» gibi illetli değilse veya «ابنين» ve «زيدين» gibi değilse; bunların hepsinde yânın fethalı olması örnek alınır.)
Elif'ten sonra onun [yânın] sükûnla okunması nadirdir.
Ebü'l-Alâ el-Maarrî'ye bir hücum:
Nâfi', «محياي ومماتي» kısmını vasıl hâlinde «محياي»nin yâsını sükûnlu olarak okumuştur; tıpkı elif'ten sonra onun kesreli okunmasının nadir olması gibi. A'meş ve Hasan-ı Basrî «هي عصاي»yi, iki sâkinin buluşmasındaki asıl üzere yâyı kesreli okumuşlardır. Kesre, Yerbû'oğulları lehçesinde cemi müzekker sâlimin muzâf olduğu yâda yaygındır (muttarid); Hamza ve A'meş'in «وما أنتم بمصرخيّ» kıraati de yâyı kesreli okumakla buna göredir. Böylece Maarrî'nin risalesinde söylediği şu söz düşmüş olur: "Arapça ehli, Hamza'nın kıraatini hoş görmemekte ittifak etmiştir." İbn Hişâm ona reddiye vermiş ve şöyle demiştir: "Maarrî'nin İslâm'a dil uzatmak gibi bir kastı vardır. Belki de [yâyı] kesreli okuyanların lehçesi izâfet yâsını sâkin okumak üzeredir; dolayısıyla onlarda iki sâkin buluşmuştur." Murâdî de Şerhu't-Teshîl'de şöyle demiştir: "Maarrî risalesinde söylediğinde yalnız değildir; İbn Hişâm'ın söylediği, her ne kadar Maarrî ilhadla itham edilmişse de, ona karşı bir haksızlıktır." [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «لم بنفرد» yazılmıştır; «لم ينفرد» olarak anlaşılmıştır.]

Ebü'l-Alâ ile nahivciler arasında:
Ebü'l-Alâ ile nahivciler arasında alevlenen bu çekişmeye değinmeyi faydalı görüyoruz. Ebü'l-Alâ bir nahivciydi, fakat nahivci olmak istememişti. Nahiv imamlarından bir imamdı, ama nahvin üslubu onu memnun etmemişti. Bu yüzden onları acı bir şekilde eleştirdi, imamları Sîbeveyh ile alay etti ve risalelerinin çeşitli yerlerinde onu eleştiri ve hatalı bulmaya maruz bıraktı; bunlara kitabımızda yer ayırmak mümkün olmadığından işaret etmekle yetindik. Bu çekişmeden daha fazlası bu kitapta ileride gelecektir.

* Vocabulary:
(النسك): with the ن taking any of the three vowels and the س vowelless, and with ḍamma on both the ن and the س; likewise النّسوك, النّسكة and المنسكة: asceticism, devotion and austerity. الناسك is the ascetic worshipper; its plural is نسّاك. Abū al-ʿAlāʾ said:
صم ثمّ صلّ وطف بمكّة زائرا ... سبعين لا سبعا فلست بناسك
جهل الديانة من إذا عرضت له ... أطماعه لم يلف بالمتماسك
(Fast, then pray, and circle [the House] at Mecca as a visitor seventy times, not seven — still you are no ascetic. He is ignorant of religion who, when his cravings present themselves to him, is not found to hold firm.)
(خَلائِفَ الْأَرْضِ): the annexation is in the sense of «في» (in). الخلائف is the plural of خليفة, like صحيفة and صحائف, so it falls under the saying [of Ibn Mālik]:
والمدّ زيد ثالثا في الواحد ... همزا يرى في مثل كالقلائذ
(The long vowel added as the third letter in the singular is seen as a hamza [in the plural], as in القلائد.) [Translator's note: the source prints «كالقلائذ» with ذ, evidently for «كالقلائد».]
Mention of الخليفة has already been made in al-Baqara.

* I'rab:
(قُلْ: إِنَّ صَلاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيايَ وَمَماتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ) A resumption set forth to emphasise carrying out the fundamental and subsidiary laws. The clause إنّ and what follows it is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). إنّ and its noun; نسكي, محياي and مماتي are conjoined. The rule of the vocative annexed to the yāʾ of the first person will come in the Benefits section [Translator's note: so in the source, «المنادى المضاف»; the Benefits section actually discusses the noun annexed to the yāʾ of the first person in general, not the vocative specifically]. لله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate); رب is an adjective, and العالمين is a muḍāf ilayhi because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; this was discussed in al-Fātiḥa. (لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ) The lā of generic negation; شريك is its noun, and له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of رب العالمين or an adjective of it. The و is a conjunction, and بذلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أمرت. وأنا: the و is also a conjunction, أنا is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and أول المسلمين is its khabar. (قُلْ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْغِي رَبًّا) The clause is resumptive, set forth to be a [rejoinder] to the invitation of these unbelievers when they said to him: "Return to our religion and the worship of our gods." [Translator's note: the source has «بدا», evidently a misprint for «ردا» (a rejoinder).] The hamza is for interrogation containing the sense of negation, i.e. "I do not seek a lord other than Him". غير الله is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and ربا is a tamyīz (specification); it may also be parsed as a ḥāl. (وَهُوَ رَبُّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ) The و is circumstantial; هو is a mubtadaʾ and رب كل شيء its khabar; the clause is accusative as a ḥāl. (وَلا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ إِلَّا عَلَيْها) The و is a conjunction, لا is negating, and تكسب كل نفس is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and muḍāf ilayhi. إلا is a particle of restriction, and عليها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "except in the state of its sin being over it, with what harms it and does not benefit it". (وَلا تَزِرُ وازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرى) The و is also a conjunction and لا is also negating; تزر وازرة is an imperfect verb and agent, وزر is a direct object, and أخرى is a muḍāf ilayhi. (ثُمَّ إِلى رَبِّكُمْ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِما كُنْتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ) ثم is a conjunction; إلى ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar placed first, and مرجعكم is a mubtadaʾ placed after it. The ف is a conjunction; ينبئكم is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a direct object. The ب is a preposition of cause, and ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the ب; the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of the second object. The clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; كان and its noun; فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تختلفون, and the clause تختلفون is the khabar of كنتم. (وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلائِفَ الْأَرْضِ) The و is a conjunction, هو is a mubtadaʾ and الذي its khabar; the clause جعلكم is the ṣila, and خلائف الأرض is a second direct object of جعلكم. (وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَكُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجاتٍ) The و is a conjunction, رفع is a past verb, بعضكم is a direct object, فوق بعض is an adverb of place attached to رفع, and درجات is an adverb; its i'rab and the discussion of it have already been given. (لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِي ما آتاكُمْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ سَرِيعُ الْعِقابِ وَإِنَّهُ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ) The لام is causal, and يبلوكم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the لام; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to رفع. فيما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يبلوكم, and the clause آتاكم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun. إنّ and its noun, and سريع العقاب is its khabar; the clause is resumptive, giving the reason. وإنه لغفور رحيم is conjoined to what preceded; the i'rab of that has been given many times.

* Rhetoric:
In His saying «ورفع بعضكم فوق بعض درجات» there is kināya (metonymy) for nobility and merit. This disparity does not arise from inability to make them equal, but is for trial and testing.

* Benefits:
The noun annexed to the yāʾ of the first person:
The last letter of a noun annexed to the yāʾ of the first person must take kasra to suit the yāʾ, and the yāʾ may take fatḥa or be vowelless. Excepted from this are the maqṣūr noun (ending in alif), the manqūṣ noun (ending in yāʾ), the dual and the sound masculine plural: in these four the last letter must be vowelless and the yāʾ with them must take fatḥa. He said in al-Khulāṣa:
آخر ما يضاف للياء اكسر إذا ... لم يك معتلا كرام وقذى
أو يك كابنين وزيدين ففي ... جميعها اليا بعد فتحها احتذي
(Put kasra on the end of what is annexed to the yāʾ, unless it is weak-ended like رام and قذى, or is like ابنين and زيدين; in all of these the yāʾ follows with fatḥa.)
Its being vowelless after the alif is rare.
An attack on Abū al-ʿAlāʾ al-Maʿarrī:
Nāfiʿ read محياي ومماتي, in continuous recitation, with the yāʾ of «محياي» vowelless, just as its taking kasra after the alif is rare: al-Aʿmash and al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī read «هي عصاي» with kasra on the yāʾ, according to the basic rule for the meeting of two vowelless letters. The kasra is regular in the dialect of Banū Yarbūʿ in the yāʾ to which a sound masculine plural is annexed, and on this is the reading of Ḥamza and al-Aʿmash: «وما أنتم بمصرخيّ» with kasra on the yāʾ. Thereby what al-Maʿarrī said in his Epistle falls away: «The masters of Arabic have agreed in disliking the reading of Ḥamza.» Ibn Hishām refuted him and said: «Al-Maʿarrī had an aim of attacking Islam; perhaps those who read with kasra, their dialect has the yāʾ of annexation vowelless, so two vowelless letters met for them.» Al-Murādī said in Sharḥ al-Tashīl: «Al-Maʿarrī was not alone in what he said in his Epistle; what Ibn Hishām said is unfair to him, even though he was accused of heresy.»

Between Abū al-ʿAlāʾ and the grammarians:
We consider it useful to present this dispute that broke out between Abū al-ʿAlāʾ and the grammarians. Abū al-ʿAlāʾ was a grammarian, but he did not want to be a grammarian. He was one of the leading authorities of grammar, but the method of grammar did not satisfy him, so he criticised them bitterly, mocked their leader Sībawayh, and attacked him with criticism and charges of error in places in his epistles, for which there is no room in our book, so we have sufficed with a reference. More of this dispute will come in this book.

﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive-making particle. ﴿تَكُنْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم. ﴿فِتْنَتُهُمْ﴾ its noun (ism), nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming (verbal-noun) and accusative-making particle. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of تكن: "except their saying". The clause تكن is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهِ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is a genitive (majrūr) noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb "I swear" (أقسم), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿رَبِّنا﴾ a badal (substitute) of الله, genitive, and نا is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما كُنَّا﴾ ما is negating. كان is an incomplete past verb, نا is its noun, and ﴿مُشْرِكِينَ﴾ is its khabar, accusative (manṣūb) with yāʾ; the clause ما كنا مشركين is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position.

﴿انْظُرْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿كَذَبُوا عَلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb انظر. The clause انظر is resumptive. ﴿وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ما كانُوا﴾ ضل is a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the relative noun ما is its fāʿil; the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. It is also permissible to parse ما as maṣdar-forming, it and the verb after it being interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of ضل, i.e. "their fabrication strayed from them".

﴿وَمِنْهُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun على قلوبهم are attached if جعلنا means "We let down"; or they are attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) if جعلنا is one of the verbs of transformation that take two objects, i.e. "We made coverings cast upon their hearts". ﴿أَنْ يَفْقَهُوهُ﴾ أن is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-making particle; ﴿يَفْقَهُوهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ is its object.
The interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive by a preposition: "so that they do not understand it" (لئلا يفقهوه). It is also said that the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of aversion to their understanding it", with a muḍāf omitted. The clause ﴿وَجَعَلْنا عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ is conjoined to the nominal clause before it, and the implied clause ﴿جعلنا فِي آذانِهِمْ وَقْراً﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; ﴿أَنْ﴾ a jussive-making conditional particle [Translator's note: the source writes «أن» here, while the word in the verse is «إن»]. ﴿يَرَوْا كُلَّ﴾ the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and كل is its object, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿آيَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُوا بِها﴾ the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; لا is negating, with no grammatical position, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined with fāʾ. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional, non-jussive. ﴿جاؤُكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يُجادِلُونَكَ﴾ the verbal clause made up of the imperfect verb, the fāʿil and the mafʿūl bihi is likewise in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿يَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ الذين is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of the verb before it, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; the clause كفروا is the ṣila. ﴿إِنْ هذا﴾ إن is negating, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَساطِيرُ﴾ the khabar. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with yāʾ. The nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; هم is a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ﴾ is its khabar (predicate), and the clause ﴿وَيَنْأَوْنَ عَنْهُ﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is negating. ﴿يُهْلِكُونَ إِلَّا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined, and ما is negating.

﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿تَرى﴾ an imperfect verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it. ﴿وُقِفُوا عَلَى النَّارِ﴾ a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). The apodosis of لو is omitted, i.e. "you would have seen a tremendous thing on that day". ﴿فَقالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا لَيْتَنا﴾ the yāʾ is for the vocative, the one addressed being omitted, or it is for drawing attention (tanbīh); ليت is a particle resembling the verb, and نا is its noun. ﴿نُرَدُّ﴾ a passive imperfect verb whose nāʾib fāʿil is "we" (نحن), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ليت. ﴿وَلا نُكَذِّبَ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of accompaniment (maʿiyya), لا is negating, نكذب is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the wāw of accompaniment, and the fāʿil is "we". ﴿بِآياتِ﴾ attached to نكذب. ﴿رَبِّنا﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The interpreted maṣdar from the implied أن and the verb after it is conjoined to an implied maṣdar, the implied form being: "Would that there were for us a return and a not-denying". ﴿وَنَكُونَ﴾ conjoined to نرد. ﴿مِنَ﴾ a preposition. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a genitive (majrūr) noun with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of the incomplete verb ﴿نكن﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the verse is «نكون»], whose noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we".

﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿بَدا لَهُمْ ما﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the relative noun ما is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined by the conjunction بل. ﴿كانُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يُخْفُونَ مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ قبل is an adverb of time, indeclinable on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation, in the position of the genitive by من; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يخفون, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. ﴿وَلَوْ رُدُّوا﴾ ردوا is a passive past verb, the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is resumptive, after the resumptive wāw. The clause ﴿لَعادُوا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لِما﴾ ما is a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عادوا. ﴿نُهُوا عَنْهُ﴾ a passive past verb whose nāʾib fāʿil is latent [Translator's note: so in the source], and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نهوا; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكاذِبُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إنّ, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction which conjoins the clause وقالوا to the clause ﴿لَعادُوا﴾ or to ﴿نُهُوا عَنْهُ﴾. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating, meaning ما, with no governing effect. ﴿هِيَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿حَياتُنَا﴾ the khabar (predicate). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the clause إن هي إلا حياتنا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ما is the Ḥijāzī ما, which governs as ليس does. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of the nominative as its noun. ﴿بِمَبْعُوثِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; مبعوثين is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of ما; the nominal clause is conjoined to the nominal clause before it.

﴿وَلَوْ تَرى إِذْ وُقِفُوا عَلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of verse 27. ﴿أَلَيْسَ هذا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation; ليس is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the demonstrative is in the position of the nominative as its noun. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; الحق is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar (predicate) of ليس; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بَلى﴾ a particle of answer. ﴿وَرَبِّنا﴾ the wāw is a particle of the genitive and of oath; ربنا is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of oath "we swear" (نقسم). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَذُوقُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition): "since you have been asked and have confessed, then taste the punishment". ذوقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾ its object. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdar-forming. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان, and the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿تَكْفُرُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as its khabar; ما and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "because of your disbelief".

﴿قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا﴾ الذين is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent), and the clause كذبوا is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِلِقاءِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ an inceptive particle. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional. ﴿جاءَتْهُمُ السَّاعَةُ﴾ a past verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا حَسْرَتَنا﴾ يا is a vocative particle; حسرة is the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf) and accusative, and نا is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿عَلى ما فَرَّطْنا فِيها﴾ فرطنا is a past verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to حسرة: "O our regret over our neglect in it". ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the verbal clause ﴿يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزارَهُمْ عَلى ظُهُورِهِمْ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿ساءَ﴾ a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun explained by what follows it, and ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as tamyīz (specification), i.e. "evil is their deed as a burden they act upon", and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa). It is also possible that ﴿ساءَ ما يَزِرُونَ﴾ is an inflecting verb, with ما a relative noun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; or ما is maṣdar-forming, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar in the position of the nominative as fāʿil: "evil is their bearing [of burdens]"; or on the assumption of an omitted object: "their bearing [of burdens] grieves them" (ساء هم وزرهم).

﴿وَمَا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; ما is negating, with no governing effect. ﴿الْحَياةُ﴾ the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لَعِبٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَلَهْوٌ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلَلدَّارُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), the lām is for inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), الدار is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْآخِرَةُ﴾ an adjective. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ the khabar. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) khayr [Translator's note: the source says «متعلقان بخبر», "attached to a khabar"], and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَفَلا تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive, لا is negating, and the clause تعقلون is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
