(Babasına «Tâlib» denir; uğursuzluk olarak size şu yeter: Ölüm de bir «tâlib»dir (arayıp bulandır).)
Rasûlullah (s.a.v.) uğursuzluk saymayı (tıyere) hoş görmez ve şöyle buyururdu: «Uğursuzluk sezdiğinizde yolunuza devam edin ve Allah'a tevekkül edin.»
- مهما: Bazı nahivciler onun harf olduğuna Züheyr b. Ebî Sülmâ'nın şu sözüyle istidlal etmişlerdir:
ومهما تكن عند امرئ من خليقة ... وإن خالها تخفى على الناس تعلم
(Bir kişide hangi huy bulunursa, insanlardan gizli kalacağını sansa bile, bilinir.)
Bu beyitte «مهما»nın i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. Bazı muhakkikler ise bu beyitte مهما'nın ref' mahallinde mübtedâ olduğu görüşüne gitmişlerdir; tercihe şayan olan da budur.
İbn Mâlik ise ما ve مهما'nın zaman zarfı olarak geldiğini zikretmiş ve şöyle demiştir:
وقد أتت مهما وما ظرفين في ... شواهد من يعتضد بها كفى
(مهما ve ما bazı şahitlerde iki zarf olarak gelmiştir; onlarla destek arayana bu yeter.)
Âlimlerin, başta Zemahşerî olmak üzere, ona reddiyeleri vardır; kitabın akışından çıkmamak için bunlara dalmayı uygun görmüyoruz.

* Lügat:
(المص): Sûrelerin başlangıçları (fevâtihu's-süver) hakkındaki söz Bakara sûresinde ayrıntılı olarak geçmişti. Şimdi buna Suyûtî'nin rivayetlerinden birinde naklettiğini ekliyoruz. Bunun özü şudur: Bu harfler, vahyin Hz. Peygamber'e (s.a.v.) ilk indiği sıradaki sesidir. Dikkat çekmede meşhur olan «ألا» ve «أما» gibi kelimelerin kullanılmamasının sebebi, bunların insanların konuşmalarında bildikleri lafızlardan olmasıdır. Kur'an ise sözlere benzemeyen bir sözdür; dolayısıyla onda bilinmeyen dikkat çekme lafızlarının getirilmesi uygun düşmüştür ki kulakları çarpmada daha etkili olsun. Yine şunu da zikretmiştir: Araplar Kur'an'ı dinlediklerinde onun hakkında boş sözler (lağv) söylüyorlardı; Allah da şaşırsınlar diye bu eşsiz nazmı indirdi; onların ona hayranlığı kendilerini meylettirmenin bir yolu, onu dinlemeleri de sonrasını dinlemenin bir yolu olsun; böylece kalpler incelsin, gönüller yumuşasın. Suyûtî'nin naklettiği bu görüşte pek çok isabet ve ince bir bakış vardır; zira nefis hayret uyandırana daha çok sevinç duyar, alışılmamış, beklenmedik şeye daha çok iştiyak duyar.

* İ'rab:
(المص كِتابٌ أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ فَلا يَكُنْ فِي صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌ مِنْهُ): المص: Sûre başlangıçlarının i'rabı Bakara sûresinde geçmişti; ona dönerek hatırını tazele. «كتاب»: mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberi; yani: «هو كتاب». «أنزل إليك» cümlesi «كتاب»ın sıfatıdır. «إليك»: câr ve mecrûr; «أنزل»e müteallik. Fâ, mübalağayı te'kîd için atıf harfidir; nehiy «الجرح»den yani buradaki şüphe ve tereddütten nehiydir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «الجرح» yazılmıştır; bağlama göre «الحرج» kastedilmiştir.] Sebepten nehiy, burhânî yoldan müsebbebten nehiydir; kastedilen, onu sıkıntıya sokacak şeyden nehyedilmesidir. «لا»: nehiy lâsı. «يكن»: «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiil. «في صدرك»: câr ve mecrûr; «يكن»in mukaddem olan mahzûf haberine müteallik. «حرج»: onun muahhar ismi. «منه»: câr ve mecrûr; «حرج»in mahzûf sıfatına müteallik; buradaki cer harfi «من» sebebiyet içindir.
(لِتُنْذِرَ بِهِ وَذِكْرى لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ): Lâm ta'lîl içindir. «تنذر»: ta'lîl lâmından sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiil; câr ve mecrûr «أنزل»e müteallik. «به»: câr ve mecrûr; «تنذر»e müteallik. «ذكرى»: «لتنذر»a ma'tûf olma ihtimali vardır. Onun mef'ûlün lieclih olarak mansûb olması mümkün değildir; çünkü zamanı ta'lîl edilen fiilin zamanından farklıdır ve fâil de farklıdır: İndirmenin fâili Allah, uyarmanın fâili ise Peygamber'dir. Onun «لتنذر»ın mahalline atfedilmesi de caizdir; sarih hâlin müevvel hâle atfedilmesi gibi; Allah Teâlâ'nın «... دعانا لجنبه أو قاعدا أو قائما» kavlinde olduğu gibi. «ذكرى»nin, mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberi olarak veya «كتاب»a atfedilerek merfû olması da caizdir. Ebü'l-Bekâ yanılarak onun hâl olmasını caiz görmüştür; bu caiz değildir, çünkü vâv sarih bir hâlin başına gelmiştir. Onun, takdîrî «أن» ile fiilden oluşan müevvel masdara atfedilerek mecrûr olması da caizdir; takdir: «للإنزال والتذكير» (indirmek ve hatırlatmak için).
Kûfeliler ise şöyle demiştir: O, «به»deki zamire atfedilerek mecrûrdur. «للمؤمنين»: câr ve mecrûr; «ذكرى»nin mahzûf sıfatına müteallik.
(اتَّبِعُوا ما أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ): İsti'nâfiyye bir sözdür; genel olarak mükelleflere, özellikle de kâfirlere hitap için getirilmiştir; delili «ولا تتبعوا من دونه أولياء» kavlidir. «اتبعوا»: nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiil; vâv fâil. «ما»: mef'ûlün bih olarak nasb mahallinde ism-i mevsûl. «أنزل» cümlesi sıladır. «إليكم»: câr ve mecrûr; «أنزل»e müteallik. «من ربكم»: câr ve mecrûr; mevsûlden mahzûf hâle müteallik.
(وَلا تَتَّبِعُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِياءَ قَلِيلًا ما تَذَكَّرُونَ): Vâv atıf harfi; «لا» nehiy lâsı. «تتبعوا»: «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiil. «من دونه»: câr ve mecrûr; «تتبعوا»ya müteallik, ya da mahzûf hâle müteallik; çünkü aslında «أولياء»nın sıfatı idi ve öne geçmiştir. «أولياء»: mef'ûlün bih. «قليلا»: mahzûf bir masdarın sıfatı, yani «تذكرا قليلا» (az bir düşünüş); ya da bir zamanın sıfatı, yani «زمانا قليلا» (az bir zaman). «ما»: azlık için te'kîdde ileri gitmek (îğâl) üzere zâidedir. «تذكرون»: aslı «تتذكرون»dur; iki tâsından biri hazfedilmiş muzâri fiildir; ref' alâmeti nûnun sabit olmasıdır; vâv fâildir.

* Lügat:
(الصَّاغِرِينَ): الصّغار, «ص» fethalı olarak: zillet ve haksızlığa uğramak. «صغر الرجل» «طرب» babındandır; o hâlde «صاغر»dır. الصاغر aynı zamanda haksızlığa razı olan kimsedir.
(أَنْظِرْنِي): Beni ertele (mühlet ver).

* İ'rab:
(قالَ فَاهْبِطْ مِنْها فَما يَكُونُ لَكَ أَنْ تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيها): Kavl cümlesi isti'nâfiyyedir. «فاهبط»: fâ, emri İblis'ten zâhir olan muhalefete terettüp ettirmek için atıf harfidir. «فما»: fâ yine atıf harfidir; «ما» da nefy harfidir. «يكون»: tam muzâri fiildir; çünkü «ينبغي» (yakışır) veya «يصح» (sahih olur) manasını tazammun etmiştir. «لك»: câr ve mecrûr; «يكون»e müteallik; çünkü «يصح» manasını tazammun etmiştir. «أن», girdiği [fiil] ile birlikte masdar te'vilinde olup «يكون»in fâilidir. «فيها»: câr ve mecrûr; mahzûf hâle müteallik.
(فَاخْرُجْ إِنَّكَ مِنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ): Fâ, inme emrini te'kîd için atıf harfidir. «إن» ve ismi; «من الصاغرين»: câr ve mecrûr; onun mahzûf haberine müteallik. «إن» ve kapsamındaki cümle hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir; yani: "Zelil ve hor olarak."
(قالَ أَنْظِرْنِي إِلى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ): Kavl cümlesi isti'nâfiyyedir. «أنظرني» cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir. «إلى يوم»: câr ve mecrûr; «أنظرني»ye müteallik. «يبعثون» cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir; bu yüzden zarf, daha önce geçtiği üzere mu'reb bir cümleye muzâf olduğu için mu'reb olmuştur. «يبعثون»: meçhul muzâri fiil; vâv nâib-i fâil.
(قالَ إِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ): «إنك من المنظرين» cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir.
(قالَ فَبِما أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِراطَكَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ): Cümle yine isti'nâfiyyedir. Fâ atıf harfi; bâ sebebiyet için cer harfi; «ما» masdariyye. Câr ve mecrûr mahzûf kasem fiiline müteallik. Câr ve mecrûrun «أقعدن»e müteallik olması caiz değildir; çünkü kasem lâmı buna engel olur; «والله لأمرن بزيد» demeyiz. Mana: "Senin beni azdırman sebebiyle yemin ederim." Bânın kasem için olması da caizdir; yani: "Beni azdırmana yemin ederim ki mutlaka oturacağım." O, mecrûruyla birlikte mahzûf [kasem] fiiline müteallik olur. Lâm, mahzûf kasemin cevabında vaki olan lâmdır. «أقعدن»: ağır te'kîd nûnuna bitişik olduğu için fetha üzere mebnî muzâri fiil. «لهم»: câr ve mecrûr; «أقعدن»e müteallik. «صراطك»: mekân zarfı olarak mansûbdur; i'rabı hakkında daha fazlası Fevâid bölümünde gelecektir. «المستقيم»: sıfat.

* Fevâid:
Sîbeveyh kitabında şöyle der: «صراطك»in nasbı zarfiyyet üzeredir; yani:
«في صراطك المستقيم». Sîbeveyh ayrıca «ضرب زيد الظهر والبطن» (Zeyd sırta ve karna vuruldu) sözünü nakletmiştir.
Ebû Hayyân ise onun nez'u'l-hâfıd ile mansûb olmasını tercih etmiştir.

Ebû Hayyân'ın ibaresi:
"«صراطك», «على»nın düşürülmesiyle mansûb olmuştur; bunu Zeccâc söylemiştir ve onu Arapların «ضرب زيد الظهر والبطن» sözüne, yani «على الظهر والبطن» (sırtın ve karnın üzerine) manasına benzetmiştir.
Bunun gibi [yerlerde] cer harfinin düşürülmesi kıyasa tabi değildir; «على الخشبة» (tahtanın üzerine) kastederek «قعدت الخشبة» denmez. [Bazıları] zarf olarak [mansûbdur] dediler; şairin bu konuda söylediği «كما عسل الطريق الثعلب» sözünde olduğu gibi. Bu da zayıflık bulunan bir izahtır; çünkü «صراطك» muhtas (belirli) bir mekân zarfıdır; «الطريق» da öyledir. Dolayısıyla fiil ona ancak «في» vasıtasıyla müteaddî olur; bunun aksine gelen şâzdır veya şiir zaruretidir." Şunu söylemeye kadar devam eder:
"Daha uygun olanı, «لأقعدنّ»e kendiliğinden müteaddî olan bir fiilin manasının içirilmesidir; böylece «الصراط» mef'ûlün bih olarak mansûb olur. Takdir: «لألزمن بقعودي صراطك المستقيم» (oturmamla senin dosdoğru yoluna mutlaka sımsıkı yapışacağım)."

Zemahşerî Sîbeveyh'e muvafakat etmiştir:
Zemahşerî ise Sîbeveyh'e muvafakat ederek şöyle demiştir: "Onun nasbı zarf olmak üzeredir; Sâide b. Cüeyye'nin bir mızrağı vasfederken söylediği şu söz gibi:
لدن بهز الكفّ يعسل متنه ... فيه كما عسل الطريق الثعلب
(Avucun sallamasıyla yumuşacıktır, gövdesi onda titrer; tıpkı tilkinin yolda koşarken titreyip salınması gibi.)"
Onu, sallanması sebebiyle sert kısmının titrediği, hiç kuruluk bulunmayan yumuşak bir mızrak olarak vasfediyor; tıpkı tilkinin yolda «عسل» etmesi, yani salınıp titremesi gibi. İkincisinden [الطريق'ten] cer harfi şiir zaruretiyle hazfedilmiştir.
«عسل» fiilinde hızla girme manası vardır.

* Vocabulary:
(ادَّارَكُوا): i.e. تداركوا, meaning they followed one another into the Fire. Its origin is تداركوا: the tāʾ was turned into a dāl, made quiescent and assimilated into the dāl, and then the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) was brought in. How this happens will be explained in the Benefits section.
(أخراهم وأولاهم): It is possible that [أخرى] is «فُعلى», the feminine of the «أفعل» that denotes comparison (mufāḍala); on this view the meaning is: the last of them in rank — the followers and the lowly — [said] to the first of them in rank — the leaders, the masters and the chiefs. It is also possible that «أخرى» means "last" (آخِرة), the feminine of «آخِر» as opposed to «أوّل», not the feminine of the «آخَر» of comparison; from this usage is His words, the Exalted: «ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى». Perhaps this is the more apparent [meaning] in the verse.
(الضِّعْفِ): Abū ʿUbayda said: الضعف is the like of a thing once. Al-Azharī said: It is as people use it in the course of their speech. In the speech of the Arabs الضعف is the like and more, and it is not restricted to two likes; rather you say: «هذا ضعفه», meaning twice it and three times it, because الضعف originally means an unlimited increase. Do you not see His words, the Exalted: «فأولئك لهم جزاء الضعف»? He did not mean by it one like nor two likes; the most fitting thing is to make it ten times, as in His words, the Exalted: «من جاء بالحسنة فله عشر أمثالها». So the minimum of الضعف is limited, namely one like, and its maximum is unlimited. In al-Qāmūs: «ضِعف of a thing, with kasra, is its like, and its two ضعف are its two likes; الضعف is the like and more. One says: لك ضعفه, meaning twice it and three times it, because it is an unlimited increase».
(يَلِجَ): In al-Miṣbāḥ: «ولج الشيء في غيره يلج, of the pattern of وعد, ولوجا [= the thing entered into another]; and أولجته إيلاجا: I made it enter».
(سَمِّ): السم is said with all three vowels on the sīn. In al-Miṣbāḥ: «السم is what kills, mostly with fatḥa; its plural is سموم and سمام, like فليس and فلوس, and also سمام, like سهم and سهام. [Translator's note: so in the source; «فليس» should be «فلس», and «سمام» is repeated.] The ḍamma is the dialect of the people of al-ʿĀliya, and the kasra the dialect of Banū Tamīm ... And السم is the eye of the needle; it has the three dialectal forms, and its plural is سمام». That is what is meant in the verse, but the Seven [readers] read it with fatḥa, and it has been read anomalously (shādhdhan) with kasra and ḍamma. The eye of the needle is proverbial for the narrowness of a passage; one says: «أضيق من خرت الإبرة» (narrower than the eye of a needle). They called the skilled guide خِرّيت, because he finds his way through narrow places likened to the eyes of needles. And the camel is proverbial for great bulk. Ḥassān ibn Thābit said:
لا بأس في القوم من طول ومن عظم ... جسم البغال وأحلام العصافير
(There is no harm in the people as regards height and bulk: the bodies of mules and the minds of sparrows.) That is: no harm or hurt befalls these people from the side of height and thickness.
In it there is mockery of them: their bodies are like the bodies of mules, and their minds like the minds of sparrows — if sparrows have minds; he means that they have no minds.
(غَواشٍ): the plural of غاشية, which is a covering.

* I'rab:
(قالَ ادْخُلُوا فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ فِي النَّارِ) The speech is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), relating what Allah will say to them on the Day of Resurrection. قال is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; the clause ادخلوا is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech); في أمم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. being among the number of nations, in their throng, accompanying them; it has also been said that they are attached to ادخلوا, the meaning being "among the number of nations". The clause قد خلت is a naʿt (adjective) of أمم; من قبلكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second adjective; من الجن والإنس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted third adjective; في النار is a preposition and its genitive noun, a badal (substitute) of His words:
«في أمم». The adverbial expressions (ẓurūf) are figurative, and they will be discussed. Abū Ḥayyān said:
في النار is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «خلت», on the sense that their entry into it came before; or to an omitted adjective of الأمم, i.e. among nations preceding in time, being of the jinn and mankind, being in the Fire. Abū Ḥayyān went on at length in what has no use. (كُلَّما دَخَلَتْ أُمَّةٌ لَعَنَتْ أُخْتَها) كلما is an adverb of time containing the meaning of condition; the clause دخلت أمة is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, or has no grammatical position if we take «ما» as a particle-relative (mawṣūl ḥarfī); the clause لعنت أختها has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussivizing condition, and the adverbial sentence is part of the completion of maqūl al-qawl. (حَتَّى إِذَا ادَّارَكُوا فِيها جَمِيعاً) حتى is a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition, or an inceptive particle; إذا is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, attached to the apodosis, i.e. to قالت that follows; the clause اداركوا is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اداركوا; جميعا is a ḥāl. (قالَتْ أُخْراهُمْ لِأُولاهُمْ) The clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of إذا. In لأولاهم the lām is a preposition of cause, i.e. for their sake, or of communication (tablīgh); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قالت. (رَبَّنا هؤُلاءِ أَضَلُّونا فَآتِهِمْ عَذاباً ضِعْفاً مِنَ النَّارِ) ربنا is a muḍāf vocative (munādā) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause أضلونا its khabar (predicate); the sentence ربنا هؤلاء is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl. فآتهم: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; آتهم is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عذابا is a second mafʿūl bihi; ضعفا is an adjective of «عذابا»; من النار is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second adjective. (قالَ: لِكُلٍّ ضِعْفٌ وَلكِنْ لا تَعْلَمُونَ)
The sentence of saying is resumptive; لكل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ضعف is a delayed mubtadaʾ; the nominal sentence is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying of the Exalted. In ولكن the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive, and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), inoperative (muhmal); لا is negating; تعلمون is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn. (وَقالَتْ أُولاهُمْ لِأُخْراهُمْ فَما كانَ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنا مِنْ فَضْلٍ) Conjoined to what preceded. The fāʾ is a conjunction: it conjoins the speech after it to the words of Allah the Exalted to the lowly ones, "for each is a double", i.e. it has been established that you have no superiority over us. ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of defective كان; من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; فضل is genitive in form and the ism of kāna in position; علينا is a preposition and its genitive noun. That is: we and you are equal in going astray and in deserving the punishment. (فَذُوقُوا الْعَذابَ بِما كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ) The fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, i.e. if it has become clear to you and you know it, and then you persisted in your contrary position, then taste; العذاب is its object; in بما the bāʾ is a causal preposition and ما is maṣdariyya, i.e. because of your earning; the clause تكسبون is the khabar of كنتم. (إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْها لا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمْ أَبْوابُ السَّماءِ) Resumptive speech introduced to confirm the fate of the disbelievers. إنّ and its noun; the clause كذبوا بآياتنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, having no grammatical position; the clause استكبروا is conjoined to the clause كفروا [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the verse is كذبوا]; عنها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to استكبروا; the clause لا تفتح is the khabar of إنّ; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تفتح; أبواب السماء is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (وَلا يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِي سَمِّ الْخِياطِ) This clause is conjoined to the clause لا تفتح لهم; حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition; في سم الخياط is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يلج. (وَكَذلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُجْرِمِينَ) The wāw is resumptive; كذلك is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. a recompense like that; المجرمين is a mafʿūl bihi. (لَهُمْ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ مِهادٌ) The nominal sentence may be circumstantial or resumptive; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; مهاد is a delayed mubtadaʾ; من جهنم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective of جهنم [Translator's note: so in the source; i.e. an adjective of مهاد fronted before it]. (وَمِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ غَواشٍ وَكَذلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ) Conjoined; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar; غواش is a delayed mubtadaʾ, the ḍamma being implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. More will be said about it in the Benefits section.

* Rhetoric:
In His words, the Exalted: «حتى يلج الجمل سم الخياط» there is a rhetorical figure called al-madhhab al-kalāmī (the dialectical method). Ibn al-Muʿtazz says in his book al-Badīʿ that al-Jāḥiẓ gave it this name. They define it as the speaker's arguing for what he wishes to establish with a proof that blunts the weapon of the stubborn opponent and cuts off his evidence, in the manner of the scholars of kalām.
For the science of kalām consists in establishing the principles of religion by rational proofs and decisive demonstrations that refute obstinacy; and of it there is a logical kind, in which correct conclusions are drawn from true premises. In the verse before us, the way the conclusion is drawn from the two premises is to say: the disbelievers will never enter Paradise until the camel passes through the eye of the needle; and the camel will never pass through the eye of the needle; therefore they will never enter Paradise — because making a condition depend on something impossible entails the impossibility of what is conditioned. Much of it will occur in the Noble Qur'an.

The dialectical method in poetry:
This figure has occurred in much Arabic poetry, and they have masterpieces in it. Among them are the words of Abū Tammām:
وإذا أراد الله نشر فضيلة ... طويت أتاح لها لسان حسود
لولا اشتعال النار فيما جاورت ... ما كان يعرف طيب عرف العود
(When Allah wishes to spread a hidden virtue, He provides for it the tongue of an envier; were it not for the fire blazing in what is next to it, the fragrance of aloeswood would not be known.)
The following piece by Bahāʾ al-Dīn Zuhayr is full of varieties of this figure, and we content ourselves with quoting it:
يا من أكابد فيه ما أكابده ... مولاي أصبر حتى يحكم الله
سمّيت غيرك محبوبي مغالطة ... لمعشر فيك قد فاهوا بما فاهوا أقول زيد، وزيد لست أعرفه ... وإنما هو لفظ أنت م
عناه وكم ذكرت مسمّى لا اكتراث به ... حتى يجرّ إلى ذكراك ذ
كراه أتيه فيك على العشاق كلهم ... قد عزّ من أنت يا مولاي
مولاه والناس فينا ببعض القول قد لهجوا ... لو صحّ ما ذكروا ما كنت
آباه كادت عيونهم بالبغض تنطق لي ... حتى كأنّ عيون الناس أفواه
[Translator's note: the line breaks of these verses are disordered in the source and are reproduced as found.]
(O you for whom I endure what I endure, my master, I will be patient until Allah judges. I called someone other than you my beloved, to mislead people who have said what they said about you: I say "Zayd", and Zayd I do not know — it is only a word whose meaning is you. How often I mention someone named for whom I care nothing, until mentioning him leads to mentioning you. I am proud over all lovers because of you: mighty is he whose master you are, my master. People have prattled about us with certain talk; were what they said true, I would not refuse it. Their eyes almost spoke to me with hatred, until it was as if people's eyes were mouths.)
All the reasons mentioned within these verses are genuine, original reasons that the stubborn opponent accepts on hearing them without dispute and without resorting to obstinacy and haughtiness; and that is not hidden from anyone with a grain of taste.

* Benefits:
1- Substitution of the tāʾ:
In ادّكر there are two aspects [Translator's note: so in the source; the word under discussion is ادّاركوا]. The first: the origin is تداركوا, as we mentioned in the Vocabulary section. Whatever has as its first radical a thāʾ, dhāl, dāl, zāy, ṣād, ḍād, ṭāʾ or ẓāʾ, on the pattern تفاعل, تفعّل or تفعلل, such that the tāʾ and one of these letters come together, the tāʾ is replaced by a letter of the same kind as what follows it and assimilated into it, e.g. اثّاقل، ادّكر، ازّيّن، اصّبر، اضّرع، اطّرب، اظّلم [Translator's note: the source prints «اصتبر»], whose origins are تثاقل، تذكّر، تزيّن، تصبّر، تضرّع، تطرّب، تظلّم. The tāʾ was replaced by a letter of the same kind as what follows it, then made quiescent to be assimilated. Beginning with a quiescent letter being impossible, the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) was brought in to escape that.
The second: when the tāʾ of افتعل is changed into a letter homogeneous with what follows it, in stating the pattern one pronounces the original tāʾ of iftiʿāl and not what it has become, ṭāʾ or dāl. So we say the pattern of اصطبر is افتعل, not افطعل, and the pattern of ازدجر is افتعل, not افدعل. Likewise we say here that the pattern of ادّاركوا is اتفاعلوا, not افّاعلوا; there is no difference in this between the tāʾ of iftiʿāl and that of tafāʿul.

2- The defective (manqūṣ) plural on the pattern مفاعل:
The grammarians have two views on a plural on the pattern مفاعل when it is manqūṣ. Some said: it is fully declinable (munṣarif), because the form of the ultimate plural pattern (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ) has left it, so its pattern has become that of جناح; [the cause] has gone, so it is declined. The majority said:
it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf), and the tanwīn is a tanwīn of compensation (ʿiwaḍ); this was discussed before.
They differed over what it compensates for. The majority hold that it compensates for the omitted yāʾ; al-Mubarrad held that it compensates for its vowel, and the kasra is not a kasra of i'rab.

* Lügat:
(يُغْشِي): örter. «انجلت عنه غشية الحمّى» yani hummanın nöbeti ondan açıldı; «نزلت به غشية الموت» (ona ölüm baygınlığı indi); «غشي عليه» (bayıldı); «أصابه غشي» (ona baygınlık isabet etti). Zü'r-Rumme şöyle demiştir:
وردت وأغباش السّواد كأنها ... سمادير غشي في العيون النواظر
(Karanlığın son kalıntıları, bakan gözlerdeki baygınlık bulanıklıkları gibiyken suya vardım.)
«على قلبه غشاوة فما يقبل الحق» (kalbinde bir perde vardır, bu yüzden hakkı kabul etmez); «استغش ثوبك كي لا تسمع ولا ترى» (işitmemek ve görmemek için elbisene bürün); «كثرت غاشية فلان» (falanın ziyaretçileri/etrafına gelenler çoğaldı). «غ» ile «ش» harflerinin fiilin fâ ve ayn harfleri olarak bir arada bulunmasının neredeyse birbirine benzeyen bir mânası vardır; o da örtmek ve gizlemektir. «غشّ» (hile) bilinen bir şeydir; sanki (hileci) tuzağını gizlemiştir. «غشم الوالي الرعية» denir, vali halka zulmüyle gelişigüzel davrandığında; o da «غشوم»dur. «غشمر السيل»: sel (hızla) geldi. «غشمر الرجل»: adam hak olsun bâtıl olsun dik başlılık etti ve yaptığına aldırmadı. Bu, dilin inceliklerindendir; üzerinde düşün.

* İ'rab:
(إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ): İsti'nâfiyye bir sözdür; göklerin ve yerin yaratılmasını takrîr için sevk edilmiştir. «إن» ve ismi; «الله» onun haberidir. «الذي» ism-i mevsûl olup «الله»ın sıfatı olarak ref' mahallindedir. «خلق السموات والأرض» cümlesi sıladır. «في ستة أيام» câr ve mecrûr olup «خلق»e müteallik olur. (ثُمَّ اسْتَوى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ): «ثم» terâhî ile tertip ifade eden atıf harfidir. «استوى» mâzî fiildir; fâili takdiri «هو» olan müstetir zamirdir; yani: keyfiyetten mücerred bir istikrarla hâkim oldu ve istikrar etti. «على العرش» câr ve mecrûr olup «استوى»ya müteallik olur. (يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهارَ): Cümle hâldir. «الليل» «يغشي»nin birinci mef'ûlün bihi, «النهار» ikinci mef'ûlün bihidir; veya tersidir. Yani: geceyi gündüze katar veya gündüzü geceye katar. (يَطْلُبُهُ حَثِيثاً وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّراتٍ بِأَمْرِهِ): Cümle «الليل»den hâldir; çünkü kendisinden bahsedilen odur; yani: gündüzü onu arayarak örter. «النهار»dan hâl olması da caizdir, yani: aranan olarak. «يطلبه» fiil, müstetir fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir. «حثيثا» «يطلبه»nin fâilinden veya mef'ûlünden hâldir, yani: hızla süren veya hızla sürülen olarak. Mahzûf bir masdarın sıfatı olarak i'rab edilmesi de caizdir; bu durumda mef'ûl-i mutlak olur, yani: «طلبا حثيثا» (hızlı bir arayış). «الشمس», «القمر» ve «النجوم»: bu üç lafız «السموات والأرض»a atfen mansûbdur. «مسخرات» onlardan hâldir, yani: doğma ve batma gibi onlardan istenen şeye boyun eğdirilmiş olarak. «بأمره» câr ve mecrûr olup «مسخرات»a veya mahzûf bir hâle müteallik olur; bu durumda «ب» musâhabe içindir, yani: onun emriyle beraber olarak, boyun eğdirilmelerinde onun emrinin dışına çıkmayarak. (أَلا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَالْأَمْرُ): İsti'nâfiyye bir sözdür; bu şeylerin bu şaşırtıcı âlemde tesirleri olduğunu söyleyenlere reddi vurgulamak için sevk edilmiştir. «ألا» istiftâh ve tenbîh edatıdır. «له» câr ve mecrûr olup mahzûf mukaddem habere müteallik olur. «الخلق» muahhar mübtedâdır. «الأمر» ona atfedilmiştir. (تَبارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعالَمِينَ): Başka bir isti'nâftır; Allah Teâlâ'nın hayrının çokluğunu, mübarekliğini, takdîs ve tenzîhini vurgulamak için sevk edilmiştir. «تبارك» mâzî fiildir, yani: mukaddes ve münezzeh oldu. Bu, tasrif edilmeyen câmid bir fiildir; yani ondan muzâri, emir ve ism-i fâil gelmez. «الله» fâildir. «رب العالمين» «الله»ın sıfatı veya ondan bedeldir. (ادْعُوا رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعاً وَخُفْيَةً إِنَّهُ لا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ): İsti'nâfiyye bir sözdür; duanın yalnız Allah Teâlâ'ya yöneltilmesi gerektiğini vurgulamak için sevk edilmiştir.
«ادعوا» emir fiil, «و» fâildir. «ربكم» mef'ûlün bihtir. «تضرعا» hâl olarak mansûbdur, yani: yalvarış sahipleri olarak. «خفية» ona atfedilmiştir. Mahzûf bir masdarın sıfatı olarak i'rab edilmesi de caizdir, yani: «ادعوه دعاء تضرع ودعاء خفية» (O'na yalvarış duası ve gizli dua ile dua edin). Bu ikisinden hangisi daha faziletlidir? Bu hususta bir ihtilaf vardır; buna geniş eserlerde müracaat edilir. Bu ikisinin mef'ûlün lieclih olarak i'rab edilmesi de caizdir. «إنه لا يحب المعتدين» cümlesi ta'lîliyyedir; isti'nâfiyye hükmüne dahildir, i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. Burada i'tidâ (المعتدين) mânası haddi aşmaktır. «لا يحب المعتدين» cümlesi «إن»in haberidir.

* Vocabulary:
(بُشْراً) with ḍamma on the bāʾ and sukūn on the shīn: plural of بشير, i.e. bearers of glad tidings.
There are four readings of it among the Seven: the second is بُشُرا with two ḍammas; the third is فشرا [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently نُشُرا] with nūn and two ḍammas; and the fourth is نَشْرا with fatḥa on the nūn and sukūn on the shīn. The meaning of نشرا is "scattered".
(أَقَلَّتْ): carried and lifted. الإقلال is derived from القلة (fewness), because one who lifts something and is able to bear it regards what he lifts as little.
(نَكِداً) النكد, with kasra on the kāf: that in which there is no good, or that which is hard and difficult; [one says] قوم أنكاد and مناكيد. Abū al-Ṭayyib [al-Mutanabbī] said:
لا تشتر العبد إلا والعصا معه ... إنّ العبيد لأنجاس مناكيد
(Do not buy a slave unless the stick comes with him; slaves are filthy, wretched [creatures].)

* I'rab:
(وَلا تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلاحِها) Resumptive speech introduced to warn mankind against corruption in the earth. لا is prohibitive; تفسدوا is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لا; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تفسدوا; بعد is an adverb also attached to تفسدوا; إصلاحها is muḍāf ilayhi. (وَادْعُوهُ خَوْفاً وَطَمَعاً) Conjoined to what preceded. خوفا and طمعا are accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. fearing and hoping; or as adjectives of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); or as two mafʿūl li-ajlihi (objects of purpose). (إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ) The clause gives the reason for what was mentioned. إنّ and its noun; قريب is its khabar (predicate); من المحسنين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قريب. (وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّياحَ بُشْراً بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ) The wāw is a conjunction, and the speech is conjoined to what is before it, namely إن ربكم etc. هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject); الذي is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the khabar; the clause يرسل الرياح is the ṣila (relative clause), having no grammatical position; بشرا is a ḥāl, i.e. bearing glad tidings of fertility and growth, so it is [a ḥāl] of the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بين is an adverb of place attached to يرسل, and its annexation to يدي is a majāz mursal (metonymic trope). (حَتَّى إِذا أَقَلَّتْ سَحاباً ثِقالًا سُقْناهُ لِبَلَدٍ مَيِّتٍ) حتى is a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition, the limit being of the sending; إذا is an adverb of future time; the clause أقلت is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the adverb is attached to سقناه, which is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); سحابا is a mafʿūl bihi; ثقالا is a naʿt (adjective); the clause سقناه has no grammatical position; لبلد is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سقناه; ميت is an adjective of بلد. (فَأَنْزَلْنا بِهِ الْماءَ فَأَخْرَجْنا بِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَراتِ) The fāʾ is a conjunction; أنزلنا is a verb and its agent; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزلنا; the bāʾ is causal, and the pronoun refers to the dead land or to the clouds. On the first [view] the bāʾ is locative (ẓarfiyya), meaning: We sent down the water in that dead land; on the second the الماء [Translator's note: so in the source; read «the bāʾ»] is causal, i.e. We sent down the water because of the clouds. الماء is a mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ is a conjunction; أخرجنا is conjoined to أنزلنا; the pronoun in «به» likewise refers to the water, the land or the clouds, as mentioned before; من كل الثمرات is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of the omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e. provision or vegetation. (كَذلِكَ نُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتى لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ) Resumptive speech introduced in a rhetorical style by way of comparison (tashbīh), meaning that He who is able to bring forth fresh fruit from dry wood is able to bring the dead to life. كذلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted maṣdar, so it is a fronted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); نخرج الموتى is a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause of hope is circumstantial; the clause تذكرون is the khabar of لعل. (وَالْبَلَدُ الطَّيِّبُ يَخْرُجُ نَباتُهُ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ) Resumptive speech introduced to complete the comparison. البلد is a mubtadaʾ; الطيب an adjective; the clause يخرج نباته the khabar; بإذن ربه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, as though it were said: its vegetation comes forth good and abundant, because it stands in contrast to His word «نكدا» later. So there is an omission in the speech because the meaning is understood, because of what البلد الطيب indicates, and because of its being contrasted with His word نكدا. (وَالَّذِي خَبُثَ لا يَخْرُجُ إِلَّا نَكِداً) The wāw is a conjunction; الذي is a mubtadaʾ, and it is a description of an omitted [noun], i.e. the land that is bad; the clause خبث is the ṣila; the clause لا يخرج is the khabar; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) because negation precedes it; نكدا is a ḥāl, i.e. with difficulty and slowly. It may also be accusative as a maṣdar, i.e. it is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar: except a scanty coming forth. (كَذلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ الْآياتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَشْكُرُونَ) كذلك is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar — the i'rab of its like has been given before; الآيات is the object of نصرف; لقوم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نصرف; the clause يشكرون is an adjective of قوم.

* Rhetoric:
1- The majāz mursal (metonymic trope) in His words «بين يدي رحمته», which is the rain; the relation is causality, because the hand is the cause of bestowing favour, and bestowing favour is mercy.
2- The unrestricted simile (tashbīh mursal) in His words «كذلك نخرج الموتى». It was pointed to in the I'rab.

* Benefits:
Al-Zamakhsharī said: «He made «قريب» masculine only by interpreting الرحمة as الرحم or الترحم (mercy, compassion); or because it is the adjective of an omitted described noun, i.e. something near; by likening it to فعيل in the sense of مفعول; or because the femininity of الرحمة is not real». Abū ʿUbayda said: «قريب» is masculine on the basis of the masculine «place», i.e. a near place. Al-Akhfash replied to him, saying: This is wrong; if it were as he said, «قريب» would be accusative, as you say إن زيدا قريبا منك (Zayd is near you). Al-Farrāʾ said: When قريب means distance, it is treated as masculine or feminine; if it means kinship, it is made feminine without disagreement among them. So one says: دارك منا قريب (your house is near us), and فلانة منا قريب (So-and-so [f.] is close to us). The Exalted said: «لعل الساعة تكون قريبا».
From it are the words of Imruʾ al-Qays:
لك الويل إن أمسى ولا أمّ هاشم ... قريب ولا البسباسة ابنة يشكرا
(Woe to you if evening comes and neither Umm Hāshim is near, nor al-Basbāsa daughter of Yashkur.)

* Vocabulary:
(تَنْحِتُونَ): In al-Qāmūs: «نحته ينحته, like يضربه, ينصره and يعلمه: he hewed it».

* I'rab:
(وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفاءَ مِنْ بَعْدِ عادٍ) Conjoined to what preceded. إذ is accusative as an object, not as an adverb, i.e. remember the time of the appointing; the clause جعلكم is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and خلفاء the second mafʿūl bihi; من بعد عاد is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of خلفاء. (وَبَوَّأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْ سُهُولِها قُصُوراً) Conjoined to جعلكم; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بوأكم; the clause تتخذون is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object; من سهولها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تتخذون or to an omitted ḥāl of «قصورا», since it would originally be its adjective if it came after it; قصورا is a mafʿūl bihi. The palace (قصر) was called قصر because of the inability (قصور) of the poor to obtain it. (وَتَنْحِتُونَ الْجِبالَ بُيُوتاً) The wāw is a conjunction; تنحتون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). الجبال may be accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. from the mountains, as in His words, the Exalted: «واختار موسى قومه سبعين رجلا», so that «بيوتا» is the mafʿūl bihi. [The verb] may also be made to include the sense of a verb taking two objects, i.e. you take the mountains as houses by hewing, or you make them into houses by hewing. Or الجبال may be the mafʿūl bihi and «بيوتا» an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara), as you say: خط هذا الثوب قميصا (sew this cloth as a shirt), وابر هذه القصبة قلما (sharpen this reed as a pen). We said "anticipated" only because the mountain is not a house at the time of hewing, nor the cloth a shirt, nor the reed a pen at the time of sewing and sharpening. And «بيوتا», even though it is not derived, is in the sense of a derived [word], i.e. inhabited. (فَاذْكُرُوا آلاءَ اللَّهِ وَلا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ) The fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; اذكروا is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; آلاء الله is a mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تعثوا is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تعثوا; مفسدين is a ḥāl. (قالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ) Resumptive speech introduced as an answer to a question. قال الملأ is a verb and its agent; الذين is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as an adjective; the clause استكبروا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative; من قومه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. (لِلَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا لِمَنْ آمَنَ مِنْهُمْ) The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قال; the clause استضعفوا is the ṣila; لمن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted [element], a badal (substitute) of الذين استضعفوا, with repetition of the governing element (ʿāmil). There are two views on it. One: it is a whole-for-whole badal if the pronoun in «منهم» refers to «قومه», so that the oppressed are all the believers only, as though it were said: the arrogant said to the believers among the people of Ṣāliḥ. Or [the other]: it is a part-for-whole badal if the pronoun refers to the oppressed, so that the oppressed are of two kinds, believers and disbelievers, as though it were said: the arrogant said to [the believers] among the weak, not the disbelievers among the weak [Translator's note: the source reads «قال المستكبرون من الضعفاء», apparently missing «للمؤمنين»]. منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. (أَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ صالِحاً مُرْسَلٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ) The hamza is for the mocking interrogative, i.e. they said that by way of ridicule and derision; the interrogative sentence is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech); أنّ, its noun and its khabar (predicate) take the place of the two objects of تعلمون; من ربه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مرسل. (قالُوا: إِنَّا بِما أُرْسِلَ بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ) The clause is resumptive, introduced as their answer. They ran ahead of events, since the context would require them to say: Yes, or: We know that he is sent. إنّ and its noun; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar «مؤمنون»; the clause أرسل is the ṣila; إنّ and what follows it is a sentence in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسل.

* Rhetoric:
In this verse there is a delightful figure called the figure of taghāyur (contrariety); part of it has passed before, and we now repeat its definition as a reminder. It is the contrariety of two positions, either concerning a single notion, such that a person praises a thing or blames it, or blames what another has praised and vice versa; or prefers a thing or blames it, or blames what another has praised and vice versa; or prefers one thing to another and then turns back and makes the inferior superior and the superior inferior. Some of them took contrary positions in the matter of obedience and disobedience, after the contrariety in their speech and belief regarding their intentions; and this is that in which a person takes a position contrary to another.
[Translator's note: the definition is repetitive in the source and is translated as written.]

* Vocabulary:
(مَدْيَنَ): a non-Arabic name. It is the name of a tribe, named after their forefather Madyan son of Ibrāhīm; and Shuʿayb was the son of Mīkāʾīl son of Yashjur son of Madyan — which is the name of a tribe — so he is their brother by lineage, and he is not one of the prophets of the Children of Israel. Madyan is also the name of Shuʿayb's town, so it is a name shared by the town, the tribe and its forefather.
(تَبْخَسُوا): diminish. One says: بخسته حقه, when you have diminished his due to him. In the proverb: «تحسبها حمقاء وهي باخس» (you think her foolish, yet she is one who cheats). Among the remarkable features of the bāʾ and the khāʾ is that when they come together as the first and second radicals of a word, we express by them an effect on things. Among them: البخت, which is luck, and its effect is too well known to be mentioned; بخ لك, a word of admiration and praise for something, said with kasra and tanwīn — the khāʾ may be doubled and the word repeated, so one says بخّ بخّ, and they are then indeclinable on sukūn; بخر الثوب: he gave the garment a pleasant scent, while البخر, with two fatḥas, is foul breath — so it is one of the words with opposite meanings (aḍdād); البخار, which is water in the gaseous state, and everything that rises from hot liquids, like smoke — its effect in driving trains and other things is well known and familiar; بخص عينه: he gouged out his eye; بخع نفسه: he destroyed himself; and بخل: he held back and withheld.

* I'rab:
(وَإِلى مَدْيَنَ أَخاهُمْ شُعَيْباً قالَ يا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ ما لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلهٍ غَيْرُهُ) This verse has recurred many times, and its i'rab has been given before. (قَدْ جاءَتْكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ) The clause falls within the scope of the saying and is in the accusative by it; بينة is the fāʿil (agent) of جاءتكم; من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of بينة. (فَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزانَ) The fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; أوفوا is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; الكيل is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الميزان is conjoined to الكيل. (وَلا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْياءَهُمْ) The wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تبخسوا is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the wāw is its fāʿil; الناس is a mafʿūl bihi; أشياءهم is a second mafʿūl bihi. One says:
بخسته حقه when you have diminished his due to him. (وَلا تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلاحِها) Conjoined to what preceded; لا is prohibitive; تفسدوا is an imperfect verb in the jussive by لا; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تفسدوا; بعد إصلاحها is an adverb of time attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and a muḍāf must be implied, i.e. the reform of its people. (ذلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ) The clause is resumptive; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); خير is the khabar (predicate); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خير; إن is conditional; كنتم: كان and its noun, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); مؤمنين is the khabar of كنتم; the apodosis of إن is omitted, i.e. then hasten to faith. (وَلا تَقْعُدُوا بِكُلِّ صِراطٍ تُوعِدُونَ)
Also conjoined; بكل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تقعدوا; صراط is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause توعدون is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. and do not sit threatening. (وَتَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ مَنْ آمَنَ بِهِ) Also conjoined; عن سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تصدون; من is the object of تصدون; the clause آمن به is the ṣila (relative clause); به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آمن. (وَتَبْغُونَها عِوَجاً) تبغونها is a verb, its agent and its object; عوجا is a ḥāl in which the maṣdar (verbal noun) stands in the place of the derived noun, i.e. crooked. It is also possible that the hāʾ is in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ) and عوجا is the mafʿūl bihi. This is a sound view, given before in Āl ʿImrān, so refresh your memory of it. (وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ كُنْتُمْ قَلِيلًا فَكَثَّرَكُمْ) Also conjoined; إذ is an adverb of past time in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi, i.e. remember, giving thanks, the time when your number was small. It may also be an adverb, the mafʿūl bihi being omitted, so that the adverb is governed by that omitted [object], i.e. remember His favour upon you at that time. The clause كنتم is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; كان, its noun and its khabar; فكثركم is conjoined to كنتم, i.e. He made you many through wealth after poverty and through power after weakness. (وَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كانَ عاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ) Also conjoined; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted khabar of كان; عاقبة المفسدين is its noun. The interrogative has suspended (ʿallaqa) [the verb of] looking, so the clause is in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition, and the [implied] preposition and its genitive noun are attached to انظروا. (وَإِنْ كانَ طائِفَةٌ مِنْكُمْ آمَنُوا بِالَّذِي أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ) The wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; كان and its noun; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of طائفة; the clause آمنوا is the khabar of كان; بالذي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آمنوا; the clause أرسلت به is the ṣila. (وَطائِفَةٌ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا) طائفة is conjoined to the first طائفة, and the clause لم يؤمنوا is conjoined to the clause آمنوا, which is the khabar of كان — a case of conjoining the noun [to the noun] and the khabar to the khabar. What لم يؤمنوا is attached to is omitted, being sufficed by what آمنوا is attached to. (فَاصْبِرُوا حَتَّى يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ بَيْنَنا) The fāʾ connects the apodosis of the condition; حتى is a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition; يحكم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اصبروا; بيننا is an adverb attached to يحكم. (وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحاكِمِينَ) The wāw is circumstantial or resumptive; هو is a mubtadaʾ and خير الحاكمين its khabar.

* Lügat:
(يَغْنَوْا): «غني بالمكان»ın muzârisidir: o yerde ikamet etti; (ism-i fâili) «غان»dır. «المغني» konak demektir, çoğulu «المغاني»dir. Tâî (Tayy kabilesinden şair) şöyle demiştir:
غنينا زمانا بالتصعلك والغنى ... وكلا سقاناه بكاسيهما الدهر
فما زادنا بغيا على ذي قرابة ... غنانا ولا أزرى بأحسابنا الفقر
(Bir zaman yoksullukla da zenginlikle de yaşadık; zaman ikisini de kadehleriyle bize içirdi. Ne zenginliğimiz bizi akrabaya karşı azgınlıkta artırdı, ne de fakirlik soylarımızı küçük düşürdü.)
(آسى): Aslı iki hemze ile «أأسى»dir; ikincisi elife dönüştürülmüştür. el-Misbâh'ta şöyle denir: «أسي أسى», «تعب» babından: üzüldü.

* İ'rab:
(وَقالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ): İ'rabı geçmiştir. (لَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتُمْ شُعَيْباً إِنَّكُمْ إِذاً لَخاسِرُونَ): Kasem cümlesi onların sözünün mekûlü olarak nasb mahallindedir. «ل» kasemi hazırlayan (muvattıe) lâmdır. «إن» şartiyyedir. «اتبعتم شعيبا» fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir. «إن» ve ismi; «إذن» amel etmeyen (mühmel) cevap ve cezâ harfidir. «ل» müzahlaka lâmıdır. «خاسرون» «إن»in haberidir. «إنكم» cümlesi kasemin cevabıdır, i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; şart ile kasemin bir araya gelmesindeki kurala göre şartın cevabının yerini tutmuştur. (فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دارِهِمْ جاثِمِينَ): «ف» atıf harfidir. «أخذتهم الرجفة» fiil, mef'ûlün bih ve fâildir. «فأصبحوا» «فأخذتهم»e atfedilmiştir. «و» «أصبحوا»nın ismi, «جاثمين» haberidir. «في دارهم» câr ve mecrûr olup «جاثمين»e müteallik olur. (الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا شُعَيْباً كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا): Bu yalanlayanların hakikatini beyan için isti'nâfiyye bir cümledir. «الذين» mübtedâdır. «كذبوا شعيبا» cümlesi sıladır. «كأن» ağırdan muhaffefedir; ismi şan zamiridir. «لم يغنوا فيها» cümlesi onun haberidir. (الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا شُعَيْباً كانُوا هُمُ الْخاسِرِينَ): «الذين» mübtedâdır. «كذبوا شعيبا» cümlesi sıladır. «كانوا» cümlesi «الذين»in haberidir. Mübtedâ ve haberdeki bu tekrar, onların taraftarlarına reddiyede ve görüşlerini akılsızlıkla nitelemede mübalağa içindir; ayrıca sılanın kapsamında zikredilen şeyin iki cezayı gerektiren şey olduğunu bildirmek içindir. (Fiil) ism-i mevsûle isnat edilmiştir; bu, dinleyenlerden başkasını [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «لغير السامعين» yazılmıştır.] yüceltmek içindir; çünkü onu yalanlayanların hüsranı, onu tasdik edenin saadetine delâlet eder; bunun lâzımı da bu makamda ne konuşan ne de muhatap olan Şuayb (a.s.)'ın yüceltilmesidir. (فَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ وَقالَ: يا قَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسالاتِ رَبِّي): «ف» atıf harfidir. «تولى» mâzî fiildir; fâili takdiri «هو» olan müstetir zamirdir. «عنهم» câr ve mecrûr olup «تولى»ya müteallik olur. «قال» «تولى»ya atfedilmiştir. «لقد أبلغتكم رسالات ربي» cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavldir. «رسالات» «أبلغتكم»in ikinci mef'ûlün bihidir. (وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ فَكَيْفَ آسى عَلى قَوْمٍ كافِرِينَ): Geçen şeye atıftır. «ف» isti'nâfiyyedir. «كيف» nefy mânasında istifhâm ismi olup hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir. «آسى» muzâri fiildir; fâili takdiri «أنا» olan müstetir zamirdir. «على قوم» câr ve mecrûr olup «آسى»ya müteallik olur. «كافرين» «قوم»in sıfatıdır.

* Belâgat:
Âyette nefsin tereddüt hâlinin tasviri vardır: (Şuayb'ın) kavmine üzüntüsü şiddetlenmiş, sonra kendi nefsine itiraz ederek şöyle demiştir: «Küfürleri, azgınlıkta ileri gitmeleri ve başlarına inene müstahak olmaları sebebiyle üzülmeye lâyık olmayan bir kavim için üzüntüm nasıl şiddetlenebilir?» Sonra bunun arasına onları tekrar kınamak girer; şunu demek ister: «Uyaran, (mesuliyetten) kurtulmuştur. Ben, kavmini cehaletin dallı budaklı çöllerine ve helâk edici tehlikelerine saplanmaktan koruma gayreti taşıyan birinin gücünün yettiği son noktaya ulaştım.» [Mütercim notu: Kaynaktaki «من الارتطام في بوادي الجهل» ifadesi bu hâliyle belirsizdir; çeviri bir yorumdur.]

* Vocabulary:
(يَغْنَوْا): the imperfect of غني بالمكان, "he stayed in the place"; he is غان. المغنى is the dwelling, plural المغاني. The poet of Tayyiʾ said:
غنينا زمانا بالتصعلك والغنى ... وكلا سقاناه بكاسيهما الدهر
(We dwelt for a time in poverty and in wealth, and Time gave us to drink of both its cups.)
فما زادنا بغيا على ذي قرابة ... غنانا ولا أزرى بأحسابنا الفقر
(Our wealth did not make us transgress against a kinsman, and poverty did not disgrace our lineages.)
(آسى): its origin is أأسى with two hamzas, the second turned into an alif. In al-Miṣbāḥ: أسي أسى (of the pattern تعب) means "he grieved".

* I'rab:
(وَقالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ): its i'rab has already been given. (لَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتُمْ شُعَيْباً إِنَّكُمْ إِذاً لَخاسِرُونَ): the oath clause is in the position of the accusative, being the content of what they said. The lām is the preparatory lām of the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), إن is conditional, and اتبعتم شعيبا is a verb, agent and direct object. إن and its noun; إذن is a particle of answer and consequence that does not govern; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); خاسرون is the khabar of إن. The clause إنكم is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position, and it stands in place of the apodosis of the condition, as is the rule when a condition and an oath come together. (فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دارِهِمْ جاثِمِينَ): the فاء is a conjunction; أخذتهم الرجفة is a verb, direct object and agent; فأصبحوا is conjoined to فأخذتهم; the wāw is the noun of أصبحوا and جاثمين its khabar; في دارهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاثمين. (الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا شُعَيْباً كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا): a resumptive clause explaining the reality of these deniers. الذين is a mubtadaʾ, the clause كذبوا شعيبا is the ṣila, كأن is the lightened form of the heavy كأنّ, its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause لم يغنوا فيها is its khabar. (الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا شُعَيْباً كانُوا هُمُ الْخاسِرِينَ): الذين is a mubtadaʾ, the clause كذبوا شعيبا is the ṣila, and the clause كانوا is the khabar of الذين. This repetition in the mubtadaʾ and khabar is an intensification in rebutting their partisans and in declaring their opinions foolish, and an announcement that what is mentioned within the ṣila is what made them deserve the two punishments. It was attributed to the relative noun in order to exalt someone other than the listeners, for the loss of those who denied him indicates the felicity of those who believed him, and this entails the exaltation of Shuʿayb, peace be upon him, who is neither the speaker nor the one addressed in this setting. (فَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ وَقالَ: يا قَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسالاتِ رَبِّي): the فاء is a conjunction; تولى is a past verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تولى; وقال is conjoined to تولى; the clause لقد أبلغتكم رسالات ربي is the content of the saying; رسالات is the second direct object of أبلغتكم. (وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ فَكَيْفَ آسى عَلى قَوْمٍ كافِرِينَ): conjoined to what precedes; the فاء is resumptive; كيف is an interrogative noun whose meaning is negation, in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); آسى is an imperfect verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "I"; على قوم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آسى; and كافرين is an adjective of قوم.

* Rhetoric:
The verse describes the state of the soul in its wavering. His grief for his people had grown intense; then he rebuked himself and said: how can my grief be intense for a people who are not worthy of being grieved over, because of their disbelief, their persistence in tyranny, and their deserving what befell them? Then this was interspersed with a return to blaming them. He means: "He who warns has excused himself", and he had done the utmost that one zealous for his people can do, short of plunging into the manifold wildernesses of ignorance and its ruinous perils. [Translator's note: the source phrase «من الارتطام في بوادي الجهل» is unclear as it stands; this rendering is an interpretation.]

* Vocabulary:
(عَفَوْا): they became many and grew, in themselves and in their wealth, from the saying عفا النبات, عفا الشحم, and عفا الوبر when they become abundant. It is said: عفا means "became abundant", and عفا means "was effaced"; so it is one of the words with opposite meanings (aḍdād) [Translator's note: the source prints «الأضداء»]. In al-Miṣbāḥ it is said that it is both transitive and intransitive, and it is also made transitive by the hamza, so one says أعفيته.

* I'rab:
(وَما أَرْسَلْنا فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ): the wāw is resumptive, and the speech is a new sentence, uttered to explain the circumstances of the nations in a general manner, so that together with the story it may be a warning to those warned. ما is negative; أرسلنا is a verb and agent; من is a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr zāʾid); and نبيّ is genitive in form and accusative in position as a direct object. (إِلَّا أَخَذْنا أَهْلَها بِالْبَأْساءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَضَّرَّعُونَ): إلا is a particle of restriction, so the exception is an emptied (mufarraghan) one, from the most general of circumstances; thus the clause أخذنا is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, with an implied "qad", as is the condition for a past verb to occur as a ḥāl, and its discussion has already preceded.
The implied sense is: "We did not send in any town of the destroyed towns any prophet of the prophets in any circumstance except the circumstance of Our having seized (its people)." أهلها is a direct object; بالبأساء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخذنا; الضراء is conjoined to البأساء; لعلهم: لعل and its noun; the clause يضّرّعون is its khabar; and the clause لعلهم يضرعون is a ḥāl clause.
(ثُمَّ بَدَّلْنا مَكانَ السَّيِّئَةِ الْحَسَنَةَ): ثم is a particle of conjunction and delay; بدلنا is conjoined to أخذنا and falls under its ruling. مكان is the direct object of بدلنا, السيئة is a muḍāf ilayhi, and الحسنة is the second direct object; and this is what prevented its being put in the accusative as an adverbial, for الحسنة is the thing taken and obtained, while مكان السيئة is the thing left and gone, and it is that which the preposition باء accompanies in a construction such as this, as has been verified before in (Sūrat) al-Baqara. (حَتَّى عَفَوْا وَقالُوا: قَدْ مَسَّ آباءَنَا الضَّرَّاءُ وَالسَّرَّاءُ): حتى is a particle of limit and of genitive; عفوا is a past verb with its agent; the interpreted maṣdar, governed in the genitive by (an implied) أن, is attached to بدلنا; وقالوا is conjoined to عفوا; the clause قد مس is the content of the saying; آباءنا is a direct object; and الضراء and السراء are conjoined to it. (فَأَخَذْناهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لا يَشْعُرُونَ): فأخذناهم is conjoined to عفوا; بغتة is a ḥāl or an adjective of an omitted maṣdar; the wāw in وهم is circumstantial; هم is a mubtadaʾ; the clause لا يشعرون is the khabar; and the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. (وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْقُرى آمَنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا لَفَتَحْنا عَلَيْهِمْ بَرَكاتٍ مِنَ السَّماءِ وَالْأَرْضِ): the wāw is resumptive; لو is conditional, merely for linking; أن and its noun; the clause آمنوا is its khabar; أن and what follows is the agent of an omitted verb, i.e. "their faith was established"; the lām in لفتحنا occurs in the answer to لو; فتحنا is a verb and agent, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to فتحنا; بركات is a direct object; and من السماء والأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of بركات. (وَلكِنْ كَذَّبُوا فَأَخَذْناهُمْ بِما كانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ): the wāw is circumstantial; لكن is a particle of rectification that does not govern; كذبوا is a verb and agent, and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl; فأخذناهم: the فاء is a conjunction, and أخذناهم is a verb, agent and direct object; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخذناهم; ما is a maṣdar particle or a relative; كان and its noun; the clause يكسبون is the khabar; and the clause of "being" is the ṣila of "ما", or the interpreted maṣdar, with no grammatical position after the particle-type relative.

* Vocabulary:
(يَهْدِ): "makes clear", from هدى يهدي.

* I'rab:
(أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لِلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْأَرْضَ مِنْ بَعْدِ أَهْلِها): the hamza is for an interrogation of denial and the wāw is a conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, reversal (of tense) and jussive; the meaning of يهدي is "to become clear", and it is jussive by "لم"; للذين is attached to يهد; the clause يرثون الأرض is the ṣila; and من بعد أهلها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرثون. (أَنْ لَوْ نَشاءُ أَصَبْناهُمْ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ): أن here is the lightened form of the heavy أنّ, its noun is the pronoun of the matter, and the clause نشاء is its khabar; أن and what follows is the agent of يهد. It is also permissible that the agent of "يهد" be a latent pronoun, namely the pronoun for "Allah", or a pronoun referring back to what is understood from the context of the speech, i.e. "Did what happened to the earlier nations not make clear...?"; in that case أن and what is within its scope are, in interpretation, a maṣdar in the position of the object. On the first view the implied sense is: "Did Allah not make clear and explain to those who inherit their end and the outcome of their affair, (namely) Our striking them for their sins?", and the direct object is omitted as we have supplied it.
On the second view the implied sense is: "Did Allah, or what happened to the nations, not make clear and explain Our striking them, had We willed that?" أصبناهم is a verb, agent and direct object, and بذنوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to it. (وَنَطْبَعُ عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ): the wāw is resumptive and the clause is a new sentence. It is not permissible to conjoin it to the answer of "لو", because that would make the sealing negated by the force of "لو", whereas it is established for them. على قلوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نطبع. (فَهُمْ لا يَسْمَعُونَ): the فاء is a conjunction, expressing that the not-hearing follows upon the sealing of the heart; هم is a mubtadaʾ and the clause لا يسمعون is its khabar. (تِلْكَ الْقُرى نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْبائِها): تلك is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ; القرى is a badal of تلك; and the clause نقص is the khabar of تلك. It is also permissible that القرى be the khabar and the clause نقص a ḥāl clause, on the pattern of His saying, the Exalted: «هذا بعلي شيخا»; عليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نقصّ; and من أبنائها [Translator's note: the source prints أبنائها, but the verse reads أَنْبائِها] is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to نقص, and من is partitive, i.e. "some of its tidings", and they have other tidings that We have not related to you. The clause of indication is resumptive, uttered to explain that admonitions and lessons are of no avail with these people, and that sermons have no effect on them, so they died persisting in their obstinacy; no stubbornness of theirs softened and no obstinacy of theirs subsided. (وَلَقَدْ جاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّناتِ): the wāw is resumptive or conjunctive; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of affirmation; جاءتهم is a verb and direct object; رسلهم is the agent; and بالبينات is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاءتهم. (فَما كانُوا لِيُؤْمِنُوا بِما كَذَّبُوا مِنْ قَبْلُ): the فاء is a conjunction; ما is negative; كان and its noun; the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); يؤمنوا is an imperfect verb put in the accusative by an implied أن after the lām of denial; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar, i.e. "they were not intending to believe"; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤمنوا; ما is a relative noun or a maṣdar particle; and من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كذبوا. If "ما" is a relative, the returning pronoun is omitted and is in the genitive, like His saying, the Exalted, in Sūrat Yūnus: «فما كانوا ليؤمنوا بما كذبوا به». This belongs to the unity of what is attached, in meaning, and the explanation of its being of that kind is that the whole of "ما كانوا ليؤمنوا" has the meaning of "كذبوا به", so the two attached elements are united in meaning.
It may also be said: His saying, the Exalted, «ليؤمنوا» is made transitive with the particle باء [Translator's note: the source prints «بالياء»], and يؤمن is the opposite of يكذب, so he treated it like it, for they sometimes take a thing as the opposite of something, as they take it as its like. (كَذلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلى قُلُوبِ الْكافِرِينَ): the كاف with what follows it is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "in the likeness of that sealing upon the hearts of the people of the towns, from whom faith was negated, Allah seals the hearts of the disbelievers who come after them". (وَما وَجَدْنا لِأَكْثَرِهِمْ مِنْ عَهْدٍ): the wāw is parenthetical, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is parenthetical; ما is negative; وجدنا is a verb and agent; لأكثرهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective of عهد; من is a redundant preposition; and عهد is, in position, the direct object of وجدنا. It is also permissible that لأكثرهم be the second object of وجدنا, preferring that it is a verb of knowing, not of finding (wijdān). (وَإِنْ وَجَدْنا أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَفاسِقِينَ): the wāw is a conjunction; إن is the lightened form of the heavy إنّ, rarely not governing; it may also govern, with its noun the pronoun of the matter, and its ruling will come in the section on Benefits; وجدنا أكثرهم is a verb, agent and direct object; the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); and فاسقين is the second direct object of وجدنا.

* Benefits:
When "إن" with a kasra on the hamza is lightened, it is necessarily made non-governing if a verb follows it, as in His saying, the Exalted: «وإن نظنك لمن الكاذبين». If a noun follows it, the more common case is also that it does not govern, as in: إن أنت لصادق ("You are indeed truthful"); and it is seldom made to govern, as in: إن زيدا لمنطلق. Whenever it is lightened and made non-governing, the lām with a fatḥa necessarily accompanies it, to distinguish it from the negative "إن", and it is called the distinguishing lām.

* İ'rab:
(ثُمَّ بَعَثْنا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ مُوسى بِآياتِنا إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَائِهِ فَظَلَمُوا بِها): «ثم» atıf ve terâhî harfidir. «بعثنا» fiil ve fâildir. «من بعدهم» câr ve mecrûr olup mahzûf bir hâle müteallik olur; zamir peygamberlere veya ümmetlere aittir. «موسى» mef'ûlün bihtir. «بآياتنا» câr ve mecrûr olup «بعثنا»ya müteallik olur. «إلى فرعون» câr ve mecrûr olup yine «بعثنا»ya müteallik olur. «ملئه» «فرعون»a atfedilmiştir, yani: onun kavmine. «فظلموا»: «ف» atıf ve ta'kîb içindir. «بها» câr ve mecrûr olup «ظلموا»ya müteallik olur. Zulüm, küfür yerine konulmuştur; çünkü ikisi aynı daldandır. (فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كانَ عاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ): Benzerinin i'rabı geçmiştir; onu bir kere daha hatırla. (وَقالَ مُوسى يا فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ): «و» isti'nâfiyyedir; cümle daha önce mücmel olarak bildirileni tafsil etmek için sevk edilmiştir. «يا» orta mesafe için nidâ harfidir. «فرعون» damme üzere mebnî müfred alem münâdâdır; bu onun lakabıdır. Gerçek adı Reyyân oğlu Mus'ab oğlu Velîd'dir; künyesi ise Ebû Mürre'dir. «إن» ve ismi; «من رب العالمين» onun haberidir [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta böyle yazılmıştır; «إن»in haberi «رسول»dür, «من رب العالمين» ise onun sıfatına müteallik olur.]. Cümle mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir. (حَقِيقٌ عَلى أَنْ لا أَقُولَ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ): «حقيق» mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberidir, yani: «أنا حقيق» (ben lâyığım), «جدير» mânasında. Cümle isti'nâfiyyedir. «على أن لا أقول» câr ve mecrûr olup «حقيق»e müteallik olur; çünkü o, fâil veya mef'ûl mânasında «فعيل»dir. «على الله» câr ve mecrûr olup «أقول»e müteallik olur. «إلا» hasr edatıdır. «الحق» mahzûf bir masdarın sıfatıdır, yani: «إلا القول الحق» (hak sözden başkasını). Bir cümle mânasını içerdiği için mef'ûlün bih olması da caizdir. (قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ): Cümle [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «الجلة» yazılmıştır; doğrusu «الجملة»dir.] «رسول»ün sıfatıdır. «قد» tahkîk harfidir. «جئتكم» fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir. «ببينة» câr ve mecrûr olup «جئتكم»e müteallik olur. «من ربكم» câr ve mecrûr olup «بينة»nin mahzûf sıfatına müteallik olur. (فَأَرْسِلْ مَعِيَ بَنِي إِسْرائِيلَ): «ف» fasîha fâsıdır, yani: Sözümü dinleyip doğru yola döndüğünde, onların işini serbest bırak ve onların yolunu aç ki benimle gitsinler.
«أرسل» emir fiildir. «معي» zarf olup «أرسل»e müteallik olur. «بني إسرائيل» mef'ûlün bihtir. Mûsâ'nın amacı onları kölelikten kurtarmak, esaret ve zillet bağından halâs etmekti. (قالَ: إِنْ كُنْتَ جِئْتَ بِآيَةٍ فَأْتِ بِها إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ): «قال» cümlesi isti'nâfiyyedir; Firavun'un, Rabbinden bir âyet getirmesini istemesi için (sevk edilmiştir). Şart cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir. «إن» şartiyyedir. «كان» ve ismi; «جئت» cümlesi «كنت»in haberidir. «بآية» câr ve mecrûr olup «جئت»e müteallik olur. «ف» cevabı bağlayan (râbıta) fâdır. «أت» emir fiildir. «بها» câr ve mecrûr olup ona müteallik olur. «كنت»: «كان» ve ismi, fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir. «من الصادقين» câr ve mecrûr olup «كنت»in mahzûf haberine müteallik olur. «إن»in cevabı, kendinden öncekinin ona delâlet etmesi sebebiyle mahzûftur, yani: «فأت بها» (onu getir).

* Belâgat:
Arapların sözlerindeki usullerinden biri kalbdir (القلب). Bu iki kısımdır: Birincisi, bir çeşit mübalağa için hakikatin mecaza çevrilmesidir. Ebu't-Tayyib el-Mütenebbî şu sözünde onun eteklerine tutunmuştur:
والسيف يشقى كما تشقى الضلوع به ... وللسّيوف كما للناس آجال
(Kılıç, kaburgaların onunla bedbaht olduğu gibi bedbaht olur; insanların olduğu gibi kılıçların da ecelleri vardır.)
Kılıcın bedbaht olmasından maksat, vurulanın kaburgalarında kırılmasıdır; bu, onun başka bir beytteki şu sözü tarzındadır:
طوال الرّدينيّات يقصفها دمي ... وبيض السّريجيّات يقطعها لحمي
(Uzun Rudeynî mızrakları kanım kırar; parlak Süreycî kılıçları etim keser.)
İkinci kısım, bu belîğ mânadan arınmış bir kısımdır; «خرق الثوب المسمار» (Elbise çiviyi yırttı) sözleri ve benzerleri gibi.

* I'rab:
(ثُمَّ بَعَثْنا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ مُوسى بِآياتِنا إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَائِهِ فَظَلَمُوا بِها): ثم is a particle of conjunction and delay; بعثنا is a verb and agent; من بعدهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the pronoun refers to the messengers or to the nations; موسى is a direct object; بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعثنا; and إلى فرعون is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to بعثنا; ملئه is conjoined to فرعون, i.e. to his people; فظلموا: the فاء is for conjunction and succession; بها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ظلموا; and wrongdoing was treated like disbelief because they are of one branch. (فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كانَ عاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ): the i'rab of its like has already been given, so renew your acquaintance with it. (وَقالَ مُوسى يا فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ): the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is uttered to detail what was stated in summary earlier. يا is a vocative particle for the middle distance; فرعون is a vocative, a singular proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and it is his title, his real name being al-Walīd ibn Muṣʿab ibn al-Rayyān, and his kunya Abū Murra; إن and its noun; and من رب العالمين is its khabar; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the content of the saying. (حَقِيقٌ عَلى أَنْ لا أَقُولَ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ): حقيق is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "I am worthy (ḥaqīq)", in the sense of "deserving", and the clause is resumptive; على أن لا أقول is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حقيق, because it is a faʿīl form in the sense of fāʿil or mafʿūl; على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أقول; إلا is a particle of restriction; and الحق is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "except the true saying", and it may be a direct object because it contains the sense of a clause. (قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ): the clause is an adjective of رسول [Translator's note: the source prints «الجلة»]; قد is a particle of affirmation; جئتكم is a verb, agent and direct object; ببينة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جئتكم; and من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of بينة. (فَأَرْسِلْ مَعِيَ بَنِي إِسْرائِيلَ): the فاء is the eloquent فاء (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), i.e. "if you have listened to my words and returned to right guidance, then leave their affair and let go their way, so that they may go with me".
أرسل is an imperative verb; معي is an adverbial attached to أرسل; and بني إسرائيل is a direct object. Moses' aim was to free them from servitude and to deliver them from the bond of captivity and humiliation. (قالَ: إِنْ كُنْتَ جِئْتَ بِآيَةٍ فَأْتِ بِها إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ): the clause قال is resumptive, due to Pharaoh's demand to bring a sign from his Lord, and the conditional clause is in the position of the accusative as the content of the saying; إن is conditional; كان and its noun; the clause جئت is the khabar of كنت; بآية is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جئت; the فاء links the apodosis; أت is an imperative verb; بها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to it; كنت is كان and its noun, in the position of the jussive as the protasis; من الصادقين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of كنت; and the apodosis of إن is omitted because what precedes indicates it, i.e. "then bring it".

* Rhetoric:
Among the practices of the Arabs in their speech is inversion (qalb), and it is of two kinds. The first is turning the literal into the figurative for some reason of exaggeration, and Abū l-Ṭayyib al-Mutanabbī clung to its hem when he said:
والسيف يشقى كما تشقى الضلوع به ... وللسّيوف كما للناس آجال
(The sword suffers as the ribs suffer by it; for swords, as for people, there are appointed terms.)
By the "suffering of the sword" is meant its breaking in the ribs of the one struck, in the manner of his saying in another verse:
طوال الرّدينيّات يقصفها دمي ... وبيض السّريجيّات يقطعها لحمي
(The long Rudaynian spears are broken by my blood, and the white Surayjī swords are cut by my flesh.)
The second kind is bare of this eloquent meaning, as in their saying:
خرق الثوب المسمار, and the like.
(The garment tore the nail.)

* Lügat:
(السنون): (سنة)nin cem'idir; o da on iki aydır. «سنين», «سنوات» ve «سنهات» şeklinde cem'lenir; tasğîri «سنيّة», «سنينة» ve «سنيهة»dir; ona nispet «سنويّ» ve «سنهيّ»dir. Cem'i, cem-i müzekker-i sâlime ilhak edilerek harflerle i'rab edilir; bazen harekelerle de i'rab edilmiştir. (السنة) ayrıca kuraklık ve kıtlık demektir; bundan türeterek «أسنت القوم» (kavim kuraklığa ve kıtlığa uğradı) demişlerdir.
(يَطَّيَّرُوا): Aslı (يتطيروا)dir; tâ, tâ'ya (ط) mahreçte yakın olduğu için ona idğam edilmiştir. Lügat sözlüklerinde belirtildiği üzere «tetayyür» uğursuzluk saymaktır. Aslı, malın kavim arasında dağıtılıp uçurulması, böylece herkese payının ve kendisine ait olanın uçmasıdır; sonra galebe yoluyla kötü bahta ve kötü nasibe ad olmuştur.

* İ'rab:
(وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِينَ): (الواو) isti'nâfiyye; cümle isti'nâfiyyedir; onların helâk edilişinin keyfiyetini ve ondan önceki olayları tafsile başlamak için sevk edilmiştir. (اللام) mahzûf bir kasemin cevabı (lâmı)dır; (قد) tahkîk harfi; (أخذنا) fiil ve fâil; (آل فرعون) mef'ûlün bih; (بالسنين) câr ve mecrûr olup (أخذنا)ya müteallik.

(وَنَقْصٍ مِنَ الثَّمَراتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ): (الواو) atıf harfi; (نقص) (السنين)e ma'tûf; (من الثمرات) câr ve mecrûr olup (نقص)a müteallik. Kastedilen, mahsulün çeşitli âfetlerle telef edilmesidir. (لعلّ) ve ismi; (يذكرون) cümlesi onun haberidir; (لعلهم يتذكرون) cümlesi hâliyyedir [Mütercim notu: Metinde burada «يتذكرون» yazılıdır; âyetteki lafız «يذّكّرون»dur].

(فَإِذا جاءَتْهُمُ الْحَسَنَةُ قالُوا: لَنا هذِهِ): (الفاء) atıf harfi; (إذا) şart mânâsını içeren gelecek zaman zarfıdır; (جاءتهم الحسنة) cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir; kastedilen, onlara isabet eden bolluk ve bereket hâlidir. (قالوا) cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır. (لنا) câr ve mecrûr olup öne alınmış mahzûf habere müteallik; (هذه) ism-i işaret olup ref' mahallinde sona bırakılmış mübtedâdır; isim cümlesi onların sözünün mekûlü olarak nasb mahallindedir.

(وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَطَّيَّرُوا بِمُوسى وَمَنْ مَعَهُ): (الواو) atıf harfi; (إن) şart harfi; (تصبهم) fiilü'ş-şart; (الهاء) mef'ûlün bih; (سيئة) fâil; (يطيروا) cevâbü'ş-şart; (بموسى) câr ve mecrûr olup (يطّيّروا)ya müteallik; (من) (موسى)ya ma'tûf; (معه) mekân zarfı olup i'rabdan mahalli olmayan mahzûf bir kelimeye müteallik, çünkü sıladır.

(أَلا إِنَّما طائِرُهُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ): (ألا) istiftâh ve tenbîh edatı; (إنما) kâffe ve mekfûfe; (طائرهم) mübtedâ; (عند الله) mekân zarfı olup mahzûf habere müteallik. Cümle isti'nâfiyyedir; Allah Teâlâ tarafından onların iddialarını [Mütercim notu: Metinde «اقتنائهم» (edinmeleri) yazılı; muhtemelen «افترائهم» (iftiraları) veya benzeri bir kelimenin tashifidir] reddetmek ve başlarına gelenin, O'nun katında kayıtlı kötü amellerine tam uygun bir ceza olduğunu bildirmek için sevk edilmiştir.

(وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لا يَعْلَمُونَ): (الواو) hâl vâvı; (لكنّ) ve ismi; cümle hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir; (لا يعلمون) cümlesi (لكنّ)nin haberidir.

(وَقالُوا: مَهْما تَأْتِنا بِهِ مِنْ آيَةٍ لِتَسْحَرَنا بِها): (الواو) atıf harfi; (قالوا) fiil ve fâil; (مهما) ref' mahallinde mübtedâ olan, cezmeden şart ismidir; (تأتنا) fiilü'ş-şart ve mef'ûlün bih; (به) câr ve mecrûr olup (تأتنا)ya müteallik; (من آية) câr ve mecrûr olup mahzûf bir hâle müteallik. (لتسحرنا): (اللام) ta'lîl içindir; (تسحرنا) ta'lîl lâmından sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir; (نا) mef'ûlün bih; câr ve mecrûr — «ta'lîl lâmı ve ondan sonraki müevvel masdar» — (تأتنا)ya müteallik; (بها) câr ve mecrûr olup (تسحرنا)ya müteallik.

(فَما نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ): (الفاء) şartın cevabına bağlayan (râbıta) fâdır; (ما) Hicazlılara göre (amel eden) nefy harfidir; (نحن) onun ismi [Mütercim notu: Metinde «ونحن واسمها» yazılı; «ونحن اسمها» kastedilmiştir]; (لك) câr ve mecrûr olup (مؤمنين)e müteallik; (الباء) zâid cer harfi; (مؤمنين) lafzen mecrûr, mahallen mansûbdur, çünkü «ما»nın haberidir. Cümle şartın cevabı olarak cezm mahallindedir; fiilü'ş-şart ve cevabından oluşan cümle (مهما)nın haberidir.

* Belâgat:
(الحسنة)nin marife, (السيئة)nin nekre getirilmesinde meânî ilminin sanatlarından şaşırtıcı bir sanat vardır. Zira (الحسنة), çokça vuku bulduğu ve (ilâhî) iradenin onun meydana gelmesine taalluk ettiği için marife getirilmiş ve tahkîk edatıyla birlikte zikredilmiştir; (السيئة) ise nadir olduğu ve ancak tebaî olarak kastedildiği için nekre getirilmiş ve şek harfiyle getirilmiştir. (الحسنة) ile (السيئة) arasında da güzel bir tıbâk vardır.

* Fevâid:
1- Tıyere (uğursuzluk sayma): Lügat bölümünde tıyerenin lügat mânâsını zikrettik. Sonra psikologlar ona yerleşik bir mânâ üzerinde ıstılah yapmışlar; onu, sinirlerin zayıflığından ve bozukluğundan doğan korku hastalıkları kolundan bir hastalık saymışlardır. Ancak o, kendine has sebepleri ve belirtileri olan özel bir korkudur; bunların ilki sinir zayıflığıdır. Sağlıklı adam ne uğursuzluk sayar ne de kötümserliğe düşer; çünkü dünyadan hayır bekler, onunla kendisi arasında bir nefret hissetmez; bu yüzden ondan korku da uğursuzluk duygusu da hissetmez. Tıyereyi, arızî şartların ve geçici ümitsizlik ve kötümserlik hâllerine uygun bir atmosferin doğurduğu geçici bir kötümserlik olarak da kabul edebiliriz; bir de bakarsın ki uğursuzluk sayan kişi, kötülük vuku bulmadan önce ondan korkuyu peşin olarak yaşamaktadır.

Uğursuzluk şairi İbnü'r-Rûmî:
Tıyereyle şöhret bulmuş şairlerimizden biri İbnü'r-Rûmî'dir. O, ruhunun derinliklerinden çok korkak ve çok temkinli olduğunu hissederdi; aynı zamanda temkininin, başına gelmesi takdir edilmiş olanı kendisinden def etmeyeceğini de hissederdi. Fakat yine de, ona sarılmak, kaybolan güveni ve titreyen kaygıyı hissetmek için ondan başka çare olmadığını düşünürdü:
فآمن ما يكون المرء يوما ... إذا لبس الحذار من الخطوب
(İnsanın bir gün en emniyette olduğu an, felaketlere karşı temkini giyindiği andır.)
Bazı eleştirmenler, İbnü'r-Rûmî'deki tıyerenin kaynaklarından birinin güzellik zevki ve tedâî-i efkâr (çağrışım) olduğunu düşünürler.
