Şöyle ki: Güzelliği tatmaya yatkın yaratılmış nefis, cezbedici ve büyüleyici manzaralar karşısında sevinir ve coşar; aksine çirkin ve biçimsiz manzaralardan ürker ve daralır. Tedâî-i efkâra gelince, sahibi dürtülerin avı, haklı bir gerekçesi olmayan te'villerin hedefidir; fısıldanan kelimelerden veya ansızın gelen düşüncelerden, insanın sakındığı ve korktuğu şeyler çıkarır. Nitekim İbnü'r-Rûmî, hastalığı sırasında dostu Ca'fer'i uğursuz saymış, fakat hastalıktan önce onu uğursuz saymamıştı. İddiası şuydu: «جعفر» (Ca'fer) ismi «جوع» (açlık) ve «فرار» (kaçış) kelimelerinden türemiştir. «خان» (han) da ona «خيانة»yı (hıyaneti) hatırlatıyordu: فكم خان سفر خان فانقضّ فوقهم ... كما انقضّ صقر الدجن فوق الأرانب
(Nice han, yolculara hıyanet etti de üzerlerine çöktü; bulutlu günün şahininin tavşanların üzerine çöktüğü gibi.)
Kâtip İbn Tâlib hakkında da şöyle demiştir:
وهل أشبه المرّيخ إلا وفعله ... لفعل نذير السوء شبه مقارب
وهل يتمارى الناس في شؤم كاتب ... لعينيه لون السيف والسيف قاصب
ويدعى أبوه طالبا وكفاكم ... به طيرة أن المنيّة طالب
ألا فاهربوا من طالب وابن طالب ... فمن طالب مثليهما طار هارب
(O Merih'e benzedi ve işi kötülük habercisinin işine pek yakındır. Gözleri kılıç renginde olan bir kâtibin uğursuzluğunda insanlar hiç şüpheye düşer mi? Kılıç ise keser. Babasına «Tâlib» (arayan) denir; ölümün de bir «tâlib» olması size uğursuzluk olarak yeter. Haydi, Tâlib'den ve İbn Tâlib'den kaçın; bu ikisinin benzerlerini arayandan kaçan kişi uçarcasına kaçar.)
Hadiste, Hz. Peygamber (s.a.v.)'in fe'li (iyi fal) sevdiği ve tıyereden hoşlanmadığı bildirilir. Merfû olarak şöyle rivayet edilmiştir: «إذا ظننتم فلا تحققوا، ... وإذا تطيرتم فامضوا وعلى الله فتوكلوا» (Zannettiğinizde (zannınızı) gerçek saymayın, … uğursuz saydığınızda yolunuza devam edin ve Allah'a tevekkül edin.) Uğursuzluk sayanların tuhaflıklarından biri de şöyle rivayet edilendir: Halifelerden birinin zamanında yıldızlar kaydı; o bundan uğursuzluk çıkardı, müneccimleri ve âlimleri huzuruna getirtti; hiçbir cevap veremediler. Bunun üzerine bir şair şöyle dedi:
هذي النجوم تساقطت ... لرجوم أعداء الأمير
(Bu yıldızlar, emîrin düşmanlarını taşlamak için kaydı.)
Halife bundan hayra yordu ve ona değerli bir ihsan verilmesini emretti.

2- «مهما» hakkındaki söz: Sîbeveyh dedi ki: Halîl'e «مهما»yı sordum; dedi ki: O, kendisine «ما»nın eklendiği «ما»dır; fakat aynı lafzın tekrarını çirkin buldular ve birincisindeki elifin yerine hâyı bedel getirdiler. Bazı âlimler onun harf olduğuna Züheyr b. Ebî Sülmâ'nın şu sözüyle istidlal etmişlerdir:
ومهما تكن عند امرئ من خليقة ... وإن خالها تخفى على الناس تعلم
(Bir kişide hangi huy bulunursa, onun insanlardan gizli kalacağını sansa bile, bilinir.)
Bunlar «خليقة»yı (تكن)in ismi, «من»i zâid olarak i'rab etmişlerdir; böylece fiilin zamirden hâlî olması gerekmiş ve «مهما»nın i'rabdan mahalli kalmamıştır; çünkü ona ancak mübtedâlık yakışır, mübtedâlık ise râbıt bulunmadığı için mümkün değildir. Onun i'rabda bir mevkii olmadığı sabit olunca harf olması gerekmiştir. Tahkîk şudur: (تكن)in ismi müstetirdir; (من خليقة) «مهما»nın tefsiridir; «مهما» mübtedâ, cümle de haberdir. Âyette «به» ve «بها»daki iki zamir «مهما»ya râcidir; ancak biri lafza göre müzekker, diğeri mânâya göre müennes getirilmiştir; çünkü o, «âyet» mânâsındadır.
Zemahşerî'nin inkâr ettiği şey, yani «مهما»nın zaman zarfı olarak gelmesi [Mütercim notu: Metinde «من أن «هما» لا تأتي ظرف كان» şeklinde bozuk yazılmıştır; bağlamdan kastın «مهما»nın zaman zarfı olarak gelmesi olduğu anlaşılmaktadır], İbn Mâlik'in gittiği görüştür. Bunu et-Teshîl'de ve diğer eserlerinde zikretmiştir; ancak onun delâletini zaman zarfı olmakla sınırlamamış, bilakis "«ما» ve «مهما» bazen zaman zarfı olarak gelir." demiştir. eş-Şâfiye el-Kâfiye adlı uzun recez manzumesinde de şöyle demiştir:
وقد أتت مهما وما ظرفين في ... شواهد من يعتضد بها كفى
(«مهما» ve «ما», zarf olarak bazı şâhidlerde gelmiştir; onlarla destek arayana (bunlar) yeter.)
Beytin şerhinde de şöyle demiştir: Bütün nahivciler «ما» ve «مهما»yı zarflıktan soyutlanmış olmakta «من» gibi kabul ederler; hâlbuki bunların zarf olarak kullanılması fasih Arapların kullanımında sabittir. Araplardan, «ما» ve «مهما»nın zaman zarfı olduğunu iddia ettiği bazı beyitler nakletmiştir. Ona reddiye konusunda oğlu Şeyh Bedreddîn b. Muhammed bize yetmiştir. Biz de bunların bazısını te'vil ettik ve bunu kendi telifimiz olan "et-Tekmîl li-Şerhi't-Teshîl" kitabında zikrettik [Mütercim notu: Bu pasaj Ebû Hayyân'ın el-Bahrü'l-muhît'inden yapılmış bir nakildir; «biz» ve «telifimiz» ifadeleri Ebû Hayyân'a aittir]. Bütün nahivcilerden kendi söylediğinin aksini nakletmesi ona reddiye olarak yeter. Fakat bir ilimle uğraşan kişinin hocaların önünde diz çökmesi gerekir. Âyetteki «مهما»yı zaman zarfı olarak tefsir edene gelince, o, Zemahşerî'nin dediği gibi Allah'ın âyetleri hakkında ilhâda (sapmaya) düşen kişidir.
Zemahşerî'nin ifadesi şöyledir:
"Bu kelime, Arap dili ilminde eli olmayanın tahrif ettiği, onu yerinin dışına koyduğu kelimeler arasındadır. O, «مهما»yı «متى ما» mânâsında sanır ve «مهما جئتني أعطيتك» der. Bu onun kendi uydurmasıdır; Arap dilini vaz edenlerin sözünden hiçbir şey değildir. Sonra gidip «مهما تأتني به من آية» sözünü vakit mânâsıyla tefsir eder; böylece farkında olmadan Allah'ın âyetleri hakkında ilhâda düşer. Bu ve benzerleri, Sîbeveyh'in kitabına bakan önünde diz çökmeyi gerektiren şeylerdendir."

* Vocabulary:
(السنون): the plural of سنة (year), which is twelve months. It is pluralised as سنين, سنوات and سنهات; its diminutive is سنيّة, سنينة and سنيهة; the relative adjective derived from it is سنويّ and سنهيّ. The plural is declined with letters (wāw/yāʾ and nūn), by analogy with the sound masculine plural, and it is sometimes declined with vowel marks. سنة also means drought and famine, and verbs have been derived from it: they said أسنت القوم, meaning "the people suffered drought and famine".
(يَطَّيَّرُوا): the original form is يتطيروا; the tāʾ was assimilated into the ṭāʾ because they are close in articulation. التطيّر, as in the lexicons, means pessimism, taking evil omens. Its origin is that wealth was distributed and "flew" (yaṭīr) among the people, so that each one's share and portion "flew" to him; the word was then applied predominantly to an evil share and lot.

* I'rab:
(وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِينَ): The wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, introduced to begin the detailed account of how they were destroyed and of the events that preceded it. The lām is the lām of an omitted oath (the answer to an omitted oath), and قد is a particle of certainty. أخذنا is a verb and agent; آل فرعون is the direct object (mafʿūl bihi); بالسنين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخذنا. (وَنَقْصٍ مِنَ الثَّمَراتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ): The wāw is a conjunction; نقص is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السنين; من الثمرات is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نقص — what is meant is the destruction of the harvest by various blights. لعل and its noun; the clause يذكرون is its predicate; the clause لعلهم يتذكرون is circumstantial (ḥāl). (فَإِذا جاءَتْهُمُ الْحَسَنَةُ قالُوا: لَنا هذِهِ): The fāʾ is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb of the future containing the sense of a condition; the clause جاءتهم الحسنة is in the position of a genitive as the second term of an annexation (muḍāf ilayhi) — what is meant is the ease and fertility that befell them; the clause قالوا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional; لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted predicate; هذه is a demonstrative in the position of nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ; and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as the content of their saying (maqūl qawlihim). (وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَطَّيَّرُوا بِمُوسى وَمَنْ مَعَهُ): The wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; تصبهم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the هاء being the direct object, and سيئة the agent; يطيروا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); بموسى is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يطّيّروا; من is conjoined to موسى; معه is an adverb of place attached to an omitted element, which has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. (أَلا إِنَّما طائِرُهُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ): ألا is a particle of opening and alerting; إنما is a restricting particle (kāffa) together with the restricted one (makfūfa); طائرهم is the mubtadaʾ; عند الله is an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar; and the clause is resumptive, uttered by Him, Exalted is He, in rebuttal of their claim [Translator's note: the source prints «اقتنائهم» (their acquiring), apparently a corruption; "claim" is a conjectural reading], and to state that what befell them is a just recompense for their evil deeds recorded with Him. (وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لا يَعْلَمُونَ): The wāw is circumstantial; لكن and its noun; the clause is accusative as a ḥāl, and the clause لا يعلمون is the predicate of لكنّ. (وَقالُوا: مَهْما تَأْتِنا بِهِ مِنْ آيَةٍ لِتَسْحَرَنا بِها): The wāw is a conjunction; قالوا is a verb and agent; مهما is a jussive-conditional noun in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ; تأتنا is the protasis, with its direct object; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تأتنا; من آية is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; لتسحرنا: the lām is the lām of purpose, and تسحرنا is an imperfect verb put in the accusative by an implied أن after the lām of purpose, with نا as its direct object; the preposition and its genitive noun «the lām of purpose and the interpreted maṣdar after it» are attached to تأتنا; and بها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تسحرنا. (فَما نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ): The fāʾ links to the apodosis; ما is a negative in the Ḥijāzī manner (working like laysa); نحن and its noun; لك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مؤمنين; the bāʾ is a redundant preposition, and مؤمنين is genitive in form but accusative in position because it is the predicate of «ما». The clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the predicate of مهما.

* Rhetoric:
In the definiteness of الحسنة and the indefiniteness of سيئة there is a wondrous art among the arts of the science of meanings (ʿilm al-maʿānī). He made الحسنة definite and mentioned it with the particle of certainty because of how frequently it occurs and because the will is bound to bringing it about, whereas He made سيئة indefinite and brought it with a particle of doubt because of its rarity and because it is not intended, except incidentally. Between الحسنة and السيئة there is a beautiful antithesis (ṭibāq).

* Benefits:
1- Superstition (al-ṭiyara): We gave the lexical sense of الطِّيَرة in the Vocabulary section. Psychologists then settled on a more established meaning for it, regarding it as an illness belonging to the branch of fear-disorders arising from weakness and disorder of the nerves, though it is a particular fear with its own causes and symptoms, the first of which is weakness of the nerves. The healthy man does not take omens or pessimistic views, because he expects good from the world and feels no estrangement between himself and it, and hence he feels no fear of it and no superstition about it. One may regard ṭiyara as a temporary pessimism summoned by sudden circumstances and by an atmosphere suited to passing states of despair and gloom, so that the superstitious man borrows in advance the terror of an evil before it happens.

Ibn al-Rūmī, the poet of superstition:
Among our poets famous for superstition was Ibn al-Rūmī. He felt deep within himself that he was a timid, wary man, and at the same time felt that his wariness did not ward off from him what was intended for him; yet he saw that he had no alternative to holding fast to it, and so that he might feel the security that had gone and the trembling anxiety:
فآمن ما يكون المرء يوما ... إذا لبس الحذار من الخطوب
(The man is safest on any day when he has put on wariness against misfortunes.)
Some critics see among the tributaries of superstition in Ibn al-Rūmī a taste for beauty and the association of ideas. The soul that is naturally disposed to savour beauty rejoices and exults at enticing, captivating sights, and conversely recoils and contracts at ugly, deformed ones. As for the association of ideas, its possessor is prey to impulses, exposed to groundless interpretations, drawing from whispered words or passing thoughts matters against which a man is wary and which he fears. Ibn al-Rūmī used to take his friend Jaʿfar as an ill omen during his illness, though he did not do so before the illness. He claimed that Jaʿfar was derived from "hunger" (jūʿ) and "flight" (firār), and that «al-khān» (the inn) reminded him of betrayal (khiyāna):
فكم خان سفر خان فانقضّ فوقهم ... كما انقضّ صقر الدجن فوق الأرانب
(How many travellers did the inn betray, for it swooped down upon them as the falcon of the overcast day swoops upon hares.)
He said about Ibn Ṭālib the scribe:
وهل أشبه المرّيخ إلا وفعله ... لفعل نذير السوء شبه مقارب
وهل يتمارى الناس في شؤم كاتب ... لعينيه لون السيف والسيف قاصب
ويدعى أبوه طالبا وكفاكم ... به طيرة أن المنيّة طالب
ألا فاهربوا من طالب وابن طالب ... فمن طالب مثليهما طار هارب
(Is he like Mars except that his deed closely resembles the deed of the herald of evil? Do people doubt the ill omen of a scribe whose eyes have the colour of the sword, and the sword is cutting? His father is called Ṭālib ("seeker") — and that is omen enough for you, that death is a seeker. So flee from Ṭālib and the son of Ṭālib; whoever is sought by the likes of those two flies away in flight.)
In the ḥadīth, the Prophet ﷺ liked good omens (al-fāl) and disliked superstition (al-ṭiyara). It is related with a raised chain: "When you suspect, do not verify, ... and when you take an ill omen, go ahead and put your trust in Allah." Among the curious tales of the superstitious is what is told that stars fell in the time of one of the caliphs, and he took it as an ill omen. He summoned the astrologers and the scholars, but they gave no answer. Then a poet said:
هذي النجوم تساقطت ... لرجوم أعداء الأمير
(These stars have fallen to stone the enemies of the emir.)
So he took it as a good omen and ordered a splendid gift for him.
2- What is said about مهما: Sībawayh said: I asked al-Khalīl about «مهما» and he said: It is «ما» with another «ما» added to it, but they found the repetition of a single word ugly, so they replaced the first one's alif with a hāʾ. Some scholars have argued that it is a particle, from the saying of Zuhayr ibn Abī Sulmā:
ومهما تكن عند امرئ من خليقة ... وإن خالها تخفى على الناس تعلم
(Whatever trait a man may have, even if he thinks it hidden from people, becomes known.)
These scholars parse «خليقة» as the noun of تكن, with من redundant, so the verb is necessarily devoid of a pronoun, and «مهما» has no grammatical position, since only the position of mubtadaʾ would suit it, and that is impossible for want of a link (rābiṭ); and when it is established that it has no position, it must be a particle. The truth is that the noun of تكن is latent, «من خليقة» is an explanation of مهما, مهما is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the khabar. In the verse the two pronouns in «به» and «بها» both refer to مهما, except that one is masculine according to the form of the word and the other feminine according to the meaning, because it has the sense of the verse (āya).
What al-Zamakhsharī denied — that «مهما» is not used as an adverb of time — was held by Ibn Mālik, who mentioned it in al-Tashīl and in his other works. He did not, however, restrict its meaning to an adverb of time; rather he said: «ما» and «مهما» may occur as adverbs of time. In his long rajaz poem called al-Shāfiya al-Kāfiya he said:
وقد أتت مهما وما ظرفين في ... شواهد من يعتضد بها كفى
(Both «مهما» and «ما» have occurred as adverbs in attestations; whoever relies on them is satisfied.)
In his commentary on the verse he said: All the grammarians make «ما» and «مهما» like «من» in being free of adverbial use, although their use as adverbs is established in the usage of the eloquent Arabs. He recited verses from the Arabs in which he claimed that «ما» and «مهما» are two adverbs of time. His son, the Shaykh Badr al-Dīn ibn Muḥammad, has spared us the refutation of him; we ourselves have also interpreted some of them differently and mentioned that in our book al-Takmīl li-Sharḥ al-Tashīl. It is enough of a refutation that he himself related, from all the grammarians, the opposite of what he said; but whoever practises a science needs to stand before the shaykhs. As for whoever explained «مهما» in the verse as an adverb of time, he is, as al-Zamakhsharī said, an impious deviator concerning the verses of Allah.
[Translator's note: the source text reads «هما» here, where «مهما» is evidently meant; the translation follows what is written.]
The words of al-Zamakhsharī:
"This word is among the words distorted by one who has no hand in the science of Arabic, who puts it in the wrong place and supposes «مهما» to mean «متى ما» and says «مهما جئتني أعطيتك» ('whenever you come to me I will give you'). That is his own invention and is not at all from the speech of the founders of Arabic. Then he goes and explains «مهما تأتني به من آية» with the meaning of time, and so he deviates impiously concerning the verses of Allah without realising it. This and its like make it necessary to kneel before the student of Sībawayh's book."

* Lügat:
(مُتَبَّرٌ): kırılıp parçalanmış demektir. (تبر)dan ism-i mef'ûldür; yani tahrip etti ve helâk etti; masdarı «التتبير»dir. «التبر» da bundandır; o, altın kırıntısıdır; insanların onun üzerine düşüp helâk olmaları sebebiyle (bu adı almıştır).

* İ'rab:
(إِنَّ هؤُلاءِ مُتَبَّرٌ ما هُمْ فِيهِ): İsti'nâfiyye bir sözdür; onların varacakları akıbeti beyan için sevk edilmiştir. (إنّ) fiile benzeyen harf; (هؤلاء) ism-i işaret olup (إنّ)nin ismi. (متبر)ın (إنّ)nin haberi olması caizdir; (ما) ism-i mevsûl olup (متبر)ın nâib-i fâili olarak ref' mahallindedir; (هم فيه) mübtedâ ve haber; cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü sıladır. Mevsûlün mübtedâ, (متبر)ın onun öne alınmış haberi, cümlenin de (إنّ)nin haberi olması da caizdir.

(وَباطِلٌ ما كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ): (الواو) atıf harfi; (باطل) öne alınmış haber; (ما) sona bırakılmış mübtedâ; (كانوا يعملون) — (كان), ismi ve haberi — «ما»nın sılasıdır. «باطل»i «متبر»a atfetmen ve «ما»yı «باطل»in fâili yapman da caizdir, çünkü o ism-i fâildir.

(قالَ: أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْغِيكُمْ إِلهاً): İsti'nâfiyye bir sözdür; ibadetin yalnız O'na tahsis edilmesini gerektiren Allah'ın işlerini beyana başlamak için sevk edilmiştir. (الهمزة) inkârî ve tevbîhî istifhâm içindir; (غير) mahzûf bir fiilin mef'ûlün bihidir, yani: «أأطلب لكم معبودا غير المستحق للعبادة؟» (Size, ibadete müstahak olandan başka bir mabud mu arayayım?). (أبغيكم) cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl; (إلها) temyîz veya hâldir. «غير»in (أبغيكم)in öne alınmış mef'ûlü olması da caizdir; (الكاف) nez'u'l-hâfıd ile mansûbdur, yani:
«أأبغي لكم غير الله؟» (Size Allah'tan başkasını mı arayayım?). Bu vecihte «غير»i hâl olarak i'rab etmek ve (إلها)yı mef'ûlün bih yapmak da caizdir.

(وَهُوَ فَضَّلَكُمْ عَلَى الْعالَمِينَ): (الواو) hâl vâvı; (هو) mübtedâ; (فضلكم) cümlesi haber; cümlenin tamamı hâliyyedir. (على العالمين) câr ve mecrûr olup (فضلكم)e müteallik. (الواو)ın isti'nâf için olması, cümlenin de i'rabdan mahalli olmayan isti'nâfiyye cümle olması da caizdir.

(وَإِذْ أَنْجَيْناكُمْ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ): (الواو) atıf veya isti'nâfiyyedir; (إذ) mahzûf bir fiilin mef'ûlün bihidir; takdiri: «اذكروا وقت أنجيناكم» (sizi kurtardığımız vakti hatırlayın). (أنجيناكم) cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir. (من آل) câr ve mecrûr olup (أنجيناكم)a müteallik; (فرعون) muzâfun ileyh olup mecrûrdur; gayr-i munsarif olduğu için cer alâmeti fethadır.

(يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذابِ): Cümle (آل فرعون)dan hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir. (يسومونكم) muzâri fiil, fâil ve birinci mef'ûlün bih; (سوء العذاب) ikinci mef'ûlün bihtir.

(يُقَتِّلُونَ أَبْناءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِساءَكُمْ): (يقتلون) cümlesi [Mütercim notu: Metinde «يقتلونكم» yazılı; âyetteki lafız «يقتّلون»dur] (يسومونكم) cümlesinden bedeldir; (يستحيون نساءكم) ona ma'tûf bir cümledir.

(وَفِي ذلِكُمْ بَلاءٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ): (الواو) hâl vâvı veya isti'nâfiyyedir; (في ذلكم) câr ve mecrûr olup öne alınmış mahzûf habere müteallik; (بلاء) sona bırakılmış mübtedâ; (من ربكم) câr ve mecrûr olup (بلاء)nın sıfatı olan mahzûf bir kelimeye müteallik; (عظيم) ikinci sıfattır.

* I'rab:
(وَواعَدْنا مُوسى ثَلاثِينَ لَيْلَةً وَأَتْمَمْناها بِعَشْرٍ): The wāw is resumptive, and the speech is resumptive, brought to give in detail what He stated summarily in Sūrat al-Baqara, namely His saying, Exalted is He: «وإذ واعدنا موسى أربعين ليلة». واعدنا موسى is a verb, agent and direct object; ثلاثين is a second direct object of واعدنا, and in it there is an omitted muḍāf, its implied form being "the completion of thirty"; ليلة is a specification; and that was so that he might fast them until We spoke to him. أتممناها is conjoined to واعدنا; بعشر is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أتممناها. (فَتَمَّ مِيقاتُ رَبِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً): The fāʾ is a conjunction; تم ميقات is a verb and agent; ربه is muḍāf ilayhi; أربعين is a ḥāl, i.e. "it was completed, reaching this number"; ليلة is a specification. The reason for its being accusative as a ḥāl will come in the Benefits section. It was also said that it is the object of «تم» because its meaning is «reached»; and it cannot be an adverb for the completion, because the completion occurs only with the last part of those periods of time. (وَقالَ مُوسى لِأَخِيهِ هارُونَ): The wāw is a conjunction; قال موسى is a verb and agent; لأخيه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قال. هارون is a substitute (badal) for أخيه or an explicative apposition (ʿaṭf bayān). (اخْلُفْنِي فِي قَوْمِي وَأَصْلِحْ وَلا تَتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ): The clause is the content of Moses' saying; اخلفني is an imperative and direct object; في قومي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اخلفني; أصلح is conjoined to اخلفني; in ولا تتبع the wāw is a conjunction, لا is prohibitive, and تتبع is an imperfect verb jussive by the prohibitive لا; سبيل المفسدين is the direct object. (وَلَمَّا جاءَ مُوسى لِمِيقاتِنا): The wāw is a conjunction; لما is a linking or temporal particle containing the sense of a condition; the clause جاء موسى has no position, or is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; لميقاتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاء, the lām being for specification, as when you say: "I came to him on the tenth that had passed of the month". (وَكَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ قالَ: رَبِّ أَرِنِي أَنْظُرْ إِلَيْكَ): وكلمه ربه is conjoined to جاء, and ربه is the agent of كلمه. The clause قال has no position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional; رب is a vocative in a construct (muḍāf) from which the vocative particle is omitted; أرني is an imperative of supplication, its agent latent, the nūn being the protective nūn and the yāʾ the first direct object, while the second object of the seeing is omitted, its implied form being "Yourself"; أنظر is a jussive imperfect because it is the answer to a request, and the clause of the request and its answer is the content of the saying; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنظر. (قالَ لَنْ تَرانِي): The clause is the content of the saying; لن is a particle of negation, accusative-causing and futurity; تراني is an imperfect verb put in the accusative by لن, and the yāʾ is the direct object. (وَلكِنِ انْظُرْ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ اسْتَقَرَّ مَكانَهُ فَسَوْفَ تَرانِي): The wāw is a conjunction; لكن is a particle of rectification, lightened and inoperative; انظر is an imperative; إلى الجبل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to انظر; فإن: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إن is conditional; استقر is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis; مكانه is an adverb of place attached to استقر; فسوف: the fāʾ links to the apodosis, and سوف is a particle of futurity; تراني is an imperfect verb, and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. (فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّى رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ دَكًّا): The fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is a linking or temporal particle; تجلى ربه is a verb and agent; للجبل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجلى; جعله is a verb and direct object, and the clause has no position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional; دكا is the second direct object of جعله, since it is a maṣdar with the meaning of a passive participle, i.e. "crushed" (madkūk); it may also be accusative as a maṣdar, the implied form being "He crushed it a crushing". (وَخَرَّ مُوسى صَعِقاً): صعقا is a ḥāl. (فَلَمَّا أَفاقَ قالَ: سُبْحانَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ): The fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is a linking or temporal particle; the clause أفاق has no position, or is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause قال has no position; سبحانك is an absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq) of an omitted verb; تبت is a verb and agent; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تبت; وأنا: the wāw is a conjunction, and أنا is a mubtadaʾ; أول المؤمنين is the khabar.

* Benefits:
The vision of Allah in the Hereafter:
Al-Zamakhsharī and others among the imams of the Muʿtazila argued from «لن» for the impossibility of seeing Allah, Exalted is He, in the Hereafter [Translator's note: the source prints «في الآخر»], saying that it is for emphasis and perpetuity. The scholars of the Sunna answered them, and a long dispute arose about this, which drew into mutual disparagement and the hurling at one another of harsh reckonings and accusations, matters for which our book has no room. So refer to the longer works for it.

* I'rab:
(قالَ: يا مُوسى إِنِّي اصْطَفَيْتُكَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بِرِسالاتِي وَبِكَلامِي): Resumptive speech, brought to console Moses, peace be upon him, for what he missed of the vision. The vocative clause is in the position of accusative as the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن and its noun; the clause اصطفيتك is the khabar; على الناس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اصطفيتك; برسالاتي is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to اصطفيتك. He made الرسالة plural because that with which he was sent consisted of various kinds and sorts. وبكلامي is conjoined to برسالاتي. He put the message first to signal the ascent to the nobler, for speaking with him was a special distinction for him, and he repeated the preposition to signal that the choosing is distinct from the speaking. (فَخُذْ ما آتَيْتُكَ وَكُنْ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ): The fāʾ is the eloquent fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and the clause after it has no position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional; the clause آتيتك is the ṣila of «ما»; وكن من الشاكرين is conjoined to خذ; and من الشاكرين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of «كن». (وَكَتَبْنا لَهُ فِي الْأَلْواحِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ): The wāw is resumptive; كتبنا is a verb and agent; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كتبنا; في الألواح is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; and من كل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted direct object — what is meant is the tablets of the Torah. [Translator's note: the source reads «جاء ومجرور» here, evidently a slip for «جار ومجرور»; the translation follows the sense.] (مَوْعِظَةً وَتَفْصِيلًا لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ): موعظة is a substitute (badal) for the position of «من كل شيء», because it is a direct object, as preceded. It is also permissible to parse «موعظة» as an object of purpose, i.e. "We wrote for him those things for the sake of admonition and detailing"; ولكل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «تفصيلا» or an adjective of it. (فَخُذْها بِقُوَّةٍ وَأْمُرْ قَوْمَكَ يَأْخُذُوا بِأَحْسَنِها سَأُرِيكُمْ دارَ الْفاسِقِينَ): The fāʾ is the eloquent fāʾ, or a conjunction of an omitted clause to كتبنا, the implied form being "and We said: Take it"; خذ is an imperative and the hāʾ is the direct object. وبقوة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from the agent of خذها; the clause امر is conjoined to خذها; قومك is the direct object; and يأخذوا is a jussive imperfect because it is the answer to a request. He singled out "the best" for taking, though all that is in it is required, as an exaggeration in seeking out and taking well, and choosing the firmest and most precise; or else the comparative sense is not intended, as in their saying "Summer is hotter than winter", i.e. summer is more extreme in its heat than winter in its cold, so that preferring the heat of summer over the cold of winter is not intended. Since by «الأحسن» what is commanded was intended — being more extreme in goodness than what is forbidden is in ugliness — it followed that taking what is forbidden is not permitted. The clause سأريكم دار الفاسقين is resumptive, brought to emphasise the command to take the best and to urge it, and so it stands in the place of a reason; and what the shift of person (iltifāt) adds of emphasis and exaggeration to taking the best is not hidden. As for دار الفاسقين, it was said that it is the abode of Pharaoh and his followers, as something to take a lesson from, and it was said that it is something else, and there is no room for independent judgement here. (سَأَصْرِفُ عَنْ آياتِيَ الَّذِينَ يَتَكَبَّرُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ): Resumptive speech, brought to warn against arrogance, which turns minds away from true thinking. وعن آياتي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أصرف; الذين is a relative noun in the position of accusative as direct object; the clause يتكبرون is the ṣila; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتكبرون; بغير الحق is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from «الذين يتكبرون», i.e. "while they are bound up with a religion that is not the truth". (وَإِنْ يَرَوْا كُلَّ آيَةٍ لا يُؤْمِنُوا بِها): The wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; يروا is the protasis and the wāw is the agent; كل آية is the direct object; the clause لا يؤمنوا is the apodosis; بها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤمنوا. (وَإِنْ يَرَوْا سَبِيلَ الرُّشْدِ لا يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا): conjoined to what preceded; سبيلا is the second direct object. (وَإِنْ يَرَوْا سَبِيلَ الغَيِّ يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا): also conjoined to what preceded. (ذلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا وَكانُوا عَنْها غافِلِينَ): The demonstrative is in the position of nominative or accusative. Nominative, on the basis that it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the preposition and its genitive noun after it, i.e. "that turning away is because of their denial"; accusative, on the basis that it means "He turned them away with that very turning away", making it a maṣdar used as a direct object. In any case the clause is an initial one with no grammatical position; the clause كذبوا is the khabar of أن; بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كذبوا; كانوا is conjoined to كذبوا, and the wāw is the noun of كان; عنها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to غافلين; and غافلين is the khabar of كانوا.

* Rhetoric:
1- The shift of person (iltifāt) in His saying «سأريكم دار الفاسقين», to draw attention, as we mentioned earlier.
2- The antithesis (ṭibāq) between سبيل الرشد and سبيل الغيّ. And since the contrast between them is by negation, its beauty appears plainly.

* Vocabulary:
(حُلِيِّهِمْ): the plural of حلي, like ثدي and ثديّ. Its original form is حلويّ: the wāw and yāʾ came together with the first of them having a sukūn, so the wāw was changed into yāʾ and assimilated into the yāʾ, and the lām was given kasra because of the yāʾ. الحلي is a noun for what one adorns oneself with of gold and silver.
(خُوارٌ): with ḍamma on the khāʾ, as is the rule for the most part in names of sounds, either on the pattern فعال or فعيل, like زئير.

* I'rab:
(وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا وَلِقاءِ الْآخِرَةِ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمالُهُمْ): The wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, to show another kind of their disobedience and their presumption against Allah. The relative noun is in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ; the clause كذبوا بآياتنا is the ṣila; ولقاء الآخرة is conjoined to بآياتنا; and the clause حبطت أعمالهم is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. (هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا ما كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ): The hamza [Translator's note: the source reads «الهمزة»; the particle in the verse is «هل»] is interrogative, what is meant by it being negation, and for that reason «إلا» entered after it; يجزون is a passive imperfect verb and the wāw is the deputy agent; إلا is a particle of restriction; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the second direct object; the clause كانوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the clause يعملون is the khabar. I see no need to suppose an omitted element, as al-Wāḥidī said, whose text is: "Here an omitted element must be supposed, i.e. «إلا بما كانوا», or «على ما كانوا», or «جزاء ما كانوا»." I say: the corresponding recompense is clearer, so there is no need for this strained effort. (وَاتَّخَذَ قَوْمُ مُوسى مِنْ بَعْدِهِ مِنْ حُلِيِّهِمْ عِجْلًا جَسَداً لَهُ خُوارٌ): The wāw is resumptive, and the speech is resumptive, brought to recount another kind of their wrongdoing; it is also possible that the wāw be a conjunction, from the conjoining of one story to another. قوم موسى is the agent; من بعده is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اتخذ; من حليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اتخذ, or to an omitted element in the position of ḥāl, because had it been delayed it would have been an adjective, as is the rule. عجلا is the direct object; جسدا is a substitute (badal), and he brought this substitute to ward off the supposition that it was a carved image of a calf; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; خوار is a delayed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective of His saying «عجلا». (أَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّهُ لا يُكَلِّمُهُمْ وَلا يَهْدِيهِمْ سَبِيلًا): Resumptive speech, brought to rebuke them for their bad choice and for their persistence in riding the back of excess. The hamza is for an interrogative of denial; لم is a particle of negation, conversion and jussive; the wāw is the agent of يروا; أن and what is within its scope take the place of the two objects of يروا; the clause لا يكلمهم is the khabar; ولا يهديهم سبيلا is conjoined to لا يكلمهم; and سبيلا is the second direct object, or is accusative by removal of the preposition. (اتَّخَذُوهُ وَكانُوا ظالِمِينَ): A resumptive clause, brought to be an answer to a question arising from the flow of the speech, i.e. "How, then, did they take it?" The wāw is a conjunction; كان and its noun; and ظالمين is its khabar.

* Vocabulary:
(هُدْنا): we repented and returned from disobedience and came to You apologizing for it. It is from هاد يهود, "he returned". The root meaning of الهود is "returning gently", and from it the Jews (اليهود) were named. It was a name of praise before their law was abrogated; after that it became a name of blame that clings to them forever, by which they are labelled for all time. الهود is the plural of هائد, which means "one who repents". One of them said:
يا راكب الذّنب هدهد ... واسجد كأنك هدهد
(O you who ride sin, repent [hadhid]; and prostrate yourself as if you were a hoopoe [hudhud].)
He likened his clinging to sin to the rider's clinging to his mount, and likened the one prostrating to the hoopoe, because of how often it bows its head to the ground.
(الْأُمِّيَّ): ascribed to الأم (the mother), as though he remained in the state in which he was born. What is meant by it is the one who neither reads writing nor writes. This description is among the things peculiar to Muhammad ﷺ. It is also possible that the ascription is to الأمة (the nation), namely the Arab nation, because the Arabs neither reckon nor write. It is also possible that it is ascribed to الأم, the verbal noun of أمَّ يؤمُّ, that is "he aimed at, he sets out for"; the meaning on this view is: this noble Arab Prophet is the one whom everyone aims at. If it is asked: the ascription should have been أَمّيّ with fatḥa on the hamza, we say that this is one of the alterations that occur in nisba formations. More on this description will come in the section on benefits.
(الإصر): the heavy burden that binds (يأصر) its bearer, that is, holds him back from movement because of its weight. What is meant by الإصر here is the covenant and pledge taken from the Children of Israel to act according to the rulings of the Torah.
(الْأَغْلالَ): plural of غلّ; الغُلّ with ḍamma is a ring of iron placed on the neck.

* I'rab:
(وَاخْتارَ مُوسى قَوْمَهُ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلًا لِمِيقاتِنا): a resumptive speech, introduced to relate the story of those who did not worship the calf; Allah had commanded him to choose seventy of them. The details are in the longer works. اختار موسى is a verb and agent; قومه is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "from his people": the preposition was omitted and the verb reached it directly; سبعين is the direct object (mafʿūl bihi) of اختار. The discussion has already preceded about the verbs that govern two objects, one of them directly and the other by means of a preposition; these are restricted to what is heard from the Arabs, and they are: اختار, استغفر, أمر, كنى, دعا, زوّج and صدق. Then the preposition is omitted and the verb governs the noun directly. So you say: اخترت زيدا من الرجال and اخترت زيدا الرجال. The poet said:
اخترتك الناس إذ رثّت خلائقهم ... واعتلّ من كان يرجى عند السّول
(I chose you out of the people when their characters grew worn, and he who was hoped for at the time of asking fell ill.)
رجلا is a tamyīz (specification). لميقاتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "for the appointed time at which We promised that they would come, in order to apologize for the worship of the calf".
(فَلَمَّا أَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ): the فاء is a conjunction; لما is a connective (rābiṭa) or temporal; its i'rab has often preceded. أخذتهم الرجفة is a verb, direct object and agent.
(قالَ: رَبِّ لَوْ شِئْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَإِيَّايَ): the clause of speech is resumptive, to explain what Moses said. The clause of the vocative is in the position of accusative as the quoted speech (maqūl al-qawl). لو is conditional; شئت is a verb and agent, and the direct object is omitted, i.e. "if You had willed their destruction". أهلكتهم is a verb, agent and direct object, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional. من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أهلكتهم. إياي is a detached pronoun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the هاء.
(أَتُهْلِكُنا بِما فَعَلَ السُّفَهاءُ مِنَّا): the interrogative here means negation together with a plea for mercy, i.e. "It is not possible that You would punish us for what others than us did." Al-Mubarrad has a fine expression; he said: "What is meant by the interrogative is the interrogative of magnification" - as if he were saying (Moses knew that no one is destroyed for the sin of another, but it is of the kind of the saying of ʿĪsā: «إن تعذبهم فانهم عبادك»). تهلكنا is a verb, a latent agent and a direct object; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تهلكنا; ما is a relative or maṣdar (verbal noun) particle, i.e. "because of that which the fools did" or "because of the deed of the fools". منا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
(إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ): إن is negative; هي is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction; فتنتك, i.e. "Your trial", is the khabar (predicate).
(تُضِلُّ بِها مَنْ تَشاءُ وَتَهْدِي مَنْ تَشاءُ): the clause is a ḥāl, i.e. "causing to go astray by it and guiding". من is a relative noun in the position of accusative as direct object, and likewise the second «من».
(أَنْتَ وَلِيُّنا فَاغْفِرْ لَنا وَارْحَمْنا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْغافِرِينَ): أنت is the mubtadaʾ and ولينا the khabar. فاغفر: the فاء is the fāṣiḥa (the eloquent فاء, introducing the consequence of an omitted condition); اغفر is an imperative verb expressing supplication; لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اغفر; وارحمنا is conjoined to اغفر. وأنت: the واو is circumstantial or resumptive; أنت is the mubtadaʾ and خير الغافرين the khabar.
(وَاكْتُبْ لَنا فِي هذِهِ الدُّنْيا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ): واكتب is conjoined to فاغفر; لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اكتب; في هذه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; حسنة is the direct object; وفي الآخرة is conjoined to «في هذه الدنيا», and the first object suffices, i.e. "and in the Hereafter a good (reward)".
(إِنَّا هُدْنا إِلَيْكَ): the clause is resumptive, introduced to give the reason for the supplication, because that is among the things that make it deserve acceptance. إن and its noun; the clause هدنا إليك is the khabar of إن.
(قالَ عَذابِي أُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ أَشاءُ): the clause is resumptive, introduced to make known Allah's answer. عذابي is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause أصيب; or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ and the clause أصيب is a ḥāl. به is a preposition and its genitive noun; من is a relative noun, a direct object; the clause أشاء is the ṣila (relative clause).
(وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ): conjoined to the preceding clause.
(فَسَأَكْتُبُها لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكاةَ): the فاء is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, introduced to allude to his people; the سين is a particle of futurity; اكتبها [Translator's note: the source reads «واكتبها»] is a verb, a latent agent and a direct object; للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سأكتبها; the clause يتقون has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative; and the clause ويؤتون الزكاة is conjoined to the clause يتقون.
(وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِآياتِنا يُؤْمِنُونَ): والذين is conjoined to the preceding الذين; هم is the mubtadaʾ and the clause يؤمنون the khabar; بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤمنون; the nominal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative.
(الَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ الرَّسُولَ النَّبِيَّ الْأُمِّيَّ الَّذِي يَجِدُونَهُ مَكْتُوباً عِنْدَهُمْ فِي التَّوْراةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ): الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of الذين or a badal (substitute) for it; the clause يتبعون is the ṣila of the relative; الرسول is the direct object; النبي is the first adjective and الأمي the second adjective, and الذي the third adjective; the clause يجدونه has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative; مكتوبا is the second direct object of يجدونه; عندهم is an adverb attached to «مكتوبا»; and في التوراة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
(يَأْمُرُهُمْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهاهُمْ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ): the clause is a ḥāl; بالمعروف is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأمرهم; and ينهاهم عن المنكر is conjoined to the preceding clause.
(وَيُحِلُّ لَهُمُ الطَّيِّباتِ وَيُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْخَبائِثَ): conjoined to what preceded.
(وَيَضَعُ عَنْهُمْ إِصْرَهُمْ وَالْأَغْلالَ الَّتِي كانَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ): also conjoined; إصرهم is the direct object, and الأغلال is conjoined to إصرهم; التي is an adjective of الأغلال; the clause كانت عليهم is a ṣila; and عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of كانت.
(فَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِهِ وَعَزَّرُوهُ وَنَصَرُوهُ): the فاء is resumptive, and الذين is the mubtadaʾ; the clause آمنوا is a ṣila; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آمنوا; and عزروه and نصروه are conjoined to آمنوا.
(وَاتَّبَعُوا النُّورَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ مَعَهُ): واتبعوا is also conjoined; النور is the direct object; الذي is an adjective; the clause أنزل is a ṣila; and معه is an adverb of place attached to أنزل.
(أُولئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ): the nominal clause is the khabar of the relative noun; the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ; هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) or a second mubtadaʾ; and المفلحون is the khabar of أولئك, or the khabar of «هم», and the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك.

* Benefits:
The meaning of الأميّ:
We spoke at length in the section on vocabulary about the meaning of الأمّيّ, and we now ask with those who ask: did the Prophet know how to read and write? Most of the Orientalists say that the word «أمّيّ» with which the Prophet was described is obscure and does not indicate conclusively that he did not know how to read, and they consider it probable that it is an ascription to the word أمّة (nation), as we mentioned at the proper place.

The false rumours of the Encyclopaedia of Islam:
As for the Encyclopaedia of Islam, it raises another difficulty. In Sūrat al-ʿAnkabūt there is the verse: «وما كنت تتلو من قبله من كتاب ولا تخطه بيمينك إذا لارتاب المبطلون». It said: "It indicates that he learned to read in later life, that is, after the revelation of the Qur'an, although the expression is obscure."
It is clear that the expression is not obscure, but the interpretation the Encyclopaedia put forward is corrupt. The wording of the verse is perfectly explicit and perfectly clear - as will come at its proper place - and it indicates, without any ambiguity, that the people of Mecca knew before the revelation came to him that he did not recite any book and did not write with his right hand; had he been so, the falsifiers would have been in doubt, since they would have said that he used to retire by himself, write the Qur'an and prepare it, then go out to the people and recite it to them.
Another verse cited by the Encyclopaedia of Islam is: «وقالوا: أساطير الأولين اكتتبها فهي تملى عليه بكرة وأصيلا». Nothing of what they want to load onto this verse can be understood from it, for it simply indicates that the disbelievers of Quraysh claimed that the Messenger of Allah was writing down what was dictated to him of the tales of the ancients; and not everything the disbelievers claim is correct. Rather, this is an outright attack and a plain slander intended to discredit and to weaken the standing of the Qur'an. Perhaps the Qur'an itself undertook to expose these false rumours in the verse before it, which is: «وقال الذين كفروا إن هذا إلا إفك افتراه وأعانه عليه قوم آخرون فقد جاءوا ظلما وزورا، وقالوا: أساطير الأولين اكتتبها فهي تملى عليه بكرة وأصيلا، قل: أنزله الذي يعلم السر في السموات والأرض إنه كان غفورا رحيما».

Al-Bājī and the claim that he was not unlettered:
It is not only the Encyclopaedia of Islam and other books of the Orientalists that try to raise these doubts; hints touching on this subject are scattered in Muslim books too. Ibn Kathīr mentioned: "Whoever of the later jurists, such as the judge Abū al-Walīd al-Bājī and those who followed him, claimed that the Prophet, peace be upon him, wrote on the day of al-Ḥudaybiya: «هذا ما قاضى عليه محمد بن عبد الله», what led him to that was a report in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī: «ثم أخذ فكتب», and this is to be read in light of the other report: «ثم أمر فكتب». For this reason the denunciation of whoever said the saying of al-Bājī was severe, and they disowned him, recited verses on that subject and preached about it in their gatherings. Yet the decisive word in this is what came in the Qur'an itself: it affirmed in many places that the Qur'an was sent down upon the heart of the Messenger of Allah, and that he was charged with memorizing it, and that the Muslims were to memorize it, not to write it: «فإنه نزله على قلبك بإذن الله مصدّقا لما بين يديه». So the Prophet did not write what was revealed to him, and we do not know precisely how the Qur'an was written in the Meccan period.

The story of ʿUmar's conversion to Islam:
But we do mention the widespread report that tells of the conversion of ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb: that he found in the hand of his sister Fāṭima a leaf (ṣaḥīfa) bearing verses of the Qur'an. Although there are other reports that omit the story of Fāṭima and what happened between her and ʿUmar, we may rely on it to learn that there were leaves on which parts of the Qur'an were written, whether those leaves were with Fāṭima, ʿUmar's sister, or with someone else. The word صحيفة does not denote paper as we know it today, but it is in any case something light to carry on which one writes easily. The word صحيفة occurs in the Qur'an, as in His saying, the Exalted: «في صحف مكرّمة مرفوعة مطهرة». Yet memorization was the basis of knowledge of the Qur'an, and it is not recitation from written pages, but rather «آيات بينات في صدور الذين أوتوا العلم».
More of this delicate topic will come in particular places in this book.

* Vocabulary:
(الْحُسْنى): the feminine of aḥsan (best), like al-kubrā and al-ṣughrā. It was also said that al-ḥusnā is a maṣdar (verbal noun) used as a description, like al-rujʿā, and it is put in the singular just as the description of what is non-rational is put in the singular in His saying: «ولي فيها مآرب أخرى» ("and I have other uses in it"); had it been made to agree [in number], the better construction would have been as in His saying: «من أيام أخر» ("from other days").
(يُلْحِدُونَ): the imperfect of alḥada, meaning to incline and deviate.
(سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ): We shall draw them gradually closer to what will destroy them. Istidrāj is moving [something] step by step, from al-daraj, which is folding; from it comes daraja al-thawb, "he folded the garment."
(وَأُمْلِي): Imlāʾ is granting respite and prolonging.
(جِنَّةٍ): with kasra on the jīm and shadda on the nūn: that is, madness.

* I'rab:
(وَلِلَّهِ الْأَسْماءُ الْحُسْنى فَادْعُوهُ بِها): The wāw is resumptive; «ولله» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted predicate (khabar); «الأسماء» is a postponed subject (mubtadaʾ); «الحسنى» is an adjective (naʿt). «فادعوه»: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the eloquent fāʾ, introducing an implied condition); «ادعوه» is a verb, agent and direct object; «بها» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «ادعوه». (وَذَرُوا الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي أَسْمائِهِ): The wāw is a conjunction; «ذروا» is an imperative verb and agent; «الذين» is a relative noun, a direct object; the clause «يلحدون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; «في أسمائه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the meaning is: "and leave off the naming of those who incline away from the truth and the right in it." (سَيُجْزَوْنَ ما كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ): «سيجزون» is a passive imperfect verb and the wāw is the deputy agent (nāʾib fāʿil); «ما» is a second direct object; the clause «كانوا يعملون» is the ṣila of the relative noun; the clause «يعملون» is the predicate (khabar) of «كانوا». (وَمِمَّنْ خَلَقْنا أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِالْحَقِّ وَبِهِ يَعْدِلُونَ): The wāw is a conjunction; «ممن» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted predicate; the clause «خلقنا» is the ṣila of the relative noun; «أمة» is a postponed subject; the clause «يهدون بالحق» is an adjective of «أمة»; «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «يعدلون». (وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِنْ حَيْثُ لا يَعْلَمُونَ): The wāw is a conjunction or resumptive; «الذين» is a subject, and the clause «كذبوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun; «بآياتنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «كذبوا»; the clause «سنستدرجهم من حيث لا يعلمون» is the predicate. You may also put «الذين» in the accusative by an omitted verb, on the principle of ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb with a pronoun), the implied form being: "We shall draw gradually those who denied," that is, We shall move them step by step from a height to a depth, that is, We bring them close to destruction by giving them respite. «من حيث» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «نستدرجهم»; the clause «لا يعلمون» is in the position of a genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ): It is permissible that the wāw be a conjunction, with «أملي» conjoined to «نستدرجهم», in the manner of an iltifāt (shift of person); but what we hold is that it is resumptive, as the predicate of an omitted subject, that is: "and I give them respite"; «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «أملي»; «إن كيدي متين»: the sentence stands as the justification of His strength, Exalted is He. (أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا ما بِصاحِبِهِمْ مِنْ جِنَّةٍ): The hamza is for rebuking interrogation, and the wāw is a conjunction; «لم» is a particle of negation, reversal and jussive; «يتفكروا» is an imperfect verb jussive by «لم»; «ما» is negative; «بصاحبهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted predicate; «من» is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; «جنة» is genitive in form, nominative in position, as a postponed subject; and the clause is in the position of an accusative, being the object of «يتفكروا», which operates upon it, because of the presence of the suspender (muʿalliq) of the verb, namely the negative «ما». It is also permissible that «ما» be interrogative, in the position of a nominative as a subject, with the predicate being «بصاحبهم», and «من جنة» a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. (إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ): «إن» is negative; «هو» is a subject; «إلا» is a particle of restriction; «نذير» is a predicate; «مبين» is an adjective. (أَوَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوا فِي مَلَكُوتِ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَما خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ): The parsing of its like has preceded. «في ملكوت السموات والأرض» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «ينظر»; «ما» is conjoined to «ملكوت»; the clause «خلق» is the ṣila of the relative noun; «من شيء» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. (وَأَنْ عَسى أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ أَجَلُهُمْ): The wāw is a conjunction; the clause is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the preceding «ما», that is: "in [the fact] that"; «أن» is the lightened form of the heavy «أنّ», its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and its predicate the clause «عسى»; the noun of «عسى» is a latent pronoun, and «أن» with what follows it is its predicate; the noun of «يكون» is also the pronoun of the matter, and the clause «قد اقترب أجلهم» is its predicate. (فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ): The fāʾ is resumptive; «بأي» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «يؤمنون»; the clause is resumptive, put forward to express astonishment, that is: if they do not believe in this discourse, how will they believe in any other! The pronoun refers back to the Qur'an or to the Messenger. (مَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَلا هادِيَ لَهُ): «من» is a conditional noun that puts its clause in the jussive, in the position of an accusative as a fronted direct object of «يضلل»; «الله» is the agent; the fāʾ is the connecting fāʾ (of the apodosis); «لا» is the lā of generic negation; «هادي» is its noun; «له» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted predicate of it. (وَيَذَرُهُمْ فِي طُغْيانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ): The wāw is resumptive; the clause «يذرهم» is resumptive; the hāʾ is a direct object; «في طغيانهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «يعمهون»; the clause «يعمهون» is a ḥāl from the hāʾ. It was also read «ويذرهم» in the jussive, conjoined to the position of His saying «فلا هادي له», which is jussive [in position].

* Lügat:
(السَّاعَةِ): Kıyamet. Ansızın vuku bulacağı için, ya da hesabı çabuk olduğu için, ya da aksine uzun olduğu için, ya da uzunluğuna rağmen Allah katında yaratılmışlar katındaki saatlerden bir saat gibi olduğu için bu adla adlandırılmıştır. Ülker yıldızı için «النجم» denmesi gibi, (belli bir şeye) galip gelmiş isimlerdendir.
(مُرْساها): «أرسى» fiilinden mîmî masdardır. «الإرساء»: yerleşme ve sabitleme. Bunun sülâsîsi «رسا»dır. «رسا الشيء»: şey sabit oldu. «رست السفينة»: gemi yürümekten durdu.
(يُجَلِّيها): Onu açığa çıkarır.
(حَفِيٌّ): Soruda ileri giden (çok soran). Kastedilen «sanki sen onu biliyormuşsun» demektir; çünkü bir şeyi sormakta ve onu araştırıp kurcalamakta ileri giden kimsenin o husustaki bilgisi sağlamlaşır ve pekişir. Bu terkibin anlamı mübalağadır; bıyığı dipten kesmek anlamındaki «إحفاء الشارب» de buradandır.

* İ'rab:
(يَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْساها): Onların sapıklıklarından bir türü beyân etmek için getirilmiş müste'nef bir cümledir. «يسألونك» fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir. «عن الساعة» câr ve mecrûr olup «يسألونك»e mütealliktir. «أيان» istifhâm ismi olup zaman zarfı olarak nasb mahallindedir —türetilişi Fevâid bölümünde gelecektir—; mahzûf mukaddem habere mütealliktir. «مرساها» muahhar mübtedâdır. Cümle «الساعة»den bedeldir. «أيان»ın mahzûf bir şeye, yani «يسألونك»e müteallik olduğu, «مرساها»nın da bu mahzûf fiilin fâili olduğu da söylenmiştir. (قُلْ: إِنَّما عِلْمُها عِنْدَ رَبِّي لا يُجَلِّيها لِوَقْتِها إِلَّا هُوَ): «إنما» kâffe ve mekfûfedir. «علمها» mübtedâdır. Zarf mahzûf habere mütealliktir. «لا يجليها» cümlesi hâldir. «لوقتها» câr ve mecrûr olup «يجلّيها»ya mütealliktir. «إنما» ve etki alanındaki cümle mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir. «إلا» hasr edatıdır. «هو», «يجليها»nın fâilidir veya müstetir fâilin te'kîdidir. (ثَقُلَتْ فِي السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ): Cümle müste'neftir. «في السموات» câr ve mecrûr olup «ثقلت»e mütealliktir; ister «في» «على» anlamında olsun, ister kendi asıl anlamı olan zarfiyet üzere olsun. Anlam: Onun ağırlığı —yani şiddeti veya gizlenmesindeki mübalağa— bu iki zarfta veya bu ikisinin üzerinde meydana geldi. (لا تَأْتِيكُمْ إِلَّا بَغْتَةً): Cümle, öncesinin muhtevasını pekiştiren müste'nef bir cümledir. «لا تأتيكم» fiil, müstetir fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir. «إلا» hasr edatıdır. «بغتة» hâl veya mef'ûl-i mutlaktır. (يَسْئَلُونَكَ كَأَنَّكَ حَفِيٌّ عَنْها): Cümle müste'neftir; bu tekrarın sırrı Belâgat bölümünde gelecektir. «يسألونك» fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir. «كأنك» cümlesi hâliyyedir. «كأن» ve ismi; «حفي» onun haberidir. «عنها» câr ve mecrûr olup «حفي»ye mütealliktir. (قُلْ إِنَّما عِلْمُها عِنْدَ اللَّهِ): İ'rabı az önce geçti. (وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لا يَعْلَمُونَ): İ'rabı geçti. (قُلْ: لا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعاً وَلا ضَرًّا إِلَّا ما شاءَ اللَّهُ): Cümle, onlardan elini çektiğini ilân ettikten sonra onların beklentilerini kesip atmak için getirilmiş müste'nef bir cümledir. «لا أملك» cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir. «لا» nâfiyedir; «أملك» muzâri fiil ve müstetir fâildir. «نفعا» mef'ûlün bihtir. «لنفسي» câr ve mecrûr olup «أملك»e mütealliktir; ya da «نفعا»dan hâl olan mahzûf bir şeye mütealliktir; çünkü ondan sonra gelseydi aslında onun sıfatı olurdu. «إلا» istisnâ edatıdır. «ما», «نفعا وضرا»dan müstesnâdır veya ikisinden bedeldir. İstisnânın munkatı' olduğu da söylenmiştir; bu durumda istisnâ üzere nasb edilmesi zorunludur. (وَلَوْ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ لَاسْتَكْثَرْتُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ): Vav isti'nâfiyyedir. «لو» şartiyyedir. «كان» ve ismi; «أعلم» cümlesi onun haberidir. «الغيب» mef'ûlün bihtir. «لاستكثرت»: Lâm, «لو»nun cevabında vâki olan lâmdır; «استكثرت» fiil ve fâildir. «من الخير» câr ve mecrûr olup «استكثرت»e mütealliktir. Cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. (وَما مَسَّنِيَ السُّوءُ): Vav atıf harfidir. «ما مسني السوء» cümlesi «استكثرت»e ma'tûftur. «ما» nâfiyedir. (إِنْ أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ): «إن» nâfiyedir. «أنا» mübtedâdır. «إلا» hasr edatıdır. «نذير» haberdir; «بشير», «نذير»e ma'tûftur. «لقوم» câr ve mecrûr olup «نذير» ve «بشير»e mütealliktir. «يؤمنون» cümlesi «قوم»un sıfatıdır.

* Belâgat:
Allah Teâlâ'nın «يسألونك كأنك حفيّ عنها» kavlinde, belâgat âlimlerinin tekrar (tekrîr) hakkındaki bahislerinde kaydetmedikleri bir tekrar türü vardır. O da şudur: Söz belli bir maksat üzerine kurulur, arada bir ârız (araya giren söz) girer; sonra ilk maksadı tamamlamak için ona dönülmek istenir; onunla ara uzamış olduğu için, sonu başına bağlansın diye ilk maksadın zikri tazelenir (طرّي). Buna daha önce işaret edilmişti; bu da onlardandır. Söze «يسألونك عن الساعة أيان مرساها» kavliyle başlanıp, sonra «قل إنما علمها عند ربي» kavlinden «بغتة» kavline kadar içerilen cevabın zikri araya girince, onların bu konudaki sorusu, onlara karşı bir tür inkârla tamamlanmak istenmiştir; bu da «كأنك حفيّ عنها» kavlinde içerilmiştir. Bu ifade soruyla sıkı bir ilgiye sahiptir ve onunla ara uzamıştır; bu yüzden zikri genel bir tazelemeyle tazelenmiştir. Onu ancak bir tür icmal ile tazelenirken görürüz; bu, ilkini hatırlatma gibidir ve daha önce geçenle ayrıntısına ihtiyaç bırakmaz. İşte bu yüzden «يسألونك» denmiş, sorulan şey —yani «الساعة»— zikredilmemiş, önce geçenle yetinilmiştir. Bu fayda için soru tekrarlanınca cevap da mücmel olarak tekrarlanmış ve «قل إنما علمها عند الله» buyrulmuştur.

* Fevâid:
(أَيَّانَ), ister istifhâm ismi ister şart ismi olsun, «متى» (ne zaman) anlamındadır. Türetilişinin «أي»den olduğu ve onun bundan «فعلان» vezninde olduğu söylenmiştir; çünkü anlamı «hangi vakit ve hangi fiil»dir; «أويت إليه» (ona sığındım) kökündendir; zira parça bütüne sığınır ve ona dayanır. Bunu İbn Cinnî söylemiş ve onun «أين»den olmasını kabul etmemiştir; çünkü o (أيان) zamandır, «أين» ise mekândır. Başkası ise şöyle demiştir: «أيان»ın aslı «أي آن»dır; o, şart anlamını içeren «أي» ile «zaman, vakit» anlamındaki «آن»dan mürekkeptir. Bu ikisi terkipten sonra gelecek zamanda şart için tek bir isim olmuş, fetha üzere mebnî kılınmıştır. Ona çoğu zaman te'kîd için zâid «ما» eklenir; şâirin şu sözündeki gibi:
إذا النعجة الأدماء بانت بقفرة ... فأيّان ما تعدل به الريح تنزل
(Esmer dişi yaban sığırı ıssız bir çölde ayrı düştüğünde, rüzgâr onu nereye yöneltirse oraya konar.)

﴿يُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the accusative-governing ﴿أَنْ﴾ and the verb ﴿يُخْرِجَكُمْ﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يخرجكم. The clause يريد is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar (predicate).
﴿فَماذا﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa.
﴿تَأْمُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the agent, and its object is omitted, its implied form being تأمروننا. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive conditional.

﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he", referring to Pharaoh; the clause is resumptive.
﴿نَعَمْ﴾: a particle of response that makes it unnecessary to say "you will have a reward" (إن لكم لأجرا..).
﴿وَإِنَّكُمْ﴾: inna, and the kāf is its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ﴾ are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the implied omitted clause.

﴿وَلَمَّا﴾: a conditional adverb, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّجْزُ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and الرجز is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). The clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the response to لما. ﴿يا مُوسَى﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative. ﴿ادْعُ لَنا رَبَّكَ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the agent is "you"; ﴿لَنا﴾ is that preposition with its genitive noun, ﴿رَبَّكَ﴾ is its object, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِما﴾: maṣdarī, interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb ادع; or ما is relative. ﴿عَهِدَ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عِنْدَكَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the verb عهد. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa); إن is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كَشَفْتَ﴾: a past verb and agent; ﴿الرِّجْزُ﴾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿عَنَّا﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) كشف. ﴿الرِّجْزُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: in the source الرجز is mentioned twice as mafʿūl bihi, and the quotation of the verse is vowelled with ḍamma, ﴿الرِّجْزُ﴾; in the verse it is accusative, ﴿الرِّجْزَ﴾.] ﴿لَنُؤْمِنَنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥ because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its agent is "we", and the lām occurs in the response to the oath. ﴿لَكَ﴾: attached to the verb before them, and the clause occurs in the response to the oath. The clause كشف is an initial clause with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿لَنُرْسِلَنَّ﴾ is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مَعَكَ﴾: an adverb, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَنِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural, and the nūn was dropped for annexation. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa.

﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), with the vocative particle yā omitted. ﴿اغْفِرْ لِي﴾: a verb of supplication to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and its fāʿil is "you". ﴿وَلِأَخِي﴾: a noun genitive (majrūr) by the kasra implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined. ﴿وَأَدْخِلْنا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ﴾: a verb of supplication to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and نا is its fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; نا is here the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil is "you"]; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَنْتَ﴾: أنت is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿أَرْحَمُ﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿الرَّاحِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

﴿ولا تقعدوا بكل صراط توعدون﴾: Bu da ma'tûftur. «بكل» câr ve mecrûr olup «تقعدوا»ya mütealliktir. «صراط» muzâfun ileyhtir. «توعدون» cümlesi hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir, yani «tehdit ediciler olarak oturmayın».
﴿وتصدون عن سبيل الله من آمن به﴾: Bu da ma'tûftur. «عن سبيل الله» câr ve mecrûr olup «تصدون»a mütealliktir. «من» «تصدون»un mef'ûlüdür. «آمن به» cümlesi ﴿مَن﴾in sılasıdır, i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. «به» câr ve mecrûr olup «آمن»e mütealliktir.
﴿وتبغونها عوجا﴾: «تبغونها»: fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir. «عوجًا» hâldir; burada masdar, müştak ismin yerine geçmiştir, yani «eğri olarak». Yahut «الها» nez'u'l-hâfıd ile nasb mahallindedir [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «الها» yazılmıştır; muhtemelen «الهاء» (hâ harfi) kastedilmiştir.] ve «عوجًا» mef'ûlün bihtir.
﴿واذكروا إذ كنتم قليلا فكثركم﴾: Bu da ma'tûftur. ﴿إذ﴾ sükûn üzere mebnî zaman ismi olup mef'ûlün bih olarak nasb mahallindedir, yani «az olduğunuz vakti hatırlayın». Yahut mef'ûl mahzûftur ve ﴿إذ﴾ o mahzûfun zarfıdır, yani «O vakitte Allah'ın size olan nimetini hatırlayın». ﴿كنتم﴾ cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir. ﴿كنتم﴾ nâkıs, nâsih mâzî fiildir; tâ onun ismidir; «قليلا» onun haberidir. ﴿فكثركم﴾, «كنتم»e atıftır.
﴿وانظروا كيف كان عاقبة المفسدين﴾: Bu da ma'tûftur. «كيف» istifhâm ismi olup kâne'nin öne alınmış haberi olarak nasb mahallindedir. «عاقبة المفسدين» onun ismidir. İstifhâm, bakmayı (amelden) ta'lîk etmiştir; dolayısıyla cümle nez'u'l-hâfıd ile nasb mahallindedir; câr ve mecrûr «انظروا»ya mütealliktir.

﴿قد افترينا﴾: Cümle isti'nâfiyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. قد tahkîk harfidir; افترينا fiil ve fâildir.
﴿على الله﴾: Câr ve mecrûr, افترينا'ya mütealliktir.
﴿كذبًا﴾: Mef'ûlün bih, yahut mahzûf bir masdarın sıfatıdır.
﴿إن﴾: Şartiyyedir.
﴿عدنا﴾: عاد, fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallinde mâzî fiildir; zamir fâil olarak ref' mahallindedir.
﴿في ملتكم﴾: Câr ve mecrûr, عدنا'ya mütealliktir; zamir muzâfun ileyh olarak cer mahallindedir. إن'in cevabı mahzûftur; ondan öncekiler buna delâlet etmektedir.
﴿بعد إذ نجانا الله منها﴾: ﴿بعد﴾ zaman zarfı olup ﴿عدنا﴾'ya mütealliktir; ﴿إذ﴾ sükûn üzere mebnî bir isim olup muzâfun ileyh olarak cer mahallindedir; نجانا cümlesi izâfetle cer mahallindedir; الله fâildir; منها câr ve mecrûr olup نجانا'ya mütealliktir.
﴿وما يكون لنا أن نعود فيها﴾: Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; ondan sonraki cümle isti'nâfiyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. ما nefy harfi; يكون muzâri fiil; لنا câr ve mecrûr olup يكون'un mahzûf haberine müteallik; أن masdar harfi; نعود, أن ile mansûb muzâri fiil olup fâili müstetirdir, takdiri «نحن»dir. ﴿نعود﴾ cümlesi masdar أن'ın sılası olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. ﴿أن نعود﴾dan oluşan müevvel masdar يكون'un ismidir; yani: «وما يكون لنا عَود». فيها câr ve mecrûr olup ﴿نعود﴾'a mütealliktir.
﴿إلا أن يشاء الله ربنا﴾: Bu istisnâda iki vecih vardır: Birincisi muttasıl olmasıdır; buna göre istisnâ, vakitlerin veya hâllerin en genelindendir. İkincisi munkatı' olmasıdır; bu durumda takdir: «لكن إذا شاء الله العود» olur. الله, يشاء'nın fâili; ربنا, الله'tan bedeldir.
﴿وسع ربنا كل شيء﴾: Cümle isti'nâfiyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. وسع mâzî fiil, ربنا fâil, كل شيء mef'ûlün bihtir.
﴿علمًا﴾: Fâilden çevrilmiş (muhavvel) temyîzdir; yani: «وسع علمه كل شيء». ﴿على الله توكلنا﴾: Cümle hâl olarak nasb mevziindedir; على الله câr ve mecrûr olup توكلنا'ya müteallik; توكلنا fiil ve fâildir.
﴿ربنا افتح﴾: Cümle isti'nâfiyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. ربنا muzâf münâdâ, افتح dua fiilidir.
﴿بيننا وبين قومنا بالحق﴾: Mekân zarfı olup افتح'e mütealliktir; yani: «احكم بيننا وبين قومنا». بالحق: câr ve mecrûr.
﴿وأنت﴾: Vâv hâliyyedir yahut isti'nâfiyyedir; أنت mübtedâdır.
﴿خير الفاتحين﴾: Haber. Cümle hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir, yahut isti'nâfiyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.

﴿قال فرعون آمنتم﴾: İsti'nâfiyye cümle olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; ﴿آمنتم﴾ cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir. Tek hemze ile okunur; ondan sonra kelimenin fâ harfi olan elif gelir.
﴿به﴾: Câr ve mecrûr, آمنتم'ya mütealliktir.
﴿قبل أن﴾: Zaman zarfı olup yine آمنتم'ya müteallik; أن ve etki alanındaki kısım, muzâf olan bir masdardır.
﴿آذن﴾: Aslı أأذن'dir; أن ile mansûb muzâri fiildir. İlk hemze, muzâri fiile giren mütekellim hemzesidir; ikincisi, başka bir hemzeden sonra sâkin olarak geldiği için elife çevrilmiştir.
﴿لكم﴾: Câr ve mecrûr, آذن'a mütealliktir; آمنتم cümlesi, onun sözünün mekûlü olarak nasb mahallindedir.
﴿إن هذا لمكر مكرتموه﴾: İsti'nâfiyye bir söz olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. إن nâsih harf, هذا onun ismi, lâm müzahlaka lâmıdır, مكر onun haberi; ﴿مكرتموه﴾ cümlesi مكر'in sıfatıdır.
﴿في المدينة﴾: Câr ve mecrûr, مكرتموه'ya mütealliktir.
﴿لتخرجوا منها﴾: Lâm ta'lîl içindir; تخرجوا, ta'lîl lâmından sonra gizli bir أن ile mansûb muzâri fiildir; أن ve fiil, lâm ile mecrûr bir masdar te'vîlindedir; câr ve mecrûr مكرتموه'ya müteallik; منها câr ve mecrûr olup تخرجوا'ya mütealliktir.
﴿أهلها﴾: Mef'ûlün bih.
﴿فسوف تعلمون﴾: Fâ, fasîha fâsıdır; سوف istikbal harfi; تعلمون muzâri fiil ve fâildir; mef'ûlü bilindiği için hazfedilmiştir, yani: «başınıza gelecek azabın şiddetli sarsıntılarını bileceksiniz».

﴿لأقطعن أيديكم﴾: The لام occurs in the answer to an implied oath. أقطعن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. The clause ﴿أقطعن﴾ is the answer to an implied oath, with no grammatical position. أيديكم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وأرجلكم﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أيديكم.
﴿من خلاف﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «مختلفة» (differing); or ﴿من﴾ is causal, so the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb itself.
﴿ثم لأصلبنكم أجمعين﴾: ثم is a conjunction denoting delay, لأصلبنكم is conjoined to لأقطعن, and أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the كاف.

﴿قالوا أوذينا من قبل أن تأتينا ومن بعد ما جئتنا﴾: İsti'nâfiyye bir söz olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. من قبل câr ve mecrûr olup أوذينا'ya mütealliktir; أن ve etki alanındaki kısım izâfetle mecrûr bir masdar te'vîlindedir, yani: «من قبل إتيانك». من بعد, من قبل'e ma'tûftur; ﴿ما﴾ masdariyyedir, sonrasıyla birlikte izâfetle mecrûr bir masdar te'vîlindedir, yani: «من بعد مجيئك».
﴿قال عسى ربكم أن يهلك عدوكم﴾: İsti'nâfiyye bir cümle olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. عسى recâ fiillerinden mâzî bir fiildir; ربكم onun ismi; ﴿أن يهلك﴾dan müevvel masdar onun haberidir; عدوكم mef'ûlün bihtir.
﴿ويستخلفكم في الأرض﴾: Önceki kısma ma'tûftur.
﴿فينظر كيف تعملون﴾: Fâ, ardışıklık bildiren atıf harfidir; ﴿ينظر﴾, يستخلفكم'e ma'tûftur; كيف istifhâm olup تعملون'un fâilinden hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir; ﴿تعملون﴾ nûnun sübûtuyla merfû muzâri fiildir, cemî vâvı fâildir; ﴿كيف تعملون﴾ cümlesi ﴿ينظر﴾in mef'ûlün bihi olarak nasb mahallindedir.

﴿فأرسلنا عليهم الطوفان والجراد والقمل والضفادع والدم﴾: Fâ atıf harfi; أرسلنا fiil ve fâil; عليهم: câr ve mecrûr olup أرسلنا'ya müteallik; الطوفان mef'ûlün bih; sonrakiler ona ma'tûftur.
﴿آيات مفصلات فاستكبروا وكانوا قوما مجرمين﴾: آيات, anılan beş şeyden hâldir; مفصلات sıfattır; فاستكبروا, أرسلنا'ya ma'tûftur. ﴿كانوا قومًا مجرمين﴾: كانوا nâkıs, nâsih mâzî fiildir; vâv onun ismi, قومًا haberi, مجرمين sıfattır.

﴿واتخذ قوم موسى من بعده من حليهم عجلا جسدا له خوار﴾: The واو is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the واو is a conjunction, being a case of conjoining one story to another. قوم موسى is the fāʿil (agent); من بعده is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اتخذ; من حليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اتخذ, or to an omitted element in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), because, were it to come later, it would be an adjective, as is the rule. عجلًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), جسدًا is a badal (substitute), له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and خوار is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the accusative position as an adjective of his words ﴿عجلا﴾.
﴿ألم يروا أنه لا يكلمهم ولا يهديهم سبيلا﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position. The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval (inkārī), لم is a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive, and the واو is the fāʿil of يروا. أن and what falls within its scope stand in the place of the two objects of يروا; the clause لا يكلمهم is the khabar, and لا يهديهم سبيلًا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to لا يكلمهم. سبيلًا is the second direct object, or it is in the accusative by removal of the preposition (nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿اتخذوه وكانوا ظالمين﴾: A resumptive clause, with no grammatical position. The واو is a conjunction, كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the واو is its noun, and ظالمين is its khabar.

﴿ولما رجع موسى إلى قومه غضبان أسفا﴾: The واو is resumptive or a conjunction, and لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya). The clause رجع موسى has no grammatical position, or is in the genitive position by annexation. إلى قومه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رجع; غضبان is a first ḥāl (circumstantial), and أسفًا a second ḥāl, of موسى.
﴿قال بئسما خلفتموني من بعدي﴾: بئس: a past verb for expressing blame, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾: an indefinite noun qualified [by what follows], meaning «a thing», in the accusative position as a tamyīz (specification). The clause ﴿خلفتموني﴾ is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿ما﴾, and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. «your succession». من بعدي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. The clause ﴿ولما رجع...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or conjoined.
﴿أعجلتم أمر ربكم﴾: The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), عجلتم is a verb and its agent, and أمر ربكم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وألقى الألواح وأخذ برأس أخيه يجره إليه﴾: The واو is a conjunction, ألقى is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to قال, and أخذ يجره إليه is a ḥāl of the pronoun of Moses latent in أخذ. [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently «and أخذ is conjoined [to ألقى], and [the clause] يجره إليه is a ḥāl…» is meant.]
﴿قال ابن أم﴾: ابن أمّ are two nouns indeclinable on the fatḥa because they are compounded in the manner of numbers, like خمسة عشر, or of adverbs, like صباح مساء. It is also said that ابن is annexed to أمّ, and أمّ is annexed to the first-person ياء, which was changed to an alif, as it is changed in a munādā annexed to the first-person ياء; then the alif was dropped and the fatḥa sufficed for it, just as the ياء suffices in place of the kasra. In that case the vowel of ابن is a vowel of inflection, and it is annexed to أمّ, which is in the genitive position by annexation. In either case the vocative particle is omitted.
﴿إن القوم استضعفوني وكادوا يقتلونني﴾: The clause serves as a reason for the way they treated him. إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), القوم is its noun, and the clause استضعفوني is its khabar (predicate). كادوا is conjoined to استضعفوني, the واو is the noun of كاد, and the clause يقتلونني is its khabar.
﴿فلا تشمت بي الأعداء﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; بي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تشمت, and الأعداء is the direct object.
﴿ولا تجعلني مع القوم الظالمين﴾: The واو is a conjunction, لا is prohibitive, and تجعلني is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لا; مع is an adverb of place attached to تجعلني, القوم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and الظالمين is an adjective.

﴿ولقد ذرأنا لجهنم كثيرا من الجن والإنس﴾: The واو is a conjunction, the لام is the answer to an omitted oath, ذرأنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), لجهنم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذرأنا, كثيرًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and من الجن والإنس is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿كثيرًا﴾.
﴿لهم قلوب لا يفقهون بها ولهم أعين لا يبصرون بها ولهم آذان لا يسمعون بها﴾: لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and قلوب is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿كثيرًا﴾, even though it is indefinite, because it is specified by the adjective. The clause لا يفقهون is an adjective of قلوب. The same is said of the two following clauses.
﴿أولئك كالأنعام بل هم أضل أولئك هم الغافلون﴾: أولئك is the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿كالأنعام﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning «like», indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the nominative position as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and الأنعام is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). بل is a particle of rejection (iḍrāb) and conjunction, هم is the mubtadaʾ and أضل the khabar. أولئك is the mubtadaʾ, هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and الغافلون is the khabar of أولئك; or ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and الغافلون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾, and the clause هم الغافلون is the khabar of أولئك.

His saying: ﴿إنَّما المُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إذا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾: its interpretation is: "When the greatness of Allah, His power, and what He has threatened those who disobey Him with are mentioned, their hearts tremble", that is: "they are alarmed at that". The poet said:
؎لَعَمْرُكَ ما أدْرِي وإنِّي لِأوْجَلُ ∗∗∗ عَلى أيِّنا تَعْدُو المَنِيَّةُ أوَّلُ
(By your life, I do not know, and indeed I am afraid, upon which of us death will first fall.)
