تقد السلوقي المضاعف نسجه ... وتوقد بالصفاح نار الحباحب
(It cuts through the Salūqī mail, doubly woven, and kindles with the flat stones the fire of al-Ḥubāḥib.) And al-qaṭṭ is used for what is crosswise. (وَأَلْفَيا سَيِّدَها لَدَى الْبابِ) وألفيا is conjoined to what preceded, and the alif is the fāʿil; سيدها means her husband (baʿl), for a woman would say to her husband "my master" because of his authority over her; it is a mafʿūl bihi; and لدى is an adverbial in the position of the accusative as a second direct object. (قالَتْ ما جَزاءُ مَنْ أَرادَ بِأَهْلِكَ سُوءاً إِلَّا أَنْ يُسْجَنَ أَوْ عَذابٌ أَلِيمٌ) ما is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ; it is also possible that ما is negative, that is, "his requital is only imprisonment or a painful punishment". جزاء is the khabar and من is a muḍāf ilayhi; the clause أراد is a ṣila; بأهلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أراد; سوءا is a mafʿūl bihi; إلا is a particle of restriction; and أن and what is in its scope is a badal from جزاء, that is, "except imprisonment". It is also possible that ما is negative, جزاء a mubtadaʾ and أن يسجن its khabar; أو is a conjunction, and عذاب is conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar; أليم is an adjective; and for من it is possible to be a relative or a qualified indefinite. (قالَ هِيَ راوَدَتْنِي عَنْ نَفْسِي) قال is a past verb and its fāʿil is هو, that is, Yūsuf, defending himself and declaring his innocence; هي is a mubtadaʾ and the clause راودتني its khabar; and عن نفسي is attached to راودتني. (وَشَهِدَ شاهِدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِها) The wāw is a conjunction; شهد شاهد is verb and agent; and من أهلها is an adjective of شاهد, and he was her cousin, who was in the company of her husband.
(إِنْ كانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِنْ قُبُلٍ فَصَدَقَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الْكاذِبِينَ) The condition is the content of an omitted saying, that is, "so he said"; إن is conditional; كان قميصه is كان with its noun; the clause قدّ, that is, "was torn", in the passive, is its khabar; and من قبل is attached to قدّ. فصدقت: the فاء is connective, صدقت is a past verb, and the clause is the apodosis, that is, "then her truthfulness has appeared"; هو: the wāw is circumstantial, هو is a mubtadaʾ and من الكاذبين its khabar. It is necessary to supply "قد" so that the connective فاء may validly enter; otherwise, if it were not supplied, the entry of the فاء would not be sound, because it is a past, inflected verb. (وَإِنْ كانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِنْ دُبُرٍ فَكَذَبَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ) It is conjoined to the first clause, and it is like it in its i'rab.
(فَلَمَّا رَأى قَمِيصَهُ قُدَّ مِنْ دُبُرٍ قالَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ كَيْدِكُنَّ) The فاء is a conjunction; لما is temporal or connective; رأى قميصه is a verb, a latent agent and an object, and the clause قدّ من دبر is circumstantial; قال is the response to لما; and inna with its noun and khabar. (إِنَّ كَيْدَكُنَّ عَظِيمٌ) inna with its noun and khabar. (يُوسُفُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هذا وَاسْتَغْفِرِي لِذَنْبِكِ) يوسف is the one addressed, with the vocative particle omitted; أعرض is an imperative verb and its fāʿil is أنت; عن هذا is attached to أعرض; استغفري is an imperative verb and the yāʾ is its fāʿil; and لذنبك is attached to استغفري. (إِنَّكِ كُنْتِ مِنَ الْخاطِئِينَ) inna and its noun; the clause كنت is its khabar; من الخاطئين is the khabar of كنت; and the clause is the reason for the asking of forgiveness.

* Rhetoric:
Someone may say that the pronoun «هي» is not other than a concealed one by agreement, and it is not for an absent person but for someone who is present. The answer is what al-Sirāj al-Bulqīnī said in his treatise called «Nashr al-ʿAbīr li-Ṭayy al-Ḍamīr»: the pronoun that explains the pronoun of the absent person is either stated explicitly or dispensed with by the presence of what it refers to, by the senses or by knowledge. The sensory case is like His saying «هي راودتني عن نفسي» and «يا أبت استأجره»; so Shaykh Ibn Mālik mentioned. Abū Ḥayyān followed him up, saying: it is not as he exemplified, because these two pronouns refer back to what precedes them: the pronoun in قال refers to Yūsuf, and the pronoun in هي refers to her saying «بأهلك سوءا»; and since she referred to herself by her saying «بأهلك» and did not say "to me", he referred to her by the pronoun of absence in his saying «هي راودتني», and did not address her with "you solicited me", nor point to her with "this one solicited me"; all this is in the manner of courtesy in wording and modesty in address. So he brought out the name in the pronoun of the absent person, as a courtesy toward the king and out of shyness before him. In my view what Ibn Mālik said is preferable to what Abū Ḥayyān said, because when two persons are in dispute before a judge, the claimant says to the judge "I have such-and-such against this man", and the defendant says "he knows that he has no right against me"; the pronoun in "he" is only because of the presence of what it refers to, by the senses. More of this enjoyable discussion will come when we speak of the story of his son Shuʿayb in Sūrat al-Qaṣaṣ. «[Translator's note: the source reads "his son Shuʿayb" (ابنه شعيب); it is translated as written, although "his daughter" (ابنة شعيب) is evidently meant.]»

* Benefits:
لدى:
It is not from the wording of لدن, even though it is from its meaning, because the final letter of لدى is weak, while that of لدن is sound. They said of it لدن with fatḥa on the lām, sukūn on the dāl and kasra on the nūn, as though they found ḍamma on the dāl heavy and so put sukūn for lightness, as they said in عضد "ʿaḍd"; and since the dāl became sukūn-vowelled while the nūn is sukūn-vowelled, they put kasra on the nūn because of the meeting of two sukūns. They also said لدن with ḍamma on the dāl, sukūn on the lām and kasra on the nūn, and they dropped the nūn from لدن for lightness, saying من لد الصلاة and لد الحائط; the dropping of the nūn is not because of the meeting of two sukūns. Know that the rule for لدن is that what follows it is put in the genitive by annexation, like the rest of the adverbials, because its nūn is part of the original word, in the place of the dāl in عند, as the Exalted said «من لدن حكيم عليم»; except that among the Arabs are those who put غدوة specifically in the accusative after it. He said:
لدن غدوة حتى ألاذ بخفها ... بقية منقوص من الظل قالص
(From morning until I took shelter at her foot in the remnant of a diminished, shrunken shade.) And Dhū al-Rumma said:
لدن غدوة حتى إذا امتدت الضحى ... وحثّ القطين الشّحشحان المكلّف
(From morning until, when the forenoon had stretched out, and the diligent, eager driver urged on the residents.) He means the camel-driver, and al-qaṭīn is the plural of qāṭin (resident). Sībawayh said in this connection:
"They put غدوة in the accusative by analogy with the specification, in cases like عندي راقود خلا and جبة صوفا, and with the object in cases like هذا ضارب زيدا and قاتل بكرا." Some of them said: غدوة is put in the accusative after لدن as the khabar of an implied كان together with its noun, the implied meaning being لدن كان الوقت غدوة; and it is also permissible to put it in the nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb, the implied meaning being لدن كانت غدوة, that is, "came into being", كان here being complete. «[Translator's note: the source prints "عدوة" with ʿayn in this last phrase; it is translated as غدوة, evidently a misprint.]» The usual case with لدن is that it is put in the genitive with من, as in «وعلمناه من لدنا علما». When it is annexed to the first-person yāʾ, the protective nūn is obligatory with it, as in «لدني». It is annexed to a single noun, as you have seen, and to a clause, as in انتظرتك من لدن طلعت الشمس إلى أن غربت ("I waited for you from the time the sun rose until it set").

* Lügat:
(بِضْعَ سِنِينَ): «البضع», üç ile dokuz arasıdır. Görüşlerin çoğuna göre (Yûsuf) orada yedi yıl kalmıştır. Lügat âlimlerinden biri şöyle demiştir: «البضع», kesre ve fetha ile, Ebû Ubeyde'nin görüşüne göre bir ile beş arasıdır; başkası ise bir ile on arası demiştir. Fetha ile «البَضع» yarmak, damme ile «البُضع» nikâhtır. Bazıları şöyle demiştir:
شقّ وري وجماع بضع ... ما بين واحد وعشر بضع
(Yarmak, kana kandırmak ve cima' «bad'»dır; bir ile on arası da «bıd'»dır.) [Mütercim notu: Beytin ilk yarısı kaynakta «شقّ وري» şeklindedir; olduğu gibi bırakıldı.]
el-Esâs'ta şöyle denir: «Yanımda erkeklerden 'بضعة عشر' ve kadınlardan 'بضع عشرة' var; sayı hükmü yolu üzere erkekler tâ ile, kadınlar tâsız. Yanında 'بضع سنين' kaldım; bu, üç ile on arasıdır.» el-Kâmûs ve et-Tâc'da şöyle denir: «البَضع ve البِضع: geceden bir kısım; üç ile dokuz arası. 'بضع سنين', 'بضع عشرة من النساء', 'بضع وعشرون امرأة' denir; müzekker ile 'بضعة عشر من الرجال' ve 'بضعة وعشرون رجلا' denir. 'بضع'ın öne alınması vaciptir; 'عشرون وبضع' denmez.» Harîrî de Dürretü'l-Ğavvâs'ta şöyle demiştir: «البضع en çok üç ile on arasında kullanılır. Bu, Hz. Peygamber'e (s.a.v.), Allah Teâlâ'nın 'وهم من بعد غلبهم سيغلبون في بضع سنين' kavlinin tefsirinde isnad edilmiştir. Şöyle ki: Müslümanlar, Ehl-i kitap oldukları için Rumların Farslara galip gelmesini istiyorlardı; müşrikler ise putperest oldukları için Fars ahalisine meylediyorlardı. Allah müslümanları Rumların galip geleceği ile müjdeleyince müslümanlar sevindi. Sonra Ebû Bekir (Allah ondan razı olsun) Kureyş müşriklerine onlar hakkında nazil olanı haber verdi. Ümeyye b. Halef 'Bunun üzerine benimle bahse gir' dedi; o da üç yıllık bir müddet içinde beş genç dişi deve üzerine onunla bahse girdi. Sonra Hz. Peygamber'e (s.a.v.) gelip ona 'bıd''ı sordu; o 'Üç ile on arası' buyurdu. (Ebû Bekir) ona İbn Halef ile bahsini haber verdi; (Hz. Peygamber) ona 'Seni müddeti kısa tutmaya ne sevk etti?' dedi. 'Allah'a ve Resûlüne güven' dedi. Bunun üzerine ona 'Onlara dön, bahiste onlara artır ve müddette de artır' buyurdu. O da onlara iki genç dişi deve artırdı, onlar da ona iki yıl artırdılar. Rumlar, Ebû Bekir'in (Allah ondan razı olsun) takdirini tasdik edercesine, ikinci müddet bitmeden Farslara galip geldiler.» [Mütercim notu: Harîrî'den nakil kaynakta kapanış işareti olmadan sona ermektedir.]
(سِمانٍ): «سمينة»nin cem'idir; «سمين» de bu şekilde cem'lenir; «نساء سمان» dendiği gibi «رجال سمان» de denir. «السمن», سمن يسمن fiilinin masdarıdır; (sıfatı) «سمين»dir. Masdar ve isim kıyas dışı gelmiştir; zira kıyasları fetha ile «سمنا» ve «سمن» olmasıdır; «فرح فرحا فهو فرح» gibi. el-Misbâh'ta şöyle denir: «سمن يسمن: eti ve yağı çoğaldığında söylenir; تعب babındandır; bir lügatte قرب babındandır. Hemze ve tad'îf (şedde) ile müteaddî olur.» Mecaz kullanımlarından: «كلام غث وسمين» (zayıf ve semiz söz), «أسمنت القدر» (tencere yağlandı), «دار سمينة» (halkı çok olan ev), «سمّنوا لفلان» (falana bol bağışta bulundular), «سمّنت في الحمد» (övgüde bol verdim). İbn Mukbil şöyle demiştir:
تركت الخنا لست من أهله ... وسمّنت في الحمد حتى سمن
(Çirkin sözü terk ettim, ben onun ehlinden değilim; övgüde (övgüye sebep olanı) bol verdim, ta ki o semizleşinceye (çoğalıncaya) kadar.)
Bir bedevinin diğerine şöyle dediği işitilmiştir: «Evi sana bedelsiz verdim ki yanında nasibim daha semiz (daha bol) olsun.» «انقلب بلدهم سمنة وعسلة»: Memleketlerinde yağ ve bal çoğaldığında söylenir. Bir darb-ı meselde: «سمنكم هريق في أديمكم» (Yağınız kendi derinize döküldü), yani malınız size harcanıyor.
(عِجافٌ): Kıyas dışı olarak «عجفاء»nın cem'idir. «العجف», kendisinden sonrası olmayan (son derece) zayıflıktır [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «الهزال الذي ليس بعده» şeklinde eksik görünmektedir; muhtemelen «ليس بعده هزال»]. «أفعل» ve «فعلاء» vezinleri «فعال» üzere cem'lenmediği hâlde «عجاف»ın «عجفاء»nın cem'i olarak gelmesinin sebebi, onun zıddı olan «سمان»a hamledilmesidir. Arapların âdetinden biri, benzeri benzerine, zıddı zıddına hamletmektir. Kıyası «عجف»tir; «حمراء» ve «حمر» gibi.
(رُءْيايَ): Arapça erbabı «الرؤيا» ile «الرؤية» arasını ayırmış ve şöyle demişlerdir: «الرؤيا» rüya bildiren (hulmiyye) «رأى»nın, «الرؤية» ise göz ile görme bildiren (ayniyye) «رأى»nın masdarıdır. Ebu't-Tayyib'i (Mütenebbî'yi) şu sözünde hatalı bulmuşlardır:
مضى الليل والفضل الذي لك لم يمض ... ورؤياك أحلى في العيون من الغمض
(Gece geçti, fakat senin lütfun geçmedi; seni görmek gözlere uykudan daha tatlıdır.)
Ebu'l-Bekâ, Mütenebbî Divanı şerhinde şöyle demiştir: «الرؤيا yalnızca uykuda (görülen şey) için kullanılır. Allah Teâlâ'nın 'لقد صدق الله رسوله الرؤيا بالحق', 'لا تقصص رؤياك على إخوتك', 'إن كنتم للرؤيا تعبرون' ve 'قد صدقت الرؤيا' kavilleri bundandır; bunların hepsi uykudadır. 'لقياك' (sana kavuşmak) deseydi daha güzel olurdu; ancak o 'الرؤيا'yı 'الرؤية' mânâsında kullanmıştır; Allah Teâlâ'nın 'وما جعلنا الرؤيا التي أريناك' kavlinde olduğu gibi; çünkü bununla uyku rüyası kastedilmemiş, ancak uyanıklık kastedilmiştir; bu da geceleyin, İsrâ gecesinde olmuştur.»
Ebu'l-Feth İbn Cinnî şöyle demiştir: «الرؤيا uykudadır; gözle (görme) için olanını bilmiyorum; gelse de şâzdır.»
İbn Hişâm Evdahu'l-Mesâlik'te şöyle demiştir: «الرؤيا hulmiyyenin masdarına has değildir; aksine Harîrî ve İbn Mâlik'in aksine, basariyyenin (göz ile görmenin) masdarı olarak da vâki olur. Delili: 'وما جعلنا الرؤيا التي أريناك إلا فتنة للناس'. İbn Abbâs: 'Bu, göz ile görmedir' demiştir. Fakat meşhur olan, onun hulmiyyede kullanılmasıdır.»
el-Kâmûs sahibi, «الرؤيا»nın rüyada olduğunu söylemekle yetinmiş ve şöyle demiştir: «الرؤيا: uykunda gördüğün şeydir.» Cem'i, «هدى» gibi «رؤى»dır.
(تَعْبُرُونَ): نصر ينصر babındandır; «علّم تعليما» gibi şeddeli olarak da kullanılır. «عبرت الرؤيا»nın hakikati, onun akıbetini ve işin sonunu zikretmendir; tıpkı nehri, eninin sonuna ulaşıncaya kadar geçtiğinde «عبرت النهر» demen gibi; o da (nehrin) «عِبْر»idir (karşı kıyısıdır). Ya da bunun benzeri olarak, rüyanın varacağı yeri, yani dönüş yerini zikrettiğinde «أولت الرؤيا» (rüyayı te'vil ettim) dersin. [Mütercim notu: Bu cümle kaynakta «وهو عبره أو نحوه أولت الرؤيا» şeklinde kısmen kapalıdır.] Şeddesiz «عبرت الرؤيا», sağlam (sika) âlimlerin itimat ettiği şeklidir [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «الإثبات» yazılıdır; «الأثبات» kastedilmiştir]. Onların şeddeli «عبّرت»i, «التعبير»i ve «المعبر»i inkâr ettiklerini gördüm. Müberred'in el-Kâmil'de bazı bedevilere ait olarak okuduğu bir beyit buldum [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «الإعراب» yazılıdır; «الأعراب» (bedeviler) kastedilmiştir]:
رأيت رؤيا ثم عبرتها ... وكنت للأحلام عبارا
(Bir rüya gördüm, sonra onu yorumladım; ben rüyaların çok iyi yorumcusuydum.)
el-Kâmûs'ta: «العبار», «العابر»in mübalağasıdır ve rüya tabircisidir. «جمل عبار»: yürümeye güçlü deve. Bugün fetha ve kesre ile «العبر» yaygındır; bu, vadinin kıyısı ve yakasıdır. Damme ile «العُبر» ise her şeyin çok olanıdır. Kesre ile «العبارة» masdardır; «عبّر»dan isimdir; bir mânâya delâlet eden lafızlardır. «Falan, ibaresi güzeldir», yani beyânı güzeldir, denir. «Bu, şundan ibarettir», yani onun mânâsındadır ve delâlette ona eşittir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «ومساوله» yazılıdır; «ومساوٍ له» kastedilmiştir.]
(أَضْغاثُ أَحْلامٍ): Rüyaların karışıkları ve bâtılları; nefsin konuşmasından veya şeytanın vesvesesinden olanlar. «الأضغاث»ın aslı, bitki karışımlarından toplanıp demet yapılan şeydir; tekili «ضغث»tir. Bunun için istiâre edilmiştir. İzafet «من» mânâsındadır; yani «rüyalardan demetler». Bir darb-ı meselde «ضغث على إبالة» denir. «الإبّالة», hemzenin kesresi ve bânın şeddesiyle, ot ve odun demetidir; «الضغث» ise yaşı kuruya karışmış bir avuç ottur. Meselin mânâsı: belâ üstüne belâdır. Arkadaşına hoşlanmadığı şeyi yükleyip sonra yine ondan (bir şey) isteyen adam için de misal olarak getirilir.
(ادَّكَرَ): Dâl iledir; fasih olan budur. Noktalı zâl ile «واذّكر» da caizdir. Aslı «اذتكر»dir; «الذكر»den ifti'âl babıdır. İfti'âl tâsı zâlden sonra gelince dâle çevrilmiş; birbirine yakın (iki harf) bir araya gelince birincisi ikincinin cinsine çevrilmiş ve idğam edilmiştir.
(أُمَّةٍ): Hemzenin dammesi, mîmin şeddesi ve tenvinli tâ ile; uzun müddettir. «الأمة» (ümmet) bilinen mânâdadır. Hemzenin kesresiyle «الإمة» nimettir; bununla da okunmuştur. Adî şöyle demiştir:
ثم بعد الفلاح والملك والإمة ووارتهم هناك القبور
(Sonra kurtuluş, mülk ve nimetten sonra, orada kabirler onları örttü.)

* İ'rab:
(وَقالَ لِلَّذِي ظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ناجٍ مِنْهُمَا اذْكُرْنِي عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ): «وقال» öncesine ma'tûftur; fâili Yûsuf'tur. «للذي» ona mütealliktir; «ظن» cümlesi sıladır; «ظن»in fâili de Yûsuf'tur. «أن» ve alanındaki «ظن»in iki mef'ûlünün yerini tutmuştur. «أن» ve ismi; «ناج» onun haberidir. «منهما» hâldir; yani kurtulanın o ikisinden biri olduğu hâlde; o da sâkîdir. «اذكرني» cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavldir. «عند ربك» zarf olup mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir.
(فَأَنْساهُ الشَّيْطانُ ذِكْرَ رَبِّهِ فَلَبِثَ فِي السِّجْنِ بِضْعَ سِنِينَ): «فأنساه الشيطان»: Fâ atıf harfidir; «أنساه» fiil ve mef'ûlün bihtir; zamir sâkîye döner; «الشيطان» fâildir. Mânâ: Şeytan ona, Yûsuf'u hükümdarın yanında anmayı unutturdu. Yûsuf'a, işini başkasına havale ettiğinde Rabbinin zikrinin unutturulduğu da söylenmiştir [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «غيرة» yazılıdır; «غيره» olmalıdır]. Müfessirlerin çoğu, şeytanın Rabbinin zikrini unutturduğu kişinin iki gençten kurtulan, yani içki sunucusu olduğu görüşüne gitmişlerdir. Bu görüş, şeytanın peygamberler üzerinde bir yolu olmadığı gerekçesiyle tercih edilmiştir. Buna şöyle cevap verilmiştir: Unutma Yûsuf'tan vâki olmuştur; onun şeytana nispet edilmesi mecaz yoluyladır. Peygamberler, Allah Sübhânehû'dan haber verdikleri şeyler dışında unutmaktan masum değildirler. Resûlullah'tan (s.a.v.) sahih olarak şöyle buyurduğu sabittir: «Ben de ancak sizin gibi bir beşerim; sizin unuttuğunuz gibi unuturum; unuttuğumda bana hatırlatın.» Ayrıca şu gerekçeyle de tercih edilmiştir: Unutmak günah değildir; şeytanın Rabbinin zikrini unutturduğu kişi Yûsuf olsaydı, bundan dolayı zindanda birkaç yıl kalmakla cezayı hak etmezdi. Buna da şöyle cevap verilmiştir: Unutma (burada) terk etmektir ve o, Allah Sübhânehû'dan başkasından yardım istemesi sebebiyle cezalandırılmıştır. Zamirin Yûsuf'a dönmesini, sonrasındaki «فلبث في السجن بضع سنين» kavli destekler; iki gençten kurtulana dönmesini ise ileride gelecek olan «وقال الذي نجا منهما وادكر بعد أمة» kavli destekler. «ذكر» ikinci mef'ûlün bihtir. «فلبث»: Fâ atıf harfidir; «لبث» fiil ve müstetir fâildir. «في السجن» câr ve mecrûr olup mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir. «بضع سنين» zarfiyet üzere mansûb olup «لبث»e mütealliktir.
(وَقالَ الْمَلِكُ إِنِّي أَرى سَبْعَ بَقَراتٍ سِمانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجافٌ): «إن» ve ismi; «أرى» cümlesi onun haberidir. «سبع بقرات» mef'ûlün bihtir; «سمان» «بقرات»ın sıfatıdır. «سبع»in değil de «بقرات»ın vasıflanmasının sebebi Fevâid babında gelecektir. «يأكلهن سبع» muzâri fiil, mef'ûlün bih ve fâildir; «عجاف» «سبع»in sıfatıdır. «يأكلهن» cümlesi «أرى»nın ikinci mef'ûlü olarak nasb mahallindedir. Sureti (zihinde) hazır etmek için muzâri ile ifade edilmiştir.
(وَسَبْعَ سُنْبُلاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يابِساتٍ): «سبع» birinci «سبع»e ma'tûftur; «سنبلات» muzâfun ileyhtir; «خضر» «سنبلات»ın sıfatıdır. «أخر» «سبع»e ma'tûftur; gayr-i munsarif oluşu hakkındaki söz Fevâid babında gelecektir. «يابسات» «أخر»in sıfatıdır.
(يا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي رُءْيايَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ لِلرُّءْيا تَعْبُرُونَ): «أفتوني» nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir; vâv fâil, yâ mef'ûlün bihtir. «في رؤياي» «أفتوني»ye mütealliktir. «إن» şart edatıdır; «كنتم»: «كان» ve ismi; o, fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir. «تعبرون» cümlesi «كنتم»in haberidir. Cevap mahzûftur; öncesi ona delâlet eder; yani «فأفتوني في رؤيا» (o hâlde rüya hakkında bana fetva verin). «للرؤيا» sözündeki câr ve mecrûrda birkaç vecih vardır: Birincisi, lâmın beyân için olmasıdır; «وكانوا فيه من الزاهدين» kavlinde olduğu gibi; bu durumda o ve mecrûru hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir. Ya da takviye için olmasıdır; çünkü ma'mûlü kendisinden önce gelen âmil, ma'mûlü kendisinden sonra geldiği zamanki gibi onda amel etme gücüne sahip değildir; bu yüzden onunla (lâmla) desteklenmiştir. Tıpkı «عابر للرؤيا» dediğinde ism-i fâilin, kuvvette fiilden aşağı olduğu için onunla desteklenmesi gibi. Bu durumda (lâm) zâide hükmündedir ve hiçbir şeye müteallik olmaz; sırf takviye için ziyade edilmiştir. «كنتم»in haberi olması da caizdir; tıpkı bir kimse bir işi üstlenmiş ve ona muktedir ise «كان فلان لهذا الأمر» demen gibi; bu durumda «تعبرون» cümlesi «كنتم»in ikinci haberi olur. Müberred el-Kâmil'de şöyle demiştir: «Bu lâm, izafetteki ziyadesi mânâsında mef'ûlde ziyade edilir. 'هذا ضارب زيدا' ve 'هذا ضارب لزيد' dersin; çünkü 'هذا ضارب زيد' ve 'ضارب له' dediğinde (lâm) izafetin mânâsını değiştirmez. Kur'an'da: 'وأمرت لأن أكون أول المسلمين'; aynı şekilde 'إن كنتم للرؤيا تعبرون'.»
(قالُوا أَضْغاثُ أَحْلامٍ وَما نَحْنُ بِتَأْوِيلِ الْأَحْلامِ بِعالِمِينَ): «قالوا» fiil ve fâildir. «أضغاث أحلام» mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberidir; yani «هذه أضغاث أحلام وتخاليط أوهام» (bunlar karışık rüyalar ve vehimlerin karmaşasıdır). Cümle mekûlü'l-kavldir. Onun cem' olarak getirilmesinin sırrı Belâgat babında gelecektir. «وما»: Vâv atıf harfidir; «ما» Hicazî nefy edatıdır; «نحن» onun ismidir. «بتأويل» «عالمين»e mütealliktir. Bâ zâid cer harfidir; «عالمين» lafzen bâ ile mecrûr, mahallen «ليس»in haberi olarak mansûbdur.
(وَقالَ الَّذِي نَجا مِنْهُما وَادَّكَرَ بَعْدَ أُمَّةٍ): Vâv atıf harfidir; «قال الذي» fiil ve fâildir; «نجا» cümlesi sıladır; «منهما» hâldir. «ادكر» «نجا»ya ma'tûftur; «بعد أمة» «ادكر»e mütealliktir. Vâvın hâliyye olması, («ادكر») cümlesinin mevsûlden veya onun âidinden, yani «نجا»nın fâilinden hâl olması da caizdir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «وجملة نجا حالية» yazılıdır; bağlam «وجملة ادكر حالية» gerektirir.]
(أَنَا أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِتَأْوِيلِهِ فَأَرْسِلُونِ): «أنا» mübtedâ, «أنبئكم» cümlesi haberdir; kâf onun mef'ûlüdür; «بتأويله» «أنبئكم»e mütealliktir. «فأرسلون»: Fâ fasîha fâsıdır; «أرسلوني» emir fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir; yani «Rüyanın tabirini istiyorsanız beni gönderin.»
(يُوسُفُ أَيُّهَا الصِّدِّيقُ أَفْتِنا فِي سَبْعِ بَقَراتٍ سِمانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجافٌ وَسَبْعِ سُنْبُلاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يابِساتٍ): Mahzûf bir şeyin takdiri şarttır; yani «Onu gönderdiler, o da zindanda Yûsuf'a geldi ve dedi ki». «يوسف», nidâ harfi hazfedilmiş münâdâdır. «أيها», damme üzere mebnî olduğu için ihtisâs üzere mahallen mansûbdur [Mütercim notu: Kaynak burada «أيها»yı ihtisâs olarak i'rab etmektedir; yaygın i'rab, nidâ harfi hazfedilmiş ikinci münâdâ olmasıdır]. «الصديق» ondan bedel veya onun atf-ı beyânıdır; lafzına tâbidir. İhtisâs bahsi Fevâid babında gelecektir. «أفتنا» illet harfinin hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir; fâili müstetir olup takdiri «أنت»tir; «نا» mef'ûlün bihtir. «في سبع» câr ve mecrûr olup «أفتنا»ya mütealliktir; «بقرات» muzâfun ileyhtir. «يأكلهن سبع عجاف» cümlesi «بقرات»ın sıfatıdır; sonrası ona ma'tûftur.
(لَعَلِّي أَرْجِعُ إِلَى النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ): «لعل» ve ismi; «أرجع» cümlesi onun haberidir [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «أرجح» yazılıdır]; «إلى الناس» «أرجع»e mütealliktir. «لعلهم يعلمون» da onun gibidir.
(قالَ: تَزْرَعُونَ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ دَأَباً): «تزرعون» cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavldir. «سبع سنين» zarf olup «تزرعون»a mütealliktir. «دأبا», emredilenlerden hâldir, yani «devamlı çalışarak»; ya da mahzûf bir fiilin masdarıdır, yani «تدأبون دأبا» (devamlı çalışırsınız).
(فَما حَصَدْتُمْ فَذَرُوهُ فِي سُنْبُلِهِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ): Fâ atıf harfidir; «ما»nın şart edatı veya mevsûl olması caizdir; her iki hâlde de «حصدتم»in mukaddem mef'ûlü olarak nasb mahallindedir. «حصدتم» fiil ve fâildir. «فذروه»: Fâ, şartın cevabında veya —taşıdığı şart kokusu sebebiyle— mevsûlün (haberinde) vâki olmuştur. «ذروه» fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir. «في سنبله» «ذروه»ya mütealliktir. «إلا» istisnâ edatıdır; «قليلا» nasbı vacip olan müstesnâdır; «مما» «قليلا»nın sıfatıdır; «تأكلون» cümlesi sıladır.
(ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِ ذلِكَ سَبْعٌ شِدادٌ): «ثم» atıf ve terâhî harfidir; «يأتي» muzâri fiildir; «من بعد ذلك» hâldir; «سبع» «يأتي»nin fâili, «شداد» «سبع»in sıfatıdır.
(يَأْكُلْنَ ما قَدَّمْتُمْ لَهُنَّ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِمَّا تُحْصِنُونَ): «يأكلن» cümlesi «سبع»in ikinci sıfatıdır; nûn fâildir. «ما» mef'ûlün bihtir; «قدمتم» cümlesi «ما»nın sılasıdır; «لهن» «قدمتم»e mütealliktir. «إلا» istisnâ edatıdır; «قليلا» müstesnâdır; «مما» «قليلا»nın sıfatıdır; «تحصنون» cümlesi sıladır.
(ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِ ذلِكَ عامٌ فِيهِ يُغاثُ النَّاسُ وَفِيهِ يَعْصِرُونَ): Bu da ma'tûftur. «فيه يغاث الناس» cümlesi «عام»ın sıfatıdır. «يعصرون» «يغاث»a ma'tûftur; yani üzümleri ve başka şeyleri sıkarlar.

* Belâgat:
1- Mübalağa:
«الضغث» lafzını cem' yaparak «أضغاث أحلام» demişler ve —rüya tek olduğu hâlde— onu rüyanın haberi yapmışlardır [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «مع ايها واحدة» yazılıdır; «مع أنها واحدة» okundu]. Bu, rüyayı bâtıllıkla vasfetmede mübalağa içindir veya birbirinden farklı şeyleri içine aldığı içindir. Cem' lafzı, zatların çokluğuna delâlet ettiği gibi, vasıflanmadaki mübalağaya da delâlet eder. Tek bir atı ve tek bir sarığı olan kimse için «Falan atlara biner ve sarıklar giyer» demeleri gibi.

2- Bir şeyi isbat ederek nefyetmek:
Buna daha önce işaret edilmişti; burada onu biraz daha açalım; çünkü o, sözün güzelliklerindendir. Onu düşündüğünde iç yüzünün nefiy, dış yüzünün isbat olduğunu görürsün. İmruülkays şöyle demiştir:
على لا حب لا يهتدى بمناره ... إذا سافه العود النباطي جرجرا
(Belirgin bir yol üzerinde ki onun işaret kulesiyle yol bulunmaz; Nabatî yaşlı deve onu kokladığında homurdanır.)
«لا يهتدى بمناره» sözüyle, onun yol bulunmayan bir işaret kulesi olduğunu kastetmemiştir; aksine onunla yol bulmak şöyle dursun, onun hiç işaret kulesi olmadığını kastetmiştir. Züheyr b. Ebî Sülmâ'nın şu sözü de böyledir:
بأرض خلاء لا يسدّ وصيدها ... علي ومعروفي بها غير منكر
(Boş bir yerde ki eşiği (kapısı) bana kapatılmaz; orada iyiliğim de inkâr edilmez.)
Lafızda onun için bir eşik isbat etmiştir; fakat kastettiği, onun bana kapatılacak bir eşiğinin olmadığıdır. Zübeyr b. Abdülmuttalib'in, nedimi ve arkadaşı olan Umeyle b. es-Sebbâk b. Abdiddâr'ı anarken söylediği şu söz de buna bağlıdır:
صبحت بهم طلقا يراح إلى الندى ... إذا ما انتشى لم تحتضره صاقره
ضعيفا يحث الكأس قبض بنانه ... كليلا على وجه النديم أظافره
(Onlara, cömertliğe neşeyle koşan güler yüzlü birini sabah içkisi olarak getirdim; sarhoş olduğunda ona kötü huyları (zaafları) gelmez. Kadehi süren parmaklarının tutuşu zayıf, nedimin yüzüne karşı tırnakları kördür.)
Sözünün zâhiri, onun nedimin yüzünü tırmaladığı, ancak tırnaklarının kör olduğudur; hakikatte ise kastettiği, onun nedimin yüzünü tırmalamadığı ve bunlardan hiçbirini yapmadığıdır. «لم تحتضره مفاقره» sözü de böyledir; yani onun, kendisine gelecek kötü hasletleri yoktur. [Mütercim notu: Beyitte kaynakta «صاقره», açıklamada ise «مفاقره» yazılıdır.] Bundan daha beliğ olanı yeri geldiğinde gelecektir; o da Allah Teâlâ'nın «لا يسألون الناس إلحافا» kavlidir; yani asla istemezler. Üzerinde durduğumuz âyette ise Bâri Teâlâ özellikle bâtıl rüyaları nefyetmeyi murad etmiştir; sanki onlar şöyle demişlerdir: «Bâtıl rüyaların, bizim kendisini bilenler olacağımız bir te'vili yoktur.» Güzellik, uyum (müvâeme) ile daha da tamamlanır: Hükümdar onlara önce «إن كنتم للرؤيا تعبرون» demişti; bu, onların, onun bilgisine göre rüyayı bilenler olmadıklarına delâlet içindir; çünkü şüphe ifade eden «إن» kelimesini getirmiştir; bununla onların, hükümdarın önce onların rüyayı bilip bilmediklerine dair istifhâm kalıbında ortaya koyduğu şüphesine uygun olarak kusurlarını itiraf etmelerini ummuştur. Gencin «أنا أنبئكم بتأويله» sözünden «لعلي أرجع إلى الناس لعلهم يعلمون» sözüne kadarki sözü de buna delildir. Bu sözü söyleyen (Allah) münezzehtir.

* Fevâid:
1- Allah Sübhânehû «سمان» kavlini mümeyyez (temyîz) olan «بقرات»ın sıfatı yapmıştır, temyîz edilen (mümeyyez) olan «سبع»in değil. Her ikisi de nahiv kaidelerinde caiz olmakla birlikte iki durum arasındaki fark şudur: Onu «بقرات»ın sıfatı yaptığında, yediyi sığırların bir türüyle, yani cinsleriyle değil, özellikle semiz olanlarıyla temyîz etmeyi kastetmiş olursun. Onu «سبع»in sıfatı yaptığında ise yediyi özel bir türüyle değil sığırların cinsiyle temyîz etmeyi kastetmiş, sonra dönüp cinsle temyîz edileni semizlikle vasfetmiş olursun. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «الميّز» ve «المميّز» şeklinde terimler karışık yazılmıştır; mânâya göre çevrildi.]
2- «أخر» kelimesi, sayı açıkça zikredilmeden kuru başakların da yeşiller gibi yedi olduğuna delâlet etmiştir. Çünkü söz, semiz ve zayıf sığırlarda ve yeşil başaklarda bu sayıya yönelik olarak bina edilmiştir; dolayısıyla «الأخر»in mânâsının yediyi kapsaması gerekir ve «وأخر يابسات» kavli «ve diğer yedi (başak)» mânâsında olur.
3- «أخر»:
«آخر» vezninden ma'dûl (döndürülmüş) bir sıfattır. Sıfatın udûlünün iki yeri vardır:
a- «فعال» ve «مفعل» veznindeki sayılar: «أحاد» ve «موحد», «ثناء» ve «مثنى», «ثلاث» ve «مثلث», «رباع» ve «مربع» gibi. Bunlar «birer birer», «ikişer ikişer» vb.den ma'dûldür. «جاء القوم مثنى» dediğinde mânâ, «ikişer ikişer geldiler»dir. Sayılardaki udûlün Araplardan dörde kadar işitildiğini söylemişlerdir; ancak nahivciler bunu ona kadar kıyas etmişlerdir. Doğrusu, bunun bir ile on ve aralarındakiler hakkında işitilmiş olduğudur. Ebu't-Tayyib şöyle demiştir:
أحاد أم سداس في أحاد ... لييلتنا المنوطة بالتناد
(Kıyamet gününe bağlanmış küçük gecemiz tek mi, yoksa tek içinde altılık mı?)
b- «مررت بنساء أخر» sözündeki «أخر». Allah Teâlâ «فعدة من أيام أخر» buyurmuştur. Bu, «آخر»in müennesi olan «أخرى»nın cem'idir. Hânın fethasıyla «آخَر», «أفعل» vezninde, «başka» mânâsında bir ism-i tafdîldir. Kıyas, «مررت بنساء أفضل» dendiği gibi «مررت بنساء آخر» denmesi idi; çünkü ism-i tafdîl «من»den, elif-lâmdan ve izafetten mücerred olduğunda müennes [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «مجردا من من أل والاضافة» şeklindedir; fazladan «من» görünüşte yazım hatasıdır, lafzen bırakıldı.], tesniye ve cem' yapılmaz.
4- İhtisâs:
Bu, ismin, takdiri «أخص» veya «أعني» olan vücuben mahzûf bir fiille nasb edilmesidir. Bu isim ancak, ondan kastedileni beyan için bir zamirden sonra gelir: «نحن العرب نكرم الضيف» (Biz Araplar misafire ikram ederiz) gibi. «نحن» mübtedâ, «نكرم الضيف» cümlesi haberdir; «العرب», takdiri «أخص» olan mahzûf bir fiille ihtisâs üzere mansûbdur. Mahzûf fiil cümlesi mübtedâ ile haberi arasında i'tirâziyyedir. Kastedilen, «نحن» hakkında «العرب» ile haber vermek değil, misafire ikramın Araplara has ve onlara mahsus olduğudur. Ebû Ubâde el-Buhturî'nin şu sözü de bundandır:
نحن أبناء يعرب، أعرب النا ... س لسانا وأنضر الناس عودا
(Biz Ya'rub'un oğullarıyız; insanların dilce en fasihi, dalca en tazesiyiz.)
İhtisâs bazen «أيها» ve «أيتها» lafzıyla olur; bunlar nidâda kullanıldıkları gibi kullanılır; damme üzere mebnî olur ve vücuben mahzûf «أخص» ile nasb mahallinde bulunurlar. Onlardan sonra gelen, elif-lâmlı, ref'i lâzım bir isimdir; onların lafzına sıfat veya bedeldir. Mahallerine tâbi olarak nasb edilmesi caiz değildir; âyet-i kerîmede olduğu gibi.

* Vocabulary:
(بِضْعَ سِنِينَ): البضع is what lies between three and nine, and most reports say he stayed in it seven years. One of the scholars of the language said: البضع, with kasra and with fatḥa, is what lies between one and five according to Abū ʿUbayda, while others said between one and ten. And البضع with fatḥa is "a slit", and البضع with damma is "intercourse". Some of them said:
شقّ وري وجماع بضع ... ما بين واحد وعشر بضع
(Slitting, watering and intercourse are بضع; and between one and ten is بضع.)
In al-Asās: "I have بضعة عشر men and بضع عشرة women" (the masculine with the tāʾ and the feminine without it, following the rule of numbers). "And I stayed with him بضع سنين, which is between three and ten." In al-Qāmūs and al-Tāj: "البضع and البضع is a portion of the night, and what lies between three and nine. One says بضع سنين and بضع عشرة of women and بضع وعشرون woman, and with the masculine بضعة عشر of men and بضعة وعشرون man. It is obligatory to put بضع first, so one does not say عشرون وبضع." Al-Ḥarīrī said in Durrat al-Ghawwāṣ: "بضع is most used for what lies between three and ten, and he traced that back to the Prophet ﷺ in the interpretation of His saying, the Exalted: «وهم من بعد غلبهم سيغلبون في بضع سنين». That is because the Muslims liked the Romans to prevail over the Persians because they were People of the Book, while the polytheists inclined to the Persians because they were idolaters. When Allah gave the Muslims the good news that the Romans would prevail, the Muslims were glad. Then Abū Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, told the polytheists of Quraysh what had been revealed to them, and Umayya ibn Khalaf said, 'Make a wager with me on that,' and he wagered him five young she-camels for a period of three years. Then he came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked him about the بضع, and he said: 'between three and ten.' He told him of his wager with Ibn Khalaf, and he said to him: 'What made you shorten the period?' He said, 'Trust in Allah and His Messenger.' He said to him: 'Go back to them and raise the stake, and extend the term.' So he added two she-camels and they added two years, and the Romans triumphed over the Persians before the second term ended, confirming Abū Bakr's estimate, may Allah be pleased with him."
(سِمانٍ): the plural of سمينة, and سمين is also pluralised on it; one says رجال سمان as one says نساء سمان. And السمن is the maṣdar of سمن يسمن, so he is سمين. The maṣdar and the noun came in an irregular form, since the regular form of both would be سمنا with fatḥa and فهو سمن, like فرح فرحا فهو فرح. In al-Miṣbāḥ: "سمن يسمن (of the pattern تعب, and in one dialect of the pattern قرب) when his flesh and fat become abundant; it is made transitive by the hamza and by doubling." Among figurative usages: كلام غثّ وسمين ("lean and fat speech"); أسمنت القدر ("I made the pot rich"); دار سمينة ("a fat house") for one with many people; سمّنوا لفلان means "they gave him much"; and سمّنت في الحمد means "I gave much in praise". Ibn Muqbil said:
تركت الخنا لست من أهله ... وسمّنت في الحمد حتى سمن
(I left obscenity, I am not of its people, and I fattened in praise until it grew fat.)
A Bedouin was heard saying to another: "I made the house yours without price so that my standing with you would be fatter." And their land turned to butter and honey (سمنة وعسلة) when both were abundant in it. And in the proverb «سمنكم هريق في أديمكم» ("your butter was spilled in your own skin"), that is, what is spent on you is your own.
(عِجافٌ): the plural of عجفاء in an irregular form; and العجف is emaciation beyond which there is none. The reason عجاف came as a plural of عجفاء, though أفعل and فعلاء are not pluralised on فعال, is that it was carried over onto سمان because it is its opposite; it is their habit to carry a like onto a like and an opposite onto an opposite. The regular form is عجف, like حمراء and حمر.
(رُءْيايَ): The grammarians distinguished between الرؤيا and الرؤية, saying: الرؤيا is the maṣdar of رأى in the sense of dreaming and الرؤية is the maṣdar of رأى in the sense of eye-sight, and they faulted Abū al-Ṭayyib in his saying:
مضى الليل والفضل الذي لك لم يمض ... ورؤياك أحلى في العيون من الغمض
(The night has passed, and the excellence that is yours has not passed; and seeing you is sweeter to the eyes than sleep.)
Abū al-Baqāʾ said in his commentary on the Dīwān of al-Mutanabbī: "الرؤيا is used for sleep only, and of it is His saying, the Exalted, «لقد صدق الله رسوله الرؤيا بالحق» and «لا تقصص رؤياك على إخوتك» and «إن كنتم للرؤيا تعبرون» and «قد صدقت الرؤيا»; all this is about sleep. Had he said «لقياك» it would have been better, but he took الرؤيا to mean الرؤية, like His saying, the Exalted, «وما جعلنا الرؤيا التي أريناك», for by it He did not mean a dream in sleep but waking vision, and that was at night, on the Night of the Journey."
Abū al-Fatḥ ibn Jinnī said: "الرؤيا is in sleep; as for with the eye, I do not know it, and if it comes it is anomalous."
Ibn Hishām said in Awḍaḥ al-Masālik: "الرؤيا is not restricted to the maṣdar of the dream sense, but may occur as the maṣdar of the visual sense, contrary to al-Ḥarīrī and Ibn Mālik, by the evidence of «وما جعلنا الرؤيا التي أريناك إلا فتنة للناس». Ibn ʿAbbās said: it was a vision of the eye. But the well-known usage is for the dream sense."
The author of al-Qāmūs restricted it to the dream: "الرؤيا is what you saw in your sleep", and its plural is رؤى like هدى.
(تَعْبُرُونَ): of the pattern نصر ينصر, and it is also used with doubling like علّم تعليما. In reality عبرت الرؤيا means "I mentioned its outcome and the end of its matter", as you say عبرت النهر when you crossed it until you reached the far side of its width, which is its ʿibr; or it is similar to "I interpreted the dream" when you mention its end, which is its return. The lightened عبرت الرؤيا is what the authorities relied on, and I have seen them deny the doubled عبرت and التعبير and المعبر, though I have come across a verse that al-Mubarrad cited in al-Kāmil by one of the Bedouins:
رأيت رؤيا ثم عبرتها ... وكنت للأحلام عبارا
(I saw a dream, then I interpreted it, and I was an interpreter of dreams.)
In al-Qāmūs: العبار is an intensive of العابر, the interpreter of dreams; and جمل عبار is a camel strong in travel. Today العبر is common with fatḥa and with kasra, and it is the bank and side of a valley; as for العبر with damma, it is the abundant of everything. And العبارة with kasra is a maṣdar, and the noun from عبّر, and the words indicating a meaning; one says "so-and-so has fine expression (ʿibāra)", i.e. clarity, and "this is an expression (ʿibāra) for such-and-such", i.e. it has its meaning and equals it in indication.
(أَضْغاثُ أَحْلامٍ): their confusions and falsehoods, and whatever there is of them from the self's talk or the devil's whispering. The origin of الأضغاث is what is gathered of mixed plants and bundled, the singular being ضغث, and it was borrowed for that. The annexation is in the sense of min, i.e. أضغاث من أحلام. In the proverb: «ضغث على إبالة»; الإبّالة, with kasra of the hamza and doubled bāʾ, is a bundle of grass and firewood, and الضغث is a handful of grass mixing fresh and dry. The meaning of the proverb is "a calamity upon another"; it is also used as a proverb for a man who loads his companion with something disagreeable and then wants it from him.
(ادَّكَرَ): with dāl, which is the eloquent form, and واذّكر with dhāl is permitted. Its origin is اذتكر, of the pattern افتعل from الذكر; the tāʾ of the pattern fell after the dhāl and was changed to dāl; then two close letters met, so the first was changed to the kind of the second and assimilated.
(أُمَّةٍ): with damma on the hamza, doubled mīm and a nunated tāʾ; it is the long period. الأمة is well-known, and الإمة with kasra of the hamza is "favour", and it was also read so. ʿAdī said:
ثم بعد الفلاح والملك والإمة ووارتهم هناك القبور
(Then after prosperity, kingship and favour, the graves covered them there.)

* I'rab:
(وَقالَ لِلَّذِي ظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ناجٍ مِنْهُمَا اذْكُرْنِي عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ): وقال is conjoined to what precedes, and its agent is Yūsuf; وللذي is attached to it, and the clause ظن is a ṣila, the agent of ظن also being Yūsuf; أن with what lies in its sphere stands in the place of the two objects of ظن; inna and its noun, and ناج its khabar; ومنهما is a ḥāl, i.e. "the saved one being one of the two", namely the cupbearer; the clause اذكرني is the content of the saying; وعند ربك is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl. (فَأَنْساهُ الشَّيْطانُ ذِكْرَ رَبِّهِ فَلَبِثَ فِي السِّجْنِ بِضْعَ سِنِينَ): فأنساه الشيطان: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أنساه is a verb and an object, and the pronoun refers back to the cupbearer, and الشيطان is the agent. The meaning: "the devil made him forget to mention Yūsuf to the king." It is also said: "Yūsuf was made to forget the mention of his Lord when he entrusted his affair to another." Many commentators held that the one whom the devil made forget the mention of his Lord was the one who was saved of the two servants, namely the cupbearer. This was preferred on the ground that the devil has no way against the prophets. It was answered that the forgetfulness occurred from Yūsuf and was attributed to the devil figuratively, and that prophets are not immune from forgetting except in what they convey from Allah, Glory be to Him. It is authentically reported from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he said:
«I am only a human being like you; I forget as you forget; so when I forget, remind me.» It was also preferred on the ground that forgetfulness is not a sin, so if the one whom the devil made forget the mention of his Lord were Yūsuf, he would not deserve punishment for that by staying in prison for several years. It was answered that forgetting here is leaving, and that he was punished for seeking help from other than Allah, Glory be to Him. What supports the return of the pronoun to Yūsuf is what follows it: «فلبث في السجن بضع سنين»; and what supports its return to the one saved of the two servants is His saying later on: «وقال الذي نجا منهما وادكر بعد أمة». ذكر is a second object. فلبث: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لبث is a verb with a latent agent; وفي السجن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; and بضع سنين is accusative as an adverbial, attached to لبث.
(وَقالَ الْمَلِكُ إِنِّي أَرى سَبْعَ بَقَراتٍ سِمانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجافٌ): inna and its noun, and the clause أرى is its khabar; سبع بقرات is a direct object, and سمان an adjective of بقرات. Why the cows were described and not "seven" will come in the section on Benefits. ويأكلهن سبع: an imperfect verb, an object and an agent, and عجاف an adjective of سبع; the clause يأكلهن is in the position of the accusative as a second object of أرى. He used the imperfect to bring the scene to mind. (وَسَبْعَ سُنْبُلاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يابِساتٍ): وسبع is conjoined to the first سبع, and سنبلات is muḍāf ilayhi, خضر an adjective of سنبلات, and أخر is conjoined to سبع (the discussion of its being a diptote will come in the section on Benefits), and يابسات is an adjective of أخر. (يا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي رُءْيايَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ لِلرُّءْيا تَعْبُرُونَ): أفتوني is an imperative indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw being the agent and the yāʾ the object; وفي رؤياي is attached to أفتوني; إن is conditional, and كنتم is kāna with its noun, in the position of the jussive as the protasis; the clause تعبرون is the khabar of كنتم, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes, i.e. "then give me a ruling on my dream". As for his saying للرؤيا, the preposition and its genitive noun have several possibilities. One: the lām is for clarification, as in His saying «وكانوا فيه من الزاهدين»; it and its genitive noun are in the position of an accusative ḥāl. Or the lām is for strengthening, because when the governed element precedes the governor it is not as strong in operating on it as it is when it follows it, so it is reinforced with it, just as the active participle is reinforced with it when you say عابر للرؤيا, due to its lowness from the verb in strength; so it is in the rule of the redundant and attaches to nothing; it was added merely for strengthening. And it is permissible that it be the khabar of كنتم, as you say كان فلان لهذا الأمر when he is capable of it and in command of it; in that case the clause تعبرون is a second khabar of كنتم. Al-Mubarrad said in al-Kāmil: This lām is added to the object in the sense of its being added in annexation; you say هذا ضارب زيدا and هذا ضارب لزيد, because it does not change the meaning of the annexation when you say هذا ضارب زيد and ضارب له; and in the Qur'an «وأمرت لأن أكون أول المسلمين» and likewise «إن كنتم للرؤيا تعبرون». (قالُوا أَضْغاثُ أَحْلامٍ وَما نَحْنُ بِتَأْوِيلِ الْأَحْلامِ بِعالِمِينَ): قالوا is a verb and an agent; أضغاث أحلام is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "these are confusions of dreams and mixtures of fancies", and the clause is the content of the saying; the secret of their pluralising it will come in the section on Rhetoric. وما: the wāw is a conjunction and ما is the Ḥijāzī negative; نحن is its noun; وبتأويل is attached to عالمين; the bāʾ is a redundant preposition and عالمين is genitive by the bāʾ in form, accusative in position as the khabar of ليس. (وَقالَ الَّذِي نَجا مِنْهُما وَادَّكَرَ بَعْدَ أُمَّةٍ): The wāw is a conjunction, and قال الذي is a verb and an agent, the clause نجا is a ṣila, ومنهما is a ḥāl, and وادكر is conjoined to نجا; وبعد أمة is attached to ادكر. It is permissible that the wāw be circumstantial, and the clause نجا a ḥāl from the relative or from its returning pronoun, i.e. the agent of نجا. (أَنَا أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِتَأْوِيلِهِ فَأَرْسِلُونِ): أنا is a mubtadaʾ and the clause أنبئكم its khabar, the kāf being its object; وبتأويله is attached to أنبئكم; فأرسلون: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and أرسلوني is an imperative, an agent and an object, i.e. "if you wish the interpretation of the dream, then send me". (يُوسُفُ أَيُّهَا الصِّدِّيقُ أَفْتِنا فِي سَبْعِ بَقَراتٍ سِمانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجافٌ وَسَبْعِ سُنْبُلاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يابِساتٍ): An omitted element is necessary, i.e. "so they sent him, and Yūsuf came in the prison and said". Yūsuf is the one addressed from which the vocative particle is omitted; أيها is accusative in position on the way of specification (ikhtiṣāṣ), because it is indeclinable on damma, and الصديق is a badal of it or an explicative apposition (ʿaṭf bayān), following it by wording; the discussion of ikhtiṣāṣ will come in the section on Benefits. أفتنا is an imperative indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, its agent latent, "you", and نا an object; وفي سبع is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أفتنا; بقرات is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause يأكلهن سبع عجاف is an adjective of بقرات, and what follows is conjoined to it. (لَعَلِّي أَرْجِعُ إِلَى النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ): laʿalla and its noun, and the clause أرجع is its khabar; وإلى الناس is attached to أرجع; and لعلهم يعلمون is like it. (قالَ: تَزْرَعُونَ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ دَأَباً): The clause تزرعون is the content of the saying, and سبع سنين is an adverbial attached to تزرعون; and دأبا is a ḥāl from those addressed, i.e. "diligently", or a maṣdar of an omitted verb, i.e. تدأبون دأبا ("you labour in labour").
(فَما حَصَدْتُمْ فَذَرُوهُ فِي سُنْبُلِهِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ): The fāʾ is a conjunction, and ما may be conditional or relative, and it is in the position of an accusative fronted object of حصدتم in both cases; حصدتم is a verb and an agent; فذروه: the fāʾ falls in the apodosis of the condition, or of the relative because of the scent of condition in it; and ذروه is a verb, an agent and an object; وفي سنبله is attached to فذروه; إلا is a particle of exception, and قليلا is an excepted noun that must be accusative; ومما is an adjective of قليلا and the clause تأكلون is a ṣila. (ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِ ذلِكَ سَبْعٌ شِدادٌ): ثم is a particle of conjunction and delay, and يأتي is an imperfect verb; ومن بعد ذلك is a ḥāl; سبع is the agent of يأتي and شداد an adjective of سبع. (يَأْكُلْنَ ما قَدَّمْتُمْ لَهُنَّ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِمَّا تُحْصِنُونَ): The clause يأكلن is a second adjective of سبع, the nūn being the agent and ما an object; the clause قدمتم is the ṣila of ما, and لهن is attached to قدمتم; إلا is a particle of exception, قليلا is excepted, ومما is an adjective of قليلا, and the clause تحصنون is a ṣila. (ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِ ذلِكَ عامٌ فِيهِ يُغاثُ النَّاسُ وَفِيهِ يَعْصِرُونَ)
Likewise a conjunction, and the clause فيه يغاث الناس is an adjective of عام; ويعصرون is conjoined to يغاث, i.e. "they press the grapes and the like".

* Rhetoric:
1- Exaggeration:
They pluralised the word الضغث, saying أضغاث أحلام, and made it the khabar of a single dream, to exaggerate in describing the dream as false, or because it comprised mutually different things. The plural wording, as it indicates a multitude of entities, also indicates exaggeration in the attribution, as in their saying "so-and-so rides horses and wears turbans" of one who owns only one mare and a single turban.

2- Negating a thing by affirming it:
This was pointed to earlier and we add some expansion here, for it is among the beauties of speech: if you consider it, you find its inner meaning is negation and its outer is affirmation. Imruʾ al-Qays said:
على لا حب لا يهتدى بمناره ... إذا سافه العود النباطي جرجرا
(On a road with no clear track, which is not guided by its landmark; when the old Nabaṭī camel sniffs it, it groans.)
By his saying لا يهتدى بمناره he did not mean that it has a landmark which does not guide, but meant that it has no landmark at all, let alone being guided by it. Likewise the saying of Zuhayr ibn Abī Sulmā:
بأرض خلاء لا يسدّ وصيدها ... علي ومعروفي بها غير منكر
(In an empty land whose threshold is not closed against me, and my kindness in it is not disowned.)
He affirmed for it in wording a threshold, but meant only that it has no threshold that could be closed against him. Connected with this is the saying of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, mentioning ʿUmayla ibn al-Sabbāq ibn ʿAbd al-Dār, who was his drinking companion and friend:
صبحت بهم طلقا يراح إلى الندى ... إذا ما انتشى لم تحتضره صاقره
ضعيفا يحث الكأس قبض بنانه ... كليلا على وجه النديم أظافره
(I greeted them at morning with one cheerful, going out to generosity, who, when he is merry, is not attended by his hawk-claws; weak, his fingertips' grip urges the cup on, his nails blunt upon the face of his boon-companion.)
[Translator's note: the Arabic of these two verses, and the explanation below, is as in the source; the wording «صاقره» in the first verse differs from «مفاقره» in the explanation.]
The outer meaning of his words is that he scratches the face of his boon-companion, except that his nails are blunt; but in reality he meant that he does not claw the face of his companion and does nothing of that sort. Likewise his saying لم تحتضره مفاقره, i.e. he has no needs (mafāqir) that would attend him. What is more eloquent than that will come in its place, namely His saying, the Exalted: «لا يسألون الناس إلحافا», that is, they do not ask at all. And in the verse we are concerned with, the Creator, the Exalted, meant to negate false dreams in particular, as if they said: "And there is no interpretation of false dreams for us to be knowers of it." And the beauty is completed by correspondence: the king had said to them first «إن كنتم للرؤيا تعبرون», to show that in his knowledge they were not knowers of it, since he used the word «إن», which conveys doubt, hoping for their admission of shortcoming, matching the king's doubt which he put in the form of a question about whether they were knowers of dreams at all. And the saying of the youth «أنا أنبئكم بتأويله» up to «لعلي أرجع إلى الناس لعلهم يعلمون» is also evidence of that. Glory be to the Speaker of these words.

* Benefits:
1- He, Glory be to Him, put His saying «سمان» as an adjective of the specifier (al-mumayyiz), which is بقرات, and not of the specified (al-mumayyaz), which is سبع. «[Translator's note: the source writes these two terms in a garbled way (الميّز and المميّز); they are rendered according to the sense.]» The difference between the two matters, both permissible in the rules of grammar, is that if you make it an adjective of بقرات, you mean to specify the seven by a kind of cows, namely the fat ones among them specifically, not by their genus; and if you make it an adjective of سبع, you mean to specify the seven by the genus of cows, not by a particular kind of them, and then you go back and describe the specified, which is by genus, with fatness.
2- The word أخر indicates that the dry ears were seven like the green, without stating the number. That is because the speech is built on its flowing toward this number in the fat cows, the lean cows and the green ears, so the meaning of أخر must include the seven, and His saying وأخر يابسات means وسبعا أخر ("and seven others").
3- أخر:
An adjective turned (maʿdūl) from the pattern آخر. The turning of an adjective has two places:
A- Numbers on the pattern «فعال ومفعل», like أحاد and موحد, ثناء and مثنى, ثلاث and مثلث, رباع and مربع; they are turned from واحد واحد and اثنين اثنين, etc. If you say جاء القوم مثنى the meaning is that they came two by two. They said that turning in numbers is heard from the Arabs up to four, but the grammarians extended that by analogy to ten; and the truth is that it is heard for one and ten and what lies between. Abū al-Ṭayyib said:
أحاد أم سداس في أحاد ... لييلتنا المنوطة بالتناد
(Is it one by one or six within ones, our little night that is tied to the Day of Calling?)
B- أخر in your saying مررت بنساء أخر, and the Exalted said «فعدة من أيام أخر»; it is the plural of أخرى, the feminine of آخر, and آخر, with fatḥa on the khāʾ, is an elative on the pattern أفعل in the sense of "other"; the analogy would have been to say مررت بنساء آخر, as one says مررت بنساء أفضل, because an elative stripped of من, of al and of annexation is neither feminised, dualised nor pluralised.
4- Specification (al-ikhtiṣāṣ):
It is putting a noun in the accusative by an obligatorily omitted verb, its implied form being أخص or أعني, and this noun occurs only after a pronoun to clarify what is meant by it, as in: نحن العرب نكرم الضيف ("we Arabs honour the guest"); نحن is a mubtadaʾ and the clause نكرم الضيف is the khabar, and العرب is accusative by specification through an omitted verb, its implied form being أخص, and the clause of the omitted verb is parenthetical between the mubtadaʾ and its khabar. The intention is not to predicate "the Arabs" of نحن; rather, it is that honouring the guest is particular to the Arabs and restricted to them. Of it is the saying of Abū ʿUbāda al-Buḥturī:
نحن أبناء يعرب، أعرب النا ... س لسانا وأنضر الناس عودا
(We are the sons of Yaʿrub, the most eloquent of people in tongue and the most flourishing of people in stock.)
Specification may also be with the word أيها and أيتها, which are used as they are used in the vocative, so they are indeclinable on damma and are in the position of the accusative through an obligatorily omitted أخص, and what follows them is a noun with al that must be nominative as an adjective or a badal of their wording; it is not permitted to put it in the accusative as following their position, as in the noble verse.

* I'rab:
(فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوا إِلى أَبِيهِمْ قالُوا يا أَبانا مُنِعَ مِنَّا الْكَيْلُ): the فاء is a conjunction, and لما is temporal or connective. رجعوا: a verb and an agent. إلى أبيهم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رجعوا. The clause قالوا has no grammatical position. يا is a vocative particle, and أبانا is the one addressed, a muḍāf. منع: a passive past verb. منا: attached to منع. الكيل: a deputy agent. They are alluding to Yūsuf's words, "فإن لم تأتوني به فلا كيل لكم عندي".
(فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنا أَخانا نَكْتَلْ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحافِظُونَ): the فاء is the eloquent fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa). أرسل: an imperative verb. معنا: attached to أرسل. أخانا: a direct object. نكتل: an imperfect verb, jussive in answer to the request. وإنا: inna and its subject. له: attached to حافظون. The shifted lām. حافظون: the khabar of inna.
(قالَ هَلْ آمَنُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا كَما أَمِنْتُكُمْ عَلى أَخِيهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ): the clause is resumptive, the answer to an implied question, as parallels to this have already occurred in many places. هل: an interrogative particle. آمنكم: an imperfect verb, a latent agent and an object. عليه: attached to آمنكم. إلا: a particle of restriction. كما أمنتكم: the kāf is an adjective of an omitted absolute object, and ما is maṣdar-forming. He means: "You said about Yūsuf, 'وإنا له لحافظون', just as you say it about his brother Binyāmīn, and then you betrayed your guarantee, so how can I trust you?" وعلى أخيه: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أمنتكم. ومن قبل: a ḥāl, that is, "before this time".
(فَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حافِظاً وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ): the فاء is the eloquent fāʾ. الله: a mubtadaʾ. خير: the khabar. حافظا: a tamyīz (specification) or a ḥāl. هو: a mubtadaʾ. أرحم الراحمين: the khabar. The meaning is that he put his trust in Allah and handed Binyāmīn over to them.
(وَلَمَّا فَتَحُوا مَتاعَهُمْ وَجَدُوا بِضاعَتَهُمْ رُدَّتْ إِلَيْهِمْ): لما is temporal or connective. فتحوا متاعهم: a verb, an agent and a direct object. ووجدوا بضاعتهم: a verb, an agent and a direct object. The clause ردت إليهم is in the position of the accusative as the second object of وجدوا.
(قالُوا يا أَبانا ما نَبْغِي): قالوا: a verb and an agent. يا أبانا: the one addressed, a muḍāf. ما: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a fronted object of نبغي, that is, "what more do we seek and ask of generosity than this? Here are our goods, returned to us." al-Zajjāj said: it may be negative, that is, "there is nothing left for us to ask for"; it is also possible that نبغي is from al-baghy (transgression), that is, "we have not fabricated, so we lied about this king."
(هذِهِ بِضاعَتُنا رُدَّتْ إِلَيْنا): هذه: a mubtadaʾ. بضاعتنا: the khabar. The clause ردت إلينا is circumstantial. It is also permissible to parse بضاعتنا as a badal (substitute) from هذه, with the clause ردت إلينا as the khabar; the sentence is resumptive, introduced to clarify their words ما نبغي.
(وَنَمِيرُ أَهْلَنا وَنَحْفَظُ أَخانا وَنَزْدادُ كَيْلَ بَعِيرٍ): the واو is conjoined to an omitted clause, that is, "we shall be strengthened and helped by it, and we shall provide for our family". أهلنا: a direct object. ونحفظ أخانا: a clause conjoined to what precedes. ونزداد: also a conjoined clause. كيل بعير: a direct object of نزداد.
(ذلِكَ كَيْلٌ يَسِيرٌ): ذلك: a mubtadaʾ. كيل: the khabar. يسير: an adjective; that is, the measure of a camel-load that we shall gain is easy for the king, since he has treated us well and honoured us more than that.
(قالَ لَنْ أُرْسِلَهُ مَعَكُمْ حَتَّى تُؤْتُونِ مَوْثِقاً مِنَ اللَّهِ): لن is a particle of negation, accusative and futurity. أرسله: an imperfect verb made accusative by لن. معكم: an adverb attached to أرسله. حتى: a particle of limit and genitive. تؤتوني: an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن; the nūn is for protection and the first-person yāʾ is a first direct object. موثقا: a second direct object. من الله: an adjective. Swearing by Allah is made a pledge because swearing by Him is among the things by which covenants are confirmed.
(لَتَأْتُنَّنِي بِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ يُحاطَ بِكُمْ): the lām occurs in the answer to the oath indicated by his word موثقا. تأتنني: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which is dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the plural wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the agent; the yāʾ is a direct object; the doubled nūn is for emphasis and the third nūn is the nūn of protection. Parallels to this parsing have already occurred. إلا is a particle of exception. أن and what is in its scope are an unrestricted exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh) from the most general of circumstances, that is, "you shall surely bring him to me in every circumstance except the circumstance of being encompassed"; so it is a ḥāl; or an unrestricted exception from the most general of causes, that is, "you shall not refrain from bringing him for any cause except the cause of being encompassed." The Arabs say أحيط بفلان when he perished or was on the verge of perishing. Abū Ḥayyān's wording is: "This exception is from the object of purpose (mafʿūl min ajlihi), taking into account his words لتأتنني, even though it is affirmative in wording and negative in meaning, because the meaning is 'you shall not refrain from bringing him for anything among things except that you be encompassed'. An example of what is affirmative in wording and negative in meaning is their saying أنشدك الله إلا فعلت, that is, 'I ask you by Allah only to do it'. It is not permissible that it be excepted from circumstances, being interpreted by a maṣdar standing as a ḥāl, even though an explicit maṣdar may stand as a ḥāl, so that the implied sense would be 'you shall bring him in every circumstance except encompassment', that is, 'encompassed', because they have stated explicitly that the أن that makes a verb accusative does not stand as a ḥāl, even if it is interpreted by the maṣdar which may itself stand as a ḥāl. If you make أن and the verb stand in the place of the maṣdar that stands as an adverb of time, the implied sense would be 'you shall bring him in every time except the time of being encompassed'." I say: Ibn al-Anbārī prevented that, and said in effect: "خروجنا صياح الديك is permissible, that is, at the time of the cock's crowing, but خروجنا أن يصيح الديك and خروجنا ما يصيح الديك are not permissible, even if أن and ما are maṣdar-forming, since only the explicitly stated maṣdar stands as an adverb." Ibn Jinnī allowed it to stand as an adverb just as the explicit maṣdar does, and so he allowed, in the saying of Taʾabbaṭa Sharran:
وقالوا لها لا تنكحيه فإنه ... لأول نصل أن يلاقي مجمعا
(They said to her, "Do not marry him, for he is the first blade, if he meets a gathering,")
and in the saying of Abū Dhuʾayb al-Hudhalī:
وتالله ما إن شهلة أمّ واحد ... بأوجد مني أن يهان صغيرها
(By Allah, Shahla, mother of one, is not more grief-stricken than I when her little one is humiliated,)
that أن يلاقى be taken as "the time of his meeting the gathering," and أن يهان as "the time of the humiliation of her little one." On what Ibn Jinnī allowed, it is permissible for the verse to be explained in this way, and for لتأتنني به to stay on its apparent affirmative sense, with no meaning of negation implied in it. [Translator's note: the source has لا تستنعون, apparently a misprint for لا تمتنعون; the translation follows the intended sense. The wording of the two verses is rendered as given.]
(فَلَمَّا آتَوْهُ مَوْثِقَهُمْ قالَ: اللَّهُ عَلى ما نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌ): the فاء is a conjunction, and لما has preceded. آتوه: a verb, an agent and a first direct object. موثقهم: a second direct object. الله: a mubtadaʾ. على ما نقول: attached to وكيل. وكيل: the khabar of الله.
(وَقالَ يا بَنِيَّ لا تَدْخُلُوا مِنْ بابٍ واحِدٍ): يا is a vocative particle. بني: the one addressed, a muḍāf, and its sign of the accusative is the yāʾ because it is attached to the sound masculine plural. لا is prohibitive. تدخلوا: an imperfect verb jussive through لا. من باب: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تدخلوا. واحد: an adjective. He feared that they would draw attention by entering as one group and so be struck by the evil eye or suffer harm.
(وَادْخُلُوا مِنْ أَبْوابٍ مُتَفَرِّقَةٍ وَما أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ): وادخلوا: an imperative verb, indeclinable through the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent. من أبواب: attached to ادخلوا. متفرقة: an adjective. وما أغني: ما is negative, and أغني is an imperfect verb whose agent is latent, its implied form being "I". عنكم: attached to أغني. من الله: a ḥāl. من: a redundant preposition. شيء: genitive in form, accusative in position as a direct object.
(إِنِ الْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَعَلَيْهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ): إن is negative. الحكم: a mubtadaʾ. إلا: a particle of restriction. لله: the khabar. عليه: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to توكلت. وعليه: a conjoining of clause to clause. فليتوكل: the lām is the lām of command, and يتوكل is an imperfect verb jussive through the lām of command. المتوكلون: the agent.

* Vocabulary:
(الحاجة): al-arab and al-lubāna. In its derivation it goes back to a single idea, namely dwelling on a thing and clinging to it, since the one who has a need is devoted to it, constantly thinking of it, dwelling on its fulfilment. The origin of (الْحاجِّ) is that it is a tree with thorns, and whatever is of this kind clings to things, as Ibn Jinnī says in al-Khaṣāʾiṣ: whatever passes by it, it catches and clings to. So the "need" was named after it by comparison with the thorny tree, as if to say: I am dwelling upon it, holding fast to its fulfilment, like this tree in drawing to itself whatever passes by or comes near. Al-ḥawjāʾ is from it, and from it the verb is conjugated: iḥtāja yaḥtāju iḥtiyājan, aḥwaja yuḥwiju, and ḥāja yaḥūju, so he is ḥāʾij.
Al-arab is from al-arba, which is a knot; ʿaqd muʾarrab means "tightened". The need is knotted in the soul of the person, going back and forth in his thought. Al-lubāna is from their saying talabbana bi-l-makān when he stayed there and kept to it, and this is the very same meaning.
This is a weighty topic which, if it becomes familiar, leads to knowing the meanings of words and picturing their referents. al-Zajjāj mentioned in his Amālī from Ibn al-Aʿrābī that al-ʿashaqa is a tree called al-lublāba, which turns green, then thin, then yellow; from that comes the derivation of al-ʿāshiq (the lover). In the lexicon: ʿashiqa bihi, like fariḥa, means he clung to it; and al-ʿishq is the love of a lover for his beloved, or it is excess of love and intensity of attachment to it. So the original material meaning is clear, and it turned into a figurative one with a deeply rooted link between it and its derivatives. al-Zajjāj also related that the origin of al-mughāzala (flirtation) is from al-idāra (turning round) and al-fatl (twisting), because it is turning someone from a matter; from it the spindle (mighzal) was named, for its turning round and the speed of its rotation, and the gazelle (ghazāl) was named ghazāl for its speed, and the sun was named ghazāla for its turning round and its speed. He gave the reason for turning from a matter in his words: "It is said ghāzala al-kalb al-ẓabya when it ran in its track and caught up with it and overpowered it and then turned away from it; from that comes flirting with women. He said: it is as if a man plays with her and she makes him hope for herself, and when he seeks to kiss her she turns away." Then, al-ghazāla may also be the feminine of al-ghazāl; it has occurred in the speech of the Arabs, in verse and prose, old and new. al-Ṣafadī denied it in his commentary on Lāmiyyat al-ʿAjam and said: it is heard only in the sense of the sun; al-Damāmīnī rejected him and cited many attestations for it, and were it not sound, the double entendre (tawriya) would not have occurred in the poet's words about the eagle:
ترى الطير والوحش في كفها ... ومنقارها ذا عظام مزاله
فلو أمكن الشمس من خوفها ... إذا طلعت ما تسمت غزاله
(You see the birds and the wild beasts in its talon, and in its beak bones, shattered. If the sun could, out of fear of it, when it rises, it would not have been called Ghazāla.)
One who goes deep in tracing the relations among words arrives at a curious doctrine and a deep secret in the origin of language and the branching of speech within it, and in this book you will see wonders from among these secrets.
(السِّقايَةَ): a drinking vessel from which water is given to drink. It is the ṣuwāʿ mentioned later; the king used to drink from it, so it was called siqāya with regard to its first state and ṣāʿ with regard to its later one, because the ṣāʿ is a measure of volume. It was said it was an elongated vessel resembling the makkūk; it was said it was the Persian makkūk whose two ends meet, from which the non-Arabs drink; it was said it was of silver gilded with gold; it was said it was of gold; it was said it was studded with jewels.
(رَحْلِ): al-raḥl, with a fatḥa on the rāʾ, is what is placed on the camel's back, like a saddle; what is meant here is the place where he rides.
(الْعِيرُ): with a kasra on the ʿayn, camels on which loads are carried because they go to and fro (taʿīr); it was said: a caravan of donkeys, and then it became common so that every caravan was called ʿīr as if it were the plural of ʿayr. What is meant is the people of the caravan, as will come under Rhetoric.
(صُواعَ): al-ṣuwāʿ with a ḍamma on the ṣād, and al-ṣāʿ, are two dialectal forms with one meaning; it is the measure of volume. It has already been mentioned that it is the siqāya, and this vessel was taken as a measure only because of the scarcity of what is measured with at that time.
(السَّارِقُ): the one who steals goods from safe places. The Arabs have a detailed classification of thieves. If he waylays caravans, he is a liṣṣ and a farḍūb. If he steals camels, he is a khārib; or sheep, he is an aḥmaṣ, and al-ḥamīṣa is a stolen sheep. If he steals dirhams from between a person's fingers, he is a qaffāf. If he slits pockets to get at them, he is a ṭarrār. If he specialises in theft, wickedness and depravity, he is a ṭamil. If he steals, commits adultery and harms people, he is a dāʿir. If he is wicked and loathsome, he is an ʿifr, and "ʿifrīya nifrīya". If he is the worst of thieves, he is an ʿamrūṭ. If he guides thieves and insinuates himself among them, he is a shaṣṣ. If he eats and drinks with them and guards their goods but does not steal with them, he is a lafīf.
As for al-liṣṣ, the lām may take three vowels, and some lexicographers distinguished between them, saying:
إغلاق باب ستر فعل لصّ ... وسارق بالحركات لصّ
جمع الألصّ من رجال لصّ ... منضم أضراس فكن ذا خبر
(Closing a door, a covering, the act of a thief; and a thief with the vowelings, liṣṣ. The plural of al-alaṣṣ among men is luṣṣ, one whose teeth are joined; so be well informed.)
[Translator's note: the two verses are rendered as given in the source, whose wording appears corrupt; the gloss is tentative.]

* I'rab:
(وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَهُمْ أَبُوهُمْ): لما is temporal or connective. من: a preposition. حيث: an adverb indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive through من; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to دخلوا, and the meaning is "separately". The clause أمرهم أبوهم is annexed to the adverb.
(ما كانَ يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ): the clause is the answer to لما; it was also said that the answer is آوى إليه أخاه. Abū l-Baqāʾ said: it is the answer to the first لما and the second. ما is negative. كان is a defective past verb, and its subject is the pronoun of separation indicated by the preceding speech. عنهم: attached to يغني. من الله: a ḥāl. من: a redundant preposition. شيء: genitive in form, accusative in position as a direct object.
(إِلَّا حاجَةً فِي نَفْسِ يَعْقُوبَ قَضاها): a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ) in the sense of "but a need in the soul of Yaʿqūb which he fulfilled", namely his solicitude for them. في نفس: an adjective. يعقوب: a muḍāf ilayhi. The clause قضاها is an adjective of حاجة.
(وَإِنَّهُ لَذُو عِلْمٍ لِما عَلَّمْناهُ وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لا يَعْلَمُونَ): the واو is circumstantial. إن and its subject; the shifted lām; ذو علم is the khabar of إن. The clause علمناه is a ṣila. ولكن: the واو is also circumstantial; لكن and its subject; the clause لا يعلمون is the khabar.
(وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلى يُوسُفَ آوى إِلَيْهِ أَخاهُ): its parsing has preceded. أخاه: the object of آوى, and the clause is the answer to the first لما and the second.
(قالَ إِنِّي أَنَا أَخُوكَ فَلا تَبْتَئِسْ بِما كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ): إن and its subject; أنا is a mubtadaʾ, أخوك a khabar, and the clause is the khabar of إن. The clause is resumptive, and so is every case where a reply was required and its reply was mentioned and then قال came after it: it is resumptive. The فاء is the eloquent fāʾ. لا is prohibitive. تبتئس: an imperfect verb jussive through لا. بما: attached to تبتئس. The clause كانوا is a ṣila, and the clause يعملون is the khabar of كانوا.
(فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُمْ بِجَهازِهِمْ جَعَلَ السِّقايَةَ فِي رَحْلِ أَخِيهِ): the فاء is a conjunction indicating their eager desire to travel. لما is temporal or connective. جهزهم: a verb, an agent and a direct object. بجهازهم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جهزهم. The clause جعل السقاية في رحل أخيه has no grammatical position. في رحل: attached to جعل.
(ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ أَيَّتُهَا الْعِيرُ إِنَّكُمْ لَسارِقُونَ): ثم is a conjunction implying delay. أذن مؤذن: a verb and an agent, that is, a caller called. It was conjoined with ثم to indicate Yūsuf's giving them respite until they set off. أيتها: the one addressed, with the vocative particle omitted; it is an indefinite specific noun (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the hāʾ is for alerting. العير: a badal from أيتها. إن and its subject; the shifted lām; سارقون is its khabar.
(قالُوا وَأَقْبَلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ ماذا تَفْقِدُونَ): the واو is circumstantial, with an implied قد. عليهم: attached to أقبلوا. ماذا: an interrogative noun, a fronted object of تفقدون; or ما is an interrogative noun and ذا a relative noun, the khabar, and the clause تفقدون is the ṣila. What was said about ماذا has already preceded.
(قالُوا نَفْقِدُ صُواعَ الْمَلِكِ): the clause نفقد صواع الملك is the quoted speech.
(وَلِمَنْ جاءَ بِهِ حِمْلُ بَعِيرٍ وَأَنَا بِهِ زَعِيمٌ): the واو is a conjunction. ولمن: a fronted khabar. The clause جاء به is a ṣila. حمل بعير: a postponed mubtadaʾ. The واو is a conjunction. أنا: a mubtadaʾ. به: attached to زعيم. زعيم, that is, a guarantor: the khabar.
(قالُوا تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمْ ما جِئْنا لِنُفْسِدَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَما كُنَّا سارِقِينَ): the tāʾ is a particle of genitive and oath. لله: the word of majesty, genitive through the oath-tāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "we swear". The lām occurs in the answer to the oath, or is an emphasis of the first oath. قد: a particle of affirmation. علمتم: a verb and an agent. ما: negative. جئنا: a verb and an agent. لنفسد: the lām is for causation, and the agent is latent, its implied form being "we". في الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نفسد. وما كنا: ما is negative; kāna and its subject; سارقين is its khabar. They swore with the tāʾ, among the particles of oath, because of the sense of wonder it usually carries, as if they wondered at being accused of this matter. The tāʾ enters an oath only on the word Allah among His names, the Exalted; you do not say تالرحمن or تالرحيم, but its entering on al-Rabb, on al-Raḥmān, and on "your life" has been reported from the Arabs; they said ترب الكعبة, تالرحمن and تحياتك.

* Rhetoric:
In the words of the Exalted "أيتها العير انكم لسارقون" there is a mixed figurative expression (majāz mursal) whose relation is contiguity, the meaning being the people of the caravan, as in the hadith "يا خيل الله اركبي" (O horses of Allah, mount!). Concerning al-ʿīr, a question arose in the assembly of Sayf al-Dawla ibn Ḥamdān, the questioner being Ibn Khālawayh and the one questioned being al-Mutanabbī. Ibn Khālawayh said: "al-baʿīr is also the donkey, and this is a rare usage which I put to al-Mutanabbī in the presence of Sayf al-Dawla; he had in him some haughtiness and arrogance, and became flustered. I said: what is meant by al-baʿīr in the words of the Exalted «ولمن جاء به حمل بعير» is the donkey, because Yaʿqūb and his brother Yūsuf, peace be upon them, were in the land of Canaan, where there were no camels; they used to get provisions on donkeys." Muqātil ibn Sulaymān mentioned it likewise in his commentary.

* Lügat:
(كِدْنا): «الكيد» aslında hile ve aldatmadır; bu da Allah Teâlâ hakkında muhaldir. Daha önce geçtiği üzere, Allah Teâlâ hakkında (yanlış mânâ) vehmettiren bu tür lafızlar, gayelerin başlangıçlarına değil sonlarına hamledilir. Keydin (başlangıcı) hile ve aldatma işinde çalışmaktır; sonu ise insanı, farkında olmadığı yerden, defetmeye imkânı bulunmayan hoşa gitmeyen bir işe düşürmektir. Allah Teâlâ'ya nisbetle «keyd» bu mânâya hamledilir. İbnü'l-A'râbî şöyle demiştir: «الكيد», bâtıl ile ve hak ile tedbir almaktır; buna göre mânâ «Yûsuf için böyle tedbir aldık» olur. İbnü'l-Haşşâb'ın ifadesi şöyledir: «"كاد"nın bir başka kullanımı daha vardır ki onda "أراد" (istedi) mânâsındadır. Ebü'l-Hasen "el-Ahfeş" ve başkaları bu mânâda şu beyti inşad etmiştir:
كادت وكدت وتلك خير إرادة ... لو عاد من عصر الشبيبة ما مضى
(O istedi, ben de istedim; gençlik çağından geçip gidenler geri dönseydi bu, isteklerin en hayırlısı olurdu.)
Allah Teâlâ'nın "كذلك كدنا ليوسف" sözünü de buna hamletmişlerdir; yani "istedik".» [Mütercim notu: Metinde «وحسلوا» yazılmıştır; «وحملوا» okunarak çevrilmiştir.]
(اسْتَيْأَسُوا): ümitlerini kestiler. «س» ve «ت»nın ziyadesi mübalağa içindir; «عجب» ve «استعجب», «سخر» ve «استسخر» gibi.
(خَلَصُوا): insanlardan ayrılıp tek başlarına kaldılar; kimse onlara karışmaksızın yalnız kaldılar.
(نَجِيًّا): «النجي», «مفاعل» mânâsında «فعيل»dir; «المعاشر» ve «المخالط» mânâsındaki «العشير» ve «الخليط» gibi. Allah Teâlâ'nın «وقربناه نجيا» sözündeki gibi; yani «gizlice konuşan olarak». Bu kullanım mutlak olarak tekil kalır; «هم خليطك وعشيرك», yani «onlar seninle karışanlar ve seninle yaşayanlardır» denir. Ya da «صديق» ve benzerleri gibi «فعيل» sıfatı üzere olduğu için tekil kılınmıştır; çünkü «الصهيل», «الوحيد» ve «الذميل» gibi masdarların veznindedir. Ya da «التناجي» (fısıldaşma) mânâsında masdar olduğu içindir; nitekim «النجوى» da aynı mânâda kullanılmıştır.

* İ'rab:
(قالُوا فَما جَزاؤُهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ كاذِبِينَ): «ف» fasîha fâsı; «ما» istifhâm ismi olup mübtedâ; «جزاؤه» haberdir. Zamir «الصواع»a aittir, yani «onu çalmanın cezası nedir?»; ya da zamir hırsıza aittir. «إن» şart edatı; «كنتم» fiilü'ş-şart; «كاذبين» kâne'nin haberi. «إن»in cevabı mahzûftur; öncesi ona delâlet eder; yani «(öyleyse) ölçeği çalmanın — ya da hırsızın — cezası nedir?»
(قالُوا جَزاؤُهُ مَنْ وُجِدَ فِي رَحْلِهِ فَهُوَ جَزاؤُهُ): «جزاؤه» mübtedâdır. «من» şart edatı veya ism-i mevsûl olup ikinci mübtedâdır. «وجد» sıla veya fiilü'ş-şarttır. «في رحله», «وجد»e müteallik. «ف» her iki vecihte de râbıtadır. «هو» mübtedâ, «جزاؤه» haberdir; «فهو جزاؤه» cümlesi «من»in haberidir. «من» ve etki alanındaki kısım birinci mübtedânın haberidir; bu i'raba göre zamir hırsıza döner. «جزاؤه»nun mübtedâ olması, «ه»nın çalınan şeye dönmesi ve «من وجد في رحله»nin onun haberi olması da caizdir; «من», «الذي» mânâsındadır ve takdir: «Ölçeğin cezası, yükünde bulunan kimsedir.» «جزاؤه»nun mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberi olması da caizdir; yani «Sorulan şey onun cezasıdır», yani «onun köle edilmesi onun cezasıdır.» Bu, Ya'kûb ailesinin şeriatı idi.
(كَذلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ): «كذلك» mahzûf bir masdarın sıfatıdır; yani «Zalimleri bu ceza gibi bir ceza ile cezalandırırız.» «الظالمين» mef'ûlün bihtir. Yani aramızda kararlaştırılmış şeriatımızda da bu böyledir.
(فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعاءِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَخْرَجَها مِنْ وِعاءِ أَخِيهِ): «ف» atıf harfi; «بدأ» mâzî fiil olup fâili müstetir, takdiri «هو»dur; «بأوعيتهم» câr ve mecrûr olup «بدأ»ya müteallik; «قبل» zaman zarfı olup mahzûf bir hâle müteallik; «وعاء أخيه» muzâf ve muzâfun ileyh. «ثم» atıf harfi; «استخرجها» fiil, müstetir fâil ve mef'ûlün bih. «ها» «الصواع»a döner; çünkü onda müzekkerlik ve müenneslik (her ikisi) vardır; ya da «السقاية»ya döner, çünkü «الصواع» onun mânâsını taşır. «من وعاء أخيه», «استخرجها»ya müteallik.
(كَذلِكَ كِدْنا لِيُوسُفَ): Yani «Bu keyd gibi Yûsuf için keyd ettik.» «ك», daha önce geçtiği gibi mahzûf bir masdarın sıfatıdır; «ليوسف», «كدنا»ya müteallik.
(ما كانَ لِيَأْخُذَ أَخاهُ فِي دِينِ الْمَلِكِ): «ما» nefy harfi; «كان» nâkıs mâzî fiil, ismi müstetir; lâm cuhûd lâmıdır; «يأخذ» cuhûd lâmından sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiil; lâm ve mecrûru haber mevkiindedir. «أخاه» mef'ûlün bih; «في دين الملك» hâldir.
(إِلَّا أَنْ يَشاءَ اللَّهُ): İstisnâ munkatı'dır; zira hükümdarın dinine göre almak, «إلا أن يشاء الله» sözüyle kastedilen şeyi kapsamaz; çünkü onu Ya'kûb'un şeriatına göre almıştır. Ya da istisnâ, hâllerin en genelinden muttasıldır; yani «ancak Allah'ın bunu dilemesi, izin vermesi ve istemesi hâli müstesnâ». «ما كان ليأخذ أخاه» ilh. cümlesi, Allah'ın Yûsuf için yaptığı keydin ta'lîli veya onun tefsiridir; her iki durumda da i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
(نَرْفَعُ دَرَجاتٍ مَنْ نَشاءُ وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلْمٍ عَلِيمٌ): «درجات» zarfiyet üzere mansûbdur; «من» mef'ûlün bih; «نشاء» cümlesi sıla. «فوق» zarf olup önce gelmiş mahzûf habere müteallik; «كل ذي علم» muzâf ve muzâfun ileyh; «عليم» sonra gelmiş mübtedâdır.
(قالُوا: إِنْ يَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ): «إن» şart edatı; «يسرق» fiilü'ş-şart; «ف», cevabın «قد» ile birlikte gelmesi sebebiyle râbıtadır; «سرق أخ» fiil ve fâil; cümle şartın cevabı olarak cezm mahallindedir. «له» sıfat, «من قبل» hâldir.
