(يا) is a vocative particle; (قوم) is the one addressed, a muḍāf to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker, the discussion of which has preceded; (اتبعوا) is an imperative verb and an agent; and (المرسلين) is a direct object, that is, those who are the messengers of ʿĪsā, peace be upon him. (اتَّبِعُوا مَنْ لا يَسْئَلُكُمْ أَجْراً وَهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ): (اتبعوا) is emphasis of the first; it is an imperative verb and an agent; (من) is a direct object; the clause (لا يسألكم) is its ṣila (relative clause); the kāf is the first direct object and (أجرا) the second direct object; the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial); (هم) is a mubtadaʾ and (مهتدون) its khabar; and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl. Some permitted that (من) be a badal from (المرسلين), and I do not know what justifies it once its governing verb is present; it is as though they imagined that an object of (اتبعوا) was omitted, and I see no need for it. More discussion of this speech will come in the section on rhetoric.
(وَما لِيَ لا أَعْبُدُ الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ): The wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ; (لي) is its khabar; the clause (لا أعبد) is a ḥāl clause, its agent a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anā" (I); (الذي) is its direct object; the clause (فطرني) is the ṣila; (إليه) is attached to (ترجعون); and (ترجعون) is a passive imperfect verb, the wāw being the deputy agent.
(أَأَتَّخِذُ مِنْ دُونِهِ آلِهَةً): The hamza is for a question of denial, and it is permissible that the meaning of the question be negation. (اتخذ) is an imperfect verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anā" (I); (من دونه) is the second direct object; and (آلهة) is the first direct object. (إِنْ يُرِدْنِ الرَّحْمنُ بِضُرٍّ لا تُغْنِ عَنِّي شَفاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئاً وَلا يُنْقِذُونِ): (إن) is conditional; (يردن) is the protasis; the nūn is the protective nūn (nūn al-wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ, omitted to follow the script of the muṣḥaf, is a direct object; (الرحمن) is the agent; (بضر) is attached to (يردن); (لا) is negative; (تغن) is the apodosis; (عني) is attached to (تغن); (شفاعتهم) is the agent; (شيئا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) or a direct object, which has often been mentioned before; (ولا ينقذون) is conjoined to (لا تغن), and the yāʾ is likewise omitted in observance of the practice of the muṣḥaf; and the conditional clause is resumptive, though it is permissible that it be an adjective of (آلهة). (إِنِّي إِذاً لَفِي ضَلالٍ مُبِينٍ): inna and its noun; (إذن) is a particle of answer and consequence which has no effect; the lām is the shifted lām; (في ضلال) is the khabar of (إن); and (مبين) is an adjective. An important discussion of (إذن) will come in the section on benefits.
(إِنِّي آمَنْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاسْمَعُونِ): inna and its noun, and the clause (آمنت) is its khabar; (بربكم) is attached to (آمنت); the fāʾ is the eloquent fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); and (اسمعون) is an imperative verb, indeclinable by the omission of the nūn, the wāw being the agent and the omitted yāʾ a direct object. The meaning of (اسمعون) is "hear my words and follow the messengers", and in it is evidence of his firmness in his principle and the sincerity of his faith. It was also said: "hear my faith, that you may bear witness to it for me". (قِيلَ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ قالَ يا لَيْتَ قَوْمِي يَعْلَمُونَ): (قيل) is a passive past verb and what it relates to is omitted, that is, "it was said to him", at the time of his being killed and his seeing what had been prepared for him as a reward for the sincerity of his faith. (قال) is a past verb; (يا) is a particle of alerting or a vocative particle, the one addressed being omitted; (ليت) and its noun; and the clause (يعلمون) is its khabar. (بِما غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ): (بما) is attached to (يعلمون); (ما) is a maṣdar or a relative, that is, "of the forgiveness of my Lord" or "of that which my Lord forgave me of sins". Al-Farrāʾ said that it is interrogative, and he was answered that if it were so, its alif would have been omitted, as is the rule. It was said that omission of the alif is the more frequent practice, not a universal one; and even granting that, it is not permissible to interpret the Qur'an by the weak of the possible analyses. (جعلني) is a past verb, the nūn is the protective nūn, the yāʾ is the first direct object, and (من المكرمين) is the second direct object.
(وَما أَنْزَلْنا عَلى قَوْمِهِ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ مِنْ جُنْدٍ مِنَ السَّماءِ وَما كُنَّا مُنْزِلِينَ): A resumptive speech, delivered to show their matter to be contemptible, that is, there is no need to send armies down on them, for the least thing suffices to destroy them and uproot their hair-lock (shāʾifa). (ما) is negative; (أنزلنا) is a verb and an agent; (عليهم) is attached to (أنزلنا); (من بعده) is attached to an omitted ḥāl; (من) is a redundant preposition and (جند) is genitive in form but accusative in position as a direct object; (من السماء) is an adjective of (جند); the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is negative; (كان) and its noun; and (منزلين) is its khabar. (إِنْ كانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً واحِدَةً فَإِذا هُمْ خامِدُونَ): (إن) is negative; (كانت) is a defective past verb whose noun is a concealed pronoun, the implied form being "mā kānat al-ṣayḥatu illā ṣayḥatan wāḥida" (it was only a single cry); the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إذا) is the particle of surprise; (هم) is a mubtadaʾ; and (خامدون) is a khabar.

* Rhetoric:
1- The iltifāt (grammatical shift of person) in His saying «ومالي لا أعبد الذي فطرني». Its benefit is that his shift from addressing them and advising them to speaking of himself is a gentleness toward them on the one hand and a threat to them on the other. He first turned the speech to himself and showed them that he chooses for them only what he chooses for himself; then he shifted to addressing them a second time, rebuking and threatening them with the consequences awaiting them; then he returned at last to gentleness in the advice, because that is more effective in the purity of the counsel, as he wants for them only what he wants for himself. He put his saying «ومالي لا أعبد الذي فطرني» in the place of "wa-mā lakum lā taʿbudūna alladhī faṭarakum" (why do you not worship the One who created you?). Do you not see his saying «وإليه ترجعون»? Had he not intended that, he would have said "the One who created me and to whom I return". He drove it along that course until he said «إني آمنت بربكم فاسمعون». So look, O contemplative reader, at these fine points, which you pass over in the Noble Qur'an while thinking that you have understood its purport and drawn out its allusions.
2- Harmony of the verse-ending:
In His saying «قيل ادخل الجنة قال يا ليت قومي يعلمون بما غفر لي ربي وجعلني من المكرمين» there is the art of harmony of the verse-ending with what the rest of the speech indicates, for mention of Paradise prepared the way for its ending. In that is a great alert to the duty of swallowing one's rage, of forbearance toward the ignorant, and of compassion for one who has thrown himself into the throng of the wicked and the transgressors and girded himself for it. Do you not see how he wished good for those who killed him and those who lay in wait for him and watched for reverses against him and set up treacheries and ruin for him? That is one side. Then, in his wishing that they would know, there is the aim that they return to themselves after the rust is cleared from their breasts and the veils lifted from their eyes, so that dawn appears to anyone with two eyes and the darkness of doubt and falsehood is scattered. In that is victory for him and triumph (the source reads «قوز», evidently «فوز») [Translator's note: the source reads «قوز», probably a misprint for «فوز» "triumph"] for his call, and beyond that is a happiness for anyone who wants more.
3- The balīgh simile in «فإذا هم خامدون». He likened them to the extinguished fire that has become ashes, in the manner of the saying of Labīd:
وما المرء إلا كالشهاب وضوئه ... يحور رمادا إذ هو ساطع
(Man is but like a flame and its light; it turns to ashes after having shone brightly.)
That is, the state of a man, his life and his splendour, then his death and annihilation after that, is only like the state of a flame of fire and its light, which becomes ashes after its shining. After this verse:
وما المال والأهلون إلا ودائع ... ولا بدّ يوما أن ترد الودائع
(Wealth and family are but deposits, and one day the deposits must be returned.)
He likened a person's wealth and relatives to deposits, a balīgh simile, with the common ground that each of them is bound to be taken back.
4- In His saying: «قال يا قوم اتبعوا المرسلين اتبعوا من لا يسألكم أجرا وهم مهتدون»: He concluded with «وهم مهتدون» although the speech was complete without it, to add urging to follow; in it is iṭnāb (expansion).

* Benefits:
An important discussion of (إذن):
We spoke about (إذن) in this book, and we add to what has preceded what al-Raḍī said, for in it is a clarification of its place in the verse. He said: "It is a noun. Its origin is (إذ); the clause annexed to it was omitted and tanwīn was given in compensation for it, and it was given fatḥa so as to be in the form of an accusative adverb. It was intended to make it suitable for all times after it had been restricted to the past, and it was given the meaning of condition for the most part. We said 'for the most part' because there is no meaning of condition in a case like «قال فعلتها إذن وأنا من الضالين»." Then al-Raḍī said: "When it has the meaning of condition in the past, it may be made to run the course of (لو) in having its apodosis joined with the lām, as in «إذن لأذقناك» ('then We would have made you taste'), that is, 'had you inclined to them even a little, We would have made you taste'. When it has the meaning of condition in the future, its apodosis may be joined with the fāʾ, as in the saying of al-Nābigha:
ما إن أتيت بشيء أنت تكرهه ... إذن فلا رفعت سوطي إلي يدي
(If I have come with anything you dislike, then may my hand not raise my whip to me.) [Translator's note: the verse is rendered as a conditional, following the author's gloss «أي إن أتيت»; the opening «ما إن» could also be read as a negation.]
that is, 'if I have come'. It may also be used after (لو) and (إن) as emphasis for the two, as in 'law zurtanī la-akramtuka' ('if you had visited me I would have honoured you') and 'in jiʾtanī idhan azūruka' ('if you come to me, then I will visit you')." Then he said: "Since (إذن), when followed by an imperfect verb, could carry the meaning of consequence, in which case the imperfect is future, and could carry the meaning of mere time, in which case the imperfect is present, and since the intention was to stipulate explicitly the meaning of consequence in (إذن), the imperfect is put in the accusative by an implied (أن), because that makes it purely future; so (إذن) is taken in its most frequent sense of consequence, since the present sense, which would prevent consequence, is excluded by the accusative caused by (أن)." Al-Raḍī went on at length in this discussion, and what we have quoted of his words suffices, to be added to what has preceded about it.

* I'rab:
(وَآيَةٌ لَهُمُ الْأَرْضُ الْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْناها): A resumptive speech, delivered to bring a sign of the resurrection and of the oneness of Allah. (آية) is a fronted khabar; (لهم) is an adjective; (الأرض) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and for the clause (أحييناها) it is permissible to be a ḥāl clause or an adjective; the secret of its being an adjective will come in the section on benefits. (وَأَخْرَجْنا مِنْها حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ): Conjoined to (أحييناها); (أخرجنا) is a verb and an agent; (منها) is attached to (أخرجنا); (حبا) is a direct object; the fāʾ is resumptive; and (منه) is attached to (يأكلون).
(وَجَعَلْنا فِيها جَنَّاتٍ مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَأَعْنابٍ وَفَجَّرْنا فِيها مِنَ الْعُيُونِ): (جعلنا) is a verb and an agent, and the clause is conjoined to (أحييناها); (فيها) is attached to (جعلنا) or to an omitted second direct object of (جعلنا); (جنات) is a direct object; (من نخيل) is an adjective of (جنات); (أعناب) is conjoined to (نخيل); (فجرنا) is likewise a conjunction; (فيها) is attached to (فجرنا); and (من العيون) is an adjective of the omitted object of (فجرنا), that is, "springs being from among the springs". Abū al-Baqāʾ gave its implied form as "what they benefit from, from among the springs", so (من) is partitive. (لِيَأْكُلُوا مِنْ ثَمَرِهِ وَما عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ أَفَلا يَشْكُرُونَ): (ليأكلوا) is a reason for what preceded; (من ثمره) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (ليأكلوا); (ما) is a relative or an indefinite noun with a description, conjoined to (من ثمره); the clause (عملته أيديهم) is the ṣila or the description. You may make it a maṣdar, that is, "and from the work of their hands", so it has the meaning of what preceded; as for its i'rab, al-Zamakhsharī said: "You may make (ما) negative, on the basis that the fruit is Allah's creation, not made by the hands of people, and they have no power over it." The hamza is for a question of denial, because nothing is uglier than denying a favour and belittling a kindness; the fāʾ, as has been explained earlier, in a situation like this is a conjunction on an omitted element required by the context, that is, "Do they see these blessings and enjoy them, and then not give thanks for them?"; (لا) is negative; (يشكرون) is an imperfect verb and an agent; and the direct object is omitted, as we indicated.
(سُبْحانَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْواجَ كُلَّها مِمَّا تُنْبِتُ الْأَرْضُ): (سبحان) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, the discussion of which has preceded, and the clause is resumptive, delivered to declare Him, Exalted is He, free of what is unbecoming to Him; (الذي) is a muḍāf ilayhi; the clause (خلق) is the ṣila; (الأزواج) is a direct object; (كلها) is emphasis; (مما) is attached to an omitted ḥāl; and the clause (تنبت الأرض) is the ṣila.
(وَمِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لا يَعْلَمُونَ): Conjoined to His saying (مما تنبت الأرض). With this He proceeded through the three matters outside which none of the kinds of created things falls, which are, in order:
1- What the earth grows of grains and kinds of trees.
2- What people beget, male and female.
3- Of pairs of which Allah has not yet informed His servants, and whose reality they have not fathomed.

* Rhetoric:
In His saying «سبحان الذي خلق الأزواج كلها» (the verse) there is the art of correspondence between meanings, or soundness of explanation (ṣiḥḥat al-tafsīr). It is that the speaker brings at the beginning of his speech a meaning whose purport understanding cannot grasp on its own: it is either general and in need of detail, or ambiguous and in need of disambiguation, or open to several readings so that the intended one needs a preference that is only achieved by explaining and clarifying it. The explanation occurs in speech in various ways: sometimes after a condition or after what carries the meaning of a condition, at other times after a preposition and its genitive noun, and at other times after a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the explanation. In this verse, soundness of explanation came joined with soundness of division, and ordering and refinement were folded into both, so that there are four arts in it. He, Glorified is He, put plants first, as we mentioned in the i'rab, and moved, in the way of eloquence, to the higher, so He put second the noblest of animals, which is man, so that mention of him implies the rest of the animals; then He put third His saying:
«ومما لا يعلمون», thus moving from the specific to the general so that it falls under the general. Glory be to Him who sent down the Qur'an.

* Benefits:
Al-Zamakhsharī mentioned that thamar (fruit) is pluralised as thamar with two fatḥas, thamur with two ḍammas, and thumur with ḍamma then sukūn; and no one other than him mentioned the first two. [Translator's note: this sentence is translated as written; the forms in the source are unvocalised in the print and the vocalisation given here follows the descriptions in the text.]

* Lügat:
(الصُّورِ): Boynuz (karn) ya da bugün «البوق» (boru) denilen şeydir; içine üflenen ve çalınan, içi boş, uzunca bir şeydir. Çoğulu «أبواق», «بيقان» ve «بوقات» şeklindedir.
Ebu'l-Feth İbn Cinnî şöyle demiştir: Arap kelamından haberi olmayan bir kimse, Ebu't-Tayyib'i (Mütenebbî) şu sözünde «بوق»u «بوقات» şeklinde çoğul yaptığı için ayıplamıştır:
إذا كان بعض الناس سيفا لدولة ... ففي الناس بوقات لها وطبول
(Bazı insanlar bir devlet için kılıç ise, insanlar arasında onun için borular ve davullar da vardır.)
Kıyas bunu destekler; zira bunun pek çok benzeri vardır: «حمام - حمامات», «سرادق - سرادقات», «جواب - جوابات» gibi. Bu, akılsız varlıkları ifade eden müzekker isimlerin hepsinde çoktur.
(الْأَجْداثِ): Kabirler demektir; «فرس - أفراس» gibi «جدث»in çoğuludur. «من الأجداف» şeklinde fâ ile de okunmuştur; bu «الأجداث»da bir lügattir; «جدث» ve «جدف» denir.
(يَنْسِلُونَ): Koşarlar demektir; sînin kesresi ve dammesiyle. «نسل الذئب ينسل» denir; «ضرب يضرب» babındandır; dammeyle «ينسُل» de denildiği söylenmiştir. Bu, yürüyüşte hızlanmaktır. el-Kâmûs'ta şöyle geçer: «'نسل ينسِل وينسُل' (sînin kesresi ve dammesiyle), masdarı 'نَسْلا', 'نَسَلا' ve 'نَسَلانا': yürüyüşünde hızlandı.»
İmruulkays'ın şu sözü bu kabildendir:
فإن تك ساءتك مني خليقة ... فسلّي ثيابي من ثيابك تنسل
(Eğer benden bir huy seni üzdüyse, elbiselerimi elbiselerinden çek çıkar, ayrılıversin.)

* İ'rab:
(وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَإِذا هُمْ مِنَ الْأَجْداثِ إِلى رَبِّهِمْ يَنْسِلُونَ): İsti'nâfiyye bir sözdür; kıyamet günü ba'si (yeniden dirilişi) takrir etmek için sevk edilmiştir. «نفخ» meçhul mâzî fiil; nâib-i fâil müstetir olup takdiri «هو»dur; «في الصور» câr ve mecrûr «نفخ»e müteallik. Fâ atıf harfi; «إذا» fücâiyye; «هم» mübtedâ; «من الأجداث» câr ve mecrûr «ينسلون»a müteallik; «إلى ربهم» da câr ve mecrûr «ينسلون»a müteallik; «ينسلون» cümlesi onların haberi.
(قالُوا يا وَيْلَنا مَنْ بَعَثَنا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنا): «قالوا» fiil ve fâil; «يا» tenbîh harfi ya da nidâ harfidir ve münâdâ mahzûftur. «ويلنا» kendi lafzından fiili olmayan bir masdardır; «نا» muzâfun ileyh. Mecâzî nidâdan muzâf münâdâ olması da caizdir, yani «Ey helak, gel; işte şimdi senin vaktindir.» «من» istifhâm ismi olup mübtedâ olarak ref' mahallinde; «بعثنا» cümlesi haber; «من مرقدنا» câr ve mecrûr «بعثنا»ya müteallik. «المرقد»ın mîmî masdar olması caizdir, yani «uykumuzdan»; mekân ismi olması da caizdir; bu durumda tekil, çoğul yerine konmuştur.
(هذا ما وَعَدَ الرَّحْمنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ): «هذا» mübtedâ; «ما» ism-i mevsûl olup haber; «وعد الرحمن» cümlesi fiil ve fâildir; «وعد»in mef'ûlü mahzûftur, yani «وعدنا» (bize vaat etti). «صدق المرسلون» fiil ve fâil; mef'ûl mahzûftur. Bu i'raba göre «مرقدنا» üzerinde durmak tam vakıftır. «ما»nın masdariyye olması ve girdiği kısımla birlikte «هذا»nın haberi olması da caizdir. Zemahşerî ve başkaları ism-i işaretin «مرقدنا»nın sıfatı (na't) olmasını ve onun üzerinde durulmasını caiz görmüşlerdir; bu durumda «ما وعد», haberi mahzûf bir mübtedâ veya mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberidir. Takdir birinciye göre «حق» (haktır), ikinciye göre «هذا» veya «بعثنا»dır.
(إِنْ كانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً واحِدَةً فَإِذا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَدَيْنا مُحْضَرُونَ): «إن» nâfiye; «كانت» nâkıs mâzî fiil, ismi müstetir olup takdiri «الصيحة»dir; «إلا» hasr edatı; «صيحة» «كانت»in haberi. Fâ atıf harfi; «إذا» fücâiyye; «هم» mübtedâ; «جميع» haber; «لدينا» zarf olup «محضرون»a müteallik; «محضرون» ikinci haber veya «جميع»in sıfatıdır.
(فَالْيَوْمَ لا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئاً وَلا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا ما كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ): Fâ isti'nâfiyye; «اليوم» zarf olup «تظلم»e müteallik; «لا» nâfiye; «تظلم» meçhul muzâri fiil; vâv nâib-i fâil [Mütercim notu: Metinde böyle yazılmıştır; «تظلم»de vâv yoktur, nâib-i fâil «نفس»tir; vâv, «تجزون»un nâib-i fâilidir]. «شيئا» mef'ûl-i mutlak; «ولا تجزون», iltifat yoluyla «لا تظلم»e ma'tûftur. «إلا» hasr edatı; «ما» «تجزون»un ikinci mef'ûlün bihi; «كنتم» cümlesi sıla; «تعملون» cümlesi «كنتم»in haberi.

* Belâgat:
«قالوا يا ويلنا من بعثنا من مرقدنا» kavlinde istiâre-i tasrîhiyye-i asliyye vardır: Uyku (الرقاد) ölüm için istiâre edilmiştir; ikisi arasındaki ortak vasıf, fiilin zuhur etmemesidir; çünkü uyuyanda da ölüde de fiil zuhur etmez. Kastedilen, itibar edilen ihtiyârî fiildir; dolayısıyla uyuyandan bir fiil sâdır olduğu itirazı varid olmaz. Asliyye dedik, çünkü «المرقد» daha önce geçtiği gibi mîmî masdardır; onu mekân ismi kılarsak istiâre tebaiyye olur.

* Vocabulary:
(شُغُلٍ): with a sukūn on the ghayn, or with a ḍamma; both were read together. In al-Qāmūs: "al-shughl with a ḍamma, with two ḍammas, with a fatḥa, or with two fatḥas, is the opposite of leisure; its plural is ashghāl and shughūl. Shaghalahu, like manaʿahu, means 'he occupied him' (shughlan, also with a ḍamma), and ashghalahu is a good, or rare, or poor usage; ishtaghala bihi and shughila, like ʿuniya, are also said, and from it one says mā ashghalahu ('how occupied he is!'), which is irregular because wonder is not expressed from a passive." The commentator on al-Qāmūs rejected ashghala and said:
It is not known to have been reported from any of the authorities of the language.
(فاكِهُونَ): enjoying ease, or delighting in bounty, from fukāha with a ḍamma, which is taking pleasure and delight, derived from al-fākiha (fruit). al-Jawharī said in his Ṣiḥāḥ:
Fukāha with a ḍamma is jesting, while fakāha with a fatḥa is the verbal noun of fakiha al-rajulu (with a kasra), so he is fakih when his life is pleasant, he is joyful and lively from luxury. So if we explain His words «فاكهون» as "enjoying ease", it is from fakāha with a fatḥa. In al-Qāmūs: "al-Fākiha is all fruit; the claim of the one who excludes dates, grapes and pomegranates from it, citing the words of the Exalted «فيهما فاكهة ونخل ورمان», is false and rejected, and I have set this out at length in al-Lāmiʿ al-Muʿlam al-ʿUjāb. Al-fākihānī is its seller; and (the form) like khajila means its eater; al-fākih is its owner; fakkahahum tafkīhan means 'he brought them fruit'; al-fākiha is also the admired palm tree, and a name for sweetmeat; fakkahahum bi-milḥ al-kalām tafkīhan means 'he amused them with it'; the noun is al-fukayha and al-fukāha with a ḍamma; fakiha, like fariḥa, fakhan and fukāhatan, so he is fakih and fākih: of good spirit, laughing, or one who talks with his companions so that he makes them laugh; from it comes taʿajjaba, like tafakkaha; and al-tafākuh is mutual jesting."
(الْأَرائِكِ): plural of arīka, which is the couch inside the ḥajala (canopied bridal chamber); it is also said to be the furnishing found in the ḥajala, (the word ḥajala being) with two fatḥas, or with a sukūn on the jīm and a ḍamma on the ḥāʾ, and it is said also with a kasra on it. What is meant is something like a dome that is closed over the couch and with which the bride is adorned.
(يَدَّعُونَ): imperfect of iddaʿā, on the pattern ifʿaʿala, from daʿā yadʿū; it has been infused with the sense of wishing. Abū ʿUbayda said: "The Arabs say: idʿu ʿalayya mā shiʾta, that is, 'wish', and fulān fī khayr mā yaddaʿī, that is, 'in whatever good he wishes for'." Al-Zajjāj said: "It is from duʿāʾ (calling), that is, what they call for comes to them; and it is also said that ifʿaʿala here has the sense of tafāʿala, that is, 'what they call for among themselves'." And al-Zamakhsharī said: "yaddaʿūna is yaftaʿilūna from duʿāʾ, that is, they call for it for themselves, like your saying ishtawā and ijtamala when one roasts or melts fat for oneself. Labīd said:
وغلام أرسلته أمه ... بألوك فبذلنا ما سأل
أرسلته فأتاه رزقه ... فاشتوى ليلة ريح واجتمل
(Many a boy whose mother sent him with a message, and we gave what he asked. She sent him and his sustenance came to him, so he roasted meat for himself on a windy night and melted fat for himself.)" That is: many a boy his mother sent to us with a message, and the message here is a request, so we gave him the food he asked for right after his asking; and he made that clear by his words "she sent him and his sustenance came to him". In it is an indication that they had no food when the boy came to them, that is, his sustenance came to him from the hunt, so he roasted some of the meat for himself on a dark, windy night in which generosity is scarce, and ijtamala means he melted the fat. In al-Ṣiḥāḥ: "ḥamaytu al-shaḥm wa-ijtamaltuhu, when I melted it."

* I'rab:
(إِنَّ أَصْحابَ الْجَنَّةِ الْيَوْمَ فِي شُغُلٍ فاكِهُونَ): a resumptive clause, brought to affirm the condition of the people of Paradise, to enrage the disbelievers, rebuke them, and add to their regret and anguish. inna and its noun; al-yawma is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); fī shughlin is the second khabar (predicate) of inna, and fākihūna is its first khabar, and the reverse is permissible; it is also permissible that fī shughlin be attached to fākihūna, or be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. The meaning of shughl and fukāha will come in the section on rhetoric. (هُمْ وَأَزْواجُهُمْ فِي ظِلالٍ عَلَى الْأَرائِكِ مُتَّكِؤُنَ): hum is a mubtadaʾ (subject), azwājuhum is conjoined (ʿaṭf) to hum, and fī ẓilālin is the khabar, that is, the sun does not reach them because it is entirely absent; ʿalā al-arāʾik are two words attached to muttakiʾūna, and muttakiʾūna is a second khabar of hum; it is also permissible that His words fī ẓilālin be attached to an omitted ḥāl. (لَهُمْ فِيها فاكِهَةٌ وَلَهُمْ ما يَدَّعُونَ): lahum is a fronted khabar, fīhā are two words attached to an omitted ḥāl, fākihatun is a postponed mubtadaʾ; wa-lahum is a fronted khabar, and mā is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause. For mā it is permissible to be a relative noun, an indefinite qualified noun, or a maṣdar (verbal noun); and the clause yaddaʿūna has no grammatical position, or is a descriptive clause (ṣifa).
(سَلامٌ قَوْلًا مِنْ رَبٍّ رَحِيمٍ): the opinions of the grammarians differ about the i'rab of this verse, and some of them brought the discussion to six aspects. We consider it right to record the text of the statement of al-Shihāb al-Samīn for its soundness. He said: "His words salāmun: the majority read it as nominative, and there are several aspects to it. The first is that it is the khabar of mā yaddaʿūna. The second is that it is a badal (substitute) for mā, as al-Zamakhsharī said. The Shaykh (Abū Ḥayyān) said: If it were a substitute, then mā yaddaʿūna would be specific, whereas the apparent sense is that it is general, covering everything they call for; and if it is general, it cannot be a substitute for it.
The third is that it is an adjective of mā, and this is when you make it an indefinite qualified noun; but if you make it mean 'that which' or a maṣdar, this is impossible because of their difference in definiteness and indefiniteness. The fourth is that it is the khabar of a concealed mubtadaʾ, that is, 'it is salām'. The fifth is that it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is what governs qawlan in the accusative, that is, 'salām is said to them as a saying', and it is also said that its implied form is 'salāmun ʿalaykum'. The sixth is that it is a mubtadaʾ and its khabar is min rabbin." And qawlan is a confirmatory maṣdar for the content of the sentence, and it, together with its governing verb, is parenthetical between the mubtadaʾ and the khabar. Al-Zamakhsharī said: "The most apt is that it be accusative as specification (ikhtiṣāṣ), and that is among his figurative usages." Al-Suyūṭī al-Jalāl made it accusative by removal of the preposition. Others said it is a maṣdar accusative by an omitted verb, and it, together with its governing verb, is an adjective of salām, that is, "He says to them"; and the clause salāmun qawlan min rabbin raḥīmin is in the position of accusative as the object of an omitted verb of saying; min rabbin is an adjective of qawlan, and raḥīmin is an adjective of rabbin.
(وَامْتازُوا الْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ): this clause is also the object of an omitted verb of saying, that is, "and Allah says to them". wa-imtāzū is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), that is, "separate yourselves from the believers"; al-yawma is an adverb attached to imtāzū; ayyuhā is an addressed noun, indefinite but specified, from which the vocative particle has been omitted, and the hāʾ is for attention; al-mujrimūna is a badal. (أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يا بَنِي آدَمَ): a clause arranged in the string of what is said to them, running in the manner of rebuke, reproach, silencing and constraint. The hamza is for interrogation containing these meanings; lam is a particle of negation, reversal (of tense) and jussive; aʿhad is an imperfect verb jussive by lam, its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anā"; ilaykum is attached to aʿhad; yā is a vocative particle, banī is the one addressed, a muḍāf, and ādama is the muḍāf ilayhi.
(أَنْ لا تَعْبُدُوا الشَّيْطانَ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ): an is explicative because it occurs after a clause that has the meaning of saying without its letters; lā is prohibitive; taʿbudū is an imperfect verb jussive by the prohibitive lā, the wāw is the fāʿil, and al-shayṭāna is the direct object. It is also permissible that an be a maṣdar particle, so that it and what follows are in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition, that is, "Did I not make a covenant with you to abandon the worship of Satan?" inna and its noun; lakum are two words attached to ʿaduwwun or to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective of it that was fronted; ʿaduwwun is the khabar of inna, and mubīnun is an adjective; the clause is causal for the prohibition and has no grammatical position. (وَأَنِ اعْبُدُونِي هذا صِراطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ): conjoined to an lā taʿbudū; uʿbudūnī is an imperative verb with its fāʿil and direct object; hādhā is a mubtadaʾ, ṣirāṭun is the khabar and mustaqīmun an adjective; the clause is causal for the command. The secret of placing the prohibition before the command will come in the section on rhetoric.

* Rhetoric:
These verses contain varieties of the arts of rhetoric, which we indicate in what follows:
1- The tanwīn of shughl. In it is an exaltation: that what they are occupied with is too lofty for the rank of expression to reach or for the tongue to be able to set down; and in its vagueness there is conciseness, under which is folded what cannot be counted or enumerated of the kinds of delights they enjoy in the gardens, while everything else is regarded as nothing. It also depicts what Allah has prepared for His God-fearing servants of kinds of enjoyment and varieties of pleasure: the deflowering of virgins, the hearing of strings, and visiting one another in the evenings and the early mornings. He confirmed it with the fact that they are fākihūna (enjoying ease), not occupied in mind with what occupies the minds of the people of the world, the turns of life and the preoccupations of the years, and no passing worry or descending grief spoils their serenity; and that every kind of delight to which eyes stretch and toward which imaginations travel is present with them and they obtain it while reclining on the couches, stretched out under the shade, as the description of it has been given in concrete form. All that is by way of kināya (metonymy), which has been discussed at length previously.
2- The tanwīn of ṣirāṭ. In it is magnification, as was said before, and a conciseness that points to what was covenanted to them: disobeying Satan and obeying the Most Merciful, since there is no path more upright than it. Among the examples of this tanwīn in poetry is the saying of Kuthayyir ʿAzza:
لئن كان يهدي برد أنيابها العلا ... لأفقر مني انني لفقير
(If the coolness of her upper teeth is bestowed on one poorer than I, then indeed I am poor.)
It is also said that this verse is among the verses of al-Majnūn, and before it:
دعوت إلهي دعوة ما جهلتها ... وربي بما تخفي الصدور بصير
(I called upon my God with a call I did not misjudge, and my Lord is All-Seeing of what the breasts conceal.)
and after it:
فما أكثر الأخبار أن قد تزوجت ... فهل يأتيني بالطلاق بشير
(How abundant are the reports that she has married; will a bearer of good tidings come to me with the divorce?)
His words "لئن كان يهدي" explain the supplication that he made deliberately and with presence of heart, and what lies between them is a parenthesis for emphasis and to convey that the supplication was in secret. That is: if the coolness of her upper teeth is what is given to one needier than I (and he singled them out because they are the first thing to appear in smiling), then I am extremely poor, worthy of being described by it because of the perfection of its conditions in me. It is also possible that "the coolness of her fangs" is a kināya for her whole self, and "indeed I am poor" is an emphasized statement indicating intensity of need and greatness of want; and what want is harder on the lover than his need for the one he loves to cure his ailments? And the an in "أن قد تزوجت" is the lightened form of the heavy (anna), and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); it is on the assumption of a preposition, that is: "I wonder at the multitude of reports announcing her marriage". And hal is an interrogative with the meaning of wishing or of wonder, as a majāz mursal (loose metaphor) by the relation of absolute request, that is: "I wish for that" or "I wonder at its absence".
3- The placing of the prohibition before the command in His words «ألم أعهد إليكم يا بني آدم أن لا تعبدوا الشيطان إنه لكم عدو مبين وأن اعبدوني هذا صراط مستقيم». That is because clearing out (takhliya) has the right to precede adorning (taḥliya), as is established in the science of tawḥīd, and so that His words «هذا صراط مستقيم» are connected to it.

* Vocabulary:
(خَصِيمٌ): an adversary, a disputant; and khuṣūma is dispute. He said in al-Qāmūs:
"khāṣamahu mukhāṣamatan wa-khuṣūmatan, then khaṣamahu yakhṣimuhu: he overcame him, and it is irregular, because for fāʿaltuhu followed by faʿaltuhu, the imperfect returns to the ḍamma unless its middle letter is a guttural, in which case it takes the fatḥa, like fākhartuhu, then fakhartuhu yafkhuruhu; as for the weak verbs like wajadtu and biʿtu, they return to the kasra, except those with a wāw, which return to the ḍamma, like rāḍaytuhu, then raḍawtuhu arḍūhu, and khāwafanī, then khiftuhu akhūfuhu; and this is not said of everything, for one does not say nāzaʿtuhu, because they dispensed with it by ghalabtuhu. Ikhtaṣamū and takhāṣamū: they disputed. Al-khaṣm is the disputant, the plural khuṣūm, and it may be used for two, for the plural and for the feminine; al-khaṣīm is the disputant, the plural khuṣamāʾ and khaṣmān; and rajul khaṣim, like fariḥ: a disputer, the plural khaṣimūn. Whoever read «وهم يخصمون» meant yakhtaṣimūna, so he turned the tāʾ into ṣād, assimilated it and transferred its vowel to the khāʾ; some do not transfer it and put a kasra on the khāʾ because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; Abū ʿAmr slurs the vowel of the khāʾ; as for joining two quiescent letters, that is an error. Al-khuṣm with a ḍamma is the side, the corner and the region, and the end of the corner opposite the ʿazlāʾ (the mouth of a water-skin) at its back; the plural is akhṣām and khuṣūm; and the akhṣām of the eye are what the eyelids are joined to." We have quoted this entry at its full length for its usefulness and to show you the extent of the error that the author of al-Munjid fell into, for he confused it strangely and made al-akhṣām a plural of al-khaṣm and al-khaṣīm, and it is, as you have seen, one of the errors of this wonderful book!!
(رَمِيمٌ): decayed; and in al-Mukhtār: "ramma (with a fatḥa) yarimmu (with a kasra) when it decays, and its chapter is ḍaraba." So it is a noun, not an adjective, and therefore it is not made feminine, though it occurs as a khabar of a feminine; and it is not faʿīl in the sense of fāʿil or mafʿūl. The clarification of this statement is that faʿīl in the sense of fāʿil does not take the tāʾ in its feminine unless it remains adjectival, while what is here has been stripped of that and has come to be predominantly a noun, that is, it became, by predominance, a noun for bones that have decayed.

* I'rab:
(أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الْإِنْسانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْناهُ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ فَإِذا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُبِينٌ): a resumptive clause, brought to denounce their denial of the resurrection; al-Zamakhsharī excelled in establishing this meaning, as will come in the section on benefits. The hamza is for rhetorical denial and wonder; the wāw is a conjunction, which has been discussed at length; lam is a particle of negation, reversal and jussive; yara is an imperfect verb jussive by lam, the sign of its jussive being the omission of the weak letter; al-insānu is the fāʿil (agent); annā and what is within its scope take the place of the two objects of yara, because the seeing here is one of knowledge; anna and its noun, and the clause khalaqnāhu is its khabar (predicate); khalaqnāhu is a verb, fāʿil and direct object; min nuṭfatin is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to khalaqnāhu; the fā is a conjunction, idhā is a particle of surprise, huwa is a mubtadaʾ (subject), khaṣīmun is the khabar and mubīnun an adjective; and the clause idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnun is conjoined to the clause lam yara al-insānu, entering with it within the scope of denial and wonder. (وَضَرَبَ لَنا مَثَلًا وَنَسِيَ خَلْقَهُ): the wāw is a conjunction, ḍaraba is a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "huwa"; lanā are two words attached to ḍaraba, and mathalan is a direct object; nasiya is conjoined to ḍaraba and khalqahu is a direct object; the conjunction enters within the scope of wonder and denial; or the wāw is circumstantial with an implied qad, that is, "when he has forgotten his creation".
(قالَ مَنْ يُحْيِ الْعِظامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٌ): man is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ, and the clause yuḥyī al-ʿiẓāma is its khabar; the wāw is circumstantial, hiya is a mubtadaʾ and ramīmun a khabar; and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). (قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا الَّذِي أَنْشَأَها أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ): the clause yuḥyīhā is the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); it is an imperfect verb with a direct object, and alladhī is the fāʿil, and the clause ansha'ahā is a ṣila (relative clause); awwala marratin is accusative as an adverbial attached to anshaʾahā; the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial, huwa is a mubtadaʾ, bi-kulli are two words attached to ʿalīmun, and ʿalīmun is the khabar of huwa. (الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ الْأَخْضَرِ ناراً فَإِذا أَنْتُمْ مِنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ): alladhī is a badal (substitute) of the preceding alladhī, the clause jaʿala is a ṣila, and lakum is in the position of the second object; min al-shajari al-akhḍari is a ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective of nāran; nāran is the first object of jaʿala; fa-idhā: the fā is a conjunction and idhā is a particle of surprise; antum is a mubtadaʾ, minhu are two words attached to tūqidūna, and the clause tūqidūna is the khabar of antum.
(أَوَلَيْسَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِقادِرٍ عَلى أَنْ يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ): the hamza is for rhetorical denial, and the wāw is a conjunction to an implied clause that the situation requires, that is, "Is not the One who brought them into being the first time, and is not the One who made for you fire from the green tree, and is not the One who created the heavens and the earth able...?" laysa is a defective past verb, alladhī is its noun, and the clause khalaqa al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍa is a ṣila; the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and qādirin is genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of laysa; ʿalā is a preposition, and an and what is within its scope are in the position of genitive by ʿalā, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to qādirin; yakhluqa has a latent fāʿil, its implied form being "huwa", and mithlahum is a direct object.
(بَلى وَهُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ): a particle of reply confirming a negation, and the wāw is a conjunction to what the affirmation conveys, that is, "Yes, He is able to do that, and He is al-Khallāq"; huwa is a mubtadaʾ, al-khallāqu the khabar, and al-ʿalīmu a second khabar. (إِنَّما أَمْرُهُ إِذا أَرادَ شَيْئاً أَنْ يَقُولَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ): innamā: inna with the restraining mā (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa); amruhu is a mubtadaʾ, idhā is an adverb of the future, the clause arāda is the genitive complement of the adverb, shayʾan is a direct object, and an and what is within its scope is the khabar of amruhu; lahu are two words attached to yaqūla, the clause kun is the content of the saying, and kun is a complete imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "anta"; the fā is a conjunction, and yakūnu is an imperfect verb in the nominative because it and its fāʿil form a clause in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, and the clause is conjoined to amruhu; it was also read in the accusative, conjoined to yaqūla.
(فَسُبْحانَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ): the fā is the fā al-faṣīḥa (eloquent fā), subḥāna is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and alladhī is a muḍāf ilayhi; bi-yadihi is a fronted khabar, and malakūtu kulli shayʾin is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause has no grammatical position because it is a ṣila of the relative; wa-ilayhi: the wāw is a conjunction, and ilayhi are two words attached to turjaʿūna, and turjaʿūna is an imperfect passive verb, the wāw being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

* Rhetoric:
Excellence of exposition (ḥusn al-bayān):
In His words: «وضرب لنا مثلا ونسي خلقه» and the verses that follow, there is ḥusn al-bayān. Its reality is bringing out the meaning in the best forms that clarify it and conveying it to the understanding of the addressee by the nearest and easiest of ways. Expression of it may come by way of conciseness (ījāz) and may come by way of elaboration (iṭnāb), according to what the situation requires. The exposition of the Noble Book came in this verse by both ways, so it was comprehensive and exclusive in the decisive argument against the opponent. And it came detached from what precedes it, because He, glory be to Him, mentioned the parable (mathal), and in the whole passage, neither before nor after, there is nothing that came in the form of a parable or that could be a parable; the matter is that Umayya ibn Khalaf came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a decayed bone in his hand and said: "O Muḥammad, you claim your Lord revives this after it has come to this state?" So it was revealed. In one report it was al-ʿĀṣ ibn Wāʾil, and it is said that it was Ubayy ibn Khalaf al-Jumaḥī.
The time has come to quote the eloquent passage that al-Zamakhsharī gave concerning these verses. He said: "Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, denounced their denial of the resurrection with a denunciation than which you see none more wonderful, more eloquent, or more indicative of man's persistence in disbelief, his excess in denying favours and being ungrateful for benefits, his penetration into baseness, and his deep sinking into insolence, in that He established that the substance from which he was created is the lowest and most contemptible of things, namely the foul sperm-drop that issues from the urethra, which is the channel of impurity; then He expressed wonder at his state, that one like him, with the lowliness of his origin and the meanness of his beginning, should undertake to dispute with the Almighty, turn his cheek in disputation with Him, mount the back of falsehood, persist and be obstinate, and say: 'Who is able to revive the dead after the bones have decayed?' Then his dispute is about the most inseparable and most cleaving description of himself, which is that he is brought forth from lifeless matter, while he denies his being brought forth from lifeless matter; and this is stubbornness beyond which there is no aspiration.
It is related that a group of Quraysh, among them Ubayy ibn Khalaf al-Jumaḥī, Abū Jahl, al-ʿĀṣ ibn Wāʾil and al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra, spoke about that, and Ubayy said to them: 'Do you not see what Muḥammad says, that Allah resurrects the dead?' Then he said: 'By al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā, I will go to him and defeat him in argument.' He took a decayed bone and began to crumble it with his hand, saying: 'O Muḥammad, do you think Allah will revive this after it has decayed?' The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Yes, and He will resurrect you and admit you into Hell.'

﴿إني إذا لفي ضلال مبين﴾: ﴿إني﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ of the speaker is its noun; ﴿إذًا﴾: a particle of response, without governing effect; ﴿لفي ضلال﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ﴿في ضلال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of inna; ﴿مبين﴾: a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿ضلال﴾; and the sentence is resumptive within the scope of the saying, with no grammatical position.

﴿ولو نشاء لطمسنا على أعينهم﴾: Vâv atıf harfidir, ﴿لو﴾ şartiyyedir. ﴿نشاء﴾ muzâri fiildir; fâili müstetirdir, mef'ûlün bih mahzûftur; yani: «لو نشاء طمسها». Lâm, ﴿لو﴾'nun cevabında vâki olan lâmdır. ﴿طمسنا﴾ cümlesinin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; o mâzî fiildir, ﴿نا﴾ fâildir. ﴿على أعينهم﴾ câr ve mecrûr ﴿طمسنا﴾'ya mütealliktir.
﴿فاستبقوا الصراط﴾: Fâ atıf harfidir; «استبقوا» fiil ve fâildir, cümle ﴿لطمسنا﴾'ya ma'tûftur. «الصراط» nez'u'l-hâfıd ile mansûbtur, aslı: «فاستبقوا إلى الصراط»; ya da mef'ûlün bihtir ve «فاستبقوا» fiili «ابتدروا» (acele ettiler) anlamını tazmîn etmiştir.
﴿فأنى يبصرون﴾: Fâ atıf harfidir; ﴿أنى﴾ «كيف» anlamında istifhâm ismidir, hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir; ﴿يبصرون﴾ muzâri fiil ve fâildir. Buradaki istifhâm nefy anlamındadır, yani: «لا يبصرون».

﴿وذللناها لهم فمنها ركوبهم ومنها يأكلون﴾: ﴿ذللناها﴾ is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ذللناها﴾; the fāʾ is for consequence (tafrīʿ); ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and ﴿ركوبهم﴾ is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يأكلون﴾; ﴿يأكلون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil.

﴿وضرب لنا مثلا ونسي خلقه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ضرب» is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); «لنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ضرب»; «مثلًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «نسي» is conjoined to «ضرب»; and «خلقه» is the mafʿūl bihi; or the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) on the assumption of an implied «قد», i.e. "while he has forgotten his own creation" (وقد نسي خلقه).
﴿قال من يحي العظام وهي رميم﴾: «مَن» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يحيي العظام» is the khabar (predicate); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «هي» is a mubtadaʾ and «رميم» is a khabar; the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

﴿احْشُرُوا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وأزْواجَهُمْ﴾ ("gather those who did wrong and their azwāj"): its meaning is: "and their peers and their likes". You say: “عِنْدِي مِن هَذا أزْواجٌ” ("I have azwāj of this"), that is: likes; and likewise “زَوْجانِ مِنَ الخِفافِ” ("a pair of leather socks"), that is: each one is the counterpart of its fellow. Likewise “اَلزَّوْجُ” is the woman, and “اَلزَّوْجُ” is the man, the two having become matched by the marriage contract. And likewise His saying: ﴿وَآخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِ أزْواجٌ﴾ [Ṣād: 58] ("and other punishments of its like, in pairs").

﴿طَلْعُها كَأنَّهُ رُءُوسُ الشَّياطِينِ﴾ ("its spathes are as though they were the heads of devils"). There are three views on it. It has been said: “اَلشَّياطِينُ” are snakes that have heads, so its spathes were likened to the heads of those snakes. It has been said: “رُؤُوسُ الشَّياطِينِ” is a known plant. And it has been said — and this is the well-known view — that when a thing is considered ugly it is likened to the devil, so it is said: "as though it were the face of a devil" and "as though it were the head of a devil"; the devil is not seen, but it is felt that he is the ugliest of things — if he were seen, he would be seen in the ugliest form. Imruʾ al-Qays said:
؎أيَقْتُلُنِي والمَشْرَفِيُّ مُضاجِعِي ∗∗∗ ومَسْنُونَةٌ زُرْقٌ كَأنْيابِ أغْوالِ؟
(Will he kill me, when the Mashrafī sword lies beside me, and sharpened blue [spearheads] like the fangs of ghouls?)
The ghoul has never been seen, nor its fangs; but likening to what is considered ugly is more effective: in the category of the masculine, it is likened to the devil, and in the category of what is considered ugly in the feminine, it is likened to the ghoul.

﴿فَما ظَنُّكم بِرَبِّ العالَمِينَ﴾: İbrâhîm, putlara tapan kavmine şöyle dedi: «Siz O'ndan başkasına tapıyorken, âlemlerin Rabbi hakkındaki zannınız nedir?!» «ما»nın mahalli mübtedâ olarak ref'tir, haberi «ظَنُّكم»dür.

﴿فَلَمّا أسْلَما وتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ﴾: «أسْلَما»: Allah'ın emrine teslim oldular; İbrâhîm oğlunu boğazlamaya, oğlu da boğazlanmaya, rüyayı tasdik ederek ve Allah'a itaat ederek razı oldu. İnsanlar, boğazlanması emredilenin kim olduğu hususunda ihtilaf ettiler: Bir topluluk İshâk dedi, bir topluluk İsmâil dedi. İshâk olduğunu söyleyenler: Ali —Allah'ın rahmeti onun üzerine olsun—, İbn Mes'ûd, Ka'bü'l-Ahbâr ve tâbiînden bir cemaattir. İsmâil olduğunu söyleyenler ise: İbn Ömer, Muhammed b. Ka'b el-Kurazî, Saîd b. el-Müseyyeb ve tâbiînden bir cemaattir. İsmâil olduğunu söyleyenin delili şu kavildir: ﴿وَبَشَّرْناهُ بِإسْحاقَ نَبِيًّا مِنَ الصّالِحِينَ﴾ [Sâffât 112]. İshâk olduğunu söyleyenin delili ise şudur: İshâk hakkında iki müjde vardı; birincisi ﴿فَبَشَّرْناهُ بِغُلامٍ حَلِيمٍ﴾ [Sâffât 101]; o boğazlanmaya teslim olunca ve İbrâhîm de onu boğazlamaya teslim olunca, kendisi salihlerden bir peygamber olarak müjdelendi. Bu ikisi hakkındaki söz çoktur; hangisinin kurban olduğunu Allah bilir. «فَلَمّا أسْلَما وتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ» kavlinin cevabına gelince —«تَلَّهُ», yani: onu yere yıktı— insanlar bu konuda ihtilaf etmişlerdir. Bir topluluk: Cevabı «ونادَيْناهُ»dir, vâv zâidedir, dedi. Bir topluluk da: Cevap hazfedilmiştir, çünkü sözde ona delil vardır, dedi; anlam: «Bunu yaptığında mutlu oldu, Allah ona oğlunun peygamberliğini verdi ve âhirette sevabını bol kıldı».
﴿وَإنَّ جُنْدَنا لَهُمُ الغالِبُونَ﴾: Allah'ın hizbi, galibiyet onlarındır.

بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
His saying: {والصافات صَفَّا}: Abū ʿAmr and Ḥamza read with assimilation of the tāʾ of «الصافَّاتِ», «الزَّاجراتِ» and «التاليات» into the ṣād of «صَفَّاً», the zāy of «زَجْراً» and the dhāl of «ذِكْراً»; and they did likewise in {والذاريات ذَرْواً} [al-Dhāriyāt: 1], in {فالملقيات ذِكْراً} [al-Mursalāt: 5] and in {العاديات ضَبْحاً} [al-ʿĀdiyāt: 1], with a divergence from Khallād in the last two. Abū ʿAmr runs on his principle of assimilating close-sounding letters, as is known of his principle, while Ḥamza departs from his principle; and the difference between their two doctrines is that Abū ʿAmr permits rawm (partial vowel) and Ḥamza does not. This is as they agreed in assimilating {بَيَّتَ طَآئِفَةٌ} in [Sūrat] al-Nisāʾ [v. 81], even though assimilating the like of it is not part of Ḥamza's principle. The rest read with all of that pronounced clearly.
The object of «الصَّافَّات» and «الزَّاجراتِ» is not intended, for the meaning is "the doers of that". Abū l-Baqāʾ parsed «صَفَّاً» as a direct object, in that it may apply to the thing arrayed. I say: this is weak. It was also said that it is intended, and the meaning: "those who array themselves", namely the angels, or the fighters, or the worshippers; or "those who array their wings", namely the birds, as in {والطير صَآفَّاتٍ} [al-Nūr: 41]; and "those who drive off the clouds", or "the disobedient", if the scholars are meant by them. Al-zajr is repelling with force, and is strength of voicing. He recited:
3789 - زَجْرَ أَبي عُرْوَةَ السِّباعَ إذا ... أشْفَقَ أَنْ يَخْتَلِطْنَ بالغَنَم
(Like the driving off of the beasts of prey by Abū ʿUrwa, when he feared they would mix with the flock.)
And زَجَرْتُ الإِبِلَ والغنمَ is said when they were frightened by your voice. As for «والتاليات», «ذِكْراً» may be its object, the "remembrance" meaning the Qur'an and other than it of glorification and praise; and «ذِكْراً» may also be a maṣdar from the meaning of «التاليات», which accords better with what precedes. Al-Zamakhsharī said: "The fāʾ in «فالزَّاجراتِ» and «فالتالياتِ» either indicates the sequence of their meanings in existence, as in his saying:
3790 - أيا لَهْفَ زَيَّابةَ للحارثِ الصَّا ... بحِ فالغانِمِ فالآيِبِ
(Alas for Zayyāba, for al-Ḥārith who raided at dawn, then took spoils, then returned.)
as though he said: the one who made a dawn raid, then took spoils, then returned; or on their sequence in degree in some respects, as in: 'Take the better, then the more complete', and 'Do the finer, then the more beautiful'; or on the sequence of those they qualify in that, as you say: 'May Allah have mercy on those who shave their heads, then on those who shorten.' Here, if you take the qualified as one, it indicates the sequence of the attributes in merit. If the single one is the angels, the merit is for the array, then the driving, then the recitation, or the reverse. If you take the qualified as three, they are ordered in merit, so the arrayers possess merit, the drivers greater merit, and the reciters a more brilliant merit, or the reverse." By "the reverse" in both places he means that you rise from the more excellent to the excellent to the less excellent, or you begin with the lowest, then the excellent, then the most excellent.
The wāw in these is of oath, and the answer is His saying: {إِنَّ إلهكم لَوَاحِدٌ}. You know the discussion of the second and third wāw: whether it is of oath or of conjunction.

Onun sözü: {وَحِفْظاً}: mahzûf bir fiille masdar olarak mansûbtur; yani «onu bir koruyuşla koruduk». Ya da vâvın zâid olması üzere mef'ûlün lieclih olarak mansûbtur. Bu durumda âmil «زيَّنَّا»dır; ya da âmil takdîrîdir, yani «onu korumak için süsledik»; ya da öncekinin manasına hamledilerek, yani «yakın göğü bir süs ve bir koruma olarak yarattık». «من كلِّ» ifadesi, pekiştirici masdar değilse «حِفْظاً»ye müteallik; pekiştirici masdar kılınırsa mahzûfa müteallik olur. «حِفْظاً»ye sıfat olması da caizdir.

Onun sözü: {دُحُوراً}: cumhur dâl'ı dammeli okumuştur. Bunda birkaç vecih vardır: Mef'ûlün lehu olması, yani «kovulmak sebebiyle». İkincisi, «يُقْذَفُون»un masdarı olması, yani «kovulurlar, kovulmak üzere» ya da «atılırlar, atılmak üzere»; mecaz ya birincide ya ikincidedir. Üçüncüsü, takdir edilen bir fiilin masdarı olması, yani «يُدْحَرون دُحوراً». Dördüncüsü, hâl mahallinde olması, yani «kovulma sahipleri» ya da «kovulmuşlar». «داحِر»ın çoğulu olduğu da söylenmiştir; «قاعِد» ve «قُعود» gibi. Bu durumda te'vilsiz kendi başına hâl olur. Ebû Amr'dan «ويَقْذِفُون»un fâile bina edilmiş olarak okunduğu rivayet edilmiştir.
Alî, Sülemî ve İbn Ebî Able «دَحورا»yı dâl fethalı okumuşlardır; bunda iki vecih vardır: Biri, takdir edilen bir masdarın sıfatı olmasıdır, yani «kovucu bir atış»; «الصَّبور» ve «الشَّكور» gibi. İkincisi, «القَبول» ve «الوَلوع» gibi bir masdar olmasıdır. Bunun birkaç lafızla sınırlı olduğu daha önce geçmişti.

Onun sözü: {رُءُوسُ الشياطين}: Bunda iki yön vardır. Birincisi: Hakikattir; şeytanların başları, Yemen yöresinde «الأسْتَن» denilen belli bir ağaçtır. en-Nâbiğa onu zikretmiştir:
3812 - تَحِيْدُ عن أَسْتَنٍ سُوْدٍ أسافِلُها ... مثلَ الإِماءِ الغوادي تَحْمِل الحُزَمَا
(Altları siyah olan bir «أَسْتَن» ağacından kaçınır; sabahleyin demetler taşıyan cariyeler gibi.)
O, acı, görünüşü çirkin bir ağaçtır; Araplar ona bu adı, çirkinlikte şeytanların başlarına benzettikleri için vermiş, sonra kendisi benzetilen bir asıl hâline gelmiştir. Şöyle de denmiştir: Şeytanlar yılanların bir çeşididir ve ibikleri vardır. Şair dedi ki:
3813 - عُجَيِّزٌ تَحْلِفُ حينَ أَحْلِفُ ... كمثلِ شيطان الحَماطِ أَعْرَفُ
(Yaşlıca bir kadın, ben yemin ederken o da yemin eder; hamât ağacının şeytanı gibi, ibikli.)
Şöyle de denmiştir: Bu, «الصَّوْم» denilen bir ağaçtır; Sâide b. Cuveyye'nin şu sözü de buradandır:
3814 - مُوَكَّلٌ بشُدُوْفِ الصَّوْم يَرْقُبها ... من المَغَارِبِ مَخْطوفُ الحَشَا زَرِمُ
(Batı yönlerinden gelip savm ağacının kütüklerini gözetlemekle görevlendirilmiş, karnı çökük, yağlı bir yırtıcı.)
Bu görüşe göre Araplara bildikleri şeyle hitap edilmiştir; bu ağaç mevcuttur, dolayısıyla söz hakikattir.
İkincisi: Bu hayal ve temsil babındandır. Zira tabiatta ve suretçe çirkin görülen her şey, gözle görülmemiş olsa da vehmin hayal ettiği şeye benzetilir. Şeytanlar mevcut olmakla birlikte Araplar tarafından görülmemektedir; ancak Allah onlara, alışık oldukları hayâlî istiâreler ile hitap etmiştir; şu söz gibi:
3815 -. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ... ومَسْنُوْنَةٌ زُرْقٌ كَأَنْيابِ أَغْوالِ
(… ve bilenmiş, mavi, gûllerin azı dişleri gibi [oklar]…) [Mütercim notu: beytin ilk mısraı kaynakta noktalarla bırakılmıştır.]
Onun dişlerini görmemiştir; hatta onlar hiç mevcut değildir.

Onun sözü: {إِذْ قَالَ}: Birinci «إذ»den bedeldir, ya da «سليم» için zarftır, yani: şöyle şöyle dediği vakitte buna karşı salim (sağlam) kaldı; ya da «جاء» için zarftır; bunu Ebü'l-Bekā zikretti, ancak açık değildir. Sonrakinin benzeri daha önce geçti.

«ضَرْباً» hâl yerine geçen bir masdardır, yani: «onlara vurarak yöneldi»; ya da hâl olan bir fiilin masdarıdır, takdiri: «فراغَ يَضْرِب ضَرْباً»; ya da «راغَ»a «يَضْرِبُ» anlamı tazmin edilmiştir, ki bu uzaktır. «باليمينِ», eğer onu te'kîd saymazsak «ضَرْباً»ya müteallik olur; aksi hâlde onun âmiline müteallik olur. «اليمينُ» ile iki elden biri kastedilebilir, ki zâhir olan budur; kuvvet de kastedilebilir, bu durumda «bâ» hâl içindir, yani kuvvetle birlikte; yemin (hilf) de kastedilebilir, {وتالله لأَكِيدَنَّ} [el-Enbiyâ: 57] sözüne vefa olarak; bu durumda «bâ» sebep içindir. İkinci «راغ»ı «على» ile müteaddî kıldı, çünkü o, üstlerinden altlarına kadar onlara hâkim olan vuruşla birlikteydi; birincisi ise onlara bir azarlama ile birlikteydi. «عليهم» sözünde akıllılara ait zamiri getirdi; bu, onlara tapanların onların akıllılar gibi olduğu zannına uygun olarak yapılmıştır.

* İ'rab:
(الواو) atıf harfidir. (إلى ربّي) ذاهب'e müteallik. (السين) istikbâl harfidir; (سيهدين)'deki (النون) vikâye içindir; âyet fâsılalarına uyum için hazfedilen (الياء) mef'ûlün bihtir.
«قال ...» cümlesi takdir edilen isti'nâfiyye bir cümleye ma'tûf olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; yani:
خرج من النار سالما وقال ... (Ateşten salimen çıktı ve dedi ki...)
«إنّي ذاهب ...» cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir.
«سيهدين» cümlesi i'tirâziyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur [Dipnot: Veya beyânî isti'nâftır.].
(100- 101) - (ربّ) muzâf münâdâ olup mansûbdur; nasb alâmeti, tahfîf için hazfedilen yâdan önceki harf üzerindeki takdîrî fethadır; hazfedilen (الياء) muzâfun ileyhtir. (لي) (هب)'e müteallik. (من الصالحين) takdir edilen bir mef'ûlün sıfatına müteallik; yani: ابنا من الصالحين (sâlihlerden bir oğul). (الفاء) atıf harfidir. (بغلام) (بشّرناه)'ya müteallik ...
Nidâ cümlesi ve cevabı.. takdir edilen bir kavlin mekûlü'l-kavli olarak nasb mahallindedir; yani: قائلا (diyerek) ...
«هب ...» cümlesi nidânın cevabı olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
«هب ...» cümlesi nidânın cevabı olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. [Mütercim notu: Bu satır kaynakta iki kez tekrarlanmıştır.]
«بشّرناه..» cümlesi takdir edilen kavl cümlesine ma'tûf olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
(102) - (الفاء) atıf harfidir. (لمّا) حين (… zaman) manasında, şart manasını tazammun eden bir zarftır; cevap olan قال'e müteallik. (معه) mansûb bir zarf olup بلغ'in fâilinden hâl olan mahzûfa müteallik [Dipnot: (بلغ)'e taalluk etmesi caiz değildir; çünkü koşma çağına erişmek baba ile oğul arasında eş zamanlı değildir. Ma'mûlün masdardan önce gelmesine rağmen السعي'ye taalluk ettirilmesi caizdir; zira zarfta başkasında caiz olmayan şey caizdir.]; o (fâil) غلام'a dönen bir zamirdir. (بنيّ) muzâf münâdâ olup mansûbdur; nasb alâmeti takdîrî fethadır; ikinci (الياء) muzâfun ileyhtir. (في المنام) (أرى)'ya müteallik. (الفاء) müsebbebi sebebe bağlamak için atıf harfidir. (ماذا) istifhâm ismi olup mef'ûlün bih olarak nasb mahallindedir; âmili ترى'dir [Dipnot: Veya (ما) mübtedâ, (ذا) haberdir.]. (أبت) muzâf münâdâ olup mansûbdur.. (التاء), hazfedilen izâfet (ياء)'sına bedeldir (ivazdır). (ما) ism-i mevsûl olup mef'ûlün bih olarak nasb mahallindedir; âid zamir mahzûftur, yani تؤمره; (تؤمر) fiilinin nâib-i fâili takdiri «أنت» olan müstetir zamirdir. (السين) istikbâl içindir; (ستجدني)'deki (النون) vikâye içindir. (شاء) mebnî mâzî fiil olup fiilü'ş-şart olarak cezm mahallindedir. (من الصابرين) âmili ستجدني olan mahzûf ikinci mef'ûlün bihe müteallik..
«بلغ ...» cümlesi muzâfun ileyh olarak cer mahallindedir.
«قال ...» cümlesi cezmetmeyen şartın cevabı olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
«يا بنيّ ...» nidâ cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir.
«إنّي أرى ...» cümlesi nidânın cevabı olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
«أرى في المنام ...» cümlesi inne'nin haberi olarak ref' mahallindedir.

* Belâgat:
Îcâz: Allah Teâlâ'nın «فَبَشَّرْناهُ بِغُلامٍ حَلِيمٍ» kavlinde.
Bu, îcâz-ı kasrdır. Bu kısa müjde üç şeyi içine almıştır: Çocuğun erkek bir oğlan olduğunu, ergenlik çağına ulaşacağını ve halîm (yumuşak huylu) olacağını.

* Fevâid:
Kurban edilmek istenen (ezzebîh) kimdir?
Âyet, peygamberlerin rüyasının hak olduğunu ifade etmiştir. Âlimler, İbrâhim'in iki oğlundan hangisinin kurban edilmek istenen (zebîh) olduğu hususunda ihtilaf etmişlerdir. Onlardan bir grup onun «İshak» olduğunu söylemiştir; Ömer, Ali, İbn Mes'ûd, Abbâs, Ka'bü'l-Ahbâr, Saîd b. Cübeyr ve başkaları -Allah onlardan razı olsun- bu görüştedir. İbn Abbâs'tan gelen rivayetler iki görüş üzere ihtilaf etmiştir: Biri İsmâil, diğeri İshak'tır. İshak olduğunu söyleyenler şöyle demiştir: Bu kıssa Şam'da olmuştur. Saîd b. Cübeyr'den şöyle dediği rivayet edilmiştir: İbrâhim, Şam'da iken rüyada İshak'ı kestiğini gördü; onu bir aylık yolu bir sabah vaktinde katederek götürdü, nihayet onu Minâ'daki kurban yerine getirdi. Allah ona koçu kesmesini emredince onu kesti ve onu bir aylık yolu bir akşam vaktinde katederek geri götürdü; vadiler ve dağlar ona dürülüverdi. İkinci görüş: Onun İsmâil olduğudur. Abdullah b. Selâm, Hasan, Saîd b. el-Müseyyeb, Şa'bî, Mücâhid, Rebî' b. Enes, Muhammed b. Ka'b el-Kurazî, Kelbî bu görüştedir; Atâ b. Ebî Rebâh ve Yûsuf b. Mâhek'in İbn Abbâs'tan rivayeti de budur; o, "Fidye ile kurtarılan İsmâil'dir" demiştir. Her iki görüş de Rasûlullah (s.a.v.)'den rivayet edilir. Kurbanın İshak olduğu görüşüne gidenler Allah Teâlâ'nın فَبَشَّرْناهُ بِغُلامٍ حَلِيمٍ kavliyle delil getirmişlerdir: Onunla birlikte koşma çağına erişince, müjdelendiği kimseyi kesmekle emrolundu; Kur'an'da İshak'tan başka bir çocukla müjdelendiğine dair bir şey yoktur; müjde de kurban kıssasından sonraydı. Bu da kurbanın müjdelenen kimse olduğuna delâlet eder. Kurbanın İsmâil olduğu görüşüne gidenler ise şununla delil getirmişlerdir: Allah Teâlâ İshak ile müjdelemeyi kurban kıssası bittikten sonra zikretmiş ve وَبَشَّرْناهُ بِإِسْحاقَ نَبِيًّا مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ buyurmuştur; bu da kesilmek istenenin ondan başkası olduğuna delâlet eder. Ayrıca Allah Teâlâ Hûd sûresinde فَبَشَّرْناها بِإِسْحاقَ وَمِنْ وَراءِ إِسْحاقَ يَعْقُوبَ buyurmuştur; ona İshak'tan Ya'kûb adında bir çocuk vaat etmişken nasıl İshak'ı kesmesini emreder? Ayrıca İshak'ı değil İsmâil'i وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ كُلٌّ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ kavlinde sabırla nitelemiştir; bu, onun kesilmeye karşı sabrıdır. Onu إِنَّهُ كانَ صادِقَ الْوَعْدِ kavlinde de vaadine sadık olmakla nitelemiştir; babasına kesilmeye sabredeceğini vaat etmiş ve vaadini yerine getirmiştir. Ömer b. Abdülazîz, Müslüman olan ve Müslümanlığı güzel olan bir Yahudi'ye "Allah Teâlâ İbrâhim'in iki oğlundan hangisini kesmesini emretti?" diye sordu; o da "İsmâil" dedi. Asmaî dedi ki: Ebû Amr b. el-Alâ'ya kurban edilmek isteneni sordum; "Ey Asmaî, İshak ne zaman Mekke'de bulundu ki? O ancak İsmâil'di; Beyt'i babasıyla birlikte bina eden odur" dedi. Allah Teâlâ en iyisini bilir.

* Morphology:
(99) ذاهب: an active participle from the triliteral ذهب, of the chapter fataḥa; its pattern is فاعل.
(102) السعي: a name for the place in which striving takes place, named by the name of the maṣdar of the triliteral سعى; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa and sukūn.
(103) الجبين: a name for the place in which striving takes place, named by the name of the maṣdar of the triliteral سعى; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa and sukūn. [Translator's note: this line is a verbatim repetition of the السعي entry, attached in the source to الجبين; it is translated as written.]
(103) الجبين: a name for the well-known part at either side of the head, so there are two jabīns with the forehead between them; its pattern is فعيل with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(107) ذبح: a name for what is slaughtered, meaning the slaughtered animal; its pattern is فعل with kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
Concision (ījāz): in His saying, the Exalted, «فَبَشَّرْناهُ بِغُلامٍ حَلِيمٍ».
This is ījāz qaṣr (concision by condensation), for this brief good news encompassed three things: that the child is a boy, a male; that he will reach the age of forbearance (ḥulm); and that he will be forbearing (ḥalīm).

* Benefits:
Who is the one to be sacrificed?
The verse indicated that the dreams of the prophets are true. The scholars differed over which of the two sons of Ibrāhīm was the one to be sacrificed. One group of them said he is "Isḥāq", and that is the view of ʿUmar, ʿAlī, Ibn Masʿūd, al-ʿAbbās, Kaʿb al-Aḥbār, Saʿīd ibn Jubayr and others, may Allah be pleased with them. The reports from Ibn ʿAbbās differ in two sayings: one is Ismāʿīl and the other Isḥāq. Those who said it was Isḥāq said: This story took place in Shaʾm. It is reported from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr that he said: Ibrāhīm saw in a dream the slaughter of Isḥāq while he was in Shaʾm, so he travelled with him a journey of a month in one morning, until he brought him to the place of slaughter at Minā; when Allah ordered him to slaughter the ram, he slaughtered it, and travelled back with him a journey of a month in one evening journey, the valleys and mountains being folded up for him. The second saying: that it was Ismāʿīl, and that is the view of ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām, al-Ḥasan, Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab, al-Shaʿbī, Mujāhid, al-Rabīʿ ibn Anas, Muḥammad ibn Kaʿb al-Quraẓī, al-Kalbī, and a report of ʿAṭāʾ ibn Abī Rabāḥ and Yūsuf ibn Māhak from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said the one ransomed was Ismāʿīl; and both sayings are reported from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Those who held that the sacrifice was Isḥāq argued from His saying, the Exalted, فَبَشَّرْناهُ بِغُلامٍ حَلِيمٍ فلما بلغ معه السعي: he was commanded to slaughter the one he had been given good news of, and nowhere in the Qur'an is it said that he was given good news of a child other than Isḥāq, and the good news came after the story of the sacrifice, which shows that the one to be sacrificed is the one given the good news. Those who held that the one to be sacrificed was Ismāʿīl argued that Allah the Exalted mentioned the good news of Isḥāq after finishing the story of the one to be sacrificed, saying, the Exalted, وَبَشَّرْناهُ بِإِسْحاقَ نَبِيًّا مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ, which shows that the one slaughtered was other than him; and also that Allah the Exalted said in Sūrat Hūd فَبَشَّرْناها بِإِسْحاقَ وَمِنْ وَراءِ إِسْحاقَ يَعْقُوبَ, so how would He command him to slaughter Isḥāq when He had promised him a child by him, namely Yaʿqūb? And Ismāʿīl was described with patience, not Isḥāq, in His saying: وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ كُلٌّ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ, which is his patience over the slaughter; and he was described with truthfulness to a promise in His saying إِنَّهُ كانَ صادِقَ الْوَعْدِ, for he promised his father to be patient over the slaughter and fulfilled his promise. ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz asked a Jew who had become Muslim and whose Islam was good: "Which of the two sons of Ibrāhīm did Allah the Exalted command him to slaughter?" He said: "Ismāʿīl." Al-Aṣmaʿī said: I asked Abū ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAlāʾ about the one to be sacrificed, and he said: "O Aṣmaʿī, when was Isḥāq ever in Mecca? It was only Ismāʿīl, and he is the one who built the House with his father." And Allah the Exalted knows best.

* İ'rab:
(الواو) isti'nâfiyyedir. (لمن المرسلين): müzahlaka (lâmı) ve inne'nin haberidir.
«إنّ لوطا لمن المرسلين» cümlesi isti'nâfiyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
(135- 136) (إذ) geçmiş zaman için zarftır; المرسلين'e müteallik [Dipnot: Veya takdiri «اذكر» olan mahzûf bir fiilin mef'ûlün bihi olarak nasb mahallinde bulunan zarf ismidir.]. Nasb mahallindedir [Mütercim notu: «في محلّ نصب» ibaresi kaynakta dipnottan sonra bu şekilde ayrı kalmıştır.]. (الواو) atıf harfidir. (أهله) (نجيناه)'daki gâib zamirine ma'tûf olup mansûbdur. (أجمعين) Lût ve ailesinin zamiri için manevî te'kîddir. (إلّا) istisnâ içindir. (عجوزا) إلّا ile müstesnâ olup mansûbdur. (في الغابرين) (عجوزا)'nın sıfatıdır.
«نجّيناه ...» cümlesi muzâfun ileyh olarak cer mahallindedir.
«دمّرنا ...» cümlesi نجّيناه cümlesine ma'tûf olarak cer mahallindedir.
(137) - (الواو) atıf harfidir. (اللام) te'kîd için müzahlaka lâmıdır. (عليهم) (تمرّون)'a müteallik. (مصبحين) تمرّون'un fâilinden hâl olup mansûbdur.
«إنّكم لتمرّون ...» cümlesi إنّ لوطا لمن المرسلين cümlesine ma'tûf olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.

أتغفلون عن ذلك فلا تعقلون.. (Bundan gafil mi kalıyorsunuz da akıl erdirmiyorsunuz?)

* Fevâid:
- Zamir:
Zamir üç kısma ayrılır:
1- Ayrı zamir (الضمير المنفصل): Bağımsız olarak gelen, hiçbir şeye bitişik olmayan zamirdir. İki türlüdür:
a- Ref' zamirleri: أنا- نحن- أنت- أنت- أنتما- أنتم- أنتن- هو- هي- هما- هم- هن.
b- Nasb zamirleri: إيّاي- إيّانا- إيّاك.. vb.
2- Müstetir zamir (الضمير المستتر): Sözde görünmeyen, ancak takdir edilen zamirdir. Bunlar:
Gâib için: هو- هي. Mütekellim için: أنا- نحن. Muhatap için: أنت.
Diğer zamirler, mesela أنتما- هما- هم müstetir olarak gelmez; yalnızca zikrettiğimiz zamirler müstetir olur. Zamir gâibte -هو- هي- cevâzen müstetir olur. Mütekellim ve muhatapta -أنا- نحن- أنت- vücûben müstetir olur.
3- Bitişik zamir (الضمير المتصل): Bir kelimeye bitişen ve bağımsız gelmeyen zamirdir. İsme bitişebilir, (كتابك) gibi; fiile bitişebilir, (جاؤوا) gibi; harfe bitişebilir, (عليه) gibi. Üç kısma ayrılır:
a- Ref'e mahsus zamirler: Bunlar tesniye elifi, cemaat vavı, muhataba yâsı, harekeli tâ ve nisvet nûnudur.
Bu zamirler yalnızca fiile bitişir. Fiil tâm (nâkıs olmayan) ise fâil olarak ref' mahallindedir; üzerinde durduğumuz âyetteki Allah Teâlâ'nın أَفَلا تَعْقِلُونَ kavlinde olduğu gibi.
Cemaat vavı bitişik zamir olup fâil olarak ref' mahallindedir. Eğer nâkıs bir fiile (kâne ve kardeşleri) bitişirse onun ismi olarak ref' mahallinde olur.
b- Nasb ve cerre mahsus zamirler: Bunlar gâib hâsı, mütekellim yâsı ve hitap kâfıdır. Fiile, isme, harfe veya fiile benzeyen harflere (inne ve kardeşleri) bitişmede ortaktırlar. Fiile bitişirse mef'ûlün bih olarak nasb mahallinde olur, (أكرمتك) gibi. Fiile benzeyen harfe bitişirse onun ismi olarak nasb mahallinde olur. İsme bitişirse izâfet ile cer mahallinde olur. Harfe (yani cer harfine) bitişirse cer harfiyle cer mahallinde olur.
c- Ref', nasb veya cerre özgü olan [Mütercim notu: Yani her üçünde de kullanılabilen.] zamir, o da (نا)'dır. Bazen ref' mahallinde gelir, (سمعنا وأطعنا) gibi; bazen cer mahallinde gelir, (ربنا) gibi; bazen de nasb mahallinde gelir, (لا تؤاخذنا) gibi.
Not: Mütekellim yâsı (من) ve (عن) cer harflerinden birine veya fiile bitişirse, yâ ile ondan öncesi arasında ayırıcı olarak vikâye nûnu getirilir; şöyle: منّي- عنّى- أكرمني- يكرمني- أكرمني..

* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لمن المرسلين) the shifted lām and the khabar of inna.
The clause «إنّ لوطا لمن المرسلين» has no grammatical position (resumptive).
(135-136) (إذ) an adverb of past time, attached to (المرسلين) [Note: or it is an adverbial noun in the position of an accusative, a direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر).]; in the position of an accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (أهله) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the third-person pronoun in (نجيناه), accusative; (أجمعين) a semantic tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun of Lūṭ and his family; (إلّا) for exception; (عجوزا) excepted by إلّا, accusative; (في الغابرين) a naʿt (adjective) of (عجوزا).
The clause «نجّيناه ... » is in the position of a genitive (muḍāf ilayhi).
The clause «دمّرنا ... » is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause نجّيناه.
(137) (الواو) a conjunction; (اللام) the shifted lām for emphasis; (عليهم) attached to (تمرّون); (مصبحين) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from the fāʿil (agent) of تمرّون.
The clause «إنّكم لتمرّون ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّ لوطا لمن المرسلين.
The clause «تمرّون..» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of inna.
(138) (الواو) a conjunction; (بالليل) attached to a ḥāl conjoined to the preceding ḥāl; (الهمزة) for a reproachful question (istifhām tawbīkhī); (الفاء) a conjunction; (لا) negative.
The clause «لا تعقلون ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied clause, that is:
"Are you heedless of that, so you do not reason?"

* Benefits:
- The pronoun:
The pronoun is divided into three types:
1- The detached pronoun (al-ḍamīr al-munfaṣil): it is the one that comes independently, not attached to anything, and it is of two kinds:
a- Pronouns of the nominative: أنا - نحن - أنت - أنت - أنتما - أنتم - أنتن - هو - هي - هما - هم - هن.
b- Pronouns of the accusative: إيّاي - إيّانا - إيّاك.. etc.
2- The latent pronoun (al-ḍamīr al-mustatir): it is the one that does not appear in speech but is only implied, and it is:
for the third person: هو - هي. For the first person: أنا - نحن. For the second person: أنت.
As for the remaining pronouns such as أنتما - هما - هم, they do not come latent; only the pronouns we have mentioned are latent. The pronoun is latent permissibly (jawāzan) with the third person: هو - هي. And it is latent obligatorily (wujūban) with the first and second person: أنا - نحن - أنت.
3- The attached pronoun (al-ḍamīr al-muttaṣil): it is the pronoun that is attached to a word and does not come independently. It may be attached to a noun such as (كتابك), or to a verb such as (جاؤوا), or to a particle such as (عليه). It is divided into three kinds:
a- Pronouns specific to the nominative, namely: the alif of the dual - the wāw of the group - the yāʾ of the addressee - the vowelled tāʾ - the nūn of the feminine plural.
These pronouns attach only to a verb. If the verb is complete (not defective), they are in the position of a nominative, a fāʿil (agent), as in the verse we are dealing with, His saying, the Exalted, أَفَلا تَعْقِلُونَ
for the wāw of the group is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative, fāʿil. But if it is attached to a defective verb (kāna and its sisters), it is in the position of a nominative, its ism (subject).
b- Pronouns specific to the accusative and genitive, namely: the hāʾ of the third person, the yāʾ of the first person, and the kāf of the addressee. They share in attaching to a verb, a noun, a particle, or the particles resembling the verb (inna and its sisters). If attached to a verb, they are in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), such as (أكرمتك); if attached to a particle resembling the verb, they are in the position of an accusative, its ism; if attached to a noun, they are in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and if attached to a particle (that is, a preposition), they are in the position of a genitive by the preposition.
c- And a pronoun that serves the nominative, the accusative or the genitive, and it is (نا): it comes sometimes in the position of a nominative such as (سمعنا وأطعنا), sometimes in the position of a genitive such as (ربنا), and sometimes in the position of an accusative such as (لا تؤاخذنا).
Note: if the yāʾ of the first person attaches to one of the two prepositions (من) and (عن), or to a verb, the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya) is brought in as a separator between the yāʾ and what precedes it, such as: منّي - عنّى - أكرمني - يكرمني - أكرمني..

* Sarf:
(141) المدحضين: المدحض'in cemidir; meçhul olarak bina edilen أدحض'ten ism-i mef'ûldür; vezni mîmin dammesi ve aynın fethasıyla مفعل'dir.
(142) مليم: "Kişi kınanacak bir şey yaptığında" denilen rubâî ألام فلان fiilinden ism-i fâildir; vezni mîmin dammesi ve aynın kesresiyle مفعل'dir. Onda kalb yoluyla i'lâl ve teskîn yoluyla i'lâl vardır; aslı damme, sükûn ve kesre ile ملوم idi; kesre vav üzerinde ağır görüldü ve vav sâkin kılındı -teskîn yoluyla i'lâl-, harekesi kendinden önceki lâma nakledildi; sonra vavdan önceki harf kesreli olduğu için vav yâya çevrildi ve مليم oldu.
(143) المسبّحين: المسبّح'in cemidir; rubâî سبّح'tan ism-i fâildir; vezni mîmin dammesi ve şeddeli aynın kesresiyle مفعّل'dir..
(145) العراء: Yeryüzünün adıdır, câmiddir. İçindeki hemze yâdan dönüşmüştür; aslı العراي'dir, çünkü فرح babından عري يعرى'dandır. Yâ, sâkin bir eliften sonra kelime sonunda gelince hemzeye çevrildi.
(146) يقطين: Kabak bitkisi için câmid bir isimdir; vezni yânın fethasıyla يفعيل'dir; "bir yerde ayrılmadan kaldı" manasındaki قطن بالمكان'dan alınmıştır.

* Fevâid:
- Yûnus (s.a.v.) ve gemi:
İbn Abbâs ve Vehb dediler ki: Yûnus -aleyhissalâtü vesselâm- kavmini azapla tehdit etmişti; azap onlardan gecikti. O da onlardan gizlenir gibi çıktı, denize yöneldi ve gemiye bindi. Gemi durdu. Gemiciler: "Burada efendisinden kaçmış bir köle var" dediler. Kura çektiler; kura üç defa Yûnus'a çıktı. "Kaçak benim" dedi ve kendini suya attı. Bu, İbn Abbâs'ın söylediğidir. Sonra onu balık yuttu. O, Allah azze ve celle'yi tesbih eder ve O'nu çokça zikrederdi. İbn Abbâs: "Namaz kılanlardandı" demiştir. Bazıları da şöyle demiştir: Bollukta Allah'ı anın ki darlıkta O da sizi ansın. Balığın karnında kalış müddeti hakkında sözler ihtilaf etmiştir: Üç, yedi, yirmi, kırk olduğu söylenmiştir. Balık onu dışarı attıktan sonra Allah üzerine yaktînden (yani kabaktan) bir ağaç bitirdi. Bu ağacın, sineklerin ona yaklaşmaması özelliği vardır. Sonra Allah onu yüz bin veya daha fazla kişiye, yani "hatta daha fazlasına" gönderdi. Hadiste onların (yirmi bin) fazla oldukları gelmiştir; ona iman ettiler.
Ubey b. Ka'b'dan -Allah ondan razı olsun- şöyle dediği rivayet edilmiştir: Rasûlullah (s.a.v.)'e Allah Teâlâ'nın وَأَرْسَلْناهُ إِلى مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ kavlini sordum; "Yirmi bin fazla idiler" buyurdu. Bunu Tirmizî rivayet etmiştir.
Ve "hasen bir hadistir" demiştir.
- (أو):
Nahivcilerin sözleri, Allah Teâlâ'nın وَأَرْسَلْناهُ إِلى مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ kavlindeki (أو)'nun manası hakkında çatışmıştır. İbn Hişâm el-Muğnî'de bu ihtilafı zikretmiş ve şu görüşleri aktarmıştır: Ferrâ dedi ki: Mana (بل يزيدون: hatta artarlar)'dir; tefsirde böyle gelmiştir, Arapçada da sahihtir. Bazı Kûfeliler: "Vav manasındadır" demiştir. Basralıların bu hususta görüşleri vardır: İbhâm için olduğu söylenmiştir. Şöyle de denmiştir:
Tahyîr içindir; yani gören kimse onları görünce "Onlar yüz bindir" ya da "daha fazladır" demek arasında muhayyer kalır. Bunu İbnü'ş-Şecerî Sîbeveyh'ten nakletmiştir; ondan sabit olması şüphelidir. Biri vâki olan iki şey arasında tahyîr sahih olmaz. Şüphe için olduğu, (bu şüphenin) görene yöneltildiği de söylenmiştir; bunu İbn Cinnî zikretmiştir. İmam Nesefî tefsirde onun (أو يزيدون) kavlini "bakanın görüşünde" diye aktarmıştır; yani gören onları görünce "Onlar yüz bindir veya daha fazla" der. Zeccâc dedi ki: Birden çok kişi "manası بل يزيدون'dur" demiştir. Bunu Ferrâ ve Ebû Ubeyde söylemiştir; İbn Abbâs'tan da böyle nakledilmiştir. Bu görüş en zahir olanıdır.
