He said that so that they would feel fear and disperse from him; so they fled from him to their festival and left him in the house of the idols with no one with him, and he did to the idols what he did. The outward sense of the speech may suggest that he thereby committed the offence of lying, whereas prophets are immune from it. The correct view is that lying is forbidden except when one speaks obliquely and equivocates; and Abraham intended that whoever has death at his neck is sick. From it is the proverb "Safety is disease enough" (kafā bi-l-salāma dāʾan). And Labīd said:
كانت قناتي لا تلين لغامز ... فألانها الإصباح والإمساء
فدعوت ربي بالسلامة جاهدا ... ليصحني فإذا السلامة داء
(My spear-shaft would not bend for one who pressed it, then morning and evening made it supple. So I prayed to my Lord earnestly for safety, that He keep me sound, and behold, safety is itself a disease.)
[Translator's note: the source prints «فألا منها» in the first verse; the verse is known as «فألانها».] Labīd describes his strength in the time of youth, then his weakness in old age with the succession of the times upon him, and that he asked for a long term of life, which became the cause of his decay. Al-qanāt is the spear; he borrowed it for his uprightness or strength by way of explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya), and suppleness (al-līna) and pressing (al-ghamz) are an embellishment (tarshīḥ) of the metaphor; al-ghamz is feeling with the hand. A man died and the people gathered around him saying "he died while healthy", and a Bedouin said: "Is he healthy who has death at his neck?" It was also said that he meant by his saying "I am sick" a sickness of the soul because of your unbelief; although some people have permitted it in deception in war, in taqiyya (precautionary dissimulation), in pleasing a spouse, and in reconciling disputants and those who have cut off relations. More on this unique story will come in the section on benefits.
2- Concision (al-ījāz):
In His saying "So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy" is a concision by brevity (ījāz qiṣar), whose definition has preceded. This concise glad tiding contains three things: that the child is male, that he would reach the age of forbearance, and that he would be forbearing. And what forbearance is a clearer proof of that than his forbearance when his father presented slaughter to him: he was not agitated, did not falter and did not object to his father's will, but said: "You will find me, if Allah wills, among the patient", and then submitted to that, and it never occurred to his mind that Allah would ransom him and would prepare the ram of ransom for him.

* Benefits:
1- Who is the one sacrificed?
The exegetes differed about the one commanded to be slaughtered. From Ibn ʿAbbās, Ibn ʿUmar and a group of the Followers: it was Ishmael, and their proof for it is that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I am the son of the two sacrificed ones", and a Bedouin said to him "O son of the two sacrificed ones", and he smiled. He was asked about that and said: when ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib dug the well of Zamzam he vowed to Allah that if Allah made its matter easy for him he would sacrifice one of his sons. The lot fell on ʿAbdallāh, and his maternal uncles prevented him and said to him: «أفديناك بمائة من الإبل» (we ransom you with a hundred camels) «[Translator's note: the mood and addressee of «أفديناك» are unclear in the source; it is rendered as written.]». So he ransomed him with a hundred camels; and the second is Ishmael. They also argued that Allah described him with patience, not Isaac, in His saying, the Exalted: «وإسماعيل وإدريس وذا الكفل كل من الصابرين», which is his patience with the slaughter. From ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, Ibn Masʿūd, al-ʿAbbās, ʿAṭāʾ, ʿIkrima and others: it was Isaac, and this is the view of the People of the two Books, the Jews and Christians. The argument for it is that Allah the Exalted informed His intimate friend Abraham, when he migrated to Syria, that he asked Him for a child, then followed that with the glad tiding of a forbearing boy, then mentioned his dream of slaughtering that boy who had been given as glad tiding. The letter of Jacob to Joseph also indicates it, in which it is said: "From Jacob Israel of Allah, son of Isaac the sacrificed of Allah, son of Abraham the intimate friend of Allah." Al-Zajjāj said: "Allah knows best which of them was the sacrificed one." This is a third position, which is to hold back from deciding between the two views and to entrust the knowledge of it to Allah the Exalted. Perhaps this is better, since this question is not among the doctrines we are charged with knowing; it is among what is beneficial to know and not harmful to be ignorant of, and Allah knows best. The exegetes and historians have long discussion of the story of the sacrifice, to be consulted in the longer works.
2- A debate between the people of the Sunna and the Muʿtazila:
There is a debate between the people of the Sunna and the Muʿtazila which it behoves us to summarise for its charm and its close connection with i'rab. Al-Zamakhsharī asked about His saying, the Exalted: «والله خلقكم وما تعملون»: "How can one and the same thing be created by Allah the Exalted and also made by them?" and he answered that this is as one says "the carpenter made the door", where the intended is making its shape, not its substance. Likewise the idols: their substances are created by Allah the Exalted, while their shapes and forms are made by them. "If you say: what prevents you from making ما a maṣdar particle, not a relative, so that the meaning is 'Allah created you and your work', as the Jabriyya say?" He answered: "The nearest thing by which this question is refuted, after its refutation by rational proofs, is that the meaning of the verse refuses it, for Allah the Exalted argued against them that He created the worshipper and the worshipped, so how can the created worship the created, given that the worshipper in both is the one who made the form of the worshipped?" He said: "Had you said 'Allah created you and your work', the speech would have no correspondence (ṭibāq); and another thing: that His saying «وما تعملون» is explained in His saying «أتعبدون ما تنحتون», and it is not said that this ما is relative, so distinguishing between them is arbitrary and partisan." He said: "If you say: make it relative, meaning 'what you do of your deeds', then it agrees with the first in being relative, so I am not obliged to distinguish between them?" He answered: "Rather both obligations are around your neck, and only submission to the truth will release them: even if you make it relative, it applies in your view to the maṣdar which is the substance of the joining, and in that is a disjointing of the composition and a cutting off, as if you had made it a maṣdar particle."
Ibn al-Munayyir took him to task and said: "It is necessary to take it as a maṣdar. That is because they did not worship these idols as stones unshaped; had it been so, they would not have cooperated in shaping them, nor singled out a stone for their worship over another stone. So it indicates that they worship them only with respect to their shapes and forms, which are the effect of their work; in reality they worshipped their own work, and the argument is sound against them, that they are like it, even though the worshipped is the acquisition of the worshipper and his work. So it is clear that the argument stands against them, on the assumption that ما is a maṣdar, in the clearest and most eloquent way. When that is established, let his speech be pursued in refutation. As for his saying that it is relative and that what is meant by their making of them is making their shapes, it contradicts the outward sense, for it needs an omitted muḍāf in a place of despair, its implied form being 'Allah created you and what you make of its shape and form', unlike the aspect given by the people of the Sunna, which needs no omission whatever. Then, if the worshipped is made the substance itself, how does it fit their rebuke by showing that the worshipped is the work of the worshipper, while agreeing that the substances of the idols are not their work? What is their work, the shape, is not their worshipped object on this interpretation, and what is their worshipped object, the substance of the idol, is not their work; so it has no stable footing that the worshipped, on his interpretation, is the work of the worshipper, whereas on what we have set out it is plain. As for his saying that the correspondence breaks down on the interpretation of the people of the Sunna between «ما تنحتون» and «ما تعملون», it is not correct; for we may take the first as a maṣdar, and that in reality they worshipped only their carving, because these idols, being stones before carving, they did not worship; when they worked carving into them they worshipped them; so in reality they worshipped nothing but their carving, which is their work. The correspondence is then achieved, and the constraint on this view is more eloquent and firmer. Had it been as he says, the argument would have stood for them, and they would have said, as al-Zamakhsharī says, confronting His saying «Allah created you and what you do»: 'No, and no honour! Allah does not create what we do, for we knew the shaping and the forming, and this Allah did not create', and they would have found a pretext for rushing into the argument."
[Translator's note: the source text of this passage is evidently corrupt in places (for example «جوهر الضم» and «في موضع اليأس»); it is translated as written.]
3- The meaning of going to his Lord:
There is disagreement on the meaning of His saying «إني ذاهب إلى ربي سيهدين». Most hold that this verse is a basis for emigration (hijra) and seclusion, i.e. "I am emigrating from the land of my people and my birthplace to where I can worship my Lord, for He will guide me to the right path." And in the sīn of futurity is an announcement that the act will certainly occur.
﴿والصافات صفا﴾: Vâv kasem ve cer harfidir. ﴿الصافات﴾ kasem vâvı ile mecrûrdur; câr ve mecrûr, takdiri «أقسم» olan mahzûf bir fiile mütealliktir. ﴿صفًا﴾ te'kîd edici mef'ûl-i mutlaktır.

﴿فاستفتهم أهم أشد خلقا أم من خلقنا﴾: Fâ fasîhadır. ﴿استفتهم﴾ illet harfinin hazfı üzere mebnî emir fiildir; fâili vücûben müstetir olup takdiri «أنت»dir, hâ mef'ûlün bihtir. Hemze istifhâm içindir. ﴿هم﴾ mübtedâ, ﴿أشد﴾ haber, ﴿خلقًا﴾ temyizdir. ﴿أم﴾ atıf harfidir ve muttasıladır; ﴿من﴾ ﴿هم﴾'e ma'tûftur. ﴿خلقنا﴾ cümlesi fiil ve ﴿نا﴾ fâil olup ism-i mevsûlün sılasıdır, i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
﴿إنا خلقناهم من طين لازب﴾: إن nâsih harf, ﴿نا﴾ onun ismidir; ﴿هم﴾ mef'ûlün bihtir; ﴿خلقناهم﴾ cümlesi inne'nin haberidir. ﴿من طين﴾ câr ve mecrûr ﴿خلقناهم﴾'ya mütealliktir; لازب ﴿طين﴾'in sıfatıdır (na't).

﴿أذلك خير نزلا أم شجرة الزقوم﴾: the clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying (maqūl li-qawl maḥdhūf); the hamza is for a question of disapproval and rebuke (istifhām inkārī tawbīkhī); «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «خير» is the khabar (predicate), and «نزلًا» is a tamyīz (specification) of «خير»; it has also been said that it is a ḥāl (circumstantial). «أم» is a conjunction, and «شجرة الزقوم» is conjoined to «ذلك».

﴿فراغ عليهم ضربا باليمين﴾: Fâ, takdiri «فلم يجيبوا فراغ» (cevap vermeyince yöneldi) olan mahzûf bir şeye atıftır. ﴿عليهم﴾ câr ve mecrûr ﴿راغ﴾'a mütealliktir. ﴿ضربًا﴾ hâlin yerine geçen bir masdardır, yani: «فراغ عليهم ضاربًا» (üzerlerine vurarak yöneldi); ya da takdîr edilmiş bir fiilin mef'ûl-i mutlakıdır, yani: «يضرب ضربًا»; ﴿يضرب ضربًا﴾ cümlesi hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir. ﴿باليمين﴾ câr ve mecrûr ﴿ضربًا﴾'ya ya da onun âmiline mütealliktir.

﴿وقال إني ذاهب إلى ربي سيهدين﴾: Vâv, takdiri «فخرج من النار سالمًا، وقال...» (ateşten sağ salim çıktı ve dedi ki…) olan mahzûf bir şeye atıftır. ﴿إن﴾ nâsih harf, yâ onun ismi, ﴿ذاهب﴾ onun haberidir. ﴿إلى ربي﴾ câr ve mecrûr ﴿ذاهب﴾'e mütealliktir. Sîn istikbâl harfidir. ﴿يهدين﴾ yâ üzerinde takdîrî damme ile merfû muzâri fiildir; nûn vikâye içindir; fâsılalara riayet için hazfedilen zamir yâsı mef'ûlün bihtir, yani: «سيهديني».

﴿وباركنا عليه وعلى إسحاق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «باركنا» is conjoined to what came before: it is a past verb, «نا» being the fāʿil (agent); «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «باركنا»; and «على إسحاق» is conjoined to «عليه».
﴿ومن ذريتهما محسن وظالم لنفسه مبين﴾: «من ذريتهما» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «محسن» is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); «ظالم» is conjoined to «محسن»; «لنفسه» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «ظالم»; and «مبين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ظالم».

﴿فَنادَوْا ولاتَ حِينَ مَناصٍ﴾: Tefsirde «ve artık seslenme vakti değildir» şeklinde gelmiştir. Lügat âlimleri ise «ve artık kurtuluş vakti değildir» ve «kaçış yoktur» demişlerdir. Bir şey birini kaçırdığında (elinden kaçtığında) «ناصَهُ، يَنُوصُهُ» denir. Tefsirdeki «لاتَ حِينَ نِداءٍ»nın anlamı: «Kurtaracak bir seslenme vakti değildir». «لاتَ حِينُ مَناصٍ» de caizdir; ref' güzeldir. Üzerinde vakf tâ ile «لاتْ» şeklindedir; Kisâî ise hâ ile «لاهْ» diye vakfeder, çünkü onu müenneslik hâsı kabul eder. Üzerinde vakfın hakikati tâ iledir. Bu tâ, «ذَهَبْتُ، وجَلَسْتُ» sözündeki fiile bitişen tânın ve «رَأيْتُ زَيْدًا ثُمَّتَ عَمْرًا» sözündeki tânın benzeridir. Harflerin tâsı fiillerin tâsı menzilesindedir; çünkü her iki yerde de tâ, i'rab almayan ve isimler yolunda olmayan şeye dahil olmuştur.
Biri: «Onu, kendilerinin "كانَ مِنَ الأمْرِ ذَيْهْ" ve "ذَيْهْ" sözleri menzilesinde kılarız; bu, vakıftaki bir hâdır ve i'rab almayan bir isme dahil olmuş bir hâdır» derse [Mütercim notu: Metin bu itiraza açık bir cevap vermez.] Cer ile okumayı da caiz görmüşler ve «لاتَ أوانٍ» demişlerdir. Ebû Zübeyd'in şu beytini inşad etmişlerdir:
طَلَبُوا صُلْحَنا ولاتَ أوانٍ ∗∗∗ فَأجَبْنا أنْ لَيْسَ حِينَ بَقاءِ
(Bizden barış istediler, ama artık vakit değildi; biz de onlara: Artık yaşatma (bekâ) vakti değil, diye cevap verdik.)
Ebü'l-Abbâs Muhammed b. Yezîd'in (Müberred) bize inşad ettiği ve rivayet ettiği ise şöyledir:
طَلَبُوا صُلْحَنا ولاتَ أوانٌ
Ve kesrenin de rivayet edildiğini zikretti. Nasb ise, onun «لَيْسَ»nin amelini yapması üzerinedir; anlam: «Vakit, kaçış vakti değildir». Onunla ref' okuyan «حِينَ»yi «لَيْسَ»nin ismi yapmış ve haberi takdir etmiştir; «Bizim için kurtuluş vakti yoktur» anlamında. Cer ile okuyan ise onu, «قَدِ لَكَ» dedikleri ve kesre üzere mebnî kıldıkları gibi, iki sâkinin birleşmesi sebebiyle kesreli mebnî kılmıştır.
Anlam şudur: «Bizim kaçış vaktimiz ve kurtuluş vaktimiz değildir». «وَلاتَ أوانَ» deyince onu «Bizim vaktimizin zamanı değildir» anlamına göre kılmıştır; muzâf hazfedilince vakf üzere mebnî olmuş, sonra iki sâkinin birleşmesi sebebiyle kesrelenmiştir. Kesre, Basralılara göre şazdır ve hataya benzer; Sîbeveyh ve Halîl kesreyi rivayet etmemişlerdir. Amel edilen (geçerli olan) nasb ve ref'dir. Ahfeş ise şöyle demiştir: «لاتَ حِينَ مَناصٍ»nin nasbı «لا» iledir; tıpkı «لا رَجُلَ في الدّارِ» (Evde hiçbir adam yok) demen gibi; tâ da müenneslik için dahil olmuştur.

And His saying: ﴿واذْكُرْ إسْماعِيلَ واليَسَعَ وذا الكِفْلِ﴾: it is also read "واللَّيْسَعَ وذا الكِفْلِ". He had undertaken surety for the work of a righteous man. It is said that this man used to pray a hundred prayers every day; the righteous man died, so Dhū l-Kifl undertook his work and used to do his work. It is also said that Dhū l-Kifl undertook the affair of some prophets and delivered them from being killed, so he was called "ذا الكِفْلِ". ﴿وَكُلٌّ مِنَ الأخْيارِ﴾: the meaning is "and each of these mentioned is among the best". "اَلْأخْيارُ" is the plural of "خَيِّرٌ"; "خَيِّرٌ" and "أخْيارٌ" are like "مَيِّتٌ" and "أمْواتٌ".

﴿هَذا وإنَّ لِلطّاغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَآبٍ﴾: the meaning is "the matter is this (اَلْأمْرُ هَذا)"; so "هَذا" is nominative, the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). Or, if you wish, "هَذا" is nominative as a mubtadaʾ and the khabar is omitted. And "جَهَنَّمَ" is a badal (substitute) for "شَرَّ مَآبٍ", that is, an evil place of return.

﴿هَذا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وغَسّاقٌ﴾: it is read with shaddah on the sīn and without it. "حَمِيمٌ" is nominative in two ways. One is in the sense of "this is scalding water and purulence, so let them taste it (هَذا حَمِيمٌ وغَسّاقٌ فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ)"; it is also possible that "هَذا" is in the sense of an explanation of "هَذا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ", and then He said afterwards ﴿حَمِيمٌ وغَسّاقٌ﴾. On this explanation "هَذا" may be in the position of accusative, and it may be in the position of nominative. When it is in the position of accusative, it is on the estimate "فَلْيَذُوقُوا هَذا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ" (let them taste this, let them taste it), as He said: ﴿وَإيّايَ فاتَّقُونِ﴾ [al-Baqara: 41]; and similar to that is "زَيْدًا فاضْرِبْهُ" (Zayd, strike him).
Whoever puts it in the nominative does so by way of the mubtadaʾ (inchoative), and makes the command in the position of the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, like ﴿والسّارِقُ والسّارِقَةُ فاقْطَعُوا أيْدِيَهُما﴾ [al-Māʾida: 38]. It has been said that the meaning of "غَسّاقٌ" is: extremely cold, which burns by its coldness. It has also been said that "اَلْغَسّاقُ" is what oozes from the skins of the people of the Fire; if a drop of it were to fall in the East it would make the people of the West stink, and likewise if it fell in the West.

Allah Teâlâ buyurdu: (ص وَالْقُرْآنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ (١) بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ (٢) كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوْا وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ (٣))
Cumhur dâlın sükûnu üzere okumuştur [Mütercim notu: Kastedilen, «صَادْ» harf adının sonundaki dâldır.]; bunun vechi (daha önce) zikredilmişti.
Kesresiyle de okunmuştur. Bunda iki vecih vardır: Birincisi, bunun iki sâkinin buluşması sebebiyle verilen kesre olmasıdır. İkincisi, «صادَى»dan emir olmasıdır; «صادَى الشيءَ» bir şeyin karşısına geçmek ve ona muarız olmak (karşılık vermek) demektir; yani «Amelinle Kur'an'a karşılık ver (amelini Kur'an'a denk kıl).»
Fetha ile de okunur; yani «اتلُ صادَ» (Sâd'ı oku). (Harfin) iki sâkinin buluşması sebebiyle harekelendiği de söylenmiştir.
(الْقُرْآنُ): kasemdir. Kasem olan «صادْ»a ma'tûf olduğu da söylenmiştir.
Kasemin cevabına gelince, o mahzûftur; yani «لقد جاءكم الحقّ» (size hak gelmiştir) ve benzeri. Cevabın şunun mânâsı olduğu da söylenmiştir:
(بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا): yani «Kur'an'ın hakkı için, kâfirler muhalefet etmiş ve imandan yüz çevirip büyüklenmişlerdir.»
Cevabın «كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا» olduğu, lâmın da mahzûf olduğu söylenmiştir; yani «لَكَمْ أهلكنا». Bu uzaktır; çünkü «كم», «أهلكنا» ile nasb mahallindedir. Cevabın bu cümlenin mânâsı olduğu da söylenmiştir; yani «لقد أهلكنا كثيرًا من القرون» (andolsun, nice nesilleri helâk ettik).
Cevabın, (Allah Teâlâ'nın) (إِنْ كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ) sözü olduğu da söylenmiştir. Allah Teâlâ'nın (إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ) sözü olduğu da söylenmiştir; ancak bu ikisi (kasem ile bu cümle) arasında, onun cevap olmasına engel olan uzun bir söz vardır.
(وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ): Aslı «لا»dır; ona tâ ilave edilmiştir; nitekim «رُبَّ» ve «ثُمَّ»ye de ilave edilmiş ve «رُبَّتَ» ve «ثُمَّتْ» denmiştir.
Arapların çoğu bu tâyı fetha ile harekeler. Vakıf hâline gelince, bazıları tâ ile vakfeder; çünkü harfler değişikliğe uğrayacak yer değildir. Bazıları ise «قائمة» üzerinde vakfettiği gibi hâ ile vakfeder.
«حِينَ»e gelince, Sîbeveyh'in mezhebine göre o «لات»ın haberidir, ismi ise mahzûftur; çünkü «لات», «ليس»in amelini yapmıştır; yani «ليس الحينُ حينَ هربٍ» (vakit, kaçış vakti değildir). (İsminin) muzmer (gizli zamir) olduğu söylenemez; çünkü harflerde zamir gizlenmez.
Ahfeş şöyle dedi: O, nefy bâbında (cinsini nefyeden lâ olarak) amel edendir; buna göre «حين» onun ismidir, haberi ise mahzûftur; yani «لا حينَ مُناظرٌ لهم» (onlar için uygun bir vakit yoktur) veya «حينُهم» (onların vakti …).
Araplardan, ondan sonra geleni ref' edip mansûb haberi takdir edenler de vardır; nitekim biri şöyle demiştir:
فَأَنَا ابْنُ قَيْسٍ لَا بَرَاحُ
(Ben Kays'ın oğluyum; ayrılmak (geri çekilmek) yok!)
Ebû Ubeyd şöyle dedi: Tâ, «لا»ya değil «حين»e bitişiktir; onların «تَحِينَ» ve «تَلَانَ» dediklerini nakletmiştir.
Bir topluluk da «لات»tan sonra geleni cerr etmeyi caiz görmüş ve buna dair beyitler okumuşlardır. Ben bunu «İlelü'l-İ'râbi'l-Kebîr» adlı eserimde etraflıca ele aldım.

His saying: {أَن تَسْجُدَ}: One who holds that «لا» in {أَلاَّ تَسْجُدَ} [al-Aʿrāf: 12] in the other sūra is redundant may cite this as evidence, since it is absent here though the story is one. And His saying «لما خَلَقْتُ»: one who holds that «ما» may be used for a rational being may cite it as evidence, since Adam is meant. It is also said: there is no evidence in it, because he was then moulded clay, not a sentient body, so he was referred to in that state. And it is said: «ما» is maṣdarī and the maṣdar is not meant, so it stands in the place of the object, i.e. "to My creature".

Al-Jaḥdarī read «لَمَّا» with doubled mīm and fatḥa on the lām, which is the temporal lammā according to al-Fārisī, and a particle of the occurrence of one thing due to the occurrence of another according to Sībawayh. The one to be prostrated to on this reading is not mentioned, i.e. "What prevented you from prostrating when I created — that is, when I created — the one I commanded you to prostrate to?" It was also read «بيَدَيِّ» with kasra on the yāʾ, like Ḥamza's reading «بِمُصْرِخِيِّ», whose discussion came earlier. And «بيدي» was read in the singular.

His saying: «أسْتَكْبَرْت»: The majority read it with an interrogative hamza, an interrogation of rebuke and denial, and «أم» here is connected. This is the saying of the majority of grammarians. Ibn ʿAṭiyya transmitted from some grammarians that it is not the counterpart of the alif when the two verbs differ, and is a counterpart only when they enter upon a single verb, as in your saying "Did Zayd stand, or ʿAmr?" and "Was it Zayd who stood, or ʿAmr?"; and when the verbs differ, as in this verse, it is not a counterpart. What he transmitted from some grammarians is a corrupt doctrine; rather, the majority of grammarians are against it. Sībawayh said: "You say: 'Did you strike Zayd or kill him?' Beginning here with the verb is better, because you are asking about one of the two without knowing which it was, and you are not asking about the place of one of them, as if you said: which of these was it?" End of quotation. So he made it the counterpart of the alif although the two verbs differ.

A group — among them Ibn Kathīr, though it is not well known from him — read «استكبَرْتَ» with a conjunctive alif, which admits two views. One: that interrogation is intended, indicated by «أم», as in his saying:

3879 - ... ... with seven they threw the pebbles, or with eight

and the other's saying:

3880 - Are you departing from the tribe, or will you leave early? ... ...

so the two readings agree in meaning. It also admits being pure statement, in which case «أم» is disconnected, because its condition is absent.

His saying: {مِنْهَا}: i.e. from Paradise, or from the form of creation, because he had been beautiful and returned ugly, luminous and returned dark. It is also said: from the heavens. He said here «لَعْنتي» and elsewhere «اللعنةَ»; though in wording one is general and the other specific, in meaning both are general by implication, because whoever is under the curse of Allah is inevitably under the curse of everyone. The Exalted said: {أُولَئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةُ الله والملائكة والناس أَجْمَعِينَ} [al-Baqara: 161]. The remaining sentences have parallels already discussed.

* I'rab:
(كم) khabariyya (declarative, not interrogative), an expression for "many", in the position of an accusative, a fronted direct object; (من قبلهم) attached to (أهلكنا); (من قرن) a tamyīz (specification) of كم; (الفاء) a conjunction; (نادوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied ḍamma on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, and (الواو) is the fāʿil, referring to the generations, or the nations, or the whole community; (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl; (لات) a negation particle working like ليس, its ism omitted, its implied form being "the time" (الحين); (حين) the one mentioned, the khabar of لات [Note: It is stated in the marginal commentary of al-Jamal: "Abū ʿUbayda said: one pauses at (لا), and the (تاء) is attached to حين, so one says 'I stood tahīna I stood', and 'tahīna such-and-such happened I did such-and-such'.. and he said: I saw it in the imām copy thus: 'lā tahīn', attached. But the codices are in fact لات حين, and the general scholars took what he saw to be among what departs from the script, like its parallels that have passed ..." End of quotation.].

* Morphology:
(3) لات: it is (لا) the negative, and (التاء) is redundant (zāʾida), like its redundancy in ربّ as in their saying ربّت.
(مناص): a maṣdar mīmī from ناصه, that is, "it escaped him", and it is of the pattern قال, or in the sense of "he lagged behind" or "he fled" or "he escaped" ... its wazn is مفعل, and it contains an i'lāl (weakening); its origin is منوص - with fatḥa on the wāw after a quiescent nūn - the fatḥa was moved to the nūn and the wāw made quiescent; then, since what precedes the wāw had fatḥa, the wāw was turned into an alif.
(5) عجاب: an intensive form from the triliteral عجب; its wazn is فعال (with ḍamma on the fāʾ).

* Benefits:
- لات:
The statements of the grammarians conflicted about its reality. The majority hold that it is two words: the negative لا, and the tāʾ marking the feminine of the word, as in ثمة and ربّت. It had to be vowelled because of the meeting of two sukūns.
In support of the majority: one pauses on it with tāʾ and with hāʾ; it was written separate from الحين; and the tāʾ may be given kasra, according to the original vowel for the meeting of two sukūns, whereas if it were a past verb - as some claimed - the kasra would have no basis. As for its operation, some said it governs nothing, and some said that it works like إن. But what the majority of the grammarians hold is that it works like ليس. Its ism comes omitted and only the khabar is mentioned, as in the verse وَلاتَ حِينَ مَناصٍ, the implied form being (ولات الحين حين مناص). There was disagreement about what it governs: al-Farrāʾ stated that it governs only the word الحين, which is the apparent statement of Sībawayh; al-Fārisī and a group held that it governs الحين and what is synonymous with it. Al-Zamakhsharī said: the tāʾ was added to (لا) and it was specialised for negating times.
A benefit:
(ولات حين مناص) was read with a genitive الحين, and al-Farrāʾ claimed that لات is used as a preposition governing the genitive of nouns of time specifically, just as مذ and منذ are, and he cited a verse of Abū Zayd al-Ṭāʾī:
طلبوا صلحنا ولات أوان ... فأجبنا أن لات حين بقاء (They sought our peace, though it was no time ... so we answered that it was no time for staying)
Al-Zamakhsharī rejected this claim, saying:
the origin is (حين مناصهم); then the cutting off of the muḍāf ilayhi from مناص was treated as the cutting off from حين, because of the unity of the muḍāf and the muḍāf ilayhi, and the tanwīn was made a replacement for the muḍāf ilayhi; then حين was made indeclinable because of its annexation to something not firmly established. Ibn Hishām added: it is better to say that the aforementioned treatment required the indeclinability of حين from the outset, and that مناص is declinable, even if it was truly cut off from annexation, but it is not a time, so it is like "all" and "part".
- Obstinacy and arrogance:
The commentators cited a historical story between the disbelievers of Quraysh and Muḥammad ﷺ as the occasion of revelation of this verse. It is an interesting story, by which you may see the extent of the obstinacy Quraysh had reached, the degree of their insistence on falsehood and their shunning of the truth. The story says:
When ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb - may Allah be pleased with him - accepted Islam, this was hard on Quraysh, and the believers rejoiced greatly at it. Al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra said to the council of Quraysh, who were the chiefs and nobles, twenty-five men, the oldest of them in age being al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra: "Walk to Abū Ṭālib." They went to him and said to him: "You are our elder and our senior, and you know what these fools have done. We have come to you so that you may judge between us and your nephew." So Abū Ṭālib sent for him and called him, and when the Prophet ﷺ came, he said to him: "O son of my brother, these are your people; they ask you for fairness, so do not lean wholly against your people." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "And what do they ask of me?" They said: "Abandon us and abandon mention of our gods, and we shall leave you and your God." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Will you give me one word by which you will rule the Arabs, and by which the non-Arabs will submit to you?" Abū Jahl said: "By your father, we shall give it to you, and ten like it." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Say: there is no god but Allah." They recoiled from that and said: "Has he made the gods one God? This is truly an astonishing thing."

The clause «شددنا ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause سخّرنا الجبال.

(21-23) (الواو) a conjunction; (هل) an interrogative particle for arousing interest; (إذ) an adverb of past time attached to نبإ [Note: this is the choice of Abū al-Baqāʾ, and al-Zamakhsharī said: "If you ask, with what is (إذ) put in the accusative? I say: it cannot be other than that it is put in the accusative by (أتاك), or by النبأ, or by an omitted word. * Morphology:
(محشورة): a passive participle from the triliteral حشر; its masculine is محشور, wazn مفعول.
(الخطاب): a noun denoting speech; in origin it is a transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral خاطب; its wazn is فعال (with kasra on the fāʾ).
(23) نعجة: an inert noun for the female sheep, and it has been used figuratively for a woman; its wazn is فعلة (with fatḥa then sukūn).

* Rhetoric:
1- Shifting from the nominal to the verbal form: in His saying, the Exalted, «يُسَبِّحْنَ».
The shift from "glorifying ones" (مسبحات), although the basic rule for the ḥāl is the singular form, is to indicate the renewal of glorification, state after state, like the verse of al-Aʿshā:
لعمري لقد لاحت عيون كثيرة ... إلى ضوء نار في يفاع تحرق (By my life, many eyes have looked toward the light of a fire burning on a height)
Had he said "burning" (محرقة, nominal participle) it would not have had that impact.
2- Antithesis (ṭibāq): in His saying, the Exalted, «بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِشْراقِ» there is a beautiful antithesis between the evening prayer and the forenoon prayer.

* Benefits:
1- (ذا الأيد): ذا means "possessor of", and it is one of the five nouns (al-asmāʾ al-khamsa) in the accusative case. The five nouns are nominative with wāw, such as: أخوك طالب نظيف - ذو العقل يشقى في النعيم بعقله.
b- And the five nouns are accusative with alif, such as: إن أخاك تلميذ نشيط.
c- And the five nouns are genitive with yāʾ, such as: كم لأخيك من فضل عليك, كن عونا لذي الحاجة.
The five nouns are not declined in this manner except under the following conditions:
a- That they be singular (neither dual nor plural).
b- That they be in the full form (not diminutive). c- That they be annexed to something other than the yāʾ of the first person.
2- (كلّ), tanwīn of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ): it is either a compensation for a singular, which is what attaches to كلا, بعضا and أيّا as compensation for what they are annexed to, such as: كلّ له أواب, that is, "everything is turning to Him", or a compensation for a clause, which is what attaches to إذ as compensation for a clause following it, such as: «فَلَوْلا إِذا بَلَغَتِ الْحُلْقُومَ وَأَنْتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنْظُرُونَ», that is:
"when the soul reaches the throat".
In writing: tanwīn is two fatḥas placed at the end of an indefinite noun that is free of the definite article (ال) and of annexation, such as: رجلا, رجل, رجل [Translator's note: the source shows these three forms, apparently meant to show the three tanwīn markings (fatḥatān, ḍammatān, kasratān); they are reproduced as written.].
3- (تسع وتسعون) numbers are of two kinds:
a- Explicit (ṣarīḥ): the defined numbers b- Vague (mubham): that which is indicated by the numeral substitutes (كم - كأين - كذا). A number, explicit or vague, needs a tamyīz to remove its vagueness. The rules for the tamyīz of numbers we summarise as follows:
a- Numbers from (3-10): their tamyīz is a plural, genitive by annexation, such as (قرأت ثلاثة كتب).
b- Numbers from (11-99): their tamyīz is a singular, accusative, such as: (إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَباً).
c- Numbers (100) and (1000) and their multiples: their tamyīz is a singular, genitive by annexation, such as (مائة رجل، وألف طفل، ومائتا امرأة).

* I'rab:
(اللام) the lām of oath, for an implied oath; (قد) a particle of certainty; (بسؤال) attached to (ظلمك); (إلى نعاجه) attached to an omitted word that is annexed to نعجتك, that is, "the request to add your ewe"; (الواو) a conjunction; (من الخلطاء) attached to a naʿt of (كثيرا); (اللام) the shifted lām for emphasis; (على بعض) attached to (يبغي); (إلّا) for exception; (الذين) a relative in the position of an accusative by connected exception; (الواو) a conjunction and the second one parenthetical; (قليل) a fronted khabar, nominative; (ما) redundant, to emphasise fewness; (هم) a detached pronoun, a postponed mubtadaʾ; (الواو) a conjunction; (أنّما) restraining and restrained (kāffa and makfūfa); (الفاء) a conjunction; (راكعا) a ḥāl, accusative, from the fāʿil of خرّ.
The clause «قال ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ظلمك» has no grammatical position, the answer to the implied oath ... and the implied oath clause with its answer is in the position of an accusative, the content of the speech.

The clause «قليل ما هم ... » has no grammatical position, parenthetical..

* Morphology:
(24) سؤال: a transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb سأل; its wazn is فعال (with ḍamma on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn).
(الخلطاء): plural of الخليط, a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning the people whose affair is one; it may also be singular, meaning the one who mixes, or shares, or is a neighbour or companion; its wazn is فعيل.. and the wazn of الخلطاء is فعلاء (with ḍamma on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn).
There is another plural of الخليط, namely خلط (with two ḍammas).

* Benefits:
- The maṣdar (ما):
It is of two kinds:
a- Purely maṣdar: it is interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar and does not convey the meaning of time, as in His saying, the Exalted, عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ ما عَنِتُّمْ and وَدُّوا ما عَنِتُّمْ, the implied form being (عنتكم), and ضاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَرْضُ بِما رَحُبَتْ, that is, (برحابتها), and His saying, the Exalted, in the verse we are dealing with لَهُمْ عَذابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِما نَسُوا يَوْمَ الْحِسابِ, the implied form being (بنسيانهم).
b- Temporal maṣdar: it conveys the meaning of a maṣdar and of time, as in His saying, the Exalted, وَأَوْصانِي بِالصَّلاةِ وَالزَّكاةِ ما دُمْتُ حَيًّا whose origin is (مدة دوامي حيا) ("the duration of my remaining alive"); the adverb was dropped and (ما) and its ṣila replaced it, as occurs in the explicit maṣdar, as in (جئتك صلاة العصر) and (آتيك قدوم الحاج), and from this is His saying, the Exalted: (إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا الْإِصْلاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ).

* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive; (لداود) is attached to (وهبنا); and the subject of praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, its implied form being سليمان (Solomon) - or داود (David) - Clause: «وهبنا ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause «نعم العبد ...» has no grammatical position; it is parenthetical.
And the clause «إنّه أوّاب ...» has no grammatical position; it gives a reason.
(31) (إذ) is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) in the position of accusative, a direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember) [Note: it is permissible for it to be an adverbial attached to أوّاب.]; (عليه) is attached to (عرض); (بالعشيّ) is attached to (عرض); (الصافنات) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (الجياد) is a badal (substitute) for الصافنات - or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it - nominative.
And the clause «عرض عليه ... الصافنات» is in the position of genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi.
(32) (الفاء) is a conjunction; (حبّ) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is an ism maṣdar (noun of the verbal noun) [Note: or it is a direct object whose operator is أحببت, by implying in it the meaning of "I preferred" or "I wanted", with (عن) meaning على.. There are other, remote interpretations.]; (عن ذكر) is attached to a ḥāl from the agent of أحببت, i.e. "distracted"; (حتّى) is a particle of limit and of genitive; (بالحجاب) is attached to (توارت), by implying in it the meaning of "it concealed itself".
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن توارت) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (أحببت).
And the clause «قال ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «عرض ...»
And the clause «إنّي أحببت ...» is in the position of accusative, being the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
And the clause «أحببت ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
And the clause «توارت ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied literal particle (أن).
(33) (عليّ) is attached to (ردّوها); (طفق) is a defective past verb, and its ism is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring to Solomon; (مسحا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, i.e. "he wiped them (wiping)" [Note: or it is a maṣdar in the position of ḥāl, and this is the choice of al-ʿUkbarī.]; (بالسوق) is attached to the implied (يمسح) [Note: or it is attached to the maṣdar (مسحا), the object of the wiping being omitted, i.e. his hand.. There is another interpretation of the verse: striking the necks of the horses and their legs with the sword; then the (الباء) in his words (بالسوق) is redundant (zāʾida), and السوق is accusative in position as the direct object of the wiping.]
And the clause «ردّوها ...» has no grammatical position; it is a resumptive clause within the scope of the preceding saying.
And the clause «طفق مسحا ...» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "so they brought them back, and he began wiping ..."
And the clause «(يمسحها) مسحا» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of طفق.
(34) (الواو) is a conjunction; (اللام) is the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (قد) is a particle of confirmation; (على كرسيّه) is attached to (ألقينا); (جسدا) is a direct object, accusative [Note: or a ḥāl from the implied object, i.e. "we cast him as a body", the pronoun referring to Solomon or to his son.]; and the agent of (أناب) refers to Solomon.
And the clause «فتنا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of the implied oath ... and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to a resumptive clause at the beginning of the story [Note: or the clause is resumptive in the course of the narrative.] And the clause «ألقينا ...» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause of the apodosis of the oath.
And the clause «أناب ...» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.:
"So Solomon went out and his people did not recognise him.. then he turned in repentance."

* Morphology:
(31) الصافنات: plural of الصافنة or الصافن, an active participle from the triliteral صفن (al-faras, "the horse stood") of the bāb ضرب, when it stands on three legs and rests the fourth on the edge of the hoof; its wazn is فاعل.
(الجياد): plural of جواد, a name for the horse, male or female; the wazn of جواد is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and the wazn of الجياد is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ, and it contains an iʿlāl (weak-letter change): its origin is جواد; the wāw was vowelled and what precedes it had kasra, so it was turned into yāʾ and became (جياد) ... And it is said that الجياد is the plural of جيّد, or the plural of جيد, which is the neck.
(32) حبّ: either a maṣdar of the triliteral حبّ or an ism maṣdar from the quadriliteral أحبّ; its wazn is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn, and its ʿayn and lām are from one letter.
(الخير): a noun meaning wealth, and what is meant by it is horses; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn. Al-Farrāʾ said: الخير and الخيل are the same in the speech of the Arabs.
(33) مسحا: a samāʿī (heard, not rule-based) maṣdar of the verb مسح of the bāb فتح; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, and it also means cutting.
(السوق): plural of ساق.. (see verse 44 of Sūrat al-Naml).

* Benefits:
- The trial of Solomon, peace be upon him:
The narrators have reported about Solomon, peace be upon him, things that do not befit the rank of prophethood and that no sound mind would believe, and these reports appear to be the weaving of the Jews, who persistently blackened the reputation of the prophets and attacked their dignity. Among these reports is what they mentioned: that Solomon, peace be upon him, raided a king at sea and married his daughter; she began weeping for her father, so the devils made for him a statue in the likeness of her father and dressed the statue in clothes resembling her father's clothes; then she, with her maidservants, kept prostrating to it for forty days without Solomon knowing. Then he entered upon his wife - Amīna - and forgot his ring; so the devil Ṣakhr came, took on the form of Solomon, peace be upon him, took the ring, and sat on the throne of his kingdom for forty days; and after his affair was uncovered he rose up [Translator's note: the source reads «هب»; «هرب» (fled) may be meant] and threw the ring into the sea, a fish swallowed it, Solomon took the fish, slit open its belly, took the ring and returned to his kingdom; he ordered that the devil Ṣakhr be brought, put him inside a rock and sealed it over him with another, then bound them with iron and lead, and then ordered that they throw him into the sea. And so on to the end of the legend, which appears - leaving no room for doubt - to be a product of imagination and of the slanders of the Jews, who have not ceased to attack the prophets and the pure. Al-Qāḍī ʿIyāḍ and other verifying scholars said: What the narrators transmitted is not sound: that the devil took the likeness of Solomon ﷺ, was given power over his kingdom, and acted unjustly in his judgment over his community; the devils are not given power over the like of this, and Allah the Exalted has protected the prophets from such a thing. And what the verifying scholars held is that the cause of his trial was what
the two Shaykhs (al-Bukhārī and Muslim) relate in the two Ṣaḥīḥs, from the ḥadīth of Abū Hurayra, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Solomon said: "Tonight I shall go round to ninety women, each of whom will bring a horseman who fights in the way of Allah the Exalted." His companion said to him: "Say: if Allah wills." But he did not say "if Allah wills," so he went round to all of them, and none of them conceived except one woman, who brought forth half a man. And by Allah, in Whose hand is my soul, had he said "if Allah wills," they would all have fought in the way of Allah as horsemen. In another narration: "I shall go round to a hundred women," and the angel said to him: "Say: if Allah wills," but he did not say it and forgot. The scholars said: The "half" (shiqq) is the body that was cast upon his throne, and this was his punishment and his trial, because he did not make the exception, being absorbed by eagerness and overcome by wishful longing,
and it was said: he forgot to make the exception, as is established in the ḥadīth, so that the command of Allah and His purpose regarding him might be carried out. And Allah knows best. The meaning of "he did not make the exception" (lam yastathni) is: he did not say "if Allah wills."

* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive; (إبراهيم) is a badal from عبادنا - or an ʿaṭf bayān on it - accusative; (الواو) is a conjunction in the three places; (أولي) is an adjective of the preceding nouns, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ, as it is attached to the sound masculine plural; (الأبصار) is conjoined to الأيدي, genitive.
Clause: «اذكر ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive [Note: it may be conjoined to the preceding clause اذكر.].
(46) (إنّا) is a particle resembling the verb, and its ism; (بخالصة) is attached to (أخلصناهم); (ذكرى) is a badal from خالصة, genitive like it [Note: if (خالصة) is a maṣdar, it is permissible for (ذكرى) to be a direct object whose operator is the maṣdar..
And it is permissible for (ذكرى) to be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي", and the clause is an adjective of خالصة.]; and the clause «إنّا أخلصناهم ...» has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumptive.
And the clause «أخلصناهم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
(47) (الواو) is a conjunction; (عندنا) is an accusative adverb attached to المصطفين; (اللام) is the shifted lām, for emphasis; (من المصطفين) is attached to the khabar of إنّ.
And the clause «إنّهم ... لمن المصطفين» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause إنّا أخلصناهم.

* Morphology:
(المصطفين): plural of المصطفى, a passive participle from the five-letter verb اصطفى; its wazn is مفتعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn, and it contains an iʿlāl by omission: the alif was omitted because it met the quiescent yāʾ as a quiescent letter, and the fatḥa was left on the fāʾ as an indication of the omitted alif, so its wazn is المفتعين.. And it contains the substitution of the tāʾ of the ifti'āl form by ṭāʾ because it comes after the ṣād; its origin is المصتفين.
(الأخيار): plural of خيّر, a sifa mushabbaha from خار يخير of the bāb ضرب; its wazn is فيعل, and the yāʾ of فيعل has been assimilated into the ʿayn of the word; the wazn of أخيار is أفعال.

* Rhetoric:
Al-majāz al-mursal (loose metonymy): in His saying, the Exalted: «أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصارِ».
الأيد is a majāz mursal for strength, and الأبصار is the plural of بصر meaning insight (baṣīra), which is also a majāz.
Or: "possessors of glorious deeds and noble knowledge", on the basis that mentioning the hands is mentioning the cause while intending the effect, and الأبصار, meaning insights, is a majāz for the knowledge that branches out from them.

* Vocabulary:
(تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرابَ): They set out for its wall and climbed down from the top of it. The sūr is the high wall. The word المحراب has been explained earlier. And الخصم means the disputant and the contender; it may be applied to two persons, to a plural and to a feminine, so one says "the two of them are a khaṣm", "they are a khaṣm" and "she is a khaṣm", because in origin it is a maṣdar (verbal noun). A parallel has already come up, namely ضيف in the verse «حديث ضيف ابراهيم المكرمين».
(وَلا تُشْطِطْ): "and do not act unjustly". It is read with ḍamma on the tāʾ, sukūn on the shīn and kasra on the first ṭāʾ, from ashṭaṭa, yushṭiṭu, ishṭāṭan, when one oversteps the limit. Abū ʿUbayda said: "shaṭaṭtu fī l-ḥukm and ashṭaṭtu fīhi" when you act unjustly; so it is among the verbs in which the forms faʿala and afʿala agree.
(سَواءِ الصِّراطِ): the middle of the road, the right course and its highway.
(أَكْفِلْنِيها): "make me her guarantor"; what is meant is "give her to me in possession". In al-Mukhtār: "kafala ʿanhu bi-l-māl li-gharīmihi, and akfalahu l-māl, I made him responsible for it; and kafalahu iyyāhu, with light fā', so he is kāfil, of the pattern naṣara and dakhala; and kaffalahu iyyāhu takfīlan is the same."
(وَعَزَّنِي): "and he overcame me in the dispute", and brought arguments that I am unable to refute. In al-Mukhtār: "ʿazza ʿalayhi: he overcame him, and its pattern is radda. In the proverb «man ʿazza bazza», that is, whoever overcomes plunders. The noun is al-ʿizza, which is strength and mastery. ʿazzahu fī l-khiṭāb and ʿāzzahu mean he overcame him." Majnūn Laylā said:
قطاة عزها شرك فباتت ... تجاذبه وقد علق الجناح
(A sandgrouse caught by a snare spent the night pulling against it, its wing entangled.)
And before it:
كأن القلب ليلة قيل يغدى ... بليلى العامرية أو يراح
(As if the heart, on the night it was said that Laylā of the ʿĀmir tribe would depart in the morning or the evening...)
He likened his heart, when he heard of her departure, to a dove whose wing the snare has seized, in the abundance of its fluttering.
(الْخُلَطاءِ): the partners who have mingled their property; the singular is khalīṭ.
Now, the lexicons have given several meanings for khalīṭ, among them: the one who mixes with, the partner, the people whose affair is one, the spouse, the neighbour and the companion; and a man's khalīṭ is the one who mixes with him, like jalīs, the one who sits with him.

* I'rab:
(وَهَلْ أَتاكَ نَبَأُ الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرابَ) A resumptive discourse, introduced to relate the story of Dāwūd. هل is a particle of interrogation whose meaning is wonder and eagerness to hear what follows, as you say to the one you address: "Do you know what happened today?" and then tell him what happened. أتاك نبأ الخصم: a past verb, a fronted direct object (mafʿūl bihi) and a postponed agent (fāʿil). إذ is an adverbial for an omitted muḍāf, that is, "the report of the disputing of the disputants when they climbed". The wording of al-Zamakhsharī: "If you say: to what is إذ governed in the accusative? I say: it cannot be other than governed by أتاك, or by النبأ, or by something omitted. It is not permissible that it be governed by أتاك, because the coming of the report to the Messenger of Allah can occur only in his own time, not in the time of Dāwūd; nor by النبأ, because the coming of the report took place in the time of Dāwūd, so its coming to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would not be correct; and if you meant by النبأ the story itself, it would not be a governor. So it remains that it is accusative by an omitted word, its implied form being: 'and has the report of the disputants' going to law reached you, when…'. It is also possible that it is governed by الخصم because of the sense of a verb it contains." The clause تسوروا is what the adverbial is annexed to; تسوروا is a past verb and agent, and المحراب is a direct object.
(إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلى داوُدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ) إذ is a badal (substitute) for the first إذ, and the clause دخلوا is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverbial to it. على داود: the two are attached to دخلوا. The فاء is a conjunction; فزع is a past verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; منهم: the two are attached to فزع. (قالُوا لا تَخَفْ خَصْمانِ بَغى بَعْضُنا عَلى بَعْضٍ) The clause is resumptive, introduced as an answer to a question arising from the report of his fright, as if it were said: "So what did they say when they saw the signs of fright imprinted on his face?" So he said: "They said…". لا is prohibitive; تخف is an imperfect verb jussive (majzūm) by لا, and its agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you"; خصمان is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), that is, "we are two disputants"; the clause بغى is an adjective of خصمان; بعضنا is the agent; على بعض: the two are attached to بغى. (فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنا بِالْحَقِّ وَلا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنا إِلى سَواءِ الصِّراطِ) The فاء is the eloquent fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); احكم is an imperative verb with a latent agent; بيننا is an adverbial attached to احكم; بالحق is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or both are attached to احكم as well. ولا تشطط is conjoined to احكم; واهد is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the weak letter, with a latent agent whose implied form is "you"; نا is a direct object; إلى سواء الصراط: the two are attached to اهدنا.
(إِنَّ هذا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ واحِدَةٌ) إن and its noun; أخي is a badal from هذا, or the khabar of إن; له is a fronted khabar; تسع is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the khabar of إن or a second khabar; تسعون is conjoined to تسع; نعجة is a tamyīz (specification); لي is a fronted khabar; نعجة is a postponed mubtadaʾ; واحدة is an adjective. The matter of the metaphorical use of "ewe" will come in the section on rhetoric.
(فَقالَ أَكْفِلْنِيها وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطابِ) The فاء is a conjunction; قال is a past verb; the clause أكفلنيها, made up of the verb, the latent agent and the two objects, is the quoted speech; وعزني is conjoined to فقال; في الخطاب: the two are attached to عزني. (قالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلى نِعاجِهِ) The lām introduces the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of affirmation; ظلمك is a verb with a latent agent, and the كاف is a direct object; بسؤال is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ظلمك; نعجتك is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive), as an annexation of the maṣdar to its object, the agent being omitted, that is, "by his asking you for your ewe"; إلى نعاجه: the two are attached to an omitted word whose implied form is "to add it". (وَإِنَّ كَثِيراً مِنَ الْخُلَطاءِ لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلى بَعْضٍ) The wāw is a conjunction, and it may also be a ḥāl wāw; إن and its noun; من الخلطاء is an adjective of كثيرا; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); يبغي بعضهم: an imperfect verb and agent; على بعض: the two are attached to يبغي. (إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ ما هُمْ) إلا is a particle of exception; الذين is a connected excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause); عملوا is conjoined to آمنوا; الصالحات is a direct object; the wāw is a ḥāl wāw; قليل is a fronted khabar; ما is redundant (zāʾida), for emphasizing the fewness; هم is a postponed mubtadaʾ.
(وَظَنَّ داوُدُ أَنَّما فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ راكِعاً وَأَنابَ) Conjoined to an omitted clause, that is, "the two angels said: the man has given judgement against himself, so he realized". وظن داود: a verb and agent; إنما: the particle kāffa (restraining) and the restrained one (makfūfa), and it together with what follows it takes the place of the two objects of ظن; وفتناه: a past verb, agent and direct object; فاستغفر is conjoined to وظن; ربه is a direct object; وخر is also conjoined, and its agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; راكعا is a ḥāl; وأناب is also conjoined. (فَغَفَرْنا لَهُ ذلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنا لَزُلْفى وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ) Also conjoined; غفرنا is a verb and agent; له: the two are attached to غفرنا; ذلك is a direct object, that is, that sin. And إن: the wāw is a conjunction, and أن is a particle resembling the verb; له is a fronted khabar; عندنا is an adverbial attached to an omitted word, in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl; the lām is the shifted lām; زلفى is the noun of إن; وحسن مآب is conjoined to زلفى.

* Rhetoric:
In the words «إن هذا أخي له تسع وتسعون نعجة ولي نعجة واحدة» the verse contains a kināya (allusion) for the woman, for they used to allude to a woman by the ewe and the sheep, as in the saying of ʿAntara:
يا شاة ما قنص لمن حلت له ... حرمت علي وليتها لم تحرم
(O sheep, what a prey for the one to whom you are lawful! You were made forbidden to me, and would that you had not been forbidden.)
He only meant the wife of his father, whom he loved; and it is said that she was his slave girl, so he made her unlawful for himself. This kināya agrees with the view that the story proceeds as a parable (tamthīl), and we shall give its summary together with the fabricated fanciful story, in order to free minds from the legends that conflict with the purity and integrity of the prophets.
The story as the commentators relate it:
The people of Dāwūd's time used to ask one another to give up a wife if she pleased him, and he would marry her. The like of this has been reported of the Anṣār, who used to support the Muhājirūn in this way. Dāwūd's eye fell on the wife of Ūriyā and she pleased him, so he asked him to prefer him with her in order to marry her; he was too ashamed before him and gave her up, so he married her and she bore him Sulaymān. It was said to him: "With the multitude of your wives, it was not for you to ask a man who has only one wife to give her up, and it would have been better to overcome desire." And it is said: Ūriyā proposed to her, then Dāwūd proposed, and her family inclined to him, so he came under the one who proposes against the proposal of his brother.
As for what is mentioned, that Dāwūd wished for the rank of his forefathers, and it was said to him that they had been tried and had been patient, so he asked to be tried that he might be patient; and it was said to him: "You will be tried on such and such a day," so he was on his guard that day and shut his sanctuary (miḥrāb) upon himself, whereupon Satan appeared to him in the form of a golden dove, and he stretched out his hand to take it for a young son of his; it flew away and he followed it, and saw a beautiful woman who had let down her hair. So he wrote to Ayyūb ibn Ḥūriyā, the commander of the army of al-Balqāʾ, to send Ūriyā and put him forward before the ark. The one placed forward was forbidden to return until Allah granted victory at his hands or he was martyred. He went forward and came through safe, and was ordered to be put forward a second time and a third, and he was killed, and Dāwūd did not grieve over him as one grieves over martyrs, and he married his wife mentioned above. This account is of a kind that it is repugnant to tell even of an ordinary Muslim marked by righteousness, let alone of one of the eminent prophets.
From Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib said: "Whoever tells you the story of Dāwūd as the storytellers relate it, I shall flog him a hundred and sixty lashes, the double of the prescribed punishment for slander."
It is related that a man told this to ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz in the presence of a verifying scholar, who called the report false and said: "If the story is as it is in the Book of Allah, then seeking anything contrary to it is slander; and if it is as you have mentioned, and Allah withheld it as a covering for His Prophet, then it is not fitting for you to disclose what Allah has covered." ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz said: "Hearing these words is dearer to me than everything the sun has risen upon."
Al-Zamakhsharī said: "What the parable that Allah struck indicates is that his story was nothing but his asking the husband of the woman to give her up to him, and no more." Then al-Zamakhsharī drew attention to the fact that the rebuke came by way of parable and allusion, not explicit statement, and that is because allusion calls for reflection and draws attention to the aspect of the error, while avoiding open rebuke and reprimand. He cast it in the form of a parable so that the person would find it ugly in another and thus make it the measure for finding it ugly in himself, while keeping his dignity, as is advised in a father's way of training his son when some objectionable fault comes from him. He said: And it came in the form of a litigation so that he might rule by his own words «لقد ظلمك», and the proof would be established against him conclusively.
And he said: His words «وهل أتاك» came in the form of a question, to draw attention to the fact that this story is a wondrous one, which deserves to spread and not to be hidden from anyone, and also to arouse eagerness to hear it.
And he said about «في الخطاب»: it may be from mukhāṭaba (addressing), and its meaning is "he came to me with a dispute I could not refute"; and it may be from khiṭba (proposal of marriage) on the pattern mufāʿala, that is, "I proposed and he proposed against my proposal and overcame me", the mufāʿala form being because the proposal issued from both of them.
And he said, on the mention of the ewes, that it is a parable, so their going to law was a parable and their speech was also a parable, because it is more eloquent for the reason given earlier, and to draw attention to the fact that this is a matter one is ashamed to state plainly and that is alluded to because of the ugliness of declaring it, and for the sake of covering Dāwūd, peace be upon him. The aspect of the parable in it is that the story of Ūriyā was likened to a man who has one ewe while his partner has ninety-nine, and he wanted to complete a hundred with that ewe. If you say: the way of the parable is used only when khiṭāb is taken as from khiṭāba (speaking); but if it is from khiṭba, what is its aspect? He said: the aspect then is that the ewe is made a metaphor (istiʿāra) for the woman, as they used the sheep as a metaphor for her in the verse: يا شاة ما قنص لمن حلت له ... (the verse). He said: The difference between parable and metaphor is that on the parable, what first came to Dāwūd's understanding, peace be upon him, was that the litigation was as it appeared, a dispute over ewes, which are cattle, and then through the warning he moved to understand that it was a parable of his own condition; whereas on the metaphor, what he understood from the two men was that the litigation concerned women, expressed by ewes as an allusion, and then he sensed that he was the one meant by it.
I say: Some have reported that this story was not from angels and is not a parable, but was from human beings, either two partners in sheep in reality, or one of them was wealthy with many women, free wives and concubines, while the second was poor with only one wife, and he asked him to give her up. Dāwūd was alarmed, fearing that they might be assassins, since they had come in to him outside the time of judging. Dāwūd's sin was only that he believed one of the two against the other and ascribed wrongdoing to him before asking him.
I say: What this speaker meant by his words was only to clear Dāwūd of a sin to which desire for women would have driven him; so he took the verse in its apparent sense and turned the sin into haste in ascribing wrongdoing to the defendant, because what usually drives to that is the flaring of anger, and its offensiveness is lighter than when what drives to it is lust and passion. Perhaps this speaker supports his view of the verse with the words of Allah the Exalted which follow it as an admonition to Dāwūd, peace be upon him: «يا داود إنا جعلناك خليفة في الأرض فاحكم بين الناس بالحق ولا تتبع الهوى». Attention is not given to admonishing him concerning judgements unless what first came from him and became apparent in him was of the kind that had occurred in his judging between people.
The wording of Abū Ḥayyān: "The apparent sense is to keep the word 'ewe' in its real sense, the female of the sheep, and not to use it as an allusion for the woman; there is no necessity calling for that, because that report issued from the angels by way of depicting the case. They gave the example of the story of a man who has one ewe while his partner has ninety-nine, and his companion wanted to complete the water «[Translator's note: the source reads "تتمة الماء", "completing the water"; the context suggests "المائة", the hundred]», so he coveted the ewe of his partner and wanted to take it from him and argued with him over it as one eager to reach his aim argues. This is indicated by his words «وإن كثيرا من الخلطاء». This depiction and parable is more eloquent for the purpose and a clearer indication of what is meant." Until he says: "And what the storytellers related, which contains a belittling of the station of prophethood, we have thrown out, and we are as the poet said:
ونؤثر حكم العقل في كل شبهة ... إذا آثر الاخبار جلاس قصاص
(We prefer the judgement of reason in every doubtful matter, when the companions of storytellers prefer reports.)"

* Lügat:
(الصَّافِناتُ): «صافنة»nın cemidir; o, üç ayağı üzerinde duran ve diğerini, arka veya ön ayaktan, toynağının ucu üzerinde tutan (attır). el-Muhtâr'da şöyle geçer: "Atlardan «الصافن», üç ayağı üzerinde duran ve dördüncüsünü toynağın ucu üzerinde tutandır. «صفن الفرس», «جلس» babındandır. İnsanlardan «الصافن», iki ayağını saf hâline getirendir; cemi «صفون»dur." Zemahşerî'nin ibaresi: "«الصفون» melez atlarda hemen hemen olmaz; ancak halis soylu atlarda olur. Onların «صفون» ve cevdet (soyluluk, hız) ile nitelenmesinin, durarak ve koşarak iki övülen vasfı bir araya getirmek için olduğu da söylenmiştir; yani durdukları zaman duruş yerlerinde sakin ve huzurlu, koştukları zaman da koşularında hızlı ve hafiftirler."
(الْجِيادُ): «جواد»ın cemidir; o da öne geçendir. «جيّد»in cemi olduğu da söylenmiştir. İbn Kuteybe'nin Edebü'l-Kâtib'inde şöyle geçer: "Ata «عتيق», «جواد» ve «كريم» denir; beygire, katıra ve eşeğe «فاره» denir. Yarış atlarının birincisi «السابق»tır; sonra «المصلّي»dir; çünkü başı öndekinin sağrısının (صلا) yanındadır. Sonra üçüncü ve dördüncü, böylece dokuzuncuya kadar (gider); onuncusu «السُّكَيت»tir; şeddeli olarak «السُّكَّيت» da denir. Bundan sonra gelen hesaba katılmaz. «الفسكل», yarışta atların sonuncusu olarak gelendir." Bu, İbn Kuteybe'nin zikrettiğidir. Üçüncüye, ikinciyi takip ettiği için «المتلّي», dördüncüye «التالي», beşinciye «المرتاح», altıncıya «العاطف», yedinciye «المؤمّل», sekizincisine «الحظيّ», dokuzuncuya da «اللطيم» adını vermişlerdir.
(مَسْحاً): «المسح»: kesmek. el-Muhtâr'da: "«مسحه بالسيف»: onu kılıçla kesti." (بِالسُّوقِ): «ساق»ın cemidir. «ساق»ın tuhaf yönlerinden biri, birçok anlamının olmasıdır. Bunların ilki —burada kastedilen de odur— topukla diz arasındaki kısımdır (incik); müennestir; cemi «سوق», «سيقان» ve «أسوق»tur. Ağacın sâkı gövdesidir. Anlamlarından bazıları: «ساق الحمام» ve «ساق الغراب» iki bitkidir; «ساق حرّ» kumrunun erkeğidir. «كشف الأمر عن ساقه» denir, yani iş şiddetlendi ve büyüdü. «قامت الحرب على ساق», yani savaş kızıştı. «ولدت المرأة ثلاثة بنين على ساق واحدة», yani kadın, aralarında kız olmaksızın birbiri ardınca üç oğul doğurdu. Bu madde hakkında söz uzar; okuyucuyu sözlüklere havale ediyoruz.
(رُخاءً): Sarsmayan, yumuşak ve hoş (rüzgâr).
(أَصابَ): İstedi ve kastetti. Keşşâf'ta şöyle geçer: "Esmaî Araplardan şunu hikâye etmiştir: «أصاب الصواب فأخطأ الجواب» (doğruyu kastetti ama cevapta yanıldı). Ru'be'den de şu nakledilir: Lügat ehlinden iki adam bu kelimeyi ona sormak için yanına gitmişler; o da yanlarına çıkmış ve 'أين تصيبان؟' (nereyi kastediyorsunuz?) demiş. Onlar da 'İşte aradığımız buydu' demişler ve dönmüşler. «أصاب الله بك خيرا» da denir." el-Esâs'ta şöyle geçer: "«وأصاب الله تعالى بك خيرا»: (Allah seninle) hayır diledi. «رخاء حيث أصاب»: (dilediği yere yumuşakça)."
(الْأَصْفادِ): Bukağılar. Kâmûs'ta şöyle geçer: "«صفده يصفده», «ضرب» babından: onu bağladı ve sağlamlaştırdı; «أصفده» ve «صفّده» gibi. Harekeli «الصفد»: bağış ve bağ. Lâmsız (صفد) Şam'da bir şehirdir. «كتاب» vezninde (الصِّفاد): esirin kendisiyle bağlandığı kayış veya pranga. «الأصفاد»: prangalar." Bu durumda, «الأصفاد»ı prangalar (القيود) diye tefsir eden Celâl'e reddiye olarak bazı müfessirlerin söylediği sözün bir anlamı yoktur; o müfessir şöyle demiştir: "Prangının ayakta olduğu bilinmektedir; bu tefsir 'ellerini (boyunlarına) toplardı…' sözüyle bağdaşmaz; eğer «الأصفاد»ı bukağılar (الأغلال) diye tefsir etseydi daha açık olurdu." el-Muhtâr'da şöyle geçer: "«صفده»: onu bağladı ve sağlamlaştırdı; «ضرب» babındandır; «صفّده تصفيدا» da böyledir. İki fetha ile «الصَّفَد» ve kesre ile «الصِّفاد», esirin kendisiyle bağlandığı kayış, pranga ve bukağıdır. «الأصفاد» prangalardır; tekili «صفد»dır."

* İ'rab:
(وَوَهَبْنا لِداوُدَ سُلَيْمانَ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; söz, Dâvûd kıssasını açtıktan sonra Süleyman kıssasını açmak için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye bir sözdür. (وهبنا) mâzî fiil ve fâildir; (لداود) câr ve mecrûr (وهبنا)'ya mütealliktir; (سليمان) mef'ûldür. (نعم) medih inşâsı için câmid mâzî fiildir; (العبد) onun fâilidir; medhe mahsus olan (mahsûs bi'l-medh), zikri önce geçtiği için mahzûftur, yani «هو». (إنه أواب): إنّ, ismi ve haberi; cümle medhin ta'lîlidir: Onun övülmüş olmasını, tövbe ile O'na çok dönen (أوّاب) olmasıyla, yahut tesbih eden, tesbihi tekrarlayan ve onu yankılatan olmasıyla ta'lîl etmiştir; çünkü (tesbihi) tekrarlayan her (مؤوّب) «أوّاب»dır. (إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِناتُ الْجِيادُ): إذ: (أواب) için zarf olması, onda âmilin (نعم) olması ve mukadder bir şeyle mansûb olması caizdir; yani «Ey Muhammed, bu kıssanın vuku bulduğu vakti an». (عرض) cümlesi zarfın ona izâfesiyle cer mahallindedir. (عليه) câr ve mecrûr (عرض)'a mütealliktir; (بالعشي) câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir hâle mütealliktir, yani «o vakitte olarak». (الصافنات) nâib-i fâildir; (الجياد) sıfattır. Daha evlâ olanı, (nâib-i fâil olan) mef'ûlün mahzûf olması, yani «الخيل» (atlar) olması ve (الصافنات الجياد)'ın atların iki sıfatı olmasıdır. Zâhir olan, bu arzın onu cezbettiği ve Rabbini razı etmek için düşmanla cihadında bu güzel, endamlı atlara güvenebileceğinin ona öyle geldiğidir; bu da onu bir süre Allah Teâlâ'nın zikrinden alıkoydu; oysa o, zikre çok düşkündü.
(فَقالَ إِنِّي أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّي حَتَّى تَوارَتْ بِالْحِجابِ): Fâ atıf harfidir; (قال) mâzî fiildir, fâili müstetirdir. إنّ ve ismi; (أحببت) cümlesi onun haberidir. (أحببت) asıl anlamı üzere cereyan etmemektedir; ancak «عن» ile müteaddî olan bir fiilin anlamını, yani «آثرت» (tercih ettim) anlamını tazammun etmiştir. (حب الخير) o fiilin mef'ûlün bihidir veya mef'ûl-i mutlaktır; mef'ûlün lieclih olduğu da söylenmiştir. Semîn'in ibaresi: «حب الخير»de birkaç vecih vardır: Birincisi: «آثرت» anlamında olduğu için (أحببت)'in mef'ûlüdür; buna göre «عن», «على» anlamındadır. İkincisi: «حب», zâid harflerin hazfi üzere bir masdardır ve onu nasbeden (أحببت)'tir. Üçüncüsü: «تشتهي» masdarıdır [Mütercim notu: kaynakta böyle yazılıdır; Semîn'de «مصدر تشبيهي» (teşbih masdarı) olmalıdır; açıklaması da buna uygundur.], yani «حبا مثل حب الخير» (hayır sevgisi gibi bir sevgi). Dördüncüsü: (أحببت) «أنبت» (yöneldim/döndüm) anlamını tazammun etmiştir; bu yüzden «عن» ile müteaddî olmuştur. Beşincisi: (أحببت) «لزمت» (sarıldım) anlamındadır. Altıncısı: (أحببت), «أحبّ البعير» (deve yorgunluktan düşüp çöktü) sözündendir; anlam: «Rabbimi zikretmekten oturdum (geri kaldım)»; buna göre (حب الخير) mef'ûlün lieclih olur. (عن ذكر ربي) câr ve mecrûr (أحببت)'e mütealliktir. İzâfet, masdarın mef'ûlüne izâfesi kabîlindendir, yani «Rabbimi zikretmekten»; yahut fâiline izâfesidir, yani «Rabbimin beni zikretmesinden». Bu ayetin bahsinin devamı Belâgat bölümünde gelecektir [Mütercim notu: kaynakta bu girdide Belâgat bölümü yoktur; konu Fevâid bölümünde ele alınmıştır.]. حتى gâye ve cer harfidir; (توارت) mâzî fiildir; fâili takdiri «هي» olan, yani güneşe dönen müstetir zamirdir; atlar olduğu da söylenmiştir. (بالحجاب) câr ve mecrûr (توارت)'a mütealliktir.
(رُدُّوها عَلَيَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحاً بِالسُّوقِ وَالْأَعْناقِ): (ردوها) emir fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir; cümle mahzûf bir sözün mekûlüdür, yani «ردوها dedi». (علي) câr ve mecrûr (ردوها)'ya mütealliktir. (فطفق) mahzûf bir şeye ma'tûftur, yani «onlar da onları geri getirdiler». (طفق) şurû' fiillerinden bir mâzî fiildir; kâne'nin amelini yapar; ismi takdiri «هو» olan müstetir zamirdir. (مسحا) mahzûf bir fiilin mef'ûl-i mutlakıdır, yani «يمسح مسحا»; cümle (طفق)'ın haberidir. (بالسوق) câr ve mecrûr (مسحا)'ya mütealliktir; (الأعناق) (بالسوق)'a ma'tûftur. İmam Fahreddîn Râzî'nin, müfessirlerin cumhuruna muhalefet ettiği, çok ilginç ve itibara layık bir sözü gelecektir; onu Fevâid bölümünde gör.
(وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمانَ وَأَلْقَيْنا عَلى كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَداً ثُمَّ أَنابَ): Vâv isti'nâfiyyedir; lâm kasem için zemin hazırlayan (muvattie) lâmdır; قد tahkîk harfidir; (فتنا) fiil ve fâildir; (سليمان) mef'ûlün bihtir. (ألقينا) (فتنا)'ya ma'tûftur; (على كرسيه) câr ve mecrûr (ألقينا)'ya mütealliktir; (جسدا) mef'ûlün bihtir. (ثم أناب) da ma'tûftur, ancak bir terâhîden sonra. Süleyman'ın fitnesi ve onun tartışılması hakkındaki söz gelecektir. (قالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكاً لا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِي):
(رب) hazfedilmiş mütekellim yâ'sına izâfe edilmiş münâdâdır. (هب) dua için emir fiildir; (لي) câr ve mecrûr ona mütealliktir; (ملكا) mef'ûlün bihtir; (لا ينبغي) cümlesi (ملكا)'nın sıfatıdır; (لأحد) câr ve mecrûr (ينبغي)'ye mütealliktir; (من بعدي) (أحد)'in sıfatıdır.
(إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ): Cümle, mağfiret ve bağış duasının ta'lîlidir. إنّ ve ismi; (أنت) fasıl zamiri veya mübtedâdır; (الوهاب) إنّ'nin veya (أنت)'in haberidir; (ikinci durumda) cümle (إنك)'in haberidir. (فَسَخَّرْنا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخاءً حَيْثُ أَصابَ): Fâ, sözün muhtevasından anlaşılan mahzûf bir şeye atıftır; yani «onun duasını kabul ettik ve bu elinden alınmış hükümranlığı ona geri verdik». (سخرنا) fiil ve fâildir; (له) câr ve mecrûr (سخرنا)'ya mütealliktir; (الريح) mef'ûlün bihtir; (تجري بأمره) cümlesi (الريح)'ten hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir; (رخاء) (تجري)'deki zamirden hâldir. (حيث) zarf (تجري)'ye veya (سخرنا)'ya mütealliktir; (أصاب) cümlesi zarfın ona izâfesiyle cer mahallindedir.
(وَالشَّياطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّاءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ): Vâv atıf harfidir; (الشياطين) (الريح)'e ma'tûftur; (كل بناء) (الشياطين)'den bedeldir; (غواص) (بناء)'ya ma'tûftur.
(وَآخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفادِ): (آخرين) (كل بناء)'ya ma'tûftur; onunla birlikte bedel hükmüne sokulmuştur; bu, bedel-i küll mine'l-küll'dür. (مقرنين) (آخرين)'in sıfatıdır; yani bir kısmı diğeriyle bağlar içinde birbirine bağlanmış. (هذا عَطاؤُنا فَامْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسابٍ): Cümle mahzûf bir sözün mekûlüdür, yani «ona dedik ki». (هذا) mübtedâ, (عطاؤنا) haberdir. (فامنن): Fâ fasîha fâ'sıdır; (امنن) emir fiildir, yani ondan dilediğine ver. أو tahyîr için atıf harfidir; (أمسك) (امنن)'e ma'tûf emir fiildir. (بغير حساب) câr ve mecrûr (عطاؤنا)'ya mütealliktir; yani «sana hesapsız ve ölçüsüz verdik»; bunda bağışın çokluğuna işaret vardır. Yahut (امنن) veya (أمسك)'e mütealliktir. Öncekilerden hâl olarak nasb (mahallinde) mahzûf bir şeye müteallik olması da caizdir; yani «onun üzerine hesaba çekilmeyen biri olarak»; çünkü o, hesap ve sayımdan yücedir. (وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنا لَزُلْفى وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ): Benzerinin i'rabı çok kez geçmiştir.

* Fevâid:
Bu ayetler ve Süleyman'ın atlar ve soylu küheylanlarla fitnesi hakkındaki söz, bu kitabın göğsünün (hacminin) kaldıramayacağı ve sınırları dışında kalan bir şeydir. Ancak biz bu fitneye ve onun hakkında söylenenlere, hevâlarla iş birliği yapan Yahudiliğin uydurduğu, onun etrafında örülmüş yalanlara ve sapkınlıklara işaret etmeye çalışacağız. Buna başlamadan önce, hayal dokusuyla süslenmiş bu kıssalara karışan bütün sapkınlıkları deviren İmam Fahreddîn Râzî'den bir fasıl naklediyoruz. Şöyle dedi:
"Kur'an'ın lafızlarına uygun olan hak tefsir şunu söylememizdir: At beslemek, bizim dinimizde olduğu gibi onların dininde de mendup idi. Sonra Süleyman (a.s.) bir gazveye ihtiyaç duydu; oturdu, atların getirilmesini emretti, onların koşturulmasını emretti ve 'Ben onları dünya için ve nefsin nasibi için sevmiyorum; ancak Allah Teâlâ'nın emri ve dininin güçlendirilmesi için seviyorum' dedi; «عن ذكر ربي» sözüyle kastedilen de budur. Sonra o (a.s.) onların hızla koşturulmasını ve sürülmesini emretti; nihayet perdeyle gizlendiler, yani gözünden kayboldular. Sonra atların kendisine geri getirilmesini emretti; bu da «ردوها علي» sözüdür. Geri döndüklerinde onların inciklerini ve boyunlarını sıvazlamaya başladı. Bu sıvazlamadan maksat birkaç şeydir: Birincisi, düşmanı defetmede en büyük yardımcılardan olmaları sebebiyle onları şereflendirmek. İkincisi, siyaseti ve memleketi idarede, işleri bizzat üstlenecek dereceye vardığını göstermek istemiştir. Üçüncüsü, o atların hâllerini, hastalıklarını ve kusurlarını başkalarından daha iyi bilen biriydi; bu yüzden onlarda hastalığa delâlet eden bir şey olup olmadığını bilmek için onları, inciklerini ve boyunlarını sıvazlıyordu. İşte zikrettiğimiz bu tefsir Kur'an'ın lafzına uyar ve bize o münker ve yasak şeylerden hiçbiri lâzım gelmez. İnsanların bu saçma vecihleri nasıl kabul ettiklerine şaşılır! Eğer 'Cumhur ayeti o vecihlerle tefsir etmiştir; bu hususta ne dersin?' denirse, deriz ki: Bizim burada iki makamımız vardır: Birinci makam: Ayetin lafzının onların zikrettiği o vecihlerden hiçbirine delâlet etmediğini iddia ederiz; hamd olsun, işin zikrettiğimiz gibi olduğu, hiçbir akıllının şüphe etmeyeceği bir açıklıkla ortaya çıkmıştır. İkinci makam ise şöyle denmesidir:
Farz et ki ayetin lafzı ona delâlet etmiyor; ancak bu, insanların zikrettiği bir sözdür; peygamberlerin ismetine dair pek çok delil kâim olmuştur ve bu hikâyelerin sıhhatine hiçbir delil delâlet etmemiştir." [Mütercim notu: alıntının bu son kısmı kaynakta kesik görünmektedir.]
Süleyman'ın yüzüğü efsanesi:
Bununla birlikte, Süleyman'ın fitnesi hakkında yüzük, şeytanlar ve Süleyman'ın evinde puta tapılması hadisesiyle ilgili rivayet edilenleri muhakkik âlimler kabul etmekten kaçınmışlar ve bunun Yahudilerin hayal ürünü olduğunu söylemişlerdir. Efsaneler şöyle rivayet eder: Süleyman'a Sayda haberi ulaştı; bu, adalardan birinde bir şehirdir. Orada şanı yüce, denizle korunan, kimsenin baş edemediği bir kral vardı. Süleyman, rüzgâr onu taşıyarak oraya çıktı; cinden ve insandan askerleriyle oraya kondu, kralını öldürdü ve onun yüzce insanların en güzeli olan bir kızını ele geçirdi. Onu kendisi için seçti; kız Müslüman oldu ve Süleyman onu sevdi. Kız babasına üzüntüsünden gözyaşı dinmeyen biriydi. Süleyman şeytanlara emretti, onlar da ona babasının bir suretini yaptılar. Kız ona babasının elbisesinin benzerini giydirdi; cariyeleriyle birlikte sabah akşam ona gider, cariyeler babasının hayatındaki âdetleri üzere ona secde ederlerdi. Âsaf Süleyman'a bunu haber verdi; o da sureti kırdı ve kadını cezalandırdı. Sonra tek başına bir çöle çıktı; ona kül döşendi, tövbe ederek ve yalvararak onun üzerine oturdu. Emîne denen bir ümmü veledi vardı; taharet için onun yanına girdiğinde yüzüğünü onun yanına koyardı; hükümranlığı da yüzüğündeydi. Bir gün onu onun yanına koydu. Bunun üzerine, Beytü'l-Makdis'in inşasını emrettiğinde Süleyman'a elmasın yerini gösteren Sahr adlı azgın şeytan, Süleyman'ın suretinde ona geldi ve "Ey Emîne, yüzüğüm!" dedi; onu taktı ve Süleyman'ın kürsüsüne oturdu; kuşlar, cinler ve insanlar onun etrafına toplandı. Süleyman yüzüğü istemeye geldiğinde kadın onu tanımadı ve kovdu. Süleyman hatanın kendisine eriştiğini anladı. Evleri dolaşıp avuç açıyordu; "Ben Süleyman'ım" dediğinde üzerine toprak saçıyor ve ona sövüyorlardı. Sonra balıkçılara yöneldi, onlar için balık taşıyordu; ona her gün iki balık veriyorlardı. Evinde putun tapıldığı (gün) sayısınca, kırk sabah bu hâl üzere kaldı. Âsaf ve İsrâiloğullarının büyükleri şeytanın hükmünü yadırgadılar. Âsaf Süleyman'ın kadınlarına sordu; onlar: "Bizden hiçbir kadını hayız kanı içindeyken bile bırakmıyor ve cünüplükten gusletmiyor" dediler. Sonra şeytan uçtu ve yüzüğü denize attı; onu bir balık yuttu. Balık Süleyman'ın eline düştü; o da karnını yardı, bir de baktı ki yüzük orada; onu taktı ve secdeye kapandı; hükümranlığı ona geri döndü. Şeytanlara kendisine Sahr'ı getirmelerini emretti; onu getirdiler. Onu bir kayanın içine soktu, üzerini başka bir kayayla kapattı, sonra onu demir ve kurşunla sağlamlaştırdı, sonra emretti ve o denize atıldı… Şehrazat'ın hayalinin Binbir Gece'de cin hikâyelerinden, şişe (kumkuma) efsanelerinden ve benzerlerinden tasvir ettiklerine benzeyen o efsanenin sonuna kadar. Kâdî İyâz'ın bu hususta söylediği söz ne güzeldir: "Ahbârîlerin naklettiği, şeytanın ona benzemesi, hükümranlığına musallat olması ve ümmeti hakkında zulümle hüküm vererek tasarrufta bulunması sahih değildir."
İslâm âlimlerinin üzerinde bulunduğu görüş şudur: Onun fitnesinin sebebi, Sahîhayn'da Ebû Hüreyre'nin hadisinde bulunan şeydir. Şöyle dedi: Rasûlullah (s.a.v.) buyurdu: "Süleyman: 'Bu gece yetmiş kadını dolaşacağım; her biri Allah Teâlâ yolunda cihad eden bir süvari doğuracak' dedi.
