(تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلى ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ) The clause (تقشعر) is a third adjective; (منه) is attached to (تقشعر); (جلود الذين يخشون ربهم) is the ṣila [Translator's note: this is how the source reads; evidently (جلود) is the agent and the clause (يخشون ربهم) is the ṣila of (الذين)]; (ثم) is a conjunction of delay; (تلين جلودهم) is an imperfect verb and an agent; (قلوبهم) is conjoined to (جلودهم); and (إلى ذكر الله) is attached to (تلين), because it contains the meaning of "become calm and at ease toward the remembrance of Allah".
(ذلِكَ هُدَى اللَّهِ يَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ يَشاءُ) (ذلك) is a mubtadaʾ and (هدى الله) the khabar, or a badal of the demonstrative noun; the clause (يهدي) is either a ḥāl or a khabar; (به) is attached to (يهدي); (من يشاء) is a direct object; and the clause (يشاء) is the ṣila. The reference is to the Book, so the clause is a ḥāl from it. (وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَما لَهُ مِنْ هادٍ) The (واو) is resumptive; (من) is a jussive conditional noun in the position of the accusative as a fronted object of (يضلل); (الله) is the agent; the (فاء) is a linking particle; (ما) is negative or a negative of the Ḥijāzī type; (له) is a khabar, or the fronted khabar of (هاد); (من) is a redundant preposition; and (هاد) is a deferred mubtadaʾ, nominative in position, or the subject of (ما), genitive in form, its sign of genitive being an implied kasra on the letter before the yāʾ which is omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters.

* Rhetoric:
1- In His words «مثاني»:
The singular is described by the plural because the Book is a whole possessing details. Do you not say: the Qur'an is sevenths and fifths, sūras and verses, stories, rulings and repeated admonitions? Its like is your saying: man is bones, veins and nerves. Al-Zamakhsharī allowed another delicate aspect. He said: «It is possible that (مثاني) is not an adjective but is accusative as a tamyīz of (متشابها), as you say "I saw a man good in his qualities", the meaning being "resembling in its repetitions".»
2- The benefit of repetition:
The benefit of doubling and repetition is to establish the speech in the mind, for souls ordinarily grow weary of admonition and warning and tire of advice at first. So in the repetition of counsel and admonition there is accustoming them to find it agreeable and to act upon it. It is established that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to repeat to them what he preached and advised, three times and sometimes seven, to implant it in their souls; and the sharp teacher does not cease to repeat the lessons he gives his students until they become agreeable to them and tender in their souls, after having been hard and repulsive.
3- Living embodiment:
In His words «تقشعر منه جلود الذين يخشون ربهم ثم تلين جلودهم وقلوبهم إلى ذكر الله» there are wonderful rhetorical points, the most important of which is living embodiment. He the Glorified wished to embody the excess of their fear, so He showed you a picture of dry skin and a picture of upright hair. Do we not say: the hair of his head stood up out of fear? [Translator's note: the source reads «شعر رأمنه», evidently for «شعر رأسه من».] As for mentioning the skins alone first and joining them with the hearts second, it is because the mention of fear, whose place is the hearts, necessarily entails mention of the hearts. It is as though it were said: their skins shudder and their hearts fear at the beginning, but when they remember Allah and remember His mercy and its breadth, they exchange the fear for hope in their hearts and the shuddering for softness in their skins. It was also said that the meaning is: since the Qur'an is at the utmost of eloquence and rhetoric, when they saw their inability to rival it, their skins shuddered at it out of reverence for it and wonder at its beauty and eloquence, then their skins and hearts softened toward the remembrance of Allah.

* Vocabulary:
(مُتَشاكِسُونَ): quarrelling, differing. al-Zamakhsharī said: «التشاكس and التشاخس mean disagreement; you say: تشاكست أحواله (his conditions were at odds) and تشاخست أسنانه (his teeth were uneven).» In al-Mukhtār: «رجل شكس (on the pattern of فلس) means a man of difficult character; and قوم شكس (on the pattern of قفل); its verb pattern is سلم. al-Farrāʾ reported شكس with a kasra on the kāf, and that is the regular form. I say: His saying the Exalted "in which are partners متشاكسون" means differing, of difficult characters» «[Translator's note: the source prints «عسرو الأخلاق», «عسرو» appears to be a misprint, probably for «عسرى»; translated as "of difficult characters"]». In al-Ṣiḥāḥ: «رجل شكس, with sukūn, means a man of difficult character, and قوم شكس like رجل صدق and قوم صدق; and شكس with a kasra, from the pattern سلم, means to be difficult in character, noun شكاسة. al-Farrāʾ reported: رجل شكس with a kasra on the kāf, and that is the regular form.»
When shīn and sīn are the first and last radicals of a word, they characteristically convey hardness, refusal and bad character. One says شئس (like فرح) meaning hard, so he is شئس and شأس. الشحس (with fatḥa) is a tree like the ʿatam but taller, from which bows are not made because of its dryness. الشخس is agitation and disagreement, as has preceded. الشرس (with vowels on its letters) is bad character and extreme opposition, like الشراسة; الأشرس is the bold one in fighting, and the lion; and "this is a camel not yet tamed" is هذا جمل لم يشرس. الشس is hard ground as if a single rock. الشطس is cunning and knowledge of it; الشطسي (like جمحيّ) is the formidable, rebellious, shrewd man. الشمس is well known, and nothing is more unyielding than it; and شمس الفرس شموسا وشماسا means the horse refused its back [to the rider], so it is شامس and شموس. الشموس is also wine, because it makes its drinker shamūs. الشموس (with vowels) is looking with the corner of the eye out of arrogance or rage, like التشاوس. This is among the rare features of our noble language.
(سَلَماً): the maṣdar of سلم. It was also read سالما as an active participle, meaning "pure".

* I'rab:
(ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَجُلًا فِيهِ شُرَكاءُ مُتَشاكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَماً لِرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيانِ مَثَلًا) A resumptive statement, brought to illustrate the one who worships many gods and the one who worships one God. ضرب الله is a verb and agent; مثلا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); رجلا is a badal (substitute) for مثلا, and a parallel parsing has already been given. al-Kisāʾī said: رجلا is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "a parable concerning a man". فيه is a fronted khabar, شركاء a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is an adjective of رجلا; متشاكسون is an adjective (naʿt) of شركاء. ورجلا is conjoined to رجلا; سلما is an adjective in the form of a maṣdar, for emphasis; لرجل is attached to the maṣdar. هل is an interrogative particle; يستويان is an imperfect verb with its agent; مثلا is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the agent, i.e. "their likeness is not equal". The specification was put in the singular because it was confined to it in the first instance. It was also read مثلين, to match the states of the two men.
(الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لا يَعْلَمُونَ) الحمد is a mubtadaʾ and لله its khabar; the nominal clause is parenthetical, because His saying «بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون» is a transitional iḍrāb (turning away) connected to His saying «هل يستويان». أكثرهم is a mubtadaʾ and the clause لا يعلمون its khabar.
(إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُمْ مَيِّتُونَ) A resumptive clause, brought to answer them; they had been waiting for his death and thinking it slow in coming, so Allah the Exalted informed [them] that death comes to all of them together, so there is no sense in waiting and impatience, nor any justification for gloating over one who is himself perishing. إنك ميت: inna with its noun and khabar; وإنهم ميتون is conjoined to what precedes. More will be said on this verse in the section on Rhetoric. (ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ) ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; inna with its noun; يوم القيامة is an adverbial attached to يختصمون; عند ربكم is an adverbial attached to an omitted element as a ḥāl. The meaning of الاختصام will come in the section on Benefits. (فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ إِذْ جاءَهُ) The fāʾ is a conjunction; مَنْ is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative, a mubtadaʾ, whose meaning is negation, i.e. "no one"; ممن is attached to أظلم; the clause كذب على الله is the ṣila of مَن; وكذب بالصدق is conjoined to كذب على الله; إذ جاءه is an adverbial attached to كذب بالصدق, i.e. he denied the Qur'an at the time of its coming; the clause جاءه is in the position of the genitive, being the muḍāf ilayhi of the adverb.
(أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوىً لِلْكافِرِينَ) The hamza is for an affirmative interrogative (istifhām taqrīrī); ليس is a defective past verb; في جهنم is its fronted khabar; مثوى is its postponed noun; للكافرين is an adjective of مثوى, or is attached to مثوى itself, because it is a noun of place from ثوى, "to dwell".

* Rhetoric:
1- The art of the proverb (fann al-mathal):
In His saying «ضرب الله مثلا رجلا فيه شركاء» to the end of the verse is the art of the circulated proverb. He likened the state of one who worships various gods to a slave owned jointly by partners among whom bitter dispute and open quarrelling have arisen; they pull him this way and that and take turns using him for their various purposes and conflicting desires, so he stands bewildered, not knowing to which of them to turn, which of them to obey, and which of them is most deserving of his obedience. And [He likened] the state of one who worships one God to one wholly devoted to his service, who meets all his needs and listens attentively to everything he is charged with and asked to do.
2- The difference between mayyit and mayt:
al-Farrāʾ said: «الميّت with shadda is one who has not yet died but will die; and الميْت with sukūn is one from whom the soul has departed.» For that reason it was not given the light form in the verse, because he had not yet died, and they had not yet died, relative to the time of the verse's revelation. al-Zamakhsharī said: «The difference between الميت and المائت is that الميت is a permanent attribute like السيد, while المائت is a newly occurring form: you say "Zayd is māʾit tomorrow", as you say "sāʾid tomorrow", meaning he will die and he will become a leader. And when you say "Zayd is mayyit", it is like saying ḥayy for its opposite, in terms of permanence and fixity. The meaning of «إنك ميت وإنهم ميتون» is that you and they, though alive, are counted among the dead, because what is bound to be is as if it had already happened.»

* Benefits:
This is a short passage whose inclusion is unavoidable concerning the meaning of الاختصام. It is reported on the authority of ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Zubayr that he said: When [the verse] «ثم إنكم يوم القيامة عند ربكم تختصمون» was revealed, al-Zubayr said: "O Messenger of Allah, will we have a dispute, after what there was between us in this world?" He said: "Yes." He said: "Then the matter is indeed severe." al-Tirmidhī recorded it and said: a ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ ḥadīth. Ibn ʿUmar, may Allah be pleased with them both, said: We lived a stretch of time thinking that this verse, «ثم إنكم يوم القيامة عند ربكم تختصمون», was revealed concerning the People of the two Books. We said: "How can we dispute, when our religion is one and our Prophet is one? What is this dispute?" Then on the day of Ṣiffīn, when some of us charged at others with swords, we said: "Yes, this is it."
On the authority of Abū Bakra, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: «When two Muslims confront each other with their swords, the killer and the killed are both in the Fire.» al-Qasṭallānī said in his commentary: that is, each of them strikes the other, when their fighting is without any [valid] interpretation but out of worldly enmity or the seeking of kingship, for example. As for one who fights the rebels or repels an assailant and is killed, no. And if the two are Companions, their matter was based on ijtihād for the reform of the religion. It also indicates that whoever resolves on a sin is sinful even if he does not commit it. In another narration: «When one Muslim [Translator's note: the source reads «جمل أحدهما», evidently for «حمل أحدهما»] raises a weapon against his brother, they are both on the edge of Hell, and if one kills his companion, both enter it.» He said: We said, or it was said: "O Messenger of Allah, this is the killer, but what of the killed?" He said: «He wanted to kill his companion.» Narrated by al-Bukhārī and Muslim. The scholars said: the meaning of their being in the Fire is that they deserve it, but their matter is with Allah the Exalted: if He wills He punishes them and then brings them out of the Fire like the rest of the monotheists, and if He wills He pardons them and does not punish them at all. It is also said that it applies to one who deems that permissible. The majority of the Companions and Successors held that it is obligatory to support the truth and to fight the rebels. The people of the Sunna agreed on the obligation to refrain from criticizing any of the Companions for what occurred among them, even if the one in the right among them is known, because they fought in those wars only out of ijtihād, and Allah the Exalted has pardoned the one who errs in ijtihād; indeed it is established that he receives one reward, and the one who is correct two rewards. These [scholars] applied the threat mentioned in the ḥadīth to one who fights without a sound interpretation, merely seeking kingship.
al-Bazzār recorded in the ḥadīth «The killer and the killed are in the Fire» an addition that makes the meaning clear: «When you fight one another over worldly gain, the killer and the killed are in the Fire.» This is supported by what Muslim recorded in these words: «The world will not pass away until a time comes upon people when the killer does not know why he killed nor the killed why he was killed. It was said: How can that be? He said: Al-harj: the killer and the killed are in the Fire.» This is all that can be said here; the discussion in this chapter is long and is to be pursued in the larger works, since it lies outside the scope of this book.

* İ'rab:
(أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ شُفَعاءَ): (أم) «بل» anlamında atıf harfi; (اتخذوا) mâzî fiil, vâv fâildir, yani Kureyş. (من دون الله) «اتخذوا»nın ikinci mef'ûlü, (شفعاء) «اتخذوا»nın birinci mef'ûlüdür.
(قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كانُوا لا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْئاً وَلا يَعْقِلُونَ): Hemze inkârî istifhâm içindir; girdiği kısım mahzûf olup takdiri «أيشفعون» (şefaat mi edecekler?)dir. Vâv hâl vâvı; (لو) şart harfi; «كان» ve ismi; (لا يملكون) cümlesi haberidir; cümle hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir. Anlam: «Hiçbir şeye malik olmadıkları ve akıl erdirmedikleri hâlde mi şefaat edecekler?» (شيئا) mef'ûlün bih veya mef'ûl-i mutlaktır; bu konudaki söz daha önce geçmişti. (ولا يعقلون) «لا يملكون» üzerine ma'tûftur. «لو»nun cevabı mahzûf olup takdiri «تتخذونهم»dur, yani «Bu vasıfta olsalar bile onları mı (şefaatçi) ediniyorsunuz?»
(قُلْ لِلَّهِ الشَّفاعَةُ جَمِيعاً لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ): (لله) öne alınmış haber, (الشفاعة) sona bırakılmış mübtedâdır; lâm mülk içindir, yani şefaat O'na mahsustur; O'nun temlîki olmadıkça kimse ona malik olamaz. (جميعا) hâldir. (له) öne alınmış haber; (ملك السموات والأرض) sona bırakılmış mübtedâ. (ثم) tertîb ve terâhî için atıf harfi; (إليه) «ترجعون»a müteallik.
(وَإِذا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ): Vâv atıf harfi; (إذا) cevaba müteallik istikbal zarfıdır. (ذكر الله) cümlesi zarfın kendisine izafeti sebebiyle cer mahallindedir; (الله) nâib-i fâil; (وحده) hâldir; Halîl ve Sîbeveyh'e göre ise masdar üzere (mansûbdur). (اشمأزت قلوب الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة) cümlesi «إذا»nın cevabı olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
(وَإِذا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ إِذا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ): Öncekiler üzerine ma'tûftur; (من دونه) «الذين»in sılasıdır. (إذا) fücâiyyedir; biz onun harf olduğu görüşünü benimsedik; dolayısıyla bir âmile ihtiyaç duymaz. Zaman veya mekân zarfı olursa, kendisinden sonrakinin ma'mûlü olur. (هم) mübtedâ; (يستبشرون) cümlesi (haberdir) [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «خبر» kelimesi düşmüştür]; yani kendisinden başkalarının anıldığı vakit sevinirler.
(قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ فاطِرَ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهادَةِ): (اللهم) münâdâdır; şeddeli mîm «يا»ya ıvazdır (karşılıktır); bunun incelemesi daha önce ayrıntılı olarak geçmişti. (فاطر السموات والأرض) muzâf münâdâdır. Başka i'rab vecihleri de vardır; onlar hakkındaki söz Fevâid bölümünde ayrıntılı olarak gelecektir. «عالم الغيب والشهادة» sözü de böyledir.
(أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبادِكَ فِي ما كانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ): (أنت) mübtedâ; (تحكم) cümlesi haber; zarf (بين عبادك) «تحكم»e müteallik; (فيما) da «تحكم»e müteallik. (كانوا) «كان» ve ismi; (يختلفون) cümlesi «كانوا»nın haberi; (فيه) «يختلفون»a müteallik; «كانوا...» cümlesi «ما»nın sılasıdır.

* Fevâid:
1- «اللهم»e dönüş:
Halîl ve Sîbeveyh'in mezhebine göre bu isim sıfatlanmaz; çünkü onlara göre mîm ile birlikte ses (savt) mesabesine gelmiştir, yani kullanımda mütemekkin değildir. Müberred ve Zeccâc ise onun lafız üzere merfû, mahal üzere mansûb bir sıfatla nitelendirilmesinin caiz olduğu görüşüne gitmiş ve «فاطر السموات والأرض»ı onun sıfatı kılmıştır. Ebû Hayyân şöyle der: Sahih olan Sîbeveyh'in mezhebidir; çünkü «اللهم الرحيم ارحمنا» gibi bir kullanım işitilmemiştir; bu âyet ve benzerleri de nidâ ihtimali taşır.
İbn Hişâm şöyle der: «(O) "قل اللهم فاطر السموات والأرض" hakkında onun "يا" takdirinde olduğunu söylemiş ve onu mahal üzere sıfat kılmamıştır; çünkü ona göre Allah Sübhânehû ve Teâlâ'nın ismine nidâ harfine ıvaz olan mîm bitişince, sesler (esvât) benzemiştir; bu yüzden onun na't yapılması caiz olmamıştır.» Yani «هلا» gibi olmuştur; çünkü mîm, ikisi de kendi anlamları üzere kalmakla birlikte, Allah'ın ismine eklenmiş bir ses mesabesindedir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «إذا الميم» yazılıdır; «إذ الميم» olmalıdır.]
2- İstibşâr ve işmi'zâz:
Zemahşerî şöyle der: «İstibşâr, kişinin kalbinin sevinçle dolması, öyle ki bundan dolayı yüzünün derisinin açılıp parlamasıdır. İşmi'zâz ise kederle dolması, öyle ki yüzünün derisinde büzülmenin ortaya çıkmasıdır.»

* I'rab:
(أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ شُفَعاءَ) أم is a conjunction meaning بل ("rather"); اتخذوا is a past verb and the wāw is the agent, i.e. Quraysh; من دون الله is the second direct object of اتخذوا and شفعاء the first direct object of اتخذوا. (قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كانُوا لا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْئاً وَلا يَعْقِلُونَ) The hamza is for a rhetorical denial (istifhām inkārī) and what it governs is omitted, its implied form being "Will they intercede?"; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāl) and لو is conditional; كان with its noun, and the clause لا يملكون is its predicate, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl; the meaning is "Will they intercede while they own nothing and do not reason?" شيئا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and this has been discussed; ولا يعقلون is conjoined to لا يملكون. The apodosis of لو is omitted, its implied form being "you take them", i.e. "even if they are of this description, do you take them?" (قُلْ لِلَّهِ الشَّفاعَةُ جَمِيعاً لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ) لله is a fronted khabar (predicate) and الشفاعة a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for ownership, i.e. it belongs to Him alone, no one owns it except by His granting it; جميعا is a ḥāl; له is a fronted khabar and ملك السموات والأرض a postponed mubtadaʾ; ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; إليه is attached to ترجعون.
(وَإِذا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ) The wāw is a conjunction and إذا is an adverb of the future attached to the apodosis; the clause ذكر الله is in the position of the genitive, being the muḍāf ilayhi of the adverb; الله is the nāʾib fāʾil (deputy agent); وحده is a ḥāl, according to al-Khalīl and Sībawayh it is [accusative] as a maṣdar. The clause اشمأزت قلوب الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to إذا. (وَإِذا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ إِذا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ) Conjoined to what precedes; من دونه is the ṣila of الذين; إذا is the إذا of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and we have taken it to be a particle, so it needs no governing element; if it is an adverb of time or place, it is governed by what follows it; هم is a mubtadaʾ and the clause يستبشرون its khabar [Translator's note: the source omits the word «خبر» here], i.e. they rejoice at the time of mention of those besides Him. (قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ فاطِرَ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهادَةِ) اللهم is a vocative and the doubled mīm is a replacement for يا; this has been discussed in detail before; فاطر السموات والأرض is an annexed vocative; there are other parsings, which will be discussed in detail in the section on Benefits, as will His saying عالم الغيب والشهادة.
(أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبادِكَ فِي ما كانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ) أنت is a mubtadaʾ and the clause تحكم its khabar; the adverbial بين عبادك is attached to تحكم, and فيما is also attached to تحكم; كانوا is kāna with its noun, and the clause يختلفون is the predicate of كانوا; فيه is attached to يختلفون; the clause كانوا etc. is the ṣila of ما.

* Benefits:
1- Returning to «اللهم»:
The position of al-Khalīl and Sībawayh is that this noun is not described by an adjective, because with the mīm it has become for them like an interjection, i.e. not firmly established in usage. al-Mubarrad and al-Zajjāj held that it may be described, with an adjective that is nominative in form and accusative in position, and they made فاطر السموات والأرض an adjective of it. Abū Ḥayyān said: The sound view is that of Sībawayh, because nothing like "اللهم الرحيم ارحمنا" has been heard, and the verse and its like admit of being a vocative.
Ibn Hishām said: «He said regarding «قل اللهم فاطر السموات والأرض» that it is on the assumption of يا, and did not make it an adjective by position, because in his view the name of Allah, Glorified and Exalted, when the mīm that replaces the vocative particle is attached to it, resembles interjections, so it cannot be described», meaning that it has become like هلّا [Translator's note: the source reads «إذا الميم»; «إذ الميم» ("since the mīm") is evidently meant], the mīm being like a sound added to the name of Allah while both retain their meanings.
2- Istibshār and ishmiʾzāz:
al-Zamakhsharī said: «الاستبشار is for his heart to fill with joy until the skin of his face spreads out and brightens; and الاشمئزاز is for it to fill with distress until contraction shows in the surface of his face.»

* I'rab:
(قَدْ قالَهَا الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ) قد is a particle of affirmation; قالها is a past verb with a fronted direct object, and the hāʾ refers back to their saying, namely «إنما أوتيته عن علم» [Translator's note: the verse reads «على علم»; the source has «عن علم»], since it is a "word"; الذين is its agent; من قبلهم is attached to an omitted element which is the ṣila of the relative.
(فَما أَغْنى عَنْهُمْ ما كانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ) The fāʾ is a conjunction; ما is negative; أغنى is a past verb; عنهم is attached to it; ما is the agent of أغنى; the clause كانوا is the ṣila; kāna with its noun, and the clause يكسبون is its khabar. (فَأَصابَهُمْ سَيِّئاتُ ما كَسَبُوا) The fāʾ is a conjunction; أصابهم سيئات is a verb with a fronted direct object and a postponed agent; ما is a relative or a maṣdar particle in the position of the genitive by annexation. (وَالَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْ هؤُلاءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّئاتُ ما كَسَبُوا وَما هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ) The wāw is a conjunction; الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ظلموا is the ṣila; من هؤلاء is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause سيصيبهم سيئات ما كسبوا is the khabar (predicate) of الذين. وما هم: ما is the negative Ḥijāzī mā, هم its noun, the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and معجزين is genitive by the bāʾ in form and accusative in position as the khabar of ما.
(أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ) The hamza is for a rhetorical denial and the wāw is conjoined to an omitted element, its implied form being "Did they say it, and did they not know?"; لم is a particle of negation, reversal and jussive; يعلموا is an imperfect verb jussive by لم, its sign of jussive being the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; أنّ with what is within its scope fills the place of the two objects of يعلموا; inna with its noun, and the clause يبسط الرزق is its khabar; لمن is attached to يبسط; the clause يشاء is the ṣila; ويقدر is conjoined to يبسط.
(إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآياتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ) inna and its fronted khabar; the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات is its postponed noun; لقوم is an adjective of آيات, and the clause يؤمنون is an adjective of قوم.

* İ'rab:
(قُلْ يا عِبادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ): İsrâf edene imkân geniş olduğundan Allah'a yönelmenin (inâbe) istendiğini beyan için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye bir sözdür. (يا عبادي): fethalı mütekellim yâsına muzâf münâdâdır; «يا عبادِ» şeklinde kesre ile de okunmuştur. Mütekellim yâsına muzâf münâdânın hükmü daha önce geçmişti. (الذين): «عبادي»nin sıfatıdır (na't). «أسرفوا» cümlesi sıladır. (على أنفسهم): câr ve mecrûr; «أسرفوا»ya müteallik. (لا): nehiy harfidir. (تقنطوا): «لا» ile meczûm muzâri fiil; vâv fâildir. (من رحمة الله): câr ve mecrûr; «تقنطوا»ya müteallik. «قنط» fiili «تعب» ve «سلم» bâbındandır; bu yüzden muzârisinde nûnun kesreli ve fethalı okunması caizdir ve her ikisiyle de okunmuştur. el-Muhtâr'da şöyle denir: «القنوط: ümitsizlik demektir; bâbı «جلس», «دخل», «طرب» ve «سلم»dir; sıfatı «قنط», «قنوط» ve «قانط»tır.» Şâz olarak damme ile de okunmuştur.
(إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعاً إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ): «إنّ» ve ismi; «يغفر» cümlesi onun haberidir. Cümle, ümitsizlikten nehyin ta'lîlidir; bu yüzden "Bu, Kur'an'daki en ümit verici âyettir" denmiştir. İçindeki belâgat inceliklerinin beyanı ileride gelecektir. (الذنوب): mef'ûlün bihtir. (جميعا): hâldir. Bu, şirkten tevbe ettikten sonradır. «إنّ» ve ismi; (هو): fasıl zamiri veya mübtedâdır. (الغفور الرحيم): «إنّ»nin veya «هو»nun iki haberidir; (ikinci durumda) cümle «إنّ»nin haberi olur. (وَأَنِيبُوا إِلى رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذابُ ثُمَّ لا تُنْصَرُونَ): (وأنيبوا): vâv atıf harfi; «أنيبوا» emir fiil ve fâilidir. (إلى ربكم): câr ve mecrûr; «أنيبوا»ya müteallik. (وأسلموا): bu da atıftır. (له): câr ve mecrûr; «أسلموا»ya müteallik. (من قبل): câr ve mecrûr; mahzûf bir hâle müteallik. «أن» ve ondan sonrası zarfa muzâf olan müevvel masdardır. (يأتيكم): «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiil; kâf öne geçmiş mef'ûlün bih, (العذاب) sona kalmış fâildir. (ثم): terâhî ile tertip bildiren atıf harfidir. (تؤمرون): merfû muzâri fiildir, çünkü «يأتيكم»e atfedilmemiştir. [Mütercim notu: Âyetteki fiil «تُنصرون»dur; kaynakta «تؤمرون» yazılmıştır.] Bunun sırrı belâgat bölümünde gelecektir.
(وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ ما أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ): (واتبعوا): «وأنيبوا»ya ma'tûftur. (أحسن): «اتبعوا»nun mef'ûlün bihidir. (ما): «أحسن»e muzâf (muzâfun ileyh olan) ism-i mevsûldür. «أنزل إليكم» cümlesi sıladır. (من ربكم): câr ve mecrûr; bu da «أنزل»e müteallik. (مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنْتُمْ لا تَشْعُرُونَ): (من قبل): câr ve mecrûr; mahzûf bir hâle müteallik. «أن» ve ondan sonrası izâfetle cer mahallindedir. (بغتة): hâldir. Vâv hâliyyedir. (أنتم): mübtedâ; «لا تشعرون» cümlesi haberdir; cümle hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir.
(أَنْ تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يا حَسْرَتى عَلى ما فَرَّطْتُ فِي جَنْبِ اللَّهِ): «أن» ve ondan sonrası mef'ûlün lieclih olarak nasb mahallindedir. Zemahşerî bunu «كراهة أن تقول» (demesini istememek için) şeklinde takdir etmiş, Ebu'l-Bekâ ise «أنذرناكم مخافة أن تقول» (demesinden korkarak sizi uyardık) şeklinde takdir etmiştir. (نفس): «تقول»un fâilidir; nekre getirilmesinin sırrı belâgat bölümünde gelecektir. (يا): nidâ harfi; (حسرتا): elife dönüşmüş mütekellim yâsına muzâf münâdâdır; aslı «يا حسرتي», yani "Eyvah pişmanlığım!"tır. (على ما فرطت): yani «على تفريطي» (kusur etmeme); «ما» masdariyyedir; müevvel masdar «على» ile mecrûrdur; câr ve mecrûr «حسرتا»ya müteallik. (في جنب الله): câr ve mecrûr; «فرطت»e müteallik. Bu kinâyenin incelenmesi belâgat bölümünde gelecektir.
(وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لَمِنَ السَّاخِرِينَ): Vâv hâl içindir. (إن): ağırdan hafifletilmiş (muhaffefe) «إنْ»dir, yani «والحال أني» (hâlbuki ben…). «كان» ve ismi; lâm fârika lâmıdır; (من الساخرين): «كنت»in haberidir. Cümlenin mahalli hâl olarak nasbdır. (أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هَدانِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ): (أو): atıf harfi; (تقول): «أن تقول»a ma'tûftur. (لو): şart edatı; «أنّ» ve ondan sonrası takdiri «ثبت» olan mahzûf bir fiilin fâilidir. «أنّ» ve ismi; «هداني» cümlesi onun haberidir. Lâm «لو»nun cevabında gelmiştir. «كان» ve ismi; (من المتقين): onun haberidir. Cümle, cezmeden bir şartın cevabı olduğundan i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. [Mütercim notu: «لو» cezmetmeyen şart edatıdır; kaynakta «شرط جازم» denmiştir; yazılı olduğu gibi çevrildi.]
(أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى الْعَذابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ): (أو تقول): öncekine ma'tûftur; fâil, «نفس»e dönen ve takdiri «هي» olan müstetir zamirdir. «أو», nefsin o çetin günde faydası olmayan ve hiçbir fayda doğurmayan bahanelerle söyleyeceklerini çeşitlendirmek (tenvî') içindir. (لو): şart edatı; «أنّ» ve ondan sonrası mahzûf bir fiilin fâilidir. «أنّ» ve öne geçmiş haberi; (كرة): sona kalmış ismidir. (فأكون): Fâ atıf harfidir ve «أكون», «كرة»ye ma'tûftur; bu, fiil takdirinden âri, sırf bir isme atıftır; buna daha önce işaret edilmişti. Ya da fâ sebebiyye fâsı olup «أكون», «لو أن لي كرة» sözünden anlaşılan temenniye cevap olarak gelen sebebiyye fâsından sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir. İki vecih arasındaki fark şudur: Birincisine göre «olmak» (الكون), temenni edilen şeyin bir parçasıdır; ikincisine göre ise «olmak», temenni edilen şeyin gerçekleşmesine terettüp eden bir şeydir, temenni edilen değildir.
(بَلى قَدْ جاءَتْكَ آياتِي فَكَذَّبْتَ بِها وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْكافِرِينَ): (بلى): söyleyenin «لو أن الله هداني» sözünün içerdiği nefyi reddetmek için gelmiş cevap harfidir. (قد): tahkik harfidir. (جاءتك آياتي): fiil, mef'ûlün bih ve fâildir. (فكذبت بها): «جاءتك»e ma'tûftur. (كنت): «كان» ve ismi; (من الكافرين): onun haberidir.

* Belâgat:
1- «قل يا عبادي الذين أسرفوا على أنفسهم لا تقنطوا من رحمة الله إن الله يغفر الذنوب جميعا إنه هو الغفور الرحيم» sözünde bedî' ve beyân ilimlerinden çeşitli sanatlar vardır; bunları şöyle özetliyoruz: 1- Allah Sübhânehû'nun onlara yönelmesi (ikbâl). Bunda, daha önce işledikleri günahların ve kirlerin silinmesi hususunda onlar için son derece itminan vardır; önlerinde, kaçırdıklarını telafi etmek ve yarılanı onarmak için geniş bir vakit bulunduğunu hissettirmek vardır.
2- Onlara nidâ etmesi. Bunda onlara sevgi gösterme ve lütufkâr davranma vardır ki, aralarındaki akıl sahiplerini inâbeye ve tevbe ile dönmeye koşmaya çağırır.
3- Onları kendine izâfe etmesi; bu, onlar için bir şereflendirme izâfesidir. Onlar, kendisine nispet edildikleri kulluk bağına layıktırlar; bu da onların buna aynısıyla karşılık vermelerine ve O'na yaklaşmak için tevbelerini ilan etmelerine yeterlidir.
4- Rahmeti, Allah Teâlâ'nın en hususi ve en yüce ismine izâfe etmesi ve kullarına muamelesinde aslın rahmet olduğunu bildirmesi.
5- «إن الله يغفر الذنوب جميعا» sözünde zâhir ismin kendi lafzıyla tekrar getirilmesi.
6- «من رحمة الله» sözünde, rahmeti az önce geçtiği gibi o kerîm isme tahsis etmek için mütekellimden gâibe iltifat.
7- «إنه هو الغفور الرحيم» cümlesinin «إنّ», fasıl zamiri ve mübalağa ifade eden iki sıfatla te'kîd edilmiş olarak getirilmesi. İşte bunlar tek bir âyette yedi tam sanattır.
2- Îzâh (açıklama):
Bu, «ثم لا تنصرون» sözündedir. Biri şöyle diyebilir: «تنصرون» niçin mansûb olan «أن يأتيكم»e atfedilmedi? Bu müşkilin cevabı şudur: —En iyisini O bilir— inâbe etmemekte ısrar ettikleri ve İslam'dan geri durdukları sürece gelecekte onlara asla yardım etmeyeceğini haber vererek va'dde bulunmayı murat etmiştir. Bu sanatta buna benzeyen bir âyet daha önce Âl-i İmrân suresinde geçmişti.
3- Tenkîr (nekre getirme):
«أن تقول نفس» sözünde «نفس»in nekre getirilmesinin sırrı taklîldir (azlık bildirmek); çünkü bununla bazı nefisler, yani kâfirin nefsi kastedilmiştir; bu, küfürde inat etme vasfıyla diğer nefislerden ayrılmış bir nefistir. Bazen bununla, A'şâ'nın şu sözünde olduğu gibi teksîr (çokluk) de kastedilebilir:
ورب بقيع لو هتفت بجوه ... أتاني كريم ينفض الرأس مغضبا
(Nice ovalar vardır ki, havasında bir seslensem, öfkeyle başını silken bir kerîm bana gelir.)
Tek bir kerîmi değil, pek çok kerîmi kastetmektedir. Bunun benzeri: «Nice beldeyi aştım», «Nice kahramanla vuruştum»; bununla beldeler ve kahramanlar kastedilir.
4- Kinâye:
«على ما فرطت في جنب الله» sözündedir. «الجنب», yan (الجانب) demektir. «Ben falanın cenbindeyim, cânibindeyim, tarafındayım» ve «Falan yumuşak yanlıdır (لين الجنب والجانب)» denir. Sonra «Onun cenbinde / cânibinde kusur etti» demişler ve bununla «onun hakkında» kastetmişlerdir. Cemîl b. Ma'mer şöyle der:
أما تتقين الله في جنب وامق ... له كبد حرى عليك تقطع
غريب مشوق مولع بادكاركم ... وكل غريب الدار بالشوق مولع
(Senin için yanık ciğeri parça parça olan bir âşığın hakkında Allah'tan korkmaz mısın? O, gurbette, özlem dolu, sizi anmaya düşkündür; yurdundan uzak her garip özleme düşkündür.)
Cemîl, sevgilisi Büseyne'nin şefkatini istemekte ve onun yüzünden başına gelenlerden dolayı ona dert yanmaktadır; yani "Bir âşığın cenbinde, yani senin üzerine vacip olan onun hakkı konusunda Allah'tan korkmaz mısın?" Burada «الجنب» bundan kinâyedir. «الوامق», şiddetli seven demektir; kendisini kastediyor. «حرى», hararet ve yanma sahibi demektir. «تقطع»ın aslı «تتقطع»dır. «الادكار»ın aslı «الاذتكار»dır; ifti'âl kalıbının tâsı noktasız dâle dönüştürülmüş ve noktalı zâl ona idğam edilmiştir. Ona tazim için cemi müzekker hitabıyla hitap etmiştir. İkinci beyitte, sözün bedî'inden olan redd'ül-acüz ale's-sadr vardır. Bu kinâyeye «nispet kinâyesi» denir; kinâyenin kısımları hakkında söz daha önce geçmişti. Çünkü sen bir şeyi bir adamın mekânında ve alanında sabit kıldığında, onu onda sabit kılmış olursun. Ziyâd el-A'cem şöyle der:
إن السماحة والمروءة والندى ... في قبة ضربت على ابن الحشرج
(Cömertlik, mürüvvet ve bağış, İbnü'l-Haşrec'in üzerine kurulmuş bir kubbededir.)
Yani onun bu sıfatlara has olduğunu, bunların başkasında bulunmadığını kastediyor; orada ne bir çadır vardır ne de kurulma işi.

* Fevâid:
Fasıl elifi:
Fasıl elifi, cemi vâvından sonra, atıf vâvıyla karışmasından korkularak eklenir; «وأنيبوا إلى ربكم وأسلموا له» ve «كفروا», «وردوا» gibi. Görmüyor musun ki, vâvdan sonra elifi getirmeselerdi ve ardından o vâv kendisinden sonraki söze bitişseydi, okuyucu onu «كفر» ve «ورد» sanırdı. Bu yüzden vâv, fasıl elifiyle kendinden öncekine dahil edildi. Bunu vâvı kendisinden önceki harflerden ayrı yazılan fiillerde, «ساروا» ve «جاءوا» gibi, yapınca [Mütercim notu: kaynakta «فغلوا» yazılmıştır; «فعلوا» olarak anlaşıldı], vâvı kendisinden önceki harflere bitişen fiillerde de, «كانوا» ve «بانوا» gibi, yaptılar ki bu vâvın hükmü her yerde tek bir hüküm olsun.

* I'rab:
(قُلْ يا عِبادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ) A resumptive statement, brought to show that turning back [to Allah] is required, since the latitude for the transgressor is great. يا عبادي is an annexed vocative, annexed to the first-person yāʾ which carries a fatḥa; it was also read «يا عباد» with a kasra; the rule of a vocative annexed to the first-person yāʾ has preceded. الذين is an adjective (naʿt) of عبادي; the clause أسرفوا is the ṣila; على أنفسهم is attached to أسرفوا; لا is prohibitive; تقنطوا is an imperfect verb jussive by لا, and the wāw is the agent; من رحمة الله is attached to تقنطوا. The verb قنط belongs to the pattern تعب and the pattern سلم, so a kasra or a fatḥa is permissible on its nūn in the imperfect, and both have been read. In al-Mukhtār: «القنوط is despair; its verb pattern is جلس, دخل, طرب and سلم; so he is قنط, قنوط and قانط.» It has also been read with a ḍamma, irregularly.
(إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعاً إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ) inna with its noun, and the clause يغفر is its khabar (predicate); the clause is the reason for the prohibition of despair, and therefore it has been said: this is the most hope-giving verse in the Qur'an; the rhetorical artistry it contains will come. الذنوب is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); جميعا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and that is after repentance from polytheism. inna with its noun; هو is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) or a mubtadaʾ; الغفور الرحيم are two khabars of inna or of هو, and the clause is the khabar of inna. (وَأَنِيبُوا إِلى رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذابُ ثُمَّ لا تُنْصَرُونَ) The wāw is a conjunction; أنيبوا is an imperative verb with its agent; إلى ربكم is attached to أنيبوا; وأسلموا is also conjoined; له is attached to أسلموا; من قبل is attached to an omitted element as a ḥāl; أن with what is in its scope is an interpreted maṣdar, annexed to the adverb; يأتيكم is an imperfect verb made accusative by أن, the kāf being a fronted direct object and العذاب a postponed agent; ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; and «تؤمرون» «[Translator's note: the source prints «تؤمرون», but the verse reads «لا تنصرون»; the explanation that follows concerns «تنصرون»]» is an imperfect verb in the nominative because it is not conjoined to يأتيكم, and the secret of that will come in the section on Rhetoric.
(وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ ما أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ) واتبعوا is conjoined to وأنيبوا; أحسن is the direct object of اتبعوا; ما is a relative noun annexed to أحسن; the clause أنزل إليكم is the ṣila; من ربكم is also attached to أنزل. (مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنْتُمْ لا تَشْعُرُونَ) من قبل is attached to an omitted element as a ḥāl; أن with what is in its scope is in the position of the genitive by annexation; بغتة is a ḥāl; the wāw is circumstantial; أنتم is a mubtadaʾ and the clause لا تشعرون its khabar, and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl.
(أَنْ تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يا حَسْرَتى عَلى ما فَرَّطْتُ فِي جَنْبِ اللَّهِ) أن with what is in its scope is in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); al-Zamakhsharī assumed it as "for fear that it says", and Abū l-Baqāʾ assumed «we have warned you for fear that it says» «[Translator's note: the source prints «أنذر ناكم», with a space]»; نفس is the agent of تقول (the secret of its indefiniteness will come in the section on Rhetoric); يا is a vocative particle; حسرتا is an annexed vocative, annexed to the first-person yāʾ which has turned into an alif, its origin being «يا حسرتي», i.e. my regret; على ما فرطت means "for my neglect", so ما is a maṣdar particle and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by على, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to حسرتا; في جنب الله is attached to فرطت. The discussion of this kināya will come in the section on Rhetoric.
(وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لَمِنَ السَّاخِرِينَ) The wāw is circumstantial; إن is the light form of the heavy inna, i.e. "while I was"; kāna with its noun; the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); من الساخرين is the khabar of كنت; the clause is accusative in position as a ḥāl. (أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هَدانِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ) أو is a conjunction; تقول is conjoined to أن تقول; لو is conditional; أنّ with what is in its scope is the agent of an omitted verb, its implied form being ثبت; inna with its noun, and the clause هداني is its khabar; the lām falls in the answer to لو; kāna with its noun, and من المتقين is its khabar; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to a non-jussive condition «[Translator's note: the source says «جواب شرط جازم», "the answer of a jussive condition", although لو is not a jussive conditional particle]».
(أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى الْعَذابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ) أو تقول is conjoined to what precedes; the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "she", referring to نفس; أو is for classification of what the soul says on that hard day, making excuses with what is of no use and yields no benefit; لو is conditional; أنّ with what is in its scope is the agent of an omitted verb; أنّ with its fronted khabar and كرة its postponed noun. فأكون: the fāʾ is a conjunction and أكون is conjoined to كرة, so it is a conjunction onto a pure noun, free of any verbal interpretation, and reference to this has preceded; or the fāʾ is of causation, and أكون is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ of causation that falls as the answer to wishing, understood from His saying «لو أن لي كرة». The difference between the two aspects is that on the first, "being" is part of what is wished for, while on the second, "being" is consequent upon the attainment of what is wished for, and is not itself wished for.
(بَلى قَدْ جاءَتْكَ آياتِي فَكَذَّبْتَ بِها وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْكافِرِينَ) بلى is a particle of reply, coming to refute the negation contained in the speaker's saying «لو أن الله هداني»; قد is a particle of affirmation; جاءتك آياتي is a verb, direct object and agent; فكذبت بها is conjoined to جاءتك; كنت is kāna with its noun, and من الكافرين is its khabar.

* Rhetoric:
1- In His saying: «قل يا عبادي الذين أسرفوا على أنفسهم لا تقنطوا من رحمة الله إن الله يغفر الذنوب جميعا إنه هو الغفور الرحيم» are various arts of the sciences of badīʿ and bayān, which we summarize as follows: 1- His turning towards them, Glorified is He, in which is the utmost reassurance for them, to wipe out their past sins and stains, and the signal that they have ample time ahead to make up for what they neglected and mend what was broken.
2- Calling them, in which is such affection and gentleness toward them as urges those of them with sound reason to hasten to turn back and return in repentance.
3- Annexing them to Himself with an annexation of honor, and that they are fit, through the bond of servanthood by which they are related to Him, Glorified is He; and that suffices for them to respond in kind and to announce repentance in order to draw near to Him through it.
4- Annexing mercy to His most particular and most majestic name, and [showing] that it is the basis of His dealing with His servants.
5- Repeating the overt noun in its own wording in His saying «إن الله يغفر الذنوب جميعا».
6- The iltifāt (shift) from the first person to the third in His saying «من رحمة الله», to specify mercy with the noble Name, as was said above.
7- Presenting the clause «إنه هو الغفور الرحيم» reinforced with inna, with the separating pronoun and with the two attributes that hold intensity. These are seven complete arts in a single verse.
2- Al-Īḍāḥ (clarification):
That is in His saying «ثم لا تنصرون». Someone may ask: why was تنصرون not conjoined to «أن يأتيكم», which is accusative? The answer to this difficulty is that He intended, and He knows best, a promise by informing them that He will never help them in the future so long as they persist in not turning back and hold back from submission. A similar verse has preceded in this art, in Sūrat Āl ʿImrān.
3- Indefiniteness (tankīr):
The secret of the indefiniteness of نفس in His saying «أن تقول نفس» is smallness in number, because what is meant by it is some souls, namely the soul of the disbeliever, which is distinguished from other souls by this trait of obstinacy in disbelief. It may be that abundance was intended by it, as in the saying of al-Aʿshā:
ورب بقيع لو هتفت بجوه ... أتاني كريم ينفض الرأس مغضبا (How many a spacious valley, had I called out in its midst, a noble man would have come to me, shaking his head in anger.)
He means many noble men, not one noble man. Similar is: رب بلد قطعت (many a land have I crossed), ورب بطل قارعت (many a hero have I fought), where he means many lands and many heroes.
4- Kināya (metonymy):
In His saying «على ما فرطت في جنب الله»; الجنب means "side". One says: "I am in the side of so-and-so", his side and his region; and "so-and-so is soft of side and flank"; then they said "he was neglectful in his side" and "in his flank", meaning in his right. Jamīl ibn Maʿmar said:
أما تتقين الله في جنب وامق ... له كبد حرى عليك تقطع (Do you not fear Allah regarding a lover, whose burning liver is being torn apart for you,)
غريب مشوق مولع بادكاركم ... وكل غريب الدار بالشوق مولع (a stranger, yearning, devoted to remembering you; and every stranger far from home is devoted to yearning?)
Jamīl is appealing to his beloved Buthayna and lamenting to her what has befallen him because of her, that is: "Do you not fear Allah regarding a lover" meaning in his due right which is incumbent upon you; so الجنب is a kināya for that. الوامق is the one of intense love, meaning himself; حرى means having heat and burning; تقطع: its origin is تتقطع; الادكار: its origin is الاذتكار, the tāʾ of iftiʿāl having been turned into an unpointed dāl and the pointed dhāl assimilated into it. He addressed her with the masculine plural address as a sign of respect for her; and in the second verse there is radd al-ʿajuz ʿalā l-ṣadr (the return of the end to the beginning), which is among fine speech. This kināya is called kināyat nisba (kināya of attribution), and the divisions of kināya have preceded, because if you establish a matter in the place of a man and his space, you have established it in him. Ziyād al-Aʿjam said:
إن السماحة والمروءة والندى ... في قبة ضربت على ابن الحشرج (Generosity, manliness and bounty are in a tent pitched over Ibn al-Ḥashraj.)
He means that he is singled out with these traits, which are not found in anyone else; there is no tent there and none was pitched at all.

* Benefits:
The alif of separation (alif al-faṣl):
The alif of separation is added after the wāw of the plural, for fear of its being confused with the wāw of conjunction, such as «وأنيبوا إلى ربكم وأسلموا له» and such as كفروا and وردوا. Do you not see that had they not inserted the alif after the wāw, and then it were joined to speech after it, the reader would think it was كفر and ورد, so the wāw was set apart from what follows by the alif of separation. And since they did this in verbs whose wāw is detached from the letters before it, such as ساروا and جاءوا, they did it in verbs whose wāw is joined to the letters before it, such as كانوا and بانوا, so that the rule of this wāw would be one rule in every place. «[Translator's note: the source prints «فغلوا» in "ولما فغلوا ذلك", a typographical slip for «فعلوا»]»

* Vocabulary:
(بمفازة): المفازة is the deadly desert, named by the name of "deliverance" as a good omen. فوّز المسافر means the traveller rode into the mafāza and went on in it. Ḥassān said:
لله درّ رافع أنّى اهتدى ... فوّز من قراقر إلى سوى (To Allah belongs the merit of Rāfiʿ, how was he guided? He crossed the desert from Qarāqir to Suwā.)
فوّز بإبله means he crossed with his camels; فوّز الرجل means the man died, and so found himself in a mafāza, the stretch between this world and the other, the extended barzakh; or because المفازة became a name for the place of destruction, from it فوّز was taken in the sense of "perished". فاز سهمه and خرج له سهم فائز mean the arrow won; فاز بفائزة هنيّة وأجيز بجائزة سنية means he gained a pleasant gain and was given a lofty prize. They also called the snake-bitten man سليم ("sound") as a good omen of his recovery, as they called the caravan of travellers قافلة ("returning") as a good omen of their return.
(مَقالِيدُ): المقاليد is the plural of مقلاد like مفتاح (pl. مفاتيح), or of مقليد like منديل (pl. مناديل), and the speech is of the kināya type. The wording of al-Qāmūs is:
«الإقليد is the ring in the camel's nostril, and the key, like المقلاد and المقلد; and a strip with which the head of the basket is bound; and something made long, such as a thread of brass, hung on the nose-ring and on the ring of the earring, like القلاد and the neck; its plural is أقلاد. ناقة قلداء means a long-necked she-camel. And like سكيت and مصباح: the treasury. ضاقت مقالده ومقاليده means his affairs became constricted for him. And like منبر: the container, the feed-bag, the measure, and a staff with a curve at its head» up to where he says: «والقلادة is what is placed on the neck, and تقلد means he put it on.» Yet al-Zamakhsharī and other scholars of language say that the origin of the word is Persian. He says in al-Kashshāf: «"له مقاليد السموات والأرض" means He is the owner of their affair and their keeper, and this is of the kināya type, because the keeper of treasuries and manager of their affair is the one who holds their keys; of this is their saying "I cast to him the keys (مقاليد) of the kingdom", and these are the keys, and they have no singular from their own wording; it is also said مقلد, and one says إقليد and أقاليد. The word is originally Persian. If you ask: what has the clear Arabic Book to do with Persian? I say: Arabization turned it into Arabic, just as use took out the neglected [word] from being neglected.»

* I'rab:
(وَيَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ تَرَى الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُمْ مُسْوَدَّةٌ) The wāw is resumptive; the adverb is attached to ترى; ترى is an imperfect nominative verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you"; الذين is its direct object; the clause كذبوا على الله is the ṣila; وجوههم is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and مسودة its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun, because the sight is visual. It is also possible that the sight is of the heart, in which case the clause is in the place of the second object of ترى. "Lying against Allah" means ascribing a partner to Him. (أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوىً لِلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ) The hamza is for affirmative interrogation (istifhām taqrīrī); ليس and its fronted khabar; مثوى is its postponed noun; للمتكبرين is an adjective (naʿt) of مثوى, and the clause gives the reason for the blackening of their faces. (وَيُنَجِّي اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفازَتِهِمْ) The wāw is a conjunction; ينجي الله الذين is an imperfect verb, agent and direct object; the clause اتقوا is the ṣila; بمفازتهم is attached to ينجي because it indicates cause: their winning of success is the cause of deliverance. (لا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوءُ وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ) لا is negative; يمسهم السوء is an imperfect verb, direct object and agent; the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negative; هم is a mubtadaʾ and the clause يحزنون its khabar. The clause لا يمسهم السوء has no grammatical position because it explains the mafāza, as if it were said: "What is their mafāza?" and it was said "Evil will not touch them". It is not unlikely to be in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from الذين اتقوا, and al-Zamakhsharī permitted that it be resumptive.
(اللَّهُ خالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ) الله is a mubtadaʾ and خالق كل شيء its khabar; هو is a mubtadaʾ; على كل شيء is attached to وكيل, and وكيل is the khabar of هو, and the clause is resumptive. (لَهُ مَقالِيدُ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ) له is a fronted khabar and مقاليد السموات والأرض a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is also resumptive. (وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآياتِ اللَّهِ أُولئِكَ هُمُ الْخاسِرُونَ) الذين is a mubtadaʾ; the clause كفروا بآيات الله is the ṣila; هم is a mubtadaʾ and الخاسرون its khabar, and the clause is the khabar of الذين; or you may make هم a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no position, as has preceded; the clause is conjoined to «وينجي الله الذين آمنوا», the conjunction of one of two opposites to the other [Translator's note: the verse has «الذين اتقوا»; the author wrote «آمنوا»], and the fact that the conjoined clause is nominal and the clause conjoined to is verbal does not prevent this conjunction. (قُلْ: أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَأْمُرُونِّي أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا الْجاهِلُونَ) The hamza is for rhetorical denial (istifhām inkārī) and the fāʾ is conjoined to an omitted element; غير الله is accusative by أعبد; the clause تأمروني is parenthetical, and the discussion of the omission of the nūn will come; أعبد is an imperfect verb, the original being «تأمرونني أن أعبد», so أن was omitted and أعبد became nominative, as it became nominative in the saying of Ṭarafa:
ألا أيها ذا الزاجري أحضر الوغى ... وأن اشهد اللذات هل أنت مخلدي (O you who rebuke me for attending the battle and for taking part in pleasures, are you going to make me immortal?)
Here is the full text of Abū l-Baqāʾ's i'rab of this verse:
«"أفغير الله": there are several aspects in its i'rab. One: that it is accusative by أعبد, fronted before it. This aspect has been weakened, since the assumed form is «أن أعبد», and that then leads to the fronting of the ṣila before the relative; but this is nothing, because أن is not in the wording, so its operation does not remain; and were we to assume that its rule remains, it would lead to omitting the relative while its ṣila remains, and that is not permitted except in poetic necessity. The second aspect: that it be accusative by تأمروني, with أعبد a substitute for it, the assumption being "Say: do you order me to worship other than Allah, the Mighty and Majestic?"; this is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) and of the type «أمرتك الخير». The third: that غير is accusative by an omitted verb, i.e. "Do you impose on me other than Allah?", which the later [verb] explains. It was also said that أعبد has no position in i'rab; and it was said it is a ḥāl. The practice follows the first two aspects. As for the nūn, it is doubled in the original and was lightened by omitting the second; he has mentioned its parallels.» The nūn of تأمروني is the nūn of the nominative, given a kasra for harmony, and the nūn of protection was omitted because of the meeting of two identical letters. It was read with sukūn on the yāʾ and with fatḥa, so the readings are four and all of them are among the seven. أيها is an indefinite specified vocative, indeclinable on the ḍamma, the hāʾ is for alerting, and الجاهلون is a badal of أيها.
(وَلَقَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ) The lām prepares for an oath (lām muwaṭṭiʾa); قد is a particle of affirmation; أوحي is a passive past verb; إليك takes the place of the deputy agent; it is also said that the deputy agent is omitted, indicated by the course of the speech, i.e. "monotheism was revealed to you"; والى الذين is conjoined to إليك; من قبلك is attached to an omitted element which is the ṣila of the relative. (لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخاسِرِينَ) The lām also prepares for an oath; إن is conditional; أشركت is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the lām falls in the answer to the oath. This oath and its answer are the answer to the first oath, while the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, in line with the saying of Ibn Mālik:
واحذف لدى اجتماع شرط وقسم ... جواب ما أخرت فهو ملتزم (When a condition and an oath meet, omit the answer of the one placed later; that is obligatory.)
ليحبطن is a past verb «[Translator's note: so in the source; the form is actually an imperfect verb]» indeclinable on the fatḥa because of the attachment of the heavy emphatic nūn; عملك is the agent; ولتكونن is conjoined to ليحبطن; the noun of تكونن is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you"; and من الخاسرين is the khabar. (بَلِ اللَّهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَكُنْ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ) A statement conjoined to an implied element indicated by the context, i.e. "so do not associate partners"; الله is accusative by an omitted verb indicated by فاعبد, i.e. "if you are rational, worship Allah"; the fāʾ is the fāʾ faṣīḥa; اعبد is an imperative verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you"; وكن is conjoined to اعبد; the noun of كن is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you"; and من الشاكرين is the khabar of كن.

* Benefits:
Sībawayh devoted a special chapter in his book to this construction, «بل الله فاعبد», and this is its gist: the original is «فاعبد الله»; then they omitted the first verb for brevity. When the fāʾ came first, they disliked beginning with it, since its nature is to stand between the conjoined and that to which it is conjoined; so they fronted the object, and it became medial in wording and indicative that there is an omitted condition which required its presence, so that what follows it be conjoined to it. To this goal in fronting is added the benefit of restriction, as has preceded, from the indication of specification through fronting.
