﴿الْأَرْضُ﴾: onun fâili.
﴿بِنُورِ﴾: câr ve mecrûr; fiile müteallik.
﴿رَبِّها﴾: muzâfun ileyh.
﴿وَوُضِعَ الْكِتابُ﴾: vâv atıf harfidir; meçhul mâzî fiil ve nâib-i fâil. Cümle kendinden öncekine ma'tûftur.
﴿وَجِيءَ﴾: meçhul mâzî fiil.
﴿بِالنَّبِيِّينَ﴾: câr ve mecrûr; fiile müteallik. Cümle kendinden öncekine ma'tûftur.
﴿وَالشُّهَداءِ﴾: «النبيين»e atıf.
﴿وَقُضِيَ﴾: meçhul mâzî fiil; nâib-i fâil müstetirdir.
﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: mekân zarfı; «قضي»ye müteallik.
﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: câr ve mecrûr; fiile müteallik.
﴿وَهُمْ﴾: vâv hâliyyedir; mübtedâdır.
﴿لا﴾: nâfiye.
﴿يُظْلَمُونَ﴾: meçhul muzâri fiil; vâv nâib-i fâildir. Cümle mübtedânın haberidir; isim cümlesi hâldir.
﴿وَوُفِّيَتْ﴾: vâv atıf harfidir; meçhul mâzî fiil.
﴿كُلُّ﴾: nâib-i fâil.
﴿نَفْسٍ﴾: muzâfun ileyh.
﴿ما﴾: mevsûle, mef'ûlün bih.
﴿عَمِلَتْ﴾: mâzî fiil, fâili müstetirdir. Cümle «ما»nın sılasıdır.
﴿وَهُوَ﴾: vâv hâliyyedir; zamir mübtedâdır.
﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾: onun haberi. İsim cümlesi hâldir.
﴿بِما﴾: câr ve mecrûr; «أعلم»e müteallik.
﴿يَفْعَلُونَ﴾: muzâri fiil; vâv fâilidir. Cümle sıladır.

﴿وَسِيقَ﴾: vâv atıf harfidir; meçhul mâzî fiil.
﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: nâib-i fâil. Cümle kendinden öncekine ma'tûftur.
﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: mâzî fiil ve fâili. Cümle sıladır.
﴿إِلى جَهَنَّمَ﴾: câr ve mecrûr; «سيق»e müteallik.
﴿زُمَراً﴾: hâl.
﴿حَتَّى﴾: ibtidâiyye.
﴿إِذا﴾: cezmetmeyen şart ve zarf edatı.
﴿جاؤُها﴾: mâzî fiil, fâili ve mef'ûlü. Cümle izâfetle cer mahallindedir.
﴿فُتِحَتْ﴾: meçhul mâzî fiil. Cümle cezmetmeyen şartın cevabıdır, i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
﴿أَبْوابُها﴾: nâib-i fâil.
﴿وَقالَ﴾: atıf harfi ve mâzî fiil.
﴿لَهُمْ﴾: câr ve mecrûr; fiile müteallik.
﴿خَزَنَتُها﴾: fâil.
﴿أَلَمْ﴾: takrîrî istifhâm harfi; «لم» cezm harfidir.
﴿يَأْتِكُمْ﴾: meczûm muzâri fiil; kâf mef'ûlüdür.
﴿رُسُلٌ﴾: fâil. Cümle mekûlü'l-kavldir.
﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: câr ve mecrûr; «رسل»in mahzûf sıfatına müteallik.
﴿يَتْلُونَ﴾: merfû muzâri fiil; vâv fâilidir. Cümle ikinci sıfattır.
﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: câr ve mecrûr; fiile müteallik.
﴿آياتِ﴾: mef'ûlün bih.
﴿رَبِّكُمْ﴾: muzâfun ileyh. «قال» cümlesi ma'tûftur, i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
﴿وَيُنْذِرُونَكُمْ﴾: vâv atıf harfidir; merfû muzâri fiil; vâv fâili, kâf birinci mef'ûlüdür.
﴿لِقاءَ﴾: ikinci mef'ûlün bih.
﴿يَوْمِكُمْ﴾: muzâfun ileyh.
﴿هذا﴾: «يومكم»ün sıfatı. Cümle kendinden öncekine ma'tûftur.
﴿قالُوا﴾: mâzî fiil ve fâili. Cümle müste'nefedir.
﴿بَلى﴾: cevap harfi.
﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: atıf harfidir; «لكن» mühmel (amel etmeyen) istidrâk harfidir.
﴿حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ﴾: mâzî fiil ve fâili.
﴿الْعَذابِ﴾: muzâfun ileyh.
﴿عَلَى الْكافِرِينَ﴾: câr ve mecrûr; «حقت»e müteallik. Cümle mekûlü'l-kavldir.
﴿قِيلَ﴾: meçhul mâzî fiil.
﴿ادْخُلُوا﴾: emir fiil ve fâili. Cümle ref' mahallinde nâib-i fâildir.
﴿أَبْوابَ﴾: mef'ûlün bih.
﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾: muzâfun ileyh.
﴿خالِدِينَ﴾: yâ ile mansûb hâl.
﴿فِيها﴾: câr ve mecrûr; «خالدين»e müteallik.
﴿فَبِئْسَ﴾: fâ isti'nâf harfidir; zem inşâsı için câmid mâzî fiil.
﴿مَثْوَى﴾: onun fâili.
﴿الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ﴾: muzâfun ileyh. «قيل» cümlesi müste'nefedir.

Allah Teâlâ'nın şu kavli: ﴿إِن فِي صُدُورِهِمْ إِلاَّ كِبْرٌ مَّـا هُم بِبَالِغِيهِ﴾.
Bu, ﴿وَاسْأَلِ القرْيَةَ﴾ kavli gibidir. «[Mütercim notu: Muzâf hazfedilmiştir.]» Mana: "Onlar bu konudaki arzularına ulaşacak değillerdir"; çünkü kibir, zaten yapmış oldukları bir şeydir; dolayısıyla bu bir müşkil teşkil etmez.
Şöyle de denilmiştir: Burada kibir, Hz. Peygamber'e (s.a.v.) üstün gelmektir; bu onların arzusuydu ve ona ulaşamadılar. Birinci (görüş)te ise onların arzusu, Allah Teâlâ'nın âyetleri hakkında onları iptal edinceye kadar mücadele etmekti; buna da ulaşamadılar.
Şöyle de denilmiştir: Bununla ancak "Yahudiler" kastedilmektedir; kibirlendiler, beklemede kaldılar ve "Deccâl çıkıncaya ve biz onunla birlikte oluncaya kadar (bekleriz)" dediler. Allah Teâlâ, Yahudilerden bu fırkanın Deccâl'e yetişemeyeceğini bildirdi. Bu görüşün sahibi, (Allah'ın) ﴿فَاسْتَعِذْ باللهِ﴾ kavlini delil getirdi.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. His saying: {حم}: like His saying {الم} and its kind. The Two Brothers (Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī), Abū Bakr and Ibn Dhakwān read the «حاء» with pure imāla (inclination of the vowel) in the seven sūras [beginning with it]; Warsh and Abū ʿAmr read it with the intermediate imāla; and the rest with fatḥa. The majority read the «ميم» with sukūn like the rest of the disconnected letters. al-Zuhrī read the «ميم» with ḍamma, either as the predicate of an implied subject, or as a subject with what follows as the predicate. Ibn Abī Isḥāq and ʿĪsā read it with fatḥa, which admits two views. One: it is accusative by an implied verb, i.e. "recite «حم»," and it is diptote (denied full declension) because of being a proper name and feminine, or a proper name and resembling a foreign word. That is because there is no pattern fāʿīl in Arabic patterns, unlike foreign ones such as «قابيل» and «هابيل». The second: it is a vowel of indeclinability (ḥarakat bināʾ) for lightness, like «أينَ» and «كيف». The saying of al-Kumayt admits both views:
3908 - وَجَدْنا لكم في آلِ حَمَ آيةً ... تَأَوَّلَها منا تقيٌّ ومُعْرِبُ
(We found for you in Āl Ḥā Mīm a verse; a God-fearing man and an articulate one among us interpreted it.)
and the saying of Shurayḥ ibn Awfā:
3909 - يُذَكِّرُني حمَ والرُّمْحُ شاجِرٌ ... فهلا تلا حمَ قبلَ التقدُّمِ
(He reminds me of Ḥā Mīm while the spears are tangled; why did he not recite Ḥā Mīm before advancing?)
Abū l-Sammāl read it with kasra. Can «حم» be pluralised as «حواميم»? Ibn al-Jawzī transmitted from his teacher al-Jawālīqī that this is an error, and that the correct thing is to say "I recited Āl Ḥā Mīm." In the ḥadīth from Ibn Masʿūd from him, peace be upon him: "When you fall upon Āl Ḥā Mīm you have fallen upon meadows." And al-Kumayt said:
3910 - وَجَدْنا لكم في آلِ حم. . . ... . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
the verse. Some of them permitted it. Ḥadīths were reported on that, among them: "The Ḥawāmīm are the brocade of the Qurʾān"; and: "Whoever wishes to graze in the lovely gardens of Paradise, let him recite the Ḥawāmīm"; and: "The likeness of the Ḥawāmīm in the Qurʾān is the likeness of the striped garments among clothes." If these ḥadīths are authentic, they are the decisive word on this.

His saying: {غَافِرِ الذنب وَقَابِلِ التوب شَدِيدِ العقاب}: There are three views on these attributes. First: that all of them are adjectives of the Majestic Name, like «العزيز العليم». It is permissible to describe a definite noun with these, even though their annexation is a lexical one (iḍāfa lafẓiyya), because it is possible to treat their annexation as semantic (iḍāfa maʿnawiyya) so that they become definite through annexation. Sībawayh stated explicitly that everything whose annexation is not pure may be made pure, and definite nouns may be described with it, except the assimilated adjective (al-ṣifa al-mushabbaha). others did not except anything else, and they are the Kufans. They say of the like of «حَسَنُ الوجهِ» that its annexation may become pure. On this, His saying «شديد العقابِ» belongs to the assimilated adjective, so how did you permit making it an adjective of a definite noun when it does not become definite by annexation?
The answer: either by adopting the school of the Kufans, namely that the annexation of the assimilated adjective may also become pure and so be definite; or by taking «شديد» in the sense of «مُشَدِّد» (one who makes severe), like «أَذِيْن» in the sense of «مُؤَذِّن», so that its annexation becomes pure.
Second: that all of them are badals (substitutes), because their annexation is not pure; al-Zamakhsharī said this. But substitution by a derived noun is very rare, unless the aspect of adjectival function is abandoned in them.
Third: that «غافر» and «قابل» are two adjectives and «شديد» a badal, for the reason given earlier, namely that the assimilated adjective does not become definite by annexation; al-Zajjāj said this. But al-Zamakhsharī said: "Al-Zajjāj's making «شديد العقاب» alone a badal from the attributes has an evident awkwardness. The right way is to say: since this single indefinite was set among these definites, it signals that all of them are badals and not adjectives. An example of that is a poem all of whose tafāʿīl (metrical feet) come as «مستفعلن»: it is judged to be of the rajaz metre; but if a single foot occurs as «مَتَفاعلن», it is of the kāmil metre." The Shaykh (Abū Ḥayyān) disputed with him and said: "There is no awkwardness in that, because proceeding according to the established, sound rules is the original position. And his saying 'it signals that all of them are badals' is a non-Arabic construction, because he made «فقد آذنَتْ» the apodosis of «لَمَّا», and it is not in their speech to say «لَمَّا قام زيدٌ فقد قام عمروٌ». His saying that all of them are badals involves repetition of badals. As for the badal al-badāʾ (substitute of change of mind), for those who affirm it, repetition of badals does occur in it. But as for the badal of the whole for the whole, the part for the whole, and the badal of inclusion, there is no text from any grammarian I know of permitting or prohibiting repetition in them. However, in the words of some of our colleagues is something indicating that a badal is not repeated, namely in the poet's saying:
3911 - فإلى ابنِ أُمِّ أُناسٍ أَرْحَلُ ناقتي ... عمْروٍ فتُبْلِغُ حاجتي أو تُزْحِفُ
مَلِكٍ إذا نَزَلَ الوفودُ ببابِه ... عَرَفُوا موارِدَ مُزْبِدٍ لا يُنْزَفُ
(To the son of Umm Unās I drive my camel, to ʿAmr; she will either bring me to my need or fall short. A king at whose door, when delegations alight, they find the watering places of a foaming source that is never drained.)
He said: «مَلكٍ» is a badal from «عمرو», an indefinite badal from a definite. He said: 'If you ask: why is it not a badal from «ابن أمِّ أناسٍ»? I say: because «عمرو» was already substituted for it, so it cannot be substituted for it a second time, because it has been discarded.'" End of quotation.
The Shaykh said: "This indicates that the badal is not repeated while the badal-from is one, and it indicates that a badal from a badal is permissible." I say: he has discussed this at the end of al-Fātiḥa at His saying {غَيْرِ المغضوب عَلَيْهِم} [al-Fātiḥa: 7], so refer to it. He said: "As for his saying «تفاعيلُها», it is the plural of «تِفْعال», «تَفْعُول», «تُفْعُول» or «تَفْعيل», and none of these is counted among the parts of prosody, for its parts are limited and include none of these patterns. The correct thing was to say: 'all its parts came as «مُستفعلن»'."
al-Zamakhsharī also said: "Someone might say: they are adjectives, and the alif and lām were omitted from «شديد» only to match what precedes and follows it in wording; they have changed much of their speech from its rules for the sake of parallelism, saying «ما يعرف سحادليه مِنْ عبادليه», so they made dual what is single for the sake of what is paired. Moreover, al-Khalīl said, regarding their saying «ما يَحْسُنُ بالرجلِ مثلِك أَنْ يَفْعل ذلك» and «ما يَحْسُن بالرجلِ خيرٍ منك», that it is on the intention of the alif and lām, just as «الجَمَّاء الغفير» is on the intention of dropping the alif and lām. What made that easy is the safety from confusion and the vagueness of the described." The Shaykh said: "There is no necessity for dropping «أل» from «شديد العقاب» and likening it to a rare altered usage, namely making dual the single for the sake of the paired; the Book of Allah should be kept free of that." I say: as for parallelism (izdiwāj), which is assimilation (mushākala), as such it does occur in the Qurʾān, and you have seen several places of it.
al-Zamakhsharī also said: "It may be said that its indefiniteness and vagueness were deliberate, to indicate extreme severity and that there is nothing more dire and bitter than it, to increase the warning. And it may be said: this subtlety is what calls for choosing badal over adjective, if the way of badal is followed." End of quotation. Makkī said: "In «غافر» and «قابل», badal is permissible on the basis that they are indefinite because of referring to the future, and the adjective is permissible on the basis that they are definite because of referring to the past."
Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī said: "There is no dispute about making «غافر» and «قابل» adjectives, and they are so because they convey the meaning of continuity and permanence. «شديدُ العقابِ» likewise conveys that, because His attributes are exalted above coming into being and renewal; its meaning is that He is such that His punishment is severe. This meaning is always attained and is not described as having been attained after not being so."
The Shaykh said: "This is the speech of one who has not stood on the science of grammar and has not looked into it. It would oblige that {حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ} [al-Naml: 6] and {مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرِ} [al-Qamar: 55] be definite because His attributes are exalted above coming into being and renewal and because they are attributes that did not come about after not being; and the definiteness of His attributes with «أل» and their indefiniteness would be the same. A beginner in grammar would not say this, let alone compile in it and venture to interpret the Book of Allah the Exalted." End of quotation.
All these attributes were listed without a conjunction except «قابل التوب». Some said: "It was conjoined only because of their joint occurrence and mutual entailment and the non-separation of either from the other, and «شديد» was cut off from them, not conjoined, because of its being on its own." The Shaykh said: "In this is a Muʿtazilite tendency. The school of the People of the Sunna is that forgiving the sinner is permissible even if he has not repented, except for shirk." I say: how far this is from the Muʿtazilite tendency! Then I say: the mutual entailment is necessary in that, whenever the Exalted accepts repentance, He has forgiven the sin, and that suffices for mutual entailment.
al-Zamakhsharī said: "If you ask: what is the point of the «واو» in His saying «وقابلِ التَّوْبِ»? I say: in it is a great subtlety: it conveys that for the repentant sinner two mercies are combined: that He accepts his repentance and records it as one of the acts of obedience, and that He makes it an eraser of sins, as if he had not sinned; as if He had said: the combiner of forgiveness and acceptance." End of quotation.
After this elegant statement and the bringing out of these fine meanings, the Shaykh said: "How great is this man's bragging and his rhetorical flourish! What he conveyed is that the «واو» is for combining, and this is well known from the surface of the science of grammar." I say: someone recited to me:
3912 - وكم مِنْ عائبٍ قَوْلاً صحيحاً ... وآفَتُه من الفَهْمِ السَّقيمِ
(How many a one faults a sound statement, while his affliction is a sick understanding.)
and another said:
3913 - قد تُنْكِرُ العينُ ضوءَ الشمسِ مِنْ رَمَدٍ ... ويُنكِرُ الفَمُ طَعْمَ الماءِ مِنْ سَقَمِ
(The eye may deny the light of the sun from ophthalmia, and the mouth may deny the taste of water from sickness.)
«التَّوْبُ» may be a singular noun meant as a genus, like «الذَّنْب», or it may be a plural of «تَوْبة», like «تَمْر» and «تَمْرَة». «ذي الطَّوْلِ» is an adjective or a badal as already mentioned. «الطَّوْلُ» is abundance of bounty.
{لاَ إله إِلاَّ هُوَ} may be resumptive, or a ḥāl, and it is an inseparable ḥāl. Abū l-Baqāʾ said: "It may be an adjective." On this, its apparent sense is invalid, since a clause is not an adjective of definite nouns. It is possible that he means it is an adjective of «شديد العقاب», because it did not become definite for him by annexation. The same is said of «إليه المصيرُ» as of the clause before it, and it may be a ḥāl from the clause before it.

Müellifin sözü: {يَوْمَ الأزفة}: Zarfta genişleme olarak mef'ûlün bih olması câizdir; zarf olması da câizdir, bu durumda mef'ûl hazfedilmiştir. «الآزِفَة»: yaklaşan; «أَزِفَ الشيءُ» yani yaklaştı. Nâbiga dedi ki:
3919 - أَزِف التَّرَحُّلُ غيرَ أنَّ رِكابَنا ... لَمَّا تَزَلْ برِحالِنا وكأنْ قَدِ
(Göç yaklaştı; yalnız develerimiz henüz eyerleriyle yerinden oynamadı, ama sanki oynadı.)
Ka'b b. Züheyr dedi ki:
3920 - بان الشبابُ وهذا الشيبُ قد أَزِفا ... ولا أرَى لشبابٍ بائنٍ خلفا
(Gençlik gitti, bu ağarma da yaklaştı; gitmiş gençliğin yerine bir halef görmüyorum.)
Râgıb dedi ki: «"أَزِفَ" ve "أَفِدَ" birbirine yakındır; ancak "أَزِفَ", vaktin darlığı gözetilerek söylenir. "أزِفَ الشُّخوصُ" denir. "الأَزَف": vaktin darlığıdır.» Ben derim ki: Böylece ikisi arasında fark kılmıştır. Nâbiga'nın beyti «أَفِدَ الترحُّلُ» diye de rivayet edilir. «الآزِفَةُ», hazfedilmiş bir şeyin sıfatıdır; takdir: «الساعة الآزِفَةُ» ya da «الطامَّةُ الآزِفة» olabilir.
Müellifin sözü: «إذ القلوبُ»: «يومِ الآزِفةِ»den bedeldir; ya da «أَنْذِرْهُمْ»deki «هم»den bedel-i iştimâldir.
Müellifin sözü: «كاظِمين»: Hâl olarak nasbtır. Sahibi ve onda amel eden konusunda ihtilaf etmişlerdir. Havfî dedi ki: «"القلوبُ" mübtedâdır; "لدى الحناجِر" onun haberidir; "كاظمين" ise içindeki müstetir zamirden hâldir.» Ben derim ki: Kalplerin akıl sahiplerinin çoğulu gibi çoğul yapılmasına bir cevap gerekir: Akıl sahiplerine isnat edilen şey onlara isnat edilince, onların çoğulu gibi çoğul yapılmıştır; {رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِي سَاجِدِينَ} [يوسف: 4], {فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خَاضِعِينَ} [الشعراء: 4] sözleri gibi. İkincisi, «القلوب»dan hâl olmasıdır; bunda geçen soru ve cevap yine geçerlidir. Üçüncüsü, kalplerin sahiplerinden hâl olmasıdır. Zemahşerî dedi ki: «Mânâ itibarıyla kalp sahiplerinden hâldir; çünkü mânâ: Kalpleri, üzerlerine (kederi) yutkunarak, gırtlaklarına dayandığı zaman.» Ben derim ki: Sanki "حناجرهم"deki zamirin yerine "أل"nin ivaz olduğunu kabul etmiş gibidir. Dördüncüsü, «أَنْذِرْهم»deki «هم»den hâl olması ve mukadder hâl olmasıdır; çünkü uyarı anında onlar yutkunmuş değildir.
İbn Atıyye dedi ki: «"كاظِمين", "إذ القلوب"un bedel olduğu şeyden hâldir, ya da kalplerin muzâf olduğu şeyden; çünkü kastedilen: İnsanların kalpleri gırtlaklarına dayandığı zaman. Bu, {تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ الأبصار} [إبراهيم: 42] sözü gibidir; kastedilen: gözlerinin dikildiği.» Ben derim ki: Sözünün zâhiri, bedel olunan şeyden hâl olduğudur.
Müellifin sözü: «إذ القلوبُ» problemlidir; çünkü «يومَ الآزِفَة»den bedel yapılmıştır ve bu hiçbir şekilde sahih değildir. Bununla ikinci vechi kastetmiştir: «أَنْذِرْهُمْ»deki «هم»den bedel-i iştimâl olması; o zaman sahih olur. «الكَظْم» ve «الحناجر» hakkındaki söz Âl-i İmrân ve Ahzâb'da geçmişti.
Müellifin sözü: {وَلاَ شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ}: «يُطاعُ»nin mahalli hakkında lafza göre na't olarak cer ile, mahalle göre na't olarak ref' ile hükmetmek câizdir; çünkü o, zâide «مِنْ» ile mecrûr olana atfedilmiştir.
{وَلاَ شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ} sözü şu bâbdandır:
3921 - على لاحِبٍ لا يُهْتَدى بمَنارِه ... . . .
(Alametleriyle yol bulunmayan açık bir yolda...)
Yani: Şefaatçi yoktur, dolayısıyla itaat de yoktur; ya da şefaatçi vardır ama kendisine itaat edilmez.

Müellifin sözü: {أَوْ أَن}: Kûfeliler «أو أَنْ» diye, ibhâm ifade eden «أو» ile okumuştur; diğerleri, «أَنْ» harfinin hem (dinin) değiştirilmesine hem de fesadın ortaya çıkmasına birlikte hâkim olması sebebiyle nesak «واو»ı ile okumuştur. Nâfi', Ebû Amr ve Hafs «يُظْهِرَ»i yânın zammı ve hâ'nın kesresiyle, «أَظْهر»den okumuştur; fâili Mûsâ'nın (aleyhisselâm) zamiridir, «الفسادَ» mef'ûlün bih olarak mansûbtur. Diğerleri yâ ve hâ'nın fethiyle «ظهر»den okumuştur, «الفسادُ» fâil olarak merfûdur. Zeyd b. Alî «يُظْهَرَ»i meçhul okumuştur, «الفسادُ» fâilin yerine geçtiği için merfûdur. Mücâhid «يَظَّهَّرَ»i zâ ve hâ'nın şeddesiyle okumuştur; aslı «يَتَظَهَّر»dir, «تَظَهَّر»den hâ'nın şeddesiyle; tâ' zâ'ya idğam edilmiştir. «الفسادُ» fâil olarak merfûdur. İbn Kesîr {ذروني أَقْتُلْ موسى} sözündeki yâyı fethetmiş, diğerleri sâkin kılmıştır.

His saying: {أَوْ أَن}: The Kufans read «أو أَنْ» with «أو», which is for vagueness (ibhām), and the others with the conjunctive «واو», because the particle governs both the change [of religion] and the appearance of corruption together. Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr and Ḥafṣ read «يُظْهِرَ» with ḍamma on the yā' and kasra on the hā', from «أظهر», its agent being the pronoun of Mūsā, peace be upon him, with «الفسادَ» in the accusative as direct object. The others read it with fatḥa on the yā' and the hā', from «ظهر», with «الفسادُ» nominative as agent. Zayd ibn ʿAlī read «يُظْهَرَ» in the passive, with «الفسادُ» nominative because it stands in place of the agent. Mujāhid read «يَظَّهَّرَ» with shadda on the ẓāʾ and the hā'; its original is «يَتَظَهَّر», from «تَظَهَّر» with shadda on the hā', so the tā' was assimilated into the ẓāʾ. «الفسادُ» is nominative as agent. Ibn Kathīr opened the yā' of {ذروني أَقْتُلْ موسى}, and the others left it with sukūn.

Müellifin sözü: {عُذْتُ}: Ebû Amr ve iki kardeş (Hamza ve Kisâî) idğam etmişler, zâl'i tâ ile birlikte izhâr da etmişlerdir; «Ve diğerleri yalnızca izhârla okumuştur.» «لا يُؤْمِنُ», «متكبِّر»in sıfatıdır.
[Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «وأظهروا الذال مع التاء، والباقون بالإظهار فقط» ifadesi kendi içinde çelişkili görünüyor ("izhâr ettiler... diğerleri yalnız izhârla"); yazıldığı gibi çevrilmiştir.]

Müellifin sözü: {الذين يُجَادِلُونَ}: Bunda on vecih câizdir. Birincisi, {مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ}dan bedel olmasıdır; «مَنْ»in mânâsı gözetilerek çoğul yapılmıştır. İkincisi, onun için beyân olmasıdır. Üçüncüsü, onun sıfatı olmasıdır; yine «مَنْ»in mânâsı gözetilerek çoğul yapılmıştır. Dördüncüsü, gizli «أعني» ile mansûb olmasıdır. Beşincisi, gizli bir mübtedânın haberi olarak merfû olmasıdır, yani «هم الذين». Altıncısı, mübtedâ olarak merfû olması ve haberinin «يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ» olmasıdır. «كذلك» de gizli bir mübtedânın haberidir, yani «الأمرُ كذلك». «يَطْبَعُ» cümlesinden mübtedâya dönen zamir hazfedilmiştir, yani «على كلِّ قلبِ متكبِّرٍ منهم». Yedincisi, mübtedâ olması ve haberinin «كَبُرَ مَقْتاً» olmasıdır; ancak «كَبُرَ»deki zamirin ona dönmesi için bir muzâfın hazfi şarttır. Takdir: «حالُ الذين يُجادلون كَبُرَ مَقتاً» ve «مَقْتاً» temyîz olur; o fâiliyetten nakledilmiştir, çünkü takdir: «كَبُرَ مَقْتُ حالِهم», yani mücadele edenlerin hâlinin. Sekizincisi, «الذين»in yine mübtedâ olması, ancak muzâf takdir edilmemesi ve «كَبُرَ»nin fâilinin, «ما يُجادِلُ» sözünden anlaşılan mücadelelerine dönen bir zamir olmasıdır. Takdir: «كَبُرَ جِدالُهم مَقْتاً». «مَقْتاً» daha önce geçtiği gibidir, yani «كَبُرَ مَقْتُ جدالِهم». Dokuzuncusu, «الذين»in yine mübtedâ olması ve haberin {بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ} olmasıdır. Bunu Zemahşerî söylemiştir. Şeyh ona itiraz etmiştir: Bunda sözün bir kısmının diğerinden koparılması vardır; çünkü zâhir olan, «بغير سُلْطان»ın «يُجادلون»e müteallik olmasıdır. Onu «الذين»in haberi yapmak da akla yatmaz; zira o câr ve mecrûrdur ve takdir şu olur: «Mücadele edenler, delilsiz bulunanlardır», yani delil olmaksızın (في غير سلطان); çünkü bu durumda «باء» zarfiyyedir ve cesetler hakkında haberdir. Onuncusu, mübtedâ olması ve haberinin hazfedilmiş olmasıdır, yani «مُعانِدون» ve benzeri; bunu Ebü'l-Bekâ söylemiştir.
Müellifin sözü: «كَبُرَ مَقْتاً»: Bununla taaccüb ve büyük görme kastedilmiş olabilir; ya da «بِئس» gibi zem kastedilmiş olabilir. Çünkü taaccüb edilebilecek şeylerden «فَعُل» vezninin ayın zammıyla yapılması câizdir ve «نِعْم» ve «بئس» gibi bütün hükümlerde cereyan eder. Fâilinde altı vecih vardır: Birincisi, «الذين»e muzâf olan hâle dönen zamir olmasıdır; bu daha önce takrir edildi. İkincisi, «يُجادلون»dan anlaşılan mücadelelerine dönen zamir olmasıdır; bu da geçti. Üçüncüsü, «كذلك»deki kâf olmasıdır. Zemahşerî dedi ki: «"كَبُرَ"in fâili "كذلك" sözüdür; yani: Şu mücadele gibisi nefret bakımından büyüdü; "ويَطْبع اللَّهُ" isti'nâfiyye bir sözdür.» Şeyh ona itiraz etmiştir: Bunda sözün koparılması ve sahih olmayan bir mezhebe girmek vardır. Koparma şundandır: Kur'an'da gelen «كذلك نَطْبَعُ» ya da «يَطْبع» yapıları birbirine bağlı olarak gelmiştir, bu da öyledir. Sahih olmayan mezhebe girmesi ise kâfı isim yapmasıdır; oysa kâf ancak zaruretle isim olur, Ahfeş'in aksine.
Dördüncüsü, fâilin hazfedilmiş olmasıdır; Zemahşerî nakletmiştir. Dedi ki: «"كَبُرَ مَقْتاً عند الله جِدالُهم" diyen kimse fâili hazfetmiştir; fâilin hazfi ise sahih değildir.» Ben derim ki: Bunu söyleyen Havfî'dir; ancak onun bununla kastettiği i'rab tefsiri değil, mânâ tefsiridir; bu da benim daha önce söylediğim, fâilin fiilinden anlaşılan mücadelelerine dönen zamir olmasıdır. Havfî aslı, yani zâhir ismi açıkça söylemiştir; kastı ise ona dönen zamirdir.
Beşincisi, fâilin kendisinden sonraya dönen bir zamir, yani temyîz olmasıdır; «نِعْمَ رَجُلاً زيدٌ» ve «بئس غلاماً عمروٌ» gibi. Altıncısı, {مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ} sözündeki «مَنْ»e dönen zamir olmasıdır. «كَبُرَ»deki zamiri onun lafzı gözetilerek müfred döndürmüştür; bu durumda önce {مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ} sözünde «مَنْ»in lafzını gözetmiş, sonra {الذين يُجَادِلُونَ} ve devamında mânâsını, sonra «كَبُر» sözünde tekrar lafzını gözetmiş olur. Bunların hepsi «الذين»i «مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ»in tâbii, yani na't, beyân ya da bedel olarak i'rab ettiğinde geçerlidir.
Bildin ki «كَبُرَ مَقْتاً» cümlesinde iki vecih vardır: Birincisi, mübtedânın haberi yaptığımızda merfû mahallinde olmasıdır. İkincisi, haber yapmazsak mahallinin olmaması, isti'nâfiyye cümle olmasıdır. «عندَ الله» sözü «كَبُرَ»ye mütealliktir. «كذلك» hakkında ise, hazfedilmiş bir mübtedânın haberi ya da fâil olmasının câiz olduğu daha önce geçmişti; ikisi de zayıftır. Üçüncüsü -ki sahih olan budur- «يَطْبَعُ»nin ma'mûlü olmasıdır, yani: Allah'ın mühürlemesi o mühürleme gibi mühürler. «يطبعُ اللَّهُ» sözünde iki vecih vardır; en zâhir olanı isti'nâfiyye olmasıdır. İkincisi, mevsûlün haberi olmasıdır; bunların hepsinin takriri geçmişti.
Müellifin sözü: «قَلْبِ متكبِّرٍ»: Ebû Amr ve İbn Zekvân «قلب»i tenvinle okumuştur; kalbi kibir ve zorbalıkla nitelemişlerdir, çünkü bunlar ondan kaynaklanır; asıl kastedilen bütün kişi olsa da; {فَإِنَّهُ آثِمٌ قَلْبُهُ} [البقرة: 283] sözünde kalbin günahla nitelenmesi gibi. Diğerleri «قلب»i kendisinden sonrakine izâfe etmiştir, yani «على كلِّ قَلْبِ شخصٍ متكبِّرٍ». Zemahşerî birinci kıraatte bir muzâf takdir etmiştir, yani «على كلِّ ذي قلب متكبر»; sıfatı kalp sahibine yapar. Şeyh dedi ki: «Hazfı kabul etmeye çağıran bir zaruret yoktur.» Ben derim ki: Aksine bunun için bir zaruret vardır: İki kıraatin uyumu. Böylece iki kıraatte de sıfatlanan tek, yani kalp sahibi olur; takdir edilmezse birinde sıfatlanan kalp, diğerinde sahibi olur.

His saying: {الذين يُجَادِلُونَ}: Ten views are possible. One: it is a badal from His saying {مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ}, pluralised in consideration of the meaning of «مَنْ». Two: it is an explication of it. Three: it is an adjective of it, also pluralised according to the meaning of «مَنْ». Four: it is accusative by an implied "I mean". Five: it is nominative as the khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. "they are those who". Six: it is nominative as a mubtadaʾ, with «يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ» as its khabar, and «كذلك» the khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ too, i.e. "the matter is thus", and the pronoun returning from the clause «يَطْبَعُ» to the mubtadaʾ is omitted, i.e. "on every arrogant heart of theirs". Seven: it is a mubtadaʾ and the khabar is «كَبُرَ مَقْتاً», but a muḍāf must be omitted so that the pronoun in «كَبُرَ» returns to it. The implied form is: "the state of those who dispute is great in detestation," with «مَقْتاً» a tamyīz transferred from agency, the implied form being "the detestation of their state, i.e. the state of the disputers, has become great." Eight: «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ also, but no muḍāf is implied, and the agent of «كَبُرَ» is a pronoun returning to their dispute, understood from His saying «ما يُجادِلُ». The implied form is: "their dispute has become great in detestation," and «مَقْتاً» as before, i.e. "the detestation of their dispute has become great." Nine: «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ also, and the khabar is {بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ}. al-Zamakhsharī said this. The Shaykh rejected it: it dissociates the speech from itself, because the apparent view is that «بغير سُلْطان» is attached to «يُجادلون», and it cannot be conceived as a khabar for «الذين» because it is a preposition-and-genitive, so the implied form would be "those who dispute are or abide in the absence of authority," i.e. "in the absence of authority," since the «باء» would then be locative, a predicate about bodies. Ten: it is a mubtadaʾ and its khabar is omitted, i.e. "obstinate" or the like; Abū l-Baqāʾ said this.
His saying: «كَبُرَ مَقْتاً» may be meant as wonder and exaggeration, or as censure, like «بِئْس». That is because the pattern faʿula with ḍamma on the ʿayn may be built from what may be wondered at, and runs in the course of «نِعْم» and «بئس» in all rulings. As to its agent, six views. First: it is a pronoun returning to the state, muḍāf to «الذين», as explained earlier. Second: it is a pronoun returning to their dispute, understood from «يُجادلون», as also explained. Third: it is the «كاف» in «كذلك». al-Zamakhsharī said: "The agent of «كَبُرَ» is His saying «كذلك», i.e. 'the like of that dispute has become great in detestation', and «ويَطْبع اللَّهُ» is a resumptive speech." The Shaykh rejected it: it dissociates the speech and adopts an unsound school. As for the dissociation, what appears in the Qurʾān as «كذلك نَطْبَعُ» or «يَطْبع» occurs only linked to one another, so likewise this. As for adopting an unsound school, he made the «كاف» a noun, and it is a noun only in necessity, contrary to al-Akhfash.
Fourth: the agent is omitted; al-Zamakhsharī transmitted it. He said: "Whoever said «كَبُرَ مَقْتاً عند الله جِدالُهم» has omitted the agent, and the agent cannot be omitted." I say: the one who said that is al-Ḥawfī, but he did not mean thereby to explain the iʿrāb; he meant to explain the meaning, which is the meaning of what I said before, that the agent is a pronoun returning to their dispute understood from its verb. al-Ḥawfī stated the original, which is the overt noun, and what he meant is a pronoun returning to it.
Fifth: the agent is a pronoun returning to what follows it, the tamyīz, like «نِعْمَ رَجُلاً زيدٌ» and «بئس غلاماً عمروٌ». Sixth: it is a pronoun returning to «مَنْ» in His saying {مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ}. He returned the pronoun of «كَبُرَ» in the singular by the wording of it; then he has observed the wording of «مَنْ» first in {مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ}, then its meaning second in His saying {الذين يُجَادِلُونَ} to the end, then its wording third in His saying «كَبُر». All this if you parse «الذين» as following «مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ» as an adjective, explication or badal.
You know that the clause «كَبُرَ مَقْتاً» has two views. One: nominative, if we make it a khabar of a mubtadaʾ. Second: it has no position, if you do not make it a khabar but a resumptive clause. His saying «عندَ الله» is attached to «كَبُرَ»; and likewise «كذلك»: it was mentioned that it may be a khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, or an agent, and both are weak. Third, and it is the sound one: it (i.e. «كذلك») is governed by «يَطْبَعُ», i.e. "like that sealing, Allah seals." As for «يطبعُ اللَّهُ», two views, the clearer being that it is resumptive; the second, that it is the khabar of the relative, as all this was explained earlier.
His saying: «قَلْبِ متكبِّرٍ»: Abū ʿAmr and Ibn Dhakwān read «قلب» with tanwīn, describing the heart with arrogance and tyranny, because both arise from it, even if the whole [person] is meant, as it is described with sin in His saying {فَإِنَّهُ آثِمٌ قَلْبُهُ} [al-Baqara: 283]. The others read «قلب» annexed to what follows, i.e. "on every heart of an arrogant person." al-Zamakhsharī implied a muḍāf in the first reading, i.e. "on every possessor of an arrogant heart", making the attribute belong to the owner of the heart. The Shaykh said: "There is no necessity calling for believing in the omission." I say: rather there is a necessity for it, namely the agreement of the two readings, since the described then becomes the same in both readings, the owner of the heart; unlike not implying it, in which the described in one is the heart and in the other its owner.

Onun sözü: {فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ}: Ebû Rezîn ve A'meş, vâvdan önceki dammeden kaçınmak için «صِوَرَكم»i sâd'ın kesresiyle okumuştur. Bir grup ise sâd'ı ötre, vâvı sükûnlu okumuş ben onu «صورة»nın cins ismi saydım; «بُسْر» ve «بُسْرَة» gibi.

* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction in the five places. (من) relative noun in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the mubtadaʾ (الذين). (حوله) adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted element, the ṣila of من. (بحمد) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of يسبّحون. (به) attached to (يؤمنون). (للذين) attached to (يستغفرون). (ربّنا) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative. (رحمة) tamyīz (specification) transposed from the agent. (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition. (للذين) attached to (اغفر). (عذاب) second direct object, accusative.
Clause: «الذين يحملون ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «يحملون ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (الذين).

* Rhetoric:
Al-isjāl after al-mughālaṭa (the registering after the sophistical move): in His saying, the Exalted: «رَبَّنا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدْتَهُمْ».
This is an elegant art among the arts of rhetoric, called "al-isjāl after al-mughālaṭa": the speaker intends an aim concerning someone praised, and so brings words that establish that he has reached that aim, as a registration (isjāl) of it for the one praised. The explanation is that he stipulates a condition whose occurrence necessitates the occurrence of that aim, then reports its occurrence by way of sophistry (mughālaṭa); and sometimes the isjāl occurs without mughālaṭa. This is the type that occurs in the Noble Book.

* Benefits:
- The bearers of the Throne:
It was said: they are four of the angels, among the noblest and most excellent of the angels because of their nearness to Allah the Mighty and Majestic. It is reported in the ḥadīth that they have no speech other than glorification (tasbīḥ), praise (taḥmīd) and exaltation (tamjīd); the distance from their hooves to their knees is like that from one heaven to another. Ibn ʿAbbās said:
«جملة العرش» [Translator's note: so in the source; «حملة العرش», "the bearers of the Throne", is evidently meant]: the distance from the ankle of one of them to the sole of his feet is a journey of five hundred years.
Jābir narrated from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: "I have been permitted to speak of one of the angels of Allah the Mighty and Majestic, of the bearers of the Throne: the distance between the lobe of his ear and his shoulder is a journey of seven hundred years."
Narrated by Abū Dāwūd.

* Rhetoric:
Al-majāz al-mursal (unrestricted figurative usage): in His saying, the Exalted: «رَبَّنا أَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ».
Because what is meant by the two deaths is: first, their creation as dead, and second, their being put to death at the end of their appointed terms.
And what is meant by the two lives is: the first giving of life, and the giving of life at the resurrection. He, glory be to Him, made this clear in His saying: «وَكُنْتُمْ أَمْواتاً فَأَحْياكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ». So in calling their creation as dead a "causing to die" there is figurative usage, because it is with regard to what they had been. Al-Zamakhsharī made this clear in the most eloquent way in his delightful passage on this subject, which we quote verbatim for its worth. He said: "If you say: how is it correct to call their creation as dead a causing to die? I say: as it is correct for you to say: Glory be to Him who made small the size of the gnat and made large the size of the elephant; and your saying to the well-digger: narrow the mouth of the «الركبة» [Translator's note: so in the source; «الركيّة», "the well", is evidently meant] and widen its bottom; and there is no transfer here from small to large, nor the reverse, nor from narrowness to width, nor the reverse; he only intended bringing into being with those attributes. The reason for its correctness is that largeness and smallness are both possible for one and the same made thing, without either being favoured. Likewise narrowness and width. So when the maker chooses one of the two possibilities, while being equally able to do either, he has turned the made thing away from the other «الآخذ» [Translator's note: so in the source; «الآخر», "the other", is evidently meant] possibility, and his turning it away from it is made like moving it from it."

* Rhetoric:
Al-majāz al-mursal: in His saying, the Exalted: «وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّماءِ رِزْقاً».
That is, rain; and provision is caused by rain, so the relation in this majāz is causal (musabbabiyya).
- And in His saying, the Exalted: «يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ».
What is meant by الروح is revelation; revelation was called "spirit" because it runs through hearts as spirits run through bodies. So it is a majāz mursal whose relation is causality, and al-Zamakhsharī made it an explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya).

* Benefits:
- The difference between the assimilated adjective and the active participle:
In this verse occurs His saying, the Exalted: «رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجاتِ», and (رفيع) is an assimilated adjective. Perhaps by clarifying the difference between the assimilated adjective and the active participle we can see the meaning of each:
1- The active participle is formed from both transitive and intransitive verbs, such as ضارب, قائم, مستخرج and مستكبر.
The assimilated adjective is formed only from intransitive verbs, such as حسن and جميل.
2- The active participle can be for the three times, while the assimilated adjective is only for the present, that is, the past connected to the present time.
3- The accusative object of the active participle may be fronted before it, as in "زيد عمرا ضارب", whereas "زيد وجهه حسن" is not permitted.
4- Its object (maʿmūl) may be a connected one (sababī) or a foreign one, as in "زيد ضارب غلامه وعمرا"; the maʿmūl of the assimilated adjective is only a connected one; you say "زيد حسن وجهه" or (الوجه). And "زيد حسن عمرا" is excluded.
5- It does not differ from its verb in operation, whereas the assimilated adjective does differ: it governs the accusative although its verb is intransitive; you say "زيد حسن وجهه", and "زيد حسن وجهه" with the accusative is excluded.
[Translator's note: the source text as written gives the same example for the permitted and the excluded form, apparently distinguished only by vowelling lost in transmission.]
6- It may be omitted while its object remains, and for this reason they permitted "أنا زيدا ضاربه" and "هذا ضارب زيد وعمرا", with زيد in the genitive and عمر in the accusative, by implying a verb or a tanwīn-bearing adjective.
But "مررت برجل حسن الوجه والفعل", with الوجه in the genitive and الفعل in the accusative, is not permitted.
7- It may be separated from its nominative and its accusative, as in "زيد ضارب في الدار أبوه عمرا", and according to the majority "زيد حسن في الحرب وجهه" is excluded, whether you put it in the nominative or the accusative-

(من) conditional noun that jazms, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a fronted direct object, and (يضلل) is vowelled with kasra because two sākin letters meet. (الفاء) connecting the apodosis. (ما له من هاد) like ما لكم من عاصم, and the sign of the genitive in (هاد) is the implied kasra on the omitted (yāʾ), so it is a defective noun.
And the clause: «تولّون ... » in the position of the genitive; muḍāf ilayhi..
And the clause: «ما لكم من الله من عاصم» in the position of the accusative; ḥāl from the agent of تولّون.
And the clause: «يضلل الله ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause that is the response to the vocative «[Note: and that is the clause إنّي أخاف عليكم يوم التناد.]».
And the clause: «ما له من هاد» in the position of the jussive; apodosis of the condition accompanied by the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(29) الرشاد: a samāʿī maṣdar of the triliteral رشد of the bāb of نصر; its wazn is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and there is another maṣdar of the verb, رشد, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(32) التناد: its origin is التنادي, maṣdar of the quinary تنادى; the letter before the last should by rule have ḍamma, but it took kasra to suit the (yāʾ).. It contains an ʿilāl by substitution first, because the alif in it originates from a (wāw), from al-nadwa, which is the meeting place where those present call to one another; and an ʿilāl by deletion second, to suit the verse endings; its wazn is التفاع.

* Rhetoric:
Al-kalām al-munṣif (the fair-minded speech): in His saying, the Exalted: «أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَنْ يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ».
This believing man drew them on gradually by citing in witness to the truthfulness of Moses, peace be upon him, that he had come from the One to whom lordship is ascribed, with several clear proofs and not a single one, and he brought them as definite, to soften their obstinacy and break their vehemence. Then he took them in argument by way of division (taqsīm), saying: he must be either truthful or lying; if he is lying, the harm of his lie falls back upon him; or if he is truthful, you are targeted to be afflicted with some of what he promises you. He mentioned only "some" even on the assumption that he is a truthful prophet, and a prophet is truthful in all he promises, because he took with them the path of sincere advice and gentle handling.

* I'rab:
(كلّ) is a mubtadaʾ, nominative [Note: it indicates generality, and it is in the intention of annexation (iḍāfa), i.e. "every group of us", the tanwīn in it being a compensation for this omitted element ...]. (فيها) is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ كلّ. (قد) is a particle of confirmation. (بين) is an adverb, accusative, attached to (حكم).
The clause «قال الذين ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «استكبروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause «إنّا كلّ فيها ... » is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «كلّ فيها ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of inna.
And the clause «إنّ الله قد حكم ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
And the clause «قد حكم ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of inna.

* Benefits:
- A question and a disagreement:
A disagreement arose among the grammarians over the i'rab of (كلا) in the reading of the one who read (إنا كلّا فيها), although the well-known reading is the nominative. As for the nominative reading, there is no difficulty in it; al-Akhfash said: كلّ is nominative as a mubtadaʾ. Al-Kisāʾī and al-Farrāʾ allowed (إنا كلا فيها) with the accusative, as an adjective (naʿt) and emphasis (tawkīd) of the pronoun in (إنا). Ibn al-Samayqaʿ and ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar also read it so. The Kufans call tawkīd a naʿt. Sībawayh forbade that, saying: because كلّا is neither described nor used to describe, and a badal (substitute) is not permissible in it, since the one who speaks of himself has nothing else substituted for him. Al-Mubarrad said the same in meaning, saying: it is not permissible to substitute for the pronoun here because it is an addressee (mukhāṭab), and a substitute is not made for the addressee or for the addressee [Translator's note: the source repeats "المخاطب" (addressee) twice; the second is probably meant to be "المتكلّم" (speaker)], because they are not ambiguous so that a substitute should be made for them.
Al-Farrāʾ and al-Zamakhsharī allowed that «كل», used as emphasis, be cut off from annexation in wording, holding to the reading of some of them (إنا كلا فيها). Ibn Mālik analysed it as كلا being a ḥāl from the pronoun of the adverbial phrase, and there is weakness in this on two counts: the placing of the ḥāl before its governor, the adverbial phrase, and the cutting off of «كل» from annexation in wording and in implication so that it becomes indefinite and thus can be a ḥāl. The better course is to take «كلا» as a badal (substitute) for the ism of inna; the substitution of an overt noun for the pronoun of a present person [Translator's note: i.e. first or second person] is permitted, as a badal of the whole (badal kull), because it conveys comprehensiveness, as in: «قمت ثلاثتكم» ("you three, all of you, I stood"); and a badal of the whole needs no pronoun. And «كل» may directly follow governors when it is not attached to a pronoun, as in (جاءني كل القوم), so its occurring as a badal is permissible, unlike «جاءني كلهم», which is not permissible except out of necessity. This is the best of what has been said about this reading.

* I'rab:
(الهمزة) is for rebuking interrogation. (الواو) is a conjunction. (تك) is an imperfect verb, jussive, defective (nāqiṣ), the sign of the jussive being the overt sukūn on the nūn, which was omitted for lightness; its ism is a pronoun obligatorily latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هم" (they), referring to رسلكم, and there is a dispute over governance (tanāzuʿ) in it; and (رسلكم) is the agent of تأتيكم, nominative. (بالبيّنات) is attached to a ḥāl from رسلكم. (بلى) is a particle of response, the matter responded to being omitted, i.e.: "they came to us and we denied them". (الفاء) is the connective of an implied condition. (الواو) is resumptive. (ما) is negative, not operating. (إلّا) is for restriction. (في ضلال) is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ دعاء.
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
And the clause «لم تك تأتيكم ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the implied content of the saying, i.e. "Did your messengers leave you, and did they not come to you ...".
And the clause «تأتيكم رسلكم ... » is in the position of accusative, the khabar of تك.
And the clause «قالوا ... (the second)» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «بلى and the matter responded to ... » is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «قالوا (the third)» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «ادعوا ... » is in the position of jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you want to supplicate, then supplicate ...". And the clause of the condition and its apodosis is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «ما دعاء الكافرين إلّا في ضلال» has no grammatical position; resumptive [Note: it is possible that it is from the speech of Allah the Exalted to His Prophet, and possible that it is from the speech of the keepers.].

* I'rab:
(الذي) a relative noun in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) الله; (لكم) attached to an omitted second direct object (mafʿūl bihi), its implied form being "سكنا" [Note: this is shown by His saying: لتسكنوا]; (اللام) denotes purpose; (تسكنوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām ..., and the wāw is the agent (fāʿil); (فيه) attached to (تسكنوا).
And the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن تسكنوا..) is in the position of genitive through the lām, attached to (جعل).
(الواو) a conjunction; (النهار مبصرا) are two conjoined elements (maʿṭūfān) on the two preceding objects, respectively; (اللام) the shifted lām; the sign of the nominative in (ذو) is the wāw, since it is one of the five nouns; (على الناس) attached to فضل; (الواو) a conjunction; (لكنّ ... لا يشكرون) like ولكنّ.. لا يعلمون [Note: in verse (57) of this sūra].
Clause: «الله الذي ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «جعل ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
And the clause: «تسكنوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «إنّ الله لذو فضل ... » has no grammatical position; it has the force of a causal clause.
And the clause: «لكنّ أكثر ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause إنّ الله لذو ...
And the clause: «لا يشكرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of لكنّ.
(62) (الله، ربكم، خالق) three nominative khabars for the mubtadaʾ ذلكم; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (إلّا) for exception; (هو) a pronoun in the position of nominative, a badal (substitute) for the latent pronoun in the implied khabar, i.e. "there is no god existing except Him"; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition; (أنّى) an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverbial (ẓarf), attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the deputy agent (nāʾib fāʿil) in (تؤفكون) [Note: (أنّى) may be made to include the meaning of "how" (kayfa), in which case it is originally in the position of accusative as a ḥāl].
And the clause: «ذلكم الله ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «لا إله إلّا هو ... » is in the position of nominative as a fourth khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلكم).
And the clause: «تؤفكون ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if these are the attributes of Allah, then how are you turned away ...".
(63) (كذلك) attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the operator of which is (يؤفك); (الذين) a relative noun in the position of nominative as the deputy agent (nāʾib fāʿil); (بآيات) attached to (يجحدون).
And the clause: «يؤفك الذين ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «كانوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
And the clause: «يجحدون ... » is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا ...

* Rhetoric:
1- Figurative attribution (al-isnād al-majāzī): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «مُبْصِراً».
Seeing has been attributed to the day, although in reality seeing belongs to the people of the day.
The night is paired with the object of purpose (mafʿūl li-ajlihi) and the day with the ḥāl, because each of them performs the function of the other, and because, had it been said "that you may see in it" (لتبصروا فيه), the eloquence found in the figurative attribution would have been lost; and had it been said "still/calm" (ساكنا) — and the night may be described as calm in the literal sense, as in their expressions "a still night" (ليل ساج) and "a calm night with no wind in it" (ساكن لا ريح فيه) — the literal would not have been distinguished from the figurative.
2- Placing the overt noun in the place of the pronoun: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لا يَشْكُرُونَ». The context required him to say "but most of them" (ولكن أكثرهم), so that the mention of "people" would not be repeated; but in this repetition there is a specification of ingratitude for blessings as belonging to them, and that they are the ones who deny the favour of Allah and do not give thanks for it, like His sayings: «إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لَكَفُورٌ» «إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لِرَبِّهِ لَكَنُودٌ» «إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لَظَلُومٌ كَفَّارٌ».

* I'rab:
(الهمزة) is for interrogation in the sense of intimidation and rebuke. (الفاء) is a conjunction in the three places. (في الأرض) is attached to (يسيروا). (ينظروا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive, conjoined to (يسيروا) [Note: it is permissible that it be accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ, with (الفاء) causal (sababiyya), an interrogative having preceded it.
And see verse (21) of this sūra, for this is the like of that.]. (كيف) is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative, the khabar of كان. (من قبلهم) is attached to an omitted element that is the ṣila of the relative الذين. (منهم) is attached to أكثر. (قوّة) is a tamyīz (specification) of أشدّ, accusative. (في الأرض) is attached to an adjective of آثار. (ما) is negative [Note: or interrogative, in the position of accusative, a direct object of the verb أغنى.], and the second is a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of nominative, the returning pronoun being omitted.]. (عنهم) is attached to (أغنى).
The clause «لم يسيروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. "were they unable, so that they did not travel".
And the clause «ينظروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause يسيروا [Note: it is permissible that it be the ṣila of the implied particle-type relative (أن), if the fāʾ is causal after an interrogative.].
And the clause «كان عاقبة ... » is in the position of accusative, a direct object of the verb of looking, which is suspended by the interrogative, on the assumption of the preposition..
And the clause «كانوا ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
And the clause «ما أغنى ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause كانوا ...
And the clause «كانوا ... (the second)» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type relative (ما).
And the interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا يكسبون) is in the position of nominative, the agent of أغنى.
And the clause «يكسبون ... » is in the position of accusative, the khabar of كانوا.
(83) (الفاء) is a conjunction. (لمّا) is an adverb in the sense of "when", including the meaning of a condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis فرحوا. (بالبيّنات) is attached to a ḥāl from رسلهم. (بما) is attached to (فرحوا). (عندهم) is an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted element that is the ṣila of the relative ما. (من العلم) is a ḥāl from the returning pronoun in the implied ṣila. (بهم) is attached to (حاق). (به) is attached to (يستهزئون).
And the clause «جاءتهم رسلهم ... » is in the position of genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi..
And the clause «فرحوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause «حاق بهم ما كانوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause of the apodosis.
And the clause «كانوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما).
And the clause «يستهزئون..» is in the position of accusative, the khabar of كانوا.
(84) (فلمّا) is like the first. (رأوا) is a past verb indeclinable on an implied ḍamma on the omitted alif, omitted because of the meeting of two sukūns.. and the (الواو) is the agent. (بالله) is attached to (آمنّا). (وحده) is an accusative ḥāl. (بما) is attached to (كفرنا). (به) is attached to مشركين.
And the clause «رأوا ... » is in the position of genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause «آمنّا ... » is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «كفرنا ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause آمنا..
And the clause «كنّا..» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما).
(85) (الفاء) is a conjunction. (يك) is a defective imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the sukūn on the nūn, which was omitted for lightness; and the ism of (يك) is a pronoun obligatorily latent, its implied form being "هو" (he), referring to (إيمانهم) [Note: or it is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn).] according to the rule of tanāzuʿ (dispute over governance), so the agent of (ينفعهم) is إيمانهم. (لمّا) is like the first, and is attached to the content of the apodosis. (سنّة) is an absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq) of an omitted verb [Note: or a direct object of an omitted verb in the manner of warning (taḥdhīr), i.e.: "beware the way of Allah".]. (التي) is a relative noun in the position of accusative, an adjective of سنّة. (في عباده) is attached to (خلت). (الواو) is a conjunction. (خسر هنالك الكافرون): the i'rab of its like has been given [Note: in verse (78) of this sūra.].
And the clause «لم يك ينفعهم إيمانهم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause قالوا [Note: or conjoined to an implied element arising from their saying آمنّا.. i.e. "so they believed, but their belief did not benefit them".].
And the clause «ينفعهم إيمانهم ... » is in the position of accusative, the khabar of يك.
And the clause «رأوا ... » is in the position of genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi ... and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: "when they saw Our might, their belief did not benefit them when they believed....".
And the clause « (سنّ الله) ذلك سنّة ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption — or parenthetical — and the clause «قد خلت ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (التي).
And the clause «خسر هنالك الكافرون» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause لم يك ...

* Morphology:
(سنّت): the tāʾ is written extended (mabsūṭa) in the muṣḥaf, though its due is to be tied (marbūṭa).

* Rhetoric:
The art of mockery (fann al-tahakkum): in the words of the Exalted «فَرِحُوا بِما عِنْدَهُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ».
They showed joy in that, namely what they had of false beliefs and refuted doubts. And calling them "knowledge" is in mockery of them.

* Benefits:
- Kinds of tanwīn:
1- Tanwīn al-tamkīn (of firm establishment): this is the one attached to a declinable noun that takes full case-endings, informing that it remains on its original state and that it does not resemble a particle so as to be indeclinable, nor a verb so as to be barred from full declension; it is also called "tanwīn al-ṣarf", as in «زيد ورجل ورجال» and the words of the Exalted in the verse we are dealing with كانُوا أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَآثاراً فِي الْأَرْضِ. 2- Tanwīn al-tankīr (of indefiniteness): this is the one attached to some indeclinable nouns to distinguish their definite from their indefinite; it occurs in the chapter of the nouns of verbs by transmission, as in (صه ومه وإيه), and in a proper name ending in (ويه) by analogy, as in: (جاءني سيبويه وسيبويه آخر) ("Sībawayh came to me, and another Sībawayh"). The difference between (إيه) and (إيهٍ) is that the first, without tanwīn, means "go on with your familiar talk that you are telling me", and the meaning of (إيهٍ) with tanwīn is "go on with whatever talk you wish". [Translator's note: the source prints both words identically and unvocalised; the first is without tanwīn «إيهِ», the second with tanwīn «إيهٍ».]
As for the tanwīn of «رجل» and the like among declinable nouns, it is tanwīn al-tamkīn, not tanwīn al-tankīr, as some students may imagine; for that reason, if you named a man with it, that very tanwīn would remain while the indefiniteness had gone.
3- Tanwīn al-muqābala (of correspondence): this is the one attached to the like of (مسلمات), made to correspond to the nūn in «مسلمين». It was said: it is a compensation for the fatḥa in the accusative, but were that so it would not be given tanwīn in the nominative and genitive; and it was said: it is tanwīn al-tamkīn, which is refuted by its persisting when it is used as a name, like عرفات, just as the nūn of مسلمين persists when it is used as a name, whereas tanwīn al-tamkīn does not coexist with the two causes (of diptotism); for that reason, if one named with (مسلمة or عرفة), their tanwīn would disappear.
4- Tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ (of compensation): this is the one attached as a compensation for an original letter, such as (جواز وغواش), for it is a compensation for the omitted yāʾ; or as a compensation for an additional letter, as in جندل, whose tanwīn is a compensation for the alif of جنادل — Ibn Mālik said this, but what appears is the opposite, that it is tanwīn al-ṣarf, and that the loss of the alif is not like the loss of the yāʾ in (جوار وغواش).
Or as a compensation for the muḍāf ilayhi, whether a single word or a clause. The single word is the tanwīn attached to (بعض وكل) when they are cut off from annexation, as in the words of the Exalted وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنا لَهُ الْأَمْثالَ and فَضَّلْنا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلى بَعْضٍ. It was said that it is tanwīn al-tamkīn, which returned with the disappearance of the annexation that was opposing it.
As for the tanwīn of the clause, it is the one attached to (إذ), as in the words of the Exalted وَانْشَقَّتِ السَّماءُ فَهِيَ يَوْمَئِذٍ واهِيَةٌ, the implied form being (فهي يوم إذ انشقت); then the clause that was the muḍāf ilayhi was omitted because it was known, and the tanwīn was brought as a compensation for it.
5- Tanwīn al-tarannum (of chanting): this is the one attached to unrestricted rhymes (al-qawāfī al-muṭlaqa), in place of the letter of release, which is the alif, wāw and yāʾ, and that is in the recitation of Banū Tamīm; and this tanwīn is not particular to nouns, by the evidence of the saying of Jarīr:
أقلي اللوم عاذل والعتابا ... وقولي إن أصبت فقد أصابن
(Lessen the blame, O reproacher, and the reproach ... and say, "if I am right, then he has hit the mark".)
The original: أصابا; the alif is the letter of release and was replaced by a nūn for chanting.
6- Tanwīn al-ḍarūra (of necessity): this is the one attached to what is not declined (diptotes), like the saying of Imruʾ al-Qays:
ويوم دخلت الخدر خدر عنيزة ... فقال لك الولايات إنك مرجلي
(And the day I entered the howdah, the howdah of ʿUnayza ... and she said, "Woe to you, you will make me go on foot.") [Translator's note: the source prints "الولايات" in the second hemistich, and "عنيرة" in the following sentence; both are translated as written, and the gloss follows the commonly transmitted verse, which reads "الويلات" and "عنيزة".]
The poet gave tanwīn to «عنيرة», which is a diptote, out of necessity; and to a vocative indeclinable on the ḍamma, like the saying of al-Aḥwaṣ:
سلام الله يا مطر عليها ... وليس عليك يا مطر السلام
(The peace of Allah, O Maṭar, be upon her ... and upon you, O Maṭar, there is no peace.)
The poet gave tanwīn to «مطر», which is a vocative indeclinable on the ḍamma, to which tanwīn is not permissible except out of necessity.

* Lügat:
(الْآزِفَةِ): Kıyamettir; yaklaşmasından (أزوف), yani yakınlığından dolayı bu adla adlandırılmıştır; «أزف الرحيل», göç yaklaştı demektir. el-Misbâh'ta şöyle denir: «أزف الرحيل أزفا», «تعب» bâbındandır, ve «أزوفا»: yaklaştı ve yakın oldu. «أزفت الآزفة»: kıyamet (yaklaştı).» el-Esâs'ta şöyle denir: «أزف الرحيل»: yaklaştı ve acele etti. «أقبل يمشي الأزفى» (hızlı yürüyüşle yürüyerek geldi) de bundandır; «الجمزى» veznindedir. Sanki «الوزيف»tendir ve hemze vâvdan dönüşmüştür. «ساءني أزوف رحيلهم» (göçlerinin yaklaşması beni üzdü) ve «أزف رحيلهم» denir....
«الآزفة»: yaklaştığı için kıyamettir. Hüdbe şöyle demiştir:
وبادرها مصر العشيّة قرمها ... ذر البيت يغشاه من القرّ آزف
(Akşamüstü sürünün iri erkek devesi onlardan önce davrandı; evin sığınağına doğru, onu soğuktan gelen yakın bir şey kaplarken.) [Mütercim notu: Beyit kaynakta bu şekildedir; bazı kelimelerin okunuşu şüphelidir, anlam yaklaşık verilmiştir.]
(الْحَناجِرِ): el-Muhtâr'da şöyle denir: «الحنجرة, fetha ile, ve الحنجور, damme ile: gırtlaktır (الحلقوم).» el-Kâmûs'ta şöyle denir: «الحنجور: küçük sepet, güzel koku tozu (zerîre) şişesi ve gırtlak (الحنجرة gibi). «الحناجر» onun çoğuludur.»

* İ'rab:
(هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمْ آياتِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّماءِ رِزْقاً): Hükmün Allah Sübhânehû'ya ait olduğunu delillendirmek için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye bir sözdür. (هو): mübtedâ; (الذي): haberdir. «يريكم» cümlesi sıladır. (آياته): mef'ûlün bihtir. (وينزل لكم): «يريكم»e ma'tûftur. (من السماء): câr ve mecrûr; «ينزل»e müteallik. Bu, göstermenin ve indirmenin yenilenmesine, devamına ve sürekliliğine delâlet etmek içindir. [Mütercim notu: Müellif «رزقا»nın i'rabını zikretmemiştir.] (وَما يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُنِيبُ): Vâv atıf harfi; (ما): nefy harfidir. (يتذكر): merfû muzâri fiildir. (إلا): hasr edatı; (من): fâildir. «ينيب» cümlesi sıladır. (فَادْعُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكافِرُونَ): Fâ fasîha fâsıdır; yani durum zikredildiği gibi olunca dua edin (ibadet edin). Lafza-i Celâl mef'ûlün bihtir. (مخلصين): hâldir. (له): câr ve mecrûr; «مخلصين»e müteallik. (الدين): mef'ûlün bihtir. Vâv hâliyyedir. (لو): şart edatıdır. (كره الكافرون): fiil ve fâildir; mef'ûlün bih mahzûftur, yani «إخلاصكم» (ihlasınızı) veya «دعوتكم» (duanızı). (رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجاتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلى مَنْ يَشاءُ مِنْ عِبادِهِ لِيُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ التَّلاقِ): (رفيع الدرجات): mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberidir; (ذو العرش): ikinci haber; «يلقي الروح» cümlesi üçüncü haberdir; yani (mübtedâ) «الله»tır. (من أمره): câr ve mecrûr; «يلقي»ye ya da «الروح»tan, yani vahiyden hâl olan mahzûf bir şeye müteallik; yani O'nun emrinden kaynaklanmış olarak. «الروح» ile kastedilen vahiydir; bu adla adlandırılmasının sebebi belâgat bölümünde gelecektir. (على من): câr ve mecrûr; «يلقي»ye müteallik. «يشاء» cümlesi sıladır. (من عباده): hâldir. (لينذر): lâm ta'lîl içindir; (ينذر): lâmdan sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir; câr ve mecrûr (müevvel masdar ile lâm) «يلقي»ye müteallik. «ينذر»in fâilinin Allah, ya da «الروح», ya da «من يشاء» olması caizdir. (يوم): «ينذر»in mef'ûlün bihidir; (التلاق): muzâfun ileyhtir. Yâ, Mushaf hattına uyularak hazfedilmiştir; ispatıyla da okunmuştur. Kıyamet gününe «يوم التلاق» (buluşma günü) denmiştir; çünkü yaratılmışlar o günde birbirleriyle buluşurlar.
(يَوْمَ هُمْ بارِزُونَ لا يَخْفى عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَيْءٌ): (يوم): «يوم التلاق»tan bedel-i küll min külldür. (هم): mübtedâ; (بارزون): haberdir. İsim cümlesi, zarfın ona izâfesiyle cer mahallindedir. Meşhur görüşe göre «يوم»in harekesi i'rab harekesidir; bunun açıklaması Fevâid bölümünde gelecektir. «لا يخفى» cümlesi «بارزون»daki zamirden hâl veya ikinci haberdir; isti'nâfiyye olduğu da söylenmiştir. Zemahşerî hâl olmasını tercih etmiştir; muhtemelen o isabetlidir. (على الله): câr ve mecrûr; «يخفى»ya müteallik. (منهم): hâldir; çünkü aslında «شيء»in sıfatı idi. (شيء): «يخفى»nın fâilidir. (لِمَنِ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ لِلَّهِ الْواحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ): O günde sorulacak şeyin ve verilecek cevabın hikâyesidir. Cümle mahzûf bir sözün mekûlü'l-kavlidir; yani Allah Teâlâ bunu söyler ve kendisi cevap verir. Bu söz (القول) öncesine ma'tûftur, ya da takdir edilen bir soruya cevap olarak isti'nâfiyyedir; sanki "O zaman ne olur?" denmiş, "«لمن الملك» denir" denmiştir. (لمن): öne geçmiş haber; (الملك): sona kalmış mübtedâdır. (اليوم): «الملك»e müteallik zarftır. (لله): takdiri «الملك لله» olan mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberidir. (الواحد القهار): «الله»ın iki sıfatıdır (na't). Zemahşerî şöyle der: «Bir münâdî seslenir ve 'Bugün mülk kimindir?' der; mahşer halkı ona 'Bir ve Kahhâr olan Allah'ındır' diye cevap verir.»
(الْيَوْمَ تُجْزى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِما كَسَبَتْ): Zarf «تجزى»ya müteallik. Söz, mekûlün devamıdır. (تجزى): meçhul muzâri fiil; (كل نفس): nâib-i fâildir. (بما): câr ve mecrûr; «تجزى»ya müteallik. (ما): ism-i mevsûl veya zarfiyyedir. (لا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسابِ): (لا): cinsini nefyeden lâdır; (ظلم): fetha üzere mebnî ismidir. (اليوم): mahzûf bir habere müteallik zarftır. «إنّ», ismi ve haberi; cümle zulmün olmamasının ta'lîlidir; yani Allah Teâlâ'yı bir hesap başka bir hesaptan alıkoymaz; O, hesabında süratli, hükmünde âdildir. (وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْآزِفَةِ إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَناجِرِ كاظِمِينَ): Vâv öncekine atıftır. (أنذرهم): emir fiil, müstetir fâil ve birinci mef'ûlün bihtir. (يوم الآزفة): ikinci mef'ûlün bihtir. (إذ): «يوم الآزفة»den bedeldir. (القلوب): mübtedâ; (لدى الحناجر): mahzûf bir habere müteallik zarftır; cümle, zarfın ona izâfesiyle cer mahallindedir. (كاظمين): «القلوب»tan hâldir. «الحناجر», çoğul yapılmasında yâ ve nûn ile sahiplerine (akıl sahiplerine) muamele edildiği gibi muamele görmüştür [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta böyledir; yâ-nûn ile çoğul yapılan «كاظمين»dir]. Zemahşerî'nin açıklaması belâgat bölümünde gelecektir. (ما لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلا شَفِيعٍ يُطاعُ):
Cümle, kalplerin sahiplerinden hâldir. (ما): Hicaz lehçesindeki (amel eden) nefy harfi veya amelsiz (mühmel) «ما»dır. (للظالمين): öne geçmiş haber; (من): zâid cer harfi; (حميم): «ما»nın sona kalmış ismi veya mübtedâdır. (ولا شفيع): «حميم»e ma'tûftur. «يطاع» cümlesi «شفيع»in sıfatıdır. Sözde bir mecaz vardır; ayrıntısı belâgat bölümünde gelecektir.

* Belâgat:
1- «يلقي الروح من أمره» sözünde mecâz-ı mürsel vardır; çünkü «الروح» ile kastedilen vahiydir. Vahye «ruh» denmiştir; çünkü o, kalplerde ruhların bedenlerdeki yerini tutar. Bu, alâkası sebebiyet olan bir mecâz-ı mürseldir. Zemahşerî onu istiâre-i tasrîhiyye saymıştır; bu da uzak değildir.
2- Temsîl:
«إذ القلوب لدى الحناجر كاظمين» sözünde, onların ateşe yaklaştıkları o günün dehşetini somutlaştırmak için istiâre-i temsîliyye vardır. O anda kalpleri yerlerinden yükselir ve gırtlaklarına yapışır; ne çıkar ki ölüp rahatlasınlar, ne de yerlerine döner ki derin bir nefes alıp ferahlasınlar; boğaza takılan bir kılçık gibi orada takılı kalır.
3- Zâhirin tersi (عكس الظاهر):
«ما للظالمين من حميم ولا شفيع يطاع» sözünde zâhirin tersi vardır. Bu sanattan defalarca söz edilmişti; çünkü onların sözü dinlenen bir şefaatçisi olması bir yana, hiç şefaatçisi yoktur.
4- Zemahşerî'nin «كاظمين» hakkındaki sözü:
Zemahşerî şöyle demiştir: «Eğer '«كاظمين» neyle mansûb oldu?' dersen, derim ki: O, mâna itibariyle kalplerin sahiplerinden hâldir; çünkü mâna 'Kalpleri gırtlaklarında iken, onu (kederi) içlerine gömerek' demektir. Kalplerden hâl olması da caizdir; yani kalpler gırtlaklara ulaşmakla birlikte içlerindeki gam ve kederi bastırmaktadır. «الكاظم»ın sâlim cemi olarak çoğul yapılmasının sebebi, onları akıl sahiplerinin fiillerinden olan kezm (öfkeyi/kederi bastırma) ile vasfetmesidir; nitekim Allah Teâlâ «رأيتهم لي ساجدين» ve «فظلت أعناقهم لها خاضعين» buyurmuştur.»

* Fevâid:
Zamanın cümlelere izâfesi:
Zaman (ismi) bir cümleye izâfe edildiğinde, asıl üzere i'rab ve binâ (mebnî kılınma) caizdir. Ondan sonra gelen mebnî bir fiil ise, uygunluk için ya da zarfın o durumda, kendisinden sonraki cümleyi kendisine ve başka bir şeye muhtaç kılması bakımından şart harfine benzemesi sebebiyle binâ daha râcihtir. Nâbiga ez-Zübyânî'nin şu sözü gibi:
على حين عاتبت المشيب على الصبا ... وقلت: ألما أصح والشيب وازع
(Gençlik yüzünden ihtiyarlığı azarladığım ve "Hâlâ ayılmadım mı, hâlbuki ihtiyarlık engelleyicidir" dediğim bir zamanda.)
«على حينِ», i'rab üzere cer ile, ve «على حينَ», binâ üzere fetha ile rivayet edilir; aslen mebnî olan «عاتبت»e muzâf olduğu için daha râcih olan budur. Binâ bazen ârızî bir hâl olur, iş yine böyle cereyan eder [Mütercim notu: kaynakta «فيجزي لأمر كذلك» yazılmıştır; «فيجري الأمر كذلك» olarak anlaşıldı]; şu söz gibi:
لأجتذبن منهن قلبي تحلما ... على حين يستصبين كل حليم
(Her yumuşak huylu kimseyi çocuklaştırdıkları bir zamanda, ağırbaşlılık takınarak kalbimi onlardan mutlaka çekip alacağım.)
«حين», i'rab üzere cer ile ve mebnî olan «يستصبين»e muzâf olduğu için binâ üzere fetha ile rivayet edilir; «يستصبين», dişil nûnuna bitiştiği için sükûn üzere mebnî muzâri fiildir; mâzîsi «استصبيت»tir; birini çocuklar arasında saydığında «استصبيت فلانا» denir. Ondan sonra gelen mu'reb muzâri fiil veya isim cümlesi ise, i'rab binâdan daha râcihtir; uygunluk olmadığı için Basralılara göre i'rab vaciptir. İ'rabın daha râcih olduğunu söyledik (vacip demedik), çünkü büyük kurrâdan olan Nâfi' «هذا يوم ينفع» âyetini i'rab üzere değil, binâ üzere fetha ile okumuştur. Basralıların çoğunluğu, buradaki fethanın binâ fethası olmadığı, «صمت يومَ الخميس» (perşembe günü oruç tuttum) sözündeki gibi bir i'rab fethası olduğu cevabını vermişler ve bu sebeple işaretin güne yönelik olmamasını gerekli görmüşlerdir; aksi takdirde bir şeyin kendi kendisine zarf olması lâzım gelirdi. Bu yüzden Fârisî ve İbn Mâlik i'rabın daha râcih olduğunu söylemişlerdir. (İbn Mâlik) el-Hulâsa'da şöyle der:
وقبل فعل معرب أو مبتدأ ... أعرب ومن بنى فلن يفندا
(Mu'reb bir fiilden veya mübtedâdan önce i'rab et; binâ eden de asla hatalı sayılmaz.)

* Vocabulary:
(الْآزِفَةِ): the Resurrection; it is so called because of its اُزوف, i.e. its nearness, from أزف الرحيل, meaning "the departure drew near". In al-Miṣbāḥ: «أزف الرحيل أزفا (pattern "taʿiba") and أزوفا: it drew close and near; and أزفت الآزفة: the Resurrection.» In al-Asās: أزف الرحيل:
it drew near and hastened; from it, "he came walking the azfā", on the pattern of al-jamzā, as if it were from al-wazīf, the hamza replacing a wāw; and "the nearness of their departure distressed me", and "their departure drew near"....
and الآزفة is the Resurrection because of its nearness. Hudba said:
وبادرها مصر العشيّة قرمها ... ذر البيت يغشاه من القرّ آزف
[Translator's note: the verse is given here in the source's wording, whose text is evidently corrupt in places; it is quoted as an instance of the use of آزف, "near, pressing", and no continuous English rendering is attempted.]
(الْحَناجِرِ): in al-Mukhtār: «الحنجرة with fatḥa, and الحنجور with ḍamma: the gullet (al-ḥulqūm).» In al-Qāmūs: «الحنجور is the small chest (safat), a bottle for powder (dharīra), and the gullet, like الحنجرة; and الحناجر is its plural.»

* I'rab:
(هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمْ آياتِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّماءِ رِزْقاً): a resumptive discourse, introduced to demonstrate that judgment belongs to Him, Glorified. هو is a mubtadaʾ and الذي the khabar; the clause يريكم is a ṣila; آياته is a direct object; وينزل لكم is conjoined to يريكم; and من السماء are two [elements] attached to ينزل, to indicate the renewal of the showing and sending down, and their continuity and persistence. (وَما يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُنِيبُ): the و is a conjunction; ما is negative; يتذكر is an imperfect nominative verb; إلا is a particle of restriction; من is the agent; and the clause ينيب is a ṣila. (فَادْعُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكافِرُونَ): the فاء is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if the matter is as mentioned, then call upon". The Majestic Name is a direct object; مخلصين is a ḥāl; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مخلصين; الدين is a direct object; the و is circumstantial; لو is conditional; and كره الكافرون is a verb and agent, the direct object omitted, i.e. "your sincerity" or "your calling". (رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجاتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلى مَنْ يَشاءُ مِنْ عِبادِهِ لِيُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ التَّلاقِ): رفيع الدرجات is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, and ذو العرش a second khabar, and the clause يلقي الروح a third khabar, i.e. [the mubtadaʾ is] Allah. ومن أمره are two [elements] attached to يلقي, or to an omitted ḥāl from الروح, i.e. revelation — that is, while it arises from His command. By الروح is meant revelation; the reason for naming it so will come in the section on rhetoric. وعلى من are two [elements] attached to يلقي; the clause يشاء is a ṣila; and من عباده is a ḥāl. ولينذر: the lām is causal; ينذر is an imperfect verb accusative by an implied أن after the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يلقي; and the agent of ينذر may be Allah, or the Spirit, or "whom He wills"; يوم is a direct object of لينذر and التلاق is its muḍāf ilayhi; the yāʾ is omitted following the orthography of the muṣḥaf, and it is also read with the yāʾ retained. The Day of Resurrection is called the Day of Meeting (yawm al-talāqī) because creatures meet one another on it.
(يَوْمَ هُمْ بارِزُونَ لا يَخْفى عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَيْءٌ): يوم is a badal of يوم التلاق (a total substitute for the whole); هم is a mubtadaʾ and بارزون its khabar; the nominal sentence is in the position of genitive by the adverb's annexation to it; so the vowel of يوم is a vowel of declension, according to the well-known view; this will be set out in the section on benefits. The clause لا يخفى is a ḥāl from the pronoun of بارزون, or a second khabar; it is also said that it is resumptive. Al-Zamakhsharī preferred the ḥāl reading, and perhaps he is right. على الله are two [elements] attached to يخفى; منهم is a ḥāl, because in origin it was an adjective of شيء; and شيء is the agent of يخفى. (لِمَنِ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ لِلَّهِ الْواحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ): a narration of what will be asked on that day and how it will be answered; the sentence is the content of an omitted saying, i.e. He, the Exalted, says it and answers Himself. The saying is conjoined to what precedes, or is resumptive in answer to an implied question, as though it were said: "What will happen then?" and it was said: "It will be said: To whom belongs the dominion?" لمن is a fronted khabar and الملك a postponed mubtadaʾ; اليوم is an adverbial attached to الملك; لله is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "the dominion belongs to Allah"; and الواحد القهار are two adjectives of لله. Al-Zamakhsharī said: «A caller will call out and say: "To whom belongs the dominion this day?" and the people of the gathering-place will answer him: "To Allah, the One, the Irresistible."»
(الْيَوْمَ تُجْزى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِما كَسَبَتْ): the adverbial is attached to تجزى, and the speech is a completion of what is said; تجزى is a passive imperfect verb and كل نفس the deputy agent; بما are two [elements] attached to تجزى; and ما is a relative or a temporal (ẓarfiyya). (لا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسابِ): لا is the lā of generic negation, and ظلم is its noun, indeclinable on fatḥa; اليوم is an adverbial attached to an omitted khabar; إن with its noun and khabar; and the sentence gives the reason for the absence of injustice, i.e. no reckoning occupies Him from another reckoning, so He is swift in His reckoning, just in His judgment. (وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْآزِفَةِ إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَناجِرِ كاظِمِينَ): the و is a conjunction linking to what precedes; وأنذرهم is an imperative verb, a latent agent and a first direct object; يوم الآزفة is a second direct object; إذ is a badal of يوم الآزفة; القلوب is a mubtadaʾ; لدى الحناجر is an adverbial attached to an omitted khabar; the sentence is in the position of genitive by the adverb's annexation to it; and كاظمين is a ḥāl of القلوب. The hearts, in being plural-ed with yāʾ and nūn (the sound masculine plural), have been treated as their owners. Al-Zamakhsharī's account will come in the section on rhetoric. (ما لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلا شَفِيعٍ يُطاعُ)
The sentence is a ḥāl from the owners of the hearts; ما is a Hijazi negative, or inoperative; للظالمين is a fronted khabar; من is a redundant preposition; حميم is the postponed noun of ما, or a mubtadaʾ; ولا شفيع is conjoined to حميم; and the clause يطاع is an adjective of شفيع. In the speech there is a majāz whose detail will come in the section on rhetoric.

* Rhetoric:
1- In His saying «يلقي الروح من أمره» there is a majāz mursal, because what is meant by الروح is revelation. Revelation is called a spirit because it flows into hearts as spirits flow into bodies. So it is a majāz mursal whose relation is causality. Al-Zamakhsharī made it an explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya), and that is not far-fetched.
2- Representation (al-tamthīl):
In His saying «إذ القلوب لدى الحناجر كاظمين» is a representative metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya), to embody the terror of that day on which they will be nearing the Fire. Then their hearts rise from their places and stick in their throats; they neither come out, so that they die and are at rest, nor return to their places, so that they could breathe deeply and find relief; rather they lodge across like a bone in the throat.
3- Reversal of the apparent (ʿaks al-ẓāhir):
In His saying «ما للظالمين من حميم ولا شفيع يطاع» is a reversal of the apparent; this art has been mentioned more than once, since they have no intercessor at all, let alone an obeyed one.
4- Al-Zamakhsharī's statement on كاظمين:
Al-Zamakhsharī said: «If you ask: by what is كاظمين made accusative? I say: it is a ḥāl from the owners of the hearts in meaning, because the meaning is "when their hearts are at their throats, they suppressing [their anguish] over them". It may also be a ḥāl from the hearts, with the hearts suppressing grief and distress within them while reaching the throats. The كاظم was given the sound plural only because He described them with suppression (kaẓm), which is among the acts of rational beings, as the Exalted said:
"I saw them prostrating to me" and said: "so their necks remained humbled to it".»

* Benefits:
Annexation of time words to sentences:
