Mekkî şöyle demiştir: Çünkü bundan, elçilerin ve kendilerine elçi gönderilenlerin nefyedilmesi lâzım gelir.
2- İkincisi: Gizli bir "أن" ile mansûb olmasıdır; o ve nasbettiği şey "وحيا" üzerine ma'tûf olur; "وحيا" hâl olduğundan bu da burada hâl olur. Takdir: "إلا موحيا أو مرسلا".
3- Üçüncüsü: "وحيا"nın anlamı üzerine ma'tûf olmasıdır; çünkü o, "أن" ve fiil ile takdir edilen bir masdardır. Takdir: "إلا بأن يوحى إليه أو بأن يرسل". Bunu Mekkî ve Ebu'l-Bekâ zikretmiştir.
"أو من وراء حجاب" sözünde cumhur tekil okumuştur; İbn Ebî Able ise çoğul olarak "حُجُب" okumuştur. Bu câr, takdiri "أو يكلمه من وراء حجاب" olan mahzûf bir şeye mütealliktir. Bu fiilin "وحيا"nın anlamı üzerine ma'tûf olduğu daha önce geçti; yani "إلا أن يوحي أو يكلمه". Ebu'l-Bekâ şöyle demiştir: "من"in lafızda mevcut olan "يكلمه"ye müteallik olması caiz değildir; çünkü istisnâdan önceki, "إلا"dan sonrakinde amel etmez. Sonra şöyle demiştir: "من", "يكلمه"ye mütealliktir; çünkü o zarftır ve zarf hakkında genişlik gösterilir.» [Mütercim notu: Alıntıda Ebu'l-Bekâ'ya nispet edilen iki ifade birbiriyle çelişir görünmektedir; kaynakta yazıldığı gibi çevrilmiştir.]
Ebu'l-Bekâ şöyle demiştir: «"أن يكلمه" üzerine ma'tûf olması caiz değildir; çünkü anlamı "Beşer için Allah'ın onunla konuşması da, ona bir elçi göndermesi de olmaz" şekline dönüşür; bu ise fasittir.»
2- Muzâri fiilin cevâzen nasbı: Muzâri fiil, beş harften sonra gizli «أن» ile cevâzen (gizlenmesi caiz olarak) mansûb olur. Bunlar şunlardır: Cer harfi olan lâm; şu şartla ki ondan önce menfî mâzî nâkıs bir «كون» bulunmasın ve fiil «لا» ile birlikte gelmesin. Eğer lâmdan önce sözü edilen «كون» gelirse «أن»in gizlenmesi vâcib olur. Eğer fiil nâfiye veya te'kîd için zâide bir «لا» ile birlikte gelirse, aynı cinsten iki şeyin, yani key lâmı ile «لا»nın lâmının idğamsız olarak art arda gelmemesi için «أن»in açıkça zikredilmesi vâcib olur; bu sözde rekîk (zayıf) bir durumdur. Örneğin «لئلا يكون للناس عليكم حجة» (nûn, nâfiye olan «لا»ya idğam edilerek) ve «لئلا يعلم أهل الكتاب» (nûn, te'kîd için zâide olan «لا»ya idğam edilerek). Bu lâma key lâmı, âkıbet lâmı ve te'kîd lâmı denir. Kendilerinden sonra «أن»in cevâzen gizlendiği beş harften geriye kalan dört harf ise vâv, «أو», «ثم» ve fâdır; şu şartla ki bunlarla yapılan atıf, fiil te'vîlinde olmayan bir isim üzerine olsun. Bu isim iki türlüdür: masdar ve masdar olmayan. Masdar olmayan, Husayn b. Humâm el-Mürrî'nin şu sözünde olduğu gibidir:
ولولا رجال من رزام أعزة ... وآل سبيع أو أسوءك علقما
(Rizâm'dan aziz adamlar ve Sübey' ailesi olmasaydı, ya da seni üzmem [olmasaydı], ey Alkame.)
«أسوءك», «رجال» üzerine ma'tûftur; «رجال» ise fiil te'vîlinde değildir. Rizâm, Nümeyr'den bir kabiledir; «علقما» terhîm edilmiş münâdâdır. Masdar ise şöyledir: «وما كان لبشر أن يكلمه الله إلا وحيا أو من وراء حجاب أو يرسل رسولا», Nâfi' dışındakilerin kıraatinde «أو»dan sonra gizli «أن» ile nasb ile; takdir: «إلا وحيا أو إرسالا»dır. «وحيا» fiil te'vîlinde olmayan bir masdardır. Muâviye b. Ebî Süfyân'ın eşi ve oğlu Yezîd'in annesi Meysûn bint Bahdel el-Kelbiyye'nin şu sözü de böyledir:
ولبس عباءة وتقرّ عيني ... أحبّ إليّ من لبس الشفوف
(Gözüm aydın olarak bir abâ giymem, bana ince ipekliler giymekten daha sevimlidir.)
«تقرّ», cevâzen gizlenmiş «أن» ile mansûbtur; o ve fiil, merfû bir masdar te'vîlindedir ve atıf vâvıyla «لبس» üzerine ma'tûftur; bu, onun bundan önceki şu sözüne dayanır:
لبيت تخفق الأرواح فيه ... أحبّ إليّ من قصر منيف
(Rüzgârların içinde estiği bir çadır, bana yüksek bir saraydan daha sevimlidir.)
«قرّت عينه تقرّ» (gözü aydın oldu), gözyaşı az olduğunda söylenir; bu da ancak sevinçte olur; «القُرّ» (soğukluk) kelimesinden türemiştir. Gözyaşı sıcak olduğunda ise «سخنت» denir; bu da ancak kederde olur. Şu söz de böyledir:
لولا توقع معتر فأرضيه ... ما كنت أوثر أترابا على أتراب
(Bir muhtacın gelmesini beklemek ve onu memnun etmek olmasaydı, akranları akranlara tercih etmezdim.)
«أرضيه», fâdan sonra cevâzen gizlenmiş «أن» ile mansûbtur. «أن» ve «أرضى», «توقع» üzerine ma'tûf bir masdar te'vîlindedir; takdir: «لولا توقع معتر فإرضائي إياه»dır. «توقع» fiil te'vîlinde değildir. «المعتر», iyilik bekleyerek kendini gösteren kimsedir. «الأتراب», «تِرْب»in (tâ'nın kesresiyle) çoğuludur; o, seninle aynı vakitte doğan ve yaşta sana eşit olan kimsedir. Anlam: İyilik yapmaktan alıkonan kimsenin beklenmesi ve onu memnun etmek olmasaydı, şair, başkasıyla yaşıt olanı kendisiyle yaşıt olana tercih etmezdi. Enes b. Müdrike el-Has'amî'nin şu sözü de böyledir:
إني وقتلي سليكا ثم أعقله ... كالثور يضرب لما عافت البقر
(Ben, Süleyk'i öldürüp sonra diyetini ödememle, inekler suyu istemeyince dövülen boğa gibiyim.)
«أعقله», «عقل» fiilinin muzârisidir ve «ثم»den sonra cevâzen gizlenmiş «أن» ile mansûbtur. «أن» ve «أعقله», «قتلي» üzerine ma'tûf bir masdar te'vîlindedir; takdir: «وقتلي سليكا ثم عقلي إياه»dır. «قتلي» fiil te'vîlinde değildir. «سليكا» (tasğîr ile) bir adamın ismidir ve «قتلي»nin mef'ûlüdür. «كالثور», «إن»nin haberidir. «الثور» ile kastedilen sığırın erkeğidir (boğa); çünkü inekler ona uyar, o suyu istemezse onlar da istemez; bu yüzden suya girsin diye dövülür, onlar da onunla birlikte suya girer. «أعقله», «عقلت القتيل» ifadesindendir: Öldürülenin diyetini verdim. Ebu'l-Alâ'nın «الثور» hakkında ilginç bir görüşü vardır: O, su yosunu tabakasıdır (ثور الطحلب); suyun üstünü kaplar, inekler de bu yüzden sudan geri döner; sığırların sahibi suyu açmak için ona vurur, inekler de suyu içer. Demiştir ki: Ona «ثور» adını vermiş ve dinleyene bilmece sorsun diye onu ineklerle birlikte zikretmiştir. Ancak bu tamamen zorlamadır; doğrusu birincisidir.

* I'rab:
(لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَخْلُقُ ما يَشاءُ) A resumptive speech to show the breadth of His dominion, Glory be to Him; «الملك» with ḍamma is taking hold of a thing and disposing of it as one wills. «لله» is a fronted khabar and «ملك السموات والأرض» a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause «يخلق» is a ḥāl; «ما» is the direct object of «يخلق» and the clause «يشاء» is a ṣila. (يَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشاءُ إِناثاً وَيَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشاءُ الذُّكُورَ) «يهب» is a nominative imperfect verb whose agent is latent, its implied form being "He", referring to Allah the Exalted; «لمن» is attached to «يهب» and the clause «يشاء» is a ṣila; «إناثا» is a direct object; «ويهب لمن يشاء الذكور» is conjoined to the preceding clause; the clause «يهب لمن يشاء» is a badal of the clause «يخلق ما يشاء», a detailed substitute for a general one. (أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْراناً وَإِناثاً وَيَجْعَلُ مَنْ يَشاءُ عَقِيماً إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ) «أو» is a conjunction; «يزوجهم» is an imperfect verb with a latent agent referring to Him, Glory be to Him, and an object; «ذكرانا وإناثا» is a second direct object of «يزوجهم», the verb being given the sense of making (taṣyīr), i.e. He makes his children males and females, by the evidence of what follows; Abū al-Baqāʾ and al-Khaṭīb chose to parse «ذكرانا وإناثا» as two ḥāls. «ويجعل من يشاء عقيما» is conjoined to what precedes, and «عقيما» is necessarily a second direct object; «إن» and its noun; «عليم» is its first khabar and «قدير» its second khabar. More discussion of this verse will come in the section of Rhetoric. (وَما كانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْياً أَوْ مِنْ وَراءِ حِجابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا) The wāw is a conjunction or resumptive, and the speech is resumptive, brought to show how Allah speaks to His servants; «ما» is negative; «كان» is a past defective verb; «لبشر» is the fronted khabar of «كان»; «أن» and its accusative verb are its noun; «إلا» is a particle of restriction; «وحيا» is a maṣdar standing in the place of a ḥāl, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb; «أو» is a conjunction; «من وراء حجاب» is attached to an implied element conjoined to the implied element that governs «وحيا», i.e. "except that Allah speaks from behind a veil" or "making Himself heard from behind a veil"; «أو» is a conjunction; «يرسل» is conjoined to a pure noun not construed with a verb, which is his saying «وحيا», as though He had said "except as one who reveals or sends", or "that He reveal a revelation or send a messenger". This verse has occupied the exegetes and grammarians, and we shall bring you in the section of Benefits a detailed discussion on it. (فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذْنِهِ ما يَشاءُ إِنَّهُ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ) «فيوحي» is conjoined to «يرسل»; both have been read with raising as a resumption, i.e. "so He sends and reveals"; «بإذنه» is attached to «يوحي»; the waḥy is inspiration and the swift signal; «ما» is a direct object and the clause «يشاء» is a ṣila; «إن», its noun and its two khabars. (وَكَذلِكَ أَوْحَيْنا إِلَيْكَ رُوحاً مِنْ أَمْرِنا) The kāf is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. like Our revelation to others than you; «إليك» is attached to «أوحينا»; «روحا» is a direct object; «من أمرنا» is an adjective of «روحا», and it is said a ḥāl, with «من» partitive, i.e. this spirit, which is the Qur'an, being part of what We reveal to you, because what is revealed to him is not restricted to the Qur'an. (ما كُنْتَ تَدْرِي مَا الْكِتابُ وَلَا الْإِيمانُ) The clause is a ḥāl from the kāf in «إليك»; «ما» is interrogative, suspended (muʿallaqa) so that «تدري» does not act, in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ; «الكتاب» is the khabar, and the clause is in the position of accusative, standing in for the two objects of «تدري»; «ولا الإيمان» is conjoined to «الكتاب». (وَلكِنْ جَعَلْناهُ نُوراً نَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ نَشاءُ مِنْ عِبادِنا) The wāw is circumstantial or a conjunction; «لكن» is a particle of rectification, inoperative; «جعلناه»: a verb, an agent and an object; «نورا» is a second direct object; the clause «نهدي به» is an adjective of «نورا»; «من» is a direct object and the clause «نشاء» is a ṣila; «من عبادنا» is a ḥāl. (وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِي إِلى صِراطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ) The wāw is a conjunction; «إن» and its noun, and the shifted lām; the clause «تهدي» is the khabar; the object of «تهدي» is omitted, i.e. every responsible person; «إلى صراط مستقيم» is attached to «تهدي». (صِراطِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ ما فِي السَّماواتِ وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ) «صراط الله» is a badal of the first, a definite substitute for an indefinite; «الذي» is an adjective of «الله»; «وبه» is a fronted khabar [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the verse is «له»] and «ما» a postponed mubtadaʾ; «في السموات» is attached to an omitted element as the ṣila; «وما في الأرض» is conjoined to «ما في السموات». (أَلا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَصِيرُ الْأُمُورُ) «ألا» is a particle of alerting; «إلى الله» is attached to «تصير»; «الأمور» is the agent; what is meant by "becoming" here is permanence.

* Rhetoric:
These verses might take in what equals the pages that the whole sūra has taken up, but we shall be brief as far as possible while avoiding impairment. In his saying «يهب لمن يشاء إناثا ويهب لمن يشاء الذكور أو يزوّجهم» there is the art of soundness of division (ṣiḥḥat al-taqsīm), which has been touched on before: it is the speaker's exhausting all the parts of the meaning he has embarked upon, so that nothing of it is left out. For He, Glory be to Him, either singles out the servant with the gift of females, or with the gift of males, or with both together, or gives him nothing; so soundness of division occurs in this verse in the order that eloquence calls for, which is moving in the composition and arrangement of the speech from the lower to the higher: He put first the gift of females, moved to the gift of males, then to the gift of both together; in every part of the bestowal He used the word "gift", and singled out the sense of deprivation by postponing it, because His favouring His servants is more important to Him, and putting the more important first is necessary in all eloquent speech. The verse is brought only to reckon with the favours; He mentioned deprivation only so that praise might be completed by power over withholding as He is praised for giving, so that it is known that there is none to withhold what He gave and none to give what He withheld; and He turned from the word "deprivation" and "withholding" to a word that is its follower and companion, which is the word "making" (jaʿl). The like of it will come in Sūrat al-Wāqiʿa, with more detail; see it there.
Besides, there is the ṭibāq (antithesis) which is not hidden, as has often been discussed before.

* Benefits:
1- Before we give you an important grammatical rule, we give what the leading exegetes and grammarians said on the i'rab of his saying «وما كان لبشر أن يكلمه الله إلا وحيا» (the verse).
Here is a summary of what al-Zamakhsharī said:
It is not right for any human being that Allah speak to him except in three ways:
1- Either by way of revelation (waḥy), which is inspiration and casting into the heart or in a dream.
2- Or by making him hear His speech, which He creates in some body, without the hearer seeing who speaks to him, because He in His essence is not seen.
3- Or by sending him a messenger from among the angels.
Until he says: "«وحيا» and «أن يرسل» are two maṣdars standing in the place of a ḥāl, because «أن يرسل» is in the sense of «إرسالا», and «من وراء حجاب» is an adverbial also standing in place of a ḥāl, as in his saying, the Exalted, «وعلى جنوبهم»; and the implied form is: it is not right that He speak to anyone except as one who reveals, or makes himself heard from behind a veil, or sends" until he says: "As for the one who makes «وحيا» in the sense of «أن يوحي» and conjoins «يرسل» to it, on the meaning 'it is not for a human being that Allah speak to him except by revelation, i.e. by revealing or by sending', he must imply his saying «أو من وراء حجاب» in an implied form that corresponds to them, such as «أو أن يسمع من وراء حجاب». It has been read «أو يرسل رسولا فيوحي» with raising, on 'or He sends', or in the sense of «مرسلا», conjoined to «وحيا» in the sense of «موحيا»."
As for the wording of al-Samīn: "Nāfiʿ read «يرسل» with raising of the lām, and likewise «فيوحي» with its yāʾ silent; the rest read it with the accusative. As for the first reading, it has three aspects:
1- One: it is raised by an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. «أو هو يرسل».
2- Two: it is conjoined to «وحيا» as a ḥāl, because «وحيا» is also in the construction of a ḥāl, as though He had said «إلا موحيا أو مرسلا».
3- Three: it is conjoined to what «من وراء» is attached to, since its implied form is «أو يسمع من وراء حجاب», and «وحيا» is in the position of a ḥāl, conjoined to that implied element, to which «أو يرسل» is conjoined, the implied form being «إلا موحيا أو مسمعا من وراء حجاب أو مرسلا».
As for the second reading, it has three aspects: 1- One: that it be conjoined to the implied element to which «من وراء حجاب» is attached, since its implied form is «أو يكلمه من وراء حجاب», and this implied verb is conjoined to «وحيا», and the meaning is «except by revelation, or making heard from behind a veil, or sending a messenger»; it is not permissible to conjoin it to «يكلمه» because of the corruption of the meaning. I say: for the implied form would become 'it is not for a human being that Allah send him as a messenger', which is corrupt in wording and meaning. Makkī said: because it would entail the negation of messengers and the negation of those sent to.
2- Two: that it be put in the accusative by an implied «أن», it and what it puts in the accusative being conjoined to «وحيا», and «وحيا» being a ḥāl, so it is here also a ḥāl, the implied form being «إلا موحيا أو مرسلا».
3- Three: that it be conjoined to the meaning of «وحيا», which is a maṣdar construed with «أن» and the verb, the implied form being «إلا بأن يوحى إليه أو بأن يرسل»; Makkī and Abū al-Baqāʾ mentioned it.
As for his saying «أو من وراء حجاب»: the majority read it in the singular, and Ibn Abī ʿAbla read «حجب» in the plural; this preposition and its genitive noun is attached to an omitted element, its implied form being «أو يكلمه من وراء حجاب»; it has preceded that this verb is conjoined to the meaning of «وحيا», i.e. «إلا أن يوحي أو يكلمه». Abū al-Baqāʾ said: «It is not permissible to attach «من» to the «يكلمه» present in the wording, because what comes before the exception does not act on what comes after «إلا»»; then he said: ««من» is attached to «يكلمه» because it is an adverbial, and latitude is allowed with adverbials.»"
Abū al-Baqāʾ said: "It is not permissible that it be conjoined to «أن يكلمه», because its meaning would become 'it is not for a human being that Allah speak to him, nor that He send him a messenger', and that is corrupt."
2- Optional subjunctive of the imperfect verb: The imperfect verb is put in the accusative optionally by an implied «أن» after five particles: the prepositional lām, when it is not preceded by a negated past «kāna» (defective verb) and the verb is not joined with «لا»; if the lām is preceded by the said «kāna», the implying of «أن» is obligatory; and if the verb is joined with a negative or redundant emphatic «لا», it is obligatory to show it («أن»), so that two like letters, namely the lām of purpose and the lām of «لا», do not follow one another without assimilation, which is awkward in speech, as in «لئلا يكون للناس عليكم حجة» with the nūn assimilated into the negative «لا», and as in «لئلا يعلم أهل الكتاب» with the nūn assimilated into the redundant emphatic «لا»; and this lām is called the lām of purpose (lām kay), the lām of consequence and the lām of emphasis. The four remaining particles of the five after which «أن» is implied optionally are: «الواو», «أو», «ثم» and «الفاء», when the conjunction by them is upon a noun not construed with a verb, and it is of two kinds, a maṣdar and other than a maṣdar. Other than a maṣdar is like the saying of Ḥuṣayn ibn Humām al-Murrī:
ولولا رجال من رزام أعزة ... وآل سبيع أو أسوءك علقما
(Were it not for mighty men of Rizām and the family of Subayʿ, or I would grieve you, O ʿAlqama.)
«فأسوءك» is conjoined to «رجال», which is not construed with a verb; Rizām is a clan of Numayr, and «علقما» is a vocative with its end shortened (murakhkham). The maṣdar is like «وما كان لبشر أن يكلمه الله إلا وحيا أو من وراء حجاب أو يرسل رسولا» in the reading of other than Nāfiʿ with the accusative by an implied «أن» after «أو», the implied form being «إلا وحيا أو إرسالا», and «وحيا» is a maṣdar not construed with a verb; and the saying of Maysūn bint Baḥdal al-Kilābiyya, wife of Muʿāwiya ibn Abī Sufyān and mother of his son Yazīd:
ولبس عباءة وتقرّ عيني ... أحبّ إليّ من لبس الشفوف
(To wear a cloak and have my eye cool is dearer to me than wearing fine garments.)
«تقر» is put in the accusative by an implied «أن» optionally, and it and the verb are construed as a nominative maṣdar by conjunction upon «لبس» with the conjunctive wāw, on her words before it:
لبيت تخفق الأرواح فيه ... أحبّ إليّ من قصر منيف
(A house in which the winds flutter is dearer to me than a lofty palace.)
It is said «قرت عينه تقر» when its tears are rare, and that occurs only in joy, and it is derived from «القر» (cold); and it is said «سخنت» when its tears are hot, and that occurs only in sorrow. And his saying:
لولا توقع معتر فأرضيه ... ما كنت أوثر أترابا على أتراب
(Were it not for the expectation of a petitioner whom I would satisfy, I would not prefer some peers over others.)
«فأرضيه» is put in the accusative by an implied «أن» optionally after the fāʾ; «أن» and «أرضي» are construed as a maṣdar conjoined to «توقع», the implied form being «لولا توقع معتر فإرضائي إياه», and «توقع» is not construed with a verb; the «معتر» is the one who exposes himself to kindness, and the «أتراب» is the plural of «ترب» with kasra on the tāʾ, the one born with you at the time you were born and so equal to you in age; and the meaning is: were it not for expecting one who is turned away from doing kindness, and satisfying him, the poet would not have preferred one equal to others in age over one equal to him in his age. And the saying of Anas ibn Mudrika al-Khathʿamī:
إني وقتلي سليكا ثم أعقله ... كالثور يضرب لما عافت البقر
(I, and my killing Sulayk and then paying his blood-money, am like the bull that is struck when the cows refuse the water.)
«أعقله» is the imperfect of «عقل», put in the accusative by an implied «أن» optionally after «ثم»; «أن» and «أعقله» are construed as a maṣdar conjoined to «قتلي», the implied form being «وقتلي سليكا ثم عقلي إياه», and «قتلي» is not construed with a verb; «سليكا», a diminutive, is the name of a man, the object of «قتلي»; «كالثور» is the khabar of «إن»; by «الثور» is meant the male of the cattle, because the cattle follow him, so when he refuses the water they refuse it, and he is struck so that he goes to the water and they go with him; «أعقله» is from "I paid the blood-money for the slain man": I gave his diya. Abū al-ʿAlāʾ has an interesting opinion about the bull; he said it is the "bull of the algae", the one that rises above the water, so the cattle turn away from it, and so the owner of the cattle strikes it to clear the water and drink it; he said: he named it "bull" and mentioned it with the cattle to make a riddle of it for the hearer; but this is sheer affectation, and the first is correct.

[Translator's note: «ويقال سخنت ... وقوله» etc. are rendered as written; the verse of Maysūn is cited as in the source.]

His saying: {وَأَصْفَاكُم}: it may fall within the scope of the denunciation, conjoined to «اتَّخذ». It may also be a ḥāl, i.e. "or did He take, in this state", with «قد» implied according to the majority. A parallel has already been given before:

Onun sözü: {عِبَادُ الرحمن}: Nâfi', İbn Kesîr ve İbn Âmir «عند الرحمن» diye, zarf olarak okumuşlardır. Diğerleri «عبادَ» diye, «abd»in çoğulu olarak okumuşlardır; resm-i hat ikisine de ihtimal verir. El-A'meş de aynı şekilde okumuştur, yalnız «عبادَ»ı gizlenmiş bir fiille nasbetmiştir: «yaratılmış kullar olarak» ve benzeri. Abdullah (b. Mes'ûd) okumuştur; onun mushafında da böyledir: «الملائكةَ عبادَ الرحمن». Übey ve Abdurrahman tekil olarak okumuşlardır. «إناثاً» ise, itikat veya sözlü tasyîr mânâsındaki «ca'l»in ikinci mef'ûlüdür. Zeyd b. Alî «أُنُثا»yı, çoğulun çoğulu olarak okumuştur.
Onun sözü: «أشَهِدُوا»: Nâfi' fethalı bir hemze, sonra zammeli, hemze ile vâv arası teshîl edilmiş bir başka hemze ve şînin sükûnuyla okumuştur. Kâlûn med ile okumuştur; yani iki hemze arasına elif sokarak ve kasr ile, yani elif olmaksızın. Diğerleri tek hemzeden sonra şînin fethasıyla okumuşlardır. Nâfi' tevbîh hemzesini, dörtlü ve meçhul bir fiil olan «أُشْهِدوا»ya sokmuş, ikinci hemzeyi teshîl etmiş, ikisinin birleşmesini hoş görmediğinden aralarına elif koymuştur; bazen ise sadece ikinci hemzenin teshîliyle yetinip elif koymamıştır; bu ikincisi daha güzeldir. Diğerleri inkâr hemzesini üçlü «شهدوا»ya sokmuşlardır; buradaki şehâdet «hazır bulunmak»tır. Eş-Şeyh, Nâfi'den ikinci hemzenin teshîlini nakletmemiş, bunu Alî b. Ebî Tâlib'den nakletmiştir.
Ez-Zührî «أُشْهِدُوا»yı dörtlü ve meçhul olarak okumuştur. Bunda iki vecih vardır: Birincisi, diğer okuyuşun delâleti sebebiyle hemzenin hazfedilmiş olması; «أعجميٌّ» okuyuşunda daha önce geçtiği gibi. İkincisi: Cümlenin haber cümlesi olması ve «إناثاً»ın sıfatı olarak gelmesi; yani «Onları, yaratılışlarına öyle şahit olunmuş dişiler mi kıldılar?»
Onun sözü: «سَتُكْتَبُ شهادتُهم»: Okuyucuların çoğunluğu «سَتُكْتَبُ»yi üstten tâ ile, meçhul olarak; «شهادتُهم»i ise nâib-i fâil olduğu için ref' ile okumuştur. El-Hasen «شهاداتُهم»i çoğul okumuştur; ez-Zührî ise «سَيَكتب»i alttan yâ ile okumuştur; geri kalanda çoğunluk gibidir. İbn Abbâs, Zeyd b. Alî, Ebû Ca'fer ve Ebû Hayve ise azamet nûnuyla «سنكتبُ», «شهادتَهم»i mef'ûlün bih olarak nasb ile okumuşlardır.

His saying: {وَزُخْرُفاً}: it may be accusative by «جَعَلَ», i.e. "and We made for them ornament". Al-Zamakhsharī allowed it to be accusative by conjunction to the position of «مِنْ فضة», as if it were said: "roofs of silver and gold", i.e. some of them thus and some of them thus.

The disagreement over «لَمَّا», lightened and doubled, has already been given in Sūrat Hūd. Abū Rajāʾ and Abū Ḥaywa read «لِما» with kasra on the lām, as the lām of cause entering the relative «ما» with its returning pronoun omitted, though the ṣila is not long. The original is: "that which is enjoyment", like {تَمَاماً عَلَى الذي أَحْسَنَ} [al-Anʿām: 154] with nominative on the nūn. «إنْ» is the lightened form of the heavy, «كل» is a mubtadaʾ, and the prepositional phrase after it is its khabar, i.e. "all that was mentioned before is for that which is the enjoyment of life". The right way would have been for the distinguishing lām to enter, because it is not made to govern, except that when the evidence indicated the affirmation, omitting it was permitted, as the poet omitted it in his saying:

3992 - I am the son of those who refuse humiliation, of the house of Mālik ... and indeed Mālik was of noble mines

His saying: {إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ}: al-Zamakhsharī said: "If you ask: how is it permitted for «لَمَّا» to be answered by the sudden «إذا»? I say: because the verb of suddenness is implied with it, and it is the accusative-assigning agent in its position, as if it were said: 'When he came to them with Our signs, they were suddenly surprised at the time of their laughter.'" Al-Shaykh said: "We do not know anything like what he went to, that the sudden «إذا» is accusative by an implied verb, its implied form being 'surprised'. Rather the schools are three: either it is a particle and needs no governing agent, or an adverbial of place, or an adverbial of time. If a khabar is mentioned after the noun that follows it, it is accusative as an adverbial, and the governing agent in it is that khabar, like «خرجتُ فإذا زيدٌ قائمٌ», its implied form being: 'I went out, and in the place where I went out Zayd is standing', or 'in the time when I went out Zayd is standing'. If no khabar is mentioned after the noun, or / a noun accusative as ḥāl is mentioned: if the noun is a body and we say it is an adverbial of place, the matter is clear, like «خرجْتُ فإذا الأسدُ», i.e. 'in the presence is the lion', or «فإذا الأسدُ رابضاً». If we say it is an adverbial of time, it is on the omission of a muḍāf, so that time is not predicated of a body, like «خَرَجْتُ فإذا الأسدُ», i.e. 'in the time is the presence of the lion'. If the noun is an event, it may be a place or time, and there is no need to imply a muḍāf, like «خرجْتُ فإذا القتالُ»; if you wish you may imply 'in the presence is the fighting', or 'in the time is the fighting'." In this there is condensation and a great addition of examples; I saw that leaving them out would be damaging.

His saying: {إِلاَّ هِيَ أَكْبَرُ}: a sentence occurring as an adjective of His saying «مِنْ آية», so its position is judged genitive in view of the wording, and accusative in view of the position. In the meaning of His saying {أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا} there are several views. The first, said by Ibn ʿAṭiyya: that they regard the sign that comes as great because of the newness of its matter and its occurrence, since they had grown used to the preceding sign, so the matter of the second becomes great and grows. This is as he said:

3999 - Though wounds heal, we are only charged ... with the nearer, even if what has passed was grave

The second, mentioned by some: that the meaning is "except that it is greater than its preceding sister", the adjective being omitted because it is known. The third, al-Zamakhsharī said: "If you ask: this is contradictory speech, because its meaning is: there is no sign among the nine except that it is greater than every one of them, so each one would be both superior and inferior in one state. I say: the aim of this speech is to describe them as great such that they hardly differ in it. Such is the habit with things that are close in merit to a slight degree: people's opinions differ in ranking them, so some prefer this one and some prefer that, and perhaps the opinions of one person differ about them, as in the saying of the Ḥamāsī poet:

4000 - Whomever of them you meet you say, 'I met their chief' ... like the stars by which the night traveller is guided

And the Anmārī woman said about all her sons: 'May I be bereaved of them if I know which of them is best; they are like a hollow ring, one cannot tell where its two ends are.'" End of his words. The beginning of it is very harsh, as if the expressions were too narrow for him until he said what he said; though his answer is good, his question is harsh. The disagreement over {ياأيها الساحر} has already been given in al-Nūr.

His saying: {مَثَلاً}: either a second object, if it has the sense of "made", otherwise a ḥāl.

His saying: «يَصِدُّون»: Nāfiʿ, Ibn ʿĀmir and al-Kisāʾī read «يَصُدُّون» with ḍamma on the ṣād. The others read it with kasra. It was said that they have one meaning, and that is the correct view, and the wording is said: ṣadda yaṣiddu and yaṣuddu, like ʿakafa yaʿkifu and yaʿkufu, and yaʿrushu and yaʿrishu. It was also said that the ḍamma is from al-ṣudūd, which is turning away. Ibn ʿAbbās denied the ḍamma, though it was reported to him from ʿAlī, may Allah be pleased with them both, and Allah knows best, before it reached the level of tawātur.

Onun sözü: {وَقِيلِهِ}: Hamza ile Âsım cer ile okumuştur. Diğerleri nasb ile. Cere gelince iki vecih vardır: Birincisi: «الساعة»ya atıftır; yani «onun katında onun sözünün ilmi vardır», yani Muhammed'in veya Îsâ'nın (aleyhimesselâm) sözünün. «El-kavl», «el-kāl» ve «el-kīl» bir mânâdadır; masdarlar bu vezinlerde gelmiştir. İkincisi: Vâv yemin vâvıdır. Cevap ya hazfedilmiştir, takdiri: «Mutlaka yardım göreceksiniz» veya «onlara dilediğimi mutlaka yaparım»; ya da zikredilmiştir, o da {إِنَّ هؤلاء قَوْمٌ لاَّ يُؤْمِنُونَ} sözüdür. Bunu ez-Zemahşerî zikretmiştir.
Nasb okuyuşuna gelince, sekiz vecih vardır: Birincisi: «الساعة»nın mahalline mansûb olması; sanki şöyle denmiştir: «O, kıyameti bilir ve onun şöyle şöyle sözünü bilir.» İkincisi: «سِرَّهم ونجواهم»ya atfedilmesi; yani «onların sırlarını ve fısıldaşmalarını işitmiyoruz ve onun sözünü işitmiyoruz». Üçüncüsü: «يكتُبون»un hazfedilmiş mef'ûlüne atıftır; yani «bunu yazarlar ve onun sözünü de şöyle yazarlar». Dördüncüsü: «يعلمون»un hazfedilmiş mef'ûlüne atıftır; yani «bunu bilirler ve onun sözünü bilirler». Beşincisi: Masdar olması; yani «sözünü söyledi». Altıncısı: Gizlenmiş bir fiille nasbedilmesi; yani «Allah, Elçisi'nin sözünü bilir» ki o Muhammed'dir (sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellem). Yedincisi: «بالحق»nin mahalline mansûb olması; yani «hakka ve onun sözüne şahitlik etti». Sekizincisi: Yemin harfinin hazfi üzere nasbedilmesi; şu söz gibi:
4012 -. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ... فذاك أمانةَ اللَّهِ الثَّريدُ
(Mânâ: «…İşte Allah'ın emaneti hakkı için, o, serîddir (et suyuna doğranmış ekmek yemeği)dir.»)
El-A'rac, Ebû Kılâbe, Mücâhid ve el-Hasen ref' ile okumuşlardır; bunda vecihler vardır: [Birincisi:] «علمُ الساعةِ»ye atfen ref'tir; bir muzâf takdiriyle, yani «ve onun katında onun sözünün ilmi vardır»; sonra o hazfedilmiş ve bu onun yerine konmuştur. İkincisi: İbtidâ ile merfû olması; «يا رب» ve sonrası olan cümle haberdir. Üçüncüsü: Mübtedâdır, haberi hazfedilmiştir; takdiri: «ve onun şöyle şöyle sözü işitilir/kabul edilir» (وقيلُه كيتَ وكيتَ مَسْموعٌ أو مُتَقَبَّلٌ). Dördüncüsü: Mübtedâ olmasıdır ve aslı yemindir; «ايمُنُ الله» ve «لَعَمْرُ الله» demeleri gibi; haberi hazfedilmiştir ve cevap daha önce geçtiği gibidir. Bunu ez-Zemahşerî de zikretmiştir.
Bir cemaat nasb okuyuşunu tercih etmiştir. En-Nehhâs dedi: «Açık okuyuş nasb iledir ve iki yönden: Birincisi, mansûb ile ona atfedilen arasındaki ayrımın göz yumulmuş olması; mahfûd ile ona atfedilen arasında ise böyle değildir. İkincisi: te'vil ehlinin tefsirinin nasb mânâsında oluşu.» Ben derim ki: Sanki Ebû Ubeyde'nin söylediğini kastediyor; dedi ki: «Tefsirde ancak şöyledir: Yoksa onların sırlarını ve fısıldaşmalarını işitmediğimizi, onun "Ey Rabbim" sözünü de işitmediğimizi mi sanıyorlar?» Ez-Zemahşerî önceki vecihlerden hiçbirini beğenmemiş, üç okuyuşta da yemin olmasını tercih etmiştir; bunun tahkiki geçmiştir.
Ebû Kılâbe «يا رَبَّ»i bâ'nın fethasıyla okumuştur; yâ'nın elife çevrilmesi, sonra fethayla yetinilerek elifin hazfedilmesiyle; şu söz gibi:
4013 -. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ... بلَهْفَ ولا بِلَيْتَ. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
(Beyit kesik nakledilmiştir; «…ne "ah" ile, ne "keşke" ile…»)
El-Ahfeş bunu kıyas edilebilir kılmıştır.

* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for the interrogative of denial (istifhām inkārī). (الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (من) relative noun, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being يجعلون [Note: i.e.: do they make one who is brought up ... a child? It is also permissible for the relative noun to be a mubtadaʾ (subject) with the khabar (predicate) omitted, i.e.: أو من ينشّأ.. ولد.], and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the verb (ينشأ) is a pronoun referring to (من). (في الحلية) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ينشّأ). (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (في الخصام) attached to (مبين) [Note: It is not prohibited here for the muḍāf ilayhi to govern what precedes it, because the muḍāf is the word غير, which has the sense of negation..]..
The clause «(يجعلون) من ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: They permitted its being conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.: do they dare and make one who is brought up ...].
The clause «ينشّأ ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «هو ... غير مبين» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

* İ'rab:
(الواو) isti'nâfiyyedir. (لولا) cezmetmeyen şart harfidir. (أن) masdar ve nasb harfidir..
Müevvel masdar (أن يكون), bir muzâfın hazfıyla ref' mahallinde mübtedâdır; yani: «İnsanların küfür üzere tek bir ümmet olmasının hoş görülmemesi olmasaydı ...», yani küfür üzerinde birleşmeleri.-
Mübtedânın haberi mahzûftur.
(اللام) لولا'nın cevabını şarta bağlayan (râbıta) harftir. (لمن) ikinci mef'ûlün bih olan mahzûfa müteallik. (بالرحمن) (يكفر)'a müteallik. (لبيوتهم) cer harfinin tekrarıyla ism-i mevsûlden bedeldir; bu, bedel-i iştimâldir. (من فضّة) birinci mef'ûl olan (سقفا)'nın sıfatıdır. (معارج) vâv ile (سقفا)'ya ma'tûf olup mansûbdur; müntehe'l-cumû' sîgasında bir çoğul olduğu için tenvînden men edilmiştir. (عليها) (يظهرون)'a müteallik.
«لولا أن يكون ... (isim cümlesi)» isti'nâfiyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
«يكون الناس أمّة ...» cümlesi gizli (muzmar) harfî mevsûl (أن)'in sılası olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
[Mütercim notu: Kaynakta burada (أن) «gizli (muzmar)» olarak nitelenmiştir; ayette أن açıkça zikredilmiştir.]
«جعلنا ...» cümlesi cezmetmeyen şartın cevabı olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
«يكفر ...» cümlesi (من) ism-i mevsûlünün sılası olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
«يظهرون» cümlesi معارج'in sıfatı olarak nasb mahallindedir.
34- (الواو) atıf harfidir. (لبيوتهم أبوابا ... يتّكئون), لبيوتهم سقفا ... يظهرون gibidir ve ona ma'tûftur.
«يتّكئون» cümlesi (سررا)'nın sıfatı olarak nasb mahallindedir [Dipnot: (سررا)'nın takdiri «جعلنا» olan mahzûf bir fiilin mef'ûlün bihi olması da caizdir.. Bu durumda cümle birinci (جعلنا)'ya atfedilir.].
[Mütercim notu: Kaynakta 35. ayet için ayrı bir numara verilmemiştir; aşağıdaki kısım 35. ayete aittir.]
(الواو) atıf harfidir. (زخرفا) takdiri «جعلنا» olan mahzûf bir fiilin mef'ûlün bihidir [Dipnot: Nez'u'l-hâfıd ile mansûb olup (من فضّة)'ya ma'tûf olması da caizdir; yani «من فضّة ومن زخرف» —yani altından— ...]. (الواو) isti'nâfiyyedir. (إن) nefy harfidir. (لمّا) إلّا anlamında hasr içindir. (متاع) mübtedânın haberidir. (كلّ) merfûdur. (الواو) atıf harfidir. (عند) mansûb zarf olup (المتّقين)'e müteallik. (للمتّقين) (الآخرة) mübtedâsının haberine müteallik..
«(جعلنا) زخرفا ...» cümlesi cevâbü'ş-şart cümlesine ma'tûf olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
«إن كلّ ذلك لمّا متاع ...» cümlesi isti'nâfiyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.
«الآخرة ... للمتّقين» cümlesi إن كلّ ذلك ... cümlesine ma'tûf olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur.

* Sarf:
(33) فضّة: Bilinen maden için câmid isimdir; vezni kesre ve sükûn ile فعلة'dir.
(معارج): معرج'in çoğuludur; sülâsî عرج fiilinden kıyasa aykırı olarak ism-i âlettir; mîmin fethasıyla مفعل veznindedir; kıyasa uygun olarak mîmin kesresiyle de olabilir.

* Fevâid:
1- Ağır (şeddeli) olandan hafifletilmiş (إن)..
Bu ayette Allah Teâlâ'nın وَإِنْ كُلُّ ذلِكَ لَمَّا مَتاعُ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا kavli gelmiştir. Buradaki (إن), ağır olandan hafifletilmiştir ve amelsiz bırakılmıştır (ihmal edilmiştir); (إنّ) gibi amel etmemiştir. Aşağıda hükmünü ayrıntılı olarak açıklayacağız:
1- Ağırdan hafifletilmiş إن, isim ve fiil cümlelerinin her ikisinin başına gelir. İsim cümlesinin başına gelirse, Kûfelilerin aksine, amel ettirilmesi caizdir. Kur'ân-ı Kerîm'de amel ettirildiği gelmiştir; Haremeyn kurrâsının ve Ebû Bekr'in (وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ) kıraatinde ve Sîbeveyh'in naklettiği (إن عمرا لمنطلق) sözünde olduğu gibi. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta ayet, hafifletilmiş إن ile değil, şeddeli «وَإِنَّ» ile yazılmıştır.] Çoğunlukla ihmal edilir; nahivcilerin birçoğu bu görüştedir; Allah Teâlâ'nın وَإِنْ كُلُّ ذلِكَ لَمَّا مَتاعُ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا ve وَإِنْ كُلٌّ لَمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَدَيْنا مُحْضَرُونَ kavillerinde, Hafs'ın (إن هذان لساحران) kıraatinde ve Allah Teâlâ'nın وَإِنْ كادُوا لَيَفْتِنُونَكَ kavlinde olduğu gibi.
2- Fiilin başına gelirse ihmal edilmesi vâciptir. Fiilin çoğunlukla nâsih bir mâzî fiil olması gerekir; (وَإِنْ كانَتْ لَكَبِيرَةً) ve (إِنْ وَجَدْنا أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَفاسِقِينَ) gibi. Nâsih bir muzâri fiil olarak da gelebilir; Allah Teâlâ'nın (وَإِنْ يَكادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ) kavlinde olduğu gibi. إن geldiğinde ve ondan sonra fethalı lâm bulunduğunda, onun aslının şeddeli olduğuna hükmet.
2- Dünya metâı azdır..
Bu ayet dünyanın çabuk yok olduğunu, nimetinin sona erdiğini ve âhiretin daha hayırlı ve daha kalıcı olduğunu açıklamıştır.
Sehl b. Sa'd'dan şöyle rivayet edilmiştir: Rasûlullah (s.a.v.) buyurdu: «Eğer dünya Allah katında bir sivrisineğin kanadı kadar değer taşısaydı, ondan bir kâfire bir yudum su içirmezdi.» Bunu Tirmizî rivayet etmiş
ve «hasen garîb bir hadistir» demiştir.
Fihroğulları'nın atası Müstevrid b. Şeddâd'dan şöyle rivayet edilmiştir: «Rasûlullah (s.a.v.) ile birlikte ölü bir oğlağın (keçi yavrusunun) yanında duran kafilede idim. Rasûlullah (s.a.v.) buyurdu:
"Bunun, sahipleri onu attıklarında onlara değersiz geldiğini görüyor musunuz?" "Ey Allah'ın Rasûlü, değersizliğinden dolayı onu attılar" dediler. Buyurdu ki: "İşte dünya Allah katında, bu koyunun sahiplerine olan değersizliğinden daha değersizdir."» Bunu Tirmizî rivayet etmiş
ve şöyle demiştir:
«Hasen bir hadistir.»

* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (لولا) a non-jussive conditional particle. (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يكون) is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e.: "were it not for the dislike of people being one community upon disbelief ...", i.e. that they should unite upon disbelief.
The khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ is omitted.
(اللام) linking the apodosis of لولا to the condition. (لمن) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بالرحمن) attached to (يكفر). (لبيوتهم) badal (substitute) of the relative noun with the preposition repeated, and it is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl). (من فضّة) naʿt (adjective) of the first object (سقفا). (معارج) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (سقفا) by the wāw, accusative (manṣūb), prevented from nunation because it is a plural on the pattern of the furthest plurals (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ). (عليها) attached to (يظهرون).
The clause «لولا أن يكون ... (the nominal one)» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يكون الناس أمّة ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن). [Translator's note: the source says "implied" (المضمر), although أن is overt in this verse.]
The clause «جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يكفر ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «يظهرون» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of معارج.
34- (الواو) conjunction. (لبيوتهم أبوابا ... يتّكئون) is like لبيوتهم سقفا ... يظهرون, and conjoined to it.
The clause «يتّكئون» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (سررا) [Note: (سررا) may be the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being جعلنا.. in which case the clause is conjoined to the first (جعلنا).].
(الواو) conjunction. (زخرفا) mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being جعلنا [Note: It may be accusative by removal of the preposition, conjoined to (من فضّة), i.e. of silver and of زخرف — i.e. of gold ...]. (الواو) resumptive. (إن) a particle of negation. (لمّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr), meaning إلّا. (متاع) khabar of the mubtadaʾ (كلّ), nominative. (الواو) conjunction. (عند) an accusative adverb (ẓarf) attached to (المتّقين) [Translator's note: so in the source; the adverb would be attached to the following للمتّقين or to the khabar.]. (للمتّقين) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الآخرة)..
The clause «(جعلنا) زخرفا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «إن كلّ ذلك لمّا متاع ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «الآخرة ... للمتّقين» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إن كلّ ذلك ...

* Morphology:
(33) فضّة: a non-derived (jāmid) noun for the well-known metal; its pattern is فعلة, with kasra then sukūn.
(معارج) plural of معرج, a noun of instrument (ism āla) from the triliteral عرج, irregularly (ʿalā ghayr al-qiyās), on the pattern مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm; it may be regular, with kasra on it.

* Benefits:
1- (إن) lightened from the heavy (inna)..
In this verse occurs the saying of Allah the Exalted وَإِنْ كُلُّ ذلِكَ لَمَّا مَتاعُ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا; (إن) here is lightened from the heavy, and it has been left non-governing (muhmala), not governing like (إنّ). We will explain its ruling in detail below:
1- إن lightened from the heavy enters both kinds of sentence, the nominal and the verbal. If it enters the nominal, it may govern — contrary to the Kufans — and its governing has occurred in the Noble Qur'an, as in the reading of the two Ḥaramī readers (al-Ḥaramiyyān) and Abū Bakr (وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ) [Translator's note: the source prints the nūn of إن with shadda here, although the reading cited is the lightened one.], and what Sībawayh reported: (إن عمرا لمنطلق). Its being left non-governing is frequent, and this is the position of many grammarians, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted وَإِنْ كُلُّ ذلِكَ لَمَّا مَتاعُ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا and وَإِنْ كُلٌّ لَمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَدَيْنا مُحْضَرُونَ, and the reading of Ḥafṣ: (إن هذان لساحران), and the saying of Allah the Exalted وَإِنْ كادُوا لَيَفْتِنُونَكَ.
2- If it enters a verb, it must be left non-governing, and most often the verb is an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, e.g. (وَإِنْ كانَتْ لَكَبِيرَةً) and (إِنْ وَجَدْنا أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَفاسِقِينَ). It may come as an abrogating imperfect verb, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted (وَإِنْ يَكادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ). Whenever إن occurs followed by the lām with fatḥa, judge that its origin is with shadda.
2- The enjoyment of this world is little..
This verse has made clear the swiftness of this world's passing away and the ending of its pleasures, and that the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
From Sahl ibn Saʿd, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If this world weighed with Allah as much as the wing of a gnat, He would not give a disbeliever a single drink of water from it." Narrated by al-Tirmidhī,
who said: a ḥasan gharīb hadith.
From al-Mustawrid ibn Shaddād, the ancestor of Banū Fihr, who said: I was among the riders who stopped with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the dead السخلة (the kid of a goat), and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
"Do you see how this became worthless to its owners when they threw it away?" They said: "It was because of its worthlessness that they threw it away, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "This world is more worthless to Allah than this sheep is to its owners." Narrated by al-Tirmidhī,
who said:
a ḥasan hadith.

* İ'rab:
(عباد) mansûb muzâf münâdâ olup nasb alâmeti, hafiflik için hazfedilen mütekellim yâsından önceki harf üzerindeki takdîrî fethadır (لا) amel etmeyen (mühmel) nefy harfi [Dipnot: Yahut leyse'nin amelini yapar; خوف onun ismi, عليكم onun haberidir.], (خوف) mübtedâ, merfû [Dipnot: Nekra, nefye dayanmaktadır.], (عليكم) mübtedânın haberine müteallik (اليوم) mansûb zarf olup mahzûf habere müteallik (الواو) atıf harfi (لا) nefyi te'kîd için zâide olup tekrarı vâciptir (أنتم تحزنون) خوف عليكم gibidir..
«يا عباد ...» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli olmayan isti'nâfiyye cümledir [Dipnot: Yahut takdîrî bir kavlin mekûlü'l-kavli olarak nasb mahallindedir.].
«لا خوف عليكم ...» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; nidânın cevabıdır.
«أنتم تحزنون» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; لا خوف عليكم cümlesine ma'tûftur.
69- (الذين) ism-i mevsûl olup عبادي'nin sıfatı olarak nasb mahallinde (بآياتنا) (آمنوا)'ya müteallik, (الواو) atıf harfi -yahut hâliyye-.
«آمنوا ...» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; mevsûl (الذين)'in sılasıdır.
«كانوا مسلمين ...» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; sılaya ma'tûftur [Dipnot: Yahut آمنوا'nın fâilinden hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir.].
70- (أنتم) ayrı zamir olup mübtedâ olarak ref' mahallinde; ona vâv ile (أزواجكم) atfedilmiştir.
O da merfûdur ... (تحبرون)'daki vâv nâib-i fâildir.
«ادخلوا ...» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; nidânın kapsamı içinde bir isti'nâftır.
«أنتم ... تحبرون» cümlesi ادخلوا'nın fâilinden hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir.
«تحبرون» cümlesi mübtedâ (أنتم)'ün haberi olarak ref' mahallindedir.
71- (عليهم) meçhul (يطاف) fiilinin nâib-i fâili, (بصحاف) (يطاف)'a müteallik, (من ذهب) (صحاف)'ın sıfatına müteallik, (الواو) atıf harfi (فيها) mübtedâ (ما)'nın mukaddem haberine müteallik; ikinci (فيها) (خالدون)'a müteallik.
«يطاف عليهم» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; beyânî isti'nâftır [Dipnot: Yahut takdîrî bir şartın cevabıdır; yani: إذا دخلوها يطاف عليهم.. Bazıları onu الجنّة'den hâl yapmayı caiz görmüştür; içindeki râbıt takdîrî olup takdiri «فيها»dır.].
«فيها ما تشتهيه الأنفس» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; يطاف cümlesine ma'tûftur.
«تشتهيه الأنفس ...» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; mevsûl (ما)'nın sılasıdır.
«تلذّ الأعين ...» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; تشتهيه الأنفس cümlesine ma'tûftur.
«أنتم فيها خالدون» cümlesi أنتم ... تحبرون cümlesine ma'tûf olarak nasb mahallindedir; ikisi arasındaki kısım iltifat ihtiva eden bir i'tirazdır [Dipnot: İltifat takdiriyle (عليهم)'deki zamirden hâl olması caizdir.].
72- (الواو) atıf harfi (تلك) ism-i işaret olup mübtedâ, haberi لكم فيها فواكه cümlesidir [Mütercim notu: Âyetin (73) metni «لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ»dir; kaynak burada «فواكه» yazmıştır.]..
(التي) ism-i mevsûl olup الجنّة'nin sıfatı, merfû; (أورثتموها)'daki muhatap zamiri nâib-i fâildir, vâv mîmin harekesini doyurmak (işbâ') için zâidedir, gâib zamiri mef'ûlün bihtir (ما) masdariyye [Dipnot: Yahut cer mahallinde ism-i mevsûldür; âid zamir mahzûftur, ondan sonraki cümle sıladır.].
(ما كنتم تعملون) müevvel masdarı sebebiyye bâsıyla cer mahallinde olup (أورثتموها)'ya müteallik.
«تلك الجنّة ...» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; nidânın cevabına ma'tûftur.
«أورثتموها ...» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; mevsûl (التي)'nin sılasıdır.
«كنتم تعملون» cümlesi i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; harf-mevsûl (ما)'nın sılasıdır.
«تعملون» cümlesi كنتم'ün haberi olarak nasb mahallindedir.
73- (لكم) mukaddem habere müteallik (فيها) mahzûf habere müteallik (فاكهة) muahhar mübtedâ, merfû (منها) (تأكلون) fiiline müteallik.
«لكم فيها فاكهة ...» cümlesi mübtedâ تلك'in haberi olarak ref' mahallindedir.
«تأكلون ...» cümlesi فاكهة'nin sıfatı olarak ref' mahallindedir.

* Sarf:
(71) صحاف: صحفة'nin cemi; büyük kap için câmid isimdir, vezni فعلة olup fethalı, sonra sükûnludur; صحاف'ın vezni ise fâ harfi kesreli فعال'dır.
(أكواب): كوب'un cemi; kulpu olmayan kadeh için câmid isimdir, vezni فعل olup dammeli, sonra sükûnludur; أكواب'ın vezni أفعال'dır -kıllet cemi-.

* Belâgat:
1- Îcâz: Allah Teâlâ'nın «وَفِيها ما تَشْتَهِيهِ الْأَنْفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْأَعْيُنُ» kavlinde.
Bu, nimet çeşitlerinin hasridir; çünkü nimetler ya kalplerde arzulanır ya da gözlerde lezzet verir.
Rasûlullah (s.a.v.) bir bedeviye şöyle demiştir: «Allah seni cennete koyarsa, orada nefsinin arzuladığını ve gözünün lezzet aldığını bulursun.»
2- İstiâre-i tebeiyye: Allah Teâlâ'nın «وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي أُورِثْتُمُوها» kavlinde.
Güzel amelleriyle hak ettikleri cenneti ve onlar için kalıcı olan nimetlerini, kişinin vârisine bıraktığı mülk ve rızıklara benzetmiştir; bundan amelin kendisinin de mûris'e (ism-i fâil, miras bırakana) benzetilmesi lâzım gelir. Böylece miras, hak ettikleri şey için istiâre edilmiş, sonra ondan أورثتموها türetilmiştir; dolayısıyla burada istiâre-i tebeiyye vardır.
Mirasın, elde etme ve alma için mecâz-ı mürsel olduğu da söylenmiştir.

* Fevâid:
- Allah'ın fazlı ve ihsanı..
Allah Sübhânehû bu âyette cennet nimetlerini beyan etmiştir; orada nefislerin arzuladığı ve gözlerin lezzet aldığı şeyler vardır.
Ebû Hüreyre'den -Allah ondan razı olsun- gelen hadiste şöyle denmiştir: Rasûlullah (s.a.v.) buyurdu: Allah Teâlâ buyurdu ki: «Salih kullarım için hiçbir gözün görmediği, hiçbir kulağın işitmediği ve hiçbir beşerin kalbinden geçmeyen şeyler hazırladım. Dilerseniz «فَلا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ ما أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ» âyetini okuyun.» Müttefekun aleyh.
Ebû Hüreyre'den -Allah ondan razı olsun- şöyle dediği rivayet edilmiştir: Rasûlullah (s.a.v.) buyurdu: «Cennete giren ilk zümre, dolunay gecesindeki ay suretindedir; sonra onları takip edenler, gökteki en parlak inci gibi yıldız (kevkeb-i dürrî) gibidir. Bevletmezler, büyük abdest yapmazlar, tükürmezler, sümkürmezler; tarakları altın, terleri misktir; buhurdanlıkları uluvvedir (güzel kokulu öd ağacı); eşleri iri gözlü hurilerdir.
Hepsi tek bir adamın yaratılışı üzere, babaları Âdem'in suretindedir; göğe doğru altmış zirâ'dır.» Müttefekun aleyh. Buhârî ve Müslim'in bir rivayetinde: «Oradaki kapları altın, oradaki terleri misktir; her birinin iki eşi vardır, güzelliklerinden baldırlarının iliği etin arkasından görünür. Aralarında ihtilaf ve birbirine buğz yoktur. Kalpleri tek bir adamın kalbi gibidir; sabah akşam Allah'ı tesbih ederler.»
Ebû Saîd el-Hudrî'den -Allah ondan razı olsun- Hz. Peygamber'in (s.a.v.) şöyle buyurduğu rivayet edilmiştir: «Cennette bir ağaç vardır ki, idmanlı, hızlı, cins bir ata binen süvari yüz yıl yol alsa onu geçemez.»
Müttefekun aleyh.
Ebû Hüreyre'den -Allah ondan razı olsun- şöyle dediği rivayet edilmiştir: Rasûlullah (s.a.v.) buyurdu: «Cennet ehli cennete girdiğinde bir münâdî şöyle seslenir: Sizin için sıhhatli olmak vardır, artık asla hastalanmayacaksınız; sizin için yaşamak vardır, artık asla ölmeyeceksiniz; sizin için genç olmak vardır, artık asla yaşlanmayacaksınız; sizin için nimetlenmek vardır, artık asla sıkıntı çekmeyeceksiniz.» Müslim rivayet etmiştir.

* I'rab:
(عباد) a muḍāf vocative (munādā), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which is deleted for lightness; (لا) negative, non-governing (muhmala) [Note: Or governing like ليس, with خوف as its noun and عليكم as its khabar.]; (خوف) a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: The indefinite noun relies on a negation.]; (عليكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (اليوم) an accusative adverb, attached to the omitted khabar; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to reinforce the negation, its repetition being obligatory; (أنتم تحزنون) like خوف عليكم.
The clause «يا عباد ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: Or in the position of accusative as the object of an implied speech verb.].
The clause «لا خوف عليكم ...» has no grammatical position: answer to the vocative.
The clause «أنتم تحزنون» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause لا خوف عليكم.
69- (الذين) a relative noun in the position of accusative as naʿt (adjective) of عبادي; (بآياتنا) attached to (آمنوا); (الواو) conjunction — or circumstantial —.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «كانوا مسلمين ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila [Note: Or in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of آمنوا.].
70- (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (أزواجكم) is conjoined to it by the wāw, and it is nominative ... The wāw in (تحبرون) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «ادخلوا ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the vocative.
The clause «أنتم ... تحبرون» is in the position of accusative as ḥāl of the fāʿil of ادخلوا.
The clause «تحبرون» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم).
71- (عليهم) the nāʾib fāʿil of the passive (يطاف); (بصحاف) attached to (يطاف); (من ذهب) attached to a naʿt of (صحاف); (الواو) conjunction; (فيها) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما); and the second (فيها) is attached to (خالدون).
The clause «يطاف عليهم» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: Or it is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: when they enter it, there will be passed around them.. Some permitted making it a ḥāl of الجنّة, the link in it being implied, its implied form being "فيها".].
The clause «فيها ما تشتهيه الأنفس» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يطاف.
The clause «تشتهيه الأنفس ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «تلذّ الأعين ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تشتهيه الأنفس.
The clause «أنتم فيها خالدون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause أنتم ... تحبرون, what lies between them being a parenthesis containing iltifāt (shift of person) [Note: It may be a ḥāl of the pronoun in (عليهم), on the assumption of iltifāt.].
72- (الواو) conjunction; (تلك) a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is the clause لكم فيها فواكه [Translator's note: the source writes فواكه here; the verse has فاكهة.].
(التي) a relative noun, a nominative naʿt of الجنّة; the second-person pronoun in (أورثتموها) is the nāʾib fāʿil, the wāw is redundant, a lengthening (ishbāʿ) of the vowel of the mīm, and the third-person pronoun is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ما) maṣdar-forming [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, the resumptive pronoun being omitted and the clause after it being the ṣila.].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كنتم تعملون) is in the position of genitive by the causal bāʾ, attached to (أورثتموها).
The clause «تلك الجنّة ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أورثتموها ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (التي).
The clause «كنتم تعملون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «تعملون» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كنتم.
73- (لكم) attached to a fronted khabar; (فيها) attached to the omitted khabar; (فاكهة) a nominative delayed mubtadaʾ; (منها) attached to the verb (تأكلون).
The clause «لكم فيها فاكهة ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ تلك.
The clause «تأكلون ...» is in the position of nominative as naʿt of فاكهة.

* Morphology:
(71) صحاف: plural of صحفة, a primitive (jāmid) noun for a large vessel; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn, and the pattern of صحاف is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ.
(أكواب): plural of كوب, a primitive noun for a cup that has no handle; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn, and the pattern of أكواب is أفعال — a plural of paucity (jamʿ qilla) —.

* Rhetoric:
1- Concision (ījāz): in the words of Allah the Exalted «وَفِيها ما تَشْتَهِيهِ الْأَنْفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْأَعْيُنُ».
This is an exhaustive enumeration of the kinds of blessings, for they are either desired in the hearts or delightful to the eyes.
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to a Bedouin: If Allah admits you into Paradise, you will find in it whatever your soul desires and your eye delights in.
2- Dependent metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tabaʿiyya): in the words of Allah the Exalted «وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي أُورِثْتُمُوها».
For what they deserved through their good deeds — Paradise and its everlasting bliss for them — is likened to the property and provisions a man leaves behind for his heir; this entails likening the deed itself to the bequeather (al-mūrith, active participle). So "inheritance" was borrowed for what they deserved, and then أورثتموها was derived from it, so there is a dependent metaphor.
It is also said that the inheritance is a majāz mursal (metonymic figure) for obtaining and taking.

* Benefits:
- The bounty and beneficence of Allah.
In this verse He, Glorified be He, set out the bliss of Paradise: in it is whatever souls desire and eyes delight in.
It is reported in the hadith from Abū Hurayra, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Allah the Exalted said: I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and has never occurred to the heart of a human being. Recite if you wish: «فَلا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ ما أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ». Agreed upon.
From Abū Hurayra, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The first group to enter Paradise will be in the form of the moon on the night of the full moon; then those who follow them will be like the most brilliantly shining star in the sky. They will not urinate, nor relieve themselves, nor spit, nor blow their noses. Their combs will be gold, their sweat musk, and their censers aloeswood (al-uluwwa, fragrant wood). Their spouses will be the wide-eyed houris. [They will be] in the make of a single man, in the form of their father Ādam, sixty cubits tall. Agreed upon. In a narration of al-Bukhārī and Muslim: "Their vessels in it will be gold, their sweat in it musk, and each of them will have two wives, the marrow of whose shins will be seen through the flesh because of beauty. There will be no disagreement among them and no mutual hatred; their hearts will be as the heart of one man; they will glorify Allah morning and evening."
From Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, may Allah be pleased with him, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: In Paradise there is a tree; a rider on a swift, lean-trained horse would travel for a hundred years without crossing it. Agreed upon.
From Abū Hurayra, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: When the people of Paradise enter Paradise, a caller will call out: It is for you to be healthy and never fall ill, it is for you to live and never die, it is for you to be young and never grow old, and it is for you to enjoy bliss and never be wretched. Narrated by Muslim.

* I'rab:
(حم. وَالْكِتابِ الْمُبِينِ) حم: what has been said about the openings of the surahs, in meaning and in i'rab, has already preceded. The waw is the waw of oath. «الكتاب» is genitive by the waw of oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I swear" (أقسم). «المبين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الكتاب». (إِنَّا جَعَلْناهُ قُرْآناً عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ) «إن» and its noun, and the clause «جعلناه» is its khabar (predicate). «جعلناه», that is, "we made it" (صيّرناه), is a verb, agent and direct object; «قرآنا» is a second direct object; «عربيا» is an adjective; «لعل» and its noun, and the clause «تعقلون» is its khabar. The clause «إنّا جعلناه» is the jawāb al-qasam (answer to the oath), and this answer has captivated the scholars of rhetoric, as will come later. Al-Zamakhsharī permitted «جعلناه» to mean "we created it" (خلقناه), following the principle of the Muʿtazila in holding that the Qur'an is created; a discussion of this will come in the section on Benefits. On that reading «قرآنا» would be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ, and the clause «لعلكم تعقلون» would be causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position, because hope (tarajjī) is borrowed here for the meaning of intention, i.e. "We made it an Arabic Qur'an intending that the Arabs should understand it." (وَإِنَّهُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتابِ لَدَيْنا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ) The waw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the answer of the oath, so it is in effect a second answer. «إن» and its noun; «في أم الكتاب» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar, the implied form being "established" (مثبت). «أم الكتاب» is the origin of the books, that is, the Preserved Tablet. He the Exalted said: «بل هو قرآن مجيد في لوح محفوظ» ("Rather, it is a glorious Qur'an, on a Preserved Tablet"). «ولدينا» is an adverbial attached to an omitted ḥāl. The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «علي» is a second khabar and «حكيم» a third khabar. Some have objected to this i'rab because it puts a khabar not accompanied by the lām before one accompanied by it. Abu al-Baqāʾ said: "«في أم الكتاب» is attached to «علي», and the lām does not prevent that; «ولدينا» is a badal (substitute) for the preposition and its genitive noun. It may also be a ḥāl from «الكتاب» or from «أم». Neither of the two adverbials may be the khabar, because the khabar must of necessity be «علي» on account of the lām; but each of them may be an adjective of the khabar, which then became a ḥāl by being placed before it." (أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنْكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحاً أَنْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْماً مُسْرِفِينَ) The hamza is for rhetorical (disapproving) interrogation. The fāʾ is a conjunction upon an omitted element implied between it and the hamza, its implied form being "Shall we neglect you, and so turn away…?" «نضرب» is an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن). «عنكم» is attached to «نضرب»; «الذكر» is a direct object, meaning the Qur'an. In «صفحا» there are several possible analyses. First, that it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) synonymous in meaning with «نضرب», since one says "ḍaraba ʿan such-and-such" and "aḍraba ʿanhu" meaning he turned away from it and turned his face from it. Second, that it is accusative as a ḥāl from the agent of «نضرب», i.e. "turning away" (صافحين). Third, that it is accusative as an adverbial meaning "side", from their saying "he looked at him sideways (bi-ṣafḥ wajhihi)", as you say "put this book aside" and "walk aside". Fourth, that it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), the meaning being: "Shall we withhold from you the sending down of the Qur'an and the imposition of the proof by it, out of turning away from you?" More will be said on this verse. «أن» is a maṣdar particle; it has also been read with kasra on the hamza («إن»), in which case it is conditional. On the first reading, it and what follows it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi; on the second, «كنتم» is the protasis and the apodosis is omitted. The words of al-Zamakhsharī: "If you say: how can the meaning of the conditional «إن» be sound when they were in fact transgressors beyond doubt? I say: it belongs to the kind of condition that I mentioned, which issues from one who is confident (al-mudill) of the soundness of a matter that is certain because it is established, as the hired worker says: 'If I have worked for you, then pay me my due,' while he knows that he has. But he makes it appear in his speech that your negligence in departing from the truth is the act of one in doubt about the entitlement despite its clarity, treating him as ignorant." «كنتم»: kāna and its noun, «قوما» is its khabar, and «مسرفين» is an adjective. (وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ) «كم» is khabariyya (exclamatory, "how many") in the position of accusative, a preposed direct object of «أرسلنا»; «من نبي» is a tamyīz (specification) of the khabariyya «كم»; «في الأولين» is attached to «أرسلنا». (وَما يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا كانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ) The waw is a conjunction, «ما» is negative, «يأتيهم» is an imperfect verb in the nominative with a preposed direct object; «من» is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition and «نبي» is genitive in form and nominative in position as the agent; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «كان» and its noun; «به» is attached to «يستهزئون», and the clause «يستهزئون» is the khabar of «كانوا». (فَأَهْلَكْنا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشاً وَمَضى مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ) The fāʾ is the "eloquent fāʾ" (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa). «أهلكنا» is verb and agent; «أشد» is a direct object; «منهم» is attached to «أشد»; «بطشا» is a tamyīz according to the more likely view, and it has been said to be a ḥāl from the agent of «أهلكنا», i.e. "while striking" (باطشين), but I regard that as sheer affectation. «ومضى» is conjoined to «فأهلكنا», and «مثل الأولين» is the agent of «مضى».

* Rhetoric:
1- The oath in His words «والكتاب المبين إنّا جعلناه» (the verse) is the art of congruity (fann al-tanāsub). He swore by the Qur'an, and one swears only by something great; then He made the matter sworn upon the magnification of the Qur'an, in that it is an Arabic Qur'an which it is hoped the worlds may use to understand. Thus the answer to the oath validated the oath, and congruity was completed between the oath and that sworn by, since both are from one valley. The poets have clung to the hems of this lofty rhetorical device, and Abu Tammām swore by the front teeth when he said:
وثناياك إنها إغريض ... ولآل توم وبرق وميض
وأقاح منوّر في بطاح ... هزّه في الصباح روض أريض
وارتكاض الكرى بعينيك في النوم فنونا وما لعيني غموض
(By your front teeth, they are ighrīḍ, and pearls, and a flashing lightning; and chamomile in bloom in the lowlands, stirred at dawn by a fertile meadow; and the stirring of sleep in your eyes in slumber, in many ways, while my eyes have no sleep.) [Translator's note: the Arabic text of the third verse as printed in the source reads «ارتكاض الكرى بعينيك في النوم فنونا»; the source's line division splits «بعيني / ك»; I have rendered it as one word.]
Abu Tammām swore by the front teeth, which are the front of the teeth, that they are ighrīḍ; so the oath and its answer relate to one thing. The ighrīḍ, as in al-Ṣiḥāḥ, is the spathe of the palm (al-ṭalʿ) and anything white and fresh; and al-tūm, singular tūma, is a bead made of silver like a pearl.
2- Metaphor (istiʿāra): in His words «وإنه في أم الكتاب» there is an explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya). The word "mother" (umm) has been borrowed for "origin" (aṣl), which is the omitted tenor (mushabbah), because children arise from the mother as branches arise from roots. The wisdom in this is to depict what is not seen so that it becomes seen; but this metaphor adds nothing except manifestness, because the mother is more manifest to the senses than the origin.

* Benefits:
1- The trial of the creation of the Qur'an: the Muʿtazila held the denial of the attributes of meaning (ṣifāt al-maʿānī) of Allah the Exalted, among them speech, because affirming them leads to anthropomorphism (tashbīh) and to a multiplicity of eternal things, which contradicts tawḥīd (divine oneness). One of the necessary consequences was that they said that the Qur'an is the speech of Allah, created. The author of al-Mawāqif said: "The Muʿtazila said: His speech, the Exalted, is sounds and letters, but they do not subsist in His essence; rather Allah creates them in something other than Him, such as the Preserved Tablet, or Jibrīl, or the Prophet, and it is originated." The Muʿtazila were not the first to say the Qur'an was created, just as they were not the first to deny the attributes. Rather the first known to have said it was created was al-Jaʿd ibn Dirham in Damascus, who was the tutor of Marwān ibn Muḥammad, the last of the caliphs of the Umayyads, and from him Jahm ibn Ṣafwān al-Tirmidhī, leader of the determinist sect the Jahmiyya, took that doctrine and said it was created, since the Jahmiyya deny the attributes. They also mention that Bishr ibn Ghiyāth al-Marīsī, leader of the Marīsiyya, one of the sects of the Murjiʾa, also said the Qur'an was created in the age of al-Rashīd. Abū Yūsuf forbade him from that, but he did not desist, so he shunned him and expelled him from his gathering, saying: "He will not stop until he spoils a piece of wood" (meaning crucifixion). When that reached al-Rashīd he said: "I vow that if Allah gives me victory over him I will kill him." Bishr remained in hiding throughout al-Rashīd's caliphate and was not caught despite the intensity of the search for him. They also mention that Ḥafṣ al-Fard, one of the greatest of the determinists (al-mujbira), held that doctrine and that al-Shāfiʿī debated him and declared him an unbeliever. In the age of al-Rashīd people were divided on that question between accepting and rejecting, until al-Maʾmūn took office and held that it was created; he was among the fiercest supporters of Iʿtizāl. It would take long to relate the course of this trial, so refer to it in its many sources if you wish.
However, we do not pass over this topic without pointing to the ordeal of Imam Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, because of its fame. We say: al-Muʿtaṣim brought Imam Aḥmad and convened a debating session for him, in which were ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Isḥāq, the judge Aḥmad ibn Dāwūd and others. They debated him for three days and he did not cease disputing with them until the fourth day, when al-Muʿtaṣim ordered him flogged with whips. He did not turn from his opinion until he fainted; ʿUjayf ibn ʿAnbasa prodded him with a sword, a mat (bāriya, which is the woven rush mat) was thrown over him and he was trampled upon; then he was carried to his house after being struck thirty-eight lashes. The length of his imprisonment was twenty-eight months. Refer to Tārīkh al-Ṭabarī, Wafayāt al-Aʿyān and Murūj al-Dhahab to read the astonishing reports of this trial.
2- We promised you that we would speak to you about the style of the Qur'an, so we say:
The Qur'an contains many words which some of the Companions and the Followers described as not being of the language of the Arabs, and scholars have written special books on this. The presence of loanwords (muʿarrab) in the Qur'an is a scholarly question on which scholars differed greatly, in two opinions, one of which:
The first opinion: the presence of loanwords in the Qur'an. To this went some of the Companions, the Followers and the scholars, among them Ibn ʿAbbās, Wahb ibn Munabbih, Ibn Masʿūd, Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, ʿIkrima, Mujāhid, ʿAṭāʾ, al-Ḍaḥḥāk, al-Suddī, Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī, ʿAmr ibn Sharaḥbīl, Abū Mūsā al-Ashʿarī, al-Zamakhsharī, Ibn al-Ḥājib, al-Suyūṭī and others.
The second opinion: that the Qur'an contains no non-Arabic words, which is the doctrine of many scholars, among them Imam al-Shāfiʿī, Abū ʿUbayda, Ibn Fāris, Ibn Jarīr al-Ṭabarī, al-Bāqillānī, al-Rāzī and others.
It is not very useful to present the details of both opinions, their proofs and the rebuttals of them; what is useful here is to understand the following matters:
1- Later students have accepted the following report from Abū ʿUbayd al-Qāsim ibn Sallām, as if finding in it a solution to the question and an exit from this disagreement. The report is: Abū ʿUbayd said: "It is related from Ibn ʿAbbās, Mujāhid, ʿIkrima and others, concerning many words, that they are not of the tongue of the Arabs, such as (سجيل and المشكاة and اليم and الطور and أباريق and استبرق) and the like. These men know interpretation better than Abū ʿUbayda, but they took one position and he took another, and both are correct, Allah willing.
That is because these words are originally not of the tongue of the Arabs; so those men spoke according to the origin, then the Arabs pronounced them with their tongues and Arabized them, so they became Arabic through that; thus they are Arabic in this state, non-Arabic in origin. This statement therefore holds true of both groups."
Al-Jawālīqī cited this report after citing the words of ʿUbayda [Translator's note: the source has «عبيدة»; Abū ʿUbayda is evidently meant]: "Whoever claims that there is in the Qur'an a tongue other than Arabic has made a grave claim against Allah," and he argued with His words: «إنّا جعلناه قرآنا عربيا لعلكم تعقلون». Then this report was transmitted by those who came after al-Jawālīqī and studied the subject of Arabization in the Qur'an, such as al-Suyūṭī and others.
2- Whether the words occurring in the Qur'an from other languages are non-Arabic in origin and Arabic in present state, or non-Arabic in both origin and state, their occurrence in the Qur'an shows that the Arabs understood and accepted them, and their understanding of them shows that they were widespread among them before it came to them; and this proves what we are concerned with, namely the existence of words borrowed from other languages in the Jāhiliyya and the continuation of that when Islam came.
3- It appears that those who rejected the existence of loanwords in the Qur'an were dominated by religious restraint more than by determination of the linguistic reality. Hence, when al-Suyūṭī cited these words in his two books «al-Mutawakkilī fīmā fī al-Qur'ān min al-Muʿarrab» and «al-Muhadhdhab fīmā waqaʿa fī al-Qur'ān min al-Muʿarrab», he set before them chains of transmission attributing them to the Companions and Followers, as though he too were guarding himself against asserting it on his own. He enumerated the languages from which those words were taken and brought them to ten, namely: Abyssinian, Persian, Greek (Rūmiyya), Indian, Syriac, Hebrew, Nabataean, Coptic, Turkish, Zanji and Berber. [Translator's note: the source says "ten" but lists eleven languages.]

* Vocabulary:
(جُزْءاً) He said in al-Qāmūs: "Al-juzʾ: a part (baʿḍ), and it may be vowelled with fatḥa; the plural is ajzāʾ; with ḍamma it is a place and a sand-dune. Jazaʾahu, like jaʿalahu, means he divided it into parts, like jazzaʾahu; and bi-l-shayʾ means he was content with it, like ijtazaʾa and tajazzaʾa; and al-shayʾ means he tightened it; and the camels ... with fresh pasture instead of water: they were satisfied, like jazaʾat with kasra; I made them content (ajzaʾtuhā) and I portioned them (jazzaʾtuhā); and ajzaʾtu ʿanka majzaʾa fulān and majzaʾatahu, which can also be read with ḍamma: I sufficed in your place as he would have sufficed; and the awl: I made for it a juzʾa, that is, a handle; and the ring on my finger: I put it on; and the pasture: its vegetation became dense; and the mother: she bore females; and a sheep on your behalf: it sufficed, a dialect form of jazat; and al-shayʾ iyyāya: it sufficed me; and al-jawāzi' are the wild animals. «وجعلوا له من عباده جزءا», that is, females." Al-Zamakhsharī rejected this and said it is a contrivance, not language. The text of his statement follows: "The meaning of «من عباده جزءا» is that they said: the angels are the daughters of Allah, so they made them a part of Him and a portion of Him, as a child is a piece of his father and a part of him. Among the novelties of exegesis is the interpretation of juzʾ as females and the claim that juzʾ in the language of the Arabs is a name for females; it is nothing but a lie against the Arabs and a newly invented and altered usage. That did not satisfy them until they derived from it ajzaʾat al-marʾa, and then fabricated a verse:
إن أجزأت حرة يوما فلا عجب ... زوجتها من بنات الأوس مجزئة
(If a free woman bears a female one day, do not be surprised: I married her to a woman of the daughters of al-Aws who bears females.)"
Al-Zamakhsharī may have an excuse for finding this interpretation implausible, but his excuse vanishes when we recall that al-Zajjāj and al-Mubarrad are the ones who reported it, and they are two imams of the Arabic language and its guardians, to whom the final word in knowing it belongs.
(الْحِلْيَةِ) Adornment.

* I'rab:
(وَجَعَلُوا لَهُ مِنْ عِبادِهِ جُزْءاً) The waw is a conjunction according to al-Zamakhsharī, because he made the speech connected to His words «ولئن سألتهم من خلق السموات والأرض», i.e. "and yet, despite that admission, they made a part of His servants for Him, describing Him with the attributes of the created"; but you may make it resumptive. «جعلوا» is verb and agent; making here means "making into" (taṣyīr); «له» is in the position of the second object; «من عباده» is a ḥāl; «جزءا» is the first object of «جعلوا». (إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لَكَفُورٌ مُبِينٌ) «إن» and its noun; the shifted lām; «كفور» is the khabar of «إن»; «مبين» is an adjective, i.e. one who makes his ingratitude manifest. (أَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَناتٍ وَأَصْفاكُمْ بِالْبَنِينَ) «أم» is the connected (muttaṣila) type, conjoined to an omitted interrogative whose purpose is denial and rebuke, the implied form being "Do you say …, or has He taken…?". Some said it is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) type meaning "rather" (bal), and others said it is both; each is sound, and «أم» has already been discussed at length. «اتخذ» is a past verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "He" (هو); «مما» is attached to an omitted element which is the second object of «اتخذ»; the clause «يخلق» is the ṣila; «بنات» is the first object of «اتخذ»; «أصفاكم» is conjoined to «اتخذ»; «بالبنين» is attached to «أصفاكم». (وَإِذا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُمْ بِما ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمنِ مَثَلًا) The waw is resumptive and the clause is resumptive, introduced to confirm what precedes; «إذا» is a future adverbial containing the meaning of condition; «بشّر» is a passive past verb; «أحدهم» is the deputy agent; «بما» is attached to «بشر»; the clause «ضرب» is the ṣila; «ضرب» contains the meaning of "made" (jaʿala), so «للرحمن» is attached to an omitted element in the position of the second object; «مثلا» is the first object of «ضرب». (ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ) «ظل» is a defective past verb, «وجهه» its noun and «مسودّا» its khabar; the clause has no position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; the waw is circumstantial; «هو» is a mubtadaʾ and «كظيم» its khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. (أَوَمَنْ يُنَشَّؤُا فِي الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الْخِصامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ) The hamza is for rhetorical (disapproving) interrogation; the waw is a conjunction, joining the clause to an implied clause, i.e. "They dare, and reach the furthest limits in bad manners, and assign to Allah one who is raised amid adornment". «من» is a relative noun, direct object of an omitted verb; it has been said that it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, the implied form being "a part and a child". The clause «ينشّؤ» is the ṣila; «ينشّؤ» is passive, and the deputy agent is a latent pronoun referring to «من»; «في الحلية» is attached to «ينشّؤ»; «في الخصام» is attached to «مبين»; «غير مبين» is the khabar of «هو», and the clause is a ḥāl. The words of Abu al-Baqāʾ: "If you say: the muḍāf ilayhi does not operate on what precedes (the muḍāf), it is said: except in the case of «غير», because it contains the meaning of negation, as if He had said: 'and he does not make himself clear in disputation'. Similar to it is the problem in al-Kitāb: 'anā zaydan ghayru ḍārib'. It is also said that it is accusative by a verb which ḍārib explains, and likewise in the verse." It has also been said that it belongs to the category of «على لا حب لا يهتدي بناره», i.e. there is no beacon to be guided by; that is, there is no disputation from them; and this is not far-fetched. (وَجَعَلُوا الْمَلائِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبادُ الرَّحْمنِ إِناثاً) The waw is a conjunction; «جعلوا» is verb and agent; «الملائكة» is the first object of «جعلوا»; «الذين» is an adjective; «هم» is a mubtadaʾ and «عباد الرحمن» its khabar, and the clause is the ṣila of «الذين»; «إناثا» is the second object of «جعلوا».
