* I'rab:
(يأيّها الذين آمنوا): its parsing has already been given, in words and clauses [Note: in verse (1) of this sūra.]. (من الظنّ) is attached to an adjective (naʿt) of (كثيرا). (الواو) is a conjunction. (لا) is a prohibitive particle governing the jussive in the two places. (تجسّسوا) is a jussive imperfect verb from which one of the two tāʾs was dropped. (الهمزة) is for rhetorical (disapproving) interrogation. (أن) is a maṣdar particle governing the accusative. (ميتا) is a ḥāl from أخيه, accusative. (الفاء) links the apodosis of an implied condition, and (الواو) in (كرهتموه) is redundant (zāʾida), a lengthening of the vowel of the mīm..
The clause «اجتنبوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the response to the vocative.
The clause «إنّ بعض الظنّ إثم ... » has no grammatical position; it is causal.
The clause «لا تجسّسوا» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause of the response to the vocative.
The clause «لا يغتب بعضكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause of the response to the vocative.
The clause «يحبّ أحدكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «يأكل ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle maṣdar (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأكل..) is in the position of accusative as the direct object.
The clause «كرهتموه ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هذا" (this)..
The nominal clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you do not like that, then this you have disliked".
The clause «اتّقوا الله ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. "so dislike suspicion, spying and backbiting, and fear Allah".
The clause «إنّ الله توّاب ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
1- Indefiniteness (al-tankīr): in His saying, Exalted is He, «كَثِيراً».
Its coming indefinite conveys the sense of partiality, and that among suspicions there are some that must be avoided, without specifying or identifying them, so that no one ventures upon a suspicion except after looking and reflecting, and distinguishing its truth from its falsehood by a clear sign, while keeping a sense of piety and caution. Had it been definite, the command to avoid suspicion would have been tied to that of it which is frequent and not to that which is rare, and every suspicion characterised by frequency would have to be avoided, while that characterised by rarity would be permitted.
2- Representational metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in His saying, Exalted is He, «أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتاً فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ».
In this noble verse there is a representation and depiction of what the backbiter inflicts on the honour of the one backbitten, in the most horrible and most repulsive way.
It contains various intensifications: among them the interrogation whose sense is affirmation; among them making what is utterly detestable to be linked with love; among them attributing the act to "one of you" and indicating that not one of all individuals likes that; among them that He did not stop at representing backbiting by eating a human's flesh, but made the human a brother; and among them that He did not stop at eating the brother's flesh, but made him dead.

* Benefits:
- The prohibition of backbiting (ghayba)..
This verse indicates the prohibition of backbiting,
for it is reported from Abū Hurayra, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do you know what backbiting is?" I said: "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said:
"Your mentioning your brother with what he dislikes." I said: "And if what I say is in my brother?" He said: "If what you say is in him, you have backbitten him; and if what you say is not in him, you have slandered him."
From ʿĀʾisha, may Allah be pleased with her, who said: I said to the Prophet ﷺ: "It is enough for you about Ṣafiyya that she is such and such." Some narrators said: she meant short. He said: "You have said a word that, if it were mixed with the water of the sea, would taint it." From Anas, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When I was taken up, I passed by a people who had nails of copper, scratching their faces and their flesh. I said: 'Who are these, O Jibrīl?' He said: 'These are those who eat people's flesh and plunge into their honour.'"
This verse was revealed about two men who backbit their companion. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went on a campaign or a journey, he would join a needy man to two well-off men, to serve them and eat with them. Salmān was with two men serving them; sleep overcame him and he did not prepare food for them. They said: "Go to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and ask him for food for us." Salmān came and asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who told Usāma to look for food for him, but he found none. He went back to the two, and they said: "Usāma was stingy." They sent him to a group of the Companions and he found nothing. When he returned, they said: "Had we sent him to the well of Sumayḥa, its water would have sunk." Then they went off spying to see whether Usāma had food or not. When he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said to them: "Why do I see the greenness of meat in your mouths?" They said: "O Messenger of Allah, we have not eaten any meat today." He said: "You have been eating the flesh of Salmān and Usāma." Then this verse was revealed.

* I'rab:
(عليك) is attached to (يمنّون). (أن) is a maṣdar particle [Note: or a lightened form of the heavy one, its noun an omitted pronoun and the clause after it a khabar.
(4, 5) It is possible that it be in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, namely the bāʾ, attached to the preceding verb ...].
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أسلموا) is in the position of accusative as a direct object, its governor being يمنّون «4».
(لا) is a prohibitive particle governing the jussive. (عليّ) is attached to (تمنّوا). (بل) is for transitional abandonment (iḍrāb). (عليكم) is attached to (يمنّ). (أن) is like the first. (للإيمان) is attached to (هداكم). (كنتم) is a past verb in the position of jussive, the protasis..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن هداكم..) is in the position of accusative as a direct object, its governor being يمنّ «5».
The clause: «يمنّون» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause: «أسلموا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type relative (أن).
The clause: «قل ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption.
The clause: «لا تمنّوا ... » is in the position of accusative as the content of what is said.
The clause: «الله يمنّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause: «يمنّ عليكم ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause: «هداكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second particle-type relative (أن).
The clause: «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then Allah confers favor upon you".. or "then Allah is the One who confers favor upon you".

* I'rab:
(يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنْ جاءَكُمْ فاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَنْ تُصِيبُوا قَوْماً بِجَهالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا عَلى ما فَعَلْتُمْ نادِمِينَ) يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا: its i'rab has preceded. إِنْ is conditional; جاءَكُمْ is a past verb in the position of a jussive, the protasis, and the kāf is a fronted direct object; فاسِقٌ is a postponed agent; بِنَبَإٍ are both attached to جاءَكُمْ; the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ for the apodosis because the sentence is one of request; تَبَيَّنُوا is an imperative, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn, and the waw is the agent. أَنْ تُصِيبُوا: أَنْ and what is within its scope are in the position of an accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "for fear of your striking" or "out of dislike of your striking"; قَوْماً is a direct object; and بِجَهالَةٍ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl from the agent, i.e. "being ignorant". فَتُصْبِحُوا: the fāʾ is a conjunction, تُصْبِحُوا is conjoined to تُصِيبُوا, and the waw is the ism of تُصْبِحُوا; عَلى ما فَعَلْتُمْ are both attached to نادِمِينَ; and نادِمِينَ is the khabar of تُصْبِحُوا.
(وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِي كَثِيرٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ) The waw is a conjunction; اعْلَمُوا is an imperative and the waw is the agent; أَنَّ and what is within its scope take the place of the two objects of اعْلَمُوا; فِيكُمْ is the fronted khabar of أَنَّ and رَسُولَ اللَّهِ is the postponed ism of أَنَّ. لَوْ is conditional, and the clause يُطِيعُكُمْ is a ḥāl from the genitive pronoun in His saying فِيكُمْ; فِي كَثِيرٍ are both attached to يُطِيعُكُمْ; مِنَ الْأَمْرِ is an adjective of كَثِيرٍ; the lām occurs in the apodosis of لَوْ; and عَنِتُّمْ is a verb and agent, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of لَوْ; the meaning is "you would have fallen into hardship (ʿanat)", i.e. destruction.
(وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْإِيمانَ وَزَيَّنَهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيانَ) The waw is a conjunction; لكِنَّ with its ism, and the clause حَبَّبَ is its khabar; إِلَيْكُمْ are both attached to حَبَّبَ; الْإِيمانَ is a direct object; وَزَيَّنَهُ is conjoined to حَبَّبَ; فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ are both attached to زَيَّنَهُ; and وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْكُفْرَ is conjoined to what preceded.
(أُولئِكَ هُمُ الرَّاشِدُونَ) أُولئِكَ is a mubtadaʾ; هُمْ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) and الرَّاشِدُونَ is the khabar of أُولئِكَ. It is also permissible to parse هُمْ as a second mubtadaʾ and الرَّاشِدُونَ as its khabar, the sentence being the khabar of أُولئِكَ. The clause أُولئِكَ هُمُ الرَّاشِدُونَ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl, or is parenthetical with no position.
(فَضْلًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ) فَضْلًا is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi or a maṣdar not from its own verb. There is disagreement about what makes it accusative on the first view: it was said it is حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ, in which case the clause أُولئِكَ هُمُ الرَّاشِدُونَ must be parenthetical; it was said it is accusative by an implied verb, i.e. "you seek favour and grace"; and it was said it is الرَّاشِدُونَ, over a disagreement between the Ahl al-Sunna and the Muʿtazila that we will report in the section on benefits. اللَّهُ is a mubtadaʾ, عَلِيمٌ is a first khabar and حَكِيمٌ a second khabar.

* Rhetoric:
These verses contain varied kinds of rhetoric, which we present concisely as follows:
1. Indefiniteness: in His saying «إن جاءكم فاسق», the benefit of which is spread and inclusiveness, because an indefinite noun, when it occurs in the context of a condition, is general, as it is general when it occurs in the context of negation; this rule has been pointed out in more than one place in this book. In this indefiniteness is a rebuttal of those who claimed that it was revealed about al-Walīd ibn ʿUqba, who was one of the great Companions, because applying "wickedness" (fisq) to him is remote: fisq is leaving a thing and shedding it, and al-Walīd, as they report, formed a judgement and erred, and the one who errs, as al-Rāzī says, is not called a fāsiq. So generality is what is meant, as if He said: "Any wicked person who comes to you with any report, scrutinize it and present it to the touchstone of right and wrong before deciding a ruling, and do not hasten matters."
2. Fronting: in His saying «واعلموا أن فيكم رسول الله» the khabar of إنّ was put before its ism, the aim of which is severity toward some of the believers, to avoid what Allah disapproved in their attempt to make the Messenger of Allah ﷺ follow their opinions.
3. Expression: with the imperfect rather than the past in His saying «لو يطيعكم» — He did not say aṭāʿakum — and that is to convey continuity and permanence, in that he would do what they deem right, and that it would be incumbent on him, whenever an opinion occurred to them or a first thought about matters appeared to them, to incline to them and do what they believe to be right.
4. Antithesis: that is in His saying the Exalted «حبّب» and «كرّه». On the making-beloved and the making-disliked there is disagreement between the Ahl al-Sunna and the Muʿtazila which the scope of this book cannot hold; let one refer to the longer works.

* Benefits:
Al-Zamakhsharī raised a difficulty about the i'rab of فَضْلًا, saying: "If you say: how can it be permissible for it to be a mafʿūl li-ajlihi when right guidance (rushd) is the act of the people and favour (faḍl) is the act of Allah, while the condition is that the agent be the same? I say: since rushd came as an expression for the making-beloved, the adorning and the making-disliked, ascribed to His name, whose names are sanctified, rushd became as if it were His act, so it is permissible for it to be accusative because of it. Or it is not accusative because of الرَّاشِدُونَ but because of the verb ascribed to the name of Allah the Exalted, the sentence أُولئِكَ هُمُ الرَّاشِدُونَ being parenthetical; or because of an implied verb, as if it were said 'that happened' or 'that was a favour from Allah'. As for its being a maṣdar not from its own verb, it is put in the place of rushdan, because their right guidance is a favour from Allah, since they were granted success in it; and faḍl and niʿma have the sense of ifḍāl."
We say: this difficulty that al-Zamakhsharī raised is based on the Muʿtazila's belief that rushd is not among the acts of Allah the Exalted but is in reality their own act, whereas in fact rushd is among the acts and creations of Allah, so the condition for the accusative of the mafʿūl li-ajlihi, the sameness of the agent of the two verbs, is found. Yet the difficulty arises textually upon our own account, but not in the manner al-Zamakhsharī put it; rather from the angle that Allah the Exalted addressed His creation in their familiar language, and among what they are familiar with is that the agent is the one to whom the act is ascribed, whether in reality or figuratively, so that Zayd is an agent, and likewise "the wall collapsed" and the like. And rushd has been ascribed to them on the basis that they are the agents, even if the ascription is figurative according to the belief. Once its arising in this way is established, you have two ways of answering it: either the answer of al-Zamakhsharī, or one more solid and clearer than it, which is that rushd here entails their being rightly guided (rāshid), since it is its mutāwiʿ (middle-voice counterpart), because Allah the Exalted guided them so they were guided; in that case the agent is the same in the manner of verbal craft, in agreement with reality. This is the reverse of His saying «يريكم البرق خوفا وطمعا», for the same difficulty arises there, since fear and hope are their act, i.e. ascribed to them as being the ones who fear and hope, while the first verb is Allah's. The answer to it is that they are objects in the sense of agents by way of the entailment of the mutāwiʿ, for if He wills them [Translator's note: the source writes «أرادهم»; «أراهم» ("He shows them") is evidently meant], they have seen; this answer has preceded in its place. The reverse of it is the verse of al-Ḥujurāt, since the speech is made sound by taking the agent as an object; and this is among the subtleties of Arabic. «[Translator's note: this last sentence is rendered as written; the passage is dense and its reasoning is elliptical in the source.]»

﴿وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنا الإنْسانَ ونَعْلَمُ ما تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ﴾: Yani onun gizlediğini ve içinde sakladığını biliriz. ﴿وَنَحْنُ أقْرَبُ إلَيْهِ مِن حَبْلِ الوَرِيدِ﴾: ”اَلْوَرِيدُ“: Boynun iç tarafında bir damardır; bunlar iki vériddir. Şair şöyle demiştir:
؎كَأنَّ ورِيداهُ رِشاءا خُلْبِ
(Sanki onun iki şah damarı, خُلْب'den iki kuyu ipidir.)
(خُلْب ile) liften (yapılmış ip) kastediliyor.

﴿وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنا الإنْسانَ ونَعْلَمُ ما تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ﴾, that is: We know what he hides and what he conceals within himself. ﴿وَنَحْنُ أقْرَبُ إلَيْهِ مِن حَبْلِ الوَرِيدِ﴾: "اَلْوَرِيدُ" is a vein on the inside of the neck, and there are two warīds. The poet said:
؎كَأنَّ ورِيداهُ رِشاءا خُلْبِ
(As though his two jugular veins were two ropes of khulb.)
He means: of fibre.

Allah Teâlâ'nın ﴿إنَّ في ذَلِكَ لَذِكْرى لِمَن كانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ أوْ ألْقى السَّمْعَ وهو شَهِيدٌ﴾ kavli; ”أوْ أُلْقِيَ السَّمْعُ“ şeklinde de okunmuştur. ”مَن كانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ“ın anlamı: Kalbini anlamaya yönelten kimse demektir. Görmez misin ki ﴿صُمٌّ بُكْمٌ عُمْيٌ﴾ [Bakara: 18] kavli, onların anlamak ve doğru yolu aramak isteyenin dinlemesi gibi dinlemedikleri için, işitmeyen kimse mesabesinde kılındıkları (anlamındadır)? Nitekim şair şöyle der:
؎أصَمُّ عَمّا ساءَهُ سَمِيعُ
(Kendisini üzen şeye karşı sağır, (başka şeye) çok iyi işiten.)
﴿أوْ ألْقى السَّمْعَ﴾in anlamı: Dinledi ve kalbini işittiği şeyden başkasıyla meşgul etmedi, demektir. Araplar ”ألْقِ إلَيَّ سَمْعَكَ“ derler, yani beni dinle. ﴿وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ﴾ın anlamı: Kalbi işittiği şeydedir, demektir. Tefsirde bununla, yanlarında Hz. Peygamber'in (s.a.v.) vasfı bulunan Ehl-i kitabın kastedildiği gelmiştir. Bu tefsire göre ﴿أوْ ألْقى السَّمْعَ وهو شَهِيدٌ﴾ın anlamı, Hz. Peygamber'in (aleyhisselâm) vasfının onun kitabında bulunduğudur.

* Vocabulary:
(الْحَصِيدِ): that which is of the nature of being harvested.
(باسِقاتٍ): busūq means height. In al-Miṣbāḥ: «basaqat al-nakhla busūqan (from the pattern of qaʿada): the palm grew tall, so it is bāsiqa, and the plural is bāsiqāt and bawāsiq. Basaqa al-rajul: the man became skilled in his work.» The poet said:
لنا خمر وليست خمر كرم ... ولكن من نتاج الباسقات
كرام في السماء ذهبن طولا ... وفات ثمارها أيدي الجناة
(We have a wine, though it is not wine of the vine, but from the yield of the tall ones; noble ones that went high into the sky in height, their fruit beyond the hands of the pickers.) And from the use in the second meaning is the saying of Ibn Nawfal about Ibn Hubayra:
يا ابن الذين بمجدهم ... بسقت على قيس فزاره
(O son of those by whose glory Fazāra rose high above Qays.)
(نَضِيدٌ): piled up, one part on top of another. The explanation of the meaning of ṭalʿ (spathe) has already preceded in His words, Exalted is He, «ومن طلعها قنوان».
(أَفَعَيِينا): from ʿayiya bi-l-amr, when one is not guided to the way of knowing it. ʿayiya ʿan ḥujjatihi yaʿyā (from the pattern ʿayā): he was unable to produce it. The past tense is sometimes assimilated, so that one says ʿayya; so the man is ʿayyin or ʿayiyun, on the patterns fa-ʿil and faʿīl. ʿayiya bi-l-amr: he was not guided to its way. aʿyānī, with alif: it tired me out; so aʿyaytu is used both transitively and intransitively; and aʿyā in his walking, so he is muʿyin (defective). In al-Mukhtār: «al-ʿayy is the opposite of clear expression. ʿayiya fī manṭiqihi, so he is ʿayyun, on the pattern faʿil; and ʿayiya yaʿyā, on the pattern of raḍiya yarḍā, so he is ʿayīyun on the pattern faʿīl. One also says ʿayyun and ʿayīyun when he is not guided to its way, and assimilation is more common; and aʿyāhu amruhu.»
(لَبْسٍ): doubt, confusion, uncertainty.

* I'rab:
(وَنَزَّلْنا مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً مُبارَكاً فَأَنْبَتْنا بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ وَحَبَّ الْحَصِيدِ): The wāw is a conjunction; نزلنا is verb and agent; من السماء is attached to نزلنا; ماء is the direct object and مباركا an adjective. فأنبتنا is conjoined to نزلنا; به is attached to أنبتنا; جنات is the direct object; and حب الحصيد is conjoined to جنات, i.e. "and the grain of the crop that is harvested", the described noun having been omitted.
(وَالنَّخْلَ باسِقاتٍ لَها طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ): والنخل is conjoined to جنات and حب الحصيد; باسقات is an implied ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara), because at the time of growing they were not tall; لها is an advanced khabar; طلع is a delayed mubtadaʾ; نضيد is an adjective of طلع; and the clause is a ḥāl of النخل الباسقات by way of succession, or of the pronoun in باسقات by way of embedding.
(رِزْقاً لِلْعِبادِ وَأَحْيَيْنا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتاً كَذلِكَ الْخُرُوجُ): In رزقا it is permissible that it be an object of purpose, or an absolute object as a maṣdar from the sense of أنبتنا, or a ḥāl, i.e. "provided for the servants" or "possessing provision". للعباد is an adjective of رزقا and attached to it as a maṣdar. وأحيينا is conjoined to فأنبتنا; به is attached to أحيينا; بلدة is the direct object and ميتا an adjective. كذلك is an advanced khabar and الخروج a delayed mubtadaʾ; the khabar is advanced for restriction (ḥaṣr).
(كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحابُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ): A resumptive discourse to explain a present reality concerning the resurrection and the agreement of all the messengers upon it. قبلهم is an adverbial attached to كذبت; قوم نوح is the agent; and what follows it is conjoined to it.
(وَعادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوانُ لُوطٍ): also conjoined to what precedes.
(وَأَصْحابُ الْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ): also conjoined; all of these have already been covered.
(كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ): كل is the mubtadaʾ, and the tanwīn in it is a substitute for a word, i.e. "every messenger of those mentioned"; the clause كذب الرسل is its khabar. The fāʾ is a conjunction; حق is a past verb; وعيد is the agent, annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, its origin being وعيدي, and the yāʾ was dropped, the kasra remaining as an indication of it.
(أَفَعَيِينا بِالْخَلْقِ الْأَوَّلِ بَلْ هُمْ فِي لَبْسٍ مِنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ): The hamza is for interrogation, i.e. "were We not unable regarding it, so that We would be unable in repeating it?". The fāʾ is conjoined to an omitted clause whose implied form is "Did We intend the creation and then fail at it, so that anyone could imagine Our incapacity to repeat it?". عيينا is verb and agent; بالخلق is attached to عيينا; الأول is an adjective of الخلق. بل is conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, brought in to explain their confusion and expose their sophistry, the implied form being "they do not deny Our power, but they are in confusion and doubt". هم is the mubtadaʾ; في لبس is the khabar; من خلق is an adjective of لبس; and جديد is an adjective of خلق.

* Rhetoric:
Definiteness and indefiniteness: in the definiteness of "the first creation" and the indefiniteness of "confusion" and "a new creation" there are miraculous rhetorical purposes. The definiteness is a distinguishing of the magnificence of what is intended to be made definite, and a glorification of it; likewise the definiteness of "males" in His words, Exalted is He, «ويهب لمن يشاء الذكور». The aim of it is to make it evidence of the possibility of the second creation a fortiori: for if He, Exalted is He, was not incapacitated by the creation, despite its greatness, vastness and comprehensiveness of what bewilders minds and perplexes thoughts, then the other creation is a mere repetition, which is more fitting to be paid no regard and not to exceed the range of power and possibility. This is the secret of the definiteness of the first creation. As for indefiniteness, its matter is divided. At times what is intended by it is the magnification of the indefinite thing, from the vagueness within it, as though it were too magnificent to be addressed by a definite form; and at times what is intended is belittling the indefinite thing and lowering it. An example of the first is His words, Exalted is He, «سلام قولا من رب رحيم», and His words «لهم مغفرة وأجر عظيم», and His words «إن المتقين في جنات ونعيم»; it is too much to count. The second is the basic function of indefiniteness and needs no illustration. So the indefiniteness of "confusion" is from exaltation and magnification, as though He said: "in a [grave] confusion"; and the indefiniteness of "a new creation" is for belittling it and making light of its matter in relation to the first creation. It may also be for magnification, as though it were a matter too great for a person to be content with its being obscure to him, when the first thing in which he observes its soundness ... [Translator's note: the source sentence ends abruptly, «وأنه أول ما تبصر فيه صحته», as printed; translated as written.]

* Vocabulary:
(تُوَسْوِسُ): al-waswasa is a hidden sound, and from it comes the waswās of ornaments. The waswasa of the soul is what passes through a person's mind and stirs in his inner self of the self-talk of the soul.
(حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ): Al-Zamakhsharī said: «The "jugular vein" (ḥabl al-warīd) is a proverbial expression for extreme nearness, like their saying "he is to me the place where the midwife ties" and "the place where the waist-wrapper is tied". Dhū al-Rumma said:
هل أغدونّ في عيشة رغيد ... والموت أدنى لي من الوريد
(Shall I go out in the morning into an easy life, when death is nearer to me than the jugular vein?) that is: I shall not be in a spacious life, since death is nearer to me than the jugular vein. The two warīds are two veins at the front of the two sides of the neck, so called because they come down (yaridān) from the head, or because the spirit comes to them (tariduhumā). The discussion of the reason for annexing ḥabl to al-warīd has already preceded.»
(عَتِيدٌ): present. In al-Miṣbāḥ: «ʿatuda al-shayʾ (with ḍamma), ʿatādan (with fatḥa): it was present; so it is ʿatid (with two fatḥas) and also ʿatīd. It becomes transitive with hamza and with doubling, so one says aʿtadahu ṣāḥibuhu and ʿattadahu when he prepared it and made it ready. In the Revelation: «وأعتدت لهنّ متكأ».»

* I'rab:
(وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسانَ وَنَعْلَمُ ما تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ): The wāw is resumptive; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of certainty; خلقنا الإنسان is a past verb, agent and direct object. The wāw is circumstantial, with an implied "We"; the clause نعلم is the khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ, and the nominal sentence is in the position of the accusative as an implied ḥāl. You may make the wāw resumptive, in which case the sentence is resumptive. ما is a direct object, and the clause توسوس is the ṣila. You may make ما a maṣdar, the implied form being "and We know the whispering of his soul to him". به is attached to توسوس and نفسه is the agent. ونحن: the wāw is a conjunction; نحن is the mubtadaʾ; أقرب is the khabar; إليه is attached to أقرب, and من حبل الوريد is also attached to أقرب.
(إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيانِ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمالِ قَعِيدٌ): إذ may be an adverbial for أقرب, or the implied form may be "remember". The clause يتلقى is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverbial to it. المتلقيان is the agent; عن اليمين is an advanced khabar; الشمال is conjoined to اليمين; قعيد is a delayed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of المتلقيان.
(ما يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ): ما is negative; يلفظ is an imperfect verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he", referring to the human being; من is a redundant preposition; قول is genitive in form, accusative in position as the direct object of يلفظ; إلا is a particle of restriction; لديه is an adverbial of place attached to an omitted advanced khabar; رقيب عتيد is a delayed mubtadaʾ, which is singular in form, while its meaning is "two watchers, present", or "two angels described as watchers, present". It is also said that there is no need for this implied form, but it is preferable to make the two descriptions for one thing, i.e. "except that with him is an angel described as a watcher, present", meaning a guardian, in attendance.
(وَجاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ذلِكَ ما كُنْتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ): A resumptive discourse, brought in to explain what they will meet of death and resurrection and the terrors that follow them. جاءت سكرة الموت is verb and agent; بالحق is a ḥāl, i.e. "while it is accompanied by the truth", so the bāʾ is for accompaniment. It is also said to be for transitivity, meaning "and the stupor of death brought the reality of the matter, which Allah gave utterance to in His books and sent with His messengers". Al-Zamakhsharī preferred this reading. ذلك is the mubtadaʾ; ما is the khabar; كان with its ism; منه is attached to تحيد; the clause تحيد is the khabar of كنت; the clause كنت is the ṣila of ما; and the clause ذلك ما كنت is the content of an omitted saying, i.e. "and it is said to him at the time of death: this is that matter you now see, not that from which you used to shy away in your life, so flight did not benefit you and escape did not save you".
(وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ ذلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيدِ): Conjoined to وجاءت سكرة الموت. نفخ is a passive past verb; في الصور is attached to نفخ; ذلك is the mubtadaʾ and يوم الوعيد its khabar; and the pointing is to the verbal noun of نفخ.

* İ'rab:
(وَجاءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَعَها سائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ): الواو atıf harfidir. (جاءت كل نفس): fiil ve fâildir. (معها): mukaddem haber olan mahzûfa müteallik mekân zarfıdır. (سائق): muahhar mübtedâ; (شهيد): «سائق»a atıftır. İsim cümlesi «كل»in sıfatı olarak ref' mahallinde, yahut onun [yani «نفس»in] sıfatı olarak nasb mahallindedir [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «في محل نصب صفة لها» yazılıdır; «نفس» mecrûr olduğundan cer mahallinde olması gerekir]; yani: «Yanında onu süren ve onun aleyhine şahitlik eden biri vardır.» Onu hâliyye yapman da caizdir.
(لَقَدْ كُنْتَ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ هذا فَكَشَفْنا عَنْكَ غِطاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ): Cümle mahzûf bir sözün mekûlü'l-kavlidir; yani her nefse şöyle denir. اللام mahzûf kasemin cevabıdır. (قد): tahkîk harfidir. كان ve ismi; (في غفلة): onun haberidir. (من هذا): «غفلة»ye müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. الفاء atıf harfidir. (كشفنا): fiil ve fâildir. (عنك): «كشفنا»ya müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. (غطاءك): mef'ûlün bihtir. الفاء atıf harfidir. (بصرك): mübtedâdır. (اليوم): mahzûf bir hâle müteallik zarftır. (حديد): «بصرك»in haberidir.
(وَقالَ قَرِينُهُ هذا ما لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ): الواو atıf harfidir. (قال قرينه): fiil ve fâildir. القرين ile kastedilen, ona müvekkel melek veya ona kötülüğü süslü gösteren şeytandır. (هذا): mübtedâdır. (ما)nın mevsûf bir nekre olması caizdir; (عتيد) onun sıfatıdır; (لدي) de «عتيد»e müteallik zarftır; yani: «Bu, yanımda hazır olan bir şeydir.» Buna göre «لدي»nin «ما»nın sıfatı, «عتيد»in ikinci sıfat olması, yahut mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberi olması (yani «هو عتيد») da caizdir. «ما»nın «الذي» anlamında mevsûl olması da caizdir; (لدي) onun sılası, (عتيد) mevsûlün haberi olur; mevsûl ve sılası da ism-i işaretin haberidir. «ما»nın «هذا»dan bedel olması, «لدي» ile mevsûl veya mevsûf olması, «عتيد»in de «هذا»nın haberi olması da caizdir. Zemahşerî «عتيد»in bedel, haberden sonra ikinci haber veya mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberi olmasını caiz görmüştür. Aşağıda Zemahşerî'nin i'rabının metni vardır; şöyle der: «Eğer "Bu sözün i'rabı nasıldır?" dersen, derim ki: «ما»yı mevsûf yaparsan «عتيد» onun sıfatıdır; mevsûl yaparsan [«عتيد»] bedeldir, ya da haberden sonra haberdir, ya da mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberidir.» Ebü'l-Bekā da şöyle der: «Allah Teâlâ'nın sözü: «هذا» mübtedâdır. «ما» hakkında iki vecih vardır: Birincisi, nekredir; «عتيد» onun sıfatıdır, «لدي» de «عتيد»in ma'mûlüdür. «لدي»nin de sıfat olması, dolayısıyla mahzûfa müteallik olması caizdir. «ما» ve sıfatı «هذا»nın haberidir. İkinci vecih, «ما»nın «الذي» anlamında olmasıdır; buna göre «ما» mübtedâ, «لدي» sıla, «عتيد» «ما»nın haberi olur ve cümle «هذا»nın haberidir. «ما»nın «هذا»dan bedel olması da caizdir. «عتيد»in mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberi, «ما لدي»nin «هذا»nın haberi olması da caizdir; yani «هو عتيد». Bu, Kur'an dışında gelseydi hâl olarak nasbedilmesi caiz olurdu.»
(أَلْقِيا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ): Cümle mahzûf bir sözün mekûlü'l-kavlidir; yani «ألقيا» denir. (ألقيا): tesniye elifine bitiştiği için nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî emir fiildir [Mütercim notu: Emir fiil kaynakta böyle ifade edilmiştir; tesniye elifine bitişik emir, nûnun hazfi üzere mebnî sayılır]. İki meleğe, yani sürücüye ve şahide hitap ettiği söylenmiştir. Bunun tek kişiye hitap olduğu, sözün iki kişiye hitap kalıbında çıkarıldığı da söylenmiştir; çünkü Arapların âdeti, iki kişiye hitabı teke ve çoğula da uygulamaktır. Bundan İmruülkays'ın şu sözü vardır:
قفا نبك من ذكرى حبيب ومنزل ... بسقط اللوى بين الدخول فحومل
(Durun da ağlayalım bir sevgiliyi ve bir konağı anarak; Dehûl ile Havmel arasındaki kum tepesinin bittiği yerde.)
Bir başkasının sözü:
فإن تزجراني يا ابن عفان أنزجر ... وإن ترعياني أحم عرضا ممنعا
(Ey İbn Affân, beni men edersen men olurum; beni gözetirsen korunmuş bir namusu korurum.)
Tek kişiye iki kişiye hitap eder gibi hitap etmiştir. Araplar bunu şu sebeple yapmışlardır: Adamın yardımcılarının en azı iki kişidir: develerinin çobanı ve koyunlarının çobanı. Yol arkadaşları da en az üç kişi olur. Bu yüzden, dilleri ona alıştığından, iki kişiye hitap teke uygulanmıştır. Bundan maksadın «ألق ألق» (at, at) ve «قف قف» (dur, dur) olması da caizdir; elifin eklenmesi, kastedilenin lafzın tekrarı olduğuna delâlet eden bir alamettir. Nitekim Ebû Osmân el-Mâzinî, Allah Teâlâ'nın «رب ارجعون» sözü hakkında şöyle demiştir: Bundan maksat «أرجعني أرجعني أرجعني»dir; vâv, anlamın lafzın defalarca tekrarı olduğunu hissettiren bir alamet kılınmıştır. «ألقين»i kastettiği, İmruülkays'ın da te'kîd yoluyla «قفن»i kastettiği, bu nûnu vasıl hâlinde elife çevirdiği de söylenmiştir; çünkü bu nûn vakıf hâlinde de [elife] çevrilir; böylece vasıl, vakfa hamledilmiştir. Görmez misin ki Allah Teâlâ'nın «لنسفعن» sözü üzerinde vakfetsen «لنسفعا» dersin. el-A'şâ'nın şu sözü de bundandır:
وصلّ على حين العشيات والضحى ... ولا تحمد الشيطان والله فاحمدا
(Akşam vakitlerinde ve kuşlukta namaz kıl; şeytana hamdetme, Allah'a hamdet.)
«فاحمدن»i kastetmiş, te'kîd nûnunu elife çevirmiştir.
(في جهنم): «ألقيا»ya müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. (كلّ كفّار): mef'ûlün bihtir. (عنيد): «كفّار»ın sıfatıdır.
(مَنَّاعٍ لِلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُرِيبٍ): Art arda gelen sıfatlardır.
(الَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلهاً آخَرَ فَأَلْقِياهُ فِي الْعَذابِ الشَّدِيدِ): (الذي)nin «كل»den bedel olması, dolayısıyla nasb mahallinde olması; yahut «كفّار»dan bedel olması, dolayısıyla cer mahallinde olması; zem üzere mansûb olması; ya da mübtedâ olması, dolayısıyla ref' mahallinde olması caizdir. (جعل) cümlesi sıladır. (مع الله): ikinci mef'ûlün bih olan mahzûfa müteallik zarftır. (إلها آخر): birinci mef'ûlün bihtir. الفاء, umum bakımından mevsûlün şarta benzemesi sebebiyle bağlayıcıdır. (ألقياه): emir fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir; [«الذي»] haber [Mütercim notu: kaynakta «خبرا» yazılıdır; «mübtedâ» kastedilmiştir] yapıldığında bu cümle «الذي»nin haberidir. Birincisi daha râcihtir. (في العذاب): «ألقياه»ya müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. (الشديد): «العذاب»ın sıfatıdır.
(قالَ قَرِينُهُ رَبَّنا ما أَطْغَيْتُهُ وَلكِنْ كانَ فِي ضَلالٍ بَعِيدٍ): (قال قرينه): fiil ve fâildir. (ربنا): muzâf münâdâdır. (ما): nefy harfidir. (أطغيته): fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir. (لكن): hafifletildiği için mühmel olan istidrâk harfidir. (كان): nâkıs mâzî fiildir; ismi müstetir olup takdiri «هو»dur. (في ضلال): «كان»ın haberi olan mahzûfa müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. (بعيد): «ضلال»in sıfatıdır. (قال قرينه) cümlesi isti'nâfiyyedir; bu yüzden vâvsız gelmiştir. Zemahşerî şöyle der: «Eğer "Bu cümle niçin vâvdan boş bırakıldı da birincisine [vâv] girdi?" dersen, derim ki: Çünkü bu, karşılıklı konuşmanın hikâyesinde yer alan cümlelerin isti'nâf edildiği gibi isti'nâf edilmiştir; Mûsâ ile Firavun arasındaki konuşmanın hikâyesinde gördüğün gibi. Eğer "Burada karşılıklı konuşma nerede?" dersen, derim ki: Karînin "هذا ما لديّ عتيد" dediği, ardından "قال ربنا ما أطغيته" sözünün geldiği ve onu "لا تختصموا لديّ" sözünün takip ettiği zaman, orada kâfirden bir konuşma olduğu anlaşıldı; fakat ona delâlet eden şey sebebiyle atıldı. Sanki "Rabbim, o beni azdırdı" demiş, karîni de "Rabbimiz, ben onu azdırmadım" demiştir. Birinci cümleye gelince, onun anlamı ile önceki cümlenin anlamının meydana gelişte birleştiğine, yani her nefsin iki melekle gelişine ve karîninin ona söylediğini söylemesine delâlet etmek için onun atfı vâciptir.»
(قالَ لا تَخْتَصِمُوا لَدَيَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُمْ بِالْوَعِيدِ): (لا): nehiy lâsıdır. (تختصموا): meczûm muzâri fiildir; cümle mekûlü'l-kavldir. (لدي): «تختصموا»ya müteallik zarftır. الواو hâl içindir. (قد): tahkîk harfidir. (قدمت): fiil ve fâildir. (إليكم): «قدمت»e müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. «بالوعيد»daki الباء, «ولا تلقوا بأيديكم إلى التهلكة»deki gibi zâidedir; ya da «قدّم» fiilinin «تقدّم» anlamında mutâvaat fiili olması itibarıyla ta'diye içindir. Fiilin «ما يبدل القول لدي وما أنا بظلّام للعبيد» cümlesine vâki olması da caizdir; bu durumda «بالوعيد» hâl olur; yani: «Bunu size vaîdle birlikte, ona bitişik olarak takdim ettim», ya da «Onu size, sizi onunla tehdit ederek takdim ettim.»
(ما يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ وَما أَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ): (ما): nefy harfidir. (يبدل): meçhul muzâri fiildir. (القول): nâib-i fâildir. (لدي): «يبدل»e müteallik zarftır. الواو atıf harfidir. (ما): Hicâziyye nefy «ما»sıdır. (أنا): onun ismidir. الباء zâide cer harfidir. (ظلّام): lafzen mecrûr, «ما»nın haberi olarak mahallen mansûbdur. (للعبيد): «ظلّام»a müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur.
(يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ): (يوم)u nasbeden âmil hakkında iki vecih vardır: Onu mukadder bir «اذكر» ile mansûb yapman, ya da «ظلام»a bağlaman; çünkü bu günde zulmetmeyince başka [günlerde] zulmün ondan nefyi evleviyetle olur. (نقول لجهنم) cümlesi, zarfın ona muzâf olmasıyla cer mahallindedir. (هل امتلأت) cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavldir. (تقول): «نقول»a atıftır. (هل): istifhâm harfidir. (من): zâide cer harfidir. (مزيد): lafzen mecrûr, mahallen mübtedâ olarak merfûdur; haberi mahzûf olup takdiri «موجود»dur.

* Belâgat:
1- «فكشفنا عنك غطاءك» sözünde gafletten kinâye vardır; sanki gaflet onun tamamını veya iki gözünü örtmüş de görmüyordur. Kıyamet olunca gaflet ondan kalkar, hakikatler ona açılır, önüne sarkıtılmış olan pas ondan sıyrılır ve hayatında görmediğini görür. Örtünün (الغطاء) istiâre-i tasrîhiyye olması da caizdir; gaflet, onunla bütün bedeninin örtüldüğü bir örtü veya onunla gözlerinin örtüldüğü bir perde gibi kılınmıştır; artık hiçbir şey görmez.
2- İstiâre-i mekniyye: Allah Teâlâ'nın «يوم نقول لجهنم هل امتلأت وتقول هل من مزيد» sözünü istiâre-i mekniyye-i tahyîliyyeye hamletmek caizdir. Mu'tezile ve Ehl-i Sünnet'ten onların görüşünü söyleyenler bu yolu tutmuştur. Zemahşerî şöyle der: «Cehennem'e sorulması ve onun cevabı, mânâyı kalpte tasvir etmek ve sabitleştirmek kastedilen tahyîl babındandır. Burada iki mânâ vardır: Birincisi, genişliğine ve kenarlarının birbirinden uzaklığına rağmen dolması; öyle ki artık hiçbir şey ona sığmaz ve doluluğuna ilave yapılmaz; Allah Teâlâ'nın "لأملأنّ جهنم" sözü sebebiyle. İkincisi, onun öyle genişlikte olması ki, girenler girer ve onda yine de ilave için yer bulunur. «هل من مزيد»in, ona girenleri çok bulmak için veya isyankârlara öfkeyle ilave istemek için olması da caizdir. المزيد ya «المحيد ve المحيد» [Mütercim notu: kaynakta aynı kelime iki kez yazılmıştır; olduğu gibi çevrilmiştir] gibi masdardır, ya da «المبيع» gibi ism-i mef'ûldür.»
Onu hakikate hamletmek de caizdir. Ehl-i Sünnet'in cumhuru hakikat yolunu tutmuş, Zemahşerî'ye ve başkalarına tahyîl lafzını kullanmalarını reddetmiş ve bunun lafız ve mânâ bakımından münker olduğunu söylemişlerdir. Lafız bakımından, çünkü bu, anlamları sahih olsa bile Allah Teâlâ'nın celâli hakkında vehim uyandıran lafızlardandır; tahyîl lafzının uyandırdığı vehimden daha şiddetli hangi vehim olabilir? Görmez misin, Allah onu, sihir ve bâtıl olduğunu haber verdiği şey hakkında «يخيل إليه من سحرهم أنها تسعى» sözünde nasıl kullanmıştır! Dolayısıyla ondan kaçınmanın vücûbunda şüphe edilmez. Mânâ bakımından ise, çünkü Ehl-i Sünnet Cehennem'e sorulmasının ve onun cevabının hakikat olduğuna, Allah Teâlâ'nın şartıyla birlikte onda bunu idrak etme kabiliyetini yarattığına inanır.
Şairler bu yüksek belâgatin eteklerine tutunmuşlardır. Onun göğüne ilk göz diken Ferezdak olmuştur. Zeynelâbidîn b. el-Hüseyn b. Ali b. Ebû Tâlib hakkında, ilk beyti şu olan kasidesinde:
هذا الذي تعرف البطحاء وطأته ... والبيت يعرفه والحلّ والحرم
(Bu, Bathâ'nın ayak basışını tanıdığı kimsedir; Beyt onu tanır, Hil de Harem de.)
şöyle demiştir:
يكاد يمسكه عرفان راحته ... ركن الحطيم إذا ما جاء يستلم
(İstilâm etmeye geldiğinde, Hatîm'in rüknü avucunu tanıdığından neredeyse onu tutacaktır.)
Ebû Temmâm ona uymuştur:
لو يعلم الركن من قد جاء يلثمه ... لخرّ يلثم منه موطئ القدم
(Rükün, kendisini öpmeye gelenin kim olduğunu bilseydi, onun ayağının bastığı yeri öpmek için yere kapanırdı.)
Buhturî onu almış ve güzel yapmıştır:
فلو أن مشتاقا تكلف فوق ما ... في سعة لسعى إليك المنبر
(Bir özleyen gücünün üstündekini yüklenebilseydi, minber sana doğru koşardı.) [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «في سعة» yazılıdır; beytin bilinen rivayeti «في وسعه»dir.]
Mütenebbî de bu yolu şu sözüyle tutmuştur:
لو تعقل الشجر التي قابلتها ... مدّت محيّية إليك الأغصنا
(Karşılaştığın ağaçlar akıl sahibi olsaydı, seni selamlayarak dallarını sana uzatırlardı.)
Câhiliyede ise bu mânâ, Antere'nin Muallaka'sında atını tasvir ederken söylediği şu sözde gelmiştir:
فازور من وقع القنا بلبانه ... وشكا إليّ بعبرة وتحمحم
(Mızrakların göğsüne isabetinden yan döndü; gözyaşı ve kişnemeyle bana şikâyet etti.)
Bu istiâredeki hissî tahyîlin ve öfkeli, doymak bilmeyen obur Cehennem'i cisimleştirmenin güzelliği gözünden kaçmasın. Dünyada hidayete davetten kulaklarını tıkayan, sapıklıklarında ve inatlarında ısrar eden o kimseler ona üşüşmüşlerdir; işte şimdi onlar onun davetine zorla icabet ediyorlar.

* Lügat:
(لُغُوبٍ) Yorgunluk. el-Muhtâr'da şöyle denir: «اللغوب, iki damme ile, yorgunluk ve bitkinliktir; babı دخل'dir. Kesre ile «لغب لغوبا» zayıf bir lügattir.» el-Misbâh'ta onun قتل babından olduğu, el-Kāmûs'ta ise منع ve كرم babından da olduğu belirtilir.
(أَدْبارَ) Hemzenin fethasıyla, iki damme ile «دبر»in çoğuludur. Zaman zarfının yerine geçmiş bir masdar olması itibarıyla hemzenin kesresiyle (إدبار) de okunmuştur; onu Nâfi', İbn Kesîr ve Hamza okumuştur. Sahâbe ve tâbiînden bir topluluk şöyle demiştir: «إدبار السجود», akşamdan sonraki iki rekâttır; «إدبار النجوم» ise sabahtan önceki iki rekâttır.

* İ'rab:
(وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَما بَيْنَهُما فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَما مَسَّنا مِنْ لُغُوبٍ): الواو isti'nâfiyyedir; söz, «Allah gökleri ve yeri altı günde yarattı, sonra dinlendi ve cumartesi günü Arş üzerine uzandı; bu yüzden o günde çalışmayı bıraktılar» diyen Yahudileri reddetmek için getirilmiş isti'nâfiyyedir. اللام mahzûf kasemin cevabıdır. (قد): tahkîk harfidir. (خلقنا): fiil ve fâildir. (السموات): mef'ûlün bihtir. (الأرض): «السموات»a atıftır. (في ستة أيام): «خلقنا»ya müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. الواو atıf veya hâl vâvıdır. (ما): nefy harfidir. (مسّنا): mâzî fiil; (نا) mef'ûlün bihtir. (من): zâide cer harfidir. (لغوب): lafzen mecrûr, fâil olduğu için mahallen merfûdur.
(فَاصْبِرْ عَلى ما يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ): الفاء fasîha fâsıdır. (اصبر): emir fiildir; fâili müstetir olup takdiri «أنت»tir. (على ما يقولون): «اصبر»e müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. (سبّح): emir fiildir. (بحمد ربك): «سبّح»in fâilinden hâldir; yani hamdederek namaz kıl. (قبل طلوع الشمس): «سبّح»e müteallik zarftır. (قبل الغروب): zarfa atıftır.
(وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبارَ السُّجُودِ): الواو atıf harfidir. (من الليل): «سبّح»e müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. الفاء atıf harfidir. (سبّحه): emir fiil, müstetir fâil; الهاء mef'ûlün bihtir. (أدبار السجود): zarftır.
(وَاسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنادِ الْمُنادِ مِنْ مَكانٍ قَرِيبٍ): Öncekine atıftır. (استمع): emir fiildir; fâili müstetir olup takdiri «أنت»tir; mef'ûlü mahzûftur; yani: «Münâdînin nidâsını dinle.» Zarf, «استمع»e müteallik zarftır.. Mef'ûlün takdirinin «Sana söyleyeceğim şeyi [dinle]» olduğu da söylenmiştir; buna göre «يوم», «ذلك يوم الخروج» sözünün delâlet ettiği mukadder bir «يخرجون» ile mansûb olur. «ينادي»nin yâsı resme uyularak hazfedilmiştir. (المناد): fâildir; bazı kıraatlerde yâ yine resim için hazfedilmiştir. (من مكان): «ينادي»ye müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. (قريب): sıfattır. Münâdî İsrâfil'dir; onun Cebrâil olduğu, üfleyenin ise İsrâfil olduğu da söylenmiştir; Şihâb el-Hafâcî bunu tercih etmiştir.
(يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ ذلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُرُوجِ): Zarf, birinci zarftan bedeldir. (يسمعون) cümlesi «إذا»nın [Mütercim notu: kaynakta «إذا» yazılıdır; burada zarf «يوم»dur] ona muzâf olmasıyla cer mahallindedir. (الصيحة): mef'ûlün bihtir. (بالحق): «يسمعون»daki vâvdan veya «الصيحة»den hâldir. (ذلك): mübtedâ; (يوم الخروج): haberdir.
(إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا الْمَصِيرُ): إن ve ismi; (نحن): fasl zamiri veya mübtedâdır. (نحيي) cümlesi «إنا»nın haberi veya «نحن»in haberidir ve [bu ikinci durumda] cümle «إن»nin haberidir. (إلينا): mukaddem haber; (المصير): muahhar mübtedâdır.
(يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِراعاً ذلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنا يَسِيرٌ): Zarf öncekinden bedeldir; bazıları, [bedelin] çoğalması sebebiyle buna engel olmuş ve onu «المصير»e bağlamıştır. (تشقق) cümlesi, zarfın ona muzâf olmasıyla cer mahallindedir. «تشقق»un aslı «تتشقق»tur; ikinci tânın şîne idğamıyla şînin şeddesiyle de okunmuştur. (الأرض): fâildir. (عنهم): «تشقق»a müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. (سراعا): «عنهم»deki zamirden hâldir. (ذلك): mübtedâ; (حشر): haberdir. (علينا): «يسير»e müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. (يسير): «ذلك»in haberidir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta hem «حشر» hem «يسير» «ذلك»in haberi olarak gösterilmiştir; «يسير»in «حشر»in sıfatı olması açıktır.]
(نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِما يَقُولُونَ وَما أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍ): (نحن): mübtedâ; (أعلم): haberdir. (بما): «أعلم»e müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur; «ما» mevsûl veya masdariyyedir. الواو atıf harfidir. (ما): Hicâziyye nefy «ما»sıdır. (أنت): onun ismidir. (عليهم): «جبار»a müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. الباء zâide cer harfidir. (جبار): «الباء» ile lafzen mecrûr, «ما»nın haberi olarak mahallen mansûbdur.
(فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْآنِ مَنْ يَخافُ وَعِيدِ): الفاء fasîha fâsıdır. (ذكر): emir fiildir. (بالقرآن): «ذكر»e müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. (من): mef'ûlün bihtir. (يخاف) cümlesi sıladır. (وعيد): «يخاف»ın mef'ûlüdür; mütekellim yâsı resme uyularak hazfedilmiştir.

﴿وجاءت كل نفس معها سائق وشهيد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; جاءت كل نفس: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); معها: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); سائق: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); شهيد is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to سائق; the nominal clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as an adjective of كل, or in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as an adjective of it, i.e. "with it is one who drives it and presses hard upon it (ويشد عليها)" [Translator's note: so in the source; probably ويشهد عليها, "and bears witness against it", is meant]; and you may make it a ḥāl (circumstantial).

﴿يوم يسمعون الصيحة بالحق ذلك يوم الخروج﴾: the adverb is a badal (substitute) from the first adverb; the clause يسمعون is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of إذا to it [Translator's note: the source has «إذا» here; the adverb to which the clause is annexed is ﴿يوم﴾]; الصيحة: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالحق: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in يسمعون, or from الصيحة; ذلك: mubtadaʾ (subject); يوم الخروج: khabar (predicate).

﴿والسَّماءِ ذاتِ الحُبُكِ﴾ ﴿إنَّكم لَفي قَوْلٍ مُخْتَلِفٍ﴾ [Zâriyât: 8] kavli: Tefsirde onun güzel ahlâk (huluk) sahibi olduğu gelmiştir. [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta «الخُلُقِ» (ahlâk) geçmektedir; «الخَلْقِ» (yaratılış) kastedilmiş olması muhtemeldir.] Dil âlimleri ise ”ذاتِ الحُبُكِ“: güzel yolları (çizgileri) olan, derler. Dilde ”اَلْمَحْبُوكُ“, işçiliği güzel yapılmış şeydir. Suda ve kumda rüzgâr değdiğinde gördüğün yolların (dalgalanmaların) her biri ”حُبُكٌ“tur. Tekili ”مِثالٌ“ ve ”مُثُلٌ“ gibi ”حِباكٌ“tır; tekili ”طَرِيقَةٌ“ ve ”طُرُقٌ“ gibi ”حَبِيكَةٌ“ da olur.
﴿إنَّكم لَفي قَوْلٍ مُخْتَلِفٍ﴾ [Zâriyât: 8] kavli: Yani Hz. Peygamber'in (s.a.v.) işi hakkında.
﴿يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَن أُفِكَ﴾: Yani ondan çevrilen kimse çevrilir.

﴿فَقالُوا سَلامًا قالَ سَلامٌ﴾; ”قالَ سِلْمٌ“ şeklinde de okunmuştur. Birincisinin nasbı ”اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكم سَلامًا“ ve ”سَلَّمْنا عَلَيْكَ سَلامًا“ (sana bir selâmla selâm verdik) manası üzeredir. ﴿قالَ سَلامٌ﴾ diye okuyana göre iki vecih vardır: ”Size selâm olsun, dedi“ manası üzere; ve ”Bizim işimiz selâmettir“ manası üzere olması da caizdir. ”سِلْمٌ“ diye okuyana göre mana: ”سِلْمٌ dedi“, yani ”Benim işim barıştır“, ”Bizim işimiz barıştır“, yani ”Bizim için bir korku yoktur“ demektir.
﴿قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ﴾ kavli: Ref'i ”Siz tanınmayan bir topluluksunuz“ manası üzeredir.

﴿وَلا تَجْعَلُوا مَعَ اللَّهِ إلَهًا آخَرَ إنِّي لَكم مِنهُ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ ﴿كَذَلِكَ ما أتى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ مِن رَسُولٍ﴾ [Zâriyât: 52] kavli: Mana: ”İş böyledir“ demektir; yani peygamberleri yalanlama hususunda onlardan öncekilerin yaptığı gibi.
﴿إلا قالُوا ساحِرٌ أوْ مَجْنُونٌ﴾ [Zâriyât: 52]: Yani ”Ancak ‘Bu bir sihirbazdır’ dediler.“ ”ساحِرٌ“, gizli bir ”هُوَ“ ile merfû olmuştur.

His saying: ﴿وَما خَلَقْتُ الجِنَّ والإنْسَ إلا لِيَعْبُدُونِ﴾: Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, knew before He created the jinn and mankind who would worship Him, as distinct from those who would disbelieve in Him. Had He created them only to compel them to worship Him, they would all have been worshipping believers, and there would have been none among them who went astray and disbelieved. So the meaning is: "I did not create the jinn and mankind except to call them to My worship, and I desire worship from them" — meaning from those who are its people.

﴿إنَّ اللَّهَ هو الرَّزّاقُ ذُو القُوَّةِ المَتِينُ﴾: Kıraat ref' iledir; Arapça'da da ”اَلْمَتِينُ“un Allah Teâlâ'nın sıfatı olarak merfû olmasıyla daha güzeldir. ”ذُو القُوَّةِ المَتِينِ“ şeklinde hafd ile okuyan ise ”اَلْمَتِينِ“i ”اَلْقُوَّةِ“nin sıfatı yapmıştır; çünkü ”اَلْقُوَّةِ“nin müennesliği ”اَلْمَوْعِظَةِ“nin müennesliği gibidir; nitekim şöyle buyurmuştur: ﴿فَمَن جاءَهُ مَوْعِظَةٌ﴾ [Bakara: 275]; mana: ”Kime bir öğüt (وعْظ) gelirse“ demektir. ﴿ذُو القُوَّةِ المَتِينُ﴾un anlamı: Şiddetli kudret sahibi, demektir.

﴿فَإنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ذَنُوبًا مِثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أصْحابِهِمْ﴾ kavli: Dilde ”اَلذَّنُوبُ“: Paydır; kovaya da ”اَلذَّنُوبُ“ denir. Mana: ”Zulmedenler için, helak edilen arkadaşlarının —Âd, Semûd ve Lût kavmi gibi— payı gibi azaptan bir pay vardır.“
﴿فَلا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ﴾: Yani ”Eğer kıyamet gününe kadar ertelenirlerse.“

His saying: {ذَاتِ الحبك}: The majority read «الحُبُك» with two ḍammas, which are the tracks, such as the tracks of sand and water when the wind strikes it; and «حُبُك الشَّعْر» are the marks of its curling and waving. Zuhayr said:
4102 - مُكَلَِلٌ بأصولِ النجم تَنْسُجُه ... ريحُ حَريقٍ لضاحي مائِه حُبُكُ
(Crowned with the roots of the plants, a fierce wind weaves ripples on the exposed face of its water.)
«الحُبُك» is a plural; its singular may be «حَبيكة», like «طريقة» and «طُرُق», or «حِباك», like «حِمار» and «حُمُر». The rajaz poet said:
4103 - كأنَّما جَلَّلها الحُوَّاكُ ... طِنْفِسَةٌ في وَشْيِها حِباكُ
(As if the weavers had covered it with a carpet whose embroidery has woven patterns.)
The root of «الحَبْك» is making a thing firm and well-made, and from this a coat of mail is called «مَحْبوكة». It was also said: «الحَبْك» is tightening and securing. Imruʾ al-Qays said:
4104 - قد غدا يَحْمِلُنِي في أَنْفِه ... لاحِقُ الإِطْلَيْنِ مَحْبوكٌ مُمَرّْ
(He set out carrying me on his nose-ridge: a horse lean in the flanks, tightly built, strongly twisted.)
There are many readings of this word. From al-Ḥasan there are six: «الحُبُك» with ḍamma as the majority; «الحُبْك» with ḍamma and sukūn, which is also reported from Ibn ʿAbbās and Abū ʿAmr; «الحِبِك» with kasra on both; «الحِبْك» with kasra and sukūn, which is a lightening of the kasra form; «الحِبَك» with kasra and fatḥa; and «الحِبُك» with kasra and ḍamma. Of these six, the last is the most troubling, because this pattern is unused among Arabic forms. Ibn ʿAṭiyya and others said: "It is from «التداخل» (tadākhul, interpenetration)", meaning that there are two dialects, kasra on the «حاء» and the «باء», and ḍamma on both; so this reader took the kasra from one dialect and the ḍamma from the other. People found this unlikely, since tadākhul only occurs between two words. The Shaykh explained it on the basis that the «حاء» was made to follow the vowel of the «تاء» in «ذات»; he said: "He did not count the «لام» as a separator, since it is sukūn, and so it is a weak barrier." «أو مالك» al-Ghifārī agreed with al-Ḥasan on this reading. [Translator's note: the source text reads «أو مالك» (sic); it is understood as Abū Mālik.] ʿIkrima read it with ḍamma and fatḥa, as the plural of «حُبْكة», like «غُرْفة» and «غُرَف». Ibn ʿAbbās and Abū Mālik read «الحَبَك» with two fatḥas, the plural of «حَبَكة», like «عَقَبة» and «عَقَب». These are eight readings.

Onun sözü: {وَجُنُودَهُ}: «أَخَذْناه»nın mef'ûlüne atıf olması câizdir -zâhir olan budur-; mef'ûlün maah olması da câizdir.
Onun sözü: {وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ}: Hâl cümlesidir. «نَبَذْناهم»nın mef'ûlünden hâl ise vâv lâzımdır; çünkü onda hâl sahibine dönen bir zikir yoktur. «أَخَذْناه»nın mef'ûlünden hâl ise vâv vâcip değildir; çünkü cümlede ona dönen bir zikir vardır. Şöyle de denebilir: «نَبَذْناهم»daki zamir Fir'avn'a ve ordusuna döner; böylece hâlde, ilk zamirin kapsadığı şeyin bir kısmına dönen bir zikir olmuş olur. Bunda nazar vardır; çünkü bu, «Sultan ordusuyla geldi, ben de onları, onun atına binmiş olarak ağırladım» sözünün benzeri olur; böylece «binmiş olarak»ı «أكرمتُهم»in zamirinin kapsadığı şeyin bir kısmından hâl kılarsın.

Onun sözü: {إِلاَّ جَعَلَتْهُ كالرميم}: Bu cümle, «تَذَرُ»ün ikinci mef'ûlü mahallindedir; sanki «hiçbir şeyi, kılınmış olmaksızın bırakmaz», yani «Zeyd'i ancak âlim olarak bıraktım» (ما تركتُ زيداً إلاَّ عالماً) gibi denmiştir. Şeyh (Ebû Hayyân) onu hâl olarak i'rab etti; bu açık değildir.

* Vocabulary:
(ضَيْفِ) Ḍayf is used for one and for many, because it is originally a maṣdar, like zawr and ṣawm. It was said they were twelve angels. In al-Qāmūs: "Ḍayf is for the singular and the plural; it may also be pluralised as aḍyāf, ḍuyūf and ḍayfān; and she is a ḍayf and a ḍayfa." As for ḍayfan, he is one who comes along with the guest as a sponger. In al-Asās: Ḍāfa ilayhi means "he inclined to him", and ḍāfa ʿanhu "he inclined away from him"; ḍāfa l-sahmu ʿani l-hadaf "the arrow veered from the target"; and "the sun ḍāfat, ḍayyafat and taḍayyafat" means it inclined toward setting. Bishr said:
طاو برملة أورال تضيفه ... إلى الكناس عشيّ بارد صرد
(Gaunt, on the sands of Awrāl, a cold, bitter evening inclined him toward his lair.) That is, it inclined him toward it. "The she-camel tuḍīfu to the stallion and the girl tuḍīfu to the man" means she takes comfort in his voice and wishes to go to him; "aḍif ẓahraka ilā l-ḥāʾiṭ" means "lean your back against the wall". Imruʾ al-Qays said:
فلما دخلناه أضفنا ظهورنا ... إلى كل حاري جديد مشطّب
(When we entered it we leaned our backs against every new, striped ḥārī (of al-Ḥīra make).) And "they alighted at ḍayf al-wādī" means at its side; "taḍāyafū l-wādī" means they came to its side; "ḍāfanī and taḍayyafanī" (he was my guest). Al-Farazdaq said:
ومنّا خطيب لا يعاب وقائل ... ومن هو يرجو فضله المتضيف
(Among us is an orator who is not faulted, and a speaker, and one whose bounty the guest hopes for.) And "aḍaftuhu and ḍayyaftuhu" (I hosted him), and he is a ḍayf, and likewise the plural; they are ḍuyūf, aḍyāf and ḍayfān.
(فَراغَ) Rāgha means to go off secretly, and this is part of the host's good manners, that he surprise his guest with his hospitality. In al-Miṣbāḥ: "Rāgha l-thaʿlabu rawghan (verb pattern qāla) and rawaghānan: it went right and left quickly and deceptively, so it does not settle in one direction; and 'rāgha fulān ilā kadhā' means he inclined to it secretly."
(فَأَوْجَسَ) He concealed within himself.
(صَرَّةٍ) With fatḥa on the ṣād, it is intensity of shouting, wailing and groaning from the heat of «الجند» [Translator's note: the source reads «حرّ الجند»; «حرّ الوجد» (the heat of passion) is probably meant], and "ṣarra the pen and the door" (they creaked). It was also said: a group of people. In al-Ṣiḥāḥ: "Al-ṣarra: the uproar and «الصحة» [Translator's note: the source reads «الصحة»; «الصيحة» (the cry) is probably meant]. Al-ṣarra: the group. Al-ṣarra: severity, of war or otherwise."
(فَصَكَّتْ) There is disagreement about ṣakk. It was said to be striking with the open hand; it was also said to be striking the face with the fingertips as one who is astonished, which is the habit of women when they find something strange. The origin of ṣakk is striking one thing with a broad thing.
(خَطْبُكُمْ) Your affair. Khaṭb originally means a grave matter, and from it comes the khuṭba, because it is eloquent speech aimed at grave matters.
(مُسَوَّمَةً) Marked, from sawma, which is the mark.

* I'rab:
(هَلْ أَتاكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْراهِيمَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ) hal is an interrogative particle, and the interrogation here means magnification and alerting that the account was not from the knowledge of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and that he knew it only by revelation. أَتاكَ is a verb with a fronted direct object; ضَيْفِ إِبْراهِيمَ is annexed to الْحَدِيثُ; and الْمُكْرَمِينَ is an adjective of ضَيْفِ. (إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَقالُوا سَلاماً قالَ سَلامٌ قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ) إِذْ is an adverb for time that has passed, accusative either by الْمُكْرَمِينَ because Abraham honoured them, or by the verbal sense contained in ضَيْفِ, or by an implied "اذكر" (remember), or by حَدِيثُ, that is, "has the account of them reached you, at the time of their entering upon him?"; Ibn Hishām preferred this because it is a maṣdar with a whiff of the verb. The clause دَخَلُوا is in the position of the genitive by the adverb's annexation to it, and عَلَيْهِ is attached to دَخَلُوا; فَقالُوا is conjoined to دَخَلُوا; سَلاماً is an absolute object whose verb was dispensed with because it takes its place, its origin being "we greet you with a greeting"; قالَ is a past verb with a latent agent, implied "he"; سَلامٌ is a mubtadaʾ, and commencing with it was permissible although indefinite because it contains the sense of a supplication; the shift to the nominative by inchoation was to indicate permanence and continuity of the greeting, so that his salutation would be better than theirs; the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "سلام عليكم". Both were read in the nominative. قَوْمٌ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, implied "وأنتم" or "هم", and مُنْكَرُونَ is an adjective of قَوْمٌ. (فَراغَ إِلى أَهْلِهِ فَجاءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ) The fāʾ is a conjunction upon an implied element required by the context, that is, "so he hastened to honour them without letting them notice", since part of the etiquette of hospitality is that the host surprise his guests with food without their noticing him, for fear they would spare him the trouble; hence رَاغَ. رَاغَ is a past verb with a latent agent, and إِلى أَهْلِهِ is attached to رَاغَ; فَجاءَ is a conjunction of immediate sequence; بِعِجْلٍ is attached to جَاءَ and سَمِينٍ is an adjective of عِجْلٍ. (فَقَرَّبَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ قالَ أَلا تَأْكُلُونَ) Conjoined to what preceded; إِلَيْهِمْ is attached to قَرَّبَهُ; أَلا is a particle of interrogation and lā is negative, the interrogation meaning offering or rebuke; تَأْكُلُونَ is a nominative imperfect verb, and the clause is the content of the saying. (فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً) The fāʾ is a conjunction upon an implied element required by the context, that is, "when he saw their abstaining and their insistence on abstaining, he sensed fear of them", thinking they intended to harm him; خِيفَةً is the object of أَوْجَسَ. (قالُوا لا تَخَفْ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلامٍ عَلِيمٍ) lā is prohibitive, and تَخَفْ is an imperfect verb jussive by lā; بَشَّرُوهُ is a past verb with agent and direct object; بِغُلامٍ is attached to بَشَّرُوهُ, and عَلِيمٍ is an adjective of غُلامٍ. (فَأَقْبَلَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ فِي صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَها وَقالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ) Also conjoined to an implied element that is indispensable, that is, "when Sarah, Abraham's wife, heard the good news, she came forward crying out". امْرَأَتُهُ is the agent of فَأَقْبَلَتِ; فِي صَرَّةٍ is attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl, that is, "ṣārra" (crying out); فَصَكَّتْ is conjoined to فَأَقْبَلَتِ; وَجْهَها is a direct object; وَقالَتْ is also conjoined; عَجُوزٌ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, that is, "I am an old woman", and عَقِيمٌ is an adjective, that is, "I am an old woman, barren, so how shall I give birth?" ʿAqīm is of the pattern faʿīl in the sense of mafʿūl, in which masculine and feminine are alike, that is, "made barren", as though she were bound with a tie; one also says "a man ʿaqīm". He said:
عقم النساء فما يلدن شبيهه ... إن النساء بمثله عقيم
(Women have been made barren and bear none like him; truly, women are barren of his like.) (قالُوا كَذلِكَ قالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ) قالُوا is a verb and agent; كَذلِكَ is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, that is, "a saying like that which we said"; قالَ رَبُّكِ is a verb and agent; inna and its noun; هُوَ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) or ʿimād, with no position; الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ are two khabars of inna. (قالَ فَما خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ) قالَ is a past verb whose agent is latent, that is, Abraham; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it makes explicit an implied conditional, that is, "if you are angels as you say, then what is your business?"; مَا is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ, and خَطْبُكُمْ is the khabar; أَيُّهَا is a vocative from which the vocative particle is omitted, indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is a specified indefinite, and the hāʾ is for alerting; الْمُرْسَلُونَ is a badal. (قالُوا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنا إِلى قَوْمٍ مُجْرِمِينَ) inna and its noun; the clause أُرْسِلْنا is the khabar, and nā is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause أُرْسِلْنا is the khabar of inna; inna and what is within its scope is the content of the saying; إِلى قَوْمٍ is attached to أُرْسِلْنا, and مُجْرِمِينَ is an adjective. (لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجارَةً مِنْ طِينٍ) The lām is for justification; نُرْسِلَ is an imperfect verb accusative by an implied an after the lām of justification, the agent being latent, implied "نحن"; عَلَيْهِمْ is attached to نُرْسِلَ; حِجارَةً is a direct object, and مِنْ طِينٍ is an adjective of حِجارَةً; the lām of justification and its genitive noun are attached to أُرْسِلْنا. (مُسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ) مُسَوَّمَةً is a second adjective of حِجارَةً or a ḥāl from it, since it was described by the preposition and its genitive noun; عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ, the adverbial, is attached to مُسَوَّمَةً, and لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ is also attached to مُسَوَّمَةً. (فَأَخْرَجْنا مَنْ كانَ فِيها مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ)
The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it makes explicit clauses that have been omitted; أَخْرَجْنا is a verb and agent; مَنْ is an object; كانَ is an incomplete past verb whose noun is latent, implied "هم", and فِيها is its khabar; مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ is a ḥāl; the clause كانَ is the ṣila of the relative and has no position; and the pronoun in فِيها refers to the towns of the people of Lot, though they were not mentioned, since they were known. (فَما وَجَدْنا فِيها غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ) The fāʾ is a conjunction, and مَا is negative; وَجَدْنا is a verb and agent; غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ is a direct object, and مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ is an adjective; they are Lot and his two daughters, and they were described with faith and submission (islām) because they affirmed with their hearts and acted with their limbs. (وَتَرَكْنا فِيها آيَةً لِلَّذِينَ يَخافُونَ الْعَذابَ الْأَلِيمَ) The wāw is a conjunction; تَرَكْنا is a verb and agent, and فِيها is attached to تَرَكْنا; آيَةً is a direct object; لِلَّذِينَ is an adjective of آيَةً; and the clause يَخافُونَ الْعَذابَ الْأَلِيمَ is the ṣila of the relative.

* Rhetoric:
1- The confirmatory interrogative (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī): in His saying «هل أتاك حديث ضيف إبراهيم المكرمين» is a confirmatory interrogative, to magnify the account and to gather the addressee's attention, as when you begin by telling someone something wondrous and ask him whether he has heard it or not, as though you require him to say "no" and ask you for the account.
2- Omission (al-ḥadhf): in His saying «قوم منكرون» there is omission, and there is disagreement about the implied omitted mubtadaʾ. It was said that what suits the state of Abraham, peace be upon him, is that he did not address them with this, given the lack of friendliness in it, which is not hidden; rather the implied form appears to be "هؤلاء قوم منكرون" (these are strange people), and he said it to himself or to those with him of his followers and servants, such that the guests did not hear it. It was also said that he found them strange because they were not among his acquaintances, or not of the kind of people he knew, or he saw in them a state and appearance different from the state and appearance of people; or that this was a question to them, as if he said "you are strange people, so tell me who you are".
3- Mursal metonymy (al-majāz al-mursal): in His saying «قالوا لا تخف وبشّروه بغلام عليم» there is a majāz mursal, for the boy was called "knowing" in view of what his affair would become when he grew up.

* Vocabulary:
(بِرُكْنِهِ) Rukn is the side one leans on. In al-Qāmūs: "Rakana ilayhi (like naṣara, ʿalima and manaʿa) rukūnan: he «حال» and settled [Translator's note: the source reads «حال»; «مال» (he inclined) is probably meant]; al-rukn, with ḍamma, is the stronger side, the great matter, and that by which one is strengthened, of kingship, troops and so on, and might and protection." The meaning of tawallā bi-ruknihi is: he turned away, swerved aside and deviated, headstrong.
(بِرُكْنِهِ)
[Translator's note: the source repeats this headword and its explanation at this point.] Rukn is the side one leans on. In al-Qāmūs: "Rakana ilayhi (like naṣara, ʿalima and manaʿa) rukūnan: he «حال» and settled [Translator's note: the source reads «حال»; «مال» (he inclined) is probably meant]; al-rukn, with ḍamma, is the stronger side, the great matter, and that by which one is strengthened, of kingship, troops and so on, and might and protection." The meaning of tawallā bi-ruknihi is: he turned away, swerved aside and deviated, headstrong.
(مُلِيمٌ) Mulīm is one who has done what is blameworthy, of stubbornness and obstinacy; malūm is one on whom blame has fallen. In the proverb: "Many a blamer is blameworthy, and many a blamed one has no fault."

* I'rab:
(وَفِي مُوسى إِذْ أَرْسَلْناهُ إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطانٍ مُبِينٍ) The wāw is a conjunction, and وَفِي مُوسى is conjoined to His saying فِيها with repetition of the preposition, because the item conjoined to is a genitive pronoun; it is attached, in meaning, to تَرَكْنا, and the implied form is "and We left in the story of Moses a sign". It may also be attached to an implied جَعَلْنا indicated by وَتَرَكْنا; al-Zamakhsharī allowed that, saying: "or it is conjoined to «وتركنا فيها آية», in the sense of «and We made in Moses a sign»", like the saying "I fed her straw and cold water". Abū Ḥayyān objected to him, saying: "There is no need to imply وجعلنا, since it is possible that the operator on the genitive phrase is وتركنا." إِذْ is an adverb for time that has passed, attached to an omitted element because it is an adjective of آيَةً, that is, "a sign existing at the time of Our sending"; you may also attach it to تَرَكْنا. The clause أَرْسَلْناهُ is in the position of the genitive by the adverb's annexation to it, and إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ is attached to أَرْسَلْناهُ; بِسُلْطانٍ is attached to an omitted element, a ḥāl, that is, "supported", and مُبِينٍ is an adjective of سُلْطانٍ. (فَتَوَلَّى بِرُكْنِهِ وَقالَ ساحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ) The fāʾ is a conjunction; تَوَلَّى is a past verb whose agent is latent, referring to Pharaoh, and بِرُكْنِهِ is a ḥāl from the pronoun of Pharaoh; قالَ is conjoined to تَوَلَّى; ساحِرٌ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, that is, "he is a sorcerer"; أَوْ is a conjunction of vagueness for the hearer, or of doubt: he put himself in the position of one in doubt although he knew him to be a true prophet, as a deception of his people; مَجْنُونٌ is conjoined to ساحِرٌ. 
[Translator's note: at this point the source runs straight on, without a break, into the next verse, reading "ساحرَأَخَذْناهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْناهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ)", with the opening of the parenthesis and the fāʾ of «فَأَخَذْناهُ» missing; the verse is reproduced here as it is plainly intended.]
(فَأَخَذْناهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْناهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ)
The fāʾ is a conjunction; أَخَذْناهُ is a verb, agent and direct object; وَجُنُودَهُ may be conjoined to the object of أَخَذْناهُ, which is preferable, or be an object of accompaniment (mafʿūl maʿahu); فَنَبَذْناهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ is conjoined to أَخَذْناهُ, and فِي الْيَمِّ is attached to نَبَذْناهُمْ; وَهُوَ: the wāw is circumstantial, and هُوَ is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative, a mubtadaʾ, and مُلِيمٌ is the khabar; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the object of نَبَذْناهُمْ or of أَخَذْناهُ. The difference between the two ḥāls is that the wāw in the first is obligatory, since it contains no mention of a pronoun returning to the owner of the ḥāl, while in the second it is not obligatory, since the clause contains a pronoun returning to it. (وَفِي عادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ الْعَقِيمَ) Conjoined to what preceded, and what was said about «وفي موسى إذ أرسلناه» is said about it; عَلَيْهِمُ is attached to أَرْسَلْنا, الرِّيحَ is a direct object, and الْعَقِيمَ is an adjective of الرِّيحَ. (ما تَذَرُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيمِ) مَا is negative; تَذَرُ is a nominative imperfect verb whose agent is latent, implied "هي", that is, the wind, and the clause is a ḥāl from الرِّيحَ; مِنْ is a redundant preposition, and شَيْءٍ is genitive in form and accusative in position because it is a direct object; the clause أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ is an adjective of شَيْءٍ; إِلَّا is a particle of restriction; جَعَلَتْهُ is a verb, latent agent and direct object, and the clause is in the position of the second object of تَذَرُ, as if it were said "it leaves nothing except as something made"; كَالرَّمِيمِ is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the second object of جَعَلَتْهُ, or the kāf is a noun meaning "like", a direct object, with الرَّمِيمِ as its muḍāf ilayhi.

* Rhetoric:
Implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya): in His saying «كالريح العقيم» [Translator's note: in the verse it is «الريح العقيم»; the source added a kāf at the front] there is an istiʿāra makniyya. He likened what is in the wind of the quality that prevents the production of rain or the pollination of trees to what is in the woman of the quality mentioned that prevents conception; then "barren" (ʿaqīm) was said, and that meaning was intended, by the indication of the wind's being described by it. The one borrowed for is the wind, the one borrowed from is the female able to bear offspring, and the borrowed thing is barrenness, which is the absence of offspring. The common ground between the one borrowed for and the one borrowed from is the absence of offspring. It is a metaphor of a perceived thing for a perceived thing, on the strength of sharing in an intellectual matter, and it is among the most delicate of metaphors.

* Lügat:
(الصَّاعِقَةُ) Gökten düşen şeydir; الصاعقة, başlara çarpan (تصقع) şeydir. Esmaî şöyle der: الصاعقة ile الصاقعة aynıdır. Şunu inşad etmiştir:
يحكون بالمصقولة القواطع ... تشقق البرق من الصواقع
(Cilalanmış keskin [kılıçlar]la, yıldırımlardan şimşeğin yarılmasını taklit ederler.)
الصعقة'ye gelince, onun «الزجرة» gibi olduğu, yani yıldırımdan çıkan ses olduğu söylenmiştir. Bazı recez şairleri şöyle der:
لاح سحاب فرأينا برقه ... ثم تدانى فسمعنا صعقه
(Bir bulut göründü, şimşeğini gördük; sonra yaklaştı, gürlemesini işittik.)
el-Muhtâr'da şöyle denir: «الصاعقة: Şiddetli bir gök gürültüsü içinde gökten düşen ateştir. Gök onlara yıldırım attığında «صعقتهم السماء» denir; قطع babındandır. الصاعقة aynı zamanda azap çığlığıdır.»

* İ'rab:
(وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا حَتَّى حِينٍ): Bu da öncekine atıftır. (تمتعوا) cümlesi mekûlü'l-kavldir. (حتى): gâye ve cer harfidir. (حين): «حتى» ile mecrûrdur; câr ve mecrûr «تمتعوا»ya müteallik olup.
(فَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ): الفاء, haber verme bakımından tertib (et-tertîbü'l-ihbârî) için atıf harfidir. (عتوا): fiil ve fâildir. (عن أمر ربهم): «عتوا»ya müteallik câr ve mecrûrdur. (فأخذتهم الصاعقة): «عتوا»ya atıftır. الواو hâl içindir. (هم): mübtedâ; (ينظرون) cümlesi haberdir; cümle hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir.
(فَمَا اسْتَطاعُوا مِنْ قِيامٍ وَما كانُوا مُنْتَصِرِينَ): الفاء atıf harfidir. (ما): nefy harfidir. (استطاعوا): fiil ve fâildir. (من): zâide cer harfidir. (قيام): lafzen mecrûr, mef'ûlün bih olduğu için mahallen mansûbdur. الواو atıf harfidir. (ما): nefy harfidir. (كانوا): nâkıs mâzî fiil; الواو onun ismidir. (منتصرين): onun haberidir.
(وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كانُوا قَوْماً فاسِقِينَ): الواو atıf harfidir. (قوم): zımnen anlaşılan mahzûf bir fiille mansûbdur; yani «Nûh kavmini de helak ettik.» Onu «Nûh kavmini de an» diye takdir etmen de caizdir. «وفي ثمود»a atfen cer ile de okunmuştur. (من قبل): من cer harfidir; (قبل) lafzen, mânen değil izafeden kesildiği için damme üzere mebnî zarftır; câr ve mecrûr mahzûf bir hâle müteallik olup. إن ve ismi; (كانوا قوما فاسقين) cümlesi onun haberidir. إن ve sonrasından oluşan cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur; çünkü onların helak edilişinin ta'lîlidir.
(وَالسَّماءَ بَنَيْناها بِأَيْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ): الواو atıf harfidir. (السماء): iştiğâl üzere mansûbdur; takdiri «بنينا السماء بنيناها»dır. (بنيناها): fiil, fâil ve mef'ûlün bihtir; cümlenin i'rabdan mahalli yoktur, çünkü müfessiredir. (بنينا السماء) cümlesi önceki fiil cümlesine atıftır; bu yüzden nasb râcih olmuştur. Âmme [nasb ile] okumuştur; yedi kurrâ dışından yalnızca iki kişi ref' ile okumuştur: Ebü's-Semmâl ve İbn Miksem. (بأيد): «بنيناها»nın fâilinden mahzûf bir hâle müteallik olması caizdir, yani «kuvvetle birlikte olarak»; ya da mef'ûlünden, yani «kuvvetle birlikte olarak [bina edilmiş]». «بنيناها»ya müteallik olması da caizdir; bu durumda الباء sebebiyyet için olur, yani «kudretimiz sebebiyle». الواو hâliyyedir. إن ve ismi; اللام müzahlaka lâmıdır; (موسعون): onun haberidir. Cümle «بنيناها»nın fâilinden veya mef'ûlünden hâl olarak nasb mahallindedir. «موسعون»un anlamı: Kudret sahipleri; güç anlamındaki «الوسع»tan. الموسع: İnfak etmeye güçlü olandır. el-Misbâh'ta şöyle denir: «وسع الله عليه رزقه يوسع (sahih olarak [vâv korunarak]) وسعا, نفع babından: Allah onun rızkını genişletti ve çoğalttı. Elif ile «أوسعه» ve teşdid ile «وسّعه» de onun gibidir. Elif ile «أوسع الرجل»: Adam genişlik ve zenginlik sahibi oldu.»
(وَالْأَرْضَ فَرَشْناها فَنِعْمَ الْماهِدُونَ): Önceki cümleye atıftır; i'rabı orada cereyan ettiği gibi cereyan eder. (فنعم): الفاء atıf harfidir; (نعم) medih inşâsı için câmid mâzî fiildir. (الماهدون): «نعم»in fâilidir. Medhe mahsus olan mahzûftur, yani «نحن»; cümle onun haberidir.

* Vocabulary:
(الصَّاعِقَةُ) That which falls from the sky; al-ṣāʿiqa is that which strikes (taṣqaʿu) the heads. Al-Aṣmaʿī said: al-ṣāʿiqa and al-ṣāqiʿa are the same, and he recited:
يحكون بالمصقولة القواطع ... تشقق البرق من الصواقع
(They imitate with the polished, cutting [blades], as lightning splits from the thunderbolts.) As for al-ṣaʿqa, it was said to be like the zajra, which is the sound that comes from the thunderbolt. A certain rajaz poet said:
لاح سحاب فرأينا برقه ... ثم تدانى فسمعنا صعقه
(A cloud appeared and we saw its lightning; then it drew near and we heard its crash.) In al-Mukhtār: "Al-ṣāʿiqa is fire that falls from the sky in a violent thunder. One says 'ṣaʿaqathum al-samāʾ' (verb pattern qaṭaʿa) when it hurls the thunderbolt upon them. Al-ṣāʿiqa is also the cry of punishment."

* I'rab:
(وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا حَتَّى حِينٍ) Also conjoined to what preceded. The clause تَمَتَّعُوا is the content of the saying; حَتَّى is a particle of limit and of the genitive, and حِينٍ is genitive by حَتَّى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تَمَتَّعُوا. (فَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ) The fāʾ is a conjunction of reported sequence; عَتَوْا is a verb and agent, and عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ is attached to عَتَوْا; فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ is conjoined to عَتَوْا; the wāw is circumstantial, هُمْ is a mubtadaʾ and the clause يَنْظُرُونَ is the khabar, and the sentence is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. (فَمَا اسْتَطاعُوا مِنْ قِيامٍ وَما كانُوا مُنْتَصِرِينَ) The fāʾ is a conjunction and مَا is negative; اسْتَطاعُوا is a verb and agent; مِنْ is a redundant preposition and قِيامٍ is genitive in form and accusative in position because it is a direct object; the wāw is a conjunction and مَا negative; كانُوا is an incomplete past verb, the wāw its noun, and مُنْتَصِرِينَ its khabar. (وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كانُوا قَوْماً فاسِقِينَ) The wāw is a conjunction and قَوْمَ is accusative by an omitted verb understood implicitly, that is, "and We destroyed the people of Noah"; you may also imply "and remember the people of Noah". It was also read with the genitive, conjoined to «وفي ثمود». As for مِنْ قَبْلُ: مِنْ is a preposition and قَبْلُ an adverb indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording and not in meaning; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl. inna and its noun, and the clause كانُوا قَوْماً فاسِقِينَ is its khabar; the clause of inna and what follows it has no position, because it is a justification of their destruction. (وَالسَّماءَ بَنَيْناها بِأَيْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ) The wāw is a conjunction, and السَّماءَ is accusative by ishtighāl (preoccupation), the implied form being "بنينا السماء بنيناها"; بَنَيْناها is a verb, agent and direct object, and the clause has no position because it is explanatory; the clause "بنينا السماء" is conjoined to the preceding verbal clause, and for that reason the accusative is preferred. The generality read it so, and only two read it with the nominative, neither of the Seven, namely Abū l-Sammāl and Ibn Miqsam. بِأَيْدٍ may be attached to an omitted element as a ḥāl from the agent of بَنَيْناها, that is, "endowed with strength", or from its object, that is, "endowed with strength"; it may also be attached to بَنَيْناها, in which case the bāʾ is causal, that is, "by reason of Our power". The wāw is circumstantial; inna and its noun, the shifted lām, and مُوسِعُونَ is its khabar, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the agent of بَنَيْناها or from its object. The meaning of مُوسِعُونَ is "able", from wusʿ, which is capacity; and al-mūsiʿ is one strong in spending. In al-Miṣbāḥ: "Wasiʿa Allāhu ʿalayhi rizqahu yasaʿu (with regular form) wasʿan (verb pattern nafaʿa): He expanded and increased it; awsaʿahu and wassaʿahu, with alif and with tashdīd, are the same; and awsaʿa l-rajulu, with alif, means the man became possessed of ample means and wealth." (وَالْأَرْضَ فَرَشْناها فَنِعْمَ الْماهِدُونَ) Conjoined to the preceding sentence, and its i'rab proceeds as it did there. فَنِعْمَ: the fāʾ is a conjunction and نِعْمَ is a past verb, fixed (jāmid), for the expression of praise; الْماهِدُونَ is the agent of نِعْمَ, and the one specified for praise is omitted, that is, "نحن" (We), so the sentence is its khabar.

* Vocabulary:
