The Basrans reject it and explain what suggests that as involving an implied mubtadaʾ, so that the oath relates to a nominal clause. Al-Zamakhsharī rejected its being the lām of the oath, saying: "For two reasons. The first: it ought to be accompanied by the emphatic nūn, and omitting it is weak and ugly. The second: «لأفعلنَّ» in the answer of an oath is for the future, whereas the verb of the oath must be for the present." This, as mentioned, is because he holds the doctrine of the Basrans. The meaning of his saying "the verb of the oath must be for the present" is that the verb of the oath is a performative (inshāʾ), and the performative is present. As for his saying "that the nūn be joined to it", this is the doctrine of the Basrans; the Kufans permit the lām and the nūn to alternate, as in «واللَّهِ لأَضْرِبُ زيداً» (by Allah, I will strike Zayd), as in his saying:
4226 - لَئِن تَكُ قد ضاقَتْ عليكم بيوتُكمْ ... لَيَعْلَمُ ربِّي أنَّ بيتيَ واسعُ (If your houses have become too narrow for you, my Lord surely knows that my house is wide.)
and «وواللَّهِ اضربَنَّ زيداً», as in his saying: 4227 - وقتيلُ مُرَّةَ أَثْأَرَنَّ. . . . . . . . . . ... . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . (And the one slain by Murra I will surely avenge …)
Something close to this verse has been given at His saying: {فَلاَ وَرَبِّكَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ حتى يُحَكِّمُوكَ} [al-Nisāʾ: 65]; but there, there is what cannot be said here, just as here there is what cannot be said there. Something close to it will come in al-Qiyāma in the reading of Ibn Kathīr {لأُقْسِمُ بيوم القيامة} [al-Qiyāma: 1].
The majority read «بمواقِع» in the plural, and the two brothers [read] «بموقع» in the singular with a plural meaning, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun), so it was made singular. Their mawāqiʿ are their places of falling and their places of setting.
It has also been said: their falling on the day they are dimmed. It has also been said: the stars [stand] for the Qurʾān; this is supported by «وإنَّه لَقَسَمٌ» and {إِنَّهُ لَقُرْآنٌ كَرِيمٌ}. What is sworn upon is His saying: {إِنَّهُ لَقُرْآنٌ كَرِيمٌ}; on this view there are two parentheses in the speech. The first: the parenthesis of His saying «وإنه لَقَسَمٌ» between the oath and what is sworn upon. The second: the parenthesis of His saying «لو تعلمون» between the adjective and the described noun. Ibn ʿAṭiyya refused to make His saying «وإنَّه لَقَسَمٌ» a parenthesis, and said: "«وإنه لَقَسَمٌ» is an emphasising of the matter and a drawing of attention to what is sworn by; this is not a parenthesis between the two utterances; rather, it is a meaning intended to be given importance; the parenthesis is only His saying «لو تعلمون»." I say: its being emphasis and drawing attention to the greatness of what is sworn by does not contradict its being parenthetical; rather, this is the meaning of parenthesis and its benefit.

His saying: {لاَّ يَمَسُّهُ}: there are two views on this «لا». The first: it is negating, so the ḍamma in «لا يَمَسُّه» is a ḍamma of inflection. On this view there are two views on the clause. The first: its position is genitive as an adjective of «كتاب». What is meant by «كتاب» is either the Preserved Tablet, the purified ones then being the angels; or what is meant by it is the written copies (maṣāḥif), and what is meant by the purified ones is all those legally responsible (mukallafūn). The second: its position is nominative as an adjective of «قرآن», and what is meant by the purified ones is the angels only, i.e. none has access to it, or none touches its tablet. One of these two loose usages is necessary, because attributing touching to meanings literally is impossible. Its being a negation is supported by the reading of ʿAbd Allāh «ما يَمَسُّه» with the negating «ما».
The second of the two original views: it is prohibitive (nāhiya), and the verb after it is jussive (majzūm); had it been released from assimilation (idghām), that would have appeared in it, as in His saying: {لَّمْ يَمْسَسْهُمْ سواء} [Āl ʿImrān: 174]; but it was assimilated, and when it was assimilated its final letter was given ḍamma because of the hāʾ of the absent masculine pronoun; Sībawayh did not memorise anything but the ḍamma in cases like this. In the hadith: «إنَّا لم نَرُدُّه عليك إلاَّ أننا حُرُمٌ» ("We only returned it to you because we are in the state of iḥrām"), although analogy requires that fatḥa also be permissible for lightness. By what I have mentioned, the invalidity of the objection of whoever objected that, had this been a prohibition, one would say «لا يَمَسَّه» with fatḥa, becomes clear; for the permissibility of ḍamma on what precedes the hāʾ in this kind was hidden from him, especially on the view of Sībawayh, who permits nothing else. Ibn ʿAṭiyya judged its being a prohibition weak, [saying]: "If it is a statement, it is in the position of an adjective, and His saying after that «تنْزيلٌ» is an adjective; so if we make it a prohibition, it is something foreign interposed between the adjectives, and that is not good in the arrangement of speech; so reflect on it. In the reading (ḥarf) of Ibn Masʿūd: «ما يمسُّه»." End of quotation.
There is no weakening of this view in what he mentioned, because we do not concede that «تنزيل» is an adjective; rather, it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it is a revelation", so the interposition he mentioned does not follow. And even if we concede that it is an adjective, then «لا يَمَسُّه» is also an adjective; and if it is objected against us that it is a request, the answer is that it is on an implied «قول» (saying), i.e. "about which it is said: let none touch it", as they said about His saying «فتنةً لا تصيبَنَّ» on the view that «لا تصيبنَّ» is a prohibition; and it is like his saying:
4228 - جاؤوا بمَذْقٍ هل رأيْتَ الذئبَ قطّ ... (They brought watered-down milk: have you ever seen the wolf?) Its verification has been given in al-Anfāl. To this question is connected the scholars' disagreement about one in a state of ritual impurity touching the muṣḥaf, and it is built upon this; its verification will come more fully than this in the book "Aḥkām al-Qurʾān", if Allah the Exalted wills its completion.
The majority read «المُطَهَّرون» with the ṭāʾ light and the hāʾ doubled with fatḥa, as a passive participle. From Salmān al-Fārisī likewise, except with kasra on the hāʾ, as an active participle, i.e. those who purify themselves, its object having been omitted. Nāfiʿ and Abū ʿAmr in a transmission from them, and ʿĪsā, [read] with sukūn on the ṭāʾ and fatḥa on the light hāʾ, a passive participle from «أطهر». Zayd, al-Ḥasan, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAwn and also Salmān [read] «المُطَّهِّرُوْن» with the ṭāʾ doubled and the hāʾ [doubled] with kasra; its original is «المتطهِّرون», which was assimilated. It has also been read in this original form.

His saying: {وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ}: it may be a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. you look on in this state which is hidden from you; or it may be resumptive and thus parenthetical; and the istidrāk (the corrective «but» clause) is clear. The seeing (al-baṣar) may be from insight (al-baṣīra) or from eyesight, i.e. you do not see the helpers of the Angel of Death.

Ve {إِن كُنتُمْ}: Şarttır; cevabı Basralılar nezdinde «فلولا»nın delâleti sebebiyle mahzûftur, yahut bunu görenlere göre öne geçirilmiştir; bunun açıklaması daha önce geçti. «El-hulkūm», yiyeceğin geçtiği mecradır. «مَدِيْنين», yani idare edilen, yahut hesaba çekilen, yahut karşılık verilen. Bu, Fâtiha'nın başında geçti; hamd Allah'a mahsustur. Kerim âyette özetlenip tahrir edilen budur. Ebü'l-Bekâ dedi: «'تَرْجِعونها', birinci 'لولا'nın cevabıdır ve bu, ikincisinin cevabından müstağnî kılmıştır. Denmiştir ki: Bunun tersi. Denmiştir ki: İkinci 'لولا' tekrardır» (sözü sona erdi). Bunun gibi şeye cevap demek hiçbir şekilde sahih değildir; çünkü bu tahzîz (teşvik) ifade eden «لولا»dır ve cevabı yoktur; cevap, vücûd sebebiyle imtinâ edilenin (امتناعية) aittir, {وَلَوْلاَ فَضْلُ الله} [النساء: 83] gibi.
İbn Atıyye dedi: «'تَرْجِعونها' sözü, tahzîzlerin gerektirdiği cevapların ve açıklamaların yerini tuttu; 'فلولا إذا'daki 'إذا' ve tekrarlanan 'إنْ' ise, söz bir kısmı bir kısmını taşıyarak, icaz ve ihtisar olarak (öyledir)» (sözü sona erdi). Böylece «إذا»yı şartiyye kıldı. «Cevaplar» sözüyle «إذا» ve {إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ}, {إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ} sözlerindeki iki «إنْ» için olanı kastediyor. «Açıklamalar» ile de teşvik edilen fiilleri kastediyor; bu, kıvrak olmayan bir ibaredir, bu yüzden onu açıkladım.
Eş-Şeyh dedi: «'إذا' şart değildir; aksine zarftır ve 'لولا'dan sonra mahzûf olan 'تَرْجعونها' onda amel eder; çünkü ikinci tahzîzdeki 'تَرْجِعونها' ona delâlet eder. Böylece birinci tahzîz, boğaza ulaşma vaktiyle kayıtlanmış olarak gelmiştir. İkinci tahzîz ise kendilerinin idare edilmemesi (rububiyete tabi olmamaları) şartına bağlı olarak gelmiştir; onlar da onu geri döndürmeye kadir değildirler, çünkü rububiyete tabi olmaları mevcuttur; dolayısıyla kahredilmişlerdir, güçleri yoktur» (sözü sona erdi). Böylece zikredilen «تَرْجِعونها»yı ikinci «لولا»ya ait kıldı; o da birinciden sonra mahzûf olana delildir ve bu, Ebü'l-Bekâ'nın daha önce naklettiği görüşlerden biridir.

Al-rawḥ is rest; this has been given in Yūsuf. Ibn ʿAbbās, ʿĀʾisha, al-Ḥasan and Qatāda among a large group read it with ḍamma on the rāʾ, and it is transmitted from the Prophet ﷺ. Al-Ḥasan said: al-rawḥ is mercy, because it is like life for the one shown mercy. From him also: his spirit (rūḥ) goes out in fragrance. The discussion of {رَيْحَانٌ}, the disagreement about it, and the manner of its morphology have been given in the preceding sūra.
And [His saying]: {فَرَوْحٌ} is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is implied before it, i.e. "he shall have rest". It may also be implied after it, because it rests upon the fāʾ of requital.

Onun sözü: {باسم رَبِّكَ}: «Bâ»nın hâl için olması caizdir, yani Rabbinin ismiyle kuşanmış olarak tesbih et; teberrük yoluyla, {وَنَحْنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ} [البقرة: 30] sözü gibi. Ayrıca müteaddî yapmak için olması da caizdir; çünkü «سَبَّح» bazen kendi başına müteaddî olur, {سَبِّحِ اسم رَبِّكَ} [الأعلى: 1] sözü gibi, bazen cer harfiyle müteaddî olur, bu âyet gibi. Onun zâid olduğu iddiası aslın (asıl kuralın) hilâfınadır.
«العظيم»in «اسم»in sıfatı olması caizdir, «ربك»in sıfatı olması da caizdir; çünkü ikisi de mecrûrdur. İkisinin her biri «تَبَارَكَ اسم رَبِّكَ ذُو الجلال» [الرحمن: 78] ve {ذي الجلال} sözünde vasfedilmiştir. İki muzâfın i'rabta farklı olması sebebiyle sıfatta fark ortaya çıkmıştır.

* Vocabulary:
(الْواقِعَةُ): the Resurrection; it is described as something that will inevitably befall (taqaʿ), or as though it were befalling in itself.
(بُسَّتِ): crumbled. [Translator's note: the source text here reads «فتنت»; it is understood as «فُتّت» (crumbled), cf. the following «وهو الفتّ».] In al-Miṣbāḥ: "basastu al-ḥinṭa wa-ghayrahā bassan, of the pattern qatala, which is crumbling; so it is basīsa, of the pattern faʿīla in the sense of mafʿūla (passive)."
(هَباءً): al-habāʾ is dust like a ray of light in its fineness; it often comes out with the sun's ray through a window that lets it in.
(مُنْبَثًّا): spread about, scattered of itself, without need of air to scatter it.
(أَصْحابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ): those who are given their records in their right hands; from al-yumn, blessing.
(أَصْحابُ الْمَشْئَمَةِ): those who are given their records in their left hands, the ill-omened (al-mashāʾīm) for their own selves.
(ثُلَّةٌ): a group.
(مَوْضُونَةٍ): woven, interlaced, like the description of a coat of mail. Al-Aʿshā said:
ومن نسج داود موضونة ... تساق إلى الحيّ عيرا فعيرا
(And closely woven [mail] of David's weaving, driven to the tribe caravan after caravan.)

* I'rab:
(إِذا وَقَعَتِ الْواقِعَةُ): regarding (إذا) there are several views:
1- It is a pure adverb (ẓarf) with no conditional meaning, governed by the meaning of negation in (ليس), as though it were said: "denial of its occurrence is negated when it occurs." Al-Zamakhsharī took this view and said: "If you say: by what is (إذا) put in the accusative? I say: by (ليس), as in your saying 'On Friday I have no occupation (yawma al-jumuʿati laysa lī shughl)'." Abū Ḥayyān rejected it, saying: "As for putting it in the accusative by (ليس), no grammarian, nor anyone who has acquired anything of the craft of i'rab, would go to the like of this. For (ليس) in negation is like (ما) and (لا), which do not govern [an adverb], and so likewise (ليس). That is because (ليس) is stripped of the indication of event and time, and saying that it is a verb is by way of figurative usage, since the definition of a verb does not apply to it. What governs an adverb is only the event that occurs in it: if you say 'On Friday I will stand', the standing occurs on Friday; but (ليس) has no event, so how can it govern an adverb? The example he compared it to — 'On Friday I have no occupation' — does not show that 'Friday' is accusative by (ليس); rather it is accusative by what governs the predicate of (ليس), namely the preposition and its genitive noun. So it is a case of fronting the predicate before (ليس), and fronting that is based on the permissibility of fronting the predicate of (ليس) before it, which is disputed; and 'qāʾiman laysa Zayd' (standing, Zayd is not) has not been heard from the tongue of the Arabs. (ليس) indicates only the predicative judgement about the subject of the judgement, so it is like (ما); but because nominative pronouns attach to it, some people made it a verb, while in reality it is a particle of negation like the negating (ما). It appears from al-Zamakhsharī's likening of (إذا) to his saying 'yawma al-jumuʿa' that he stripped it of the conditional indication that is predominant in it. Were it a condition with the apodosis being the clause headed by (ليس), the fāʾ would be required, unless it is dropped in poetry, where that has occurred. So you say: 'idhā aḥsana ilayka Zaydun fa-lasta tatruku mukāfaʾatahu' (if Zayd does you good, you will not fail to repay him), and 'lasta' without the fāʾ is not permissible, unless one is compelled to it."
2- That what governs it is an implied "udhkur" (remember).
3- That it is conditional and its apodosis (jawāb) is implied, i.e. "when the Event befalls, such-and-such will be", and that is what governs it.
4- That it is conditional and governed by the verb after it which follows it directly. This is the choice of Abū Ḥayyān, who followed Makkī in it. Makkī said: "What governs it is (وقعت), because it may be used for conditional requital, so the verb after it governs it, just as [the verb after them] governs the conditional (ما) and (من) in your saying 'mā tafʿal afʿal' (whatever you do, I will do) and 'man tukrim ukrim' (whomever you honour, I will honour)."
5- That it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and (إذا رجت) its khabar (predicate); this is on the view that it is declinable (mutaṣarrifa).
6- That it is an adverb of (خافضة رافعة), as Abū al-Baqāʾ said, i.e. when it befalls it will lower and raise.
7- That it is an adverb of (رجت), and the second (إذا) is either a badal (substitute) of the first or a repetition of it.
8- That what governs it is what is indicated by His words (فأصحاب الميمنة), i.e. when it befalls, the states of people in it will become clear.
9- That the apodosis is His words (فأصحاب الميمنة).
10- Al-Jurjānī said: (إذا) is redundant (ṣila), i.e. "the Event has befallen", like (اقتربت الساعة) and (أتى أمر الله); it is as one says "the fast has come", i.e. drawn near and approached.
(وقعت الواقعة) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
(لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِها كاذِبَةٌ): (ليس) is a past verb, rigid (jāmid) and incomplete (nāqiṣ); (لوقعتها) is its fronted predicate, and the lām means "fī" (in), with a muḍāf implied, i.e. "there is no lying [soul] to be found at the time of its occurrence"; (كاذبة) is the noun of (ليس). (كاذبة) is an adjective of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "a lying soul". It is also said that (كاذبة) is a maṣdar (verbal noun) that came in the form of an active participle, meaning "lying".
(خافِضَةٌ رافِعَةٌ): (خافضة) is the predicate of an omitted subject, and (رافعة) a second predicate.
(إِذا رُجَّتِ الْأَرْضُ رَجًّا): (إذا) may be a badal of the first (إذا), or a tawkīd (emphasis) of it, or its predicate on the view that it is a subject — this has preceded in detail. It may also be conditional, governed either by something implied or by its verb that follows it, as preceded for its counterpart. Al-Zamakhsharī's wording: "It may be put in the accusative by (خافضة رافعة), i.e. it lowers and raises at the time of the shaking of the earth and the crumbling of the mountains, because at that time what is high is lowered and what is low is raised." (رجّا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
(وَبُسَّتِ الْجِبالُ بَسًّا): the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause.
(فَكانَتْ هَباءً مُنْبَثًّا): the fāʾ is conjunctive; (كانت) is an incomplete past verb, its noun latent (mustatir), its implied form being "hiya" (it); (هباء) is its predicate, and (منبثّا) an adjective of (هباء).
(وَكُنْتُمْ أَزْواجاً ثَلاثَةً): conjoined to (رجّت); (كان), its noun and its predicate; (ثلاثة) is a naʿt (adjective) of (أزواجا).
(فَأَصْحابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ ما أَصْحابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ): the fāʾ is conjunctive, of ramification (tafrīʿiyya), beginning the detailing and explanation of the states of the three kinds. (أصحاب الميمنة) is a subject; (ما) is interrogative, in the position of the nominative as a second subject, and what is intended by the interrogative is magnification; the second (أصحاب الميمنة) is the predicate of (ما), and the clause is the predicate of the first subject. Repeating the subject here with its own wording made a linking element — the pronoun — unnecessary. Its like is (الحاقة ما الحاقة) and (القارعة ما القارعة), and it occurs only in contexts of magnification or belittling. This is the first category of the kinds.
(وَأَصْحابُ الْمَشْئَمَةِ ما أَصْحابُ الْمَشْئَمَةِ): conjoined to what preceded; what is intended here is belittling their standing. They are the second category of the kinds.
(وَالسَّابِقُونَ السَّابِقُونَ): the wāw is conjunctive; (السابقون) is a subject and the [second] (السابقون) a tawkīd. They are the third category of the kinds, and the most deeply rooted in merit.
(أُولئِكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ): (أولئك) is a subject and (المقربون) its predicate, and the clause is the predicate of (السابقون); the demonstrative made the linking element — the pronoun — unnecessary. Al-Zamakhsharī chose that the [second] (السابقون) be a predicate and not a tawkīd. He said: "And the forerunners are those whose state you know and whose description has reached you, like his saying 'and ʿAbd Allāh is ʿAbd Allāh', and the saying of Abū al-Najm 'and my poetry is my poetry', as though he said: and my poetry is what has reached you and whose eloquence you have heard of. [The second] (السابقون) has been made a tawkīd and (أولئك المقربون) the predicate, but that is not [convincing]." This is what al-Zamakhsharī mentioned, and it is not far-fetched; rather it is perhaps more firmly grounded in eloquence. Do you not see how the setting forth of the state of the forerunners came first through His words (أولئك المقربون), combining the demonstrative, pointing to something known, with the predication about it by His words (المقربون), made definite by the alif and lām of prior reference (al-ʿahdiyya)? Below we quote the text of what Abū Ḥayyān presented. He said: "(والسابقون السابقون): they allowed it to be a subject and predicate, like their saying 'anta anta' (you are you), and his saying 'I am Abū al-Najm and my poetry is my poetry', i.e. those who reached the utmost in forerunning — i.e. in acts of obedience — and excelled in them, and whose state is known; and [they allowed] the [second] (السابقون) to be a verbal tawkīd, with 'al-khayr' in what follows that." [Translator's note: so in the source, «والخير»; evidently «والخبر» (the predicate) is in what follows.] Abū al-Baqāʾ's wording: "The words of the Exalted (والسابقون): the first is a subject and the second its predicate, i.e. those who are foremost in good are those foremost to Paradise. It is also said that the second is an adjective of the first, or repeated as emphasis, and the predicate is (أولئك)."
(فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ): a second predicate, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (المقربون), or attached to it, i.e. they have been brought near to Allah's mercy in the Gardens of Bliss. The annexation of "gardens" to "bliss" is annexation of a place to what is in it, as one says "the house of hospitality", "the house of the call" and "the house of justice".
(ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَقَلِيلٌ مِنَ الْآخِرِينَ): (ثلّة) is the predicate of an omitted subject, i.e. "they are a large group of the earlier ones"; (من الأولين) is an adjective; (قليل) is conjoined to (ثلّة); and (من الآخرين) is an adjective of (قليل). Al-Jalāl [al-Maḥallī] chose that (ثلّة) be nominative as a subject because it is qualified, with its predicate being the following (على سرر).
(عَلى سُرُرٍ مَوْضُونَةٍ): either a predicate, on the view that (ثلّة) is a subject, or a second adjective of (ثلّة), on the view that it is the predicate of an implied subject.
(مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَيْها مُتَقابِلِينَ): two ḥāls of the pronoun in (عليها), i.e. they are settled upon them, reclining, facing one another, not one of them looking at another. [Translator's note: so in the source, «لا ينظر بعضهم إلى بعض»; the commonly cited gloss is "none of them looks at the back of another" (إلى قفا بعض), and the phrase may be defective here.]

* Lügat:
(مُخَلَّدُونَ): Ölmeyen, yaşlanmayan ve değişmeyen, bâkî kalanlar. Bir görüşe göre de الخلد'den, yani küpeden (türemiştir; küpeli olanlar). İmruülkays şöyle demiştir:
وهل ينعمن إلا سعيد مخلد ... قليل الهموم ما يبيت بأوجال
(Ancak tasası az, geceyi korkularla geçirmeyen, mutlu ve ebedî yaşayan kimse nimet içinde olabilir mi?)
الولدان, صبيان gibi وليد'in çoğuludur; مولود (doğmuş) anlamındadır. الولد ise أولاد şeklinde çoğul yapılır.
(مَعِينٍ): Ne taşan ne de hiçbir zaman kesilen bir kaynaktan akan şarap.
(لا يُصَدَّعُونَ): Onun sebebiyle kendilerine baş ağrısı arız olmaz. Zemahşerî şöyle demiştir: «Hakikati, baş ağrılarının ondan kaynaklanmamasıdır.» الصداع, insanın başında arız olan bilinen hastalıktır; şarap da (bunda) etki eder. [Mütercim notu: Metinde «والخمر تؤثر» ifadesi böyle kısa geçmektedir.] Alkame şarabı vasfederken şöyle demiştir:
تشفي الصداع ولا يؤذيك صالبها ... ولا يخالطها في الرأس تدويم
(Baş ağrısına şifa verir, onun sıcaklığı (sertliği) sana eziyet vermez; başta onunla bir baş dönmesi de karışmaz.)
(يُنْزِفُونَ): Zâyın fethası ve kesrasıyla (okunur); «نزف الشارب» ve «أنزف»tan. Meçhul binâ ile «نزف الرجل» denir; yani sarhoşluktan aklı gitti. «نزف الرجل دما»: Burnu kanadı da bütün kanı çıktı. Her ikisi de (kullanımda) vârid olmuştur.

* İ'rab:
(يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدانٌ مُخَلَّدُونَ): Cümle isti'nâfiyyedir; hâliyye olması da caizdir. (عليهم): يطوف'a müteallik câr ve mecrûr; (ولدان): fâil; (مخلدون): ولدان'ın sıfatı. Anlam şudur: Hizmet için çevrelerinde, yaşlanmayan ve değişmeyen, aksine görünüşleri daima çocukların görünüşü olan gençler dolaşır. (بِأَكْوابٍ وَأَبارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِنْ مَعِينٍ): (بأكواب): يطوف'a müteallik câr ve mecrûr; sonrası ona ma'tûftur; (من معين): كأس'in sıfatı. (لا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْها وَلا يُنْزِفُونَ): Cümle isti'nâfiyyedir ya da عليهم'deki zamirden hâldir. (لا) nâfiye; (يصدعون): meçhul binâ ile (muzâri fiil), vâv nâib-i fâildir; (عنها): ona müteallik câr ve mecrûr; (ولا ينزفون): لا يصدعون'a ma'tûf. (وَفاكِهَةٍ مِمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ): Öncekine, yani وكأس'e ma'tûftur. (مما): فاكهة'nin sıfatı; (يتخيرون) cümlesi sıladır. (وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ): Bu da öncekine ma'tûftur. (وَحُورٌ عِينٌ): Ref' ile okunur ve bunda birkaç vecih vardır: Birincisi, ولدان'a ma'tûf olmasıdır; yani hizmet için değil, nimetlendirmek için onların etrafında dolaşırlar. İkincisi, haberi mahzûf mübtedâ olmasıdır; yani «لهم حور» (onlar için huriler vardır) ya da «وثم حور» (orada huriler vardır). Üçüncüsü, mahzûf bir mübtedânın haberi olmasıdır; yani «ونساؤهم حور» (kadınları hurilerdir). «يعطون» (verilirler) veya «يجازون حورا» (mükâfat olarak hurilerle karşılık görürler) takdirinde nasb ile de okunur. Anlamda değil lafızda أكواب'a atfen cer ile de okunur; çünkü huriler etrafta dolaştırılmaz. Bir görüşe göre de (cer ile okunduğunda) جنات'a ma'tûftur; yani cennetlerde ve hurilerin arasında. (عين): حور'un sıfatı. (كَأَمْثالِ اللُّؤْلُؤِ الْمَكْنُونِ): (كأمثال): حور'un ikinci sıfatı; (اللؤلؤ): muzâfun ileyh; (المكنون): sıfat. (جَزاءً بِما كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ): (جزاء): mef'ûlün lieclih; yani bütün bunlar onlara mükâfat olarak yapılır. Ya da mahzûf bir fiilin mef'ûl-i mutlakıdır; yani «جزيناهم جزاء». (بما): جزاء'ya müteallik câr ve mecrûr; (كانوا) cümlesi sıladır; كان ve ismi, (يعملون) cümlesi de onun haberidir. (لا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيها لَغْواً وَلا تَأْثِيماً): (لا) nâfiye; (يسمعون): muzâri fiil, vâv fâili; (فيها): يسمعون'a müteallik câr ve mecrûr; (لغوا): mef'ûlün bih. Vâv atıf harfi; (لا) nâfiye; (تأثيما): لغوا'ya ma'tûf; yani çirkin söz ya da günaha sokan şey. (إِلَّا قِيلًا سَلاماً سَلاماً): (إلا) istisnâ edatıdır; istisnâ munkatı'dır. (قيلا): nasbı vâcib olan munkatı' müstesnâdır. (سلاما سلاما) hakkında birkaç vecih vardır: Birincisi, قيلا'dan bedel olmasıdır; yani orada «selam, selam»dan başka bir şey işitmezler. İkincisi, قيلا'nın sıfatı olmasıdır. Üçüncüsü, masdar olduğu için قيلا ile mansûb olmasıdır; yani «ancak 'selam, selam' demeleri»; Zeccâc bunu tercih etmiştir. Dördüncüsü, mahzûf bir fiilin mef'ûl-i mutlakı olmasıdır; yani «سلّموا سلاما» (selam verdiler).

* Belâgat:
1- «كأمثال اللؤلؤ المكنون» kavlinde teşbîh-i mürsel mücmel vardır. Benzetme yönü hazfedilmiştir; o da korunmuşluktur. Bir şair, bir kadını korunmuşluk ve ortaya saçılmamışlıkla vasfederek onu sedefinde saklı bir inciye benzetmiş ve şöyle demiştir:
قامت تراءى بين سجفي كلة ... كالشمس يوم طلوعها بالأسعد
أو درّة صدفية غوّاصها ... بهج متى يرها يهلّ ويسجد
(Cibinliğin iki perdesi arasında, en uğurlu yıldızlarla doğduğu gün güneş gibi görünerek kalktı; ya da dalgıcı sevinçli olan sedefli bir inci gibi; onu gördüğünde sevinç çığlığı atar ve secde eder.)
2- «لا يصدعون عنها ولا ينزفون» kavlinde îcâz sanatı vardır; bu daha önce geçmişti. Bu iki kelimede, dünyadaki şarabın bütün kusurlarını bir araya getirmiştir.

* Vocabulary:
(سِدْرٍ): al-sidr is the lote tree (nabq).
(مَخْضُودٍ): the root meaning of al-khaḍd is bending a soft stick; hence al-makhḍūd is that which has no thorns, because what is moist and soft mostly has no thorns. In al-Mukhtār: "khaḍada al-shajar: he cut off its thorns; its pattern is that of ḍaraba; so it is khaḍīd and makhḍūd." Umayya ibn Abī al-Ṣalt said, describing Paradise:
إن الحدائق في الجنان ظليلة ... فيها الكواعب سدرها مخضود
(The orchards in the Gardens are shady; in them are full-breasted maidens, and their lote trees are thornless.)
(طَلْحٍ): al-ṭalḥ is the banana tree. Abū ʿUbayda said: it is every large tree with many thorns. One of the camel-drivers chanting to his camels said:
بشرها دليلها وقالا ... غدا ترين الطلح والجبلا
(Her guide gave her good tidings and said: tomorrow you will see the ṭalḥ trees and the mountains.)
Al-Zajjāj said: al-ṭalḥ is the umm ghaylān (acacia) tree, so it may be in the finest state.
(مَنْضُودٍ): a passive participle from "naḍadtu al-matāʿ", i.e. I placed the goods one on top of another.
(أَبْكاراً): al-bikr is the woman whom no man has deflowered, so she is in her first created state, as when she was brought into being. From it comes al-bukra for the beginning of the day, al-bākūra for the first fruit, and al-bakr, the young camel, whose plural is bikār and bikāra; and "the people came ʿalā bakratihim" and "ʿalā bakrati abīhim" (all together, to the last one).
(عُرُباً): plural of ʿarūb, the woman who shows affection to her husband out of passionate love for him.
(أَتْراباً): plural of tirb, which is "al-ladhdha" [Translator's note: so in the source, «اللذة»; evidently «اللِّدة» (the peer of the same age)] who grows up with his like in childhood. It is taken from the child's playing with dust (turāb), i.e. they are like children who are of the same age. ʿUmar ibn Abī Rabīʿa said:
أبرزوها مثل المهاة تهادى ... بين عشر كواعب أتراب
(They brought her out like a wild cow, swaying gently among ten full-breasted maidens of equal age.)

* I'rab:
(وَأَصْحابُ الْيَمِينِ ما أَصْحابُ الْيَمِينِ): resumptive speech, set forth to begin detailing what was first stated in summary. (أصحاب) is the mubtadaʾ (subject); (ما) is an interrogative noun for magnification, in the position of the nominative as a subject; (أصحاب اليمين) is the khabar (predicate) of (ما), and the clause is the predicate of (أصحاب). The linking element is the repetition of the subject in its own wording, as preceded.
(فِي سِدْرٍ مَخْضُودٍ وَطَلْحٍ مَنْضُودٍ): a second predicate of (أصحاب), or the predicate of an omitted subject, i.e. "they are among lote trees"; (مخضود) is a naʿt (adjective) of (سدر).
(وَظِلٍّ مَمْدُودٍ وَماءٍ مَسْكُوبٍ وَفاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ لا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلا مَمْنُوعَةٍ وَفُرُشٍ مَرْفُوعَةٍ): conjoined to "wa-lahu fī sidr" [Translator's note: so in the source, «عطف على وله في سدر»; evidently for «عطف على قوله في سدر», i.e. conjoined to His words (في سدر)]. (لا) in (لا مقطوعة) is for negation, as in your saying "I passed by a man neither tall nor short"; that is why its repetition is required.
(إِنَّا أَنْشَأْناهُنَّ إِنْشاءً): inna and its noun; the clause (أنشأناهنّ) is the predicate; (إنشاء) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The wording of al-Kashshāf: "(إنّا أنشأناهنّ إنشاء): We began their creation anew, without birth. Either those whose creation was originated are meant, or those whose creation was renewed. It is reported from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that Umm Salama asked him about the words of the Exalted (إنّا أنشأناهنّ إنشاء), and he said: 'O Umm Salama, they are the ones who were taken in the abode of this world as old women, grey-haired and bleary-eyed; Allah made them, after old age, of equal age, born at one time in [their] evenness; whenever their husbands come to them, they find them virgins.' When ʿĀʾisha heard that from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, she said: 'Oh, the pain!' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'There is no pain there.'"
(فَجَعَلْناهُنَّ أَبْكاراً عُرُباً أَتْراباً): the fāʾ is conjunctive; (جعلناهنّ) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أبكارا) is the second direct object; (عربا) and (أترابا) are two adjectives of (أبكارا).
(لِأَصْحابِ الْيَمِينِ): (لأصحاب اليمين) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (أنشأناهنّ).
(ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْآخِرِينَ): (ثلّة) is the predicate of an omitted subject; (من الأولين) is an adjective of (ثلّة); and (ثلّة من الآخرين) is conjoined to what preceded.

* Rhetoric:
1- In His words (وفرش مرفوعة): if (الفرش) is explained as the plural of firāsh (bed), its meaning is literal, i.e. raised upon couches. If women are meant by it, it is an allusion (kināya) to a described entity; the Arabs call a woman "firāsh" (bed) and "libās" (garment). This interpretation is indicated by His words (إنّا أنشأناهنّ إنشاء).
2- In His words (عربا أترابا) there is also an allusion to their returning to, or being brought into being at, a young age. An old woman said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "Pray to Allah to admit me into Paradise." He said: "Old women do not enter Paradise." She turned away weeping, and he, upon him be blessings and peace, said: "Tell her that she will not be an old woman." Also from him ﷺ: "The people of Paradise will enter Paradise hairless of body, beardless, white, curly-haired, with kohl on their eyes, aged thirty-three." [Translator's note: the source writes «والعرب» ("the Arabs"); the word meant is «العُرُب».] Al-ʿurub is the plural of ʿarūb, the woman who shows affection to her husband. Al-Mubarrad said: she is the one passionately in love with her husband. Zayd ibn Aslam said: she is the one of fine speech. Al-atrāb are those born at one time, of a single age.

* Lügat:
(سَمُومٍ): السموم, bedenin gözeneklerine giren sıcak rüzgârdır. Bedenin مسام'ı onun delikleridir; gözeneklere giren zehir (السمّ) de bundan alınmıştır.
(يَحْمُومٍ): اليحموم, simsiyah, koyu dumandır. el-Muhtâr'da şöyle denir: «حممه تحميما: yüzünü kömürle karaladı. الحمم: kül ve kömür; ateşten yanan her şeyin tekili حممة'dir. اليحموم: duman.»
(الْحِنْثِ): Günah. Erginlik de الحنث ile ifade edilir; «لم يبلغوا الحنث» (hıns çağına ulaşmadılar) sözleri bundandır. Böyle denmesi, insanın ergenliğe ulaştığında hınsten, yani günahtan dolayı sorumlu tutulması sebebiyledir. «تحنث فلان», yani günahtan uzak durdu (demektir). Hadiste şöyle geçer: «كان صلى الله عليه وسلم يتحنث بنار حراء» [Mütercim notu: Metinde «بنار حراء» yazılıdır; doğrusu «بغار حراء» (Hira mağarasında)dır.]; yani günahtan uzak durarak ibadet ederdi. Bunların hepsinde تفعّل (kalıbı) selb (giderme) içindir.
(الْهِيمِ): Kendilerine isabet eden bir hastalık sebebiyle sudan kanmayan susuz develer. Tekili أهيم, dişisi هيماء'dır. هيم'in aslı, حمر vezninde hânın dammesiyle هُيم'dir; fakat yâya uygunluk için damme kesraya çevrilmiştir. Semîn'in ifadesi şöyledir: «الهيم, أهيم ve هيماء'nın çoğuludur; o da الهيام'a yakalanmış erkek ve dişi devedir. الهيام, susatan bir hastalıktır; develer ondan dolayı ölünceye ya da ağır bir şekilde hastalanıncaya kadar su içerler.»

* İ'rab:
(وَأَصْحابُ الشِّمالِ ما أَصْحابُ الشِّمالِ): Benzerinin i'rabı az önce geçti; onu bir daha hatırla. Söz, ashâb-ı yemînin hâlini tafsil ettikten sonra onların (ashâb-ı şimâlin) özetle söylediği hâllerini tafsile başlamak için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye bir sözdür. (فِي سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ): İkinci haberdir ya da gizli bir mübtedânın haberidir; benzeri daha önce geçmiştir. (وَظِلٍّ مِنْ يَحْمُومٍ لا بارِدٍ وَلا كَرِيمٍ): Öncekine ma'tûftur. (إِنَّهُمْ كانُوا قَبْلَ ذلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ): Cümle ta'lîliyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. (إنّ) ve ismi; (كانوا) cümlesi onun haberi; كان ve ismi; zarf mahzûf bir hâle ya da مترفين'e müteallik; (مترفين): كانوا'nın haberi. (وَكانُوا يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى الْحِنْثِ الْعَظِيمِ): Öncekine ma'tûftur. كان ve ismi; (يصرّون) cümlesi onun haberi; (على الحنث): يصرّون'a müteallik câr ve mecrûr; (العظيم): sıfat. (وَكانُوا يَقُولُونَ أَإِذا مِتْنا وَكُنَّا تُراباً وَعِظاماً أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ): Bu da ma'tûftur. كان ve ismi; (يقولون) cümlesi onun haberi. Hemze istifhâm içindir; (إذا), «أإنا لمبعوثون» kavlinin delâlet ettiği bir şeye müteallik şart zarfıdır. Görmüyor musun, إذا zamandan bir zarftır; dolayısıyla kendisine müteallik olacağı bir fiil veya fiil anlamı bulunması zorunludur. (متنا) kavline müteallik olması caiz değildir; çünkü o (إذا'ya) muzâfun ileyhtir; muzâfun ileyh ise muzâfta amel etmez. Onu bu fiile hamletmek caiz olmadığına, إنّ'den sonrakine hamletmek de —إنّ'den sonraki, ondan öncekinde amel etmediği için— caiz olmadığına göre (ki لا'dan sonraki, ondan öncekinde amel etmediği gibi, istifhâmdan sonrakinin de ondan öncekinde amel etmesi caiz değildir), onun «أإنا لمبعوثون» kavlinin delâlet ettiği bir şeye müteallik olduğunu anlarsın; bu da «نحشر» (haşrolunuruz) veya «نبعث» (diriltiliriz) ve bu sözün delâlet ettiği benzeri fiillerdir.
(متنا): fiil ve fâil; (كنّا): متنا'ya ma'tûf; كان ve ismi; (ترابا): onun haberi; (عظاما): ترابا'ya ma'tûf. Hemze istifhâm içindir; (إنّ) ve ismi; (lâm) müzahlaka lâmıdır; (مبعوثون): onun haberi. (أَوَآباؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ): Hemze istifhâm içindir, vâv atıf harfidir; (آباؤنا): مبعوثون'daki gizli zamire ma'tûftur. Zamire «نحن» ile te'kîd olmaksızın atfın güzel olması, ara giren hemze sebebiyledir. Bir görüşe göre de ma'tûfun aleyh, ma'tûfun haber üzerine öne alındığı göz önünde bulundurularak, إنّ ve isminin mahallidir; takdir şöyledir: «أإنا أو آباؤنا مبعوثون». (الأولون): آباؤنا'nın sıfatı. (قُلْ إِنَّ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلى مِيقاتِ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ): Onların inkârını reddetmek ve hakkı tahkik etmek için sevk edilmiş isti'nâfiyye bir sözdür. (إنّ) ve ismi; (الآخرين): الأولين'e ma'tûf; (lâm) müzahlaka lâmı; (مجموعون): إنّ'nin haberi. إنّ, ismi ve haberi mekûlü'l-kavl olarak nasb mahallindedir. (إلى ميقات يوم): مجموعون'a müteallik câr ve mecrûr; (معلوم): يوم'ün sıfatı. (Toplama) fiili «sevk etme» anlamını tazammun ettiği için «إلى» ile müteaddî kılınmıştır; aksi hâlde zâhir olan «في» ile müteaddî olmasıydı. (ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا الضَّالُّونَ الْمُكَذِّبُونَ): (ثم): tertip ve terâhî için atıf harfidir; kavlin hayyizine dahildir. (إنّ) ve ismi; (أيها): nekre-i maksûde münâdâ; (الضالون): أيها'dan bedel; (المكذبون): الضالون'un sıfatı. (لَآكِلُونَ مِنْ شَجَرٍ مِنْ زَقُّومٍ): (lâm) müzahlaka lâmı; (آكلون): إنكم'in haberi; (من شجر): آكلون'a müteallik câr ve mecrûr; (من زقوم): (من شجر) kavlinden bedeldir ya da atf-ı beyândır ya da sıfattır. (فَمالِؤُنَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ): Fâ atıf harfi; (مالئون): آكلون'a ma'tûf; (منها): مالئون'a müteallik câr ve mecrûr; (البطون): ism-i fâilin mef'ûlü. الشجر'e dönen zamir müennes getirilmiştir; çünkü o cins ismidir; cins isminin ise müzekker ve müennes kılınması caizdir. (فَشارِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ): Fâ atıf harfi; (شاربون): آكلون'a ma'tûf; (عليه): mahzûf bir hâle müteallik câr ve mecrûr; (من الحميم): شاربون'a müteallik câr ve mecrûr. (فَشارِبُونَ شُرْبَ الْهِيمِ): Fâ atıf harfi; (شاربون): öncekine ma'tûf; (شرب الهيم): mef'ûl-i mutlak. Bir şeyin kendisine atfı sahih olmuştur; çünkü ikisi gerçekte farklıdır: Birincisi, aşırı sıcaklığına ve bağırsakları parçalamasına rağmen kaynar suyu içmektir ki bu başlı başına şaşılacak bir iştir; ikincisi ise bu hâliyle kaynar suyu, susuz develerin su içtiği gibi içmektir ki bu daha şaşılacak ve daha garip bir iştir. Bu teşbihte iki fayda vardır: Birincisi, ondan içmelerine dikkat çekmektir; ikincisi, içmenin bir faydası olmadığına ve içilen şeyin, susuz develere fayda verdiği gibi onlara fayda vermediğine (dikkat çekmektir). [Mütercim notu: Metinde «كما ينجع في الهيم» (develere fayda verdiği gibi) yazılıdır; bağlama göre «كما لا ينجع» (fayda vermediği gibi) beklenir.] (هذا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ): (هذا): mübtedâ; (نزلهم): haber; (يوم الدين): zarf, mahzûf bir hâle müteallik; yani o çetin günde var olarak.

* Belâgat:
1- «لا بارد ولا كريم» kavlinde ihtirâs sanatı vardır; tanımı daha önce geçmişti. Burada «وظل من يحموم» deyince, bu gölgenin yorgunluktan sonra onlara biraz rahatlık getirebileceği vehmini vermiştir. Bu sebeple ondan gölgenin iki sıfatı nefyedilmiştir. Kastedilen şudur: O bir gölgedir, fakat serinlik ve ferahlık yayan, kendisine sığınan ve altında gölgelenen kimseye fayda getiren diğer gölgeler gibi değildir; böylece «gölge» kavramının anlamındaki rahatlama yönü silinmiştir. Dolayısıyla «لا بارد ولا كريم» kavli «من يحموم» kavlinin değil, gölgenin iki sıfatıdır. Burada şöyle bir itiraz varid olur: Fâ, ta'kîb ile birlikte tertip ifade eder. [Mütercim notu: Metinde böyledir; ayette fâ bulunmadığından, itirazın sıfatın mevsufa yakınlığı (yakın olana bağlanması) hakkında olduğu anlaşılmaktadır.] Deriz ki: Radî, bunun vâcib olmadığını açıkça belirtmiştir; üstelik burada (bunu Yahmûm'a bağlamak) iki fâsılanın dengesizliğine yol açar; onları يحموم'un iki sıfatı kılmak Kur'an belâğatına uygun düşmez. Ayrıca bunda ta'rîz sanatı da vardır: Serinlik ve ikram bulunan gölgeye layık olanlar bunlardan başkalarıdır; bu da onların boğazlarını daha çok düğümler ve hasretlerini daha çok artırır. Bütün bu nükteler sebebiyle, bu cezayı hak etmelerini «إنهم كانوا قبل ذلك مترفين» kavliyle ta'lîl etmiştir. Râzî şöyle demiştir: «Onların azabının sebebini zikredip ashâb-ı yemînde sevaplarının sebebini zikretmemesindeki —'Onlar bundan önce şükreden ve boyun eğen kimselerdi' dememesindeki— hikmet, sevabın Allah Teâlâ'dan bir lütuf (fazl), cezanın ise O'ndan bir adalet olduğuna dikkat çekmektir. Lütfun sebebi ister zikredilsin ister zikredilmesin, lütfedende bir eksiklik veya zulüm vehmi uyandırmaz. Adalete gelince, eğer cezanın sebebi zikredilmezse O'nun zalim olduğu zannedilir. Buna şu da delâlet eder: Allah Teâlâ, sâbıklar hakkında dediği gibi ashâb-ı yemîn hakkında 'جزاء بما كانوا يعملون' dememiştir; çünkü ashâb-ı yemîn amel ile değil, büyük bir lütufla kurtulmuşlardır. İyilikleri çok olan ise farklıdır; onun hakkında 'cezâ (karşılık)' ifadesini kullanmak güzel olur.» Bu son derece güzel bir sözdür; onu iyice düşün. Bu hayret verici sözün satırları arasında gizli olan mukâbeleyi de unutma: Bu hâle düşen bu kimseler dünyada lüks içinde boğulmuş, onun nimetleri içinde dönüp dolaşarak yaşıyorlardı. Bir de bakıyorsun ki semûm ve yahmûm onları sarmış; içinde bulundukları şeyi hatırlıyor ve onu şimdiki hâlleriyle karşılaştırıyorlar; tecsîm ve tahyîl önlerinde hazır ve hazırlanmış olarak duruyor, Buhturî'nin sözü üzere elleri onları dokunarak yokluyor. [Mütercim notu: Metinde Buhturî'nin sözü zikredilmeden cümle böyle bitmektedir.]
2- «هذا نزلهم يوم الدين» ayetinde tehekküm (alay) sanatı vardır; bu da daha önce geçmişti. Cehennem'i ve içindeki azap çeşitlerini ve dehşet türlerini, onlarla alay olarak «نزل» diye adlandırmıştır; çünkü نزل, misafire ikram olarak hazırlanan şeydir. Allah Teâlâ'nın «فبشّرهم بعذاب أليم» kavlinde olduğu gibi; Ebü'ş-Şa'râ ed-Dabbî'nin şu sözü gibi:
وكنّا إذا الجبار بالجيش ضافنا ... جعلنا القنا والمرهفات له نزلا
(Zorba hükümdar ordusuyla bize misafir geldiğinde, mızrakları ve keskin kılıçları ona ikram yemeği kılardık.)
Yani zorba hükümdar ordusuyla birlikte misafirin konması gibi bize konduğunda. Bunda onunla alay vardır; zira o savaşmak için gelmiştir, şair ise onu iyilik istemeye gelen kimseye benzetmiş, mızrakları ve bilenmiş keskin kılıçları misafir için hazırlanan yemek olan نزل kılmakla bu teşbihi terşîh etmiştir.

* Vocabulary:
(سَمُومٍ): al-samūm is the hot wind that enters the pores (masāmm) of the body; the pores of the body are its openings. From it is taken al-samm (poison), which enters through the pores.
(يَحْمُومٍ): al-yaḥmūm is jet-black smoke. In al-Mukhtār: "ḥammamahu taḥmīman: he blackened his face with charcoal. Al-ḥumam is ashes and charcoal, and everything burnt by fire, the singular being ḥumama. Al-yaḥmūm is smoke."
(الْحِنْثِ): sin. Al-ḥinth is also used to express reaching puberty; from it is their saying "they had not reached al-ḥinth". That was said only because a person, on reaching puberty, is held to account for al-ḥinth, i.e. sin. "Taḥannatha fulān" means he avoided sin. In the ḥadīth: "He ﷺ used to taḥannath in the fire of Ḥirāʾ" [Translator's note: so in the source, «بنار حراء»; evidently «بغار حراء» (in the cave of Ḥirāʾ)], i.e. he devoted himself to worship, avoiding sin. So the pattern tafaʿʿala in all these is for privation (salb).
(الْهِيمِ): thirsty camels that are not quenched by water because of a disease that afflicts them; the singular is ahyam and the feminine haymāʾ. The origin of hīm is "huym", with ḍamma on the hāʾ, on the pattern of ḥumr, but the ḍamma was changed to a kasra to suit the yāʾ. The wording of al-Samīn: "Al-hīm is the plural of ahyam and haymāʾ, which are the male and female camel afflicted by al-huyām, a disease causing thirst from which the camels drink until they die or fall gravely ill."

* I'rab:
(وَأَصْحابُ الشِّمالِ ما أَصْحابُ الشِّمالِ): the i'rab of its parallel has preceded shortly before, so refresh your memory of it. The speech is resumptive, set forth to begin detailing what He stated in summary of their states, after He detailed the state of the Companions of the Right.
(فِي سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ): a second khabar (predicate), or the predicate of an implied subject; its parallel has preceded.
(وَظِلٍّ مِنْ يَحْمُومٍ لا بارِدٍ وَلا كَرِيمٍ): conjoined to what preceded.
(إِنَّهُمْ كانُوا قَبْلَ ذلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ): the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) and has no grammatical position. Inna and its noun, and the clause (كانوا) is its predicate; (كان) and its noun; the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) or to (مترفين); and (مترفين) is the predicate of (كانوا).
(وَكانُوا يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى الْحِنْثِ الْعَظِيمِ): conjoined to what preceded; (كان) and its noun, and the clause (يصرّون) is its predicate; (على الحنث) is attached to (يصرّون), and (العظيم) is a naʿt (adjective).
(وَكانُوا يَقُولُونَ أَإِذا مِتْنا وَكُنَّا تُراباً وَعِظاماً أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ): also conjoined; (كان) and its noun, and the clause (يقولون) is its predicate. The hamza is interrogative; (إذا) is an adverb of condition attached to something indicated by His words (أإنا لمبعوثون). Do you not see that (إذا) is an adverb of time, so it must have a verb or the meaning of a verb to which it is attached? It cannot be attached to (متنا), because that is its muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct), and the second term of a construct does not govern the first. And since it cannot be referred to this verb, nor to what comes after (إنّ) — inasmuch as what comes after (إنّ) does not govern what precedes it, just as what comes after (لا) does not govern what precedes it, so likewise what comes after the interrogative cannot govern what precedes it — you know that it is attached to something indicated by His words (أإنا لمبعوثون), namely "we will be gathered" or "we will be raised", and the like of what this speech indicates.
(متنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (كنّا) is conjoined to (متنا); (كان) and its noun, and (ترابا) its predicate; (عظاما) is conjoined to (ترابا). The hamza is interrogative; inna and its noun; the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and (مبعوثون) its predicate.
(أَوَآباؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ): the hamza is interrogative; the wāw is a conjunction; (آباؤنا) is conjoined to the latent (mustakinn) pronoun in (مبعوثون). Conjoining to the pronoun without the emphasising "naḥnu" is acceptable because of the separator, namely the hamza. It is also said that what it is conjoined to is the position of (إنّ) and its noun, taking into account that the conjoined word precedes the predicate, the implied form being "Shall we, or our fathers, be raised?" (الأولون) is an adjective of (آباؤنا).
(قُلْ إِنَّ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلى مِيقاتِ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ): resumptive speech, set forth to refute their denial and to establish the truth. Inna and its noun; (الآخرين) is conjoined to (الأولين); the shifted lām; (مجموعون) is the predicate of (إنّ); (إنّ), its noun and its predicate are in the position of the accusative as the speech quoted (maqūl al-qawl). (إلى ميقات يوم) is attached to (مجموعون), and (معلوم) is an adjective of (يوم). "Gathering" has been made to include the meaning of "driving", and so it was made transitive with (إلى); otherwise, the apparent [construction] would be to make it transitive with (في).
(ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا الضَّالُّونَ الْمُكَذِّبُونَ): (ثم) is a conjunction for sequence with delay, falling within the scope of the speech. Inna and its noun; (أيها) is a vocative of the intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda); (الضالون) is a badal (substitute) of (أيها); and (المكذبون) is an adjective of (الضالون).
(لَآكِلُونَ مِنْ شَجَرٍ مِنْ زَقُّومٍ): the shifted lām; (آكلون) is the predicate of (إنكم); (من شجر) is attached to (آكلون); (من زقوم) is a badal of His words (من شجر), or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), or an adjective.
(فَمالِؤُنَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ): the fāʾ is a conjunction; (مالئون) is conjoined to (آكلون); (منها) is attached to (مالئون); (البطون) is the object of the active participle. The pronoun referring to (الشجر) is feminine because it is a generic noun, and a generic noun may be treated as masculine or feminine.
(فَشارِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ): the fāʾ is a conjunction; (شاربون) is conjoined to (آكلون); (عليه) is attached to an omitted ḥāl; (من الحميم) is attached to (شاربون).
(فَشارِبُونَ شُرْبَ الْهِيمِ): the fāʾ is a conjunction; (شاربون) is conjoined to what preceded; (شرب الهيم) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). Conjoining a thing to itself is valid because the two are in reality different: the first is drinking boiling water as it is, at its extreme heat and cutting the bowels, which is a wondrous thing in itself; the second is drinking boiling water in that state as thirsty camels drink water, which is more wondrous and stranger still. In this simile there are two benefits: one, drawing attention to their drinking of it; the second, the futility of the drinking, and that what is drunk has no effect on it, just as it has effect on the thirsty camels. [Translator's note: so in the source, «كما ينجع في الهيم» ("as it takes effect in the thirsty camels"); in context «كما لا ينجع» ("as it has no effect") would be expected.]
(هذا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ): (هذا) is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and (نزلهم) the predicate; (يوم الدين): the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. being on that grievous day.

* Rhetoric:
1- In His words (لا بارد ولا كريم) there is the device of iḥtirās (guarding against misunderstanding), whose definition has preceded. Here, when He said (وظل من يحموم), it might be imagined that the shade could bring them some rest after weariness; so He negated of it the two attributes of shade, meaning: it is shade, but not like other shades that spread coolness and refreshment and bring benefit to whoever takes refuge in it and rests beneath it — in order to efface what the word "shade" connotes of finding relief in it. So His words (لا بارد ولا كريم) are two adjectives of (ظل), not of His words (من يحموم). Here an objection arises that the fāʾ conveys sequence with immediacy; we say that al-Raḍī stated explicitly that this is not obligatory [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse contains no fāʾ at this point, and the objection as printed appears defective], besides which, here it would lead to the imbalance of the two verse endings, and making them two adjectives of (يحموم) would not suit the Qur'anic eloquence. There is also in it the device of taʿrīḍ (innuendo): those who deserve the shade in which there is coolness and honour are other than these, which is more choking to their throats and more provocative of their regret. For all these subtle points, He gave the reason for their deserving this punishment by His words (إنهم كانوا قبل ذلك مترفين). Al-Rāzī said: "The wisdom in His mentioning the cause of their punishment, while not mentioning in the case of the Companions of the Right the cause of their reward — He did not say 'they were before that thankful and submissive' — is to draw attention to the fact that reward from Him, the Exalted, is grace, and punishment from Him is justice. Grace, whether its cause is mentioned or not, does not suggest any deficiency or injustice in the one who bestows it; but as for justice, if the cause of the punishment is not mentioned, it may be thought that He is unjust. This is shown by the fact that He, the Exalted, did not say regarding the Companions of the Right (جزاء بما كانوا يعملون) as He said regarding the forerunners, because the Companions of the Right were saved by the tremendous grace, not by deeds — unlike one whose good deeds are many, for whom the use of [the word] 'recompense' is fitting." This is very fine speech, so ponder it. And do not forget the hidden contrast (muqābala) latent between the lines of this wondrous speech: these who have come to this condition used to live in this world immersed in luxury, rolling about in its folds; and then, enveloped by scorching wind and black smoke, they remember what they used to be in and contrast it with their present state, with the embodiment and imagery present and ready before them, their hands feeling them by touch, in the manner of the saying of al-Buḥturī. [Translator's note: the source does not quote al-Buḥturī's verse here.]
2- In the verse (هذا نزلهم يوم الدين) there is the device of tahakkum (sarcasm), which has also passed: He called Hell and the kinds of torment and varieties of horrors in it "nuzul" (hospitality) in sarcasm at them, since nuzul is what is prepared for the guest to honour him — as in the words of the Exalted (فبشّرهم بعذاب أليم) — and like the saying of Abū al-Shaʿrāʾ al-Ḍabbī:
وكنّا إذا الجبار بالجيش ضافنا ... جعلنا القنا والمرهفات له نزلا
(Whenever a tyrant came to us as a guest with his army, we made the spears and the keen blades his hospitality.)
I.e. when the tyrant came down upon us with his army as a guest comes down. In it there is sarcasm at him, since he came to make war; so he likened him to one who came seeking kindness, and reinforced (rashshaḥa) that simile by making the spears and the keen, sharpened swords his nuzul, which is the food prepared for the guest.

* Vocabulary:
(بِمَواقِعِ النُّجُومِ): their places of falling and their places of setting; it was also said: their stations (manāzil); and it was also said: their dimming and scattering. Further explanation of it will come in the I'rab section.
(مُدْهِنُونَ): al-Rāghib said: "Idhān (compromising) is originally like tadhīn (anointing with oil), but it was made an expression for cajoling, being soft, and abandoning seriousness." Al-Muʾarrij said: the mudhin is the hypocrite, or the unbeliever who is gentle in his manner in order to conceal his unbelief; idhān and mudāhana are denial and hypocrisy, and its root is softness, and concealing the opposite of what one shows.

* I'rab:
(فَلا أُقْسِمُ بِمَواقِعِ النُّجُومِ): the fāʾ is resumptive and «لا» is redundant (zāʾida); the meaning is "So I swear". «لا» is added in oaths, so one says "لا والله" and "لا أفعل". Imruʾ al-Qays said:
لا وأبيك ابنة العامري ... لا يدعي القوم أني أفر
(No, by your father, O daughter of al-ʿĀmirī, the people shall not claim that I flee.)
The meaning is "by your father", and it was only added for emphasis and strengthening the speech. It was also said that it is negating, and the negated thing is omitted, namely the speech of the unbeliever and the denier, its implied form being "there is no truth in what the unbeliever says"; then He began anew and said "I swear". It was also said that it is the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ) entering a clause made of a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), namely "أنا أقسم", as when you say "لزيد منطلق"; then the mubtadaʾ was omitted and the lām became joined to its khabar, its implied form being "فلأقسم" with the lām alone. Abū Ḥayyān said: "The more likely view in my opinion is that it is a lām whose fatḥa was lengthened so that an alif was generated from it, as in his saying «أعوذ بالله من العقارب»." More of this discussion will come in our book. «أقسم» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنا"; «بمواقع النجوم» — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقسم».
(وَإِنَّهُ لَقَسَمٌ لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ): the wāw is parenthetical; «إنّ» and its noun, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «قسم» is its khabar; «لو» is conditional; «تعلمون» is an imperfect verb, nominative; «عظيم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قسم». The clause «لو تعلمون» is parenthetical between the qualified noun and its adjective, and the clause «إنه لقسم لو تعلمون عظيم» has no grammatical position because it is parenthetical between the oath and its answer; so they are two successive parentheses. The answer (jawāb) of «لو» is omitted, the implied form being "if you were people of knowledge you would know".
(إِنَّهُ لَقُرْآنٌ كَرِيمٌ): the clause is the answer of the oath and has no grammatical position; «إنّ» and its noun, and the shifted lām; «قرآن» is the khabar of «إنه» and «كريم» is a first adjective of «قرآن».
(فِي كِتابٍ مَكْنُونٍ): «في كتاب» is a second adjective of «قرآن», and «مكنون» is an adjective of «كتاب».
(لا يَمَسُّهُ إِلَّا الْمُطَهَّرُونَ): «لا» is negating; «يمسّه» is an imperfect verb with its object; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «المطهرون» is the fāʿil of «يمسّه», and the clause is a third adjective of «قرآن». It was also said that «لا» is prohibitive and «يمسّه» is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by «لا», but since it was assimilated (idghām) its final letter was given a vowel because of the assimilation, and the vowel was a ḍamma in harmony with the hāʾ. There is no need for this contrivance; what we have mentioned is preferable and more consistent with the harmony of the adjectives. What we have adopted is supported by the reading of ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd «ما يمسّه» with the negating «ما». In "touching it" there is a metonymy (kināya) for what it entails, namely the negation of access to it and to what it contains.
(تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ): a fourth adjective, and «من رب العالمين» is an adjective of «تنزيل».
(أَفَبِهذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَنْتُمْ مُدْهِنُونَ): the hamza is for the rebuking, disapproving interrogative; the fāʾ is a conjunction; «بهذا» — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «مدهنون»; «الحديث» is a badal (substitute) for the demonstrative; «أنتم» is a mubtadaʾ and «مدهنون» is the khabar.
(وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ): the wāw is a conjunction; «تجعلون» is an imperfect verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; «رزقكم» is the first object of «تجعلون»; «أنّ» and its noun, and the clause «تكذبون» is its khabar; «أنّ» with what falls within its scope is in the position of the second object. A muḍāf must be implied, i.e. "the thanks for your provision".
(فَلَوْلا إِذا بَلَغَتِ الْحُلْقُومَ): the fāʾ is resumptive; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) meaning "هلّا", and the verb does not occur after it [Translator's note: so in the source, «ولا يقع بعدها الفعل»; as written it means "a verb does not come after it", whereas the context probably requires "a verb must come after it"], so the implied form is "فلولا ترجعونها إذا بلغت الحلقوم"; thus the governor of «إذا» is the verb occurring after «لولا», namely «ترجعونها». «بلغت» is a past verb and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "النفس", i.e. when the soul reaches the throat at death.
(وَأَنْتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنْظُرُونَ): the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «أنتم» is a mubtadaʾ; «حين» is an adverb annexed to one like it, namely «إذ», and the tanwīn in it is a substitute for the clause annexed to it, i.e. "when the soul reaches the throat"; the clause «تنظرون» is the khabar of «أنتم», and the clause «وأنتم حينئذ تنظرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of «بلغت».
(وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْكُمْ وَلكِنْ لا تُبْصِرُونَ): the wāw is circumstantial; «نحن» is a mubtadaʾ and «أقرب» the khabar; «إليه» and «منكم» are attached to «أقرب»; the wāw is a conjunction; «لكن» is lightened and inoperative (muhmala), for rectification (istidrāk); «لا» is negating; «تبصرون» is an imperfect verb, nominative, from baṣīra, i.e. knowledge.
(فَلَوْلا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ تَرْجِعُونَها إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صادِقِينَ): the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لولا» is a particle of urging reinforcing the first «لولا»; «إن» is conditional; «كنتم» is «كان» and its noun; «غير مدينين» is the khabar, i.e. not to be requited by being resurrected, i.e. not to be resurrected. «ترجعونها» is the governor of «إذا»; the adverb was placed before its governor, to which the two conditions are attached, namely «إن كنتم غير مدينين» and «إن كنتم غير صادقين» [Translator's note: the Qur'anic text reads «إن كنتم صادقين»; the wording "غير صادقين" is as in the source]. The meaning of their being attached to it is that it is the requital of both of them, i.e. of each one of them; so there is an inversion in the speech, and the meaning is: why do you not return it, if you deny the resurrection and are truthful in denying it? The summary of the speech: if you are truthful in denying the resurrection, then return the soul of the dying person to his body so that death is removed from him, and thus resurrection is removed.

* Rhetoric:
The implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya) in His saying «فإذا بلغت الحلقوم» [Translator's note: the Qur'anic text reads «فلولا إذا بلغت الحلقوم»; quoted as in the source]: it is as if the soul were a bodily thing that reaches the throat in a perceptible movement.

﴿وَكانُوا﴾: «كان» ve ismi. ﴿يُصِرُّونَ﴾: merfû muzâri fiil; vâv fâilidir; cümle «كانوا»nın haberidir. ﴿عَلَى الْحِنْثِ﴾: (câr ve mecrûr) fiile müteallik olurlar. ﴿الْعَظِيمِ﴾: «الحنث»in sıfatıdır; «كانوا..» cümlesi öncesine ma'tûftur.

﴿تَرْجِعُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun (ism). ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause كنتم is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position, and the apodosis of the condition is omitted.
﴿نحن جعلناها تذكرة ومتاعا للمقوين﴾: نحن mübtedâ, جعلناها cümlesi haber; تذكرة ikinci mef'ûlün bih; متاعًا, تذكرة'ya ma'tûftur; للمقوين câr ve mecrûr olup ﴿متاعًا﴾'ya mütealliktir veya onun sıfatıdır.

﴿فلا أقسم بمواقع النجوم﴾: Fâ isti'nâfiyyedir; ondan sonraki cümle isti'nâfiyye olup i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. لا sıladır (zâid); nâfiye olduğu ve menfînin mahzûf olduğu da söylenmiştir; ibtidâ lâmı olduğu da söylenmiştir: mübtedâ ve haberden oluşan bir cümleye, yani «أنا أقسم» (ben yemin ederim) cümlesine -tıpkı «لزيد منطلق» (Zeyd mutlaka gidicidir) demen gibi- girmiş, sonra mübtedâ hazfedilmiş ve lâm onun haberine bitişmiştir; takdiri «فلأقسم»dur, yalnızca lâm ile. Fetha'sı uzatılmış bir lâm olduğu, bundan bir elif doğduğu da söylenmiştir. أقسم merfû muzâri fiil, fâili müstetir olup takdiri «أنا»dır; بمواقع النجوم câr ve mecrûr olup ﴿أقسم﴾'e mütealliktir.

His saying: {أَلاَّ تُنفِقُواْ}: like His saying {وَمَا لَنَآ أَلاَّ نُقَاتِلَ} [al-Baqara: 246]. The original is «في أن لا تُنْفِقُوا» (in not spending); when the preposition was omitted, the well-known disagreement arose. Abū al-Ḥasan holds that «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), as its explanation has already been given in al-Baqara.
His saying: {وَللَّهِ مِيرَاثُ}: a circumstantial clause from the agent of "settling" (istiqrār) and its object, i.e., what prevents you from spending in the way of Allah, when the inheritance of the heavens and the earth belongs to Him? This is a state that contradicts your miserliness.
His saying: {لاَ يَسْتَوِي مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَق}: There are two views on the agent of «يَسْتوي». The more apparent is that it is «مَنْ أَنْفَق». On this view an omitted conjoined element (maʿṭūf) is necessary to complete the sentence. Al-Zamakhsharī implied: "Among you, those who spent before the conquest of Mecca and the strength of Islam are not equal to those who spent after the conquest; he omitted it because the indication is clear." Abū al-Baqāʾ implied "and those who did not spend", saying: "What indicates the omitted element is His saying {مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ الفتح}." The first is better, because the context brings the verse only to distinguish between those who spent at two different times.
The second view: its agent is a pronoun returning to spending (infāq), i.e., the kind of spending is not equal, since some of it took place before the conquest and some after it, and these two types differ. On this view «مَنْ» is a mubtadaʾ, «أولئك» is a second mubtadaʾ, «أَعظَمُ» is its khabar, and the clause is the khabar of «مَنْ». This ought not to be permitted at all; it is as though this i'rab-writer overlooked His saying «منكم». Had this speaker parsed «منكم» as a fronted khabar and «مَنْ» as a postponed mubtadaʾ, with the implied meaning "among you are those who spent before the conquest, and among you are those who did not spend before it and did not fight", and this omitted because the speech indicates it, it would have been sound; but he overlooked the word «منكم».
His saying: {وَكُلاًّ وَعَدَ الله الحسنى}: The majority read it accusative, as a fronted object, and it is written in their codices «وكلاً» with an alif. Ibn ʿĀmir read it nominative, and there are two views on this. The more apparent is that it is nominative as a mubtadaʾ, with the following clause as its khabar and the returning pronoun omitted, i.e., "Allah promised him." Similar is:
4231 - قد أصبحَتْ أمُّ الخِيار تَدَّعِي ... عليَّ ذَنْباً كلُّه لم أَصْنَعِ (Umm al-Khiyār has begun to claim ... against me a sin, all of which I have not committed)
with «كلُّه» nominative, i.e., "I did not commit it." The Basrans permit this only in poetry, like the saying:
4232 - وخالِدٌ يَحْمَدُ ساداتُنا ... بالحقِّ لا يُحْمَدُ بالباطلِ (And Khālid, whom our chiefs praise ... in truth, is not praised for falsehood)
Ibn Mālik reported a consensus of the Basrans and Kufans that this is permitted if the mubtadaʾ is «كلاً» or something resembling it in need of completion and in generality; I have not seen this from anyone else. Something similar has already been discussed in Sūrat al-Māʾida at His saying {أَفَحُكْمَ الجاهلية يَبْغُونَ} [al-Māʾida: 50]. The saying «كلُّه لم أصنَع» has been transmitted only with the nominative, though it would be possible to put it in the accusative, saying «كلَّه لم أصنعِ» as a fronted object. The people of rhetoric (ahl al-bayān) said: because he intended the generality of negation, not the negation of generality, for the former is more eloquent. They counted among this the saying of the Prophet, peace be upon him:
«كل ذلك لم يكنْ» (None of that came to be). Had he said «لم يكن كلُّ ذلك», it would have been a negation of generality, whereas the intention is generality of negation.
The second view: «كل» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, and {وَعَدَ الله الحسنى} is an adjective (ṣifa) of what precedes, with the returning pronoun omitted, i.e., "and those are each one whom Allah has promised the best reward." If it is said: omission is present here too, and you have returned to what you fled from, the answer is: omitting the returning pronoun from an adjective is frequent, unlike omitting it from a khabar. An example of omitting it from an adjective is the saying:
4233 - وما أَدْري أغَيَّرهم تَناءٍ ... وطولُ العَهْدِ أم مالٌ أصابوا (I do not know whether distance has changed them ... or the length of time, or wealth they acquired)
i.e., "they acquired it", and the like is plentiful. In the codices of Syria it is written «وكلٌّ» without an alif, so Ibn ʿĀmir's reading agrees with his codex. «الحُسْنى» is a second object, and the first is omitted in the nominative reading; as for the accusative reading, the first object is fronted before its operator.

Onun sözü: {مَّن ذَا الذي يُقْرِضُ}: Bu ve sonrası, Allah'a hamdolsun, Bakara sûresinde kurrânın bu konudaki ihtilafıyla birlikte etraflıca geçmişti. İbn Atiyye burada şöyle dedi: «Ref', ya atıf ya da kat' ve isti'nâf iledir.» Âsım «فيضاعِفَه»i istifhâmın cevabı olarak fâ ile nasbla okudu. Bunda bir tedirginlik vardır. Ebû Alî dedi ki: «Çünkü soru karz hakkında sorulmadı, karzı verenin kim olduğu hakkında soruldu; fâ ise ancak, hakkında soru sorulan bir fiile atfedilen fiili nasbeder. Fakat bu topluluk bunu mânaya hamletti; sanki {مَّن ذَا الذي يُقْرِض} sözü, "Biri Allah'a karz verir mi?" sözü mesabesindedir.» Sözü burada bitti. Ebû Alî'nin söylediği kabul edilmez; görmez misin ki, daha önce fiil geçmediği hâlde isimlerle istifhâmın cevabında fâdan sonra nasb yapılır: «أين بيتُك فأزورَك» (Evin nerede ki seni ziyaret edeyim), bunun gibi «مَنْ يَدْعوني فأستجيبَ له» (Kim bana dua eder ki ona icabet edeyim), «متى تسير فأرافِقك» (Ne zaman yola çıkarsın ki sana eşlik edeyim) ve «كيف تكونُ فأصْحَبَكَ» (Nasılsın ki sana arkadaşlık edeyim). Burada istifhâm, dua edenin zâtı, zaman zarfı ve hâl hakkında vâki olmuştur; fiil hakkında değil. İbn Keysân da Araplardan şunu nakletti: «أين ذَهَبَ زيدٌ فَنَتْبَعَه» (Zeyd nereye gitti ki onu izleyelim), «ومَنْ أبوك فنُكْرِمَه» (Baban kim ki onu ikram edelim).

His saying: {يَوْمَ تَرَى}: There are several views on it. First: it is governed by the "settling" (istiqrār) that operates in «لهم أجرٌ», i.e., a reward has settled for them on that day. Second: it is governed by an implied verb, i.e., "remember", so it would be an object. Third: [the implied sense is] "they are rewarded on the day you see", so it is an adverbial in its original sense. Fourth: its operator is «يَسْعى», i.e., the light of the believing men and women runs on the day you see them; this is its basic form. Fifth: its operator is «فيضاعفَه». Abū al-Baqāʾ stated the last two.
His saying: {يسعى}: a ḥāl, because the seeing is visual (physical sight). This holds if he does not make it operate on «يوم». «بين أيديهم» is an adverbial of the running, and it may be a ḥāl from «نورُهم».
His saying: {وَبِأَيْمَانِهِم}, i.e., and in the direction of their right sides. This is the majority's reading, I mean with fatḥa on the hamza, the plural of yamīn. It is also said that the bāʾ means «عن» (from), i.e., from all their directions; He singled out the right sides only because they are the noblest of directions. Abū Ḥaywa and Sahl ibn Shuʿayb read it with kasra. This verbal noun is conjoined to the adverbial before it.
The bāʾ is causal, i.e., it runs, being thus and thus, because of their faith. Abū al-Baqāʾ said its implied form is: "they deserved it by their faith", or "by their faith it will be said to them: your glad tidings."
His saying: {بُشْرَاكُمُ}: a mubtadaʾ, with «اليومَ» an adverbial and «جناتٌ» its khabar, with an omitted muḍāf (governing noun), i.e., "entering gardens". This clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of an implied saying, which is also the operator of the adverbial, as mentioned above. Makkī said: "Al-Farrāʾ permitted the accusative of «جنات» as a ḥāl, with «اليومَ» as the khabar of «بُشْراكم»." He said: "That «جنات» is a ḥāl has no meaning, as there is no sense of a verb in it. He also permitted «بُشْراكم» to be in the position of the accusative, [meaning] 'they give them glad tidings with the glad tidings', with «جنات» put in the accusative by «البُشرى». All of it is remote, because one may not separate the ṣila (relative clause) and the relative noun by «اليوم»." End of quotation. It is strange of al-Farrāʾ that something unintelligible, and impermissible by the craft [of grammar], should issue from him: how could «جنات» be a ḥāl, and who would be the owner of the ḥāl?

His saying: {المصدقين والمصدقات}: Ibn Kathīr and Abū Bakr lightened the ṣād in both; the rest of the Seven doubled it. Ibn Kathīr's reading is from taṣdīq (believing as true), i.e., they believed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in what he brought, as in the saying of the Exalted {والذي جَآءَ بالصدق وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ} [al-Zumar: 33]. The reading of the rest is from ṣadaqa (charity), which suits His saying «وأَقْرَضوا». The original is al-mutaṣaddiqīn wa-l-mutaṣaddiqāt, then it was assimilated; Ubayy read it so. The first may be preferred on the ground that lending makes mention of charity unnecessary.
His saying {وَأَقْرَضُواْ}: three views. First: it is conjoined to the active participle in «المُصَّدِّقين», because when it occurs as the ṣila of «al-» it takes the place of the verb, as though it were said "those who gave charity and lent"; this is the view of most i'rab-writers, and al-Fārisī, al-Zamakhsharī and Abū al-Baqāʾ held it. It is invalid because it requires separation between the parts of the ṣila by a foreign element: do you not see that «المُصَّدِّقات» is conjoined to «المصَّدِّقين» before the ṣila is complete? And it may not be conjoined to «المُصَّدِّقات» because the pronouns differ in masculine and feminine.
Second: it is parenthetical between the noun of «إنَّ» and its khabar, which is «يُضاعَفُ». Abū al-Baqāʾ said: "This is said only so that the past tense not be conjoined to an active participle." I do not know what this obstacle is, because whenever an active participle is the ṣila of «al-» it suits the three times; had he objected by what I mentioned, the separation by a foreign element, he would have been right, but that was hidden from him as it was hidden from those greater than he, al-Fārisī and al-Zamakhsharī.
Third: it is the ṣila of an omitted relative noun, which the first indicates, as though it were said "and those who lent", like the saying:
4234 - أَمَنْ يَهْجُو رسولَ اللَّهِ مِنْكُمْ ... ويَمْدَحُه ويَنْصُرُه سَواءُ (Is he who satirizes the Messenger of Allah among you ... and he who praises him and helps him, equal?)
i.e., "and he who helps him"; the Shaykh preferred this, and you already know what is in it from the beginning of this work.
His saying {يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمْ}: two views on the deputy agent. One, the apparent one, is that it is the preposition phrase after it. The second is that it is the pronoun of taṣdīq, which requires an omitted muḍāf, i.e., "the reward of taṣdīq".

* Lügat:
(انْظُرُونا): «النظر»den emirdir. Nazar, gözü görülen ve görülmesi istenen şeyin bulunduğu tarafa çevirmektir. Buna delâlet edenlerden biri şairin şu sözüdür:
فيا ميّ هل يجزى بكائي بمثله ... مرارا وأنفاسي إليك الزوافر
وإني متى أشرف على الجانب الذي ... به أنت من بين الجوانب ناظر
(Ey Mey! Ağlamam ve sana yönelen iç çekişlerim, defalarca mislince karşılık görür mü? Ben ne zaman yanların arasından senin bulunduğun yana yükselsem, oraya bakarım.)
Eğer nazar rü'yet (görmek) olsaydı, ona karşılık istenmezdi; çünkü seven, sevdiğine bakmaktan bir karşılık beklemez, bilakis bunu ister ve arzular. Buna diğer şairin şu sözü de delâlet eder:
ونظرة ذي شجن وامق ... إذا ما الركائب جاوزن ميلا
(Binekler bir mili aştığında, hüzünlü ve seven bir kimsenin bakışı.)
Allah Sübhânehû'nun «ولا ينظر إليهم يوم القيامة» kavline gelince, mânâ şudur: Allah Sübhânehû onlara rahmetini nail etmez. «Falan bana baktı» (نظر إليّ فلان) dersin, sana bir şey nail ettiğinde. Biri de «انظر إليّ نظر الله إليك» der; «Bana bir hayır ulaştır, Allah da sana ulaştırsın» demek ister. «نظرت» fiili ve ondan türeyenler birkaç şekilde kullanılır:
1- Birincisi: Bununla «نظرت إلى الشيء» kastedersin; cer harfini hazfeder ve fiili doğrudan bağlarsın. Ebü'l-Hasen'in inşad ettiği şu beyit bu kabildendir:
ظاهرات الجمال والحسن ينظر ... ن كما ينظر الأراك الظباء
(Güzellik ve hüsünleri açık olan o kadınlar, ceylanların erâk ağacına baktığı gibi bakarlar.)
Mânâ «ينظرن إلى الأراك»tir; cer harfi hazfedilmiştir. Bunun için Ebû Hayyân şöyle demiştir: «İbsâr (gözle görmek) mânâsındaki nazar, şiir dışında kendi başına müteaddî olmaz; ancak «إلى» ile müteaddî olur.»
2- İkincisi: Bununla «düşündüm, tefekkür ettim» kastedersin; bu, müteaddî olmayan bir fiildir. Arapların «اذهب فانظر زيدا أبو من هو» (Git de Zeyd'e bak, kimin babası) sözü bu kabildendir; bununla düşünmek kastedilir. «انظر كيف ضربوا لك الأمثال» ve «انظر كيف فضّلنا بعضهم على بعض» kavilleri de bu kabildendir. Bu (mânâdaki fiil) bazen cer harfiyle de müteaddî olur; Allah Teâlâ'nın «أفلا ينظرون إلى الإبل كيف خلقت» kavlinde olduğu gibi; bu, düşünmeye teşviktir. Bazen de «في» ile müteaddî olur; «أفلم ينظروا في ملكوت السموات والأرض» kavli gibi. İmruülkays'ın şu sözüne gelince:
فلما بدا حوران والآل دونه ... نظرت فلم تنظر بعينك منظرا
(Havrân göründüğünde, önünde de serap varken baktın; fakat gözünle bir manzara göremedin.)
Bu «Baktın da serâba (الآل) doğru gözünle bir manzara göremedin» demek olabilir. Nazarla genişletme yoluyla rü'yetin kastedilmesi de caiz görülmüştür; çünkü gözü görülen şeye çevirmeyi rü'yet takip eder. Bazen bir şeye, onu takip eden ve onunla birlikte bulunan şeyin lafzı verilir; su kırbasına «râviye» denmesi gibi. «نظرت فلم تنظر», «تكلمت ولم تتكلم» (konuştun ama konuşmadın) gibi de olabilir; yani istenen şekilde bir söz getirmedin. Aynı şekilde «نظرت فلم تنظر بعينك منظرا», «istediğin gibi bir manzara görmedin» ya da «hoşa giden bir manzara görmedin» demektir.
3- Üçüncüsü: Bununla «onu bekledim» kastedersin. «غير ناظرين إناه» kavli bu kabildendir. Ferezdak'ın şu sözü de onun gibidir:
نظرت كما انتظرت الله حتى ... كفاك الماحلين لك المحالا
(Allah'tan beklediğin gibi bekledim; ta ki O, sana tuzak kuranların tuzağından seni korudu.)
«انتظرت كما انتظرت» kastetmektedir.
4- Dördüncüsü: «أنظرت»ın «انتظرت» mânâsında olmasıdır; «أنظرني» demenle, beklemeyi gerektiren mühleti (nefes alma imkânını) istersin. Amr b. Gülsûm'un şu sözü bu kabildendir:
أبا هند فلا تعجل علينا ... وأنظرنا نخبرك اليقينا
(Ey Ebû Hind! Bize karşı acele etme; bize mühlet ver de sana kesin haberi verelim.)
«فأنظرني إلى يوم يبعثون» kavli de bu kabildendir; bu ancak mühlet ve erteleme istemektir. Hamza'nın hemzeyi kat' ve «ظ»yı kesre ile «أَنْظِرُونا» kıraati de buna göredir.
(يُقْرِضُ): Karz, başkasına sana ödemesi için verdiğin şeydir. O, bir malı, mislini geri vermek tazminatıyla, sahibinin izniyle ondan kesip ayırmaktır. Araplar, birine iyilik veya kötülük yaptığında «Sende benim doğruluk karzım (iyi karz) var, kötü karzım var» der. Şair şöyle demiştir:
ويقضي سلامان بن مفرج قرضها ... بما قدّمت أيديهم وأزلت
(Selâmân b. Müferric, ellerinin önden gönderdiği ve verdiği şeyle onun karzını öder.)
Buradaki mânâsının daha fazlası Belâgat bahsinde gelecektir.

* İ'rab:
(مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضاً حَسَناً فَيُضاعِفَهُ لَهُ وَلَهُ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ): Bunda birkaç vecih vardır. Birincisi: «من» istifhâm ismi olup ibtidâ ile ref' mahallindedir; «ذا» ism-i işaret olup onun haberidir; «الذي» ona sıfat veya ondan bedeldir. «من ذا»nın başlı başına bir istifhâm olup ibtidâ ile ref' mahallinde bulunması, «الذي»nin de onun haberi olması da sahihtir. «ذا»nın mübtedâ, «الذي يقرض الله»nin sıfat, «من»in de içerdiği istifhâm mânâsı sebebiyle mübtedâya takdim edilmiş haber olması da sahihtir. «يقرض» muzâri fiildir; fâili müstetirdir; cümle sıla olduğu için i'rabdan mahalli yoktur. «الله» onun mef'ûlüdür. «قرضا» mef'ûl-i mutlaktır; «حسنا» na'ttır. «الفاء» sebebiyyedir; «يضاعفه», istifhâmın cevabı olarak fâdan sonra gizli «أن» ile mansûb muzâri fiildir. İsti'nâf veya atıf üzere ref' ile de okunmuştur. Ebû Hayyân'ın burada latîf bir sözü vardır; onu aşağıda naklediyoruz: «Âsım «فيضاعفه»yi istifhâmın cevabı olarak fâ ile nasb üzere okudu. Bunda bir rahatsızlık (kalak) vardır. Ebû Ali el-Fârisî şöyle dedi: Çünkü soru karz üzerine değil, karzın fâili üzerine vâki olmuştur. Fâ ise ancak kendisinden soru sorulan bir fiile döndürülen bir fiili nasbeder. Fakat bu fırka, yani kurrâdan bu grup, bunu mânâya hamletmiştir; sanki «من ذا الذي يقرض» sözü «أيقرض الله أحد فيضاعفه» (Allah'a biri ödünç verir mi ki O da onu kat kat artırsın) demesi mesabesindedir. Ebû Ali'nin vardığı bu görüş —fânın ancak kendisinden soru sorulan bir fiile döndürülen fiili nasbettiği— sahih değildir. Bilakis istifhâm isim olan edatlarıyla olduğunda da caizdir; «من يدعوني فأستجيب له» (Bana kim dua eder ki ona icabet edeyim), «أين بيتك فأزورك» (Evin nerede ki seni ziyaret edeyim), «متى تسير فأرافقك» (Ne zaman yola çıkarsın ki sana arkadaş olayım), «كيف تكون فأصحبك» (Nasılsın ki sana eşlik edeyim) gibi. Burada istifhâm fiil hakkında değil, dua edenin zâtı, mekân zarfı, zaman zarfı ve hâl hakkında vâki olmuştur. İbn Keysân Araplardan «أين ذهب زيد فنتبعه» (Zeyd nereye gitti ki onu takip edelim) sözünü nakletmiştir; aynı şekilde «كم مالك فنصرفه» (Malın ne kadar ki onu harcayalım) ve «من أبوك فنكرمه» (Baban kim ki ona ikram edelim) sözlerini de fâdan sonra nasb ile nakletmiştir. «فيضاعفه»nin nasb ile kıraati mütevâtir bir kıraattir. Fiil, «الذي» için sıla olarak vâki olmuştur; «الذي» «ذا»nın sıfatı, «ذا» da onun haberidir. Bunun gibi bir yerde nasb caiz olunca, önceki misallerde caiz olması evleviyetle sabittir.» [Mütercim notu: Kaynakta alıntı içinde «عى» yazılıdır; «على» olmalıdır.] «له» câr ve mecrûr olarak «يضاعفه»ye mütealliktir. «الواو» hâliyyedir. «له» mukaddem haber, «أجر» muahhar mübtedâ, «كريم» sıfattır.
(يَوْمَ تَرَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ يَسْعى نُورُهُمْ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمانِهِمْ): «يوم» zarftır; «وله أجر»da âmil olan istikrâra mütealliktir; yani «O gün onun için bir ecir sabit oldu». Ya da takdiri «يؤجرون» (ecir verilirler) olan gizli bir fiile mütealliktir; (veya) «اذكر» ile mansûb olup mef'ûlün bih olur. Ebü'l-Bekā şöyle dedi: Onda âmil «فيضاعفه»dir. «ترى المؤمنين والمؤمنات» cümlesi, zarfın ona izâfesiyle cer mahallindedir. «يسعى نورهم» cümlesi hâldir; çünkü görme gözle görmedir. «نورهم», «يسعى»nın fâilidir.
